Casino is small and that has advantages, slots very tight, casino rewards and cashier staff not very friendly, bar staff was great.  There are limited first come first serve lounge chairs at the pool, limited umbrellas for shade, there are reserved lounge chairs with umbrellas for a hefty fee which is waived if you meet a required food/drink order, with charging resort fees I expected more.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand for Punk Rock Bowling 2025 experience
allReviews.text: Great check in, room was decent, beds comfy. A little loud in casino tower when motorcycles run thru the street between the two towers but not to bad for a bartender like me. I am usually up til 3am in California.  $3 beer and a hot dog was a great deal.  Slots are not loose at all.  Avoid corner room of huff and puff games. Never could find $1 black jack and the $5 crap table was fun. Our server in the restaurant on Sunday was not great but I kinda figured wouldn't be good when I asked for a 32 oz of XX lager and was served a 16oz of modelo. Ordered a bison blue burger was told out of blue cheese so said fine cheddar is fine. Than 30 minutes went by. Asked were food was at. He said kitchen is busy. Than 2 minutes later he showed up with a cheddar burger but said they had no bison.  No worries.  I felt bad for him at first but when saw four tables with a different server got orders,drinks,food came out, and paid out before we got our food I lost my pity for him. All in all good experience.  Fix the elevators in your parking garage. Front desk person said been broken since they started working there.

allReviews.title: Great hotel and even better staff!
allReviews.text: Great room. Had a coffee maker. Love that in Vegas. The pool although crowed because of Punk Rock Bowling was well maintained and the staff was absolutely top notch. The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable…… I think. Haha ya know Vegas. All around a great place to stay. I would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: My favorite place to stay
allReviews.text: I have stayed at Wynn and a few other places in Vegas, and while they are nice, The Grand actually welcomes me like family. I stay here during the Punk Rock Bowling Festival and every staff member goes out of their way to make sure it's a wonderful experience. I often do the room block through the festival but have to add a night on at the beginning and two years in a row I've been able to stay in my first room (so no packing up, checking in and out, etc.).  Everything is clean and doesn't feel rundown or worn out, which I appreciate in a high volume place like Las Vegas. The Art Bar has good basic breakfast needs so I don't have to leave the hotel. Good coffee, breakfast sandwiches and at a decent price. You can't beat the $3 hot dog-PBR special that the hotel runs daily, either. Yes, there is a resort fee, but I don't mind it here where everything works and feels like you are getting your money's worth. Bathrooms are spotless, bedding is clean, soft, and provides a great night's rest. Nothing in the rooms is broken or damaged. I don't often find that I can really relax in hotels--there's always something wrong--but not here. When I am at the Grand, I reallly am on vacation.I also have to compliment the staff again for their kindness. This year, I was in the queue to check in and Aundrea, a manager, walked past and--even though I was next in line--offered to check me in at the concierge desk. Again, she made it so that I didn't have to switch rooms after my first night stay (booked through Priceline), and I was thrilled that the Grand offered a "3rd night free" special when I booked the rest of my stay through the hotel website so no switching rooms. She asked if I preferred a room on the mountain side or the Fremont side, which I appreciated so much (mountain side for the sunrises and sunsets, thank you!). And by the end of my check-in, we had exchanged some brief stories about our current hardships (I had just gotten a devastating health diagnosis and was celebrating my birthday this weekend) and she exhibited so much care for my situation. I wasn't treated like just another hotel guest, getting great service--she really cared enough to offer encouragement, kindness, and a hug, which is exactly what I needed in that moment. Thank you, Aundrea, for being a wonderful staff member here, and for making my stay for this festival (and my birthday) such a good experience!!

allReviews.title: Fine hotel, but missing some key items for some strange reason.
allReviews.text: Hotel is clean and nice. Staff was very cool. No real complaints, but it was missing some things that I've never seen absent from a hotel. The rooms are good sized, but there's just like a lot of empty space. Putting a chair or a small couch in the void would be nice and hey, maybe someone might want to sit in them when they're in their room doing some work or reading a book. Also I was baffled to find out that the room has no mini fridge and no coffee maker. This was a first for me. I've literally never been in a hotel, big or small that did not have those two appliances. I asked them if they just forgot to put them in my room and they said no, they don't provide them. So all in all a fine and clean hotel for a short stay in downtown Las Vegas, but if you require or expect any of the things I listed, you'll not be getting them at the Downtown Grand.

allReviews.title: Greatest
allReviews.text: Bed was to soft. It was good. It was awesome experience with you guys and we had fun together at the hotel and we will come again. It was a great experience thus year will come again soon and see you soon as possible. The walk to the restaurant was great.

allReviews.title: Great location and excellent service
allReviews.text: The location was excellent. Walking distance to Fremont Street, the Container Store, the Mob Museum. Easy pickup space for Uber. Superb service at the coffee shop, front desk and bell hop. Bring earplugs. Lots of noise from neighbors and night life. The rooms run cool, even with temp intervention.

allReviews.title: Thank you for another great stay!
allReviews.text: This is our fourth time staying and it’s always a great experience. From check in to the pool staff and casino everyone is friendly and helpful. The rooms in the gallery tower are super clean and quiet. Love that it’s within a short walk to the Fremont experience. Would recommend and we will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Amazing Birthday stay at Downtown Grand!!
allReviews.text: Me and my partner stayed 5 nights in a spacious king studio on the top floor of the gallery tower. Was given a view of the pool and downtown which was very nice. The hotel staff were amazing, check-in was a breeze. The room was spacious, modern and very clean. The pool area was fun with lots of room to lounge. The casino was on the smaller side but the slot selection was adequate and the low limit tables were very fun! The location is a block north of the Fremont Street Experience which allows you to walk to the action and be able to escape from it to a quiet room. I 1000% recommend staying here as the price, location and quality of the hotel make it a downtown standout! P.S for the best pizza in LV you must try Pizza Rock across the street from the hotel!

allReviews.title: Once is bad luck...
allReviews.text: Great location for a Fremont Street trip. Room was clean and bright but...Hot water was almost cold, even after running for 8 minutes. This is my seond stay here in 2 months, and had the same issue last time. Once is bad luck  but twice is a permament problem. I will not be staying here again !

allReviews.title: Will not stay again.
allReviews.text: Paid extra to stay in the refurbished rooms, however, the hotel locks the air conditioning at 70 degrees which is too warm to sleep. The elevators that require a room key were not working at all. Many guests had the same complaints. The front desk kept sending engineers to the rooms regarding the air but they just said the temperature is locked. The casino itself was too warm to gamble, left and gambled at other hotels.

allReviews.title: Attention to detail.
allReviews.text: The bedding and bath towels were lovely. I had 3 lights in my room that did not work and the bathroom lights were not favorable. I appreciate the free parking however, the instructions to get in and out of the garage were quite poor. They offered texting communication and they were either slow or did not get back to me when I used it.

allReviews.title: Would not recommend
allReviews.text: The room is nice enough for an inexpensive hotel. The bed was comfortable in the room felt clean. Unfortunately, those are the only positive comments I have for this hotel.I called ahead to add a name to the room because my boyfriend was going to arrive before me. They assured me that his name was added. When my boyfriend showed up, he was unable to check in and had to wait several hours for me to arrive. We requested turndown service and they never came to do it. We requested a late checkout and paid $20 to leave later however we were woken up three times that morning by someone knocking and asking if we were checking out that day. I did get my $20 refunded after complaining that we were unable to sleep in. I still am not sure who that was knocking on our door but the hotel assured us it was a hotel employee. On top of that, the sink in our room didn’t drain properly. The device in the elevators that required a key to access the rooms wasn’t working correctly, so it wasn’t very secure.There is a major communication issue in this hotel, and I will not be returning. Unfortunately, the surrounding downtown area also felt very unsafe and often scary.

allReviews.title: Horrendous customer service, very offended
allReviews.text: Parking was unclear, valet guy told us to go to the front and the front door told us to go back to valet area and valet guy told us to use the free parking garage. Dropped my husband at the front lobby with our bags to wait while I figured out parking, the security guard harassed him knocking on the glass next to him saying “YOU CANT SLEEP HERE” (he wasn’t sleeping he was looking up at the art). We think he was profiling him, very rude ruined our whole arrival for a short day trip. When we went to leave the parking garage the attendant was very condescending that we should have gotten a parking pass but the front desk never offered one. Almost everyone who works here seemed rude so far except the guy opening the front door. The rooms are just ok. If you’re looking for good customer service and quality this isn’t it.

allReviews.title: My go-to place downtown Vegas
allReviews.text: My go- to place downtown.  Always efficient and courteous staff.   Great food nearby in Pizza Rocks. Close (within 1 block) but not too close to Freemont so it's decently quiet at night.  Decent workout area and fantastic pool set-up.  Can't wait to come back in June.

allReviews.title: Cult of Personality
allReviews.text: After a horrendous experience using Priceline to book at another hotel In town, we were met by Lin at the front desk of the Downtown Grand Hotel. They say everything happens for a reason, and this was one of those times. Lin was extremely helpful getting us set up with a room last minute, had great recommendations for dinner, and was more than accommodating. There are a lot of great things nearby whether you’re trying to stay on a budget or live it up. A fantastic casino and restaurant downstairs, lots of local shops, there was even a free concert from Living Colour right around the corner! Would most definitely recommend!

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: It is a nice quiet get away and not to far from the strip. Clean and great staff. Freedom Beat is great restaurant. In the Fremont District and not to far from the art district. My family love this hotel. This was my second stay and will be back again.

allReviews.title: Colorado Mom and Son experience Freemont Street experience for Mom's 77th Birthday.
allReviews.text: Perfect location for Freemont Street experience. The ambiance with the Casino, The Art Bar, the Fat Cat was excellent. The rooms were clean. Excellent Staff (Hotel and Casino) they were friendly and helpful whenever needed.Some of the downside was some of the waiters and waitresses at Freedom Beats were rude.

allReviews.title: Vegas Virgin OBC
allReviews.text: Everything was great.....The room and View was epic....  The hotel was at max capacity but yet everything was still in order and clean. The Hotel could definetly use more microwaves. I hate to waste food and had to discard of a lot of meals that I couldnt finish.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand is the best
allReviews.text: We love staying at Downtown Grand.  The employees who are there to help you are so friendly.  Housekeeping does a terrific job.  We won’t stay anyplace else. Love their restaurant Freedom Beat.  The Art Bar is fabulous.  The employees at check-in are so helpful.

allReviews.title: Great experience! Would stay again!
allReviews.text: This place is great! The staff is wonderful and treated us very well. The pillows are fluffy and the bed was so comfortable. Super clean. Would definitely recommend and stay again next time we’re in California. Kudos to housekeeping!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Good TRIP, would recommend  Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Very nice rooms, Great service, Fun Casino. Pool area Excellent,  with Great service, Great bar and restaurant at pool. Nice T.V. Screen to watch sports while in pool. Restaurant off Casino. Coffee Bar in Lobby. I used the Fitness Center, small but workable. I would recommend  this Hotel for your stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: The Downtown Grand has everything you need
allReviews.text: The staff were amazing. They helped me find the perfect room (Royal) and helped me book an extra night with lower fees (Britnnie). Asked for a room with less noise. Studio suite came with a sound machine and an amazing view. Had fun playing tables with lower minimums in the casino. All the restaurants are so good. The Downtown Grand has everything you need.

allReviews.title: Hotel has good vibe
allReviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights, wish we can stay longer. The beds and pillows are comfortable. The vibe is good at the casino compare to other hotels in the downtown area. The pool area is awesome and the cabana looks rather new. My girls likes the room a lot and will definitely stay in this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Love it
allReviews.text: This hotel have the best pillows I ever slept on in my life. The shower head is relaxing.  They have good TV channels list. Its close to Freemont street and easy access to go downtown or the container park. I will definitely be back there again bet

allReviews.title: Fun,fun, fun
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and in a great location.  Right by Freemont st. Tha restaurant had fantastic food and ran specials. 14.99 prime rib that was amazing! Gambling fun for all. The gym was also a nice surprise.  Very friendly and helpful staff. Reasonably priced and close to everything.  Free parking, which is amazing.

allReviews.title: James Rocks!
allReviews.text: James the arrival ambassador was awesome!Very easy going, extremely respectful, and down to earth!You can’t find people like James anymore, a very valuable asset to the company.The hotel was great because of the price but in terms of our room, we could quite literally HEAR the elevator from our room 24/7, there was no fridge which I thought was odd, and the middle elevator just stopped working mid day?I’m sure this side of the hotel is due for renovation but damn…

allReviews.title: April 2025 downtown grand stay
allReviews.text: This was the 2nd time staying at the downtown grand and it did not disappoint. I absolutely love this hotel. From the clean, comfortable room to the restaurants and casino floor everything was perfect. Could not have asked for a better experience. Will definitely be staying there again next year and I recommend it to all my friends and family.

allReviews.title: A nightmare on third Street the title
allReviews.text: if I can give a negative star, I'll give it a-3 not only was the room $100 on a weekday, but I paid an early check-in fee not only was the room not ready for check-in but when I called the front desk, they didn't seem surprised they gave me a semi upgraded room after a terrible experience this will be my last day here downtown grand This is absurd, my ass. an upgrade was not acceptable for the dissatisfaction and service. at this point I want my money back. then they tried to offer $50 food and beverage credit that's not even half of the room price!! pathetic!

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Grand
allReviews.text: Enjoyed my four night stay at the Grand. Rommy Garcia was extremely helpful with reservation. Rommy was courteous and professional and much appreciated by an old guy with limited computer skills. My room was spotless and comfortable. Although I visited many of the downtown casinos, each night I ended up at the Grand playing 3-2 blackjack with friendly dealers. I’m looking forward to myreturn visit to the Grand.

allReviews.title: Amazing front desk host !
allReviews.text: Greg is absolutely amazing, he delivered all my needs and them some.. thank you Greg! You’re the absolute best!! The room was amazing! I had no problem w the new tower, Thank you for suggesting the room to me. We love staying at the hotel grand!

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand hotel and casino
allReviews.text: Great stay at the DTG. Room was spacious and clean. Location is close enough to Fremont, yet still quiet enough  to rest. The pool area wasn’t overly busy, lots of chairs and couches to chill in the sun or shade. We used the gym daily which was convenient, clean, and plenty of options for equipment. All staff in hotel are super friendly and helpful. We can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Very nice, quiet hotel
allReviews.text: This is a great hotel! Our room was so quiet (1223), no noise from Fremont Street Experience.  Had a great time in the hotel casino and dining at Freedom. I loved the daily complimentary water left in the room too.  We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: March 20th through March 25.  Room 931
allReviews.text: shower was awful… Had to take cold showers to have pressure. hot water there was terrible pressure. also, the phone we couldn’t get to work, there was no dial tone when u picked it up and none of the buttons worked when we pressed them over and over.

allReviews.title: It was okay
allReviews.text: The "Downtown Grand Hotel & Casino" is a complex adjacent to the Fremont Street Experience. There are three hotel towers.Originally, there were two hotel towers. The 18-story Casino Tower houses hotel rooms, the main casino floor and restaurants. The 25-story Grand Tower is located across the street (N 3rd Street). Built in 1985, these two towers are connected by an enclosed overpass. The newest hotel rooms are in the 8-story Gallery Tower. The Gallery Tower was built in 2020.I booked a block of five hotel rooms for a group trip. All of the rooms assigned to us were in the Grand Tower. For the most part, the rooms were "okay". However, the stay was not without incident. The basic evaluation of the room(s) are as follows:Booking ::I booked the rooms via a third-party aggregation website.As with most Las Vegas hotels, this establishment charges a property fee (aka resort fee). I have learned that if you have a Nevada State ID, and if you book your room directly with the hotel, they will waive this fee.Parking ::The hotel's parking structure is located across the street (Ogden Street). Our booking included free parking.Location ::In general, the location of this facility is very good. If you are interested in regional tourism, this hotel is positioned near freeway exits and entrances. It is also within easy walking distance of the Mob Museum, the Fremont Street Experience and other Fremont Street resort properties.Hotel Room ::If you are looking for a room to luxuriate in, this room won't meet your expectations. If you are looking for a nice room to sleep and clean up in, the room is more than okay.The square footage of the room and the size of the bathroom are all reasonable by modern standards. While the intended design of the room is nice, I noticed a lot of inconsistencies between the eight rooms I inspected.On the plus side: The beds were reasonable comfortable, although some in our group described the mattress as "firm". The sheets were clean and in good condition.The furniture was clean and in good condition, without major bumps and bruises.The carpets were generally clean. But in half of the rooms I visited, there was a strange stain located on the carpet, just inside the entry.During daylight hours, plenty of light comes through the window. At night, the room is dark because of inadequate lighting. There is one recessed light above the entry. Most of the eight rooms I saw had one table lamp. Some had one table lamp and one floor lamp. For adequate lighting, I think the room needs one floor lamp, one table lamp on the desk and one table lamp on the nightstand.The bathroom is where you might see the most wear and tear. The bathrooms were generally clean and in good condition. There was no ventilation fan, which was a bit inconvenient. The hotel must have recently purchased new towels because the specimens we had were in very good condition.So here is the snafu ...For context, the purpose of this trip was to enjoy March Madness.Our group arrived at the hotel at about 10:00a on March 21, 2025. I went to the front desk to inquire if our rooms might be ready, or if early check-in was an option. I was told that our rooms were not ready. Check-in was 3:00p. The fee for early check in was $35/room. However, I could check back at 1:00p. We left to watch some of the televised games.We returned at 1:00p. The desk clerk checked us in, waiving early check in fees.Of the five rooms assigned, I discovered that two rooms had been cleaned, and were ready for occupancy. However, three of the rooms had been cleared of bedding and towels but had not been cleaned. But housekeeping was working on the floor, and we assumed that they would get to our rooms.I returned at 5:00p only to find that the rooms had not been cleaned. I went to the front desk to express my concern. The desk clerk stated that they would contact housekeeping.I returned at 6:30p. The rooms still had not been cleaned.At this point, I will fast forward. At 7:00p, I asked to speak with the desk manager. I requested that they identify three rooms that were clean and ready for occupancy and transfer us into those rooms.The problem was resolved. But I think that I was unrealistically patient. I was hoping that hotel management would resolve the situation (e.g. clean the three rooms); but that didn't happen. And I don't know why staff didn't volunteer the solution of transferring us into new rooms. When I suggested it, they agreed that this was a reasonable solution.

allReviews.title: Downtown Las Vegas has grown up.
allReviews.text: Very clean. The Gallery Tower rooms were very comfortable and roomy. Casino was small but had everything you needed. The food at Freedom Beat was very good and the service was on point. The location is perfectly situated for those looking to have a good time but still go to bed a at sensible hour. I will be back for sure.

allReviews.title: Deadheads at The Grand
allReviews.text: Excellent stay despite the very loud music coming from street level. We were on the 22nd floor. Nice to see king size pillows.However, in the Grand Tower you could not take the elevator down to 1st floor, having to get off at 3 and cross into a different building. Not very disability friendly.

allReviews.title: Decent Stay near Freemont St
allReviews.text: My wife and I wanted to be near Fremont Street, and this hotel was very close and at a decent price. The casino had a decent variety of slots and games. The restaurant was decent, though the prices were a bit on the high side. Overall a decent place to stay.

allReviews.title: The employees at the Grand were great.
allReviews.text: Royale was so sweet at the front desk and saw we were an older couple and gave us a quiet room in the new tower  He was very professional. The door fell off the closet and the maintenance lady came within 15 minutes to fix it. She was very nice as well

allReviews.title: Poor rectification
allReviews.text: TV didn't work. They said they would fix it, I came back 12 hours later. It wasn't fixed. They didn't even notified me that they did nothing. They moved me but I was tired since it was late and had to repack everything. $20 food credit, which I couldn't used is not close to covering the inconvenience

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay!
allReviews.text: Beds here were wonderful slept very well the bedding and the beds both top-notch! The gallery tower was very nice, clean and remodeled. Did not have a lot of luck in the casino seemed like everything was a little tight here, but I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: A DOWNTOWN GEM!
allReviews.text: Gem of a hotel a perfect block off Fremont. Cozy casino, great sports book, clean rooms, free parking across the street, quick check ins, super polite, friendly, staff, great little diner on floor, bell dropped off and picked up luggage, 10 out of ten. Back? You bet. Now my place.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay !!  The room was clean and the bed was more comfortable than ours at home.   We had to stay an extra day because our road home was closed and the front desk was very helpful.   I would not want to stay anywhere else.  Only a block from Fremont street which is a must see!

allReviews.title: Double booked room
allReviews.text: Unfortunately, this trip did not go well. The hotel double booked the 2 rooms I had reserved. They took almost $800 from my credit card without my knowledge and are giving me a hard time returning it. It made for a very uncomfortable stay. I  suspect I will end up losing the money because of a computer glitch that wasn’t my fault. Be extra careful if you book with this hotel. Double check your credit card transactions from the date of reservation until the date you arrive. I probably will stay clear of this hotel in the future.

allReviews.title: DTG Is A Good Choice Downtown
allReviews.text: Down Town Grand hotel is great location downtown. $1 Blackjack all day $5 Craps in the morning. $3 Nathan hot dogs or chicken tacos and Pabst Blue Ribbon in cans Can’t beat the value. DTG also near other food options like Pizza Rock. DTG offers room promotions and then gaming promotions as well

allReviews.title: good room
allReviews.text: The room was quite comfortable. The pool deck was open in mid march, but the pool deck was not.  A great location. Friendly staff. Can get $3 hotdog/pbr on the casino floor for a cheap snack.   I would stay here again. The room was quiet and clean and good.

allReviews.title: Great location but…
allReviews.text: I liked the location of The Grand due to being close to Fremont. Parking across the street is easy to use and felt safe having my car there. Everything was pretty clean at the property. I had to ask two times to get bathroom toiletries that were never put into the room in the first place and I could not get hot water out of the shower. Just say it warm may be an overstatement. The nightly rare was good for the value of

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: Location is Great! Easy access to Freemont Street. Nice hotel. Our bed was a bit soft, we got "short sheeted" one day. A couple of outlets didn't work, no coffee maker or fridge in room, they did give us credit to get coffee. All of the Staff is great! Casino was fun, loved the $1.00 blackjack table, dealers were fun & engaging! Don't sleep on the breakfast specials!

allReviews.title: Lovely stay!!
allReviews.text: Our stay was absolutely amazing!! The staff were wonderful, friendly and very accommodating, will definitely refer to friends and stay there again! At our arrival we didn’t realize that our room was across from a bar and it was very loud, I asked at the front desk if we could move, no problem!! They did it right there , not even a issue, the girl at the desk was very helpful and understanding… I was very pleased!

allReviews.title: Your Downtown Hub for Fun
allReviews.text: Our stay was fun and the Downtown Grand was a great hub for everything we wanted to do in the Downtown area. It’s centrally located between the east and west side of Fremont. The hotel was clean, staff was friendly and helpful and it is surrounded by great food options. Pool deck on the 3rd floor is perfect for getting your winter Vitamin D.The Fremont St concerts may keep you awake at night but just turn up your white noise machine.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and feel safe hotel
allReviews.text: Traveling alone as a female I like the smaller, clean and feel safe hotel. Room is comfortable and if the noise from Fremont bugs you at night stay in the other tower. Staff always friendly and I like the food at the restaurant. A very quick walk to Fremont street is a bonus.

allReviews.title: PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE STAYING
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: Over priced and not upfront about pool closure
allReviews.text: Asked about pool at check in but was never informed that it was closed. Way over priced for the room. Especially since the pool was closed. Would not waive the resort fee that added $38 each night. Other hotels will waive it since you will be gambling/eating at that hotel and considering the pool was closed. No water pressure.

allReviews.title: Excellence at its best !!!
allReviews.text: The staff was very courteous and friendly.The room was excellent .The view was spectacular. The location was right in the middle of all the fun. I definitely will stay there every time I go back. When you walk out the door you are right on Fremont.

allReviews.title: Steps from Fremont Street, but quiet in the rooms
allReviews.text: Our trip was great! We are a couple with two kids under 12 years old.We were on a top floor (by request). Steps from Fremont Street entertainment, and great food.At night it was quiet in our room. Sleep came easily for all of us.Pool is un heated (as advertised), so a little chilly in February. 🥶

allReviews.title: Awesome stay experience
allReviews.text: The hotel was awesome!! Very clean and comfortable stay. Our room was great with a view. There was a bit shouting outside from the night lifers but it wasnt that bad. Family that came to our room loved it better then where they were staying. Overall the room was clean and beautiful and I would definitely stay at the Grand again.

allReviews.title: Very clean facility, nice, accommodating employees, and great room rate!
allReviews.text: I thought the room rate was great in comparison to other hotels, main reason I decided to stay there. Check in went well and your employees were very accommodating. I wasn't told I had to schedule to have my room cleaned, but they did the next day and brought up towels. The room was very nice size, king bed and pillows were very comfortable. Only issue was the shower had very weak flow and the water never heated sufficiently. I will stay there again in the future.

allReviews.title: Meh
allReviews.text: The room keys wouldn't work in the elevator. We asked for towels and water early in the afternoon and didn't get them delivered until after 10pm.We stayed in a gallery tower studio and the shower is half covered with no door or curtain making for a cold and drafty shower. No fan in the bathroom. Forget about getting a seat at the $1 blackjack table. With as heavily advertised that it is, there was a line for that table everyday we were there.

allReviews.title: Eh ok
allReviews.text: 3 stars due to the hotel needinga little TLC. We stayed in the tower, hoping for a little quieter experience.... not so much.  They offer ear plugs at the front desk,  take them.  Fremont street is LOUD. With that being said,  the hotel staff was friendly.

allReviews.title: Not too bad a price for the location
allReviews.text: Room never got cleaned during our stay. We were also supposed to get 2 bottles of water per day, never got them since house keeping was a no show. Early Bird special at the Freedom bar was decent. The Burrito hit the spot after a night of drinking, loaded with potatoes to smoke up the alcohol & was on $8. Place is centrally located, but get earplugs, some rooms get a lot of outside noise.

allReviews.title: I am not going back but despite all the many little hotel issues we had a great stay.
allReviews.text: Okay. While the hotel (Downtown Grand) has many issues, our stay was nevertheless wonderful. Fremont Street isn’t the strip but it’s a great place to get your 90’s grunge on and really enjoy yourself. As for the hotel?  You can hear the people above stomping around. The elevators were notoriously unreliable in both the hotel and the parking garage across the street. The lack of communication was remarkable (for example “My parking pass isn’t working”. “What time did you checked out?”  “About 30 minutes ago”. “You only gots 20 minutes after you checked out”.). Oh and worst of all!  Cold showers. No kidding. Buuut. I took a grand from one of their slots so that kinda made it all better.  So we experienced the Fremont Street Experience and it was wonderful. But next time we’re staying at the Venetian for a completely different experience. Did I mention I took a grand from one of their (Downtown Grand) slots?

allReviews.title: Strike two.
allReviews.text: Room was dirty, outdated and very unappealing. Light fixtures missing, walls had chips and dings in them, walls were painted in a deep red and what looks to be painted 30 years ago. Overall a ln unattractive room. I think I was the only one on the 23 floor and felt very isolated.

allReviews.title: Clean & Comfy & safe
allReviews.text: Rooms were super nice! Comfy bed, free water, wifi, sound machine.. food is good and I like the location so it’s not right smack in the middle of all the people. It’s like our own little corner downtown. This has replaced our normal place the nugget

allReviews.title: Not a bad place to stay!
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a business trip. Price was great for a busy week in Vegas. Made sure I got a room on the gallery tower side. No noise from Freemont street. Slept great. Much better then nugget and four queens. Room was clean. Bed was soft and coffee was great. Two blocks over feom Freemont. Will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Not as clean as you think
allReviews.text: Dirty.  I was put in a room that the trash wasn’t emptied and my tub had a dirt ring from the last person.  Had issues last time I was there for furniture market. Also, don’t stay there in the summer unless you want to hear the pool DJ til 3am.  I wouldn’t recommend unless you want a step up from circus circus

allReviews.title: Unhappy ending
allReviews.text: The rooms are OK, their rates decent, and the hotel overall is serviceable, but my Vegas trip was marred by their valet guys denting the door of my brand-new car. I left before dawn, so I didn't notice the damage till I got home, which means they won't do anything about it. And management never returned my calls or emails. I was hoping they'd at least refund the 60 bucks I paid to park my car safely. Guess not ...

allReviews.title: Always stay at the grand
allReviews.text: The staff is awesome. Nice rooms and the casino is bright and open. We go in summer also and love the pool. The Freedom Beat restaurant inside is also really good and reasonably priced. We won’t go anywhere else. It is a great choice for money conscious travelers.

allReviews.title: Top-tier maintenance, custodial and desk staff.
allReviews.text: I had a few requests day 1 and they took great care of me. The hotel is ok, the live bands in the bar are good. It is an older facility but the people who keep it running are the real MVP'sThank you to those we encountered for providing prompt, kind customer service.

allReviews.title: Ok, but not ideal
allReviews.text: Price was right. Room was clean. 2 pillows not enough. Had to call housekeeping for cups for bathroom & included water bottles. Had to call maintenance to fix heat. No on-site restaurant for dinner. Had to go to 1 of 2 on 3rd St or Fremont St if walking.

allReviews.title: If you're looking for service, stay away from this hotel
allReviews.text: Good luck getting housekeeping to clean your room or deliver towels. You have to manually ask every day for towels to be delivered. Your room will not be cleaned unless you call and request it. Stayed for six days and only had room cleaned once.

allReviews.title: Just okay.
allReviews.text: The African American male at the front desk was so helpful, and professional.  The room was not up to pare. The sink was stopped up, maintenance was called but it didn't fix the problem. There was no housing keeping the entire time we were there.  We have stayed here before and it was pleasant. But not this time...

allReviews.title: 100% would recommend!
allReviews.text: Perfect location with tons to do! Right outside of Fremont street experience, great food close by like pizza rock and street tacos, 3$ PBR and hot dog right inside casino, multiple bars, freedom beat restaurant was great too! And a coffee shop open in the mornings!

allReviews.title: Fat Cat Lounge
allReviews.text: I have not stayed at The Grand but we did go over to enjoy their $3 hot dog and beer special. While there, we discovered The Fat Cat Lounge and, dang! I wish we had discovered it sooner! They have a great space with an awesome cocktail program and nice happy hour, but the music was beyond amazing! There was a $5 cover charge which is so incredibly reasonable for such great music! I really hope The Grand does more to promote this amazing space!

allReviews.title: Nice Rooms / Great Location
allReviews.text: Quick check in and out via their kiosks. Clean rooms.  Good amenities, especially the bottled water.  Very helpful house cleaning  staff.  Did not dine in the hotel so could not comment on that.  No complaints, which says a lot!   Would definitely recommend.

allReviews.title: Best hotel ever!
allReviews.text: Thank you Jennifer L. for all of your help with getting my family all squared away for our annual trip. We can’t wait. The prices here are great and this is one of my personal favorite hotels to stay at. I really have no desire to stay anywhere else in the freemont area at this price point!

allReviews.title: Overall Review
allReviews.text: The casino and restaurant staff were very nice. The bed was comfortable. Other than that it was not a great experience. When we checked in we were not informed we had a food cost included in our room. We ended up spending over a hundred dollars extra that didn't need to be spent. We were told after the fact and was told nothing could be done. The walls are paper thin. Not even a sound app could cover the amount of noise during all hours. The worst part of the room was the bathroom. It clearly had a sewer smell and we could not switch rooms because we booked through a third party. The shower was completely stained and dirty. I asked to have it cleaned and they did not. The shower also had no door which made the floor easily wet and bathroom cold while showering. This hotel was lacking basic things most hotels have; refrigerator, shower doors, somewhere to put your luggage and coat hooks. Overall we would not stay here again. The Hilton grand vacations was a much better experience.

allReviews.title: Book elsewhere
allReviews.text: I stayed in the new building, nice room but it smelled really bad. Rotten cheese smell the whole time. Housekeeping did spray but front office never offered to switch me rooms. This is my 6th time staying at the Grand. I will not be going back.The waitress serving drinks to the tables was really rude. Drink are “free” if you are gambling. In two days I had two drinks and paid for them while gambling….the waitress would not leave until she felt the tip was correct.Very disappointed with this experience.

allReviews.title: Solid spot with a great price.
allReviews.text: Clean place, clean room, great price. Water pressure was not wonderful, but solid hotel, free parking and walking distance to may restaurants and options. Comfortable bed and exceeded expectations. Great and engaging staff that was very helpful.

allReviews.title: Dishonest Management
allReviews.text: I feel obligated to share my experience mainly due to the fact management lied to me and no doubt many other customers. If you want to get any sleep this is Not the hotel for you.  Hogs N Heffers is across the street and you can not only hear the music but you can feel the Bass while laying in you bed. Management Alicia and Alex, promised me Vip parking because is was disabled which they then charged me for. The parking garage is not only across the street, but the elevator is Broken also. I was unable to climb 5 stories to retrieve my car due to the pain in my leg. Management was not accomedating of my disability nor did they have any compassion. They promised a return of the booking fee and a $25 food voucher with I didn't receive.   When I called to speak with the Management I left numerous messages with no returned phone calls.

allReviews.title: To Loud and Outdated
allReviews.text: Room was outdated and carpet felt dirty.  Soap in the shower was cheap and the bedding was ok.  Elevators in the parking garage didn’t work and you couldn’t hear all the street noise in the room.  Check in process was easy. Next time I’ll choose somewhere else to stay.

allReviews.title: 1st time stay, won't be my last!
allReviews.text: LONG POST ALERT- I checked in to the Grand on Friday for the holiday weekend, and luckily a room was ready when my friend and I arrived in the morning. There was no wait in the lobby either.  We had booked grand tower but was offered a room in the new gallery tower which was very happily accepted.  We went to the room and were genuinely happy upon our entry.  The room and bed linens were both clean and the towels were fluffy. The gallery tower had coffee maker and fridge in the room also.  There is an ice machine right by the elevator on every floor in gallery tower.  Our room had a view of the pool, which is closed for the season, yet there is still water in the pool which I found odd.  Just drain it why don't you? We started unpacking and relaxing from our travel.  When we finally reemerged, we walked around casino and it was not smoky at all, but we never stayed here before, so we did not game here, we have players cards with a competitor on Fremont.  When we finally returned to the room for sleeping, the bed is comfy, but the pillows are flat.  Linens were thin and room was a little chilly, so we cranked the heat.  It works decently. Next morning, we showered. We are both ladies in the room, needing to shave, this shower is insanely poor designed.  The door is half missing, which is similar to D showers, but there are absolutely no ledges to rest your legs to shave, all the water splashed everywhere we had to use all our towels to shower here. We shaved in the sink. Must say, the water pressure is decent in shower and the temperature gets hot, but the Kohler faucet and sink in vanity, has a slow pressure.  Housekeeping never came all three nights of our stay, but we got one night off of resorts fee because of that. App did not work for me either. Noise level- It was still loud at night sleeping though, but we had earplugs we packed.  All of our outlets in the room functioned, but the lamp near the corner chair did not turn on. We did not eat at any of the restaurants on site, but I tried buying juice in the vending machine on Saturday am, and it ate my funds and no juice.  Then I told the desk, and they said that they personally do not own the machines and to contact the number on them for refund.  I'm not going to worry about $3, but I am advising anyone else to not use them.  Uber pick up is convenient and quick just outside the property.  I did buy a vodka red bull at freedom beat bar on Saturday and it was only $9 I was really happy.  That same evening, we went to Wynn/ Encore and one of those drinks there was $30. Needless to say, I did not buy the drink at Wynn, but that is the price on their menu there.  This was a budget property, but for the price, I actually think it was decent.  I never had any issues all weekend with the elevators or keys, and we don't rent cars in Vegas, so I did not use the parking structure either.  Only real complaint I have, is the service needs to be polished up a bit, but overall, it was clean, and worthwhile to us.

allReviews.title: Nightmare stay
allReviews.text: Bad. Hair in the shower. Crap on the toilet literally we called to let them know they said someone will come clean it. A hour in a half later after calling twice to see how long it will take because it’s already 830pm and we wanted to get ready to go out. Gra cleaned it ask us how was it and still missed the crap on the toilet we pointed it out oh I didn’t see that. But cleaned it finally. We get in the shower showers clogged. Bathroom sink clogged too. We get ready go out come back around 2am turn tv on don’t work. Check out to leave parking garage u can’t use key card it’s telling me to pay. We called front desk to see why they didn’t give me a parking pass when I checked in so had to park walk back to hotel get a pass to leave. Go one u need an access code to use elevator which we didn’t have one. 10 minutes later someone came down it and we was able to get to my car. Then pass didn’t work. Worst hotel ever.

allReviews.title: Nothing special anymore
allReviews.text: Having stayed here pre covid and gambled and eat here in our last few post covid trips we were looking forward to staying here again.This time it was underwhelming. The positive was that at 1100 our room was ready, but that was it. The room felt a little tiered and the mattress and pillows had seen better days. Gone are the coffee makers and ear plugs (this is the old town so all casinos have a lot of noise from Fremont street) but oddly there was post it note I only noticed on the bathroom mirror on our last day saying you could request them from reception (this was also on our friends room who had also not seen it!!) The shower had the tiniest toiletries I have seen but no shower gel but a bar of soap, which was very odd and not very hygienic! Another big disappointment was the lack of waiters in the casino. We never did see one so we gambled elsewhere.The breakfast on the Saturday was a complete failure. They were clearly understaffed and it took ages just to be offered a coffee and then an age for our order to be taken and then it was delivered incorrectly and cold.Sadly for us we will stay elsewhere as this is never a cheap option but this time I failed to see any benefits of paying extra!

allReviews.title: Meh at best
allReviews.text: Only cleaned our room once in 3 days, charged a 39 dollar a day experience fee and didn’t even get the water and other amnesties that were supposed to be provided yet still charged the fee. They also deactivated our room key and hour before check out requiring me to get a new key to get my bags to hand the key back each time having to wait in a 20 minute line. Overall pretty mid, could have been better but there most likely won’t be a second opportunity for them to fail.

allReviews.title: Downtown Gem
allReviews.text: Our 1st time staying here. Stayed in casino tower, room comfortable and quiet. At times, could hear street noise & band from Freemont stage. Staff was friendly & great. Highly recommend bar breakfast @ Freedom Beat with Lenna. Made our mornings! Convenient to walk to all downtown sites plus rideshare just outside door. We felt safe walking at night as street was lighted. We will be coming back.

allReviews.title: Great Stay at The Downtown Grand
allReviews.text: A hidden gem! We stay a lot on the strip,  and sometimes downtown. We reserved during the holidays and had a fantastic rate. It's convenient to Fremont street and the Mob Museum is across the street.. you can walk out the door, cross a street and go in the Fremont food court. The freedom grill has a good selection and delicious

allReviews.title: Comfortable stay…
allReviews.text: Comfortable room, easy check-in and clean hotel and lobby. Close to outdoor amenities, old downtown Las Vegas. Easy walk to a number of restaurants and events. Much less expensive than strip hotels while I was in town for the consumer electronic show.

allReviews.title: Will absolutely stay again!
allReviews.text: The good: nice location, clean casino, cute coffee shop, moved us immediately when the a/c broke.The bad: several times(3pm, 10pm)we went to find food(in the hotel) and nothing was open, but if you don't mind walking a block or 2 there is plenty open nearby. The elevator being operated by room keys caused issues a few times but I understand that it's for security reasons.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: This is my go-to hotel whenever I visit Las Vegas. It has never disappointed me and just like before, I had a great stay this time. It's right off Fremont but quiet enough that the you can still sleep. The staff are ncie ans helpful. I highly recommend this hotel!

allReviews.title: Pretty ok
allReviews.text: I will say everything was adequate, but could easily be stellar with a few changes. First, no one like a shower with no door. Period. It's cold and everything gets wet. The water never got warm enough for it to be a comfortable shower. Second, the room was barely clean. Linens were clean but walls and bathroom floor were pretty gross. The amazing vanity mirror I was excited to use didn't work. We always check for bed bugs, but the mattresses were black, I feel like this is intentional by the hotel and is wholly unappreciated. The good things, are it's a lovely room and where we were situated it was very quiet, which was surprising and appreciated for those of us not doing the typical Vegas thing. The beds and pillows were comfortable and the outlets with a USB on the nightstand was awesome.  The casino wasn't ever super busy, it was clean, and the staff were nice. I really liked being able to check-in via a kiosk and just go straight to our room after. The Freedom Beat restaurant was really good, well priced, and also has a stellar staff. We ate there 3 times during our stay. I would probably stay there again because of the location, but I would just be more proactive in ensuring our room was more clean before getting settled.

allReviews.title: Not a 4 star hotel.
allReviews.text: My wife and I booked a room here for our wedding. There was a stranger’s pants in the bathroom and dried blood on the sheets!! We informed them and they moved us to another room and comped the resort fee for one of the nights. We shlepped all of our stuff to the new room (this was literally 2 hours after our wedding and we were exhausted), only to find that the new room was basically equally as dirty (period blood on toilet seat and visibly sticky substance on the bed frame). They upgraded us to a nicer room and the person we spoke with was nice, but when I asked if we could get a cart for our stuff (which they only allow an employee to use, understandably), the person told me i could go downstairs and ask for one…. I gave him a look and he changed his tune and said he’d send someone up. The new room is great but the shower doesn’t get hot. The elevators are also a total disaster, requiring very finicky keycards. We also called for water one night and they said they’d send it up but never did.Points for friendly (though somewhat ineffective) staff and comfy bed.I’m usually very easy going but i’m disappointed. I truly don’t understand how this hotel is rated 4 stars. We won’t be staying here again.

allReviews.title: DON’T STAY HERE UNLESS YOU’RE DEAF
allReviews.text: Don’t stay here if you want to be asleep before 2 a.m.  Live music down the street is so loud, even earplugs don’t work. Everything is dingy and the halls smell. A colleague was sitting next to a woman at slots who just peed right on the floor. That’s the kind of place this is. Worst experience ever.

allReviews.title: Not as expected.
allReviews.text: Elevators in parking garage not working and stair wells were dirty and there was urine! Curtains were not total blackout and too short, too much daylight throughout the room. Be warned; they don't do housekeeing, I requested the service  on our third night and the room wasn't cleaned.

allReviews.title: Good New Year Spot
allReviews.text: I stayed for New Years Eve at the Downtown Hotel Las Vegas and had a fantastic experience. The location is excellent—right near Fremont Street, yet far enough to avoid the noise, which made for peaceful nights. The hotel is also conveniently close to some great dining options, so you’ll never have to go far for a good meal.The rooms were clean, comfortable offering excellent value for the price. The staff provided great service, always friendly and helpful. The on-site casino was decent, though not as lively as some of the larger ones nearby, but it’s a convenient option for some casual fun. Overall, this hotel is a great choice if you want affordability, comfort, and easy access to fantastic restaurants in downtown Las Vegas. I’d definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: New Year’s Eve
allReviews.text: We stayed here for New Year’s Eve! It was right by the festivities on Fremont street! The beds were super comfortable! We will definitely look forward to staying here again in the future! The breakfast options were great! The staff was very friendly!

allReviews.title: Night out on the town with friends and family
allReviews.text: The rooms were nice and clean had a nice view The studio suites are great and excellent very peaceful very quiet very secure beautiful service great personalities great casino great machines great food everything was nice I recommend this place anybody will stay in downtown Las Vegas right next to Fremont Street beautiful it's a beautiful view that I had beautiful room on the 22nd floor The suites are very beautiful next time I go I'm going to get the grand lux suite thank you the downtown Grand for making my stay very pleasant and a great experience

allReviews.title: Great staff small rooms
allReviews.text: The staff was amazing and make the hotel.  The casino was the only place that does not pay out at all . The restaurant closed too early. All and all great place for the price.  Coffee shop was great in the am . Wish there were fridges and microwave in the rooms .

allReviews.title: Not the best not the worst. Misleading booking and amenities
allReviews.text: Parking is not free. Booked late check out then did not get late check out. Room heat did not work well.  No blankets. Carpet was extremely stained. Door to bathroom falling apart. Staff not friendly at the desk either. Not what we were expecting

allReviews.title: Poor/Inconsiderate Service at the Downtown Grand's American Beat Restuarant/Bar
allReviews.text: My wife and I are currently staying at the Downtown Grand for a short after-the-holidays vacation. We went down to the American Beat Restuarant/Bar and were seated at a booth. We ordered drinks and when asked about food we told the server (Lydia) that we did not want any. She then informed us that we could not sit in a booth unless we ordered food. The restuarant was nearly empty and there were numerous empty tables and booths. We had previously stayed at the Downtown Grand in October and we ordered only drinks at the American Beat and weren't forced to sit at the bar. My wife presently has a broken ankle and was cautioned by her orthopedic docs and physical therapist not to sit and let her leg dangle because this could cause swelling and discomfort. She cannot sit at the bar. We left the mostly empty American Beat restuarant/bar without ordering any drinks and went to another casino to order our alcohol and spend our money. We've never been at a casino restuarant before that was mostly empty and did not want our business (money). We're seriously considering whether we will stay at the Downtown Grand and give their restuarant our business (money) in the future. We're "I Prefer" members and think we were treated unfairly after staying at the Downtown Grand over six times in the past. Maybe this is reason their restuarant is empty on a Saturday aftrnoon. We do not recommend the Downtown Grand 's American Beat restuarant/bar and anyone reading this review should seriously consider giving them their business.

allReviews.title: TERRIBLE!!
allReviews.text: LONG REVIEW ALERT!!‼️ Beware!!!! I received an alert to my device that someone had checked into this hotel using my identity, immediately  I contacted the hotel where the party was still on the premises, I was advised by a staff member  that she was contacting security to check the room where they made contact with the person. I advised the staff member what state Im in and that I was headed to a local police department Never did the hotel contact the  LVMPD, I contacted the police whereas they were waiting for them to contact them also to put them on notice of the fraud, the staff became very not helpful, I asked the description of the party who was in the room they couldn’t advise. I asked them to contact police to show the video footage of the party no help, I was able to contact  local news station and legal teams to help out. I will be also contacting them owner of the hotel to advise of this. Customer Service starts with first point of contact with customer and ends there. I’m concerned that the staff maybe working with scammers

allReviews.title: Great place at à great location
allReviews.text: Excellent customer service..super Nice clean spacious rooms..one block from fremont street..lots to do within walking distance. Plenty to do in side and..the property is huge..no clothing or souvenir shops..the restaurants and bars  inside  are ok

allReviews.title: My trip was great, and the enviras perfect. The staff was friendly and helpful . The breakfast was perfect for traveling
allReviews.text: My trip was great, and the enviras perfect. The staff was friendly and helpful . The breakfast was perfect for traveling

allReviews.title: It was ok
allReviews.text: The power went out for an hour and we was out in the cold because we couldn't get in our room. They charge a $50 for microwave so don't be expecting to have one in your room. allReviews.title: Never again.
allReviews.text: Worse check in experience.  Directed to kiosk that was not properly lighted instead of personal aid. BTW I'm 76 yrs old using kiosk first time.  No ice/vending machine on same floor. 2 floors away.  No refrigerator or coffee maker. Matteresess were broken down and too soft. And biggest error....housekeeping needed to be requested. No longer daily tasks.  When I tried to call front desk or housekeeping just beeping ...no one answered. Not all elevators were functional.  Only 2 of 4-6 were functional from 19th floor. And totally failed last day. Called from cell phone direct front desk/reservation number to tell anyone we were stuck in hallway trying to get elevator to work.  I understand electric outage Friday 13th night could have played in problem But All elevators did not work prior to outage.  I was refunded part of costs. But "resort fees" are what?  Nothing resorty feeling at all. Stay was from Wednesday Dec 11th checking out early morning Dec 14th. 2024.

allReviews.title: Extremely disappointed
allReviews.text: I have been looking forward to staying here for a long while. I was so disappointed in the whole stay. I will start with the room. Although a Kingsize bed the room was very big, the mattress was so firm and for lack of better wording(springy) I could feel the springs every where I laid. When i went in the morning to shower I got no hot water. Not just a depleted water tank when you turned the handle over to hot nothing came out. I called the front desk and told them about it. I was informed that engineering would come up which they never did. The toilet paper is single ply just like a porta potty. When I checked out I informed the front desk of disappointment and that engineering didn’t show up and she said oh I thought you meant the water just wasn’t hot I will let them know it doesn’t work. The dining room is so old and run down that it was uncomfortable.

allReviews.title: Just as I wish every hotel room would be
allReviews.text: Very good,     It was a  very nice hotel room, quiet and.had a fabulous view through windows that occupied the entire wall. The price was not excessive, especially since I checked in with no reservation.      The bed and bedding were very  comfortable.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend staying here
allReviews.text: Hotel is really nice for a great price, lots to do in and around hotel, comfortable rooms that you can stay in or go out., super kind staff who are very helpful and knowledgeable with what to do! I would recommend staying here for a weekend or longer.

allReviews.title: Overall was an amazing stay
allReviews.text: Even though we never got the room we booked the two queen beds were convenient for us. Everything was in walking reach & we never had any problems with our overall stay at your hotel & casino. The casino was well maintained & cleaned well & the variety of games were great.

allReviews.title: Grand Hotel
allReviews.text: I was hesitant about booking based upon reviews I had read, but I booked because the other family members were there. We stayed in the new tower, rooms were nice, clean, no noise. I would stay again. Fremont Street 2 blocks away easy access to alcohol & outdoor entertainment.

allReviews.title: Downtown Great
allReviews.text: We upgraded to a Gallery Tower deluxe room and it was very good. It was clean and easily accessible from the casino. The Downtown Grand is one of my favourite casinos so we were delighted to stay in the hotel. The location to Fremont is very good and the facilities in the casino are good. The only negative is have was the check in clerk, he was quite curt and didn’t engage with us at all. Very disappointing start but thankfully that was the only negative. Would stay again

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Great experience. Clean hotel with good amenities and right off Fremont street. Slightly loud at night due to close proximity but thats to be expected for the area. They also provide ear plugs if needed. Good coffee bar in the front. Casino is very nice also.

allReviews.title: December NFR Vegas
allReviews.text: The hotel was great!!! Staff was excellent very friendly. Micheal always made a point to say good morning and to make sure I had my players card.......yes I kept loosing it. Best place to get a hot dog and a beer for $3 I don't think anyone has a deal like that!!! Restaurants were also very good as well Freedom has the best Classic eggs Benedict.

allReviews.title: Worst service ever
allReviews.text: While the hotel was pretty good the service was nonexistent. They expect you to check in at a kiosk but it doesn’t really work. On our 3 night stay our room was never cleaned. No fresh towels or even take out trash. Phone calls were generally not answered. Never again!

allReviews.title: We was ok

Our friends room didn’t have a tv that worked . Other then that it’s close to everything if you plan on staying in the Fremont area

allReviews.title: Great value, enjoyed local eats.
allReviews.text: We stayed during a quiet period in Vegas, between the F1 and NFR. Visited Vegas numerous times and have always stayed on the strip. Chose to stay downtown as we previously enjoyed the more sense of “local”, compared to the strip. We don’t gamble but came to relax, enjoy relatively warm weather, and eat at local haunts. The hotel itself is well placed. Being one block off Fremont keeps the noise down. We were given a suite in the tower, upgraded as I had Preferred rewards status. It was spacious. Bed and furniture was all in good condition. Only thing was the one side of the bathroom door was clearly not wiped down and covered in “something”. So 3/5 for cleaning. At the hotel, we grabbed morning coffee from the Art bar and did happy hour at the Triple George bar across the road. Friendly service and good prices on both. Given its location we were able to walk to the Parlour Coffee and Downtown Terrace for breakfast. Lunch  at Le Thai far exceeded expectations (Waterfall beef!) and was good value, Mona Rosa had a great taco Tuesday and inexpensive margaritas. Lovely atmosphere too. We also loved the container park - the sandwiches at Bin 702 and wine special was great. Plus Oak &Ivy makes the best nightcap / cocktail. For our one “fancy meal” we chose to uber to Herbs and Rye. Amazing steaks and no where else in Vegas are steaks 50% off during happy hour. 5 star meal. We did hit Top Golf and walked the strip one afternoon but were glad to be back downtown with the relative calm. We’d come back to the Downtown Grand when staying in Vegas because of the value and ability to walk downtown.

allReviews.title: first time staying in Las Vegas Nevada was great for me. we stayed there three days and nights. weather was beautiful!
allReviews.text: first time staying in Las Vegas Nevada was great for me. we stayed there three days and nights. weather was beautiful!

allReviews.title: Great trip for the NFR
allReviews.text: Great stay, clean property, good offerings in the hotel, and close by.   Staff was friendly, valet was attentive, and great options for breakfast. Things were made easy, even though busy never had waits, and location is easy to experience the rest of the city.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Just spent a week there friday to friday. We were on the fourth floor of the gallery tower. We expected a lot of noise from Fremont Street and ended up having no trouble at all. Our room was clean and every staff member was very friendly. Had a great week.

allReviews.title: Horrible experience
allReviews.text: I booked the room originally for 1 night and decided to extend my reservation for 1 more day. By the time I got back to the room all of my belongings were gone. I informed the front desk and they stated it was a mix up with house keeping and that my items are in lost and found and I could come to the front desk to retrieve my items. My boyfriend came back to the room shortly after I got off the phone and informed me that several more items were missing as well. So, we went to the front desk and he informed them of all the other items we were missing. Security came and brought his iPhone charger, my bandana, his chapstick,  and his wallet. He informed them that our food, beverages,  my charger, my slides, our Marijuana, cigars, our gummies, our toothbrushes, toothpaste,  and body wash. They stated that they did not know where the items were and that we would have to fill out an incident report to resolve the issue. The staff was very unprofessional at the front desk and were giggling at my boyfriend which upset him. Once an additional Security guard intervened things got worse because the security guard became agitated when my boyfriend began filming him. The security guard began cursing and telling my boyfriend he can't film him. When the security guard walked by me he was venting and stated that he did not want to deal with my boyfriends sh** because it was interfering with his lunch break. Eventually my boyfriends brother and I were able to calm him down to fill out the incident report. While he was telling me what all was missing from the room to put down on the incident report security found the remaining items. This situation ruined our night. He was beyond agitated for the lack of professionalism the staff had while dealing with this situation. I have stayed at this casino several times and never experienced such horrible customer service in my life. We got the room to get away from the world and spend time with each other before he leaves town for the holidays. We can not get that time back.

allReviews.title: Disappointment
allReviews.text: Very disappointed in overall stay at Downtown Grand.   We have stayed here multiple times in the past and hotel is loosing focus on customer support and satisfaction.   We will be looking at other properties in the downtown area on future travels.

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: Rooms are ckean and spacious, but bed was not very comfortable. Top layer is comfy but when you lay down you can feel the hard platform. I like the look and function of the glass, half shower wall, but it is too short to function right, the floor mat gets completely wet and doesnt allow you to retain any heat so you're standing there feezing while you take a shower. Being close to Fremont St is fun but you can hear too much loud noise from the streets below at night. Lastly, the room keys not working all weekend really got ridiculous. We had to go to the front desk on 6 times over a 3-night stay to get keys re-programmed. After walking all day, the last thing I wanted to do at midnight get all the way to my room 9th floor, grand tower and then have to go all the way back to front desk because my key didnt work, AGAIN. This was our 3rd stay, Not sure we're coming back. Will try new location.

allReviews.title: Excellent place to stay!
allReviews.text: The hotel is nice, room and beds were comfy and clean. All hotel staff were friendly and helpful. The casino was great and played great music. Best of all, they are a dog friendly hotel and we were able to bring our 2 fur babies along on this trip. My family and I will definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Probably not coming back
allReviews.text: The room was very old school and basic. Pillows were flat and there were only two on the bed. The ac does not work and our room was very hot! Don’t think we will be coming back. We stay at this hotel quite a bit but for whatever treason this time around was not up to standard.

allReviews.title: Gambling at The Grand
allReviews.text: This is for the Casino and restaurant only.  We ate at the restaurant right off the casino floor. It is a cafe, but I don't recall the name.  It has potential, but was not anything extra although the servings were big.  The service underwhelmed as it was mid afternoon so the place wasn't in the swing of things.    The Grand also has their Hot Dog deal which you may see advertised.  It was actually pretty good for a heavy snack/light meal. Surprised the cold Pabst beer tasted pretty good and the bottom of the sign shows a Nathans logo.  You do not getting any toppings however. I think The Grand draw is they have low minimum Black Jack.  They did have a  1 dollar table, but it was difficult to get on if at all. They did have $5 minimum which we played easily mid day during the week.  They also had a $5 minimum roulette table. The interior of the casino was really nicer than what I expected.  High ceilings so smoke was not an issue. The staff was courteous too. I would visit again if I was in the Downtown area.

allReviews.title: Friendly staff
allReviews.text: We went down for our wedding and my sons 21st birthday.  We stayed in the Gallery Tower which I think must be an older tower.  No fridge or microwave in the basic rooms and ours had a broken tp holder.  My new hubby went to talk to the desk and they found out the reason for our visit and upgraded us to a suite.The service was great.  The casino was small but I like that.  I did not know until he checked out but my son and his buddy had no air in their room.  It was a sauna in there.  Overall 4 stars, it's affordable but needs some repairs in the older tower.

allReviews.title: Good facilities, poor quality services.
allReviews.text: We stayed from 16.10.24 until 29.10.24. We arrived at 23h to check in and already had a large queue with only one attendant to make guest registrations. The disappointment has already begun. Arriving in the room the safe didn't work. Despite the goodwill of the Lord who went to try to fix it, it was not possible to carry out the repair. It was suggested to change room, which we did not pq was already late (midnight) and we were already open all the bags. The bathroom toilet didn’t flow the water properly and the door whispered when it opened and closed. The worst was not that. It was only after we returned from the first tour on 17.10 that we saw that the room was not clean, not cleaned and no towels changed. We complained at the front desk and then with the manager of the hotel and the same told us that it was policy of the hotel to change towels and clean the room after 3 days of hosting. Pasmem! Said it was like this since the time of COVID that we rebated and demanded clean towels. We paid a resort fee and a fee in advance if any damage was done in the room which would be refunded at check-out. On the day of check-out, 29.10 at 9:00am the elevators of the tower where our room was staying were not working. So we had to load our bags to the other tower, go down the ground floor, cross the street to the main entrance of the hotel. Nothing was working that morning. Then they said that they would email up to 5 days (not specifying if it would be 5 running days or nights) the receipt of the stay and the "REFUND" of the amount paid in advance at the time of check-in. Until now on 07.11.2024 when I am making this assessment, no response from the hotel regarding the case. This was our 5th trip to Las Vegas and this time we decided to stay in "downtown" pq we wanted to explore the area of Freemont. So travelers, watch out for this hotel. Bad service and do not keep what they promise. We never saw this of cleaning the room and changing towels after 3 days of staying, a situation that was not informed when the reservation was made. Unpleasant...

allReviews.title: DTG is affordable and very nice.
allReviews.text: Really nice hotel for downtown Vegas.  I liked that it's located a little bit off Freemont but still close enough to walk.  Casino is fun.  Reasonable table game minimums is a perk for sure.  They have a Caesars sports book which I took full advantage of.Room is basic but clean.  Doesn't have some of the issue of the older casinos on Freemont.  I for sure would rather stay here than anywhere else downtown save for Circa.  Circa would be three or four times the price.Overall would rate it a 10 for value.  I don't think you can beat this place for the price and location.

allReviews.title: It’s was not the nice stayed!

They tried to clean but because it was 12am just a work guy came to try to minimize the situation that I could shower, but I still could not take a shower, and in the end I neeeded to clean my hair in the sink to be able to sleep! I stayed 4 nights there because the marathon and any day I have somebody to clean my room! I needed to stop a housekeeping in the hall and ask myself for new towels. I am not here to be a bad guy but next time, if I decided to stay there, I would like to have at the least my room clean!

allReviews.title: Great location, great price, heart of downtown
allReviews.text: Rooms are clean and updated. They offer earplugs at the front desk for the noisy nightlife. But the location seriously can't be beat. You are right by the mob museum and Fremont Street and everything downtown. There is not a coffee maker, microwave, fridge or other amenities in the room. There is ice down the hall, but I always appreciate a coffee maker for hot water. Staff is very nice and though we didn't use any extras, they looked nice. The pool is only open 9-6 so it's only a daytime thing.

allReviews.title: Lack Luster for 4 Star ⭐️ Hotel
allReviews.text: I expected more from a 4-star hotel. The room was poorly lit and one of the lamps did not work. We arrived in the early morning after a delayed flight so the room was cool. We couldn’t use the heater because it smelled of something burning when turned on and who wants that while you’re asleep? I reserved a room with a tub since I wanted to soak after the marathon. Instead I was placed in a room with a half enclosed shower which  left water on the floor; no trash can in the bathroom -ladies can relate. And finally, the tv didn’t work. Had to call the front desk and wait nearly 40 minutes for the “engineer” to come. They sent a person who worked on HVAC.The downstairs is beautiful but the room was not.

allReviews.title: Great downtown experience
allReviews.text: The valet, George, made my day.   He’s so kind, helpful, and careful.  He certainly represents top quality care. I don’t like to entrust my car with anyone else but he was the epitome of care.   I love the grand. It’s a great place to eat and is just the right amount of fun and rest.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Downtown
allReviews.text: We recently stayed at the Downtown Grand Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas, and I couldn’t wait to share how wonderful our experience was! My husband and I got married during our stay, and it was truly unforgettable. From the moment we checked in, we felt so welcomed and appreciated by every member of the staff. This hotel has such a unique charm – it’s close enough to the excitement of Fremont Street but tucked away just enough to give it a cozy, boutique feel in the middle of downtown Vegas.Rooms:The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable, which made getting ready for our wedding day so special. I’ll always remember the joy of preparing for the biggest day of my life in such a cool, vibrant space. The view from our room gave us a glimpse of the bustling downtown, adding to the electric atmosphere while still feeling like we had our own oasis.Staff, Dealers, and Bartenders:A huge shoutout to the entire team – they went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. The front desk staff was warm and accommodating, always ready to help with a smile. The dealers at the casino tables were fantastic, bringing great banter and making every game fun and lively. The bartenders made some of the best margaritas we’ve ever had in a casino – absolutely top-notch! Their skill and friendliness truly set this hotel apart.Location and Atmosphere:Situated in the heart of downtown Las Vegas, the hotel is just a short walk to the excitement of Fremont Street, but it has a much more laid-back, welcoming vibe than the busy Strip. After moving to the Strip for the remainder of our trip, we found ourselves really missing the positive energy and genuine friendliness of everyone at the Grand. It’s a place with character, where the staff truly cares, and you feel the difference.Final Thoughts:The Downtown Grand holds a special place in our hearts, and we’ll always remember this hotel for making our wedding experience extra special. Thank you to everyone at the Downtown Grand for an unforgettable stay. We are lifelong fans, and we’ll definitely be back soon!

allReviews.title: Very good hotel in perfect location!
