allReviews.text: Had a great hotel experience...will come back. Bed was great shower was wonderful even liked the safe.  Every accept of the hotel stay was good.  I appreciated the staff the most and that's the real reason I choose to stay

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: The location, staff and restaurant were all great.  I enjoyed myself and is definitely a return experience for me. The front desk staff were very helpful and assisted with directing my stay to assure a pleasant visit

allReviews.title: The Grand Vacation!
allReviews.text: My family and I were visiting Las Vegas in June of 2023. We decided to stay at the Downtown Grand Hotel. It was very nice! We arrived late at night and were very tired because our flight was delayed. The staff was very empathetic and amazing! The house keeping staff was also wonderful. The rooms were excellent and very clean! One young lady, in particular, Antoinette Collins was very professional and helpful as were her staff. She was quite a gem. She ensured that everything was to our satisfaction. They were very informative about the activities going on at the hotel. She really made us feel welcome. I would definitely recommend the Downtown Grand Hotel! I will definitely be coming back to stay on my next visit to LasVegas.

allReviews.title: Vegas stay
allReviews.text: My wife and I celebrated our anniversary there, the stay was absolutely incredible, rooms very clean, dinner was great and the staff very pleasant and helpful from the moment we checked in. Special thanks goes out to the hotel manager Antoinette she really made our stay special.Thanks again!

allReviews.title: The best hotel I’ve ever stayed in
allReviews.text: Staying at this hotel was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had. We came a long way, (Alabama) and was very excited and pleased about our stay at the grand. Everything was so welcoming and with the help  of Antoinette, checking us in and guiding us through our entire stay made a delightful trip. Thanks again grand hotel staff for the best hospitality service i could ever receive. I will definitely be back soon.

allReviews.title: Bad customer service
allReviews.text: That is a scam hotel. Their customer service is awful. They charge you for nothing. They reserve for you for a wrong time and they are not responsible for that. I have a bad experience with them specially at the New Year’s and I want to stay there for December 30 and they book for me for December 29 and charge me and their manager Didn’t adjust the price for that day that they booked wrong for me and they never get a good feeling to you. Overall that’s a bad place to stay.

allReviews.title: My vacationing Vegas at the Grand.
allReviews.text: The staff at the Grand was very professional, the rooms was spacious and equipped with everything we needed.  I really enjoyed my stay there and will recommend it to other friends and family members. I definitely will be back.

allReviews.title: One of the best hotels to stay while downtown
allReviews.text: Lovely stay was very clean safe  we did not have any problems checking in/out the front desk really does an excellent job antionette I believe her name was is very nice lady and helped us very much,  quite not a lot of noise . We enjoyed everyday stay there for the price and also location couldn’t beat it we will be back

allReviews.title: The hidden Gem of Downtown Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: The Downtown Grand is the hidden gem of Old Vegas.  I've been staying here for years.  The staff is amazing, the rooms are large and clean, parking is FREE, machines are good (not too tight), and you are a stones throw from the Fremont Street experience.  In fact, staying at the Grand, you are actually closer to Fremont St than many of the rooms at the Golden Nugget.  But it isn't as "crazy" as the others on Fremont.The pool is wonderful although nothing extraordinary as you might find at the high end places.  Still... there are always places to sit and it isn't overwhelming.  If you want the frenetic party scene, you are a 5 minute walk to Circa's Stadium Swim.  But if just wanting to chill, The Grand Pool is just fine and Citrus has drinks for reasonable prices.I hoped to share one special experience that I had here in September.  Jodi who is a fixture at The Furnace, was deep in conversation with another patron about something.  I'm a curious guy, so I asked what they were talking about so intently.   In so many words, she shared that they "thought" U2 might be doing a pop up performance somewhere in the vicinity.  Well...it didn't take much to get me out of that bar stool and figuring out where one of my favorite bands of all-time was performing!I was in town again this weekend for New Years and told her how one of the best nights of 2023 was initiated by her.  She's great.  Mike is too.  Everyone at The Furnace is friendly and attentive.Get a players card.  They are generous with comps for parking (if you're not staying there when it's free) and they give nice discounts for Freedom Beat which has wonderful specials.  And Pizza Rock next door is some of the best Pizza I've ever had (Detroit Style is my fave).  And now, they have a vendor in the casino that sells a hot dog and a PBR for $2.  What a great idea!!!Thanks to everyone at The Grand.  You guys are the best!

allReviews.title: Super trip with the Downtown Grand.
allReviews.text: We stayed at Downtown Grand the week following Thanksgiving.  Our room was very good.  The bed was comfortable.  The App on my phone to request anything was a super great addition. This was our first stay.  Everyone was so nice and accommodating.  Loved the casino.  We are planning our next trip. We have stayed on the strip for 25 years.

allReviews.title: Terrible hotel
allReviews.text: I dislike the fact that I checked in on the 19th and checked out the next day and they still have a hold on my deposit money. It’s the 30th now smh no other hotel in Vegas has ever held my money this long

allReviews.title: Bad front desk staff
allReviews.text: The front desk service is extremely unsatisfactory, and the overall customer service experience, as well as the management, leaves much to be desired. I was charged for a mistake made during check-in, and I am not willing to bear the cost of an error committed by a customer service representative.

allReviews.title: Not what they claim it is.
allReviews.text: On check in I requested a room close to elevator as I have limited mobility. I was given a room in a tower which involved crossing a skybridge and negotiating a labyrinth of corridors. The only directions offered by the clerk was take the elevator to the eighth floor. She neglected to explain that there are two elevators, only one of which has access to the room I was given. The furnace in the room squeaked so loud I had to turn it off completely. There was no fan in the bathroom. There are no coffee makers in the room even though they claim to have them on their website. The bell hops were friendly, but provided incorrect information on several occasions. This is a sprawling facility made up of several buildings on both sides of the street, but no map or blueprint is provided. There was no informational brochure on nearby attractions. Most of the restaurants mentioned on the website are across the street from the hotel.  The street noise was so loud you had to have earplugs to sleep. Our trip was to for a visit to watch the National Finals Rodeo, but the hotel refused to air it on any of their TVs including the sports bar. They played golf! The housekeeping was good with the exception of the chairs in the lobby.

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: Check in was easy and quick, the agent  also recommended us the Freedom Beat and it didn’t fail it was delicious. Room was very clean and well put together. Casino floor was busy very good vibes all around.

allReviews.title: Too bad the noise from parties is so loud, otherwise this would’ve been a good place
allReviews.text: The facilities are nice and clean. The location is great. The problem is they prioritize party guests at their pool parties over hotel guests. The noise from a party at the pool on a Thursday night was so loud we could hear it three hotel aisles away in our room. We had to run the air conditioner, full blast to block out the thumping. I can’t imagine what it would’ve been like to have a room facing on the pool. most of the people at the party were not staying at the hotel, and there was a separate admission to the party. I’ve never been to a hotel that prioritized party guests over hotel guests.

allReviews.title: Girls weekend in Vegas
allReviews.text: Comfy, clean, spacious. We had a double queen, more than enough room. Right on the Fremont Street Experience, so we were given earplugs upon check-in. Worth it to be close to the action. Only complaint is lack of signage. No indication of where to find ice or vending. Had to call front desk. However, this is a very minor complaint. Overall, great stay!

allReviews.title: The Grand downtown is Grand!
allReviews.text: This was our first time staying at The Grand.  The staff was amazing from check in, housekeeping, bellhop, valet thru check out.  We will definitely be back! Nice clean,  spacious rooms. Very close to Fremont Street so if you're looking for quiet this is not the hotel for you,  but for you nightlife peeps is right in the middle of all the downtown action.  It was perfect for us!

allReviews.title: Great hotel near old downtown Vegas!
allReviews.text: Great location to Freemont Street without the noise. Bed was comfortable. Casino was nice, even won a little! Slightly smoky but not overwhelming. The only thing we didn’t like was the shower. Only half of a glass wall, no curtain or door. Would’ve been nice to have a fridge too.

allReviews.title: Awesome Stay
allReviews.text: I was reluctant to stay here, we always stay at The Nugget but it was a family event. I have to say it was an awesome experience , great hospitality, very clean and updated. We had four families stay here and they all had the same experience.

allReviews.title: Nice rooms, great staff.
allReviews.text: Staff, incredible. Room was dated but clean. It was a comfy bed and spacious. Nice pillows. Also excellent views. Shower was small and pressure was low, but really wasn't a deal breaker. Loud music from Freemont is unavoidable,  but I used my loop ear plugs which worked fine. The biker club beneath has some obnoxiously loud motorcycles they love to rev randomly, but again has nothing to do with the hotel. Right next to the Mob Museum which is a great place to visit and learn.Uber and Lyft was always fast to pick up here.

allReviews.title: Adult Family vacation did not disappoint.
allReviews.text: The upgraded Gallery tower was great. We appreciated the ear plugs to help quiet the noise from people enjoying their Fremont experience. The pool area was nice. The staff was friendly and accommodating to our needs and requests.

allReviews.title: Great place for Fremont Street Experience and Off Strip Entertainment
allReviews.text: The casino was modern with good air quality for non-smokers. The front desk, valet, and bell hop staff were a pleasure to work with. They were attentive, polite & informative. We were in the Gallery Tower and the room was well appointed, bed was comfortable, good shower water pressure, and a safe in closet. No fridge or microwave if that is important to you. The only noises we heard were foot steps from the room above. Very easy to walk to 3rd Street and Fremont Street Experience restaurant and entertainment. We've been to many hotels in Vegas and we would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: AWESOME  choice for downtown Vegas
allReviews.text: If you’re planning to be in downtown rather than the strip this place is fantastic.  The casino is small but pretty nice.  They have low $ tables too if you want any to take it easy.  It’s inexpensive, rooms are super clean and big. And you are a 2 min walk from Fremont.

allReviews.title: Worst experience EVER
allReviews.text: I did not like it. Our toilet didn’t work and they never came to fix it after I called. Arianna was the only positive part of my experience. If I paid to stay in a room I shouldn’t have to find a working bathroom. This is absolutely HORRIBLE AND ILL NEVER STAY HERE AGAIN. But thank you Arianna you were amazing! She gave a  complete understanding. So thank you Arianna!

allReviews.title: Grand Halloween
allReviews.text: Nice room but maid service skipped us and we had wet towels, no promised water bottles or coffee.  Good continental breakfast deal downstairs for $12.  Restaurant near casino had great Philly Steak sandwich.  Need to open more tables when the others are full - craps.  Had to leave the casino to play.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: First time staying at Downtown Grand and I have to say I wasn’t sure what to expect.  There were good and bad reviews.  Check in and checkout process was smooth.  Our room was great and overall facility was very clean!  Casino was great as well.  Overall very happy with our stay and we will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Okay if you like sewage smell in your room.
allReviews.text: Room smelled like sewage and drains were plugged. Not much gambling area so we had to play at another casino. Slots are so tight and drinks are worst than Fremont casinos. Parking is across the street.

allReviews.title: Stay Here…but don’t make the prices go up
allReviews.text: I love this property.  Easy to get to. Away from the strip. Clean and comfortable.  And I’m a big fan of the little boutique type casino.  I have stayed here numerous times and will absolutely r back!

allReviews.title: Vegas trip !
allReviews.text: Room ok, housekeeping service great, Players perks, not good. Players free drinks, bad!!!!!!!!!!!I only saw one hostess for the floor. I’ve stayed there before and sis not see much improvement!  I booked because of an early reservation thru booking.com,but rates are too high.@ Parking garage elevators not working and Haven’t been for a while. Have to walk down with luggage!!!!!

allReviews.title: Decent downtown Vegas hotel
allReviews.text: rooms were suitable and fairly clean but, no coffee maker in room or refrigerator. Pool looked nice but, no hot tub. Easy walk to Fremont street and restaurants. Freedom restaurant in hotel is not that great and bartender was rude

allReviews.title: Little amenities, great location
allReviews.text: Really enjoyed the location of The Grand. If you are looking for a very basic hotel with very little amenities this is a great choice. I gave it a 3 star just for the fact it took two days and multiple requests for additional pillows and soap.

allReviews.title: Solid Meh...
allReviews.text: We are staying here as we have some friends getting married at the mob museum and this was the suggested hotel. Nothing fancy. As multiple people said, no coffee, refrigerator, or microwave in the room, which is annoying but there is a safe. Front desk worker was nice, self-check-in was smooth. We do have a pretty view of the hills and the white noise machine was nice. Bathroom was clean, the room needs a new mattress. The room was large but again meh, nothing exciting or interesting about it.  Close to fremont, solid 15 from the rest of the strip. So all in all it's fine. If I wasn't here for the wedding, I would have probably choose somewhere else. Can't comment on the casino.

allReviews.title: Just ok
allReviews.text: The pillows were fluffy.  There's no coffee in room.  There seems to be no free drinks on casino floor unless you're playing tables.   Spent my fair share of dough at slots thirsty.  Their American whatever restaurant is a joke.

allReviews.title: Horrible Housekeeping and Front Desk.
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and employees friendly, except for the hotel operator or the non-existent housekeeping staff. On our first day we needed the sheets changed and called the front desk and housekeeping who advised they would put a "request" in. My response was what do you mean a request? Why 🤔 wouldn't someone be coming to change them because I advised it needed to be done? I spent the remainder of my stay of 3 days without sheets on my bed with a blanket and no one ever came to change the sheets and make the bed, even after I asked 3 times. The most ridiculous thing I have ever had to deal with while paying for a hotel room. Maybe I can dispute the charges since I never received what I paid for. 🤔

allReviews.title: 10/22/23 stay
allReviews.text: Very clean Hotel and the front desk staff was friendly and helpful. There were a few things that I wasn't aware of that other people may want to know.. we booked with Expedia, so we didn't have a " full service room", so we weren't brought towels, waters etc. unless we requested it and no one made beds or emptied trash during our stay. Just something to keep in mind if you want those services.

allReviews.title: Great hotel right near Fremont!
allReviews.text: Great hotel with pool and casino. Super friendly staff always willing to help! Would come back and stay again! Close to transit and the Fremont experience. Strip isn’t too far via transit and lots of stuff to do in the area.

allReviews.title: it’s fine for vegas.
allReviews.text: the hotel was fine. unfortunate that their cafe/breakfast options are pretty limited and expensive on top of the reservation prices. very surprised they don’t have any complimentary breakfast service.upon departure my room keys were deactivated prior to my checkout time, and all staff were rude and unwilling to help. seems pretty inefficient to demand someone *leaving* to wait in a line of 15+ check-ins rather than freeing up a room?highly disappointed in the customer service here.

allReviews.title: Fabulous.
allReviews.text: Pillows were soft and comfy, beds too! Everyone that worked there was so very nice and friendly, we very much enjoyed ourselves!! The bartenders in the casino on the gaming floor at night are super awesome as well!!

allReviews.title: Last visit
allReviews.text: Was able to check in on arrival at approximately 1:30 PM. That was the only good thing about my stay.Had to ask for an extra pillow twice before I got one. Was told the room would only be cleaned on day 3, which was fine with me BUT then provide me with enough amenities to last until then. Had to call for clean towels, facecloths, water etc. did ask for my room to be cleaned on day 3 but that never happened. My room was not cleaned once.Asked for the “angel app” link to be sent to me 3 times so I could easily communicate with the hotel rather than calling. Never received the link.  Had to buy a bar of soap as two little bars don’t last  6 days for two adults and I felt like I was inconveniencing staff to the point that I just bought the soap rather than call yet again.This was my third and last stay at the Downtown Grand.Staff there are not happy or friendly and that goes right from hotel check in to restaurant to rewards desk and I’m not that hard to please!  I’ve never had such a consistently poor experience in all of my travels and hotel stays.

allReviews.title: Barely tolerable
allReviews.text: The room was not adequately cleaned when we arrived. There was hair in the bathroom on the toilet, floor and shower. We could hear all the sounds from everywhere around our room including music from the street, plumbing, and noise from other rooms and hallway. Check-in/out was fine. The real disappointment was at the restaurant Freedom Beats. Just disgusting. We picked at the food. When the waitress asked if we wanted boxes I said "no, it was pretty disgusting and inedible" she replied "I feel that", took our plates and left.

allReviews.title: Gross, unclean,  plus loud
allReviews.text: Between finding your adorable little sticky note about the earplugs stuck to our mirror, no earplugs to be found, and the tissue box stuffed full of SOMEONE ELSES USED TISSUES it is incredibly clear that you dont clean your rooms. There is a game night with a DJ right outside your room so sleeping wont be an option here. They say they provide earplugs but they dont actually clean their rooms so they wont be there anyways. There was a literal tissue box full of used tissues in the bathroom.  Soda stains on the walls in the room, boogers on the walls next to to toilet. Just buy some clorox wipes and take out the freakin trash and maybe you'll get some repeat customers.

allReviews.title: A nice stay.  Could have been better.
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at this hotel for his work conference.  The room was clean and the bed and pillows were amazing.  Staff was friendly and was great about bringing extra pillows and bottled water to our room.  The location was less than a block from Fremont Street.  I loved getting take out from Pizza Rock next door. Their food was exceptional. I also appreciated the free parking in the garage right across the street.Being by myself most of the time, I would have loved to find a nice, shady spot on hotel grounds to read, relax, and enjoy being out of the room. I was disappointed that there were no shady spots by the pool, other than dining tables. All of the shaded cabanas are marked “reserved”, even though no one was ever there.  There are about 6 umbrellas out there, which is not nearly enough for the amount of people out there. I was never lucky enough to claim one. By the time my husband came back to the room after work and had some dinner, we were disappointed to find that the pool closes at 6.  We had hoped to go to the hot tub to relax outside and enjoy our time together.  Also, bring ear plugs.  There weren’t any pool parties going on the nights we were there, but you can still hear music late into the night, with the bass notes being especially hard to drown out. Not having a fridge in the room was a bummer, too.

allReviews.title: It’ll do.
allReviews.text: The staff is amazingly helpful, polite and attentive when there are requests from guests. The employees at the front desk and coffee shop are incredibly nice. My requests for bottles of water or extra hangers and pillows were met with smiles immediately. As for the rest, it’ll do. The beds are soft mattresses on plank like bed frames, not very comfortable. I was there from Sunday to Saturday and the room was never cleaned except when I asked for the trash to be emptied. Apparently I needed to be more specific. There is no amenities shop in the lobby so for toiletries you’re walking down FSE to the Walgreens. The room smelled of stale cigarette smoke the entire week. Can’t blame the hotel if people want to break the rules and smoke in the rooms. All in all it was fine. It’ll do if you need a place to stay. Just an average older hotel on Fremont.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Nice quiet hotel. Very clean room. Issue i had is they had no daily cleaning of room. Also shower had no shower door. Gambling was fun food good. All in all nice hotel and i had fun . The employees were so nice aswell

allReviews.title: Housekeeping did not clean!
allReviews.text: Great bed & air conditioning. That was really the only good part of our room.  There was a dirty sock on the floor in our room at check in. We stayed 5 nights. Housekeeping only showed up one day. I had to request towels, toiletries, and water bottles a few times since they never bothered to clean our room. I love the casino but the hotel was a huge disappointment this trip. We've been staying here ever since they opened and never had an issue like this before.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand
allReviews.text: The room was just a plain room, no microwave, no fridge, no coffee machine, every hotel I've been in has all those amenities you get nothing for the money you pay, but the bed was comfy that's the only good thing.

allReviews.title: Great stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Was a great hotel at the Freemont area. Clean, affordable, quiet. The room was the perfect size for 2 people in vegas and walking distance to the other casinos and activitiesI'm looking forward to staying here again and doing more activities

allReviews.title: Nice hidden gem!
allReviews.text: This hotel is in an amazing location. The hotel has an overall great look! I stay in a standard room, but if I ever come back, I will definitely have to try out a suite because that side of the hotel has a great view of the hotel pool and other things that surround the area.

allReviews.title: Ok for just stay
allReviews.text: The check in was easy and friendly staff. We were 4 and there were only 2 towels and the bedroom felt dirty. Hairs in the shower, clogged sink and towels didn’t smell like laundry. Comfortable bed. It’s just ok.

allReviews.title: Best staff on Fremont!
allReviews.text: ONLY place we stay when we go to Vegas!!! We travel here 5-6 times a year and love it!!! The staff go above and beyond! Our favorites are-CurtBree MikeDavid JodiWe are always taken care of, rooms are clean, foods great, drinks are strong, super affordable and location is fabulous! We love the DG! Can't wait to see you all again in Dec!!!-Kevin and Gina

allReviews.title: Payed $39.55 daily resort fee, for no housekeeping or water, NOT good enough!!
allReviews.text: Comfortable, basic clean rooms, pool area great (although small for the amount of hotel rooms)  Really disappointed in the $39.55 usd resort fee, this was listed as being for daily housekeeping, pool use, gym use and daily water bottles  great for three days, the remaining 3 days we had/got nothing, so wet towels having to be reused (shower screen did not block water coming out onto the floor) asked at front desk for new towels and water daily, did NOT receive, lots of apologies and promises the next day, but still not follow-up Very disappointed Beer and hotdogs in casino a great ideaMeals were very good in the restaurant

allReviews.title: Totally excellent value and a perfectly located hotel in Downtown Las Vegas. I highly recommend it with an A+
allReviews.text: Totally excellent value and a perfectly located hotel in Downtown Las Vegas. I highly recommend it with an A+

allReviews.title: Good experience poolside - good hotel.
allReviews.text: Good Hotel, good bang for your buck - you can tell they really try. Located well, free parking nearby. Mike, Manager of the pool area very cool - accommodated our wedding party at the pool on very short notice. Rooms were clean, bed was comfortable, I'd stay here again.

allReviews.title: Practice Better customer service
allReviews.text: Tried to call several times and was ignored, put on hold forever, or hung-up on. Was unable to check on reservations all though I attempted multiple times. I rarely write reviews, but this was frustrating.

allReviews.title: Best experience in a Hotel !!
allReviews.text: I was greater by the MOST helpful Bellman - Barry !.. he was so kind and knowledgeable- and efficient!.. the. I had the best experience at the desk from Lin ! She was so please and treated me so professional but like family !… the pool was great and the bed was super cumfy !.. the pillows were the SOFTEST EVER !..  Thanks again for such and awesome experience!!!!… I definitely will be back 💜

allReviews.title: Great place....good location
allReviews.text: I've  always wanted to stay in the "original" las vegas so I chose this hotel because it was close to Fremont st but not to close. It is also right next to the Mob museum which I wanted to visit. The hotel is modern and clean. It does have food options and is located near other resturants(pizza rock, triple George, hogs and heifers,food court at binons). The staff were friendly and helpful especially Lin at the front desk. The casino is small but has everything you need. You can hear the music from Fremont street but they do have a nice canceling machine in the room so no problem. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Lock your doors as staff try’s to enter unannounced
allReviews.text: I don't know what this is but what I would like is for people from your hotel to stop coming in my room.  I don't feel comfortable here one bit. Twice in the same day. Earlier a gentleman and now a housekeeper who when I asked her to close the door kept her foot in the way on purpose and would not close the door. What if I was naked ? Sleeping? This is crazy. I thought this was a ok place but I’ve completely changed my mind after this past experience.

allReviews.title: Casino staff was great and fun. Easy to talk with and very helpful.
allReviews.text: Maid service every day, room were very clean. The staff was very good to deal with and helpful. We were on the 3rd floor which is the pool level and yet our room was very quiet. We would definitely stay there again and looking forward to it.

allReviews.title: Good choice a block off Fremont
allReviews.text: Stayed in the tower section of the hotel, it must have been built or renovated fairly recently. Checkin process went well, the room was fine, good service from staff. Was a bit noisy, even with a room facing away from Fremont street.They also charge a 'resort fee' like most other hotels in Vegas, which is just a way to deliberately confuse customers about what the room actually costs

allReviews.title: Great hotel,  great location!
allReviews.text: This is our second stay here! We really like the location and we sleep so good here! We love the location,  not directly on Freemont but very close! The only thing we didn't like was the shower in the gallery tower. It is not a good design,  gets the whole room wet and you can't turn it on unless you step inside.  We'll keep coming back though!

allReviews.title: Great hotel for proximity to Freemont and free parking for guests
allReviews.text: We only stayed one night and our overall experience was good.  We didn't have issues with noise from Freemont-just typical road noise you'd get at most hotels.  The rooms were clean, and beds were comfortable.  The staff was helpful and check in/out was easy.  The location to Freemont and free parking for our rental car was the reason we booked here.  We did not use the pool or Casino.  I would stay here if visiting the area again.  Please note- I wouldn't recommend venturing out to areas around the hotel (esp at night) other than the Freemont Experience.  It felt a bit unsafe to do so.

allReviews.title: Very loud
allReviews.text: So I know you don't go to Las Vegas to get a good night's sleep, and this is not necessarily Downtown Grand's fault, but they really need to invest in sound-proofing in their hotel rooms, or at least warn their guests that their "Gallery Tower Deluxe" rooms are right across the street from the Goldspike Hotel, which blasts dance music in their hopscotch courtyard until 2am each night. At least provide earplugs or something. Even without the DJ playing late 80s hits to crowd of screaming bachelorettes, there's also motorcycles and loud cars making noises on the road right below you. Anyway, the pros - clean room, nice people.

allReviews.title: Horrible cleanliness and management
allReviews.text: Our bedding was stained, pubic hairs on the bathroom floor upon arrival. Only 1 of the 3 elevators worked 90% of the stay. The hotel service manager said there is noone above him to talk to refused to give any other contact information apparently they own it. One of our family members had to have security come let them in their room when they needed in due to key card service stopped working for their room. Place is a joke! Refund a night stay, however they charge for a guest service fee and other fees when they don't even service quest that they don't redund. Choose a different place!!!

allReviews.title: Excellent value for money
allReviews.text: Covered and secure parking associated with the hotel (free).Cleaning.Proximity to covered gallery with concerts and attractions. Excellent value for money.In reality everything went well, but if I wanted to make a suggestion, maybe I would have included breakfast.The location is a bit far from the center but with Uber we only paid €8 to get back to the hotel from Bellaggio

allReviews.title: Very Nice
allReviews.text: A very good experience. Located off the hustle and bustle of the Strip, but still offering a lot of close by entertainment. The rooms were very comfortable and the service was very friendly and efficient. The gaming options down stairs were very good also. It represented great value, I will be back.

allReviews.title: Grand stay at the Downtown Grand!
allReviews.text: Downtown Grand is a gem. We stayed here three nights 9/20 to 9/23 to celebrate my daughters 21st birthday. We are very glad we chose the Grand. Rooms were very nice and very comfortable. Check in was smooth and fast (unusual for Vegas these days). We liked the restaurant inside and Pizza Rock across the street. Unlike the strip, downtown vegas is very walkable with a ton of great restaurants at all price points an easy stroll away. The Fremont St experience is two minutes away down a wide pedestrian causeway. People like to throw around the “Old Vegas” moniker about downtown but that is so outdated. Downtown is a vibrant and fun scene with tons to do. The Citrus Pool at the Grand is also nice with great service and good prices. We’ll definitely go again.

allReviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at the Downtown Grand Twice this month.  Sept 3rd and Sept 20th.   On Sept 3 I requested a particular room on the top floor and an early check in, the hotel met my every request and on my Sept 20th stay I booked a corner suite and it was perfect once again.  They make the stay very personal.  They send a text to your phone so you can text back any request you have and needs are met promptly.   Customer service, rooms and location to Fremont street are excellent.  Now for the casino; I would recommend playing some Keno at the bar because on both stays the slots kicked my ass🤣🤣🤣 but I did win on Keno to more than make up my loss on the other machines.   This hotel will definitely be my place from here on out for the Fremont experience.  This room review is based on rooms in the Gallery tower so I recommend to book that tower for your stay.  The rooms are exactly as pictured on the website.  I give my experiences there 5 stars ⭐️

allReviews.title: The downtown Grand gallery tower
allReviews.text: Stayed for 3nights was wonderful slept so good in the queen bed no noise really when asleep great room clean house keepers nice room had a great view 21st floor would definitely go again my mom really liked it as well

allReviews.title: Lies about rooms
allReviews.text: I booked a premium room with a king size bed and they gave me a regular room with a double bed. At the front desk they told me, do you think the bed is too small? Sorry, those are the sizes we have. Inappropriate response for the situation. Additionally, it says that it is close to downtown at 1.6 miles and it is really 4 miles away, with the sun no one walks that distance to walk. Horrible experience. It's a shame about the lies they tell customers.

allReviews.title: Wedding
allReviews.text: The room wS dark. There is a constant light on over TV. The toilet had a broken handle and didn't get repaired until 8:45. am next morning. Why is the full length mirror in the dark. There is no light near it. Otherwise the bed was very comfortable. The Restaurant downstairs was very good even though it was extremely slow with little customers and only one waitress.  It took 30mins to get the bill. After I had finished eating.

allReviews.title: Best value in Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms are ample in size and well maintained.   The hotel was very clean both inside and outside.  Great in and out free parking.   I loved staying downtown as opposed to the strip. Restaurants had great food and service.   Low minimums to bet.  ONE DOLLAR blackjack tables!!

allReviews.title: Unhealthy place
allReviews.text: Filthy hotel. Dust came rushing towards me when the room door opened. Dirt on the floor, dirty spots everywhere. Very unhealthy to stay here. You can hear the footsteps of the upstairs neighbors thundering. Would definitely not recommend.

allReviews.title: To summarize .... Do yourself a faver DON'T STAY HERE. If the mean , And cheating Dealers don't get you the homeless will... Nas
allReviews.text: To summarize .... Do yourself a faver DON'T STAY HERE. If the mean , And cheating Dealers don't get you the homeless will... Nas

allReviews.title: A hotel that cares more for EDM than Guests
allReviews.text: We stayed Friday and Saturday night in the Gallery tower. Both nights they held EDM concerts on the adjacent pool deck into the early hours of the morning. The 'music' blasted so loud we were unable to sleep, and at one point my phone vibrated off its charger and fell, cracking the screen. We asked a pool manager about this and he said they regularly host these concerts and they are the preferred type of events at this hotel, then told us to go find earplugs if it was a problem. I'm loathe to call the Saturday night sounds music, as it was more akin to car alarms at jetplane levels of volume. Otherwise a nice hotel, but those events and the rude teenagers it attracted made this an awful stay. We will not be returning, and have communicated this to our friends and family.

allReviews.title: Everyone has great service
allReviews.text: Right from the being the check in the girl from front desk made the check in smooth and easy. Went to the bar and our bartender she was amazing and her kept us entertained. Hotel Rooms were very clean even the hallways. We can’t stay there again.

allReviews.title: Good value for what you pay
allReviews.text: Clean hotel, pillows not at all comfortable, a few steps from Freemont, friendly staff, small but good casino, I don't know if you can hear the noise from Freemont, it has a good quality-price ratio, close to restaurants, a lot of people say that

allReviews.title: Vacation time
allReviews.text: Gregory Walver was a wonderful host for Downtown Grand Hotel and casino, he was fantastic representation for this chic hotel which is perfect for us!  He gave us great suggestions and upgrades.  We’ve already booked a return visit due to his treatment!!  5 stars for this guy!!

allReviews.title: Last minute weekend
allReviews.text: Surprisingly really nice hotel, had a great view, bed was very comfortable, gambling was fun, great staff at the tables. Was not loud and noisey like other casinos in Las Vegas. I will stay there again on my next trip to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Go somewhere else!!!
allReviews.text: I recommend you stay somewhere else.  This place acts like they are doing you a favor by allowing you to stay here.  The “high tech” rooms have a view of a painted wall right out your window.  You can look through your phone to see minimal activity.  The pool is small and want you to pay for most of the seating.  If it rains they will close the pool for the day and not re-open it even though the sun is out and is not supposed to be closed for 2 more hours.  Go to complain at the front desk and the response is next person please.  Stay somewhere else, you will have a much better time!

allReviews.title: Fees ruin the experience
allReviews.text: The first room I stayed in was the casino tower, an old dirty room. I got switched to the gallery tower newer but smaller and cleaner. Not impressed. Remember boutique means smaller, more expensive but well decorated. Paying for parking and a resort fee was way overpriced, just a money grab. Will not be back.

allReviews.title: The Kenny's of Citrus Pool Deck
allReviews.text: Kenny and Kenny Jr. are by far the best duo of bartender and server. They take the extra steps to make sure you're having the best experienceat the citrus pool side bar. I've been here in the past with other servers/bartenders and the level of service from these two should be the standard of all bartenders/servers. They definitely embody the spirit of customer service and experience.

allReviews.title: Great blackjack tables
allReviews.text: Excellent blackjack tables and dealers. Fully recommend, best one found in Vegas.They have 1 dollar black Jack tables until 3 PM and black Jack tournaments every Thursday. No other casino offers this.

allReviews.title: Downtown Gem!!
allReviews.text: We stayed 8/24-8/27/23…First impressions are lasting…Let’s start with the warm welcome and great service from the front desk staff.. this was our first stay here and it will not be the last… The front desk quickly checked us in and EARLY. He provided information about the hotel, restaurants and nearby activities. He also upgraded our room and asked if we had questions. We stayed in the Gallery suite on the 3rd floor with great access to the pool and again wonderful bar/pool staff. The room was immaculate and the bed provided us with a great nights sleep. We were provided earplugs but did not need to use. Housekeeping was always accessible, helpful and friendly. The casino was well kept and the drinks at the bar were very reasonable. In the mornings we would buy coffee at the Art cafe and the coffee was great as well as the staff.Every interaction with the hotel staff was wonderful!!! We go to Vegas 1-2x a year… and stayed elsewhere with lackluster staff and accommodations… no more The Downtown Grand will be our choice in our future visits to Vegas. Kudos to the entire team for a job well done. It’s a first for us in all our years visiting Vegas. If you are considering a stay here… Do it!

allReviews.title: Literally Thee Best Hotel Downtown.  I said what I said.
allReviews.text: I will not stay anywhere else but the Downtown Grand. My stay is always top shelf. I'm usually solo but observant. All guests are treated with excellence, and made to feel like a high roller. I could spend all day at the pool. My 1 and only critique would be to utilize the gym space a little more with multi use equipment and free weights. Anyway, Thanks and Praises to the Grand and it's Staff.

allReviews.title: Feel scammed
allReviews.text: A week and a half before we were to stay at this place my reservation was canceled because they did not charge me for the room before and were trying to "guarantee" that my room was available. I had to call back and book a new reservation and now it was going to be an extra $100 dollars because room rates had now gone up and they wouldn't give me back my original reservation. If any one in the room next to you or above you or in the street make any noise, you will hear every peep.

allReviews.title: Sets the standard for downtown Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I've stayed in the hotel a handful of times and loved the experience and hospitality each time. This hotel sets the standard for what a downtown Las Vegas hotel should be like. The rooms are clean and quiet. And if you want to have a little bit more fun, the Citrus rooftop pool holds nightly events and concerts on the weekends. Service is always great. Staff is friendly. The Grand is always my go-to hotel when I want to stay in downtown.

allReviews.title: One of the best hotel experiences in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Amazing experience from start to finish. Hotel is clean and organized. The highlight of my visit was the Citrus Pool Deck, great ambiance, friendly staff and a very observant and helpful management team. I would highly recommend this place to anyone that loves pools, great music and delicious drinks.

allReviews.title: Grand stay
allReviews.text: Great decor, music, and service.. this was an amazing trip with my baby and our friends.  The place was top notch especially for the price.  Location is just off Fremont, so you’re right around the corner but you don’t get all the late night noise if you want to get a good nights sleep. Saw the MJ one shoe and it’s a must see.

allReviews.title: Great location. Fresh modern hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel is in a perfect location. It is in a lively area, however, rooms are quiet and peaceful when you need to rest.   It is clean and fresh, albeit housekeeping is very limited, almost to the point of nonexistence.  Pool is perfect.   We enjoyed our stay there.

allReviews.title: Good experience!
allReviews.text: Nice hotel! Super close to downtown so very convenient. Pool had good music and our cabana was great! Pool was a good temp and clean. This hotel had friendly staff and the games were great here! Would stay again.

allReviews.title: Local gem
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the downtown grand for a weekend staycation for our anniversary. I loved the pool. It had a super fun vibe with chill music, great food and drink. I also really enjoyed the restaurants in the hotel and conveniently across the street. Don’t miss the hot dog & pbr cart deal! A perfect local gem to stay, play and eat.

allReviews.title: Weekend Trip In Vegas
allReviews.text: Best hotel DTLV steps from Fremont and all of the fun bars. The only rooftop pool with city views and no obstruction. $2 dogs a great beer selection to choose from. Affordable and good ambiance for all ages.

allReviews.title: Casual and fun the Citrus Pool exceeded my expectations…
allReviews.text: Some friends and I attended Citrus recently for Cosmic Gate… All I can say is that the venue was perfect for this event… There was plenty of open seating in the middle with a great view of the stage… Drinks were reasonably priced and weren’t overpriced like some other strip pool party venues… The staff always seemed approachable and were very fast to take my order and serve me up my drinks… The pool offered some cool relief to the hot open air and also had a great view of the stage… Cosmic Gate put on an amazing performance and everyone was vibing and enjoying the show… I will def recommend this hidden gem in downtown… I hope they put on more events like this…

allReviews.title: Great room and food
allReviews.text: The suite was on the North side of the tower, away from all the noise of the Fremont Street Experience.  Nice and quiet with an excellent view of the mountains and city of Las Vegas.  Nice, comfortable bed and convenient living area.  We used the Wifi for a business conference on Saturday morning and it was plenty fast.  We ate at Freedom Beat restaurant several times and had breakfast, lunch and dinner there.  Saturday and Sunday mornings feature a Brunch menu after 10am with specialty items not available on the regular menu.  The Prime Rib is an excellent deal with a generous portion of beef and GREAT side veggies!  Nice crisp sliced carrots and broccoli sautéed in butter and garlic.  My girlfriend thought the horse radish sauce could have been a bit stronger, but I thought it was just right.  We highly recommend this hotel and all the amenities.

allReviews.title: Fun in the sun !
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my time at the Grand, I was so impressed with how pretty and professional the casino was. This will be my ' all the time future stays. The pool was a nice place to relax. This place is a hidden gem !

allReviews.title: One of the best in old downtown Las Vegas
allReviews.text: One of the newer  hotels in downtown Las Vegas. Very clean, chill atmosphere. All these people complaining about loud music obviously forgot where they were vacationing at, vegas has many pool clubs with events at their pools. Stay in a station casino if you want minimal noise lol parking structure is right across the st and free with validation.

allReviews.title: Fun,beautiful and clean.
allReviews.text: The Grand Hotel was my favorite part of my Vegas experience. The best part of it was the pool deck. The staff was so kind, helpful and fun. The entire pool area was very clean. I’m looking forward to booking our stay in the future just to hang out by the pool.

allReviews.title: Convenient and not too pricey
allReviews.text: I loved the location, the hotel was nice and clean, I did enjoy my stay even though I’m not into Casinos. Food was really good, the only not too good thing was the pool. Just three umbrellas and they are never available, all the seats are reserved ALL the time, so either you stay 100 degrees under the sun or inside the pool. The housekeepers forgot about us, good luck we’re clean because they don’t wash linen due to drought, but we had to ask for dry towels because they never checked the room. Check in was super easy, as well as check out. They take a deposit but hopefully they give it back once you’re all checked out.I highly recommend this hotel if you’re a quiet person, but still enjoy walking around. There’s so much to see and you are not surrounded by crowds like in the strip but still very accesible using Uber (that are not too expensive, about 16 dlls to the strip area). If you have a rental the hotel also offers parking across the street. You’ll have everything you need with a recent budget! The Grand is basically one block away fromFremont Street and it has a nice caffe shop in the lobby to grab a quick breakfast and sit while you wait. It also has vending machines for sodas and snacks. Even though they offer bottle water in your room, they didn’t put any but the two we had on our arrival.  The pool bar drinks were fine, you can refill your large glass and save $5, in my case it wasn’t necessary because one was plenty!

allReviews.title: Comme ci comme ça.
allReviews.text: The room was fine for cleanliness and style. The lobby, like all Las Vegas hotels, is a smoke filled casino. The elevators smell like vape fumes. The Art Bar was closed in spite of it being within operating hours on their materials distributed to guests. We had a small dog with us. The dog fee was twice the normal fee. There’s no accommodations for a dog. Parking was included, which was a nice touch. We looked forward to a swim after a long drive. Pool was closed for a special event. After no place to eat with our dog, no room service, we looked forward to Sunday brunch by the pool. They don’t serve food until an hour after check out. We finally left the zone for Urth Cafe. They don’t pay attention to details. The tile transition at the elevator is a trip hazard. I have a bruise hand from a fall completely sober. Waiting for the elevator at 10pm, someone was loudly wrenching in the ladies room. This went on for a long time.

allReviews.title: Surprisingly pleasant
allReviews.text: The Downtown Grand Las Vegas is a surprisingly decent hotel despite its location in downtown Vegas. I was pleasantly surprised to find that it had been modernly renovated. I stayed in the new tower, and although the decor was sparse, it was clean and had a nice touch of color. The room was well-maintained without any marks around the knobs and sink areas. The coffee machine was also clean and stocked with coffee pods and bottles of water for use.One drawback was the loud music over the citrus pool area, which started quite early and could interfere with audio during meetings or calls. However, overall, the hotel provided a pleasant stay.The casino had a limited number of tables, with the craps closing around 6 PM and only one blackjack table available by 8 PM. On the bright side, there were plenty of slot machines, some of which were fairly new, and the casino didn't have a strong cigarette smell. The bar had friendly staff, notably Hugo, and offered affordable drinks.The hotel's location is within walking distance to other lively hotels, although it might not be the first choice for those seeking upscale or business-oriented accommodations on the strip. Nevertheless, downtown Vegas offers plenty of interesting activities, and Fremont Street has a lot of historical charm, providing a different side to Vegas.One downside of the area was the presence of many transients, panhandlers, and visibly troubled individuals struggling with mental illness or drug addiction.The hotel itself was clean, affordable, and convenient to access. There might be two other hotels in the area that are equally good or better, but they have sprawling casinos that make entry and exit more tedious. The check-in process was straightforward, thanks to an electronic system and a tablet for easy check-out.Overall, I was happy with my stay at the Downtown Grand Las Vegas, except for a minor issue with the elevators. One of the elevators got stuck, preventing the other two from being called down to the first floor. However, the hotel staff promptly addressed the problem and fixed the elevators within a few hours. During the incident, a staff member kindly escorted several of us through service corridors using a service elevator for a temporary solution.

allReviews.title: Pretends to be fancy but is a nightmare
allReviews.text: Edited my review to be “poor” rating after staying here longer and just getting worse. Pros: great pool, fun views. Cons: loud. No soundproofing from outside activity. Lukewarm water - literally, the shower doesn’t create any steam. So if a weekend with cold showers is your thing, stay here. Creaky floors - you’d think it was built in 1922 tenements. I hear every step of the people above us. Also here with a group and the curtains were removed from bedroom windows in one of our groups’s suite. This is the second time staying here in some years. After my last visit I said I wouldn’t return. The curtains then only came halfway down the wall so morning light was blinding. I have the management an opportunity to rectify the situation, they refused to acknowledge that anything was wrong. But I was convinced by friends to come back. I regret it.

allReviews.title: If you enjoy pools look elsewhere
allReviews.text: Where to start? First of all this is located in Las Vegas right? So let me first say if you want a hotel with a pool that is open after 6pm look elsewhere. Even when the pool is open you can’t even access it from your tower because they have that entrance blocked off. So you have to go down 3 floors, through part of the casino, through the lobby, up the other side of the hotel on an escalator, and get bag checked like you’re going through security at the airport. All for a mediocre rooftop pool that you can’t even get in because every square inch is already occupied. Then as soon as you start enjoying it they come around kicking everybody out at 5:50 pm. If this hotel had a slogan it would be “no fun.”

allReviews.title: I had the most fun outside of the hotel! I just wish I could have enjoyed the pool more! I feel incomplete
allReviews.text: I had the most fun outside of the hotel! I just wish I could have enjoyed the pool more! I feel incomplete

allReviews.title: Ridiculously EXCELLENT value......AND the property is first class, gorgeous, and fun!!!
allReviews.text: I stayed 5 nights (in on Sunday, out on Friday) for $255 ALL-IN.  Let me say that in a different way - my rate per night was $51 ALL-IN.  This was the "Las Vegas Advisor" rate for subscribers to that publication.  This rate WAIVED the Resort Fee.  If you don't subscribe, don't worry.  Downtown Grand's "Buy 2 Nights Get one Free" rate is available to ANYBODY and costs just a little bit more.So what do you get?  ONLY the second-BEST hotel in the Fremont Street area of historic Downtown Las Vegas.  Circa is a better hotel, BUT you'll pay 4X as much.Rooms here are spotless, first class, and oh-so-clean.  The casino is fabulous.  Two $5 dollar Blackjack tables and a $5 Craps table.  They EVEN have a $1 Blackjack table (and YES, the free drinks come fast and furious to THIS table, as well).  Casino may have the best ventilation in Las Vegas.  NO problems with hazy cigarette smoke (although you're free to light up, if you wish).Lots of food options inside and out.  For $2, you get a hot dog AND beer at the stand in the casino.  NOT $2 each, $2 TOTAL.Some of the world's best pizza is right across the lane at Pizza Rock (great prices too).  Also across the street is the elegant Triple George Grill, for that special meal.  Triple George Grill also has an extremely affordable lunch menu that is first class.  Their Happy Hour is also great.Why all this great value + high quality?  The Downtown Grand is a block off Fremont Street and is UNKNOWN to most of the public.  However, Nevada government workers, knowledgable airline crews, and savvy Vegas travellers all know about this place.  I've stayed here about a dozen times.  In July, I'll enjoy my lucky 13th stay!One caveat.  If you want a quiet room, request the Gallery Tower or the east side of the casino tower.

allReviews.title: Skip the Downtown Grand
allReviews.text: We have stayed here a few times. The only good part of staying here is the valet. I'm serious. No other redeeming quality. Rooms are very gross and dirty. If you want to be grossed out, bring a black light. You'll never stay here again. Whoever owns this place doesn't care about the quality of your stay. So if ownership doesn't care guess what, management certainly doesn't care. If I had to guess I'd bet the age of the manager of this hotel is between 28 and 35. Why do I say that? Because he or she doesn't know what they are doing. They probably were a business major at Devry University. They have no real world experience. And I would bet they wouldn't stay at this hotel if they had to. They are fully aware that the Downtown Grand is a joke. The sidewalk out front is cleaner than the hotel. I could go on about the individual problems and how it's dumb that the pool is only open until 4pm daily or that the employees and managers at the pool are incompetent lazy losers but I will end it with this, don't stay here. There are so many other places in Las Vegas to stay and that want your business. The Grand is a dumpster fire.The staff at the pool area are awful. The waitresses walk with an attitude and only serve certain people. The worst is the security people. If you move a piece of furniture they freak out. Seriously. Put your feet on the nasty gross furniture, they kick you out.

allReviews.title: Location is the only positive about this self service hotel!
allReviews.text: The best thing about this hotel is the location. I just returned from a 4 night stay with a group of 9 friends. Do not expect to have your room cleaned, garbage emptied, fresh towels,  or toilet paper. My group sent twice daily texts to at least replace towels and empty garbage. Nothing ever happened and 4 were staying in the suites! Finally, found a maids cart and got my own towels and tp.

allReviews.title: NOT pet-friendly - charges last minute fees with NO NOTICE - crooks!
allReviews.text: They give no notice of such in the booking information, but wait until check-in to tell you they charge a $75 pet fee at their "pet-friendly" hotel.  And the hotel is zero pet friendly with no place, concrete all round, to take your dog to potty.  So after long wait at check-in, you are forced to pay up because late at night and they have you by highway robbery.  They lost my casino and dining business though, and I moved the next day elsewhere, and will never go back.

allReviews.title: Worst Hotel experience in my 60 years
allReviews.text: I have stayed here multiple times over the years.  I like the size and the pool.  This however will be the last time that they get any of my money or business.   Further more I will steer anybody away from this place going forward.  I have been to Vegas more times than I know I booked a room directly through them.   They upgraded my room because of overbooking.  Great!! Or so I thought.   Later in the afternoon of my second of 2 nights there, I was contacted by them that they needed to go into my room because of some cooling problems.   I told them no problem.  That’s the last I heard from them.   A couple of hours later I got back to my room to find it was unbearably hot.   I called the front desk I got nowhere talking to the worker and she told me that I would have to come down there to talk to her manager.   I said there must be a better way to deal with this.  I was put on hold, then told I would have to change rooms but they would send a bellman to help and they would wave the second night of resort fees.  I said that I was meeting people for supper and there must be more that they could do.   Then the manager Alexa came on and that I was already in a room that I didn’t pay for (the upgrade for them overbooking). I explained to her that I didn’t want an upgrade, I simply wanted a room that was not unbearably hot.   She told me that that was all she could do She explained that the part that was needed to fix my AC was not available.   Again I explained to Alexa that that called me to enter my room, then knew that they couldn’t fix the problem, and then waited for me to call them back.Do not stay at this hotel!!Never again The Golden Nugget will be getting my money going forward

allReviews.title: A good clean hotel
allReviews.text: Other reviews have mentioned the excellent pillows and I absolutely agree.  As with many hotels, they don't do daily housekeeping but the app means that you can easily request your room to be serviced or other requests very easily.  We had a studio room on the 26 floor.  You can still hear the noise from Fremont street but it's very muffled and hardly the fault of the hotel.Really liked the idea of being able to purchase a continental type breakfast as its an easy way to start the day.The hotel is clean and tidy and the casino although small has plenty of options.  We found it quite nice to return to the oasis of calm of the DG casino after the madness of the strip and Fremont street.One or two of the bar staff could do with some urgent customer service training, but all of the others were lovely.  Big thanks to Jose on the front desk who patiently answered my many questions and was very reassuring.Apparently there was problems with the lifts during our stay and a few other guests mentioned this.  We had  no problems whatsoever so maybe it just happened at certain times of the day.We really enjoyed staying at the DG.  It may not be the best place to stay if you're a real party person.  But if your looking for a comfortable clean place to stay slightly away from Fremont but walkable in couple of minutes, the DG is a really solid hotel and we would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Don't expect to sleep!
allReviews.text: Don't come here on the weekend if you plan to sleep before 2 AM. I'm writing this as I sit in my hotel room which is rattling from the bass blasting from the pool deck several floors below. They have these big stupid pool parties on Friday and Saturday nights, apparently, which is never apparent from anything on their site/anything you'd find when booking a room. I specifically requested a room away from the noise--even offered to pay for an upgrade. They said my request was noted, yet here I am in the thunderdome. One decent little restaurant inside the hotel, and some of the newer rooms are cute enough, but this place is really giving trash energy. It's unfortunate, 'cause it could be a decent downtown spot. But right now, it's definitely way overpriced for the absolute apathy they show towards guests who want to get any sleep.

allReviews.title: Too noisy to sleep/Doors are unsafe
allReviews.text: Seriously the best pillows of any hotel I've stayed at, and I travel frequently.  Other than that, it was not a great experience. I was up half the first night due to a band on fremont that went until midnight that was so loud it was thumping on the 19th floor. The second night a pool party at the hotel pool bar also made it hard to sleep.  I specifically asked when I made the reservation if there was a quiet side and was told theyd never had a noise complaint unless there was a big event in town.  But the best part was getting two stitches and xrays after closing the ridiculously HEAVY door on my finger.  Absolutely no empathy or concern when I went to the front desk with a bloody hand. They literally said "go see security for a bandaid".

allReviews.title: NEVERAGAIN--SPRINKLER SYSTEM MALFUNCATION!
allReviews.text: We have stayed at Downtown Grand several times, and due to our recommendations, several of our friends choose this Hotel. Due to the experience and treatment we received on our last stay, I would NEVER recommend this hotel to anyone. Our third night of a 7 night stay, I was woken up by the fire sprinkler systems going off, ruining my phone, purse/contents and pretty much soaking everything by the bed and on the bed. When I reported this to the front desk, they sent up several security and manintence people. The only highlight of this experience was the head of security. He was awesome. That being said, they realized there must of been plumbing issues in the wall and due to their safety concerns (I did not want to move but was forced too) we were told we could not stay in that room and had to pack our things quickly, (my husband was in the shower at this time and was rushed out!). I did overhear at this time the bellman and Head of Security talking. I heard the Head of Security said "why are they being put in that room?" with a concerning voice. I have my suspicions we were getting dumped in the "slush" room. The room that has all kinds of things room and you just throw people in there to shut them up. I was absolutely right! The AC did not work, TV did not work, the soak tub had exposed wires (safety hazard right!). So sleeping in a 80 degree Vegas hotel is not very relaxing. So the next day I went to the front desk and ask for the manager to give me a call. I could not stay in a room like that. They said they would have manintence up, 5 hrs later NOTHING. No call from management, no AC, no TV. Went down again, pretty much got the rudest person ever, who rolled her eyes and said well the manager has other things and people to worry about. She will get to you when she can. She is very busy. After that, I left it up to my husband. He went down and told them you need to have her call me ASAP or my wife is going to loss it and we both do not want that. Finally after another 2 hrs, he gets a call from the manager. She takes him to the new room and told him she would make sure we were fully taken care of. Then check out comes, we go down and the clerk tells us, you only have to pay $176 for 1 lunch at the pool. I was like, I am good with that (we have witnesses to this as well!). She runs my card. Then proceeded to tell me, you still own $1900+ and proceeds to run my card without my permission as this is not what was discussed or agreed upon. We asked to speak to the manager. This is 11am, you would think the manager would be there. Apparently not! I deny the charge due to an alert on my phone from Chase. Then then LOCKS my account! No cc no way to access funds at all. We told the clerk we had to get to the plane and to have the MANAGER call us to discuss a fair price. I have reached out to her several times since and nothing, no reply. Now fast forward to June 8th, imagine my surprise to see $1300+ and a $176 charge from them on my account. This is absolutely not acceptable. We asked for a call to discuss a fair charge for what we incurred and was promised! So BEWARE of the place. We go to Vegas 3 times a year, to the point we know ALOT of workers at alot of hotels by name! We never expect anything for free but we also expected the accommodations to be livable and charges to be agreed upon. Neither of this happen at this hotel. We will make sure when we come for National Darts every, we tell every person we meet (theres 50,000 darters) to never set foot in this hotel!

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand Casino
allReviews.text: Get to Downtown Grand Hotel and Casino , a very good time and friendly dealers who really appreciates you being there - especially SAN , clean safe cozy casino that doesn't overwhelm you with it's size sights and sounds of the bigger properties.AND has $5  craps table and $1 blackjack....Probably spent 75% of my visit there dining , gaming and surrounding neighbors than my casino I booked  my stay at.

allReviews.title: Worst Experience Ever!!
allReviews.text: I do not recommend, I just had a white man walk in on me partially nude due to a mix up at the front desk. The manager on duty is terrible at her job, showed no sympathy whatsoever to a male walking in on me nude.

allReviews.title: I give this place an A all around
allReviews.text: The staff is so nice and super attentive and helpful. The hotel and casino are very cool and well maintained. We are staying in the gallery tower and we love the sleek colors and design. Our room is on the opposite side of the pool so it is very quiet.

allReviews.title: Don't you dare! Scary extra charges on our credit cards
allReviews.text: This hotel has a terrible mess with its accounting department. They not only charged us for the room, but they also added extra charges on our credit cards after check out. We had charges for over three times the actual room rate. At the front desk, where I returned to ask for explanations, a manager called Alex Flores (Manager of Hospitality, but not kind at all), was unable to explain to us what all those charges were, he promised he would find out and write back to us and I'm still waiting for his answer. At the front desk, I was obviously very upset, even more because of his hostile and unfriendly behavior. Our problem was not solved until almost two weeks later (when the charges were finally released). We had to send several emails to two of the managers in order to get our money back. The room was clean and confortable; no complaints, but I do not wish this horrible experience with the charges to anyone.

allReviews.title: It's like sleeping in a nightclub...
allReviews.text: The mattress was a thin, despicable excuse for a bed. One flat pillow each was very sad. The loud music came through paper thin walls and windows left us awake until 3am wondering how anyone could get any rest here. The staff is unorganized and management is rude. For $300 plus a night we were denied access to the pool at 9am opening due to a special event, and were expected to wait on a long line to go to the pool at 10am! We checked out a day early and found a much better hotel with an amazing pool and were able to get a good nights rest. I do not recommend this dump.

allReviews.title: Great hosts for PRB
allReviews.text: Clean room!  The staff were amazing.  Friendly, helpful, and welcoming. The casino staff was fun. The pool cabana offered the perfect shade and seating. Reasonably priced everything. Very convenient pick up and drop off for taxi and ride share. Plus, $1 blackjack and $5 min roulette. Might’ve been a special for the music festival, but was a great way to have fun in the air conditioning.

allReviews.title: The pool has no shade. Everything else is "meh."
allReviews.text: This was a very disappointing experience. My wife and I reserved the "City Suite King Bed Non-Smoking" for 4 nights, for ~$425/night. We encountered a number of issues with the hotel, mostly small, and each easily discounted: no coffee maker in the room, even though it's listed on the site, extraordinarily slow elevators (~2 minute wait), reallllly loud noise coming all the way to the 18th floor until 2am. But the motivation for the review is the pool. It sucks. It's really hard to understand the setup from the photos, and the photos are very misleading. Essentially, it's a small pool, edged on one side by a giant open area with chairs (the "free" area) and then surrounded with lounge chairs in partial shade (the "cabana" area; $300+ per day.)If you aren't willing to pay for it, there's no shade, of any kind, poolside. No umbrellas, even though they are in the photos. No overhangs. It's 95 degrees, 100% sunshine all day long. It goes without saying that there was no-one at the pool for most of our stay at all, except those sporting a massive red sunburn or willing to pay hundreds a day for what is only partially covered. We selected this hotel with the intent of sitting by the pool and working in the day, and exploring the city at night. The pool sitting wasn't happening, and there's pretty much no choice in downtown Vegas for a quiet area to work outside. I contacted the hotel for help with this. I received a half-baked "let me work on it" answer, with no response afterwards, from the same person that's been replying to everyone else's complaints about similar issues.We left a day early as a result of this.

allReviews.title: Perfect Downtown location, great service and value.
allReviews.text: Right in the heart of buzzing cool Downtown with big rooms, big views and my fave breakfast offering in the Art bar.  Staff were so accommodating as was a "big" birthday. Loved the gym and pool too - neither massive but clean and not far from the rooms.  Excellent value too.

allReviews.title: Sons 21st bday
allReviews.text: Really great hotel. Close to Fremont street and all the staff were so friendly. Cooper in self parking was so helpful in telling us things to do and history of downtown. A++ to Cooper on amazing customer service.

allReviews.title: When the fun stops
allReviews.text: Sometimes you want a staycation to be just like a vacation. You know, easy, convenient, and certainly hassle free.  It had been a while since I stayed here so I went to the cage soon after I arrived to see if my line of credit was still good and after 50 minutes and a few form signings I was told I was all set and everything was good to go.  Fast forward to the next afternoon when I tried to get a marker, but all I managed to get was a hefty dose of ineptitude and apathy as I waited for over an hour and counting. Were they calling the Federal Reserve for approval?  No, silly me, that wasn’t it,  I was finally told their system was down, but should be cleared soon, more waiting, another 20 minutes pass.  I now take out the little bit of cash I have to play and order a drink in the seat I’ve been squatting in for over an hour. People have birthed children in less time, but I digress.  Waitress comes by, I order a Manhatten, they don’t make those sort of drinks here, she says. WTF!?!  Finally some dude comes over to tell me my marker has a 24 hold until it’s cleared because of inactivity, his inertia and lack of trying to offer anything as a remedy to compensate for this fiasco was disappointing.  Even minimally it  would have been nice if they told me that the day before, before more hours of my time and effort slipped away needlessly.Fed up, I left to gamble, drink and dine elsewhere.  When I went back to my room hours later, it had not been cleaned, no water replenished, yada, yada, yada..I sense a trend.  I go back down to the cage to get my check in match play offer; printer not working. Way past the three strikes out of here zone I decide to ask for the contact info for their casino manager, because really, it’s enough. There is no casino manager I’m told, but should take this issue up with security.  Security, WTF!  Finally, I get the name and contact info for head of operations, but I decide to clarify that with the front desk, because I’m not willing to waste anymore hours in this all too Kafkaesque scenario. That woman gives me a…wait for it…a different person to contact.   Heavy sigh surprise to add to my can’t wait to see how that will play out as I keep my expectations to the only thing grand about this place is incompetence infused with a hearty dose of don’t give a F!  As for the rooms, basic, adequate, clean but worn. Don’t expect any nice touches or amenities and bring your own earplugs, you’re going to need them.

allReviews.title: Some Good, Some Bad...
allReviews.text: I had never stayed downtown before on my many trips to LAS.  We got a deal on rooms at the Downtown Grand by using a coupon supplied by the Las Vegas Advisor so we decided to try it.  First the good--good location if you want to be close to the action downtown.  One block from Fremont Street.  Rooms were basic but adequate.  The price was lower than the strip hotels where we usually stay.  Parking was free if you used the parking structure across the street.  Now the bad--the rooms were not soundproofed to the outside.  I could hear (and feel) the bands playing on Fremont--until 1:00am!  The solution was to turn on the air conditioning full blast.  That was so loud and noisy that it drowned out the outside noise.  Maid service was not provided unless you called the front desk, and then they only would "tidy" the room.  (This was not announced until we asked.)  If you wanted fresh towels you also had to call.  One reason we selected the hotel was that my friend is an early riser--he would be able to go to the casino while I slept late.  Problem--the small casino did not open (table games) until 11:00am, so that didn't work!  About the parking garage--yes it was across the street but if you drove in late in the evening you would have to park on an upper floor and one day the elevator (which had a faint aroma of urine) wasn't working.  And, of course the neighborhood is rather "rough" with panhandlers asking for money!  Finally, as I stated earlier, we used a coupon which reduced the price to the lowest available rate without a resort fee.  That was helpful but we kept getting different quotes regarding what the rooms would cost, so we weren't sure what we were going to pay!  Thus, our experience with this hotel was a mixed bag--not sure we would do it again!

allReviews.title: Good Casino
allReviews.text: Downtown Grand Casino is a good place to gamble on Freemont Street.  They have a lot of slot machines, and the staff very extremely friendly and helpful.  I had an issue with one of the machines and the staff immediately remedied my issue. I will visit again.

allReviews.title: Consistently amazing
allReviews.text: Amazing stay as always! We had the one bedroom suite and it was a gorgeous room that felt and smelled brand new.  Great service by everyone I encountered. Favorite hotel in downtown.  Machines were hot and the food was fantastic. Cannot wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Check in was easy with good folks at the check in desk.  Resort fee seems high.  There is no daily housekeeping service; it needs to be requested.  I did ask for more towels and they were brought quickly.  WiFi was good.  Room was on a higher floor and had a great view of the mountains. No coffee maker in room which was a downer.  No reason not to have a coffee maker unless you're trying to squeeze a few extra bucks out of your guests.  Did play some $1.00 21 and made a few bucks (but was betting more than $1). No Jacks or better video poker.  Downtown casinos seem to be removing that game which is a big shame. Parking was included in resort fee.

allReviews.title: Great location, Clean!!
allReviews.text: Was here in April with friends, stayed for one evening.Overall, a great time, very clean overall, great rooms!!The only “bad” issues were, when checking in, there was a line like any hotel on a Friday evening, so I went to the self check-in kiosks that were available. Unfortunately, it froze twice on me, but when trying to start over it gave me two different prices that was still owed for my room! Other guest standing next to me trying with theirs had trouble as well.
