allReviews.title: SID'S CAFE MANAGER TIARA THE BEST!!
allReviews.text: Excellent trip to Westgate Las Vegas! Great Property, Great Dining & Excellent Service Staff! While all my trips to WGLV have been fantastic, I felt it necessary to write this review due to one specific situation involving a specific WGLV staff member, Ms. Tiara of Sid's Cafe! One of the highlights of my trips to WGLV is weekend breakfast at Sid's and specifically their Buttermilk Pancakes (out of this world delicious)! The specific situation on my most recent trip visiting Vegas from Arizona began by going to Sid's this particular weekend for breakfast and indeed ordering (as usual) pancakes, however upon doing so my server informed me that pancakes were not available as they were only serving a "limited" breakfast menu. I mentioned to the server that I have always ordered the pancakes at Sid's and they were always available on the menu, and I was perplexed about what had changed. The server informed me that many breakfast items were no longer made available after 11am and only a few breakfast items could be ordered after 11am. I asked the server if there was any way an exception could be made and the server proceeded to inform me that he would ask. He then came back to my table to tell me the kitchen said no. Upon hearing this disappointing information, Ms. Tiara (the  Manager) came over to my table to inquire about the ability to assist. Upon speaking with Tiara and explaining the situation to her, she went into the kitchen to address this situation. Ms. Tiara came back to my table after a brief visit to the kitchen and informed me that a Hot fresh order of pancakes were being prepared in the kitchen and would soon be on their way to my table. A few minutes later a hot fresh stack of buttermilk pancakes were brought to my table for what turned out to be the BEST BREAKFAST EVER! Ms. Tiara is simply Professionalism Personified! Ms. Tiara's actions turned a disappointing situation into a professional opportunity to completely turn around a situation of disappointment into one of great pleasure and appreciation! Ms. Tiara is exactly what a management level employee in a hospitality setting should be, Professional, accommodating, courteous and going the extra mile for the guest! A big THANK YOU to Ms. Tiara!! WGLV Management, I have two STRONG Recommendations/Suggestions for you.... First, place the Pancakes back on the all day dining menu (you're in a Las Vegas market where people eat breakfast all hours of the day) and second, acknowledge Ms. Tiara's efforts at Sid's! People like her are hard to come by and are Difference Makers!!

allReviews.title: Manilow was awesome and our seats were too, thanks to a generous usher!!!
allReviews.text: We went to the Westgate to hear Barry Manilow in concert one last time for my 65th birthday. Joseph B., an usher asked us if we would be interested in exchanging tickets from our nose bleed seats to the 3rd row. We thought it was a joke until he asked us to follow him. He gave us tickets in the 3rd row and we had an unbelievable night that we will never forget. Barry was Wesson’s so were our seats. Thank you Joseph!!!!

allReviews.title: Westgate Resort- A classic Las Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: The Westgate Resort is a classic! Conveniently located on the monorail line it is a quick and reasonable way to explore the entire strip. We have stayed here at least 3 times and have never been disappointed. It is also a great place to hold an event. The Vegas Acro Cup has been held here numerous times, I am sure we will be back.

allReviews.title: Alisa D thoughtfulness!! International Theatre
allReviews.text: Got an amazing and welcome surprise when Alisa D, in Entertainment dept at the International Theatre, picked us from the back balcony seats for the Barry Manilow show and gave us 6th row to see the legend up close! Thank you for your thoughtfulness and kindnessWhat a show!! Paul

allReviews.title: What a beautiful casino!
allReviews.text: We came to Westgate to see Barry Manilow. The casino is so nice, clean, and they have live music. It doesn’t smell like cigarettes, just lovey. The theater is beautiful, Valarie, an usher with entertainment department, hooked us up fantastic seats! What a friendly yet professional woman. The drink prices were very reasonable. Next time I come to Vegas I am definitely staying at Westgate. I really liked it.  Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Four stars! Michael is awesome. I look forward to seeing him again!
allReviews.text: Michael Speaks rules! I've never heard anyone sound like Michael McDonald. Michael is awesome. I can't wait to see him again! If I ran the Westgate, Michael would play at the Westgate every weekend! The variety is Bar none. We must have him here weekly. I'm telling all my friends

allReviews.title: BEST team members at Westgate
allReviews.text: I was in the owner lounge. And had the amazing team members Aida and Rosita they made sure I had everything I need happy hour was amazing if you stop by the lounge go see Aida and Rosita they will not disappoint they was very reliable and pleasant.

allReviews.title: Must stay!
allReviews.text: We are never disappointed with the Westgate!  From being greeted by Mr. Westgate (Jose) to Mary our host.  The entire hotel and casino is so sparkling clean and the rooms are great.  We totally enjoyed our stay!  We have stayed here a few times before and will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: They jumped on the nickel and dime our customers to death bandwagon
allReviews.text: This resort has always been a 5 for me, but no more. They now CHARGE for parking which I am so against since I spend a lot of money in the casino. How dare them nickel and dime their customers like this.  This was pretty much the only casino on the strip that felt a little like old vegas. I will now drive a few miles down the strip to another casino which DOES NOT charge to park and still feels like old vegas (not going to mention their name).  Boo Westgate.

allReviews.title: Dated overpriced hotel and food.
allReviews.text: The hotel is dated and feels dirty. When I checked into my room, there was a plastic wrapper and clothing tab that wasn’t cleared during cleaning.This is also a high sales place, there are many employees who are tying to get you to do their timeshare presentation with an offer of a free breakfast.Then if you’re in the north tower you pass by two stores, Soap Sanctuary and an electronics store and their sales people are aggressive. After a long day at the conference I felt anxiety getting to my room. I got lured into the soap store because I wanted a soap. I was quickly ushered in by a sales person who gave me this serum for my under eyes. The product didn’t blend, and cakes right off as soon as you touch it. The salesperson wanted to sell me a two year supply for over $200. he said that this is about 1/2 what it usually costs. I tried to get out of the seat and told him I’d be back. He said that the sale ended at 3 pm that day. I asked him if that was the time he gets off work. Then he said let me check something and came back to say that he would hook me up by selling me the 2 year supply for the cost of a one year supply.The taco restaurant wasn’t great (the street tacos were greasy and cheesy) and the food I ate at the conference was average at best. I sat in the Japanese sushi place and waited over 5 mins before I summoned a server over who told me that he’d get my server. After another 5 mins  a server came, didn’t greet me or even make eye contact put a glass of water next to me and left. At that point I left too.  They don’t have a designated food delivery place. Usually at the hotels I’ve been too, there is a table where the drivers can leave the food. I had to go downstairs and meet my driver and he was at a different entrance and finally left my food on a random table and by the time I got to the door on the opposite side of where I was waiting, someone had taken my food.Additionally, the only friendly employee that I came across was our roulette dealer, Barry, everyone else just seemed annoyed and when I asked for directions the person just pointed and didn’t say a word.The best part was the Soul of Motown review. Such a fun show.

allReviews.title: False Advertising
allReviews.text: This was complete false advertising for March Madness tickets - this was NOT for tickets in the Sportsbook.  Nowhere on the webpage did it mention that it was going to be in the movie theater (that was depressing and horrible).  It was awful - we did not stay. I spoke to someone working and they agreed that we were bamboozled - I tried to get my money back but it hasn't happened.

allReviews.title: High Octane Performance!
allReviews.text: This band is the best. The lead singer is totally great. Bass player was very consistent. High Octane is a suitable name, because they really bring the energy! Every song is a banger, and the lead singer is totally great. Holy moly I had so much fun.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow at the Westgate Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Carolyn Leslie with the Barry Manilow team was absolutely amazing!!!!  She helps us get settled with our seats and offered additional assistance if needed ( my son has autism).  I would highly recommend visiting Westgate and going to the Barry Manilow concert - you will be so glad you did!!

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Valarie in Entertainment Manilow she’s friendless and accommodating. Enjoying Barry concert  she help us locate our chair and inform us the amenities of the hotels. My family enjoyed the show they here  visiting all the way for Philippines

allReviews.title: Wonderful staff, ease of access
allReviews.text: Everything was awesome! Only reason for 4 stars was one set of bedsheets were visibly dirty, and the tub had rust and hard water stains aka cleaning standards are what you pay for. Personal shout out to Tyler T at the front desk, he was extremely helpful and insightful on accommodations and random cool Vegas/hotel facts.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Westgate
allReviews.text: I love staying at the Westgate when I travel for work.  It is close to the convention center (walking distance), if I want to go to the strip I can use the Monorail, take an taxi/Uber/Lyft.  But they have great restaurants, a nice pool right in property.  The biggest x factor for me, is the staff.  They are just really nice and helpful.  It is about the people for me!

allReviews.title: Sports book at the Westgate
allReviews.text: The best sports book in Vegas. Great atmosphere for betting and watching sports. All the people working the betting windows were helpful and friendly especially Robert L. I was there for March Madness and the place was electric. I would definitely make this a stop  if you are visiting Vegas.

allReviews.title: Perfect place to stay with family and friends
allReviews.text: I highly recommend staying at the Westgate. Housekeeping was very attentive  with any amenities we needed.  Our room was perfectly cleaned. The rooms are very spacious, great views from our window. Had lots of fun at the casino. Thank you for having us.

allReviews.title: There are better places to stay, eat and gamble.
allReviews.text: The parking garage isn't operated by the hotel and it is an absolute nightmare. Trying to ask the front desk how it works is usually met with uncertainty or apprehension about giving any information out.The front desk is hit or miss, some people i spoke to were incredibly helpful and some were rude. Good luck trying to get a straight answer out of anyone, it's nearly impossible.If you're waiting to check in, you will be offered a "free" breakfast or lunch. Don't talk to these people. I asked what was the catch, he said nothing and brought me to a customer service desk. After about 30 seconds, the lady mentioned a time share showing and I immediately mentioned that time was told there wasn't a catch. Our friends got roped into the "90" minute presentation that lasted nearly 5 hours. They had a better chance of escaping the temple of doom than getting out of the meeting with their promised stuff.The room wasn't too bad, and the rest of the staff were nice.Based on the parking, front desk, and the lying piece of garbage from their time share dept, I won't return. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

allReviews.title: The main thing that ruined our stay at this hotel were the predators that constantly bully you in to buying a timeshare.
allReviews.text: The main thing that ruined our stay at this hotel were the predators that constantly bully you in to buying a timeshare.

allReviews.title: Great service!!!
allReviews.text: There were multiple examples of great service. Beginning with our shuttle driver Edmond S, went above and beyond to make sure our trip to the strip was convenient and easy. Then our server at drafts made sure our meal met our expectations. The front desk accomdated us with an easy room switch when we changed the number of guests we had. Everything showed that we are valued as customers

allReviews.title: We enjoy the band JAMIT!!!!
allReviews.text: I have family and friends come to visit me in Vegas all the time and I always make a point to come to Westgate with them to have dinner, gamble a bit and listen to the band called JAMIT!! JAMIT plays music for all and we end up dancing and partying the whole night!!

allReviews.title: Joe in Entertainment ❤️
allReviews.text: Joe B in entertainment was the BEST!!!!! We had such a great experience because of him. He made my mom’s birthday one we will never forget. He was pleasant and accommodating and helped to make it the best time. We will always remember this night. Thanks, Joe!!!

allReviews.title: What a great way to start!
allReviews.text: This review is being done prior to Barry’s performance.  Though relatively filled, there were still some empty seats in the front.  When we purchased, it showed most of the seats closed but I was able to get some decent seats in Row V.  Before the start, some people were being moved so my daughter and I asked an usher who was Jonathan B., and he took care of our family of 3 by relocating us to Row G.  Needless to say, my wife was extremely happy as the reason we flew to Vegas was to see Barry perform.  He’s my wife’s all-time favorite singer.  In fact, I even brought down a Barry Manilow impersonator from FL to perform at our wedding at Turtle Bay on the North Shore 18 years ago.  Aloha and Mahalo from Honolulu!  Thanks again, Jonathan B., for taking care of Barry’s guests!

allReviews.title: Great place for families.
allReviews.text: Enjoyed the Westgate. Very convenient location since it had a parking garage and monorail attached to it. Rooms were very comfortable and clean. Staff was very friendly as well. The dining options were really good as well, especially the pub style food in the sports area.

allReviews.title: Race Book was short Staffed but a teller saved the day.
allReviews.text: Spent a few days in the racebook and was shocked they only had 2 tellers taking horse racing bets.  It all worked out thanks to Tiffany Newport a teller in the sportsbook.  She took all my last seconds to post bets with a big smile and great personality.  Hopefully next year whoever is in charge will add another teller  during mach madness time.

allReviews.title: Vocals!
allReviews.text: Amazing show, sang all classics! Great backup singers and visuals. Voice was spot on! Service to get into show was good, drinks were a bit pricey but we only had 1 and that lasted us just fine! Looks were great also! Overall a great show and would recommend to families, couples and friends!

allReviews.title: Valerie
allReviews.text: We went to see Barry Manilow.Other than the concert started about 20 minutes late. It was a pretty good concert. It was fun to see him and the band was fantastic.What I really wanted to write about was Valerie.Valerie in the showroom was so nice and helpful. We just had to write and single her out. She is a keeper!

allReviews.title: FUN! Wednesday night got down
allReviews.text: FUN! Coolest duo in town. They brought the VIBES forsure! Especially for a Wednesday night. But regardless of the night, a must come back for! Stevie Wonder, Earth Wind & Fire, SteelyDan, Tower of Power, WAR. The two of them using the Congas, Flute, violin, Sax... DOPE! SanJose,Ca in the house . Lol

allReviews.title: Westgate
allReviews.text: I really do not like the experience I had in the hotel, though I had a nice time but the services were far from professional. Honestly speaking I want rating of five star hotel because of the experience I had and also the services being rendered at the hotel

allReviews.title: Westgate wedding week
allReviews.text: The Vip (Westgate Club) room is awesome Antonia and Rizalda are awesome. They are friendly and fun to talk to. We enjoy the snacks and breakfast and the wine and the beer and cheese and crackers on the weekend. If your a Westgate owner the VIP room is a must.

The hotel bed was very comfortable but the hotel itself is a bit worn out.  Clean.   The pool was very nice and there were plenty of lounge chairs.  Music at the pool is too loud but not awful.   My room supposedly had a Strip View but it wasn't really.   The room also had a connecting door.

allReviews.title: Best sports book in Vegas!!!
allReviews.text: The best sports book experience in Vegas! March Madness games were a hit to watch here. You have to meet Rolando who is an absolute superstar bartender!!! He is very attentive and full of positive energy. A must go to spot for live games, great atmosphere and a lively crowd.

allReviews.title: Fun filled audience participation and dancing experience
allReviews.text: The Motown show was spectacular...a MUST see!!! The singing and dancing had me grooving during the entire show. I was actually amazed by the extraordinary singing talent, as well as the dancing talent. While I was impressed by the songs they performed of various artists, my favorite was the Temptations songs...oh, those dance moves!!!!

allReviews.title: Largest Sportsbook with the least amount of sports
allReviews.text: Atrocious. Have been coming here every year for opening weekend of March Madness. Paid extra to watch games yet they can’t air any women’s MARCH MADNESS games while having three TV’s air the same game. Waste of time and money.  I think I’ll look elsewhere next year. March madness is the time for both men’s and WOMEN’S basketball.

allReviews.title: Westgate sportsbook
allReviews.text: Tiffany Newport in the sports/race book is awesome. She has a positive energy that makes us seek her out. Tremendous employee who represents the Westgate so well. We’ve been coming to the Westgate for 10 years and it’s starting to show its age but the experience is still thumbs up.

allReviews.title: Always an enjoyable trip to the Westgate.
allReviews.text: The rooms and casino are always clean, the employees are great, and the facility is safe and fun. The restaurants are exceptional! The televisions in the sports book are huge. There seems to be many frequent jackpots being paid out on the casino floor so what more could you ask for.

allReviews.title: Great staff, large resort
allReviews.text: Nathan, the floor manager of the casino was AMAZING - great service and advice for every machine. Really took the time to make my group feel safe and welcomed, same with his coworker Michelle. Sylvia was a cocktail server aswell. Lyndsie who bartended at sportsbook was also great.

allReviews.title: Great house band!!!
allReviews.text: I was walking thru the casino and heard the band High Octane playing - I came over to see and sat here for the next 4 hours!!!  Kara could sing any song we requested, the band was amazing! I would definitely come see them play every Thursday!!! It was a great time really awesome to stumble upon a really great house band I’ll be back for sure. Go check them out!!!

allReviews.title: Great Entertainment and Restaurants, but hotel room staff DO BETTER! Never again!
allReviews.text: I was looking forward to this hotel, and I was a huge let down ! I enjoyed all the entertainment , casino, and the food ,  but the hotel stay was awful . My husband was playing in a pool tournament and they had rooms discounted for us so I chose for that reason. It is  worth visiting for the Elvis statue , his artifacts and memorabilia, the casino is nice and the diner is really good and affordable . We also enjoyed Benihana’s one night . The entertainment  staff went over and beyond on our international theatre tour and we saw the show the next night and I HIGHLY recommend the Elvis show at Westgate !! Best we have seen in Vegas and you can see very close . Great bar and snacks too!    Now for the bad.  The hotel stay! We arrive late at night  around 10 pm and no welcome , no hotel info , very rude front desk staff. I have never felt so unwelcome in my life at a hotel!  I asked what we can eat.. the response from the front desk girl, “ oh nothing is open this late after 10 but a salad  sitting over there at the deli you can grab. No smiles , no greeting of any kind by the front desk ! They did not seem to want to be there at ALL or want us there . Then every question I asked they had NO INFO or knew what I was talking about when it was all on the website and I just needed more info on some of the hotel . She acted like I was stupid everytime I asked a question . Then they would send me over to the annoying time share people who would not stop every-time we passed to go to the elevator with ,” do you want a free breakfast? “ We were on a tight schedule for pool at Rio and had no time for that everyday all day! No, I  do not want a share of a hotel with such rude  staff! Then we got to the room.. it was clean , but bathtub was old and not remodeled . It had stains . The worse was the SINK COUNTER! The sink was just above my knees, mid thigh !!!! It was SO SHORT !! Very hard to brush our teeth or use the water !   It was not a handicapped room!! We asked several front desk to confirm it was not .  When we told the girl , she acted like she did not believe us and said I’ll send a guy up there . The guy never showed and we were starving from traveling all day so didn’t want to wait anymore . So then we tell a front desk guy.  We tell him we are not waiting anymore longer for this guy and what is he going to do anyways? He NEVER makes eye contact with us , does not apologize  , never offers another room, did nothing but type on the computer and as we described how low the sink was  with a picture ,he just says ,” oh that’s our standard sink .” Still no eye contact or care or concern! So we decide to just put up with it for 5 days! I have stayed in hotels for 48 years and NEVER have I seen a sink that low except in a PRE K room!!  That is NOT STANDARD! The hotel is not an idea location either .  Our room also was not cleaned each day when we would come back late was up setting .  We would ask each day for it to be cleaned and towels restocked . I even left messages on the maid service  lineand called the front , but everyday came back to no towels or a clean room. My husband was showering and I kept begging the maid for more towels , but he just kept saying 5 min , I do not speak English. He could see I was asking for a  towel now cz my husband was having a nose bleed and kept saying 5 min I do not speak English . UGG! I finally had to say firmly we need a towel  NOW!   He hands me a WASH CLOTH! Then wants to clean when we were trying to get ready for dinner !! So frustrating !! So yes, I would visit if you love Elvis and do the theatre tour, the great Elvis show (The Elvis is amazing ! ) , and see all the Elvis things,  but never will I stay here AGAIN!  Besides food and entertainment staff , HUGE LET DOWN!

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: Dated hotel, smokey lobby. Takes FOREVER for front desk to answer phono. Nice staff. Food is absolute worst, in terms of pizza and chicken. Good fitness room, and great having strip monorail station on site. Mold in shower tub.  Needs modernized and hotter cocktail server staff.

allReviews.title: As above. Great fitness center, good live music, smoke-free would be fantastic!
allReviews.text: Nice experience! Wish there wasn’t smoking in the casino, but food was good. Especially liked Fresco Italiano!  Favorite part of the hotel was the live music in the evenings- great bands, tons of fun!!Otherwise, surprisingly good fitness center- appreciated the yoga mats and fresh crisp water!Easily top band was High Octane!!! Such a groovy crew- thanks for an amazing night Kara!

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: Great accommodation, very comfortable!!We only had one negative point, at the reception , the luggage managers should be able to speak another language besides English, Spanish for example, were very rude for not being able to speak English fluently!!

allReviews.title: Our first trip to Vegas was wonderful with the help of Westgate Resorts!
allReviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our birthdays with a first ever trip to Vegas and chose to stay at the Westgate Resort.  This i resort popped up on my FB page with an offer I couldn't refuse.  I know it was a timeshare tour but, for that price, I was willing to give up two hours of my time.  The Resort did not disappoint.  Our room was on the 18th floor, and we could see the beautiful Vegas skyline.  We also had a great view of the Sphere and all its splendor.  Our room amenities were wonderful.  The room was large and spacious with two double beds (just in case I got tired of hubby) that I practically had to jump my 5'2" stature into.  Refrigerator, coffee pot, desk, TV, nothing elaborate.  But, on the tour they showed us their top-of-the-line beautiful accommodations.  We won over $2k within minutes of being there so we treated ourselves to the $30 brunch buffet.  Great food but, a waste for us.  We were tired and couldn't eat $60 worth of food.All in all, the resort is top notch.  Easy access to public transportation, close to other resorts (if you're a walker) and great entertainment and restaurants.

allReviews.title: Terrible hotel!!!
allReviews.text: Terrible hotel service!!!This hotel threatened to kick me out, I’m pregnant, because of a $210 bill after I paid $1000 for 5 nights. They have zero compassion!! Stay away! We’ve spent thousands and my credit card was frauded so the bank locked all my cards until tomorrow. They won’t even wait until tomorrow for payment!

allReviews.title: Couple get away
allReviews.text: We always love our stay at Westgate. We have made several friends and enjoy seeing them when we arrive. Mr. Westgate is always such a joy and so helpful. Our Host David always has gone above and beyond to make sure we are taken care of. The staff is great and the place is always clean

allReviews.title: It was a great experience.
allReviews.text: We had a great time here at Westgate. We had dinner at The Court Snack Bar. Tsega welcomed us and made our experience better. She was very helpful and accommodating. We will definitely come back and maybe try something different like the concerts.

allReviews.title: Westgate Las Vegas- go see Jimmy!
allReviews.text: We attended Dice Tower West 2025.The hotel was great. BIG shout out to Jimmy the doorman- he’s definitely keeping the old school Las Vegas level of service alive!We loved the Elvis memorabilia.Benihana and the Fresh Buffet were our favorite dining experiences.

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay at the Westgate
allReviews.text: Great place to stay had a great time at the Elvis the king comes home tribute show, dinner which was fantastic at the Edge steakhouse and service from Bobby was fantastic followed by amazing service and cocktails at the international lounge with both beverage servers Gustavo and Ray Ratsdakltom who were both amazing! Great experience and would definitely go back!

allReviews.title: I walked in and was greeted with a smile and a very kind welcome from every staff member.
allReviews.text: The whole experience was amazing and having Tyler T at the front desk to set the pace for amazing service made the trip better. For my first time in Vegas &Westgate I was super pleased ! I can’t wait till my next trip and hopefully I’ll be greater with the same energy !

allReviews.title: It was the Soul of Motown!!!
allReviews.text: Soul of Motown had great vocalists, great energy and had us laughing at some points!  With everyone singing along, it was like we were all part of the show!  We were up, singing and dancing right along with the performers!  It felt like we were going down memory lane with friends. Great atmosphere, it was wonderful way to spend the evening!

allReviews.title: Amazing show very well run and fun! Valerie in the showroom was great. Barry is a tremendous talent!
allReviews.text: Never saw Barry Manilow live. You will not believe how many songs you forgot that he sang. They WILL make you happy. It is a must see & must do! My wife and I really enjoyed ourselves. Hospitality of everyone that worked at Westgate was next level five stars for sure.

allReviews.title: Great time at Westgate
allReviews.text: If Dre were running for public office I’d vote for him. Best Front Desk check in , I want to say that the experience was smooth and the staff professional. Anything I needed was a phone call away. If you are ever in town for an event at the los Vegas convention center, the Westgate is a no brainer.

allReviews.title: Fun time!
allReviews.text: We have a fun time at Soul of Motown. Smaller venue so all good seats. The show is about an hour and 15 minutes. They go through the decades with the songs. Lots of fun and dancing. Performers do a great job and production was good. Fun to go as a couple or with friends!

allReviews.title: Stayed for 3 days
allReviews.text: Westgate Resort & Casino is a great spot! Loved the $10 blackjack tables and the fun atmosphere. Betty, the cocktail waitress, was amazing—fast, friendly, and always smiling. Can’t wait to come back!My only complaint is that the rooms feel extremely dry so bring a humidifier if you have one.

allReviews.title: I missed a certain news channel
allReviews.text: Room was large and clean. Blankets were very thin, but the comfortable large king bed was a plus. Toilet was not working, overflowed. We put in a call, and they fixed it while we were out for the day. We were not allowed to watch Fox News here. The channel assigned to it would change to a different channel number when attempted. Fox News not also not available when going through the channel list one-by-one.  CNN and MSNBC were perfectly functional, though. Hmmm.

allReviews.title: High Octane rocks!
allReviews.text: This band gave such a high energy performance and has so much talent! My favorite song that Kara sang was Shania Twain's "Man! I Feel Like a Woman". Superb vocal range had the place rocking! It's too bad that bass player was missing though. Would've added another dimension and made sush an amazing show even better!

allReviews.title: the service continues to improve
allReviews.text: WOW My wife and I left Vermont on a Tuesday to hopefully be a bit warmer and everything was warmer /weather ok but all of the service at Westgate was top notch. The Westgate Resort/ Casino has reached a new level  check-in super room service wonderful food court  excellent restaurants superb (The Edge especially) floor people very friendly . I could go on and on If you haven't been here for a while you need to go now.

allReviews.title: “Mr Westgate” Jose !!
allReviews.text: I met Jose “Mr Westgate” in the lobby , what a fantastic guy he was , he showed me so many gems in the hotel of the great Elvis Presley and took a lot time with me , he answered many of my questions and was very welcoming , being a huge Elvis fan I couldn’t believe when Jose introduced me to Elvis Presley’s step brother who I had a lovely chat with !! Mr Westgate I thank you again ! A* service !!Charlie

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown - great show!
allReviews.text: We loved the Soul of Motown show. Family friendly and appropriate for all ages. It was a real trip down memory lane! The performance was very entertaining and interactive. They had us up and dancing to the music! The performers' vocal range was impressive. Loved it!

allReviews.title: International  bar-michael  speaks
allReviews.text: Heard of this artist and came to see his show. This is one of my everlasting experiences. Show started onbtime and was not disappointed. I danced with my wife then my daughter then a stranger on the floor came over to join the group. I enjoyed and good

allReviews.title: Michael speaks - international lounge
allReviews.text: Michael speaks!!! Not sure what to say. Came out to the Westgate on a random Wednesday night and ran into an unbelievable performer. Boy did he command the stage!!!  The voice, was one of kind. Truly a memorable vegas night. Glad we came out!! Talented

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Concert
allReviews.text: My wife is a huge Barry Manilow fan, and we’ve seen him perform in several different locations. We’ve had the pleasure of seeing him at the Westgate Las Vegas resort and Casino several times, but this recent concert was one of the best! The reason why it was the best, was because of one particular Usher.  Laura Nelson was our private guide for a VIP gold Barry Manilow experience. It started prior to his concert, and included a backstage Tour that included pictures and historical commentary about Barry Manilow and the venue.Laura Nelson is by far the most perfect and professional usher/guide that I’ve ever met. Her passion for the history of the performer and venue is unmatched.The Westgate Las Vegas resort and Casino, and Barry Manilow should be congratulated that they have such a professional and enthusiastic person working on their behalf. Laura made this concert extremely special and I encourage anyone that’s visiting the Westgate Las Vegas hotel and casino to make sure the Barry Manilow is on their list. And if you do so, make sure you seek out Laura Nelson because she is spectacular!

allReviews.title: Great overnight stay!
allReviews.text: Pros: Clean hotel and casino, very friendly staff, spacious room, great amenities! Hotel parking was great with in and out privileges and flat daily rate. Bed was very comfortable.  Breakfast was good at Sid's Cafe in the lobby. Con: can't think of any.

allReviews.title: Tyler T. is awesome!
allReviews.text: Tyler T. checked me in at the registration desk and kicked off my excellent stay! He was friendly, professional, courteous, and kind. l really enjoyed my large room with a view of the sphere and the bed was super comfy. I booked with a third party so got a suberb price. I’m pleased

allReviews.title: Had to see a show in Vegas and need something reasonable
allReviews.text: First time at this hotel. Ample parking deck (10$)/day. Big open first floor with storefronts , nice size casino area, many different restaurants, they even had a three bout boxing fight in the auditorium that night. The tram picks up on the grounds. Clean, easy , nice hotel with big rooms. The beds are med/soft with soft pillows. The rooms can be a bit cold from the ac not getting hot, just call room service and have them adjust ac. The food can be a bit pricey but I’m sure that’s true of most hotel in Vegas.  For the price it’s a perfect hotel off the strip. Will return to this hotel when back in Vegas

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: It was a great experience overall. There was a guy named Tyler T. Who assisted me at the front desk and accommodated me with a very nice room. My two night stay went very well. I would definitely stay at Westgate hotel again as it’s right off the strip and convenient and easy to get around.

allReviews.title: Spectacular show. Every note, every song was on point. Her backup singers was such a hit!!! I love every moment of the s
allReviews.text: Spectacular show. Every note, every song was on point. Her backup singers was such a hit!!! I love every moment of the s

allReviews.title: Lounge Band High Octane
allReviews.text: Just spent the past week in Vegas and enjoyed the Westgate very much. We wanted to specifically comment on the bands in the lounge. Although all of the performances were good, the band High Octane was especially strong. The female singer is exceptional and they had excellent energy through out the show. The singer was kind enough to pose for pics with our group and we appreciated that.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: Soul of Motown brings energy, talent, and those hits you want to dance, groove, and reminisce to!  By far the best Soul tribute in town!  A special shout out to our usher who took special care of us as did all the staff!  Sean Godfrey thank you so much for your generosity on top of your amazing vocals and arrangements.  What a night!

allReviews.title: Concert at the Westgate Casino/
allReviews.text: Went to see Stephanie Mills concert. The drinks were great. The concert area had good sound and the seat were located to view the stage well.Then we played in the casino and had some pizza in the food area. They had free parking which made a big difference.

allReviews.title: High Octane Band boosts your spirits
allReviews.text: I returned from my business travel to LV. I'm still singing the band's songlist in my head. This is one of favorite stops when in town. Since Formula 1 racing, it seems ALL costs have spiked. This is still a band you see for $0 cover at Westgate Lobby Bar on Thursday nights while enjoying your favorite cocktail.  It is packed with fans, fun and energy.  Kara’s singing is nothing short of captivating—her voice is both powerful and infectious. She is truly a gem. Backed by a group of incredibly talented musicians, they seamlessly blend their vocals and explore various music genres with brilliance. This band has consistently earned top rankings from locals over the years. The locals definitely know what's great! Be sure to make it a part of your stay before you head home.

allReviews.title: Happy hour is the best!
allReviews.text: Love the happy hour @ the Westgate club. A nice touch. Bring back those 5 days a week. Rooms are lovely, staff are exceptional. Nice to be away from all the hustle and bustle of the main strip. Shout out to Aida and Rosita, excellent service!!Will be back again soon for sure

allReviews.title: Westgate Club Happy Hour
allReviews.text: Really enjoyed the happy hour in the Westgate Club. Nice treat for owners. Aida and Rosha were wonderful hostesses. Would like to see it continued for the entire week instead of just weekends. It’s also nice to have a place to go for coffee and water or soda during the day.

allReviews.title: Zero housekeeping, poor front desk experience, but beautiful room
allReviews.text: My room was one of the updated rooms and it was lovely and well-appointed. The mountain view each morning was incredible. The access to the Convention Center via The Tesla Loop was a terrific bonus.Where my stay fell short was with housekeeping and front desk customer service.I was there from Monday-Friday and didn't receive housekeeping services my entire stay. Because I was there for a very busy work trip, I didn't make it back to the room until after 8:00 each night. Each night, I was disappointed to not have fresh towels, fresh toiletries, a made bed, and trash removed. Because it was late (in one case past midnight) and I was tired and didn't want to deal with it, I didn't call down for housekeeping. I was always hopeful it would be resolved the next day, then was disappointed when it was not. I even double checked to make certain my Do Not Disturb hanger wasn't out.Upon check-out on Friday, when the Front Desk Agent asked me about my stay, I let her know the situation. I framed it as, "I don't usually make complaints and I'm not expecting anything, but I wanted to let you know so future guests have a better experience."  The agent immediately got prickly and said that housekeeping is available only by request (that is not true, my coworkers had daily housekeeping). She said if I wanted housekeeping, I should have called each day to request it. Her answer was very frustrating and terribly delivered. This isn't a Hampton Inn. This is a full-service hotel with a $45 resort fee. Daily housekeeping is an expected service that I shouldn't have to beg for each night.My company had over 50 rooms at this hotel for a week's stay. I'll request they book elsewhere for future events.

allReviews.title: Experience at Westgate resort casino Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I’m a owner and I love westgate experience every time. The Westgate Las Vegas Resort Casino is incredible. The employees at the owners lounge are the best, especially Antonia and Rizalda in house greeter that are really nice and helpy. I recommend!

allReviews.title: good experience
allReviews.text: john s. took photos for us he was very nice rooms are beautiful, clean tooeveryone’s happy and friendly not too crowded and parking was easy, don’t like that u have to pay but that’s normal now lolumm overall good experience would recommend!

allReviews.title: Friends.Fanilows.Forever.
allReviews.text: We had a girls’ Fanilow weekend Thursday to Saturday and so enjoyed our stay in the Celebrity Club Suite!!  The suite was totally sweet!!  Loved the vibrant colors and art work.  Very comfortable, clean, and fabulous views.  Wow!  I might even say, “BOW WOW!!”  We had a wonderful dinner at Fresco Italiano (Andrea, our server, is awesome) and terrific breakfast at Sid’s the day of the concert.  It was a short but memorable stay.  The four of us haven’t been together in 9 years and the last time in Las Vegas was 20 years ago this year, seeing Barry here, then known as the Las Vegas Hilton.Leaving Saturday morning, Jimmy helped us with a cab. Jimmy is a true gem— so friendly, kind, and helpful.  And yes, Jimmy, you DID get us the best cab driver—Berne was a gem, too!!  THANK YOU, Westgate Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: A Quiet Gem, Located Not Too Far from the Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: The grounds of the resort were lovely to walk around. Our one bedroom unit was nice although the bedroom was on the small side and the t.v. remote controls were difficult to use. The resort tried to help by printing a few instructions, but there were still too many issues with using the remote. There were many restaurants and small stores within a few blocks of the resort. Myesha, one of the resort shuttle bus drivers was delightful. She was pleasant, helpful, and professional. She was a responsible and careful driver. She patiently helped answer questions from riders who might have been confused about their destination or about the shuttle times and locations (pick up/drop off).

allReviews.title: Rooms need some attention.
allReviews.text: I live locally. Ostensibly, BARRY MANILOW was sold out and the only way to obtain tickets was to do a stay-cation at the WESTGATE. So that's what I did. I booked two stay-cation packages, one for my husband and myself and another for our friends. Two couples, two rooms. Each package included two nights hotel lodging, a $50 dining credit and two tickets to see MANILOW.Check-in took a while. Cheryl was very polite, professional, competent and patient. Nonetheless, it took way too long for the two couples to check in mostly because we asked how we would obtain the $50 dining credit. It should be easy. Pre-cell-phone,  obtaining a dining credit was easy-peasy. The Westgate's process, for those of us who don't carry our entire lives with us on our cell phones, was anything but easy. It meant yet another 20 minutes during check-out but I wasn't leaving the WESTGATE until both couples received our $50 dining credit. The way it was applied was nothing short of crazy but we did finally get the dining credits included in the package. (Dinner for two at BENIHANA was $270 with tip, so you can understand why I wanted that $50.)After checking in, one should be able to walk to one's room without being accosted.  There are Timeshares on the property so we were approached numerous times during our short stay. As if that's not enough, there are shops en route to the elevator bank. Shops on both sides of the only walkway between the Lobby and the elevator bank. Staff from the shops accost guests with free samples and shouting, hawking their wares like carnie barkers. That's annoying when you're just trying to get to your room.Restaurants were pricey. The seats in the theatre are narrow even though most Americans are Wide Body. The video poker machines were as cold as ice.Drink prices are crazy high and the drinks are not very good. We had one round of drinks in the Lobby. By "one round," I mean one bottle of beer, two cocktails and an inexpensive Cabernet. With tip those four drinks cost $60! Nothing special about either the beer nor the wine. The Whiskey Sour was just bottled sour mix, very tart. (If you want really good drinks, go to Esther's Kitchen in the Arts District.)The room was adequate but in need of maintenance. See photos.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Show
allReviews.text: We purchased booth seating and the VIP package. The gifts were fun! No spoilers here. The drinks were good. Laura Nelson, our usher was awesome! She made sure we received all of our gifts and was knowledgeable about the venue. Our sever was great too.Barry was amazing! He’s as great at 82 as he was at 50 when I saw him last! He had laryngitis and still brought so much energy to the show. This was a birthday trip for me with my hubby. We had so much fun! We love Barry!The hotel was nice. They are doing some refurbishing. All the employees were nice, knowledgeable and friendly.

allReviews.title: Family and Friendly
allReviews.text: Antonia and Rizalda were kind, friendly, welcoming and had the space tidy. They were sweet with our energetic kids. The food was individually packaged so it felt sanitary, but we wish there was also a toast option. We had a good experience. We will be back.

allReviews.title: Westgate please read!
allReviews.text: Hotel was comfortable, rooms were clean, great view of the sphere!  However, AVOID ALEENEK TECHNOLOGIES.  I don’t understand why this nice hotel has such scammers operating out of it.  I got swindled out of $300 and my friend $999!!  The product is crap, but they pull up a website ( obviously created by them) and tell you the product is $500 when it’s actually on amazon for $70!!!  Ruined my stay there, and I won’t stay there again because of the rip off experience.  I thought it was suspicious why they kept asking when we were leaving, we were leaving on Sunday, and suspiciously they were closed all day Saturday..  I’m sure we’re not the only ones who just tucked tail and got on our plane and left.  No one wants to admit to being scammed and really what’s the recourse??  None.  Wake up westgate!  Read the reviews of this store you have!!

allReviews.title: Overall,  a good hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is nice, very big, and had lots of options to eat in, but all are very very expensive. The front desk staff were and helpful nice until we had an issue in day 5. However Valerie the Customer Experience Manager was amazing to deal with. We had a lovely large room with a view of the Sphere, which we loved! We couldn't fault it,  however on day 5, a couple moved into the room connected which had obviously not been occupied up to that day. The couple didn't do anything wrong at all. And we're merely chatting and laughing etc...but the issue is we felt like they were in our room and most likely us in there room when we spoke! There was zero zero zero sound proofing. It was so unsettling. It really tainted our final 2 days and although Valerie said she would try to move us, we declined. A manager at front desk had already, in a very rude manner, told me he wouldn't be moving us due to the hotels full capacity which I understood. I really feel the hotel needs to tell couples if they are being put in a connecting  room and give the choice of accepting it or not, as it doesn't feel right that you are in a room with just a regular, very light and not sound proofed room door between you and complete strangers! The noise level is unbelievable and it is not at all private. Other than this we really enjoyed the Westgate and Valerie was so lovely.

allReviews.title: Memorable
allReviews.text: Our trip was nice. The staff was professional. We received great service. The only down side is that there aren't any stoves in the suites. Other than that our experience with Rex R, Rachel D, Juan J & Anthony P were wonderful.  We'd definitely return to this location again.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow…another great show!!
allReviews.text: We were greeted by Rex Ricarte who sure made picture taking a fun experience!  He took pictures of all of us in front of a picture of Barry. Nice start to our experience with Barry Manilow…what a great show!!  This is our third time seeing Barry and it never gets old!

allReviews.title: Mr Westgate
allReviews.text: Jose Mr. Westgate was fantastic! Very knowledgeable and took time to teach me the history of the hotel and Elvis’s time there. He took the time to walk us through the hotel and show us all the different places and even the statue. I highly, highly recommend you search him up.

allReviews.title: Thanks from the Fanilows!!
allReviews.text: Joseph was a FANTASTIC host at the Barry Manilow concert. Made the birthday girl’s day!!! The seat upgrade was PERFECT. Thanks for the experience and keeping an eye on us the whole night. We won’t forget the experience. You are a great ambassador!!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Westgate
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed seeing Cheap Trick at The Westgate in Las Vegas on February 8th.  I thought the property was older (it is), that's part of the charm.  Having the Monorail Station right there was awesome, I could have the peacefulness of staying off-strip with access to visit it.  I didn't try the Loop, but I will likely next time I visit Las Vegas.  There were plenty of places to pick up something to eat (Rikki Tiki Sushi was excellent!)  and the casino floor had plenty of people but you could find spots at different machines and tables easily.  Also, Elvis.  What more can you say?  I love the statue in the lobby of him and how they keep all sorts of tributes around it.  I went to the tribute show, The King Comes Home, and it was fabulous.  Finally, CT is my favorite band and to see them play where Elvis played was amazing.

allReviews.title: Dated, expensive, not for us
allReviews.text: We came to Vegas for a gymnastics event and chose the Westgate since that's where the event was held. The hotel is right next to the convention center with a view of the sphere, so if you're in town and don't care about accommodations, this might be your place.  We won't be back. The hotel is dated, not close to anything within walking distance, like a bar, simple restaurant, fast food, a cvs, etc just bland for accommodations, and everything is ridiculously overpriced. I realize it's the same all over the strip, but good god, next to check-in should be a loan application center. Make sure you have extra money and then double or triple it to be safe; you'll need it.  There are kids all over the hotel, but the food choices at the hotel suck for families unless you have a thick wallet. We didn't even use the casino; we couldn't afford to. The best part of the hotel was two things...the monorail is a huge help to avoid rental cars and constant Ubering...and the front desk staff were extremely nice and helpful.  After that, not much else sticks out.  If we come back, we'll either try a nicer place on the strip or find a place off strip and adjust to the events.

allReviews.title: Wonderful time in concierge!! Thanks,Aida
allReviews.text: Aida and Rosita were wonderful in the westgate club room!   Department was in house Greeter!  Aida was my favorite!! I just cannot wait for them to do the hospitality all day like they used to do. Atleast my last night they did the wine, beer and veggies and cheese and crackers. Thank you m!

allReviews.title: Tyler T made our check in exceptional
allReviews.text: We were greeted at the front desk by Tyler T. Tyler recognized my husband from previous stays, and greeted him warmly. He was friendly and super helpful. He gave us some helpful suggestions, and made us feel very welcome. This was a wonderful way to begin our stay, and we're looking forward to an amazing 33rd Anniversary.

allReviews.title: In house greeters
allReviews.text: We visited the Westgate club and the in house greeters Antonia and Rizalda were amazing in helping us when we needed them.  The room was always cared for and the food always available.  Thank you for taking such great care of us.  It was an amazing experience.  Thank you again.

allReviews.title: David & Derrick Are Awesome!
allReviews.text: David & Derrick are Amazing!!!!!The best music, best sax, best vocals!!We will be back every time they play!!!They play music that is loved by all.  Dancers were dancing, groovers grooving, rockers were rocking.They included the audience insuch a beautiful way!  Felt like family.

allReviews.title: Great venue for entertainment
allReviews.text: Saw Barry Manilow and the concert was excellent.  Staff were very friendly.  Shout out to Alisa Dolan for being so accommodating at the entertainment venue and we were seated and ready for the show in short order. Theater has a lot of history given Elvis’ Residency here.

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service.
allReviews.text: I want to give a shout out to Racheal R. She went above and beyond to assist me with some accessible seats for the Cheap Trick concert. We had tickets purchased in advance however I broke my ankle before my arrival to the hotel. The extra leg room made the best of a painful situation.Thank you Racheal.

allReviews.title: Top band at Westgate. High octane
allReviews.text: What a treat. Fantastic band on Thursday night. They really got us oldies going after the manilow concert which was also great. High octane played the perfect music for the crowd and changed it through the night. Even did requests. It was sad that the night ended. Thankyou Westgate for a great band, great show and great staff service to

allReviews.title: Valarie was on it and full of hospitality
allReviews.text: There was a mixup in tickets in the showroom and two tickets were issued for the same seat. I went to Valerie, who was the showroom manager, and she handled the situation brilliantly and with hospitality and kindness. She arranged for another seat, which was actually better than the original seatand made sure everything was OK. Vegas properties need more people like Valerie.

allReviews.title: Superbowl party 2025
allReviews.text: The setup was great, huge tvs, great buffet style food, open bar with plenty of options. Westgate always puts on a great party. Casino  host Dave Rosenwinkel always takes good care of us. Westgate is lucky to have him. We will be back for March Madness due to how well Westgate takes care of us. If you haven’t given Westgate a try you should.

allReviews.title: Amazing performance!
allReviews.text: Unc was amazing and the performance was nothing short of perfect. Great voice and presentation. The gentleman on the saxophone also killed it. Very consistent!!Please invite this guy again, he had the place jumping! Such a good vibe and he brings the energy. 10/10!!!

allReviews.title: Live Music
allReviews.text: Michael Speak did an amazing show he’s very awesome. I love Westgate hotel and Casino this is my 1st time attending a show here at Westgate. My family and friends invited me out to come and see a good show. He’s put on a very good show for the audience I love his music and him as a person. All hands iI to Michael Speak will come back to see his show anytime.

allReviews.title: Home Away From Home
allReviews.text: The  workers are very friendly. Rooms are very comfortable and beds are great. Casino is clean and the dealers are very personable. If you need any type of help all you have to do is ask and they will be more than helpful to fulfill your needs. This will be our home away from home from now on.

allReviews.title: Awful parking and no restaurants
allReviews.text: There was a line for the parking garage when we arrived. Then there was a wait to leave the garage of over an hour because there were a few unfortunate employees collecting parking fees.  If I pay for parking, it should at least be worth paying, not a simple cash grab for nothing..  I'm not paying to wait and I'm not scanning posted QR codes that can be easily hacked.  NEVER scan QR codes especially in Vegas.When the concert ended at 10pm, there were no restaurants open. Not one.  Am I in Vegas or Topeka, Kansas?  Maybe it was because it was Super Bowl weekend..

allReviews.title: Worst stay in 30 years
allReviews.text: I was in Central Tower room 1821. The room had multiple issues that couldn't be ignored. First of all the shower/tub faucet leaked a lot of water to the point I had to shut the door in order to drown out the noise and sleep. The tub was also rusty and moldy. The thermostat couldn't be changed, it was stuck on high fan without being able to change the temperature. My son was in another room and had some issues with his including thermostat not cooling the room and a toilet that struggled flushing. Would not recommend staying here but in all fairness the sports book and casino were good.

allReviews.title: Team #1
allReviews.text: We appreciate the team members in the owners club, Antonia, Jemil, Aida. They are very welcoming and accomodating and are always smiling when we come in. Also they keep the club clean and fully stocked with drinks, snacks everything else. Thank you! Just missing the fresh cut fruits cheese and crackers to go with our wine. Please bring them back :)

allReviews.title: Coming back soon
allReviews.text: Rooms were great. I went during Super Bowl weekend expecting chaos instead I received an amazing experience. I liked how everything was theme related for the Super Bowl. I also noticed that all the other guest were also enjoying themselves.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Westgate
allReviews.text: We had a nice stay at the Westgate. It was our first time there and we'll definitely go back, it will be our new go to hotel. Nice sized casino, awesome concert venue with quite a history too. The location was great if you are mobile and like the Pepper Mill, El Gordo, Bagelmania, Circus Circus - all within a 15 min walk.  It's next to the monorail too.  The AC wasnt working the first night but it was fixed by the second. That would've been a deal breaker. I saw a housekeeper in the hall and got my room cleaned one day too (rare for vegas these days) . Easy to communicate via text to an AI robot (at least i assume it's AI but actually helpful). The downside was check-in and $45 to stay past 11am. Only 2-3 workers checking people in so lines were LONG. The employee checked us in quickly but the (customers were slow b/c every one seemed to be wanting to make changes or look at book of suites they would never stay in or who know what) just not enough of them. Would be great if a kiosk was an option.Also need MORE Elvis.

allReviews.title: Westgate & Cheap Trick Rocks!!💖🤘🤘🤘
allReviews.text: We had a Wonderful time seeing Cheap Trick. They were so Fabulous, the audience was on their feet the whole time. They Rocked the Westgate!! Everyone that works at the Westgate we’re so professional and kind. We absolutely Love the Westgate!! They have the Best Everything!! I Highly Recommend the Westgate & Cheap Trick!!

allReviews.title: Love cheap trick and love the Westgat.  Such a wonderful hotel
allReviews.text: Cheap trick is better than ever. Excellent guitar solos and a tightness to the band. They not only play  their original hits but they have so many new great songs. The audience was on their feet the whole time just enjoying everything the band played. Highly recommend the westgate the band the casino the restaurants the parking is so easy.  Just had a super fun evening.  This is the best casino in Las Vegas. Absolutely loved my evening at westgate. Staff is so pleasant and helpful. I can’t say enuf good things about my experience. Loved it. Can’t wait to see them again

allReviews.title: Westgate Hotel and Casino better than staying on the strip
allReviews.text: From the moment I checked in it was a great experience. Desk clerk was quick, efficient, and assigned me the perfect room. There was a fridge and microwave and coffee pot. Room was clean and ready for occupancy. Silk road is a restaurant you must try. Westgate beats any hotel on the strip for price and comfort. Westgate is close to everything and with Uber, Lift, and Taxi no reason to stay on the strip.

allReviews.title: Tremendous Experience
allReviews.text: Clean, comfortable, my refrigerator went out was replaced in 15 minutes Service through out is top of the lineFood every where is fabulous I don’t stay anywhere but The WestgateGreat casino, good variety of machinesYou have to try the Buffet, what great food and unbelievable Variety.

allReviews.title: Mary, David and Preston were very nice to and also made us feel like family. to us.
allReviews.text: Housespetality was awesome. & Cecilia Villa in slots area, made us feel like at home. The rooms were clean and bug free. The cleaness of the resort, restaurant, rooms and bathrooms. Thanks for your amazing personal and the dedication the they have and perform, makes y'all stand out.

allReviews.title: Staying for 7 days
allReviews.text: Great service by greeter Rex Ricarte directed us to the hotel lobby and guided us to the elevator and helped every guest on the lobby. The hotel is very accessible to monorail transport and use of RTC to the airport, walking distance to the strip and accessible to use the Deuce transportation. We will surely recommend Westgate to all our friends and Family. We would surely come back next time to watch Barry Manilow, Adore working at the gift shops were excellent and very good in assisting us with our gift shopping and superbowl gifts items.

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: The Westgates charm, history & customer service is top notch. Jimmy, the valet gentleman at the front entrance, was genuine, kind, super helpful and just an all around awesome human (amongst having the best NY accent!). The price is right and right next to the monorail. You'll always win at the Westgate. Be sure to say hey, to Jimmy!

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: Muhammed from EVS was so very  helpful.   I lost my phone, I had no clue were I left it or dropped it.   He directed me to the phone to call security for lost and found.  It had not been turned in.  He found my phone and came looking for me.   He went aove and beyond!

allReviews.title: Best guest experience!
allReviews.text: Carolyn  Leslie was an usher who was very knowledgeable and kind to our group.We appreciate her she needs to be acknowledged for her superior customer service towards us guest for the Super Bowl showroom 2025! We enjoy coming to Westgate yearly for Super Bowl! The Sims

allReviews.title: Amazing service!
allReviews.text: We had the best bar service, Irene was hands down the best server I have ever had. Completely professional and an asset to this establishment. Thanks for the great service!!!From the doormen to the restaurant staff, wonderful service all around. The Edge steakhouse was amazing and the sushi at Benihana’s was top notch. We will be back for sure!

allReviews.title: High octane rocks
allReviews.text: High Octane rocks and the lead singer is super cute! 😝  love the music and vibes will definitely come by to see them again!!!! High Octane rocks and the lead singer is super cute! 😝  love the music and vibes will definitely come by to see them again!!!!

allReviews.title: Great Dealer
allReviews.text: Johnny Chau, table game dealer, was very helpful in figuring out how to play a table game I didn’t understand. At one point I was up some money, but just like Vegas, I donated some back. Had fun anyway, would definitely recommend coming back here

allReviews.title: IT WAS ALL GOOD UNTIL IT WASN’T!!!!
allReviews.text: I’ll start with the GOOD! Mr. Jimmy the bellhop was the best! First impression is everything, so after interacting with him, we thought that all would be well. We also liked that we had access to the train, which goes back and forth to the new strip throughout the day.All was well until we attended the timeshare presentation. Everyone that we encountered were all kind, even though everyone’s goal was to get us to attend the timeshare presentation.I must note that the only reason that we selected Westgate was due to an owners referral; we thought that we’d save a few dollars, and cancel our reservation at Elara, and it is the biggest mistake that we could’ve made! NEVER AGAIN.We attended what we THOUGHT would be a 90 minute presentation. We ended up being there for 4.5 hours. It’s all a SETUP, and they’re all in on it! Our tourist was a wolf in sheep’s clothing, literally. He told us upfront that even if we say no, he’d treat us with respect, and that was a LIE. He even told us that he went in on his day off, we’ve figured out that this was a lie as well. Once he realized that we weren’t giving in to this timeshare business, his entire demeanor changed. He told us that he already makes 6-figures a year, and that he wasn’t tripping if that meant he’d help us get $150! Ha! It was NEVER about a giftcard, again, it was the $500 fee that they’d charge if we did not attend. Also note that we already make 6-figures, so that comment did not phase us AT ALL. 😂 This “ resort “ was not worth $700 for 2 nights, so we were NOT going to allow them to charge us that (with the $500 fee). After several interactions with he and his boss, and saying NO over and over again, they finally accepted that we weren’t giving them our money. Also note that we and maybe 2 more families were still in the room by this time (we went at 9:30), and an entire new group of people were there by the time they gave up (their goal is to hold you up, and force you to buy). Only ONE family of all that attended purchased (they made an announcement), so why were they holding us up? Our tour guide was very upset and said that not everyone wants the finer “s*” in life, lol. and walks off! I thanked him anyway. After he finally got out of our hair, a rude little lady came to the table to close us out, and process our gift, so she say. She came to the table to offer us time to think about the offer, and then turned around to also invite us back for 4 nights, for $75. I told her that I’d think about it, she was very rude and wanted a definite yes or no. We said no, and she escorted us out. You can tell that she was not happy. The staff cannot take no as an answer, and it’s weird! They get so butt hurt if you decline their offer. The resort is VERY OUTDATED, and if you’re there on a promotion, they will give you a room with issues, so that when you see the demo room, you’ll be easily persuaded. At the end of our tour, we spoke with hospitality about the time that we spent being hassled by these tour guides, and he said “ I’m sorry if they told you 90 minutes before going inside, it recently changed to 120 minutes.” We knew that he’d been trained to say that! We did receive a $100 gift-card, that we considered as reimbursement.Also, they will present you with an 100K+ offer with a 25K down payment first, and they will then work themselves down. Our last offer was $118 a month, with a $300 down payment and we still said NO! We didn’t like the attitude, hassle, and the fact that our tour guide purposely held up our day. So, please avoid this resort and stay somewhere else!!!!!!! We will go back to Vegas, but we will NOT stay there!This location also has the lowest reviews out of their other locations, and I now see why.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Hotel Staff
allReviews.text: They are GREAT. So very attentive and happy. From the moment you are greeted at the door by Louiz, to Shelly H. in the Entertainment department, their "above and beyond" helpfulness made my experience even better. Great experience! Thank you!

allReviews.title: There for business, show and pleasure
allReviews.text: We really enjoy this property. Everything you want and love about Vegas is right there in one place, including the top sports bar venue in the city! They consistently have great shows in their theater, the restaurants are excellent and their staff is outstanding

allReviews.title: Perfect Date Night
allReviews.text: We ate dinner at Edge Steakhouse and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. Our servers Liman and Laura were very attentive and made our experience unforgettable. The food was perfect - the filet was like butter and the ribeye was cooked to perfection. Overall, it is one of the best steakhouses we have ever tried and are looking forward to when we can visit again.

allReviews.title: Customer Care Extraordinaire
allReviews.text: Cecilia Villa, Casino Slots & Sports Book area, went above & beyond helping me figure out game seating - too confusing!. She found the mgr to assist me and also searched me out later to re-confirm, twice! She has a strong customer-orientation within her DNA.  This is the type of person every org wants dealing with the customer. She made my experience at Westgate Resort "tops." I'll return in large part because of her. David C, North Carolina

allReviews.title: All inclusive resort with the best staff and amenities anywhere
allReviews.text: If you look up the most inclusive resort to stay at in Las Vegas, you will find pictures of the Westgate Resort in Las Vegas.  I have stayed at the Westgate for the past 3 years.  I was married in their Crystal Chapel last year and celebrated our 1-year anniversary there in January 2025.  Every employee has a smile on their face and a great overall demeanor.  The slot machines are always hitting, and the blackjack tables are always a blast.  We honestly love this resort and cannot wait to return.  Did I mention the Vegas loop is now up and running as well?  Enjoy an underground system running with state-of-the-art Tesla's.  Why deal with traffic when you do not need to.  The hub for the Vegas Loop is right outside the front entrance.... or you can also just jump on the monorail with a station right outside the resort also.  Both have several destinations to all the must-see places in Vegas.  Don't just take my word for it, experience it yourself.  You will not be disappointed.

allReviews.title: Good trip after a time
allReviews.text: I came into town from London so it was a long journey, I get my room key and someone else has had the room it's not clean so I need to go down and go fix that, 18 hours of cabin plane on me not the best start, the internet kept dropping in and out The room was comfortable though when I was in there and I had a view of the sphere which was awesome Room service was good I recommend the crinkle cut fries and coleslaw that was soooo good No one came to service my room in the time I was there 3 nights 3 Days Lots of kids running up and down the corridor screaming which isn't ideal floor 24 North towerThat aside I like that the hotel has a monorail station and plenty of stations for Uber and LyftDidn't have the breakfast there had Uber eats which was easy and painless go meet the driver out in the valet front entrance On check out I had such a good experience with CRAIG he was so nice, so friendly so helpful so smiley he made the trip Good hotel overall if you want something off strip don't go Jan 30th they have a gymnastics convention so I was glad I was checking out that day Zoe Dennis

allReviews.title: Perfect Hotel for Trade Shows
allReviews.text: If you're going to a trade show at the World of Concrete, you can't beat the location. Nothing beats being able to walk from your room to the booth, then back to your room. They've also got several very good restaurants inside the hotel that you can take customers to...we'll be back!

allReviews.title: Excellent service, food and drink.
allReviews.text: Older casino, could use updating, but the staff from the bar tenders to the check in desk to the restaurants were hands down the best service we have had in Las Vegas. Food and drinks were affordable and everything was great. I don’t write too many reviews but this place was exceptional.

allReviews.title: Great hospitality
allReviews.text: My experience with Aida in the owenera lounge was amazing!!! She gave us great hospitality and had a great communication she was a pleasure meeting!! She was a pleasure speaking with and just had a very welcoming spirit and hope to see her again soon!

allReviews.title: A Solid Choice
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino over a weekend in late January. We had a "Premier Room" that overlooked the Las Vegas Country Club and greater Las Vegas area. The room was very clean, large and had everything we needed. The Westgate's theatre was "Home" to Elvis Presley for over 600 sold out shows and celebrates that history throughout the building (kind of fun.) The casino is as good as any in Las Vegas and the restaurants are quite good as well. One very convenient feature is that the Las Vegas Monorail station is on hotel property, so getting to the Las Vegas Strip is incredibly easy. We will definitely return to the Westgate shall our travels take us to Las Vegas in the future!

allReviews.title: Three Dog Night Concert
allReviews.text: The Three Dog Night concert was a memorable experience, with the band delivering timeless hits like "Joy to the World" and "Mama Told Me (Not to Come)" with incredible energy. The vocal harmonies were as powerful as ever, showcasing the depth of their musical legacy. The crowd was fully engaged, singing along to every word, creating an electric atmosphere. Overall, it was a night of nostalgia for many and pure musical joy that left everyone smiling.Westgate keeps delivering a great Variety of Music acts and events.   Don’t miss out, check out their whole roster of Exciting musical artists that are slated at the WestGate!  Thank You Westgate, Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Westgate Date Night - Three Dog Night
allReviews.text: The Westgate and staff are amazing! And so accommodating to us. My girlfriend and I attended 3 Dog Night, what an amazing show and Dinner before was out of this world. Thank you Westgate for an amazing Evening.We will look forward to seeing Cheap Trick in February….David K.

allReviews.title: Westgate keeps the fun coming !
allReviews.text: So fun! Brought me back to my school days. They sounded incredible and they told fun stories to the audience. The newer band members were an awesome addition. The seating and stage was wonderful. The Westgate is my favorite spot for entertainment.

allReviews.title: Great and an Unexpected Experience

I ususally stay at Resorts World but my company decided to book us at the Westgate. Again I was so stunned with my experience!! Great job by all that were involved with the hotel.

allReviews.title: Stay on Strip or Downtown
allReviews.text: We stayed here for work, as it is next door to the LV convention center.  We didn't get the room we reserved with a king bed.  They gave us two tiny beds with an 'upgrade', the upgrade apparently means next to the elevator so you can listen to people get on and off all night.  After one night, they had us change rooms for a king room.  The new room had a king bed but the bathroom was half the size of the first one.  If you are here to do anything other than the convention, you an uber/cab ride away, no where to walk to.  Also if you are here to gamble, don't bother, it was a tiny casino and tables were rarely open.  I wouldn't stay here again if it was free.

allReviews.title: Overall a nice place, helpful staff
allReviews.text: Our son had a conference at the Westgate and wanted his wife to attend the social events. My husband and I went to babysit our grandchild while they attended the conference events.The room was a one bed suite with adjoining room. It was dated but very spacious. The views were incredible.Pros: Every staff member we spoke with was kind and helpful.Jose, greeted you as you first entered the lobby. He was the sparkly dresser you could not miss. He was my  “goto” guy for any information regarding places to visit and transportation decisions.Gladys was our housekeeper and she was very accommodating and helpful regarding my coffee needs and cleanup after a toddler.Michael arranged the accommodations so my son could bring his family for the conference and I am very appreciative.Cons: the only appliances in the room are the Keurig coffee maker and the refrigerator. It would have been very helpful to have a microwave in such a nice suite with a toddler.Overall it was nice and I would stay there again.
