allReviews.title: Westgate Pool employees need training
allReviews.text: I have been a Westgate owner since 1998 and have been happy with them overall. That being stated, I have waited several months before posting this to see if I got over our last experience, unfortunately I haven't.  We stayed for 10 days, as is our norm, and had extended family join us.  ALL of our problems happened at the pool/spa areas. Issue #1:  We are President card holders and as such, we are entitled to a free cabana each day.  As is our norm, I called the Spa before we arrived, provided my President's card number and reserved a cabana for each of the 10 days we would be at Westgate.   Upon arrival the pool team members had No idea about our reservations and the Spa team members were just as clueless. The real issue was that the Pool team members did not know what a President's card was and just told us it was "worthless in the pool area".  Even after showing them the stated discounts on the back of the card, they stated they were no longer valid.  WRONGIssue #2:Subsequently we were charged $100 for a cabana on that first day.  Seven days later we charged another $350 for a cabana - as of January 2025 we still have not received a refund from the Westgate Spa for this - even after providing documentation.Issue #3:The majority of the time we are at the Pool, our waitress is "Irene" and she is absolutely the BEST.  We have Never had any issues with Irene and cannot provide enough applause for her work ethic, people skills, and general awesome attitude.  As is usual they had another waitress fill in on Irene's day off.  This relief waitress came,  took our order and took our President's card along with my credit card to set up a tab for us - only problem was she simply disappeared from the pool area with my cards.  After about 30-45 minutes I needed my cards so that my wife could go shopping.  Looked all over and couldn't find the waitress.  Finally talked to the bartender and she called the waitress' cell phone several times - no answer.  Finally bartender called the Beverage Mgr.  From here on we spiraled down further - the Beverage Mgr. was fairly new and obviously overwhelmed.  After several more phone calls it was decided that I should go back to my room and they would bring my cards back when they found the waitress.   As we were packing up our personal items to leave, the waitress magically reappears and we are able to get our cards back and pay our bill.  Upon asking the waitress where she went, she happily told the Beverage Mgr. and myself that she was in the Spa having an interview for a different job.  Of course I couldn't let that go, so I stated the obvious - you went to an interview with a different department while on the clock, without telling your supervisor with a customers credit cards and are gone for over an 90 minutes and you don't see that as a problem.  Her answer was well no, didn't think she'd be gone that long and her supervisor wasn't around....Later found out that they really don't have a supervisor for the pool staff - bartenders just call management if something is amiss.It simply amazes me that Westgate cannot train the employees thoroughly and consistently.  Maybe they need to focus more on their existing time share owners and not so much as trying to sell new timeshares.

allReviews.title: One awesome hotel!
allReviews.text: My wife and I love the Westgate Las Vegas.  The hotel is off strip which is nice due to less traffic - really easy to navigate.  Free valet parking but you should tip.  Hotel has easy check-in and we stayed in a newly remodeled room which was very comfortable.  Lots of shops and restaurants.  We went to Benihana and it was amazing.  Great casino and the International Bar always has live entertainment.  Sportsbook is the best around with so much action.  We love going here and will be back. allReviews.title: CLEAN and WELL PRICED hotel just 1 block off the strip!
allReviews.text: I don't usually write reviews but I want to share an experience that this hotel provided since it's a little off strip. Certain spots are forgotten and it breaks my heart. This hotel may be slightly off strip and looks a little older but it doesn't look or feel old once inside. They've done a lot of renovation to the rooms, at least the one I was in, and the lobby area feels like any other on-strip hotel. The halls are clean. The carpets are clean. And it isn't packed like other hotels. The ease of movement was so key for me and my family, especially with an 8 year old. It felt safe. The staff was extremely professional and kind. allReviews.title: Excellent Service and Delicious Food, Westgate Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Went to Westgate Hotel and Casino for dinner at Benihana’s.  On arrival we were met by 3 hostesses who immediately found us a table for 5.  The server was there within minutes taking the initial order and we had a beverages within 5 minutes.  The server explained about the cooking grill and where the chief would be working.  Must compliment the ambiance of the restaurant, low lighting with ancient of red lights.  In the Center of the restraint is an indoor flowing stream with several fish.  The stream is in a lower level and is adorned with lighted trees, benches to sit and relax.  Our Chief came in and introduced himself, he went over again the individual orders of everyone in our party.  The chef explained the dipping sauces he had made for out menu order (ginger sauce along with Mustard ginger sauce) Then the Chef began his presentation of cooking and culinary talents.  Onion Volcano, onion train locomotive and the smoothest effort getting the vegetable onto the grill and seasoning them to perfection.    The steaks were cooked and seasoned well and when served finally cut into bite size portions, the sauce explained did enhance the streak on the pallet.  During the 5 course dinner both the chef and server were very personal engaging in conversation, asking what we were doing in Vegas and how long we were staying.  They offered suggestions on places to visit and to see while during our stay.     Lastly the manager of the restraint (Kit) came, introduced herself and inquired about the service she received.  We thoroughly enjoyed the evening, the ambiance added to the pleasure and ultimately the food was delicious and mouthwatering.  The service, hospitality and food received was well above what one experiences in Vegas Restraunts.  Highly recommend visiting and experiencing the staff, servers and chef’s at Benihana’s at the Westgate Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.  You will not be Disappointed.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel with great Views!

Most guests like to wake up slowly with coffee.  I would definitely visit again.

allReviews.title: Fabulous stay at the Westgate Las Vegas Casino and Resort
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort and Casino during the National Finals Rodeo from December 8-15, 2024.  From the time we entered the building, we were treated very well by any staff we encountered.   The rooms were clean and comfortable.  We were fortunate to stay in a 2 bedroom villa and it was absolutely beautiful.   There were a wide variety of food options at various price points.  All the meals we had on site were quite good.   The Westgate partnered with the NFR to host watch parties every night.  The events were well organized, well attended and we had a blast!   We had tickets to the actual rodeo one night and were also able to easily catch a shuttle bus from the Westgate to the Thomas and Mack Centre where the Rodeo was being held.  Last but not least, I would like to mention the very easy access to the Monorail which runs along the Las Vegas Strip.   Great jobs Westgate Team!  We will be back!!  Corinne and Jerry B.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Westgate for the NFR.  Was very pleased with the entire hotel.  Had great food options, a fun watch party, great after parties, and the casino didn’t smell of cigarettes which was wonderful.  Definitely will be booking with Westgate again.

allReviews.title: It was just okay…

The nightstand on the side of the bed was also very dusty at the bottom. I guess you have to request room service each day because no one came by during our weekend stay. The only thing conveniently within walking distance is the convention center next-door. Any of the Vegas attractions would require your ride share apps or the shuttle. Pros: The staff was very nice and welcoming as soon as you enter. Beautiful Mountain View through the window. Decent casino and sports bar area.

allReviews.title: Try the Westgate and take the monorail to the Strip!

We had a great stay there.  The room was clean and large, the bed was very comfortable, the bathroom was very nice too. We had a Keurig in our room as well.  Their rates are always reasonable too.

allReviews.title: Évite—plenty of other hotels in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Terrible expérience.  When I arrived at this hotel I was convinced  to upgrade, which I willingly did. I was staying for two weeks.  I received a pretty big room BUT with a thermostat/air conditioner problem, only cold air and no way to heat the air or stop the fan.  I kept daily asking for repair. I eventually asked to speak to the manager, who was constantly “in meetings but would call me back!”  which of course he/she NEVER did phone back or even try to speak to me or to solve the problem. I could never even  speak to the same person.  No repair, despite being told it would be taken care of that day—I explained that it appeared to be a broken thermostat, therefore I had nonstop freezing air conditioning pumping on high day/night this is in Nov/Dec it was actually colder in my room than outside the hotel. I changed rooms one week later after contracting bronchitis.  Add to that the fact that I had to call on 3 out of 4 days to have any  cleaning service, towels etc.  Oh, almost forgot— two mornings with no hot water for a shower. One bank of elevators in the East Wing had only one elevator out of four working and very often not even that one. But since there was no notice posted you could actually wait indefinitely. I travel pretty frequently. This is the worst hotel.

allReviews.title: Excellence off the Strip

The Westgate  is convenient to the Convention Center and monorail. and has a shuttle bus  to downtown and the Strip. The casino has plenty of gaming choices, make sure you sign up for a rewards card.. There is quite a variety of dining choices from a coffee bar, food court and fine dining. I think the Superbook at Westgate is the best racing and sports book in Vegas. I visit several times a year and have never had any issues. I'm looking forward to a return trip in Feb

allReviews.title: Westgate Experience
allReviews.text: As Las Vegas locals we have many choices in restaurants, shows and casinos, but the Westgate never disappoints. The atmosphere at the casino is always amazing and you immediately start to have fun, whether it’s the live music playing or the amazing staff that greets you. We had dinner at the Edge steakhouse. Everything was amazing from the unique bread to start the meal and the great salad. The menu was rather large for an upscale steakhouse and the staff was able to explain all the options and ensured you had a great experience. The desserts were amazing. The milk chocolate sphere dessert was a work of art and a must have. After dinner we enjoyed Barry Manilow’s concert. The venue is the perfect size and there is not a bad seat. You will be entertained the entire time. Barry is an amazing entertainer and his band is as good as it gets. One of the best vegas shows. You will be not disappointed with your visit to the Westgate.

allReviews.title: WESTGATE always the highest standard of service!
allReviews.text: As always incredible service and fantastic food! WESTGATE is truly a cut above all! The staff and management are committed to the highest level of excellence. You can tell that the employees love their jobs by the way they treat their guests. It is my understanding that many have been there for many years and you can tell.

allReviews.title: Friendly staff

The giant TV’s at the Superbook are incredible, and perfect for the college football and NFL games.  5-stars, I’ll be making another trip soon

allReviews.text: My friend and I went to the Barry Manilow show on Friday December 7th. We had a great experience and the crowd gets involved, it feels like a big party. Barry Manilow’s holiday show was amazing and so much fun! I highly recommend the show to everyone.

allReviews.title: Jessica gave me a fantastic mani/pedi express
allReviews.text: I saw Jessica for a $69 mani/pedi express. Regular price $100. So I thought it would be a quick, whatever service. But I needed my polish removes, cuticles cut and nails trimmed. Jessica was fantastic. My nails looked so good when I left. I was so happy. It included polish too but I was too impatient to wait for them to dry. She gave me a nice buff. Thanks Jessica.

allReviews.title: Great night!
allReviews.text: Amazing staff at the Barry Manilow show!! They were incredible to my elderly parents and my mom’s 80th birthday.  Shout out to Shelley from Australia.The head of the show… John?  And also Maria in the casino!! Thank you for your hospitality and helping is create great family memories.

allReviews.title: Trapped like a rat, avoid this place
allReviews.text: Stayed 8 days for a bridge tournament probably 500+ rooms rented for up to 11 days. Horribly understaffed, have to beg almost daily  to get your room made up, (day one room wasn’t made up, I asked at the checkin the morning of day 2, phoned housekeeping at 2:00, had to go stand in line at 6:30 and wait 30 minutes to get the hotel manager who then did send housekeeping to my room at 7:00), long waits at checkin and every shop and restaurant, very long walk to access uber, entire casino floor terribly stinky from tobacco smoke, prices in shops and food court restaurants are very high even by Vegas standards, elevators are so bad you have to go up to go down otherwise the full elevator passes right by you on its way down, no reason for the pool to be closed down when it’s 70 degrees outside, no coffeemaker in the room, long walk from pavilion to the only bathroom next to Benihanas, the place is so miserable that we spent almost 100 dollars including transportation to eat Applebees 2 for 25 meal deal and felt it was well worth the money, of the literally hundreds of attendees I talked to I only found 2 with anything good to say about the facility.

allReviews.title: Best night in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The staff was wonderful and very attentive. Laura gave us a backstage tour which was outstanding. Barry Manilow was amazing. He was funny, interactive, and highly entertaining. It was a magical experience.  I highly recommend attending this show.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow show
allReviews.text: The Barry Manilow show is amazing! Known for his full scale productions, and awesome voice, this show has it all !Team member Shelley H. was a big help, very friendly! She explained the short delay opening the doors, and made everyone waiting calm and comfortable

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service
allReviews.text: We were helped by Mohammed in the EVS department. Very pleasant gentleman helped us in finding the Fed Ex shipping store. He was so kind, he didn’t just tell us where to go. He stopped what he was doing to walk us there ensuring we didn’t get lost. His dedication to customer service made our trip much easier and enjoyable.

allReviews.title: THE Casino to meet all walks of life!
allReviews.text: The Vast walks of life! The WestGate has conventioneers, regulars and locals all gambling,eating and partying together!  We always,always have a blast here. Be sure to hit the bars… ya’ll will meet some employees that have been working here for years.

allReviews.title: I Feel as Though We Are Part of Their Family
allReviews.text: My wife and I have been coming to the Westgate Resort and Casino twice a month for nearly 4 years. During that time, I have become a Diamond Player. My casino host, David Rosenwinkle always takes care of us ranging  from special events invites, Westgate's VIP Stadium Suite events (i.e. - Copa America), outstanding food and drink comps, suite upgrades, VIP Slot Tournaments, Blackjack Tournaments, free 18 rounds of golf, and more. From the valet, dealers, pit bosses, supervisors, managers, cage, food and drink servers, everyone that works there treat us with courtesy and respect. I feel as though we are part of their family. They have plenty of options when it comes to gaming. They have many table games including blackjack, poker, craps, and roulette. They also have all of the new slot machines that most always pay out. I always enjoy staying at Westgate. Thank you

allReviews.title: Id do it again!!!!
allReviews.text: A nice dinner, fun rewards,  and pleasant staff. The welcoming at the tournament was amazing.    The live band helped make the evening...thanks westgate!!! It was a night to remember for all. Enjoyed so much! Westgate always makes me feel welcomed.

allReviews.title: Robert Raymond
allReviews.text: Robert Raymond is the best security person at Westgate.  He is very sweet to us fanilows a Westgate and greets us with a hug every time we visit.  We are always very happy to see him and adds to our joy of seeing Barry Manilow at International Theater at Westgate.

allReviews.title: Legends Slot Tournament Finale!
allReviews.text: It was love at the first spin!What a fabulous time we had at the Westgate!  The Legends Slot Tournament was a blast. We had a fantastic dinner reception with great enetertainment, prizes and give aways. I can't wait for the series to start again next year.Thank you Marty Kunkel for being the BEST casino host in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Horrible Experience Terrible Service Do Nor Choose This Hotel
allReviews.text: This is the worst hotel. The service is terrible. I had to complain to the manager and he was rude to me. My husband and I had breakfast in the restaurant - just an omelet each - and the bill was $80.  There is no coffee in the room. The tissue is single ply and scratchy. There is smoke smell everywhere.  The ceilings are low. The elevators don’t work. There are 6 elevators near my room and only one works. I asked for daily housekeeping and I have been here one week today and I have gone without housekeeping five days despite waiting at the front desk for 30 minutes to complain and then have the manager be condescending and rude.  The restaurants are open to the casino and the smoke wafts in. One must walk through the low ceiling casino full of smoke to get to the convention center and the smoke smell is in the air conditioning.  There is marijuana smell wafting in from outside too. The rooms have no insulation and you can hear everything from the hallway and the adjacent rooms.  Do not stay here.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Staff in spite of Aging building
allReviews.text: The staff at the Westgate are wonderful.nnRex Ricarte is  a friendly, helpful doorman, prepared to answer any of our wuestions. Paul in Sid’s dining area was an incredible member of the wait staff.  He always remembered our favourite orders.The hotel itself is showing its age, but the staff makes up for it.Traveller from Canada

allReviews.title: Great Experience!!
allReviews.text: I Had a Great Time at the Barry Manilow Concert. Joe B., our usher, upgraded my seats as it was my birthday!!How Awesome Is That??Thanks Joe for making my experience even better!!! Thank You Very Much!!!!The Concert Was Very Very Good!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Christmas show was great!
allReviews.text: Linda M was terrific.  I bought a good seat in the theater but my seat was next to a gentlemen who was clearly over 300 pounds.  There was no way I could sit in my assigned seat.  Linda was excellent/very helpful and discreet in helping me to get a new seat.

allReviews.title: Awesome place to stay!
allReviews.text: I stayed at Westgate in July 2024 and then again in November 2024! Both times the staff were very polite and helpful! I will be staying here in the near future! Very clean hotel and so much to do there! Next time I will be bringing my sister and her family to stay as well!!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow - A must attend show while in Vegas.
allReviews.text: He is called the "Showman of our generation" for a reason. Barry belted out all his hits and took the audience on a roller coaster of emotions from beginning to end.The highlight for me was a handshake on night 3.I have been enjoying Barry's shows beginning in July 1978. Each time is a whole new experience.

allReviews.title: Good hotel for conferences
allReviews.text: Westgate is a great hotel for a conference. Unfortunately they always up there prices of all items when a conference is in town. Way too expensive for what you receive.Rooms are nice and large, with plenty of room. Not like the newer hotels on the strip that have much smaller rooms

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel. Will stay again.
allReviews.text: I was surprised to see so many shops in the hotel but most surprising was that there was a coffee snack shop open 24 hours. I forgot my pillow and the pillow on our bed were very hard and uncomfortable. We are used to much softer pillows. We received an online message the next morning asking how our stay was. I did mention the pillows but didn’t expect it to go anywhere. We had soft pillows on our bed that night. That and everything else offered in the hotel was wonderful, including the Thanksgiving buffet.

allReviews.title: Highly disappointed
allReviews.text: I have been staying at Westgate for over 8 years. I must say Westgates last visit was utterly disappointing and bias. Rewards member whose room rate was less than resort fees and my room was ridiculously embarrassing, dirty and old. A rewards member who comes out of town, giving an old room. Not a remodeled room with a walk in shower but a room that was ADA in which I was not, then complained and giving a utter disaster. Not to mention the check in reps attitude because I noted the upcharge.That stayed ruined my WHOLE TRIP! $300 of disappointment

allReviews.title: N.B:  Check-in security deposit includes resort fees
allReviews.text: The "security deposit" at check-in included a $50/day resort fee.The "resort" was closed all of one bad air day (fires in the area),and my pre-teens were not allowed in the gym.  Westgate chargedthe $50+tax nevertheless.  Westgate fought my chargeback with a signature bearing no resemblance to my own.  For me Westgate is a no go.

allReviews.title: It takes a Team
allReviews.text: This is not the fanciest place in Vegas but they blow the rest away with customer service.   Special call out to Greg in the Diamond check in he helped me navigate my room block.  Jimmy the door man he is old school Vegas, has been there 15 years but doesn’t age, great first perception.  Flawless room block execution from Carmen McLee and then the star player at my events-Shannon Athenos from in Room catering. With Shannon at tge helm I am assured that all our events went off without a hitch.  It takes a team to make this annual event happen and Westgate has it.

allReviews.title: Awesome Talent!
allReviews.text: Great show and performers. Was expecting a live band but the track worked well. The performers were extremely talented.  The venue was nice and intimate with great service.  I enjoyed the modern twist of the music while keeping the traditional sound.

allReviews.title: Rocktane Band Was Fun!
allReviews.text: Just had a lovely Vegas vacation and enjoyed the Westgate. Some hotel highlights were the impressive sports book area and the delicious steak house.We saw several nice bands performing in lounge but the band that really stood out was Rocktane on Thursday night. This band was talented and professional but also very fun and entertaining. We will make a point of seeing Rocktane again on our next visit.

allReviews.title: Casino lover
allReviews.text: Slots are my favorite , table games were fun as well got to sit down on a couple of $25 min blackjack tables but also some $10 min tables . Hotel rooms were nice and comfy they were also Clean and professionally dressed. The sports book area is a must see , the screens are massive and it was fun watching the Tyson fight there.

allReviews.title: High Rocktane rocks!!!
allReviews.text: We originally planned to leave Las Vegas onThanksgiving Day, but saw that High Rocktane was performing that night. We changed our schedule and stayed an extra night to see them. They are awesome!!! They play a wide variety of tunes, so everyone can enjoy. We will be back to see them again.

allReviews.title: Did not meet expectations.
allReviews.text: No coffee makers & microwaves!! There was no water for a few hrs. Elevators were glitching, but at least the room was clean.Harressment about time shares everywhere!. Probably would not stay there again,  just for the fact u can't make a cup of coffee in your room,& are forced to spend $8 for a 12oz coffee!

allReviews.title: Disastrous stay: broken amenities, poor service, and hidden fees.
allReviews.text: I had the absolute worst experience at this hotel. I was here for work, expecting a smooth and comfortable stay, but it turned out to be a complete nightmare. Here’s a rundown of the issues I faced:1.	Broken Amenities: The heater on the air conditioner didn’t work, and the elevator in our tower was out of service. We were relocated to a different tower, only to find that the elevator there stopped working the very next morning. To make things worse, the water supply was cut off shortly after.2.	Horrible Communication: When I returned from work at 3 AM, exhausted, the parking entrance and main door to our tower were both blocked. There was no prior warning about this. I had to walk all the way around the building to get in. When I approached the reception to ask why guests weren’t informed, Charlene at the front desk was shockingly rude. She told me the entrance is always closed at night and said, “This hotel has 600 doors; we’re not going to notify you if one of them is closed.”3.	Overpriced and Hidden Fees: The hotel is overpriced for the terrible experience it offers. On top of that, I was charged a $200 hotel fee that wasn’t mentioned anywhere during booking.4.	Facilities Closed: When I came back from work the next evening, the restroom was closed too.This hotel completely failed on all fronts—comfort, service, and communication. For the premium price they charge, this level of service is unacceptable. If you’re looking for a hassle-free stay, avoid this place at all costs.

allReviews.title: Great check in
allReviews.text: It's a great experience to check in at Westgate resort in Las Vegas,  Rachelle is excellent at customer service and able to accommodate our need. Your company is lucky to have her!It is a smooth process,  the hotel rooms very modern and nice, great view, clean and smells good

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Show is a Must See!!!
allReviews.text: I saw the Barry Manilow on November 14th and what an amazing show! I also want to thank Joseph B for using me as a “seat filler” by finding an empty seat in row 3 when my ticket was for Row 15. He didn’t have to do that and when I offered to tip him, he put his hand up and said “I appreciate that but it’s not necessary.” Give that man a raise and a promotion for excellence in customer service!!

allReviews.title: EVS Department
allReviews.text: Mohammed was very professional and nice to me. Great great worker!! He is apart of the EVS department. I also saw him helping others as well. Mohammed is a great look for the Westgate hotel. Most definitely was the nicest person since I’ve been here!!

allReviews.title: Great Staff and Customer Service
allReviews.text: The husband and I had dinner plans at Edge Steakhouse for Friday night.  We arrived a little early and stopped at the I-Bar for a drink.  Our bartender Magdalia was an absolute doll.  She had the greatest personality and friendly as can be.  My husband and her shared something in common and it was great seeing her passion come out.  We then went to Edge for our dinner.  Our server Liman was another amazing employee.  He to was very polite courteous and knowledgeable.  He assisted us from picking the wine to great recommendations on the meal.  Westgate has great employees who clearly love there jobs and the place they work for.

allReviews.title: Westgate Timeshare Owners Customer Service Manager Sylvia is Awesome !
allReviews.text: Westgate Timeshare Owners Customer Service Manager Sylvia is terrific and awesome and very helpful to me during my stay at the Vegas Resort & Casino. It makes my visit this year worth the long trip.   I am very appreciative of her support and she is a very accommodating person. Awesome.

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: Westgate was a great time. And the door man Jimmy was the most friendly and helpful during our visit. I will definitely be coming back. Jimmy went above and beyond opening doors for us and making sure we were taken care of. He even assisted in taking our picture.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: We enjoyed a great presentation of Motown music presented live by some very talented singers. They presented great music and encouraged audience participation in a very intimate environment without a bad seat in the house. The drinks were decent as well although priced typical of Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Always a Treat/Close to Everything but Peacefully Located on Paradise!
allReviews.text: Very comfortable stay ALWAYS, w/every detail of comfort at your fingertips…I am glad to be an owner for two years now, & everyone is so accommodating!  Fresco Italiano is a FAV each visit, with exemplary service this time from bartender Emre :-)

allReviews.title: Motown in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Motown Review in Vegas was a Great show. They sing alot of the Hits from the beginning. They give the history of Motor Town aka Motown. Competing with Barry Manolow, I think this Group holds it's own. They definitely fit the Vegas Atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Great Check-In experience
allReviews.text: Veronica G. Provided great service upon check in. She was able to get my group a larger room which I really appreciated. We were celebrating a couple of birthdays and she helped make our time at Westgate a good experience. Thank you Veronica!

allReviews.title: Phenomenal!!!
allReviews.text: I felt just like I was at home!! After hanging out on the strip daily, I couldn't wait to get back to my home away from home! I felt very safe when I slept...walking around the premises... was able to get late night snacks...I had no worries I cannot wait to return!!

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: I didn't stay at the hotel but attended The Soul of Motown. It was AWESOME! I was about to complain that there were no Jackson Five hits but they were at the end. The show started on time, the singers were amazing and brought back so many great memories and made me happy.Having a roving drink server would have been helpful so we didn't have to go to the bar.

allReviews.title: Great visit
allReviews.text: Fantastic service and the friendliest staff I’ve ever had in Las Vegas   From the front desk to restaurants to the cleaning staff. The room was very clean and the bed was fantastic. The pillows are the best. I will definitely come back to the westgate and tell my friends to come as well.

allReviews.title: Charged for extra night for which I did not book.
allReviews.text: I called the hotel to add two night to my booking and was told that the hotel was full.  When I arrived they said that I was expected two night prior.  I was charged for an extra night even though I did not receive any confirmation of the change in my reservation.  I was pretty much told that I was a liar because they were not willing to believe my side of what was said on the phone.  I would have booked my flight for 2 days earlier had I known my reservation was changed.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown - Nice Trip Down Memory Lane
allReviews.text: I had a great time watching Westgate's "Soul of Motown" show. The performers sang many memorable Motown songs. I even danced along a couple of them, which the performers encouraged, btw. As a photographer,  I appreciated that I could take pictures provided that no flash is used.. Value for money. Would watch again.

allReviews.title: Mohammed from EVS f(environmental services)
allReviews.text: Super helpful! Mohammed took the time to take me where I needed to go. Stellar Customer service!!!! I highly recommend it to everyone. He was busy but he still took the time to spend it with me. Everyone has been great . Great experience. Has been coming for a long time.

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: Loved the band High Rocktane! They sang everything I liked!! I highly recommend catching them! They were awesome! Sat there for a couple of hours I will be back! The bar was packed with many people that were dancing and having a great time! love

allReviews.title: Employee appreciation
allReviews.text: Hello, wanted to mention your employee.  Joseph B.  He was the team member that helped us.  So friendly and courteous.  Very professional.  Wanted to make sure he receive a that a boy.   We had the best time.  I am an owner and appreciate people that care about their jobs/ guests.  The week was my birthday had wonderful time.  Thank you.  Cari L. Wilson.

allReviews.title: Sidney Patrick! Come see her!
allReviews.text: Sidney Patrick is amazing! Definitely go see her perform! Her voice is so impressive. She also has the best of the best shoes. She has a variety of music that she sings so there is something for everyone. Come see her if you are anywhere in the area!

allReviews.title: Sidney performance
allReviews.text: Saw Sidney and Billy perform at the Ibar.  They were great! The atmosphere was great, her voice was phenomenal.  Good sound system and friendly staff.  We hope to see Sidney perform again soon. It was a great experience for our whole family and friends.

allReviews.title: Evening at Fresco Italiano
allReviews.text: Everything was wonderful. The meal, the wine and the service. Our server, Emre, was the best part. He was knowledgeable and gave great recommendations. He was attentive and made the evening. We even went back a few days later to try other items on the menu.

allReviews.title: The King Played Here
allReviews.text: Westgate Las Vegas has been a pillar in the Las Vegas Hotel industry for many years. The updating and cleanliness of the property is impressive and the restaurants are among the best in Las Vegas. When you go, check out the Sports Book! Everyone we met was kind and professional.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow is still Awesome!
allReviews.text: We went to the Barry Manilow concert and he did NOT disappoint!  His voice and his moves are still awesome and we had the best time when Joseph B helped us move to an upgraded seating section.  Go see Barry and tell Joseph hello when he helps you find your seats!

allReviews.title: A good show & worth the price!
allReviews.text: I liked the show. I rated it a 4 only because it wasn’t a must see again type thing. I liked that the crowd was able to sing and dance along. The lead female singer was good and she was beautiful with each dress/wig change!  Her male counterparts were also good. The show started on time. There was a bar inside for drinks and a few snacks.

allReviews.title: Birthday Weekend Celebration
allReviews.text: Sunday, Nov 17: Saw April & Brian at the Westgate Las Vegas. They gave an excellent show and are both great singers.  I was celebrating my birthday weekend. My friends and I had a great time. Stayed for two sets. Awesome show…a must see on your next visit to Vegas!!!!

allReviews.title: Front desk - above & beyond. Thanks Tonya.
allReviews.text: Tonya on the Front Desk was absolutely wonderful. Kind, helpful and cheerful and I’m sure she had had a long day! I know I did and she made me feel relaxed and welcome right away. She was knowledgeable about the Trade show I was attending and very helpful with ideas about unwinding after my travels.

allReviews.title: Now dated and it shows
allReviews.text: We had booked a room and we had written in the requests a room on the upper floors and away from the lobby because there is a casino inside , arrived at 21:30 give us a room on the 3rd floor and on the pool ... old room , ugly and dated and not so clean ... we return to the reception and after a bit 'of attempts (thanks to the manager ) give us a room on the upper floors with a beautiful view but still dated and cleanliness mmmmm ... too bad !

allReviews.title: Excellent choice for a Vegas Stay!
allReviews.text: This is a great choice especially if you’re in town for the convention center. It’s only 1 Monorail stop away. The rooms are recently renovated and clean. Comfy bed and nice showers. Good number of shops to get what you need. Excellent steak house, great sport betting area. Seeing Barry Manilow in their theatre was amazing. Thanks to usher Editha C. who was able to give a ticket upgrade. There may be more glamorous hotels, but this is an excellent choice!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow
allReviews.text: A thank you shoutout to Carolyn Leslie who upgraded our Barry Manilow show tickets on Friday. My husband and I are over from England and enjoyed the concert so much but those seats were like hitting the slot progressive. Thank you so much Carolyn and the entertainment team who joined in with the excitement of the crowd.  We have memories to treasure forever.

allReviews.title: Barry or bust.....
allReviews.text: I went to see Barry Manilow and Jonelle was amazing and so helpful through our experience! What a great venue to see a show something you shouldn't miss out on.Great casino, not a bad seat in the house. Don't miss this opportunity to see this amazing show.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow!
allReviews.text: Barry Manilow was Amazing! Great music from the 70’s til now! Timeless Tunes! What a show…The staff at the Westgate is simply Amazing! Especially Jose “Mr Westgate” that was right there to greet us when we waked in! Thanks for a great time! They also have really good live music all night and a nice Poker Room and Sportsbook!

allReviews.title: Always Amazing
allReviews.text: This hotel stands out everytime mainly because of it's amazing staff and leadership. From the valet to frontdesk to housekeeping to food & beverage places to the events planning and services - all the people make the visits enjoyable and pleasurable.

allReviews.title: Very good 5 stars I will hive them
allReviews.text: Very good place for price,food and shows,very helpful  at desk,they tell you everything about hotel,shows and how you can save money,Parking is good,next doors are all wonderful hotels to visit.Fountainblue,Wynn,Trump,Treasure island very near.in your walking around, you will have great fun.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Westgate
allReviews.text: First time to stay at the Westgate Las Vegas.   In town for a convention and proximity to the convention center was important.   Can’t say how impressed we were with our stay.  Yes, it is an older hotel but it has been maintained and kept updated.  Our rooms were huge and recently renovated.    The restaurants were all great and service was spot on.    Check-in / out was quick and efficient.   Access to the strip was a 5 min ride on Uber or cab.  Convention center was a 10 min walk.  We will 100% stay here again.

allReviews.title: Bucket list fulfilled- thanks Racheal for being so awesome!
allReviews.text: Seeing Barry fulfilled a long time bucket list wish. What an amazing experience. Racheal (Entertainment) ensured we found our seats and enjoyed the entire experience. She looked out not only for us, but all other guests in her section with the challenging stairs and ramps. Racheal is a definite asset for the guests and venue!

allReviews.title: We saw Barry! 💙
allReviews.text: Joseph B. was AWESOME!  It was my birthday and we got upgraded! We had a blast and Joseph made sure we were having a good time.  We had a great time seeing Barry at the Westgate in Vegas! Not gonna lie it was an experience of a lifetime with my friends all thanks to Joseph B!

allReviews.title: An old place with few upgrades.
allReviews.text: This is an old casino with superficial things done. Bathroom is a good example. An old fiberglass tub.The room is fairly spacious and shows upgrade (unlike bathroom).The casino floor is small and ventilation is poor.The sports book is huge, well ventilated and the food good.

allReviews.title: Festival of Trees and Lights
allReviews.text: We come to The Festival of Tress and Lights every year. IVery great experience’. Thank you Ken and Team.  It’s our third year in a row.  Making our Special day memorable every year.  Table service and all.  We had the largest attendance this year at almost 500 guests.

allReviews.title: Complete Westgate review.
allReviews.text: Liked the casino floor, sports betting screens were amazingly large, buffet service was efficiently pleasant and delicious. Elder was such a joy the next morning at Sids, after a late night of gambling.The room was just ok, and the bathroom needs updating and more lighting.

allReviews.title: Horrible!!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: I would never ever stay at this hotel again! Unfortunately, I got Covid while I was there, and decided to check out a day early and come home so I wouldn’t get the rest of the hotel guests sick. I called to see if I could get the one day refunded and was told no, that I would have had to call 14 days prior to get a refund. How in the hell could I have known I would have gotten Covid while there? I guess I should have just stayed and got the entire hotel sick? I asked the representative the same question and she just told me there was a 14 day cancellation no matter the situation. Absolutely ridiculous, I’m sure the other guess would not have appreciated me staying and walking through the casino having Covid.   Also, my shower had mold on the ceiling, and the tub was rusted, and the silicone was all chipped out against the wall. This place is awful! Do not stay there if you have a choice!

allReviews.title: Trip saver Nancy Maglich General Manager of Westgate
allReviews.text: Our first trip to Vegas ever to see Barry Manilow almost turned into a disaster...we. were moved three times to different rooms due to a number of issues and then got caught in an elevator for around 40 minutes on our way to the concert making us around 20 minutes late...after technical difficulties and listening to only one song, the concert was cancelled...we had flights out the next day so it looked like the trip was a lost cause, but after explaining our numerous issues Nancy Maglich the general manager stepped up and corrected the problem.  Not only did she give us some credit on our room, but also gave us perfect seat tickets for the Friday show allowing us to stay one extra night for free and threw in $100 credit to our account, which we used for a wonderful dinner the night of concert.  Nancy also offered us a free room for another night, but we had already changed our flight.   As a result of Nancy's professional courtesy we were able to have a very enjoyable trip and a lasting memory of all that could have gone wrong...This is what should be done in all hotels, but this is not always the case.  We are very thankful  we had Mrs. Maglich step in and correct the situation.  If we go back to Vegas anytime soon, we will definitely stay at the Westgate...Mike & Melanie

allReviews.title: Sydney Patrick
allReviews.text: Finally, the Westgate brought some talent back to the International stage. Two years of suck, this duo is fresh, different. A pretty lady with a guitar and a solid beat boxer doing great arrangements of contemporary music, it takes a while to pick it out until you recognize the lyrics, they are OUTSTANDING! New and unique, I'm really glad I stayed.

allReviews.title: Westgate Resort & Casino
allReviews.text: The owners club at Westgate was very nice.  Aida the In House Greeter was awesome & very helpful.  She made our visit at the Westgate Club very enjoyable & relaxing.  The refreshments were good.  Overall the resort was excellent. The only negative no internet.

allReviews.title: Would definitely stay again!
allReviews.text: Great hotel, easy to navigate, all the amenities without being over the top.  Nice bar, great restaurants, good shops, sports bar and sports book area really good, casino was good without being toooo much. Easy to get to the strip from the monorail or grab a cab or Uber.  I would definitely stay at the Westgate again.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown show in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I went to the Soul of Motown show and it was outstanding me and my cousin that lives in Vegas had so much fun. She had not experience this great show even though she lives in the city so it was a great treat for us to be able to enjoy this show. I will definitely come back with friends and family please Westgate do not let these entertainers Leave your venue.

allReviews.title: Barry Maniolw

allReviews.title: BEWARE
allReviews.text: Arriving at 10pm on a Thursday night, there was a long line to check-in, but only one agent at the desk with about 20 open stations. Lots of employees were wondering around but no one seemed too concerned. The rest of the weekend, the lines were substantially longer. I felt bad for those folks. After about 20 minutes of waiting in a line barely moving, I called the number to the hotel to let them know. When I told the operator, she told me she was just the operator so she wasn’t able to help. I asked, “well, could you let a manager know?” She said she would. A few minutes later, about 3 more agents filed out from the office to assist. Finally with a check-in agent, we were told that even though we booked a king room, they had none available, so they would put us in a room with 2 beds. She blamed other booking agencies for overbooking - which I can sympathize with but that is not our problem. But no worries, tomorrow, we could go through the hassle of moving once a king room became available. We had to leave our luggage with the bellman the next morning before heading out. We picked up our luggage later that afternoon, went to new room, and it smelled of sewage upon opening the door. They moved us again and this room was fine. Listen, this is a time share hotel and they are vultures. If you go to Guest Assistance looking for the closest restroom, they will try to get you to book a tour. It’s really annoying. I will not stay there again for those reasons and its location. I’ll pay more and be on the strip. Also, like many other Vegas hotels, there are no coffee makers in the rooms. You have to get presentable in the morning to go get coffee or pay for room service.

reviewsWithMentions.title: High expectations but left a little salty
reviewsWithMentions.text: When my wife and I walked in the lobby we felt like celebrities.  The place is beautiful and massive but after a few days it starts to feel like a hotel within a luxury mall.  Far enough away from the strip to avoid the congestion and chaos but close enough to walk there.  Also within walking distance of Fremont Street. The gym is spectacular.  The staff was great. The casino is clean and nice but allows smoking including cigars.  That was annoying and I smoke cigars. Most of the pools were closed due to ice rink set up.  Our suite was big and had a great view of strip and sphere.  I know it is Vegas but $54 for two glasses of house wine at the main casino bar is a joke.  $27 for a smoothie in the food court is also absurd.  My wife and I make great livings but overcharging for basic drinks and food pissed us off. We found a local liquor store and walked around with our own cocktails after night one. Also, as we read in several reviews, get rid of one ply toilette paper and clear some space in the room fridge for guest waters (so guests don’t have to buy $20 bottles from you).  Those little things make a five star hotel a four star. This is a nice, clean and modern hotel but we left feeling a little salty and will try somewhere else next time.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: Luxury, celebration, and modern elegance
allReviews.text: Our stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas was truly spectacular. From the very beginning, Leslie at reception welcomed us with warmth and professionalism, surprising us with a $150 credit to celebrate my birthday and our anniversary. This thoughtful gesture elevated our celebration and set the tone for an unforgettable visit. Mike at concierge was equally outstanding, ensuring every detail was seamless.The room was impressive and ultra‑modern, with intuitive electronic controls for curtains, drapes, and lighting that added both comfort and sophistication. Housekeeping kept everything impeccable, enhancing the sense of refined luxury.Beyond the casino, the restaurants, the variety of bars, and the world‑class facilities were fabulous, offering a perfect mix of style, atmosphere, and culinary excellence. With its $3.7 billion investment, Fontainebleau is far from ordinary. It redefines what a Las Vegas resort can be. We are absolutely delighted with our experience and would recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone seeking an unforgettable stay.

allReviews.title: Our new favorite hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Book your stay at the Fontainebleau without hesitation! I spent way too much time researching whether or not to stay here - only to decide to give it a try… and we LOVED it. In the past we’ve stayed at Mandalay Bay, Aria, Venetian, Cosmopolitan, Encore, and Wynn. Fountainbleau is our new favorite. For this trip, we spent 1 night at the Wynn before switching to the Fontainebleau for 3 nights.I have a separate review of our stay at Wynn, but suffice it to say it felt outdated and ‘tired’ compared to the Fontainebleau. We arrived at the Fontainebleau at 11:50am on a Wednesday. Were greeted by smiling valets who opened the doors for us. Seems like a small gesture, but great service gives the right vibe to start your stay (Wynn valets were chit chatting instead of opening doors for guests). The lobby is breathtaking. The smell of fresh flowers is a nice welcome. It looked like there was a small line about to form but Oscar directed the two families in front of us to different agents, then told us to follow him and checked us in himself. He was friendly and helpful. Room was ready, no wait. Oscar gave us a room of the 65th floor, with a great view of the Sphere. The friendliness of the staff at the Fountainebleau was significantly superior to the Wynn. The room is awesome. Clean. Beautiful. They did an incredible job with the design and branding. Bow ties everywhere. Clean white and blue design makes you think it’s a Vegas casino meet Santorini. High ceilings. Luxe atmosphere. Plenty of tables and slots. The casino is not crowded but not dead either, it strikes the right balance of enough people that it’s a buzz, but without the crowds. It’s perfect. A lot more people at night - still the right balance.  The promenade is great, and the food options are excellent. We ate here several times throughout our stay. The Salmon bowl at Bar Ito is excellent. The Black Jack burger at Capons incredible. The Bird (Turkey, avocado, bacon, Brie) sandwich at Nona is the best Turkey sandwich we’ve ever had. Lots of options for coffee, like ‘Break’ at the food court, Chez Bon Bon, or Cafe Cuto (very close to guest elevators, 2nd floor). The gym is superb! Large, spacious, lots of machines. Modern. Feels like going to a real upscale gym. I recognized Gaten Matarazzo (Dustin from Stranger Things) working out in the gym, but he had his headphones in so everyone left him alone. Turned out he was presenting one of the awards at the NHL Awards later that afternoon. Pool area is awesome. Lots of pool options and great service. The servers were on point and attentive. Limited menu selection to your chairs, but full menu if you want to go to La Cote for lunch. Food was delicious and service was great (believe our server was Nashawn. Super friendly). We also had dinner one night at the Washing Potato (upscale Chinese. Great food. Great vibe. Showed up at 9pm with no reservation and were seated promptly). Hotel checkout time is 11am but they extended us to noon without a fuss. If you’re doing Uber, there are 2 rideshare locations for pick up. Just stick with the North rideshare. It’s easier. The south rideshare is downstairs and every Uber driver seems to get confused (they circle around the Taxi area upstairs and don’t realize they need to go down the ramp). North rideshare is easier. Also, bring your own water bottle as the hotel has those airport water bottle stations throughout the casino, where you can refill your own water. The room also has a small cooling drawer besides the mini bar, which is great to chill BYO drinks or late night snacks.  Everything about this hotel just put all the other hotels on the strip to shame. And btw - the water pressure! Excellent. I’m buying the same shower head. Sportsbook is one of the better ones around too. I’m pretty set of sticking with Fountainebleau for my upcoming visits. Nothing else on the strip compares. If you don’t mind taking an Uber to/from shows or clubs - book this hotel without hesitation and have a blast!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel

allReviews.title: Wanna-Be.
allReviews.text: TL;DR:  FONTAINEBLUEAU has potential, and the public areas are impressive. BUT it's low-class and disappointing.  Wanna-Be.  HOWEVER, I really want you to stay here because then you will help free up occupancy at the good places we like to go to normally :)   We (couple) go to Vegas an average of 1/month for 15 years now, almost all high-end casinos (we have our favorites).  This is the first time we stayed at FONTAINEBLUEAU (4 days), and we will not be back.FONTAINEBLEAU disappoints.-- Public areas are impressive. Shiny and huge. But!... -- Rooms are very subpar.--  Weird super disgusting grease (KY?) smeared in blobs on the window.  Very obvious.-- Room window in general super dirty (from the inside).-- Huge nest of long black hair inside the shower.  Yuck.-- Sinks have super water-savers, almost non-functional (drip drip drip) -- Very heavy (50 lbs+) rock room table not secured to tiny wooden foundation -- dangerous.-- Check out on TV did not work.-- Check out on email did not work.-- Half the number of towels of other casinos on the strip.-- Tiny individual shampoo pouches (reminds me of Motel 6, etc.). Smells disgusting (opinion).-- Tiny hard white soap for the sinks -- low quality and literally as bad as Motel-6 quality.-- Lamp in room did not work, and no access to plug to fix it.-- Window black-out shades/curtains close randomly during our entire 4-day stay.-- Housekeeping staff has very loud conversations for 45+ minutes daily outside the room door!... disruptive and insensitive.-- Concierge gave us completely wrong information regarding picking up our concert tickets.-- Location (not factored into my low review) is abysmal.  -- casino drinks were the worst I've had from anywhere in Vegas (including lowest-end places).

allReviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
allReviews.text: Personally I didn't experience some of the negative comments around the piped scent (more to follow on that one) or the poor hygiene standards. The only issues I found was the smell of cigars around the casino area and the bleau bar in the centre of the ground floor (not a massive problem just when walking past a cigar smoker which may explain the comment/review about the overpowering piped scent, rather have that than disgusting cigars IMO). The drinks and food were expensive in the hotel however this is Vegas so kind of accept it but no more expensive than Dubai for example. The food we had was of excellent quality. Location was perfect in the slightly quieter north end of the strip, however only a 15min walk to the Strat or the Dueuce bus which goes up and down the strip for $16 a 24 hr pass stops outside north and south, its a 20 min ride up to Freemont Street or a 25 min ride down to the Las Vegas sign. Overall this hotel was fantastic and would highly recommend it, if in Vegas again we would definitely stop here.

allReviews.title: Warning for Allergy Sufferers and Guests Sensitive to Fragrance
allReviews.text: I want to leave a warning for anyone with allergies, asthma, mast-cell issues, or even mild chemical sensitivity: the scent diffusers at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas are overwhelming. The fragrance is so thick you could cut it with a knife—you can literally taste it. The smell is strong enough that you notice it 30 feet outside the property, and once inside it is intense enough to make people with even moderate sensitivities genuinely sick.For context, I do not live in a bubble and would describe my sensitivity level as somewhere between mild and moderate. I’m not opposed to signature scents at hotels either. In fact, if I could bottle whatever Wynn and Encore use, I’d run it in my own home. But staying and walking through Fontainebleau felt like spending 24 straight hours inside an Uber with the cheapest gas-station air fresheners hanging from every surface.The scent is so heavy it affects the taste of your food in the restaurants. I eventually learned to breathe through my mouth while covering my face with my shirt every time I left my room. My first day in Vegas was ruined before I even realized what was happening—just 30 minutes on the property triggered a pounding headache, itching of my scalp and back, and complete nasal congestion. When I called home to say I’d arrived safely, my boyfriend immediately said, “You sound awful,” without knowing I was having a full reaction.If you have any kind of fragrance sensitivity, I strongly recommend avoiding this property.For those without sensitivities, the hotel itself is lovely. The price was reasonable, the service excellent, and the rooms are comfortable. I was a bit disappointed that the developers didn’t take the opportunity to surpass Wynn and Encore in design and build quality (particularly with regard to the uninspired common areas) but perhaps there is only one Steve Wynn and one Roger Thomas.  If those spectacular properties were not next-door for comparison purposes, or if this were a large convention hotel and casino anywhere else, it would easily set a standard for quality and design.  I have two more nights here covering my face,  breathing through my mouth, dousing myself in antihistamines and avoiding common areas because it is a prepaid reservation through a third-party vendor.  Wish me luck!

allReviews.title: Disappointed and dirty room for a 5 star
allReviews.text: I was really excited to stay here. It looked like it could compete for #1 in LV. But when we got to our room, there was something smudged on the wall. Pubic hair was in the shower and bathroom floor. Cleanliness should be non negotiable for a 5 star. But it was an issue in our room. When we notified staff, they took their sweet time coming to help. They didn’t bother to clean it but just abruptly moved us to a new room, which is fine but there was no apology but they did give $25 casino credit. The new room was clean and beautiful, as you should expect from a 5 star.

allReviews.title: Still Extraordinary and Exceptional
allReviews.text: Many a stay at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas since our first and still extraordinary:  A at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas decidedly did not disappoint to say the very least. The establishment presented with exceptional and extraordinary attention to the most minute of guest and aesthetic detail only overshadowed by the exemplary level of servicing.The accommodations were superb and well thought-out inclusive of provided amenities. Where the likes of the Bellagio rooms have become dated and stale, this resort is fresh, innovative, welcoming and crisp. Similarly, the common areas exhibit the same ambiance and thoughtfulness to curating the overall experience. Unfortunately, where the culinary offerings within were vehemently energetic serving up remarkably brilliant fare, the gaming area lacked said energy and vibe due to the simple lack of persons therein.The writer is confidently hopeful that given time that this outstanding and incomparable venue will draw in the crowds in filling the common areas. With this said, the lack of masses in attendance did not significantly detract from the experience and was soundly augmented by consummate and commendable servicing. The staff came across as being a genuine part of the Fontainebleau “family” providing caring and conscientious servicing to the extent of making the guest feel more than welcome and an appreciated included member of the same intimate family. In speaking with staff, the majority seem to have come from other top-tier competitors in the fervent belief that they could contribute in such a significant way in making this establishment the best on the Strip. Consequently, “exemplary” servicing throughout….Finally, for those concerned with the distance from the central Strip, a short walk destines one in the heart of everything. Although, with such extensive offerings within the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, there really is no reason necessitating leaving in the first place.My entire group looks forward to many more return engagements….

allReviews.title: High expectations but left a little salty
allReviews.text: When my wife and I walked in the lobby we felt like celebrities.  The place is beautiful and massive but after a few days it starts to feel like a hotel within a luxury mall.  Far enough away from the strip to avoid the congestion and chaos but close enough to walk there.  Also within walking distance of Fremont Street. The gym is spectacular.  The staff was great. The casino is clean and nice but allows smoking including cigars.  That was annoying and I smoke cigars. Most of the pools were closed due to ice rink set up.  Our suite was big and had a great view of strip and sphere.  I know it is Vegas but $54 for two glasses of house wine at the main casino bar is a joke.  $27 for a smoothie in the food court is also absurd.  My wife and I make great livings but overcharging for basic drinks and food pissed us off. We found a local liquor store and walked around with our own cocktails after night one. Also, as we read in several reviews, get rid of one ply toilette paper and clear some space in the room fridge for guest waters (so guests don’t have to buy $20 bottles from you).  Those little things make a five star hotel a four star. This is a nice, clean and modern hotel but we left feeling a little salty and will try somewhere else next time.

allReviews.title: A five star rating but could still be subtly improved......
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Fontainbleau for 5 nights, with five other relatives and friends also joining us.I had spent ages looking at the various reviews of all the other hotels in Las Vegas, and that the Fontainbleau hotel had still only been open for less than 2 years, and its modern look and feel swung it for us.   Hotel roomWe stayed in a best view golden room on the 69th floor.   I had pre requested a suite, but none were available on checkin.   We were not that disappointed though and the view was really good looking out onto the sphere.   These rooms have a large walk in shower, rather than a bath tub/shower as per the rooms that have the mountain view.  The fit and finish of the room was very nice and of a good standard and the bed very comfortable.   The air con was also efficient and relatively quiet.  One aspect to be careful with is the minibar and adjacent snacks.   If you remove an item for more than 60 seconds, you will be charged for it automatically.  On checkin we were also cautioned about this.   One aspect for us europeans that was also lacking, was an in-room coffee/tea making facility.   A minor issue but we missed that option.   The room was made up every day but again one minor comment is that the floors were only vacuumed once during our 5 day stay.   While we are not untidy, we would have expected this more frequently.   The rooms have touch panels for the lighting and also to close the curtains.  A nice touch, but they seemed to have a mind of their own on occasion and could take several goes to get the curtains either fully open or closed.   I suspect that long term these may be problematic.     Location.  We were aware that the hotel is located toward the far end of the strip, but we were aware of that and used the nearby monorail station at the Westgate hotel a couple of times, and equally enjoyed the walk to the other hotels, such as Caesars Palace etc.    On site parking.   The hotel has a huge self parking garage, which was free for the period of our stay having signed up to the members club.    Overall hotel quality.   As others have mentioned, the hotel communal areas are kept very clean and tidy and are beautifully finished, providing a modern, spacious and elegant feel.   Restaurant and bar options.  There is a wide range of options and all that we ate at, Dons Prime, Washing Potato (twice) and The Tavern were really very good.   During our visit, the SEMA car show was on, and the hotel was really busy as the exhibition centre is attached to the hotel.   It was pretty imperative that you booked the restaurant in advance to avoid disappointments, especially when looking to seat larger groups.  Fortunately I had made bookings on three nights for us well in advance.   The main bar area on level 1 was really busy in the evening and the staff were struggling to keep up, and it could take some time to obtain a drink and all seats taken.   On occasion we gave up and went to the bar on level 2 near the food court and koyu restaurant, as this tended to be less busy.   Collins bar was lovely and we enjoyed several visits there.  Worth a visit !I will be writing separate reviews for Don Prime and Washing potato.   One thing that I find frustrating though is that the online menus do not include the prices.  I really wish that this could be corrected, but note that others do a similar thing.   I just like to have an idea of approximate prices ahead of a visit.  Overall, a really lovely hotel and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.   It's definitely a five star award but with some minor improvements could make it unbeatable.   We would certainly return again.

allReviews.title: I really want to like this hotel…but I can’t
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Fontainebleau. Had high expectations since it’s a one Michelin Key hotel.All the hardware are modern, elegant, more elevated than other luxury hotels on the strip.However, the hardware is the only thing to be impressed about. Our trip took a turn at night.Our room is facing the swimming pool. At 9 PM, some staff started working on the pool, likely cleaning as we hear loud jet stream cleaner noise. We thought it will be just an hour, so did not mind too much about it.They continued on deep into the night. With the loud machine noise until 3AM. Called the front desk at 1AM to complain and ask if they can start cleaning in the morning. I was shocked by the response: “We are a 24 hour resort, the staff needs to do things when it needs to be done”There was no apology at all about the noises, just a cold answer. This unprofessional is at a 5 star luxury hotel doubts me why they were awarded the Michelin key. Don’t think I would stay here again, the service is way below what it should be.

allReviews.title: First and NOT last stay at Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at Fontainebleau and it will not be the last. The resort is the cleanest I have seen in Vegas in a very long time. From our room to the gaming area, it was spotless. We had numerous meals there and they were all delicious. The staff was extremely friendly and went out of their way at numerous times during our 4-day stay. It was refreshing knowing that it is hard to attract and retain good help in so many of the service industries all over the world... but they have some keepers!

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel with great customer service!
allReviews.text: This hotel is great! It is very clean, modern, and spacious. The rooms are large and technologically advanced. It is also a very short walk to the Sahara, which has the monorail to take you down the strip. We had a small issue with one of the room appliances and the staff were extremely accommodating to help us get it resolved. I’d recommend this to anyone coming to Vegas!

allReviews.title: First Class Experience
allReviews.text: An overall excellent experience.  The fact that the property is very new, certainly doesn't hurt.  Beyond that the hotel has a luxury feel without the Las Vegas tackiness.  The rooms are good size with large bathrooms.  The rooms that don't have a bath have a huge shower.  Until 12/31, they are not charging for o/n guest parking.  They also, do not charge that annoying "resort fee".  There is a large number working at the checkin desk.  No wait for checkin or out.  Service was excellent overall as well.

allReviews.title: Luxury Stay
allReviews.text: I had a great experience during my stay. From the moment we arrived, things started off on the right foot—we were able to check in early and the staff greeted us warmly even offering complimentary bottled water.The room was lovely spacious, clean, and with a beautiful strip view. The shower was impressively large, and the bed was comfortable.There was a minor hiccup with the toilet not flushing properly, but I called the front desk and maintenance arrived within about 10 minutes. They fixed it quickly and professionally.We appreciated the combination of comfort, service, and amenities and would definitely go back!

allReviews.title: Worst hotel experience ever.
allReviews.text: My wife, daughter and I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas from August 28th to August 31st, 2025, and I’m disgusted by our experience. On the morning of the last day of our stay, we heard a loud noise in the room, however after sitting up in bed and looking around, we did not find what caused the noise and went back to sleep. A couple of hours later when opening the curtains in the room we noticed that a window was cracked. We immediately contacted the front desk to let them know.  Shortly thereafter security guards, concierge and maintenance personnel from the hotel arrived to inspect the damage. After looking over everything, they mentioned that it was likely caused by an external impact. We were then asked to go to the front desk to speak with a resort manager.The resort manager, explained that security had determined the damage was due to a duck impact, as they had found a dead duck in the area below the window.When doing our checkout, we paid the resort fees and some restaurant charges and then left.After coming home, I was blindsided with a $11,000 charge to my credit card. When I reached out to dispute the charge, their response was dismissive, unprofessional, and completely lacking in accountability. No evidence was provided, and no effort was made to fairly resolve the issue. I felt totally taken advantage off and fell like they expected me to just accept it. The final straw was when I was advised that their third-party vendor determined that we were at fault, but no other information was presented. I have never encountered this kind of blatant dishonesty from a hotel. I have since disputed the charges with my bank and filed formal complaints and even had an attorney send a letter to the hotel to dispute the charge and yet, have not gotten any response from the hotel. This is not just bad customer service, it’s fraud. The hotel management should be ashamed of this behavior.

allReviews.title: Bogus resort fee
allReviews.text: This is not a 5 star hotel. There is no coffee in the room. Not even a free water bottle in the room. The food in the food court is RIDICULOUSLY expensive. They are renovating the largest pool into an ice rink, so we could not get lounge chairs at the pools. $55 resort fee for WHAT?! Total scam.

allReviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Beautiful hotel with everything you need inside
allReviews.text: The hotel is really beautiful and very big, with a casino, restaurants, shops, and bars all inside … you almost don’t need to leave! Everything was clean, and the rooms were comfortable and nicely decorated. Definitely a great place to stay in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay!
allReviews.text: Check in was a breeze and very courteous. Our room was on the 19th floor and the first impressions on the way was WOW! Chic and Posh! Our room was beautiful and had a great view of the Sphere. Overall, we had a wonderful 3 night stay!

allReviews.title: A spectacular hotel
allReviews.text: I was here for a two-day conference and was amazed by the beauty of this hotel. Brand new, it represents an unbridled luxury where the casino with its bright colors is out of tune in the midst of the many luxury boutiques (if there were no casino it would seem to be in Via Montenapoleone). Slightly outside position compared to the strip but really classy.

allReviews.title: Thiefs at this resort
allReviews.text: My eldest daughter decided to elope to Las Vegas so we booked three room at the Fountainebleau for the whole family. We were robbed!!! Someone came into my daughters room and took our families pearls and the Hermes bag that had her and her new husbands wedding gifts inside. We reported it to the resort and although they acted like they cared nothing was done. No return call, no follow up. I also reported the theft to the police as it  was over $4000. The officer that took my statement did tell me that when he was younger the same thing happened to him at the Venetian. So be aware!!!!

allReviews.title: Very good rooms and service.
allReviews.text: Despite being a massive convention hotel, it’s really a nice place to stay. Room was large and comfortable. Equally so for the bed. Bathroom super nice. Rooms on both sides of the hotel have beautiful night views of the city. You will want to be careful about staying on the side that faces music venues, since those can get very loud. I had to move rooms to the other side, but I figure that out quickly enough. Lots of good restaurants to eat at, judging by the menus. Casino is so-so. Location is mediocre as well, given that it is on the northernmost part of the strip. That said, I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

allReviews.title: This place is huge and amazing!
allReviews.text: It took more than 15 years to finish this place,  but it was well worth it. The place is huge! The place is grand! Tons of slots, tons of table games. Very spacious upscale casino. Many different restaurants; many shops. All upscale. Bring your wallet. The chandeliers are amazing. Wide spacious isles. It's worth just seeing the place. They could really make it excellent by making the table games lower limits and better rules. It's worth a visit.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend, especially if you’re attending an event at the festival grounds
allReviews.text: Friends and I stayed here to attend the When We Were Young Festival at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds. Everyone thought the hotel was incredible and you couldn’t beat the location for attending the festival, it was right across the street. The room was amazing, I stayed in a double queen room on the 65th floor, it even had a huge soaking tub, which was amazing after 12 hours on my feet at the festival. We also had a cabana at the Oasis pool on Saturday, which was also great. You really can’t beat the service either, all of the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. I definitely plan on staying here again.

allReviews.title: Absolutely Fabulous!!
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is just absolutely fabulous!!! From the moment you arrive you are greeted with a smile. Andrew at the front desk was fantastic.  Derel Turner at the bell desk was so accommodating.  The lobby is spectacular.  The rooms are GORGEOUS.  The high end finishes through out the hotel are gorgeous.   A yes yes yes!! The pool is amazing!  The carpet still smells like brand new.  I would definitely stay here again.  I highly recommend!!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Room With Impeccable Service
allReviews.text: For business this hotel is perfect. The rooms are stunning and the conference facilities are extremely well located. All the staff here are superb and although LV is not my most favourite place to visit I would most certainly look forward to returning to stay in this hotel.

allReviews.title: Horrible customer service
allReviews.text: The customer service is not there.Not only I had an only experience but a friend of mine had also a worst experience.I love the hotel but the employees have an attitude and not a good one

allReviews.title: Upscale strip location
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at almost every hotel in Las Vegas for the last 40 years, so I like to try anything new that pops up. Despite my disdain for staying anywhere on the strip, I opted for a weekend here. The hotel is simply one of the most beautiful in the world. The artwork, the flooring and the decorations are just amazing. The gym is the biggest and nicest gym I’ve ever seen in a hotel, however, it was usually pretty busy. You are best to work out early in the morning if you can do it.My emphasis is on the gambling, so I’m going to just talk about that. This is typical strip – you get worse payout odds, and all the house advantages. More importantly, the dealers making it a great experience with a few and far between. There’s nothing I hate worse than a dealer with no personality. The slot machines were as tight as anything I’ve ever seen and even when you hit a bonus, it was often a bust. Did not see many hand pays the whole weekend. No place to really watch sports unless you reserve a table at the Tavern- that really aggravated me. Had to walk across to Westgate to have the real Sportsbook college football experience. Food was typical- high priced and not memorable. Pool was overrun by college kids as it was their senior weekend and they flooded Vegas. Not going to complain about that though !Room was beautiful and clean. Best water pressure in the shower ever! Also no issues with hot water.

allReviews.title: Luxurious rooms, but you pay for everything
allReviews.text: Beautiful rooms and bathrooms. The gym is great. And they were filming Hacks on site, which was really cool. Big drawback for me was no coffee in the room. You can rent a nespresso machines… for $100!! Room service coffee was $17. That bugged me a lot. When traveling for business, coffee in the room is a must.

allReviews.title: Vegas Elegance Far from the Vegas Glam and Actiom
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for four nights during a tech conference and it was a treat! Check-in was a breeze and from the moment I stepped inside the lobby just radiated elegance and beauty. My room on the 16th floor was pure luxury. Loved the comfy king bed and stunning views of the Vegas skyline. I was obsessed with the room’s techy touches like controlling the lights and drapes right from my bedside felt so fancy.Now let’s talk food...
