I splurged on room service one night and ended up with the most expensive (but yet delicious) nachos and Coke of my life. It was a jaw-dropping $71! The food court wasn’t exactly a budget saver either with fast food running about $45 per person. So bring your high-roller energy (or in my case my company expense card ).The casino looked modern and inviting, but I didn’t get the chance to test my luck as conference life kept me busy. My only real gripe is that The Fontainebleau is a bit of a hike from the main Vegas strip so wear comfy shoes or grab an Uber. Overall, I had a wonderful stay full of luxury, high-tech and Vegas glam.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay
allReviews.text: Fabulous hotel, extremely high quality. The bedding, facilities, staff, all 10/10. Stunning view of the strip. Highly recommended, wonderful stay.

allReviews.title: We will be back
allReviews.text: Wonderful decor, very accommodating and professional staff, excellent food at Vida, excellent cocktails - only the gaming result (slots) is not satisfactory even on the third visit.

allReviews.title: Beware of Hidden Fees at Fontainebleau Hotel
allReviews.text: I booked my stay at the Fontainebleau Hotel through a third-party vendor and paid hotel fees and taxes upfront, as pre-payment was required. Despite this, upon checkout, I was hit with an unexpected charge of over $249+ in additional taxes and fees — none of which were disclosed during booking or at check-in.The lack of transparency around these charges is deeply concerning. While the hotel clearly communicated the $150 food credit, they failed to mention these hidden fees until the very end of my stay. I’ve since contacted the third-party vendor, who is now investigating why these charges were added.If you value clear pricing and reliable customer service, I would strongly reconsider booking at this establishment. Unexpected charges like these should never be part of the customer experience.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous Hotel, with lux room & plenty of great food choices
allReviews.text: Gorgeous hotel, great room & tasty, diverse choices for food.Having stayed at many high end hotels in Vegas, it’s hard to be surprised but Fontainebleau did just that. From quick, organized checkin to thoughtful, friendly staff who went above & beyond. Whether calling down for foam pillows or extra towels..every request was handled quickly & professionally. The room itself was beautiful & well appointed & planned out with enough space, draws & closet area to accommodate an extended stay.The casino is clean & beautiful with well working HVAC system so you hardly notice any smoke. Food options are fabulous with plenty of variety from garment to takeout, small cafes, diner style & cute food court area for those who don’t want to eat at an expensive, fancy restaurant every night. They even have a little store with snacks, meds, drinks etc so you don’t have to leave the resort if you choose not to. The pool is lovely with plenty of open space & chairs. My only criticism is Uber pick up is a bit far & confusing, but that is true of many large Vegas resorts. So much to see with plenty of cute, hidden corners & art work to discover….can’t wait to return.

allReviews.title: Showtime on the Strip
allReviews.text: A great place to see a show, first class lounges and restaurants, to go with the best sound system on the strip. We look forward to seeing more band’s at this hotel in the future.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: This is by far the best hotel in Las Vegas . We have stayed at several hotels in Vegas and The Fontainebleau is exceptional and no other Vegas hotel can compare. Check in was easy and service throughout the hotel was excellent. There are 6000 red roses in the lobby that are changed daily. The hotel is 2 years old, luxurious and has spectacular views of the sphere and the Las Vegas strip. We had a best view gold room on the 53rd floor. We tried La Fontaine restaurant and Don’s Prime restaurants as well as the pool cafes and the food court. All were very good.  the casino is modern and bright and much nicer than dated snd dark casinos in the strip. The hotel is 2.5 miles from the Bellagio fountain and a quick Uber ride . We will only stay at this hotel now she we come to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent new hotel in Las Vegas (few minor hiccups however)
allReviews.text: We stayed at Fountainebleau Las Vegas after switching hotels from New York New York. All I can say is WOW, this hotel is gorgeous. Immediately when we arrived in the uber, the friendly doormen greeted us. We walk into reception and see this huge display of red roses. The reception was busy, so they immediately opened another kiosk and was checked in swiftly, Overall this hotel was top notch, The only reason for the 4 star rating was the original room we had had a leak under the carpet which was only discovered on day 2 of us being there. Nevertheless the hotel moved us to a different room upon request. However it would have been nice if they offered us a free room upgrade or food voucher given the inconvenience of room switching. We also found the cocktail prices at the pool bar astronomical, I get this is vegas but honestly was shocked how much each cocktail cost. Also the first day we dined at an in house burger hotel, and didn’t find the quality there for the price.However despite these hiccups, I would stay here without hesitation if ever back in Vegas.

allReviews.title: The worst experience ever
allReviews.text: The worst service experience ever.I had a reservation since August for a convention (October 6), and when I arrived, the hotel’s system declined three different cards, including a debit card with enough funds. The staff admitted that many guests attending the convention were having the same issue, yet they offered no real solution.I even called my bank in Mexico, and they confirmed that there were no issues with my cards and that the charges the hotel claimed to have made never even appeared. Clearly, the problem was on their end.After wasting so much time at the lobby, I finally booked a room at the Hilton right across the street, and my card was accepted instantly — no problem at all.A traveler expects to feel welcomed and taken care of, especially after a long trip. Instead, this was the worst experience I’ve ever had at a hotel. A place of this level should never treat guests this way or have such a faulty payment system.I absolutely do not recommend staying here..#46536776-1

allReviews.title: #1 Hotel Resort in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Wonderful resort, food choices first class.  The service level is unappareled compared to the other resorts.  The staff genuinely cares about the guests and will go out of their way to make sure your stay is perfect.   The pool area is perfect and secure, along with a lot of fun.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Experience
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel and rooms were luxurious, spacious and meticulously clean.  Staff was very professional and friendly. I loved the variety of slots.

allReviews.title: Modern Comfort & Average Service
allReviews.text: Location (4/5)North end of the Strip, but easy to access rideshare.  Easy walk to Resorts World, Wynn, Venetian, and a Walgreens.Accommodations (4/5)Excellent room rate for a rewards member during a weekday.  Bleu King room was not a strip view, but located on one of the top floors.  Room was very clean and modern, however,  will say lacked the Las Vegas "wow factor" and was not as large as expected. Note: some Bleu King rooms have a shower and some have both a shower and tub; be certain to request at the front desk if this is important to you.  Service (3/5)Overall, service was adequate, but nothing stands out.  As I was new to the property, I wish the information provided by the front desk was more complete and welcoming.  Not once greeted by staff at the pool.  Blackjack dealers and pit bosses were kind and engaging, however, not many people playing.  Dining (3/5)Expensive as expected.  I sat solo at the bar at Don's Prime.  Service and food were mediocre.  Maybe the dining room is better?Atmosphere (4/5)Other than the casino, the property is inviting and the pool area was large.  A bit "sterile" as others have mentioned. Value for Money (4/5)Excellent rate for weekday stay as rewards member.  I likely would not pay rack rates for this property.  Cleanliness (5/5)The hotel was clean and fresh in all areas.Overall ExperienceI would return in the future if offered a good rate.

allReviews.title: Great place for mother daughter get away!
allReviews.text: My daughter and I go to Vegas every year. First time at Fontainebleau! We are spoiled now!! Loved everything about it. Rooms, casino, pools, bars, restaurants, and staff. We have found our forever vacation home!!

allReviews.title: Wonderful time that I'd recommend to anyone
allReviews.text: Great and beautiful hotel that is starting to feel like my home away from home that I'd recommend to anyone and everyone I know...

allReviews.title: Very beautiful, high end hotel
allReviews.text: A very beautiful hotel. Feels very clean and high-end. The pool is beautiful. The room was very clean and comfortable. The cooling drawer for drinks was appreciated. The only downside side were the prices. Yes, Vegas is expensive. But the restaurants, bars and pool area prices were extremely high. If your going to celebrate and just have a good time, just be prepared to spend a lot!

allReviews.title: Great room and food.
allReviews.text: Great room and view. The space was good. I am from Texas so I am use to space . The food at the hotel was good. The only problem I encountered was that our door didn’t shut. We had to make to sure the door closed. Our room was right by the ice machine and someone mistakenly came in our room, thinking it was the ice room. After that we had to make sure the door closed all the way. I did love how you could put on your privacy light and the service light for service.

allReviews.title: A gem in the desert
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with a great staff waiting to help you.  Truly a gem in the desert!  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The quality of the food at the restaurants was fantastic.  I would of liked to stay longer unfortunately it was a very short trip.

allReviews.title: Good location, fair prices
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. The hotel is new and beautiful, with very appealing rooms that are not as clairvoyant as many other Vegas hotels. The cleanliness of the rooms was also good. The location is ideal, and the Price quality ratio for the rooms was fine. We didn't play at the casino, we just stayed the night. The coffeehouse offers fresh produce, but the prices are a bit high. Overall a recommended stay!

allReviews.title: Pushing towards Top Tier
allReviews.text: Price wise Fontainebleau is charging Top Tier rates. Is it worth it?  Yes if you’re catching a concert like the Tears for Fears residency, while staying, playing and partying poolside. Da Chicago Bears were in town and there was a notable fan base. Instead of going to Allegiant we opted to watch the game on the Giant Screen by the pool. Great decision! Sure you’re still paying stadium prices for food and drink, but way better people watching. The new concert showroom is not opulent, and neither are the hotels lobbies, but they’re classy.  And the staff is taking a page out of Steve Wynn’s playbook making you feel welcome.

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed here on a business trip to visit a tradeshow. Great location next to the Vegas Convention Center. Beautiful hotel with friendly employees. Quick & easy check in. Our room on 62th floor was amazing. Automatic controls for the blinds, lights & A/C. We will be back to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Overall a great hotel
allReviews.text: Overall a lovely hotel which does not attract so many walk ins as further down the strip So it is a more pleasant experience.Such a shame the music by the pool is so loud first thing in the morning and so inappropriate.It’s pricy to eat.Dons Prime is excellent but Vida is really dreadful in every aspect.For such a huge hotel it is overall a lovely experience.

allReviews.title: Great Weekend Getaway - Beautiful Casino.
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau  was awesome!  Rooms are great, Service is great.  No complaints whatsoever and can't wait for my next visit.

allReviews.title: Our only choice of Las Vegas resort!
allReviews.text: Our 2nd stay at Fountainblue!  A luxury resort above the rest! Never disappointed! Always a memorable experience! We will be back!

allReviews.title: Best wedding EVER
allReviews.text: Very beautiful and perfect to avoid the crowds Great views Awesome pools and spas and viewsDelish pool side drinks and snacks

allReviews.title: Stunning!
allReviews.text: We stayed three nights and were beyond happy with our experience from the moment you walk in  everything is absolutely beautiful!   Check in was a breeze.  We were on the 38th floor in a room close to the elevators.  Rooms are probably the quietest that we've ever stayed in in Vegas and we've been coming two to three times a year since 1998 and have stayed at almost every hotel.  The bathrooms are huge with a big walk-in shower. In the room there's a table and two chairs. The bed was comfy and there's also a seating area by the full wall of windows with an excellent view of the strip.  Loads of restaurants and bars to eat in and the food court is elevated compared to any other I've seen. It's an a easy walk to resorts world or the Wynn.  The pools never seemed crowded.  Absolutely loved our stay here.  My only complaint if I had to come up with one is that the fragrance that they use in the hotel is pretty strong.  We'll definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Room with a view
allReviews.text: This hotel is on par with the Wynn checked in early no problem a room was ready so didn’t have to wait. When we go to our room we were impressed we had a view of the sphere and part of the strip.

allReviews.title: Top notch experience!!
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau exceeded our elections from check-in to check-out.  Customer service is their main priority… Taking care of their customers and making sure they have an experience not just a regular stay makes all the difference… The food and choices of food is top-notch… The quality of food is worth the money for sure… My family and I have been going to Vegas for so many years and we have been Hilton members for so many years and have been so faithful to stay at the Hilton every time we come to Vegas… But we were given the opportunity to stay at Fontainbleu we took it, and we will not be staying at the Hilton when we are in Vegas anymore… Fontainbleau is our go to and I recommend it 100%. I recommend it to all my family whom I love and want nothing but the best…

allReviews.title: Poorly maintained property but good restaurants
allReviews.text: Arrival started out good with a great check in experience and they made us feel valued as a platinum Amex member.  Then the problems started: 1) TV remote did not work, 2) bathrobes were missing from the room, 3) they completely shut off the water without warning in the middle of taking a bath and did not restore running water until 5am the next day, 4) the phone in the room did not work, and 5) the Poodle Room hostess (tall white lady with blonde hair) was very rude and disrespectful not once, but twice during our stay there. She should be fired immediately.  Overall, this is not a 5 star hotel and nothing is being maintained.  There was also zero drink service in the casino the entire time we were there.  The only great thing is all the excellent food at Chyna Club, La Fontaine, and Don's, but we don't need to stay there to eat there.  We will stay at Venetian next time.

allReviews.title: Best Hotels in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel I highly recommend the very comfortable rooms excellent view and is one of the newest hotels in Las Vegas super central easy access and good Internet

allReviews.title: We loved the Fontainebleau LV
allReviews.text: We loved the Fontainebleau LV.  To start the hotel is designed absolutely beautifully!  The restaurants, the rooms and the decor around the whole hotel are just stunning.  The rooms were clean, the cleaning person was wonderful and accommodating to our crazy times.  We ate at two of the restaurants and they service was spectacular.  The dealers were so nice--it was my daughter's first time at the tables and they helped to educate her.  Our stay was perfect.

allReviews.title: Great overall property, our new “go too” in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Was in town to see Tears for Fears who were playing in the venue there at the Fontainebleau which is a great place to see a musical performance.  At the property, there are lots of eating options, an amazing pool with lots of umbrellas to give you shade (often you don’t see that in Las Vegas), a great sports bar and plenty of gaming options if that’s your thing.  We had an upgraded suite which was simply amazing.  They even have a “cooling drawer” in the cabinet which is basically a fridge!  Was our first time at this property but it is now our favorite!

allReviews.title: Best hotel in all of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This is the best hotel in all of Las Vegas. Incredible views of the sphere, walking distance to the sphere, great restaurants, great bands, beautiful decor. Would stay here again and again. And the rooms are impeccably clean, the beds are comfortable and the room is beautiful

allReviews.title: Wonderful Trip Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Fontainebleau!  It is a wonderful beautiful friendly place to stay.  It is close to the busy area of the strip but not right in the middle of it.  We can't wait to come back.  The room was spacious and nice!  The view from the 53rd floor was stunning.

allReviews.title: 5 days if the best !!!
allReviews.text: Amazing amazing just amazing,From food to service customer service, the best pools in Vegas if we can move in we would🤣 hope to see you again soon thanks for the great service and friendliness and giving us great memories

allReviews.title: New upscale Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is a top tier hotel in Las Vegas room are nice and clean with lots of room. Spent the day at the pool was awesome. Lots of great food options.

allReviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Incredible Experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: From the moment we arrived, this property blew us away. The entire resort is stunning, sleek, modern, and designed to impress at every turn. A huge shout-out to, Andrew at the front desk, who set the tone for our stay. His warm welcome and genuine care made us feel the love from the minute we checked in. Everyone we encountered, from housekeeping to restaurant staff, truly seemed invested in making our visit unforgettable.Our suite was spectacular, spacious and beautifully appointed, with a mesmerizing view of the Sphere that lit up the skyline every night. It felt like having our own private show right outside the window!The pool area is fantastic, with plenty of space to relax and soak in the Vegas vibes. The club was a highlight of our trip, the music was so good I literally couldn’t leave the dance floor. Pure energy and pure fun!I also have to rave about the gym, it’s AMAZING. Spacious, state-of-the-art equipment, and the kind of atmosphere that actually makes you excited to work out (even after a late night of dancing!).We were in town for a company convention, and Fontainebleau managed to be both the perfect professional venue and an exciting playground once the sessions were over. If you’re considering a stay in Las Vegas, this is where you want to be.

allReviews.title: Chose another hotel...
allReviews.text: Everything is a hassle.  Anything I need as a VIP involves 15 min phone calls without any possible results.  For the price of the room choose another hotel on the strip.  Fridge broken, no hot pot without a $23 charge per day, Cleaning the room took 2 hrs from request, and concierge couldn't book reservation but we called direct and got in no problem.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel but needs improvement
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel rated five stars, but as with most strip hotels, really lack the in-room amenities and service that truly make a hotel a five star. No in-room coffee or tea, no turn down service, no complimentary bottled water and lackluster housekeeping. On the plus side, the beds were comfortable, the WiFi service superior and parking was included in the 50$ resort fee. The location is far from the heart of the strip. If you are attending a concert here, it’s worth a one or two night stay. Otherwise, there are more exciting five-star options on the Strip.

allReviews.title: 1st class pool
allReviews.text: 1st class pool, best pool in Las Vegas.  Plenty of sun and shade spots, great food too.  Pool attendants friendly and timely.

allReviews.title: Great consistency over time
allReviews.text: This is fifth visit in two years.  We are never disappointed.  We come back for the pools, food, cocktails, gaming, and friendly personnel.  Great consistency and high quality each visit across all restaurants, bars, and amenities.  Really friendly personnel across the board.  Love this place for an out of state trip each year.

allReviews.title: Horrible customer service.
allReviews.text: Needless to say, I love the fountain blue experience in Miami and I had a blast,  however the fountain blue in Las Vegas customer service is the absolute worst. They literally lie lie to your face about room availability when there is an issue or problems with your current room. Speaking to three different people nothing was done. Your voice is not heard at the fountain blue while it is a beautiful hotel that customer service is horrible.

allReviews.title: Business and pleasure - fun, easy, amenable stay.
allReviews.text: It is located at the very end of the strip (North) so it is quite a walk away from most relevant casinos; however it also makes it more secluded and coveted. The decoration is impeccable and cleaning services will fix your room splendidly. I experienced some check-in issues which took a while to get fixed but the managers were attentive. Unless you are a big party person, you won't be able to get to the pool on the weekends as it is the hot spot for younger crowd day-clubbing. I was there for business and extended my stay for personal reasons and overall it was a great stay.

allReviews.title: Would not recommend--there are better options in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms were big and nice but there were multiple nasty stray hairs in the bathroom and bed. We ate at Mother Wolf and I became extremely sick that night after the meal with obvious food poisoning. I reported these issues to the front desk and a manager at check out. The response was, "we're sorry to hear that," and "would you like to report this to security?" This is not a 5 star 4 diamond resort response.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Establishes Itself as One of Las Vegas' Finest Resorts
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau has established itself as one of the premier hotel/resorts on the Las Vegas Strip. This was our third stay at the Bleau, and this was a highly memorable trip, thanks to exemplary, energetic employees who are committed to customer service at every turn. We tried a Noble Suite on the 65th floor during this stay and were rewarded with stunning views of the entire Las Vegas valley and landmarks up and down the Vegas Strip. Fabulous views and the suite had every amenity imaginable, including the best shower heads in Vegas, spacious common areas, a loaded bar, two bathrooms and a larger than king-sized bed. Everything about the suite was crisp and clean. On a scale of 1 to 10, the accommodations rated a 12 or 13! The restaurants at Fontainebleau are some of the best in Las Vegas. Don't miss Don's Prime for fabulous steaks and seafood, and Komodo offers a variety of asian dishes, as well as favorites such as grilled halibut and several chicken dishes. The Pagoda Box for dessert is the best in Vegas -- think of bananas foster inside a pagoda box made out of sweet grahams. -- beyond delicious! Fontainebleau Resort has become the true anchor property on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip and continues to deliver an unforgettable Vegas experience at a reasonable rate in all regards!

allReviews.title: Stunning Hotel, Exceptional Service, Perfect for Events
allReviews.text: We hosted our Orthopaedic Conference at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas this past weekend, and I cannot say enough good things about the experience. The hotel itself is immaculate, everything is super clean, and the rooms are absolutely gorgeous. The food was excellent across the board, and the service was truly top notch.The concierge and events team went above and beyond, and all staff were incredible — professional, attentive, and on top of every detail. They made coordinating a large event feel seamless.The only downside is that everything at the hotel is very pricey, so be prepared for premium costs. That said, the level of quality and service you receive makes it feel worthwhile.Overall, Fontainebleau is a world-class venue, whether you’re staying for leisure or hosting a major event. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Amazing. Book here if you want to be Amazed!
allReviews.text: From the second you enter the Property to the moment that you leave the whole experience is Amazing. Book here if you want to be Amazed!

allReviews.title: Excellent High Class
allReviews.text: Excellent stay, a high end premise with exceptional customer service, gaming and restaurant options.  The ambience is amazing and bars are one of a kind experience!

allReviews.title: Awesome stay! Staff went above and beyond and amenities were great!
allReviews.text: Had a great stay at Fontainebleau! Staff were great in getting us checked in early which we really appreciated! Restaurants and food hall had a lot of great options and the food was delicious. My favorite part was the fitness center; it was clean, had a large space, and a wide range of gym equipment. Staff here were also very friendly and helpful! Would definitely stay here next time I’m in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Fulfilled my year long dream
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: Definitely coming back
allReviews.text: Such a nice hotel. Everything was beautiful and the people working there were super kind and attentive. The place is just gorgeous!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Room wasn’t super clean
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is a really beautiful hotel. We stayed 2 nights and the hotel was packed because of a boxing match. Some of the areas were transformed for the Netflix crew so I didn’t see everything. There was great energy. Despite all the people it was easy to still get drinks at the Bleau Bar and find a spot to layout at the pool. The music at the pool was great and felt like a calmer beach club.  I loved that you could scan a barcode to order drinks/food. The poolside casino was fun even though we lost our money there. Side note: It was nice that the pool had a shower for the afternoon we flew out since they could not offer late checkout.I had a chance to go to LIV for Tiesto and it was  great atmosphere for those who like the beach club vibe. I didn’t think the balcony’s would be good but they were even great spots too. The rooms are beautiful, bed is comfy, shower is huge and the bathroom has a fan in it! However our room was not deep cleaned. There were kid handprints all over the window, crumbs all over the window floor area, stain on the sheet part that was tucked in to the foot of the bed, and tons of little hairs all over the bathroom floor. The door was really thin, we could hear people walking by and doors slamming. In the morning you could hear housekeeping. Luckily we weren’t  next to the elevators or we would’ve had zero sleep. We stayed in the gold rooms and had a nice-ish view of the strip.I saw about 6-10 families with kid. The hotel is not catered towards children but I can see that there’s a few considerations for them including and a zero entry pool. We went for a couples trip and overall it was great.

allReviews.title: Experience at FB
allReviews.text: I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas last week for a work event during fight week, and honestly, the experience was really disappointing. For a property with such high fees and luxury branding, the value just wasn’t there.Every meal I ordered came out cold, including a breakfast that was nearly $200 without alcohol. At the pool, I spent $180 on food only to be told ketchup with fries was an extra $3 charge. Drinks were $30 each, and even a quick coffee run ended up costing over $50. On top of that, we constantly had to chase down servers, who would disappear for long stretches.I expected so much more from a hotel of this caliber. Between the outrageous prices, cold food, and dismissive service, the overall experience was awful and not worth the cost. I truly hope the hotel takes this kind of feedback seriously and makes improvements for future guests.

allReviews.title: Most memorable hotel
allReviews.text: A stay here will change you! Fountainbleu is truly to good for Las Vegas, it’s just that special.  The attention to detail raises the bar and the Fountainbleu doesn’t miss a beat. The most beautiful restaurants and bars, delicious food (some of which can be found at the food court alone)! The staff is exceptionally friendly and seem to genuinely like working here.  You just have to experience this hotel, it puts the rest to shame.

allReviews.title: A great time was had
allReviews.text: Had a great time here! Room was beautiful, check in easy and the in room dining was great.  The lobby even smelled great! I didnt win at slots though...

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and Hall Of Excellence is INCREDIBLE
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, great location and amazing staff. The Hall of Excellence is a MUST SEE for any sports fan, and even music fans. Some of the coolest memorabilia you'll ever see, all with a guided digital tour where you can scan the items and hear narrations from legends like Morgan Freeman, Tom Brady, Bob Costas, Marv Albert and even Oprah! Honestly, the coolest sports-related museum I've ever been to

allReviews.title: "Bleau" Oasis at the end of The Strip
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is worth trying.  It's not in the heart of The Strip, but you can access the Monorail and there was never a problem getting a RideShare or taxi.  The views from the higher floors show less of The Strip and more of the vast, stunning landscape of the greater Las Vegas area, which at night is pretty, even peaceful beyond the neon.  Try a Fontainebleau "staycation" and eat at the great restaurants, shop in The Promenade and relax in the 3 pool area.  Mother Wolf is worth every penny, but get a reservation!!  Above all, the service from every staff member at the resort was perfect.  Truly focused on providing a wonderful, carefree experience.

allReviews.title: Blueberry Pancakes!!
allReviews.text: We stayed at Fountainebleau in the first weekend of September. Yajaira checked us in at the front desk and went over all the amenities with grace but efficiently. It was nice to walk around the property and check out the casino, pools, and restaurants. You also have shops around the hotel. I never felt bored. The pool was great as there are 6. Some were smaller than the others and there is also a pool day club. Drinks are taken care of if you gamble and sure enough we do. We had breakfast at the Vida Cafe and Promenade and the server recommended the blueberry pancakes. That was worth the trip itself. Must order! Ricardo was the agent who checked us out for the hotel and he did a great job ensuring everything was correct on our bill. I must say the training for the team was on par and I enjoyed the service at Fountainebleau Las Vegas.Thank you for a great stay. We'll be back!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau the place to Stay in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Wonderful places to eat, super  friendly staff.  But I would like to hear more variety in music, hey play some 60’s and 70’s tunes.

allReviews.title: The Fountainbleau--a great place to stay.
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Fountainbleau in Las Vegas a great deal!  I attended a conference. I found the facilities wonderful.  My room was first class. The people who work there were very friendly.  I was treated great.

allReviews.title: Attention to detail and service oriented!
allReviews.text: This hotel is all about service! We were extremely satisfied with everyone we came in contact with! They went above and beyond to meet our needs!!!Must go back!

allReviews.title: Luxurious Hotel with Great Amenities
allReviews.text: We stayed at a Best Mountain View Queen Bleau room and were amazed by the beautiful view, especially at sunrise and at night. It was worth paying more to upgrade for a higher floor. The room has very comfortable beds with high thread-count bedding and the high quality soft pillows. The restroom had very luxurious bathrobes and the water pressure in the shower was strong, it felt like a spa. All of the hotel staff we encountered were very attentive and helpful. The hotel lobby smells amazing and was much less smoky than the Wynn and Venetian lobbies. We had a dining credit and enjoy our breakfast at Vida so much we went back the next morning. We loved our stay at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great choice for stay on the Strip
allReviews.text: Spent a week at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for a work conference. The hotel is one of the newer properties along the Strip (although on the extreme end, across from Circus Circus), and the rooms, the gym and all of the facilities are bright, clean and comfortable. Accessibility to the conference center is easy as well. The on-property/resort restaurants provide plenty of good dining options at various price points. Staff were helpful from checkin through departure. Would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Review-08/27/25
allReviews.text: Extremely poor offers (Free Play and Resort Credit) for best players. Extreme difficulty to advance to a higher tier compared to other casinos (e.g., Caesars, MGM, Resorts World, The Venetian, etc.). The High-Limit Slots is always nearly or completely empty, after having visited the property five times. The casino doesn’t seem to care about attracting players or retaining them. It was a struggle to open a Credit Line with the casino. The Bank Wires take too long to process. The High-Limit cashiers may need more training, as it takes them a long time to process transactions. There is a lack of entertainment. Limited options for restaurants. Except for a few of them, (e.g., Mother Wolf, Vida, and Chyna Club), the food quality is subpar and/or the prices are very high at restaurants. For example, La Fontaine has the most expensive American Breakfast on the strip, as far as I know. The website is cumbersome and not user-friendly. On a positive note the property is gorgeous and has beautiful, modern rooms. I was fortunate to have an excellent host, Jennifer Loucke, who is very responsive and available at all times. The Slot Attendants are very efficient and friendly. Chez Bon: Excellent quality but very expensive.La Fontaine: Good quality food, average service, very expensive.Don's Prime: Very good steakhouse.Komodo: Below average food quality, expensive.Kyu: The worst food. Mother Wolf; Best food, best service, might be noisy at times.Papi Steak: Average food quality for the price.Vida: Very good food with reasonable prices.  Washing Potato: very good food for the price.

allReviews.title: We "Liked"our stay.
allReviews.text: Lets start with the good...Super great smelling property.  Very clean.  Staff very nice.  Will stay here again for the right price without hesitation.Now the not so good....Casino is like a huge shopping mall with gambling.  Not very busy at all, I mean like nobody is there.  If it weren't for the Crawford fight, and Crawford staying here, there would have been less people.  The rooms are OK.  Water pressure in bathroom sink is horrible, but the shower is awesome.  Hotel room phone didnt work, no biggie just noted.  The location is just not good, unless you like walking over to Circus Circus and gambling.  Resorts World not a bad walk.  Wish this was in the center of the strip, then this would rate nearly perfect.  No Starbucks close by, big downfall for me.   Hard to believe there is no Starbucks inside this exceptional hotel.  Slots were super tight and no Poker room is a bummer too. The casino servers were literally the worst we have ever had in Vegas.  I got drinks faster by walking down to the Venetian and getting a drink there and then walking back, seriously.  In three days was asked 4 times if I wanted a drink.  So this is a mixed review.  Will I go back, Yes.  Do I hate the location, Yes.  Do I need drinks comped, No, but I'd like one now and again.Does it smell fantastic inside and not smokey, Yes.

allReviews.title: Must Visit!!
allReviews.text: From the moment we arrived, Fontainebleau set a new standard for luxury in Las Vegas. The property is absolutely stunning—every detail from the grand lobby to the modern rooms reflects elegance and sophistication. The design strikes a perfect balance between glamour and comfort, making you feel both pampered and at home.The staff was exceptional—professional, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. Every interaction, from check-in to dining to concierge service, exceeded expectations. It’s clear that customer care is their top priority.The amenities are world-class. The pools and cabanas create a true resort atmosphere, and the dining options are phenomenal—offering something for every mood, from fine dining to casual bites. The casino floor is vibrant and exciting, yet still feels spacious and upscale compared to many other Vegas properties.What really sets Fontainebleau apart is the atmosphere. The fragrance throughout the resort is intoxicating, the décor is chic, and the vibe is lively but never overwhelming. Whether you’re here for relaxation, entertainment, or nightlife, everything is thoughtfully designed to make your stay unforgettable.I can’t recommend Fontainebleau Las Vegas highly enough. It’s not just a hotel—it’s an experience. I’m already looking forward to coming back! ★★★★★

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: The Best Resort in Vegas!! Absolutely beautiful place and Customer Service Top Notch Hotel!!! Will most definitely recommend

allReviews.title: Exceptional Stay from Start to Finish!
allReviews.text: From the moment I arrived until the time I checked out, everything about my stay at this hotel was top-notch. The staff were incredibly welcoming, professional, and attentive to every detail, making sure my experience was nothing short of perfect.The hotel itself is beautiful, clean, and well-maintained, with all the amenities you could ask for. Whether it was the comfort of the room, the quality of the service, or the overall atmosphere, everything exceeded my expectations.I highly recommend staying at this hotel if you're visiting Las Vegas. It has become my go-to place whenever I'm in town, and I wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

allReviews.title: My trip
allReviews.text: Overall I like the hotel just wish there was coffee available in rooms and the room I requested was available for me with a tub and just a little bit more effently with cleaning.  But was great stay the main thing that was a terrible factor was when we went to see a specific artist day club LIV was overly packed not enough pool space and was gross and just not enough for the amount of people who were there.

allReviews.title: The best Las Vegas experience I have had.
allReviews.text: I originally chose fountainebleau because that's where David Lee Roth was performing.I stayed 3 nights and four days, and after the first day I did not want to ever come home.Everything about the resort, was very classy. From the art decorations to the food in the restaurants to the absolutely beautifully laid out pools. and all the employees. This is definitely where James Bond would visit if he were to come to las Vegas.5 stars

allReviews.title: Fantastic weekend!
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas feels fresh and modern from the moment you walk in. The décor is stylish and new, with a lot of attention to detail in the design. There are plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from, so you never run out of options.The service was great, staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay. The rooms are clean, spacious, and comfortable, with everything you’d expect from a luxury hotel.Overall, a beautiful property that combines modern design, good service, and lots of dining choices.

allReviews.title: Spent 450 on food and gambling and then have to fork over 20 for parking.
allReviews.text: Beautiful but was told that parking was free under 4 hours, not the case!  Waited 2 hours for lunch at the pool bar.  Nice bar tender, not her fault, kitchen took a long time.   She needed additional help behind the bar, but again, not her fault.   Casino games are expensive even in the middle of the afternoon.  I won’t be coming back.  It was pretty.

allReviews.title: Be wary of the pool area
allReviews.text: Lovely luxurious hotel but have no care for guests at the pool with very strict rules on what can be taken into the pool area and mandatory bag searches. They also appear to encourage skin cancer with refusing to allow guests to put up the provided umbrellas for shade, even when there is no wind. Extortionate prices for day beds or cabanas, they would rather leave them empty than reduce the price to encourage usage even on weekdays. Pretty typical money grabbing corporate Vegas.

allReviews.title: Weekend Excursion
allReviews.text: This was my 3rd trip to Fountainebleau Las Vegas in the last 3 month. Everything about this resort is stunning and exceptionally clean! Very luxurious rooms with large bathrooms and in-room refrigerators. Open and close drapes at a touch of a button, Easy check out from your phone! Honestly I cant imagine staying any where else!

allReviews.title: Exceptional place
allReviews.text: Staying at Fontainebleau was an unforgettable experience. I wholeheartedly recommend exploring this exceptional place and savoring all the diverse restaurants it offers.

allReviews.title: Favorite Vegas resort
allReviews.text: 5th time staying at Fontainebleau, We love how easy it is to get to check in, All the staff were there for a quick and early check in, it always smells so good, the entire resort is beautiful, rooms are some of the best, pool has great seating options, bar, restaurant staff and ambiance are among the best. Players rewards is one of the best going right now. For us the location is great, it’s a little disconnected from the strip but for us it’s in the center of it. We go to the arts district, downtown or the main strip. All of it’s a short uber away. Or by car, if your staying your parking is free.  We travel to Vegas 4-5 times a year and blue has moved up to our preferred spot.  Already looking for our next stay.

allReviews.title: Fountainbleu is 4 U!
allReviews.text: Stayed here for my birthday trip to Vegas. We were upgraded to a higher floor with a view of the Sphere. Our room was clean, beautiful & bed was comfy. Those robes & slippers (yes Hunty). The pool party was fun. While I didnt win on the slots, I enjoyed playing at clean slots with attentive cocktail hosts. We ate at Washing Potatoe, so good. Thanks Fountainbleu for my great  birthday accommodations.

allReviews.title: Great location, stunning decor, and amazing hospitality.
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas exceeded all my expectations. The location is unbeatable—right on the Strip, but just far enough from the busiest intersections to feel like a true retreat. It’s the perfect balance of convenience and calm. The hotel’s decor is absolutely stunning, with a sleek, modern aesthetic that still manages to feel warm and inviting. Every detail, from the grand lobby to the elegant room finishes, reflects thoughtful design and luxury.

allReviews.title: Try the Fontainbleau! Awesome!
allReviews.text: Very nice high end hotel experience! Rooms are big and comfortable. The hotel is easy to get around and the staff was very professional and pleasant. We got a great deal on an upgraded room with no resort fees!

allReviews.title: FONTAINEBLEAU is the class of Vegas
allReviews.text: The FONTAINEBLEAU Las Vegas is the jewel of the strip. It’s a fresh and clean hip classy resort that makes me keep coming back. I’ve stayed there multiple times and will continue to stay there. It’s by far the best value on the strip due to its amenities, staff and pristine facilities.

allReviews.title: The Fantastic Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: This is an absolutely wonderful property- it's on the same level as Wynn/Encore but, it's less crowded, cleaner, and more affordable.The shopping can improve with more boutiques but, I found it to be wonderful nonetheless. Motherwolf was a revelation- possibly the best Italian food I have ever had in Las Vegas. The pool was fantastic- I hold it in the same class as any in Vegas but, it was cleaner- service was better and it was an overall fantastic experience.

allReviews.title: A+ hospitality, and breakfast at Vida!!!
allReviews.text: So I strolled into the Fontainebleau one morning, and this was my first visit to Las Vegas. I was on a mission to collect as many $1 chips from as many different casinos as I could get my hands on. I had walked about 3 miles already this morning. I think it was somewhere around 9:30am when I walked in. Immediately I was taken back, this casino stood out FAR nicer than the other 30 or so places I had been too (including the Cosmo my close #2 fav). Lots of blues, silver and grays. Very 'cool' feeling as temps were going to be up around 105F for a high this day, that already made it feel super welcoming. On top of that I stroll over to a blackjack table for my $1 chip, and the pitboss comes over to me, Latrice, and she is super hospitable. She explained every floor, and accommodations on the property in extreme detail. I told her I was hungry, and she pointed out a couple of coffee shops on the second level. I told her I was more interested in a nice sit down 'bacon and eggs' kind of breakfast. She told me that there is a restaurant called Vida in the back part of the casino that made a great breakfast, and she was 100% correct. You get what you pay for in Las Vegas. It was a $40 breakfast consisting on 3x eggs, 2x pancakes, 3x sausage links, and a hashbrown patty that almost looked like a crabcake. The hashbrown patty alone is a reason to go back to this restaurant. The food was amazing. The only reason for the 4/5 stars is my experience at this hotel is the location. While the immediate location is fine, as is a stroll south, going north is ill advised after sundown as the neighborhood between here, and the Strat begins to deteriorate. I did make the walk in the late morning/early afternoon after breakfast. It was fine for me. I would not make this walk at night alone, in a group, maybe. Again the shout out to Latrice, as I was just a guy wearing shorts, and a t shirt looking for a $1 chip, and she acted towards me like I was the most important person to walk into the casino that morning.

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel. It is off strip but couldn’t fault it. We stayed in a King Gold Room with Best Strip view (6945) facing the strip and the Sphere. Very clean and comfortable. Hotel is just something else.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Casino
allReviews.text: We loved staying here!   It was absolutely beautiful and so high end.  The casino is amazing.  We actually won!  I love how it is at the end of the strip not in the middle of the craziness but easy to jump on the Duece bus and go onto the strip and visit the other casinos.  The pool was perfect after a day of walking.  Plenty of lounge chairs available in and out of the pool and bar service was great!  We also loved the food court to get bagels or pizza for quick bites!  Would def recommend!

allReviews.title: Everything was great, but the prices were WILD
allReviews.text: An impeccable facility, we loved the design and attention to detail. Everything feels new, well thought out, luxe, and distinctive. In a town full of mega-hotels, the Fontainebleau holds its own. Our room was awesome, from our view (51st floor) of the strip including the Sphere, to the spacious layout, to the high end finishes. And like any good Vegas property, everything you need for a vacation is on premise. There are a ton of different eateries, ranging from super high end to grab and go. The pool area is a sight to behold, including falconry agents who use birds of prey to keep the are free from pigeons (I kid you not). The casino is well appointed and the table minimums are accessible for just about anyone. The only reason this gets a 4-star instead of a 5-star is because of the cost. It's exorbitantly expensive, even by modern inflationary standards. We're fortunate to have the means to afford it, but know that you'll be shocked if you don't go in prepared. A few examples. There's a little coffee shop near the guest elevator bank where they recommended we go for our morning coffee. Two drip coffees were nearly $20, excluding tip. And mind you, there isn't a coffee pot in your room to do it yourself. Another morning my wife and I went to the food court and there's a wellness spot. We got a fruity smoothie, an acai bowl, and a single energy shot. The bill was $110. No exaggeration. Another day we had two salads (one with chicken, one with falafel) and two seltzers, the bill was $130. Like I said, inexcusably high prices that warrant a star reduction. Had the staff, facilities, design, or attention to detail not be ELITE, the pricing would've really been a massive red flag. Fortunately, this is as nice an experience (outside of the price tag) as you can find in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Wonderful but needs improvement
allReviews.text: The resort is very nice. I was so happy not to be down at the other end where it feels dirty and filled with a lot of undesirable people. Our room was very nice! Great size, comfortable bed, good water pressure, good  view of the Sphere from our room but not our friends room, some amenities included (a tooth brush would be a nice addition) with the ability to add on with purchased amenities (although VERY expensive). There were two issues our room. 1) The toilet was loose. 2) It’s a great shower head but it didn’t move, so I was shoved up against the wall opposite of the faucet, which was very annoying and made showering more of a task, plus water poured out on the bathroom floor. We enjoyed the Cafe Cuto bar area every morning and watched a game in the sports bar. We would have enjoyed watching from the front area but a $1,500 minimum for 4 people is ridiculous! It was college football not the Super Bowl! It was nearly empty too. And $150 a seat to sit at the bar stools facing the screen - it was empty! A crowd attracts a crowd. We had a cocktail in the Collins Bar while there was someone  playing the piano, which was nice but the cocktails were nothing special. At $25 a cocktail, they should be outstanding. I would have given them 5 stars if it weren’t for the issues mentioned above. If they listen to their customers and resolve these minor, but multiple issues.We would stay here again. Fingers crossed they make some improvements.

allReviews.title: This is the best resort in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We looked foward to our second stay at Fountainbleau and really enjoyed spending almost all of our time on property. The hotel is beautiful, comfortable and has everything we needed for a relaxing and romantic weekend. The restaurants are excellent and we love the bars/lounges, each with their own signature cocktails and great service. Nowhere Lounge is a hidden gem in Las Vegas. We enjoyed an outstanding live three piece band that played classic R&B, hip hop and pop in a beautiful room and no cover charge.We also really enjoy the pool area. We even won a couple bucks in the casino.Fountainbleau is my new favorite Las Vegas resort.

allReviews.title: Cannot wait to return to the Beautiful Fountainebleu!!!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Spacious, clean accommodations, friendly staff, smoke free. Gorgeous pool area with lots cabanas, umbrellas and lounge chairs-some at no additional costs. Want to return and explore more of the property. This was for a Birthday celebration and loved it!!

allReviews.title: Not worth the money
allReviews.text: Our group of five couples met up at Fontainebleau for Labor Day weekend. Some of the group wanted to try a new place so we ended up here instead of an MGM property which we have been frequenting in recent years. We like to hang out at the pool in a cabana during the day then have dinner and gamble at night. Overall we found the place nice but very expensive. We appreciated the non-smoking environment but hated the strong scent pumped into the air and infused in all the soaps and lotions. We enjoyed our cabana in the Sun Club the first day but the second day we got booted to the regular pool because some high roller decided they wanted to buy out the entire Sub Club on a few hours' notice. The cabana manager originally moved us to two small cabanas but grudgingly agreed to give us a King cabana, the only one that actually fit our entire group. The only compensation we were offered was to knock $200 off our required minimum spend. We went to Papi Steakhouse for dinner Sunday night. It's super loud and there's a whole presentation when someone orders the $1000 Tomahawk steak so the lights flash and the staff come out holding signs and do a chant. That happened probably 5-6 times while we were there. The steak was fine but didn't have much flavor and the sides were dished out to everyone by the servers without asking who had ordered what. The table minimums were at least $25 so our group ended up going to other places to gamble two out of the three nights we were there. The room was nice, I was happy there are dresser drawers and the water pressure in the shower was amazing. I think in another few years it will feel like other higher end resorts on the stip. Everything was notably more expensive. Bottom line, it was fine but we won't be back.

allReviews.title: Vacation for the win
allReviews.text: Clean, classy and comfortable. Check in was a breeze. Rented a cabana on resort pass and it was perfect. Nicely tucked away and our server Taylor was so attentive five. This has to be the classiest hotel in the strip.

allReviews.title: Loveee this hotel.
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel, had a great experience. The hotel was so clean and new. The fitness center was amazing, had all the machines you need and they also offer classes which was great. I took a stretch class with Justin and I loved it. Coffee at Cafe Cuto was really good and they have a hotel guest only lounge where you can grab quick coffee and skip the lines or get a drink to start the night. The lounge is called Nowhere on the 2nd floor by the gym. Love this benefit bc the cafe lines get crazy! It was a far from the strip, but I honestly preferred it because it was a lot more relaxing and avoids the crazy crowds for everything. Had an overall great experience!

allReviews.title: Five stars +++
allReviews.text: Service!I have never experienced the same level of customer first service since the 90s.I worked at the Regent Beverly Wilshire in Beverly Hills for several years then the Mondrian West Hollywood, the Standard and the Intercontinental in SF so I have a good understanding of what it takes to have a professional staff attend to guests and Fontainbleu gets it. We decided to take an advantage of a promotion Fontainbleu extended after getting status matched to our 7 star Caesars rewards.Upon check in we were upgraded to a view Royal Suite. What a view!  Our host Kathy is amazing and because of her we decided to ditch our original plans of staying at our home casino Caesars and return to Fontainbleu for the remainder of our stay.Thank you Fontainbleu.We will be back for tears for fears in October!

allReviews.title: Labor Day weekend 2025  FBLV
allReviews.text: Extremely clean, fun vibe, yes, it is off the main strip however that provides a very quiet and relaxing night when you want to go to bed. It was absolutely perfect.

allReviews.title: Unexpected Charges and No Real Support
allReviews.text: I was incorrectly charged for a bar order I never made, despite having checked out 8 hours earlier and already being on my flight home. To make matters worse, I was informed that I must resolve the issue by phone due to a so-called “security policy.” This is highly disappointing and extremely inconvenient for an international business traveller. Whether this stems from intentional misconduct or poor management, the fact that their systems cannot even register when a guest has already checked out is unacceptable.

allReviews.title: A Fantastic Stay from Start to Finish
allReviews.text: I loved everything about my stay — from the stylish furniture and the spotless cleanliness to the excellent service. Everyone was super nice and always in a good mood, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.The Fitness Center was excellent; I truly enjoyed training there. The equipment is modern, complete, and offers everything you need for a great workout.The pool area was another highlight — spacious, relaxing, and with a great music selection that created the perfect atmosphere.Overall, it was a fantastic experience being at your hotel, and I can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: One Beautiful Resort
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau took 17 years to complete, with many setbacks along the way. It was well worth the wait. Our first stay was for 4 nights in August 2025. Our room was on the 54th floor, looking toward the southeast. So we had a view of the Sphere and Encore as we looked toward our right out our window. The constantly-changing Sphere was mesmerizing to watch at all hours of the day and night. Our room was immaculately clean, decorated in white and shades of blue. There was a fridge drawer for guest use and a bunch of snacks and drinks for purchase, and a safe to lock up valuables. There were robes and slippers in the closet. The bathroom had double sinks and both a shower and a large bathtub. The toilet was separated from the rest of the bathroom by a frosted glass door. The room’s climate control worked well and we had very restful nights. The hallways were extremely wide and the whole vibe was one of comfort, crispness, and cleanliness. No smoke smell in any public or private areas. The lobby at Fontainebleau was amazing, with REAL vibrant red roses filling a number of huge urns and containers. We actually saw an employee in the early morning hours replacing any that were wilted. The artwork throughout the facility was huge and gorgeous. Do take the time to really walk the whole thing because around every corner is beauty- greenery, sculpture, photographs, and paintings. There were a number of grand escalators which were very tall and an adventure to ride. Fontainebleau has its share of designer retail, but the thing that is different is that it is located within the casino as opposed to in a street of shops with a mall-like feel. Similarly, the restaurants are along the perimeter of the casino. There’s a food court on the floor above the casino, but you really can’t call it a food court. It’s much higher-end. We ate two times at Washing Potato, which is on the casino level. Why two times at the same place? Because it was probably the best Pan Asian food I’ve ever eaten, in a truly unique environment. But that’s the subject of another review. There are several pools and they have a relaxed, chic vibe. I was impressed that they hired a company which uses natural methods to keep pigeons away, specifically, a large bird that pigeons fear, which was there with its handler, who was happy to do meet and greets. What a good idea, as opposed to using cruelty or chemicals!There are several fantastic resorts on the Strip, neighbors Wynn and Encore among them, but what truly sets the tone at Fontainebleau are its people. At every turn, there was a knowledgeable, friendly, helpful person available, and there were enough of them to make it seem that you were truly being looked after. I felt like this was the Vegas of 20 years ago in terms of service, presented in a fresh, gorgeous, clean way. This is a place for the young and hip party crowd, as well as the seasoned and relaxed leisure traveler. People make a big deal out of its location on the north end of the Strip. Yes, it’s not perfect, but it does seem that the epicenter of the Strip is starting to shift northward with the superior resorts of Wynn, Encore, Resorts World, and now Fontainebleau there, plus the Sphere located up Sands Avenue. We purchased a 3 day bus pass and rode the Deuce bus if we wanted to get further than our feet allowed. $20 per person for 3 days can potentially get you anywhere you want to go around the Valley. As in any other major city, keep your wits about you and be more diligent as the evening wears on. I had begun to get really discouraged watching all the videos coming out of Vegas about how bad it is now. Don’t believe all of them. Quality costs money. It’s a balancing act to be sure, but if you are willing to pay a bit more to have beauty, fine people, and clean furnishings around you, you will not be disappointed with this resort. My trip to Fontainebleau has restored my confidence that Vegas can be truly a world class destination. Congratulations, Fontainebleau, on an amazing resort!

allReviews.title: Fake luxury, rude staff and trashy environment
allReviews.text: The WORST customer service at a hotel I've ever had.First of all every single interaction with guest services and check in has been awful. I'm traveling for business and the room rates are close to 700 dollars a night. Check in the lines were extremely long and every agent was rude.Because of the lines the agent told me she gave me late checkout. I called to check on that later and told there was no notes on my account for late checkout. When I told her that was unacceptable that I was basically lied to, she told me there was nothing she could do.I've stayed in a lot of hotels in vegas and have never been treated like this.Overall the hotel is fake luxury. The crowd is gross the staff is rude and is not worth the price. Very dissatisfied

allReviews.title: Excellent throughout, perfect stay! Well, minus the Hall of “Meh”xcellence
allReviews.text: Excellent stay. Tom Brady’s Hall of excellence was a weird “meh”experience. Not meant for families really. The food was perfect. The atmosphere was incredible. Staff everywhere except the Hall of Excellence security were so nice. We rented a cabana. The food was great. Pools were clean. And the service was fantastic. Gambling options rock. Pool casino? I felt like JB at the FBLV. Will return soon.

allReviews.title: Stunning hotel, would recommend a visit!
allReviews.text: Lovely hotel, clean, friendly and lovely rooms. Only negative would be that it would be handy if gym was 24x7, esp for international travellers suffering from jet lag ;)

allReviews.title: Glamourous experience.
allReviews.text: Fontainbleau was a beautiful visit.  This hotel is very spacious; however, if you do not have good mobility, it may not be good for you.  The pool was great, not packed with people. We could easily find a chair; however, service out there wasn't the best.  All the food we had was amazing!  If you're looking for a honeymoon, anniversary getaway, this is perfect.  You can choose to have a view of the sphere, which is worth every penny!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau at Las Vegas best resort!!!
allReviews.text: This place is so amazing!!! The people, rooms, pool, casino, everything is just outstanding. All the services people are really nice and helpful.

allReviews.title: Superb Hotel to stay when in Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed in August 2025. The hotel is huge but once you work out what is where is easy to navigate. It was not busy.The rooms were spacious, modern and very clean. All of the housekeeping staff and hotel staff were friendly and helpful.The pool area was lovely and lots of sun beds available . The restaurants we used were very good. The gym was amazing .The hotel sits at the end of the main drag but it’s not too far to walk to the main places. Ubers are cheap and easy too .Definitely stay here again next time in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Never staying anywhere else!
allReviews.text: Beautiful, clean & bright! Best hotel on the strip! Yes, it is higher end; however well worth the money spent! Lobster roll in the food out should be your first stop! Also, recommend talking to the lady with the hawk at the pool!

allReviews.title: Great Dining & Service, but Location and Value Could Be Better
allReviews.text: Stayed at Fontainebleau for a two-night girls’ trip through Amex FHR. The property is beautiful, clean, and modern, though some areas feel a little bare. Check-in was quick and easy, and staff were friendly throughout. Loved the filtered water stations on the casino floor!Our Bleau Queen room was spacious, spotless, and well-designed with plenty of outlets (huge plus!). Noise wasn’t an issue. The only letdown was no upgrade despite booking through FHR, and the location is far from the main Strip.Dining was the highlight! Komodo was incredible (amazing cocktails, great vibe with a live DJ), KYU was very good, and breakfast at Chez Bon Bon was solid. The fitness center was also excellent - clean and well-equipped. Gaming was fun too, though craps table minimums jumped from $15 to $25, which was disappointing.Overall, a great stay with fantastic dining and service, but the location and value at full price make me hesitant. I’d return if there’s a good deal.

allReviews.title: LIV Beach Club and Sun Club is a Vibe
allReviews.text: Amazing property with the best pools in Las Vegas. LIV Beach with James Kennedy was Lit!  So much fun!!! The Veuve Clicquot Sun Club was super pretty and a cool vibe!  Nice restaurants and shops.  Overall property is very nice.  Would revisit.

allReviews.title: good rooms and nice lobby
allReviews.text: it is a nice place to stay with not too many people and a easy access to most of the places except the parking garage is a little far away from the guest rooms

allReviews.title: What’s not to love?!
allReviews.text: What’s not to LOVE?! It’s such an amazing resort.  Our host is amazing. The rooms are always clean, the staff is friendly, the floor service is great, and the food is incredible.  We saw the MAW, Christopher Cross and Toto concert at their theater and it was a great experience. Well ventilated, great sound and intimate.  Mother Wolf and the bagel shop is awesome, and this is coming from an old school NY Native. Best Italian I’ve had in years. “Icing on the west coast.  We love the Fountainebleau.  Every experience is amazing! Can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Exceptional experience at Fountainebleau…
allReviews.text: A true mark of service and luxury , this hotel stands out in Las Vegas  in my opinión… staff is very efficient from the get go thru check out . Food and service at dining venues  is  always a good experience .. I highly recommend the hotel .

allReviews.title: Probably best Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Hotel was excellent, Nice and clean, Pool party was awesome. Overall a great experience will be coming back !! Great Espresso Martinis at the bar :)

allReviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful.
allReviews.text: Beautiful, clean, and inviting. Staff couldn't be more friendly and helpful. Restaurants were top notch with fantastic employees.  Our room was amazingly Spotless!

allReviews.title: Exceptional Experience
allReviews.text: Great Food Good Times Excellent Customer Services Easy Access Plenty Parking Offers Retail Therapy-Shopping and Entertainment plus a place to Dance the Night Away

allReviews.title: Relax.
allReviews.text: The Fountainbleau is a great place to stay. Professional staff. Great room. Love the fitness center. I didn’t visit to gamble - just wanted a relaxing weekend. And I got exactly what I needed. And the location works great force. Close to the BEST 2 breakfast spots in LV. Closer to the arts district and all the local/off strip bars and restaurants. I have ZERO issues.

allReviews.title: Best of the Best
allReviews.text: Great all-around experience for hotel, gambling, food, spa and fitness center.  My new favorite property on the Strip!

allReviews.title: Most memorable Vegas trip!
allReviews.text: Think Wynn/Encore is the "place" to stay?? THINK AGAIN! The Fontainebleau is Next-Level! From the moment you arrive at the property you feel welcomed and special. The property is stunning, and the rooms exceed expectations in both comfort and elegance. The Casino is large, offers amazing gaming options and is extremely clean. Most importantly, in my opinion what diferentiates Fontainebleau over other properties is that the staff embodies a profound sense of pride in both the hotel and casino. It's a quality that seamlessly extends to every guest's experience. From personal experience - This is something you won't find at Wynn/Encore! The restaurants are incredible, the pool is glamorous, and the Spa is amazing! Can't wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Yes! Finally the perfect Vegas hotel.
allReviews.text: New favorite place in Vegas. Love being on the strip but away from the madness. Bars and restaurants were amazing. Motherwolf and No Where are awesome.  Staff was excellent and very professional. Pool area was perfect with great service.  Clean! The hotel is stunning. Had a great view of strip and mountains.  Look forward to returning.

allReviews.title: Quick Visit
allReviews.text: Wife and I were staying at two different casinos on the strip and wanted to check out the Fontainebleau because of the videos we saw on Instagram.  The resort is opulent. The center bar is very classy and everything is still new.  The people we encountered both guests and employees all seemed genuinely in a good mood.  We signed up for our rewards cards and then got a quick bite to eat at the food court.  This was the only downside I saw. The food court reminded me of a Simon Mall food court.  But dinner was okay.  My wife absolutely loved the selection of slots and had a great time. I hit the electronic craps games and the slots and, while I didn’t win anything sizable, I at least enjoyed myself. Same cannot be said of all casinos in Vegas.  We probably stayed two hours. Had to pay the now going rate of $25 for parking.  But again, it was fun.

allReviews.title: Amazing Resort
allReviews.text: Very friendly Staff. Room was impeccable. Very clean organized equipped with everything you need for comfortable stay. Incredible amenities. Multiple option on restaurant, bars and lounges, great gambling areas. The oasis pool 10/10.

allReviews.title: Hotel and casino are beautiful, room was disappointing
allReviews.text: I used the AMEX Fine Hotels deal and was told I was upgraded, but the room was their standard, lock-off room. It was on a high floor, but the view was of the rooftop of the convention center. We could hear everything in the rooms on either side of us and were woken up as partiers came back to their rooms around 3am. The bathroom was consistently 10 degrees warmer. The room reminded me of a Marriott room. The hotel and casino are beautiful. The pool is nice. The gym was super hot so we only stayed 20 minutes. We bought a two day pass on the monorail to get to the other end of the strip which is where everything we wanted to do was.

allReviews.title: Overcharged and Overrated!
allReviews.text: 1. Reserved strip view, and was given pool view. 2. Room was not cleaned prior to check in. Pubic hair by the toilet, trash in our ice bucket, a dirty q tip by the bed, and an empty tissue box!3. Vida restaurant charged us $175 for eggs, hashbrowns, and 2 mimosas. It was an error but glad we looked at the check and it still came up to $100.4. Pools were nice but 21+ pools were either closed or full of reserved chairs and cabanas that were EMPTY.5. We were awaken by repeated calls at 6am from the front desk asking if we need the police sent to our room!????6. The next morning we were awaken at 8am by a man that was "housekeeping" letting himself into room even though our DND light was on!! Wayyyy too much inconvenience for a 3 night stay!  For the price, just stay at the Wynn.

allReviews.title: Amazing!!
allReviews.text: Great experience beautiful hotel.  If you have AMEX book through them.I got early check in, late check out, free breakfast voucher, an upgraded room and an additional $100 voucher for dinning

allReviews.title: My top resort in vegas
allReviews.text: We all know the property that has been THE place to stay in vegas for years. The Fontainebleau should be on that list for you. Beautiful open resort and  very nice rooms. Arguably the best restaurants top to bottom of any property in town.  Have stayed several times in the 2 years they’ve been open for work, personal and with a business group. Every time we leave loving the FB experience.

allReviews.title: No Coffee in Hotel Room
allReviews.text: Hotel was beautiful and clean but there was not coffee in the room. I think that's a simple offering that would make a huge difference in my opinion. Instead, if I wanted to enjoy a coffee while I'm getting ready in the morning, as I often do, I would have to get dressed, walk downstairs, find somewhere that's open that probably takes 10 minutes to locate, then I have to wait in line and pay $15 for a coffee, then go back to my room. Building in this extra time is a pain

allReviews.title: Thumbs up and will definitely return
allReviews.text: Such a great Hotel / Resort to be and stay at. Food and shopping all great!!! Easy access to casino, valet, and restaurants!

allReviews.title: Fantastic Stay — Clean Rooms, Great Service, and Fair Rewards
allReviews.text: I’ve started staying at Fontainebleau regularly for business and it’s been outstanding. Easy to get off the Strip, with clean, modern rooms and great service. The casino and restaurants are top-notch, and rewards/comps are very fair. A perfect mix of convenience, comfort, and fun.

allReviews.title: A top notch Vegas experience
allReviews.text: We loved everything about our stay at Fontainebleau, from check-in to our guest room to drinks and dining to gaming. The entire resort is clean and well kept. The gym and pool are incredible. We'll definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Better than most of the strip hotels
allReviews.text: This is a great resort on the northern potion of the strip.   The casino is large with a great selection of table games and slots.   Many food choices with some great restaurants.  The room I stayed in was clean and modern.  The hotel staff provides excellent service.   This was my second stay in the past year and I will stay there again in the future.

allReviews.title: amazing experience
allReviews.text: the Hotel is amazing the facilites are great, the rooms are well decorated we strongly suggest the following restaurantsKomodo, Fontaine, Mother wolf, we travel with 3 and 6 years old kids pool was great for them

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This hotel stands out as one of the finest in Las Vegas, offering an unparalleled level of luxury. For those seeking a VIP experience, this is undoubtedly the ideal destination.

allReviews.title: Wonderful resort to stay at in Vegas.
allReviews.text: I am a big fan of the Fountain Bleau Miami location.  the Vegas property did not disappoint.  The layout was well thought out.  Great restaurants.  The bar vibe was just what I needed after a long day.  The room was well designed with easily accessible lighting and drape controls throughout the room.  Elegant bathroom.  The room service was impeccable.   Overall, one of the most problem free stays in my travel history.  Beware of August though.  It was too hot to even enjoy the pool.  I think the sun bounces off the tinted windows directly into the pool area.  This would be great at a different time of year but in August was just too much for me.  However, if you are there to gamble, this is no big deal.  Great stay.  I would definitely go again for the right price!

allReviews.title: 10 out of 10!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with stunning views! Excellent water pressure in the shower and soft comfortable beds. The pools are amazing

allReviews.title: Luxury and friendly
allReviews.text: I loved my time in The Fountaineblue Las Vegas, the staffs members all the time was amazing; check in and check out was very easy and fast. The room was perfect.

allReviews.title: Wonderful spot
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel! I was there for business, but mixed in a bit of fun toward the end of my trip. I like how it is a little removed from the heart of the strip, as it lends itself to a calmer, higher-end vibe. However, you can still easily walk or rideshare to the more lively spots. The service, ambiance, and pool were incredible. My room had an amazing view of the Sphere which I enjoyed every night. The blackout shades were effective at keeping out the light. Overall, would definitely return if I find myself back in Las Veas.

allReviews.title: Best Las Vegas hotel by far
allReviews.text: I’ve been going to Las Vegas once or twice a year for the past 14 years and Fontainebleau is by far the best hotel here! The overall experience is great, rooms are nice and very clean, restaurants are amazing and the bars/club is the best! I don’t think I could have lost in the casino if I had wanted to! Definitely will be staying here from now on!

allReviews.title: Not the best experience I’ve ever had
allReviews.text: I don’t know what to say. It’s just a big impersonal casino. Seems to be overrun with too many people all jammed together. Dealers vary from good to sad

allReviews.title: Unwind and relax
allReviews.text: thee best hotel in Vegas hands down the place is super clean and family friendly  my whole stay was very relaxing and my family loves it

allReviews.title: Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice new hotel, clean and very large rooms with great views of the LV, especially the Sphere. Nice swimming pool and gym.I found the prices of minibar products and the general confusion of the lobby excessive

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau worst 5 star ever
allReviews.text: My first time staying here and last I had high expectations. When we got to the room it smells like sewage. It smelled so bad we had to stsy outside. We went back to front desk and they did nothing for us worst customer service ever. They down graded us to another room. Never staying here again. I never been treated so bad ever. There’s many other Hotels don’t stay here.
