allReviews.text: I ordered food delivery to Fontainebleau Las Vegas. When the courier arrived, I called the reception and politely asked to have the food brought to my room. Reception informed me that it was against hotel policy and that concierge service was unavailable after 10:30 PM. They also informed me that the courier had only 15 minutes to wait. As a result, I was forced to get dressed and go downstairs myself.It took me about 8-9 minutes out of the given 15 minutes to reach the courier. However, upon reaching the entrance, I discovered that hotel security had already sent my courier away despite the promised 15-minute waiting period not being over. Due to the heavy traffic conditions typical of Saturday evenings in Las Vegas, it took the courier an additional 10 minutes to return.When I expressed my frustration and described the absurdity of this situation at reception, staff offered no viable solution besides advising me either to return to my room and come back down again later or to remain waiting downstairs for the courier’s return.To summarize clearly:	•	Staff refused to allow the courier to deliver food directly to my room door.	•	Staff refused to bring the delivery to my room themselves.	•	Staff refused even to hold the delivery at reception.	•	Staff only provided a 15-minute window for the courier to wait.	•	Staff forced me to dress and come down personally, yet still prematurely dismissed my courier.	•	Staff agreed with me about the absurdity of the situation but still provided no effective solution.Considering the level of this hotel—a 5-star establishment charging approximately $3,000 for a four-night stay—this experience is extremely disappointing and completely unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Poor Hotel Room experience, Amazing Restaurants
allReviews.text: Room was not clean and found toenails on carpet and hair in shower.  Front desk was not helpful and rude.  However, Mother Wolf Restaurant was outstanding, great food, service was over the top and best cocktails. Don't miss the speakeasy for great after dinner entertainment and cocktails.

allReviews.title: Hotel has the "Wow" Factor
allReviews.text: We had a fantastic stay at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas! From the moment we arrived, the hotel delivered a serious WOW factor — it’s modern, beautifully designed, and impeccably clean. The overall vibe is energetic yet sophisticated, and the views are definitely a highlight. My room had an amazing view of The Sphere, which made the experience even more memorable.My sister, niece, and I thoroughly enjoyed brunch at Le Fountain — everything was fresh and delicious. We also had some incredible cocktails at the bar; they were both creative and expertly made.Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a stylish and memorable Vegas experience!

allReviews.title: Horrible stay
allReviews.text: I wouldn't recommend this place to anybody unless you would like to have like the most inconvenience stay of your life. I didn't like the fact that you had to walk so far from the parking lot just to get to your hotel room. The people that asks you to show your ID Card are very rude and profile people. Their restaurants don't stay open past 10 PM.And they don't have space in the mini fridge. It's just all stacked with their drinks. And you can't move anything, pass 60 seconds without getting charged to your room.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay
allReviews.text: Great place to stay on the strip all though its not in the center of the strip it was still in a good location close to the Sphere, The Stratus, the famous Peppermill restaurant. It was clean classy and fun for all occasions. I would stay here again. No doubt.

allReviews.title: Conference hotel with a club -  not for luxury travelers
allReviews.text: The room was very clean and new, but that was the only reason we did not check out early. We stayed for 10 nights in late Mar/early Apr 2025 in a Royal Suite. While the room is very new and clean, the furniture is uncomfortable and the room is missing many features that I’d expect of a luxury resort (oddly basic showers, no sprayer or rain shower, no luxury bath products, etc). I did enjoy the clothes steamer.The staff were not well trained and there is no luxury service here. The Bleau Bar staff were by far the worst staff we encountered in all of Vegas. The security staff and the housekeeping staff here were absolutely lovely, though. The pool (despite it officially opening in March) was closed all throughout the weekdays unexpectedly. It was only truly open Fri-Sun when it was packed. There were no “lounging” or relaxation areas, everything is packed tightly together and constantly pushing for additional drink/food sales.The restaurants are also lacking, with very few mid-range options. The baristas all need additional training on how to properly use an espresso machine, especially for $9+ per coffee. The resort also does not provide any bottled water or any other includedWe have stayed in luxury resorts around the world, and while we know we can’t expect the same service level of Asian resorts in the US, the service here was truly disappointing. This resort is setup only for two types of clients: those who stay for two nights to go to LIV/partying or conference attendees. The location is also pretty bad. The walk to the Wynn is only about 10 min, but you have to walk through a pretty sketchy stretch to get there. It didn’t look so bad at first, but after a few days of walking it we encountered several different bad situations that made us decide to take Ubers the rest of the trip. I would never stay here again by choice, though my company is planning a conference here so I will be forced to return at some point.

allReviews.title: You MUST stay here
allReviews.text: We come almost monthly to Fountainebleau. The food, service, shopping and people are all amazing. We started coming here a year ago, and have come back at least a dozen times, and now we ONLY stay at Fountainebleau.  We are actually coming back in June and bringing our 10 year old with us. She is very mature for her age and has begged us to come and enjoy the shopping and eating. I know she will love the beauty that is Fountainebleau

allReviews.title: Consistently Delivers
allReviews.text: From the check-in experience, to the beautiful rooms, to the restaurants that keep popping up and the great gaming experience, the Fontainebleau continues to surprise me with every visit. I could not recommend enough, spending some time at the pool, in the Solo Club, and enjoying some omakase in addition to the great gaming environment.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: I had a lovely stay at Fontainbleau. Check in was a breeze. Staff was very pleasant.  Arrived at 9:00 a.m. and room was available by 11:00 a.m. Receiving water at check in was a nice gesture. Upon entering my room the lights came on and the window shades opened automatically. My view was really nice. Room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. I went to a show at the Wynn. The walk was not bad at all. Even at night I felt safe as there were a number of people around. Don't let the location deture you from staying at this beautiful hotel. Check out was a breeze.....I checked out from my phone. I would definately stay here again!!

allReviews.title: underwhelming at best
allReviews.text: The room was nice, but there was party tape on my walls from the last guest.The tape seems silly, but once I fixated on it, I couldn't not see it. Made me wonder what else was overlooked.The hotel has a bar code you can scan to order food. But the system is not user friendly. it needs a search bar so if you want breakfast or hamburgers you can look by item. I stayed there 4 nights and chose door dash over room service because it was more user friendly. The staff was all really nice.While playing the machines, I ordered a drink and was ready to play. 20 min later I'm down 25.00 and still no drink. In fact, I only noticed 2 drink girls the whole time. So, to offer drinks and not have enough staff to serve the guests seems slimy. Based on the amount I spent on the room, I was actually very disappointed. next year I will be staying elsewhere

allReviews.title: Great Customer Service Makes the Fontainebleau a Great Choice in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent customer service abounds at the FONTAINEBLEAU LAS VEGAS. Staff went out of their way to provide a great hotel, dining and casino experience. Even the food hall offerings were over the top with great burgers, pizza and other fare. Our favorite restaurant was La Fontaine - we went twice to experience their spectacular brunch fare. Recommend the endless champagne, caviar bagel tower and tarte flambée.

allReviews.title: 3 day stay
allReviews.text: Clean and modern hotel, all thinkable amenities on site, great room view. Location is good, easy to explore the strip. Can recommend also as base to explore surrounding national parks. Reception can get busy as the hotel is huge. Would return when visiting Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Lovely hotel!
allReviews.text: Great hotel! Gorgeous, clean and the personnel were too notch! We had a great time at the Liv Beach pool. Super fun with a DJ! We also at Kumodo. Delicious food and excellent service! Holden was great! Rooms were clean and spacious and innovative! Everything you could want!

allReviews.title: Best Customer Service and Rescue!
allReviews.text: Beautiful facility at the north end of the strip.  This is our 3rd stay at the FB since it's opening.  This time we brought friends!  We booked several rooms.  They all loved the luxurious facility.  Only downside is there is only one food option (Chez Bon Bon deli) after 9:45 pm.  So do not expect to find any restaurants open here after a show.  There is also no food availability in the bar areas.Because we booked multiple rooms, there were a few hiccoughs with our reservation and billing.  A huge shout out to Jalena C. at the front desk.  She was very patient and understanding as we sorted out several issues.  Her ability to listen and problem solve (all with a smile) really made our day.  She easily melted our frustration away.  I hope management recognizes what an asset she is to your team!  We will be back.

allReviews.title: Watch out for the service fees
allReviews.text: Service fees were outrageous they told me that they would waive them if I book through them that was a lie I went to checkout and the front desk said they couldn’t do anything for me and the 2 rooms I booked and the extra $250 resort fees I asked to speak to a manager he called someone supposedly and said it would be taken care of and I would be credited but I need to pay the whole bill and a never received a refund

allReviews.title: Loved everything
allReviews.text: I went with some friends and we loved everything from the  service to the rooms and the casino was top tier! The aesthetic of this hotel is picture worthy and with everything to do it was worth every penny. Anything we asked for it was provided and it was with a gracious attitude and smile!

allReviews.title: Las Vegas - Fountainebleau
allReviews.text: Very nice property... make sure you communicate effectively with the front desk on your intentions of an extension...or you may come back from a outside excursion and have to seek your stuff...they don't play...all and all...a beautiful resort!

allReviews.title: Best Resort on the Strip!
allReviews.text: This resort is absolutely amazing! Cleanliness and helpful and friendly Staff made my stay here one of the best i have ever experienced! The Food and Drinks were Top Notch. Would totally recommend this resort to anyone looking to get pampered!

allReviews.title: Amazing stay at this gorgeous hotel
allReviews.text: We just returned from Vegas and our first stay at The Fontainebleau. We had a lovely experience. The hotel is absolutely stunning, and our room was beautiful. The service, from the front desk to the bellhops to the spa staff, was exceptional. We had an amazing breakfast at Vida; the most perfect Eggs Benedict and wonderful service. We enjoyed the Bleau Bar and the Collins Lounge. The Promenade Food Hall has some wonderful casual choices; we had a super last-day quick lunch at Roadside Taco that was delicious.The spa is a must-do if you stay here. Huge, absolutely beautiful space. My massage therapist, Ruby, was stellar. We enjoyed the infrared sauna, the salt room, the steam room, the hot tub, the snow shower (!), and the heated lounge chairs throughout. We spent a couple hours after our massages just exploring the facility and relaxing.The hotel is a bit further up the strip but still a good location. I would definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: The extra mile.
allReviews.text: Had concerns about booking this as we regularly stay mid-strip. From the first minutes any fears were allayed- the property is wonderful and the staff warm and enthusiastic.We had become used to apathy borderline rudeness at MGM and Caesars properties and this felt like it was a return to old school Vegas.The rooms are immaculate in design. The cleanliness and maintenance second to none.The resort features a pool area and spa that is probably the best we have seen.The dining options are varied and excellent with Dons Prime outstanding.Above all the peoples attitudes- wanting to help, check in housekeeping and rewards were excellent and special mentions to Cindy - Night Casino  Supervisor and Marina Snr Slot Host.When you’re deciding on your location you will see negative comments about where it is situated. It is a $10 ride anywhere in an Uber, Lyft or cab and that buys you excellence quality and value.So in making your decision you will have to decide whether to go that extra mile - our recommendation - definitely!We’re converted

allReviews.title: Must stay when in Vegas
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers an exceptional experience with its amazing service and stunning design. The staff is incredibly attentive, ensuring every need is met with warmth and professionalism. The hotel itself is a visual masterpiece, blending luxury with modern elegance. From the elegant rooms to the breathtaking views, every detail is thoughtfully crafted. Whether you're here for relaxation or excitement, Fontainebleau promises a memorable stay.

allReviews.title: Fountainbleu Vegas Needs Help
allReviews.text: Beautiful property nice staff. They just are going to have a hard time keeping up with the other resorts because of a few issues.One is in the most important, my eyes burned like heck the entire time I was there I was continually putting in eye drops, which caused my nose to also run. I don’t usually have allergies this time of year.I’m pretty sure that I agree with the other reviews on this webpage about whatever they are pumping in to the air! The only other thing I could think of was they allow pets and they use some cleaner to sanitize in the rooms and that could’ve caused it.There is no seating anywhere in the entire huge open spaced lobby or some of the winding hallways because they don’t want anyone sitting - they want people to be in the casino, which is mostly empty…… but if they were smart, they’d  change this. It would look much more aesthetically pleasing- it’s almost like they ran out of money to finish it with couches and chairs like most good resorts have! Also beware that they do not have any coffee in the rooms! Very inconvenient Again, it’s like they ran out of funds for a small Keurig or Nespresso machine!They have some goofy rules about food -some bars you can take food into because they don’t offer any. Also, because there are no tables anywhere or furniture anywhere where would you eat? Besides the food court in the promenade - it is not that cool to sit up there. It’s like you are in a mall. So just know that if you get something in that promenade, you better just eat it there. There was a main bar that lets people bring their food in. We’re not talking about camping out, just a sandwich and of course you clean up your little mess! The resort is pretty I just think that there are better options in Vegas  that are more complete luxury resorts. There is too much competition there for a resort to fall behind in these ways. And they have some of the nicest designer shops! A waste not to fix these issues!

allReviews.title: Exceptional Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent, exceptional experience at the Fontainebleau! The Spa is one of a kind! Stunning, luxurious accommodations and state of the art decor and restaurants. Love this property!!! The restaurants are impeccable, and the food presentation at all outlets are artistic and unique.

allReviews.title: Unimpressive
allReviews.text: This is the newest hotel/resort on the Strip. Amenities and environments are neck to neck with other top resorts. Elegance is how I described this resort. But I don't see how they set themselves apart with it's being further north of the Strip (not centrally located and in a rougher side of the Strip), with more rigid check in experience. They don't have the best panoramic view like Trump Hotel, they don't have the location like Bellagio or Caesar's or Venetian, their room size is about the same as other top hotels. The only thing they have is "it's new" but new will eventually become old. The only lever they can compete is through pricing. The rigid check in experience was unpleasant and draining, which killed the excitement and anticipation of staying in this place. I walked away unimpressed and will not consider staying here again.For the price they charge, you can stay in other more centrally located resorts on the strip and still have the same or way better experience.They wanted to scan every guest's ID and refuse to own up responsibility for any guest data security breach.The housekeeping was unresponsive when raising inappropriate behavior of a man on in front of the elevator waiting area near the hallway though the surveillance camera should have recorded it.Over-rated.

allReviews.title: Everything Was Perfect
allReviews.text: I went here in august and then i came back for christmas break in december. everything is so extravagant, literally everything. the hotel is beautiful, the food is so delicious, and so much more. the hotel is very remarkable with its architecture inside and art, making it have such a good modern vegas style. all the restaurants were full of life and fun. the pools and seating were so advanced and pretty. the best best best food was the pizza from miami pizza. i went here 2 times in the past year and i miss it so much already, that’s how much i love it. this hotel is seriously the best hotel in vegas and i can’t wait to come again. thank you for you making this hotel so worth it to visit!!

allReviews.title: More subdued, quiet hotel with great bars and restaurants
allReviews.text: Very comfortable, clean, large room (we had bleu king).  Beds/pillows were great.  Some electronics (like curtains), but not overly modern rooms.  Location is quite a ways from rest of strip (across from Circus Circus), so 15 minute walk to Wynn, 40 to Paris).  No real theme in hotel, caters to night clubs, and very high end restaurants and exclusive shops.  Free self park garage is very convenient.  In general, due to location and pricing in restaurants I would not return (we are in our 60’s), but if I were young, hip and rich it would be fantastic for the clubs and bars.

allReviews.title: Nice!
allReviews.text: We had a great visit to the Fountainebleau.  The hotel is clean and smells great.  Our room was very comfortable and spotless. We appreciated the refrigerated drawer and nice bathrooms.  We really liked the pool -- the vibe was festive but not a drunken rager.  The workout facility is amazing and overlooks the Strip.  The service was really what set the property apart.  It was exceptional when compared to other Vegas hotels.  Every single employee was not only good at their job but also really pleasant.  We booked through Amex Fine Hotels and Resorts and they honored each amenity seamlessly.  The only downside to the property is the location.  It's at the far north end with only Circus Circus nearby (yikes).  We took some long walks or ubers during our stay there, so if that bothers you, you may wish to stay elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Exceptional service and staff. Good amenities. Boring decor.
allReviews.text: We spent one night here on a Sunday night in a double room on the 68th floor with a spectacular view. The room was nothing special and it was gray. I hate gray rooms. But the view was incredible. The room was spacious enough for three of us and they had nice features like the floor ceiling drapes opening and closing with the push of a button. Actually, there were so many buttons it got a little confusing. The spacious bathroom had a soaker tub and a shower. Several light switches and I appreciated a nightlight switch. There was no coffee maker, but there are never coffee makers in Vegas hotels so I bring my own miniature travel water boiler. And make instant. They want you downstairs getting your coffee where you might gamble. (The only exception I have found by the way is the Marriott across from the convention center, which is a standard Marriott with all the typical business amenities, including a coffee maker yay. )Whoever trains, the staff here deserves a bonus because the thing that makes this hotel special is the wonderful service.  We had only been checked in perhaps 10 minutes when there was a knock on the door and a woman from housekeeping was there with a clipboard asking if everything was OK and if there was anything more we needed it. There was a mini bar which I did not plan to use, but she also showed us that there was a refrigerated drawer for your personal items you wanted to keep cool, which was very welcome. She also offered twice to send us up a microwave or a bigger refrigerator if we want it. We were only there for one night and we didn’t need it, but I was impressed. The Bellman brought up our bags quickly after we called down with our room number, and he offered to bring us an additional luggage rack because we only had one. My brothers told him we didn’t need it, but then he turned and asked me and I said sure why not. So a few minutes later, we got a second luggage rack. I was impressed at the hotels desire to make us completely happy.  When I checked in, they also gave me without asking a color laminated map of the resort which I appreciated because it seems nowadays they just want to give you a QR code, which is annoying. It’s so much easier just to look at a paper map in your hand. The casino just seems like a standard casino. Nothing special, but it did not smell smoky at all, which made me very happy. We tried to go down and look at the beautiful pool complex at 6:30 PM but unfortunately we couldn’t even walk out there because it was already closed and the doors were locked. That was super disappointing because I had to leave early the next morning, and I really wanted to see it. I was hoping maybe there was at least a hot tub and a fire pit we could enjoy. Photos of the spot it’s gorgeous, but we didn’t have time to check it out. We ate at the Komodo Asian fusion restaurant and loved it. We are vegetarian and it was easy to order delicious vegetable dishes. The cocktails were very expensive but also really really good. On the second floor, there is an upscale food court with fast food. It’s more attractive than most of its ilk, but we didn’t see anything we wanted to eat since we were not interested in slices of pizza or burgers. The reason I did not give this resort five. Stars is because of the decor. It’s supposedly only a year and a half old but the decor looks really tired and like it’s from the 90s. Dripping modern crystal chandeliers from the ceiling. Yawn. It doesn’t look shabby just boring. Especially in comparison with the other over the top resorts of this quality. Everything from the lobby to the casino to our room just looked bland and uninspired. I don’t know what they were thinking. Even the spacious lobby when you first walk in, had this fragrant and huge display of roses, but it wasn’t interesting to look at. The only decor element I liked was a huge mural sized  colorful painting that was similar to Basquiat. They definitely needed a lot more of that fresh element. Especially since they don’t have the best location on the strip I would’ve liked to have seen much more of a wow factor when I walked in.

allReviews.title: Worth the walk from the main strip
allReviews.text: I did not stay here, just went to explore. I was looking forward to seeing this place because of its very long history of being abandoned and incomplete. The casino is close to the main doors. Lots of restaurants, even vegan food options. The atmosphere seemed casual but cherry. Workers seemed cheerful, the piped in music was upbeat, it was bright inside with lights and colors. But the bathrooms. You must check out the bathrooms, enough said!I enjoyed my visit.

allReviews.title: Amazing!!!!
allReviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing, very clean room, amazing customer service, good food. Won $2k on the Wheel of Fortune slot machine! I will definitely stay at the Fountain Bleu in Las Vegas again! If you’re on the fence about staying there, don’t be; I love this resort!

allReviews.title: Great food staff and fun
allReviews.text: The property is amazing ! Great location to eat drink enjoy time with friends and family . Looking forward to seeing if they can offer the same comps as some of the other property groups on the strip. I would hands down give this property a chance if your looking and will def be a new long time supporter if they can make the comps work

allReviews.title: Target on our backs.   Read review. Do you want your family treated as such?
allReviews.text: From the first night having our dinner reservations cancelled for wearing open back shoes at Komodo, visiting desk twice but never receiving any resolution to the restaurant mess, the bellhops harrasing us because we ordered giordanos and take out, yelling at my fiancé chastising her saying they are in their better mind to cancel the order because you cannot door dash to this hotel, right up until checkout things having hotel security following us harassing me bc they thought my $40k Leica camera and lense case was full of guns, then escorting us out of hotel forbidding us to return unless we let them inspect our bags in lobby. which we refused. the guard told us that it will not be nice or comfortable if w choose to come back. see photos. this hotel is a nice property but for some reason. we had a target on our backs the moment we stepped in. I do not recommend staying here as it's over priced. thei discourage shopping or dining eksewhere and make no bones about making you uncomfor table if you choose to shop elsewhere.   The staff look down at you and don’t take you seriously.  The security was very threatening and made us fear for our safety.  While there is a lot of riff raff in LV mind you we did absolutely nothing to attract this type of treatment and were only trying to enjoy our first trip to Las Vegas together as a couple photographing the sights and experiences Vegas has to offer. We feeling less than human and left looking over our shoulders not knowing if we would have to defend ourselves.  Fountainblue single handedly ruined our vacation and soured our experience on the city.  Very sad. Very shameful.  Just our airfare was 3400 plus the rooms and what we spent.  All in all it was a 15000 week that left us feeling frustrated and unsafe.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: Nice brand new hotel. Very classy. I wouldn’t stay here again. A little north of the strip and away from the action but peace and quiet is good. Good brunch and dinner restaurants, high end shopping. Casino is really nice! Food hall places are delicious and not too busy—although orders take a long time to fulfill. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great get away for the wife and I
allReviews.text: Amazing time. Great staff. We did a day at the cabana and pool. Staff there was great. The min spend was reasonable. The bar nowhere was also amazing and great staff. We did dinner at Washington potato. Had the best server I’ve experienced in a very long time. Personally we have nothing but great things to say. I’d go back again

allReviews.title: An incredible getaway!
allReviews.text: The beautiful rooms were spacious and comfortable, with a fabulous view of Las Vegas! I highly recommend the Spa and all of the amenities included in each package! It was the perfect place for my daughters and I to spend quality time together!

allReviews.title: Great stay.
allReviews.text: The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. The bathroom was very large and had great amenities. We enjoyed food in the sports book it was delicious, we actually ate there several times, sandwiches were large we shared the meatloaf sandwich, the prime rib sandwich and have the chicken nachos!! The staff was friendly staff everywhere we went. This place is a prime example of you get what you pay for ... we paid and they did not disappoint!

allReviews.title: We love the Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: Just the best place you can stay.  Upscale, friendly staff, we won in the casino, so many food options.  What's not to love.  Vida for your morning start is a great place to eat.  We do like the pools but haven't been yet this year, we will later in the year when we return.The BEST casino floor staff in all of Vegas.  Make that all of Nevada!!  And plenty of nightlife with more and more big name entertainment always coming.

allReviews.title: Room Good/Food bad
allReviews.text: Room was nice. Views in room were nice. Casino is nice and clean. Staff was friendly. I was excited to see so much diversity in the staff. Love that parking is not charged to guests of the hotel. The food was not great. We ate at Vida for breakfast. I had the country skillet and it was just a soupy mess of tomato sauce. It was basically inedible. My husband had the omelet and it was the most basic bland omelet. It just wasn't great. I wouldn't eat there for breakfast again. Capon's burgers had a weird system and gave our food away to a woman when it had a man's name on it after we had waited a long time to get it. We had to chase her down to get our food. We went back again another night to get ice cream and that took a long time. Chez Bon Bon was good overall, except there was plastic on the egg of each our breakfast sandwiches. I would still try Chez Bon Bon again, but not the other ones.

allReviews.title: Luxurious and stunning resort!
allReviews.text: The aromas alone in the lobby are so inviting along with the beauty of the roses! The rooms are beautiful and the view from the 69th floor was mesmerizing. We chose the mountain view and could also see the Sphere. The bathrooms are ample and luxurious. Our room rate was excellent in terms of quality/price. The location is fabulous for the convention center and if you have a car, as we did, nothing is too far away.

allReviews.title: The FountaineBleau does not disappoint!
allReviews.text: My fifth stay since they opened in December 2023.Offered a reasonably priced room upgrade at check in.  This made me feel like a valued upper customer / rewards member.Room, Staff, and Dining facilities are all top notch in my opinion.  I had some problems with my room account portfolio that were addressed promptly and courteously.The hotel and casino are beautiful structures.  The rewards program is appealing to me and has attainable goals that offer valuable services, like free valet parking...Take the short walk to the Peppermill Restaurant, just across from RW.  It is full of history and character, with large portion meals that easily justify the costs.This will be my "go to" hotel for the foreseeable future.

allReviews.title: Very nice and clean hotel.
allReviews.text: Positive experience at this property. Very neat in terms of order and cleanliness. The room nice spacious, ours had a view of the sphere and mountains .. Very clean and always stocked with everything you need. Inside the hotel there were several restaurants and bars, as for the restaurants I do not know the quality not having tried while for the bar I can say that I made good breakfasts, a little expensive but acceptable in terms of cost given the average of Las Vegas. Anyway I would stay there again even if it is a bit out of the strip but not too far.Just a note about the room, during the night even with the air conditioning off you could hear an annoying noise.

allReviews.title: Fabulous place to stay
allReviews.text: I have been there twice.  Once in January and again in March.The hotel has everything you need for your stay.  You don’t need to leave the hotel. Great choice of restaurants.  7 pools, a great gym and the casino is huge.  They offer a great rewards program also.

allReviews.title: A good experience...could have been better....
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with all of the amenities.  Check in was a breeze but we were placed in a room so far away from the elevator that I thought we were in a different building.  The young person who checked us in SAW that my sister was walking with a cane (recent surgery) so it was interesting and inconsiderate that she would do that.  Fortunately, when we asked for a change, we were accommodated immediately.  The place is huge so even getting from the parking lot to the guest elevators was quite a trek.  We ordered room service only once since we spent most of our time out.  But the one time we did order food - two omelets cost nearly $80!  Even with the high cost of eggs this was insane!  No drinks, nothing additional, just two omelets....The one other time we wanted to grab a bite we decided to try the food court.  Everything was closed.  Maybe around 10pm?  Seems one or two places should stay open later - maybe burgers, sandwiches, pizza - since the casinos are open and people are up very late.Overall, it was a decent experience.  The hotel is beautiful, and the rooms are comfortable.  The beds and robes are comfy cozy, and I may stay again.  But there are so many options in Vegas, I may not....

allReviews.title: Not typical of Fountainbleau, but I will definitely stay there again
allReviews.text: Great place.  I was there for a convention so it was nice to be able to walk to the tradeshow.  Beautiful hotel and comfortable rooms.  Housekeeping didn't do so well of a job on this stay.  They did not inspect the room before I checked in because the drawers should have been emptied out.

allReviews.title: Pleasant Stay
allReviews.text: Overall, a very good hotel. Staff is very professional and experienced. We use d the gym which is equipped with all the equipment necessary to have a great work out. The SPA is absolutely a must. Restaurants, a must go is Vida for breakfast or lunch. Food is excellent.Another one that tops it all is ITO located at the top of the hotel. Only two seatings 6pm and 8:30pm I believe. Breathtaking experience not only for the superb food but for the view.

allReviews.title: Lights came on randomly in the middle of the night.
allReviews.text: Worst hotel room I have ever had. A hotel's fundamental purpose is to allow you to sleep and the Fontainebleau Las Vegas failed at that. The lights in the room came on randomly at 11:21pm and at 4:48am. When I called the front desk and asked if this happens to other people, the answer I got was "in some rooms the lights sometimes randomly flicker on".  Ours did not flicker; they came on and stayed on. To turn them off I had to read the complex bedside panel to find the "off" button.The front desk person offered to send the facilities maintenance team.It is an otherwise very nice hotel.

allReviews.title: Not the greatest for being the newest
allReviews.text: For the price I would go back to Aria from now on. Pretty place but nothing that stands out. Food court is garbage. Restaurants that I could get into couldn't cook steaks to right temp, but took so long to get first time wouldn't send back. If u wanted to walk anywhere u can go a mile to wynn or resort world that had much better food. There was a shooting g at circu circus while we were there watching out windows.

allReviews.title: Please train the front desk better
allReviews.text: I was so excited to try Fontaine Bleau but I don’t think I’d go back. To start, our room was not ready when we checked in and we didn’t get into our room till after 7pm and 3 trips back to wait in line at the front desk. I overheard several others having similar issues. This set the tone for our entire stay and was extremely disappointing. Once inside, I found several hairs in both the tub and shower. We did have a resort credit so we tried a few restaurants on property. The food was ok but extremely overpriced for what it was ($115 for 2 sandwiches and soda !?) On the good side, the rooms are new with lots of outlets and that was convenient. We also liked the view and how close it was to the Convention center. Overall, there are many other choices in Vegas. This will not be at the top of list for us again.

allReviews.title: Made a memorable trip
allReviews.text: Check in was quick and easy, though we arrived late at night. Beware if you are sensitive to smells as this hotel like many, pump strong perfume out into the air. A large hold was placed on my credit card upon check in, something to be prepared for.My kid and I were in a two Queen Better Mountain view room on the 61st floor for 5 days. The room was beautiful and clean, other than the half eaten food that was not cleaned out of the fridge from the previous guests. The pillows, bedding and mattresses were dreamy. Extremely comfortable. All of the lights and drapes were controlled with panels by the door and bed. The bathtub was massive and could probably fit 6 people comfortably. The hotel has excellent water pressure and the enormous tub did not take long to fill at all. Toilet and shower had their own separate stalls which is nice for privacy when you are sharing a room.There were plenty of drawers and an illuminated closet with very cozy bath robes. The ‘pay bar’ fridge was the size of a normal mini fridge but the fridge you could put your own food or drink items in was extremely tiny. For some reason they have included compartments to separate items which takes up even more of the space.Climate control worked well. I do have a complaint about the noise. Almost every night without fail, we were woken up by women fighting in the halls. Also traffic and music at ground level despite being so high up were very loud. I ate at two of the food court places, the burger and the pizza ones. Both were delicious but the pizza really stood out. I frequented the Bon Bon Cafe daily and nightly for their lattes and also their selection of gelato which I would eat in my giant bubble bath! I liked the proximity to the Fireside Restaurant as well as the Walgreens down the road just past the Sahara (go there for drinks and snacks, not the AMPM). I had purchased unlimited passes to the monorail but found it was too much of a hassle to walk to the nearest station and resorted to taking ride share instead. Check out consisted of simply turning my keys in and leaving, however a few days later I had charged on my credit card from the hotel with no folio or explanation as to what they were for, so I do wish I had waited for a receipt. Overall, I would stay here again and I would recommend it to others. I feel like the hotel had a lot more to offer that I didn’t get a chance to experience.

allReviews.title: Going to Vegas and not checking out Fontainebleau would be a mistake!
allReviews.text: The fontainebleau in Las Vegas is worth every effort to visit. The staff truly welcomes you and makes every effort to make you feel important as a guest. The cleanliness is way above average for casinos. It is off the strip but a short cab ride from wherever you are staying- the pools are amazing and the food choices cover everything!!

allReviews.title: Spring break family trip
allReviews.text: We were in town for spring break with my son and daughter.  Room was beautiful, plenty of good food options for all of us and went to see the Pitbull residency show which was so fun.  Breakfast at Cafe Cuto was delicious - only wish there was more seating.  Kids enjoyed Miami Slice and El Bagel.

allReviews.title: Spring at the Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas was exceptional! Food was delicious, rooms were comfortable and clean! In room dining for breakfast was very good. LA Fontaine for lunch and Miami Slice for midnight snack hit the spot. We will definitely be back. Thank you!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed at FB and had a great weekend!  This place is beautiful and offers great food and gaming experience.  The GYM is a top gym with everything needed for a workout during your stay.  We also enjoyed drinks at the BLEAU bar right in the middle of the casino floor.  Such a great HOTEL, we will be back next month for sure!

allReviews.title: The Pros and Cons of Size
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is a gigantic structure with two valet entrances. The entry is cavernous. Noise throughout is intense and busy. For some, this could be a plus. Mixture of casino and hotel is apparent. Orientation is as expected in casino hotel. Stayed in Royal Suite, gigantic soaking tub, high quality, nice. Two rooms, separate bedroom, fabulous views. Nice decor. Bed, King, excellent, tooth brushes and shaving accoutrements a nice extra, cleaning service great. Cons: No coffee maker in room, to order half a liter of coffee is $32 and up. The setup for restaurants forces wandering the casino. I do gamble, but I hate roaming or searching for restaurants I can’t find. Always waited with the crowds in morning around Azul entrance. I usually stay at 4 Seasons. Fontainebleau is not at the level of the 4 Seasons, but its newness is worth a visit.

allReviews.title: Best of the Best
allReviews.text: Best Hotel in Vegas, the best experience for a family getaway, it has everything for all ages. The staff is very attentive and always attentive to all the details, the rooms are very well maintained. The restaurants are perfect and their food is exquisite, the service at the bars in the pool are excellent.

allReviews.title: Top Notch
allReviews.text: First time staying at this property and loved it. The rooms were clean and luxe. They thought of everything from variable lighting in the rooms and bath, to soft close drawers in the dressers and night stands, even motion activated closet lights. It was so nice not to have your typical low quality hotel hair dryer and iron. Instead they had a T3 professional hair dryer and an  easy to use garment steamer. The beds and pillows were incredible too. Love the floor to ceiling windows for a fantastic view of the sphere and strip. I know you won’t be disappointed if you book your stay here.

allReviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful and exquisite
allReviews.text: Upon entering, I was taken away by the entrance area. The hotel looked very clean and refreshing. I loved the rose display that sits in the middle of the floor. The chandeliers are breathtaking. The center bar in the casino area is absolutely beautiful. The restaurants and shops were very classy. If you dine, be sure to dine at VIDA...they have blueberry pancakes that will knock your socks off. There were beyond delicious. There was construction going on inside, that caused a bad look, but it didn't interfere with maneuvering through the hotel. We did encounter some issues within our room that were resolved quickly, but those issues did make me frown upon my experience, which is why I did not give 5 stars. Had I not encountered any issues, I would have definitely given 5 stars. I have, however, recommended this hotel to others that have asked about our experience, personally. Despite the issues, I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: The hotel is wonderful. Our experience was top-notch. Everything was clean well-maintained weight staff were courteous and professional. We loved lounging by the pool. There were more than enough seats. And I love the fitness center. It was incredibly well appointed and easy to maintain my Fitness goals while away from home.

allReviews.title: Great Weekend
allReviews.text: FREE parking. Great room, pool, and food. Loved breakfast at VIDA. Had a great time at the pool. Pool water was clean and warm. Ate lunch at the pool and enjoyed the food. Loved the huge bathtub in the room. Loved all the lighting buttons in the room.

allReviews.title: Fantastic resort/casino
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is one of the best resort/casinos in Vegas. Every single person we dealt with was as friendly and professional as could be. The room was clean, modern, and well appointed. The casino is great (we're blackjack players and unlike most Vegas casinos they aren't trying to win ever. single. hand.) I cannot recommend them highly enough

allReviews.title: Opulence and Grandeur
allReviews.text: Truly one of the best experiences at our recent visit. From the room, to the food, to pool and safety, it was all perfect. The staff were friendly and helpful.   This was our first get away as empty nesters to celebrate my 50th birthday. The room and views were perfect. Everything is high end, down to the toiletries in the bathroom. The bleau bar is opulent and phenomenal. I found myself without one of my credit cards after visiting the bar. It was given to lost and found (Kansas girls shouldn't leave Kansas!). The promenade had great, affordable food options. My favorite was Miami Slice! It was still pretty cool outside but went to the pool to soak up some vitamin D. Plenty of chairs and very clean(the whole resort, really). While we are not the biggest gamblers, the casino floor was great. Plenty of slots and gaming tables. It didn't feel jammed packed because of the high ceiling, like many of the casinos. I can't wait for my next visit!

allReviews.title: Overall, Absolutely Amazing stay with 2 small concerns
allReviews.text: This was am absolutely beautiful hotel/casino with top notch service, restaurants, and shops.  Our stay there was wonderful, and we thoroughly enjoyed exploring some of the many wonderful restaurants, bars, and cafes, especially the specialty chocolate shop and gelato shop. We attended a concert at their venue, which was an amazing experience.  They handled the sold out crowd with no delays and no issues.I had only 2 issues which prevented 5 star rating.  First, and not sure if all of the hotels are doing this, but note that there are no coffee makers in any of the rooms.  I called to inquire, and they confirmed, no coffeemakers.  So if you're an early riser, or had a late night out, you need to get dressed and leave your room to get coffee. They have plenty of choices, but all coffee, just regular "drip" is $7 for a medium in any of their cafes / patisseries/ food court/ etc.The other issue was the room.  Although VERY beautiful, and clean, with one of the most comfortable beds we have ever slept in, the room we booked stated "Mountain View", which was a stretch.  Although the mountains were visible in the way distance, most of our view was blocked by the incredibly awful Circus Circus Hotel, quite possibly the ugliest remaining hotel on the strip. The other issue is that the Fontainebleau had a VERY large (we saw it from our plane) display board with rotating visuals and dynamic images of all of their restaurants, shows, and amenities.  Although beautiful, is was on 24 hours a day, and even with our privacy drapes drawn, lit up our whole room all night.  We were already unpacked and settled in before we realized it late on our first night, and with only 3 nights there, didn't ask to switch, so I'm not sure how they would have handles it or if they would have up charged us for another "view".  I would highly recommend a stay here, but note the coffee maker issue (it is very important to some travelers), and be careful of inquiring about the view and what's outside your window.

allReviews.title: Definitely will stay here again!
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the room was nice, but the staff are outstanding! They were kind and considerate and made my family believe they truly cared that we had a good experience. The pool area was a bit crowded and I had to stand the entire time I watched my grandson swim.

allReviews.title: This casino will take every dollar you have not just on gaming!!
allReviews.text: This hotel is seemingly struggling to make ends meet. We ordered room service tonight , 2 items, sliders and lobster rolls totalling $59 and was handed a bill for $91, we had asked for two empty glasses and we’re charged $5 dollars each for the empty glasses, we graciously gave the glasses back and said no thank you please remove them from our bill, we were also charged 18% gratuity and a nine dollar service fee. When we asked about the nine dollar service fee and what it was for on top of the gratuity, we were told it was a Casino charge. Keep in mind we were ordering room service to our hotel room and clearly the nine dollar service charge is just an extra money grab. The manager, I spoke to you tried every excuse in the book. Honestly, the customer service at this hotel is terrible. You don’t recommend it, they are far more capable casinos in Las Vegas than this one.

allReviews.title: Vegas fun
allReviews.text: One of best hotels on strip, modern , spacious and never felt crowded. High quality rooms and experience . Go for rooms overlooking pool and high as you can get - great views .Really top draw swimming pools and great fitness facility . Crowned off with 2 great barista style coffee shops -1 open24 hrs.

allReviews.title: Terrible Experience at Property, Beware!
allReviews.text: Terrible service and property. Never received  new host after my old one was terminated. Restaurants commit fraud by charging illegal tips. Beware. Overall guest services are absolutely terrible with attitude and security knocking on bathroom door 6 times in HL slots area causing major disturbance. Be aware, and look at the Wynn or Venetian as an alternative.

allReviews.title: Worked for us!
allReviews.text: Went for a quick getaway with the fam and wanted to try this hotel. It was perfect. Clean, wonderful service. Our room was basic but it was a decent size and very clean. Staff was on top of things and very kind. I will absolutely go back as soon as I have the chance.

allReviews.title: It was worth the wait
allReviews.text: Overall wonderful experience.After all the years of sitting half finished they really did something special there.Our room was great, everything was spotless and the dining options were fantastic.The staff was friendly and very knowledgeable.

allReviews.title: Stunning!
allReviews.text: This hotel is amazing. The scent as you enter is incredible. The rooms are spectacular. Beds and pillows so comfortable. Felt like I was sleeping on a cloud. Classier crowd outside the strip. Beautiful experience. The casino is gorgeous. A lot of beautiful shops! The check in was flawless. Staff all so friendly.  Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Not my cup of tea!
allReviews.text: Nice luxury hotel but not my cup of tea. (Boring vibe) but I must say our room was perfect clean with a nice view!For me it was awful air freshener smell on the main floor  gave me a headache the two days I was  there and it discouraged me from gaming and trying  out to the hotel restaurants.

allReviews.title: Great Pools!
allReviews.text: Such a great property and second time staying. They make it hard to stay anywhere else. The service is top notch and anywhere you go you get great service. They have some of the best venues for clubs, pools, day parties, and restaurants! Enjoy the view from our room and have one of the best hotel gyms. Will definitely stay again!

allReviews.title: Would recommend to everyone!
allReviews.text: This hotel was breath taking, from the reception areas to the rooms. Everything was finished to such a high standard. The comfiest beds and pillows and it also offered some of the nicest food I have experienced. Would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting vegas.

allReviews.title: Pool closure for ‘weather’ on reasonably nice day.
allReviews.text: They completely closed the pool with little explanation other than ‘weather.’ Not even allowed to sit outside. It was a bit on the chilly side and windy, but truly not that bad - 60 degrees, with winds up to 20 mph (and was only supposed to get better). Will not stay here again. There are other places that won’t close completely for mild weather concerns. Incredibly, incredibly disappointing. Strong regrets. Would never have booked here if we’d known they would completely shut down over a bit of wind. Avoid this hotel.

allReviews.title: Dangerous mold in bathroom so bad mushrooms were growing
allReviews.text: Mold so bad in the bathroom mushrooms were growing, don’t be fooled by this beautiful new facade. We brought the mold to management’s attention and they downgraded our room and simply offered us a food and beverage credit less than one night’s stay when we had already been there for 5 nights. Was a truly bizarre experience

allReviews.title: Nice room with a view of the Sphere by........
allReviews.text: Room was very nice with a good view of the Sphere. Tavern restaurant food mediocre at best.  Casino is very poor at payout for amount of bet placed. Concert arena is a nice place to see a concert but a $64.00 margarita in a souvenir cup a bit too much

allReviews.title: 10/10 Would Stay Here Again
allReviews.text: Great experience! All staff is friendly and attentive, I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Amber at Bleau Bar and Shayla at LIV Beach are the sweetest servers and will take great care of you! Do not miss out on the Lapis Spa, the Celestial Waters experience is very relaxing

allReviews.title: Avoid at All Costs
allReviews.text: My card was hacked on check-in. It was downhill from there. No one helped. Locked out. Cynthia was rude and condescending. As a 30 year local, having stayed in every luxury casino and some not, this place is NOT a place I would ever step foot into again. Don's is a joke: $85 filet was tough and mushrooms inedible. Outback is better!Don't bother to visit. Better off going to Miami or not at all. Bet it will not be long in FB brand. It just doesn't belong there. Oh, there's an odor not well hidden by the fragrance in the air. Mr Soffer should be ashamed!

allReviews.title: Pretty but needs better service and attention to detail
allReviews.text: It’s a beautiful hotel but I was disappointed with the lack of attention to detail that the property has. First and foremost, at check in they neglected to put my Fine Hotel guaranteed 4pm late check out so of course we could not get back into our room. Once calling the front desk from outside our room, they made us walk all the way back downstairs where we waited in another line. Then that guy asked us our hotel room number and then said we were on a government room (what?) and had a 11am check out. Then he stated a room number that we were not in, to which I had to correct him that that was not our room number, and then he finally located my reservation to then say “oh you have a 4pm check out.” There was no apology for the inconvenience or mix up or the fact that he tried to tell us that we were wrong about our check out time. And then finally after going all the way back to the room, we were in the room and then the shades all closed and the television turned off after five minutes. The room was pretty and the bathroom was gorgeous, but at one point we smelled something was off and it was the back of the bathroom door with a robe that was folded nicely but clearly was old and unwashed. The back of the door was an absolutely awful rancid smell. The closet door by the handle was stained. I am disappointed that while I loved the look and feel of the room and hotel, I was not happy with how we were treated by the front desk regarding the mix up on our check out time. And the cleanliness of the bathroom — that door was awful.Steve - probably a pit boss? - on the casino floor was super helpful and the best level of service we got during our stay.

allReviews.title: Humidity in the room at the edge of human comfort
allReviews.text: The hotel is outstanding in many ways—truly a 10 out of 10. However, I can’t help but wonder: why do we build spaces for humans that feel so uninhabitable?The humidity in the rooms is consistently below 30%, sometimes dropping as low as 20%—a level at the extreme edge of human comfort. Waking up with a blocked nose and a sore throat becomes inevitable.Why create such an environment? Why not allow windows to open or implement better air circulation to naturally maintain humidity at a more comfortable level, at least 40%?I appreciate that humidifiers are available, but they are not a standard part of the room setup. Even when provided, they struggle to reach 40%, taking hours to make a noticeable difference.Ultimately, the designers who created this hotel (who I'm sure you payed extremely well) have failed the most basic test: be human with humans.

allReviews.title: Luxurious Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent stay! Hotel rooms were luxuriously appointed. They thought of everything. Robes and slippers were provided. The Bathroom had toothpaste, shaving cream along with a razor and toothbrush. The bed was incredibly comfortable. The bathroom was huge. The toilet closet should have had a door but otherwise it was great. Drapes and lights are operated with switches that are everywhere. We had a room looking at sphere and that was a great view. The casino had everything you would want and wasn’t crowded. They had lounges everywhere that you could sit and talk. The sportsbook was great on a Saturday afternoon for college basketball watching. We didn’t eat dinner here but definitely want to try Papi Steak and Mother Wolf next time. They need a few more casual breakfast options. Hotel is still being built out so I will want to come back when it is all finished. Great hotel for adults in Vegas

allReviews.title: Beautiful but Boring
allReviews.text: This hotel has no energy, no Vegas Vibe.  If you’re looking for clubs, pubs, shopping, heck excitement, choose one of the other hotels.  This one is located at the North Part of the strip so expect paying extra for transportation on a daily basis.  We spent all of our evenings elsewhere cause there’s nothing exciting going on here,  there’s only 5-6 places at the food court but closed after 10pm.  Very disappointing and very expensive even for Vegas standards.

allReviews.title: Incredible Stay All-Around
allReviews.text: From check-in to check-out, from Spa to Pool, from housekeepers to games Dealers and from one Guest to another......nothing but welcoming kindness.Truly an incredible hotel. Had smiley faces the entire time! Well done Fountainebleau Las Vegas. Can't wait to come back.

allReviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful...But...
allReviews.text: My family (all adults) wanted to visit the property as we had not seen it before. We did not stay at the resort. It is breathtakingly beautiful. The colors, decor, casino, and layout are gorgeous and unique. This is where things go south. While there, we stopped at the 'food court' to grab an easy bite. The service was terrible, the food barely warm enough, and our order was incomplete. When we brought it to their attention (with the receipt) they told us we hadn't ordered the items missing,... and then, they read the entire receipt. They filled part of it right away, and then we waited another 10 minutes for the last item. I'm not one to, create a scene, so we didn't raise a fuss there. All told, while we don't have a problem paying crazy prices for a unique experience, ultimately, after this, we truly have no inspiration to return.

We had an AMAZING stay at the Fontainebleau hotel. It was a 10/10…very clean and we had exceptional views on the 53rd floor. The bed was very comfortable and the robes were so thick and warm. Our standard room was so spacious. The hotel was very modern (I loved) and the restaurants had great food - Azul, Miami Slice & the Sports bar. It was close proximity to everything we could have needed. We really enjoyed our 3 night stay and would definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Fountainebleu concert weekend
allReviews.text: This is our second stay. The rooms are beautiful  and spacious. The bathrooms are big and huge shower. We have booked the gold executive king room both times. We were able to get a nice view of the Sphere. Beautiful casino and nice atmosphere. Definitely would stay there again in the future.

allReviews.title: Go back for sure
allReviews.text: Great hotel, beautifull roses in the lobby and a good experience. Staff is very friendly.No problems. Will go there again.Great casino en theater.Restaurants are tasty.Nice place on the strip.Travelled to a lot of different places in vegas, the strip en freemont street but i can recommend Fontainblue.

allReviews.title: Nice, New, Not Staying Here Again
allReviews.text: 1. we stayed here primarily for the spa. However, when we arrived, they said there are no reservations left, unless we paid for a service, which was another 60 dollars for a 40 minute chair massage? A chair massage for 60 bucks? I could get a full body Thai or Swedish massage for 60 bucks. Clearly a scam.2. The location isn't great and is out of the way. If you want to go to the strip for other activities, you'd have to pay for parking or uber. If #1 wasn't available, why would I ever stay here again? Half the stores aren't open, so forget shopping and the food options are limited.I've worked in Vegas for many years and stayed at all hotels on the strip, mainly Caesars. Fountainebleau's rooms are pretty much the Augustus Tower in Caesar, but you're in the prime location of the Strip. Hence, I wouldn't recommend anyone staying here, unless the rates were super cheap. Not worth the location hassle and their trickery to upcharge you on the things that are actually worth doing.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: Bed and bedding were very comfortable,  it is extremley important for us to sleep well. The robe was very nice but my skin started burning and turning red.  Very spacious and quiet room with a great view, we choose strip view room.Staff was extremely polite and eager to help. Really loved the technology of the lights and drapes it was great to turn all the lights on and off with one touch.Plenty of outlets throughout the Room.Unfortunately no coffee maker, but a clothes steamer  was handy.  Wish the fridge would have a little room to put a beverage or left over. There was however a cooling drawer that worked good for a few bottles of water. We enjoyed our stay.

allReviews.title: Amazing Hotel Experience
allReviews.text: We had an incredible experience and will definitely be returning to this hotel. From the moment we checked in until the end of our stay, everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Lee at the front desk was especially kind and helpful, ensuring we had a fantastic view of the Sphere.We treated ourselves to the Lapis Spa experience, booking a massage and enjoying the amenities. A special shout-out to Grace, the amazing masseuse, who worked wonders on releasing all my tension and knots. It was one of the best spa experiences I've had, and I’ll definitely be back.The location is perfect, and there are so many great restaurants to explore on our next visit. Thank you for a fun weekend.

allReviews.title: Fantastic with unbelievable spa!!
allReviews.text: Fantastic with unbelievable spa!!  This is a must go it you enjoy a unique and massive spa area.  We also enjoyed the excellent dining options and Miami slice is key to cover you in a pinch quickly.  Finally it was an easy walk to several Vegas staples including the Pinkbox Donut.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau did not disappoint!
allReviews.text: Overall fantastic experience! It’s immaculate and inviting. No smoke smell at all and the staff rocked it. It’s quieter than the  casinos on the strip, but on the other hand, it is far from the strip so it’s a taxi or uber to visit that area.  One plus, it was not as crowded when we were there so moving around was easy! Downside, no coffee makers in your room, and no Starbucks in the casino…not really a deal breaker, but I do love my Starbucks. Would we stay there again? Hell yeah!

allReviews.title: new hotel with nice facilities & minimal cigarette odor
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful stay: new & spacious room, huge fitness center, good restaurants, best of all barely any cigarrete odor. Room was state of the art with all the bells & whistles, we had a great view of the Sphere, love the huge bathroom which had shower as well as a hot tub, there was a safety box. We didnt gamble but ate at several restaur. Washing Potato dimsm was better than I expected, love that petite pineapple bbq pork bun. La Fontaine was just ok. Cafe Cuto had good pastries such as the signature raspberry bowtie croissant. Fitness center was the largest I have even seen in any hotel, prob the size of any local gyms.  I would def return if the price is rght.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: 1 night stay, but overall great! The rooms were really nice. No issues with staff or parking. It was a nice experience overall. The location isn’t my favorite, but that’s just my preference since I’m used to staying closer to the middle of the strip where there’s lots of places to walk to.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem
allReviews.text: Nice new hotel. Hallways are very spacious, lots of high-end shopping, the service is great. Really awesome pool area. Their sports book is combined with a tavern which is really cool and relaxing to hang out and watch a sporting event at or just to dine. The rooms are beautiful with lots of technology in them automatic opening drapes and lights and all the right hook ups for charging equipment. The showers have amazing pressure and you will get a great night sleep in those comfortable beds and pillows. I was here in March so it’s very reasonably priced right now. They also have a great concert hall.

allReviews.title: Old Hollywood glamour meets Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: As a longtime admirer of our Miami property, I was beyond excited to discover that I could bask in that same enchanting old Hollywood charm at there Las Vegas location! From the very moment I stepped inside, I was absolutely dazzled by the elegance of the property, which radiates the glamour of a bygone era.The staff truly elevated my experience; they were warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in making my visit extraordinary. The atmosphere was dripping with sophistication, making it feel as though I had walked right into a classic film. Every moment I spent there was pure joy, and I can’t wait to return and dive even deeper into all the incredible offerings the property presents.Everything about my stay was outstanding! From the luxurious accommodations that enveloped me in comfort to the exquisite design elements that evoke nostalgia, this place undeniably lives up to the celebrated reputation of our original location. I am already counting down the days until I can immerse myself once again in that timeless old Hollywood ambiance!If you're looking for a classic hotel experience that stands apart from the usual Las Vegas scene, this is the ultimate destination to relive a forgotten era of glitz and unparalleled customer service. Don't miss out!

allReviews.title: Won’t budge on resort fee when services not provided
allReviews.text: Stayed here twice, pool closed both times and still had to pay full resort fee. They told me resort fee had nothing to do with pool. Kinda like a rental car company saying A/C not working is not part of rental agreement. That woman that checked me in 3/6/25 told me that.

allReviews.title: Rewards program is pitiful
allReviews.text: Their rewards program is pitifully.  Their so called hosts are really just customer service reps that don’t really understand their job is meaning of customer service.   I have stayed there and reached silver tier status and get offers regularly from FB.  When you actually call to speak to a host, you get a poorly trained , un-accommodating customer service rep that could not care less about meeting your needs or helping you.     The Wynn, any of The Stations Properties, and the Venetian all offer better service.     I spread my play amongst many casinos, so partially my fault—but I know good service and training from bad.   FB is just plain bad.

allReviews.title: Service issues, lack of 24/7 food options, nice rooms
allReviews.text: At face value this place looks great. New build, beautiful, food options, all the usual Vegas style amenities. However, as someone who is a frequent traveler and expects a lot when I’m paying a lot of money, this experience had several key cracks that revealed some issues in primarily two categories:- service quality / customer care - amenities To start, check in was far from smooth. I’ll spare you all the details but we spent around one hour just to both get into the room. The room itself was beautiful. Design flaws in the bathroom which has a water runoff issue, the shampoo bottles are inconvenient to operate, and the shower doesn’t get warmer than a sort of average temperature. Mini bar etc well stocked and lots of options. There are no proper sit down food or snack options late night (and I’m talking like 10-11pm lol) on a weeknight besides some cafe that had run out of most items. This is a disgrace. We are in Las Vegas which is known for partying off hours. I had even made a dinner reservation that evening at Komodo at 10:30. I first got a call at 7 from the hostess asking if we can come earlier. No, I said, we cannot. Then at 9:30 she calls me again to tell me the restaurant is closing early and my reservation is being cancelled.I worked in fine dining restaurants for five years and not once did we close our restaurant early even if we only had one couple on the books for the latest possible reservation slot. Very poor hospitality and when I asked her for other options in the hotel we got sent to that french cafe. No thanks!! I don’t want a stale pastry for dinner under overhead lights. That night we had bar snacks from Collins bar for dinner. Ridiculous. Anyways, willing to look past it, we went about the rest of our five day trip. We took a trip to Lapis spa and I had really hyped up this experience to my partner; who had never gotten a couples massage before. We got there and the lobby was so… vibrant?! Lots of people with luggage lounging about chatting loudly/ the opposite of a calming spa welcome that I’m used to virtually anywhere I’ve been in the world. It was chaotic and loud and social. Inside not much better, the plunge pool/sauna area was totally overrun by so many people, loud chatter, etc. you’d think you were at a pool party. Further, we did end up eating breakfast at La Fontaine which was great. Also there were issues with housekeeping. They did not come the first day until like 3pm despite me calling twice in the morning to get our room fixed up and being told it had been noted. Just tell me if you can’t do it but I’m planning my time around it. Further, no personal touches or requests for feedback throughout our stay. It’s a 5 star property but felt like I was sleeping in a giant mall. This place needs to train all their staff much better, needs to expand food options around the clock, needs to seriously improve their check-in services, and needs a new spa manager.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: I'm feeling picky. The receptionist was not having a good day? She did not give us a rundown; we saw other guests getting welcome waters which is key in the desert. On that note, there are water dispensers in the ice rooms on each floor, but they are not well filtered (bad taste). We walked to the store and bought bottled water. The rooms were nice, clean. The lighting switches can be confusing. Like most Vegas hotels, the hotel itself is just too big. It was a 1:20 walk from the elevator to our room. We got 7K steps each day just going to and from the lobby every day. The two restaurants we went to were great. The service at the Collins bar is wonderful. The gym is the nicest hotel gym I've ever used; it has everything.

allReviews.title: Convenient and Fun
allReviews.text: Comfortable rooms.  Wonderful tower views.  Modernized outlets and sufficient outlets.  Closer to both the downtown area and the strip.  There are lots of events and dining places that make this place a convenient location if you don't want to venture out to the downtown area.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleu Las Vegas is my new favorite destination in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The reom was beautifully decorated and very spacious. The bed was so comfortable and cozy. The bathroom included an amazing shower and soakng tub, and the towels were so soft! The staff from checkin, bell service, concierge, valet and housekeeping strived to meet my every need.

allReviews.title: Second visit was as good as the first.
allReviews.text: This was our second visit to the FOUNTAIN BLUE (as they all seem to pronounce it) ;)It did not disappoint.  The staff is fantastic (shout out to "Jay" (sp?) at check in.  Wide hallways, super clean, beautiful rooms, if slightly less "lux" than the Wynn.  Love this place.We ate at MOTHER WOLF, LA FOUNTAINE (incredible breakfast), WASHING POTATO, KOMODO, and on or last visit, DON'S PRIME.  All of them were sincerely outstanding.  I don't throw these words around loosely, I panned my last visit to an upscale Gordon Ramsey restaurant in London - it sucked HARD.Anyway, the Fontainebleau is first class, it's right up there with the Wynn for top choice in LV.  If you're on the fence - GO.

allReviews.title: Best of the Best Place to Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas is out of this world fabulous.  Parking is easy. The lobby is full of fresh floral arrangements. The chandeliers are breath taking. We enjoyed a wonderful concert in the comfortable theater. The food was good and a nice variety is offered.  The casino is clean and the staff is attentive. Our room offered a terrific view.  Beds are so amazing and the lighting in our room was perfect.  Amazing hotel!

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. Extremely clean. Restaraunts were amazing. No riffraff. Easy check in.  Very polite staff. The food is amazing. Pappi steak was just great!  Baked clams were to die for. Wagyu strip steak was on point. Service was amazing.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Newer Hotel
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a girls' trip. The hotel and rooms are beautiful and a good value! You can tell it's a newer hotel. Loved the bathroom and robes! The staff were great and went out of their way to make things right. My server forgot to put my lunch order in at the pool, an hour later when I asked about it, she was very apologetic and didn't charge me for my food. The shade umbrella on a chair we rented was broken, so they heavily discounted it. These things happen. We did request adjoining rooms, but upon check-in, they said they couldn't accommodate it, but when we went to the rooms, the adjoining room was almost done with housekeeping.  Better communication would have been better as they still wouldn't let us change rooms so we could be together. Keep in mind that you will need an Uber to go anywhere on the strip. This added up fast. Also give yourself a lot of time! The walk to the car pick up is far, the lines are long, and it takes a really long time for the driver to get out of the hotel, though the lights and onto the main drive. We were really late to our dinner reservations. We would not recommend the spa. We booked massages at the spa for around 315. We showed up at 2, so we would have time to enjoy the rooms and saunas, but it took over 45 minutes to check in. We had dinner reservations, so we could not stay afterward. They left us sitting forever in the main lobby because they were "understaffed," so we didn't get to enjoy the rest of the spa. The massages were over $500 each, so you would expect more. The place was bright and not really warm and relaxing once we did get to go inside. The sushi place in the hotel was wonderful!

allReviews.title: FONTAINEBLEAU is the TOP Hotel on the Strip!
allReviews.text: FB continues to exceed and anticipate your every wish.  Without a doubt, this is now the new Luxury Property on the strip.  I can not say enough good things about this property, the staff, the spa, or our gaming experience. We can not wait to return.  FONTAINEBLEAU is the TOP Hotel on the Strip!

allReviews.title: Good, but VERY expensive if you eat or drink there.
allReviews.text: Very new hotel, and located next to the LV Convention Center.Room was great, Elevators can be slow, and personnel are very friendly.Very clean and friendly, in general.  Maintained very well.  VERY EXPENSIVE compared to alternatives.  I am considering staying at the Conrad next time.  Very comparable ammenities, more dining venues, and lower pricing in general.  Spa was $180 for four hours use of the spa - not included in the room rate.Restaurants averaged over $120 per person, and that was only with one drink.  Exceptionally expensive.If money is not important, then this is the place for you.  If you want a luxury hotel that is a fair value, the rooms meet this criteria, but everywhere that you go in that complex is going to reach into your pocket and not let go.

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel with caveats
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. I enjoyed the quiet of the casino floor. It wasn't blasting in your face. The restaurants are fantastic. The conference center was excellent - probably the best in Las Vegas. My issues came with the hotel side. I am 6'4" and I had requested a king room at reservation (a month before) due to the need for the longer length so my feet wouldn't stick off the bed. When I went to check-in, the hotel hadn't reserved a king room for me, nor did they have one to give me for at least two of the nights of the 4 I would be staying with them. Honestly, the rooms are beautiful and if their checkin/reservation systems were fixed, this would be a 5 star place.

allReviews.title: Fitness Centre needs a rethink
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel but the Fitness Centre has serious safety issues.  I was injured twice in the same week using their gym due to the actions of other gym patrons.  The spacing of equipment stations is too close together, which can result in a misuse of equipment causing injury to others.  They also have two spinning tower racks of dumbbells, and I was injured by these when someone spun the rack while I was putting away a 70lb dumbbell, breaking my toe.  The Fitness centre needs a serious rethink to remove some cardio stations and give more room to weightlifting equipment, the spinning dumbebell racks need to be replaced by a regular style with all weights in a row at waist level.

allReviews.title: First time and won't be our last
