allReviews.text: This is the first time staying here. We came to see Heart in concert and loved it. The hotel was pristine and beautiful. Check in was easy and they were very nice during that process. The room was fantastic and gorgeous. The bed was very comfortable and the views were amazing. We had a view of the strip which includes the sphere. The hotel wasn't super busy which was great because it wasn't crowded. The restaurants at the promenade weren't busy at all and the food at Capon and the begal were so good. We ate dinner one night at the Tavern which offered really good pub/sportbar food. The casino was fun and we walked away winners. And the music played at the hotel was awesome... 70s and 80s. We would totally stay here again!!!!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas… ok but lacks charm
allReviews.text: This hotel is massive and although very clean and new, it lacks the charm of most of the other hotels in Vegas, especially when its closest neighbour (Wynne) has so much charm. The restaurants are trying to be high end but the prices are very high for the food quality that we were served. We ate at Vida, Komodo, Cafe Cuto, and several outlets at the food court. We actually had a bad experience at both the Taco outlet (upset tummies) and the Sandwich concession (Nona’s) who took so long to prep our sandwiches that we nearly missed our check out time on the last day. No complaints re the bars or casino. We saw “Heart” live in concert at Bleu Live Theatre. We booked these tickets in advance from the UK and again feel we were overcharged for a very short gig (compared to Uk gigs which we attend often). Rooms are spacious and beds are comfy but no tea/coffee in rooms. No bath tub in our room also a little disappointing. Service generally ok but again just not quite slick enough compared to the many other high end hotels we have stayed in. Took ages to get drinks served at the poolside. They are definitely missing a truck here as so many people would have spent much more on drinks had they been able to find a server (1 attendant for hundreds of people).

allReviews.title: It’s meh
allReviews.text: Need coffee machine in room.  Main entrance was closed when I arrived so had to drag luggage from southern entrance to check in, not fun.  In room catering food was okay but arrived late for a client meeting.  Don prime was over rated.  Food court was pretty good.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel In Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The best hotel in las vegas. Everything was beautiful and lovely from the moment you walk in the lobby. Casino floor is very spacious not too much cigarette smoke, lots of machines to win and a very nice bar on casino floor. The rooms were amazing, i love how they had floor to ceiling windows and also how from the moment we open the door to our room the windows shades and curtains automatically open up for you to see the view. The spa is the best in vegas wonderful but it was a headache to get in since it was always booked and we didnt have reservations ahead of arriving at the hotel so make sure if you want to pamper yourself with the spa make reservations and book your massages section at least 2 weeks before your arrival if not just get a day pass.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleu was Amazing
allReviews.text: I had an amazing stay at Fontainebleau! The rooms were really nice, with a stylish and comfortable ambiance. The beds were incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep. One of my favorite features was the oversized sink in the bathroom—it added such a touch of luxury and convenience. From check-in to check-out, everything exceeded my expectations. I can’t wait to return!

allReviews.title: Amazing Las Vegas destination
allReviews.text: Must see and experience Las Vegas destination.  Absolutely gorgeous spaces, rooms, spa, etc.  From your first step into the lobby you know you have arrived at a very special place.  It's my go to look forward Las Vegas location, can only imagine how great it will continue to develop as the North end of the strip makes additional investments and places of interest.  Urging all to visit and experience excellence at the Fontainebleau!

allReviews.title: Not just a hotel, but an experience.
allReviews.text: The beds were as comfortable as home, rooms are spacious, the staff is welcoming, friendly and informative.  We ate at Komodo, which was one of the best dinners we've had.  Their venue is intimate and beautiful.  The hotel is definitely an exquisite experience.

allReviews.title: Fontain-Fabulous
allReviews.text: What a beautiful hotel!! We had amazing Valentine’s Day celebration!  We arrived and were greeted with warm welcomes and smiling faces!! Since we used Amex platinum we were invited to the poodle room, which is absolutely breathtaking!!!  We then had the most amazing experience at ITO where we had access to a private bar and an intimate omakase overlooking the amazing Vegas lights!!  We had spa treatments at the Lapis spa which was again amazing, my only recommendation is to make sure you bring swim suits as you can not enjoy the entire experience without them!!  We then went to the Colin’s bar which again was lovely, and then Papi steakhouse a lively great show starter!!  I look forward to returning in the summer to enjoy the pool vibe as again it looks amazing!!!

allReviews.title: Ridiculous high prices for drinks and food, but very nice hotel and casino
allReviews.text: The hotel is very good. The casino does a nice job of mitigating the smoker's smoke from being over powering. I would rate FountainBleau higher, but the prices at the restaurants and bars are just stupidly high, even by Vegas standards. If they would drop the food and bar prices, it would easily the best hotel / casino on the Strip, but at this time, it's just a money grab.

allReviews.title: If the staff pronounce it Fountain Blue, then its Fountain Blue
allReviews.text: We liked the hotel overall.  However, there were a few issues.  First, we specifically asked for a quiet room and instead our room was very loud and we could clearly hear our neighbors next door as if they were in the room with us.  Upon checking out, we were able to speak with the same employee that checked us in and told her we requested a quiet room but instead it was actually quite loud. She told us we should have asked for a room that could not be adjoined rather than asking for a quiet room. This was a rude response and we have never had this experience during any of our several stays in Vegas. This did not give us a good feeling about staying at this resort again for our next Vegas vacation.  Also, we booked a Gold King Strip Best View room thinking it had a deep soaking tub. Since it did not, we switched at check-in to a queen room and were told we would be on a higher floor and other than losing the king bed, we were not downgrading.  This was not the case. Despite being on a higher floor, we had a mountain view and not the strip view or room size we paid for. This definitely took away from a post Valentine's Day romantic getaway and felt like we didn't get our money's worth. We also paid for late check-out however Housekeeping was not informed and came by our room twice on our last day. The restaurants and bars we visited were amazing however, there were some places that we would have loved to try but seemed they were always closed.  Azul Bar in the lobby was never open past 11p during our stay. We made attempts to visit 2x nights in a row and they had just closed both times. This was disappointing as we specifically researched this bar and made a plan to visit while on our trip.  This was also the case with Vida, which had just closed when we visited on our last day in town.  Bar Ito did not have similar hours to other restaurants in the Promenade so we were not able to try them either.  Please bring back the crepes at Chez Bon Bon or at least to another restaurant onsite.  Having crepes during our Vegas vacation is a tradition we were not able to enjoy this time because there was no where on property to get one and we did not have the time to go all the way to Paris. Having some of the same options as other resorts further down strip may attract more customers to the area instead of only Vegas veterans like us that don't need to be center strip. The $25 for 2025 casino reward was also hard to use.  We wasted a lot of time trying to find a machine that would except the free credits which became more annoying than anything. We enjoyed Lapis Spa but wished it wasn't so busy on a Monday afternoon.  Our experience could have been better if some of the coed sauna rooms were a little bigger and if there were signs encouraging guests to be quiet. Also wish that there were more allergy free options at the restaurants onsite.  If there was at least one meal at every restaurant that was both vegetarian and gluten free, we would have never left the property.  We did not visit Don's Prime or Papi Steak because they were not able to accommodate these dietary restrictions. The only pool that was open was crowded and I'm glad we didn't waste time going to the pool since we likely would not have enjoyed it.  Please consider opening one of the larger pools on busy days or at least not obstruct the view to the larger, prettier pools in order to tempt customers like us to return during normal pool season. On a positive note, we loved the staff and our experiences at No Where Lounge, Roadside Taco, Nona's, La Fontaine, and Miami Slice.  We would have went to No Where Lounge 3x nights in a row instead of just 2x if they were open later.  Even the Bell Desk and Security staffs were excellent and each experience made us like the property even more.  Not sure if we would book another stay at this resort given the problems with the room, but we may stop by one of the restaurants/bars or to visit the beautiful property if back on that end of the strip.

allReviews.title: Anniversary getaway
allReviews.text: This was the most beautiful and comfortable stay we have had in our 15 years of traveling to Vegas!  Loved our 19th floor room with strip view. Casino is well laid out with lots of VP and slot options. Great place staffed by great people!  We look forward to coming back soon!

allReviews.title: Stunning
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, never too crowded, great food hall with the most delicious everything bagel I've ever indulged in (2 days in a row).  Great casino with the best rewards program we found during our stay.  Great customer service, very clean, fresh and new.

allReviews.title: Not recommended!
allReviews.text: Well the stay was supposed to be a family celebration of my 70th birthday and our 40th Anniversary. When I called ahead to check parking I was told that the van was too high and we would have to use the valet to park at the hotel next door. When we arrived the valet said parking was not available and my son had to find parking elsewhere, which he found at Circus-Circus. No ride was offered.. At the front desk we were assigned to RM 847 and our party of 5 went to the room for a short celebration. The key would not open the door, so I called the front desk, and was told that there was likely a bad battery on the door and someone would be sent. No one came. Twenty minutes later I called again, and again was told that someone would be sent. No one came. Ten minutes later I walked back down to the front desk to try in person. Meanwhile a staff member came to let the group in with his pass key, which (for the reason we had already discussed with the front desk) would not work . Then we waited for maintenance, who tried to jimmy the door but was unsuccessful.  Now, an hour later, our dinner reservations were lost, we are still sitting on the floor in the hallway. Our luggage could not be delivered because we did not have a room. I then made ANOTHER trip to the front desk to be offered a similar room (1047).   We had to lug all the luggage ourselves two floors up. All the front desk was willing to do to compensate was $100 in room credits (about 4 drinks). Because of the hour we were forced to eat burritos and fast food and a drink each at the hotel. That was about $260, and the front desk would not even allow that amount to be comped. Finally, to add insult to injury, the manager would not allow us a shuttle to get us to our vehicle, telling us to call Uber! So we had to carry all our luggage through traffic back to Circus-Circus. I have traveled all over the world, and the service offered by Fontaine Blue was the worst I have experienced

allReviews.title: Loving Fountainebeau!
allReviews.text: We went to experience the new kid in town and we weren't disappointed.  The rooms were beautiful and super clean. Bedding plush, towels fluffy and very nice toiletries.The casino was laid out so logically that we didn't get lost even though it was huge.  It had retail nearby to take a break and shop. Food courts, restaurants and theaters were on the second floor easily reachable by escalators scattered around the casino.We ate at Komodo.  Very pretty, great food and fast service.Located at the end of the strip was not a problem either. We took a quick cab ride to a more central location and cabbed back.  If going to a meeting or convention, it is right next to the LV Convention center.It was still too cold to lounge by the pool but there were several.  I will come back and lounge by the pools next visit.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay, everything was excellent from the amenities to customer service. The facility is just marvelous, clean, elegant and top notch. Next time I ll go back to Vegas, I will definitely stay there again. New favorite hotel.

allReviews.title: An experience for the senses!
allReviews.text: From the moment the doors open to the moment you leave, FoutainBleu is filled with the scent of fresh roses, hospitable staff, sparkling floors, and attention to detail throughout the property. The staff were always smiling and willing to assist as needed, the restaurants and bars were exceptional, and the rooms are fantastic.

allReviews.title: Great new hotel
allReviews.text: Wonderful service, dining, beautiful views. We went for Keith Urban concert and Valentine's Day weekend. We enjoyed Mother Wolf, Washing Potato, The Tavern and Collins Bar. All great food and service. The facility is top notch, very clean, all team members are ver courteous and professional.

allReviews.title: Deluded
allReviews.text: Quite frankly I have little positive to say about this hotel. I totally fell for the marketing on their website and so arrived with expectations for a luxury resort offering a comfortable stay a great nights sleep. Unfortunately, I left feeling really disappointed.First of all the location. This hotel is in what seems to be Vegas’ seedier side surrounded almost completely by low end properties, boarded up shops and dispensaries. Stepping inside the entrance first impression is strong with a huge lobby. As is often the case with vegas properties there were ridiculously long queues to check in and we wanted over an hour to check in due in large part to the disinterest and glacial pace of the staff.After having checked in I went to my room only to discover it wasn’t the room I had booked. On calling down to the front desk I was told there was nothing they could do on the phone and I would have to come down to reception again and yes queue again. This was exactly what I wanted after nearly 24 hours of travelling. Luckily it was only a 30 minute queue this time but no change in the disinterest and rude nature of the staff. The member of staff admitted that they had actually tried to fob me off with an inferior category room without informing me.Finally with the right room I explored the hotel and casino and found this to be completely fine but certainly again not worthy of the luxury and high end promises. The restaurant selection seemed reasonable but I didn’t try any with the exception of the patisserie.The room was actually relatively nice being of a large size with a very comfortable bed and a bathroom containing an oversized bathtub and separate shower. Cleanliness seemed to hit and miss with visible dust and dirt and stains on the carpet and also an over perfumed air freshener sprayed in excess.The biggest frustration with the room was with the automatic drapes and curtains which had a mind of their own and would suddenly close without any instruction. They would also close any time you left the room meaning that on return you had a multiple click effort to get natural light into the room.Outside the room the winter pool was nice and the gym was also niceOn departure day I had booked and paid for late check out and had this confirmed. Of course my keys stopped working at 10am and so I had to queue yet again only to be berated for not letting them know I actually needed access to my room for longer as part of my late check out.

allReviews.title: Take me back to the Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: If you are looking for the quintessential high-end Las Vegas experience than the Fontainebleau is for you. Exceptional cocktails, cuisine, and experiences from an amazing concert venue to the most relaxing spa I’ve ever been to and worth ever cent.  I honestly never want to leave!!

allReviews.title: 5 star property but 1 star service
allReviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing and large hotel, we enjoyed our first few days but unfortunately personal items were removed from our room when we were at the pool area (nb no bar servixe at the pool area despite it being busy with guests). Poor response from management thereafter.  Wouldn't recommend this place but if you are staying here, put your belongings in the safe although it is small. The Wynn Encore is a superior resort and more central to the strip.

allReviews.title: Best hotel
allReviews.text: One of the best hotels I've stayed at. Great staff that is very cheerful and attentive. Zero complaints. Don's Steakhouse was amazing - you must try the Tomahawk STEAK! Everything was exceptionally cleaned, fresh, and updated. You will not be disappointed.

allReviews.title: #AmazingPlace
allReviews.text: Hello All, we want to tell you All that if You come to Vegas for an amazing time. Stay here if You can . We know it might be a little bit pricey but it’s well worth every dollar! From the property to the staff. It is by far top 3 properties on the strip. We come to Vegas 3 times a year and We stay at Venetian/Palazzo, Wynn/Encore and now Fountainbleau. We have stayed at other properties in the past but We found these 3 properties to be the best of best.

allReviews.title: Theft from hotel room
allReviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing and large hotel, we enjoyed our first few days but then had a theft of personal items from our room. Provided a statement to security but we've heard nothing further following our departure, despite a promise to update us. No apology or reimbursement. Have since learned that theft by staff is not a one off at this property. Either they need to vet housekeeping staff better or improve surveillance and security.  If you are staying here put your belongings in the safe although it is small.

allReviews.title: Strong perfume smell may cause problems.
allReviews.text: Unfortunately, the perfume that is pumped into the lobby and common areas caused a severe allergic reaction for my fiance.  We left on our 4th day of a 5 night stay because he was in such discomfort.  The hotel should provide a notification of the smell as many people are sensitive - hence why many workplaces and healthcare facilities have "no scent" policies.   Also, if you want to enjoy a morning coffee in your room, bring your own coffee maker.  Otherwise your options are getting dressed and going to the cafe for a $7 drip coffee or spending close to $45 to have a one litre carafe delivered to your room.

allReviews.title: Great Service
allReviews.text: This is a Beautiful resort.  All the staff go out of their way to provide amazing service. The spa is the best in the strip.  Every food option is top quality.  The drinks are the best on the strip.  As this resort grows and becomes more popular will be hard to beat

allReviews.title: Great trip but more costly than expected
allReviews.text: Hotel rooms are the best! They are clean and refreshing. The water pressure is 10/10! Food is expensive but quite tasty. Better than your average. Down sides-table games are always $25+parking isn't free unless you're staying there. Rooms are also pretty pricey and they dont offer much comps. Overall the experience was great but it was a pricey adventure. If you can get their deals when they have them, it will balance out and take a little weight off. Not much but some.

allReviews.title: Superb Experience at Fontainebleau.  Best time ever!  I'd highly recommend it to anyone!
allReviews.text: Great hotel stay.  Concierge staff were helpful in getting my transportation reserved from the airport to the hotel and return.  The checkin process was fast and easy.  The restaurants were great.  The Mother Wolf and the Washing Potato resturants proved excellent service and good food.  The Nowhere Lounge provides live music and the server proves great service. The pastries and the coffee are excellent in the morning at the Nowhere Lounge.  The Fitness provides multiple workout machines and free weights.  Enjoyed my workouts.  The Tavern provides good food and friendly service. The hotel theater provides some great concerts.  I saw Duran Duran in December and Tears for Fears in February.  They were excellent shows.  Overall, I had a superb experience at the Fontainebleau.  I would highly recommend it to anyone.  Robert

allReviews.title: Was wishing for WOW but got Meh!!!
allReviews.text: The hotel is drop dead gorgeous. The service is subpar and the answer to most requests to make a stay epic is “NO” So many fees for everything under the sun. It was an hour wait at the bagel place for a quick take away bite. We got there a little late in a Friday nite but when we went to get a bite to eat there were no descent sit down restaurants open past 10:00pm, in Vegas on a Friday on a long weekend?!?! Weird. The saving grace was our epic dinner at Mother Wolf. One of the best dining experiences we’ve had. It was my husbands 50th birthday and that meal with their impeccable service saved the trip. For as opulent as this hotel is, they need to do better in the service dept for sure.

allReviews.title: Vegas trip
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, rooms and spa.I was too far from everything tho.The spa was fantastic.Main reason we stayed there was for the coed spa area.Food promenade was good didn't get to any of the resturants other then a cute little cage with amazing service...Jesse and an apple braid

allReviews.title: Fleur-de-Lis Executive Suite
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience at Fontainebleau, stayed at Fleur-de-Lis Executive Suite, great decor, comfortable, and excellent butler services.  Worthy alternative to Wynn Tower Suite Salon, in fact cost less, better services & amenities.  Suites has VIP check-in area and private entrance/exit & elevators.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and comfortable, but lacking
allReviews.text: FountainFountainebleau is a beautiful and nicely appointed resort that features most of the amenities we have come to expect from a property of this caliber. That said, there are some gaps in the guest experience. There’s no faulting the design, amenities, or service. However, the property is still not fully realized and has large unused sections throughout. The casino is small compared to the competition on the strip. The shopping is lacking with only a few very high end options. There are no guest shops with needed sundries. The rooms, while beautiful and comfortable with lots of high end features, are missing the details and creature comforts that make for a more pleasant and enjoyable stay (no iron, coffee, or bathroom sundries). And the location, which makes for a relatively quiet and less crowded experience, can also be a bit isolating. Basically, everything is nicely executed and top notch, but there’s very little depth, the details are missing, and there’s no extra conveniences for guests.It’s also worth mentioning that Fountainebleau is expensive. Everything costs more, and not just little, but a lot. Which isn't unexpected. This is a five star property in Las Vegas after all. However, what I find frustrating isn't the high price, but when these prices don't translate into superior service, execution, or experience. They're charging more because they can and that's just price gouging. At the very least, I want to feel like I’m getting something more for the extra cost, and we just didn’t.In the end, we enjoyed our stay, but I don’t think I’d go back. Beautiful and pleasant as it is, there just isn’t enough value in staying here.

allReviews.title: Las vegas hotel
allReviews.text: Goid beds, good casino, good people, stay away from room service . We enjoyed our stay here. The view was amazing.   We like it allot we will come back.   Valet was perfect. Flower smell was good. People seems to want to help us. All I got to say.  They want more, blah blah

allReviews.title: Great room
allReviews.text: Our room was very spacious, clean and modern. One of the best room we have stayed in in Vegas.  Only thing I did not like about my stay at Foutainebleau was that the entire resort was so warm temperature wise.  Even the dealers were complaining about how hot it was.

allReviews.title: First visit and will be returning!
allReviews.text: The place is new and still working through some things and the place is nice, clean and classy. The front entry is clean and crisp, the car drop off in the front needs more logistics for smoother drop off and pick up. The room was very nice, the beds are super comfortable, nice bedding and bathroom was very elegant. Consider changing the shampoo/conditioner bottles as the it is very hard to get the product out of the bottles, especially thr conditioner.

allReviews.title: HIGH in Vegas
allReviews.text: We spent a fabulous Valentine's Day weekend at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas!  Our room was spacious, clean, comfortable and bright.  We enjoyed delicious food, awesome entertainment (especially at the No Where lounge), the friendly staff, and we took full advantage of the amazing Fitness Center and gym.  We saw Keith Urban in concert Friday night (at the wonderful hotel theater).  The performance was incredible, as was our entire weekend!

allReviews.title: Not worth the money. Beautiful hotel but better cleaner rooms at Hiltons and mandalay Bay.
allReviews.text: Room not clean and dirty sheets 2 days as we were ready for bed. Bath had other peoples hair in it. Beautiful hotel not worth the money at all for the rooms and don’t touch anything it will cost you.  Regular coffee $7 a cup cheapest thing there. I’m happy to pay for good service and quality food. This is not the hotel ill stay at again

allReviews.title: If you want nicer hotel near the Convention Center, stay here, if not, save your money for the Wynn/Encore
allReviews.text: If you want nicer hotel near the Convention Center, stay here, if not, save your money for the Wynn/Encore

allReviews.title: Excellent Experience!
allReviews.text: Everything about my stay was great!  The fitness center was amazing - every piece of equipment imaginable with great views of outside on the cardio machine.  The food was drink was amazing.  Great Atmosphere.   The rooms were brand new, comfy beds, and very spacious.  We will be back!

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is the best casino/hotel in LV.  It is not only beautiful, but every single staff there is wonderful, helpful and a joy to be around.  The restaurants, especially Komodo are amazing.  The rooms are wonderful, great workout area and cafe's. Beautiful view from any room!!  We loved it!

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: My stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas was absolutely incredible! The rooms were luxurious, the service was top-notch, and the atmosphere was unbeatable. From the stunning decor to the world-class dining and entertainment, every detail was perfect. Can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Excellent Bleau Live Theater Experience
allReviews.text: Visited the Fontainebleau to attend a Tears for Fears concert in their theater.  Excellent experience!  Pleasant, helpful staff.  Love the intimacy of the 3800-seat venue.  Seats were comfortable, not too close together.  Sound quality was outstanding!  Reminded me of the very old Aladdin Theatre for the Performing Arts experience: no nonsense, just enjoyable sightlines and sound quality for all seats.  Keep bringing shows here!

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: This is a gorgeous hotel that rivals or exceeds the Wynn properties. Plenty of reasonable food options. Great sportsbook and outstanding service. I like the fact that they had plenty of staff in all areas and that all were friendly and engaging. Felt like old customer service you used to get in Vegas. We used self park. It is nice that there are two exits on opposite sides of the property and two entrances to the south or north lobby. This would be a 5 easy if the pillow and the bed was more comfortable

allReviews.title: Shard Sheet Gate
allReviews.text: Living in Las Vegas we have plenty of options. Every 4 months my lady and I have a date night staycation. We stayed on 2/8, booked through Amex fine hotel and resorts. After a great evening of food, gambling and drinks we decided to call it night at 1AM. When pulling our bed coves open to sleep there was a large shard stain from what looks like the previous people covered with some napkins. Disgusting! Room service came to change sheets and three others ones they grabbed where dirty also. When checking out in the morning, we brought it to the managers attention. The only compensation given was $100 off our bill. I have been a manager in the hospitality industry for 14 years and understand how to ensure guests leave happy no matter what. The level of compensation for Shard sheet gate does not fit the crime. I would have expected to be compensated for our room that evening especially since the amount of $$$ spent on our evening.

allReviews.title: Love the Hotel, but as a guy with a wheelchair loved the accessible room
allReviews.text: I will keep this brief. The hotel is impeccably beautiful. I was particularly impressed with the room I selected, which featured a very nice roll-in shower bathroom. As someone with a disability, booking a room sight unseen can be quite daunting. One never knows if it will meet their needs without compromising on upscale quality.

allReviews.title: Feeling Bleau when I have to Leave
allReviews.text: Second time at the Fontaine! I wouldn't stay anywhere else on the Strip. I love this place. Modern and Bright atmosphere, friendly staff, comfortable room, excellent bars + dining and beautiful spa. I visit Vegas just to have a weekend at this Resort. See you next trip.

allReviews.title: Fontainbleau...your new destination in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful hotel!  Staff was very friendly and accommodating, my room was fancy and super clean, and the vibe was very "inviting", I think, because of the large spaces and high ceilings.  Plus the bar in the center of the casino floor is amazing.

allReviews.title: Finally a Hotel in the U.S. that can hold its own with the 5 stars overseas
allReviews.text: Wow!  What an incredible experience.  Fontainebleau achieves the impossible by being even more beautiful in person than online.  The customer service is exceptional and doesn’t miss from the front desk to valet and everyone in between.  5 stars all the way around! We will be back time and again.

allReviews.title: luxury defines fountainbleau
allReviews.text: i had the most relaxing and enjoyable stay at the luxurious foutainbleau.  the ambiance, the numerous slot machine, nice room accomodations and friendly staff contributed to the overall positive experience.   i also recognize the excellent filtration system which removes smoke.   i will definitely come back soon

allReviews.title: Amazing Experience
allReviews.text: OMG the absolutely best experience in my traveling life. What made it special was not the smells, beauty, cleanliness, and experiences, but the amazing and friendly staff and customer service.  It’s so beautiful and we were made to feel like Royalty!  SAVE FOR A STAY here!!! Totally worth it!!!

allReviews.title: 10/10 would NOT recommend
allReviews.text: The check in process was a nightmare.  Be prepared to wait in line for nearly 2 hours if you are attending a business meeting there. You will not receive the room you requested, and the room you get is likely to be dirty. I found hair and tissues on and in my bed. The water pressure is poor and the water is COLD no matter what time of day you shower. If you like a relaxing spa experience, I would NOT recommend the Lapis Spa. I had the worst experience of my life here. The massage therapist, Pedro, made inappropriate comments about my neck and how I have a horrible hump there for my age. He did not give me the massage I requested, and I felt so uncomfortable with him the entire time I was there. I did receive my money back for the massage which is why I didn't give this place 0/5.  But, why would you waste your time with such a horrible experience with so many nice places on the Strip?

allReviews.title: The best experience in Vegas so far
allReviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Fontainebleau in Vegas! The property is new, modern, and beautifully furnished. Unlike many other casinos, there was no noticeable smell of cigarettes, even in the gaming areas, which was a huge plus. Every employee we interacted with was well-trained, professional, and courteous, making our experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Great hotel, typical of Vegas.
allReviews.text: The.hotel is amazing. The perfect standard room in size, the wonderful bed, the amazing bathroom in both size and distribution.  She feels sorry for a closet of consistent size with the room or a walkinn closet as the one she has is very small.The bad thing, the distance to the center of the strip makes its location a little awkward and forces you to use Uber for everything.

allReviews.title: Elegance and attention to detail
allReviews.text: The level of detail and elegance at the property is impressive, it it’s a much more exclusive feel than the rest of the strip. Our favorite spot at the hotel was listening to the piano at Collins. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for a more refined Vegas experience.

allReviews.title: A place to remember and return
allReviews.text: Where can I start. This place was so amazing. The atmosphere was so relaxing and calm and the staff I’ve never encountered a staff that was so friendly, every single person had a smile and  was happy to help. Always offering to go out of their way anytime.The food we had for in-room dining was most delicious plus an incredible meal presentation I think I’ve ever had and I travel quite a bit with my wife at high-end resorts.This is the only place I’m going to go to when I return to Las Vegas.Also my wife took snapshots of the tags on the sheets on the bed because they’re so comfortable and the bed itself wow she said she’s never slept better her whole life and she has back pain every single morning she wakes up.

allReviews.title: A very nice hotel
allReviews.text: We chose to stay at  Fontaineblue because the concert we went to see was at the hotel making just easier to leave the concert and go back to room. Our room was very clean and high tech, buttons to turn on all lights and open/close the curtains. No sticks to pull or dirty curtains. We took an upgrade and ended up with a suite with a great view of the Sphere and two bathrooms and separate bedroom. Being during the week it was quiet which is always nice. As much as we loved the room the food on the Promenade was not great. We ate at Roadside Tacos and the food was bland, the nacho cheese was lumpy and tasted like it was made from a powder. Not enjoyable. We did breakfast at the Bagel Bet and were much happier. Food was fresh and hot. Overall we really liked the hotel. The casino was not overly busy but that could be because it was midweek. We drove to Vegas from AZ and it was easy to get to the hotel without too much traffic. I would definitely stay there again mainly for the room.

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing restaurants, casino, and amenities. Everything is to the absolute highest standard! Although it is at the end of the Vegas Strip it is easily walkable! Would absolutely recommend to stay here on your next trip to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Gran Hotel. Highly recommended.
allReviews.text: We went to Vegas to go to the Tears for Fears concert and it was convenient to stay at the same hotel where the show was taking place. Great decision! Great hotel. The automated rooms. Spacious without being ridiculously large. Comfortable well lit (although the view did not favor us). Outstanding cleanliness and services. It was low season and there were few people. But the ceilings are so high the light colors and well lit that it gives you a different feel to the hotels and casinos in the area. We would stay there without thinking!

allReviews.title: 5 Star experience and felt like a VIP
allReviews.text: Loved everything about the clean and spacious property.  Hotel room was very nice and convenient.  Easy and comfortable with electronics in room.  Loved the three restaurants we ate at.  Komodo, Vida and Tavern.  Great food and superb service.

allReviews.title: Great, Quieter option in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Fontainbleu is a lovely newer hotel in Vegas that is a bit off the beaten path from the craziness of the main Strip.  Our room was a very good size, beds were comfortable, dining options were great.  We stayed here because we were attending a concert in their theatre and had a great time. Not huge gamblers but the casino seemed fine.

allReviews.title: Amazing new Vegas property MUST TRY
allReviews.text: Beautifully clean place to visit when in Vegas. Being brand new you can still smell the freshness. Plenty of different level rooms to choose from and the pool area is amazing. Lots of offers around to try yourself. Location isnt the best but its not as bad as it once was.

allReviews.title: Terrific hotel off the Main Strip Area-Great View of the Sphere
allReviews.text: We booked the "strip view" room (stack 37) and forget the strip--it is a PERFECT view of the Sphere!  Room is huge, comfortable and beautifully decorated. Auto drapes did not work on one control, but did on the others.The lobby is huge with some great art, particularly the "wave" sculpture.  But it seems a little sterile.  Self parking is easy, plentiful and included in the resort fee.This is a great location to access events at the Smith Center--easy 10 minute drive on back streets.Also easy to access great restaurants just outside. Ate at Mother Wulf and it was terrific.

allReviews.title: Vegas has more options
allReviews.text: The rooms are small for waht you pay for , I was gambling at night and did not see any waitress so I had to walk to the bar and buy a drink the bartender didn't care , the next morning I got a players card horrible comp system I guess you don't want people coming back

allReviews.title: Bad experience and broken promises
allReviews.text: This trip was to celebrate a friends birthday.  He arranged it with a host, Mike W.   The agreement with the host was that 4 nights would be comped for everyone, and drinks and food would be compensated base upon individual play.Upon arrival, some of our reservations hadn't been made.   One being mine.  From there on there was confusion within the hotel.  Long story short, some guys did not get their rooms comped as promissed.   I was comped for only three of the four nights.  And we found out that our host, Mike W. was terminated prior to our arrival.

allReviews.title: Great stay for a concert!
allReviews.text: Stayed here to see Tears for Fears and was very impressed with the Fontainebleau!  The rooms were nice (comfortable bedding), great bathroom with powerful shower and deep bathtub.  NoWhere was a great lounge after the concert - had a couple of drinks that were covered by our “food and drink” credit (book the room through their website to get best deals and credits).  Also, sign up for the Rewards Card if you plan to gamble - but also use it when you buy meals and drinks.

allReviews.title: Shiny and calm
allReviews.text: Shiny and new and calm. It’s big enough to handle the crowds and not feel crowded. Very high ceilings on the first floor with two cool sculptures (one interactive). Our stay started off nicely with a friendly check-in (thanks, Estevan), and our room being available so early!  Woohoo!  After walking through other hotels during our trip, it was really nice to come back to the Fountainebleau. The pool and most restaurants are tucked away on the 2nd and 3rd floors. Housekeeping brought us a microwave (who knew?) as there’s no coffee pot in the room; we had brought tea bags. Enjoy a stay here!

allReviews.title: Great getaway from CA. Taxes
allReviews.text: The Fontaineblue looks very luxurious, clean, wonderful decor. The service was second to none, and for for the promenade ambiance is just fresh, spacious and lots to offer. Next time I’ll try the Prime restaurant. The location is also great because it’s close to other wonderful casinos, The Trump tower, the Mall. Parking is also very accessible with close parking to the facility.

allReviews.title: Unforgettable BDay Trip
allReviews.text: I’ve lived in Las Vegas over 28 years and my wife and I completely enjoyed every minute we spent at Fontainebleau this past weekend. The staff was engaging at every return, my wife commented the shower had the best pressure ever… Mother wolf is not to be missed!

allReviews.title: My second visit to Fountainebleau in the last 6 months!
allReviews.text: The hotel is well designed. Immaculately clean and all areas except for the casino is smoke free.. even the casino area seems to be well ventilated.  All staff memebers I encountered were courteous and professional.   I saw the Tears for Fears concert, not really a bad seat in the house! Food court was great!

allReviews.title: Sensationnel
allReviews.text: This is the best of the best hôtel ever, the staff, the atmosphere, the food, the great professionalism of the staff, the cleanliness of the rooms, the great diversity of slot machines, the security, advantages on membership cards rewards, wide variety of restaurants

allReviews.title: Some things to like about Blue
allReviews.text: The hotel is a little out of reach from most of the strip action.It's not as inviting as some other resorts because it has a colder conference center vib. But there are some pluses. The gym and fitness center is superb.The beds are really comfortable.The staff is very friendly.In the end I might stay again, but for the price there are better options.

allReviews.title: Must Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas two years in a row for our internal company meetings and I would definitely recommend to stay here again. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. Everyone from the wait staff to the managers were extremely catering to my needs during my stay. I had a 16 party team dinner at KYU and received several compliments on the food experience and a follow-up email from the manager to ask about my experience. The rooms are exceptionally clean and modern. I absolutely loved my stay and can't wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Our vehicle was stolen at the Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: Be careful staying at the Fontainebleau if you have a vehicle!  We stayed there for 7 nights and our vehicle was stolen from their parking garage on the second night. We had even parked right under a security camera. We are a rewards member and have stayed there numerous times since it opened.  I understand things happen but I was waiting to see if management would contact us while we were still there to see how they could help us.  Never happened. I had to call to speak to a manager in guest relations who said she would look into it and get back to me but never did. When we checked out, I spoke with a front desk supervisor and told him how upset I was that my vehicle was stolen and that I thought the right thing for the hotel to do is to comp us all or part of our stay. He assured me that I would most likely be compensated one way or another after it was investigated. I was afraid that once I paid the bill they would flush us afterwards which was exactly what happened when we received a form letter email saying they were sorry about our vehicle being stolen but there would be no compensation of any kind…not even 1 night free!  Las Vegas police found the vehicle abandoned the day before we left but it was not drivable and everything had been stolen from inside. We had to leave the vehicle in Vegas for insurance to deal with and rent a car to drive back home. You would think a classy hotel would try to help you out by covering part of your stay since we have so many other expenses now as a result of what happened there…but not Fontainebleau. We will never stay there again.  It’s too bad because we liked the hotel and the restaurants.  Terrible management and bad security!

allReviews.title: Bleau…
allReviews.text: One of the newest nicest and tallest hotels on the strip. I had a great room with a great view directly looking at the sphere. Not all of the restaurants are open yet, but what’s available currently is really good. I was on the company dime so I took advantage of that eating and drinking at the best restaurants and bars in the place. Great pool area and I actually liked the location a little further down the strip.

allReviews.title: No in-room coffee and disorganized service
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the rooms are well-appointed, but the lack of a coffee-maker in the room was a deal-breaker for us.   Also, some of the employees don’t seem to know what they’re doing.  When we checked in, the front desk clerk never mentioned that we had a $50 per day resort credit or address whether parking was included.  We also had no soap in our room, so we had to call housekeeping.  After the first night, they cleaned our room, but forgot to replace the hand towels & wash cloths.  These are minor issues, but I expect better service for a hotel of this caliber.

allReviews.title: Just go, if you want to an amazing time.
allReviews.text: OMG, I don't know why this property is not as recognized as the others down the strip.  The property is impeccable, the service from the team members is outstanding.  I mean, whenever I asked a team member where something was, they would escort you over to it, instead of just pointing and giving me a bunch of directions.  The choices for gaming is wonderful, and the hotel rooms are to die for.  It is a little further north of the main strip, but you will be glad you did.  I have stayed at almost all the resorts on the strip, and this is my all time favorite.

allReviews.title: Tremendous experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a very remarkable property. Decor is absolutely unique, bright and beautiful as well as comfortable. Very comfortable and clean room with great shower head water pressure. All food was delicious with quick, knowledgeable, and friendly service. Wife loved the spa. Casino was so fun - bright, clean, right mix of slots and table games. I can not imagine anyone not being very pleased with their entire experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Disorganized
allReviews.text: Tried sending a simple gift of champagne and charcuterie to a room. It has resulted in confusion, missing items, duplicate charges, and the run-around between depts even after escalating. They are so disorganized I wouldn’t trust them to do anything correctly

allReviews.title: Modern, luxurious and clean Las Vegas hotel
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas for one night at the end of April. Overall, we had a pleasant experience. The staff was extremely friendly and kind, and our room was very clean. We enjoyed the spacious and fully equipped gym, which offered every piece of exercise equipment imaginable. The hotel also featured a variety of excellent dining options, and every meal we had—from breakfast to dinner—was delicious, though on the expensive side, which is to be expected in Las Vegas.However, we did encounter a few issues during our stay. There was confusion among the hotel staff regarding the amenities at the guest pool; multiple staff members informed us there were no private showers, but we later found several near the guest pools in the restrooms. Given that the pool had only recently opened for guests, the hotel should ensure staff are fully aware of its amenities. Additionally, the spa seemed extremely overpriced, even compared to New York City and the Los Angeles metropolitan area where I live. The hotel is located at the far end of the Strip, making it less lively than some of the larger hotels and casinos, and it doesn’t offer as many casino options as other hotels in the area.Despite these drawbacks, we would consider staying here again.

allReviews.title: Did not dissapoint 🥰
allReviews.text: Booked our trip through Virgin as uk residents and got an excellent deal for this new hotel. I went to las vegas 16 years ago and always wanted to go back. I was nervous about booking this hotel as i had never heard of it and it seemed a bit further out (opposite circus circus) but I couldn't have been more thrilled..... it was perfect and the location for me personally was amazing....... I found the centre of the strip almost felt a bit too hectic and this hotel was slightly out the way of all the craziness but easily accessible on the duece bus or via a cab. The hotel was just incredible. Brand new. Beautiful room. Most fancy hotel and room I have ever stayed in infact. Stunning pool and hotel interior. I would stay again in a heart beat. Even the smell of this hotel as you walk in is just incredible. Lovely staff. Thank you fountainblue, one of the best trips ever......x

allReviews.title: When Luxury Slips: Mishaps and Missed Service at the Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau: where luxury meets limping. My spa day quickly turned into a slapstick skit when I slipped on a wet surface. I immediately plunged my foot into the cold plunge (self-medicated first aid at its finest) and waited for help. At first, I thought it was manageable—I could still walk—but then the comedy of errors began.I filled out an incident report and requested a wheelchair to get back to my room. Thirty minutes later, it finally arrived. I asked if I could keep it for my work lunch. “No,” they said, as if I was planning to steal their one and only wheelchair. Back in my room, I called again for a chair, waited another 20 minutes, only to be told I’d need to pay for it. Seriously? A rental fee for your own negligence?Frustrated, I decided to hobble my way to lunch with a colleague acting as a human crutch. Picture this: a business meeting featuring me, a swollen foot, and sheer humiliation. By lunchtime, walking wasn’t even an option anymore. I called a manager, who responded with all the warmth of a TSA agent at rush hour. “There’s a process,” she said, as if I had slipped on red tape instead of their wet floor.I explained I had tickets to The Sphere but couldn’t attend because of my new hobble life. She promised help, which apparently meant leaving me stranded at the hotel’s potato restaurant since 11 a.m. It’s now 3 p.m., and I’m still here, making lemon drop martinis my emotional support beverage. No assistance. No apologies. No discounts. Not even a comped spa treatment—the spa treatment where I had my literal downfall!Here’s the kicker: I’m here scouting venues for a technology conference my company is hosting. If this is how they treat me, I’d hate to see how they’d treat our customers. Needless to say, the Fontainebleau won’t be seeing us again. But hey, at least their lemon drop martinis are world-class. Too bad their service is not.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau is a Gem
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a gem of a property. The rooms are clean, well appointed and have very comfortable pillows and bed. An overall Beautiful resort with plenty of amenities and fantastic restaurants. I have stayed in over two dozen hotels in Las Vegas over the past 5 years and the Fontainebleau is tops in my books. I very rarely write reviews but I honestly think you need to consider this property next time you visit Las Vegas. 10/10

allReviews.title: Heavenly perfection!
allReviews.text: Every detail was striking and beautiful!  I will never think of Vegas in the same way again.  I was there for business, got in late and left early so desperately need to get back for my own personal enjoyment and experience all that the fontainebleau has to offer (which is a lot!)

allReviews.title: A Major Room Problem, With No Help from the Hotel
allReviews.text: TL DR: had a major problem with my room during my 1 night Fontainebleau stay 12/29. The front desk at checkout said a manager would "get back to me" about a refund, but I've heard nothing from them. I've NEVER asked for a room refund before, but this situation warrants it. I stayed for one night last month, 12/29, having booked through Amex Platinum's Fine Hotel and Resorts program.I really enjoyed the hotel; service was wonderful, beautiful space and great food.However, the room had a major problem, in that the lights wouldn't work. It's one of those fancy modern lighting systems, like at Wynn, where everything is controlled by a panel on the wall, labeled "all on," "all off," "low," "drapes open," etc.My room was apparently broken, because when we needed the lights on in the evening, they would stay on for a few minutes, then turn off. We'd have to continually turn them back on to get ready to go down for dinner. I called down to the front desk, but by the time the technician came up, I was in the middle of getting ready, and since the lights had been on for more than a few minutes, figured the problem was resolved, so sent him away so I could keep getting dressed and head down for dinner.However, he did say someone would take a look at the electronics outside the room and troubleshoot to fix the problem. I figured that would be it...Unfortunately, when we came back up around 10:30pm to head to bed (we needed to get up for a drive to Salt Lake City the next morning), the opposite problem happened: THE LIGHTS WOULDN'T STAY OFF.Trying to sleep, we'd have to continually turn the lights back off, but a minute or two later, they would pop back on.I called down to the front desk again (the agent had the temerity to suggest to me that I could "just sleep in" since Amex's FHR program includes late checkout), and they sent up a technician. So around 11:30pm or so, a technician came in and took a look, unscrewed a few lamp bulbs, but still couldn't get the lights to stay off.He was apologetic and said he'd escalate it and get another tech up right away, that night, so we could sleep. So I waited up another 45 minutes, but the next tech never came, and I finally just laid down and slept the best I could with the lights on.The next morning, I headed to the front desk. The agent was kind and said she could see the notes about the trouble in my account, and went to talk to someone higher up about the room refund I requested. She came back and said the manager would "get back to me" about a refund, and it would take 2-3 days. The only thing she was able to do was waive my resort fee for that night, which I appreciated. The manager has yet to get back to me.It's unfortunate, because otherwise I really enjoyed the hotel and thought the rest of the service was wonderful. I'm currently working with Amex concerning a refund.

allReviews.title: Extremely disappointing check-in experience
allReviews.text: The hotel has a strange check-in process whereby the front desk staff call a "room coordinator" to assign the room when you arrive at the hotel. I have never experienced this before and it just adds another layer to checking-in, and I believe  it attempts to absolve the front desk staff from all accountability.Anyway...we specifically booked a "Gold King Strip Best View" room - not the ADA version. When I was making the booking, the ADA version came up as a separate option and I did not select it because I did not want it. On our arrival at the hotel, the front desk woman called the "room coordinator". She then hung up and told me that they had assigned an ADA room to us because the room we booked was not available. I indicated that this was not acceptable. Since she had already hung up on her call with the "room coordinator", she had to call them back. After speaking with the "room coordinator" again, she hung up again. I was then offered another room. On further questioning, I established that this room was on a very low floor, possibly overlooking the pool. I had particularly booked a room on a high floor with a view - not a room overlooking a noisy pool. I did not want this room and told the front desk woman so. She then went to speak to her supervisor. This took a while. It seemed as though they were just trying to wear me down into accepting a room that I did not book. I got sick of waiting for them so I went up to speak with the supervisor. I had to challenge her repeatedly into giving me the room type that I booked. Eventually, she said that there was another guest that hadn't checked in yet so we could have the room that was assigned to them. I asked her how a specific room had been assigned to them if they hadn't turned up yet - since it is clear that their practice is to get the "room coordinator" to assign rooms when guests arrive at check-in, not in advance. The supervisor said that the other guest had specifically requested that particular room number in advance. I didn't believe this for a second and I told the supervisor so. In addition, if that guest had specifically requested that room number in advance, why did they freely give it to me!  It appeared to me as though the room type that I booked was always available and they were just trying to assign me an ADA room to see if I would accept it. They should keep these rooms for people who need them. The whole check-in process took at least half an hour which was just terrible. At no point was I given the option to speak to someone who could actually do anything about the fact that they had assigned the wrong room type to me. I had to hunt down the supervisor. It leaves a very bad impression. I would not stay at this hotel again - nor would I book their hotel in Miami as a consequence of their practices.

allReviews.title: Don't try to plan for a group here
allReviews.text: It was my Dad's 85th.  He loves Vegas and the FB vibe is from his generation so we were so excited.  They were disorganized and bad to work with to plan, couldn't accommodate ADA needs for our group & is very un family friendly for kids &screwed up our check in.

allReviews.title: Top Hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Hotel is pristine. And the service is unmatched. Everything from how quickly elevators would arrive to the water pressure was top notch.Bars and restaurants are expensive but in line with other Vegas properties of similar quality / value.I highly suggest a bow tie croissant!

allReviews.title: upset by the attitude towards customers
allReviews.text: My partner and I spent two days at the hotel from December 31 to January 2.  the hotel is new and looks great.  The room is large and with a good view.  one minus in the room - there is no coffee machine.  everything was fine, upon check-in they took a deposit from my card of $400, upon departure we paid all the bills with my partner’s card.  It's been 22 now!  days and my deposit has not been returned!  my emails are being ignored!  I'm furious!  I think this is an outrageous attitude towards the client.  starting next week I will contact a lawyer and check whether these actions are legal.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel but terrible cocktail service
allReviews.text: Fabulous hotel and restaurants, the rooms are very comfortable and the casino area is  beautiful but the drinks/cocktail service is absolutely terrible compared to other hotels on the strip and we have stayed in plenty over the 20 years we have been visiting -  we managed to get 1 drink in over 2 hours playing !!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Cleanest most thoughtful hotel going!
allReviews.text: Like many folks I find myself in Vegas for business at least once a year. This is the best hotel experience I have had in Vegas in decades. Clean, modern, thoughtful, comfortable! Fitness center is world class. Extremely comfortable beds, thick doors, terrific room lighting.    My wife had decided she was done with Vegas many trips ago but she agreed to come on a lark and Fontainebleau won her over! I am now indebted to them because I am almost certain she will come back the next time I have to go.

allReviews.title: beautiful new clean hotel, great beds and service.
allReviews.text: comfortable clean rooms. The restaurants were WAY overpriced but the quality was good. Just ridiculous high prices and no other options in this hotel or anywhere nearby. The beds and pillows were very quiet. Dont get room facing the strip rd or you will be blinded all night by a 300 ft tall electronic billboard.

allReviews.title: Nice option by the end of the strip
allReviews.text: This would be a 5 star review, hotel is brand new, very beautiful, room is amazing, bed, pillows, bath, everything top notch. IMO the nicest cassino in the strip. However there are a few negatives, being:1) Digital customer service - I'm trying to get in touch with the hotel to get a folio that should've being sent digitally to me and it is completely impossible.2) Location - Far from the strip, you will need to take an Uber for almost everything3) Expansive- Everything costs a lot inside the hotel.

allReviews.title: An excellent addition to the North Strip
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel with great restaurants, clean rooms with convenient amenities, and a location that is ideal to the convention center. Valet and self parking were easy, the gym and fitness center was spotless, frequently cleaned, and has great hours.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay!
allReviews.text: If you want to be spoiled in luxury, head to Fountainbleu. The beds are the most comfortable we've experienced in our travels. Everything we ate while there was amazing! Staff are accommodating and friendly. The hotel is absolutely lovely,  we shall return!

allReviews.title: Amazing Vegas Experience.
allReviews.text: This is one of the best hotel casino-resorts I have ever been to in my life.   Best spa, amazing food at Komodo, Kyu, and Mother Wolf.   Great mixed drinks across the casino.   I need to try Liv next and Don's Steakhouse.   Papi's Steakhouse is a fun experience but remember to bring your ear plugs!

allReviews.title: Home away Home
allReviews.text: I always enjoy my time here. Been here since the opening month and stayed here several times. From the check-in to check-out the process has been always smooth. The service is solid. The amenities are amazing and I love being away from the crowded strip. This has been my favorite spot to book.

allReviews.title: First class all the way.
allReviews.text: Clean hotel. The most amazing spa. Love the food there. We ate at Mother Wolf and Dons Prime. Been multiple times and can’t wait to go back. We watched football games in the sports book at the Tavern. The food hall there is first class as well. Our favorite place to stay in Vegas and will continue to go back.

allReviews.title: 4th time to Fontainebleau - excellent place each time!
allReviews.text: Fantastic place!  just going to list what was excellent about it: pillows, beds, linens, mattress - incredible sleep.  Bathtub and bath.  View. Cleanliness of rooms. Property is immaculate and beautiful.  Very good people. Have a hot lap pool in January - love it. Excellent food - Mother Wolf and La Cote especially.

allReviews.title: Exceeded My Very High Expectations
allReviews.text: One of the nicest properties I have ever been to. It is not overcrowded, which is probably not what the investors want, but it is very nice for those who are staying there now while the property develops their regular clientele. The restaurants are all first class. The shopping is starting to expand now that the place has been open over a year. The rooms are amazing, and the strip view is incredible with unblocked views of the Sphere if you are on a higher floor. Finally, the service is second to none. everyone is so nice and professional and they treat you as a VIP. I won't stay anywhere else when in Vegas from now on. Stay here before the secret is out and this place explodes in popularity!

allReviews.title: Good vibe, meh rooms
allReviews.text: Beautiful lobby, amazing restaurants, great spa… rooms were very sub par. It already looks dated and scuff marks everywhere. Felt like it was a cheap and rushed build and already seems dated. If you want to be in this area I recommend the Conrad and just going there to visit. Mother Wolf was amazing! This should not be placed in a 5 star category.

allReviews.title: Nicely done, however, very pricy.
allReviews.text: Nicely done, however, very pricy. Promised discounts to "members" are unfounded, and there are "blocked out" dates, so reservation could not be made.No indoor pool.Exercise facility closes too early. No showers. Rude staff.No work desk in the guest room.Wifi requires daily registration during the stay.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau - best new spot on the strip
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is top notch. The hotel and casino is incredibly designed, superb staff, and beautiful rooms and general resort. The food and rooms were incredible and would definitely go back when in Vegas for either business or personal!

allReviews.title: Nice but too far
allReviews.text: This is the kind of hotel you make once... very nice contemporary, but nothing really French in fact. No theme so it's the pretty kind without soul. Since it is very far from the center strip , (1h30 walk) , you are there only to sleep , not to live the moment . A semi-disappointment

allReviews.title: Luxurious rooms
allReviews.text: Wow what can I say. This hotels is absolutely beautiful, from walking through the doors you are made to feel so special.Everyone was so welcoming and couldn’t do enough for you.Cleanliness is of the highest standard and the room was absolutely breathtaking, quality and luxurious throughout.

allReviews.title: Very classy inside and sober outside.
allReviews.text: I just spent one night at thé Fontainebleau after spending a week at the venetian. This hotel is extremely classy, i loved the decoration of blue and gold. The bars and restaurants are very nice also. It’s not the nearest of the certer of the stripe

allReviews.title: Dining
allReviews.text: We had an unpleasant and rude customer service with the security guard at the front check in. She left a bad first impression.  Other than that, the hotel is very spacious, clean, and elegant. We enjoyed our dining experience at La Fontaine restaurant.

allReviews.title: The best!!
allReviews.text: The best Vegas experience that I can remember. Very stylish and clean. Top notch amenities throughout. Royal suite was amazing with a great view of the strip. The room was very modern and had everything we needed. The food court was amazing (Miami Slice is a must), so many top restaurants to choose from (we ate at Kyu), the best meal I’ve had in a very long time. Service was top notch and every staff we encountered was exceptional. Worth every penny and reasonable for what you get. I am officially switching from a Wynn guy to Fountaine!

allReviews.title: Exceeded my expectations.
allReviews.text: Elegance and comfort to the 9s'!!!!  I experienced the best sleep ever! My husband and I stayed at the Fontainebleau in Miami and couldn't wait to stay at the Vegas location.  We will definitely be back in the summer to enjoy the pool and hopefully LIV nightclub.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau over the Wynn
allReviews.text: Love the fontainebleau for a weekend getaway! The most relaxing (in a good way) and nice resort we've experienced in Vegas, and we've been to them all, we used to be Wynn people but have converted to Fontainbleau, positives over Wynn include a) not bumping elbows constantly with a million people at every turn and fighting crowds, Fontainebleau is huge and spread out, b) you're not rammed through their smokey casino for absolutely anything, at FB it's actually pleasant when you need to walk through casino and you don't even need to for most things, c) MUCH better food options, especially easy options, Wynn is nearly impossible to 'grab a quick bite,' whereas super easy at FB and their food court is seriously the best ever, every single spot is worth visiting, 'food court' doesn't do the words justice, it's amazing, d) easily the best gym at FB in all Vegas whereas Wynn is just ok, e) their spa is incredible, f) price is right compared to Wynn, g) staff all around have been much nicer and genuinely happy you're there. Still love Wynn pool the most, but FB's is very nice as well.

allReviews.title: Good Hotel, a little far away
allReviews.text: The hotel is very well designed. elegant, fine, not ostentatious. Your location is base away from everything. There's nothing relatively close except a ROSS and a Wallgreens at 200 yards and a McDonalds in front. What if, it's a good location if you go to the Convention Center. The rooms were spotless, good shower, good light, digital curtains and honeycombs, excellent soap.

allReviews.title: 100% Luxurious in every way!
allReviews.text: Best weekend ever!We stayed for 5 nights and loved every minute of our new room. The whole experience was amazing but the prices of room service! We were upgraded for free upon arrival and the room was out of this world. Bellagio is old hat, Fontaineleau is the new Bellagio of Vegas,

allReviews.title: Anniversary trip to Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: The ambiance is ecstatic. The pillows are nice and fluffy. The staff is nice and friendly knowledgeable and approachable. I visited the solo bar and had a drink that was awsome. We booked a king room great strip view but the view could of been better! The mini bar was cool also but there was a charge if you ate or drank anything. Over-all it was what I expected worth every penny and I will definitely do it again!

allReviews.title: Unfortunate
allReviews.text: First, let me make it clear that the reason for the poor review is for billing only. We loved the room and the service and the food at the different restaurants. However, we did a 2 night prepaid stay with Amex in order to get our $200 annual credit. Unfortunately at check out they said we still owed for one night. Our check out process ended up taking more than 20 minutes and involved a manager. Unfortunately they were unable to resolve the issue which meant we had to take the dispute to Amex. I would have liked to return to this hotel but based on the overbilling we will not be able to return. Another negative is that it is far from the "action of the strip."

allReviews.title: Exceptionalism
allReviews.text: Ive been staying at Fontainebleau for a year now and it has the best restaurants, the best staff and they have such a beautiful facility. I love their larger executive suites. Ive stayed at every major resort property in Vegas and they all pale in comparison.

allReviews.title: A joke of a hotel. Do not stay here.
allReviews.text: Where to even start… Let’s start with this. There’s a mini bar in each room, like most Vegas hotels. Several bottles of wine and 2 champagne options. Great. I go to look for the wine glasses…. Guess what. There aren’t any. There’s a cutout for them in one of the drawers, so I assume they just forgot to put them in here.I call down. I’m informed that no, there aren’t supposed to be wine glasses in the rooms, and that if I’d like some, there will be a $9 charge to bring them up… You’re telling me if I want to pay the $100 for the half bottle of champagne in the mini bar, I have to pay another $9 to get proper glassware for it? The biggest joke.What else… the first room I checked into was dirty. Stains on the comforter, hair in the bathtub, and trash by the end table. I call down. It’s fine, it happens. Hotel is EMPTY, so I assume it will be relatively quick to get me into a new room. Finally get to a manager, who puts me on hold for 18.5 minutes. 18! To check for another room at an almost empty hotel? Are you kidding? She offered me a F&B credit for the inconvenience, but I already wasted a total of 40 minutes between the hold and then waiting for the new keys. Again, it happens, but that was anything but professional service.I genuinely don’t know how this place is still open. Vegas sets a pretty high bar for hospitality. I was excited to try out the newest offering on the strip (which yes, it’s in a terrible location if you’re doing anything other than going to the convention center).Will not be back. SO many better options. Stay at Wynn or Encore down the road and you will have a MUCH better time. Don’t even consider this joke of a property. They just really do not care.

allReviews.title: Negative experience
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel but not well as far as surveillance in the corridors of the rooms they entered at night in my room and robbed me and the hotel washed its hands despite the complaint they have not even answered my e-mails

allReviews.title: 10s across the board
allReviews.text: Amazing property. Super clean. Kind and assisting staff. Top top concierge well connected and can get you exclusive access to various venues. The rooms are super clean and the bathrooms are superb. Doesn’t smell like smoke like most Vegas hotels even in the casino. All the dining and bar options are phenomenal especially Komodo, Vida, and Chez Bon Bon. Very close to the Sphere.

allReviews.title: Excellent service kind personal
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel, best service , kind personal, I ll like to go there again , I decided when go to Las Vegas stay only in Fountainbleaue , because there is kind personal , best service Ill say In United states , and compare prices to other old Hotels it is much cheaper

allReviews.title: Loved our trip and want to go back soon.
allReviews.text: Excellent overall experience for our New Years Eve four day visit. The NYE dinner at Don's prime with prix fixed menu and wine pairing was well worth the premium price considering the quality and the overall experience. The champagne New Years Day special Brunch at La Fontaine was terrific and so much better than most other Las Vegas offerings. The hotel room, Panoramic suite was excellent, and the views of the NYE fireworks gave us a good reason not to be outside on the strip. The gambling experience was good for us as my wife had several hand pay jackpots. We loved our trip so much we cannot wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Top notch accommodations and excellent customer service.
allReviews.text: The lobby and casino were breathtaking, modern, new.  Service was exceptional from the reception through our stay.  The room was well appointed with a wonderful mountain view.  Happy that they had a separate cold drawer from the mini-bar. I forgot my toothbrush and was delivered a kit within minutes.  Food at the Tavern was super!  Never have seen and doubt I will see again bigger, tastier chicken fingers!! These aren't for the kids!

allReviews.title: Good clean fun
allReviews.text: Beds are comfortable, water pressure and temperature in shower were amazing, awesome view of the sphere. The ice skating rink was a wonderful experience for the whole family definitely looking forward to see what the pool is going to be like in the summer. Not much to do with kids other than ice skating, but if you cross the street you have plenty of things to do at the circus circus. Pizza and burgers were great for quick meals and Riding the super long escalator was also very fun. Overall good times

allReviews.title: vacation in vegas
allReviews.text: Every thing was excelent good restaurants & bars  & the atmospher is perfect, good place to spend yor vacations or other kind of travel ; bussines or plesure .The room is big an comfortable and good service .I recomended the hotel Thanks it was a plesure

allReviews.title: The Bleau
allReviews.text: Incredible new resort... Watched it being built for many years (from our timeshare across the street)... Very clean, beautiful decor and style... Lots of eateries... Show theater... High end shopping...One of the tallest hotels on the strip (maybe THE tallest)...Parking was free for hotel guests (most Vegas resorts charge to park)... Staff was top notch... I will be back to check out the pool in the summer

allReviews.title: Service was outstanding!
allReviews.text: Service was outstanding from check in to check out. This was our first visit. We like to avoid weekends to enjoy a more relaxed atmosphere! Property is beautiful! Returning again in April for 4 nights. Being north of strip is perfect for us. We play golf so nice to have easy access to surrounding courses.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel in vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, excellent service, delicious restaurant and great bars. Our room was with a great view to the mountains and the Sphere. Room was modern and well decorate, comfy bed and pillows, super clean, the dining in room service was great also. Everybody was nice and providing and excellent service.

allReviews.title: Pricey beautiful mess!
allReviews.text: Beautiful resort,  but they say they offer "First Class Service" but couldn't get someone to clean our room after pressing the Service button and being gone 6+ hours, still came back to a dirty room. When I called, they basically blamed me and said that I must have pushed the wrong button! Grrr

allReviews.title: Worth a stay
allReviews.text: The rooms are spacious with floor to ceiling windows and the multiple pools are well staffed and clean. The modern design is stylishly simplistic with a few good dining options. Worth the stay if you don’t mind being further down the strip. Management is still working on consistency since it is a newer property.

allReviews.title: Too expensive for stay, cute for visiting only
allReviews.text: For the price that I paid I thought the room would be much nicer and I thought it’ll be an stress-free fun New Year’s visit. But it was not when I initially got to my first room. The room was dirty. There was a big hairball in the shower and the loose hair is on the entrance floor. I had to call the front and they said another room key wouldn’t be ready until 45 minutes, but it took almost 2 hours. Then when I did move rooms and I Use their phone the phone kept disconnecting the calls.
