They eventually fix this and for the TV instead of being able to just mirror or use a streaming service you have to use Chromecast, which is a little annoying. I had ordered DoorDash later that night and the driver forgot to give me utensils so I called room service and ordered utensils. They said there was a service charge for nine dollars and said it would be right up but that took 30 to 45 minutes I ended up eating my food with my fingers, washing my hands and falling asleep. I’m just saying for the price that I paid I’ve had way nicer rooms for New Year’s on the strip or near the strip and better experiences and it was cheaper. I was expecting more. Not sure I will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Bad experience
allReviews.text: Bad experience. We asked for a suite and had a leakage on one of our rooms. We had to wait for technician to fix it from 4:30 am to 6am in New Year’s Eve. Compensation offered felt like an insult, they offered a compensation on late checkout and a small fee

allReviews.title: Best NYE experience
allReviews.text: Definitely lives up to its hype. Visited the Miami Fontainebleau years ago. High-end, clean, well-managed property. We went there to celebrate NY and booked last minute with high prices. We were lucky enough to get a room with the strip view as requested and really enjoyed the spectacular fireworks from our room. Totally worth the money! A very memorable experience for my kids and I as the first time spending NY in Vegas. We had NYE dinner at Mother Wolf and NY Day Brunch at La Fontaine, and even late night gelato. All excellent meals!

allReviews.title: Luxury Vegas experience
allReviews.text: Rooms are gorgeous and clean. The service has improved and staff are friendly. They take great care of the facilities and maintenance and make sure everything is clean. The place is huge and there’s plenty to do for anyone in your party. Whether with your family or a couple this spot does not let you down. The food options and dining experiences are fabulous and I recommend anyone to stay here. If there are any issues- let the staff know and they will make it right. 5/5 recommend!

allReviews.title: Good stay with some caveats
allReviews.text: Clean and new room, good amenities. Lacks attention to detail and there are some service gaps to be addressed if this resort wants to stay competitive. Would stay again, but would not be my first choice due to location and the lack of things to do in the area.

allReviews.title: Superb hotel in every way
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel with a lovely, huge, spotlessly clean room overlooking the Strip and the Sphere.  Every single member of staff that I encountered was friendly and helpful, often going out of their way to help me.  Cannot fault anything at all about this hotel.

allReviews.title: The new spot for Luxury on the Strip
allReviews.text: I chose to spend my birthday at Fontainebleau Las Vegas.  I love luxury hotels and wanted to see what they had turned that dormant massive waste of steel into.  I was super pleased.  Access to the property from the strip is super easy.  Valet is beautiful and there are plenty of staff to assist you with getting to check in.  Everyone is smiling and nice as they welcome you in.  Front desk check in was super quick.  There was no line so the process went smoothly.  The walk to the guest elevators isn't as long as some but wear your walking shoes.  My Noble suite best view of strip was everything.  I could see the Sphere and the Marquis in front of the hotel.  The suite was bigger than I expected and had a second bathroom with a glassed in shower.  It was so relaxing and invigorating at the same time.  I never heard any noise from the hallways and there is a filtered water spout on the ice machine!  I didn't have to buy water!  The property also smelled wonderful!

allReviews.title: Enjoyable holiday at FB!
allReviews.text: Oscar at front desk and the housekeepers (sorry I forgot their names) provided excellent customer service! The room was immaculate and the food at the restaurants were mostly good - Kyu, Capons, Ito bar, Mother Wolf and washing potato was just ok. It’s at the end of the strip so the casino is not as crowded. Stay here if you want to relax and have a more peaceful ambiance. Would like to experience their spa the next time we come back.

allReviews.title: Bar too small
allReviews.text: The hotel is brand new which is great. But both the inside and outside looks dull. Entire building is just a rectangular box. Also, the bar is too small. Three of us cannot find seats and ended up going to outside bar.The cafe is great especially the bakery and cake are amazing. In

allReviews.title: Best in class
allReviews.text: This is an outstanding property. You will not be dissappointed. Check it out and thank me later!Spa is amazeballs:) Food choices are off the hook from formal to casual. Shopping hits the mark, friendly staff as well. In my time there, four days from Dec 25-29th the hotel was tastefully adorned with fresh flowers. The only negative is due to airline delays, I was not provided with the highest floor as requested in my reservation, despite 2 phone calls to advise of arrival time changes.

allReviews.title: First Visit - won't be the last!
allReviews.text: From the minute you walk in, you are just "wowed" by the place.  I checked in solo, I was there to visit a family member and friend who live in Vegas.  I also pampered myself at the spa.  It was worth every penny!  I would suggest to go early, use the facilities before and after your treatment.  The soaking, the treatment, the lounge, the massage - all of it was wonderful!  I felt so recharged.  I also enjoyed the fitness center quite a bit to start my mornings.  Then I'd grab some coffee across the way at the little coffee place.  Next time, I will try to see a show there.  The tickets were sold out this time for Duran Duran. The location was good and it was not far from other things I saw and did.  The food court was pretty good.  I did not try any of the restaurants.  I had some drinks in a few of the bars.  Everyone is really friendly.  The customer service was very good overall.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel Experience on the Strip
allReviews.text: The suites are exceptional. Very clean, great service and Christmas time is a wonderful time to visit. The variety of restaurants is excellent and they all offer a different atmosphere. It’s worth earning royal status because of the room upgrades and free valet.

allReviews.title: Wonderful beds & food.
allReviews.text: They have the most comfortable beds and bedding. So much so I wanted to take the bedding home with me. The rooms are a nice size along with the bathrooms with a huge tub.  The hotel is just beautiful and not overly crowded, so it makes it more enjoyable. It was a great one night stay.

allReviews.title: Birthday trip
allReviews.text: Absolutely outstanding hotel with exceptional customer service. Our room was stunning with a fantastic view and the bath robes were to die for. Miami Slice and Vida were both fantastic and we can't wait to try the bagel and sandwich place. The pool is beautiful, as is the casino and we can't wait to stay again in July 2025

allReviews.title: A winter trip to FBLV
allReviews.text: Overall Review of Fontainebleau Las VegasI recently had the pleasure of staying at Fontainebleau Las Vegas and came away with a mixed but mostly positive experience.Check-In Experience:The check-in process was a bit slow and unorganized, which was a minor inconvenience at the start of my stay.Room:My room was excellent. It had a great view and came with high-quality amenities like soap, a robe, and toiletries. It was very clean and smelled nice, providing a comfortable and relaxing space throughout my stay.Bell Services:I used Bell Services to drop off a gift for a guest, and they were helpful and efficient.Concierge:The Concierge team stood out by providing me with a high-class gold toothbrush and shave kit, both of which were impressive and added a nice touch of luxury to my stay.Pool and Oasis Deck:The Oasis Pool Deck was open, and I appreciated the sunshine during the late morning and early afternoon. However, I was disappointed that food service wasn’t available at the pool deck, which would have made the experience much better.Lapis Spa & Wellness:Lapis Spa was a highlight of my visit. The steam room and pool facilities were great, and the coffee and fruit offerings were a nice touch. My massage was exceptional—the therapist did great work and even provided me with valuable insights that I appreciated.Fitness Center:The fitness center at Fontainebleau is by far the best I’ve encountered on the Strip. The calisthenics setup was perfect for my workout style, and there were plenty of high-quality stationary bikes. Mckenzie, a staff member, was especially helpful and knowledgeable, which made the experience even better.Dining:I had great experiences at both Washing Potato and Vida. At Washing Potato, the food was excellent, and they accommodated my carnivore diet request without issue. I also had a romantic and unplanned dinner with a beautiful young lady, which added a memorable personal touch to the evening.Vida, in particular, was outstanding. It’s easily one of the best breakfast spots on the Strip. The atmosphere is bright and inviting, and I loved the coffee, fruit, and steak and eggs. Adrian, my server, provided exceptional service that made the experience even more enjoyable.The Tavern:The Tavern was a fun place to eat, especially with action on the game. I found plenty of great menu items for my carnivore diet and had a good time overall.Gaming Experience:I had a mostly positive gaming experience at the casino. The $20K line of credit redemption was a hassle and took much longer than I’d expect, especially compared to places like Caesars Palace. The cashier had difficulty with my request, and I was given slot tickets instead of cash. That said, I did hit a nice jackpot on video poker, getting a straight flush while playing 10 lines max bet at $5—definitely a highlight of the trip.Disappointing Incident:The most disappointing part of my visit occurred at the end of my stay. I'll leave out the specifics but it left a negative impression on what otherwise would have been a great experience. Feel free to reach out to me for more color.Overall Experience:Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers a beautiful and upscale experience, with standout features like the spa, fitness center, and breakfast at Vida. However, there were some operational kinks, including the check-in process, issues with the gaming experience, and the food service at the pool. Despite these drawbacks, the property offers a lot of great amenities and a fantastic atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Great Stay After Christmas
allReviews.text: Stayed here under an Amex FHR rate and was overall extremely happy with my stay. Parking was very easy and it's great that it's at least included in the resort fee (whereas most other resort fees on the Strip don't have any actual benefit...also free parking on the Strip is basically gone at this point). Check-in was fast and efficient. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful and stunning, if this was located more south in the heart of the Strip, it would definitely be a lot more busy IMO. The stay was right after X-Mas and overall the hotel was pretty busy it seemed (at least near the check-in area).The room was really luxurious and definitely one of the best standard rooms on the Strip. Bathroom amenities were in these small bottles and while nice, were hard to get out of the bottle. Would probably prefer a large dispenser bottle instead honestly. The facilities were great all around with one of the pools still open and the gym being one of the best I've seen anywhere. Breakfast at Vida was really good (albeit pricey) with a good brunch selection. Chez Bon Bon had a really long line for coffee and it was a little disappointing to see them use an automatic espresso machine instead of a true manual espresso machine for a hotel of this caliber. Cafe Cuto upstairs though did have a true espresso machine. All the food in the Promenade was fantastic, we tried the Bagel shop as well as Miami Slice. Only negative experience was my keycard not working at around ~1330 even though I had a 1600 checkout confirmed during check-in. Thus, I had to go all the way downstairs to get a new key. Thankfully there wasn't much of a wait. Everyone here for the most part was very friendly and definitely more personable than the large casinos/resorts.Would definitely come back for the right price.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: Lots of positives, really nice modern room (well it is a brand new hotel), very large bathroom. We were on the 70th floor, and it was so incredibly high, the lift was something else, so fast! The view was great , we could see the sphere and enjoyed looking at the different illustrations. We went to New York after and I think the hotel lift and view was more impressive than the viewing platforms we went to!The pool closing at 7pm was rubbish as the weather was still perfect.The main downside was how massive the hotel was, it was a very long walk to everywhere and hard to navigate. The location is not great, but we took an Uber to the other end of the strip and spent the day walking back, which worked really well.

allReviews.title: Clean and modern. Well designed, helpful and friendly staff. One of the nicer hotels on the strip. 👍
allReviews.text: Clean and modern. Well designed, helpful and friendly staff. One of the nicer hotels on the strip. 👍

allReviews.title: Hotel double billed me and would not refund!
allReviews.text: The hotel staff billed me incorrectly!  They double charged me for my stay and would not refund me!  I tried to call numerous times but the staff would not listen or refund me.  I am owed over $500 from them because of this billing error!  Would love if someone from the hotel can contact me to correct this.

allReviews.title: You can't go wrong here
allReviews.text: Fine luxury hotel with a few minor flaws.  This is a newish hotel and the rooms reflect that.  The bathrooms are wonderful with a separate shower and bathtub. The vanity is large with 2 faucets. The main issue is that it takes minutes before hot water flows in the shower.  And even then it isn't totally hot. The bedding is superior and my room had a fabulous view of the mountains.  In the winter, when they are snowcapped, this is a superior view to the strip. One small issue is that there in a spiked spiral ornament on the headboard above the beds for interior design.  I wasn't a fan of this as it occurred to me that if there was a jarring event, it might come unglued and impale me.  But I eventually got over that. Still, it wasn't my style. Overall, it was a high quality room with surfaces finished in marble. Housekeeping was excellent and timely in cleaning the room. I appreciate this and that team deserves credit.  By the way, pictures in the hallway are from Napolean's Fountainbleau in Paris.  Many guests did not recognize this, so I'd like to point it out.The gym was excellent and not too crowded.  It had free weights, all sorts of cardiovascular equipment,  mats for stretching etc.  They close at 7pm and I suggest they stay open to 8pm because quite a few of us were still in the gym at 7.In the winter, an ice skating rink opens in the pool area and this was quite popular. Still, one pool remains open, and while small, it was heated to perfection.Some say the hotel is a bit far from the main strip.  I did not find this to be the case as the Resort Worlds, Encore, and Wynn, as well as the Convention Center and Fashion Mall are not far away.  And the traffic in the area is reasonable.  This contrasts with the traffic in front of the Bellagio where you have to wait for the signal to change 7 times before you can move forward. I ate mostly offsite, so I can't comment on the restaurants.  And unfortunately, I did not game this time because it was a short excursion.This is an aside, but if one is interested in a nice bottle of wine/champagne  for the room, head to Wally's at the Resort World across the street where the selection is comme il faut.  And for Las Vegas, the prices are reasonable.  Or for quick Mexican food, look for Tacos el Gordo down the block where the lines are long but the food is good.I plan on returning.

allReviews.title: Comfortable hotel for conventions, Not so much for gabmling/nightlife
allReviews.text: Nice hotel with very good looking accommodations.  Lackluster casino floor especially compared to Wynn, Venetian and many others.  Location excellent to get to Convention Center, West Hall in particular but not hard to take loop to others.  Spa is most expensive on the strip though very nice. If in town for a convention and the price is right I'd stay again.  If looking to gamble/night life then not the place for you.

allReviews.title: Perfection!
allReviews.text: The hotel was perfection down to every little detail. The bed was super comfortable, the restaurants were classy and great food. The spa exceeded my expectations. The Christmas trees and decorations throughout the casino and hotel were beautiful. Definitely a 5* hotel.

allReviews.title: Luxury stay, but be prepared to pay.
allReviews.text: There are many great things about staying at this hotel. The rooms are big and clean, with full tubs and super comfy beds. The spa is hands down one of my favorite experiences in Vegas. However, you can't get a glass of wine for under $30, half the restaurants were closed, and overall you are just a little far away from the rest of the action on the strip.

allReviews.title: Beautiful property
allReviews.text: One of the cleanest restaurants on the strip. I love that everything is new. The food is fantastic. Highly recommend Mother wolf and Komodo. Rooms are gorgeous. Customer service was top notch. Its a little bit of a walk to get down the strip but Uber is easy to get to at Fontainebleau. I would definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: very nice
allReviews.text: very nice and clean hotel and casino, about a year old but is being kept up nicely. A little far from the main area of strip but nice not being overly crowded. easy to catch Lyft and not that expensive to get anywhere. Easy walk to some of the other nice casinos too.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau - Beautiful Place - Can't wait to stay here again
allReviews.text: Highly recommend this hotel. We stayed here for 7 days and didn't venture outside of it till after 2nd day. Many places to eat, shop, or just stay and gamble. All the staff from cleaning staff, security, front desk, concierge, and various other staff we encountered were so friendly and helpful. The hotel was glamorous and felt like you were enjoying a bit of luxury. You felt welcomed and safe here. Security was throughout. Very clean hotel. Had the mountain view room - gorgeous view! Room and bed was so comfortable - had some of the best sleeps ever!  Fitness area was large and had various equipment from weights, treadmills, fitness classes, crossfit  equipment. No issues with it being on the north end of strip - easy to get to the rest of the strip as the Duece bus runs every 10 mins. Bus stop just outside the doors. Each night you stay gives you a $50 credit to use throughout the hotel, promenade, restaurants or in-room. We had a vehicle and did the self-parking - no cost for guests.

allReviews.title: Horrible experience exiting parking structure after concert.
allReviews.text: We attended the Derek Hough Christmas show in the theater.  It took us over an hour to get out of the parking garage.  Every floor and every aisle was backed up and had to do a 4 way merge.  It was chaotic and dangerous as tempers flared.  I will not attend another concert at this hotel due to the parking situation.  Also, what I saw of the hotel did not impress.  Very cavernous feeling.  Everything is so spread out and hard to find your way around (poor or no signage.) Not very welcoming.

allReviews.title: Just Outstanding!
allReviews.text: Food was just outstanding and resort people were just great.  An outstanding experience (despite losing at casino) as everyone was so nice and accommodations were very clean and nice!  Highly recommended!  Without hesitation, I would choose Fontainebleau as my first choice for a return visit.

allReviews.title: My new favourite Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: I had booked a paid for an early check in and had an email letting me know this was going to be honoured, and when I arrived at 11 I was told there was a room ready on floor 36. I had booked a Bleau room because the website said they all had soaking tubs and the Gold rooms did not. I asked for a room where I could see the Sphere and the receptionist (Kayleigh, who was lovely) said the Bleau room that was ready did not have a tub. So she changed me to a room on a slightly lower floor (24) with an excellent view of the Sphere. My room was the basic Bleau room and it was lovely, a large double wardrobe, chiller draw to store my own stuff as well as the usual mini bar. There was plenty of draws and hanging space as well as two hooks by the large mirror in the hall for coats. Like most of the Vegas hotels I have stayed in there was no kettle or coffee maker but I was expecting this and had my own travel kettle and tea. The room was beautifully furnished, curtains and sheers controlled from a small panel by the bed and another by the door, all the room lighting was also controlled in this way. However there was a glitch as the lights came on on their own two nights in a row, waking me up, and I was sleeping far away enough from the panel to know that I did not accidentally turn them on in my sleep!The bathroom had a large soaking tub, shower, double sink and WC. There was an opaque glass door between the WC and the rest of the bathroom. The shampoo, soap etc was provided in small bottles and smelt lovely too. And unlike the Bellagio where I had been staying prior to this, the Fontainebleau provide cotton wool, cotton tips and a shower cap, all useful! Their robes are also a lot nicer than the standard Bellagio robes - towelling on the inside and cotton on the outside, very comfortable for the times I was just chilling in my room. The shower was very strong and hot, and the towels and bed linen were high quality. I had a table with two chairs for in room dining as well as a sofa to chill out on. I spent the rest of the day exploring the Fontainebleau - there was one small pool open which was very warm, next to the ice rink. They were showing Christmas movies up there during my stay and I saw Home Alone. I could see at least two more pools and guess there was one under the ice rink too. The hotel is lovely, with a great ambience. I had dim sum for lunch at Washing Potato and dinner at Mama Wolf. There is a food court there too so plenty of choice for food - I collected pastries from the cafe for breakfast each morning. Some of the bars and restaurants were closed and due to reopen on Christmas Day but the bars I went in were quiet. Having stayed at the Wynn Tower, NoMad and Bellagio, all high end hotels, I think that the Fontainebleau is better than all of these and will be my new favourite hotel. It might be north of the Strip but I didn’t feel the need to walk elsewhere as there are handy bus stops close by and plenty of taxis.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau LV experience
allReviews.text: Overall check in experience & room was phenomenal. I stayed here twice already & love the atmosphere there. Only thing i wish is that they would have more food restaurants open after midnight on a friday night. There was only 1 spot that was open at midnight & that was chez bon bon. The food was good but kind of pricey.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Most fabulous hotel we have ever had the pleasure to visit!The rooms, the restaurants, the Casino and the staff were all top notch! Everything you need all in one gorgeous hotel! Staff is always available to guide you, give recommendations or answer questions. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. An abundance of restaurants with all types of menus and varieties of food. The burgers and tacos on the Promenade are spectacular.  So many amazing restaurants we need to return to try more!

allReviews.title: A must stay
allReviews.text: The hotel was very Beautiful  with plenty of things to do while staying there.  Casino was big with friendly dealers and plenty of slot machine to choose from.  Rooms were big and spotless with plenty of amenities.  You will not be disappointed.

allReviews.title: Our New Favorite!
allReviews.text: Fontainbleau is our new favorite!  We stayed here in Dec 2024 for the first time even though we visited a couple of times prior to this we did not have the opportunity to stay at the hotel.  The rooms are extremely nice, they are beautifully decorated and spacious.  The restaurants are fantastic, the bars/lounges are great.  Plus there are a lot of things to do here besides gambling, which we did our fare share of!  See you soon!

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel with excellent staff
allReviews.text: The rooms are beautiful and very up-to-date. The staff is friendly and professional. Check-in was a breeze and she was able to offer a discounted upgraded room that was amazing. On site dining options are plentiful and vary greatly in cost and food options. I hope to stay there again.

allReviews.title: Very Good.....But NOT Great
allReviews.text: Spent two separate 3 night stays at the Fontainbleau in Las Vegas, one in July and the other over Thanksgiving weekend.I really wanted to love this hotel and instead I walked away thinking I liked it but there's still a few hiccups along the way.I would not honestly characterize this hotel as a 5-star property.    4.5 stars would be more appropriate.Firstly, in the Summer, there are no cushions on the chaises and no one helps you to set up your chair with towels and coverings.   Instead, you come out to the pool, get your towel and you're on your own.    Providing service at the pool should be a total given, especially in a property that believes they are 5-stars.Second, the gym, while amazing,  closes at 7pm daily.    That one is a big-time head-scratcher.   You have to sign in to access the gym at the spa, but to not provide 24 hour access to the gym, (especially in Las Vegas) is inexcusable.Turn-down service was spotty.  Offered one day but not another.No coffee maker in the room, which is odd.Although I asked prior to arriving in July for my son's room to be in the immediate vicinity and was told it was given at check-in, he was actually placed way over on the other side of the floor.While this is minor, it was mentioned in other reviews.   The shampoo/conditioner/lotion are all in hard plastic bottles.   It is sometimes very difficult to get the product to come out.   The bottle cannot be squeezed so you have to furiously shake it.   This is probably something that should have been rectified a year ago with the packaging.The food at Vida for breakfast is excellent.  The hotel allocated only the bare minimum of $60 per couple when you book thru AMEX FHR.   The breakfast menu was replaced by a brunch menu so there is really only 1 item on the menu offered daily that covers that $60.   Hotel sets the dollar amount too small.Service in Vida was mostly excellent but on the last day it was a disaster and the server vanished, then blamed the kitchen for the delay.All in all, I would return to the hotel but with lower expectations.   The rooms are clean & luxurious.   The views are amazing and the beds are very comfy.  You are north of the main part of the Strip but I know that going on and was fine with it.  Also be mindful that the resort fee includes things that you aren't necessarily using, especially in Winter, such as the pools or self-parking (if you come without a car.)

allReviews.title: Great, clean, beautiful hotel & casino
allReviews.text: The hotel was designed with such great care and necessities in mind that you might need when you travel. They had a clothes steamer, bottle opener in the drawer, cozy robes, comfy bed, and just over all a beautiful place to stay. I thoroughly enjoyed my time there and plan to go back in the future!

allReviews.title: Nice new option for staying in Vegas
allReviews.text: I was very happy staying here.  I did not have any problems.  The hotel is nice.  Check in was easy.  The staff is great.  There are some hidden gems with the restaurants.  The gym is excellent. I would go back.  I was concerned because there were some negative reviews when this place opened but I did not have any problems at all.

allReviews.title: Awful experience.
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and clean, but was ultimately so disappointing (mostly on the service side). The room was large and clean, but the view out the window was literally a dirt pit (picture attached to prove that I’m not exaggerating). The hotel is pretty far North on the strip, so it feels a little quiet and like you are not in the middle of the action. I’m sure that is appealing to some, but I feel like most people don’t come to Vegas for a nice, quiet experience. We also had 2 extremely poor service experiences. 1. We made a reservation at Papi steak based on a recommendation. It is inside the hotel, and I was told it had a great “nightclub like” atmosphere, which was appealing to me. I was seeing a show that night, so I had to make the reservation for 10. I figured it would be no problem since the restaurant was open to 11 and supposedly a “cool” place. That afternoon, the restaurant called and said they wanted to seat the last table at 9 pm that night and asked if I could move the reservation up. I could not since the show didn’t even get out before then, so I was forced to cancel and find something else at the last minute. I can easily get seated at any chain restaurant in the suburbs after 9 pm, so I’m not sure how they can justify holding themselves out as a cool destination when they can’t even compete with a Chili’s or an Applebees. 2.  I was attending an industry awards dinner and sent a dress shirt out to be pressed. I did it very early in the morning to meet the same day deadline, but it was not returned by 7 pm as advertised. It ended up being delivered much later (well after the dinner started). The concierge did recommend a men’s shop in the hotel to possibly buy a shirt last minute, but I could not justify paying their low, low price of $360 for a plain white button up shirt. I ended up having to attend in something other than a suit and tie and felt extremely underdressed. It ruined what should have been a great night as our company won our category, but I had to take pictures as pretty much the only person not in a suit and tie. The night was embarrassing enough, but I never got the impression that the staff cared at all or wanted to do anything to proactively help me solve the problem that their hotel created. I’m sure others have had good experiences, because the hotel does have its strong points, but based on personal experience, I can not recommend it, and I would strongly encourage others to stay elsewhere.

allReviews.title: North end of the Strip is my go to now
allReviews.text: Second time here and love it. Easy check in and lots of fast elevators. Room is large and when compared to NYC or most large cities it’s huge. The Xmas decorations or very nice and the place is very walkable. In too visits I’ve yet to stay on the weekends so don’t know how  crazy that can be. Ice rink out in the pool area is cool

allReviews.title: Best beds in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: They have the most comfortable beds. The pools in the summer are great. The atmosphere is wonderful. Lots of different food choices that will not all break the bank. Everyone that works there is pleasant and you really feel safe on their property.

allReviews.title: Broken amenities, tasteless food, wouldn't return
allReviews.text: Nothing about my stay was 5 stars. I give it 2 because at least employees were friendly. The "upgrade" I was offered resulted in a low room facing the skating rink with screaming children outside my window and a 100 foot tall LED wall that the shades were not able to block out. The electronic controls for the shades did not work, maybe because the control panel is not even secured to the wall, similar to the HVAC intake. I ordered a pizza and salad to room my room that cost $100 and were void of any flavor whatsoever. Couldn't use the $3 billion fitness center because despite paying a hefty resort fee it closes at 8pm.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Gem at the end of the Strip! A must stay !
allReviews.text: From the moment you arrive it is the best experience in Vegas. Combination of new with the flare of vintage Vegas. The food is the best-The convenience of the casino to rooms is great - best bathroom / bedroom. Newer hotel that is very well maintained! Mountain View’s are spectacular- the Spa is a Must! Bring your swimsuit to enjoy the amenities though.

allReviews.title: Nothing but the best in Vegas...
allReviews.text: Perhaps the best hotel I've ever experienced.  No attention to detail left unturned. The staff was friendly and helpful at every turn.  The fabulous restaurants had world-class food and service, the fitness center was second to none, the numerous bars were comfortable with great bartenders and wait staff.   The hotel presented unbelievable luxury.   Even the room cleaning staff was responsive and the room was cleaned almost immediately when the service light was turned on. And there was even an outdoor ice skating rink for the holidays.  I could go on and on but I think you get the idea.    After visiting other hotels on the strip, we found nothing to compare to the experience we had at the Fontainebleau.

allReviews.title: Beautiful property, great staff, superb rooms.
allReviews.text: We have been visiting Las Vegas for several years and always wondered about this big building that was just sitting there. It was exciting to hear that they were opening and even more exciting to have the opportunity to book a couple of nights here. First thing to know is that this is what I call the north end of the south strip. The Sahara and Strat are the only big names between here and Downtown. If you walk it is a really long way to the Mandalay Bay. However, the monorail, the Deuce, or ride share are all reasonable ways to get around. The hotel is impressive, no doubt. The lobby is large and shiny, the ceilings are high and opulent, and the bars are beautifully laid out. The choice of dining in the hotel is broad and everything we tried was very good, and (on the Vegas scale) reasonable. The people here made all the difference. Our bartenders and servers were all attentive, accurate, and gave us a great experience. Fontainebleau has a very wide array of slot machines, scattered all over the floor. Every corner we rounded, there were more machines. The tables are laid out in areas around the floor, with a longer cluster set in one wing. While they were not crowded, there were quite a few people playing and there were some tables available for overflow.All in all, this is a new, gorgeous hotel. The staff is invested in your experience, the rooms are spectacular, and while smoking is permitted, the high ceilings seem to help avoid the cloud of smoke that gathers in some casinos. I will return.

allReviews.title: FontainBleau - Gorgeous, pricey and maybe a bit over-deccadent.
allReviews.text: Fantastic experience at this new property! Yes, it's pricey. My wife and I both have special dietary needs and we got outstanding accommodations with our food allergies (non-Gluten). Highly recommend getting the app for the property and put in your guests' dietary needs - it will make it much easier for the staff to prepare accommodation and offer suggestions. Gluten free bun at the fast-casual burger joint? Sure! Gluten free rolls at Don's Prime? Yup! Gluten-free toast as an option for breakfast? Sure! No upcharge for these, by the way, which would be a normal addition at most establishments. Now the "shops" are a bit silly - as you'll find at places like The Venetian, Bellagio, etc. These are shops that seem to solely exist where you blow the money you just won at the casino, or you're a world traveler with no concerns for expense. Branded stores (Gucci) with very limited selection and very expensive merchandise. There is a small shop for necessities that's located just off the lobby, but you can probably skip the rest of the "shops" which carry luxury purses, clothing and accessories. Unlike further down the strip, there aren't any walking-distance shops like Target or Ross, so you may not be shopping much, and the area, on the end of the strip near Downtown is pretty limited. Avoid walking around the area at night, and consider taking an Uber to get you to additional shops at places like Miracle Mile.

allReviews.title: Almost perfect stay
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed this hotel. The staff were very nice, the facilities were upscale. It was decorated beautifully for Christmas. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the sink in our room barely had any water pressure and it took foreeeever to get warm or hot water. And the toilet paper sucked. It just broke apart while I tried to use it

allReviews.title: Wow Bleau! Wow!!!
allReviews.text: This has to be the best room in Vegas for the price. Wonderful on all aspects. The ambience is the best. My rooms was comforable on a different level which allowed me to relax for short stay in Vegas. Top class. Everything about the establishment it Top Class.

allReviews.title: Must go
allReviews.text: This place was amazing! The spa was out of this world.  Only comment would be expanding the sit down breakfast options but well worth the prices! Comfy bed. Room service was great. Would go again next year.  Try it for yourself, you won't regret it

allReviews.title: Definitely Coming back
allReviews.text: The hotel was absolutely fantastic and Service was Five Star for sure - from the moment you get there you feel like your taken care of and the people at the Hotel really care about your overall experience.  Lots of smiling faces.   Papi restaurant was epic, saw a show at the concert arena that's next door to the restaurant.  Komodo had amazing food and drinks.

allReviews.title: Glamourous..oh the glamorous
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing shower pressure. Bed was comfortable and furnishings were all of high quality. The only hotel we stayed in Las Vegas that still provides slippers. Sometimes it's the little touches that make the difference.Staff absolutely amazing. Attentive, helpful and friendly. All restaurants we ate in, whilst prices were a little high, were above average. All quality and simply delicious and we went back to some places simply because everything was so good.For us, we like the North end of the Strip and Fontainbleau is reminiscent of a glamourous hotel from the past with a modern and sophisticated vibe without the pretentiousness.

allReviews.title: Spectacular weekend at the Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: We just stayed at the Fontainebleau last Thursday through Saturday.  Each part of our stay at the Resort exceeded our expectations.  The Fontainebleau was beautiful and tastefully decorated.  The gym was spectacular.  The pools and ice skating rings were beautiful and inviting. We ate at Komoda and Mother Wolf and had delicious dinners.  World class dinning.  Our daughter joined us (recent Cal grad) and loved the experience.

allReviews.title: Classy Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: It’s a class act resort. It’s beautiful and the service, food and ambiance are excellent. It’s my new favorite place. I love the rooms, in room dining and the Casino is amazing. The staff goes out of their way to be accommodating and welcoming!

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay
allReviews.text: I stayed here for one night on a recent trip. The hotel looks new and they really did it first class. It’s a pretty great place.  The room was large and had a great view.  The people were all super nice.  There are a ton of places to eat and it’s easy to find things. It’s really well done.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay
allReviews.text: Great property. 10/10 The staff is amazing, and the property is fresh and clean. I've stayed here 5 times, & it has become my favorite Vegas get away spot. The bars are amazing, and Lapis spa is incredibly luxurious. The pools are really nice with plenty of space to spread out.

allReviews.title: Amazing anniversary trip!!!! 10 out of 10
allReviews.text: This was my second time in Vegas. My wife and I were celebrating our 14th anniversary. My wife had seen the Fountain Bleau on instagram and we decided to book it. We hade an amazing time. The resort is upscale and doesn't lack in any amities. Everything from the room, bars, restaurants, and casino are amazing! Truly a place to go and not have to leave in search for anything else! This resort is what Vegas needed!

allReviews.title: Always 5 stars for us!
allReviews.text: The rooms are very comfortable and inviting. The staff is very friendly and helpful in all areas of the establishment. Casino is easy to get around. We love to eat at La Fontaine for brunch, you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. The endless champagne is one of our favorite things to get. We always make reservations so we don't miss out on starting our day out right!

allReviews.title: I recommend it highly.
allReviews.text: Excellent food, service is outstanding and the ambiance with high ceilings make it feel at ease, also smells nice without the taste of cigarette smoke in your mouth. You might be a little away from the other casinos but a little walk good for us.

allReviews.title: Don’t be fooled by a few nice pictures. It’s not a nice stay
allReviews.text: The place is like a sterile castle. I was shocked how empty it was. Not just of attractions but of people. Thomas Rhett was playing here but the casino and restaurants were still empty on Friday and Saturday night.  It might be because it’s further away than you’d think looking on a map. The rooms were a little small too. Some nice decor in them, but ours hadn’t really been cleaned and there were several things broken.

allReviews.title: Loved this hotel.
allReviews.text: Loved it here. Beautiful hotel and lovely staff. Had a wonderful room on the 61st floor. Great views. Loved the ambience of the casino and great restaurants. Would definitely stay here again. Location was 30 mins walk to the Sphere which was perfect for our Eagles concert. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Fountaine Bleau
allReviews.text: My husband and I have been going to Vegas twice a year for years. This was our first time staying at the Fountaine Bleau and it’s the best hotel we ever stayed at. Lots of restaurants, room and view were beautiful, staff was great, smelled wonderful, ceilings were very tall so didn’t smell smoke and a variety of slots. Many slots min bet of .75 cents. This is our new go to hotel!!  It was amazing!!!

allReviews.title: Other places are better
allReviews.text: This hotel is new-ish, but there is better locations. Parking is a nightmare with traffic going every which way, food was ok, the gambling area was lacking items. Hotel is down the strip, so if you are use to being on the middle of the strip don’t stay here.

allReviews.title: Well Heeled.
allReviews.text: Fun Place to visit.  Many well heeled people walking around; great for people watching.   Slots are loose.  Staff friendly.         You can walk across the street and see the last slot machines that take coins.  See you there, see you on The Strip !!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Amazing week
allReviews.text: The smelling good pillows were the fluffiest and comfortable.  We were at right across the nightlight view of the Spheres.  My family were very satisfied and love the view of the skating rink also outside.   We’ll definitely come back again to spend our relaxing visit.

allReviews.title: Great view, but not the bathtub I paid for
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful property, but it is at the end of the strip, so access from the airport is problematic.  Coming in last night the traffic on the cab ride was terrible, to the point of carsickness, so beware of the access issues.  The main problem I had was the room I received vs. what I thought I ordered.  I paid a premium - last minute to see George Strait/Chris Stapleton and go to the NFR.  Looked at the Fontainebleau’s reviews and properties - great, for the most part.  The problem was the hotel filled up, and instead of a nice bathtub, I got an ADA accessible room.  I understand that the hotel has ADA obligations, and that is a great thing, and I fully support that accessibility.  Management just needs to realize that a guest may have been looking forward to soaks in the beautiful bathtub that was advertised as part of the room (not the minimum price mind you, but a premium view room) and should have made sure that a room was available that had the advertised amenity, in this case a bathtub.  If I had known my room was going to not have the bathtub I thought was included with the premium price, I would have found another room, for sure closer to the airport, and avoided the carsickness on the cab ride.  I asked for another room, or a discount, and was told, the “Hotel is full and I can’t do anything, you need to go to the front desk”.  Just make sure you get the room you ordered, and don’t leave the front desk until you have their assurance that you are going to get the room you ordered, and watch out for the cab ride.  Beautiful property, I just wish I got what I thought I paid for.  Another problem is the gym closes early, at 7 pm, so that was another small burr under the saddle.

allReviews.title: My New Favorite Hotel In LV
allReviews.text: This hotel is AMAZING, from the staff, the decor, the room accommodations, the spa, the huge choices in dining, the shopping, and the entertainment. You can see that they take great care of the hotel, because every where you go there is staff cleaning and sanitizing, and that's an A++ for me.  The guest rooms are also cleaned and maintained very well. This place definitely will not disappoint!!

allReviews.title: Extraordinary Resort
allReviews.text: No other resorts or hotels compares to the Fountainebleu. This resort hold a category of its own. I will stay only at the Fountainebleu Resort when visiting Las Vegas. The #1 resort in Las Vegas! This is my second time staying at this resort and I recommend this resort!

allReviews.title: Interesting…..
allReviews.text: Have looked forward to staying while watching the construction process. I think this property will have to up its game to truly be considered a 5star. The food outlets are sub par , no excuses at this point! Property has been open a year. Considering the quality and options in LV this should not be the case. Retail is basically non-existent… sad.  The rooms are comfortable and functional. The casino floor is ok. Not sure if I would recommend.

allReviews.title: AMAZING all around!
allReviews.text: Noble Suite facing the pool/Las Vegas strip and you won’t forget it! You’re one lucky customer if you encounter Karen Crisostomo at Concierge. Amazing customer service! She will make your stay a wonderful experience. Resort is newer, modern with luxurious finishes. Smells so good too! Food promenade is yummy and unique to only Fontainebleau resorts. You have to try Miami Slice! Komodo is also a must for dinner! Guests have free parking using your room key.

allReviews.title: Great first experience
allReviews.text: The whole resort is spacious, clean, well kept, with great lighting.  The staff is friendly and responsive.  The food court had great options.  Bar Ito had great hand rolls and poke bowls and miami slice had great fresh put of the oven pizza.  Room was spacious and clean.

allReviews.title: Outstanding
allReviews.text: We had a great experience! Rooms/bathrooms were exceptional, the decoration of the hotel is so pretty and it's not very crowded. Food and service at the restaurants can get a bit better but they were good. Will definitely come back and highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas.
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas Is now the place to stay in Vegas. The staff is precise and attentive. The views are amazing and the dining exquisite. It was worth every penny, my only regret is not staying longer. I will definitely return to soak it all in.

allReviews.title: Great Value!
allReviews.text: I really like this hotel, especially the staff. Everyone is incredibly friendly and helpful. I also appreciate that it’s a non-smoking hotel. Although I did notice a few people smoking inside and could smell the smoke, overall, it’s much better than the MGM hotels.While many people enjoy a bustling atmosphere, I prefer the more spacious and less crowded feel of this hotel. Some shops are still under construction, but I think they’ve curated a great mix of stores, and I’m looking forward to their opening. The parking lot is also more spacious, which is a big plus—I hate searching for parking.Overall, it was a great experience, and I’ll definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Go for the vibe, stay for the Matzo Ball Soup!
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a must visit in Las Vegas. The vibe is amazing and food is out of this world. Don’s Prime on the Casino level and Bagel Bagel in the food court are outstanding! You have to try the Matzo Ball Soup. They have 24/7 restaurant and the hotel is dog friendly. What more can you ask for.

allReviews.title: November to Remember
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel with 5-star ambience and service.  Must try the resto - Washing Potatoes - unusual name but delicious dimsum !  The check-in experience is prompt and staff is courteous. The rooms are clean, the linens crisp and the daily cleaning of the rooms are prompt.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: Best hotel ever I had the best shower here the water pressure is great the towels smells like flowers everything is good here we were at the 59th floor hotel is beautiful !!! It’s at the end of the strip but it’s ok I love to walk! The receptionist are all nice here

allReviews.title: Absolutely Awesome (Versailles 2.0?)
allReviews.text: Immaculately kept and almost brand new, this is actually an oasis resort filled with all of the most beautiful and interesting items and memorabilia that I have ever seen.  It’s like the most beautiful museum I’ve ever seen (besides Art Institute of Chicago) where my wife and I went on our first date. I love the atmosphere, the stores are all of the highest luxury imaginable and it’s a place you hope you have unlimited money to buy whatever your heart desires.

allReviews.title: Worst hotel experience in Vegas.
allReviews.text: An absolute scam. Our stay was awful. If they would have refunded us (they refused), we would have left the first night. Our room was beautiful, and except for the painters tape we found everywhere. The hallway for our room was still being built. The was construction all night. It increased after midnight! Drills, saws, hammering. We paid over $6,000 for an f1 package that basically gave us tickets that cost $1000 and charged us $5000 for a 4 night stay. It’s $250 on the site. The shuttle left us at the stadium and we stood in the cold (41 degrees) for an hour. We were given a $100 credit when we asked about the high price of our package vs the average rates, but their room service charged a $9 fee and included an 18% tip. We were going to tip anyway, but our $100 credit got us two pieces of cheesecake. We didn’t receive our refund for the full incidental and deposit fee either? Still waiting for a response. I have worked in the hospitality industry and never leave bad reviews, even if the stay isn’t the best, but this place is beyond disappointing. I honestly felt scammed. Everything was falsely advertised and misrepresented.

allReviews.title: Pamper Yourself at the Fountainebleau Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Our staycation at the new Fountainebleau Las Vegas for my husband's birthday was perfect!  We had a view of the Sphere which was a treat.  The room was immaculate, roomy and modern.  The pressure in the shower was incredible.  Bed was super comfortable and sheets divine.  Check in was easy.  Stayed the Monday after the Formula 1 race and got to see a car just outside of the ride share area.  Wasn't crowded and we were able to get around very easily.  Wanted to eat at Azul, but was closed on Monday. Went to The Tavern instead and was a great choice.  Brandy was our server and she was exceptional. I ordered what had to be the best Fish and Chips in Las Vegas, 3 pieces, delicious coleslaw and lots of crispy fries.  Hubby had a double cheese burger and announced it as the best he's had ever.  Cudos to the chef.For breakfast we ate at Chez Bon Bon, excellent coffee, croissants and fruit parfait.All and all extremely positive experience with the exception of the gaming machines.   Tight machines, no payouts after several hours of play:-(

allReviews.title: Bleau Bar Better Than Collins
allReviews.text: This review is for both bars at the Fontainbleau.  We went with friends to Collins bar.  It was OK.  I much preferred the Bleau bar for atmosphere and a great bartender.  Cory was a great bartender at the Bleau Bar.  He made the best espresso martini.  I told him I liked it a little creamier and he put Bailey' in.  We like the open atmosphere at the Bleau bar compared to Collins, which was inside, kind of dark and not as good.

allReviews.title: Loved this upscale option
allReviews.text: Nice hotel experience where I felt like the staff were a bit more attentive than usual for Vegas, which was a pleasant surprise.The room was spacious and well decorated with good amenities. Even though I got the lowest level of room, I still felt like I was getting a treat, particularly with the huge soaking tub.I ate at three of the restaurants and enjoyed all of them, particularly Kyu and Washing Potato. They were a bit expensive, but I didn't feel ripped off. Service was very good at all also.I used the North uber pick up only and found it to be relatively convenient compared to some of the other rideshare pick up options at other Vegas properties.The spa was a happening place and had top of the line facilities. In the women's area it was a little hard for them to keep up with replenishing the snacks and beverages. It was also inconvenient to have to ask for a lot of typical amenities like hairdryer because they didn't put much out. I assured the staff I would not steal the hair dryer they handed me. They have a rule against using cell phones in the spa, which I was surprised to see appeared to be well obeyed by patrons. Because of that rule, I would have expected better kept and more options for magazines available in the relaxation area. The spa did feel a bit excessively priced. The nail service pricing was an absolute joke, particularly the $60 upcharge for Dazzledry when a Dazzledry manicure tends to cost less than $60 for the entire manicure.I thought my room rate was on point pricing wise. I asked for a quiet room and indeed got one. Despite the fact it was the weekend, I got a great quality sleep. I asked for a late check out so I could do my spa treatment and then head back to my room but it was denied. So I was forced to check out at 11am and then hit the spa. Unconventionally the hotel does not accept room charges after you check out. So I had to take my spa treatment receipt to the awards desk to make sure I got credit for it with the membership rather than just being able to add it to the room like literally every other hotel. If you can't extend late check out, please figure out a way for guests to continue to charge hotel expenses to their account.

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Nice relatively hotel, very nice and comfortable rooms, big  casino including slkt machines and gaming  tables, variety of restaurants, friendly staff especially the host Mr. Scott Poster.Location on Las Vegas strip, easy to drive to, big and clean parkinglot.

allReviews.title: The Newest ‘Go-To’ Hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: I was booked in to Fontainebleau for business and wasn’t sure what to expect as it’s not one of the ‘recognised’ Vegas names but I have to say I was blown away! The decor and quality of the rooms were amazing. The staff were all superb and so helpful and friendly. As a fitness enthusiast I was probably most excited to see the gym. I’m often not hopeful with hotel gyms but the gym here was really different class! It’s better than most commercial gyms. As a former Equinox employee, I would say this is at a very similar size and standard!They have a fantastic array of restaurants - from Chez Bon Bon for your morning coffee and overnight Oats, Washing Potato for some of the best Dumplings I’ve ever eaten, and Don’s Prime Steakhouse for that special treat.Can not recommend highly enough. I’ll be back next year!

allReviews.title: Calm and relaxing
allReviews.text: What an incredible Hotel! Beautiful beautiful beautiful! Every inch sparkles! All the employees are incredibly nice! Can’t wait to go back! The room and the view were breath taking! Everything was done to perfection! I am so impressed with everything!

allReviews.title: Fantastic F1 Weekend At The Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: I had the privilege to be invited to F1 by Puma and watch the race from their hospitality suite. I stayed in a Noble Suite for the weekend which definitely had a eurotrash vibe to it. The hotel of course was full and they did a fantastic job of catering to race fans and A listers alike. We had a low key dinner at Don's Prime which was stellar as always and a nice alternative to Papi Steak. The casino floor was busy but easy to get on the tables and the dealers were patient with some of the Aston Martin team that were a little green on playing craps for the first time. I took advantage of a quiet Saturday afternoon to enjoy a massage and steam at Lapis Spa  followed by a pre party at Komodo before the race. Overall F1 weekend in Vegas was a blast and given the opportunity I'd do it again as the Fontainebleau continues to execute the art of hospitality flawlessly.

allReviews.title: Best Resort in Vegas!
allReviews.text: This resort is the best resort in Veags in my opinion! I have stayed at all of them and never had service at this level from start to finish! Food was excellent, facility was extremely clean and EVERYONE was so friendly and helpful! We will be back!

allReviews.title: My new go to
allReviews.text: The Lighting and the smell of the lobby was breath taking. The accessibility to the strip was convenient . My room was very modern decor, technology but the best was the ability to cast from my phone to the TV. Will stay here again, cant wait…..

allReviews.title: Designed by out of touch bros bathed in cologne.
allReviews.text: Other than being new, it was an uncomfortable stay. There were no good food options after hours. The lobby scent was musky and strong like a group of boys bathed in Axe spray walked by. The functional design of the rooms was not well thought out. Door to the toilet barely clears when pushed inwards. The shower heads could not be adjusted, shorter people basically will have to touch the wall to get in the spray of the shower. The toiletry products came in pretty blue bottles that were a nightmare to get the product out of. On top of the that it’s poorly run, first room we got was not cleaned, crumbs and hair all over the floors. The solution to this was to send house keeping to the room? So we can awkwardly sit in the room while they clean? I had to demand a room change. Bad training for the staff even thought they were every where. This place is designed and run by some rich guy who thinks he knows what luxury is but obviously never pays attention to or appreciate people in their lives that’s do all the little things to make life easier or functional. This place is out of touch for what it wants to charge and to be labeled luxury. Bring in a Hilton or Marriott to run the place at least they have a baseline of hospitality even if they don’t want to go for the pedestrian strip casino market

allReviews.title: High end Vegas. Regal and top notch!
allReviews.text: I stayed at this resort and also partially at Mandalay Bay. The stay at fountainbleau surpassed Mandalay by mikes for me. The quality of room and service can’t be compared. Everything felt new and crisp. The views were incredible overseeing the sphere and portions of the strip. The amenities were extremely plush and well thought out. I loved every second of my visit.

allReviews.title: Pool hours limited.  Food overpriced.
allReviews.text: Resort fee not justified.  Silver tier does not get resort fee waived.  Front desk would not waive it when asked based on emails sent saying they would waive it in November if you booked two nights.  Well this email came after we booked and were on our way.  But it seems FB just nickels and dimes you on this resort fee which is not good value.

allReviews.title: Favorite LV resort
allReviews.text: This has become our favorite property when in Las Vegas. Everything is top notch. Very well done. Staff is wonderful. Attention to detail is wonderful. The atmosphere and tone the entire resort sets is a step above. It is easy to get to and slightly removed from all the craziness of the strip but still close enough to get to center stop with a short taxi ride. Love it.

allReviews.title: Birthday Stay
allReviews.text: We just completed our 4th dtay at the Fountainbleu for my birthday.  We stayed in a Noble Suite with a great view of the Sphere and south strip.  The customer service was top notched shout out to Aislinn and Karen Crisostmo for taking care of all of our needs.  We were able to check in around 10:00am without a hitch.  They were able to change our initial room because the view was horrible.  The food and bars are outstanding.  Our favorite place to stay on the strip. Love the free coffee

allReviews.title: Excellent Experience
allReviews.text: This is an excellent hotel to stay at. The roomsare wonderful and customer service first class. Everything is first class. The rooms were spectacular and also very quiet. The location is right in the middle between freemont and other casinos. Highly recommend

allReviews.title: Highly recommended. The perfect setting and position to be able to really enjoy Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: An exceptional hotel, perfectly positioned to get the most of Las Vegas. We loved the light and bright rooms with floor to ceiling window and views of The Strip and The Sphere. The Lapis Spa is the perfect antidote to jetlag; we could easily have spent the entire day there. The choice of bars and restaurants is incredible, from fine dining and cocktail bars, to the Promenade of classy bagel, pizza and taco options. The Fontainebleau has all you need on site, and is within easy reach of the Strip, shopping and the Convention Centre.

allReviews.title: The most twinkles in a Las Vegas casino on the strip
allReviews.text: Great rooms, clean and nice finishes. housekeeping was fabulous. Restaurants are top notch. In terms of gaming - they are giving away the money in this beautiful casino. All my friends won big money. I only won $300 but at least I didn’t have my clock cleaned

allReviews.title: Vegas charm
allReviews.text: This was our second time stay at this fabulous resort. Unlike other Vegas Mega resorts, the service by far is the best to be had in Vegas.  The gambling tables have happy smiling dealers who actually want you to win.  The choice of restaurants is amazing and elegant.  The pool is heaven on its own and has a covered full casino, a full bar and full of employees ready to help.  The rooms are fresh, clean and always ready upon check in.  Highly recommend this resort.

allReviews.title: First time at FB
allReviews.text: A beautiful property! One of the cleanest on the strip!Rooms were so fresh it actually had a live plant on the table.It was costlier that other casinos to get money out of my checking account.  One night I did very well in the casino the next night not so lucky!  Would love to return.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Friendly staff,  clean, beautiful rooms. Promenade food delicious. Restrooms very clean. Every employee there was always willing to help and give suggestions.  Second time I have stayed here and will continue to in the future. Beautiful decor and great food choices.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Best food and clean rooms. Staying here we were well taken care of. So much to do at this casino always packed on weekends. Looking to revisit hopefully sooner rather than later. Hopefully during the summer to try out the pool area. Casino was huge with plenty of room between machines waiting staff exceptional with drinks.

allReviews.title: Fountaine fabulous
allReviews.text: Rooms and services were great. Super new and super clean. Nice food. Nice casino. Saw a show in the theater. Was a great stay. The bed was super comfy. We enjoyed a casual meal in the sports tavern. We also had some great dim sum. Would highly recommend staying here in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent experience
allReviews.text: The hotel room provided an excellent experience, offering exceptional comfort and ample space. The decor was nice and the environment was quiet, ideal for relaxing after a busy day. The furniture was of high quality, ensuring a comfortable stay. In addition, the room space was perfect, with enough area for us to move freely and accommodate all our needs. Without a doubt, this convenience contributed significantly to making our stay even more pleasant.

allReviews.title: Would stay again for sure
allReviews.text: I had not stayed at this property before and needed something on short notice. After a quick search I noticed that the prices here were significantly lower than prices on the central part of the strip, so we decided to give it a shot. It was an easy Uber ride from the airport and the property was clean and well maintained. Check in at 10pm was easy and straightforward. We had booked a double queen room and it was large, with comfortable beds and very nice bathroom (separate tub and shower and vanity/sink that was large enough for two people to use at the same time). My single room complaint was that there isn't a coffee machine, but the coffee shop downstairs was easily accessible and fast ($7 cup of drip coffee). At night there was some noise from a TV in an adjacent room but it wasn't bad.In the past this has been a sketchy part of town but after walking from the Cosmo to the Font at 11pm on a Saturday night, I found it to be very mellow. No insane behavior/drug addicts or homeless people and we felt quite safe walking LV Blvd through this section. We were only hassled by one guy who was hustling for some strip clubs, but he was pretty friendly and not aggressive. We didn't gamble or eat at any restaurants on the property and we didn't use the pools or the gym, but what I appreciated was that it wasn't as crowded as other resorts on the strip, and it felt very clean and modern. It was very easy taking a ride share service from the Font to other areas. It's also close to the arts district, which has great breweries and casual food. Absolutely would stay again if I needed to be on the strip.

allReviews.title: They have a lot of work to do
allReviews.text: I should preface this with Vegas hotels were the pinnacle of service pre covid and they have not bounced back. This hotel was brand new so I'd like to give them some leeway but it was an meh experience for a lot of money. We had connecting rooms both of which were dirty with big black hairs left in the sinks, gross. We ordered room service for dinner twice, the food was hardly edible.for dinner. Breakfast room service though was delightful. The room was spacious and beds comfortable.

allReviews.title: Maybe the best experience I've had in Vegas.
allReviews.text: I visit Las Vegas quite regularly and although this was my first time at the relatively new Fontanbleau,  it won't be my last. I was there for 9 night enjoying every aspect of this resort. Room, staff, restaurants, bars were all amazing. Everyone seemed to go the extra step to insure an enjoyable experience.  This was one through ten on my bucket list and it achieved them all. Absolutely beautiful. If there's  anyone out there with a bad experience, they are too critical or lost more money than they had set aside.

allReviews.title: New Luxury stay on the Strip
allReviews.text: Hotel is great and service was fantastic. Rooms were spacious and the bathrooms high end. We went for a long weekend, and the hotel itself did not seem to be that crowded, which we appreciated. The restaurants were full but the casino and bars were not over run like some hotels on the strip get. We ate at several restaurants and had very good food. Papi steak was the best - similar to Delilah in my opinion but more of a party - and the service at the Chyna club was excellent.  We did not make it to LIV, so I can’t speak to that. Would definitely recommend staying here for an upscale vibe in Vegas!

allReviews.title: It’s Not Just For Gambling
allReviews.text: What a beautiful and well-appointed property, with fabulous facilities and sumptuous service in safe and secure surroundings. An exceptionally attentive staff. The food for our meetings was appetizing, handsomely presented, and delightfully varied.

allReviews.title: Fabulous Experience
allReviews.text: The Fountain Bleau was a very Pleasent Experience.  The personal were above and beyond then most places on the Las Vegas Strip.  The Check-In experience was above and beyond anything I have experience here in the States, it has a European flair to it.  As does all the employees associated with this Hotel.  In addition, the cocktail waitress were "Fast" and friendly.  Fountain Bleau should be the trainers for the other casinos in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: My new go-to on The Strip.
allReviews.text: this is my first stay. the hotel is brilliant. The architecture and interior design are draw-droping in awe. The rooms - even a "normal one" are roomy, brilliantly decorated with tons of natural and ambiemt light. The staff is as professional as can be. Mother Wolf, imho, is the best Italian restaurant on The Strip, nhands down.

allReviews.title: Move Over Four Seasons...
allReviews.text: Obsessed with this property!  We were long term Four Seasons Las Vegas devotees and tried the Fontainbleau on a recommendation. So glad we did.  This will now be our LV default hotel.  Everything is new, sparkling and amazing.  The hotel is well staffed and the rooms are nicely appointed. I'd read reviews about cleanliness and dirty rooms, but our rooms were spotless!  Definitely one of the best/most posh rooms (especially the baths) on the strip. Everything is well run EXCEPT check-in/check-out front desk.  There was a 35 min wait/line at the front desk at check-in and check-out at mid day Friday, Saturday and Sunday.  Rule #1-don't make guests line up to give sign for money they've already given you!  That 30-35 minutes could have used spending more money on the casino floor, restaurants or elsewhere. This has to be fixed!  Otherwise, it was one of the best experiences I've had in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Stay somewhere else...
allReviews.text: I expected a lot more for the price we paid.  The hotel/ room was nice but we've stayed at much better for much less money.  The environment was very "snooty" and the customer service was sadly lacking.  The vibe was very dull and it did not feel like Vegas at all.  I would not recommend staying here.  If you do want to check out the hotel, have dinner at Mother Wolf.  The food was delicious and their customer service was exceptional.

allReviews.title: Was hoping for better : (
allReviews.text: I was hoping for a lot more from Vegas' newest hotel.  The rooms were small and average compared to many Vegas hotels.  The prior occupants of our room left jewelry and drugs behind in the dresser, which were found by our young children.  The solution was a $100 hotel credit, which seemed a bit lack luster.

allReviews.title: Breath of Fresh Air for Vegas
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience all around. The facility is clean and breath taking, live fresh flowers through out the whole property. Staff was friendly and helpfully.  The fitness center is the best I have ever seen traveling. The spa facility is epic, lots of amenities and friendly staff.the food is amazing, while we didn’t get to every resturaunt we did hit most and they were all top notch, the steak house Don’s Prime was amazing. Even the food court had amazing food! Fun table action

allReviews.title: The Prestigious Experience
allReviews.text: The room was beautiful. We had Mountainview Bleau King. WOW. The in room service. The on site restaurant experience. Just 10/10. I loved the directives for the ease of getting an Uber pick up. It was just a great experience. I wouldn’t stay anywhere else from the other casinos we visited while on our stay.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous Resort BUT…
allReviews.text: Massive and Beautiful BUT…. We’re currently staying at the Fontainebleau.This is just a general view covering a couple of things we noted upon arrival. It is a beautiful massive  sprawling resort. Be prepared to walk a lot because it is massive.  Just wanted to point this out  for anyone with mobility issues.Unfortunately, the common areas of the resort have a very strong, overwhelming scented chemical odor.  It is so strong they we have had to limit our time being in the casino, restaurants, etc.  We had to go to other casinos on the strip because the odor is so strong we couldn’t take it.We did not smell it in the hallway or room (68th floor).   Also, we visited last December and we did not smell it then.   For allergy and asthma sufferers these chemical ‘fragrances’ are irritants can be troublesome.  It’s not healthy for anyone.About 15 years ago, a very popular resort on the strip used a similar chemical scent.  There were many many complaints.  Eventually the resort stopped using it.The Fontainebleau is gorgeous.  We really hope that management will eliminate the use of this piped in ‘fragrance’.  It’s such a shame we couldn’t spend more time at the resort.  We will be checking out early.  We look to forward to returning if and when the ‘fragrance’ is no longer used.

allReviews.title: Honest impartial review from an experienced traveller
allReviews.text: The good:The hotel itself is immaculate. The staff professional and attentive. The food is good. Cocktails are on point.The bad:Possibly it’s due to the time we were there, SEMA week, however: restaurants are all always busy and a wait. Bars even worse. Get fed up and ate elsewhere several times.The ridiculous:The Lapis spa, incredible property, treatments were superb. HOWEVER, and again, perhaps it was due to the week we were there and the clientele present, but the coed area was filled with loud, obnoxious clients. Remarkable a facility like this wouldn’t enforce a quiet policy.

allReviews.title: Terrible customer service
allReviews.text: We heard good things and decided to try this new Vegas property. The room is fine, but on the small side. The restaurant options are good. But they are clearly still trying to figure out their customer service. We went to check out the pool and learned that’s it’s closed for construction. Any credible hotel will let you know about construction when you book your reservation. We called guest services about this and spoke with two supervisors. Both had quite an attitude and said it’s not their policy to let customers know about pool closures. I asked about crediting us back the resort fee given that the main pool area is closed and they refused. Oh well. There are so many nice properties in Vegas with good customer service. No reason to settle for one that doesn’t understand what good customer service is.

allReviews.title: Amazing casino
allReviews.text: Beautiful experience, very clean and staff was great. Definitely the best casino in the strip. Room was spacious and their food court areas was great, great delicious choices to choose from. Would definitely recommend and choose this casino for my future visits.

allReviews.title: Nice room, not so great service
allReviews.text: I had high expectations because the hotel is so new and the overall Fontainbleau brand, however a lot of annoying lapses in service happened during our stay, listed below. I did really enjoy the restaurants on site, especially Washing Potato and Mother Wolf. And the room itself was really nice with a great view (from the 69th floor). Small but annoying experiences: - Housekeeping did not come even after we pressed the service button. We had to call to request they come. When they did come, they did not remove our in-room dining items. They also did not tell in-room dining to come clear it. So we came back to the plates still there and had to call again to have them removed.- Internet did not work after the first day of our stay. Impossible to connect both phones and laptops. - When we checked in, we were given late check out because of our Amex Platinum booking. I told the staff member we were going to check out at 4pm and she noted it. However, on the day of check out, our room keys stopped working in the afternoon. We were locked out. I asked a woman from housekeeping for help but she refused to help me. It was only after I basically begged her to call her manager that she helped. She refused to let me use the phone in a room that was unoccupied. She also couldn't give me the phone number of the front desk. It was only when her manager arrived that we were let into our room. - Maintenance and painting of the hallway started on our floor. We weren't given any notice of this. It was noisy, smelly, and blocked the hallway. - The main pool deck was closed. We weren't given any notice of this prior to our arrival. Ridiculously, we were still charged the resort fee. - Unacceptable that there isn't coffee in the room. - The small bottles of shampoo and body wash in the shower was very difficult to use. The bottles are too hard to squeeze so it's very difficult to dispense liquid. Not practical and very wasteful to have single-use plastic like that in every room.- A lot of shops are closed or boarded up and not yet open. It feels very empty walking around the first couple levels of the hotel. - Check out took too long. The combined check in and check out lines meant we had to wait with newly arriving guests. The line was 4 rows deep. The staff member who checked us out made errors on our final bill that I had to spot and correct. This also took a long time. - We were not told how to exit the car park after check out. We were stuck at the gate and had to wait for a staff member to arrive to tap their card to let us out. This surely can't be the most effective way of guests leaving the car park after they've checked out. While none of these are really that terrible on their own, the fact that they all happened to us on a short, 2 night stay isn't really acceptable.

allReviews.title: A five star resort
