allReviews.text: A conference at the Fontainebleau brought my husband and I in October 2024. We were super impressed with the hotel. Every single staff member was friendly and so helpful. Honestly, the staff was probably the best I’ve ever encountered at a resort. It’s a beautiful resort and smells AMAZING!  Our room was quite large for a standard king and the bathroom was very nicely appointed. The bed was extremely comfortable too. We spent 6 nights here and explored many of the restaurants and we were not disappointed with any of them. We liked that there were so many dining options on site.  Some might not like the distance from the main part of the Strip, but we didn’t mind that. We liked the quiet. We enjoyed that the casino was not filled with smoke, like so many others. We will definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Great hotel, BUT.............some disappointment!!!
allReviews.text: I actually would have given our stay a FIVE, except a couple problems.  After staying there 6 days, five nights, spending several $1000s, Sunday our flight departed Vegas at 4:30, I called guest services and requested a late check out until 3:00 instead of noon.  They charged me $125, said we could not stay until 3:00 unless we paid $125 (did I mention we had spent $1000s over the week?).   I told her that was not fair, she said she couldnt do anything.....very unusual lack of service for any Vegas hotel.Secondly, we were in a Noble Suite, GREAT VEIW, but the furniture is small and uncomfortable....couch is like of love seat, cant relax and chill to watch the sunset.  Lastly, none of the fine dining is open late.  WE MAY OR MAY NOT TRY IT AGAIN.

allReviews.title: New but very raw
allReviews.text: Terrible place service is very bad, awfully crowded, disgusting service and awfully expensive not delicious restaurants. Especially surprised breakfast, was a tight line, $150 bill for two and not delicious. In the tea room casino cheap chips on the tables . In general, there was a feeling that the hotel was opened not ready for further work with guests , of the pluses probably only good rooms , large enough and beautiful , but it is not a hotel 5 stars ...

allReviews.title: Best hotel vibes on the strip
allReviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas, great food and service.  Mother Wolfe was amazing.  Hotel staff and service is second to none.  The spa is amazing and made us feel so good.  The beds are comfortable and pillows are amazing.   We will be back as often as they will have us.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay!
allReviews.text: Gorgeous room and so many wonderful little details that added up to a wonderful stay! We have stayed at some very fine hotels, and I would definitely rank this one up in the top three hotel stays!  Check in was a breeze, loved the casino and the bars are top notch!

allReviews.title: Best Resort on the Strip.
allReviews.text: The most beautiful resort on the strip period. Pair that with the best set of restaurants, great gaming, beautiful rooms, and an incredible spa, what more could you ask for.  So many hidden gems, I find new things every time I come. Can't wait for my next trip.

allReviews.title: Best hotel on the Strip!
allReviews.text: Fantastic hotel! By far the best hotel I've stayed at in Las Vegas. Hotel was spotless, room was fantastic, staff was extremely nice and helpful. Worth every penny and I can't wait to go back and attend another concert in the incredible concert hall.

allReviews.title: Bonkers amazing!!
allReviews.text: I stayed 1 night and had an amazing time.  I went to the Oct 30th Tears for Fears show.  The bed was delicious and the pillows so soft. The promenade is a spectacle  all on it's own with the art and flowers. The staff were so attentive and kind.  I'd do it all over again but stay a couple nights next time.  I just loved it!!

allReviews.title: The newest kid on the block, is the best in vegas in the last 20 years!!
allReviews.text: It is the best Casino Resort on the strip and the best I have been to in years!! The facility is beautiful, big and awesome.  The service top to bottom was 5 star, the rooms were very big, well appointed, will the finest linens and towels.. The casino was expansive with games and ranges for everyone.  The slots were the newest and the best. The food offerings was outstanding

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: Everything was amazing the staff the hotel was really nice and clean. Smelled amazing, I did not have one complaint. The room was very spacious and everything was upgraded of course. I loved the real roses they were everywhere. Room service was good also.

allReviews.title: Awesome and Clean
allReviews.text: Very clean, new and great fun.Was there for Tears for Fears concert in the theatre. While far more upmarket than most Vegas properties it also has maybe older client set. Also a little more on expensive side but ok as not as crowded. Service was ups ale. Ate at Mother Wolf really good.Probably has best hotel gym I have ever been in.Tavern/sports book was good and unlike some properties on the strip they do not hit you up for a beverage minimum if there for NFL on Sundays

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel, well-thought-out room lighting
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, very stylish without being gaudy. Prompt and friendly car valet service, they even charged my car (after signing a consent form). My favorite part was the in-room lighting controls. Very high-end glass control panels, and great features like room scenes, bedside controls, a nightlight in the bathroom and a dimmer on the vanity mirror. The shower is huge! I wish it had a shower wand - that is my only (Very minor) wish. I stayed in a Gold room.

allReviews.title: Fountainebleau Vegas Shining Diamond Experience
allReviews.text: This is a must visit first class resort style hotel, check in, pool area, rooms and room service dining was above and beyond for the nightly price in comparison to other hotels on the strip. Advice for those that have sensitive skin to request a humidifier and wear single layer nurturing lotion, it will help with the Vegas dry air and AC in the various venues. You won’t want to leave this facility once you spend an evening there, every room have floor to ceiling windows capturing the strip and sky of either early morning sunrise or evening bliss of sunset.

allReviews.title: Friends weekend at the Foutainbleau Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, excellent accomodations, great restaurants, best work out facility, with free pilates classes and tons of equipment, rooms were attractive, clean and very comfortable. Service was terrific! The pools and outdoor seating areas were very attactive and there was ample seating and lounges. Overall a great place to stay!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau experience - Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very welcoming. Spacious room, great view. Fantastic gym facilities.Plenty of dining options available - promenade food hall was good for relatively quick bite; sushi etc in Komodo was delightful; good breakfast portions in Chez Bon Bon.

allReviews.title: Huge Disappointment-Luxury just not for you.
allReviews.text: Disclaimer, this was my first visit to Las Vegas.  The list price for a basic room at this hotel during my visit was north of $800.  So I had high expectations for comfort and luxury.  What I experienced was something very different.FIRST IMPRESSIONS We entered the built from the far side, and were greeted by security staff who very politely directed us to the lobby.  It took a while to traverse the shopping and casinos to reach the lobby. The building is grand and beautiful. The floral arrangements and artwork are beyond belief.  The lines for checking in were long, and moved quickly.  The desk clerk was efficient and waived an early check in fee, but also would have allowed us to store our luggage at the bell desk.  Everything, was great.   Or so I thought.  When I looked around the lobby, I noticed there wasn’t a single place to sit, no benches, no chairs, no couches.  There was a hard plastic ledge alongside one of the planters between the lobby and the elevators.  But where could an elder or a weary traveler rest?  In front of a casino machine.  It struck me—the lack of seating was intentional and despite the fact that millions of dollars were spent on the lobby—-nothing was spent on the comfort of guests.  I asked the concierge if I could get a razor as I left mine at home.  THE ROOMThere was no offer of a bottle of water, piece of fruit—nothing.  The elevators are quick and frequent.  The room key worked.  The room was as promised—-two queen beds., a dresser with medium sized capacity. There was no fridge, microwave, coffeemaker, balcony or desk.   Clearly not appointed with the comfort of the guests in mind.  There were very expensive amenities for purchase —and for which I was charged despite never having used.  The room appeared fairly clean, however when I went to put my clothes away I found the floor of the closet to be unvacuumed and quite dirty.  The  same when I looked around the edges of the roomThe bathroom was spacious  with tub shower stall, two taps (one big sink basin).  And a toilet in a separate enclosure.  The toilet needed to be flushed three times to fully flush down No. 2.  Water pressure was adequate, it often took a long time to get hot water.  The towels were of moderate quality.  The toiletries were similar.  Oddly the shampoo, body wash and conditioner were in small bottles (not the typical pumps found in  modern hotels seeking to minimize environmental impact. The bottles were so rigid and the product so thick thst it was almost impossible to dispense.  Like trying to get ketchup out of a glass bottle.    Clearly not well thought out and not in the interest of the comfort of the guest.OTHERThere really want much else except the pool which was off opened only from 9am-6pm.  There is what I can describe as an unusual level of scrutiny of the guests bags-/just to insure no outside food or beverages were brought in.  Security actually build some guests the could not bring coffee purchased on the second floor into the pool. There were no staff assisting guest in finding or setting up a chair.  It was a free for all of getting through security and running to a vacant spot.  Reminded me of a concert—not a luxury hotel.  Lastly the most disturbing part of the visit was the experience I had with the residents of another room.  Late one evening I heard a screaming child in the hall and came out to see if everything was okay..  the mom “apologized” as they were just playing.  I suggested they play in their room or in the downstairs areas it was disturbing, Hours later I hear a child screaming again, put on a robe and went into the hall, a father was throwing his child in the air.  I said that it was late, I was trying to sleep and it was very kid and disturbing.  Several doors opened, and others added their voice saying the same thing. The dad, and an uncle told me to mind my f-ing business and approached me threateningly.  I returned to my room called security but never heard what happened.  Didn’t feel safe or comfortable.  No follow up from Management.—so disappointing.

allReviews.title: Welcoming elegance.
allReviews.text: I am a local but I’ve been staying away from the strip because of parking fees. I just discovered that Fontainebleau has four hours of free parking.  We went Thursday and were back today. The hotel ambience is elegant and tastefully done. They have restaurants open for lunch  that has sophisticated service and upscale dining  atmosphere. And the car exhibition are piece of art. I think I found a place where I could hang out whenever I need a place to go.  One more thing- they are arguably the best hotel food court in Vegas. - teaaroundtheworld

allReviews.title: An ok stay but won't be in a hurry to return.
allReviews.text: A difficult review for me as I want to be fair:  obviously a very new hotel and the room was v comfortable however there were a few niggles:  the elevators are a LONG waĺk from reception which I found weird, the car valet pick up was at a different to valet drop off, and again a long walk away, the food prices were on the high side and finally, having paid for a strip facing high floor room, I was a little dissapointed because despite being on the 62nd floor, my strip view was largely blocked by the Encore Hotel.  I had no sight of any hotel on the east side of the strip and only down as far as Ceasars on the west side, although I did have a good view of the Sphere.  All in all, nothing not to like, but equally I wouldn't be in a hurry to return.

allReviews.title: A Resort not to miss
allReviews.text: The most amazing experience with customer service. Everyone was eager to help. The room was sparkling clean. Great choice for restaurants which were reasonably priced. The complimentary fitness classes were flawless. Unfortunately the spa services were very very expensive. The location is in a good area for walking and felt safe with all the security. The size of the room was enormous and the soaking tub was just what I needed

allReviews.title: Looking for luxury? ... then Fontainebleau should be your choice
allReviews.text: Staying in Suite 65-21 was nothing short of incredible! The view alone is breathtaking, offering an unobstructed panorama that truly makes you feel on top of the world. The suite is outfitted with high-end amenities that elevate the entire experience—every detail has been carefully considered. The bed was superbly comfortable, and I have to say, the pillows were the fluffiest and softest I’ve ever slept on, making each night a restful retreat. Being a newer hotel, everything is immaculate and luxurious, which only enhances the sense of a premium stay. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a perfect blend of comfort and elegance!

allReviews.title: The most beautiful new hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau, which opened this year in Las Vegas, was a lovely surprise. We were in LV on business and took an afternoon to explore the hotel. As a designer, I was deeply impressed by the thoughtfulness of the design which permeated the whole property, including lobbies, retail areas, restaurants, and bars. It's big, and tall and impressive, but also calm and sophisticated. Definitely worth checking out!

allReviews.title: Sticker Shock
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, good food, comfortable beds and spacious rooms, but all highly overpriced. Pool was closed. limited table games with very high limits. Guests charged for valet parking, although when I called the hotel before coming they told me parking was free, but they didn't clarify that was only self parking.Service was great everywhere.

allReviews.title: Mother Daughter Trip
allReviews.text: Great hotel to bond with your adult child. The beds were firm and soft. The robes were a nice amenity. The building and people were very attentive. The food at Mother Wolf and Don's Prime was cooked to order and melted in our mouths. I did miss an in-room coffee machine :)

allReviews.title: Great Stay at the Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: The hotel is gorgeous. The spaces are expansive and dramatic. I had a standard king room and it was much larger than the average room. The toiletries smelled amazing smelled amazing. Everything in the hotel was very clean and of course new. The  pool area was very pretty as well. I went to the pool in the mornings as it started to get crowded by Eleven o'clock or so and hard to find a place to sit. All of the food that I had was good as well as the service. The staff I interacted with were very nice and helpful. I would definitely recommend staying at the Fontainebleau.

allReviews.title: Beware of Theft in your room!
allReviews.text: Warning, I had $1,500 stolen from my room. The hotel security team didn’t care to do any sort of investigation whatsoever. They wouldn’t tell me on the phone if my room was accessed by hotel staff and told me to file a police report so they can then subpoena for the records. Filed the police report and haven’t heard back. STAY AWAY. I don’t think they hired the most competent of staff. Will never stay there again. I’d say the only positives was the sushi bar upstairs in the food court, high quality and not offensively expensive.

allReviews.title: Be careful
allReviews.text: Customer service should’ve been a lot better. Make sure that you check your receipt upon checking out because I was triple charged and room service is very expensive so I would just be very very careful. Make sure you stay on housekeeping to make sure your room get cleaned

allReviews.title: Great hotel!
allReviews.text: This property is beautiful, comfortable and clean. One of the best hotels I've ever stayed at. Casino is great, restaurants were awesome and the location is perfect especially if you came for the football game. I will definitely be staying again .

allReviews.title: Don't Arrive Hungry If Checking In Late
allReviews.text: Checked in after midnight after long flight from Florida was starved but there was no open restaurant besides Chez Bon Bon which has very little offerings besides were out of 75% of the items on the "menu." I've never stayed in a major casino that didn't have a full sit down 24 hr restaurant availableAlso no convenience type store on premises, Walgreens was a 4 block walk in not a great neighborhood.Besides that hotel was beautiful and stay was wonderful.

allReviews.title: The Best
allReviews.text: Just outstanding!!!The resort experience is the best on the strip, having stayed in just about every resort along Las Vegas Bl. The casino floor was clean and smoke free making it feel healthy. The resort atmosphere make you feel secure. Will definitely be on top of my goto resort on the strip. My host Jen was professional and very helpful.

allReviews.title: Get Here Before Everyone Else Does
allReviews.text: This hotel is brand new and doesn't disappoint.  The casino was very clean.  The rooms were very clean with a great layout.  I interacted with probably 10-20 staff besides the casino people and everyone couldn't have been more helpful, cheerful and eager to please.  It was just a thoroughly enjoyable experience.

allReviews.title: Vegas at its best !
allReviews.text: The overall quality and attention to detail are best we have seen in Las Vegas or anywhere for that matter! We typically stay at Bellagio but this was another level up of quality. Quality restaurants and fantastic lounges cannot be beat. Can’t wait to return

allReviews.title: Excellent Vegas strip hotel experience
allReviews.text: Beautiful not overly done hotel on the Vegas Strip, away from the crowds but easily accessible to key destination sites. Not too smoky, plenty of restaurants, games, pool, bars, and the like. We will return to this our newest favorite strip hotel.

allReviews.title: VERY expensive resort
allReviews.text: This resort is very nice, but over-priced for what you get.  The pool areas were crowded (one pool was closed completely) and it was hard to find lounge chairs and umbrellas.  The resort restaurants are hit or miss in terms of food quality.  Some of the details are very nice, while others seem like they weren't completely thought through.  For example, the blue plastic soap containers in the shower are hard plastic, which makes it hard to get the soap out of.  This seems like a weird, nit-picky thing to put in a review, but this resort is EXPENSIVE, so details like that matter.  The resort is quite far from the liveliness of the strip, which is bad and also good.  It was much less crowded than, say, the Bellagio but also, it doesn't offer quality enough food to make you want to eat there.

allReviews.title: Las vegas Fountainbluea Hotel not bad either.
allReviews.text: We went to Las Vegas and stayed at the Fountainbluea (across from Circus Circus).  It is at the other end of strip, but we didn't want to be in the crowd of the strip.  My husband loved this hotel from the restaurants, prominaid,  room service, the room itself,  ( it has a razor, shavingcream, toothpaste and toothbrush) NICE ROOM Royle Suite, pool and there is different one's too. Next door is Sarah's which you can catch the tram from there, also restaurants over at Sarah's too.  Bell services ( at the airport) takes you right to the door.  We got a taxi to take us to Fremont Street.   All the staff is professional and know their stuff.  I recommend that you stay here at least once it's not your average stay (hotel).

allReviews.title: Awesome Resort!
allReviews.text: What a wonderful and beautiful resort! First class in every respect! The room was immaculate and the bed and pillows were unbelievably comfortable! Excellent food and service and a great casino. Don’t miss this resort! It’s well worth checking it out!

allReviews.title: Pool!
allReviews.text: Main reason for booking was for the pool, I visit on an annual basis and I am a true Resorts World fan, but I thought I 'd give it a try. I'm sorry that I did, 2-3 of the pools were closed and therefore the others could not accommodate the guests properly. There was no music, or so low you couldn't hear it. Wait staff stated there had been complaints by "families" that the music was too loud. Family demographic is not the audience and therefore unsure why this would be accommodated over the actual demographic of people there with no children. (note: this was "end of season" Oct24). But they should've waited to turn the pools into ice rinks a week later then as they were doing nothing, one still had water in it. AND NOTE THIS ON THE WEBSITE, somewhere visible so guests are aware.Overall the property lacked character as well, it seemed very bland and stale with no personality but a bunch of "bow-ties".There are positives also. The staff was great and the room was a good size.Note: there are 2 rideshare pick ups/drop offs.

allReviews.title: Finally heading home after a fantastic stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: The resort was generous with promotional credits, which made my time at the slots even more fun, especially on the last night. 🎰🤘🏼 The hotel itself is stunning, with a classy, modern vibe and plenty of high-end amenities. While it is a bit north on the Strip, making people-watching less of a priority here, the distance does lend a more relaxed and refined atmosphere that’s perfect if you’re looking to escape the usual hustle and bustle.Rooms were beautiful and comfortable, and I managed to book at a really reasonable rate by keeping an eye out for deals. The dining options were excellent, with a mix of reasonably priced and high-end restaurants that add a real touch of elegance. Just a heads-up—guests definitely bring their style game at night, so if you’re heading out for a late dinner or drinks, expect to see some serious fashion statements!All in all, Fontainebleau makes for a luxurious and memorable Vegas stay, and I'd definitely come back!

allReviews.title: Recommend
allReviews.text: We found the big F a great visit, nice, clean, new recommend.  Would stay here again. Recommend Mother Wolf restaurant, and El Bagel for morning food & coffee but be prepared for a wait or order ahead on the app.  Now I am writing to hit the maximum characters to post.

allReviews.title: Don't Overthink It - Do It
allReviews.text: What a gem of a hotel.  They've transplanted the iconic style and feel of the original Miami Fontainbleau, but updated it really well.  The casino was hopping but not crazy, the jazz bar Nowhere spun 1940's post-WWII joyful vibes, and the food at Mother Wolf was transcendent.  My Noble Suite was pitch perfect with its decor and charm and mid-Century understated elegance, and all the employees were en fuego and on point.  I'm a picky and long-time Vegas lover.  Oh yeah, the fitness center was large and impressive.  This place is great.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay. Looking forward to our next visit!
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, modern, luxurious and elegant. Service was excellent, our room was pristine (like the rest of the hotel) and the atmosphere was sophisticated and fun. Less crowded than the other big hotels which was nice and relaxing, but still had enough of a crowd to give fun energy. There were so many upscale and incredibly well designed lounges and restaurants it reminded me of NYC, but  we just didn't have time to visit most of them. Highly recommend Motherwolf for dinner. Vida was good and simple for breakfast, along with more beautiful design. The pools were fun, and LIV nightclub was fun too. Excited to stay here again in December.

allReviews.title: Expected much more
allReviews.text: Disappointed:Room was (just) okay, clean etc. Plugs not in convenient spot to work at table; had to stretch them across the floor.  Lighting was also not good for working at the table.Bathroom/Shower extremely poor design.  Although shower was reasonable size, the location of the showerhead made it almost impossible to rinse the lower part of the body as the shower  stall width was too narrow.  Discussed my stay while at the airport with a stranger and he had the same problem in the shower.  Also tried running the hot water for at least 10/15 minutes multiple days and could not get hot water in the sink to shave.Was attending a conference that included food.  Overall the food was also just "okay".  Have been at many conferences on the strip in the past and I would have to say the food was nowhere near the top.  Also room labeling at the conference was not great.  Even the coffee was sub-par.Nothing like the Fontainebleau in Miami.  Expected much more here.

allReviews.title: Extraordinary on all levels
allReviews.text: Where to even start giving our experience has been fabulous. The food and beverage is fantastic as we’ve eaten on premises at several restaurants, including room service breakfast each day. I highly recommend Komodo for dinner. The self parking is free and very convenient to get in and out. The hotel is absolutely gorgeous in all respects, from the common area’s exquisite design and architecture, to the casino, to the rooms. The beds and pillows are extremely comfortable and everything is in excellent condition and good working order. We’ve had quiet nights of sleep and the fitness facility is exceptional and energizing. The equipment options could suit anyone of any age, of any condition. It’s nice that it’s not a party scene and all of the staff and guests we encountered have been very friendly.The new retail that’s opening is absolutely exquisite, and worthy of a visit on its own.

allReviews.title: Luxury Personified
allReviews.text: I initially had a reservation at Mandalay Bay, but later discovered this hotel and boy am I glad I did. The only thing better than a 5 star hotel is a brand new 5 star hotel that opened less than a year ago. Just to echo what others have written, this hotel is spectacular. Beautiful room with marble everywhere. Hi tech lighting. Incredible bathroom. Super comfortable bed. Even the hallways are beautiful- very wide with artwork on the walls. Elevators are touch screen which I’ve never seen before. The fitness center stands alone as the best hotel gym I have ever seen, and I’m an old man.  The gym is as big as a commercial gym, but has equipment that’s better than 90% of commercial gyms. All of the hotel employees are incredible. Special shoutout to Gabriel who works at the fitness center. Nothing I have said is hyperbole. It’s the truth.

allReviews.title: Shaken not Stirred
allReviews.text: First trip to the Fontainebleau Vegas was for Business, it was so nice we decided to return for pleasure. If you are looking for top shelf, pampering without the usual Vegas clutter and commotion, upscale pool vibes. Think James Bond/Sinatra old time classy vibes only. If you want oversized margaritas look elsewhere.

allReviews.title: A First Class Luxury Experience
allReviews.text: I’ve been visiting Las Vegas for over 25 years and I must say, this is the finest resort I’ve ever stayed. It was top notch from the moment I checked in. I felt like a VIP. It is so well thought out and designed. The staff is first class, friendly & very helpful. I do not miss the location south strip that is so congested and feels like a circus. I will certainly be making plans to come back very soon!

allReviews.title: Strange housekeeping situations
allReviews.text: View is great, bed is comfortable, Don's Prime is amazing!  This was our 2nd stay here and we enjoy the property however the housekeeping was subpar this time.  Upon checking in, we went to our room and it smelled as though there had been a serious sewer issue so we immediately returned to the check in desk.  The woman made a call and was told to put us in a certain room number so we went there and the room was smaller but that's okay, there are only 2 of us and we still had a great strip view.  2 days into our stay, we came back from the pool and the door would not open.  The latch that flips across the door was closed somehow and Engineering had to come open it.  He had a "tool" to open it so this must be a common issue.  Later that night when we returned to the room, a staff member was coming out of our door.  We asked her what she was doing and she brushed us off saying we were "VIP" guests so she was doing an inspection and quickly walked away.  Please note there was no other evidence or mention of a "VIP status" the entire stay and the room smelled strongly of perfume when we entered as if it had just been sprayed.  The following day, we returned from brunch around 2 and a male employee was directly outside our room, walking away.  The sink drains had been closed (we were unable to open them), water was slowly running in one sink (more than a drip), 2 garbages were still full but we had new towels and the bed had been made.  We were both feeling poorly so we climbed in bed and did not report the water/garbage issues.  We left early the next morning.  Stay was good overall, but the housekeeping situation was very odd.

allReviews.title: You won't regret staying here!
allReviews.text: Beautiful and very spacious rooms.  Excellent views with a whole wall of windows to see that view from.  An amazing giant tub 2 people could fit in, might need a step to to get in and out of lol.  Probably the most comfortable hotel bed I have ever slept in.

allReviews.title: Very nice place to be in vacation with your friends and family
allReviews.text: This place is awesome. I will recommend this place to my friends and family. They have good drinks good comps it’s a must go! Also the view is beautiful restroom super clean my room had a tub and a shower. The housekeeping is awesome there they clean up with the room. Every day!

allReviews.title: Couples trip
allReviews.text: We only stayed 1 night at this beautiful hotel and my only regret was that we didn't stay longer. From the minute we walked through the door, the customer service was faultless. At check in, we were given 2 bottles of water each, without us having to ask.Our stunning room on the 33rd floor had a spectacular view. The room was spotlessly clean, super comfy bed and was finely appointed and decorated. Unfortunately, I didn't get a chance to enjoy the super deep soaking tub but we did enjoy an hour or 2 at the beautiful pool. Breakfast at Vida the next morning was outstanding and I would stay at this gorgeous hotel again in a heartbeat 💓 💗

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort!
allReviews.text: This was my second visit to Fontainebleau this year. I love it there!  It is a beautiful resort. The vibe is unmatched.  The decor is glamorous yet modern. The service was fantastic and the restaurants and bars are all amazing.  They even have live jazz and a piano player.  There’s something for everyone.  It is spacious and open which is nice and makes it feel more comfortable than other resorts on the strip.  The pool area is beautiful as well.  I will definitely be going back soon!

allReviews.title: Short stay
allReviews.text: This was a short stay for us 3 adults and 1 teenager. Everything was as it was described. Hotel rooms were clean with good housekeeping. Good location smooth checking and out.

allReviews.title: Service above and beyond!
allReviews.text: Arrived at Trump International on a Saturday night. Quickly greeted by Nick in valet who handled my valet.  Kevin was there to greet me and offer to bring my bags up to my room.  My adventure begins. I check in and was given an upgraded room on a high floor.  Passing through security on my way to room only one of the key cards worked, no problem I was going to head back down to meet a friend.  The bellman was on the elevator with me, we arrived at room and neither key card worked. He quickly called security, and they arrived immediately.  Within a couple of minutes in the room, I received a call from Nick in valet.  My rental car would not start, strange the car was a 2025.  I went downstairs to meet my friend and check on car at valet. Nick asked me to call rental car company for a tow and not to worry about the car he would handle getting it loaded when truck arrived.  If you have to have a car break down, be sure to do it at a 5* hotel where they offer to handle everything and send me on my way.  Tow truck company called upon arrival, and I couldn't help but go out to valet. Kevin who handled my bags was there and we joked about this big flat bed truck navigating valet.  I couldn't help but laugh that within 10 minutes of arriving at hotel 5-6 employees knew me by name. All through my 5 day stay they greeted me and we would joke about my car not starting. My room was very comfortable as was the bed, couch and chairs. Plenty of room in the nice size bathroom.  Housekeeping came each day and took care of room. As a woman traveling alone, I felt very safe with someone greeting me each time I arrived back at the hotel.I couldn't ask for a nicer stay.  I do have to do a shout out for Nick and Kevin who handled my car situation amazingly and greeted me each time I arrived or left the hotel.  As well as all the security people I encountered.  I will be back next time I travel to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Horrible water - all hot no cold
allReviews.text: I got  3 night stay for $199, if I listened to Hilton Grand Reward Vacations time share   I said sure, never been to Vegas and took the bait. Hilton said only availability was Trump Hotel. They told us ot was a king size bed with kitchen teeth, sounded great!When we arrived they told us to room service, but if we needed something call.Room was on 34th floor and when we arrived it was a suite. Looked amazing with 2 bathrooms, 2 showers and a tub, and a full kitchen, overall we were happy and excited until...We used the water for a bath in the master bathroom in the jacuzzi tub.  It filled fine and we were enjoying it, but wanted some more cold water...there was none. Cold faucet ONLY produced HOT water. I tried, my boyfriend tried. The sink did the same.  We go to bed it was late and I use the master bath toilet in the middle of the night, weird the bowel feels hot.  Day 2 boyfriend uses shower seems fine although toilet it hot again. We gone al.ost all day a d arrive back to sleep. No shower that night.  We go to use shower on the 3rd day, scalding hot no matter what, toilet bowl hot and sink water.  Thankfully the 2nd bathroom seemed fine that was a showered only.I was thinking the pipes were just crossed and thankful for the 2nd shower. We left on the 3rd day complained and they told us they never had anyone complain about that before.  Well the whole thing really bothered me so I went online after getting home....sure enough a couple other complaints online about the SAME DAMB thing. This is a lawsuit waiting to happen.I would NEVER recommend this hotel to anyone. Yes the room looked amazing and we got a great price but at a cost. However, they have a major problem with the water.  Either all hot or all cold.

allReviews.title: Another great stay
allReviews.text: 2nd stay at Trump Hotel in Vegas. Like this hotel as it's non smoking. Massive rooms. Bed & pillows really comfy. Room was cleaned daily. Good location,  just a short walk down to the main strip. Staff really friendly & helpful. Reasonable prices. Would definately stay again

allReviews.title: A clean, well-lighted hotel -- with friendly service and good food
allReviews.text: We expected garish decor, but this hotel is tastefully designed and decorated, with muted off-white colors in the lobby. Our room was spacious and comfortable. Staff were polite and helpful. The steakhouse restaurant, though not inexpensive, served excellent food, and the breakfast was delicious. Valet parking was efficiently run. The location across from a shopping mall is convenient. This is a well-run hotel.

allReviews.title: W Trump
allReviews.text: Shiny, extravagant, spotless. I’d expect nothing less from Trump. 5 star experience done in a way only Trump properties can. Honestly it’s a great spot for families because there’s no casino.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel was excellent. Service was excellent. Location is an easy 30 minute walk to the Sphere. It is across from the mall.

allReviews.title: Great place, location, service
allReviews.text: Room service kept room clean, all the staff were very kind and helpful, spacious room near the Fashion Show Mall and the strip

allReviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL WITHOUT CROWD OF THE CASINOS
allReviews.text: The location is excellent, the room is large and very comfortable. The pool is nice. Good service. I missed having a lounge in the lobby.

allReviews.title: Just perfect!
allReviews.text: The stay at the hotel was really nice! The room was clean and cozy, the staff very friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel was also perfect. Overall a very pleasant stay.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The hotel is extremely well located, has a square in front, and is walking distance from theme hotels. Very clean and luxurious. The room is large and very complete. The staff is very friendly. Breakfast at an affordable price just like the restaurant. 10/10 in security. I'd come back.

allReviews.title: Room was great. Check in and Breakfast service took way too long!
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this property before. I really like the fact that it doesn’t have a casino and is conveniently located. However on this visit, check-in took 45 minutes due to a long line and lack of staff. The next day I had breakfast in the lobby restaurant. Service was also painfully slow due to insufficient wait staff. On the bright side, I really enjoyed my room. The quality of the bed , pillows, linens furnishings etc was excellent.

allReviews.title: Amazing Folks Representing the Brand,,,, BUT
allReviews.text: The people working at this location are amazing!Valet parking is included but PLEASE TIP THEM.  They do an amazing job taking vehicle and getting it when needed.Enjoyed not having casino on the propertyTrain tracks 500 yards from the property so check your room location...  Rooms on 16th floor have the lights, illuminating the entire structure, just a few feet below the windows so have NO expectation on having a room dark at night. Could read in ours after even using hangers to fasten curtains.Elevators are amazingly fast!Small bar in lobby at night. We were literally the last customers at the pool bar for this season so you needs to walk/drive to other locations to get a drink.STILL advertised the jetted tubs have been shut off in all rooms.View on side of sphere is cool. Other side.... not so much.The folks working here are very polite and professional.HUGE mall across the street and Las Vegas Blvd isn't too far to walk.  If you want fufu coffee good luck. Nice folks at the lobby coffee bar are kind but black coffee only. and $7.50 a cup.Bring a sharp knife if you think you will need to cut something and don't count on the ice maker in the fridge working. Each floor is supposed to have an ice machine. Didn't try restaurant or room service...Would suggest that you do DO NOT OPEN door to built in combination washer/dryer. Apparently not used much and extremely funky. Apparently no rules against "hitting the hay" outside entrance so don't be surprised.Saw lots of pets which is very cool.In spite of the positive engagement with the folks, we will look for another place to stay when in town.BTW:  if traveling between Oct and Nov 2025, reconsider your plans unless you don't mind screwed up traffic and blocked streets.  Getting ready for F1 race and it's a frigging mess!!!!!

allReviews.title: Nice.
allReviews.text: Mixed views on this hotel. The service is definitely NOT 5 star. We had a room on the train track side and the noise from the horn of the freight train  woke us three times.  The manager David promises things and then front desk try to wriggle out of what he promised.  He’s then suddenly “not available” or “in a meeting for the rest of the morning.”  Funny that when I literally could see him at front desk two minutes later. Lying and hiding  from guests is not a good look David. Anyway that aside after delays with room change and the rudeness of front desk they did eventually comp my resort fees but I had to fight for it.  They don’t like being told when things aren’t right and accuse you of “coming at them and making them feel uncomfortable”.  Complete nonsense - I was completely polite and calm but this is their way of deflecting. The room we were moved to was better. We were not woken by train noise so make sure you ask for a room strip side.   Rooms are well appointed.  Note that they have turned off the whirlpools on the bathroom so they don’t work. Not sure why - maybe they caused problems.    Didn’t matter - the bath was huge and lovely.  The shower is a proper powerful drench shower. Really nice high end toiletries in the bathrooms. Really liked that you had a mini kitchenette with coffee machine, complementary fridge, microwave.  Beds and pillows and linen were incredibly comfortable!   It’s quite a walk to the strip but good to get your steps in!

allReviews.title: Fabulous Corner Suite!
allReviews.text: The room was top notch in every way. We booked a corner suite and the views from the 46th floor were fabulous! It was a surprise that we had two bathrooms. The suite was absolutely huge. Loved every minute there.It was also so nice that it didn't have a casino and was nonsmoking. After walking through a couple other Vegas hotels, we were SO happy we had decided to stay at Trump International!It should be considered a business hotel rather than a resort. The pool is pretty but basic (and was not open in the evenings when we were there). The spa was closed half the week. The restaurant was fine for breakfast, but glad we went elsewhere for dinner since it's located right in the lobby and kind of noisy.Complimentary valet parking was nice but there was quite a long wait when all the guests checked out at the same time. The valet workers were running and did a great job, but it was not a luxury experience to be waiting wihle with crowds on the curb for our vehicle to appear. If we went back to Las Vegas, we would love to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Have water with you. The hikes are long and remember that Las Vegas is in a desert.
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the Trump Hotel on 2 occasions and both have been very satisfactory.Compared to the other 5 stars this is a very good price being an excellent choice for value for money.There is no casino, so you will find a much more relaxed Mood. It is a discreet luxury and the reference images that are put online are very faithful to what you will find there.The staff is very friendly and willing to help you. several speak Spanish, but those who still won't find a way to give you what you need.Spacious rooms, very comfortable bed, with kitchen and refrigerator, large bathrooms with double sink and bathtub for two people. It doesn’t offer a Jacuzzi anymore, but you’ll still enjoy a nice dip after long walks on the Strip.If you get a room on high floors facing the Strip, you will have another show there. The sphere itself is one that is active 24 hours.The location is correct, 500 meters walk from the Strip and in front of the Fashion Show Mall, which is the largest in the city.It also has free Valet Parking (very comfortable).

allReviews.title: Great Spot Just Off The Strip
allReviews.text: Trump offers great accommodations just slightly off the strip.  Without a casino, it is nice and quiet, but the rooms have a full kitchen which is great, and the restaurant is excellent.

allReviews.title: A good alternative in LV  but not 5 star
allReviews.text: We have just returned from a stay at Las Vegas Trump hotel. I chose it for a number of reasons. The price was ok. It is a non casino resort and is located off the Strip but is a 5 minute walk away. Check in was smooth and the front desk.staff were friendly and helpful. We opted for a high floor ( 51 ) with a mountain view.The room itself appeared a little dated ie old tech tv and no usb sockets. On the plus side the bed was very comfy and we made use of the kitchen facilities for our breakfast requirements. We didn’t eat at the restaurant but after chatting to other guests we were told the food was good but expensive. The pool area was a lovely place to chill and not crazy  like many other LV pool areas. Located across the road from the front entrance is a decent shopping mall which was very useful.

allReviews.title: Incredible hotel
allReviews.text: Great Hotel.  No Complaints.  Perfect hotel, wonderfull location!  Staff was there for everything we needed.

allReviews.title: Great, clean. Big poll
allReviews.text: Great Service big pool, great gym.all people are nice and normal. only valet parking, sometimes long wait until you can drop the key

allReviews.title: First time staying at this resort and overall experience is very good
allReviews.text: Room is spacious and comfortable. Living room sofa is a bit uncomfortable. Location is not the best as it is further away from Vegas strip. Staff is friendly. I would stay here again if I want a quieter place overnight, but if I want to be clsoe to shops and entertainment I would choose another resort.

allReviews.title: Fabulous!
allReviews.text: Amazing!Amazing!amazing!Everything was perfect:location, pool, rooms(amazing view), staff so friendly and accommodating.  The hotel is beautiful a clean, luxurious atmosphere.

allReviews.title: WOW
allReviews.text: WOW.Nothing really to say. There are all the comforts, large rooms, clean and sanitized daily, free valet Service, attentive staff to any need. Absolutely the best stay of our trip to the USA.Extra point for the fact that the hotel is has two steps from the Strip and does not have Casino inside.. which makes it quiet and even more exceptional

allReviews.title: TRUMP TOWER AN AMAZING EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: Staying at Trump  Tower has always been on my bucket list.  It did not disappoint.  From the valet upon arriving to the check out process, everything was perfect.  The staff is incredible, everyone went out of their way to make our experience wonderful.I love the smoke free environment and the upscale class .  The room was amazing!!We will be back!

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel and room
allReviews.text: Please know that there is no maid service. They did bring fresh towels when we called, but they do not even empty the trash cans or make the beds.

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort,
allReviews.text: Everything is top notch. True Trump fashion. The restaurant was delicious, prices were fair ( a little pricey for breakfast ). Close enough to the strip to walk. Directly across from fashion show mall, which is huge. Plenty to do, staff couldn’t be nicer. A really great resort!

allReviews.title: Perfect hotel
allReviews.text: Very good hotel. Very clean with perfect service. Really close from Strip. No casino inside so quite calm inside. Recommended

allReviews.title: Never forget something in your room
allReviews.text: Beautiful room beautiful bedding But forget nothing I forgot my IPad and despite several calls and specifying that the app of Apple location located it in their establishment it remained untraceable

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: Reasonable priceGood atmosphere and serviceRooms were cleanGood locationShopping mall right oppositeNot exactly on the Vegas strip though and no entertainment on offer

allReviews.title: Not good.
allReviews.text: Not as good as my last visit in 2017.    The TV was a mess - it was installed with some fancy (that means problems!) extendable arm that does not secure the TV properly, so it can rest on the base which has control buttons that are depressed or activated.  First afternoon they sent unqualified housekeeping staff come in to fix and didn't work and said they would get maintenance who didnt arrive.  Eventually he figured it out.  Secondly, the whirlpool bath (which I wanted to use) was broken.  They need to up their game for this level of Hotel.

allReviews.title: Canadians first time Vegas stay
allReviews.text: This hotel was the best ! So quiet st night didnt smell like an ash tray like the rest of them we walked through and no casino was amazing to keep it quiet. Best staff. We would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great hotel whilst in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great hotel, short walk to the wonderful Las Vegas strip. Fantastic room with more than you'll require. Lovely staff,  fantastic pool area with all facilities. Would definitely choose this hotel again for my next visit.

allReviews.title: QUIET HOTEL STEPS FROM STRIP
allReviews.text: To begin with this is not the typical Hotel and Casino, apparently some problem of compatibility between gambling and politics allowed Trump to build his luxury hotel but did not allow him a casino inside, therefore this is an excellent hotel without the bustle of hotels that have casino. The location is very good, almost at the end of the strip, facing the Venetian and Treasure Island. One of the amenities of this 60-story hotel is that it has at least 10 large elevators, which are divided by floor sectors. There are 3 that only go from the lobby to the 12th floor, then another 3 that go from the 13th to the 18th floor and so on. I was staying on the 58th floor so the elevators I took climbed dizzyingly to the 54th floor without stops and from there only stops on the floors to the 64th, this prevents crowding and makes you get much faster to the upper floors. The rooms are spacious and feature living and a kitchen area with stoves, fridge, coffee maker, electric kettle and microwave oven, the king beds are super comfortable and the bathroom is a luxury, with toilet and shower in separate cabinets, two pools on a large table and a jacuzzi, I stayed in room 5809 which overlooked the sphere. Complimentary bottles of water are being offered all the time and in the pool area, towels are available in bulk. It is also important to note that in the lobby we always find some employee who spoke Spanish, the wifi works wonderfully, it also has a restaurant where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner, but this is not included in the reservation.

allReviews.title: I'd come back 1000 times
allReviews.text: Excellent in all respects.Enormous apartment with mini kitchen structure, wonderful bathroom with shower and bathtub.Location near Fashion Mall. Free parking!!!

allReviews.title: Friendly staff, but room for improvement
allReviews.text: Large, clean and quiet rooms with kitchenette, ideal for relaxing away from the casino noise. Friendly staff and good Price quality ratio convince. Slightly off the Strip, with sometimes long waits at the valet and occasionally inconsistent cleaning.

allReviews.title: Perfect hotel, highly recommend
allReviews.text: Hotel without casino, which to me is positive, safe, beautiful, fast and free maneuvering Service, impeccable room, clean every day, if you need any kitchen items, just request by phone that deliver in the room quickly.   Near the Strip, it's away from the mess, with an excellent shopping front.    I recommend!

allReviews.title: Great experience!

allReviews.title: Good location, great value
allReviews.text: Used points to get a great room.  Location was more convenient than we expected.  Walked back from concert at the sphere that wasn’t bad at all.  Very close to Wynn, Encore and Venetian.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel

allReviews.title: good experience

allReviews.title: Gteat location and food.
allReviews.text: Off the strip but very neat to it, which was very nice as it was quieter and less foot traffic. Beautiful property and services were as advertised and worth every penny. Can't wait to return..

allReviews.title: We Loved Our Stay!
allReviews.text: We LOVED our suite and the housekeeping services were very efficient! Our front desk clerk (Ms. Yazzy) was very friendly and welcoming as well!!!However, you'll need patience with the valet services...

allReviews.title: Elegance in Vegas
allReviews.text: Elegance in Vegas I think that the place was surprisingly awesome. I would go back here again. I liked the fact there was no resort fee and no cost to park

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel with great amenities
allReviews.text: Recently stayed at the Trump International Hotel in August 2025. The weather was great and not too extreme (hot) as expected. It actually rained on a couple of days we were here. The hotel was an excellent pick as it was located very close to the Fashion Outlet Mall, within walking distance. Access the strip was very easy as well . The rooms at the hotel were very clean and spacious. I was located on the 29th floor and an excellent view of the Sphere and the Venetian hotel. There weren't any issues with the house keeping which showed up on the 5th days we were here. I would definately stay at this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Three Stars masked in High Profile Brand
allReviews.text: Pool was murky and way too warm. Room looked like a Hampton Inn- not cleaned to five star standards.  It's embarrassing to see his name on the top of something so awfully average. Really wanted to love it, but the view of Vegas's slums, porn industry and dispensaries didn't do it for us. I can only imagine the folk leaving a five star review have never actually been to a five star hotel in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Trump Hotel
allReviews.text: The Trump hotel is an absolute peak of comfort and luxury. The whole visit there, even though short, was pleasant, comfortable and unforgettable. The views from the rooms are definitely one of the best in Las Vegas and the beds are highest quality. One of the most impressive things in the hotel is definitely the restaurant, looks terrific and the food is great as well.

allReviews.title: A dream night
allReviews.text: Returning from Page with 5 hours of travel I had booked a top hotel for the last night in Las VegasI found a fabulous room with a huge whirlpool shower room spacious scrambled room, very kind staff we were received by a very friendly manager. My daughter particularly enjoyed the pool. Everything runs like a perfect machine: Congratulations everyone!

allReviews.title: Great Location and Bright comfortable stay
allReviews.text: A great location with easy access to Vegas Strip and a stone throw away from a nice fashion mall.  Spacious rooms, full kitchen and a very clean pool.  I would highly recommend the hotel.

allReviews.title: Decent - but bit of a walk to strip
allReviews.text: Very well facilitated gymNo cutlery in the room.Breakfast Room service was very quick  - delivered within 5mins of ordering. Pool towels provided. Water station at the pool area for nice chilled water.

allReviews.title: Trump Las Vegas: More Carnival Cruise Than Luxury Hotel
allReviews.text: Let me begin by saying that as a proud Trump Card member, I actively seek opportunities to stay at Trump hotels and have always been treated exceptionally well, until this trip. On this trip, I booked two rooms and traveled with friends to celebrate my wife’s recent retirement, selecting Trump Las Vegas specifically because of the high standards we’ve experienced at other Trump properties. Sadly, this stay fell far short. We arrived at 2 PM to find the valet and drive-in area completely jammed. It took 10–15 minutes just to drop off our car, and we were told it was due to understaffing. Thankfully, the bellman was excellent, he took our luggage promptly and met us at our room as promised. Check-in was smooth, and the young woman assisting us kindly arranged a suite upgrade for only $50 more per night. The room itself was beautiful, with a fantastic view.Unfortunately, the atmosphere quickly soured. Each day felt busier than the last, and the clientele became increasingly loud and boisterous to the point it felt more like a Carnival cruise than a luxury hotel. This is not the refined environment we’ve experienced at other Trump properties.The valet situation was especially frustrating. We were told we could not call ahead for our car, and the “summon” feature in the app had been disabled, again, due to understaffing. Each time, we waited nearly 20 minutes for our vehicle. Completely unacceptable for a property of this caliber.While I look forward to visiting other Trump hotels in the future, I will not return to the Las Vegas location. I could have received better service at the Wynn, Four Seasons, or other nearby high-end hotels. I have always said that although I don’t have a billion dollars, Trump hotels make me feel as though I do. I sincerely hope that remains true at other locations, because it was not the case here.

allReviews.title: Best in town
allReviews.text: Great hotel, service and facilities. Not your typical casino circus hotel. Free parking which is rare enough to be mentioned. Next to a modern mall with a (real) pool and gym.

allReviews.title: Review for Trump International Las Vegas – Pool Team & Lifeguard Liv Bawek
allReviews.text: Review for Trump International Las Vegas – Pool Team & Lifeguard Liv BawekMy wife and I always enjoy our time at the Trump International pool, and it’s because the team here is truly exceptional. Every staff member is warm, friendly, and engaging—always greeting guests with a genuine smile and making everyone feel welcome.One lifeguard in particular, Liv Bawek, stands out. We look forward to seeing her and the rest of the wonderful pool team on every visit.

allReviews.title: Elegant setting, attentive Service
allReviews.text: The property is very elegant and the atmosphere more refined than other facilities in Las Vegas, the attention to guests is in line with the category. The rooms are very spacious and clean, the huge bathrooms with fine finishes even if today can be considered a bit 'dated. The hotel is not located on the Strip but still remains in a good location. The Sphere was clearly visible from the room.

allReviews.title: You need to read this
allReviews.text: The stay started out amazing in the beginning… last day was horrible. I saw the true colors of the staff. allReviews.title: Terrible service and a waste of money.  I won’t be back.
allReviews.text: This hotel has no food service or room service upstairs. The swimming pool closes at 8 PM. Valet is mandatory and it’s slow as hell and the pool is really small and not much to it. allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Check in was a nightmare. All I asked was a hipper floor facing the strip if it is available and possible. I was told yes but to wait a bit. We did not mind waiting, however if they have changed their minds, they should have let us know instead of telling us up till 4:30 pm from 8:30am that the room is not ready. Everyone we tried approaching them on the front desk, they all just walk away. We eventually requested for any room even if it is located close to the toilet. Magically, a room became available, it was around 4:30 pm. They were saying we are Hilton guest therefore check goes from 4 pm all the way to midnight. We never asked for any preferential treatment. We just needed someone to be honest and tell us from the beginning that upper floor facing the strip cannot be reserved for us and we will wait till whenever they decide to check us in. It was my third time in this hotel and check in has always been a breeze and they were always kind. This time this was not the case. Anyway, I will definitely stay again.
We walked from the Fashion Show shopping mall by the Strip. We found the hotel beautiful with an understated elegance. Restaurant/bar was simple yet elegant.

allReviews.title: TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: We stayed at this hotel from 8 to 12 July. Even before our accommodation we had a bad assistance, we contacted them to ask if it was possible to bring forward the departure by a day but they never responded, either by e-mail or by chat integrated with the platform on which we ordered.Upon our arrival we noticed that the refrigerator inside our room froze food, we contacted them to ask for support but we were only granted it after 2 hours.On July 11th we asked the Hotel staff if it was possible to clean our room while we went to the pool. On our return the room had been cleaned but there was missing an envelope in the bathroom that contained our dirty clothes. We immediately went to the Reception where, however, we did not receive the necessary assistance. Mr. and Mrs. Fernando Oliva (assistant front Office manager), April Jackson and the person in charge of security promised us that they would solve the problem even remotely promising us the discovery of the envelope or the refund of the value of the clothes that amounted to about 500 euros as, as we listed, it contained the change for 4 days of 4 people and all branded.We left with these promises and when we returned to Italy no one was heard from, we sent several emails to which we received only two replies, the first where they claimed that they were still carrying out checks, the second, today, where they wrote that it is not their responsibility as nothing can be seen on the cameras and they did not find their clothes. I state that to clean the rooms they enter with cleaning carts in the rooms where there are no cameras! Luckily we had stored the valuables such as watches, money and documents inside the safe.So, not only have we been made fun of but we will never get our clothes back and we will never get a refund to buy them back! I recommend the Trump for the cleanliness and beauty of the structure but be careful, any person you meet who works in this Hotel will never be able to solve problems of any nature!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel, But Parking Needs Serious Improvement
allReviews.text: This is the first time I’m not giving this hotel a 5-star rating. The room was super clean and spacious as always, and the staff were great — no complaints there. I've stayed here many times and usually take an Uber, but this time I rented a car and ran into a major issue: parking.The hotel only offers valet parking, which is complimentary — a nice perk — but it quickly becomes a problem during busy times. At checkout, everyone is leaving around the same time, and the valet service gets overwhelmed. It took over 30 minutes to get my car, and there’s just not enough space for all the vehicles to come through efficiently.The valet staff are clearly working hard, but the system itself isn’t working. The hotel really needs a better solution for handling parking, especially during peak checkout times.

allReviews.title: Trump delivers again
allReviews.text: This was so wonderful!!  We had so much fun. The beds are so comfy and we especially like not having a casino to get lost in. They need to redo the poo area. Very hot surface and need ambiance

allReviews.title: Beautiful Property
allReviews.text: The room was very spacious, bedding was comfortable and everything on the property was very clean. You can't walk ten feet thru the lobby without encountering an employee eager to help you should you need. The DJT restaurant has an outstanding staff, food is average. The front desk personnel are very eager to help with any questions or concerns you may have. The valets might quite possibly be the hardest workers in the place, since there isn't a self park option (valet is free) you are at their mercy to get your vehicle and that can take a bit during their peak hours but they are obviously working their tails off so its hard to get frustrated by a 15-20 minute wait...just plan for it.

allReviews.title: Diamond in the Ruff
allReviews.text: This was my very first time being in Vegas and I thought I by me choosing to stay here would have been the least of my worries. I won't trash this hotels name or value.i mean the rooms are beautiful ...But if it had not been for Fernando and the other guy management, my stay would have been terrible. So thank you Mr Fernando for making my stay as comfortable as possible...  I will never forget your kindness and patience... I won't be back there but if and when I do come back I will stop by and say hi...

allReviews.title: Great location.  Clean, quiet & smoke-free.  Great bar.
allReviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located just off the Strip with a short walk to the casinos and the main hub of Las Vegas.  As it's a hotel not a casino, it was not super crowded and there was no smoke, so this was a huge bonus for us.  When we arrived, we were offered a room on the floor of our choice and we chose 54, so the view was amazing.  Our room was big, with a small kitchenette (including microwave) and a huge bathroom.  We really appreciated the bar and the restaurant downstairs and enjoyed a meal and a few drinks sitting at the bar, being served by a first-class bar tender.  We were able to take our leftover dinner to the room and heat it up for lunch the next day.In terms of things that could have been improved - the shower temperature was not hot enough, in our opinion, and it took 5 minutes of running the shower for the warm water to come through.  No tea was provided in the room, so we bought a tea & coffee in the hotel which was super expensive (US$15).  We brought wine glasses up from the bar and they were not removed by housekeeping when the room was cleaned so these sat on the kitchenette counter until we left.  That said, these were minor annoyances, and we would likely stay here again if we returned to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Top notch stay.
allReviews.text: Top of the line service!! Upon arrival I tried to grab my bag out of the trunk but a bell hop was immediately by my side saying he would be taking everything upstairs to our room and that all cars receive valet parking. Everything was immaculate and the stuff was unbelievably organized.  This was such a top notch experience for all of us.  The pool was clean and pool staff were vigilant and friendly. Definitely recommend this smoke free and safe resort.

allReviews.title: The trump hotel
allReviews.text: The Trump Hotel is a lovely hotel, clean and friendly. Our hotel room was clean and tidy and cleaned and restocked everyday of pur trip. There is a restaurant and in the morning there is a smaller takeaway area for breakfast items which was a takeaway service, it was quite expensive but the food was goodWe were disappointed to not be able to sit at the bar and enjoy a drink as this is apparently not on option. We ended up going to a bar around the corner, which we would highly recommend called The Happy Camper.The concierge was good and they offered transport services if they weren't overwhelmed with other jobs. The trump hotel is one of the only hotels without a casino, which was a nice touch for us.

allReviews.title: AMAZING…BEAUTIFUL AND ROYAL STAFF
allReviews.text: Beautiful Luxury Hotel with a Phenomenal Staff… it the Staff that creates the Magic at a Hotel and the Trump Staff exceeds expectations and goes the extra distance with smiles, respect and sweet personalities.
