allReviews.title: Worth it!
allReviews.text: Stayed 3 nights in late April. Check in, DJT and pool fabulous. Miguel at the desk was very helpful. Ernest was great at the pool and for breakfast. DJT was good for any meal. The pool was great and Calen was very helpful

allReviews.title: Elegance and tranquility just steps from the Strip
allReviews.text: We stayed for two nights at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas and the experience was overall very positive. The structure stands out for elegance and tranquility: a well-kept, orderly and, above all, quiet environment. It is ideal for those who want to rest away from the noise and chaos of the Strip, while remaining minutes from everything.The rooms are spacious and bright, with large windows overlooking the city. The interior layout, although in part it seems adapted – some elements of the furniture show a certain modularity – still remains pleasant and well finished. The style is sober, functional, but with a touch of class.The bathroom is one of the highlights: spacious, finished in marble, equipped with a comfortable whirlpool bath, a spacious shower and a double sink with golden mirror. A really comfortable environment, designed for relaxation.The common areas are also well-kept and welcoming. The staff is friendly, helpful, and the lobby atmosphere is elegant and relaxed.However, there is a significant flaw: the hotel bar closes at 10pm. In a city like Las Vegas, where nightlife is an integral part of the experience, being back and not being able to order even a drink was a pretty disappointing limit. A detail that, for a hotel of this level, weighs more than you might think.

allReviews.title: Great stay in a great location
allReviews.text: Trump Towers offers a clean, stylish, and relaxing stay. The rooms are fantastic — spacious, comfortable, and well-appointed. Service throughout the hotel was excellent, and the food was very good.The bar service was a little slow at times, but the overall experience more than made up for it. The location is excellent, and the lack of a casino gives the hotel a more peaceful, laid-back feel compared to others in the area.The pool and gym facilities are also very good. A great choice if you’re looking for a more relaxed luxury stay.

allReviews.title: Luxury and Comfort at Trump's Hotel in LV 💸
allReviews.text: My family and I booked an apartment at Trump's Las Vegas for one week: One of the best experiences ever made! Perfect location in the heart of LV, great views and a fantastic pool awaits you. Recommended for families before the hot summer days. 😎

allReviews.title: Unbelievably Bad Experience
allReviews.text: Wow, my wife and I just had an unbelievably bad experience at Trump International Hotel. We booked our hotel room one month in advance excited for our first experience at Trump's hotel. Our flight got in around 8 p.m. and we arrived to the hotel at around 9:00 p.m. As we got in the "check-in" line, we noticed that the people at the check-in counters we having a hard time checking in.When it was our turn to check-in, we approached the counter and Desiree greeted us. Initially it sounded promising, but within a minute Desiree let us know that our "room was not available" and that there was no definitive time frame for when it would be available. After asking her what was going on, she said that while our check in time is 3:00 p.m. that does not ensure that a room will be available to us (even though it was 9:45 p.m. at this point). She then told us sarcastically that she could cancel our room at no charge and that we could go find somewhere else to stay if we like. After asking what was going on and when our room would be ready, Desiree became upset and called security over.We asked to speak to a manager - Fernando - who was already speaking to another couple who was going through the same experience. When he came to us he let us know that the rooms were not available and that they may not be ready until after midnight. In fact, other people had been waiting over 5 hours for their rooms. Fernando then explained that Korean Air had a conference there and had done an ultra late checkout on a lot of its rooms and that the contract with Korean Air was more important to the Hotel than any of the customers that were now without a room. When pressing Fernando on how that was possible, it became evident that despite knowing about this request for late checkout by Korean Air personnel in advance, Trump Hotel and its staff did nothing to notify any of its impacted incoming guests that their rooms would not be available for them to stay in and that they would not be doing anything to try to help their guests. So, were were told we were guest number 15 in line to get a room with no rooms currently available.To add insult to injury, there was no effort to apologize or to make things right except for a $50 food voucher. The approach to the situation was abysmal leaving many people without anywhere to stay late at night despite having reservations. And they didn't really care.I was looking forward to supporting a DJT establishment, but this was worse than bad.

allReviews.title: In decline, but decent as a business traveler
allReviews.text: This is my go-to hotel in Las Vegas, but it's clearly suffering -- room rates during the week and weekend are pretty low, staffing levels are far below what they'd normally be (thus long waits for various things), and rooms have been put on a program of managed decline -- the "jacuzzi tubs" are being turned into "soaking tubs" by no longer maintaining them when they break, other maintenance is being rationed, etc.The hotel still has a lot of good things about it -- being a non-casino hotel, it's a lot less annoying as a guest, and the rooms are basically condo/apartments (especially the suites) with a great refrigerator, microwave, oven/stove, and dishwasher.  However, the cutbacks over the years, and the areas where the property has always been weak (Food and Beverage, especially) make it not a particularly "fun" place.  It's good as a business traveler and someone with a car, especially if you're going to conferences at nearby properties/convention centers, but it's not really a place I'd go for the "Vegas Experience".

allReviews.title: Excellent Quiet Vacation
allReviews.text: The many associates were very professional. They assisted even with my wheelchair and made sure we were guided in safely. The building was beautiful, inside and out.  Housekeeping was superior to many hotels we have visited. The one maid for our room was very kind as well as quick with the work. The room was kept superbly clean. Loved the wheelchair accessible bathroom.  So very quiet we were able to truly rest very well. Bed was excellent. Loved the recessed alcove greatly dampening any walking traffic in the hall. The only fly in the ointment, as it were, was the registration system is bugged. Efforts to register for a party of two (military couple) kept glitching, three times, to show only one person.  Hence the room was set for only one.  The housekeeping staff very quickly restocked our room for two people.  Other than that, I would recommend Trump International L. V.

allReviews.title: Deposits
allReviews.text: The hotel itself was amazing however, we were misled with poor communication from staff. When we got to the hotel, we had 3 rooms under a booking and paid 500$ deposit on each room. We was told that money we spent in the restaurant would be redeemable against all three rooms and we would only need to give one room number rather than spread it out across the three to make things easier. When we checked out, we were told as all the money was on one room that the money over the 500$ had to be paid extra rather than redeemed across the three rooms. This left us short of money in our accounts as the 1000$ deposit from the other two rooms was not back in our account for several days. I would have understood this policy however the fact we was told one thing to ‘make things easier’ and then when it came to it be misled was very disappoint. Whilst staff remained professional whist dealing with the issue, I can’t say they were too helpful about it.

allReviews.title: One week stay
allReviews.text: We love that it’s clean and quiet. A place to rest and recover from the busyness of the strip. Love the non smoking policy… love the gym and pool.. truly classy and elegant 🥰

allReviews.title: elegant and quiet place
allReviews.text: Nordstrom (mall) closer. Valet parking excellent service.  Trasportation free in luxury SUV Cadillac Escalade.

allReviews.title: Great experience!!
allReviews.text: My wife and I usually stay over at the Bellagio and while it is a very lovely hotel it was booked up on the day we needed to stay there, so we decided to give the Trump International Hotel a try and we were very happy with our choice. The DJT restaurant is absolutely stellar. We tried numerous things on the menu, but I must say that the Filet mignon is an absolute must do. We stayed on the 54Th floor with a strip view. We’ve stayed in many beautiful hotels in Vegas over the years, but none with a more beautiful view. The room was gorgeous in every aspect. There was a lot of attention to detail when this hotel was built and it really shows. Subzero refrigerator, a small stove top and kitchen sink were in the room all of the cabinets were self closing and the Bathroom was exquisitely decorated. I was impressed that although we were on the 54Th floor the water pressure was really good. The bed was very comfortable and we were able to get a good nights sleep. The hotel doesn’t have a casino in it but this actually has an advantage to it the check in and out is very easy because you don’t find yourself trucking through a mile of slot machines before you can get to the front desk and it’s just as easy to get to your room without walking another mile through large crowds of people. The bottom line is if you’re looking to stay in a luxury hotel with friendly staff and fair prices this is the perfect place to stay.

allReviews.title: Very good
allReviews.text: I had a very worthwhile experience here. Although there were very few Koreans, I felt the class and respect for the country. The staff were very friendly and the service skills were the best. The staff were very friendly and the service skills were the best.

allReviews.title: AWESOME ACCOMMODATIONS, NEED FIRMER BEDS!
allReviews.text: Elegant suite. Spacious, bath n a half! Excellent accommodations, view and service.Our floors were OWNED by Hilton Hotels. There was a second couple with us. We were Hilton travelers, directed to Trump Hotel as Hilton had NO suites available. We wanted suites!  WE LOVED IT!One Problem- Mattress was SOFT! Our backs HURT! I slept on the sectional  sofa in the living area. No real rest for the 4 day stay. To have such GREAT amenities and not able to rest well..NOT!😪PLEASE get some decent, firm mattresses on those beds. I'd like to return THEN.Thank you for a great trip. We plan to return.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel
allReviews.text: Booked this hotel although it is not in LV strip. Room is having kitchen like space with microwave and sink. Utensils are not provided but it is sent to us after we called attache services.Bathroom is large with separate shower, bath tub and toilet. Bath tub with jet but didn't work, only until we soaked in a while, it suddenly turned on by itself. Gym room is big. Although I didn't get the chance  to use it but it is the reason we booked this hotel as it has 24-hour gym facility.Just a bit surprised that i heard quite clearly a train passed by from my 59th floor room at 11.36 night.Checked out is fast n easy through our in-room TV with all the charges. Receipt is sent to our email.

allReviews.title: Disappointing Experience and No Response from Management
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at Trump International Hotel Las Vegas (April 23–27, 2025), expecting a high standard of service. Unfortunately, our stay was marred by a series of issues:1. The jacuzzi was cold and unusable, with staff unable to resolve the problem even after another guest had already reported it and we waited an hour.2. Maintenance issues in our room (broken shower head, non-working drain stopper) were fixed, but housekeeping failed to service the room-no fresh towels or cleaning.3. Our Uber was unable to drop us at the entrance due to parking mismanagement, forcing my elderly mother to walk from the street.4. The master bathroom’s jetted tub-a selling point for booking-was inoperable, and only after purchasing bath supplies did we learn all jets are permanently disabled, with no prior disclosure.5. The shower in the second bedroom flooded. While maintenance responded quickly, our request for a one-hour late checkout to accommodate the disruption was denied, leaving us scrambling to leave on time.While some staff responded promptly to individual problems, the overall experience was a cascade of inconveniences, poor communication, and inflexibility. Most frustrating: after reaching out directly to management with these concerns, I have received no response or acknowledgment to date.Given the Trump brand’s reputation, this was a disappointing and stressful stay. Based on my experience and the lack of follow-up, I cannot recommend this property.My  review seems to be consistent with other guest complaints about unresolved issues and lack of communication from management at this property. :(

allReviews.title: One word is insane!!!
allReviews.text: We booked 5 rooms, and when I arrived at 16:30, they said the hotel was overbooked and the rooms would be delivered later. We thought you should upgrade at least one room to get one right away, and they had a staff who couldn’t even imagine it. We paid for this upgrade and just received one room. When I arrived around 8:30, they said that 1 room was more ready, but they couldn’t offer the other 3 rooms. An ignorant and relationship management zero night manager explained the situation and apologized that they would refund the nightly rate for these 3 rooms. 3. Have paid a Reservation to them We said this refund from party properties was unlikely and was not processed in the last w0 days. We didn’t have such a request from them yet, so we told them to give them the room. Said it would be ready at Q1 at night, uh, we went because we had it. When we arrived at 12 a.m., the rooms still weren’t available, and these 3 people were given a suit room at our request. This suite room didn’t make us happy, but there was nothing to do due to jetlag, so we had to stay in one room instead of 3 different rooms. Their staff is incredibly rude and ignorant. I’ll never even stand by trump hotel chains again.

allReviews.title: LUXURY ACCESSIBLE WITH PERFECT LOCATION
allReviews.text: Hotel level!Great location 5 minutes walk from the Strip, but away from noise and chaos.The gigantic room overlooking the sphere and the skyline.Extreme cleaning of both the room and the common areas.Free parking with attendants in front of the reception who pick up and return cars as needed (subject to a non-mandatory tip of even $ 1 / 2 )Impeccable facilities, beautiful reception and relaxed / very luxurious atmosphere.Excellent value for money taking into account that it is a 5 star with all suites (price considerably lower than hotels on the strip)

allReviews.title: Fabulous Hotel Stay & Housekeeping Service
allReviews.text: Fabulous hotel. Our housekeeping lady, Yattou who services our room when we are there is amazing. She cares so much about doing a good job and making our room perfect I have to say wow. Trump should never let her go, she is special. Always when we are staying at Trump International we request only Yattou to clean our room. Truly excellent service.

allReviews.title: Pleasant Stay in Sin City
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel.  Very close to the Fashion Mall.  This hotel has high quality finishes, a great restaurant, no casino to minimize noise and excellent location to the strip.  We definitely will be staying here again.  Highly recommend this hotel for any occasion.

allReviews.title: mentaince not done for room be be rented
allReviews.text: We checked into Room 5711 for a two-night stay. The next morning, I attempted to use the jacuzzi tub but found it wasn’t working. I contacted the front desk and was informed that the hotel had changed its amenities and the tub was no longer a functioning jacuzzi—it's now considered a "soaking tub." This change was not communicated at the time of booking, which was misleading and disappointing.On the second night, around 9 PM, the cold water supply suddenly stopped while my sister was in the shower. Her hair was shampooed and her body was fully wet when only scalding hot water remained. She had to jump out of the shower immediately, and her skin turned visibly red from the heat. It took her 10–15 minutes of applying ice packs to cool down.Even after 30 minutes, when the technician (Gilbert) arrived and ran the water, the cold supply had not returned. We were later told that some type of maintenance or repair was being performed. However, there was no advance warning about a cold water shutdown, which is completely unacceptable—especially in a hotel that advertises five-star service.I reported the incident to the manager on duty, Steven, who asked if I wanted to file a report with the security department. By that time, it was close to 11 PM, we had early plans the next morning, and my sister’s skin had stabilized, so we chose not to escalate further that night.This was, without a doubt, one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I've ever had. I hope management will take this incident seriously and implement better communication and safety protocols for future guests.

allReviews.title: This Hilton timeshare was fab!
allReviews.text: Luckily got a deal and would happily stay here again.  The only thing that made me nervous was the constant police presence.  All fees included so not nickeled and dimed.

allReviews.title: Lovely Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Trump was a beautiful place to escape in Vegas. The staff were all exceptional. Our view of the Sphere was spectacular. The restaurant and bar were very good. We were disappointed in the pool and hot tub. Thus the four star review rather than a five star review.

allReviews.title: The best hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Trump Hotel Las vegas is definitely the best option to stay if you want a high-end hotel and with the peace of mind that gives you no casino.This hotel is wonderful, located in what for me is the best area, opposite has a wonderful shopping , this hotel is meters from the strip without being on this which avoids you noise and see the worst of Vegas at night. The hotel itself is beautiful, reception, restaurant, floors, has a beautiful pool and excellent gym.In the mornings you have the option to buy your breakfast on the ground floor near the reception before entering the elevators.In my case I bought a deluxe room with a view of the city , what a wonderful room, spacious beautiful, comfortable and with a view that took your breath away on a 46th floor, had a kitchen, microwave and refrigerator, we ordered the utensils to be able to breakfast in the room as they give you an exquisite complimentary coffee.The hotel has free parking.It is certainly the best hotel in Las Vegas and my only choice when I return to this city.

allReviews.title: RCI Hilton Timeshare at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Overall average.  A lot of room for improvement.  Items are given as requested in very small amounts.  Housekeeping is very slow to bring the requested items.  Sometimes I have to ask for it twice or 3 times to have items delivered to my room.

allReviews.title: Bogus charge st trump international hotel spa
allReviews.text: Very disappointed.   The spa charged me 200 dollars for a spa treatment I did not book.   The hotel manager, Roger, told me it was a mistake and took off bill.   I checked out on January 30 and paid bill of 83.41 dollars.   When arrived home I found the hotel charged my Amex card 200 dollars.   I’m 82 years old and cannot afford this bogus charge.  Please never stay there.  Sandra

allReviews.title: Security Deposit Not Refunded - Disappointing Service
allReviews.text: Extremely disappointing experience at Trump International Las Vegas. The security deposit of over $500 was not refunded after check-out. Despite multiple emails over the past 3 months, I've received no response from the hotel and still no refund. The service is unacceptable and completely fails to meet even basic customer service standards. Potential guests should be wary of this practice.

allReviews.title: A Great Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: We loved the Trump Hotel.  The location is the best as it is not on the busy loud strip but just barely a block off the strip, easy walking distance to the Sphere. Also, just right across the street is the indoor mall. The rooms were updated, nice and clean. The room service was excellent.  The staff was super friendly.  We can't wait to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Absolutely amazing
allReviews.text: The trip was all around amazing the staff was great always willing to help with the quickest way possible wouldn't take a trip no other way or wouldn't never go thru anyone else or any other trip advisor me or my friends will always go together.

allReviews.title: Great stay at Trump Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great hotel! The beds were comfortable, the place was extremely clean, bathrooms are beautiful, the toiletries were top-notch. The Bartenders were great, selections were great, breakfast was incredible. I would warn you that getting the adult size pancakes, unless you have a giant appetite, they are as big as frisbees. Class all the way.

allReviews.title: Thanks a ride without a casino - a perfect vacation
allReviews.text: For the third time in the hotel of the ride ..the hotel is magnificent levels over +++ all in goldEnormous rooms with 3 shower rooms and huge jacuzzi bathrooms and panoramic viewsThe team's service is amazing.I love not having a casino.Besides the kitchen with a huge microwave refrigerator, a dishwasher and more...The restaurant is very good. Everything is clean.Thank you and hopefully I will be back soon.

allReviews.title: No better place in Vegas!!
allReviews.text: Staying at Trump International this past week has ruined me from ever wanting to ever stay anywhere else in Las Vegas, and in fact, has me wanting to come back to Vegas specifically so I can stay here again! The hotel is absolutely THE BEST from the time you pull up in front of it — every aspect of the hotel is just luxurious. I’ve never stayed in as nice a hotel room — it was so spacious with huge windows, and I had the most incredible views!! I could go on and on about how beautiful the hotel was, but that’s not what I loved about it. The most incredible thing about Trump International Hotel is that you’ll experience the friendliest vibe among staff and guests. They were kind and courteous and happy and friendly, and treated us as though we were family who they were so excited to host. It was just a very down to earth vibe that made us feel so welcome!! I wish I could give a shout out to specific staff members, but honestly, I don’t know how I would pick them out because it was an across the board stellar staff — they seemed truly happy that we were their guests and treated us as such. Although this is a five star luxury hotel, there was not the stuffiness that sometimes goes along with such a luxurious place. I’ve stayed at five star hotels where I felt like I didn’t measure up to the level of clientele they wanted, and felt a little out of place. You won’t feel that at all at Trump international. They honestly seemed like they valued all guests with the same level of friendliness and helpfulness whether they were in sequins & heels or jeans & sneakers. I wish there were better words to explain the vibe of this place, but all I can say is if you get to stay here, I’m so jealous!  I literally can’t wait to come back. Thank you to all the staff at Trump international for your smiles, kindness & commitment to excellence!!

allReviews.title: poor value
allReviews.text: it is very over priced and the service was not good - slow and really quite unfriendly. in a town with a lot of options i would skip this hotel. i also found the location was not to my liking close to a busy road. the pool was pretty average and small for the size of the hotel

allReviews.title: Cold Showers, Poor Service
allReviews.text: Our showers (both rooms 5226 and 5222) broke on the 3rd day and would only run cold. After multiple complaints at reception and follow up emails I never got another hot shower or email response from anyone. Very disappointed we spent $6k+ to wake up to cold showers for 5 days. Most disappointing was after making a written complaint via email (as nothing was done at reception) to multiple email addresses including the manager David Li, still no one has responded! It seems once they have your $6k the service stops there.

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel
allReviews.text: This is the best deal on the Las Vegas strip, all the furnishings in the hotel have been replaced within the last couple of months. we were upgraded to a suite, had an amazing time.  We had breakfast several times at the restaurant downstairs was pretty good.  Whether you love him or hate him this is the best deal going.

allReviews.title: The best and most reasonably priced five star hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Trump hotel several times in the past and the furniture and rooms were getting a little bit dated, they have just finished a massive remodel everything is brand new new furniture new carpeting new bedding this place is outstanding. We booked a 500 square foot one bedroom for $132 on TripAdvisor, and were able to upgrade to a one-bedroom suite for an extra $50, that is the way to go there again this should be number one on TripAdvisor

allReviews.title: Rate of Trump International Hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel Washington a very nice sorprise, it's beutiful, confortable, the rooms have a good size and with a lot of things thas help to enjoy your time in this hotel. Líke microwave and others electronics.To enter at the rooms are enough security to access, with out your card of access you can't use the elevator.

allReviews.title: Rude staff, room not well cleaned.
allReviews.text: The staff was rude. When I found someone else’s dirty socks under my bed the guy at the front desk laughed and joked about us getting a “free pair of socks” The room was not well cleaned there were water spots on the fixtures and dust in the corners.

allReviews.title: Great overall!
allReviews.text: We were very happy with our check in/out experience and our room was lovely. It included a nice kitchenette which allowed us to enjoy leftovers. This property wasn't as chaotic as the other strip hotels because it doesn't have a casino. My only negative is that it's off the strip and 1 mile from the closest monorail station so we had to walk A LOT or Uber to get to everything on the strip. Also we faced the interstate and train tracks so we could hear speeding motorcycles and trains all through the night. Light sleepers beware!

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: Hotel is closed by in the strip. Easy in out in the hotel. Excellent service at valet. Not to crowded in the lobby. The bar tender is so nice to make me a special drink.

allReviews.title: Amazing room , great service
allReviews.text: Was here for a conference and I notice over the course of many years I stay healthy staying here instead the smoke filled hotels on the strip.They always go above and beyond great security , really good fish and chips and just nice people.Jake the manager went out of his way to make me feel comfortable and I had a personal emergency and he did nothing but show empathy and care for me. Made me a lifelong customer here.

allReviews.title: We expected great not very good.
allReviews.text: We recently stayed at the Trump hotel.The rooms and bathrooms are large with comfortable beds.We like that the hotel does not have a casino or entertainment so it’s quiet and smoke free.The staff is very good and polite. The rooms are very clean.There is only one restaurant and that didn’t live up to expectations and the Trump name with poor service.One problem we had was we wanted to have breakfast with room service. We could not order the night before. I could live with that. Selections were limited which I found surprising. Then I couldn’t bill it to my room which surprised me. It had to be Apple Pay. We decided to pass on breakfast and went out.

allReviews.title: safety first
allReviews.text: It is a walk to the strip but this is the safest hotel I have ever been in. You can not get to the elevators without you key card. The room is spacious. The bathroom is pure luxury. the toilet and shower are both enclosed in the bathroom. The jacuzzi is huge. Dept store shopping is across the street. Valet parking is free and all day.Free bottles of water all day

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel buy luxurious is a stretch.
allReviews.text: Stayed there twice recently. The first night was on the west side of the property. The road and train noise was loud and we were on the 53rd floor. The toilet paper holder was loose. The jetted tub did not work. Internet was good, room size was great with plenty of cabinets and a kitchenette. Resort fee is $44/night which was not disclosed when booking via 3rd party. Valet parking was free which took some of the stung out of the resort fee. Hotel lobby was forgettable. The 2nd stay was on the east side of the property (at my request). 42nd floor this time. Had a great view of the Sphere. Much quieter than the previous stay.The property is across the street from Fashion Show Mall which is very nice.  Hotel staff was great. They could use a permanent coffee shop on site opposed to the cart that’s available a few hours in the morning. The spa closes early in the evening. They need to up their game if they want to include luxurious in their description, especially in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great location close to the strip, dining and shopping
allReviews.text: My business partner and I were in town for a conference and we enjoyed our stay. Great location near the strip, shopping mall, and dining. Super clean and staff was very accommodating. We would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great resort!
allReviews.text: Nice, large clean room! Exceeded my expectations. Top of the line appliances. One of the best time share spots in a while.It was close enough to the Strip and convenient to have valet parking.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas 2.25
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel and very spacious rooms!  Loved that it didn’t have a casinos or shows or theatre venue.

allReviews.title: TERRIBLE!!!
allReviews.text: Absolutely do not stay here! There are constant protests, which means you can’t get into the hotel for hours. There is a lot of police presence and the staff is not going to accommodate in anyway. Yazzy and the manager Paul C. who worked at the front desk were absolutely horrific. They just seem to shrug their shoulders at everything that was happening, which we understood because they can’t control the protest but they seem to be angry with us about feeling inconvenienced. They also said one thing they cannot guarantee is our safety in the hotel. When we were finally able to enter after hours, we had to go in a back way and drive through a dirt road and we were told to carry our bags about half a mile and climb through rocks to get to the front entrance. When we asked them if they could help us with our bags, the response was “do  you absolutely need help or can you carry them on our own?” Clearly that meant no, they can’t help. We ended up carrying everything on our own and climbing through the rocks just to get into the entrance. Yazzy and the manager, Paul C. were extremely rude when we asked them for help with bags to our room now that we’ve carried them inside. They also had very rude responses when we were asking them why they weren’t able to call us, since the protest had been going on for five hours, to let us know they weren’t going to be able to let people in for hours after check-in time. they should’ve called us so that we could’ve found another place to stay. At this point, the staff was extremely rude and that might be because they were frustrated with the protest outside, but still taking that out on us was not right. We ended up canceling our stay and finding another hotel. Do not stay here at least during the next four years since they said that there are going to be constant protests and there’s nothing they can do to ensure a convenient day or the valet parking that was promised. They also cannot guarantee safety.

allReviews.title: Very pleased with the room, the service, the location!
allReviews.text: The rooms were very comfortable (we had a suite) that faced the Strip and the Sphere.  Staff were professional and the location was great for us.  We actually were pleased that there was not a casino on property as it was a quiet oasis after all the commotion, crowds, and noise at the various hotels and casinos near by.  The shopping center is across the street and there were plenty of restaurants in easy walking distance.  We did eat at the hotel dining area and the food and service were good (even though it was a crowded weekend).  We felt the value was much better than the Bellagio (where they wanted to charge us for a teapot in the room!).  The suite here has a refrigerator, coffee maker, etc.  We would definitely recommend and would stay here again when we visit Las Vegas.  Good service, good value.

allReviews.title: Great way to see Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Best suite we have stayed in on a corner room, 28th Floor.  Great views of Vegas and the Sphere!  Quieter just off the strip.  Very effective security.

allReviews.title: enjoyable and nice stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed the stay at Trump International Las Vagas its location to the strip was a couple of blocks. The staff was friendly and helpful, we had a few questions of things to see and do, they gave us a few ideas. All in all it was an enjoyable stay.

allReviews.title: Very comfortable stay
allReviews.text: Hotel is very comfortable, best pillows I’ve ever slept on, very very large room, friendly staff and large bathtub in room. Highly recommended. Just remember all the low rated stays especially 1 stars are just leftist crybabies that hate Trump and have never stayed here.

allReviews.title: Enjoyed our Getaway
allReviews.text: Scored a great deal on a corner suite for my birthday weekend. Front desk staff are very friendly and valet were very fast. Luggage arrived promptly. Our room was located on the east side of the tower, great views of the strip. Room had plenty of space, the kitchen definitely came in handy. Jacuzzi tub was relaxing after a day of walking the strip. We had our two dogs with us and they received treats and toys which they loved and they had plenty of space to run and play. Decor didn’t feel outdated, was better than I was expecting. Bed was comfortable and we slept with the curtains open to enjoy the scenery. The only negative is the location of the designated dog area. It’s located to the left side when exiting the tower right along the sidewalk. There is so much foot and car traffic that we had to be extra careful and the pups couldn’t run and exercise because the area isn’t fenced off. Other than that we felt safe, slept comfortably and enjoyed our stay. We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: What a fantastic hotel!
allReviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom suite that had to be 1,000 sq ft. And it had two full bathrooms!  The main bathroom was as large as most hotel rooms. But what made it completely special were the employees!  They are so kind and helpful and friendly!  We will definitely go back!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Property!
allReviews.text: The hotel, the staff, the room, the location…was just perfect. 10/10 recommend staying here especially if smoking and gambling aren’t a priority.

allReviews.title: Horrible experience/ Expected much more
allReviews.text: Absolutely horrible experience at the Trump Hotel. I expected mush more from this organization. I booked a New Years Eve trip for my Birthday and my 34th wedding anniversary so we would arrive Dec 31st. When we arrived at 4pm, we were told the room was not quite ready but we could check in. I asked if it would be a couple of hours and was told yes. This was lie #1! We waited around until 6:30 pm and checked back in and were told it the room was not ready. I went to the manager desk and asked why and was told the people in the room would not check out until 8:30 pm and then they would have to clean the room. The manager said he would refund the room for the first night which was not doing enough since we would miss our dinner reservation and our NYE party at that point. The refund part was lie #2! We ate dinner at the restaurant and the food was not very good so that did not help matters. At 8:30 we started seeing a flight crew of 17 people from Korean Airlines coming down and checking out. Granted at this point the lobby was full of angry people and kids sitting on the parents lap crying and upset. The manager, David L., was no where to be found unless we made someone go get him from his hiding spot in his office. We were finally able to check into our room at 10 pm which was too late to get cleaned up and dressed for our party. Thanks for ruining day 1 for us! The next morning, we awoke to fireworks going off and when we looked outside we saw the Cyber Truck fiasco going on. I do not hold that against the hotel, as they could not control that. However, there response and handling of the situation leaves a lot to be desired from both the guests and residents of this Hotel. There was absolutely no communication from the hotel or anyone and the only thing we knew was what was on the TV. I walked down 39 flights to see if we needed to be evacuated and was told I had to leave even though my wife and clothes were all up in the room, yet we would be safe if we would stay in the tower and they would not let us return. I waited in the cold parking lot herded like cattle and told my wife to stay put. I finally had to leave the parking lot to go to the mall and stay warm. 4 hours later I told my wife to come down and we would find somewhere to go as there was no food in our room. WE walked around all day in what my wife could bring down for me. We had to cancel our dinner and show reservations for night 2 since we could not get cleaned up and changed. We still had not communication from the hotel. At 9 pm that night we asked the police if they knew when we could go back since we could not find a room that was available. He told us we could go back in the back way to get to our room. We walked the long way across the parking lot (1/4 mile) and told the staff they should get golf carts or shuttles to help the elderly people struggling to get across the parking lot. Not one of the 4 people cared and made comments there was nothing they could do. The next 2 days were good and we had a nice time. When I checked out, I questioned the staff on my refund for the first night and I should get a refund for the second night. I was told they could not refund either night since I booked through a 3rd party. They refunded me the resort fees after I asked to speak to a manager but that still did not amount to enough to cover what I lost in show tickets and being out for 2 days. The hotel room was very nice, but I would not recommend them and will not stay there again due to how they handled the entire situation.

allReviews.title: Perfect family stay with Grand Canyon and Antelope Canyon  tours
allReviews.text: Room was so clean for being a Vegas hotel. We pick the hotel because we didn’t want to walk through the casino. Perfect for family with full kitchen and refrigerator with lots of storage space so we can keep things tidy. Bed was very comfortable. Design is timeless.

allReviews.title: Cybertruck Explosion Handling
allReviews.text: This was my second stay at the Trump, great room, very spacious and I had a view of the strip on New Year's Eve, it was exceptional until the cybertruck explosion happened. I was one of the guests who evacuated the building, and understandable that safety came first. I would recommend management to review its crisis management practice; guests and staff were outside in the parking lot for 1.5 hours (many of us were freezing in our pajamas out in the cold with no wallet and ID, 40F) and supposedly guests were said to be transported to the Resort World to be more comfortable while waiting, it never happened, we lined up from the parking lot, then onto a bus and sat there for another 4 hours. There was no communication from the hotel and when we were allowed to return to our room after 5.5 hours, it wasn't even announced, we the guests had to find out on our own. They could of communicated via text or email, just let us know the status, it was definitely an unforgettable experience. It dampened my confidence with the hotel chain.

allReviews.title: Would stay here every time in Vegas!
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before (4 yrs ago) and we had 1 night in Vegas, so we enjoyed so much the first time, we stayed again.  Our king room cost (takes and resort fee) was around $160-$175.  The hotel was very busy (it was Christmas Day).  We ate dinner at the DJT, was seated promptly, and waiter was excellent.  The food was great as well.  We enjoy this place bc there is no casino here.  The rooms were immaculate, and the view of Vegas is awesome!  Everything about this place screams excellence, and for a good price!You honestly feel like you are being pampered and living close to luxury for a not luxurious price.  Anytime we are in Vegas, we will stay here

allReviews.title: Incredibly, it surprised
allReviews.text: We love this hotel, super comfortable, always in good condition very luxurious with excellent lighting in the spacious rooms and very comfortable for four people, the views the hotel has are incredible. The pool is very good size, has no casino, but the truth is that at the price it is incredibly good to sleep and be very comfortable

allReviews.title: Beware of unauthorised charges
allReviews.text: I haven’t even stayed there yet. I have just made a booking a day ago with free cancellation until April. My card has been charged twice. No email or any message about the charges. Once I will sort out everything with my bank as my card is now blocked I will be cancelling this stay.

allReviews.title: Need to Fix the Mattress to Earn Higher Score
allReviews.text: Beautiful large room and bath but the bedding was so soft we got back aches.  I had expected a high end room service experience but instead the delivery was a paper bag full of what you would expect from a fast food takeout with paper plates, cups, and disposable tableware.

allReviews.title: Luxury,  enjoyed our stay
allReviews.text: Beautiful décor, quiet rooms. Staff were efficient, helpful, and cheerful. Valet attendants very quick. Doorman nice touch, gave the experience a New York luxury feel. Security attendants very reassuring. We had a beautiful room on an upper floor, but the water temperature in the shower was inconsistent. It would cool down during our shower then heat up again. We would still stay here again when in town.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel, Bad Practices
allReviews.text: We booked this hotel a few months prior to our trip.  100% prepaid, done, right?  When you arrive they of course require a credit card for “incidentals” which one would think things like “restaurant charges/movies/others” NOPE.  We stayed without charging absolutely anything to our pre-paid room.  I go back and check my expenditures from the trip and have a random $176.88 charge from Trump Int’l. They failed to email a receipt for these extra charges or provide a description for them.  This is not cool, it was plenty to stay here for 4 nights, without unidentified or undisclosed charges.  We are 100% positive we did not charge anything to the room or purchase any services.  Do not stay here!  One of those places that charges you once for doing it, then again because they think they can.  Watch your credit card very closely, if you do. Then, you will know stay somewhere else next time.  I don’t mind paying for things I enjoy, but i do mind when places just take it randomly.  Stay somewhere else!!!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
allReviews.text: Wonderful stay at Trump Vegas. Enjoyed the quietness of the hotel without a casino and yet close proximity to the Vegas strip, right across the street from Fashion Mall. Although, the restaurant options at the hotel were limited.

allReviews.title: Daddy Trump Tower
allReviews.text: Was our first choice to stay, after our little Las Vegas wedding ceremony! Huge room, great views, and great people working and staying there! We went during Rodeo week! So many Cowyboys and girls! So many patriots! Can't wait for our next visit!

allReviews.title: Excellent vacation, relaxing resort
allReviews.text: Very clean, welcoming and these days a safe resort. Large rooms (ask for view of the sphere) with nice pool and exercise area. Across the street from the mall and a short walk to Wynn, Venetian, Caesars, etc. Free valet parking for timeshare. We vacation here twice a year.

allReviews.title: A great starting point
allReviews.text: Great hotel The best in Vegas Book Monday through Thursday for excellent rates The weekend is a little pricey We started in Vegas because the flight was cheap and the access to some of the country’s best national parks are fairly close by Had a great time with on our 29th anniversary!

allReviews.title: Iconic hotel
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel with a decidedly lavish style, in perfect Vegas style. It is located 10/15 minutes from the nightlife area and is one of the few hotels in Las Vegas that does not have the casino inside, resulting in a particularly quiet. The room was very large and comfortable. Negative note, the staff service not 5 stars, we were not redone the room the next morning and several times we had to request slippers not in the room. The room service closes at about 10pm. Restaurant improveable.

allReviews.title: Extremely Poor Service
allReviews.text: Upon arriving for 3pm check-in, we were told our room was not ready. Each hour, we checked back to see when room would be available. Only after asking for a manager to assist, we were able to check in at 6:30pm (3 1/2 hours later).Once we were checked in, we were informed that the room we had booked and prepaid for was not available. We were downgraded to a less superior room but told we would be refunded the difference already paid.The next morning, we called room service to ask if we could get extra towels and shower gel. After waiting an hour, we called to let them know we would be leaving the room to get breakfast and asked for an update on when someone would arrive as we did not want to miss them. The employee responded, "well since you only called 9 min ago, sometimes it takes us 10 min to get to your room." This was appalling as we had been waiting an hour.The following morning when we checked out of the hotel, we were still charged daily resort fees (of which manager said we would not be charged as an inconvenience of having to wait 3 1/2 hours to check in). We were still charged for a breakfast (of which the manager said we would not be charged as an inconvenience of having our room downgraded). And we were still charged the full rate of the upgraded room we booked but were not able to stay in. While the hotel corrected the resort fees and breakfast charges, the upgraded room charges have still not been resolved.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Just returned from a 7 night stay at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. It’s not on the strip, but just off. It doesn’t have a casino but the plus is a smoke free hotel and probably saved money by not having a quick flutter before bed. The staff are all welcoming and cannot do enough. We had a rental car and used the valet parking and that worked brilliantly. We had a deluxe room overlooking the strip and the sphere. The rooms are huge with a small kitchen and sofa area, very nice. The only criticism I have is the bathroom was huge with a jacuzzi bath, two sinks and a wc. The only shower was over the bath (there was more than enough room for a walk in shower) and basically unless you are a child you had to hold it to have a shower as it did not extend to a large enough height. Very poor for a hotel like this. But to be a fair that is the only fault. excellent hotel with excellent staff.

allReviews.title: Great stay off the strip!
allReviews.text: Trump International is a great hotel to be at off the strip.  The staff was friendly and fun and it is nice to stay at a hotel where there is no gambling.  Makes for a quiet tranquil stay and you don't have to walk forever to get to an elevator and your room.  Added bonus President Trump was in town and the hotel handled everything surpurbly!!  Will defintely stay here again.

One of the best hotels in Vegas! The rooms are stunning, the meals are of exceptional quality, and the staff is truly outstanding. They went above and beyond to make my stay unforgettable. The only thing that could improve is the espresso coffee—it’s still not quite as expected. Can’t wait to return!

allReviews.title: Fabulous Hotel
allReviews.text: What a fabulous hotel, from the moment we arrived it was everything we expected and more.  The lobby is beautiful, very elegant, check in was fast and Alex was very helpful. We were travelling with my sister and her husband and were given rooms close to each other which was fantastic.  The rooms were beautiful and the added bonus of a kitchen area with a decent size fridge was great, the bed was huge and very comfortable, we also had a sofa and 2 chairs which we really liked.  The bathroom was very large and had everything you could need, plenty of towels and lovely toiletries, very good quality.  We had a small issue with our shower, I spoke to the concierge and it was fixed straight away.  We ate breakfast & dinner in DJT a few times, food was delicious and the staff were excellent, very accommodating of some of our specific needs, nothing was too much trouble.  Every morning my sister & I would pop down for a latte, Arnold & Jiles along with Tanya were so friendly it started our day on a very happy note.  The bar area is comfortable and Annie & Lance make great cocktails.  The shop is great and both ladies that work there are so helpful, I don’t feel that it was particularly over priced, we got some great gifts there, they also have a good selection of sundries, lip balm, pain meds, and lots of other things should you need something.Housekeeping were excellent, they too were very friendly and professional.  Check out was very quick & easy (again with Alex).  It was really nice that the hotel doesn’t have a casino, we had no issues with anyone causing havoc, yes you can hear the train but that didn’t bother us at all.  The hotel is a couple of minutes walk from the Strip & Fashion Show Mall is opposite if you want to shop. Any staff we encountered could not have been more friendly or helpful, they were great.  All in all we had a great week and I would definitely recommend staying here, I really hope to be able to return again soon.

allReviews.title: Great hotel!
allReviews.text: Staying at the Trump Hotel in Vegas was a great experience. The rooms were spacious, clean, and felt super luxurious, with a killer view of the Strip. The staff was friendly and professional, and I loved that the hotel is non-smoking and quieter compared to the casinos. It’s close enough to all the action but still feels like a retreat. Definitely worth it for a more relaxed Vegas stay!

allReviews.title: Great Vacation
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed in a 1-bedroom unit. The room was very clean, and the staff were very friendly. The location could be a little better, but Treasure Island has free parking and it's on the strip. The pool area is very nice with bar service. While we were their President Trump actually stayed there at the hotel, it was crazy security everywhere. I would definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Disappointing customer service
allReviews.text: Our stay was pleasant, but the customer service was awful. After our stay, I noticed an unexpected charge of $19.99 on my credit card. While I was aware of the resort fee, I was shocked to see an additional $20 charge for internet. We only used the complimentary internet included in our stay and never requested any upgrades. I called twice to resolve this issue, but both interactions with customer service were extremely disappointing. The agents were rude and condescending, repeatedly insisting that "someone in your party must’ve purchased it." This was not the case. When I asked about filing a complaint, the representative spoke to me in an unprofessional and disrespectful manner, saying, “It’s on the record, so you must’ve bought it.”This was unhelpful and unacceptable, especially for a 5-star hotel. We had plans to return but have decided never to stay here again. If you’re considering staying, be cautious about potential unauthorized charges to your credit card and don’t expect 5-star customer service

allReviews.title: Quality Hotel
allReviews.text: I have just returned from a week stay in this lovely hotel. I loved everything about it. The entrance and foyer are beautiful and impressive. It sets the feel for the rest of the hotel. DJT restaurant serves delicious, good quality food and drinks, with great choices. I had my first coffee there every morning. Arnold, Jiles made fantastic lattes, Annie great cocktails, Tanya, who I think was a manager in the restaurant, were so friendly and made us feel like valued guests. All staff were very professional, helpful and friendly, accommodating too. The rooms were large, luxurious and exactly as they appeared online. I was delighted with it. I particularly liked having kitchen area, which is unusual in American hotels. When jet lag hit, hubby and I were able to have a tea (my own teabags) or coffee in the middle of the night. The bed was so comfortable, and the pillows were really fluffy, soft but supporting. Bedding and towels were very good quality. I loved the bathroom too. It was large with separate toilet and shower cubicles. It also had twin basins and a huge jacuzzi bath. The toiletries too were a lovely addition. Some hotels use inferior products: not so here. They were a pleasure to use. Shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, body lotion and bar soap. You definitely don’t need to bring your own.The hotel shop was a hit too. Plenty of gifts to buy, plus essentials you may have forgotten - Indigestion remedies, pain killers etc. I had a fantastic stay and I would not hesitate to go to this hotel again. I highly recommend it.

allReviews.title: Normal
allReviews.text: The room we found good in question that the bed is really cozy, it is just what you need to rest deeply after much doing in Las Vegas, the bathroom has the perfect size and amenities, what is unfortunate is that they are not very friendly, they are just norrmal and supposedly absolutely no one speaks Spanish, and the cleanliness leaves much to be desired, from then on, the trip was fine, the hotel I think can improve in attention to travelers with "third party" reservations.

allReviews.title: Dated- average hotel
allReviews.text: Non Smoking- non gaming hotel next to fashion city mall. Walking distance from resort world. Rooms are dated and our couch had a blood stain. Large jet tub and decent size bathroom with Kitchenette .Some minus points are slow house keeping service. Lobby gets very noisy and front desk does not step in to help as there were a large group of drunks in 17th floor and was laughing/yelling at 3 am in the morning. Only one dining option downstairs and its decent.

allReviews.title: Very good hotel
allReviews.text: All wonderful, with a point of attention associated with the fact that there is no heated pool in the hotel, in a place of such low temperatures.

allReviews.title: Hotel The Trump International Hotel
allReviews.text: Ask to be given a room with a view of the sphere. Super clean and all luxury hotel. Excellent option with valet parking included. Close to downtown and easy to get to and from. The rooms are super stylish and comfortable. The prices quite accessible more if it is a Sunday. I would definitely return

allReviews.title: Getaway
allReviews.text: Hotel was courteous and room was very clean. Overall service was beyond satisfactory and would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Needs updated.  Jacuzzi tubs in rooms. "They no longer work". On purpose supposedly, but does not disclose that.  Beautiful but
allReviews.text: Needs updated.  Jacuzzi tubs in rooms. "They no longer work". On purpose supposedly, but does not disclose that.  Beautiful but

allReviews.title: Wonderful Stay
allReviews.text: This hotel is off the Strip. We were booked here for a HGV tour. The staff are accommodating and the amenities are excellent. The hotel is beautiful and our suite was perfect. We were on the 32nd floor and it was very quiet. Arrived on Election Day and that evening the bar and restaurant were packed with folk watching the results. Lobby was full too. Moved to the Elara mid-week and we were surprised at how much nicer Trump International was.

allReviews.title: Filthy hotel!
allReviews.text: We had high hopes for our stay here but were truly disappointed. The first room they gave us had a dirty bathtub and the air conditioning didn't work. We asked for and were given another room. The mattress was uncomfortable and we didn't sleep well because of this and the noise outside. I do not recommend! We also got bed bugs from staying here.

allReviews.title: Favourite Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: This was a very high class luxurious hotel that me and my partner really loved staying in. The rooms are absolutely massive and can accommodate your every need. There is also an oven and microwave, which we didn’t use but it seemed to be very useful. Within the hotel there is a lovely pool, the Trump store and the DJT restaurant. Big shout out to the bartender at the DJT restaurant who got our food orders right before close as we were starving! Huge shout out to the receptionist when we checked in (I believe her name was Katy) who tried her absolute best to give us the best possible room. The staff were all really friendly, and this has become my no-brainer location when coming to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas did Not Disappoint!
allReviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located directly across from the Fashion Show Mall. It is only a 4 minute walk to the strip. The hotel entrance is grand and nicely decorated with fresh flowers daily. All the staff we encountered during our stay were extremely pleasant and helpful. The unit itself was larger that the average hotel room that we had previously stayed in on past trips. It had a super comfortable king size bed, sofa bed, bar fridge, an induction stove top, a kettle and a kurig coffee maker.  Lots of free bottled water and coffee available  in our room.  The outdoor pool area was large with lots of loungers. Gym was well equipped.  Both the pool and gym had free water stations set up which was nice as it was extremely hot (for October). Elevators were sectioned off for the first half of the building and then the top half. We did not have to wait long and they were very fast. Like the fact that there was no casino located in the hotel. Made for a more pleasant stay. Woud definately recommend.

allReviews.title: Trump excellence
allReviews.text: Excellent staff,  superb rooms excellent distance to resturaunts and attractions.Elevators are fast and very easy to get on with 4 of them.  Rooms were super clean and comfy.  Bathrooms were super clean, roomy.  Shower was great.  Roomy, clean.  Hvac was a breeze to use and very precise in temp maintenance. Trump store was great for the Trump Souvineers you may want.  Over all, excellent  hotel.

allReviews.title: We Loved the Trump Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Trump International Hotel Las VegasWe stayed at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas for an extended weekend getaway in October 2024. The hotel is quiet, clean & smells fresh. The beds & pillows are very comfortable, the bathroom is clean & roomy. There's a nice sitting area with a couch and chairs. They don't have a casino, so it doesn't reek of cigarette smoke, & there isn't constant noise from slot machines. It's a nice change from all the hustle & bustle of the loud casinos. Fashion Show Mall is literally right across the street, there is a wide variety of stores & a lot of the same stores that are in the Venetian & Ceasar's Palace. We walked all over from the hotel - we like getting a walk in everyday, so for us every place we wanted to go was within reasonable walking distance. It's easier than driving and fighting for parking spots. We took an uber to & from the airport. We also took an Uber to see Sammy Hagar @ the Palms, it's a short ride to most places. It was over 100 degrees the entire time we were there, so we spent a lot of time at the pool. The water was perfect. There's food & drink service at the pool. They have many loungers & towels available. They also play a variety of music. The gym is very nice with a lot of options. There is 1 main restaurant. They also have room service & food available at the pool. In the morning, they have giant muffins, sweet rolls and coffee for sale. All of the staff we encountered were friendly & accommodating. We will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Very classy
allReviews.text: LOVED it.  Great hotel just off the strip very classy and upscale. Nice restaurant and bar.   Best part no casino. Nice and quiet atmosphere.   Very gracious staff great pool area will definitely stay there again next time  great place to stay 👍👍

allReviews.title: Las Vegas getaway
allReviews.text: Great property close to the strip no casino so there was no smoking inside the building whatsoever. Love that.

allReviews.title: Started out slowly but became one of the best ever time share week
allReviews.text: Our week was the best ever even when I had a heart attack because the staff did everything possible to make my wife feel better

allReviews.title: Wheelchair accessible suite
allReviews.text: We had the pleasure of spending 10 nights in a WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE SUITE floor 53 thanks to Mister "Nico Tanner" concierge.This suite was thanks to the trump international tower las vegas and especially the conciergeMISTER NICO TANNER provided complimentary.THIS WHEELCHAIR SUITE IS A DREAM,EVERYTHING YOUR HEART DESIRES.A CLASSIC QUIET ELEGANCE AND A SLEEP LIKE ON CLOUDS.2 BATH UNITSHIGH TOWER GLASS FRONTJACUZZI TUBFULLY EQUIPPED KITCHEN -MICROWAVE-OVEN-REFRIGERATOR LARGE-HIGH CLASS-Dogs allowed.A wonderful scent envelopes the entire hotel!We thank you for this wonderful time and the kindness shown to us.Also many thanks to “NICK”responsible for Valent parking!Their mother did everything right for them!

allReviews.title: Trump hotel Vegas
allReviews.text: The pillows are too flat. Otherwise, the service was great.The room was big including the bathroom.The kitchenette is also Included and the fridge.The spa with the heated poll with daybed and lavishly equipped,air conditioned cabanas. Restaurant ,bar etc.

allReviews.title: Class and style
allReviews.text: No matter your politicle views, this place is worth the money. From very plush bedding, tv built into the mirror so when on the mirro becomes a tv, and off its back to being a mirror. First time ever having a phone with outside line next to the toilet.Across the street from high end shopping. If your looking to spoil someone special a night or two should do it, and if that someone is yourself so be it.Very impressive

allReviews.title: Top hotel
allReviews.text: This is our 2nd visit in as many years The main man was in the hotel the first few days but wasn’t such a distraction Corner one bed suite over looking the sphere Room was tidy every day fresh towels Breakfast was great in restaurant if not little pricy Room service great Will stay again

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: Apartment is big, clean and beautiful  only negatives (very small ones) no teaspoons for making Tea and Coffee and no where to hang dresses or long skirts as hanging areas are only long enough for shirts and skirts etc, other than that fab!

allReviews.title: Trump Towers
allReviews.text: The resort was clean and comfy. We walked to other resorts to gamble and go to shows.  We ate lunch at the pool and had dinner twice at Trump towers.  Good food.  Full bar.

allReviews.title: A sphere from the window of the room,
allReviews.text: It was a lovely hotel, except for a few details.First of all, there is no casino, so the customer base is good. I'm calm.From the 51st floor room, the sphere was fully visible between Wynn and Palacio. I was comforted by the constantly changing sphere of the world. The elevator is fast and stress-free.It is also convenient to have a mall across the street.Small points.It's still a long way from Poolbird. It's so far away.The Jacuzzi is too big to float.It's not well-built, the closet doesn't close, well, a lot of things.It was a great deal considering the price.

allReviews.title: Stayed here Oct 2024, and WILL come back!
allReviews.text: Just stayed here and it was great!Rooms very large and HUGE bathroom.  I've stayed at many of the hotels around Las Vegas strip and this one is now ranked as one of my top "go-to" hotels, especially for the money.  I'll definitely stay again (and again)!  Yes, it doesn't have a casino at the bottom, but I'm too cheap to play big casino minimums anyway...so I go to my favorite places for Blackjack.  It's slightly off the strip, but who cares, you Uber everywhere in Vegas anyway.  Terrific mall directly across the street....the whole experience was just excellent for me and my wife for a couple of nights!

allReviews.title: Great time at Trump Tower!!!
allReviews.text: We enjoyed the hotel, big, quiet and comfortable room. Great and relaxing pool area. Luxury lobby and restaurant. Good location, 15 min walking to the Strip

allReviews.title: Enjoyed Trump Hotel
allReviews.text: The room was huge and extremely clean.  There was a coffee maker but no cups.  There was no notepad or pen in the room.  I thought there would be bathrobes, but nope.  The food was outstanding.   We loved our stay but thought those small things were odd for a fancy hotel.

allReviews.title: Excellent Value and Location
allReviews.text: The Trump International is in an excellent location and represents very good value.  The rooms were large and well appointed. Bedding was comfortable and the pillows magnficent. Bathroom very large and well set up.  Lifts were fast.  Cleaning service efficient and prompt.  You are 2' walk from the Strip and across the road from a massive shopping mall.  The pool was a tad small for my taste but I wasn't there for that.  The hotel doesn't have a casino which is a plus as there are a lot less people coming and going.  Parking was free, and the valet parking efficient.  Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: The best place to stay in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for the second time and loved it again. Having no casino in the lobby is a very quiet and safe hotel, which for us is one of the main points. The rooms are spacious, nice, well maintained, and have everything you would expect them to have in a hotel of this category. The restaurant is very good, both for breakfast, dinner or going for drinks. Thanks to Michelle, front desk who with her willingness helped us a lot with a somewhat problematic Reservation extension that we had with booking and the hotel manager did not help us at all. In short, super recommended hotel, we will surely return in the future.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Hotel for large groups
allReviews.text: I booked 13 rooms for a family wedding. Everyone was overjoyed with the hotel and service. All I would recommend if a guest is coming in late to put your credit card down to secure the room for incidentals.

allReviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!
allReviews.text: The sheets on 1 of our beds were stained.  The hot water for the shower took forever to get hot.  Never did see a maid, or even a maid cart.  I fell out of my wheel chair on their property, and was injured.  they never addressed this either.  Employees' seem so unhappy also.  Not a good atmosphere at all.

allReviews.title: The Real Trump Was There
allReviews.text: My GFs and I stayed one night at the hotel before we headed out to Zion National Park. The universe decided that on the one night we were there the real Donald Trump would show up and host a campaign rally. Every which way into the hotel was blocked except for one route which required your car be searched by Secret Service. That was fine. Then there was a very long line into the hotel which required your suitcase and bags be searched again by Secret Service. By the time my GFs and I got into our room, we were so tired. Check in wasn’t bad. Dude that helped us was a little grumpy but I could imagine his stress from the crowd. Restaurant is limited but food was good, whiskey/Old Fashion was great!  The rooms are absolutely huge for Vegas standards and what you pay for makes it worth it. Cleanliness is top notched! People’s reviews are accurate when they said the hotel smells so good! It does! It smells like fresh clean laundry. Overall, I enjoyed our stay. I think it would’ve been made excellent if we didn’t run into the Trump man and his campaign crew and the whole of the secret service agents. That was nosy but I would definitely stay here again. Valet is great! Nicest folks available and eager to help out. The elevators can get congested. Check out at least 15-30 mins before 11 am.

allReviews.title: First Class All The Way!
allReviews.text: I have never been to a better hotel in my life.  Everything from the valet, to the check-in personnel to people helping with our luggage, to the gentlemen by the elevators checking customer info, to the lovely ladies in the Gift Shop, to the waiters, to the individuals responsible for cleaning rooms...each and every one of them made my husband and I feel like we were family.  It was a first-class hotel and I feel so blessed for our time there.  I hope one day we get to return.  Wonderful wonderful wonderful!!!

allReviews.title: Trump International Gives You LOTS for your money!
allReviews.text: Huge suite accomodations with full kitchen. Great restaurant at reasonable prices. Service was impeccable. They even let us check-in at noon rather than usual 3 pm check-in time. Very sedate, unlike other strip hotels with casinos. Only negative is that it can be noisy since the main highways run past the back of the hotel.

allReviews.title: Close to everything, but quieter
allReviews.text: I state that I was staying on the 16th floor. Very clean room. Spacious: Huge bathroom with whirlpool tub and shower, two sinks, huge mirror and lots of light. Definitely large bed, very comfortable. Kitchenette with induction hob, fridge, microwave. Lounge with sofa and armchairs. Breakfast for a fee. Expensive but plentiful and tasty. If you order room service for breakfast, you will be disappointed. They don't serve on carts, they don't carry plates or glasses, but they just stuff everything into a plastic bag and deliver. Considering the cost, some attention onwards would be appreciated. Overall, super recommended hotel because who does not want to stay in the confusion.

allReviews.title: Luxurious Weekend
allReviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful time at the hotel. The property is very clean and elegant. We loved the complimentary water bottles! The room had a pleasant smell and are spacious. The bed was very comfortable with the perfect down filled comforter. The hotel is a little ways off the strip but a short walk to it and the Fashion Show Mall directly across the street.

allReviews.title: TRUMP LAS VEGAS
allReviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, Staff was pleasant and helpful. Would definitely book again when going to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Make Las Vegas great again thanks to Trump International
allReviews.text: We stayed here for two night. From the 28th till 30th of August. We had a extraordinary Room with a stunning view. It was the corner Suite Nr. 4325 thanks to the wonderful Ashley on the reception! We felt welcomed from the first start till the end. Room super clean and the gym has a nice view to the pool and skyline of Vegas. The Valet worked out perfectly. We didnt had to wait longer than 10 min. The Hotel is close to a Mall and you can walk through there to reach the famous Vegas strip. I would say its a 30 min walk but its built with moving staircase so you dont feel like walking a lot. You can see the tower also from the famous Venetian. Room Service was also very quick. We def. Come here again.

allReviews.title: Not a convenient location
allReviews.text: This hotel was booked by accident on Hotwire. Was the room nice, yes.  Were the staff nice, yes.  The location wasn't convenient to the strip when the adjacent mall was closed. Police presence around the clock was bothersome. Never would have stayed at a Trump location in the current political climate had we known.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: This is a non-political review.Great location at the end of the strip. Service was superb, and the cleanliness was fantastic. Loved the room and had a great view of the sphere. The pool was nice, gym too. Only small thing I would like to see USB connections in the room. There are no gambling rooms/areas in the hotel, which we didn't mind, but if wanting that, then it would be best to look at other hotels. Overall, it was a really great stay, and we would definitely come back again.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Location of the hotel was great, was nice to be a short walk away from the madness of the strip.. The lack of casino here is actually a big positive for us having visited the other hotels and seeing how busy they were and how it would probably be a nightmare navigating through everything to get to just get back to your room! Food here was great and our room was fantastic, only reason we can't rate as 5/5 is because of the train noise (loud horn!!) when you get the mountain view room; it woke me up a good few times during our stay and we were on the 25th floor! 😔

allReviews.title: Decentralized city hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is ok. Slightly off the beaten track. Expensive and loud. Small pool, manageable breakfast. Railway line nearby. Large room and large bathroom. Roomkeeping only upon request. Very anonymous. No airport shuttle. No casino and that is very good.

allReviews.title: Beautiful food and service, gorgeous decor .
allReviews.text: We visited to have a look around during our stay in Las Vegas. The hotel is gorgeous, absolutely immaculate and the staff are amazing. We were dressed very casually and were a bit worried that we should have dressed better but nobody seemed to care. We checked out the gift shop and bought a few little treats. We had a look around and then had a look at the food menu. We were surprised at how reasonable the prices were so decided to have dinner there. As you can imagine, the service, food and drinks were top notch. The seating area was beautiful. The other patrons were all very chilled out friendly people, a mixture of well dressed and casual patrons. The bill was surprisingly cheap for what we got. We were very impressed, will definitely return and would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Pamper yourself in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Located at the end of the Strip (so conveniently located), while still immense, this hotel offers a quieter and less chaotic environment than the facilities on the Strip with in-house Casinos. We stayed in a superior suite on the 56th floor really spacious and welcoming. Living area with kitchen, bathroom with shower and sitting area with double sofa bed; sleeping area with corner double bedroom and immense bathroom with bath and shower. All with a truly amazing view of the city. The hotel has a gym, spa and swimming pool. Very convenient that parking is included in the price, with a very fast service.

allReviews.title: Good value but dated
allReviews.text: Arrived as a family of 5 we had 2 rooms both were clean but dated no working phone sockets bedside jacuzzi baths in both rooms were not working lamps had to be unplugged to switch off but this hotel is good value compared to other hotels luggage took 45 Minuits to get a bell boy as they were too heavy to carry had to go up to desk 3 times as car was waiting allso nowhere to sit in lobby had to buy a drink from bar while waiting for luggage

allReviews.title: Peace and quiet in Vegas
allReviews.text: Comfortable hotel, close to the top end of the Strip. We appreciated the fact that there are no casinos, so much quieter than many of the big hotels, nice to come back to after the hustle and bustle of Vegas. Tried to sit out by the pool for an afternoon but had to abandon as the golden glare, reflecting from the hotel,  and the heat, made it unbearable for us. Bed very comfy. Hadn’t appreciated that we’d have no kitchen items, such as bowls, spoons etc, although these can be requested from housekeeping. Staff were all courteous and helpful, and got a lift one evening down the Strip from one of the team, instead of getting a taxi. He was a joy, just wish I could remember his name!

allReviews.title: An amazing timeshare exchange!
allReviews.text: Generally our timeshare exchanges have been for location with inferior quality rooms and service.  Not Trump Hotel! We had a great room, great service, and would absolutely exchange here again.

allReviews.title: Great rooms, staff...
allReviews.text: Currently here. Stayed here last year and loved it.Pros: Rooms are great. There is plenty of space.  Cons: On arrival, no help from staff with bags. They were too busy talking between themselves. Staff at the front counter were rude. Wife actually said   she's happy now after checking in, she won't have to deal with any staff members.  Not sure if we will stay here again next year after a few negative interactions with staff, to many other options on the strip.

allReviews.title: Exceeded My Expectations
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, and it exceeded my expectations. Initially, I was apprehensive about booking, unsure of what the atmosphere would be like. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the diverse and welcoming clientele. The hotel room was not only spacious but also impeccably clean and luxurious, with thoughtful decorative touches, including beautiful pieces in the glass built in bookshelves. The bathroom was absolutely luxurious. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable.
