allReviews.title: VIP Experience
allReviews.text: We go back to the PALMS frequently. And every time, the experience is pleasant. Last trip, we had a VIP experience and was working with Alexis Ridgeway. She was very helpful, kind, quick to respond to our needs, and very professional. She made our stay wonderful!!! I want to give kudos to all the staff (bell boys, to drivers etc) but especially to Alexis. We will be back!

allReviews.title: Terrible front desk customer service.
allReviews.text: Stayed from 05/16-05/20. Everything was okay except our bathroom sink in the room was not draining. I called early Friday morning and the maintenance man came in an out for hours but could not get it fixed. Eventually they had to call a plumber. We didn't want to leave our room open to strangers so had to stay until it was fixed. The plumber had to take the sink fully apart and snake the drain. There was a huge mess in the bathroom and smelled of sewage. This went on from 9am until about 3pm. During this time, we were unable to use the bathroom. Waste of our day. They would not let us switch rooms. The mantainence man said he would talk to the front desk about compensation.The morning of check out, I called down for a late check out. They did not accommodate. I mentioned the plumbing issue and they said a manager would call me back. I did not receive a call.When I went to check out at the front desk, Oscar assisted. He was extremely rude and unpleasant. When I mentioned the plumbing issue again he said there where no notes and became upset and asked me what I wanted for compensation. I told him I wasn't sure. He then said he would take off one day of the resorts fee. After handing me the final invoice, I asked to clarify the authorization on my card and how much I would get charged. This really seemed to set him off. He became upset and was short when explaining. I told him to have a good day before leaving in which he said nothing and walked the other way. I came back to the front desk to ask his name. He turned to me and pointed at his name tag. I've never seen a grown man throw a temper tantrum.This type of service is unacceptable. I was very understanding with the plumbing issues and could have cause a big fuss.The maintenance man, Carlton and valet were great. Front desk definitely needs some retraining in customer service.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend!
allReviews.text: I wanna start by saying Stephanie the hotel director is Amazing. Back in march I ran into a very unpleasant situation with the palms hotel. I was wrongfully put out of my hotel room at 1:30 am. After calling for a few days straight A security guard by the name of Mike Valdez found the problem & immediately turned it over to Stephanie. She then gave me call & went above & beyond to fix the problem! Here in may I returned to the palms hotel & they did everything in their power to make me feel welcomed. From the second I walked in to the second I left everything was amazing. We stayed in the fantasy suite that was very nice , spacious, bed was soft & housekeeping kept the room clean. I highly recommend the cabanas they are very relaxing. Also, the ghost bar has an amazing view & outstanding vibes. I’ve stayed at many hotels in Las Vegas & I must say the palms is now one of my favorites. I will most definitely be returning.

allReviews.title: Beautiful views and great customer service
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Palms place penthouse. The place is gorgeous and had everything we needed. The views were breathtaking. Oscar made this experience extra nice. He was so kind and helpful. His bright attitude made our trip start of right. Amazing customer service!

allReviews.title: The best experience
allReviews.text: This weekend I attended the kountry Wayne show and I had the best experience with a janitor name Larry he will go over and beyond for good customer service real nice guy it was the best customer service I ever had when it comes to being in a Casino when I come back to Vegas I will be staying at the Palms

allReviews.title: Palms ruined my Mother’s Day Weekend of “Relaxation” with a bowling alley above my head
allReviews.text: Huge disappointment! For Mother’s Day weekend, I was “treated” to a weekend in Vegas. iI’ve never stayed at the Palms before and was so excited to check it out. As a mother, you can imagine how much I was looking forward to this weekend.  One of my favorite parts about staying at a hotel is in/room dining. The first night, I got in late after a big dinner and wanted some tea. I called down to order tea and asked the girl to bring up a large pot. In every single hotel I’ve stayed in, the tea is brought up with an insulated silver tea pot. I was told they do not have large pots and that their tea only comes in one size, 16 ounce container. I asked the girl to bring up 2 containers instead and went on to ask “it will stay hot in there anyway right?” And the hotel rep said “yes”. The tea arrived in 2 paper cups!! When I told the server to take one of them back and credit me, he said he could not and that I “was already charged”. That isn’t true - in room dining is charged at the end to the CC on file. I called the next morning to order some coffee and asked the supervisor to credit the $10 paper cup of tea from the night before as I had not touched the second cup and that there was a misunderstanding about how the tea would be served. I had to talk to 2 agents and a supervisor to finally refund that $10 tea in a paper cup. When I asked to order coffee, an espresso or Americano (strong), I was told the whole hotel only serves “pike’s place” a very watered down American coffee. I opted out of ordering in room dining thereafter from this hotel. At around 1am, as I put my head down to sleep, I was constantly startled by HORRIBLE LOUD SOUNDS on my ceiling and could not sleep- sounded like furniture being thrown against the floor and moved around. I could not sleep and called down to see what the issue was and if they can help me out. The first rep told me there is a BOWLING ALLEY INSIDE THE ROOM a couple floors above me and they can’t do anything about it. I asked a supervisor to call me - as this was ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS. I had to wait for a Supervisor to call me back to “help” but she ended up repeating the same thing - told me “those guests paid for that room and we can’t tell them not to use the bowling alley. There are rooms with bowling alleys floors 19-25, we can move you if you want. I don’t agree with the construction either but there is nothing we can do about it but move you or give you ear plugs.” Mind you this was 1:30 am already and I happened to be on the 18th floor directly below these TERRIBLE rooms. WHO DOES THAT?! A BOWLING ALLEY inside a hotel room placed ABOVE regular rooms? When I went on to tell the supervisor that I should’ve been warned and given the option of a different room in ADVANCE, she said “well that room wasn’t rented yet when you booked your room”. That does not matter. The mere chance of a bowling alley being booked directly above your room is enough reason for a GOOD HOTEL to give their guests a warning like “hey there is a BOWLING ALLEY above your head while you try to sleep in your HOTEL ROOM. Do you like 50 lb balls being tossed on the hard wood floors above your head or would you want a different room?” Absolutely HORRIBLE “guest service” agents all around. Every single person I spoke with regarding the tea issue and the bowling alley, were not equipped to handle any guest service issues, let alone one as ridiculous as finding out there is an entire bowling alley above your head in a hotel room for a weekend when all you want as a mother is some rest and some good treatment. HORRIBLE HOTEL. Will never return.

allReviews.title: Cool place, fun entertainment
allReviews.text: Came to try our luck on the slots with some friends that live in Vegas. Wasn't too successful but still had a great time. My partner and I ate at Scotch 80 which was phenomenal and then went to the yachtly krew concert at the pool. That was definitely a good time, fun energy. Cool place, will for sure come back!!

allReviews.title: Oscar my man
allReviews.text: A nice hotel and casino that has nothing to envy from the strip. Strong all round. Personnel was really kind and friendly. Oscar, at the reception was mindful of our well being. He answered all our questions and was very helpful. Definitely recommend

allReviews.title: Nice Resort with Amazing Views from your room.
allReviews.text: Original tower is comfortable with an amazing and unobstructed view of the city and mountains.  'So pretty at night!  Room is large and bed was comfortable.  Maid was amazing!!!!   Wish the shower had a door on it   Nice to have so many good restaurants on site!

allReviews.title: Horrible housekeeping service
allReviews.text: I have traveled a lot in my life and I have never had worse housekeeping services. Not only was our room dirty upon arrival ( counters and used glasses) but it continued to be bad. Housekeeping never emptied our trash over a 4 night stay despite it being all in the receptacle. Ultimately I had to go ask for a trash bag to fill it up with three days worth of trash. Drains in the bathroom did not work properly and the housekeeper did not ensure her hairs were gone after replacing our towels ( I say this as floors were not cleaned ever). Also, our room was under a bowling suite. Which as a family traveling was the worst location as we would go to bed early. Lastly the manager said I would get a call from the housekeeping supervisor and I never did. I sometimes have to stay at low caliber hotels on road trips and those have been far cleaner than the Palms.

allReviews.title: All around BAD!
allReviews.text: Where do I start?  Was it the condescending attitude of the VIP host who checked me in?  Was it the pungent smell of carpet fresh that made it difficult to breathe in the room?  (Our last day we encountered the stench they were trying to mask) Was it the lumpy mattresses?  Was it the fact they informed us the water would be shut off the first morning of our stay?  Was it the rough crowd?  Was it the non-existent entertainment on the slots?  We’ve decided this will be the property of last resort for our stays in Vegas from now on. We’ve tried it twice now and it’s just NOT the place for us!

allReviews.title: This place sucks; don’t book it
allReviews.text: Stayed for a family wedding. Booked an ivory suite. Smelled like someone smoke 10 packs of cigs in our room. Asked to be moved and was moved to standard room in palm palace. Asked for a new room and they tried charged to up charge me $500 per night. Place is a joke I highly recommend booking anywhere else

allReviews.title: The Palms is not friendly to Diamond players
allReviews.text: Yaamava top management needs to get much more involved with the Palms, if they plan to keep this property long term.Palms does NOT recognize or take care of Diamond Players coming from Yaamava. I know, I’m one of them.Palms could have cared less about me being a Diamond player. I had to even go to a supervisor, just to get cleared for late checkout. And beyond that, they displayed zero regard for me as a player.Overall Palms staff is NOT friendly. Most of the workers there acted robotic and not friendly.The opposite is true at Yaamava, where the vast majority of team members are friendly and accommodating.Yaamava has a problem. They need to clean house at The Palms, and get management in there that treats us players well, like Yaamava does. And Yaamava has a much, much, much better selection of slot machines than The Palms.

allReviews.title: stayed once for a show at the hotel/casino
allReviews.text: Ther Hotel was ok but the staff were horrible! no help at all with the deposit on the room, I wound up having to dispute the charge on my credit card. definitely won't stay there again!

allReviews.title: terrible attendant Oscar
allReviews.text: I'm staying here until the 23/04, today I went to check in and the receptionist Oscar treated me terribly, the hotel is wonderful, it's a shame to leave such an arrogant and stuck-up guy at the hotel reception, the last time I'm staying.As for the gentleman who carried our bags, he is 1000% more polite than the attendant Oscar, he should be working at the hotel reception.

allReviews.title: Excellent service and accommodations!
allReviews.text: We came for our Anniversary and had a wonderful time. We had excellent service at Tonic Bar by the bartender Angela while watching the NCAA final. Very good upbeat atmosphere and she gave us recommendations on the restaurants also. We ate at Mabel’s BBQ, Scotch 80 & the AYCE breakfast all delicious. Our room had a fantastic view of the strip was clean and very spacious. Definitely coming back soon!

allReviews.title: Wrong charges without any information
allReviews.text: Unfortunately the hotel wrongfully and without any information charged me for the minibar to my security deposit. It took a long, annoying exchange of e-mails to get the hotel to at least agree to refund.  It seems based on other reviews that's not the first time they're doing that. Also no signs outside where to park and where to check in, check in is very slow, parts of the bathroom were very dirty (see pictures).

allReviews.title: Exceeds expectations
allReviews.text: I’ve been visiting Vegas since I was a young child, stayed at plenty of hotels/casinos over the years but the palms by far was the best. Great customer service, beautiful rooms, excellent food and loose slots. Me and my family enjoyed our stay very much and will back very soon.

allReviews.title: MARY Ann
allReviews.text: I had the best experience my waitsteess  Mary Ann is the best me and my husband sit in her section just  because of her I really appreciate  her kindness and smile everytime we are here. Mary Ann knows what drinks we like and even have them ready before we sit down at out slot machine. Palms casino you need more waitstees like here.

allReviews.title: Sarah Alcantaro
allReviews.text: Sarah Alcantaro with guest services was incredibly sweet and helpful during our stay on the 17th floor during the Cheer Choice Awards. She gladly offered help with our multiple trips up and down the halls and genuinely cared to make our stay enjoyable and carefree.  Thank you!

allReviews.title: Musty rooms...
allReviews.text: Musty, worn room with carpet that looks like it's alive. In general, the cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired, especially in the bathroom, especially for this price! You can hear every noise from the room next door through the connecting door! It takes 30 minutes to walk to the Strip, we wouldn't stay here again!

allReviews.title: Memorable times at the palms!
allReviews.text: I give this resort a  five star review from the hotel staff, restaurants, and  casino floor. Had a great time! I will definitely be back! I would highly recommend checking this hotel out. Very relaxing!  Free parking and many new casino slots to choose from.

allReviews.title: Best customer service
allReviews.text: Planned on taking a trip to Vegas, but I mixed up the dates and it turned into a real mess. I was really stressed out but Debra helped me fix everything. She was very kind and understanding. If you ever need any help, I highly recommend speaking with her.

allReviews.title: SUPERB!
allReviews.text: Upon check in Oscar was very pleasant and accommodating to begin with. The room is very clean, new and perfect size. Plus they have a food court that is open for 24 hrs, plus the buffet that also has unlimited crab legs and the kids got to enjoy the pool and theater. We loved everything in Palms Casino Las Vegas and we will definitely comeback!

allReviews.title: You must visit!
allReviews.text: Beautiful place to stay with a great location, clean room with a lot of space and friendly staff. Most of all the beautiful view! Thank you to Osear for welcoming my family and making us feel special! Can’t wait to come back! Must visit PALMS resort.

allReviews.title: Loved it!
allReviews.text: We loved staying here!! Oscar was super friendly at the front desk. Great restaurant options, reasonably priced drinks, clean bathrooms, and the room was huge!!! And for such a great price. I think we might have been upgraded?? Idk but it was amazing. We will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Professional
allReviews.text: Great Resort, thank you to our housekeeper Sarah Alcantara who was very Professional, our room was immaculate when she was done , Thank you  Sarah we will be visiting Palms casino again in the future, we had a great time here with our family on spring break 😃

allReviews.title: Amazing service!
allReviews.text: The Caker and Bellmen made our trip amazing! They were so attentive and accommodating. Always professional and a smile on their faces no matter how busy they were. I'd like to give a shout out too: Oscar, Teddy, Nyan and Noah. I felt like a true VIP and they made sure that we truly enjoyed our trip! I would stay at the palms hotel based on this customer service!

allReviews.title: Awesome service
allReviews.text: We had such a super  good time here, the staff is very friendly and the rooms are clean. Desanka was our server the first night we were here and she was super quick and friendly! I definitely recommend coming here and I would totally stay here again!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Veiw.
allReviews.text: The beds were comfy. The room also had a chase lounge that could be used as an extra bed so note of that! slept really well overall and for me, that's not common at hotels! The coffee was very good and the running/walking path was very nice and useful after a long day. The room was also very clean. Interesting decor though. Minifridge was very useful and clean. It had a variety of alcohol and was fully stocked up. Nice view too. I recommend this resort.

allReviews.title: They Got It!
allReviews.text: Rudy (valet) was the best ever!  Calm, quiet , confident.  Under control.Tavares (check in) was cool, calm, and knowledgeable.  Never got frazzled…even with a long lineWorth the trip to watch these professionals!One can tell this was not their first day!

allReviews.title: Salon suite must be updated
allReviews.text: We booked the Salon Suit for almost $800 / 2 nights and were hoping to get a luxury suit. However, when we arrived I realised that this is not luxury just a suit. I called to ask to be moved in the nicer suit and away from the elevator and has been transferred 3 times. Finally Nina the hotel manager got on the phone but didn’t really want to help at all . allReviews.title: So basic! Here for business & quickly leaving. Won’t be back.
allReviews.text: Here for business meetings being hosted in the hotel and stayed for convenience of location for early morning meetings. I feel like I landed on another planet. In no way the Vegas experience we are use to. No one to greet you when you arrive. I asked a security guard, “ where do I check in”,  and he just pointed down the hall. There is a bell desk but no eye contact or welcoming. You walk right into the casino which well it’s Vegas so that’s normal but it has no feeling of a hotel. The rooms; I’ve stayed in Sandman’s that are way nicer. So basic. Bed is uncomfortable. Grout in bathroom looks dirty. No coffee in room. Arrived at about 9pm and walked around trying to find something to eat. Aside from the buffet it’s like a mall food court. There is a bbq and a steak house that perhaps we will look at tonight but they were empty and did not look inviting. We also took a walk to check out where the meeting rooms are located to meet up in the morning. My husband walked through two sets of open doors to read the screen with all the meeting times and rooms on it. A security guard sitting up in his podium started whistling and yelling at me. I actually looked behind me thinking he must be yelling at someone else. He kept whistling and yelling so I asked..,”are you talking to me!?” He said yes we had to get out of the ballroom entrance. I told him with are here for a business summit and reading the  board. At that point he gave me a thumbs up. No class at all! I felt like he was a prison guard. The vibe here is an affordable place to stay if you are simply wanting to play slots and smoke! Very smoky in the casino. Not my vibe at all. We booked the Bellagio for the remainder of the week and I am so grateful I went with my gut on that. Palms is too far from the strip as well. We will not be back. The board room set up was good for our business part of the trip but if it’s hosted here again we will stay offsite.

allReviews.title: Ellein Lam is the best host
allReviews.text: Ellein Lam is the best host she is always very prompt and always very helpful Me and my wife are very happy with her service she always responds to our requests properly She makes it a pleasure to stay at the Palms We are so happy with everything especially with Ellein that we go there almost every month We also recommend the Palms to all our family and friends Shan Hacco

allReviews.title: The best, the staff, specially the room cleaner, Sara. The worst the expensive it is.

allReviews.title: Special Guest stay.

allReviews.title: Best Bartender

I sat down and was immediately greeted and treated like a regular and not just a tourist passing through.  Rare to find such great service in Vegas anymore

allReviews.title: Reasonably priced.
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a conference and the rooms are very nice. The conference center is large and they provided good food and service for our group.  The casino has some reasonable limit options. It's off-strip and walking over isn't really an option given how busy the street is, but other than that - nice hotel, reasonably priced, with good service, so I would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Bed Mattresses are worn out.  Time for a refresh of the beds
allReviews.text: Our company conducts client meetings in Las Vegas every year.  This year we rotated through the Palms and I have to say this was some of the best food provided at each meal.  Very good attention to detail in preparation and staff were always courteous and friendly.Few opportunities for improvement though.  The beds are terrible and not comfortable.  They are dished out with a hump in the middle of the mattresses.  Stayed here the past two weeks and both rooms had the same issue.  Also the curtain and curtain pull in my room was unattached at the top of the curtain and I could not get total darkness in the room at night.  This is a problem when the adjacent tower is shining neon lights all night.Upon checking into the room this past week i walk into the bathroom and find the key card holder for the last guest who was in here.  More attention to detail needed in room servicing.  Makes me wonder what else was missed or not cleaned up.You really need to place a lamp on the desk.  I could not use my computer to book reservations as it was too dimly lit to see keyboard.  Had to open the curtains all the way open to let in light to see my way around the room.Little things here but they add up when I can't get a good night of rest or complete a few simple tasks like looking at email on laptop before going down to gamble.

allReviews.title: No Coffee, and rude security staff.
allReviews.text: This is the first hotel I've been to that didn't have coffee in the rooms - no coffee maker either.  So I go down to the cafe in the morning to get coffee and the lady at the counter says that she can get it, but I'll have to wait to pay.  So she makes it and it's sitting on the other side of the counter, but then she goes into the back and nobody's there!  There are 8 other people also waiting to pay, and no one behind the counter, so 10 minutes later I walk into the cafe to see if I can find someone and a security guy (with an earpiece)  yells "Back away sir!!!"  Mind you, I wasn't behind the counter or in the back, I was just near the entry to the back but still on the right side of the counter.  I explain that I just wanted to find out how long I was supposed to stand there and he again yells "Back away!!!".  I told him he was an idiot and walked out without my coffee.  So, IF YOU DRINK COFFEE, DON'T STAY AT THIS HOTEL!

allReviews.title: Great last minute trip
allReviews.text: Had a last minute trip. Hotel staff was amazing! Took care of all needs and made suggestions to make the trip so much easier. Room was comfortable and check-in was quick and easy.  Dinner at Mabel’s was set up for us and it was delicious. Will return many times!

allReviews.title: Cash machine
allReviews.text: Factory hotel, no consideration for customers.No bottle of water in the room, no mini bar, the floor dispensers are all empty or “out of order”When I talk to reception about it, they tell me there’s nothing we can do 🤷‍♀️

allReviews.title: Won't be back !!!
allReviews.text: Ok, so I'm not trying to be a grumpy ole man, but after a 3 hour trip, I arrived at the Palm via self parking and was informed I was at the wrong check-in location, no worries, I needed the walk after sitting for 3 hours behind the wheel. So after checking in and walking into my room, I noticed a strange oder which smelt like cigarette smoke.  Ok, no biggie, I'm tired lets keep it moving. While in the bathroom I noticed spots (Stains) on the floor, soooo at this point I was like, ok let me check the other areas in the room, hmmm, it appears nothing was cleaned properly. So I called house keeping and asked if I could get some wipes or something to clean the room with, she stated they didn't have anything BUT I can purchase wipes from the shop in the lobby. Soooo, I went to Walgreen and purchased alcohol wipes and lysol spray to do a once over. Now the room smells and feels fresh. If I could check out tomorrow I would BUT this was paid via reward points. I'm not here to stay in my room but when I do I would like to feel like I'm sleeping in a clean space. The Palm has missed the mark, for me !!! won't be back !!!

allReviews.title: Lack of accountability and disregard for guest safety is UNACCEPTABLE
allReviews.text: I am deeply disappointed with my experience at the Palms Resort and Casino. My friends and I stayed at this establishment from Wednesday to Sunday in a standard double Queen bedroom. While the weather was beautiful and we enjoyed our time by the pool, the incident that occurred during our stay has left a sour taste in my mouth.In an attempt to avoid carrying all my belongings to the pool, I made the unfortunate decision to leave my wallet in my suitcase in the room. Little did I know that this would be a grave mistake. Upon returning to the room on Friday to get ready for the night, I discovered that my wallet had been tampered with. Shockingly, $200 bills and one of my credit cards were missing. It was evident that someone had entered the room and stolen these items from my suitcase.Disturbed by this violation, I immediately checked my credit card app and found that unauthorized charges totaling close to $500 had already been made. I promptly disabled my credit card to prevent further misuse. Seeking assistance, I reported the incident to the front desk, but to my dismay, they did not escalate the matter to the manager. Instead, I was directed to speak with security and asked to fill out an incident report.Throughout my stay, I diligently followed up with security, hoping for some resolution. However, when I checked out on Sunday, I was informed that I would be contacted within 24 to 72 hours. Regrettably, no one reached out to me during this time. After two days of silence, I took the initiative to call them myself, only to be told that nothing would be done about the situation. Security claimed to have reviewed the surveillance footage, but conveniently found no suspicious activity in the hallway. Well, of course, there wouldn't be any activity in the hallway when my belongings were stolen from inside the room!Furthermore, I must express my utter disbelief at the treatment I received from the security personnel at the Palms Resort and Casino. In addition to the distress caused by the theft, I was subjected to unnecessary questioning regarding the possibility of me misplacing the missing credit card myself. This insinuation was not only insulting but also completely unfounded. As a guest, I expected to be treated with respect and empathy, not met with baseless accusations.It is disheartening to see that the Palms Resort and Casino not only failed to address the theft adequately but also attempted to shift the blame onto me. This level of unprofessionalism and lack of accountability is simply unacceptable. I implore anyone considering a stay at this establishment to think twice before entrusting their belongings and personal safety to a resort that displays such disregard for its guests.To add insult to injury, I was informed that according to Nevada law, the hotel is not obligated to return lost or stolen items. This revelation is deeply concerning and raises serious doubts about the security measures in place at this resort. I urge anyone considering a stay at the Palms Resort and Casino to exercise extreme caution. It is evident that they currently have a thief on their staff, and the hotel management seems unwilling to take any action to rectify the situation.I cannot stress enough how disappointed I am with the Palms Resort and Casino. I will never be staying at this establishment again, and I strongly advise others to think twice before booking a room here. The lack of accountability and disregard for guest safety is simply unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Palms!
allReviews.text: We stayed here for two nights in June during our tour of California and Nevada, as we were getting married at The Little Church of the West. Having never been to Vegas/the States before we were amazed by how huge and slick the hotel was. It was very busy but we checked in and out with ease. Not sure about other Vegas hotels but there was free parking. We had a king room in the Ivory Tower. Great view, very spacious, lots of amenities, very clean and a great bathroom. While it’s off the strip, it’s in a good location and a short taxi ride to the strip. Having a 24/7 McDonalds downstairs was amazing… having a breakfast McMuffin while I did my wedding makeup was great. Sadly didn’t get to check out any of the restaurants/pool due to our short stay. I can’t comment on the gambling as believe it or not, we don’t gamble haha. Loved it though! Recommend!

allReviews.title: They'd Rather Snub You Than Serve You
allReviews.text: My husband and I are locals who used to enjoy visiting this hotel.  However, with the new ownership at the Serrano Cafe, we won't be going back to The Palms any time soon.To our shock and surprise, when we approached the hostess at the Serrano, she refused to seat us!  She said there were no tables available.  When I pointed out the place was half empty, she said, "Those tables are all reserved for other people."  Really?  So where are all these people?  Then she showed me her reservation sheet--and there wasn't a name on it!We had no choice but to leave, but I don't see how a hotel can operate when the breakfast cafe's motto is:  WE'D RATHER SNUB YOU THAN SEAT YOU!

allReviews.title: Unscrupulous billing practice
allReviews.text: I rented a room on 10/1 from the Palms for a friend. Checkout was 10/2. I put a deposit on the room for $100. I paid for a suite upgrade. After checkout, I was supposed to receive a refund of $95. Instead they charged me for the deposit, the upgrade and an additional $88. When we called to complain, they reversed all of the charges. Then 2 days later they charged me again for the upgrade and charges not made during the visit. I went up to the hotel and spoke to a manager. He informed me that my friend who stays there weekly had charges from August that were outstanding. So they just transferred them to my card for payment. I told him that that was not my problem. I only authorized the October charge. I asked them how come they didn't say there was an outstanding balance in over 2 months. He said they tried reaching him and couldn't. This was obviously a lie since he stays there every week while here on business. They couldn't tell for two months that there were charges. The manager told me that the charges will stand because I didn't specifically say that I only authorize the October charges. Why would I say that when they didn't provide information related to outstanding charges? They didn't care whose card was on file. They were going to charge it. The manager ended up being rude. I warn everyone who reads this, they are thieves and will charge whatever they want to your card and not care. Now I have to waste time contacting my bank to dispute the charges that I was never informed of prior to giving them my card information.

allReviews.title: Stay away
allReviews.text: Was not a pleasant experience. The main pool was closed for the 4 days during our stay. Charity event, so the the pool, in the building palms place, not the casino hotel, had no place to sit, even along the pool edge. Small pool with horrible pool service for drinks and food. Had to get my own. No place to sit poolside on one day of our stay. My wife and me went to Vegas for a Friday and Saturday night shows. Thursday night was our bar night. Left on Sunday. Upon checking out I asked for a reduced rate, due to the whole pool area was closed. I explained to him, we didn’t come to gamble, but relax by the pool and enjoy the shows and nightlife. He told me no, with a smirk  on his face, stating it could of rained and you would have not been able to use the pool. Well it was 90 degrees and sunny everyday. Wow, it rains 15-20 days a year in Vegas. I guess all the families that come with kids, don’t use the pools, kids come to gamble. There was no posting stating the pool was closed prior to my booking. The staff was rude, except for the housekeeper. Wonderful young lady. On the last day, I went down to the casino level to get a coffee, and as I got to the elevator a security, asked me for my room key. I said to him, for the previous 3 days and nights nobody ever asked me for a room key. He then proceeded to point his finger and pound his hand on the podium showing me a sign that says security and I take my job seriously. Well, I’m 61 years old, in a tee shirt and gym shorts with a coffee, and you just saw me get off the elevator 10 minutes ago, to get my coffee. Do you really think I’m a threat. What about all the drunk people taking the elevator Thursday night, and nobody asked for proof of a room key. My wife was taking a shower, what if I left my key in the room. Would it be a 20 minute deal, to wait for my wife to answer the phone? The guy was a jerk. The young lady serving sandwiches in the food court was unfriendly to my wife.maybe they should hire people that give a crap and our professional. I would recommend staying on the strip , at one of the many happening hotels. We are very laid back people, and I don’t like to confrontation and usually let things go, but wow, what a crappy experience.

What happens in Vegas should stay in Vegas, but Ramon A. in the Guest Rewards Center really took care of us, and made my birthday all the more special. So our sitter flaked and we had the kiddos and had to change plans a bit. He was so friendly and very knowledgeable on all the things to do and see during our stay that was kiddo friendly. He saved our trip. We will definitely recommend. Everything was so clean and comfy. Totally going to do this at least once a year. We ended up having a blast!

allReviews.title: Robert Plant in concert!
allReviews.text: Love this casino! Everyone is so friendly and service was great. Rooms were clean, bed was so comfortable! I hated to leave. I most definitely will be back! The concert was amazing! The restrooms were beautiful and so clean. We had dinner one night at Scotch 80 Prime and were treated like royalty and the food was spectacular! This is our go to hotel when we come to Vegas. I’ve stayed at the Palms at least 6 times in the last few years. The price of rooms is very affordable as well.

allReviews.title: Great recovery after a rocky start, thanks to Paige!
allReviews.text: Initially, this stay was a complete flop - the room type I ‘reserved’ several weeks ago was apparently not set aside for my arrival and we ended up in a 2 bed room vs a king.  The room was dirty, missing several items and had used toiletries - not to mention hearing the elevator cables all night.  I decided to complain and, lucky for us, Paige was at the front desk.  She was able to completely change our experience and make sure that the remaining part of our trip was the best.  We got an upgraded room that exceeded our expectations.  Negative things can happen but it’s how a business recovers that makes a difference, in my opinion.  This was our first stay at the Palms and I had originally written it off as a place to not return to but  thanks to Paige, we will consider the Palms again.  The casino is great and clean!

allReviews.title: Best Day Ever at the Best Hotel Ever!
allReviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the Grand Corner Suite in the Fantasy Tower almost two weeks ago, I was accommodated by Paige in every way & she made my stay as seamless as possible, even with the heavy flow of people checking in due to the Beyoncé concert. Paige thoroughly communicated and made sure my needs were met the entire stay! Our room was exceptionally clean and every feature worked perfect. I ended up getting engaged and later found out Paige assisted my now fiancée in making sure decorations were properly set in place for the proposal. Easily one of the best days of my life!

allReviews.title: We Love The PALMS
allReviews.text: My experience in the Grand Corner Suite/Fantasy tower was more than exceptional. Paige met every need of mine from check-in to check-out. The room was clean and the view was breathtaking. The view outlooking the strip was amazing. Paige’s customer service was top tier, she was able to assist me in an elegant proposal to my now fiancée. I would definitely be booking at the Palms again and again!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in  Vegas
allReviews.text: We stay in Palms almost every month. This time we celebrated my parents 50th anniversary at Palms. Great memories!!!We love everything about this hotel, nice and clean rooms, friendly staff. The pool is very fancy, they have very beautiful cabanas. We have a great host Erno Mabini, he always keeps us happy:)

allReviews.title: Great host
allReviews.text: I am so fortunate to have Erno as my host. He is amazing. So thoughtful, helpful, and available. I have had other casino hosts that I book rooms through that have never bothered to even meet me at other hotels- not Erno. Every time I am there he comes and talks to me and seeks me out. Simply the best. Thanks Erno Mabini!

allReviews.title: Will always be my off strip place to stay!!!
allReviews.text: Palms hotel is one of the best casino off strip that you want to stay to. Rooms are big with  comfy bed and pillows. We had an issue with the AC but they were prompt to fix it. The food is amazing, from the AYCE buffet, Serrano Cafe, Tim HoWan, Scotch 80, basically all their restaurants, has great choices of food!!! It’s a little bit pricey but you always get what you pay for. Erno Mabini, my host, super friendly, always go beyond to help guests and patrons. Always one txt away from his guests needs. Highly recommended place to stay and experience super Fun and safe stay in Vegas!!

allReviews.title: Best host at Palms: Erno Mabini.
allReviews.text: My host Erno Mabini arranged dinner for me and my nephew at Scotch 80. The restaurant was great. Erno, as always did a great job taking care of me like he does with all his customers. Erno is one of the best hosts in Las Vegas. I am glad I have him as my host.

allReviews.title: Kudos to Palms - and host Erno Mabini!
allReviews.text: Palms is great, made only that much better by my host Erno Mabini!  He's always there to help, provide exciting opportunities and just a great guy.  From simple restaurant reservations to some excellent and unique experiences, Erno has made it all happen and made me a loyal Palms customer!  And did I mention the theater?  What other hotel/casino in Vegas has an IMAX theater?  If you haven't been there, you should go.  Today.

allReviews.title: Casino Host Erno Mabini
allReviews.text: My Casino Host Erno Mabini is very accommodating and helpful he went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction in all hotel accommodation and restaurant reservations and giving freebies as one of the VIP player of Palms Hotel and Casino.

allReviews.title: Great host
allReviews.text: Great restaurants and great employees especially our host Erno Mabini. Never had a host as attentive as Erno and we've been playing for over 50 yrs We're local so we know the resorts and we have been to most.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Palms Casino Resort
allReviews.text: The place was great, plenty of restaurants to choose from, lots and lots of slot machines, fast-food restaurants at the food court , movie theaters and FREE covered parking!!!!The room was well appointed, smelled fresh and very welcoming.The front desk person was so nice and resourceful.My host, Erno Mabini, was the best!  He made my stay a wonderful experience. He made sure that I was comfortable in my room and enjoyed my meals at the restaurants he comp me for my stay! He knows how to take care of his guests! He really makes you feel appreciated!Great fun place, excellent people, and the best host in Vegas, Erno Mabini!

allReviews.title: Went to Tonic Bar every night!
allReviews.text: Big shoutout to Danny at Tonic Bar! We went there every night to try different cocktails made by him. He really cares about his craft and his drinks are always so balanced.  Try the margarita, spicy margarita, Mexican candy shots— anything he recommends really!! We loved his drinks and service so much that we asked for his work schedule, to make sure we catch him next time we’re back.Also shoutout to Jeff who we met one night - we jokingly had a margarita showdown between Danny and Jeff and it was hilarious! Jeff’s margaritas are delicious too!

allReviews.title: great vibe and restaurants
allReviews.text: We had a great time at the Palms. They have a couple of the best restaurants in the city (Scoth80 Prime and Vetri Cucina, oh and the newly opened La Popular!!) and the whole staff was very welcoming and helpful. Our hospitality host Gabriel Swinn took great care of our group and made sure we had an awesome weekend. Thank you and we look forward to coming back! I hope they introduce an EDM night at Ghostbar, that would put it over the top!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Time At The Palms Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I had a wonderful weekend staying at the Palms hotel in Las Vegas. My hospitality host Gabriel Swinn did a wonderful job setting up my hotel room, dinners at Scotch 80 Prime and Vetri Cucina as well as an amazing cabana at the pool. If your looking for a great host that truly provides a wonderful experience, look no further than Gabriel Swinn at the Palms Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Customer Experience
allReviews.text: Front desk management were awesome and extremely helpful.  Front desk staff, not so much.  Krista in the office was super helpful, and my housekeeper Melody was amazing.  My pool server Evelyn was the absolute best!  She’s the best server in Vegas!!

allReviews.title: Nice for sleeping
allReviews.text: The room is spacious and clean. The bathroom is sumptuous. The swimming pool is also very nice if it weren't for the fact that it closes a little too early (at 6pm). The flaws are the casino which I didn't like, the smell of oriental cuisine and the distance from the main road.

allReviews.title: Soak Pool Cabana
allReviews.text: Hello!!My husband and I were not staying at the Palms but we recently rented a cabana for the day on 8/23/23. We had not stepped foot in the Palms in about 7-8 years, the renovations were beautiful! Back to the cabana… we arrived and waited a few minutes before Sesen checked us in.I am a firm believer in the frontline is the face of your organization and it can make or break an experience with first impressions. Sesen immediately apologized for the wait and she was very  welcoming, sweet and had a sunny ☀️ and bright attitude.Sesen offered us an upgraded cabana due to the other side of the pool being closed. We ended up with a cabana with a private soak pool. We were most excited and enjoyed it immensely! Diane was our cocktail server for the day and Louis was assisting. Drinks were just okay  to me, but my husband enjoyed his cocktails and we both thought the food was AMAZING! We especially loved the Vegas hot chicken wrap!The bathrooms were incredibly clean, any staff members you encountered greeted you with a smile.At one point I had to run into the store to grab an essential, Sesen I turned security I was there for the day (no room key)and would be returning shortly. She made sure I wouldn’t have any issues. It was such a chill vibe, great music, and it was a very comfortable cabana! We will definitely do this again, we enjoyed it immensely.

allReviews.title: Not for us SORRY!!!
allReviews.text: Not so special for 2 nights with family, better go to other hotel a bit outside the strip when you have a car because this hotel is only meant for people who want to play. Las Vegas is nothing special just great if you’re a player, for a family trip avoid all cost this or other hotels near to the strip.

allReviews.title: BEST WEEKEND EVER!!!
allReviews.text: I went to Vegas this past weekend and it was such an enjoyable experience. Throughout my stay, my friends and I hung out at the "Tonic" Sports Bar and the bartender Danny was so warm and friendly. Was very knowledgeable on what his suggestions for drinks and whatnot and HE DID NOT DISAPPOINT!! So much fun talking and laughing with friends and Danny. BEST BARTENDER EVER!! If you ever stay or stop by The Palms, say hello to Danny and have him mix you a delicious cocktail or two.

allReviews.title: Great Blackjack Dealer
allReviews.text: Dennis on graveyard dealing blackjack was great. Entertaining and so courteous. Five stars. He acted like he was on your side. Great attitude and smile throughout. The pit bosses at the Palms are fantastic. Everyone is so courteous    Would recommend

allReviews.title: Fun stay
allReviews.text: Overall a good stay. Our room was tidied each day with fresh towels given. The staff were all very friendly and helpful! We ate at Mabel’s a couple of times which was very nice. The pool was nice although we didn’t use it (just sat by it for a while before we caught our flight home). The casino itself was good too. I think the rooms could have been “cleaned” more for example there was a lot of dust/grime along the skirting board. Having said that, it didn’t affect our stay and we still had a lovely time. We had an issue with being checked into the wrong room at first (which was sorted out very efficiently by the front desk) but the first room had coffee stains and hair in the bathroom too. The bed was huge and super comfy!The hotel is a 20 min walk or 5-10 minute drive to the strip. If you don’t mind this it’s a great hotel to stay at and a little more affordable than the ones on the strip. We ended up spending a fair amount of money on Ubers  as we didn’t want to walk in 40 degree heat! Something to bare in mind.Overall we had a great time, thank you!

allReviews.title: Great hospitality!
allReviews.text: Vegas was the destination of our mother daughter yearly trip! The room was great and house keeping even better! We were very needy but Yanitza was very pleasant and helped us immensely! We also had a great time at the casino!

allReviews.title: Rude security and they kicked us out.
allReviews.text: It started out nice, but then security for some reason denied my wife and child to come in. I was already in the room and they had been out shopping. And then I was told to pack up my things and leave the room.Just managed to get a room for usbat the flamingo by the strip.I would advice everyone to pick anything that doesn't have "Palms" in it for your stay

allReviews.title: An Amazingly Fun Time enabled by the libationary skillz of two Mad Scientist Bartenders!!!
allReviews.text: My Wife & I were in Las Vegas for business but made a bit of time to have a little fun. We did a lot of research before our trip on the best rooftop bars. After sifting thru a lot of YouTube Vlogs we decided to check out the GhostBar at The Palms. Well, it was....AMAZING! The view is by FAR the BEST view of the strip because you get to see the whole strip! The pictures simply do not do it justice! Great vibe outside too!Speaking of vibe, you go to say hi to Paul & Brian! Those two Bartenders are awesome man! I love champagne cocktails and we worked together to come up with what I call the "MarcoPolo" (MarkPaul)!!! It's Champagne, simple syrup, grenadine, and RUM. It got so popular that others took notice and started ordering it too! I will be going back in a month or so and I cannot wait to stop by to order another one from My Man Paul! Brian too! As for Brian? That dude reminds me of Nate Ruess from FUN. Super cool dude and a great Bartender as well! Eva & I had a GRAND time there! Oh! And let's not forget the DJ. That dude was spinning the platters that matta all night long! He played all our jams and got the dance floor going!Our only suggestion is that they add a more diverse set of alcohol choices to fully allow these talented Bartenders to explore their already formidable skillz! More top shelf items are a must. All in all Eva & I believe you will enjoy yourselves at The GhostBar at The Palms! I look forward to staying there too! It would be our first time! Hopefully we can review that as well! Can't wait to go back! Paul & Brian, look forward to seeing you guys....have that "MarcoPolo" waiting for me...

allReviews.title: Las Vegas vacay
allReviews.text: We have fallen to love the Palms but this last visit was extraordinary. Our housekeeper Sarah Alcantara went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable and clean. Our family really  appreciated it. The only reason I give a 4 is because our bed was to soft for us and there were no bed swaps available nor roll away beds. If it wasn’t for the beds no doubt I would rate our stay a 5. Thank you Sarah Alcantara!!!you were awesome.

allReviews.title: Read the fine print!!! Buyer beware!
allReviews.text: Read the fine print very very carefully before booking here! I made a reservation 2 months in advance. Never received a confirmation email for my reservation. Cancelled via phone call it a few days later since I found a better price at a hotel that was actually ON the strip. The person I spoke to on the phone did not mention that I would not be receiving a refund if I cancelled.  Now they are refusing my refund saying it was a non-refundable reservation...?  I looked everywhere on their website for their cancellation policy prior to cancelling, nowhere did it mention non-refundable if it is cancelled so far in advance. In fact, the cancellation email I did receive says "cancellations are accepted up to 48 hrs before arrival with a full return of deposit". If the cancellation policy was any different than the standard, they should have at least sent a confirmation email at the time of booking to explain this.  Very deceitful tactics. Will not be staying here and will not recommend to anyone.

allReviews.title: WSOP & Bacarrat & Black jack games
allReviews.text: Elaine Lam (Sr. Executive Palms casino) is one of the best host that I ever have. I really appreciate her for accommodating booking hotels & buffet reservations & response back quickly even though she’s in the meeting. Overall she is the best host. Execellent host. I feel grateful and thankful that she is my host.  I feel happy & enjoying the palms environments & wonderful services. I will definitely recommend all my friends and relatives and families to enjoy the best buffet at Palms casino.  The rate of my host is 10 out of 10!  Way to go Elaine Lam & thank you making me for the great experience trip this year 2003. Excellent Host Elaine Lam for many thanks. Sincerely,Hong Minh TranKnownothing73@gmail.com

allReviews.title: Racist guest.
allReviews.text: I was born in the US. I was born in California and I experienced extreme racism At this casino the palms. The manager rather see me leave instead of the racist. Avoid here if you are against racism…..

allReviews.title: Birthday at the palms
allReviews.text: The place was very upscale and clean and the drinks were the best our  view was wonderful and Gabriel made sure he took the best care of me and my friends for her birthday we will definitely be coming back soon !

allReviews.title: Amazing Weekend Getaway
allReviews.text: One of my favorite and frequent weekend getaway destinations is Las Vegas. I spent over ten years living there so I know the city as a local and a visitor. I just had my second stay within a year at the Palms. I enjoy the Palms because it has so much to offer I can stay here for the weekend and continue to find new and fun experiences. I spent all Saturday morning at The Spa and had an excellent aromatherapy massage from Patrice.  I spent the morning relaxing and exploring the many rooms the spa had to offer. Beyond self care, I also indulged in some of the restaurants. Both La Popular and Scotch 80 offered excellent and attentive service but delicious dishes and  well crafted cocktails. Highly recommended, 5 starts and can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: TIERRA!
allReviews.text: Tierra was the best waitress. Even on a very busy night, she made us feel welcome and like we were her only table. She was attentive, kind, and efficient. If you stay at Palms, look for Tierra. You will receive the best customer service ever. Thank you Tierra!

Great atmosphere. Great service. Tracey the bartender is awesome. Great rooms. The people are great and make you feel welcome. Would totally come back again. I was only here for one day and it was a great day.

allReviews.title: A great experience for getting off The Strip!
allReviews.text: Had a great time at the Palms last week! The room was comfortable and clean, the pool was beautiful and relaxing, and the hotel's bars were lots of fun for when we didn't want to venture out on the strip. All of the bartenders were great, but Tracey was a treasure... She slung some delicious drinks and was just really fun to chat with.The casino was good, too! I didn't win, but I knew that going in, lol. Still had a good time with a good selection of games. I'll happily stay at the Palms the next time I'm down ol' Vegas way.

allReviews.title: Great vip room
allReviews.text: Best room ever i got vip with vip top took an elevator to the pool not the hotel elevators vip elevator it’s fast good my room is good beautiful get a patio get basketball room I did a back flip but nice bathroom love it recamend

allReviews.title: Rooms need Renovation
allReviews.text: Stayed here in July. Paid almost $300 for a night. These rooms need renovation. It is an older hotel. Our room smelled of smoke and sulphur/sewage.  Air would not get colder than 72. Not that clean, hair in the bathroom, the mirror had the metal backing coming off it was so old. This seemed like a $100/night hotel. The casino and shops below were fine.  When I checked out I mentioned the issues and they did nothing. Just said have a nice day.

allReviews.title: A must stay
allReviews.text: I had a blast staying at the palms with my friends and family! We had a great dinner at scotch80 and spent sometime at the Shark bar where summer and Ray took great care of us. We later ended our night at the Tonic bar where we also had great service from the bartender over there. We also met the bar manager working that night Casey she gave us some tips on where and what to do while in town. Overall we had such an enjoyable time. Will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Great stay!  Kelton Simon took great care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. He was amazing and made our stay so comfortable. Highly recommend for families and couples. Great property, quiet and clean.

allReviews.title: The Palms Experience!!
allReviews.text: The Palms treated me like a King. VIP services were excellent especially Alexis @ VIP LOUNGE!! I really enjoyed my stay!! I will be returning in the near future!! The restaurants & food court provided an abundance of choices!!

allReviews.title: Great location, Stunning Hotel, Beautiful Views
allReviews.text: Beautiful, spacious rooms. The pool area was a blast! Get there early to book yourself a table with an umbrella. $200 for the whole day, which goes into your tab spend for drinks and food. There's a mini bar in the rooms. The hotel is slightly away from thr strip, which was perfect for us, but also easy to get to the strip by taxi. There's a pharmacy just down the road to buy water. The staff was also very friendly, was able to get a top floor room with stunning views upon request. Will definitely be coming back here

allReviews.title: Fantastic Stay! Will be back
allReviews.text: A real treat! From the arrival experience to our room was amazing. Stayed in the fantasy tower---very short walk from the front desk and most of the hotel amenities.  Dinner at Scotch 80 Prime was 5 star...we were decadent and shared a seafood tower...fantastic! Spent some time in the casino...employees were very friendly and engaged. Kudos to the leadership team. We will be back!

allReviews.title: Next time you should look for the customer’s information first
allReviews.text: I checked in with a lady and my room wasn’t ready at that time, I paid for a deposit and she said come back to get a key when it ready! I got a text that my room was ready and I went to get a key with another person at the counter and the gentleman who works there at the counter asked me to pay for deposit again even though I paid for it I told him for so many time that the lady charged me, he looked upset and didn’t understand what I say and he wasn’t even look for my information on a computer he just wanted me to pay! I decided to show him my bank account statements that I got charged and explained him! I’m so frustrated!! Finally after I showed him my bank account and he apologized to me!!

allReviews.title: MUST!!
allReviews.text: We booked and stayed at the Ivory Tower on the 25th floor with Double bed. The room is beautiful and roomy with a panoramic view breathtaking view towards the strip. We had VIP service and Desie was an angel! Overall, the hotel and casino areas are clean and smell good. We would recommend to everyone single or as a family trip. Can wait to make another trip and stay here.

allReviews.title: Fascinating!
allReviews.text: We booked and stayed at the Ivory Tower on the 50th floor with King bed. The room is beautiful and roomy with a panoramic view looking out to MGM, Mandalay Bay hotel and Allegiant Stadium. The living room separate from bedroom with its own toilet. Main bathroom is really huge and clean. The only minor thing is the small fridge not working, and the weather was hot in which we would like to store drinks. Overall, the hotel and casino areas are clean and nice since it was renovated recently. We would recommend to everyone. Next time perhaps we will try to stay at "Fantasy" Tower.

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: KENTON WAS THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP. He was courteous and went out of his way to bring us pots and pans and condiments. The palms place owners need to UPDATE THEIR APARTMENTS. They have become pretty run down and housekeeping is not bad but it’s a hit or miss!! There is not STANDARD

allReviews.title: The Best!
allReviews.text: My favorite hotel as a local and to recommend to tourist friends and family! I love that it smells so clean in the rooms and in the casino! So much better than other hotels in town. I am a frequent visitor of the Palms. Beautiful hotel & amazing customer service.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: Experience from valet to getting checked in and playing in the casino was phenomenal.Customer service here is great all smile and friendly. Experience a whole different vip check in, it was an awesome experience for my wife and I!Thanks for the great experience and see you guys soon!!

allReviews.title: Go See Tracey at Tonic !!!!
allReviews.text: Stayed at The Palms and had a great time for my first time in Vegas for my birthday. I was so happy to meet Tracey at Tonic. She was the best and made my birthday stay very special !!! Can't wait to go back

allReviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service
allReviews.text: Out of the plethora of hotel / casinos I’ve been to in Vegas (Strip & off) over the years, I have to say my experience at the Palms this last week was one of my best.   By and large from the stellar service provided at the sports bar by Tracey.  My friends and I were in town from Cali & the service she provided for not just myself, but my entire group was nothing short of exceptional.  Unfortunately my biggest gripe while visiting Vegas tends to be arrogant bartenders who rarely exhibit the endearing attributes of someone like Tracey.  I’m typically not one for reviews. However, I will proudly be returning to The Palms next time I’m in town & will look forward to hopefully seeing our new favorite bartender again!  Free parking & convenience to the amazing food in Chinatown was another huge bonus!

allReviews.title: Great great hotel
allReviews.text: Really nice hotel! Rooms was amazing. Food was really good we tried about every restaurant lol Our cocktail server Tiara was great as well she recommended some nice places to go! Will be back next year Thanks Palms

allReviews.title: Lovely
allReviews.text: Rich was amazing. Customer service was spectacular nonetheless. Rich was interested as to why we stayed and due to our marriage plans that week he went out of his way to ensure we were provided great service. The entire hotel was clean, amazing service and pleasant. I became a member that night and realized I would be staying at this hotel moving forward. I visit Vegas on a yearly basis and sometimes more and I can’t believe I haven’t stayed here. I’m impressed and I will definitely stay here again and recommend.

allReviews.title: Great drinks and gambling
allReviews.text: Came by the other night for some drinks and gambling and we had a blast! Met a lovely lady named Tracey and she really made our experience! Drinks are great fun gambling and clean atmosphere! Lots of great restaurants to Pick from too! We will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Don’t like it
allReviews.text: Was on a trip. Lost 50 k and the girl made me to put another 40k. The service was worst to. I would rather go to another casino than this. The machines were so complex too. My friend recommended to go here but I regret going here. I will never go here ever.

allReviews.title: Casino is pretty cool
allReviews.text: Didn't stay at the hotel but did stop by the casino.  Modern and lots of promos available.  Buffet is probably the last affordable casino buffet in Vegas. Mostly writing this review as a shout out to Aaron our blackjack dealer. Got to be honest when you play odds are you're not going to make any money. When you have a dealer with less personality than a piece of cardboard it makes it an even worse experience. Aaron is what a dealer should be, sociable, friendly,  outgoing, just a good guy. I would have been happy to lose money at his table, but I actually won a few bucks as an added bonus. Gotta hire more guys like him.

allReviews.title: Terrible experience
allReviews.text: I play a lot and I'm  a diamond serrano club member . When I called vip services over the phone and representative was very rude with us and said that we don't have any offers and hung up the phone. This is was very sad experience with vip services at Palms Casino Resort.

allReviews.title: Loved our stay at the Palms
allReviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful stay at the Palms Hotel. Paige at the reception desk was so helpful and professional. James , manager went out of his way to assist us with some complicated issues and took the time to navigate us to a prompt and excellent resolution. Veronica, inside the Serrano cafe gave excellent service. We will definitely return to this lovely hotel.

allReviews.title: Palms resort is a great experience
allReviews.text: Went to Palms and was very pleased with all aspects of the resort..  Absolutely loved the ayce lobster (yes all you can eat lobster) Buffett and playing the slots.  Very clean well managed hotel property and amenities.  Off the strip so usually not my go to but because of this experience it’s now in my top 3.  100% go back on my next Vegas trip.

allReviews.title: Worst experience at a hotel ever in my life
allReviews.text: Worst experience at a hotel ever in my life, we were driving into the parking lot to check in and my girlfriend had drank to much and playfully dumped some water on me. We pulled too close to another car and didn't hit anything all in fun in Vegas whatever got to the hotel yay. No Security Superviser starts screaming in my face DO YOU WANT TO PRESS CHARGES DO YOU WANT TO PRESS CHARGES? While he waives a giant flashlight at us and calls all this other security. I dont even know what he is talking about. Then he gets us out of the car and explains he thinks my girlfriend hit me in the face not poured a little water on me for making a bad joke. Then proceeds to call the police and say that we are in a domestic incident, all while making my girlfriend and I feel confused and we just are tired and want to check into the hotel. This takes now over an hour and then he bans us from the property and tells us we can't check into our hotel. We then had to spend thousands more trying to find a hotel room last minute EDC Weekend in Vegas, worst experience ever with a hotel.On camera there was zero evidence of my girlfriend hitting me as the security supervisor accused and zero evidence of us hitting any other cars which was their other reason for escalating. Also not one mark on me or any car to support these outlandish claims from the security team.The Palms has a Security team looking for any excuse to call the police and get their own guests in more trouble instead of protecting them. I would never ever stay here if I was you, unlike other Vegas hotels this hotel does not have the best interests of their guests in mind.

allReviews.title: Oscar was the best :)
allReviews.text: Oscar you were the absolute best!!!! Oscar was our guest service attending. He checked us in and made sure we had an upgraded room that was available and sent us Champaign and fruit from the downstairs restaurant. He made us feel valued. This is exactly the highest quality you should expect in any hotel. Thank you, Oscar; for making our trip rememberable. We will be returning again and hope to see your warm and inviting smile! Mahalo from Hawaii!!! ❤️

allReviews.title: An ok visit
allReviews.text: The hotel was off the main strip and not a great walk to get to the main area, but there is free parking and the hotel is comfortable.  We were unfortunate to get a room adjoining the elevators, which were constant and noisy all night long.  The rooms are comfortable, and nice bathrooms - just make sure you aren't near the elevators!

allReviews.title: Great check in experience
allReviews.text: This review is for Paige at the front desk. She was extremely helpful and friendly checking our group in for two rooms. She helped us get a roller bed and a fridge for our room too (we didn't even know these were offered). Her customer service was excellent and I wish all of my checkin's at Vegas would be through Paige! She was extremely transparent with all of the hotel fees upon checkout as well.

allReviews.title: BOUJI
allReviews.text: BOUJI, try to present well or at least be funny here!!! Really world class entertainment, Celebrity friendly. DO NOT underestimate the people here...there are some really big names that love this place!! Come down in your best draws!!

allReviews.title: Thank You Gentily 💖
allReviews.text: I want to thank our Hostess Gentily for always providing my husband and I an outstanding experience. Thanks to Gentily we always feel as though we are VIP. I also appriciate that she always responds to text messages immediately.Thank you Gentily for all you do. You are amazing!!!

allReviews.title: Weekday Trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: This was me and my wife’s first trip to Las Vegas and we chose well staying at the Palms. The AYCE buffet Wednesday night was worth the stay alone. The staff was friendly, and the house keeping team was top notch. Thank you Perla Valencia was making us feel like we were at home. I can’t wait to come back and stay with The Palms again!!!

allReviews.title: Best dealer ever
allReviews.text: We were there for a week for our anniversary. The  hotel was amazing, but what made our experience extraordinary was our dealer Lee Ehrlich. He is the best dealer at this casino hands down! We had so much fun at his table, we will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Went for a bite and a show - didn't disappoint!
allReviews.text: My fiance and I went to the Palms to see one of our long time local favs, Frankie Moreno. The Kaos venue is hands down one of the nicest he's ever played and we can't wait to return for another show. Before the concert we ate at Palms Pizza and it was super tasty, and the slices were as big as our heads! We also wanted to give a shout-out to one of your casino cleaners, Stefon, who took our trash for us when we were finished and checked in with us at our machines to see if we needed anything. Very polite and great service. Would definitely return and recommend!

allReviews.title: Staycation!
allReviews.text: Wanted to get away for the weekend and made a  reservation here at the Palms. Poms is located across the freeway on flamingo and catty corner from the Gold Coast casino. It almost seems like the palms that we capture the spirit of what the Rio used to be. Great local casino with really good food options. Staff was super friendly and I definitely will return sometime in the future.

allReviews.title: Nicest Hotel in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Palms for with a big group of friends for a bachelorette celebration. They were so accommodating to our big group making any reservation stress free! Which was really refreshing as most places make it hard for big groups. Ghost Bar is a hidden gem, we had so much fun, not to mention one of the best views of the city! All staff we encounter were very friendly and helpful. The hotel itself was one of (if not the) nicest and cleanest resorts in Las Vegas. Will definitely be staying here again

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel with great employees
allReviews.text: This hotel and casino was fantastic! Check in was fast and friendly, room was spacious and clean, all the employees from front desk, security, casino floor, housekeeping, pool, buffett, parking, we're outstanding, it was the best trip I've had in a long time! All made possible with the helpful people here! The buffet was great, lots of choices for gaming! The pool atmosphere was outstanding!

allReviews.title: Awesome Craps Dealer
allReviews.text: Was able to play Craps yesterday. It was my pleasure to have Lee Ehrlich as one of my Dealers. Lee was AWESOME!  Not only was he fast and accurate, but he quickly learned my betting moves and anticipated my next press. He was fun to chat with during the game as well. The thing he did that I like the best was, he watched my chip rail, and when paying my bets, he gave me chips I needed, not just the chips that were easy for him to give me. ToMe, this separates the OK Dealers from the BEST Dealers, as it is so rare when it happens. I can’t wait to go back and play at Lee’s table!

allReviews.title: The Palms is my favorite place in Vegas!
allReviews.text: From Valet to the VIP lounge, multiple restaurants, a fancy pool and even a Movie theater The Palms hotel is an all inclusive experience! If you play your cards right you could even be treated like royalty by the executive host team! (Erno Mabini is the best!) When it comes to the rooms they are well equipped and the beds are heavenly after a long day on the casino floor! It's truly a place for people of all ages!

allReviews.title: Great fun easy access Casino that has everything!
allReviews.text: The Palms hotel and casino is a really fun place just off the strip on Flamingo. It has so many areas inside to eat from signature buffet, casual, fine dining, and more offering several ethnicities and types of foods to choose from.It’s very colorful as a casino should be with an eclectic vibe throughout the property. Slots are fun and they feature all the newer games.  It’s very well kept up and very clean everywhere. They even have dancers at the open area bar off the slot floor. The parking garage is huge and it’s FREE! They have the coolest movie theater I’ve ever been to. It’s setup like a nightclub. Upon initial entry, you are on a dance floor and they have several plush blue velvet couches roped off on the side. If you purchase any concessions, you can go sit there before your movie starts and feel like s VIP! They play really hip music. Interestingly, you don’t hear any when you are watching your movie. Tickets are same price or less than you would pay at regular theaters. When you’re walking down the corridor to get to your movie room there are beautiful wall murals liken to the artist banksy. At each room they have disco balls twirling around which takes you by surprise. At the concessions they have several really good quality ice cream flavors by the scoop like an ice cream parlor. Staff is fun, laid back and friendly. The theater inside and out was very clean. They have shows as late as 4am too and the party is still going! If that’s not enough, just outside the entry is a mini food court offering McDonald’s, Panda Express, Boba drinks and a few others! This is a very cool fun interesting concept movie theater that you won’t find anywhere else…only in Vegas as they say!

allReviews.title: 5 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 Service when you need it!
allReviews.text: To Whom it may Concern : During a short trip to, visit our Daughter, in Las Vegas. My Wife forgot her C.C. So thanks to ( Agent : Lorraine ).. Who works for the Palms, did an outstanding C/S. To help my wife. Thus the Casino, was able to process my concern to help out my wife.. Where she was able to get a room for tonight.. Thank You ( Agent : Lorraine), and the Palms Casino for going above C/S Standards.. That's why me and the Wife, stay there, when we are in town.. Dan De Leon

allReviews.title: Nice casino hotel, just a bit disappointment with the Ivory Suite.
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: Dennise is the best!!
allReviews.text: Dennise the slot Attendant is by far the best person inside a casino I have ever had the pleasure of interacting with,she is the example of over the top customer service.  She's literally why I come to this place ,all my friends and I LOVE HER!!

allReviews.title: Horrible Beds
allReviews.text: The beds were all horrible. When we got there the first thing out of their mouth was we are overbooked and I said this was reserved back in February 2023 so there were plenty of rooms  back then. The King size mattress sunk to the floor with me just laying my knee on it and I weighed 165 pounds. We complained and the following night we got a different room with 2 queens sized bed I was pissed imagine being married for 33 years and this hotel separated my wife and I. I tried sleeping in same bed to no avails the mattress sunk to the floor. We didn’t want complain again because we didn’t want to keep packing up our clothes. The staff knows about this problem but the big managers just ignores them. Typical higher ups looking to get to general managers or go. So if you don’t mind sleeping basically on the floor look else where

allReviews.title: You can easily do better.
allReviews.text: Don't be fooled by "remodeled", the property is old and tired.  Table games are very limited to non-existent and the focus is almost 100% on slots.Definitely overpriced and dumpy, much beter options out there for sure.

allReviews.title: Best Birthday Celebration
allReviews.text: Best birthday celebration with family and friends!!!  Our host Juan Morales is the absolute best.  Always treats my family and friends extremely well.  The entire staff including Ray, Kim, VIP front desk, and restaurant help have been amazing.  We will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: A tale of two towers
allReviews.text: Stayed in Fantasy Tower king rooms last year and decided to upgrade to two Ivory Tower Suites this year.Ivory Tower Suite – One StarThe rooms have not been recently updated evidenced by the non-digital thermostat. The rooms are decorated in garish colors of red and white. The rooms are the size of a suite but have the amenities of a below standard Holiday-Inn Express.The rooms have no clocks. The open closet is in the bathroom with three small shelves; that is the room’s only storage. There is no dresser. There is a phone jack and electric outlet where there was a dresser at one time. There are no end tables with storage, just a shelf. Obviously, the regular occupants of this suite did not have luggage nor could be trusted with movable amenities.The single sink bathroom has an open shower design, giving your clothing a steam treatment whether they needed it or not. The shower caddy/shelf in one of the showers had broken off and had not been replaced. The full-length mirror in the other shower was propped up against the wall where it had broken off the wall. I felt the need to use a hand towel when using the shower to avoid contact with the shower floor.We “downgraded” to Fantasy Tower kings after one night.Fantasy Tower King – Five StarThis room is equivalent to a standard room at Wynn/Encore. Decorated in lovely earth tones with updated amenities: digital thermostat, lighted closet, automatic closing drawers in the dresser, large television, makeup mirror, and a beautiful, closed shower with bench seating and separate water closet.I would highly recommend the Fantasy Tower king and avoid the Ivory Tower rooms.

allReviews.title: Alexis you are the best!
allReviews.text: Alexis is a phenomenal VIP host! She treated us with respect and made our check in process seamless. Hotel is awesome! Rooms are nice and clean. Conference rooms are exceptional. Will definitely will be coming back for business or with the family.

allReviews.title: Off the strip is better
allReviews.text: Beautifully renovated rooms.Beautiful casino with no smell of smoke. Good table rules for blackjack.Good selection of restaurantsGenerous comps.Is our first day here and we would strongly consider returning

allReviews.title: Another superb stay at the palms
