allReviews.text: This was mine and my nephews 3 rd visit to the palms from the uk this year .This place should be renamed the friendly casino .The staff welcomed us back like old friends many remembering our names from our previous visits , we felt like family.The choice of food is amazing at this resort from fast food to top quality fine dining , this time we were lucky enough to eat in the superb Scotch 80 restaurant (simply the best meal I’ve ever had ,and I’m 57 ) Our room was very big and spotlessly clean.With a fantastic view.I feel i must single out a few members of staff for personal praise .First of all a cocktail waitress called Grace ,such a happy friendly young lady , she remembered the drinks we liked from our previous visits , and nothing was too much trouble, and always had time fir a chat  , a credit to the palms .Secondly a pit boss called Rob ,a true gentleman and very very helpfull . On one occasion I left my cash out ticket in a slot machine ,Rob sorted this for me in super quick time Thank you Rob.And last but certainly not least Gina our customer host . Wow what a lady , catered for our every need . WELL DONE THE PALMS SIMPLY SUPERB!See you again soon we cant wait .Harvey Instance and Thomas Eley from the uk

allReviews.title: A night at the Tonic Bar
allReviews.text: I started visiting The Palms last year, and it's now one of my favorite spots.  I love the restaurants, and the Tonic sports bar is a great place to watch the games and play quarter video poker.  I hung out there for a couple of hours the other night and Tracy was my bartender.   She is a very friendly person.  She has a great smile and seems to really enjoy her work and her customers.  She was so nice to me and the other folks who were there that night.  And she makes a mean cocktail.  Hope to see more of her next time I visit the Palms.

allReviews.title: Wonderful VIP worker Yanet McFarlane
allReviews.text: I wanted to share my wonderful experience in the VIP services lounge with Yanet Mcfarlane . Her kindness and willing to help with even the smallest detail was uplifting to say the least. Her personality really let me feel like I was special and important despite not being a huge gambler. The trip was short but hectic and every time I asked Yanet for help she went out of her way to make sure my request was fulfilled. Palms sure has a great employee in Yanet and I’m excited to return soon .

allReviews.title: Great customer service
allReviews.text: Our experience at the Palms was fantastic! The customer service was outstanding. It started with Tracey who was bartending at the Tonic Bar the day we arrived. She was so personable and just fun to be around. She introduced us to some new delicious drinks.   As sports fans, that bar is our destination but next night without her there it didn’t feel the same.  Love the Palms. Be back for sure.

allReviews.title: Bartender extraordinaire!
allReviews.text: I’m not one to usually write a review, however, the amazing service that I received from one of the bartenders needs to be focused on. Tracey was amazing! She made me and my three friends feel so welcome at the sports bar. I travel to Vegas about once every other year and this is my first time at  The Palms.  The atmosphere was great and she had us laughing the entire time. Will definitely be going back next time I’m in town.

allReviews.title: Elvis
allReviews.text: Excellent service and kentrell did excellent job to help us stay comfortable in this hotel. Thank you kentrell for your hospitality and professional job that you provide to us. God bless you and have blessed Easter  thanks

allReviews.title: Getting a great Host.  Erno
allReviews.text: Palms is a great casino.  A lot to offer.  Food, movies, pool, ect...My experience was a process of gambling and being taken care of by my host Erno Mabini.  He was expeditious with handling all my needs.  So, when you get to the Palms, reach out to him and let the fun begin.

allReviews.title: NI SAFETY ~ NO SECURITY ~ NOT A SAFE PLACE
allReviews.text: NO SAFETY ~ NO SECURITY ~ GUEST and VEHICLES NOT SAFE HERE... They say, "Public parking is not their responsibility".Our Polaris SxS and trailer were stolen in mid-day while their security watched. They failed to tell us that just 12 days after someone else's SxS was stolen February 28th. Our story... there a lot of family to celebrate my husband's 70th birthday and go SxS'ing after in St. George after 2-days. Our truck broke down and we needed to tow it to the dealer. We parked where PALMS SECURITY asked us to park, "they would watch for us", we were gone just two hours, when some backed up to our trailer and stole it, just 3-minutes earlier. Security refused to question the landscaper, who was just 10' from where our trailer and SxS was parked, the security laughed about our frantic demeanor. Come to find out, there is a lot of theft in their parking lot, their security is a joke... Another SxS was stolen just 12-days before ours. We believe that the landscaper and/or security might me involved, letting the would-be-thieves know the location and items to be stolen. The management is ABSOLUTELY NO HELP!!!! STAY AWAY FROM PALMS HOTEL... it not worth it!

allReviews.title: Disappointing Stay
allReviews.text: My husband and I just came back from a one night stay at the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas on March 25th and we were very disappointed.  We had booked one night there because where we were staying the other 5 nights (Vdara) was booked, so I booked the Palms for one night.  We were excited to stay at this newly re-opened hotel.  We had been there before several years ago, but never stayed there and we really liked it back then, so we were looking forward to seeing what is like now.  We arrived at the hotel at a little before check-in time about 2:45pm.  I had reserved a king room in the Ivory tower. I put in the reservation that we were celebrating my husband's birthday.  When I made the reservation, I received an email back from the hotel stating:  Hello, thank you for choosing palms as your vacation destination. Currently we are not preassigning guest rooms, however your special request has been noted. We look forward to celebrating with you. We have passed on your special occasion and request to the Guest Experience Team. If available, they will see what the hotel can set up for you. When we checked in nothing was mentioned at all.  When we went up to the room it was 2 double beds.  I had reserved a king and wasn't too happy with 2 double beds.  The Front desk clerk never mentioned that there weren't any King rooms available at check in.  The room itself was not good.  Very worn carpet and furniture and not very clean at all.  The bathroom had mold in the shower, and it was very worn as well.   While I am aware that the Ivory tower is the older tower there is still no excuse for the room to look like that.  We tried to call the front desk, and nobody answered there were only 2 clerks working so I guess they were busy, so my husband went downstairs and was told that there were no king rooms available. She said they would give us a $50 food and beverage credit.  That was okay since we were only staying for 1 night only, though I wasn't happy that we weren't told that the king room I reserved wasn't available when we checked in.  Did she think we wouldn't notice when we went into the room?  Obviously, the Guest Experience Team did nothing for my husband's birthday and never mentioned anything.  The hotel itself was just okay, honestly, I remember it being better than it is now.  The highlight of the hotel was the dinner we had at Scotch 80 Prime.  That restaurant was fantastic.  The food, ambiance and service was wonderful.   My husband has Celiac disease and can't have any gluten and they made sure he was safe and had a wonderful birthday dinner.  I highly recommend that restaurant.  The next morning, we went to the buffet for brunch and for the price it was good though the coffee was terrible.  Would I go out of my way to go back there no I wouldn't.  I was glad to check out and go to Vdara which was so much better than the Palms.  As a Travel Agent/Travel Business Owner I would not recommend this hotel to the majority of my clients.  I definitely would not recommend a room in the Ivory tower.  I would not go back there.

allReviews.title: Better than expected
allReviews.text: Great location, close to Vegas strip, downtown and national parks. Manny at the front desk gave a room with our choice view and was always helpful. Our experience with all personnel was better than expected which made the trip more enjoyable.

allReviews.title: Palms host Erno Mabini
allReviews.text: My visit to the  Palms was very good.Palms host Erno Mabini is a credit to the company.He  sought me out and offered many great free perks which were valuable gifts.His friendly demeanor uplifts the company standard for excellence.

allReviews.title: Best Customer Service
allReviews.text: Came to stay at the Palms Had the greatest service from Patrcia Explaining some of the drinks.Was here for bar and nightclub show.Patricia took the time to explain the cocktails and the ingredients.I was very impressed.The customer service is totally a 10 scale.Looking forward to coming back soonThank you again Patricia.

allReviews.title: Our 5 Day Stay at The Palms
allReviews.text: The Palms overall was satisfactory.  The good: The room and grounds were very clean.  The personnel we encounter at check in, servers at bars and restaurants and the bell hop were all great.  Michael at check in was awesome.  He gave us recommendations and always had a smile on his face when he saw us. So 5 stars for customer service.  Other areas that can use improvement- $45 a day resort fee for what? The WiFi sucks, we didn’t use the gym and no one was at the pool it was so cold. So that was a rip off.  If you are fortunate enough to go when it is warm enough for the pool, they try to up-charge you with seating, private pool areas, cabanas, etc.  Also, check your room fees upon check out. We were being charged $10 for something from the minibar when we didn’t take anything.  We were told  that happens sometimes due to the weights. But my biggest complaint is there is NO shuttle service from the resort to the strip.  We spent about $50/$60 daily on ride share services. Next time in Vegas honestly, I will probably stay at a resort on the strip so I can walk outside and get to everything conveniently. I believe The Palms would be more attractive to guests if shuttle service was offered.  Rooms: the  room itself was basic.  You could hear your neighbors.  There were no robes, or fridges, and the water was never hot. We also ran out of tissues day 2 and they were never replaced during our 5 day stay.  Lastly, we ate at almost every restaurant there and the food was all good- expensive but that’s to be expected. Overall, we had a good time but probably wouldn’t return unless shuttles were provided.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem
allReviews.text: Palms is a gem hiding in plain sight. You can't go wrong with any of their buffet options for food. The casino itself is just a nice casino and doesn't feel too over the top or too stuffy. The customer service is terrific and Lee in particular is a fantastic blackjack dealer and storyteller. I have enjoyed Palms each time I have been there and recommend checking them out.

allReviews.title: First Time.  I’m very impressed
allReviews.text: First time — I’m very impressed.  The room was big and nice.   The buffet was really good and that’s coming from a vegan. I look forward to the next time I come back.   Even the doormen and guys who park cars are great.  The one thing I would critique is the pizza but I’ll probably do that under separate cover

allReviews.title: Great week, just wish my sinuses weren’t on fire and I could talk without yelling.
allReviews.text: My only critique is on the main floor - the vanilla smell and music should both be drastically subdued. Both should be hints in the background; not overwhelming to the point of being uncomfortable.The vanilla / flower smells they add to the entire entry and forward section of the casino is strong it leaves you gasping trying to get clean air.The music is almost always so loud you have to raise your voice to almost yelling to be heard by others. It actually detracts from the gaming machines as you almost cannot hear them. A better experience would be the hint of a scent in the air, and music played low so it too is background noise.

allReviews.title: Service Equates to a 2 Star Experience
allReviews.text: This was a 2 star experience. I had a do-not-disturb sign on my door. At 10:35 a.m., the housekeeper Araceli (Aracely) ignores the sign and persistently knocks on my door to see if I will check out. When I asked her why she couldn't wait 25 minutes, she just kept apologizing. I have stayed at thousands of hotels in my lifetime. I have never experienced such a blatant disregard for the guest experience or privacy. When I decided to complain to the front desk, I was transferred to the housekeeping supervisor and then hung up on. The guest experience is not about kowtowing to an employee's needs so she can finish her work early.

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: Nice ,clean,  Oscar the receptionist very friendly and helpfull ,a gentleman,very very nice and professional we had a good time,I’ll love to have a swimming pool but unfortunately at that time the pool was closed.

allReviews.title: Service with a smile
allReviews.text: Palms was great. Clean rooms. Unknown bar is great. Shout out to Ray.  Service with a smile. Specially my girl Tracey.  Rock star survivor with a smile to light up the room.  No complaints. - Michigan 😉

allReviews.title: The only hotel I've ever checked out of early!
allReviews.text: The only hotel I've ever checked out of early! Checking in is literally on the casino floor, so noisy I could barely hear the receptionist. Reception staff couldn't care less about any issues. Room was unclean, blood on the curtains. All furnishings dated, chipped, scraped, in poor repair. The vent or window itself was broken and so loud it sounded like I was outside on the street, even though I was 16 floors up. Then the wind started throughout the night, impossible to sleep! Had to complain and chase reception and housekeeping 5 times over 36 hours to get them to do anything, it's always 'maintenance' is on the way'! When maintenance did arrive, all they did was put a bit of tape over the window vent, which made no difference! Complaining again they then moved me to a different room which was on the 6th floor facing the busy main road, just as noisy. This room was even dirtier and dated, at this point I'd had enough and checked out and went to the trump - much better for the same money!Other points of note:no coffee machine or kettle in the room. In 2023....! Nearest place for coffee is all the way across the casino floor. Valet took ages to retrieve car every time.Definitely never staying here again!

allReviews.title: Off the strip paradise!
allReviews.text: My hubby and I stayed here for our wedding anniversary and it was a spectacular weekend. The check-in was a breeze thanks to Michael and Paige. Their spa is very accommodating and all the food options were top-notch. I'm a Texas girl, but still enjoyed the brisket Benedict at Mables. The casino was lively and our dealer, Ken Mills, at the black Jack table was awesome. We had a hoot at the resorts table games. The suite we stayed in was so spacious and offered up impeccable views of the strip. I highly recommend anyone staying here on their next visit to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Very nice except resort fees.
allReviews.text: Very nice property and great staff.  Only concern is the industry that forces guests to pay horrible resort fees.  It is an unnecessary and unused means of increasing profits over guest convenience.  You will certainly your stay here.

allReviews.title: Best bartender in Vegas
allReviews.text: I was so happy with my stay always Tracey was are bartender and she made us feel welcome and at home made are stay fun will return and again me and my friends will return and pre game with the best bartender in Vegas come see Tracey at the palms thank you Tracey for the Vegas experience

allReviews.title: Cocktail Waitress
allReviews.text: Love coming to the Palms , third time and we always get welcome by Cocktail Waitress GRACE!!  Her customer service is excellent and we are never thirsty! Always a smile walking around!  Thanks Grace and great job The Palma Casino for excellent service!

allReviews.title: Amazing experience! A+
allReviews.text: The room was clean and very spacious.The location was great, minutes away from Las Vegas Blvd.The mini bar prices were reasonable 👍 the mini bar person (Ramon) was very helpful and extremely nice. The cleaning lady was great, she was very nice and did an amazing job. She make us feel very special! Thank you. Definitely coming back, Frank.

allReviews.title: Kaos show room
allReviews.text: Nice lay out the WORST SOUND SYSTEM ever. The BASS is so strong it goes right through you. This was the second time we have been to a show there  walked out after 20 minutes; the Yachtley Crew group was very good the sound again was a disaster several others walked out as well.

allReviews.title: Very  professional and serious in helping the customers. Thank you
allReviews.text: The Casino Host team and Mr. Mabini are the best and most aproveche available people that finally I meet during my visit two both casinos. (Yaamava & Palms) they take this business seriously.I am very satisfied. Thank you The Palm

allReviews.title: Amazing Time at the Palms.
allReviews.text: I came to the palms for the weekend to celebrate my friend Drake's birthday. It was an amazing time to say the least. Aside from the hotel being really new and the rooms being big and elegant, the people who worked there made it a pleasant place to be. The bartenders at the BBQ Grill were amazing and had great suggestions on what to eat and drink, also they were very lively and made it a fun time. The people who stole the show were the blackjack dealers however. Dennis, Don and Brenda were amazing and made gambling (losing money) way more fun than any other group of people I have ever played with. They were having a fun time with us too as it was apparent. Dennis had some amazing jokes that my friend and I to this day still refer too. We made Don laugh and deal bewilderedly as my friend was double downing on 16 and winning the hands. Brenda was a sweetheart and it seemed that everyone had good energy and enthusiasm. It was an incredible amount of fun and we have both decided that anytime we come back we are choosing the palms as our stay. Along with amazing deals and great rates, the atmosphere is what really stands out and I can not wait to be back!

allReviews.title: Above and Beyond service!!
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Palms for an event. We have over 80 athletes and parents traveling from Alaska.  From start to finish the overall process for group booking was seamless and each staff member that assisted us was attentive and accommodating.One we arrived we immediately noticed pleasant smell, there was zero cigarette smoke which was much appreciated by our parents and athletes. We were directed to  VIP room for check in where Romeo greeted us with all our pre keyed rooms. They also allowed all our guests to check in on their own which was fantastic and less time consuming for me. When we go to our room, we had a beautiful complementary fruit plate and drinks. Our room was clean and spacious with a fantastic view. Romeo also assisted me with some packages that were being shipped to the hotel and made sure the Bell Desk knew to hold them for me. We are so grateful to the staff at the Palms and their above and beyond service. We had such a great experience and will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Project Tradeshow
allReviews.text: Local but brought a couple clients here for Magic Tradeshow and ran into Tracey at the bar one of days all I gotta say is the service we received was amazing and top notch definitely coming back because of her and bringing all my clients here THANK YOU TRACEY HOPE YOU SEE THIS!!!

allReviews.title: Amazing staff and service
allReviews.text: Had a fantastic couple of days for our 30th Anniversary vow renewal.  We did so in our room with a local minister.  The staff at the hotel was superb, friendly, helpful, always smiling and courteous.  Even the valet guys were superb.  Dinner at the Scotch Prime was amazing...best service ever and the food was beyond good...it was heaven on a plate.  The room was very clean and updated and the housekeeping staff was wonderful.  We needed the room made up quickly for our little ceremony and the attendant for that floor took care of it immediately.  Just amazing service from everyone we encountered. We will absolutely return.

allReviews.title: Great aesthetics better staff
allReviews.text: Had a bad interview around this area and wanted to pop in for a drink, started gambling and the most amazing bartender Traci came over to chit chat, she was so kind easy to talk to. I ended up telling her what happened and she was so accommodating and understanding. Did not let me drink too much and let me know I can come back anytime. 10/10 will go back just to say hi!!!

allReviews.title: Entertaining customer service.
allReviews.text: Had the pleasure of having a few drinks with lovely bartender Tracy. She was able to serve me and other guests drinks while also being enthusiastic and entertaining. Had no qualms throwing extra dollars for the amazing service. I hope she is here on my next visit.

allReviews.title: The Place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: So I am in my late forties and I loved my stay here at the Palms.  They really have it down with the music, food and the vibes to cater to my demographic. it was super easy and fast to check in then a short walk to my room (other casinos feels like miles of walking to the rooms).  I hit up the sport book and 3 of the restaurants everything was great. Scotch 80 Prime for dinner was fantastic. and you gotta do Dim Sum!

allReviews.title: Not for me, but not bad
allReviews.text: The place itself is nice and the room was cleaned well each day. I wouldn’t stay there again though for a number of reasons:1) location. Our room was on the flamingo rd side so it was noisy throughout the night with sirens every night. And the general location of not being located on the strip or Fremont Street kinda sucked with having to get rides everywhere. I knew  that going in, so that’s on me. 2) the resort fees. I know other places do it in Vegas too. I read before going that some places waive the fees if you don’t need/want to use the gym, phones and in room Wi-Fi. They do not and costs an additional $39+tax/night. 3) we went to quite a few different hotels on our trip. We were offered comped rooms and tickets to other shows/events at a few different places. Nothing at all while we were at the palms. All in all it’s a decent place, just not for me.

allReviews.title: Most Underrated Hotel In Vegas
allReviews.text: I do rate my experience 5 out of 5Why you ask? Last June I was here for a trade show & stayed at a crappy hotel near the convention center. I was invited to a gala at the Palms & checked the rooms & I was blown away by how much better they were for about the same price as the crappy hotel. I always have a car so I don’t need to stay on or by the strip. Plus it’s less congested at The Palms. The staff is always excellent especially Hannah at check in. I love Italian & she recommended Vetri.  If you like Italian, it’s the best she said. I’m sold. I’m taking my clients there for dinner.  People like Hannah make The Palms a destination.  The ghost bar is now open & it’s an experience-A must see.  Whenever I come to Vegas, I only stay at The Palms

allReviews.title: Best casino in vegas
allReviews.text: Tanisha best host of all time! Great service great hotel. Will continue to come here. Fun and big winning! Love the palms! Great casino love to come by jimei best dealer ever drinks kept coming service was awesome rooms are great. Love this place best off strip casino in VEGAS

allReviews.title: Amazing time at the Palms
allReviews.text: Our stay was simply amazing. We had a great time here. Our room was amazing. They celebrated our engagement by giving us champagne and chocolate covered strawberries. Totally surprised us. We were totally surprised by this kind gesture. Me and my fiancé are forever grateful for this acr of kindness. Thank you so much.

allReviews.title: Engagement Celebration
allReviews.text: Clean, Friendly, Available, and accommodating. My family and I really enjoyed our stay at the Palms Place . The Staff is super friendly, helpful and thoughtful. The shower and jacuzzi bath tub was super relaxing and had  great water pressure. We came to Las Vegas to celebrate our Engagement and, the Hotel staff went about and beyond by surprising us with a bottle of Champagne, chocolate covered strawberries and a memorable hand written card (that we  will keep forever). We just want to say Thank you to Stephanie Christensen , Director of Guest Experiences. Customer Service adds to the experience and we our highly satisfied customers .

allReviews.title: 5 Stars!
allReviews.text: Great Casino and Hotel,  rooms have recently been remodeled, clean and eveything is in good working order.   Casino was also clean and updated, staff is friendly and efficient.   Steakhouse was delicious!!!  5 stars for food,  ambiance and service!   Nice place to stay if you want to be off  the strip,  but still close enough to the strip to take a short taxi ride.    Highly recommend, 5 stars- great job Palms!!

allReviews.title: TRACEY is her name!!!!!
allReviews.text: Love this place. The atmosphere, and drinks were spot on. TRACEY our bartender was very personable, attentive and always kept a smile on her face. She knew her mixology and it showed in the drinks. Great place to hangout, chill or go out on a date.  Will definitely go back and make sure TRACEY is our bartender. Excellent customer service. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

allReviews.title: TONIC Rocks
allReviews.text: Go to the sports bar... TONIC. Tracey is AWESOME! Very personable and spot-on with the drink orders. Highly recommend! Kim is also great. No better place to watch a game than this bar with these two beautiful ladies.

allReviews.title: Excellent Service.
allReviews.text: I always have a great time at the palms it's a solid casino to visit. I usually go hit the slots and have casual drinks with friends and family. I had a great time talking to the bartender I believe her name is Tracey I just had to share she was awesome and very helpful.

allReviews.title: Commendation to Tracey at the Bar at The Palm Casino Resort.
allReviews.text: Thank you Tracey for your beautiful smile, conversation and great drinks. You made my vegas trip very memorable. I can’t wait to return to visit with you again. Enjoyed the jokes and meeting your other customers and friendship you connected me with. You are amazing! Thank you.

allReviews.title: Conference Success!
allReviews.text: We held our conference last week at the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas. I hold multiple conferences annually. The staff at Palms absolutely blew me away. Enough to even get me to write a review!First, National Sales Manager, Teresa Hemphill, made the contracting process simple and efficient. Very accommodating even when we had to move around dates. She was very gracious and thoughtfully provided treats in the room when we arrived. Next, the Director of Catering and Conference Services, Jocelyn Mckinney, provided the next level of care. Ensuring I always had contact information for someone on the team to provide excellent service every step of the way. She even brought me Starbucks in the morning. Extremely thoughtful and consistently checking in on how my conference and I were doing.Then, our banquet server, Cosme Montenegro, was fantastic. He we above and beyond to provide service to all of our attendees and myself. When he noticed I was drinking Perrier water he had one waiting for me at the registration desk the next day. So extremely thoughtful. He checked in on our attendees and me nonstop to ensure the highest level of satisfaction.Lastly, our valet, Jack, was phenomenal. It was cold and windy, but he made sure our truck and 2 hotel carts FULL of conference materials and luggage were waiting for us and packed, and our truck was PACKED! He even got out truck up early and was first in line when we departed. So considerate.Teresa, Jocelyn, Cosme, and Jack were all VERY considerate and thoughtful. This is how I will describe working with the Palms. I highly recommend bringing your conference to the Palms. The phenomenal staff there will ensure it's a success!

allReviews.title: Great Stay!!
allReviews.text: I visited this hotel for my birthday and had a wonderful time. Tavaris at the front desk was so hospitable and professional. He absolutely went above and beyond for a minor mishap with my room. He definitely made my birthday trip one to remember! The only con was that I experienced was that money was stolen from my wallet in the spa’s locker room. I wish I was more vigilant with the two women that were in the lockers rooms standing around. They were standing around the lockers, watching me and speaking in Russian. Obviously they watched me as I entered my code but I didn’t realize it until after my cash was missing. I knew they seemed strange.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
allReviews.text: We were impressed by the modern decor and renovations, clean restrooms and even the nice smell of this off-strip casino instead of the smoke in most casinos and were happy that it also had free valet parking.  We visited the Palms for the breakfast buffet (8am-11am) for $25.00/person, but were pleasantly surprised that it was a very large spread of good food with a great variety of choices that was actually BRUNCH food... not sure why it ends at 11am.  We'll definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Erno Mabini IS THE BEST HOST
allReviews.text: We have a host on all casinos Nevada and California and gamble every weekend Erno by far is the best very attentive and on point always inviting and welcoming the casino and resort are also A1 thank you we will see you soon

allReviews.title: A NYE to Remember
allReviews.text: My friends and I booked a stay at Palms for the end of December through the New Year, which was a serendipitous experience, largely made possible by our VIP host Erno Mabini. He was nothing short of helpful, from sorting out our room reservations to accommodating me and my party for an eventful NYE celebration. Nothing more to say than we ended 2022 on a memorable note!

allReviews.title: Horrible. Avoid at all costs.
allReviews.text: Horrible and horrific experience. Avoid at all costs. I recently stayed for a so called VIP experience. I got a offer and decided to stay because of the service I usually receive. I was told by the booking agent I would get a specific room type and was told when checking in i would get a different room. When checking in, I got different keys for check in and had to walk down to get the lobby again to get the right keys.The room was smelly, old and had lots of stains on the carpet and bed sheets. The bed was uncomfortable and it was really hard to sleep. I told the front desk agent about my situation but understood he couldn’t do anything because of his position. I asked if I could speak with someone who actually could. I got connected with the assistant manager who was unprofessional and unhelpful.I am never coming back to the palms. You should consider all options when coming to Vegas and consider places where they strive in customer service and customer satisfaction. It is clearly not the Palms.

allReviews.title: Manny is the man at VIP checkin
allReviews.text: Checked in the Palms last minute and unexpectedly with my girlfriend. She is from Australia and first trip to Vegas. Manny at the VIP desk was awesome! Very friendly and accommodating. He took the time and attention to help us with a great room with awesome view. It was my first time staying in the fantasy tower. I’ve been to Vegas prob 50 times and this room was one of the best. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Many thanks to Manny and the Palms!

allReviews.title: The Palms Casino is BAAACK!
allReviews.text: I had not been to the Palms since it was owned by the Maloof family. I have now stayed and played twice. Casino host Erno Mabini is outstanding. Professional but personable. He anticipates your needs.

allReviews.title: The Palm’s Pit Pros
allReviews.text: My fiancé and I come to Vegas regularly and find fun in most pits we play in.  We sat down with Lisa as our dealer and Heather was the pit boss.  They were so outgoing, friendly, and kind that it made for a terrific experience. It had been years, since we’d visited The Palms.  We will definitely be back soon. Matthew and Alice

allReviews.title: A.Y.C.E. Buffet Review
allReviews.text: We went here to see if it was any better since the San Miguel Tribe took it over. Yes it was much better in many ways.We signed up for a players card and were told if we spent $20 on slots, we would get a free buffet. So when I've never been to a certain buffet before I ask to go and take a look at all the food before paying for it. They always say yes. I walked around and looked at all the food and I was surprised at how good everything looked. Everything was fresh and looked appetizing.The bad part is that there is an insanely long line! The later it gets, the longer it gets. I was pleased with everything they had except the shrimp. I have never seen this kind of shrimp that had the heads on it and they taste mushy and gritty and that was a huge disappointment because I am a shrimp lover! I have been to many buffets all over the country and I have never seen any place that offered this kind of shrimp. It's terrible! If they changed this one thing, my rating would have been much higher. I'm guessing this shrimp is cheaper but it's not good quality and I know my shrimp! We will give it another try though.

allReviews.title: A Return to 2001, in the Best Possible Ways
allReviews.text: Hey, everyone.  Las Vegas trip #40 found me at the Palms in early December, and I couldn't have been happier to return.  Let me give you some details.The first time I stayed at the Palms was in early 2002, just months after opening.  Historically, we had stayed at the Hard Rock (back in its heyday) but when our host and good friend moved from the Hard Rock to the Palms, we followed.  It was incredible.  We loved everything about it and between myself and my family, we probably stayed there 50 times from 2002-2010 (and a few times since)(our host moved to the Cosmopolitan in 2010 and we once again followed).  When Palms Place opened, I stayed there because it was the best of the best (San Manuel PLEASE update this place and bring it back to its former glory!!).  As time went on, we started staying elsewhere beginning in 2010, but always loved the Palms and returned occasionally. However, the last time I stayed there was in 2017 when it was owned by Stations...and I vowed I'd never return.  It was terrible.Cut to November of 2022.  On a whim, I decided to book a quick solo getaway.  I booked a room at the Cosmopolitan but shortly thereafter learned of an incredible deal to stay in a suite at the Palms for essentially the same money.  Knowing that the Palms had changed hands once again, I felt it was necessary to give it another try.  Before doing so, I wanted to talk with someone on staff about the newly opened and owned casino.  By some stroke of luck, I ended up speaking with Danielle, who is a room coordinator/reservation manager (I believe (sorry if I'm getting your title wrong, Danielle)).  I spent a good 15 minutes on the phone with her and by the end of the call, I was hooked and booked.  Most of my fears and bad Stations memories washed away after that call, and upon arrival, I realized I had absolutely made the right choice.  The place is fresh, updated, and beautiful.  But the aesthetics aren't what's most important to me.  It's the people that keep you coming back.  And I can tell you this - EVERYONE was wonderful.  Everyone was thoughtful, attentive, friendly, and real.  It felt like the old Palms, but just a little milder, which was fine for me being 46 now and not in my early 20's like when it opened.  But to be clear, it's certainly not an old fart casino either.  It's great for all ages.And as a barometer, I also visited the newly opened Virgin, seeking to check out the vibe there and see if it encapsulated the old Hard Rock feel.  It doesn't, but somehow Palms manages to make that happen and rekindle its old feel.The room was amazing, I ate at every restaurant except the buffet (which I learned later was a big mistake to have missed) and loved them all, and even won a few bucks.   I definitely recommend Scotch 80 (went twice).  Special shout out to the new apprentice bartender (a young lady whose name unfortunately escapes me).  Ask for a Hendricks and lemonade and you won't be disappointed.  She will hand make the lemonade for you in front of your eyes.Anyway - that's enough out of me.I'll leave you with this.  If you used to come here but stopped for whatever reason, go back.  If you've never stayed here, go.  Go now.  You won't regret it.

allReviews.title: Decent hotel with no major problems
allReviews.text: Decent clean hotel which should be the bare minimum of course. I would stay again with a competitive price.Pluses:-Quiet & not crowded as it's away from the strip-Walgreens & regular (not over-priced) chain restaurants just next door-Parking is easy to get in and out ofSome downsides:-No shower door but half the side is glass and the other half is just exposed, so you can feel the cold air from the exposure and need to position the shower head away so water doesn't leak out. Weird design.-It did it's job but the HVAC system is old school where it just has an up & down slider with no numerical adjuster or digital thermometer which you would think a modern looking hotel should have.

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay for a city break in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Nabbed a great seasonal rate for a 4-night stay from the hotel website (15% off the room rate plus $25 daily resort credit).  Had seen advertisements that the hotel is recently renovated with Native ownership so wanted to give them a chance, and *so* glad we did!!Stayed in an 18th floor Ivory King room, which was a great size with a lovely view and really nice, modern decor, furnishings & toiletries.  (I wish the room came with coffee service, but it's not like they say it does--I just wish it did.  Housekeeping *will* bring you a humidifier, though, which is fantastic for a hotel in the desert!)Because of the resort credit we ate at a number of the dining establishments and found them ALL to be decent (the noodle shop & 24hr cafe) to really quite wonderful (the fine dining, BBQ restaurant & pizza place).The majority of staff we encountered were friendly & competent, and self-parking and getting to/from the Strip were a breeze!  We didn't play on the casino floor, but there are also a ton of diversions (a movie theatre, a stage, a nightclub) that looked just a fun/high-quality.I really can't recommend this resort highly enough!  I will definitely book them for future visits to Vegas and just hope I'm there during a season when their beautiful-looking pool areas are open!  (Would also consider one of the Palms Place accommodations, depending on group size/configuration--they look *very* comfortable for a larger party/longer stay!)

allReviews.title: Hella whack
allReviews.text: Whack experience, the hotel room I stayed in had a weak airflow from the a/c. The first time I had to have maintenance in my room to fix it. Lots of police presence which is a red flag. To be honest the scene was very whack and customer service was slow and poor. I don't think I'd ever come back to stay. The room was also small and the windows were dirty as heck. Can't enjoy any view with the debris on the window. The hotel is just underwhelming, I would encourage people to do your due diligence. I'll be avoiding this hotel and casino. It ain't my scene.

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: When we arrived there was a bit of a line at check in and I accidentally made our reservation for the next week, but Rich helped us change our reservation to the correct day and checked us in quickly. He did a great job explaining all of the amenities and upgrades we are eligible. Definitely will be coming back and asking for him!

allReviews.title: We had the best stay cation and good food what a relaxing night
allReviews.text: I go to this hotel at least once a month I love the freshness and the cleanliness the room are amazing. So if you are looking for a nice place to stay this is it. And it doesn't smell like smoke as soon as you walk in the door. So try it and see what a great experience you will have.

allReviews.title: AWESOME!!!!!!
allReviews.text: I walked in the room,,, it was AMAZING!!  The view was Great!!! Room had everything I needed ,would have been nicer if there was coffee pot in there, but all n all my stay experience was awesome! I would stay there again, and recommend it to friends and family. Thank You PALMS!! ☺♥

allReviews.title: Nico Helped Us to Have a Great First Time Experience of the Casino
allReviews.text: I play blackjack in the high limit room. That’s where I primarily played the 3 days I was there. Nico was a floor manager that happened to be in that room when I would usually be playing. His customer service was tops. He was welcoming, informative and had great energy. Because of this experience, my girlfriend and I will definitely come back to stay at Palms Casino. Looking forward to coming back and experiencing the Ghost Bar with my girlfriend. Unfortunately, it was closed during our stay due to a private party.

allReviews.title: The Palms hotel Vegas.
allReviews.text: Sensational hotel, truly warm, friendly and professional staff who always went one step further to ensure our stay was completely memorable. Magnificent rooms in the Fantasy tower, great restaurants especially Scotch 80 and a pool you won’t want to leave….

allReviews.title: Best hotel on or off the strip!
allReviews.text: We loved our experience at Palms! All of the staff were hospitable and professional. Rooms were spacious, clean, and had great views of Vegas. Restaurants in the hotel had great food with lots of variety. The best thing about Palms is its resort pool. Poolside staff were excellent and both pools are large with plenty of seating options to lounge on. Seriously the best pool out of all of the hotels on the strip!

allReviews.title: Golf tournament
allReviews.text: From the time I arrived and Patty helped me check in to the dinner at Scotch 80 that was delicious and the fun little golf tournament at TPC Summerlin, I had a blast.  My host Juan Morales is always helpful, kind, fun to be around, the staff is always courteous and helpful, and my rooms have been amazing!  I highly recommend staying at The Palms.  Oh Ray Bell is the best too!!!

allReviews.title: Don’t Pass Up Palms!
allReviews.text: Palms was a great home base for our trip to Vegas. The rooms, service, amenities, and restaurants were all fantastic but the location just can’t be beat. Close enough to the strip to walk or take a cheap ride share, far enough away that you aren’t inundated with crowds, chaos, and noise. We also spent a fair amount of time on the casino floor and had a great time there too- prompt drink service, great variety, helpful and polite staff, and a couple big wins! Ghost Bar was BY FAR the highlight of our stay, the show there was incredible, as was the panoramic view of the strip! Would recommend this to families, friends, and business travelers alike.

allReviews.title: Impressive!
allReviews.text: So impressed with this place. I was only there for a short weekend and would have liked to stay a few more days! Gorgeous rooms—the bed was so comfortable and the bathroom was amazing (an especially great shower!). It felt like staying at an expensive spa. The pool was great and a blast. Great food downstairs—grabbed coffee there every morning and had lunch and dinner there too—all excellent. Close to the strip but away from the chaos of it. The staff was so friendly and accommodating. I felt like a celebrity staying here! Can't recommend it enough. I'll definitely be back and will recommend it to anyone I can!

allReviews.title: Top Notch!!
allReviews.text: Our stay at the Palms was top notch! Our room on the 13th floor offered amazing views of the lights by night and beautiful mountains by day,   We enjoyed a relaxing day lounging by the beautiful pool, where the staff was attentive, the food and drinks fun and delicious,  We enjoyed great food at several of the restaurants and wish we would have had time to try more!  The Palms has everything you need for a great weekend Vegas getaway without ever leaving the hotel (the free parking was a nice added bonus)!

allReviews.title: Perfect Getaway!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Palms for a Family wedding and it was incredible! The rooms were  so beautiful and well put together with an amazing view from our window. Had fun checking out the Ghost Bar too. What a fun surprise to discover it! The view alone from the Ghost Bar is worth checking out. Also all the staff I interacted with were so friendly and very helpful!

allReviews.title: DISABLED VETERAN LOCAL GAMBLER
allReviews.text: I  Live here in Las Vegas for about 30 years now and have seen the Palms go through several hands and I have to say that I want to give a shout out to a young man who I consider to be a very decent man. 5 STARS to RUDY ROBLES, ASSISTANT MANAGER  At the front desk at the Palms Hotel here in Las Vegas.    RUDY  It's very much the professional and I am at a disabled veteran and needed some assistance and he was there for me. Everything was awesome and hes just a great guy. If you get a chance to say hello to Rudy tell him VegasFletch sent you, he'll know right away!   There is much that the Palms has to offer you just have to know where to look and Rudy can steer you in the right direction.   The buffet food is awesome and it's always packed make sure you let Rudy know that you would like to go to the buffet and he might be able to see what he can do For the best times to go.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Palms
allReviews.text: My friends and I had a phenomenal experience at the Palms! The rooms and views were gorgeous. We had great coffee, BBQ, Pad Thai and a late night meal at the 24/7 cafe. The entire hotel was super clean and customer service (including valet) was helpful! I would definitely visit again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a great Las Vegas stay!

allReviews.title: Ghost Bar was phenomenal!
allReviews.text: The rooms were immaculate and the staff was very friendly. Tons of options for dining and the Ghost Bar was fantastic! I would highly recommend. My friends and I had a blast and will definitely be going back. Close to the strip and the remodel is gorgeous.

allReviews.title: Big Smoke weekend stay , The Palms
allReviews.text: Attended The Big Smoke Las Vegas (Cigars), Erno (Host at the Palms) made it all come together effortlessly. Room, food, Palms events, added to an already great weekend. Thank you Sir, and happy birthday (Erno).

allReviews.title: 6 night stay - 10/31/22 to 11/6/22
allReviews.text: I needed at place to stay while attending the SEMA-AAPEX Car show. My observations are for my 6 day stay. I don't gamble and don't drink, so I have no comments on those 2 aspects. All I want is a clean, safe room and the opportunity to try my favorite pre- covid buffets, when I come to Las Vegas.     My room request was for no smoking, quiet Fantasy King room. I was given only two choices, 18th or 35th floor.  I took the highest 35-227. I suspect that the entire Fantasy Tower was not renovated before reopening and perhaps these are the only 2 floors they are using in the Fantasy Tower building. Newly decorated room but mechanical components of the room were not working/installed properly. Toilet continuosly ran after flushing and each time needed a manual reset. It was running when I arrived. Very little hot water in shower, ran for up to 30 minutes with a luke warm result, for the entire week. (needs a new water mixing unit.) Good hot water volumn from the sink, so this was a perplexing problem. TV control worked sporatically. Battery compartment was screwed shut. This was NOT a quiet room. At night, the street noise and loud people having a good time required ear plugs. I was on the 35th floor!. This seems to be an architectural design issue.Walls are pretty thin so floor noise would be an issue. Construction noises were heard, monday to friday daytime. Either above or below my room. I was not forewarned by management. I used my earplugs again for my afternoon naps.Thye did not replace the mattress with a brand new one. Mine was old, soft, lumpy. They need to! It was definitely from the former Palms era.The new Palms did not offer me anything to bring me back. I was originally optimistic. Hotel guests should be able to book a reservation and time for buffets. First come first serve, no reservation policy does not encourage someone to stay at the resort for the food. My time to be seated at the first 2:00PM seating was 2 hours and 40 minutes. I won't be back for the food.Feeling of security. Uncomfortable?  I noticed that there is heavy security in the ground floor. Keys to my room where checked twice, one night before I could get to my elelvator. I counted 12 security people and guards between going from my elevator to the valet parking desk outside the front door on Friday night. Why so much and so many?This is another off strip hotel trying to compete with the other off strip locations and the hotels onstrip.  Nothing special, I was not satisfied

allReviews.title: Wonderful Customer Service and A Beautiful Hotel!
allReviews.text: We arrived to the hotel late at night after a long drive from Los Angeles, and the front desk attendant Chanél made our first experience at this hotel amazing! She was very accommodating and helped with making our check-in process run smoothly. I would definitely recommend staying at this hotel, and we look forward to staying here again in the future!

allReviews.title: Fun memories
allReviews.text: We had great service. Our butler James was very nice and helpful . Also Kimberly checked us in and she was very nice. The sports bar Kim and Omar and Paul. Are good bartenders.  Security is very good. That's another story.  We will be back again. 😊😊

allReviews.title: Operationally challenged
allReviews.text: First time back at the Palms since new ownership. For me it’s about the service. If I’m gonna pay $20 for a martini It better be spot on …agree?Good - the crab and lobster portion of the buffet is better then Wynns buffet. Wynn doesn’t have lobster and the crab is meatier than what Wynn is serving. The wait was minimal for a 3 pm arrival. Time limit stated was 90 minutes but not enforced by wait staff when inquired. Our server (Ethiopian lady) was very passionate and genuinely cared about making us happy. Bad - the rest of the buffet wasn’t worth the $65.00. Plates were saturated with water and needed to be wiped before our into service. Cleanliness was not there. Food was tepid. The cooks in the dessert station were using profanity in Spanish unknowingly I understand Spanish and called them out on it. They scoffed.  The service at the bar directly across from valet and the buffet was a disaster. 3 of the employees at the bar it was their FIRST day!!! They had  no clue about the menu or how to close checks. I tried to pay half in cash and was told they cannot do that due to the new system. One complained that they aren’t union and then proceeded to explain that they have to serve our $20 espresso martinis in rocks glasses. I still couldn’t get an itemized bill bc they couldn’t figure out how to close the check. Each had on a different uniform as they complained they couldn’t all get uniforms that matched. The person running the valet booth was also running cars so had to stand there for 10 minutes before my ticket was accepted. Unfortunately the service isnt there and the hospitality was cold and uninviting.  The struggle will continue at Palms until they hammer out the operations  portion of the resort. Pass until then.

allReviews.title: Cool to visit
allReviews.text: Came to the palms to for a business trip. The electrician Mo was pretty awesome. He helped me with a power issue I had in my room and emily from house keeping was awesome and sweet as well! She made sure I got everything I needed and was just very sweet when I had a late request for my room to be cleaned

allReviews.title: A great visit
allReviews.text: We wanted a short break in Las Vegas after traveling through California. We decided to try the Palms as it is close to the strip but not on it.  The check in was great. So friendly and quick, the parking was easy and we loved the buffet for breakfast.  We also loved the friendly staff, we even met a Butler in the elevator called James. We wish we had remembered all the names of the team as they were great. We will definitely  be back for sure

allReviews.title: modern, fun!
allReviews.text: Palms casino/resort is a fantastic property - modern and spacious, everything looks/feels new. Great assortment of shops, slots and dining. Staff at every interaction were friendly, helpful and professional.My preference next time in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Love the Palms West Bar!!
allReviews.text: My husband and I are frequent visitors to the West Bar at the Palms. We adore Oliver, Brian and Ruel. They are the BEST bartenders in Las Vegas and the only reason why we never venture off to the strip. These guys are rockstars!

allReviews.title: Mediocre
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Palms. Overall it was just blah. Don’t feel the need to return. Location really isn’t great. PROS: Friendly staff and pretty clean. The bathroom was the best part of the room.CONS: One of the outlets in the room didn’t work. You can’t store leftovers or drinks in the mini fridge because it’s full of the obligatory overpriced drinks and snacks.

allReviews.title: Palms Gambling Stay
allReviews.text: I recently spent 3 nights at the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas. The room was spacious, comfortable, and attractive. Although my room was near the end of the hallway, the walk to and from the elevator was relatively short. The TV channel selection was more than adequate. There was no bathtub but the shower was large with a place to sit or put your foot up. The water pressure was fine. While there is a fridge in the room it is strictly for housing minibar items. I was warned during check-in that if I removed an item from the fridge to put something else in the fridge, I would be charged for the item. If I were sharing the room with others, I would have been tempted to put crime tape around the fridge area to be sure nobody even opened the door. The room did include an iron and ironing board which i made good use of.Although off the strip, the Palms is within walking distance of two other casino/hotels as well as a number of independent dining options. Combining those places with the dining choices offered by the Palms, along with the food court and you have plenty of options for eating both in price and cuisine.The pool wasn't crowded as I was there on a weekday. There were plenty of places to lie down but the music was a bit loud. My stay was comped based on my casino play at Yaamava Resort and Casino but a resort fee was still charged. I knew this when I made my reservation and Palms was generous with $150 of free play. But to me, if a room is comped, that should include the resort fee. Personally I would have preferred $50 of free play and no resort fee. The casino offers a wide variety of games, some with very good odds for the player.Overall, an excellent stay. The room was very comfortable, the casino offers good games, there are lots of dining choices. I plan on returning before the end of the year.

allReviews.title: Awesome service at the Pearl!
allReviews.text: The bartender Brandon is awesome and so friendly at the concert venue Pearl! He was super conversational and helpful even during a busy time! He was quick and the drink was great! I’ll definitely come back!

allReviews.title: 5- stars!
allReviews.text: My checkin, stay, and checkout was phenomenal.  Chanel was very informative, and helpful!  She ensured our stay was comfortable and seamless.  I would recommend this hotel/casino to all friends and family.  I will be back within the next year and book with The Palm!  Great job, Palms and staff!

allReviews.title: Off the strip delight.
allReviews.text: We chose Palms for our trip to Vegas and glad we did. It felt modern and clean. The room was lovely with everything we needed. Spacious and airy.We ate at a couple of the restaurants in the Palms and they were pretty good without the prices of some places.It is a little off the main strip but close enough for a short Uber trip and we even walked a couple of times.Would happily stay again and recommend Palms to others looking for a break from the bustle and noise of the main hotels.

allReviews.title: Hoped for a better experience
allReviews.text: We just got back from the Palms, with a group of friends.  I had booked two rooms for our part of the group.  One the fantasy grand suite and other just a standard king room.  The stay had a few problems, some minor, some kind of gross.  When we checked in, the staff was I wouldn’t say rude but just not personable.  I am not sure the staff looked up from the computer screen at all, just head down.  The most personable thing I think she said was “Checking in”.  Not the biggest problem in the world but didn’t feel welcome. It felt more like just another check in.  On the other end of the spectrum the bartenders were great, friendly, fun and always very personable.  After getting to our room, my wife and I were very disappointed to find out our half bath in the grand suite was not clean.  First we noticed the counter top which looked like toothpaste residue from the last guest.  Which with the white color of the countertops could be easily overlooked,  not that big of a thing, not even worth pointing out.  But next I found the red droplet in front of the toilet. I like to think of it as red wine and not blood.  Not sure what it was but very easy to pick out on the white of the tile.  Then we saw the bloody booger on the wall next to the sink.  To the person who left it, there was a box of kleenex just as close to you as the wall, grow up.   We headed back down to the front desk to speak with someone but it was busy, only two of them. So I asked someone off to the side. I think he was a bellman if there was someone I could talk with and told him the situation.  He got me someone right away from the back.  I was told there were no other rooms to switch to, which was not a problem.  I said we were going to the Unknown bar to have drinks. We just needed it cleaned. They called me a bit later and told me that they had cleaned the bathroom with a sorry.  They cleaned the booger and the unknown red splatter, but they didn’t clean the toothpaste residue.  I just cleaned it up myself with the hand towel.  I noticed there was a few kleenex in the wastebasket,  I didn’t notice if it was in there before they came to clean so I am not sure if the cleaning crew used it to clean or if it was left from the last guest.  I just know it was not from us.    It was very disappointing to have walked in for your vacation to start out like this.  Disappointed that of all the people we talked to, the bellman was the most concerned about the situation.  They were busy and seemed to be understaffed in the front, but they could have at least sent us a cocktail over while we waited..Overall we enjoyed the Palms casino, location was nice being off strip, the vibe of it was great, the 80’s music during the day was so great had us dancing along while we played.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: special thanks to Chanel from reservation desk, she was amazingly assist us from the moment we started check in, hotel is clean but a bit far from strip, we would definitely come to stay within this hotel again in the future

allReviews.title: Missrepresented
allReviews.text: I trust Tripadvisor when booking accommodations, and will always check reviews before booking.  In many years of doing this, this is the first absolute miss. I had a last-minute business trip to Las Vegas and based on the property description and reviews, expected accommodations that were updated.  When I checked in, I was told that my room was in the original tower that had not been renovated in 10+ years.  An upgrade to a more recently renovated tower was offered for $150 a night, which is not possible.  This would have been OK if the room had been clean.  The bathroom floor is sticky and there is hair on it.  There is hair sticking to the AC intake vent.  The floor of the closet is full of dust and dirt. The carpet is designed so you can't tell if it is clean, and suspect that it is not. I have tried calling Housekeeping and the Front Desk and there is no answer.

allReviews.title: The “New Palms” Is Fabulous!!
allReviews.text: Stayed at Palms October 13-16. This was my first stay since the re-open and new ownership. The new Palms is fabulous!!All the staff are happy, friendly and excel in Customer Service. I had an issue that was immediately addressed and the manner in which it was made me feel valued as a customer. Stuff happens and the way it is handled is what makes a property stand out. Thank you to the staff at Palms. The bartenders at The Tonic Bar are the best, Omar, Kim, Danny, Eli!  Such a friendly crew.  Cocktail servers on the floor are friendly and efficient. As I was mostly solo, I did casual dining at Serrano Vista twice; the hostess and server where I sat at the bar were so welcoming and friendly. I wish I had written down their names (I killed a few brain cells in Vegas lol). Food was excellent. Had dinner at Mabel’s…delicious. Will have to try to work my way through the menu on future trips. The food court has a favourite of mine The Earl of Sandwich; the Holiday turkey is my favourite. The Coffee Bean has excellent coffee.  I’m looking forward to trying Tim Ho Wan and Scotch 80 Prime on my next trip in December and will be staying at Palms again. It was an extremely busy weekend in Vegas. When departing for the airport, no taxis were available. The valet had a Palms car bring me to the airport. I have been visiting Vegas regularly for 40 years and I have never experienced that level of going above and beyond for a customer. The rooms in the Fantasy Tower are beautifully decorated and comfortable. Looking forward to my next visit in December. Thank you Palms for a fabulous Vegas getaway. See you in December.

allReviews.title: Excellent service
allReviews.text: I work in customer service. I know when your dealing with someone excellent in their craft. We had a small problem with our room.  Chantel handled everything professionally and quickly, smiling the entire time. Experiences like this is what you remember. Thank you to Chantel and the management team at the Palms. You are what excellence defines. Thank you again.

allReviews.title: Oasis in the desert
allReviews.text: From the first and last steps on this property, our group was in incredible & thoughtful hands the entire stay. Highly recommend! I look forward to my next trip to Vegas and staying on property. Casino, food options, proximity to the rest of Vegas (Allegiant Stadium and shopping especially), and our beautiful suite made this the trip of a lifetime!

allReviews.title: Best valet in Vegas
allReviews.text: Incredible staff and the best valet team we’ve ever experienced! They were so considerate and friendly as a greeter and bag assist!!It makes a huge difference to get friendly help as you enter and exit. That level of service is paramount to a great stay. Thanks valet!

allReviews.title: Wedding weekend at the Palms
allReviews.text: My wife and I got married 10/7/22 and the Palms went above and beyond to help accommodate us and our guests (30 total). My wife and I stayed in the View penthouse, which was absolutely amazing, the styling, the service, the "View" were all top of the line. We had a butler named James who was our saving grace, as you could imagine we are getting married out of state and we needed various things during our stay. One phone call away was James, not only is he the nicest guy around but he dropped everything he was doing to come assist us. From bringing us extra garbage cans to picking up our wedding cake in the lobby, the man did it all. He cemented his spot in our wedding memories because off his personality and work ethic, Thanks James!! P.S. he deserves two candy bars ;)After we got married in the desert we brought our guests back to the Palms and had dinner at the top of the fantasy town at a venue called the "Moon". The best way to describe this venue is just breathtaking. Every single person in our party was in awe at the view of the strip you had on top of the world. Also, the food and service that was provided during our reception was some of the best I've had. Half of our guests complimented the food saying things like "This is hands down the best food I've had at a wedding" and "You always remember a wedding because of the food, I won't forget this one". Don't get me started on the bartender, John would have your next drink ready before you even stood up haha. Can't beat it.After our perfect wedding day just when I didn't think the day could get better, the Palms hooked us up with free tables at the Ghostbar, which is a one-of-a-kind experience, you're on the top floor of the Ivory tower with an incredible view and an amazing live band, such a cool venue as well!Palms thank you so so much for creating such an amazing experience for us and our guests, your service, atmosphere, and food will certainly not be forgotten. We will definitely be back!The Leonards

allReviews.title: Vacation with Airport TSA
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel!!!!
allReviews.text: Chanel at hotel check in was great!!! She had great customer service with nice hospitality…. She was very nice and helpful… she went above and beyond to assist us to make sure our stay was everything we needed to be… I would definitely come back to the Palms… People like her make people want to come back to this hotel…Great energy, I love it!!!! 🥰🥰🥰🥰

allReviews.title: Best Customer Service!
allReviews.text: e property Awesome service truly amazing suppoit's really amazing support I'm grateful and thankful to be here because the staff is truly amazing especially Chanel who has truly made my visit here very very unique I feel so special and honored not only does she smile but she's smart and she's been a great assistant to me because I have no vision so I'm so grateful that you have people like her and you should definitely give her a raise and a promotion thank you So  Much!

allReviews.title: Lovely, sterile environment- no warmth in interactions
allReviews.text: Stayed with my family.  Hotel is lovely and clean, but most of the security is abrupt and rude.  It is a treacherous 20 minute walk to the strip on a very narrow walkway - too dangerous to repeat. The street is at least 9 lanes with traffic traveling about 40-50 mph.  We had to Uber back - which is only $15-19 from Paris Hotel.  We were standing outside the buffet while it was closed looking at prices for about 20 seconds and security told us we had to move.  Pool security checked my Fanny pack early in day when we looked at pool.  I’m sure me and my preteen son looked very ominous (not).  Later, we went for a swim and were told pool closes at 6.  No problem - 25 minutes to swim.  Except the same security man that searched my Fanny pack earlier came around and said it closed at 5:45 and very rudely made us exit abruptly - at 5:54.  Not apologetic in any way. Acted like my kids and I were criminal trespassers.  There’s a nice way to communicate - and then there’s this guy’s way.  Best interaction was with the late night McDonald’s gal who was friendly efficient and smiling.  No water at McDonald’s though???No seats or benches anywhere in hotel - same as all of vegas now.  No warmth or fríendliness - just rules, harshness, rude interactions.  I’ve been to vegas 8-9 times but likely won’t return.

allReviews.title: CHANEL!!!
allReviews.text: My very first visit at Palms Casino, was amazing! The service that I received when I came here was very nice and  I would love to come back again! - CHANEL THE SERVICE WAS IMPECCABLE!!  Definitely my #1 recommendation!

allReviews.title: Modern and Spacious Rooms
allReviews.text: Very modern spacious rooms. Very friendly staff (thanks Chanel). There is a food court as well as high end restaurants. Very relaxing pool area. Ideal if you enjoy walking. Walking distance from the main strip.

allReviews.title: Badly Needed an improvement!
allReviews.text: The Facade of the hotel is excellent, It has a solid perfumey hotel scent inside. The Guest service was not accommodating and didn't smile either. Guest Service badly needed an improvement at check-in. The room was decent, and the bed was clean and comfy but the bathroom was a nightmare, they didn't replenish a bath gel, and they have the entire amenities half used, there were hairs all over the shower and toilet and some yucky stains on the wallpaper. I can tell rooms are dilapidated, again the facade of the building was excellent, I hope not just the facade :(When I was about to shower I noticed that there was no hot water, so I did call the front desk to notify the issue as well as the bath gel. The guest service advised me to wait for like about 5 minutes and if still not getting hot water then I should call back so she could send the maintenance and, she would send someone to bring a shower gel as well. Then an attendant came up and didn't even greet me ( Which is fine ) with like about 20 bottles of shower gel, I was so shocked at how wasteful that would be. I don't find it generous at all, they are aware there were only 2 people, and yet they brought 20 bottles?! so we just left all those. I hope they could improve their service. Not all the people coming to vegas are just there to gamble, we wanted to have a great experience in a nice hotel too.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Hotel was amazing. Rooms were clean and nice setup, and beautiful view of the city. Great customer service and really enjoyed our stay. My husband played a games of black Jack and he loved our whole stay there. We also did a couples massage at the Palms Spa and it was amazingggg :-)

allReviews.title: Wouldn't stay here again.
allReviews.text: Room was OK, stains on the carpet but apart from that it was clean. Main reason for 2 star rating is that out room was left open by the cleaning staff. The saftey bolt was pulled across so the door it wouldnt close. How did they not notice this?!! We arrived back at around 11pm after spending the day on the strip, luckily nothing missing!! Not the first review of issues with doors here from what I have read! Was offered a late check out for the inconvience which we didnt need. Had also read previous reviews about the pool noise ... I had thought hey its Vegas! ..... But it is incredibly loud. We didn't use the pool at all during our 3 night stay for this reason. Wouldn't choose to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Awesome Experience
allReviews.text: We have visited the Palms many times in the past. We recently checked it out for the first since the new owners re-opened it. We were not disappointed with anything. Excellent customer service, food, cleanliness and beautiful rooms. Great variety of slots and food venues. We will definitely be returning!

allReviews.title: Great Casino
allReviews.text: This is a great casino off of the strip. It is extremely clean and well laid out. They have a lot of slot machines, it's not as crowded as the casinos on the strip. They have a lot of great dining and game options. I highly recommend this casino, if you want to do something off the strip.

allReviews.title: Much needed vacation
allReviews.text: We were staying at TI so took an Uber to The Palms.  I thought it was beautiful & seemed to have plenty of various slots. I particularly enjoyed the AYCE Lobster/Crab Leg special buffet. It wasn't cheap but it was SOOOOO GOOD!  The lobster tails were fantastic! Desserts were lacking but the people working at Desserts were very friendly & welcoming. The bar pictured had a shark sectioned across the bar.

allReviews.title: Went back to my room and found a stranger sleeping in my bed!
allReviews.text: I came here for a work conference and it was a 3 night stay. On night number two, I  had left the hotel for a few hours and when I came back to my room, there was an adult stranger sound asleep in one of the two beds! A person! Sleeping in my room! With all of my stuff just sitting there for the taking. This person did not notice me come into my room so I went back downstairs to grab security. They then had to verify who I was, what room number it was, etc. etc. Another security guy came over and asked if I was Steve. (I am not.) They said there was a "Steve and guest" added on to the room. I said that I was there by myself and had no guests staying with me. There should not be a "Steve" on the room. He walked away -- with MY license -- to the front desk to verify all this info and see how Steve got added to my room. It ends up there was no additional guest added to my room. So how did this person end up in my room? They said, "Well your door must not have been closed all the way." I said that I'm sure that is possible but the door is self-closing and closes shut by itself every time I've used it. It's a good explanation but seems unlikely. Anyway, after about 45 minutes from start to finish, they extracted this drunken stranger from my room. They said he was actually a hotel guest but went to the same room location on the wrong floor. Innocent mistake, sure. But how did my door get unlocked for him? They said his key did not work on my door. Also, he did "not get under the sheets" in my room so basically they said they would notate the event and I said I would talk to a manager the next day. So I went to sleep (in the other unused bed) since I had to be up early for a conference in the morning.I calmly went to the front desk today and explained the situation to a manager. I also told him I tested my door and I can close it and then open it without the key, even though it is fully closed. He said that's not normal and offered to have a maintenance man come check my room. He asked if there was anything else. I said, "Yes, I would think the hotel would offer me some kind of compensation considering what happened." I was offered a $100 food and beverage voucher. He said my room was already paid for and had no balance. I said that was because I already paid for it! I mean, c'mon! He said since it was paid through a third-party, he couldn't offer any kind of room credit. The only other option was an "investigation" and that it would take 7 days for somebody to get back to me. So I am in the same room, no food and beverage credit (since I opted for the investigation) and I have to wait 7 days for management to review and get back to me. And who knows if they will even call me or do anything about it. I'm not a big complainer, but I thought this was egregious, the manager at the front desk seemed ill-equipped to handle the situation and he wasn't even going to offer me anything besides having somebody check my door locking mechanism. I just want to remind you I came back to my room with a drunk person sleeping in my bed. I'm not complaining about a hair in my bathtub or a dirty sink. This was a personal safety issue that could have resulted in a physical altercation, personal items being stolen, etc. Thankfully, it did not. But I'm disappointed in the way the hotel is handling it. (P.S., the engineer did come to my room and confirmed there was an electrical short in the door and he is replacing the body of the lock.) Security had guessed that maybe my door hadn't been closed all the way which I felt was passing blame onto me, but it turns out that the lock did have an issue.

allReviews.title: Free Valet & Great Buffet
allReviews.text: Four of my favorite letter FREE. Where everyone else has high valet charges and resort fees, this off strip property was great. Ubers into the city were easy for the 2 trips you take day and night otherwise huge casino, plenty of food options, and lovely staff. Specifically Monique at the Front Desk helped me handle a last minute travel schedule where they accomodated my requested and saved me from a flight change. I couldn't be happier with their customer service, their check in lines also moved way faster than any other casino, they had a defunct nightclub that now is the hotel pool are which is awesome because it's MASSIVE so get over there and check it out before they realize they're sitting on gold. Rooms are a great size and all remodled with the new renovation. Can't way to go back!

allReviews.title: Stunning and absolutely awesome !
allReviews.text: I’ve been waiting patiently for The Palms to reopen and believe me, it has definitely been worth the wait. I switched to The Palms year ago after always staying on the strip every time I was in Vegas. I had a four nights stay recently and the minute I stepped onto the property, I felt like I was home. On arrival the first thing I noticed was how happy and positive the staff were and the whole facility was so clean and nicely refurbed. Everyone I interacted with were so kind and helpful. I booked a standard Fantasy Tower strip view room. I checked in and was assigned my room. I opened the door to my room and my first impression was WOW !. What a nice surprise, I had been upgraded to an absolutely beautiful corner room. The room was huge and was stunning as was the view. The breakfast buffet at A.Y.C.E was I think the largest and most comprehensive I had seen anywhere in the world, my jaw dropped literally when I saw what was on offer. Another great alternative is the Serrano Vista Café on the gaming floor, great menu with a nice relaxed atmosphere. Parking is free (another bonus). I am returning in February 2023, coming from New Zealand and I can’t wait. Well done The Palms, you’re awesome !

allReviews.title: Housekeeping didn't clean room upon arrival
allReviews.text: The hotel check-in staff and the room was great! However, upon check in there were bobby pins in the shower, used soap in the shower, the shampoo and other bathroom give-always were 1/2 used.
