allReviews.text: Payed 250 for a lousy hotel on newyears eve. Worst service,Filthy,smelly, had to wait 60 min  to get a shower fixed, sheets, towels, and call reception 6 times, to find out there is no service call.Ripoff!

allReviews.title: Hotel Guest
allReviews.text: Elaine Gutierrez, Hotel Front Desk Manager, is a poor example of hospitality.  She is insensitive, uncaring and non customer friendly.  She totally ruined my family get away!!! I will never stay at the PALMS EVER AGAIN!!!  ELAINE SHOULD BE FIRED AND SHOULD BE BARRED FROM THE HOSPITALITY BUSINESS FOR EVER!!

allReviews.title: stay at palms
allReviews.text: everything was ok until we had to walk to spa, construction and con. workers walking around was a bit annoying,blocked window was a surprise,if not for those issues stay would been excellent.first stay for me there and it was ok even for those things

allReviews.title: Won a complimentary night at the kiosk
allReviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed a free night in the Ivory tower. Our room was on the 24th floor overlooking the construction being done looking south. Next to nothing heard from the construction site. The room was very clean and I was very glad to see that there was no smoking allowed. You find that out when you check into the hotel as you sign in. The elevator was quick to get to the floor. We checked in around 4pm and a maid was cleaning a room down the hall. She greeted us warmly and asked us if we needed anything just ask. The room was a premier king bed with a chaise lounge. It was very clean and after doing a bit of gaming in the casino the bed was okay. I had to turn off the heater because it was just a bit too much. All in all, this was a nice place to be in.

allReviews.title: Good Rooms, Mediocre Staff
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Palms last weekend for the first and it was good. The room was really pretty and clean. I enjoyed the room. The staff to say the least was just OK. Upon checking in I asked the guy if the rooms were nice and his response was "well you bought the cheapest room we have." I would think they would want their hotel staff to boast their rooms even if I bought the cheapest one available. Anytime we walked up to concierge to ask a question she acted like we were bothering her or taking her time from starring at the computer. The construction starts early so beware if you are wanting to sleep in you can not. The housekeeping does not pay attention to detail as they provided me a stained pillow case.

allReviews.title: Good place and Spa was great!
allReviews.text: Overall great place. The view on the 52 floors was perfect!  Cafe opposite spa had good food but unfortunately ended up getting a pretty dry salmon on my salat. Staff was helpful and friendly, especially in the bar. The spa was just what I needed to get all refreshed after a long work weekend! They had a sauna, steam bath, cold water pool, and hot tub. Free shavers, toothbrush and whatever you needed to get ready for a good day of work. Overall great experience, looking forward to being back again.  Cheers

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: I stayed here last week and there was still construction. Don't let that deter you from staying at this beautiful hotel off the strip.The A.Y.C.E. Buffet is as a great value. Dinner was $21.99, but you get $2 off if you sign up for their free player's card. The Palms also has a mini food court with Panda Express and McDonald's. Rooms are clean and remodeled. They have one of the best player services in Vegas. The team is very friendly and helpful. Give this hotel a try and you won't be sorry.

allReviews.title: PISSED
allReviews.text: If you want roaches crawling up your bed this is the best hotel ! I’m pissed as hell we were doing so well and this morning we find a HUGE Roach crawling up our damn bed ... this is digusting and I’m utterly upset !

allReviews.title: Love the redesign
allReviews.text: Had a comp night with our boarding pass and decided to check out Stations newest hotel. They have done a fantastic job in remodeling the place. We parked in the east garage and they are staging their construction from there. Parking garage is a little tight, but had no problem parking our Tahoe.Had dinner at the A.Y.C.E. buffet and it was delicious. The food was hot and fresh even though they weren't terribly busy. We got one of the remodeled rooms in the Fantasy Tower and loved it. The beds were very comfortable and the room was well lit. Have comps again next month and might use it for the Palms again

allReviews.title: Off-Strip, $20 Dinner AYCE Buffet, Free Parking, Free Wifi
allReviews.text: We stayed in early November, and there was still construction in the front (they're building a pool and a couple of restaurants). It didn't bother us that much, and we didn't hear construction noise in our room in the Ivory Tower until mid week (Wed). Like almost all Vegas hotels, the Palms has a resort fee on top of the nightly fee. But, they also offer Free Parking anywhere on the property and Free Wifi, which was why we choose them. The best part of staying at the hotel was the A.Y.C.E. Buffet. It was a great value. Dinner was $21.99, but you get $2 off if you sign up for their free player's card. Best dishes were the prime rib, mashed potatoes, moqueca (clams and mussel stew), and smoked korean bbq ribs. It's not a seafood buffet, but they do have seafood dishes and these rotate each night so you can get a variety. One night, they had honey walnut shrimp, another night the moqueca. The Palms also has a mini food court with Panda Express and McDonald's.The Ivory Tower is nice and comfortable. They don't change bed sheets (just make the beds) for  multi-day stay, unless you ask Housekeeping to, but this is pretty standard in the industry. Housekeeping missed a few spots for vacuuming, but it wasn't a big deal. Generally clean. The only real bummer about staying at the Palms is they discontinued the free shuttle to the Strip. It's about a mile, and we didn't feel it was walkable because of the busy freeway interchange. If you head to the Strip, you can park for free at the Venetian. Hotel stay also included free entrance to their club. No pool except for the one at Palm's Place (you have to cross the casino to the other side to get to it).

allReviews.title: Comfortable, clean rooms!
allReviews.text: We headed to Vegas to see Blink-182 and celebrate my birthday! The check in process was quick and the staff was super friendly.The room itself was big, comfortable and clean! I would definitely stay here again, especially with the availability of the restaurants and fast food chains!

allReviews.title: Enjoyable stay
allReviews.text: We arrived at the hotel Sunday at noon and our room was not ready... was ok with that went to the food court which was pretty good and watched NFL in the sportsbook. Finally got our room at 3:45 lol but they were very nice about it and upgraded us to a resort room in the fantasy tower at no charge for our patience. Room was very nice big bed was comfy bathroom was large the shower was HUGE the water pressure good have been better but the water was nice and hot ... toilet door was weird though it was a sliding door lol and the flat screen TV on the wall was huge One of the best features was the A.Y.C.E. breakfast buffet for $10.99 which included your drinks for that price . The food was excellent and the selection was huge trust me check this out definitely worth the price Downside was there is no longer shuttle service from the Hotel to the strip so if you plan on doing alot on the strip you may want to avoid this cause although it's only like a 5 Minute ride to the strip the ride back after a long day was a bit of a pain. We were doing anything much on the strip so we found the break from the hustle and bustle a nice change of scenery . If you are a first timer to Vegas I would not recommend staying off the stripThey are doing massive construction on building new pools and hot tubs but it was not a distraction or nuisance Staff was excellent and polite and we enjoyed our stay . Recommend this hotel if you are looking for more of relaxed quieter trip to Vegas

allReviews.title: A Maze
allReviews.text: The room itself was great! It was comfortable and ideal. However, I think it is ridiculous that we can’t even have a coffee maker in the room. It is such a pain in the butt to not be able to relax in the morning and just have a cup of coffee without having to get dressed and go downstairs. Oh that’s right you can get it room service but it’s $20.00 (+3% tax and gratuity) for a 4 cup pot! The other pain was it was a maze trying to get to the pool! When you get there it is nice but getting there is interesting. You can easily get lost. It’s not a pool that you can swim in. Plus it isn’t on the strip which has its advantages but then its disadvantages. We had a great stay overall. Oh and we did see Owen Wilson there! He hopped out of his Uber!

allReviews.title: roaches... move on
allReviews.text: Stayed Nov 15 & 16.... roaches in room on day of check out, could not even put on make up without them crawling at my toes.  Flight was at 12 but checked out at 730 AM.... told front desk and showed pics... he said he would send housekeeping... really,,, I am checking out... Offered no customer service... home now in Monterey, another fine "manager" calls.. says all she can do is reverse my early check in (don't forget I did an early check out!!) and reverse the "resort" fee but no room charge adjustment cause I paid on Expedia... wow... Both "managers" failed, perhaps their new "gun" Jon the GM should spend more time on customer service training.  You know for every one roach you see there are 300 hiding.  They should have refunded the room charges regardless of how I paid.  So unless you want bugs crawling on you during the night and chasing you in the AM ... move to another booking.

allReviews.title: We really enjoy this Hotel and Staff. Casino Host John is really great.
allReviews.text: We usually stay here at least one or more nights when we come to Las Vegas. My Husband enjoys the table games in the Casino and I like to watch him play. Although the last two visits they still are under construction, we are really looking forward to returning to see it all finished.  ESP. The Pool area.  We have enjoyed the old pool area in past. Sad to see it not available but I bet the new pool will be Awesome! The rooms are always very clean and the staff always pleasant. One of these trips I would love to see a live performance in the Pearl Theater. We have eaten at several of the on site restaurants and enjoyed them.  Had some luck playing in the Casino as well. We used to rent a car in past visits but now find it so reasonably priced and quick to just take Uber if we go off site. Now that Palms is owned by the same group that owns the Station Casino’s we can collect more players points.  Highly Recommend The Palms.

allReviews.title: A.Y.C.E. was the bomb!!
allReviews.text: We were there for a concert but stayed at Palms Place. The casino was not very good to me but I had fun! The buffet was great and the price was reasonable. Very good choices. Will for sure visit there again we I return to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Breakfast at the palms buffet
allReviews.text: Went to breakfast at the new buffet at the palms and was very good , a lot of variety to choose from all the food was good ! The service was good the staff were all friendly definitely worth checking out even though it’s a little bit off the vegas strip!

allReviews.title: Terrible customer service
allReviews.text: terrible! terrible! terrible!stayed 2 nights, complained 3 times.  Complain #1 - 6AM, something banging on the window.  called the front desk, answer " very sorry, we knew about that.  A lot of people complain".  Complain #2 - 8:30PM, the shower drain clogged up.  Called the housekeeping, the engineer came right away (very good).  He spent 15 mins, couldn't fix it because the drain shared with the next room.  Another guy came, worked in the other room for another 15 mins.  still did not work.  But my whole room stink with the stuff they pulled out and the bath room and the carpet were disgusting. Called the front desk.  They are not willing to change room and said they will send somebody to clean and spray the room.  I insisted to change room.  They say they will send the bell boy up to bring us the keys for new room.  15 mins later (while we were still in the stinky room), nobody showed up.  i went down to the front desk and they told me nobody at the front desk talked to me.  I wanted to talk to the manager.  The lady at the front desk went to the back office and the manager came out 5 mins later and told me they are very busy and they have only 2 bell boys (btw, there were not a soul at the front desk) and the bell boy went up.  While i was arguing with them and my wife called me that the bell boy showed up.  She told me he was very rude.  Complain #3, the new keys did NOT work.  Oh, i was mad.  went back down.  Same answer, "sorry, we are very busy and fully booked tonight"  Will never ever stay there again.Terrible terible terrible customer service.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel, would definitely visit again
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 3 days in October. I got a mailer offering free "comped" rooms so since my friends were also going to be in vegas that week I booked it last minute. There is major construction going in in the parking lot and casino, as of late October 2018. The parking lot construction was not a problem, you just have to walk a little farther if you self park to get to the casino. The construction in casino was a little annoying during the day; they was drilling sounds and and fire alarm type noise constantly going off. Night time was much better since they didn't seem to be working in the casino at night. They have a food court but everything was closed when i arrived except for McDonalds so I ordered room service, which was ok but it took 1 hour and 15 minutes for my food to arrive. Room was nice as usual, just wish they would put a small frig in there. Best part is they don't charge the resort fee if your room is comped, so all I ended up paying for was the room service. All the staff I interacted with was friendly.  The have a multiplex theater connected to the hotel off the food court that was great; I had to kill time so watched a matinee movie for only $6 with great reclining seats.

allReviews.title: This place is worth a try
allReviews.text: My boyfriend love this place.  The rooms are very comfortable and clean.  We usually stay at the Ivory Tower but we did get the Fantasy Tower with the jacuzzi tub once.  It’s worth the upgrade.  I enjoy gambling here too.  The buffet and little cafe is great and a surprise.

allReviews.title: Blink 182
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Palms because my friend and I took our two 15 year old sons to the Blink 182 concert.  We stayed here in hopes that we would just happen to run into the band members, and we did!  We met both Matt and Mark!  The boys we thrilled!As far as the hotel goes, it was pretty good.  Set quite away from the strip - 20-25 min walk to the strip.  It's walkable, but we mostly used Uber.I actually liked being away from the strip, the hotel is not super busy, the restaurants aren't really busy, it was relaxing.We liked the Pearl theatre, it's a smaller, more intimate venue.  Perfect seats pretty much everywhere.The movie theatre was good, reclining chairs and small theatres.We ate at both the Lucky Penny and the AYCE buffet. The AYCE was great for breakfast, good price and good selection.  We only had small snacks at the Penny, but what we did have was good, and everyone else's meals looked and smelled amazing! Our waiter was fantastic.The rooms were clean - I have really high standards and I couldn't complain.  There's always room for improvement, like getting in the corners and giving the shower a good scrub.The beds were super comfy and the pillows were amazing.  In room safe, hair dryer, iron - all worked well.  TV selection was decent, wifi speed was decent.  We moved a bunch of stuff out of the fridge so we could cool our own drinks - a guy came into refill the minibar and I told him we only moved stuff - we were initially charged for those items right away, but the front desk didn't hassle me at checkout when I told them we didn't actually use them  They took all charges off without question. I think that was my only negative - I will never pay the minibar fees, I'd rather have an empty fridge to house my own stuff than them stocking the fridge.We took advantage of the pool - it was a trek to get to, and quite hard to find, but once we got there it was great.  Very quiet and relaxing - very few people were there.  It was nice to be able to relax without all the drunk, rowdy people like you get at strip pools. The pool is great for kids, our boys loved it, but it would be good for little ones too - no partying and the pool is not deepI would totally stay here again.  It's far enough from the strip that you don't get the partying and the crowds.  You can walk places, but Uber is really your best bet because the walks can be very long.  I loved how quiet this place is compared to hotels on the strip.  You don't have to walk through crowds constantly within the hotel, the noise level is good - still a fun atmosphere, but not a big party place.Hotel amenities aren't abundant - one small store with a bit of drinks, snacks and clothes.  They had a great selection of Blink shirts! A small food court and just a few restaurants, but it worked for us.

allReviews.title: Good rooms - currently under construction
allReviews.text: We've stayed here before and enjoyed it.  You probably know it's off the strip (but close enough), so that's nothing new.  However, it is under construction/renovation, so many restaurants are not open, there is a small-ish pool located in a different tower which is a little bit of a hike.  The fitness center is there, too.  We found there wasn't much to do there.  The room was very nice, well-equipped.  We stayed here because we were seeing a show in the theatre there and the price was competitive.  But  it won't be our first choice again for lack of things to do.

allReviews.title: The Pearl at Palms Casino Restort - Great concert venue
allReviews.text: When to see Simple Minds and Blink 182 here this week while in Vegas.  Great concert venue - small and intimate but large enough (up to 2,500 people) to get some great energy in the room.    Close to all the main hotels so just a short taxi ride away.   I have been to concerts with 80,000 and much prefer the smaller venues - better experience overall getting to it and getting home from it and while there.  There are bars on every level here and it is a nice clean venue.   There is also waitress service during the events.   If you see an event you like, book it as I am confident you will enjoy the venue.

allReviews.title: Over chargeing
allReviews.text: I stay here before but KNOW plams casino  service has got tick of tack no one came to the room to clean it up an I call in to conform I'm leaving. came back the room was the same. bathroom has water the stay on the floor from shower uneven drain where water goes down if your in the bathroom LADIES make sure no eclectic core touch the floor?? The Wi-Fi should be FREE but their charging you after you log in / but what is the resort fee for as long as Palms casino has your credit card they can care LESS /an the Iron did not work

allReviews.title: Impresive buffe
allReviews.text: I was staying somewhere else but a friend wanted to meet at the buffet at the Palms.  I am so glad she suggested it.  The place is very nice and lots of seats.  As for the food, the selection was outstanding.  The fried calamari was spicy and great.  I'm surprised I didn't eat more.

allReviews.title: Very Impressed
allReviews.text: I just recently returned from a long weekend staying at The Palms in Las Vegas!  It was absolutely awesome!  They have made some very improvements to the property.  Fabulous new rooms!  Excited to go back!

allReviews.title: Will not return....business traveler with car for two days
allReviews.text: My experience:The positive:1) Comfortable bed2) Casino was not busy so access to tables was easy3) Free parking Cons:1) Toilet backed up first night2) TV remote control did not work3) Construction equipment and supplies stored in the parking garage which completely limited parking spaces4) "Free internet" charged to room when logging in and then had to request removed at check out. This is the "normal" process.5) Free newspaper - you have to go down to the lobby and wait in line to get from the front desk - it is not delivered to you6) Construction noise in the casino during the 7am-4pm hours so if you eat breakfast or lunch you hear banging and equipment moving aroundWhen I mentioned these topics to the front desk at check out the response was - "Would you like a printed receipt for your stay?"

allReviews.title: Nearly Constant Construction Noise
allReviews.text: I had never stayed at The Palms before this trip. Booked The Palms because me and my friend were going to a concert at the Pearl Theater. I thought the staff that I encountered at the Front desk, the restaurants, the lobby bar, and the casino, were all really friendly and provided excellent service. The hotel is clean and fairly nice, but the remodeling and construction noise didn’t make it very enjoyable. They are building a new pool complex onto the hotel, adjacent to the “Ivory Tower”. During my stay, the pool was closed. Apparently they were offering the use of a small 6th floor pool over at the “Palms Place”, but you had to walk down a temporary path to get to the other part of the property due to construction going on. On the last day of my stay, they fired up the grinders or whatever loud power tools they’re using in the construction at 6:00 am. As I write this review on the 10th floor of the Ivory Tower, there is the nearly constant sound of grinding or cutting coming from the area under construction. Not enjoyable at all.I had a “regular “(two queen beds) room. The room was clean and nice the beds were average, but too much remarkable about it. I don’t know if this is true of all of the rooms, however in my room and that of my travel buddy, there is no bathtub, just a shower. They no longer operate a free shuttle to/from The Strip, as of October 1, 2018. Not sure if this is a permanent change or not. Like many hotels, they charge a “resort fee” (around $26 during my stay) that includes WiFi and some other “nice to have’s”. Seems like they should have lowered this during their remodeling/construction, since the pool is closed and for the inconvenience of the remodeling process... I might consider staying here again but not until the remodeling process is complete - Apparently it’s going to last a year? (I did not verify this)

allReviews.title: Love the new Palms and only getting better with construction
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Palms this week after a 10 year absence from the property.  We didn't like the Palms before because it catered to the 20s crowd, and while it was great for those that admire the scenery, for the crankier older guys, it was just loud and obnoxious. The redone Palms is wonderful! Loved the laid-back vibe and great staff.  Let's talk about rooms first.Ivory tower is redone and standard nice; good job on remodel.  Room was clean, modern and did the job for me, staying alone.  Ivory is close to gambling and 24 hour restaurant.  Also, park in the east garage if you are staying there and have a car.  It isn't crowded and you are literally steps from the tower.  So nice not to have to walk or fight traffic. One complaint- wish they had USB charging for phones- come one Palms!! Bring adapter for cell charging. USB in wall did not charge phone. Some of my group stayed at the Palms Place and that was a huge hit! Went on the tour there and if you are staying as a couple, this is the place to be.  Pay a little more but get a whole lot more! Bit of a walk to main casino, but it's only 2 minutes so no big deal. Amazing rooms and definitely the place to be for me when I bring my wife back.Sports book is nice and found seats every time.  Spa/fitness very good.  Lucky Penny serves good food and large portions! Buffet was good value with Boarding Card and they do have continuing construction, but it is bringing additional restaurants, so that is a good thing. It was a little tight in the front, but no noise or other issues. Casino staff was awesome- Thank you to Snow, Lisa and especially Randy at the Ultimate Texas Hold Em table for making the experience great and of course, two 4 of a kinds in 2 days didn't hurt! Entire staff was excellent for the trip.  Love a friendly casino staff. Check in and check out took no time at all and housekeeping was good, although I'm so neat there really wasn't much to do. Can't wait for the finished product, but definitely my favorite right now and will be back with my wife to enjoy the Palace.  I don't stay on the strip any more, so this was the perfect spot for me.  So glad they changed their image. Even Friday and Saturday nights were very tame compared to the old MTV days! Only saw one kid in 4 days- so not really a family destination either. Thanks for a nice weekend Palms!

allReviews.title: Mostly Very Nice
allReviews.text: This resort has been undergoing a renovation that is still in progress so expect some noise during daytime - they are currently building what they say will be the largest pool in Vegas.  We stayed in the Fantasy Tower and the room was beautiful and well appointed - large TV, great shower, comfy furnishings.  The only issue with the room was trying to figure out the lights - they really need a guide just for the lights.  The casino looked pretty nice and it was large.  We do not gamble so cannot speak to the quality of the offerings.  Plenty of dining options, friendly staff at the front desk (although the music is loud enough that it is difficult to hear them).  You are just over a mile from the Strip and there is no shuttle service so be aware of that.

allReviews.title: Solid 4 Stars
allReviews.text: We stayed one night at the Palms Casino Resort and it did the job. This hotel is located 8 minutes of driving or 25 minutes of walking from the strip. The hotel is currently under renovation, so we got a really good deal with our room rate. The room itself was good. It was recently updated and the bed was comfortable. The casino on site is small and had small crowds. There’s a small food court and buffet and everything is within a short walking distance inside. I’m not sure if I’ll return again in the future, but I wouldn’t take it off the table. The area between the hotel and strip feels a little unsafe, so that would be my biggest deterrent from staying again.

allReviews.title: Remodeling the hotel
allReviews.text: Palms is going through overhaul in a better way. They are upgrading their rooms and casino area to make it more modern. Fairly decent dinning options. The only thing I noticed was it seems they are running very thin on staff. Most (90%) of the time calling to front desk or concierge service is unattended to a point we got frustrated and just went down but no one was available to attend us.

allReviews.title: Great!!!
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful stay here! The employees were always very friendly and would help with anything you needed! Lots of places to eat and open all hours of the night! Very clean and would stay here anytime I’m in town!

allReviews.title: OCT 2018  UNDER MAJOR CONSTRUCTION BEWARE!
allReviews.text: Palms Place Studio Suite is about 1/4 of a mile away from parking your car or walking to casino. So pack light and wear walking shoes.   Also no view of strip from our suite--so disappointed. Balcony doors are locked shut, so no point paying extra for that feature.  King size bed has sink holes, caved in--opposite of firm or comfortable--really bad for back support.  Bed comforter had a blood spot on it.  Recessed lighting in bathroom had bad bulb.  Check in at 3pm ended up being at 4:30pm with no apology or comps of any kind.  If you miss house cleaning, you are responsible to call them back up or your room will not be cleaned.  One night sheets smelled like mildew--awful.   We booked through  Tripadvisor via "cancelcom" and were tricked into believing resort fees were paid in advance.  $37 a night--ugh!  Gym was so small and depressing.  Crappy machines and small selection.  Elip and treadmills faced a parking lot so no view and no tv monitors to keep you from getting bored.  Go elsewhere this year.  The construction is insane and Palms is not worth the extra moula.  The slots are super tight--so we moved on to Palace Station and Fremont Street.  I never saw one strip shuttle from the Palms.  Gold Coast across street has shuttles pretty often though.

allReviews.title: Not Strip, but fantastic!
allReviews.text: This hotel looks a little ole on the outside, but major work is going on, and once you enter it is sheer luxury! High ceiling, modern and beatiful, and still very much Las Vegas! service great, room fantastic. What a surprise. I will be back in a heartbeat. Keep an eye on pool-work and things going on...it may take a while before everything is updated. But the hotel? GREAT!!

allReviews.title: Modern room with funky decor and comfortable bed...but nothing more
allReviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for one night, and after an uneventful check-in procedure we found that the room was spacious and the bathroom was clean an modern. We found a bar fridge full of bottled drinks,and since we needed refrigerator space, we removed the bottles. We had also two small cooling elements that need refreezing, but the fridge had no freezer compartment. As a result, we went back to the front desk and asked, whether they could possibly keep those small elements in a freezer overnight.On our extensive travels this has never been a problem, but here it was one:the person at the front desk said that they could not do it! This would involve extra charges. We were told that they would accommodate us in a condo unit of the same establishment at an additional charge. It reeked of revenue-generating, and we really did not need the space of a condo for one overnight stay! We have never experienced this type of attitude before. It sounds like: here is your room; don't even think of asking for any type of extra service! The room itself does not have any other creature comforts for the traveller, not even a small coffee maker. You also pay $36.00 in addition for their resort fee, which is a common feature in Las Vegas. As a result, anybody should think twice before booking here!

allReviews.title: Awful Experience / Disinterested Staff
allReviews.text: Room smelled strongly of sewage.  Toenail clippings on the beds and benches at the ends of each bed.  Debris elsewhere on the floor, including an unidentifiable prescription pill (photos attached). It was evident that this room was never cleaned or deodorized after the prior guest.  WiFi system denied access despite our confirmed reservation and the room phone could not connect to the front desk.  Made repeated efforts to go through the concierge to get someone at the front desk and waited on hold for 25 minutes across 4 separate calls, the first three of which ended by being forwarded to a voicemail box that was not set up.After a long day we wanted only to go to bed in a reasonably clean room; when it didn’t seem that would be possible we simply asked to have the reservation cancelled so we could book and travel to a different hotel for a better experience.  The front desk, when finally reached, refused to waive a cancellation fee of $415 and instead offered to move us to a different room with a $30 food credit.  Including the service charge and automatic gratuity of 21%, the $30 credit would allow for a single order of approximately 25% of all items on the room service menu.We refused the credit and will eat our meals elsewhere.  I will never set foot in this hotel after our trip is over and will ensure that everybody we know to be traveling to Las Vegas stays in another hotel.  We don’t scare easily and the room conditions were disgusting.  But for the bellhop who helped relocate our family the staff was inattentive, disinterested and/or completely disrespectful.

allReviews.title: Nothing to fault
allReviews.text: This is my third stay here gets better each time especially with new lobby and all.. stayed at most strip hotels but always drawn back here!! Would definitely  recommend also has free self-park which comes in handy.. thank me later :)

allReviews.title: Very disappointed with overpriced suite!
allReviews.text: Arrived Thursday & upgraded to a suite. Walked in to a room that had obviously not had the floors or furnitire vacuumed (all carpet except the bathrooms with a fabric couch) & reaked of stale cigarettes. Had the room cleaned during our stay, still wasn't vacuumed or thoroughly cleaned. Bar fridge had EXPIRED beverages... year old beer, juice, pop!! Also, barely kept our water cold. The curtains had unsightly stains on the bottom & all room items were quite weathered. One of the toilets ran all day/ night, without an offer to resolve. And, there was not one drawer or dresser to put clothing in to, we were in a one bedroom suite?! They also are undergoing renos, so everything was near impossible to access with no signage to PROPERLY guide the guests. Most staff were quite nice, however a few of their older front desk clerks could use some re-training in how to treats the guests (and their co-workers!!) paying almost $300/night for a suite with their "resort fees" that include nothing, that we could take advantage of, but wifi - which in 2018 is included at most places. Palms is also located a 5-7 min DRIVE from the strip so bargain for, a minimum, $20 drive to your hotel per day via Car Share options or a $30 taxi. Oh! There is no poker... at a Casino! And, next to no knowledge about where to find it in town?! We were sent to another hotel 5 mins away, only to be redirected to another hotel a 5 min DRIVE away.

allReviews.title: 40 Yr Re-Union
allReviews.text: Thank you to the Palms for giving us a night we will not forget! The experience was unbelievable! Bar for us with the nicest Bartenders with a beautiful Pool just outside the windows and Food I have never really enjoyed before! The Staff, Velet, Food service was exceptional. Thank You and we will be back!

allReviews.title: Overpriced Tired Suite
allReviews.text: We reserved a corner suite at the Palms for a special birthday getaway.  The entire hotel casino is going through a major renovation.  They evidently haven't gotten around to the suites yet.  At least I hope they haven't.  The room is not just tired looking, it is not in very good condition.  The walls and furniture have marks and gouges on them.  It is disappointing to say the least.  There is a desk with no chair and there are no dresser drawers.  The buffet however, is fantastic.

allReviews.title: I would not do it again
allReviews.text: I was given three nights and slot money in the Ivory tower from my casino in N.J. as a gift give away. I was given a letter at check in welcoming me and saying to speak to a host for concerns or comments. The woman at the card center reluctantly called Val Thai. I asked for a pass to the spa for my husband. Val explained he would see if I qualified for a comp when I left.My husband did not go to spa as he did not think that was an unreasonable request as we were given the stay at the Palms from my casino. I sent a text to Val as we were leaving explaing our only room charges were for food. He has never responded.                                                                                                      Our Suite was O..K. There are some shelves in the closet but no drawers. A small alarm clock but no radio. There was not a coffee pot  in the room so it was room service or get dressed to go to the food court. I was only able to connect my iPad to the Internet not my kindle. I was told we could connect up to three devices.                                                                 The pool was a trip to the other side of the resort and small. When the construction is finished I am sure this will be a better resort.                                                                     The casino is pretty limited as is the race book. You must make a $50 race bet to get a drink and my husband was closed out for a race because of a shift change even though  he should have had plenty of time.                                                                                        We ate at The Lucky Penny and the buffet. Both were reasonably priced and the food was good.The buffet had a nice selection. Not extravagant.                                                                  The shuttle service was easy and convenient. The driver was very helpful and pleasant as was Manny to and from the airport.                                                                                  All the wait staff on the casino floor and in the restaurants were friendly and efficient.            Overall I would say this is 3 star resort at best.

allReviews.title: Birthday party gone bad
allReviews.text: A friend and I decided to go "all out" for our birthdays this years. We decided to book with a resort where we can begin celebrating at the cabanas during the day and a club/lounge at night. We had been seeing a lot of advertisements on the remodeling that the Palms has been doing so we decided to seek out availability and pricing. We were then referred to an individual named Ahron Bragg to help us with book our party. Im not sure if he was a promoter (or what his actual title was) however, he gave us a tour of the hotel including the cabanas and nightclub (Apex). We were to have 22 guests that night, he painted a picture for us that sounded like our guests and us will be treated like VIP. The package was to be $1275. We were told we can either have bottle service or our guests can order their preferred drinks to reach a limit of 1275. So here's how the day went. We got to the palms around 11, checked in, we went to the pool, had our reserved cabanas and enjoyed the pool (really no problem there). Around 8 pm we started getting ready for our main event at the APEX, we had been looking forward to this for a long time. We head over at around 9:30pm, the security greets us at the door, takes our ID's and has us wait in line. Of course we're already becoming irritated because we had spent money on making sure this was a vip experience. I tried contacting Ahron, he said he was on the other side of the resort and wasn't going to be there so he was going to text us the number of the manager that night (by the way, he said that he was going to be there with us the entire night, making sure everything went smooth). 15 minutes later, he texts us the number of this so called manager. At the point, we were walked upstairs to the nightclub. The escort then starts walking us outside, we stopped him and advised him that we were promised a spot inside. He then leaves to find the manager, the manager returns with an attitude as if we owed him something. When we began telling him that Ahron told us we'd be getting inside seating, he says, "Ahron doesn't know what he's talking about." This is extremely unprofessional, this is an individual that is representing your hotel!!! After a few minutes, we were able to get a small corner (for 22 freaking people!, unbelievable). Then when our waitress came to the table, they were trying to charge us 1375 instead of 1275 (which was the agreed price). When we told her that we decided we wanted our guests to be able to order their own drinks instead of doing bottle service, our waitress told us "well, I don't think I can do that because it's a lot of walking back and forth." Our bill for that night ended up being 1800. I know this is a lengthy review, but I encourage you all to review it before booking your party at the Palms. If it wasn't for all our guests cheering us up this experience would have ABSOLUTELY RUINED MY NIGHT. It seems like you're saving money at a place like this but I promise it's not worth the trouble. I would highly NOT RECOMMEND this hotel for a special event.

allReviews.title: A Great Visit
allReviews.text: Tuscany is a welcoming fun place to visit.  The games are fun and accommodations are roomy and clean. The beds were comfortable and appreciated having a coffee maker in the room.

allReviews.title: The Best Gamble to take while in Vegas Baby!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino is a wonderful place to come for your Vegas getaway. It's a close and easy walk to the strip or a short uber/taxi drive and close enough to Harry Reid international without the noise of the airplanes.  Sometimes "you get what you pay for" can come into play, but I was VERY pleasantly surprised that this wonderfully affordable hotel was beautifully manicured, had large spacious and clean rooms, and a great variety of restaurants, bars, and cafes!  Not to mention, if I didn't want to go to the strip to gamble, the casino on site had so much to offer.  I already told my husband that we're coming back and staying here because next time I also want to enjoy the beautiful pool and spa area they offer. You will not be disappointed. Save the $ for shows, shopping, and more and stay at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. It's the best gamble you'll make while in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Nice stay off the Strip
allReviews.text: Nice room: large, clean, with fridge, great bed, and quiet. No microwave in room but could have requested one. Didn’t use the pools but they looked inviting and well kept. Distance from Strip was OK if you are willing to do the walk (about 15+ minutes).

allReviews.title: Awesome Stay!
allReviews.text: In town for a concert we selected this hotel as it was off the strip and less costly. We were a family of four adults and the room was impressive as it was quite spacious. The room consisted of two full-size beds, a living room with a nice sized couch, armchair, office chair/desk and a dining table, TV. There was a kitchenette with fridge and coffee maker (Keurig) and wet bar but no microwave (but we did see severalmicrowaves locked up in the maids’ closet at end of hall). The bathroom consisted of a square-shaped size shower (single person size), a toilet, bathtub and vanity. The room was carpeted (as opposed to a wooden or linoleum floor). They had a nice pool, bar and breakfast restaurant on site, too. The main pool had loud punk music being piped in but the nearby lap pool did not. They had poolside drink service, too. We all loved the small scale of the resort (three stories) and the ability to park close to your room. One evening we walked to the Hotel Cosmopolitan (30 minutes) passing Paris-Las Vegas, Planet Hollywood and Bellagio along the strip. The hotel staff was very accommodating, especially Shaun, the manager at check out. We would definitely come back here again.

allReviews.title: Vegas hidden gem
allReviews.text: Great valueVery clean 10 mins Walk to strip Very nice restaurants with GREAT prices Vegas hidden gem for sure The grounds landscaping is beautiful The pool and hottub are heated and open all year round

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: There always clean and very affordable. The staff are very friendly and willing to help. If you plan on staying in Vegas I'd recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: not a better place to stay.
allReviews.text: for me...it truly is the best place to stay. location is killer. the rooms are huge. live music 7 nights a week. (no cover) name 1 hotel that provides a coffee maker (with coffee pods) a refrigerator, and a microwave.(ask for one, upon arrival) I can tell you ...none! the grounds are immaculate. the pools stay open til 10pm. the buildings are only 3 stories high mand with the rooms being so big, you have only 10 rooms per floor. the eats, are very good. and Cafe Bottega has thee ..best coffee! truly, you cannot go wrong choosing this establishment. it truly is a throwback to the way, Vegas used to be. treated like royalty....but without the ransom!

allReviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTED
allReviews.text: We arrived tired in the evening after a long day of travel.Check in was perfect and Noah was friendly and helpfulThe room assigned was removed from the parking areas so relatively quietWe retired early due to the travel and time difference w/o checking out the roomWe awoke to find that our coffee maker was broken, we next noticed the dead bolt doesn't work on our door, we also found out the vault was already locked and un-usable.We called for service before leaving the htel to report these things to front desk.She stated they would send someone out to fix these things while we were out exploring.  While speaking with the operator I asked where the complimentary water bottle was. She stated only (casino) VIPs were given complimentary water bottles. RME gasp.9 hours later after returning to the room we found NOTHING had been touched.It was dinner time and our show was to follow - on the way to the dnner we again reported these issues to the front desk . . . instead of making an effort to fix right away the assistance mgr on duty tried to accuse use of not reporting these things in a timely manner.  We were comped a 3rd of the over priced dinner in the hotel's restaurant which wasn't worth the 3rd let alone the full price.Overall, I'd recommend buyer beware at this hotel - not terrible but certainly DOES NOT meet expectations or norms for service and accomodation.

allReviews.title: Unhappy this Vacation at the Tuscany
allReviews.text: My husband and I have been staying at the Tuscany for more than 15 years. This was the first time we were disappointed in our stay. The rooms are always nicely furnished and clean. The pool is great and a good way to relax in the sun. We have been to the strip but rather enjoy just being at the Tuscany, The restaurants are good except the prices are rather high. I felt the air conditioning in the casino was way too high because I was freezing most of the time. I had a bad experience in the casino where someone stole my ticket from the machine for $88.17. I was treated like a criminal when I first had staff come to the slot machine when I said my ticket was gone. Eventually they checked cameras and found some woman cashed it out then walked out of the casino. I felt that they could have helped more or compensated me for my loss. I do have to say they were helpful when we checked in because I have cancer and they did give me a room one the first floor of the building we always stay in. I'm disappointed with our vacation at the Tuscany this year because I may not be able to make another year because of my health.

allReviews.title: Great location and value, perfect for business travel
allReviews.text: Great option within walking distance of the Venetian, Paris, Caesar's, the Sphere, BattleBots Arena, and the Atomic Museum. Room was large with a living area. Grounds and room clean. I stayed for a conference, so value, comfort, and quiet were my primary concerns. The rooms are in a completely separate building from the bar and casino, so sleep was good. Marilyn's Cafe also provided a solid diner breakfast.

allReviews.title: Fun times.
allReviews.text: Need those Tuscany coupons back. Need the pens back. Rooms look great. Property is always great. I will see ya'll again in the near future.

Easy walk to the Sphere.  Construction on strip a real pain - I avoided as much as possible. Plan time to enjoy the resort itself if you would like to just relax. I did & am so glad I did vs stress of navigating the strip! I enjoyed choose salad at Pub 365, panini at I think Bogetta? And the entertainment in the lounge bar area was really good! Clean, good service. They do need more bellman though to manage all the activity.

allReviews.title: SPHERE and RAIDERS Weekend Fun in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Tuscany is the perfect hotel and awesome location for ez walk to THE SPHERE and other casinos and a short Uber ride to RAIDERS game!! It is also perfect for a one and done casino hotel restaurant entertainment pool experience if you don’t want to leave the property.

allReviews.title: Fabulous accommodations.
allReviews.text: Best place in Vegas to stay. The grounds are beautiful and all of the employees are very helpful and kind.  We will stay at Tuscany Suites on every trip we take.

allReviews.title: Exceptional staff. Lovely, clean hotel. Great location.
allReviews.text: Beautiful grounds, perfect location, just far away enough to walk to the strip. Peaceful and relaxing. Exceptional staff. Room was very big and really clean. Would definitely recommend.

allReviews.title: Terrible experience, never again!!
allReviews.text: Terrible experience.!! There for a softball tournament. Returned to hotel after playing all day and couldn't get into the room. Walked all the way down to front desk and learned water issue, had to move us to another building. went up to room to wait for somebody to let us in to retrieve our belongings and no one showed up for over a half hour sitting in hallway. Had to call again and finally again after 15 minutes a security guard showed up! Ask to use a cart for suitcases and refused, thus taking 2 trips to move to another building. Finally in new room and noticed window was not in its track with air running full bore, had to replace ourselves. Not way wanted to spend evening after playing ball all day !! The next day returned from playing ball all day and the TV was not working and was that way all evening!! Terrible experience and will never stay there again even though there every year !!

allReviews.title: Overrated Value/40 minute Check-In/Long walk to room, no luggage rack
allReviews.text: More than 40 minute wait to check in even with echeck.  $42 additional Resort Fee Hotels.com didn't mention.  No Microwaves, small lumpy Beds, carpet was wet.  Tuscany restaurants were to expensive and crowded.It was far from where we frequent in Silverado Ranch/Henderson+Downtown.No premium channels

allReviews.title: Always a GREAT VALUE at the Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany Suites numerous occasions over the past several years.  Although they charge the "BS Las Vegas" resort fee, as does all of the other major Vegas hotels, I opine there is still tremendous value when staying at the Tuscany.  Parking is included in the resort fee unlike the Caesars and MGM properties (which have gotten just ridiculously out of control with their room rates and fees).   The Tuscany rooms are extremely spacious and reasonably well kept (could use a "refresh" in the future, but I can see that leading to increased room rates).   I also like being able to park right outside the building where my room is and also being able to go to my room without having navigate through a crowded casino.    Staff members are always friendly and helpful.  The casino floor is not large, but my wife enjoys the variety of slot machines they have (wish she could win rather than lose though...).  I've only eaten at PUB 365 and I find their food, drink selection, service and value are great.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Property, Great Value, Just Short of Perfect
allReviews.text: My son and I came from Colorado for the Raiders Monday Night Football game and stayed at the Tuscany on September 14 and 15. I will just say it up front: the Tuscany has ruined me for future hotel stays. From now on, I will probably judge every hotel by this one, whether it be cleanliness, décor, maintenance, the meticulous care of the grounds, or especially the value.The property exceeded my expectations. It is a beautiful and meticulously maintained place. Every morning I saw crews cleaning leaves, picking up debris, and keeping the grounds spotless. Inside was no different. No matter where you walked, someone was wiping windows, polishing door handles, or vacuuming. Considering the number of people passing through daily, it is pretty remarkable. I live a few minutes from the Broadmoor Hotel in Colorado Springs, and honestly, their standards do not seem as high as the Tuscany’s.Our two-double room was huge and absolutely spotless. I always test for dust on furniture, and there was not any. One half of my one-star deduction was the lack of a microwave in the room. This seems to be a trend, perhaps to encourage guests toward on-site dining, but it is very convenient to have the option to reheat leftovers, even from the hotel’s own restaurants. Microwave aside, I had zero complaints. The room was clean, spacious, and comfortable, and the shower had excellent water pressure. All in all, it was simply great.The restaurant food and value, especially compared to what you would pay just a couple of blocks down on the Strip, was excellent. We ate at Pub 365 twice and Marilyn’s Café once. Pub 365 had great food, and the late-night special was impressive for the price. Marilyn’s served me one of the better chicken fried steak meals I can recall, hearty, flavorful, and cooked just right.The only area where my experience did not quite match the high standard of the property was the service, which is the second half of my one-star deduction. At both Pub 365 and Marilyn’s, the three servers we had seemed a little stretched once food was delivered, even though the restaurants were not particularly busy. At Marilyn’s, our waitress was away for nearly 30 minutes, likely on break, and no one else stepped in to check on tables during that time. Service was never unkind, just not as attentive as I would have hoped. On the positive side, one woman at Marilyn’s, who I believe may have been a manager, was very friendly when we arrived and seemed to notice we had been waiting. When our waitress returned, she appeared to gently encourage her to stop by our table, which I really appreciated.Another moment that stood out was when I paid at Marilyn’s. I handed the woman at the register my ticket and a $50 bill, explained the leftover was for the tip, and that was the entire exchange. It was not rude, but there was no thank you or acknowledgment, and it felt a little impersonal.A similar theme came up at the front desk. When we arrived early, the man explained our room would not be ready for about five hours. That was perfectly fine since we were early, but there was no “Welcome to the Tuscany,” no small talk, and no offer to explain where we could leave our bags. Later in the day the staff member who checked us in was pleasant, but again there was no “Thank you,” “Enjoy your stay,” or “Please let us know if you need anything.”I do want to highlight the bell staff. The man who took our bags when we arrived was especially kind, warm, and friendly. Later in the day, when we picked them up, a different bellman helped us and he was also very kind and helpful. These two stood out as excellent examples, and it would be great if their personalities and warmth were reflected throughout more of the staff.That said, the property itself was outstanding. It is rare that a place truly meets my expectations for value, cleanliness, and attention to detail, but the Tuscany did both inside and out. Even the pool area was one of the best maintained I have ever seen. The pool was a perfect temperature, and the hot tub was actually hot, which in my experience is rare.Overall, the Tuscany delivers one of the best values I have ever experienced in a hotel. Clean, spacious, beautiful, and affordable. If every staff member showed a little more enthusiasm and they added microwaves to the rooms, this would easily be a five-star review.

allReviews.title: Ambiance and the workers and security guards are always pleasant and caring. Everyone makes you feel you belong.
allReviews.text: Ambiance and the workers and security guards are always pleasant and caring. Everyone makes you feel you belong.

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our 4-night stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino. Our room was large and comfortable. The grounds of the hotel were well-maintained and the pool and hot tub were great. We enjoyed the Bodega for breakfasts and lunch and loved Bistecca for dinner (I'll write a separate review for that). The casino was bright and friendly and we LOVED the 5-dollar blackjack table (Shawn was our favorite dealer). The hotel is about a half mile from the Strip, but that's what makes it affordable. Great value! If we return to Vegas, we'll be sure to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Top location
allReviews.text: Perfect location for a visit to Las Vegas. Close to the strip, easy to reach.The hotel ells is a quiet hotel since thencasino and te rooms are not in the same building, Also nice swimmingpool and fitness center

allReviews.title: Clean well maintained all over the Property.
allReviews.text: Suites Rooms are very clean very. Employees are friendly. Property is maintain inside and out. If you book Tuscany website is higher rates. And if you order to go. Is a ridiculous 1$ per order. Overall I had lots of fun I would recommend Casino, Restaurants and suites rooms.

allReviews.title: 1000/ 100 experience
allReviews.text: 1000/10 experience .. excelent location and service ..  Ill definitely consider to stay there on my future vegas trips.

allReviews.title: Our Vegas favorite
allReviews.text: We stayed for the weekend. The room was remodeled with a new bed, new couches and are so roomy. Our favorite place to stay in Vegas. The employees are friendly from the players club to the gift shop to the resteraunts. Marilyns breakfast is so good. Bring you appetite as the portions are very big.

allReviews.title: Expect to pay More for HOLD and Resort Fee
allReviews.text: It's a pretty place. I was charged a resort fee when I arrived, and they put a $150.00 hold on your credit card. YOU have to use a major credit card and NOT a debit card!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: great hotel, perfect location just off the strip (15-20 min walk to Bellagio/Caesars). Good size rooms. Good bars etc. nice pool area . just really good value

allReviews.title: Peaceful, elegant hotel with all the amenities you need, central location.
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, a place to retreat when you need a break from the Vegas scene. Quiet well-maintained grounds, lovely pools, friendly staff, good food, spacious well-appointed rooms. I'd recommend it to anyone.

allReviews.title: Very good experience
allReviews.text: The hotel is pretty nice, is clean, has a good coffee shop, mini market shop and restaurants, and its near the Strip, I recommend it.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino my go to place in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites & Casino is the perfect spot when visiting Las Vegas.  It is close enough to all the key spots yet far enough away to insure a quiet time when there for business or pleasure. Reasonably priced clean and spacious suites and excellent dining options.  Great pool area and the workout facility is top notch.  My go to place from now on in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites and Casino provide a comfortable stay full of amenities
allReviews.text: My husband and I booked a short stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino. We chose the hotel based on excellent reviews and the proximity to the Sphere and "The Strip". The Tuscany is within walking distance for us to The Horseshoe (old Bally), the monorail and The Sphere; approximately 1 mile.We ate at two of the restaurants and the food was very good with a friendly wait staff.  The Casino has gaming tables, a Parlay desk and a good selection of slot machines. I would suggest the Casino increase the air filtration system because at times the cigarette smoke smell was heavy.The rest of the property and the rooms did not smell like smoke.Our room had a coffee maker and a mini fridge and sink. There were no dishes or utensils provided.We enjoyed our two night stay and would book here again.

allReviews.title: Another great stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino
allReviews.text: Tuscany is a great property and staff. Only place we stay since we found Tuscany. Great restaurants and great vibe in casino. Wife and I absolutely enjoy Tuscany.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: We stayed at Tuscany for one full week- from the end of August thru first week of September and had a great stay. The rooms were very clean, great size, and well appointed. We spent parts of 2 days by the pool and had great service both days. The casino had all of the games we look for and the walk to the strip was very manageable. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: The best family friendly option in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We spent an excellent week there, very good place in Las Vegas to go with the family, varied food and entertainment options, is about 20 minutes walking to the strip, very close to the dial, allowing you to have a proper rest and at the same time be close to everything, very good pool to spend the summer heat in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Relaxing and Comfortable!
allReviews.text: Went to conference at Tuscany Suites, was so relaxing and comfortable,  We ended up staying an extra five days. Staff was helpful, rooms were clean, quiet, and roomy. Food and Bars, had great food, service and entertainment. Will stay at Tuscany Suites again, due to location, value, service and entertainment. Making for a wonderful trip!!

allReviews.title: Not the best
allReviews.text: The suites advertise kitchen as usable but they refuse to provide ANY utensils, bowls, etc. Nothing. Walls are so thin you can hear people in rooms on all sides and even when the TV volumes are regulated you can hear the TV blaring all night long. The pool and hot tub and fitness center were nice.

allReviews.title: The good and the bad.
allReviews.text: The rooms and location is really great! Check in was slow and late. We couldn't get a room until close to 5 pm. Even with a reservation. The part I hated the most was the casino. It was really smokey, so if you have to do anything in the main building, dinning, conference, etc just know their ventilation is NOT good at all. It just smelled like the entire building was a big astray.

allReviews.title: A great play to stay
allReviews.text: Everything went well. Everything was clean inside and out. All Staff were helpful and Friendly. The Security employees were on point inside and out.

allReviews.title: Good value in general
allReviews.text: Nice enough!Nice pool area. Big rooms with kitchen,  however no utilities and no microwave,  which didn't make the kitchen very usefulVery loud AC in the room that disrupted my sleep. Maybe that's normal. I'm not used to having loud ACs from Europe. Got a turkey burger instead of a veggie one in the restaurant- the waiter told me he was 100% sure it was veggie but still double checked after I had eaten from it and turned out it was turkey. He didn't even apologize but told me- veggie and turkey look the same.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Tuscany
allReviews.text: Beautiful room. Very well maintained and comfortable. The check-in was a little long because there was a lot of people checking in for the conference.

allReviews.title: Great value! All in one location
allReviews.text: Great value for the money. I would stay here again! Everything is in this one location- good food and drinks, a little coffee bottega with great pastries and matcha/ coffee lattes at a decent price. Was surprised at the prices for the value I got for staying here.

allReviews.title: This is the place to stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: This is a great place - BIG rooms and reasonable prices.  Good service.  Love this place and will definitely come back! We ate at Marilyn's twice, for breakfast and lunch, and the food was very good both times.  I like the fact that the rooms are so big and spacious.  They provided 2 complimentary bottles of water every day.  We had a great time!

allReviews.title: All the Stars for Tuscany Suites and Casino!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino is an excellent hotel in Las Vegas at an incredible price. It’s located just a few steps from the Strip, which allows you to enjoy the area while still having a peaceful place to rest. The rooms are very spacious, comfortable, and offer everything you need for a pleasant stay.What I value the most is their customer service, which is truly outstanding. During my stay, I was expecting a package that, due to shipping delays, didn’t arrive on time. The hotel staff took care of helping me and arranged for the package to be returned, a detail that very few hotels would handle, and it shows their real commitment to guests.Between the comfort of the rooms and the quality of the service, I have no doubt in giving them the highest rating. Definitely a hotel I will return to and one I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Great staff and room
allReviews.text: The housekeeping and front desk staff were superb, helpful, friendly.  The accommodation was very nice and clean with lots of space.

allReviews.title: Tuscany is like being at home.
allReviews.text: Tuscany is like going home to your family. Everyone is pleasant, helpful, and they make you feel like family.  It's a small but fun casino.  The rooms are everything and I've stayed on the strip at big hotels, but Tuscany rooms are everything.

allReviews.title: Near; but adjacent to the circus....
allReviews.text: Is the calm before the storm! Great rooms. Hyper clean. Safe. Beautiful grounds. Marilyns is fantastic...if you love to eat moms food!!!! OK, just about!!!Rat Pack is alive.  Pool fantastic. Ambiance. Tuscan, of course. We've been 10-year loyalists wanting to avoid the strip rip-off,  yes but  be close to the fountains!!!

allReviews.title: Staying at Tuscany
allReviews.text: The AC made a chirping sound throughout the night, and when I reported the issue to the front desk, the staff were rude and no action was taken during our stay.

allReviews.title: Just like osmanthus wine.
allReviews.text: This was my second time staying at Tuscany suites.  Just as pleasant as I last remembered.  Had such wonderful experiences both times that I will always book with Tuscany when I go to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay
allReviews.text: We went to Vegas to go to the BSB concert at the Sphere.  The location is perfect.  We were able to walk home instead of getting an Uber which would have taken forever.  Our room was really nice.  It was very large, clean, didn't feel outdated at all.The people at the front desk were wonderful.  We got an early flight into Vegas and were able to checkin early which was great since we got a nap in before going to the concert.We had lunch before we checked in at Marilyn's Cafe.  The food was good and reasonable and really quick.I definitely plan to stay again when we come to Vegas.  And you should too, you won't be disappointed.

allReviews.text: Aggressively Harassed by Security Returning to My Room – Profiling, Humiliation, and Management Retaliation

allReviews.title: Great Value Stay Near the Strip
allReviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel, it was more than I expected for the price we paid. The property was very clean, and the staff was attentive throughout our stay. Our room was spacious, with two full beds, a separate living area, and even a small kitchenette with a sink and mini fridge, which was a nice bonus.While the room could use some updates for a more modern look, it was comfortable and well-kept. If you’re someone who prioritizes comfort and value over luxury, this place is a great choice.The location is about a 10-minute walk from the Strip, which can feel a bit longer in the Vegas heat, but there are bus stops nearby and Uber rides to the Strip averaged around $8, making it very convenient.Overall, I’m very satisfied with my stay and would definitely consider staying here again.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at Tuscany Suites. It is very close to the Strip but without the commotion of the Strip, and it is a really good place to rest after a hard day.

allReviews.text: I finally realized  ''accessable'  is the way to go for this old lady at 88. allReviews.title: Great Hotel!

allReviews.title: Great stay

allReviews.title: Really really great.
allReviews.text: Had a Really great time.  Only ptoblem (:  is that I don't want anyone else to find about this Jewel.   Only kidding.  This the best place I have ever stayed in Las Vegas and I have been coming to LV for over 40 years.

allReviews.title: Oasis in Vegas.
allReviews.text: What a great spot, its like an oasis in the middle of Vegas. Loved the staff the restaurants and the entertainment. Poolside is fantastic.

allReviews.title: Local Gem
allReviews.text: Local Gem conveniently located close to the Strip.  As a solo traveler, I felt safe. The pub & restaurants were very good!!

allReviews.title: hotels in the centre
allReviews.text: The hotel is just a few minutes walk from the main street of Las Vegas, convenient.Very spacious rooms. Inside the hotel there are several bars and restaurants. Recommended

allReviews.title: Great little casino/hotel
allReviews.text: Nice little self-contained casino with excellent pub for beer snobs like me.  Pool is pretty nice too, and not jammed like a strip hotel.  Rooms are clean and huge.  Ellis Island is right around the corner for more gambling and dining options, though that walk is pretty sketchy.

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: The beds were extremely comfortable and the room was very clean and spacious. The shower head wasn't working well, it could be swapped out or have the limescale buildup removed. Besides that, the location was perfect. It is walking distance to the strip, and there was no loud guest keeping us awake. I loved the easiness of parking.

allReviews.title: speed up check-in
allReviews.text: I liked the hotel and the service, but when it came to checking in, it took many hours longer than they had said and we wanted to go out and explore, so we wasted time on that.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: My family has been to Tuscany Suites before to eat at Marilyn's. So it was a great surprise to us that that rest of the property upheld the high standards of Marilyn's. The rooms were spacious and well maintained. The staff was friendly and accommodating. The facilities were very nice and up to date. We availed ourselves of the valet and bell services. We were not disappointed. They both were spectacular. The only gripes we had is the WiFi is pretty non-existent on the property. Oh it is there, it just doesn't work well if at all.  Fortunately we had good phone reception there. The other thing is the valet was almost non-existent after 10pm although the hours stated it was available until midnight. Overall we will be back.

allReviews.title: Happy Solo Traveler
allReviews.text: 1st time at this location. I felt like I was at a resort in Florida with a casino. After a 10 min walk, you're on the Strip. Plenty of food options, very affordable. The room was excellent and spotless.  Pool and fitness center were perfect.  Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Wonderful place to stay!
allReviews.text: Such an amazing place to stay! Rooms are amazingly maintained, and huge for the prices. Never a complaint from either me or my wife. This is always our go-to place to stay. The beds are super comfortable, and I love they have Keurig for the coffee, as I'm obsessed with coffee and need plenty of it throughout the day. The casino isn't super huge, but always has a wide variety of games to play, nonetheless. I also like that it's off-strip, but not too far off that you have to travel to get to the Strip. So location is perfect.

allReviews.title: Good solution out of the chaos of the Strip
allReviews.text: We chose this property to stay off the chaotic Strip, but at the same time reachable with a 15-minute walk.The hotel has a large car park from which you can directly access the various buildings, reception staff available.The room despite being a classic type was very spacious (even the bathroom), clean and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, fantastic beds and good soundproofing with the adjacent rooms.In the structure of course there is a Casino, bars, pizzerias and restaurants of all kinds and some shops.Recommended if you do not want to stay in the midst of confusion.

allReviews.title: Low Accessibility Score, In Disrepair
allReviews.text: The Tuscany is a hotel in disrepair. I went to an event that was hosted at the hotel and was highly disappointed with the quality of the suites themselves but also the “villa” buildings. My friend’s sink in her room’s kitchen area simply fell apart while being used— the faucet randomly just fell off, spraying water everywhere. Multiple people in our group had the AC in their rooms stop working. The elevator in our villa stopped working and there is no way to walk from one floor to another without exiting and re-entering the building. The hotel also has far too few accessible rooms and parking places available, and is laid out in a way that requires a lot of outdoor walking to get anywhere. This is a big problem in the full heat of Las Vegas in the summer, and I don’t recommend this hotel for anyone with a disability of heat sensitivity because of it. My heart rate would spike going from my room to the casino building where the restaurants and ballrooms are.Those services are also only okay. They certainly are nowhere near the quality of other similarly priced places to stay in the area.The Tuscany also advertises being near to The Sphere but it’s almost impossible to get there on foot. It’s “in a good location” but you can’t actually access almost anything from there without getting a car.The pool was the nicest feature of the hotel, but it had far too few chairs for the amount of people using it.

allReviews.title: Great value stop
allReviews.text: We stopped here for 1 night on the way back from the Grand Canyon. Huge room , coffee machine , fridge etc . The pool area was pleasant , comfy sun loungers . We stayed on the strip for 2 night at New York New York and this was a much better experience .

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites is Superb!
allReviews.text: Great place if you like peace and quiet in the midst of the hustle and bustle of Vegas. It is close to everything while remaining cozy and peaceful. I do not like to stay in the major Vegas hotels because I feel claustrophobic (they are so big you can never find your way out), so Tuscany feels perfect for me and the quality of the rooms and services are outstanding.

allReviews.title: Comfortable stay
allReviews.text: Very good experience in the stay But many problems with the charges charged to the credit card until 20 days after you left the hotel did not make the correct charge

allReviews.title: Quiet, family friendly, and cute.
allReviews.text: Family friendly hotel, but pool is small and not heated. It's twenty minutes from the strip. The hotel is separated from the casino, which is great because you're away from the noise. The rooms are spacious, with a couch and small kitchen (doesn't include silverware or dinnerware).

allReviews.title: Loved the Tuscany and will definitely be back
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Tuscany. The rooms were large and clean, it was more affordable and quiet than staying on the strip yet conveniently located. The pool, fitness center and spa were all great and we really enjoyed our massage with Norma. We had other family and friends staying on the property and it was easy to coordinate and find each other in the casino (not too big). The food options on site were great as well. We'll definitely be back on our next Vegas adventure.

allReviews.title: Terrible customer service. Unfriendly staff
allReviews.text: Save yourself trouble and book somewhere else because this hotel would give your room to someone else with no heads up and leave you stranded in the middle of the night.My wife and I booked this hotel for 2 nights. We called 4 hours in advance before arrival, but upon arrival they told us our Deluxe king non-smoking room was no longer available and the only room left is a smoking room that was barely cleaned up before given to us. I let them know that my wife is pregnant, and I would not risk her and the baby's health staying in a room full of smoke when we've booked a non-smoking room. We went back and forth between the room and the front desk to see if we can get any non-smoking room at 2 AM. Not only were the  staff unapologetic, their manager was extremely rude and told us that's how hotels work, and they would overbook and give the room to whoever show up first. They were also unwilling to find another hotels that they may do business or are simply friendly with to help their guest for their mistake. Again, if you are there for any event or concert, save yourself the headache and don't risk scrambling to find a place to sleep in the middle of the night because they do not care about their guests but only their money

allReviews.title: My go-to in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Very clean. Staff is wonderful. Free parking and I don't have to walk a mile to get to my room. Try the coffee shop. Great value!

allReviews.title: Best kept secret
allReviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas!  Budget friendly, extremely clean and roomy. Wonderful staff, easy parking. Great food!  I just booked another stay.  Love this hotel.

allReviews.title: Lovely Suite, Quiet, Good Sleep
allReviews.text: From check-in to checkout, it was a positive experience. I asked for a quiet room and the clerk was very accommodating. We were given a quiet room and were impressed with the kitchenette area with dining table. We had a wall thermostat to regulate the A/C which was wonderful. Exceptional suite with nice decor, clean, upscale furniture & furnishings. The bathroom was beautifully decorated and luxurious. Water pressure was excellent. TV & wifi were great. The mattress and pillows were firm, and we had a good night’s sleep. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Nice experience.
allReviews.text: My wife and I had a nice experience.  We arrived very late after a delayed flight and got checked in quickly.  Our TV was small for such a large room but it was remodeled nicely.  I would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Relaxing for those who are working not on vacation. Recommend
allReviews.text: Always a great place to stay and can recommend to our clients also. Clean and friendly staff. Relaxing and no hassle for those there on business.

allReviews.title: Needs some work
allReviews.text: My spouse and I came for my birthday. Karina Blanco, the assistant manager was pretty short with us at check in. She never said please or thank you to us and talked at us. The shower didn’t have shampoo or soap and it took them two days to figure out how to fill it and the air conditioner sounded like a diesel truck starting. The room was otherwise nice and so was the house keeping staff. Saving grace is the slots were pretty loose and it was fun to be able to keep playing.

allReviews.title: There's no place like our home away from home!
