allReviews.text: This hotel and casino continue to exceed expectations.  After almost 30 years of coming here, she's becoming a home away from home.   We just love to come, play, dine and relax here.  If we do go out, everything is nearby.

allReviews.title: Large, clean rooms - hotel has everything you may need
allReviews.text: Wonderful place to stay. Rooms were huge and everywhere was so clean! We were about a 15 minute walk to both the Strip and the Sphere. It was nice to be away from the craziness of the Strip. It was about a $25 Uber trip to the Fremont Experience. The hotel has everything you may need - don’t even need to leave if you don’t want to. Food and drinks at restaurants were good but be sure to check your bill for a “service” charge - the already added gratuity. Casino was large enough.

allReviews.title: Tuscany for the win
allReviews.text: Officially our new Vegas home base. Staff, amenities, location, casino,,,tough to beat, the whole package is covered at the Tuscany.

allReviews.title: Love the Tuscany
allReviews.text: Great  place to stay and convenient.  I stay each time I am working in LV.  The pillows have improved but they still fill with air and are awkward

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel to stay at!!
allReviews.text: The size of the rooms and having a living area and kitchen area is so nice.   The beds are very comfortable. The grounds are beautiful also!!

allReviews.title: Great Girls Trip
allReviews.text: The staff was so friendly everywhere we went on this property. Book one of the cabana packages, it was very reasonable priced and worth it to guarantee some pool chairs in the sun AND shade all day.

allReviews.title: Great stay, everything I needed and very quiet and chill.
allReviews.text: Loved the room, service, amenities, restaurants, casino service, massage at the spa, pool. I will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Best bang for your buck. What normal Vegas vistors should be looking for.
allReviews.text: Love staying here whenever I'm in Vegas. Rooms are huge, food and drinks are good quality and affordable, while it can be busy with guests around the property its very managed and everyone is respectable no loud groups or children unattended running at your feet. Location is still close to everything. You could walk (Vegas blocks are enormous) Lyft and Uber can get you to your destination quickly and affordably.The pool is perfect and the staff is great.Beds and blackout curtains help you forget what time it is so you can just sleep in for as long as you would like.Again everything is affordable which is hard to find anywhere near the strip or Fremont. Definitely a place where you feel like you get some value for your dollar. Geared towards normal Vegas visitors that made Vegas what it was at it's peak. Casino is a decent size and you don't have to walk through it if you don't want to. Also they still have $5 dollar tables. Pub 365 has good food deals and 365 different beers so don't forget to check in and try a flight! Enjoy your time. I can't wait to be back.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Stay here always now. We had a timeshare just down the street and a half a block closer to the strip, but when we relinquished it, we began staying here. Only wish we had started sooner.

allReviews.title: Favorite place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice quiet Property just far enough off the strip to avoid all the congestion, but close enough to walk to wherever you would like to go. Great pool area. I enjoy the Piazza lounge as well.

allReviews.title: Appreciate the service your team always provides
allReviews.text: Staff was great, we always love staying at your hotel.Needed a room last minute and you all made it easy for us to book and the stay was great.

allReviews.title: good overall stay. i'd go back.
allReviews.text: the rooms are very large which is great for a family of  to spread out. this made the stay worth it for us. the rooms could use a little freshening up. leaky shower covered up with a plastic bag, running toilet, that kind of thing. the hotel is a short uber to the strip but well worth it for the price.

allReviews.title: No reason to stay anywhere else.
allReviews.text: The Tuscany is our go to place to stay when visiting Las Vegas. This was our 3rd stay at the Tuscany in the last 18 months. We choose the Tuscany for many reasons. It’s clean throughout the resort. All the employees are friendly and helpful. The rooms are large and spacious. All the restaurants serve great food and drinks. The pool area is relaxing It’s a short walk to the strip. We’ve already booked for next February.

allReviews.title: Overall it was nice.
allReviews.text: Spent the night at the hotel.  The room was great, the pool was great, the casino is kind of small so I would of thought it would of paid better.

allReviews.title: Tuscany where have you been all my life
allReviews.text: The room was spacious, clean and very nice. The kitchenette was perfect. Just a great experience overall. The casino was not too big which made it feel intimate.

allReviews.title: Great hotel.
allReviews.text: Brilliant holiday atmosphere in spacious rooms and with friendly staff. The fitness studio offered many possibilities. It is very nice that the pool is directly adjacent.Overall it was a very pleasant stay.

allReviews.title: If you smell perfume in your room, you got yourself visitor! 😁
allReviews.text: This is the second time we visited the Tuscany. The room was very comfortable. Nicely decorated. We stayed in the H building that was right behind the pool area, but on the other side. Which I preferred because I didn’t have to hear all the music and people chatting down below. The layout of room was really nice compared to other places I’ve stayed at. It had this old classic Vegas feel to it. My only complaint was that the bathroom toilet fan was super loud.  I honestly don’t think it did much. Weirdest thing about this room was every time we walked through the door we smelled perfume. The smell was only on the inside side of the door. Not in the hallway. It smelled like old lady perfume. The smell would dissipate right after. It didn’t linger at all. It only appeared whenever we came back to the room. I read of  hotels that add a fragrance to their vent system, but there was no vent by the door and we didn’t have the room cleaned at all during our stay. When we checked out, I asked the front desk about fragrance in the ventilation system, she had no idea what I was talking about. I honestly think we were visited by a former visitor or occupant of the room. No weird paranormal activity. Just the smell of perfume. Would I stay here again? Absolutely!

allReviews.title: Thought it was nice
allReviews.text: Room was huge and clean with ample room to sit and stretch out. Bathroom was a decent size. AC worked nicely. Casino was a bit cozier which was nice, not too crazy with people. There were also a good amount of food options available. Service was friendly. Shampoo, conditioner, body soap and moisturizer smelled nice. Overall a good stay. I liked the cozier smaller Vegas resort feel.

allReviews.title: Solid Value and Simple Comforts
allReviews.text: Solid value, great location, and easy in-and-out for exploring the town. If you're into spirits, the lobby bar offers a remarkable variety--everything from cognacs to Amari--far more than you'd expect from your typical hotel bar. The rooms are huge and decently lit (except for the showers). Pro-tip: Ask housekeeping for a "flat pillow" unless you enjoy resting your head on an 8" cloud. (It's fluffy, but a bit too high for some). The Tuscany's four eateries offer a range of dining styles--diner, pub, cafe, and steakhouse. The patty melt at the diner ("Marilyn's") was one of best I've had--simple and perfect with freshly grilled onions and Swiss cheese.

allReviews.title: Great staff made it all super easy and fun
allReviews.text: Everything was terrific, but the warm welcome by every single person on staff who I encountered all week was unsurpassed by anywhere I have ever stayed! Awesome team - give them ALL a raise!Cheers, Michael Albuquerque NM USA

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem That Feels Like Home
allReviews.text: As a former casino employee, I’ve seen the full spectrum of hospitality in Las Vegas, from flashy façades to lackluster follow-through. But Tuscany Suites genuinely surprised me. Tucked just steps off the Strip, it offers a level of care and charm you’d expect from a private resort, not a hotel in the heart of Vegas.I stayed during the BiggerVegas event, and my room was massive, clean, and comfortable, like a personal retreat after a day of poolside chats or late-night adventures. The space felt less like a hotel room and more like a peaceful suite I could actually live in for a while.What really set the tone, though, was the staff. Every person I encountered, from front desk to food service to housekeeping, was genuine, kind, and sincerely helpful. It's rare to see such consistent positive energy, and it made every interaction feel warm and personal. This is the kind of service culture that takes real leadership and team pride to build... and it shows.Now, let’s talk food:☕ Cafe Bottega became my go-to for a quick, delicious bite. Their coffee and sandwiches are better than most trendy cafés you’ll find in town.🍳 Marilyn’s Café delivered classic breakfast comfort with heart and generous portions.🥩 And Bistecca? Phenomenal. The atmosphere was intimate and inviting, and the meal, from appetizers to dessert, was unforgettable.The pool area was another standout: peaceful, uncrowded, and just what you need to decompress. It feels more spa-retreat than Strip chaos.If you're craving a real vacation vibe in Vegas, without sacrificing location, Tuscany Suites is a rare find. It’s the perfect blend of accessibility and serenity, with a staff that truly elevates your stay. I'll definitely be back, and if you're heading to Vegas for any event, this should be at the top of your list.

allReviews.title: terrible reception service
allReviews.text: The person who helped us at check-in was not interested in helping, despite asking us to accommodate us in a room near the pool due to a physical problem, it seems that he did not care and his response was to give us room M220, which made us walk excessively, he showed no empathy, the hotel is really very nice, I can't complain about anyone else, the cleaning people are always willing to help, but my entire experience was an excessive physical effort, thanks to the person who helped us when giving us the room, my overall rating would have been a 9, if they had accommodated us in a room closer to the lobby.

allReviews.title: Disability issues are not being addressed at Tuscany Suites.  Shameful.  I won't be back.
allReviews.text: Tuscany doesn't have any ADA-compliant rooms near the pool and main building.  I requested an accessible room when I booked the reservation several months prior.  I had to check out two days early due to an injury that wouldn't have happened if there were grab bars in the bathroom.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend will be back
allReviews.text: I had a pleasant stay at the Tuscany Hotel.The room was spotless and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and always ready to help. The location is excellent just a short walk from the Vegas Strip. I also really enjoyed the pool, which was clean and relaxing.I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back.

allReviews.title: Business Meeting Stay
allReviews.text: Overall, it was a good stay...business meeting This was my second stay, as i drove up i remembered staying there previously.

allReviews.title: Top-notch hotel
allReviews.text: Top of the top! Love it!Will come again 200%. The staff is very friendly and helpful, the room servese is great, the location-7min by foot from the Flamingo hotel.

allReviews.title: We were made to feel we mattered.  Great staff.  Great food.  100% recommended.
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Tuscany.  I found nothing to complain about.  The rooms and grounds were clean and meticulously maintained.  The staff was quick to engage if we looked uncertain about anything at all.  We were treated like we mattered.  Gotta love that.  And the restaurants are so good we often returned to the comfort of the hotel for meals.

allReviews.title: Great Location, Competitive prices, Professional staff, Amazing rooms.
allReviews.text: Very well located (15 minutes walk from the Las Vegas Strip), the Tuscany hotel offers fully equipped spacious suites in a beautiful environment with great pools and "go the extra mile" style staff services. On top of all this, the rates are more than competitive. My wife and myself come at that hotel since many years and have always been happy with everything it contains.

allReviews.title: Great experience attending for a business conference
allReviews.text: The rooms were HUGE! I was impressed that I saw a lot of security walking the venue (which helped me feel extra safe) and there were many service providers cleaning the lobby and common areas. It was spotless! Loved the pool, rooms, palm trees, everything.

allReviews.title: Worst wifi and check-in process ANYWHERE
allReviews.text: The rooms are huge suites and pretty nice and functional (though a little dated). HOWEVER, their wifi is basically unusable. So slow that we had to use the hotspot on our phones, and we ran out of high-speed hot spot data on our phone plans. That is unacceptable and for that alone we will never, ever stay at your hotel again, and if you need decent wifi, you’d be crazy to stay here.To boot, after waiting for over 1 hour in line to check in, they said their system was down and that I had to check in online. They said there was no other way to check in. They said they had emailed me the check-in link, but I didn’t receive the email. They tried sending it about 5 times over the next 30 minutes. At that point, I gave up and called Hotels.com to ask them to move us to another hotel, and Hotels.com called the Tuscany and after a long time they realized that their front desk people had a typo in the email address that I had just given them. It took me almost 2 hours to finally check in, which is unacceptable. Overall, a very disappointing stay.

allReviews.title: Off strip value and less crowded
allReviews.text: Great off strip option. Walkable to the strip and Linq promenade as well as the Sphere. There’s a 7 11 close by and a liquor store over the road.

allReviews.title: Decent stay
allReviews.text: Overall the suite worked well with the two rooms. The beds were comfy and the living area very nice. It was a noisy stay for us  with the upstairs families that were staying above us. Honestly, we will try a VRBO next time but did like the resort overall other than not getting a good nights sleep. The pool water is cold and the techno music was annoying but hey it was a hot week so we dealt with it. The layout of the resort is vey nice!

allReviews.title: Extremely Disappointed.
allReviews.text: •	Arrived June 20 around 3:30 p.m. – systems were down	•	Waited 2 hours, then told systems were still down	•	Offered a link to register manually, but had to do it myself to get room/key card	•	Mentioned I had a show that evening and needed time to prep	•	Sunday morning: security knocked, told to go to front desk and move due to building renovations (no prior notice)	•	No help offered with relocation – moved from Building J to Building H	•	Later that day, found carpet around AC unit completely soaked – wet my socks	•	Extremely disappointed – never stayed in a hotel with wet carpet like that	•	Front desk was unhelpful, rushed me, didn’t take concerns seriously	•	Still waiting for a call from the property manager

allReviews.title: Accommodating for the most part
allReviews.text: The facility is huge. Vegas is not anywhere I will ever go to again. Vulgar,stinky, nasty in every way ☹️. The Tuscany Sweets is a good place to stay but it would be a great place in any location other than Vegas

allReviews.title: Not terrible but could use some love
allReviews.text: Overall the hotel was fine. It seems to be on the older side and could use a refresh. The mattress and pillows were too hard, in my opinion. The location isn’t directly on the strip, but it is perfect if you’re going to The Sphere (which is why were there).

allReviews.title: Great location but clearly needs to fix issues
allReviews.text: We have grown to love the Tuscany for many years. But in the last 2 times we have stayed there are numerous issues that we feel are making us sway to try another place for our Vegas stay. The check in process is fairly easy, but we have been checked in by Sixto the last could times and its not a great experience. He's very rude, not friendly and has bad customer service. For sure doesn't make you feel like a valued customer or welcomed, which at check in is a bad way to start your stay.The grounds are always very well kept which we love. This time we experienced a bit of a hard time parking at they were doing maintenance on the whole parking lot which we weren't informed of at check in. Once the parking lot had opened up a few days later, while walking through it found numerous screws and nails which made it concerning to park/drive there. There are definitely things that need updating like pool towels and times around the pool, but for the most part its a very clean outdoor resort.They are trying to keep up the rooms the best they can but there are some things that need help as well. We always loved walking into the hallway and it smelling so clean, especially being in Vegas hotel then coming to this hotel to smell how clean it is was great. The last couple times though , that hasn't been the case. It has lost the clean smell which is upsetting. Our room this time was for sure "surfaced cleaned". There was noticeable trash, food and other stuff on the carpet. The curtain had a huge white smear of some sort that was disgusting. The fridge does not get cold at all. The items they leave for the coffee maker such as sugar, where already wet and stained ,clearly not replaced. The pillows are horrible, too fluffy where you cant even sleep with them. The bathroom was again surfaced cleaned which is gross and the most disgusting thing was the bathroom sink drain did not drain. You're brushing you teeth with a sink full of water and gunk and it takes a hour or so to drain. I had to do a full room cleaning for myself before we were able to unpack which sucks but it's a Vegas hotel and who knows what went on before us. So for some peace of mind I cleaned. Last time we stayed our door wouldn't latch at all so we had to wait 2 hours for maintenance to fix it.That's it in a nutshell. We again love the location and atmosphere that Tuscany has but we are going to try other places because there are quite a few issues and most of all we don't feel like valued/welcomed customers.

allReviews.title: Found a gem in Tuscany Suites and Casino in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino was awesome!  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there.  Every staff member we encountered was friendly and accommodating.  They greet you as they walk by, even security.  The rooms are very large and spacious.  The food at the PUB 365 was excellent.  The only complaint I have are the pillows, they are not very soft.  The lay out was  also great, each building was like little villas.

allReviews.title: Spacious Rooms
allReviews.text: We did out annual tour of Vegas eateries and this hotel was the best place to stay at because of its spacious rooms. I highly recommend it!

allReviews.title: Everything you want with none of the price gouging!
allReviews.text: They have become our favorite place to stay! Done with the overpriced, mega resorts on the Strip that take all your energy just to get through the casino and up to your room. Rooms are clean and spacious and the staff is friendly. Located behind the Horseshoe Casino & Hotel it is a short 10 minute walk and you're at the center of the Strip, not to mention the pool is open from 7am-10pm! Beautiful, clean grounds and is now our go to spot!

allReviews.title: Great all around stay and value!
allReviews.text: Excellent all around. Would definitely go back!Nice rooms, great breakfast, friendly and helpful staff and casino crew!

allReviews.title: Hidden fees
allReviews.text: Hidden booking fees and hidden hotel resort fees. I was not told there would be additional booking fees on the Expedia website. The website said the fees you see are what you will pay but at the end of the booking when they charge your credit card you have to pay taxes and other fees. At the hotel is was never mentioned that an additional $47.62 in resort fees and resort taxes would be added to the cost of the room.

allReviews.title: Great location in walking distance to strip
allReviews.text: Great location and beds were comfortable. Room was fairly spacious too. Room service was excellent. Made sure we had clean towels and bedding everyday

allReviews.title: Very happy to stay at the Tuscany had a pleasant stay
allReviews.text: Repeat customers and planning on returning, the staff very attentive and responsive quality of the hotel is top notch offers good amenities to include 2  pools jacuzzi workout room and 3 different eateries

allReviews.title: Bad Experience
allReviews.text: Too many issues with room keys, AC noise,  Had change room, card keys not working properly. Shower not working unless hit the head hard. Just too many issues. Would not recommend.

allReviews.title: Will come again!
allReviews.text: Great hotel. Beds are fine!. Good Pool.  In walking distance of the strip. Nice staff. We stay for 4 nights. Will come again!

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: It was a good stay, we have been coming here for over 10 years. It feels safe and is in a convenient, quiet location off the strip.

allReviews.title: Fun was had by all
allReviews.text: I loved the location, within walking distance of everything! The rooms were clean, and spacious. Woo-hoo for the city that never sleeps.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
allReviews.text: First time stay and was so pleasantly surprised at the quality and customer service. Very CLEAN... from the room to the restaurants to the lobby bathrooms. Stayed here for close proximity to the Sphere but would stay again when in town next time even if it wasn't for that. The room was so spacious, clean, one of the most comfortable hotel beds I've experienced, nice coffee in room. Good food options, really liked the café. I wasn't expecting much from this place, but was shocked in a good way of what a great place it was.

allReviews.title: Recommended!
allReviews.text: Very spacious room with fridge and coffee maker, good value for money. All the hotel staff very friendly. It is located within walking distance of the main boulevard. Free parking is available on site. The hotel has several bars and restaurants where you can eat or drink.

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel, clean,safe with a nice casino.
allReviews.text: Other then the mix up with our room reservations we love this place and always stay here. We live 90 miles away near Laughlin NV with 8 casinos there but enjoy weekend get sways to Vegas. Rooms are always very clean and a nice size. A great value for the money. Parking is easy. We like the coffee shop with seating by the pool. You can find us there enjoying our morning coffee every morning we stay..

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Very comfortable and close to the strip. A little gem in Vegas. The rooms were big and comfortable, just missing a microwave. PUB365 had the best steak and eggs meal after 10pm. The pool was very nice and the grounds were kept clean.

allReviews.title: It is imperative to pay attention to guest experience
allReviews.text: LOVE HAVING COFFEE IN THE ROOM Room size is so welcoming It makes me feel like want to live there Room above us was extremely noisy at nite It was easy to regulate the temperature in the room I enjoy the makeup removers provided in the bathroom The lip for shower door was damaged on missing I nearly ripped my tgum nail backwards Then I tried using a washcloth the 2nd day Did not work I hurt my knuckle Altho reported no repair was made

allReviews.title: Despite front office experience, one of the best vacations
allReviews.text: During my recent stay, I had an uncomfortable experience at the front desk. When it was my turn to be helped, the clerk informed me that an "Anglo lady" would be assisted first, despite the fact that I had been waiting longer and it was clearly my turn. As a Native American guest, I felt dismissed and disrespected by this action. This interaction gave the impression of biased or discriminatory treatment, and it left me feeling unwelcome. I hope the hotel takes this feedback seriously and provides staff with training on cultural sensitivity and equitable service.

allReviews.title: Terrible Experience – Poor Management and Misleading Booking Practices
allReviews.text: Our recent stay at Tuscany Suites & Casino was deeply disappointing and frustrating. We were a group of nine, including senior citizens, and had specifically booked three non-smoking executive studio suites well in advance. Despite our confirmed reservations, we were told upon arrival that the hotel was overbooked for the weekend and the only rooms available were smoking rooms—completely unacceptable, especially with elderly travelers in our group.The problems began even earlier in the day when my cousin and her husband arrived before us. Though the booking was under my name, we added their names to the reservation in advance. Still, the hotel refused to accommodate them, leaving them stranded and without a room until we arrived late at night. Agoda, through whom we booked, tried to resolve the issue but ran into complications because the hotel somehow had our booking under Expedia instead. The lack of coordination and accountability between the property and these platforms was astounding.Communication at the property was virtually nonexistent—housekeeping and reception routinely ignored phone calls, forcing us to physically walk to the front desk for even basic requests like extra towels or toiletries. Despite booking rooms for three guests each, only one room had a proper sofa-cum-bed; the other two had standard sofas that were completely inadequate for sleeping.As compensation, we were offered a measly $20 per room to use at the property's restaurants—a single-use credit that did not come close to covering the inconvenience we faced. Frankly, a gesture like complimentary breakfast for the entire stay would have been far more appropriate and appreciated.While the reception staff were polite, it was clear they had no authority or resources to actually resolve any issues. I would like to recognize Jemini and Victoria for doing what they could, but even their efforts were hamstrung by poor management policies and systemic inefficiencies.This experience was a complete letdown from start to finish. We expected a relaxing and comfortable stay and instead got miscommunication, neglect, and poor service. I do not recommend Tuscany Suites & Casino, especially if you're traveling in a group or with family. There are far more reliable options in Las Vegas that actually honor bookings and value their guests.

allReviews.title: Superior service and value within walking distance of the Strip!
allReviews.text: Excellent value and service. Super clean and well stocked. Free parking and superb room service. It was nice and quiet and I liked that the secondary entrance was closed at night. Security presence was reassuring. Will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Returning guest. Relaxed, fun and great location
allReviews.text: Large clean well appointed rooms, very comfortable bed and amenities. Love the location just off the strip but close enough ,it was no issue getting to attractions. Food and drink at the resort were convenient and fairly price. I always stay here.

allReviews.title: One night on the road.
allReviews.text: The rooms were spacious and clean. The two double beds were a bit smaller than we are used to, but we still slept great. Check-in was a breeze. Just don't take your luggage out of the car until you have your building letter and room number. There are many hotel-like buildings around the pool area, and it is easy to drive to a parking location close to the right building and room. Overall, we had a great stay.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay when going to Sphere
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our stay at Tuscany Suites.  We attended Kenny Chesney at Sphere and it was a nice 18 minute walk which was much better than having to take a rideshare.  Casino was good and property was very nice.  Restaurants in the property were very good also.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas May 2025
allReviews.text: Been going to Las Vegas for 20 years and stayed at this hotel for 13 times. In the early days it was a little gem, however the last two trips we have gone in May and the hotel was turned over to the fans of the group called Dead and Company. If we had known about this we would have not booked in May. It's made our mind up that we will not be returning to this hotel in the future.

allReviews.title: Nice suites but customer service needs improvement at front desk
allReviews.text: This hotel is an off-strip hotel, about a 15 minute walk from it.It is an all suite hotel and the suites are pleasant, with a good sized and comfortable bed, reasonable size bathroom, a sitting area and very basic kitchenette (but that did not even provide any cutlery/crockery or proper drinking glasses. I'm not honestly sure what was the point of having it there as a result).I ate a few times in Marilyn's cafe and the food was good and plentiful , the menu varied and the staff helpful. There are three other eateries within the hotel all of which had good offerings. There is a nice pool with plenty of places to sit around it, and a good variety of live music on many eveningsThe main reason for my low review score is that most of the front desk staff were not at all friendly or particularly helpful on both occasions I stayed there.  On the second occasion, after I complained in the morning about my room being situated next to the water heater which rumbled incessantly all night meaning I did not get much sleep, the lady at the desk simply said I should have asked to change rooms.  Why would I want to change rooms in the middle of the night?  I did not know this was going to be a problem until the night.  In the morning I asked if they could offer any compensation, for example, a complimentary breakfast that morning, and, after consulting with her manager, this was refused.Very poor customer service in my view.

allReviews.title: almost perfect
allReviews.text: I found it a shame that in such a large room the beds were not wider (room with two double beds) .The hotel is very well located, a stone's throw from the strip, which is its advantage. It is also very clean and luxurious in my opinion.I would stay there again without any hesitation.

allReviews.title: The Only Place Toi Stay When Dead and Company Play Sphere
allReviews.text: Big room, nice free pool, and great experience overall. Really the only place to stay for the Dead and Company shows. Between the Shakedown, post and pre shows in Copa and Piazza, and the post show food options, I will be back when Dead and Company returns to the Sphere.

allReviews.title: Everything was absolutely great !
allReviews.text: The beds and pillows were all great, as was every other aspect of the Room. We enjoyed the Patio by the pool for relaxing and catching some sun. The firepit is a beautiful addition to the poolside. Everywhere we visited clean and neat. All personal were friendly and helpful. Already looking forward to our next trip to the Tuscany Suites Hotel and Casino.

allReviews.title: Great location and amenities
allReviews.text: Great location, amenities and staff. We stayed overnite for a show at The Sphere and the location was walkable to the venue, plus a plethora of restaurants in and around the area that you can walk to. Nice pool and grounds. The room was as big as advertised, bed super comfy and the place was spotless.

allReviews.title: Chilled hotel!
allReviews.text: It’s a great hotel with very easy access to your room from the car!Beds are super comfy and great to have a fridge to stock up on juices and fruit for the room!I would say I think the rooms could be decorated or painted just a little brighter as it can feel quite dark but overall the hotel is a little gem with good size rooms.

allReviews.title: Excellent!
allReviews.text: My suite was clean and well stocked (towels, etc.)  I wanted a ground floor suite by the pool and I was told there were none available.  I booked my suite 2 and a half months before my stay, so I was suspicious when they told me the pool view ground floor wasn't available.  I've been staying there for over 10 years and all and all I love it!  I have recommended Tuscany Suites to over 30 people and after their stay, they thanked me and have gone back many times!  Scott Brown

allReviews.title: A hotel that provides FREE parking AND smoking rooms...Yeaa!!
allReviews.text: Liked the fact that parking is next to the building and is FREE, unlike other hotels that even charge guests for parking. Extremely happy that the Tuscany has smoking rooms available for smokers like myself.Nice clean, comfortable suite. Bed and pillows were just right for a good night's sleep.The only complaint I have is that the cocktail bar does not do a "Harvey Wallbanger" Apparently the bar does not stock one of the main ingredients - Galiano - and no one knows why.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel!
allReviews.text: Love everything about this hotel from cleanliness, service, and location.  Location is perfect, not quite in the middle of the strip chaos but close enough to the strip.  About 15 mins away from downtown. Only minor issue I had was trying to get the heater to go on.  AC/Heat unit could possibly be outdated...?  Other than that, everything is great! For sure, my place to stay!

allReviews.title: Excellent service.  Not far off the strip.  In room coffee.
allReviews.text: As an "older" adult, my friend and I found The Tuscany the perfect place to eat, drink, gamble, and sleep, away from the crowds on The Strip.  Their service in all departments is impeccable.  The rooms are spacious, and we LOVED having coffee in our room as opposed to standing in line somewhere on the strip for morning coffee.

allReviews.title: A bad suite
allReviews.text: We stayed in a suite and unfortunately had a terrible experience. The air conditioner leaked badly, soaking the carpet and leaving the entire room damp and musty. The smell was unbearable, especially with kids. Although a technician came to fix the issue, it was never properly resolved. To make matters worse, customer service was unhelpful and dismissive throughout our stay. This really ruined our trip, and we wouldn’t recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: A home away from home
allReviews.text: The Table games are too much money to stay and play and we love Roulette, so we have to go elsewhere.  The staff are helpful and the rooms are great for two or more and it feels like home away from home!  The grounds are kept clean and we always enjoy the nice clean pool/spa.

allReviews.title: a hidden gem of a hotel.
allReviews.text: well, I’m in two minds to write this.Let me explain,I’ve been coming to Las Vegas for over 20 years,I have written thousands of reviews truthfully reflecting hotels and restaurants.I’ve stayed in the best most expensive hotels and their best suites , so this leaves me with a dilemma , do I rate the Tuscany suites properly ? I’ve stayed before and rated it as good,well this time I have to be honest, and I hate to do this as I feel I am going to give away a Las Vegas secret.Anyway,I have to be honest,this is a hidden gem !, as I say I’ve been coming here for 20 odd  years,so this is how you should vacation.Hire a car,this hotel allows you to park…FREE!,Then, go to Walmart,this hotel gives you a full size fridge…FREE.It’s just off strip,but it’s a 10 min walk.The suites have been redecorated,the bathroom has been re tiled , it’s large clean and has an excellent power shower,a separate bath, a separate toilet.In room coffee machine,air conditioning is an older variant but it’s good,the rooms are very large,very clean and the beds are comfortable, it is raining here , my wife asked for an extra blanket, it arrived in minutes!.Now it also offers room service , it’s not 24 hours,but it’s a new experience in this hotel.I was so happy to be back playing blackjack with a human !,the last time I was here it was covid nonsense. The staff are really friendly,the upkeep on this property is seen everyday,painting and the maintenance staff are everywhere,it’s so clean !,the scent of flowers and the chirping birds takes you away from the strip,it’s so nice to see.The pool area has improved, new beds,but still very clean,with staff waiting on you,I am still here and indeed I have been so impressed I have extended my stay until Wednesday,I never do this, as it can get boring, but it’s priced very reasonably, the only downside I see is with me opening the Tuscany suites up to those who will see this review and I won’t get to keep this gem hidden any longer.I always tell the truth woth these reviews ,rarely do you get a bargain hotel with really good level amenities,the fact you can park,then just walk into your room from the street, without walking miles,then cutting through a casino,then waiting on a lift with others going up 40 floors will only mean something to seasoned vegas travellers,I cannot state enough how private these suites are!. I used to think that this hotel was second rate,I am so wrong,I genuinely can’t fault it, ty again for having the upgraded areas, and importantly, humans to play bj with ! What a difference that makes.I will be using the m monroe cafe and the Bistecca restaurant, as I’ve heard very good things, I used the cafe before and the prices are very good, the Italian restaurant is more pricey ,but it’s very highly rated,so I look forward to forward to trying it out.I just wanted to write this review whilst still in the hotel, it’s that good! Congrats to the owners,this has become my favourite!

allReviews.title: Noise is an issue, if that is a concern
allReviews.text: Two major noise issues. Proximity to airport and noise from hall and above floors. Do not expect to get help with selecting a quieter room location in advance. It is pot luck on arrival only. Rooms are suites, but it is one large square room. You can see the door from the bed.

allReviews.title: A great hotel, walking distance from the strip - Recommended
allReviews.text: The hotel is a complex of buildings, like a village, featuring green lawn areas, a pool, and a large, fantastic fitness center. The room was nice, clean, and comfortable. It has a refrigerator, but no microwave oven. The bathroom features a bathtub, a separate shower, and a private restroom with its own door for added privacy. The bed was comfortable, and there was no issue with the room.The front desk staff was great. The location is next to the Tuscany casino, which you have to walk through to get to the restaurant, but it wasn't as smoky as I recalled from the past. The local restaurant was good (services, food, and prices)There's a local cafe and a gift shop with inflated prices, but they were all under one roof, which made staying easy.We walked to the strip, visited the other attractions on foot only, and worked in the room during business hours. The hotel provides a slow Wi-Fi connection, but we had our own equipment.One thing to remember: when you get the room, ensure it is not next to the elevator shaft. You will hear the elevator moving at all hours of the day. This was our room the first night. We requested to change rooms, and the request was fulfilled immediately without any issues.We were there from Monday to Friday, and there were not many people around or in the street. We were told the weekend is a zoo. will definitely revisit this hotel.

allReviews.title: Nice room and place but bar should not have live bands playing loudly until past 3AM
allReviews.text: The resort and casino should absolutely NOT allow bands to play in the bar near the check in area until 315AM in the morning. I was in building H by the pool and could clearly hear that music even with the doors and windows all closed. Other than that the rooms are nice and it is a good value.

allReviews.title: Stay at Tuscany
allReviews.text: Love Smoke Out great time . will be back next year and we always stay before we fly out .Bar service is great food service great 365 great onion rings. pillows in room were a little hard . please continue to host Smoke Out Tuscany does great job !!!1

allReviews.title: My stay at the Tuscany.
allReviews.text: Tuscany is a very nice place to stay. It's clean and well cared for.The room I had was excellent. Had a kitchenette with a fridge, coffee maker, table and chairs, a sofa and arm chair as well. A work desk if needed. It's a very lively place. My only issue was when I arrived my room wasn't quite ready. It was resolved promptly and was pleased with the results.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Great rooms and casino! Everything is super close and comfortable here. The food options are amazing. Also within walking distance of other local spots if you need other options. Honestly i don’t even touch the strip when i come here. Don’t need to

allReviews.title: Best Stay Off the Strip
allReviews.text: Best experience off the strip.   The location is really nice.  20 minute walk to the strip  or a $20 uber to Freemont Street (there were 7 of us).  The place is exceptionally clean.  The grounds were immaculate.  I can't give enough praise to the staff.  Not one bad encounter.  It has everything you need.

allReviews.title: Total perfect with our budget
allReviews.text: This hotel is brilliant for families with a car in the United States. Super lovely pool area where we ended up spending our vegas days. Family with 4 children had a great stay. Short for good food, easy parking. The rooms are huge and easily 6 people in 2 rooms. Definitely here I/we will stay the next time we get to Vegas. Thanks is just the word we said goodbye with.

allReviews.title: Exceptional Service That Felt Like Home
allReviews.text: I would like to highlight the excellent service we received from Andoni during our stay at the hotel. From the moment we arrived, he made us feel at home with his warm, kind, and professional attitude. He was always ready to assist with any questions or requests, making our experience even more enjoyable. His kindness and dedication truly made a difference in our stay. Without a doubt, his attention was one of the main reasons why our time at the hotel was so special. Thank you, Andoni, for making our visit an unforgettable experience!

allReviews.title: Enjoy Tuscany.
allReviews.text: Easy access and free parking. Recently I always staying Tuscany. Two nights or three nights reservation. Casino area is a small  but easy access any place. I love Marilyn Cafe and the coffee Bottega. Next time try bistecca restaurant.Very comfortable stay. I like.

allReviews.title: Tuscany is the best!
allReviews.text: Look no further. The Tuscany is the place to stay. This is my second stay at the Tuscany and I will be returning. I’ve recommended friends and family and have never had a complaint. The GM Grayson is the best. He was very accommodating and truly cared about making this trip memorable. Mission accomplished!! Well done to Grayson and the entire staff.

allReviews.title: A Marvelous Experience
allReviews.text: I had the best night's rest away from home!  Wonderful accommodations and location.  Well-groomed and kept property.  The ease of access to the gym and swimming pools and dining areas added to pleasantness of our experience.  We celebrated our 16th Anniversary and have wonderful memories as a result of the place and treatment received where we stayed.

allReviews.title: Warm a comfortable feeling from check-in to check-out!
allReviews.text: Most amazing relaxed feeling I’ve ever experienced in Vegas. Like a beautiful home away from home!  Really amazing the way the resort accommodated shakedown street and allowed this deep-rooted family a venue to reconnect with our tribe. We will never forget. Thank you!!

allReviews.title: Great for Deadheads
allReviews.text: Hotel went above and beyond to make all the Deadheads feel welcome and comfortable for the Dead & Company shows at the Sphere. Best place in Vegas to stay when seeing Dead & Company! Pool area is nice, bar is fun and the casino is fine if you want to do some gambling. A great time.

allReviews.title: Nice stay downtown with parking
allReviews.text: The hotel is a nice location near the strip but removed a few blocks which is nice and quiet with free parking. The rooms were very comfortable and large with a great shower. Check-in was a breeze too. My only challenge was an elevator that was slow/problematic.

allReviews.title: avoid!!!
allReviews.text: terrible, from smell to wet carpet, leaking faucets, broken toliet, keys not working....terrible. I would never stay here again. Called front desk to switch rooms, was first told no, but finally did switch, next room was no better. AVOID!

allReviews.title: Great weekend at the Tuscany!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany went all out to make our Sphere weekend of shows a true experience.  The room was spacious, clean and had everything we needed including a little refrigerator we could stock ourselves. We loved the music at Bistecca during brunch and the bands playing after our Sphere shows were great.

allReviews.title: Another great stay
allReviews.text: My second year of staying at the Tuscany for Dead & Co shows at the Sphere.   Management and staff are all very welcoming to the crowd and it certainly enhances the overall experience.   The rooms are spacious and very well maintained.  Cleanliness was above average.  And I really appreciate having a coffee maker and refrigerator.  The casino is small by strip standards but it serves the purpose well and the dealers and other staff are very laid back and friendly.  Drink service at the tables was excellent.Can't beat the location for a short walk to the Sphere.   I will certainly return again.

allReviews.title: Great location and good price.
allReviews.text: Hotel is clean and price is reasonable.  Rooms are very spacious with lounge sofa and desk.  Location is very near to the centre of the strip. There are good facilities as well.  However, double bed are rather small. So if you are larger in size, it would be a problem to share the bed.

allReviews.title: Great Value!
allReviews.text: Absolutely! Here’s the updated review with that detail included:⸻Review for Tuscany Suites & CasinoHad a great stay at Tuscany Suites! The hotel has a bit of a dated decor, but everything was very clean and well-maintained. The beds were on the smaller side, but still quite comfortable.The restaurants on-site were a pleasant surprise—delicious food at very reasonable prices. It’s also conveniently located just a short walk from the Strip, which made getting around easy without being in the middle of the chaos.The pool area was another plus—very clean, and we never had trouble finding available lounge chairs, which made relaxing super easy.We did have a minor issue with the toilet breaking, but maintenance came and fixed it right away—really responsive service.One of the highlights of our trip was catching The Rat Pack show in the Copa Room. The small, intimate theater made for a fantastic experience, and the show itself was incredible—definitely a must-see if you’re staying there.Overall, Tuscany Suites offers solid value, great food, a relaxing pool, and a few hidden gems that make it a strong choice for your Vegas stay.

allReviews.title: It was a good time!
allReviews.text: This hotel was decent overall. The room was clean and a reasonable size, though nothing exceptional. Staff were polite but could not help solving my reservation issue! The location was convenient, about 15 minutes from main attractions.

allReviews.title: Staycation!!!
allReviews.text: We loved our staycation. The comps are great!!  There is great music seven days a week in the lounge. If you get a chance have a jumbo martini while listening to the great music, they are wonderful! The suites are very roomy and the bed was comfortable. We will be back.

allReviews.title: Resort fee
allReviews.text: I can't understand that if I checked in at almost 1 AM they charged me the resort fee for the first night. I understand that I have to pay for the room but not for the resort fee. In other hotels they always waive this charge if we arrive after 12. I spoke to the front desk and they said they couldn't do anything about it.

allReviews.title: Great hidden gem in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The property is within walking distance of the Las Vegas Strip. We utilized ride-sharing services on four occasions.  We found the on-site Marilyn's restaurant at the Tuscany Suites & Casino to offer convenient, high-quality meals at reasonable prices. We were unable to dine at Bistecca during our stay. Our guest room was spacious and well-maintained.  Customer Service staff was very friendly and helpful.  The Casino was clean and well-maintained.   We did not utilize the pool area due to the cool weather during our visit.

allReviews.title: Avoid this hotel.
allReviews.text: Terrible stay. 1.  Although booked months ago were stuck in a smoking room which reeked of nicotine   Told the fright staff to please move me into another room they said to come down the next day and it would happen. It did not happen.Absolutely revolting and disgusting 2. When you stay at this dive hole you must  prepay and it’s non refundable ( who does that in 2025) Advise to avoid this hotel if possible

allReviews.title: Satisfied with our stay
allReviews.text: The room is spacious and the front desk very helpful checking us in.  Location  is very convenient, next to a lot of shopping, dinning and entertainments.  Fully stocked amenities. We only stayed for 1 night and everything is awesome! Would stay again for the next trip.

allReviews.title: Comfort and resort feel in a value property close to the strip.
allReviews.text: I can't wait to stay here again. The staff were helpful and that helped me feel welcome. I appreciated the pool area so much in the evening. It was well taken care of and very comfortable. I liked the location because I was able to leave my car throughout my stay.  Food at the café was quick and delicious. Would stay again.

allReviews.title: Go Elswhere
allReviews.text: Don't stay here and think you'll get a room before 5pm. Check in starts at 3pm and can be up to 5pm. Wandered for hours starting at 11am, until my room was ready. Better places that are the same price. Go elsewhere for a better experience. Staff don't want to be bothered helping you either

allReviews.title: Recommended but they need to make one of their buildings dog-friendly.
allReviews.text: Excellent all around, even won some money in the casino.  Good room, decent price, good restaurants.  Set up like an apartment complex with multiple buildings… they should make one dog friendly, if they did that I would make this a destination stay with family, not just on my own for business as this stay was.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem minutes away for the Vegas shrimp
allReviews.text: You are not going to get more for your money anywhere else. The rooms are twice this size of anything on the strip,at a fraction of the cost. There are the food options in, and around the Tuscany. I also have a great spa on site, and a good workout in as well.

allReviews.title: Overall good value for money for me.
allReviews.text: Everything was fine and as expected with good value for money. My only issue was that there was noise from some of the appliances and also from the outside in the morning, probably the gardening team.The kitchen didnt have a microwave initially which is crucial for me because of medical reasons. I asked for one and got it very quickly but it was not in the best condition and a bit banged up and tilting forward. did the work.

allReviews.title: Plan to book here again.
allReviews.text: The casino is in a separate building so the air in the residences is fresh.  Its just 2 blocks East from the center of the Strip.  Property well monitored with actual security personal, not just cameras.  Marilyn's Cafe has to-go order desk so you can easily take the food to your room. One negative, no grab bars in the bathrooms to use.  Must be very careful.

allReviews.title: Vegas Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Great hidden gem in Las Vegas. Perfect place to stay for Dead and Co at the sphere. Plenty of music, art, and fellowship if that is what you are looking for. Also, clean and quiet oasis in a large room with kitchenette. Quality food in the Pub and great little coffee shop with pastries and sandwiches.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem off the strip
allReviews.text: Wow…we were very pleased with our only one night stay. All of the staff were friendly and helpful. Will definitely stay here again. A hidden gem just 1000 feet from the strip. Bed was comfortable. Only complaint is that there was no utensils , plates of glassware provided with the kitchenette

allReviews.title: Nice place, bad room service
allReviews.text: It was extremely difficult to get room service on the phone, and once I finally did, the food was cold, served in cheap plastic clamshell containers with grooved bottoms, we had over-medium eggs, most of the yolk was spread across the bottom of the container, unretrievable due to the grooved bottom. There was not an option for real creamer, only the powdered crap. Also, the creamer offered was wrapped in packets with stuff we did not need, a huge waste, we only used the creamer and the rest went into the trash. I called to complain, could not get anyone on the phone so I left a message and my call was not returned. I was pretty upset by the lack of response.

allReviews.title: Absolutely perfect place for Dead & Co shows at The Sphere
allReviews.text: Spacious, clean room with excellent comfortable bedding.  Nice feature having the kitchenette, sofa, and desk.  Very large bathroom.  Pool and poolside bar with live music greatly enhanced our experience.  Excellent location for attending shows at The Sphere as it is only a 17 minute walk.

allReviews.title: Good location, nice hotel for a few days in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: The rooms are very large, the bed was comfortable but I prefer a firmer mattress. The location is good (away from the noise on the strip) but within walking distance of the strip. There was a refrigerator but no microwave. Bathroom is large (separate shower and tub). Restaurants in the hotel are pretty good, less expensive than restaurants on the strip. I didn't use the pool but used the hot tub, which was nice after a long day of walking a lot.

allReviews.title: Great Place To Stay!
allReviews.text: Came to town for shows at the Sphere.  Cab ride was less than $10 Suites were much bigger than expected, Staff were eager to please and totally accommodating!  Coffee shop was open at 2am, Bistecha restaurant was amazing.  Great value for Las Vegas.  Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Such a nice place
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel! Will be back in the future! It was like a little oasis that I didn't even know was there. I like the ground level rooms and the ease of getting where you want to go. I would highly recommend to anyone! Worth every penny to stay here.

allReviews.title: Best value for your money in all of Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms are huge, the bed was super comfortable and the room was very clean.  I think this place is the best value for money in all of Vegas.   I will definetly be staying there again.  Its also a very quick walk to Sphere and the rest of the strip.  Best place to stay if you are going to see Dead and Company as Shakedown Street is there as well

allReviews.title: Executive Suite
allReviews.text: We were very impressed by the room at the Tuscany. It is off the strip and we were pleasantly surprised by how nice it was.  It was easy to check in and everyone we spoke to was very kind.  We also ate at Bistecca at the Shakedown brunch and the food was delicious, the service was great and the music was very nice. We really enjoyed our staycation!

allReviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas, especially if your going to the Sphere.
allReviews.text: I've been back to the Tuscany 3 separate times and being a very picky clean-freak it's always went past my expectations. The front desk staff are always helpful, cheery and efficient. The rooms are spotless! I mean I'm never very comfortable away from home, but I sleep like a baby at the Tuscany. The rooms and bathrooms are just spotless. Room's are massive, beds are very comfortable, air conditioning, even in 120f are cool. WiFi is good. They don't charge you for putting your own things in the fridge like other tiny roomed places do in Vegas. Staff is as chill and nice as they can be. I would sit outside the  pool for hours just enjoying the people and area. Restaurants are good and well priced. I iwll be coming back in May, would never stay anywhere else.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay!
allReviews.text: Had the most amazing stay.  Hotel was fabulous and staff was kind and courteous. Rooms were A+ so clean huge and shower pressure was so strong.  Room service fast and tasty.  Even had gluten free bread options.  Can’t wait to stay again!  Room was amazingly priced.

allReviews.title: Prefer Tuscany over Strip Hotels, better value overall! And quiet break from strip!
allReviews.text: Stayed a few times, overall would stay again for the more calm pace than the strip (it's 2 blocks away from The Horseshoe and walking distance to the Sphere). It's older, but spacious room & bathroom with separate tub and shower. Kitchen area with mini fridge and K-cup style coffee machine with pods. Free parking. 2 pools, 2 hot tubs (main one and gym area one). 3 restaurant choices and 1 cafe/coffee shop Bottega, but we only ate at Marilyn's and Bottega (all day breakfast, large menu, better value portions and prices), and Bottega is coffee shop with paninis, salads, smoothies (can sit outside by pool here). Service at Marilyn's was either fantastic, or not. Many servers looked very unhappy and ignored us. Others were lovely. Bottega service was good, shout out to Michelle. The bathroom fan and A/C units are loud. Street noise in room was loud, but we asked for top floor with Sphere and Link view. Couldn't hear other rooms. Beds were firm, pillows were not the best but ok. Never used the casino. Cute gift shop. We enjoyed the smaller resort size here, lower price, and multiple buildings for rooms that were only 3 floors high so could take the stairs. Elevators were fine however. Will return considering the better value in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Grateful Dead Fun!
allReviews.text: I loved that he bars had incredible live bands Grateful Dead cover bands like Catfish John, all day & night & the Shakedown outside Parking lot with the bands &  Grateful Dead vendors was amazing too! That's what would make me return. Lots of cab service to the Sphere.

allReviews.title: Above Average Stay!
allReviews.text: Very good. Had some issues. Shower head and valve broke but were fixed in timely manner. We requested a microwave first day. We weren’t able to get till 3rd day. Staff for most part courteous and professional. Rooms are large, outside grounds very clean.

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Would definitely stay here again. Off the strip but very close enough to walk to the strip. Beautiful grounds. Make sure your poolview though is not in front of the cabanas. They were amenable to crediting us for that since we paid extra for that and they didn't have another poolview room available. Three great restaurants on-site and nightly entertainment.

allReviews.title: Would stay again and again
allReviews.text: We have stayed here multiple times and it’s always great! Off the strip, clean, secure, and very convenient with free parking. The pools are well maintained, the coffee bar is convenient and well priced, and the happy hour martinis are awesome!

allReviews.title: Great alternative to the big strip casinos
allReviews.text: Excellent experience.  I will definitely stay here again.  Much better than the big strip casinos.  Wonderful service and very convenient.  The location is great close enough to the strip for easy access but just far enough away to avoid the crowds and congestion.

allReviews.title: Extreme highs and lows with overall room and dining experiences.
allReviews.text: First room we checked into wasn't ready... looked like cleaning crew left in the middle of cleaning (bed wasn't made, trash cans were out with no bags, toiletries hadn't been restocked). 2nd room we were moved to, the entire front of the AC unit had fallen off and was on the floor. We dined at Bistecca and the food was amazing but the service after we received our entrees was horrible and disrespectful so it ruined the dining experience.

allReviews.title: Not good…
allReviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for five days in March 2025. It's two blocks south of the strip, the hotel itself is very quiet, you can't hear any neighbors showering and there's no car traffic in block D where we stayed. What sucks, though, is that on the first day the fire alarm went off because workmen weren't doing something properly, so I had to get out of the shower and leave the building. On the second day, the water pump near the ice machine was so loud that we could only sleep with earplugs. Hearing protection is recommended anyway, the airport is close by and the planes fly late into the night. The cleanliness was very good, but the air conditioning is a disaster, very old and insanely loud. All in all, we would not stay here again.

allReviews.title: Relaxing quick vacation looking for sun and hoping to avoid the drunk and young crowd
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and clean pool without a throng of drunk 20 somethings you get on the strip. It is close, but just far enough away to avoid the crazy. I liked how you did not have to walk through a casino in your bathing suit to enjoy the pool. The size of the complex is much more enjoyable than the mega places on the strip. I'd like better room coffee- but coffee shop is open early and the price of a latte is the same as at home... as opposed to the big hotels on the strip where a Starbucks is in the teens.

allReviews.title: Definitive Hotel for Dead Sphere shows..location great, festival atmosphere, positive vibes, big enough but not huge.
allReviews.text: Definitive Hotel for Dead Sphere shows..location great, festival atmosphere, positive vibes, big enough but not huge.

allReviews.title: Solo 4 day vacation
allReviews.text: I love this hotel and stay there every time I go to Las Vegas. The rooms are suite size and clean. Marilyn’s restaurant has great affordable food. The drinks are good there too. Great service all the way through from the front desk to bar to restaurant

allReviews.title: Many better places to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: We had a terrible time with the front desk at Tuscany. The clerks were rude and unhelpful. We requested to speak with the manager and was told no one was available. After numerous further requests a manager appeared wearing a mask. We told him our problem and his reply was completely muffled because of the mask he would not remove. Unbelievable. If you want to have a horrible Vegas vacation be sure to stay at Tuscany.

allReviews.title: Elevator broken, old rooms, could LOUDLY hear every step taken in the room above us, bellman takes forever,
allReviews.text: Elevator broken, old rooms, could LOUDLY hear every step taken in the room above us, bellman takes forever,

allReviews.title: Beware! Lounge adds 22%to any purchase.
allReviews.text: This is more informational , although it's probably an obvious thing to locals. I would like to bring awareness to the bar lounge in the lobby area. It's a great atmosphere but be aware that when ordering drinks they automatically add 22%!!!! to the total for gratuity.... In my case I didn't receive a receipt just told the total and with the crowd I just paid and tipped (I use cash) . On the second round I was told  total and paid again with cash tip and got a receipt. When I looked at the receipt later I noticed the disrespect and fleecing of the customer by the management policy. I am aware this policy is used in situations with large groups but didn't not know it was used when walking to the bar and getting three drinks.  Viva Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Hidden gem off strip
allReviews.text: Hidden gem just a 15 minute walk to the strip. Location was fine and away from hustle bustle of Vegas. Sweet young lady works at check in. Restaurant (Steak/Italian) looked and smelled fabulous, wish I had one more night to test it. Heard great things about it. Hotel was clean and set up like a small campus, neatly landscaped. Room is spacious with table, desk and fridge. No frills but has exactly what is needed and clean. Walk between buildings was short and manicured greens are pretty. Coffee shop has large selection of drinks, snax and breakfast / lunch items.

allReviews.title: Always beautiful!
allReviews.text: We returned to this hotel after our first time in April 2017. Room H207, huge, spotless and with comfortable bed. Even the rest of the structure is kept in a manic way with maximum cleaning, paths with flowers everywhere, garden and pool really well cared for and clean. Friendly and helpful staff! All at a fair price, about $170 a night. Go there, although not located right on the Strip but about 500 meters.

allReviews.title: One out of TEN REVIEW
allReviews.text: Changed for the WORSE!  Fewer games that have no payoff. And the FOOD is not worth a review.    Have had good experiences for past 10-12 years but will not go back. No positive reason to return.  Room has been the same for past 10-12 years and  past three years the play and food has not been anything to talk positive about.  Marilyn’s is actually AWFUL!  So DISAPPOINTING.

allReviews.title: Beware of cancelling
allReviews.text: I have stayed here many times and always loved it. However had booked a upcoming trip here and person I am with didn’t think she could go.  Within minutes of cancelling I called and tried to reinstate, and they would not work with me.  I could rebook , but still will be charged for the cancelled room full price. I tried to reach out to a manager and was told to send email.  This was not even acknowledged one way or another.  Very poor customer service, as I was not lookin for a refund, just the room back.

allReviews.title: Good for Tourists, Not Great for Meetings & Events
allReviews.text: Property is beautiful, rooms are very large but unexceptional in terms of the decor and quality of the furnishings, and the location is outside the strip but only a mile away. Staff is very friendly and accommodating. However, if you're planning to host a meeting or event there, be prepared to have a frustrating experience in terms of responsiveness and accuracy of the information you receive.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend. Great priceoff strip relaxed atmosphere. Lounge with nightly bands, restaurants, casino, 15 minute walk to Ven
allReviews.text: Highly recommend. Great priceoff strip relaxed atmosphere. Lounge with nightly bands, restaurants, casino, 15 minute walk to Ven

allReviews.title: Lovely Property/Great price
allReviews.text: This is a lovely, well kept property at a great price. Within walking distance of the strip as well as other attractions, such as the Sphere. There are several restaurants on site with good food and some nice specials. The onsite casino is on the small side, but a nice, quiet reprieve from the bigger casinos on the strip.

allReviews.title: Worth the stay for 4 nights!
allReviews.text: Spacious, clean rooms with lots of space to spread out.10 minute walk to the strip, this really felt like an oasis just away from the mayhem and cattle herds .....Didn't have a chance to use the pool, but all other facilities were just a i had hoped for .....

allReviews.title: do not check in to your room early
allReviews.text: I drove to Vegas and arrived early, around 11:00 AM. Before heading to the hotel, I called the front desk at 10:30 AM to check if there were any available rooms for an early check-in. However, the woman on the phone refused to provide room availability and said I needed to speak to the front desk in person.When I arrived at the hotel, the front desk agent was able to expedite a room for me at 11:00 AM and mentioned it would be ready around 1:30 PM. In the meantime, I left the hotel and went to have lunch with my family.We returned around 1:30 PM, only to find out the room still wasn’t ready. The agent called housekeeping to rush the preparation for a second time. While waiting in the lobby for over an hour, I noticed other guests checking into their rooms.Around 2:30 PM, I spoke with the same front desk agent, who reminded me that the regular check-in time was 3:00 PM and promised to notify me once the room was ready. It wasn’t until 3:30 PM, after I approached the desk again, that I was informed the room was finally ready.I wish they had provided this information over the phone initially, so I wouldn’t have wasted the entire day waiting for my room.

allReviews.title: Great first stay at Tuscany
allReviews.text: The executive suite was so spacious, very clean and well maintained. I didn’t care much for the view of the room. AC was a little wonky sometimes but overall we were very comfortable with our stay. Coming back to a hotel like this was refreshing after the busy night life of the strip. The location itself was perfect for us as we were attending a concert at the Sphere. The sphere was about a 15-20min walk from the hotel. Walking to the strip was doable but Lyft/Uber was preferred because it was an easy pick-up/drop off process. I stayed on the strip before and getting a ride was chaotic. I will definitely recommend this place and would stay here again as the deal we got for a non-smoking room was great.

allReviews.title: Comfy without the Hassle of Hotel Life!
allReviews.text: Our family has stayed at Tuscany Suites for the last 15 years.  The suites are a great size.  The only drawback is the pool area; the pool is not big enough to accommodate patrons staying at the Hotel. Marilyn's Cafe has a great breakfast.  We'll be back in 2025!

allReviews.title: Relax in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent resort, just a 10/15-minute walk from the Strip.Very peaceful and set in a relaxing environment, with truly spacious and well-maintained rooms.The resort is well-kept, and the staff is friendly and professional.Perfect for those looking for something quieter compared to the massive resorts on the Strip.I would gladly return!

allReviews.title: Great Value
allReviews.text: If you’re looking for a hotel that’s near the strip, that treats their staff well,  and has everything you need in one place, You have it at the Tuscany. We have been staying there for 10 years and have never been disappointed. We love the lounge acts, The restaurants, and the slot machines, and especially the old school machines.

allReviews.title: We love Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: We always enjoy staying there. It feels very civilized compared to the craziness of other hotels on the strip. The suites are very spacious and the employees always are friendly not trying to rush you. Check-in was a piece of cake. See you next time!

allReviews.title: Tuscany is No Ka `Oi !
allReviews.text: We love the intimate setting, from the arrangement of the rooms, to the casino and restaurants, and the lounge with live music. Parking is easy and available. We love Tuscany for over 10 years from the first time we discovered this jewel that is off the strip.

allReviews.title: Vegas trip 2024
allReviews.text: What a great find near the Las Vegas strip!  Quiet boutique-like hotel and we enjoyed our stay.  The food, the hotel room and amenities including the entertainment was very nice.  So many places also nearby the Tuscany too.  We will definitely come back when we visit Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Great off strip hotel.
allReviews.text: Big room, well kept, and clean. Grounds are beautiful. Marylyn’s restaurant was very good and good value. 18 minute walk to Sphere. Only issue was we requested a microwave and after confirming they had one available and would bring it we never received it.

allReviews.title: Why stay Anywhere Else.
allReviews.text: This is our third consecutive year for staying at Tuscany.  Love  everything about it…location cleanliness spacious rooms very comfortable beds the fact there is a mini kitchen area with mini fridge however no microwave coffee in room good food coffee bar in resort. It has become our go to accommodation when in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Grounds are the best.
allReviews.text: The grounds are beautiful.   The mattresses are harder than a 2x2.  The pillows are flat and not comfortable.   Our bathroom light flickered, the shower dripped for hours after using.  The carpet is frayed.  The toilet ran.  There is a mini fridge, no microwave, limited tv channels.

allReviews.title: No Pool View in Pool View Rooms
allReviews.text: We were upgraded toa pool view room that hadno pool view. The cabanas around the pool obstruct the view. This was highly disappointing in addition to never receiveing the microwave we were promised. This was highly disappointing when they charged us for an upgrade.

allReviews.title: Very Dissapointing Stay at the Tuscany
allReviews.text: My room was broken into on my first day at the Tuscany. Multiple items were stolen, including cash. The issue was raised with the security desk, and I was assured that it would be reviewed within 48 hours. When I left the hotel 8 days later, they still had not addressed the theft, and instead gave me a new excuse and contact each time I checked in with the security team. Extremely disappointed with the lack of urgency or care on the part of the Tuscany team. If you stay here, do yourself a favor and leave your DO NOT DISTURB sign up at all times, use your safe, and do not leave anything valuable in your room.

allReviews.title: Perfect Choice!!
allReviews.text: Great place to stay off of the strip and yet easily walkable to the Sphere. Suites are large and spacious, plush and comfortable. Spotless! Nice furnishings, nice decor and good amenities. Reasonably priced! Pretty grounds with a gorgeous pool and patio.

allReviews.title: Has gone down hill
allReviews.text: We have stayed at this resort several times but this will likely be our last time. Service was not great, parking lot was over filled and we were not accommodated. We could not reach the front desk from our our. Our toilet was not working and our room was not ready upon check-in. It felt like we were in a motel-6 with Bellagio pricing. We were not pleased.

allReviews.title: Spacious room but beware that bed sizes are King and Double
allReviews.text: The rooms are spacious and wide so we did not feel cramped but could spread out. The beds are comfortable but we did not realize that the two beds in our room are only Doubles, not Queen size, so that was a bit uncomfortable. The bathroom looked very nice but the lighting wasn't very bright for putting on makeup. The separate shower enclosure had excellent shower pressure and wide range of temperature but the shower head was installed very high and its aim was not adjustable, so a shorter person like me was constantly being sprayed with water on the chest bouncing up onto my face with no where to move. It was nice to have a separate door for the toilet so someone else could use the sink.

allReviews.title: Economical, Luxurious can get better
allReviews.text: We landed up at Tuscany finding that Agoda giofed our booking and we do not have one. We could find an alternate room quickly and parked in in a large 700+ sft room.  Equipped with REfregerotor, Kithennete, Dining table and large bathrooms.  Its is Luxurious at a fraction price.It is walking distance from Bellagio and Horse shoe and the Sphere. 15 min on each sode so if you are ok to saunter a little just go for it.  They downside was that their ice machines were not working anywhere andf t get water to drink you need to go to the Restaurant as they found it difficult to fix water machines.  Sometimes hotels feel if you do not do something quaint, youa re not a hotel.  Hope they fix thisWe may have encountered bed bugs as i had a swollen skin above my temple in the morning. Despite may still peek in this place if I visit again.

allReviews.title: Girls trip.
allReviews.text: Conviently located near the airport. The only thing i would recommend is having shutte service since you are only several minutes away from the airport. I think shuttle service to and from wity a fee would be a nice added bonus for your guest.

allReviews.title: Bed sheets were not very clean.
allReviews.text: The location was perfect, close to the strip. I've stayed in this hotel a few times. This time I was not fully satisfied with the bed sheets. The first night there were pieces of short hair and the second night after getting back to the hotel and after the room was cleaned, the bed sheet had a dirt on it. Everything else was great otherwise.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem
allReviews.text: This is a hidden gem and I doubt we will stay on the Strip again. We went to the Venetian for dinner but the traffic problems caused by the forthcoming Grand Prix road closures and construction meant getting a taxi was a nightmare. We stayed local the next night and thoroughly enjoyed the music entertainment in the bar. This place is an oasis!

allReviews.title: Never stay anywhere else.
allReviews.text: Close enough to the strip if that's what you are after, but we rarely leave the Tuscany. There are enough activities and venues to satisfy most everyone. The lounges have great entertainment, Ashley Fuller is excellent.Even have free parking with close access to help out challenged walkers!

allReviews.title: A nice hotel with a large room at a value price.
allReviews.text: I chose Tuscany Suites because it was a much better price than the Venetian where I was attending a conference. I knew it would be a bit of a walk, and it took about 25-minutes between the hotels. (The walk was made a bit more inconvenient by the current detours due to the upcoming Formula 1 race.) Tuscany Suites is also close to a Starbucks and a few restaurants without having to go to the strip. The hotel registration staff was professional and efficient. The room was large, well-maintained, and clean. I was disappointed that the air conditioning unit was so loud and you can't have the fan on all the time (only when it's heating or cooling), so I was constantly turning the TV up and down as the AC cycled on and off.
