I could also hear the guest in the room above me walk around (when the AC was off), so the space between the floors is not adequately insulated for sound (either that, or the guy wheighed 350+ pounds). Other than those issues, I did not have any problems with my stay. I did not use the casino, so I have no feedback on that part of the property -- this review is only about the hotel.

allReviews.title: enjoying my Vacation and Quality time with my wife...
allReviews.text: This Place was Quiet and relaxing, and the area was secure and safe... the room was clean and comfort I really enjoyed with my wife, just at the end no microwave in the room but everything was fine, the repair of the parking lots everyone very organized the security, front desk and the house keeping with an excellent customer service.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: Nice Hotel. Good food. Nice bar. Okay Casino.  Not to crowded in November. Fine rooms. Good food. Nice with all the green areas between the buildings. Walking distance to the strip and conference center. Only minus was that I could hear the floor from the upstairs neighbor.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel for a reasonable price
allReviews.text: The property was actually very nice!  Rooms were clean and large sized with room for our kids to hang. Restaurants were tasty, but no 24 hour dining or store option onsite. Casino still offered $5 minimum tables and friendly dealers at the tables.  Conveniently located close to the strip, without being in the middle of it. Rooms were spread out in 3 floor high buildings and grounds were well maintained.

allReviews.title: Reasonable, comfortable and close to the Strip
allReviews.text: We like to come to this off-strip resort for the quality of the rooms and the service, as well as the free parking, the value and the convenience to the strip. Rooms are comfortable, with small (not mini) refrigerator, beds are very comfortable, A/C is loud though. Housekeeping was good. The week of our stay there were a couple of days where they blocked off a part of the parking lot due to preparation for the Grand Prix race so we had to park rather far from our room. On previous stays we had no problems with parking close to our room. We like the dining options, and the gaming is relatively reasonable compared to the casinos on the strip.

allReviews.title: What happened?
allReviews.text: I’m a regular customer but most likely that will end now.  It’s convenient for walking to the Sphere and dinning at Lowry’s.  But,  the shower curtain fell down and cut my wife’s toe.  They put us back in building L, I asked for closer, there was none?  A rat ran across the pool area at night.  The bathroom fans are way too loud.  Lots of stomping in the room above us. Rates were the highest ever and the resort fee is a rip off.

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Las Vegas – Tuscany Casino & Hotel
allReviews.text: If you're looking for a Las Vegas getaway that offers a more intimate, relaxed vibe without sacrificing excitement or convenience, the Tuscany Casino & Hotel is the perfect choice. Nestled just off the beaten path on Flamingo Road, this delightful property combines old-world charm with modern comfort, making it one of the best-kept secrets in the city!The Hotel:From the moment I stepped into the lobby, I knew I had found something special. The hotel’s Mediterranean-inspired design, complete with beautiful arches, warm tile floors, and elegant furnishings, sets a peaceful tone. Check-in was smooth and the front desk staff was friendly and efficient, setting the tone for an easy, stress-free stay.The rooms are spacious, clean, and well-appointed. I stayed in a King Suite, which featured a comfortable bed, a cozy sitting area, and a well-stocked minibar. The bathroom was large and modern with all the amenities you'd expect, plus a great shower with plenty of water pressure. I especially appreciated the attention to detail – plush towels, quality toiletries, and a peaceful atmosphere that made unwinding after a busy day so much easier.

allReviews.title: Best deal for those on a budget!
allReviews.text: Best bang for your buck! Located not far from the strip (within walking distance, really) and quiet enough at night to get a good night's sleep. Beds and pillows left us feeling rested and the room was very spacious and clean. Loved that there was plenty to do without even leaving the property (coffee shops, restaurants, casinos, shops, etc.). My partner and I do not make a ton of money but coming here and staying here left our wallets feeling happy while not stressing about the cost! We would stay here again 100%.

allReviews.title: This Place is Da Bomb!  5 STARS
allReviews.text: Highly recommend!  Huge, clean, beautiful room -  Pub 365 BEST PLACE TO EAT (any meal) and hopefully you'll get Randall the bartender!!  Fish tacos, pub platter, breakfast burritto all fantastic...Pool looked fun too! Love Love Love Tuscany Suites!!!!

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites and Casino is truly a hidden gem just off the strip.  The entire resort is one of the cleanest we've seen, and the staff makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The suites were spacious, the fitness center did its job, and the pool was refreshing. Most importantly, they have gluten free options at the cafe which was a surprise to my wife.  We will be returning soon!

allReviews.title: Huge room
allReviews.text: This was my second stay at the hotel, and it surpassed my first experience. I requested a room close to the main building because of my back issues, and the staff was very accommodating. The room was spacious and the bed incredibly comfortable. The staff was also friendly and helpful. My only minor complaint was an unpleasant smell in a hallway near the bathroom, but I easily avoided it by taking a different route to my room.

allReviews.title: Good location for a good price.
allReviews.text: Friendly employees, big room and a lot of green between the buildings.The buildings are not new, but the maintanance of the buildings is good.Only the beds are too small for sleeping with two people in one bed. Two queensize beds  should make our stay perfect. And one extra chair at the table, would be better, when four people stay in one room.And I think the floors/ceilings are made out of wood, because we could hear the people above our room, walking around in their room.We could not hear the neighbours on the same floor or below us.

allReviews.title: Good choice off The Strip
allReviews.text: I stayed here for a couple nights in October 2024. What's good:- Suites are large, comfortable, and generally quiet. - Staff are helpful and nice- Nice little casino- Dining options are limited but certainly sufficientWhat's not so good:- The walk to The Strip is not the most pleasant stroll you'll ever take- In my room I could hear the person above me whenever they walkedOverall it was a very good stay and I'd stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great quiet secure Hotel stay.
allReviews.text: Just finished our week stay at this vibrant property...excellent staff,clean rooms. We're repeat customers for 20 years. Love Tuscany Suites...close to everything, we walk most everywhere.  The Tuscany is geared to the 50+ clientele. Music from the it's plays throughout the resort. Beautiful grounds to stroke around. Lots of free parking.

allReviews.title: Bait and switch
allReviews.text: I was very excited about staying at the Tuscany and it looked amazing and the promotion sounded wonderful however, as most things are, it was too good to be true. Once we arrived. Our room was completely in adequate. The suite was not at all a suite there was no microwave. There were no utensils no Body wash or liquids in the shower but worst of all is the air conditioner. Unit on the wall was broken and rattled nonstop and was extremely loud, we immediately called the front desk and were told that someone from maintenance would come up when we arrived back later that evening we don’t know if anyone had come or not and at some point during the middle of the night, the front of the unit fell off and crashed to the ground woke us up, scared us to death not to mention every time the unit would kick on. It was so loud it would wake us up. We got no sleep the first night. We also had an awful experience at the restaurant the steakhouse because we were sold a package and we thought we had a credit of $160 to use at the steakhouse however what we were given was a price fixed menu that we had to pay an up charge to get what we wanted and the food was awful. The service was non-existent we ended up not even being able to finish the steak and the fish that we paid extra for. It was very very disappointing and we would have never purchased that head. We known the first night. We got no sleep and had no food. It was absolutely awful. We went down to the front desk the second day and was told that it would be taken care of and they listened and said that we would be in touch with us and then we also were told that we would have a 20% discount off of our bar visits and none of that was applied. Everything was a bit and switch. I was so disappointed and not to mention the fact that I have told the story to at least five people managers included and not one person has ever gotten back to me. I also said please do not charge me until I can speak with somebody because I feel like we are overcharged and no one has ever gotten back to me and I was charged more than I thought that we should’ve been very very disappointed. We had planned on staying when we come back in January because we love the location we love to set up, but now after the way we were treated I am so frustrated that we will not be back unless this is taken care of.

allReviews.title: Quiet location yet near busy Strip
allReviews.text: Deliberately chose not to stay on the Strip for once, and that went well. No fuss to lose your car, no search for where the hotel reception is located in a mega large casino, but well-organized, atmospheric, and very large rooms that were exceptionally well cleaned. We were in a block in front and found the view of the Sphere very funny!

allReviews.title: OK but a few Problems
allReviews.text: Tuscany is spread out over quite a chunk of land. I was in building M and it was a LONG walk to the main building. Do know that this resort is spread over many buildings, not under one roof. The room safe did not work, I had to call someone to fix it. As I waited for the repairman, who was prompt and did a good job, a person burst into my room (glad I was there). The desk assigned her to my room in error. Not a good thing. And this necessitated another call to get new room keys since mine were then canceled by her. The soda machine (only on one floor) was empty the entire time. The room itself was plain but nice, lots of room, good bathroom shower, had a fridge in the main room. Noise factor was good, mostly quiet to sleep. A/C was fine, but old type in the wall and it was noisy. The checkout process was easy and smooth. Food onsite was good but limited to high end and the cafe which had no sandwiches, just burgers, limited other snacks at another food offshoot. Not easy to get a taxi. Not much outside right close at hand since off strip. I found the whole experience just OK.

allReviews.title: Tuscany can't group groups together
allReviews.text: Tuscany failed to group our group together.  We were scattered all over the property.  Happened in previous years so whomever is in control is incompetent or they just don't care.Happened in previous years so whomever is in control is incompetent or they just don't care.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: I have lost track now of the number of times I've stayed at this hotel because I've stayed there every time I have gone to Las Vegas.  I've stayed in other hotels on the Strip over the years, and we didn't like them as much we have liked as the Tuscany.  What I especially like about the Tuscany is its location.  It's just a short walk from the Strip, and is basically located behind Bally's (rebranded as the Horseshoe in December, 2022).  Normally, this hotel is on the quieter side, being away from the hectic Strip area.  I also like the garden landscaping and outdoor areas.  Outside of the hotel lobby area are a couple of fire pits that lend a cozy environment to the evening. The pool is a good-sized one, as is the hot tub.  Beautiful trees, shrubs, and flowers make me feel as if I am in a garden rather than in a large city like Las Vegas. The room we stay in is quite large--much larger than the Strip rooms I've stayed in--with a mini-kitchen, refrigerator, coffee maker, table and chairs, sofa with coffee table, large bathroom with both step-in shower and tub, and a king-sized bed. There is no microwave oven, for some reason. To make the experience even better is that we don't have to walk through a huge and crowded casino like in the Strip hotels to get to our room. There are three-story buildings from A-M, with the A, B buildings being closest to Flamingo Road, and the check-in building with casino and restaurants. For security, guests have to use a key card to enter the building where they are staying.  Almost everything we encountered on the property from the outdoors areas to the guest room was well maintained and seemed like first class. Dining is reasonably priced at the hotel's Marilyn's Cafe.  Portion sizes are very large and service is excellent.  Our efficient waiters Marcelo and Herman had a good sense of humor.  We ate breakfast there and had dinner there, also.  They offer specials of the day seven days of the week. We enjoyed the food they served there. I have just a couple of complaints. One is the bill, which was incorrectly detailed when I booked online.  The price that it said I still owed after paying a deposit was less than what my actual check-out bill was.  I approached the guy at the front desk and asked him about it, and he said the amount that I paid for deposit was correct. I just needed to check my credit card bill.  I think he was right, but I also pointed out to him that their online booking service needs to be corrected to reflect what a guest actually owes when checking out.  My second complaint was the elevator in the M building where we stayed.  We were on the third floor, and on our first day there we could not get the elevator to come to the third floor, even after pressing the 1 button multiple times.  We walked down to the second floor and saw the elevator just sitting there with an open door.  There was a child standing there, so I thought maybe he was playing with the elevator.  I reported this.  Yesterday, we got into the elevator on the first floor to go up to the third floor and the elevator would not move. We punched the button a few times and it didn't move.  I called the office, because there was no way to get to the third floor.  The stairways are set up so that they are only accessible for going downstairs during fire emergencies.  This is a bad setup, in my mind.  How can guests get to their upper-floor rooms when the elevator isn't working? While I was talking on the phone with the person at the front desk, the elevator suddenly began to work.  I mentioned this problem to the front desk guy when I was checking out, also. I am glad the elevator began to work, because we didn't feel like carrying our heavy suitcases down three flights of stairs. In spite of this glitch with the elevator this time, I will give the hotel a 5.  I know this was an unusual occurrence.

allReviews.title: First Time LV
allReviews.text: Got there late evening. Did the Pre check in ( recommemded & easy) got a requested room. Very spacious room, nice. Beds are soft and fluffy. Grounds are calm and serene.  AC worked great ( it was scorching hot in early oct) front desk ppl are pleasant, Eden is a doll. Loads of security personal, very safe!  Tuscany is a 10 min walk to central strip, not bad. My only complaint:  in the bavk parking lot, a current infrastructure project goin on,  small bulldozer woke me up at 4:30 am. Theyre breaking up concrete in back parking lot.  Front desk should do a better job of telling hotel guests. Im sure it will be much better when project is complete.PRO TIP: ASK for a inner courtyard view to avoid construction noise

allReviews.title: You Will Love Staying At Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Tuscany Suites. I have stayed here 3 times now and still think it's great. I enjoy Tuscany because everything is on the property, there is fine dining, a casino and a wonderful pool areas to kick back and relax.

allReviews.title: Van broken into
allReviews.text: One night to visit relatives.  Over $2,000 of items were stolen from our van and there were no security cameras.  Hotel staff was less than helpful.  The LVPD were great, however.  Decent hotel otherwise but nothing special, including food.  AC in the room was super loud.  Getting a cocktail waitress in the casino was impossible. Probably better suited to a party crowd.

allReviews.title: Good hotel in a great location with amazing staff
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our time at Tuscany Suites.The location was peaceful and a ten minute walk from the strip. The food at Marilyn’s and Bar 365 was excellent and good value for money, as were the numerous beers on offer. The staff in 365 were so friendly, recognised us and even remembered which was our favourite beer. Thank you, especially the lovely lady from Chicago.The room was large and comfortable and cleaned regularly with good a/c.The only negative we had was that the main pool had music blaring out all day from ten in the morning, which was excessive and prevented us from using it. There was no way you could sit quietly and read a book. The hotel should rethink this in order to accommodate ALL their customers needs. We discovered too late that there was a lane swimming pool which we could have used also, however I don’t know if that had music as well. Perhaps this could be made clear to customers when they check-in.Overall a good hotel in a great location with great staff.

allReviews.title: I’d like to come back.
allReviews.text: Beautiful, welcoming, calm and relaxing hotel, close to the STRIP and the SPHERE.Too bad there are no dishes and microwave oven. Andthe slightly old furniture needs to be changed.But, I would probably stay at this hotel again. Thanks to the hotel staff.

allReviews.title: Great holiday
allReviews.text: Room was good ,beds very comfortable.|10 mins taxi from airport. |10 min walk to the strip. |Casino was good ...Would recommend  Tuscany Suites.   Very clean inside and out. Staff very friendly  ,nothing too much trouble Air con was very much needed.

allReviews.title: Amazing Convention Experience at Tuscany
allReviews.text: We were at Tuscany for a convention. Staff is very helpful. Rooms are spacious and comfortable.  Food at Marilyn's, Pub 365 and at catered events at the hotel was amazing.  Very tasty, reasonably priced, and lots of choices.  The convention rooms were right off the elevator, which was very convenient.

allReviews.title: Wanted nice off the strip and we got it!
allReviews.text: Always nice to stay in nice big suites.  King bed was way comfy. They must have been doing some maintenance on our floor because there wasn't an ice machine. no big deal. love the pool with all the big palm trees. Some expensive hotels have giant pools but not one palm tree. WT? Friendly staff, easy to get around, restaurants were ALL good. The Rat Pack show was great.

allReviews.title: good base for Las Vegas
allReviews.text: A great base for Las Vegas. Nice and close to the Strip. Just a minute or 5 walk to dive into the bustle of the city. The hotel is spread over several buildings.  It's a pretty big complex. The room was spacious, and quiet. The only downside to the room was the constant rumble of the air conditioning. Turning off was not an option, as the outside temp was well above 40c. If you have rented a car, you have no trouble parking it at this hotel. Furthermore, we thought it was a great hotel where you could spend the day at the pool, or take a chance in the own casino. Plenty of opportunities to eat and drink. Not cheap, but it's not cheap anywhere in Vegas.

allReviews.title: HIGH ALERT AT THE TUSCANY?!
allReviews.text: For those of you thinking of visiting The Tuscany Casino in Las Vegas, they are on high-alert for .   .     .  something.Talk about paranoia, I will relate my recent visit there:  On July 28, 2024, I entered the front door of the casino, where I was immediately confronted by security and treated like a criminal suspect (I had no prior history with security there).  They wanted to inspect my backpack for no good reason.  I was simply attending the coin show there so had valuable coins and personal items I didn't want 'inspected'.  I asked the guard if he also checked purses and he admitted "No".  I pointed out that whatever he was looking for could easily be hidden in a purse as well so it's pointless to check one and not the other.  I also pointed out that people are walking around with luggage and bags as well that aren't being examined.  The logic was too deep for him, so he stubbornly insisted.  So I finally said "Ok, I'll just go back to my car and empty my backpack and put the contents into my pants and jacket pockets (which they weren't checking btw) at my inconvenience.  When I returned, he then wanted to check my ID!  Why?  So I politely declined and left to find a direct entrance to the coin show where I wouldn't be subject to such treatment.  There was no separate entrance so I started walking to my car to leave.  Then 2 security guards started following me to my car so they could record my license plate and threatened to "trespass" me.  Really?  For what?  For going to my car?  For wanting to go to the coin show?  Keep in mind the following points:1.  At that casino I did not see them check any bags, boxes, luggage or purses, only backpacks as though those are the only devices that can hide anything bad.  That's just plain irrational discrimination.  If they did a complete body/baggage scan (like at the courts and airports), then I could see the utility, but this was just ridiculous harrassment.2.  Anybody with anything 'dangerous' could simply return to their car, and transfer that 'danger' to their jacket pocket and not be searched and achieve whatever nefarious crime they wanted to commit.  Problem solved.3.  No other casino I know engages in such paranoid activity and people enter and roam freely about with their bags, boxes, luggage, purses AND backpacks without incident.4.  I wrote to the Tuscany manager that week and so far haven't received an explanation, apology, or anything (which concedes my point and tells me a lot about their Public Relations).  Just a fair warning what to expect if you decide to visit their 'fun' gambling establishment.

allReviews.title: Great hotel for families
allReviews.text: Smaller hotels than the huge hotels on the Strip. I really appreciated the secluded location compared to the chaotic Strip and the possibility to park the car for free in the structure. The room was huge with two queen beds, just as big the bathroom with shower and tub. Furniture a bit dated but very comfortable room, with also a small kitchenette, table, chairs and sofa with armchair. I loved the pool, few people despite being a hot Saturday in August, very relaxing as well as the hot tub, operable until 22:00 (as opposed to the hotels on the strip that close the pools at 18:00). The distance from the Strip is not excessive, wanting feasible on foot, we used Uber.

allReviews.title: Horrible Service and Maintenance, Clean Rooms
allReviews.text: There was a hole in the floor that I almost tripped on in the middle of the night, how in the world was this room allowed to be sold? That alone was enough for me to never recommend this place. When we informed the front desk they basically just "oh no" and didn't do anything to compensate us or move us.  I felt the staff were useless in helping with any problems we had while there. The TV was set up awkwardly so we had to just watch our shows at max volume which I'm sure was very audible from the other rooms. We asked for extra pillows and blankets but those never arrived. In general everybody but housekeeping seems to be not great at their jobs if what we experienced was the norm at this location.

allReviews.title: Best deal in Las Vegas and I'm a local
allReviews.text: Large suite with coffee and refrigerator.  Couch and chair living room setting.  Dining table. Comfortable clean and very spacious. Great food and friendly knowledgeable staff. No resort fees and parking is free. Location is close to everything.

allReviews.title: Clean and nice!
allReviews.text: Great hotel, very large rooms with two beds, sofa and armchair, kitchen and bathroom with shower and bathtub. It has an outdoor swimming pool in the center of the hotel. Very distracting to find parking under your room block, I was in H block.Near the strip 20/5 minutes walk to get to the Belagio.Free parking!Very friendly staff! Recommendation!

allReviews.title: No hot water
allReviews.text: No hot water in room, could not take shower in morning.  Shady people staying in building, arguing in front of entrance door while smoking and had entrance door propped open.  Seems to be a timeshare or residence where people live.  No security checking the room areas.

allReviews.title: Don't stay at the Tuscany MOTEL - it's not a hotel
allReviews.text: Don’t stay at the Tuscany MOTEL and Casino unless you want a Reno type experience.We’ve been to Vegas dozens of times, and this is the worst property we’ve ever stayed at, the room was atrocious, broken creaking floors all night, constantly being woken up.  One morning, leaf blowers were running directly outside our window at 5 am.We called the morning of arrival saying we would be there @ 11 pm, when we arrived, the King Bed we had reserved was unavailable, at the Tuscany Motel it’s FIRST COME FIRST SERVE, it was like the Seinfeld episode at the car rental counter.  They didn’t even provide a comp drink to make us sleep in separate beds.We do prefer off-strip, but this is not a place I will ever advise anyone to stay at this Motel.  The pool area is fine, the steakhouse is very good, the casino is small and lower limits which suits many, just don’t stay overnight.There were many around the pool and bar that had the same experience and will never be back, don’t be fooled by the low price and the photos.

allReviews.title: Good stay a little bit off the strip for a decent price
allReviews.text: After some years we did stay again in this hotel and we had a great stay.It is located a little bit off the strip but still close by. The rooms are big and clean, the beds are comfy and you get a decent price.Will definitely stay here again when we are back in town.

allReviews.title: Overall a Great Stay
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites & Casino is close to the strip, yet far enough away to be able to relax from the bustle and noise. Our pool view room was spacious and very clean.  The bathroom included both a tub and separate shower.  The tub was nice after walking around for hours on the strip.  The only draw-back (in my opinion) was the cigarette smoke.  While not in the lobby, the casino and outside eating and lounging areas were heavy with the odor.  Otherwise, a very nice stay.

allReviews.title: Leaky tub, no hot water
allReviews.text: No hot water in the shower, just the tub and sink, had to bade in the tub, not comfortable at all, tub was leaking the whole time we were there, reported this to the front desk, but it was like I never did

allReviews.title: Room i301
allReviews.text: Room was not ready on arrival, missing soap in shower , Faucet was broken.,only 1 bar of soap every day. At 3am garage truck noise, 4am receiving products noise, Overall rating should be 1 but everything besides the room was good

allReviews.title: The Best
allReviews.text: The best off the strip hotel in Las Vegas! The staff was very friendly. The hotel rooms were really big. The grounds were very nice. The swimming pool hot tub was very beautiful! And the food there was lovely very delicious. Thank you, Tuscany and Swiz. We stayed there six days and we had a wonderful time. See you guys next year.

allReviews.title: September 2024
allReviews.text: Everything was good. This was my 6th time staying. This time I noticed that we did not have in-room microwaves. Which meant that we could no heat up any doggie bag containers that we brought back. Next time we stay we will get a cheap microwave from Walmart and abandon it when we leave :)  The parked lot perimeter was getting new curbs so it was all roped off. This made parking after sundown a REAL challenge. Final night of our stay we parked so far away that I couldn't find the car and thought it had gotten towed. But I would assume that the work will eventually get done.

allReviews.title: Affordable Conference Location
allReviews.text: This property would be considered ‘off-strip’ however not by much.  Rooms are in different 3-story buildings located around the property with the front desk, lounge (with evening live music), and restaurants available in the main building/entrance.  The suite rooms are newly renovated with a large sofa area.  HDTV was a little on the smaller side…  The premises are clean and well maintained.  There is a standard pool with good size cabanas located in the far corner.  We rented a cabana with the drink package which worked great and included good service.  There is a Starbucks within a couple blocks walking distance.  There is also a popular Karaoke bar – Ellis Island – within a 10-minute walking distance.  This property would be a good option for and location for conferences or high school reunions.

allReviews.title: We love staying here.
allReviews.text: Such a nice place to stay.  So calm and relaxing.  Love the grounds and pool.  Bestecca had fantastic food.  Marilyn's cafe is barely average.  The coffee shop is very convenient and good.  Great breakfast sandwiches.  Only big complaint was that the pool music stayed on til the wee hours of the morning and was disturbing.   Love the free entertainment in the bar too.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Place to Stay
allReviews.text: Tuscany was a beautiful place to stay.  The pool was great and the whole area was well maintained.  The food was delicious.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay in LV, closs the the Strip
allReviews.text: Great resort, 3 blocks from Strip right on Flamingo. 3 great restaurants on site, entertainment, great pool with wonderful bar service and HUGE rooms! Smaller, but still quite busy, Casino.Quiet location a few minute walk to all the noise and excitement of the Strip.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Excellent stay....was there for a conference for 5 nights and everything was 5 star from the pool servers to the check-in staff to the spacious guest suites....the food in all the restaurants and bars are excellent and great value....great location , centrally located just off the strip but an easy and quick walk to the strip and a safe walk at night

allReviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
allReviews.text: We were very pleased with this beautiful hotel. It was peaceful, the food and service was great and we really loved our large comfortable room.  Would definitely recommend.

allReviews.title: Tuscany in Vegas
allReviews.text: Large comfortable rooms with mini-fridge, couch, chair, table/chairs set. 2 beds plus pull-out and desk. Beds on softer side which I prefer. Super large bathroom. Very nice pool area and Caffe Bottega has excellent coffee drinks and great chicken panini. All staff very, very, polite and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay
allReviews.text: Everything about this hotel is great! Mobile check-in was easy. Staff was super friendly. Rooms were huge exactly as advertised. we will definitely book here again and would recommend anyone do the same. 15-minute walk to the Sphere. Better than some 5 star rated hotels.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: Stayed one night. Hotel was close to airport which was easy to get to. Smaller casino but had nice restaurants and rooms.

allReviews.title: vacation needed
allReviews.text: had several issues with room but big issue was toilet had to be replaced, it took 3 men 3 hours of which we had to cancel our plans and lost our money. Housekeeping never cleaned the tub and we had to call them for shampoo and shower gel.

allReviews.title: Top Notch
allReviews.text: I've been staying here annually for many years for a conference but always extending my stay for several days.  The rooms are large, parking is excellent, restaurants serve decent food and Bistecca is particularly good.  It's a hidden gem.

allReviews.title: Rooms and facilities excellent, gambling, not so much
allReviews.text: Rooms: accommodations and cleanliness were exceptional.Property:  Pools and restaurants and services were all excellent.While the rooms and facilities were clean and excellent, and the return of the table games was welcome, the gambling experience was disappointing, especially the video poker. Not because of results, but because of the lower grade return (pay tables) on video poker.Once a great place at which to play, this is no longer the case. Video Poker Gambling at Tuscany is no longer practical for sustained play. This information has now become widespread common knowledge, on the websites, and more importantly, among customer discussions and feedbacks.

allReviews.title: Don't eat at the Italian Restaurant Bistecca
allReviews.text: Expensive prices for marginal food and the service is HORRIBLE. Even though we told multiple servers we were there for a show (in 1.5 hours) Took over an hour to get our food and some didn't arrive until later because "they dropped it", the manager comp'd the late dropped food but argued with me about any other accommodations. We normally stay there every 6-8 weeks but we've had other issues with the hotel (including giving me a key to a room someone else was already in and I walked in on them) so we've decided we won't be going back.

allReviews.title: A Great Time
allReviews.text: If you're looking for a great time...this is the place to be. The entire place is well maintained. The rooms and the beds are very comfortable. The casino has plenty to offer in gaming and pool /surrounding area is well kept. The restaurants and bar are a great value. We've been coming here for the past 6 years and have never been disappointed. This place is a refreshing change from staying on the strip. Come and enjoy!!!

allReviews.title: Tuscany review
allReviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights the first time. The rooms were so well equipped, with the very nice bedding and tv.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites has everything you need
allReviews.text: Everything you need is here and included. They do not upsell by nickel and diming you for everything you use (WiFi, connectivity with apps, etc.). All included with parking that is also included and not a mile away from your room. Kitchenette allows you to stock your room w drinks and food. There is so much more but I’ll let you see for yourself. Location is great too!

allReviews.title: Huge rooms
allReviews.text: Rooms are very large, food at Marilyn’s was great and the price was nice. Pool service was amazing.I’d say the biggest downfall is, it’s a bit of walk to the Strip. About 15 to 20 minutes to Horseshoe/Paris

allReviews.title: An Amazing place to stay!
allReviews.text: We love this property! The size of the room, the friendly employees, the great pool area and the excellent food were amazing!! It’s also very quiet compared To staying on the strip, yeah it was only a five minute walk from this hotel to the strip. We will stay here every time we go to Vegas now!!

allReviews.title: September 2024
allReviews.text: Another great visit to The Tuscany. A superb option off strip. Just a 10 minute walk to the strip. Highly recommended

allReviews.title: Once a year trip
allReviews.text: If you occupy a room on the Bottom floors prepare to lose sleep, you hear everything happening above. Hard stomping and banging all through the night Hard to sleep unless you keep the tv on to drown out the sound. Other than that everything else was fine.

allReviews.title: Worlds - 2024
allReviews.text: Great atmosphere, great accommodations, great service.  Within actual walking distance from the Strip.  Will definitely return on my next trip.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: In town for the Eagles concert at the Sphere. Amazing btw. Room was clean and spacious. Service was great. Everyone we encountered was friendly. Would definitely recommend and will stay again if needed.

allReviews.title: Never trust anybody
allReviews.text: see other rating or my particular experience for my nasty check-in process.  The gal that checked me in tricked me and I didn't expect this type of treatment from Tuscany

allReviews.title: Enjoyable stay
allReviews.text: What was liked · Off-center position with respect to the strip therefore quiet. In 10 minutes walk you will still reach the Strip/Flamigo rd intersection, the heart of the strip itself.What did not like · Soundproofing room. Customers upstairs hear walking and at night is a problem

allReviews.title: Disgusting blocked and overflowing toilet, unhelpful staff
allReviews.text: Blocked and overflowing toilet with sewerage. We stayed three nights at this hotel, broken up by an overnight stay at the Grand Canyon. Our first room was on the first floor with a view of a wall so very little natural light coming in. The fridge and safe were both broken. Our second room was on the third floor so lots of natural light, but when we arrived in our room there was a maintenance man in the room having just finished fixing the toilet. Not a good start we thought. The next day the toilet was blocked and awful, sewer water started overflowing to the floor. We blocked the water with towels and reported it to front desk who said they’ll lodge the job. When we checked later, they hadn’t lodged the job and the staff made us call maintenance to lodge it. We asked front desk if it would be fixed by the time we go back and they could not confirm yes, and said we could be given another room based on availability. I’d say having filthy sewer water flowing into your room is a considerable health risk but they did not care. When we returned the toilet had been fixed but nothing had been cleaned, dirty towels still on the floor and the toilet itself was disgusting. The lack of care from the staff was unbelievable. Will never stay here again and would advise others to find an alternate hotel. It’s also a 20 minute walk to the strip passing some pretty dodgy  individuals each time.

allReviews.title: Happy, Clean, friedly,
allReviews.text: I went on this trip for work. But I also ended up enjoying myself very much as I always do when I visit the tuscany hotel and casino.

allReviews.title: Quick Getaway
allReviews.text: Overall happy with the resort - very clean. Only couple things to say:1) Fan in the bathroom very loud and since the light and fan work off one switch it has to be on.2) Server in the lounge on Tuesday night was very slow - ordered appetizers and delivered by another server, our server never came back to check on us to see if we had everything or needed anything.  We had to track her down for our bill.3) Server at the pool on Wednesday, we ordered drinks and took 30 minutes to get them, they were can drinks so not much to getting them.

allReviews.title: Large quiet rooms well equipped
allReviews.text: Large well equipped quiet roomsBeautiful swimming pools Close to the stripBeautiful green spacesIt changes buildings

allReviews.title: I love Tuscany Suites, but service after hours for guests outside is nonexistent
allReviews.text: I love Tuscany. I love that it's not a high rise and is off the strip. The room sizes are more than adequate and the maid service is top notch. The casino is a casino- the usual suspects of machines that you see in pretty much every casino in Vegas. My biggest issue is with the lack of service for guests who sit outside the pool area after hours and how early the lounge closes, pushing you to get a drink at 365 OR inside the casino where you might just drop a few pennies in a slot machine-it's too manipulative. If they would just have one cocktail waitress come outside and take drink orders, there'd be a little more revenue happening outside. Also, if you book, request building K or L but NOT J! While the rooms are all the same, the access to the side parking lot next to J (and near the casino) is a long walk and the wall against the parking lot forces you to either take the short staircase at either end of the walkway by building J. If they would cut a short staircase in between that long walkway, it would make accessing the parking lot OR your rooms better and easier for someone with limited mobility. All in all, a good experience, I've stayed at Tuscany for the last 4 visits and being a block or two from the strip really helps keep things quiet. Guests are usually older (35-60) so it's not loud or crazy-which I like. The food at Marilyn's is basic but good; the food at 365 is good but it's sports themed so the music or the television is always too loud for you to "chill" and the Botegga is my favorite place to catch a quick bite and a coffee. I haven't tried the steakhouse yet but hopefully will visit the next time I'm there.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Paradise
allReviews.text: Great resort.  Love that the pool is not always full and getting a chair is possible.  Great restaurants and spacious rooms.

allReviews.title: Tuscany very nice.
allReviews.text: Good hotel. Rooms very spacious and complete with every comfort. In the rooms there are two beds. Very large bathroom with shower and bathtub. The pool is clean , with a separate pool that makes bubbles. In the restaurants inside the hotel you eat well. The hotel is Near the center. Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Non Accommodating Front Desk Person and Drilling at almost midnight
allReviews.text: I asked to extend my stay by one day ( I was there for 5 nights) The front desk person did not even try to help as he said my current room was already booked.  When I asked if they could switch me, one day in advance of my departure, he said NO.  Check out of your room by 11 and book another stay and check in at 3:30.  My last night I was a little frustrated and decided just to head out early instead of staying another day.  That was fine until 11:30 at night when the maintenance people started working on the room across from me and started DRILLING!!!! They were working on the door at almost midnight. When I checked in everyone was polite and helpful once it was time to leave then I felt like they couldn't care less about my stay.  It's too bad because I think the hotel is really nice but this is the second time I had an issue.

allReviews.title: Great stay at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This is a great location to stay in Las Vegas, closer to the strip.  Clean, big room.  I also noticed that the gardens are meticulously maintained using artificial grass, so is environment friendly, considering the drought in that area.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: First time staying at Tuscany Suites and Casino and was very happy overall. Will return on our next visit to LV

allReviews.title: I wouldn’t come back to vegas to stay in Tuscany.
allReviews.text: I did not enjoy my stay. I kept losing electricity, the TV kept going on and off, the coffee machine just didn’t work, the bathroom lights kept going on and off. I did not find the receptionists that helpful in this regard.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Very clean, quiet and good location. Big room has lots space. Room is insulated very well. Don't need turn the air condition on at night when outside temperature was 104. Service person are polite. Good swimming pools and gym.

allReviews.title: A Wonderful Place
allReviews.text: We cannot say enough positive about staying at the Tuscany! Poolside areas are wonderful, service out there was good, and the entire pool experience is just so relaxing.  Every restaurant inside provides excellent service and quality food and beverage. And the suites are so comfortable and absolutely beautiful.  We have been home for 4 days and already look forward to our next visit!!

allReviews.title: Perfect spot away from the Strip
allReviews.text: I really liked this location and would stay here again. The room was spacious and comfortable. For the price I was impressed. Just remember the extra $40/night resort fee. It's not in the initial price you pay when reserving.

allReviews.title: Nice local place to stay with big suites
allReviews.text: Overall the hotel suites are great and even have smoking rooms, food was good to very good at cafe, bartenders are on top of it but cocktail service on casino floor is a hit or miss.  Some are there to work, others not so much.

allReviews.title: Easy time at Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: Our group meets regularly in early September at Tuscany Suites. Rooms are reasonably priced and the hotel has all the amenities we require.

allReviews.title: Cleaned and well maintained
allReviews.text: I really recommend Tuscany Hotel it very family friendly, Everything in the hotel is great, I wouldn’t change it for nothing.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very big room for a good price. Free parking. Just off of main part of Strip. I highly recommend the Tuscany Suites and Casino.

allReviews.title: Another great stay!
allReviews.text: This was our 2nd stay at Tuscany and enjoyed it once again. Friendly staff, clean, large rooms. A bit off strip but great place to stay.

allReviews.title: Better than the strip!
allReviews.text: Most comfortable bed ever!  I loved that it wasn’t a high rise on the crazy strip!  I loved all the trees.

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: The place is near of Strip, clean and comfortable. The personal is very kind and profesional.The relationship between price and comfort is the best.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The hotel it self is amazing , clean , great location , we love the pool , the service .There's nothing negative that i can say !Is amazingly fantastic!.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Rooms are spacious,restaurants food was really good and well priced,bread pudding from pub365 and tiramisu from Marilyn’s are a must try.overall would stay here again very clean rooms

allReviews.title: Bad experience
allReviews.text: 1. I reserved two rooms in one order, one was using my name the other is my husband’s name, they said 3rd party doesn’t tell it’s from same order , so it’s hard to put it closer.2. After I requested it to be on the same building same floor, the elevator was broken.3. I reserved two king room + a sofa bed because we have 6 people, they said only the king bed is guaranteed not the sofa bed, I only got one sofa bed in one of the two rooms. And guy at front desk is very impatient and said there are people in line he can’t just rearrange my room??!4. Red mark on the pillow, I recorded it.5. One of the room key doesn’t work I have to walk to front desk to change it.6. No extra blanket and sheets for sofa bed in the room, I have to walk to front desk again to request it.7. Nobody answered front desk line from room. I have to walk to the front desk for any issue.

allReviews.title: Relaxing haven from the busy strip.
allReviews.text: Wuiet location yet handy to main strip & shows at Planet Hollywood. Room was clean & comfortable & great pool.

allReviews.title: Lira Couple's Trip
allReviews.text: Had a great time will definitely be back. Staff very friendly and attentive. Pool was very nice. The grounds were kept well and nice place to stroll around.

allReviews.title: Great hotel, great staff - great value
allReviews.text: Great place and perfect location with a short walking distance to the strip. Everything in order and spotless. Room very comfortable and clean. All staff from the Front Desk, Pool, Maintenance to Housekeeping was outstanding. Great value. I really enjoyed my stay. Strongly recommended.

allReviews.title: Near to the Strip but some disadvantages
allReviews.text: The rooms are large but the beds to small for two adults. Pool is not sufficient for the hotel capacity and water was to warm. Staff at Marilyn Cafe quite unfriendly. Location is near to the Strip but in the evening it is safer to use Taxi or Uber.

allReviews.title: Our go-to hotel, but…
allReviews.text: … they’ve done away with their $5 craps table.  What a shame. They now only have one $10 table, it doesn’t open until 7:00pm and every time we’ve wanted to play, they were only playing a half table and there was literally no one playing.  $5 tables are hard to find, unless you want to go downtown, but we always were so happy with  the table and dealers in the Tuscany casino.  On our last day in town, we decided to walk to Ellis Island, only five minutes away.  To our delight, at NOON there was a $5 virtual table and a $5 classic table.  Both were packed and the vibe was pure energy.  I said to my husband, “I’d like to bring management from the Tuscany over here right now to see this.”  We stayed there almost 5 hours shooting and had a great time.While we will continue to stay at the Tuscany (I mean, if for no other reason than for Pub 365 - thanks Jose!), our gambling days there are over.  It really is a shame.Other than a few issues with our room upon check in, (broken bathroom sink handle, sink stopper broken so I couldn’t use the sink, and a drawer from the dresser sitting on the floor - broken), it still wouldn’t deter me from booking here again.  The rooms are clean, great restaurants, very convenient location and the staff is very helpful.  Bring back $5 craps and I would up this review to 5 stars in a heartbeat.

allReviews.text: I ha no ironing board. And no towels. And instead of the man that came to my room saying he wasn’t coming back he didnt come back and couldn’t get I touch with room service till the next morning.

allReviews.title: Great staff, great time, great value
allReviews.text: Not much else to say. Clean, and spacious rooms, friendly staff, good restaurants, close to lots of fun stuff, great pool.

allReviews.title: Appreciated The Experience
allReviews.text: Hotel was very nice, spacious, and clean . Lady that helped us at the front desk was very accommodating and I appreciated the early check in

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The only thing in room is the tv need to be bigger  and the air conditioner unit is pretty old and sometime it made some noise

allReviews.title: Excellent Service
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites Service Staff from the Front Desk, Pool, Maintenance to Housekeeping was excellent.

allReviews.title: Large, disjointed, slow

allReviews.title: Loved our stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Tuscany very much.   Would 100% recommend to anyone who is looking for a quiet, peaceful stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best Bet
allReviews.text: If you want to avoid the crowds and hustle/ bustle of Vegas; steps from the strip behind the Chromwell near the action center of the strip this is a great place to stay. Quiet, clean, spacious and sprawling resort describes the hotel. Wonderful, quiet pool area with foliage and cocktail server. It was a really nice relaxing retreat in LV. Plenty of secutity and nearly empty hotel lobby. No signs of casino action too for total relaxation. I will return for sure. Spa on premises too; booked up but available. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Needs severe maintenance and service is inferior now
allReviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany probably 4 or 5 times before but this time I had several issues. On the plus side the rooms are very ample and the staff is great overall. However, the L201 room needs some serious maintenance. I reported not once or twice, but 4 times that the door was not properly working and that I had to use my card up to 10 times before I was able to unlock the room. The forth time I complained the maintenance person finally came to the room and basically said that the door worked, and that I had to try several times rotating the card key until it opens. WHAT? How is that acceptable?Also, the shower drain was clogged and the shower head was constantly leaking. I did not even bother reporting these last items because I was waiting for them to fix the door first. Which never happened.Service at Marilyn's cafe was very slow even when there were only a few tables occupied.Lastly, I've sent several emails trying to get a copy of my bill to no avail. They have not even replied back after several weeks.Again, this is a great place to stay but it does have some issues lately. I'd probably come back again, but they need to work on these details. Last year they addressed the maintenance issues quickly and they sent me a copy of my bill too, so not sure what happened this time, maybe it's a management issue?

allReviews.title: Noisy AirCon and Poor Service
allReviews.text: It's close to the strip. Good property and big rooms. However, the upkeep is a question. AirCon in the room is noisy as hell and quite difficult to sleep. In  Bathroom as well, the holder and other available rack items were loose and unusable. The exhaust fan in the bathroom is noisy as well and is attached to the light, so no way to turn it off. Check Out was painful as since morning they bang on the doors ensuring you leave the room asap.

allReviews.title: Not Worth It
allReviews.text: The bad way outweighs the good.  Most of the staff was helpful and friendly.  One night manager was terse and uncaring.  Location was good as far as convenient, but not great for safety or for people with disabilities.  While not required, there are no auto doors at entrances.  This means guests don't matter.  Some of the building doors are not ADA compliant.  Generally very quiet.  Not a busy hotel.  I didn't park, but I guess there was free parking.  Hot water in shower with good pressure.  Large bathroom (includes bathtub).Food at Marilyn's was 50/50.  Twice good, once bad.  Bistecca was excellent as was the service (kudos to Kevin).  Negatives:1.  Didn't care about guest safety.  Told them multiple times that the outside door to the building did not require a key in order to get in (all others did and only for people staying in that building at ALL times).  Gave me some BS story about they didn't want to have to keep giving out keys and said they could get in the building, but not into my room so....2.  I explained that the bottom lock in my room did not work...AND...so long as I was in my room I was safe?  What if I was coming in at midnight (which I did) or 1 am (which I did) and someone either followed me in or was already there.3.  Bed bugs. (see photo) (and I have bites all over me).4.  Refrigerator didn't work.5.  TV worked only intermittently.6.  Couldn't get anyone at front desk to answer the phone.7.  Drinks were incredibly expensive.  Asked for a cup of water at the bar and they wouldn't give it to me.  They said they only "sold bottled water."  In 108 degrees.8.  Lots of construction going on9.  Landscapers started working before 8 am.  I can understand they want to get done when it is cool but it is a distinct disadvantage for guests.10.  Cleaning crew was banging on the door early in the morning on checkout day (on a Sunday).  Ignoring them didn't help.11.  Not much in the way of a casino.The bugs and the lack of safety are more than enough for me not to go back.

allReviews.title: Sphere
allReviews.text: Excellent stay. Awesome rooms. Affordable meals and coffee. Service was outstanding.  Would definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Well-maintained property
allReviews.text: Big, well-maintained rooms, nice pools.Hotel is in walkable distance to the Strip.Gym that is open 24/7.

allReviews.title: Good Hotel
allReviews.text: Off the beaten path.  close to the Sphere.  Walkable to other hotels.  Very  large and comfortable room.   A varied choice of reasonably priced eating options.  The swimming pool is the right size.  The bars also serve reasonably priced drinksThe staff is very friendly and helpful

allReviews.title: We'll Be Back!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany was a wonderful place to stay.  I think this will be our place to stay from now on. Thank you Tuscany!

allReviews.title: Great Stay !!
allReviews.text: What a great resort - had a fabulous stay and would definitely book again when I return to LV.  The room was huge, comfortable and CLEAN.  I enjoyed being able to walk over for coffee in the AM. The pool somehow felt cool even when it was 110 degrees outside. Pool service was outstanding, restaurant was good.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel was nice check in was a joke beds are not soft very hard to sleep in room was clean pool was nice

allReviews.title: smoke-free rooms set in different buildings from Casino
allReviews.text: Like a suburban condo complex! Loved it.  Central building with casino, restaurants and pool, and then a bunch of 3-story buildings with hotel rooms scattered around parking lots. That layout kept my room quiet and smoke free.  About a 10 minute cab ride due West to Ceasar's Palace.  My 2-bed room + bathroom was huge!  Shower + separate tub; couch, loveseat, table, fridge.  About a 15 minute walk from the Sphere!  #deadforever.

allReviews.title: Will stay again!
allReviews.text: What a great place and a good location for The Sphere!  Super clean, well-maintained rooms. Perfect for the Dead & Co residency as they had Dead bands play at the bar and Copa Room. Pool and restaurants are very nice, with the exception of Pub 365, which is terribly loud and was understaffed. We finally had to go ask for our check after our table had been cleared and we sat there for 15 minutes waiting. I recommend otherwise!  I felt very fortunate that we picked this hotel!

allReviews.title: Dead and Company stay over
allReviews.text: The Tuscany hotel and Casino was the bomb. We had a grand pool side room with a beautiful patio. The suite was spectacular and had everything we needed. Thus place is so much better than staying on the Strip and you can still get everywhere you want to go. Five stars for sure.

allReviews.title: Really Good Option for the Price!
allReviews.text: This would be a great place to stay if you want the Vegas experience and not break the bank.  It is perfectly located near everything, but a fraction of the price.  Plus, it is a much more chill atmosphere, a locals feel, but still right in the middle of it all.

allReviews.title: LV vacation and enjoyed a concert at the Sphere
allReviews.text: Hotel was very convenient to the venue, the Sphere. The entertainment at Tuscany was first rate. The food at the main restaurant was excellent and everything I wanted was on site or very close by. Second stay at the Tuscany, really great friendly staff

allReviews.title: Dead and Co at the Tuscany
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites was the perfect location for Dead Heads!!!  Talk about jumping on the bus and going for a ride.... they mastered it!  Management embraced the opportunity to cater to a group that most would turn away.  Room was huge, restaurants were reasonability priced and had a great selection of beer. Shakedown on site was amazing ... just wish the slots hit a little more!!!

allReviews.title: Never disappointed !
allReviews.text: third time we stay at Tuscany (6 nights). It is really one of the most comfortable hotel in LV. Rates are not expensive while the rooms are large and well equiped.

allReviews.title: Oasis in the desert
allReviews.text: We had an enjoyable stay at the Tuscany. Staff was friendly and welcoming from check in to check out. Clean and comfortable rooms. Beautiful pool area and good entertainment. Food in the restaurants was good and a reasonable price. A great experience! We will definitely return to the Tuscany. Thank you to the kind staff for making our stay a wonderful experience!

allReviews.title: Great Location and spacious rooms
allReviews.text: A fantastic value.   Our room had a dinette set, a living room area,  and two twin beds.  Very comfortable and home away from home for the three of us.   Front desk generously checked us in early, breakfast at Marylyns cafe was great, and the staff in the gift shop was very helpful.   We were in town for the Dead and Co show at the sphere and it was close enough to walk to though we took a cab since it was pretty hot out.   The hotel was very accommodating to the hordes of dead heads staying for the weekend.   There were several good Dead Cover bands in the bar throught out the weekend.   The casino is on the smaller side and is smoking though they seemed to keep it non smokey somehow so it didn't bother when it ususally does.  We look forward to staying here again the next time we need to be Vegas for a show

allReviews.title: Not a Strip Hotel
allReviews.text: I've been staying here for years. I like it but don't love it. Food quality has gone down, prices up. Housekeeping is very busy to the point it's hard to reach anyone on the phone. Long lines at front desk.That being said, it's perfectly adequate.Was not impressed with a $2 fee for picking up my drink at the bar as I was in my bathing suit. I thought i'd save the busy pool waitress a trip by getting my own drink but they penalize you for it.

allReviews.title: Look no further!
allReviews.text: Best managed property in Vegas. Stress free and easy on the pocket. Will always make this my go to in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great Value
allReviews.text: My selection of Tuscany was strictly by price and proximity to The Sphere however I am sure I could not have been happier at any other hotel. The entire weekend was perfect. Every aspect of the hotel I encountered exceeded my expectations; online pre-check-in, checking in to pick up keys, cleanliness and size of room, lovely pool area, great band in the bar before & after the show, exceptionally good bartender, super-friendly staff and beautiful grounds. If I get back to Vegas I plan to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel great location.  Bars and restaurants were excellent! Nice pool and rooms. Highly recomend this hotel. Would stay here again next time I'm in the area

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: The rooms are big.  Everything you need is nearby.  Walk to the Sphere for a show.  Short cab to the strip or dispensory.

allReviews.title: July-August
allReviews.text: Visiting Sphere for Dead and Company. Loved the entertainment at Copa Room, Piazza Lounge, and Shakedown Street. PLEASE have us back next year. I have already recommended you to several of my friends. Also appreciated the Shakedown Shuttle presence at the Casino entrance. Driver Michelle was very helpful.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas stay @ The Tuscany
allReviews.text: Very good experience would do it again. My room was very comfortable, hotel was clean and staff was friendly.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: We loved to stay here. Rooms are big, location was perfect for us. Not to far to the strip. Beds were a little bit small for 2 persons and the airco makes a lot of noice.

allReviews.title: Dead and Co guest
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. Being near the Sphere for the show, going to Shakedown St, listening to the cover bands and being with the tribe was great. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

allReviews.title: Great off strip location
allReviews.text: This was my first time staying at an off strip hotel/casino. What a pleasant change. We stayed to attend a concert at the sphere. The entire hotel was pretty much full of fans of the particular band. They welcomed our group and treated everybody great there was pre-concert and post concert music in the lounges although the casino/hotel is rather small. It provided everything we needed. The rooms were spectacularly, clean and well appointed. Parking was free and very simple to park very close to your room. There were stores and restaurants within walking distance and the Uber ride to the venue was very short. I would definitely recommend this property and it is likely my go to spot from here forward .

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: A great place to stay. We wanted to celebrate our 20th anniversary and couldn't have pick a better place

allReviews.title: So much better than expected - hidden gem for sure.
allReviews.text: I’ve been to the casino a bunch of times but never stayed in the hotel before and I will not make that mistake again. The rooms are fantastic, the staff is lovely, the gym and pool were great and every meal was delicious. This is truly a hidden gem in Sin City and I will definitely go back again.

allReviews.title: Weekend getaway
allReviews.text: Front desk personel very pleasant,accomodating,rooms very clean.Casino floor very nice,not over crowded. Cocktail waitresses,very nice and quick with the drinks

allReviews.title: Best place to stay while in Vegas!
allReviews.text: We loved our stay at the Tuscany! Friendly staff, clean suite, great atmosphere! Super relaxing! We will definitely be back!!!

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: Lovely, spacious suite. Pool was clean and never overpopulated.Entertainment was nice tooFelt in security.All staff were helpful and polite

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel, close to strip
allReviews.text: The rooms are nice, clean and huge with Sofa, kitchenette and extra dining table. Pool ist fine. The Resort was quiet and close to Strip (25 min). Bathroom was also great.A Microwave would be a nice add-on, fridge is in the room.

allReviews.title: Great place off the strip
allReviews.text: Wow! First visit to Las Vegas where we didn't stay on the strip. WOW! This place was amazing! Not the glitz of the strip, but just down to earth nice. The staff was incredible, the property was clean, and the grounds felt safe. The rooms were very large, and undated. Beds were incredible, definitely worth the coming too.

allReviews.title: Look forward to staying here every year
allReviews.text: My husband and I have been going to the Tuscany for over 18 years. We love the atmosphere and always enjoy ourselves. The rooms are nice and we always get our request to stay in a particular building. The restaurants are good.  We enjoy the pool and gaming which adds to a fun vacation.

allReviews.title: A week at Tuscany
allReviews.text: A great place to stay with amazingly helpful and friendly staff . The rooms were very clean spacious and comfortable.  Great pool and restaurant

allReviews.title: Safety, lockouts, and handicapped guests stranded
allReviews.text: We like this property, but they had some serious safety issues this last visit.  If they resolve them, then the place is a gem. However, the safety of my family members outweighs any other positives.  The elevator went out and the doors to the staircases were locked.  My Mom was stranded on the second floor in a handicapped accessible room.  I could not get back to her. The issues was reported and not attended to for the next Hour we waited for help.  Other guests and I got our family members out of the building.  Thank goodness for the kindness of strangers.

allReviews.title: Nice and fun place to stay
allReviews.text: Spacious room. Family and parking friendly. Offstrip but in walking distane to Ceasar and fountain, sphere...

allReviews.title: Excellent stay, Will be back
allReviews.text: We stayed here because it was close to our event we were attending. Our room was spacious. Our room was so close to the casino and pool which we spent all day Sunday. We didn't have to leave the property. Breakfast lunch and dinner were all there!. Will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Nice place to Stay
allReviews.text: Would like better access to pool, one pool for a lot of guests is not enough. Wish there was More activities for those who do not gamble and are traveling with family, kids.

allReviews.title: Nice property
allReviews.text: I was pleased with the spacious rooms and very nice fitness facilities.  I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Beautiful  grounds, huge room, comfy bed, and great staff at Marilyn's  Cafe, Gift shop and Security detail.

allReviews.title: Very nice property just off the strip
allReviews.text: Had a few small issues with the room but they were quickly resolved.  Everyone on the property was very nice and helpful. I would certainly stay again.

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel at a great price! Highly Recommend!
allReviews.text: Our stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino was excellent from start to finish. The rooms are very affordable and comfortable. The housekeeping does an excellent job and are very prompt if you need anything for your room. The pool was perfect and there was plenty of seating around it for when you weren't swimming. We ate at two of the restaurants and the food was excellent every time with friendly staff. The casino was fun and not overcrowded. The hotel is off of the strip but my wife and I easily walked the 10 minutes to the strip and the sphere so the location was not an issue for us. If you are not able to walk the distance it was easy to call for an Uber anytime of the day/night. Overall we had an amazing time during our stay and I would highly recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Locked out
allReviews.text: Everything was good till was locked out of our rooms and then made to feel like I was breaking in when the battery just died on the door.  Made my day so long ruined all my plans for the rest of the day

allReviews.title: Always a good time
allReviews.text: not too crowded...great service from bars, restaurants, and dealers. Great place to go experience Vegas without too much sensory overload

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: We travel to Vegas twice yearly for work. The comfort and space offered at the Tuscany is a thing we count on surfing our week long stays. With efficient, patient and friendly staff, we couldn't ask for anything more.

allReviews.title: Lovely place!
allReviews.text: I would come again, big apartmetn, very quiet, housekeeping every day. Also the swimming pool, the bar, the restaurant in place made me feel good.

allReviews.title: Beautiful place!
allReviews.text: Good choice, hotel looks amazing and clean, there's everything a guest might need and the location is perfect, walking distance from the Strip

allReviews.title: Excellent experience
allReviews.text: Wonderful place to stay that's away from the strip but within walking distance. With all the amenities.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Good place for the price and location. We stayed in the room a lot, so the bed was too hard for my liking and the TV was about half the size of other places we've stayed.

allReviews.title: Second stay in as many weeks.  I rate it high.
allReviews.text: If you don't enjoy the accommodations then I am sure you are looking for something less.  A group of us stayed the second week of July and all was great.  So on my return trip I knew where I was going to stay.

allReviews.title: It was okay
allReviews.text: Check in attendant was kind of stand offish and not interested in conversation, got to my room and the shower door wouldn’t shut, which was annoying. Packed my fridge full of some perishable snacks and it was barely working so I had to throw away a good $60 in food. Casino and restaurants were good, the property was clean.

allReviews.title: Home away from Home
allReviews.text: Hotel location is very good, Verey courtious check in staff, Property, rooms/Suites are very good. Restaurtant pricing are very reasonalbel and food also very good quality and with wnough quantity.Excellent Stay.

allReviews.title: Great location and property!
allReviews.text: Nice quiet property with a great location. We felt safe on the property as well as walking to the Strip or the Sphere. The staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The room was very large with 2 queen beds, a sitting area with a couch and chair as well as a small kitchenette with a mini fridge and a sink. However there was no microwave. There were also no service items like plates or silverware.

allReviews.title: Worst ex
allReviews.text: Bed covers were filthy with blood and fluid stains, walls are thin and can head every lil noise upstairs and next door. Was not compensated properly. Will never stay here and dont recommend staying here!

allReviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas !
allReviews.text: The rooms, the grounds, the buildings are so well cleaned and groomed! The service and food is so damn good

allReviews.title: Nice hotel a short walk away from the strip
allReviews.text: We stayed for 2 nights in July at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. Our executive suite was very spacious and well equipped and looked exactly like the photos on the website. We especially loved the atmosphere at the pool.The food of Caffè Bottega was decent and the staff very helpful. Ability to eat outside was a plus for us.The location of the hotel is convenient. Just a 15 min walk away from the Strip but keep in mind there is almost no shadow.

allReviews.title: Becoming too family oriented now
allReviews.text: It is one of our favorite venues in Las Vegas. We enjoy staying, playing and eating at this facility. In prior times I would have rated Tuscany as first class, but some points need to be addressed. Small, but important to us was that there was no longer complimentary bottled water in the suites. We were told that we may purchase water at the vending machines on the first level. That did not happen being that they were empty. Another is purchasing drinks for the poolside. An automatic fee

allReviews.title: Great place to Stay
allReviews.text: We were invited down by Holiday Inn Club Vacations and this is the place they provided for our stay. We were pleasantly surprised by the size of the suite and the staff was great, everything you need was on site.

allReviews.title: Great Choice for a Vegas Stay
allReviews.text: Sprawling resort off the Strip but walkable weather permitting. Suites are spacious, quiet, comfortable and clean. Great pool. Good onsite bar and restaurants. Free WiFi was slow and our kitchen only had a small fridge and coffee maker. Would stay again.

allReviews.title: Room review
allReviews.text: The suite was great!LV has become extremely hard to get around with the formula 1 detours and we just can't handle this so it will be a long time before we return!  Hope you clean this up!

allReviews.title: Quick weekend getaway
allReviews.text: Great off strip casino that gives big casino vibes, but away from the Hussle and Bussle of the strip.  Tuscany has great bars, restaurants, and a cool casino.  Nice pool area, and friendly staff.  Definitely would visit again on my next trip.

allReviews.title: Tuscany review
allReviews.text: Our favorite is that the pool is open early and stays open late. And there are enough lounge chairs.One comment - maybe a couple more clothes dryers. One in the building would be nice.

allReviews.title: Quality Hotel
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the hotel, I will be booking my next visit to Vegas at this hotel. I like that its located off the strip but is in walking distance,

allReviews.title: Not very helpful
allReviews.text: Our first two nights here after the long flight. Although booked for months non-smoking we were put in two smoking rooms. It smelled so bad, you felt sick. The beds, pillows all stunk. The air conditioning extremely loud, 70 decibels I measured, sleeping was unthinkable. The first night we could not change, the second night yes, but only at 5 pm.  The beds are rather narrow for 2 people, probably small queen size. We ate at the pub, was okay. The second meal at Bistecca. Meat was very good but expensive. Front desk always long queue, not very helpful. On the whole, we would not stay here again.

allReviews.title: A great address in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: After a week in the national parks, Las Vegas was the total contrast program. Tuscany is a good place to enjoy the highlive on the Stip and to be able to leave in a few minutes walk to relax in peace. Be it by the pool, at the bar or in the room. The rooms are spacious and despite carpet very clean and nice. The beds are a bit narrow but very comfortable. The staff are extremely friendly. An absolute Recommendation.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: I love how this property is off the strip but not far.  Nice quiet location and close to many amenities.This is a large well maintained property.  Truly my only complaint is for a property this large they only have a small pool and a lap pool.  I would have loved to get in the pool but it was too crowded.  This place should have two large pools.

allReviews.title: Fun times!
allReviews.text: Love the location, love the pool, love the rooms being detached from the casino and love they have live dealer table games! Fun stay!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: I have been staying at the Tuscany Suites for at least the past 10 years. The rooms are big, comfortable and always clean. The couch pulls out to a bed and all rooms have a mini fridge, table with chairs and I believe most have microwaves. One thing we appreciate is the ease in parking. Unlike the big resorts, you do not have long walks from your vehicle to your room or any part of the resort. Parking is free, convenient and secure. Another thing we like is that it is not far from the strip. You can definitely walk to the strip and back at night with no issues. Many restaurants within walking distance as well. The lobby bar is always fun with live music at night and martini happy hour which I take full advatage of. They have fire pits outside the bar which offer a nice place to relax and enjoy a glass of wine with family and friends. The pool area is small but works for our family. the casino is also small but again, works for us. There is a coffee shop that offers quick bites for breakfast and lunch that is good and not very pricey. We have eaten at 2 of their restaurnats and liked them both for a quick burger and breakfast. Nothing fancy but the food is good. We have tried staying at other hotels and we always come back to the Tuscany Suites.

allReviews.title: Great stay just off the strip
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites is the perfect location, not far from anything and a beautiful, clean property with all the necessities. Would not hesitate to stay again.

allReviews.title: Book Thru Tuscany not Groupon
allReviews.text: Groupon should EXPLICITLY state that if you don’t have a credit card available with $150 limit your stay will not be permitted. Otherwise it was awesome.

allReviews.title: none
allReviews.text: I like this property, it is really nice, and one of my favorites when staying in Vegas. I wish they had free shuttle up/down the strip. The traffic was horrible. The room was nice and roomy but there was no microwave to reheat food. No iron or ironing board and the tub had no curtain?
