We stayed on the bottom floor and we could hear our neighbors stomping around late at night and early in the morning.  Otherwise a good stay.

allReviews.title: 100% Amazing Experience!!!
allReviews.text: I have been to dozens of hotels, timeshares, Airbnb and I was never satisfied with the bed. Tuscany has the best bed in their suites!! The best, clean bathroom that I have ever been to. Definitely coming back to Tuscany for any travels in Vegas!! The staff were great and with smiles on their faces even when there were hundreds of us that checked in at one point!

allReviews.title: Tuscany review
allReviews.text: Excellent apartment like setting  and a European feel. It did not feel like I was in a typical Vegas hotel. Spacious rooms and parking …

allReviews.title: Fantastic!
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed the time in Tuscany. The pool was excellent, the rooms large, air conditioned and cozy. The location was great and so was the price!

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: If the pool was open later I would give it 5 stars besides that I was happy with my stay & the restaurants

allReviews.title: Best Hotel off the Strip
allReviews.text: Tremendous value here at Tuscany.   Four star accommodations, reasonably priced.   Room was large and very clean.   Front desk staff are super accommodating and friendly.  No issues during stay.  Would recommend.   Also a shout-out to Shaun at the front desk, he gets an A+ in customer service.

allReviews.title: Plumbing issues
allReviews.text: Checkin was fine. But my toilet was plugged and I called multiple times to get someone out. They never came. I shouldn’t have to pay for a room  where the toilet won’t flush! Front desk was too crowded to even ask for a credit or refund.

allReviews.title: Too Bad Staff Wasn’t Nice
allReviews.text: Tuscany has no much potential as an off strip property. The staff need to step up their service - and, smile people are there to have fun.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Always really good and nice. It was really clean and a big room with a lot of services. We dont have any problem during our night with them.

allReviews.title: Awesome Getaway
allReviews.text: My daughter and I stayed and absolutely loved it. The room was large and clean. The pillows were so comfortable. The person at check-n was so nice and the process was quick and easy. The pool was smaller than I thought it would be, but still great and clean. It was really like walking around in a little European village. I will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The whole property was METICULOUSLY maintained. The staff was attentive and kind. Our room air-condition had some problems but the staff had it fixed in no time.The check process seemed to take a long time but the staff handled it with professionalism and grace. My husband and I will definitely stay here whenever we travel to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice close to Strip prop
allReviews.text: Nice spacious suite.  No View, just of the next building across the walkway. That"s ok, I only look when I first come in. Common areas are very nice. Pools crystal clear, used the fitness center and it was well maintained and had high end functional equipment. Schedule didn't allow me to see any of the live entertainment, but it is nice they do offer it. If I had a gripe parking is a bit confusing, took awhile to find parking near the building I was assigned to. and when I returned after 1am no parking anywhere near building I.

allReviews.title: Suitable
allReviews.text: Family vacation with our 16 year old. We were close to everything to be able to walk to. Rooms were suitable. Wish there would have been a microwave.

allReviews.title: Pleasant surprise
allReviews.text: We booked our stay through a third party and were pleasantly surprised at how nice the room resort and amenities were.

allReviews.title: Good hotel for a fair price.
allReviews.text: Hotel staff is friendly and the grounds are clean and well maintained. Would have rated higher but the air conditioner in my room made a jack-hammering sound 2-3x per hour which made it impossible to get a good night sleep.

allReviews.title: Not handicapped accessible.
allReviews.text: Well, they do have a few rooms that are handicap accessible. They do not have enough when there is a large group in town. Also, their doors are not automatic. It's difficult if you're using a Walker wheelchair or scooter to open the doors because there's no button to push for it to automatically open

allReviews.title: Just awful
allReviews.text: My wife and I booked a room for a conference being held at the hotel. Everything was fine for 2 months until 1 day before checking in. They stated we needed a credit card to secure the room for any damages. My wife and I don't use credit cards. So needless to say, this was a huge inconvenience when I called to try to get the matter resolved. I was told conflicting information all the way to I could use any credit card to secure the room to it didn't apply to conference attendees (which at in person check-in they said was not correct and that any CC had to match the reservation holder's name). Then there was back-and-forth between our attendant checking with other staff debating whether I could use a debit card or not since I was a conference attendee. Again, none of this was stated at booking! Check in was also at three o'clock and we didn't have a room ready until five o'clock. Even then, we had to go to the front desk and ask for our room versus them letting us know. Our conference room was sweltering the first day, so then they moved everyone to another room. We ate at pub 365 and the food was incredibly salty for everyone, small portions.  The only bright spot was most of the dealers were fun and accommodating. I absolutely would not stay at this hotel again and would have moved if our conference wasn't in the same building. Wish you better luck if you book here!

allReviews.title: Good times!
allReviews.text: Wish my discount had been applied correctly! Overcharged $176.88! When I made the reservation online, I used Shakedown 2024 to not be charged Resort fee but still was. Very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: Great Place, love the fitness pool without kids space and hot tub.  Love the coffee/bakery shop.  Close to walk to lots of things.

allReviews.title: Great Off Strip Place
allReviews.text: We attended a convention and found the hotel very nice with a great pool. Accommodared our special needs

allReviews.title: Value Vegas
allReviews.text: Check in line was long, Sunday afternoon with 3 attendants.  Very helpful and nice staff. Clean lobby, beautiful appearance. Room AC unit was leaking water on the carpet, a wall of outlets were out of service. The elevator in out building (B) functioned intermittently. Staff was pleasant and great! Beds were comfortable. Good value.

allReviews.title: Nice Place
allReviews.text: We love to stay here every time we're in Vegas; the staff is very nice and helpful.   We had a little glitch this past Sunday, we'll try not to return when is as crowded as the past weekend.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Resort review
allReviews.text: Loved the resort having all I needed right there.  The casino staff are great.  y room was clean upon arrival and kept clean daily.

allReviews.title: Read the room details
allReviews.text: Overall, I'd recommend the hotel. The staff is great, rooms are spacious and comfortable. Just be sure if you have more than 2 people in your party that you read the room details before booking. The couches in the suites are NOT fold out beds, they are love seats. If you are relying on the couch as a bed for someone who is taller than 5 feet, consider a roll-away bed or another room. The double beds listed are at best full sized beds.

allReviews.title: Tuscany
allReviews.text: It was a great stay. Kind employees and great restaurants. Good service, except for the female bartender at the Toscana Bar. She wasn't the friendliest.

allReviews.title: The best bang for the buck in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The rooms are spacious and beautiful, and the pool and other facilities are fantastic. The different restaurants are delicious and inexpensive.

allReviews.title: a very beautiful & friendly resort
allReviews.text: I generally like to stay downtown when i Visit but came on a special Business trip and we stayed at the Tuscany suites - It was so much better than some of the resorts on the strip that I’ve stayed at - You walk out the door and catch the bus and take you directly down onto the Las Vegas Blvd. and then catch the deuce buses up and down Las Vegas Blvd. wherever you wanna go -, Was amazed at how much vegetation and plant material was on the property. It’s absolutely gorgeous.

allReviews.title: Tuscany-a room with a view
allReviews.text: The entire exterior was very nice. No trash on the ground. Clean rooms, comfortable beds, and working air conditioning. The heat was unbearable outside, but it was very comfortable inside.

allReviews.title: July 2024
allReviews.text: Shakedown vegas was a very fun experience. Everything went smoothly and we had a great time. Highly recommend

allReviews.title: Positive experience.
allReviews.text: Great hotel, clean and comfortable. New structure, spacious rooms and equipped with all the necessary amenities, bathroom with both bathtub and shower modern and very clean. Friendly staff and quiet rooms. Free internal parking. The only flaw is the distance from strip; nothing transcendental, but we talk about a 15 minute walk that if you add to the lap to do you get 40 minutes walk.

allReviews.title: The pot smoking
allReviews.text: Very disappointed with how many people were smoking pot couldn’t walk anywhere in the hotel without smelling it, and my daughter was harassed by one of them.

allReviews.title: Love Las Vegas Hate the Cigarette smoke everywhere
allReviews.text: Nothing special but effort and good location, nice late night restaurant. Cigarette smoke everywhere gave me an insane headache

allReviews.title: Watch out for Hidden Resort Fees
allReviews.text: The hotel room was lovely and comfortable.  Location is great for our purposes.  To note, we only stayed one night, which was our plan.

allReviews.title: Retired looking for value and good seevice
allReviews.text: Just wish craps table was open much sooner with $5 minimum during slower play. Slots seemed really tight. My wife played slots for hours and biggest jackpot or bonus was under $100

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here if you’re pregnant!
allReviews.text: I specifically requested on my reservation that I wanted to be assigned to a room closest to the front because I didn’t have a car and also close to a door because I couldn’t walk far because I am very pregnant. Bed was uncomfortable, and pillows were horrible. I would not stay here again and in the past, I always had a great experience. Things must have changed with their service and their furniture/bedding.

allReviews.title: My favorite oasis in the desert
allReviews.text: Awesome place. Every room is spacious and comfortable. The layout for the property makes you feel like you arent in a desert any more. Great pools and an awesome gym. Full gym, not just a treadmill and a few items. This has it all.Depending on the events around your stay, I'd have to say the rooms can vary from hundreds and sometimes thousand. That would be my only problem with the property.

allReviews.title: Meet Me @ The Tuscany
allReviews.text: Huge rooms, comfy beds, good a/c.Excellent food options on site at all hours. Easy walk to strip or sphere.Can't wait to be back. MEET ME AT THE TUSCANY!!!

allReviews.title: Mobilty scooter stolen from Bell Desk
allReviews.text: One would think leaving an item at the bell desk is the safest place you could put it. Not true. Took me four different trips to the bell desk to find out what happened to my scooter. Finally after reviewing the video surveillance they admitted it was stolen. I think the thing that most irks me is no one from the hotel contacted me to follow up.(A person from the security team did contact me, but no manager ever followed up)

allReviews.title: Positive stay
allReviews.text: One night stay at the end of our car tour of the parks. Good location half a mile from the strip within easy walking distance. Hotel with multiple buildings of a few floors. arranged around the pool. Spacious apartments, clean, equipped kitchen. Generously sized bathroom, large and pleasant shower with glass. The only drawback our apartment on the second floor had a view of the adjacent building, close up. Quick, courteous and helpful reception staff. Free car parking.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas adventure
allReviews.text: I had a really nice stay at this hotel. We had everything in the resort. Restorants, casino and pools. Everything was amazing. I loved walking around the resort always something new to see and explore. Room was clean and really comfortable. Staff was nice and helpful.

allReviews.title: Another win!
allReviews.text: Love the location, off the strip!  Rooms, spacious and clean.  Pool lovely and relaxing.  Restaurants, great.  Casino, fun but prefer non-smoking.  Staff, respectful and helpful.  Have been here multiple times.  As has been noted, it’s time for some upgrades and improvements to stay relevant.

allReviews.title: Quiet stay, inexpensive and with all the other cool stuff you like in Vegas
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at Tuscany Suites. We have visited the casino before and seen the Rat Pack and ate at Marilyn's. If I thought that was the best, it isn't - the Hotel is astounding! The room is enormous, the property is huge and well organized (and safe!) It was like staying at a college campus where Buildings are clearly marked and mapped out. The Palm trees make everything feel so much like a resort!The first night we were there, we arrived as the Grateful Dead concert was letting out. So many Deadheads!!! But everyone was having an amazing time and made the property feel cool! The room was quiet even though there were so many people staying there. The room itself was absolutely enormous. We could easily have had 4-6 people sleep in the room. There was a king bed, full sized pull out couch, a large comfy chair as well as a desk and a table and chairs in the kitchenette. The coffee machine didn't work properly and when I advised staff, they replaced it very quickly. There is a fridge that has NOTHING IN IT!!! You can fill it with all the water, Gatorade, beer and liquor you want! The walk to the strip is about 3 blocks so prepare yourself accordingly. But Ellis BBQ is one block away, Hofbräuhaus is about 4 blocks away as well as Harmon Square Mall which has LOTS of food options and the Virgin Hotel/Casino. If you are looking for a quiet stay, inexpensive and with all the other cool stuff you like in Vegas, Tuscany Suites is for you!

allReviews.title: Recommended!!!
allReviews.text: Nice hotel with large, comfortable and nice rooms, has coffee maker, mini bar, free parking and near the strip but the truth that the return with a few beers on top becomes endless haha. Very good value for money.

allReviews.title: A review from a 10 year old
allReviews.text: It was in a certain spot somebody said that it was cleaned, but every other was dry, drawers were  empty, no couch bed, pool was great though, wecame because my 9 year old son's birthday, we meant to go here for 1 night and then we will go to Hawaii.The bathroom door won't close room 118

allReviews.title: Liars and Thieves
allReviews.text: It finally happened where I got screwed by a Vegas hotel and the winner of that is, wait for it, Tuscany Suites. I’m waiting to get into an apartment locally in Vegas as it’s been delayed and needed to stay somewhere for 5 days. Tuscany popped up as an option on Priceline and I thought the rooms would be great to accommodate my remote work. Unfortunately I’ve had to scale back to one credit card as I’m working of debt and this one card I tried to put money on that day, Sunday, for the security deposit. I assumed it would be available right away but I was wrong. So Tuscany refuses to check me in even though I offered to pay double the security deposit on my debit card as a hold that other hotels in Vegas don’t seem to have a problem accepting. Luckily I still had a couple good offers at the Rio (it’s in much better shape these days by the way) so I headed there. Before I left the front desk the  guy working reception assured me they would honor the cancellation and refund my money. With moving expenses I had to use affirm via Priceline for monthly payments as moving is expensive and was waiting on funds to be paid to me for work completed currently and for the past few months. Anyways I call Priceline and apparently Tuscany refused to honor my request and will not give me back my money. Now mind you I offered to pay double on a visa backed debit card for their security deposit and resort fees. The first time my contact from Priceline called they said they didn’t have the money. They next day they said they can’t do anything because payment has already been made. So I’m stuck paying for a stay I was not allowed to use. So for the love of God make sure you have a working credit card otherwise they will cancel your reservation and steal your money. That’s all.

allReviews.title: Visiting for my son's 21st birthday 🎂 🥳
allReviews.text: Loved this place. We stayed Saturday through Tuesday. It was super close to the sphere & everything Las Vegas. Had a great, fun & friendly atmosphere, live music, pool side service, breakfast nook, and bustling casino. Would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Highly recommended hotel to stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel in Las Vegas. spacious rooms with coffee maker in the room and refrigerator. Impeccable cleanliness. Very friendly attention from the staff. Ample parking. The casino is also very quiet. Close to the main street. You have to discover shortcuts that cut the way from the Street to the hotel by going inside the hotels. 100% recommended hotel. Quality-price balance

allReviews.title: Excellent experience
allReviews.text: Very clean and only a couple of blocks from the strip nice pool and staff good food also  the panenies were our favorite we will stay here again I'm not a gambler so I don't know anything about the casino you can see the sphere from the front entrance it's so close

allReviews.title: No elevator,no communication
allReviews.text: They really don’t care for the ADA here. We booked the Da Vinci suite for our wedding week trip so our guests could come spend time with us in the suite. The front desk woman said the elevator was being repaired, which sounded like a one day fix.  It wasn’t  until we spoke with the repairmen working on the elevator, that we were told it was being replaced. No one told us before we booked or offered to rebook another room that wasn’t a third story walk up.  We reserved these rooms eight months in advance, and we were never notified of the elevator replacement. They  were well aware that this was our wedding week.They certainly want your gambling money but this is not a place we’d recommend.

allReviews.title: If you wanna have a hood (projects) experience Tuscany Suites is it.
allReviews.text: The place would be nice if they had control of it, I grew up in the hood so I know what it is like and this here is just it. I felt like I was living back in the project. I understand I’m coming into Vegas, the neighbors were so loud it’s impossible to sleep. So if you want a little sleep Tuscany is not the place! As you will not get any at all. Mind you the dogs they allow people to have is also crazy to me. Sad cuz the place is nice.

allReviews.title: Charming
allReviews.text: This was the second time staying at the Tuscany, and both times did not disappoint! The rooms are spacious and clean, and the cleaning staff did a great job every day of our stay!We love the layout of the facility and it felt like a quiet little community when walking back to our room! The Rat Pack show was great and we loved all the eating facilities!We would definitely recommend the Tuscany and we will be back!

allReviews.title: In need of customer service training.
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our stay several years back so we returned. The rooms are expansive and the restaurant superb. This time wasn't so smooth. The elevator to our second floor room was not functioning, nor was the ice maker. We entered and exited through a fire exit door that said alarm will sound when opened as that was the door that exited to the parking lot. Thankfully it didn't alarm.  I booked a double room and was given a one king instead. When I called the desk they said I could use the pull-out and call when we wanted it fitted with bedding. We called at 8 pm, and were told housekeeping closes at 5 pm. When we pressed the issue they relented, but someone showed up 2 hours later and dropped off sheets but no blanket or pillow. So customer service was abysmal but the rooms are still expansive and the restaurant good.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas style
allReviews.text: Less renowned hotel than more famous names but it really has everything. Beautiful swimming pool, cafe and pub with affordable prices, casino. Very kind staff. Comfortable and super clean rooms. To get to the strip you have to walk 15 minutes but absolutely pleasant. 10 minutes instead from the Sphere

allReviews.title: Very welcoming human-sized hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel on a human scale, unlike the vast majority of other hotels in Las Vegas, with beautiful surrounding vegetation and a pleasant swimming pool, as well as a place to have breakfast, a very pleasant bar with live music and several restaurants.The rooms are distributed in several small 3-story buildings. They are large, well equipped with a small kitchen, quiet and the bedding is great.I highly recommend this hotel, located on the large Flamingo Avenue, 15 minutes from the strip and all its gigantic hotels and diverse and varied restaurants. I will return without any hesitation.

allReviews.title: Great off strip hotel
allReviews.text: This is a great off strip hotel. Perfect if you dont want to hassle with the big casinos, but stay close to the strip. Big rooms, very clean, free parking, great rate, nice staff. We stayed while visiting our son at UNLV. Would stay here again for sure.

allReviews.title: We loved this hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the main strip in Las Vegas.  It was very nice with wonderful restaurants and a nice cafe.  The room was extremely nice, very large, very clean and very quiet.  We were not far from the pool and the fitness room.  Both well kept

allReviews.title: Ok resort
allReviews.text: Overall a nice place off the strip. The guest rooms are fabulous, pool and grounds are kept immaculate. Casino is small, but adequate.Guest services are slow at all times. Food was good in pub, sub par in Marilyn’s with terrible management..would not recommend this restaurant.

allReviews.title: It's Official: This is my go-to hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: When I visit my brother who lives near Las Vegas, I treat him to a hotel stay our last night together. Then I'm close to the airport the next day--we both win! We stayed at Tuscany in September of 2022 (you can see my review posted 9/13/22). Our second stay did not disappoint!Tuscany is still a great value with large, luxurious rooms, with enough distance from the craziness of the strip to be a tranquil oasis, but close enough be within walking distance. Both times staying here, we noticed maintenance people everywhere, fixing this, touching up that, making the place shine. Whatever age the place is, they keep it looking fresh and new. There was a fire alarm at 5:30 am, which was a false alarm, so we went right back to sleep. We found out later that it was someone tampering with the alarm system, so not the hotel's fault. Our only recommendation to the staff is that blackout curtains would be a good added touch. The room's curtains were only translucent, and let in some light in the morning. That wasn't a bother to us, but we thought that some guests might be more light-sensitive (especially if they were out partying the night before). The on-site restaurant (Marilyn's) is convenient, very good, and a good value for breakfast.Unless I'm gifted a penthouse stay in another hotel, this will continue to be THE place I will stay in Las Vegas. They now have my loyalty.

allReviews.title: Not-so-good experience
allReviews.text: The check-in experience was devastating as we were made to wait for 1.5 hrs just for that. We had a cranky baby all the while which the hotel staff didn't pay attention to. When we entered the room, the room was full of burning smell and the shower area also didn't work.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: This is a nice, clean hotel available at good price.Pro:- Price is amazing, even after the resort fee.- The room is so spacious! And mostly really clean - except for the desk chair.- The bathroom is so spacious! Shower and bathtub are separate.- Coffee and breakfast available at the cafe was affordable and good enough. (I heard it's hard to find good coffee at reasonable price in Las Vegas.) Con:- The hotel cafe is attached to the casino, and was filled with cigarette smell. We ended up eating our food on the outside area. I assume that this is a common case with most hotels in Las Vegas.- We noticed dust / white powder on the desk chair. We wiped it ourselves, but questioned why room-keeping wouldn't have cleaned the chair. It was very visible when the room was dark.- No microwave- the 20 min walk to the strip was harder than I thought it would beI would stay at this hotel again if I visit Las Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Great Practical Choice When Staying in Vegas
allReviews.text: While it lacks the glamour and glitz of hotels on The Strip, the Tuscany Suites makes for a great practical choice when visiting Vegas. Location is good less than a mile from the Strip. It's a 15 min walk or a short inexpensive Uber. There is also free parking and the rates at the hotel represented good value for what is offered. Rooms aren't stylish but are large and comfortable. There are 2 pool areas, and the grounds of the hotel are well maintained.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: Tuscany suites was awesome. The rooms are roomy suites. The grounds are very manicured and clean!!  There are two pools, several restaurants, a showroom, pub, bar with live music, and of course a casino. The prices are reasonable since it is off the strip behind the Horseshoe. Very nice staff. Fitness center open 24’. Very comfort and clean rooms. Definitely will stay again.

allReviews.title: Wow... super!
allReviews.text: 3rd time in Las Vegas and I have to say this is a great hotel. Giant and clean room, very comfortable bed, fridge, TV, air conditioning in the room, excellent Wi-Fi. Parking available for free which in Las Vegas is a luxury. Quiet and peaceful area even if close to the road. Nearby places and restaurants for both eating and shopping (supermarket). Friendly and helpful staff. It seems to be in a tourist village. In 10 to 15 minutes you arrive on the Strip (on the corner with the Paris and the Flamingo so to speak). Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Wonderful 4 years ago...hasty woman at front desk.
allReviews.text: I really loved this place in 2019 and 2020 when I stayed there. It was great. I showed up with no reservation and got a fantastic room at a great price, and I was able to pay cash, which was wonderful, because I was bankrupt at the time and had no credit card.I attempted to do the same thing earlier today, however, the policy must have changed in the last four years.The front desk agent said she couldn't take cash for a deposit, so I took out my bank card, she said she couldn't take it because it's a debit card, even though it's a Navy Federal CREDIT UNION card. So, I pulled out my little pathetic $300 limit card, and then she began becoming rude and told me it's not a credit card that it was a prepaid debit card, even though I deposit zero dollars into it and pay it off ...so, I told her about my previous stays and she would not help me and was really rude she almost got to calling security over. I wish I had gotten her name, or asked to speak to a manager, but I just booked another room on my phone and had no issues when I checked in.  So, I intend to book online next time just to see what happens. Never in my life have I been treated like a deadbeat while I have six figures in the bank.

allReviews.title: Good hotel...
allReviews.text: The rooms are really spacious and the staff pleasant.The hotel, even without being on the strip, remains rather well placed.The fact that there is free parking is much appreciated.On the other hand, the soundproofing is not good and the beds are really narrow... 😔

allReviews.title: GREAT hotel, very close to the strip!
allReviews.text: LOVED this hotel! Tuscany Suites was a 10 minute walk to the strip, so all of  the excitement without the noise and craziness. Beautiful big rooms, free parking and wonderful pool area. Will definitely stay again on our next trip to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Oasis in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great hotel, just off the Strip. Spacious with many hotel blocks, a maximum of three floors in a green environment. The focus is more on the hotel stay than on the casino. Unlike many other hotels where you have to go through the casino to your room. Excellent restaurants available. Nice and tidy swimming pool. Very spacious room

allReviews.title: Very disappointed
allReviews.text: Booked this hotel because of an artist playing there and the pools. Arrived to find the main pool under construction for the 2 weeks we were there and the spa heated pool’s heater was broken so not able to use this one either. The hot tub filter was broken and not able to use that for several days. There were only 5 loungers and 4 chairs by spa pool and we as well as other guests had to sit on the ground. The musical artist we came to see that they advertised on their website hadn’t played there for months. The 2 star rating is because the food is excellent at the restaurants. Would not recommend this hotel as their website was not up to date and vey misleading.

allReviews.title: Nice property a few blocks off the strip
allReviews.text: This is a very nice family-owned property a few blocks off the strip, and close to the Sphere. The restaurants have good food and friendly staff. The rooms are very clean and larger than most, and have a small kitchen table, cupboards, small sink, coffeemaker, and small fridge. The only minor complaint is with the bathroom. The bathtub and shower are separate, but the shower stall has no lighting in it and is very dark. The only light comes from the lighting over the vanity sink, which is nowhere near enough. There is a heat lamp in the ceiling of the bathroom which provides more light, but made the bathroom way too warm. Also, for the ladies, there is no makeup mirror. Other than these minor issues, our stay was great.

allReviews.title: Grandson's 21st birthday trip
allReviews.text: I last stayed at this property in 2019. Five years later, it's just as great. Well-kept grounds that are adjacent to the strip (not too far to walk, not too expensive to Uber), a quiet space near the action. Good mattresses, spacious rooms, good restaurants onsite. The coffee shop is a gem! Nice pools and hot tub. 100% will stay again.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel just off The Strip.
allReviews.text: Very clean property, large roomy suites, loved having a mini frig and in room coffee maker.  The hotel buidings were secure and the grounds were nicely kept.  A good location off The Strip, but The Strip was only a 15 -20 minute walk away. A good value.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: Clean, comfortable. Huge well equipped room with small kitchen area (fridge and coffee machine). Two king sized beds, full bathroom with separate toilet. Housekeeping every day. Lovely grounds, two pools - the lap pool was closed for maintenance on two of the days we were there.  We were in block N - it was quiet. Had food in both Pub 365 and Marilyn's Cafe - good quality, tasty, big portions and very reasonably priced.  Fifteen minute walk to the strip. (If you have a Deuce bus ticket you can use the local bus 202 to hop to the hotel from the strip). Rebecca M in Marilyn's was the stand out member of staff, friendly, helpful and answered all our Vegas questions.

allReviews.title: Oasis is a busy city!
allReviews.text: QuietBeautifulPeaceful and calmRoom was hushedGood sleepingWe enjoyed our Break Break days!Had great meals in Marilyn’s The Casino was just our speed!!Only half an hour from home!!We look forward to many more weekend get aways!We would really recommend to visitors or stay-cations!!!

allReviews.title: This is A True Value For Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Friendly staff, huge room. Reasonable prices for the room during the week on Booking.com A true Vegas Value. I will return again. I can't say enough about this hotel. As we traveled around to the national parks our last night and stayed  at the Madi Gras in Las Vegas. Compared to Tuscany Suites we wanted to cry. I'm sorry I missed the Rat Pack Show at the Tuscany. I also wanted to sit by the stone fire place outside the pool area. I loved the separate shower and tub. That was wonderful. This was truly a suite.

allReviews.title: Stay away from this hotel
allReviews.text: Horrible - would rate a 0/5 if possibleBooked 4 nights for a family trip, and was told to stay either in a smoking room or a room without elevator (no apology at all - stay or go) Chose a room without elevator (not a big problem for us) But on the second day, the front desk said the room went out of service,  and we must switch to another room by 3pm, otherwise all personal items will be removed by security. (Again no apology at all). After checking out, I got a bill with all mistakes. I was charged multiple times for all sorts of fees and taxes. Incidentals were not properly charged as pending transaction but posted transaction. The money taken out from my card cannot reconcile with what front desk told me. Stay away from this hotel!

allReviews.title: BED BUGS!
allReviews.text: There were Bed bugs here!  Stayed here with my son for a baseball tournament. Our room had bedbugs. I reported it to management and they filed a report with their “security team.” hotel management was horrible in dealing with it. I reported them to the Las Vegas Department of health.

allReviews.title: Fantastic in every way that matters (to me)
allReviews.text: My girlfriend and I had a great experience here.  We went to see U2 at the Sphere and this is just a short walk away.  We could see the Sphere from just outside the building.  It was my first time in Vegas and I was concerned that everything would smell like cigarette smoke, even though we booked a non-smoking room.  We were in a whole non-smoking building, and even in the casino, where we could see people smoking, the ventilation was so good it didn't bother us.  The pool and hot tub were nice.  We had a couple nice breakfast and lunches at one of the cafes onsite.  The room was big and comfy.  The vegas strip is close enough to be an easy walk, and far enough that you can get a break from it if all feels a bit manic and superficial after the heart-opening profundity of seeing U2 at the Sphere.  I will definitely be back here.

allReviews.title: Unethical staff and management
allReviews.text: Not the place you want to bring your family or even your spouse. This hotel on the weekend of 2/15 is host to a sex conference with suites being used for group sex. NOT somewhere you want your family around. Management and leadership know about this and have done nothing. We took our stuff and left

allReviews.title: Lack of information and building site
allReviews.text: The hotel itself is good, the restaurants serve very good food and it's very well priced.The rooms are big and clean.  It's very close to the strip My reason for the score is simply due to the fact we were not told about the building work at the main pool, so it was very disappointing to have to sit in a construction site. On CHECK OUT I was told about a smaller lap pool which was open . No good to me on checkout!!!! I was only told too because I voiced my complaint,  shame this could be an amazing place

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here!
allReviews.text: Worst hotel experience ever! Checked in just to have no hot water or working wifi. Had to take a cold shower before dinner and came back 2 hours later to the water still not fixed then when I was in the bathroom some guy barged in without knocking to finally fix the water. Then I’m about to go to sleep and a jack hammer starts going outside my room and had to drive back to the front desk and switch rooms and after all that they offer me 25$ food coupon as I’m leaving. DONT STAY HERE! A motel will be nicer and treat you better

allReviews.title: A hidden gem! We chose it because it was within walking distance to the Sphere, and were beyond thrilled!!
allReviews.text: A hidden gem! We chose it because it was within walking distance to the Sphere, and were beyond thrilled!!

allReviews.title: Nice stay at the Tuscany.
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights of our 5 night vacation. Hotel is clean. Rooms are large with plenty of space. Refrigerator is nice to have in the room. One of my biggest complaints of hotels and found the same here…time to reinvest in your television. The tv was small for such a large room. I know people don’t spend alot of time in their hotel room but we like to turn it on in the morning before heading out. Anyway…will definitely return to Tuscany Casino and Hotel as it’s clean, everyone was friendly and it’s close to just about everything.

allReviews.title: Not a Single Night's Rest
allReviews.text: We liked the hotel facilities but our room's soundproofing was extremely inadequate. We were kept awake every night of our stay as the guest in the room above was very heavy-footed and constantly pacing, emanating in incessant and annoyingly loud thumping through our ceiling every night and all night from dinner hours through sunrise. Only in the mid-afternoons were we unable to get any rest. We  contemplated requesting a different room but I was recovering from a medical procedure and felt that moving to a different room would have been too risky. Therefore we held out hope for a different guest to check in, but we weren't that fortunate and instead endured the noise for the duration of our stay.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Hotel!!!
allReviews.text: Always a great stay, this is an awesome hotel.  Marilyn's and Pub 365 are amazing, and the casino is pretty good too.The suites themselves are very spacious and are very clean.  And it is a quick walk to the Strip.  This is not my first time here, and I will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: ancient, noisy heat/air unit in room--fan blades made a racket, needed ear plugs
allReviews.text: The biggest problem was the old heating and air conditioning unit that needs servicing. It kept cycling on and off because the fan blades were loose or warped and made a huge racket. I turned the heat up when I left so that it would be warm when I returned and I wouldn't have to listen to it as much. And I slept with ear plugs. I told management about it; they said there was nothing wrong with the unit. So I assume all their units are in poor repair because they can't/won't recognize a problem.I paid $600 for 5 nights. I liked that it was a few blocks from the strip rather than being right in the thick of things. About a 15 min walk to the strip. I had a non-smoking room that was clean and didn't smell. Though the hallways were musty from both smoking and moisture issues--it rained for 3 of the 6 days and water seeped in the doorways.

allReviews.title: Best kept secret in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This is my home away from home , I am an owner at a Las Vegas resort and kften I find myself booking with the Tuscany, it's like having a time share without the mostly fees.. it afford an excellent view , plenty of game play , they have even added table games and yet not so much that it distracts from the ambience that is ,, the Tuscany. They ha e a very nice sports.bar PUB 365 , try the Unicorn beer and Burger I recommend it 😎, plan the petrct clioles.get away and ennis the Rst pack show it will make your stay memorable. Who know I might even see you there ..

allReviews.title: If you don’t like peaceful rest, this is the place for you
allReviews.text: I was excited cause the room is huge and felt clean. but i can’t sleep because all you hear are people fkn in one room, and people stomping around from 4 to 7 am in the room above me. no rest. no peace. i’m exhausted. This was a total price gouge rip off. never in my right mind would i stay here again

allReviews.title: Great option with a car
allReviews.text: I flew solo from Fri night late to Wed and Tuscany worked out great for me. Nice big room that smelled nice, complete with kitchenette (you can ask for a microwave apparently. I wished I thought to ask for one). I liked that the rooms are sprawled out in separate buildings with your own free parking right outside, which I loved as a nice base of operations for the city. It's off the strip, the streets are all multi-lanes with tons of traffic - you can't really walk anywhere. So if you have a car, stay at Tuscany. The downside to the separate buildings, is the casino, restaurants, fitness, pools are a bit of walk. It poured the whole time I was there so that sucked, but the room was cozy even tho the TV was tiny and annoying. There is free wifi that is limited to 5mps. You can pay $10 for faster speed, but that still wasn't really fast enough. So parking was free (yes!) but functional wifi had a fee (boo!). I ate alot at the 365 pub. Decent food, a ton of draft beer choices, not crazy expensive. As I discovered in Vegas in general, people don't really talk to you so I sat at the bar chatting with the bartenders mostly. Marilyns place had good breakfast and other cheap options. I didn't eat at the nice restaurant. The lounge has happy hour everyday with half priced martinis every night. Yum. And live music every night although it's kinda lame lounge act stuff. But hey, live music is live music. I didn't check out the Rat Pack show but it looked fun.   The casino was smoking but they ventilate very well for casinos. I wasn't gagging at all walking through it to get to restaurants. The fitness room was dated and kind of dirty but I made due. I didn't use the spa. Since it was raining I didn't use the pool or hottub, although the hotub looked awesome. So overall, I'd say stay at Tuscany if you have a family and a car. Definitely reasonable cost, you can trust the positive reviews, and it makes for a great base to explore the city.

allReviews.title: Nice rooms but…
allReviews.text: Stayed for two nights in early February.  I selected the hotel because the prices were reasonable, there was free parking and the Rat Pack is Back show is in the Copa Room.  The rooms are in several different buildings.  The plus is you don’t get casino noise.  The down side is that it feels more apartment complex or dorms than resort.  The room was huge and clean without smelling like bleach.  The water was hot but our shower drain was slow.  A microwave would have been helpful.  We had an individual approach us on our third floor hallway asking us to smell a shirt he was holding out, which was odd and predatory.  We made it into our room without incident but didn’t feel great this individual was either an odd guest or had made it into the secured L building at the back of the facility.  I reported to security and they said they were sending someone to investigate.  I presume they did but they never followed up with us.  I should have asked to be moved to make my daughter feel safer but our room was secure.  The area around the pool is nice if you manage to get a room closer to that area.

allReviews.title: Excellent meal
allReviews.text: Super meal included with the ticket to the Rat Trap cabaret. Excellent service from our lovely waiter. Had a soup starter and steak for main and a delicious pudding. Could not fault it. We were surprised at the excellent meal included in the ticket for the show as we're inexpensive tickets.

allReviews.title: BEWARE - sharp metal objects in pillow
allReviews.text: Beware of sharp metal staples and pins in their pillows. Scratched myself on the hand (easily could have been on face or neck) just by moving the pillow around, light bleeding. After notifying reservations/front desk they didn't seem to take the issue seriously, asked me to call their security team.

allReviews.title: Will stay here next visit to Vegas
allReviews.text: Had an excellent stay at the Tuscany!  Check in staff were friendly and helpful, room was very clean and housekeeping did a great job.All rooms are located in separate buildings from the casino so nice and quiet.  Courtyard areas are well kept.  The entire facility from casino to restaurants to washrooms kept very clean.About a 10 minute walk to the Strip, you can see the Sphere from the front of the hotel if you want to get some pictures.

allReviews.title: Oracle conference
allReviews.text: I paid $USD 150.00 that was to be refunded within three days of my church out, but upto now I was not paid my refund of $USD 150.00 and not getting any feedback regardless of many messages sent. I am requesting for the refund.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Rooms are huge and beds very comfortable.  It is quiet and well appointed.  The bathroom has a separate toilet area, tub and separate shower.  Beautiful.  We were in Building B which is close to the lobby.  I would recommend that.  The property is very large and some buildings are quite a walk from the main area.  There is a kitchen area with a pod coffee maker and a small fridge.  It would be helpful to have a microwave.  We are both tea drinkers and asked for a kettle and were advised they don't have any.  We were able to make tea a cup at a time by running water through the coffee maker.  I didn't like that the conference room smelled of the smoke from the casino below.  If I can do a separate review on the "spa" I will, but there is no spa, just a room for massage, which was not great. The pool area is lovely with comfy chairs and the pool is nicely heated so I enjoyed swimming, even in December.  Hot tub was great.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel.
allReviews.text: The suites are set up with several buildings throughout the property. The property is very green with lots of planting.  The property is located centrally and within a couple of blocks from the main strip.Each suite is very spacious, as you can see from my attached pictures. There is a casino attached to the property.

allReviews.title: What a nice property!
allReviews.text: We spent the night here on Dec 5, booking 2 rooms for ourselves and friends traveling with us.  Both rooms lived up to the description completely!  They were truly HUGE!  And VERY quiet.  The beds were comfortable, albeit not 'new' but nothing to complain about either.  Bathroom was big and had a shower and a seperate tub, very uncommon anymore in hotel rooms.  We could have used a couple extra towels but I should have asked when checking in.  Everything was really nice.  No lines and we didn't have to walk through a casino to get to the lobby - a big PLUS for me.  We parked right out front and had absolutely no issues at all.  I would absolutely recommend this place if wanting something off the strip with great prices - book on their website, it's cheaper than the 3rd party apps.We ate at the Pub - decent prices and a great happy hour too! For breakfast we ate at Marilyns, equally had decent prices and quick service.  The pool and hot tub were closed, which was too bad, I really wanted to check them out.  Next time!We walked to and from the strip.  There were a lot of people doing the same.  We walked back to the hotel about 10pm and there were no sketch people anywhere we saw.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay.
allReviews.text: Stayed for three nights on a trip to see U2 at the sphere. I was really glad I stayed a bit off the strip with the F1 construction in full force. This hotel was very quiet comfortable and clean. The pool area was lovely. Room was big and everything was functional. Check in and out were easy. Liked that the casino was set apart so you didn’t have to walk through it. Only complaint was that it was hard to get something to drink by the pool in the afternoon. Nothing was open except for inside the casino.

allReviews.title: Think twice about staying at Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites is on the edge of a seedy area and there were sketchy individuals walking past this property at all hours of the day and night. My car was parked in the lot along Flamingo Ave and I discovered that during the night someone tried to pry open its trunk, leaving obvious damage. I informed the manager on duty and she didn’t seemed surprised, just told me parking there was at my own risk and to go down the hall and file a report with security, which I didn’t see any advantage of doing. If I could do it over I’d book a hotel closer to the Strip which offered a parking garage so my car would be safer. Beware!

allReviews.title: Rest near the Strip
allReviews.text: A wonderfully laid back hotel in the middle of the city. The suites are located in different low-rise buildings. Nice spacious rooms. The pool is very relaxed and there is a nice cafe with good coffee and breakfasts to take away. The casino is next door, you don't walk through it at all. It is a lot quieter and nicer than the gigantic hotels on the strip. It's only a 10-minute walk to the hustle and bustle there.

allReviews.title: Good stays at Tuscany
allReviews.text: When I was moving I stayed off an on at the Tuscany Suites. I felt it was an excellent hotel. Spacious rooms, comfortable beds, up-to-date TVs, nice sofas. Overall great. My only complaint was I couldn't bring my dog with me. Went to the swimming pool, nice. Had margaritas at pool side. For breakfast I was able to get croissants (although they serve other things) and latte at their cafe. I also ate breakfast in their restaurant. The cost was reasonable and the staff was great.

allReviews.title: USS Grayback Reunion
allReviews.text: The room was very large and more than adequate for our stay.  The coffee maker was a nice feature that was used.  We did not need to use the frig with so many eating places nearby. The large bathroom was nicely arranged with a separate door for the stool, separate tub and shower and an adequate wash sink.

allReviews.title: Very nice stay
allReviews.text: Comfortable room. The bed had the right amount of firmness. We had a delicious breakfast at Marilyn's Cafe located inside the casino. Great central location, just off the strip. Parking was available just outside the building we stayed in. They had several buildings that were on the property. We stayed in Building N. It had a resort-type look to it.

allReviews.title: Off-strip fine
allReviews.text: We arrived around 6pm. Had done pre-check-in online and the queue wasn't long. There was some confusion about resort fees and credit card hold. We only stayed one night as it was close to our event - a 15-min walk to the Sphere. Room was spacious and clean. Staff around lobby were friendly and helpful - more so than at other Strip hotels we stayed at.

allReviews.title: A great time.
allReviews.text: My room was very large with sitting area,  kitchen table, fridge and wet bar. The bathroom had a standup shower as well as a tub. The room was very clean. The pool area was nice and relaxing. I liked that the casino was small and not so noisy like the strip. I would recommend if you want to be a little bit away from strip. I will definitely book again. I tried for December but they were full.

allReviews.title: Reunion
allReviews.text: Someone opened our door and started to walk in. I yelled door shut and a voice said sorry checking phones. Front desk didn't know anything about that. Wife was filled by someone after she wouldn't let them into the gym. Told maintenance guys and he ran off. Room smelled of alcohol each time we walked in.

allReviews.title: Super Oasis in the middle of Vegas!
allReviews.text: We hold our Reunion and Memorial for Black Lions here every year because the personnel are so friendly and the prices at the various restaurants are not inflated like at other Strip Hotels. The Bell Captain (Sonny) was unbelievably helpful at a high stress situation and deserves a commendation. Daiwa, the pool waitress, is one of the nicest and most cheerful and helpful employees anyone could hope for. I love this place and so do my Viet Nam Buddies from 28th Infantry Regiment of the 1st Infantry Division. God Bless you all.

allReviews.title: For an atmosphere like in the south
allReviews.text: Beautiful suite and above all clean. Affordable restaurants with daily menu. Welcoming casino. 10 minutes from the strip. Everything is easy to access. Beautiful landscaping with palm trees and lots of landscaping. Very pleasant. Do not hesitate to choose this location.

allReviews.title: A full house of amenities
allReviews.text: Very pleased with the Tuscany --from the rooms and all the other amenities the resort has to offer.  One hardly needs to leave the premises as everything from food to entertainment is available, not to mention a beautify pool environment and exercising room for those that like to keep in shape.

allReviews.title: Nice quiet place.
allReviews.text: I checked in Online and let it be known that it was our anniversary.  When I arrived I was asked for all IDs again and told no rooms would be available until 3 PM.  At 4 PM we got our room, no mention of our anniversary and were charged an additional $150 damage deposit.  This is the 3rd time we are staying with you, we are Henderson residents and retirees.  No other hotel anywhere in the US ever charged us a damage fee.  Yes it was reversed but it makes your hotel appear to be an unsafe place to stay.  Also why would I bother to do anything online and then have to do it all over again when I arrive?  Know your customer.

allReviews.title: Good hotel but nuisances which spoiled our stay
allReviews.text: The hotel is huge like most hotels in Vegas and a little off the strip. The rooms are very spacious, not very modern but very pleasant with a large bathroom. The bedding is quality. Unfortunately when we were there we had a very noisy first room, door slamming constantly, infernal elevator noise every 5 minutes. We asked to change rooms but despite the change it was still noisy due to the air conditioner and the day and night exterior work in connection with next month's Formula 1 event. No insulation. We barely slept for 3 days. This is why I cannot give more than 3 stars even if the value for money for Vegas is good.

allReviews.title: Overall fun!
allReviews.text: As always we had a great time at one of our favorite hotel casinos. The staff is always polite and unhelpful . The atmosphere, the gambling, and restaurants were all great. We had a awesome dinner at Tuscany Gardens which has great steaks and Italian dishes. The gaming floor was clean and inviting.

allReviews.title: Great staff
allReviews.text: Clean and comfortable off the strip casino with hospitable staff.  Food was good if a bit pricey but generous portions. Pool has cabanas and plenty of seating. Accommodating to my group of friends and family.

allReviews.title: Memorable
allReviews.text: Checkin service is fast. Staff are nice. The happiest thing is that the room is quite large. The place is quiet since casino is on the other side. It made me so relax at the moment when we were there.

allReviews.title: NSLA
allReviews.text: We come every year since 2019. Tuscany has been a great resort and venue. My favorite place to stay in Las Vegas. I prefer not to stay right on the strip and Tuscany has all the amenities I like for a comfortable, relaxing get away, whether it is business or extended stay for some fun.

allReviews.title: Great smaller and quiet all-suites hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying in Tuscany Suites about a week ago in Las vegas. But I really liked about the hotel these days is that there's no gambling machine noise in the hotel portion of the hotel. The hotel is reasonably quiet and nicely appointed. The suite rooms are extremely good sized it would be good for a group of people.The price that I paid for the hotel was also extremely reasonable when compared to other properties located in a similar area.I've stayed here several times in the past but liked it enough this time that I was compelled to write a review.

allReviews.title: Book here!
allReviews.text: Not luxury rooms but the beds were nice and rooms were spacious. Pool area was nice. Just hate it closed at 10pm. There is a cafe on site for coffee and pastries at a reasonable price. The people were wonderful. Book here!

allReviews.title: Fun, friendly and convenient
allReviews.text: Had a really enjoyable stay at the Tuscany resort. The rooms are spacious and well maintained. The staff are very friendly, especially the team at Pub 365. The hotel is conveniently located just a few minutes walk from the main strip. Check-in and out were quick.  Overall a very pleasant stay away from the main hustle and bustle but close enough to be there in a few minutes.

allReviews.title: Tuscany is yet to let me down
allReviews.text: I have stayed at Tuscany several times now, during Vegas visits, and honestly speaking Tuscany is yet to let me down.  If you are sick of being treated like "just a number" by the major chains, and if you prefer a more relaxing and less crowded experience, then give Tuscany a try.  It's an old school and "treated like a person" kind of guest experience that I totally like.  And the property is very fairly priced for the room size and location, and very well maintained.  Oh, and by the way, the casino slots are usually set very fair when compared to strip properties.

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: Our weekend getaway! The best place to be! It’s 10 minutes walk from the central Las Vegas Strip.  Has comfortable rooms, free gym and parking. Has beautiful swimming pool and jacuzzi and great dining and entertainment.

allReviews.title: Great little Gem - Locals Vibe
allReviews.text: This place is a gem, if you are more laid-back and do not want the loud music pool party experience.They welcome families too, which was nice. We brought our toddler and had a great stay.The rooms were clean and big, and the bed was nice, although a little too firm for my liking. The only thing about our room is there was a little light that crept in from the window, that the curtains would not cover to the end past the window. That was my only annoyance, because I sleep in a blacked-out room at home. The food was great, I ordered a prime rib special from the diner downstairs, that was amazing. Breakfast the next morning was good too. And - I played slots, and won enough money to cover our expenses, so overall I was very happy with our visit!

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites has it all
allReviews.text: This resort has it all- beautiful all around.  Peaceful, comfortable, clean with all the amenities you could ever want.  Sometimes you just do not want to be on the strip.  This is a perfect place to stay.

allReviews.title: We had a great stay
allReviews.text: We had an excellent stay at the Tuscany Suites. The rooms were spacious and clean. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the towels are old and need to be replaced and we could have used a small microwave oven.  We tried the coffee shop, cafe and sports bar and had a lovely experience in each of them. The pool looked great but was very crowded.

allReviews.title: Nice Trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: Very large hotel complex. Sufficient parking spaces available free of charge. Very large room with separate seating area, desk, small kitchen with fridge. A coffee machine with pads is also available. The bed is very large and comfortable. Large bathroom with separate shower.Everything very clean. The entire complex and the hotel are very clean and well maintained. The staff is very friendly. The casino invites you to linger. Pub 365 is also very good. Large beer selection. The food is also very good. 10 min. walk to the Strip.

allReviews.title: Upgrades needed
allReviews.text: Room was a nice size, TV was too small for the room, no good cable channels, bathroom had some previous guest boxers & shirt left in there (nasty & trifling), no microwave 🙄🤔. Updates are needed bad

allReviews.title: Won’t stay again
allReviews.text: First room I was put in had spiders, even found a couple in my bed and in my pillow. I asked the front desk for a new room and the woman who was assisting me was very rude and said there were no rooms left for me to switch. She had an accent and long hair. Didn’t get her name. House keeping came and found another spider so I went back to the front desk 20 min later and the gentleman was very kind and immediately gave me a new room after she said there were no more rooms left for me to move to. I was offered to speak to a manager but never saw one. All the rooms are very outdated and smell like mildew. I won’t stay again. Especially after how the first woman treated me. Horrible attitude.

allReviews.title: Great place. Mehh food.
allReviews.text: Overall, it’s a great place. Good service, facilities, and location. Only negative is the food at Marilyn’s Cafe is  kinda mehh. Of course it’s priced accordingly, so I guess you get what you pay for!

allReviews.title: A very pleasant  stay as always
allReviews.text: As always, a very pleasant stay. Good breakfast at Marilyns Cafe with a very friendly staff. Some very minor remarks for room O206:- In the bedside lamp was one of the bulbs not working.- Make sure the correct amenities are placed and not 2 conditioners and no shampoo.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Reunion
allReviews.text: We were at Tuscany for a reunion.  We arrived at 10:00 AM on a Monday morning.  I knew that we would not get a room at 10:00 AM, the ladies at the front desk said it would be 3:00PM before we could get our room.  I checked our bags with the bell hop and we walked to the strip.  Spent a few hours at the strip and returned to the hotel at 2:00 PM.  Our hospitality suite for the reunion was in building "G" so we had to get a key to allow us access to our hospitality suite and when we got the key to "G" I inquired about or room, still not ready.  I went to the hospitality suite and met up with 3 other couples for our reunion and to my surprise they had been assigned a room, and had just arrived at the hotel, now I wonder why I have been at the hotel 5 hours and still do not have a room.  I go back to the front desk, and I am told it will be 5:00 PM for my room, to say the least I was UPSET.  Asked to see a supervisor.  Explained the issue and it takes him about 5 minutes to find us a room and get us checked in.  We are assigned to building "J", so now we have two different set of keys.  Had to have key reloaded twice because the key for "G" kept failing and the key for "J" would only allow us entry on one end of the building.  We had plans for Friday morning late an early afternoon.  After breakfast around 9:30 we attempted to open the safe and it will not open "low battery warning" I contact the front desk and ask to have someone come open the safe, they send a Maintenace man.  He can't get the safe open and tells us they will have to force the safe open, after an hour wait another guy shows up and spends almost an hour attempting to force the door open, does not have the correct tools and has to go get more tools.  Come back and finally gets the safe open but the door is not no good.  The entire safe has to be replaced, third man shows up with a new safe and it takes almost an hour to replace the safe.  Bottom line we can finally leave the room at 2:30 PM and have lost all of our plans for the day.  I stayed at Tuscany every summer from 2000 to 2007 for a week and it was super.  This place has gone downhill in a hurry, Casino is a mess with only machines no live tables, restaurants are a mess, we went to 365 for dinner on Friday night, got a table and waited 35 minutes after we ordered and still had not received our DRINKS.  ONLY ONE WAITER, one bar tender and one bar back on a Friday Night ??????????.  It should have been a warning sign to me that there were only about 6 other customers in the place when we sat down.  Needless to say, we left and went elsewhere for dinner.Sorry Tuscany you are off of my list of places to stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Steven's 21st Birthday
allReviews.text: It was a clean and large room. We were accommodated with our room requests and had a great time!  The staff was wonderful and very nice.  They even remembered us as we walked through to the Casino and bantered with my son about turning 21. It was a great stay and the pool was perfect, including the towel and drink staff as well as clean restrooms near the pool.

allReviews.title: Affordable, Friendly and Very Clean
allReviews.text: Very Friendly Atmosphere Very Clean & QuietGuest Service was outstandingAll amenities were available on siteGreat location - Very Secure - Ample Parking - Rooms were spacious- Beds were very comfortable

allReviews.title: Little gem off the Strip with human beings
allReviews.text: We are normally used to the big names on the Strip in Vegas we were are attending every year an industry convention. Last year we really felt ripped off : crazy prices, attitude toward tips and loss in the quality in general made us feel really frustrated. so this year we tried something different : the Tuscany. And boy!! that was a very good call. The hotel is situated off the Strip but only 15/20 mins walk from Sands Expo, it is very good as in some massive hotels at a closer range, it takes you 10/15 mins to get out. So it's a match here. The hotel is full of coherence. By that, it stands for what it is and doesn't pretend otherwise thru plastic accessories. It is a very nice hotel : the rooms are big, clean and comfy, made daily thru a great team of cleaners always kind, the restaurants are good and offer excellent value for money, way above the big names. Kudos on the choice for local beers. The gym is well maintained and 24/7. We didn't try the pools but heard good things about them. The staff is very helpful, kind and laid back. This is the first time we are talking to knowledgeable people with a smile in a relaxed atmosphere - far from the pretending-to-be-exclusive fancy artificial places where an AI (maybe without the I) could run the show.  The bottom line is : if the Tuscany stays what it is  - a human managed / nice and very decent place to stay without the buzz and whistles - we will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Every time we stay at Tuscany it is Fantastic!!!!!!
allReviews.text: Tuscany is a Great hotel! The Staff is Fantastic from Check in & House keeping is Great! Check out is easy & Facility's are super! I cannot say enough good things about Tuscany Suites & Casino!!!!! We stay at  Tuscany every couple years & it's always a Great Place to stay!!!!! No better place to stay in Las Vegas, Location Price & facility's & Staff are by far the best in Vegas!!!!

allReviews.title: Hidden fees and security do not do there job.
allReviews.text: When we checked in there were only two people helping. As I stood in line for about 15 minutes two other people walked up and broke in line to check out. They were told by a Gentleman that worked there that if they needed to see a clerk they had to wait. One did not and the receptionist still helped him even after the security guard let him have a free ride also. Everyone in line was not happy. Next the $46 a day resort fee is a joke. I have already paid you to stay there and now I am charged another $221. This hidden fee made my decision about ever coming back to your resort.

allReviews.title: Grayback reunion. We have had several thee at Tuscany and will return in 2025.
allReviews.text: The front desk help with keys they kept deactivating each day and I’d go to desk and they reprogrammed them. Marilyn’s restaurant was a regular to get things I could eat with my eating disorder. Was visiting during ur 40th anniversary and attended the Rat Pack program. Another fabulous display of talent.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem in Vegas
allReviews.text: Very happy with everything. Friendly and helpful staff. Everything perfectly clean. They let us check in earlier which was very appreciated after 3 nights of camping. Breakfast was delicious. Room very spacious and a bathtub was a nice little bonus. Definitely coming back

allReviews.title: great hotel at a good price
allReviews.text: hotel with casino among the palm trees, excellent location - very close to the main streets in the center, comfortable rooms, nice interior of the hotel, nice and helpful service, relaxation at the pool

allReviews.title: Loved it
allReviews.text: We stayed here whilst in Vegas for a couple of nights. Apart from us getting lost a couple times (I can’t follow map directions) the complex was perfect. It isn’t too far from the strip but far enough away to not hear the hustle and bustle. Our bedroom was large and comfortable with coffee making facilities and a fridge. The bathroom was clean and tidy and well laid out. We loved staying here and will be back on our next adventure to Vegas. We never got to use the pool, but it was always busy in there and looked absolutely lovely

allReviews.title: The staff makes all the difference
allReviews.text: The staff is exceptional. The desk staff was so helpful and kind. The bar staff were friendly without going overboard.I had a beautiful room with a view of the pool and as a solo traveler the presence of uniformed security was reassuring.

allReviews.title: This place is great!
allReviews.text: We love the Italian restaurant here. Food was amazing and the Rat pack is back did not disappoint. Love the hotel.  It was clean and large rooms to relax in.  Pool was great after a lot of walking.  We became rewards members and received free coffee and discounts for the resort. Great view of the sphere

allReviews.title: Enjoy play slots there n eating
allReviews.text: The rooms are very nice and clean. The outside of the hotel was very nice the staff there were very helpful and friendly like the food at the pub and Maryland’s. There are a lot of parking stalls and overall nice environment.

allReviews.title: Exceeded Expecations
allReviews.text: Beautiful grounds, pool, fire tables.Spacious and functional room with large refrigerator and the windows open 🙌Very professional and attentive staff.Very clean with regular cleaning of common areas.Great dining options.Felt safe with active security presence.We didn't have to leave the place for anything.

allReviews.title: FUN
allReviews.text: ENJOYED MY STAY . COMFORTABLE CASE AND GREAT CAFE . UTS A REAKKT NICE PLACE TO HAVE FUN AND STAY. PARKING COULD  USE MORELIGHTING SOME PLACES ARE SUPER DARKIN THE BACK.COFFEE SHOP IN THE MORNING HAS THE BEST OATMEAL AND I MEAN THE BEST. 'ONE OF MY FAVORITE PLACES TO BE

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: We loved this resort so much we didn’t leave for four days. We met many amazing humans, both guests and employees alike. We aren’t really Vegas people but we will return to the Tuscany Suites for sure

allReviews.title: Fun and relaxing.
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites is the place to stay when you want to save and pay for the value you get.I love staying at The Tuscany. The rooms are big enough and very comfortable. This place has all the amenities you need. Multiple bars and restaurants. The atmosphere is clean. They have two pools and a gym. The Tuscany is a half mile from the strip but definitely walking distance. This is the place to stay.

allReviews.title: Stuck in the back
allReviews.text: They put me in a building in the ass-end of the parking lot.  Every morning at 6am I was awakened by the F1 bleachers being built.  Pretty awful all things given.  And they don't use toilet seals so sitting on a toilet at this place is a little bit like a rocking chair.   My third or 4th stay here, and I’ve pretty much had my limit of tomfoolery.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: I have stayed at The Tuscany for over 20 years. Everyone is so welcoming and friendly, beautiful relaxing hotel. The casino hostesses are amazing, food at Marlyn, 365 pub is good. Tuscany Gardens Italian restaurant is beautiful, definitely worth a visit.

allReviews.title: mediocre
allReviews.text: The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.  Our room was not made up on two separate days.The facility did not have a concierge.  Prices were high for the quality of the facility.  The Coffee in the room was mediocre.

allReviews.title: A great reunion venue!
allReviews.text: The staff was very friendly and efficient. The rooms are very spacious and nicely decorated. The price of the rooms for our reunion was great! I thought the food was very good for a banquet, although Elvis French Toast made me chuckle.All in all, a good time.

allReviews.title: High school reunion
allReviews.text: Enjoyed my stay for our high school reunion. Rooms were clean and the room was cleaned daily. Restaurant prices were a little steep but then again this is Las Vegas. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who asked me about where would be a good place to sty.

allReviews.title: Family
allReviews.text: The trip was to celebrate my husband 79th birthday. The bathroom did not  have enough t towels for 4 adults We had double beds full queen very small and sheet not fitted to bed very loose . The room was clean . I only had an issues with the beds

allReviews.title: Always have a great time here
allReviews.text: I personally love everything about this hotel i use to stay here with my family when I was younger and now I bring my family here. Amazing food love how the pool is open until 10 pm here. I love how close it is to new sphere it has the perfect view

allReviews.title: Tuscany was unorganized and didn't care about the customer
allReviews.text: Felt like Tuscany was unorganized and didn't care about the customer.When I tried checking in, they didn't have a room for me in the same building in my group. They said the building (J) was closed (even though I had people in my group already checked in there), and wanted to put me in another building for a night before moving me to building J. Also, my phone in my room didn't work, so they couldn't give me wake up calls. Ants in the room too.

allReviews.title: Money taken from my room, spiders and cockroaches
allReviews.text: The worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. So many things went wrong with my stay. And the some front desk was not kind or accommodating. I was here for a week long seminar and many of us in the group had issues

allReviews.title: Would come back again!
allReviews.text: This is such a nice, lush, and quiet property close to the strip!  We really enjoyed our deluxe queen suite.  Clean, nice bedding, ample pillows.  We especially loved the private commode area so someone can still get ready in the shower or at the bath vanity.  Only two drawbacks were that the ice machine on our floor didn't work, so had to take the elevator to the 1st floor.  Also, the jacuzzi hot tub was not heated.  We looked forward to that but it was cold water.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience
allReviews.text: The rooms are huge, beautiful and clean love being off the strip, but it’s so close to walk to it. Your hotel has everything we needed restaurants coffee, shops, fire tables, bars, pools, and the casino will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Good Value, Off-Strip, Big Rooms and Great Staff
allReviews.text: This property is a good value if you want a low-key off-strip stay. We selected this property to be within walking distance of the Sphere, as we were in town for a concert. It was a fairly easy walk from Tuscany to the Sphere up Koval. There is an AM/PM mini market up the block for snacks and drinks. The room was clean and spacious. We were on the second floor and could hear heavy clomping of foot steps from the room above. Maybe request a top floor room if you are sensitive to noise. We visited the pool one day and it was a nice environment. Plenty of chairs and a towel attendant. They do have drink service at the pool and the server was friendly. Overall, a low-key relaxing vibe at the pool. Not a hip, party spot, which was perfect for us!We ate at Marilyn's Cafe for breakfast one morning and it was a good value with very friendly staff. Also had grab and go salads from the little coffee bar and they were very fresh and tasty.Front desk staff was friendly and accommodated our early check in request. We had also noted that when we pre-registered via the email message they sent the day before.We walked to and from shows on the Strip including after midnight. It felt safe walked, especially because there is a lot of F1-related construction on Koval and Sands, so a big construction present and also police. Final comment ... if you want to be in the glitzy mix of the strip, this is not the spot for you. It's about a 20 minute walk to the strip. If you want a good value, low-key, chill spot that is clean and friendly ... this is the spot for you.

allReviews.title: Feels Like a Tropical Getaway
allReviews.text: We were three friends staying in one room in this older hotel.  The room was huge, well-equipped, clean and well-maintained, as was the entire property. The staff were friendly and efficient.  Extra special was the outdoor pool area, which felt like a tropical getaway.   Although very close to the Strip, this hotel felt like an escape from the Las Vegas madness. I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites - Our New Favorite Stay
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites provides a respite from the madness. Just a couple blocks off the Strip, it’s close to everything. It’s also elegantly quiet. A tasteful refuge if you’re looking for some sanity. This is not to say stodgy. There’s a lovely bar area just off the lobby, with adjacent outdoor seating. It offered a break from the mania. Adding to the quiet is that the Casino is located in a separate building, but just a few yards away. Our large rooms were nicely decorated, and perfectly clean. We appreciated our room’s living space / kitchen area.  Bathroom included stall shower, tub, and separate water closet. Rooms are located in low-rise, two story buildings set among well-landscaped and maintained European garden style grounds. Multiple restaurants on site, including coffee bar, diner style coffee shop and high-end dinner house. Finally, our group agreed the staff was excellent, in particular Carolina at front desk. Our compliments on high degree of gracious service and true hospitality.

allReviews.title: OK stay at Tuscany Suites
