allReviews.text: Hotel was nice. Rooms are big, and clean. Casino was good, and Circa sports book Kiosk on site is a nice bonus. The pool was nice, but kind of small and not enough chairs.  Stay away from Building M.  it's the farthest from the front desk, and it's very noisy with F1 construction going on 24 hours a day. Very loud at night!

allReviews.title: Quite, relaxing and ideal getaway
allReviews.text: Staff was helpful and courteous the whole time especially when I locked myself out the room and needed new key.  Security was hardly noticed yet I felt secure the whole time.    Bravo  definitely Will come back

allReviews.title: Fabulous for extended stay.
allReviews.text: Loved my room, spacious and clean. Loved the hotel overall. Nice pool, gift shop and restaurants.  Could hear people upstairs a bit easily.  Had a clogged sink drain but was fixed quickly. Overall very happy.

allReviews.title: Triple check your reservation, get names of people you speak with.
allReviews.text: I would have given 5 stars had the hotel provided what I had requested upon making my reservation. I made a online reservation. I followed it up with a phone call to confirm I’d be able to have a ground floor room, due to medical reasons and not able to use elevator. The gentleman on phone said it being added to the reservation request. I made my reservations 30+ days in advance. When we checked in, they only had a 3rd floor room, and said I could not access stairs from outside.  I will not be able to stay here again unless they provide ground floor. Overall, hotel was pleasant. Front desk manager at checkout said she’d comp me one night stay due to the mix-up. My bill charges don’t reflect the credit yet, so not sure that was even done.

allReviews.title: Tuscany suites
allReviews.text: Room was large and clean. Engineering had to fix mini fridge (froze over), but never addressed water leaking from shower door. Had to ask for microwave at front desk. Also Had to ask/get coffee pods every day of week long stay rather than getting enough at one time.

allReviews.title: Definitely recommend
allReviews.text: Great customer service and very nice room. Loved the size of room and everything hotel had to offer. Fantastic restaurants inside and beautiful landscaping. Nice and quiet right off the strip. Definitely recommend!!

allReviews.title: High school reunion
allReviews.text: Great time. Room was spacious and clean. Staff was helpful and amicable. Pool was great. The cabana that we rented was great. Amenities were very nice towels and the area were nice. Casino was very cool and enjoyable.

allReviews.title: Convenient location and good value
allReviews.text: Good location for our stay. I was competing in the Nevada Senior Games at UNLV, so the location couldn't have been better! We walked across the street to Panera Bread, Fogo de Chao, etc. Also, we enjoyed Marilyn's, Pub 365 three times, and the Bottega for coffee and breakfast in the mornings. Hotel was quiet, great room service and nice, spacious fitness room

allReviews.title: Very nice
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino has large rooms, comfortable beds and cushions, and fresh towels every day. As requested, we stayed in a quiet part of the hotel, and we didn't hear anything from the neighboring rooms. There are several restaurants and a bar/pub in the Tuscany. We always had breakfast at Cafe Marilyn's and had dinner once. The portions are huge and the coffee was excellent. The staff at Cafe Marilyn's were very friendly, attentive and always in a good mood; we felt comfortable. We spent 4 nights in the Tuscany. The location is also perfect, only about 15 minutes walk to the Strip and about 15 minutes to the Sphere (visiting this was the reason for our trip). I would stay there again anytime.

allReviews.title: Great space; extra fees charged
allReviews.text: Large room with excellent amenities; the bathroom was luxurious, only helpful addition would be a microwave. One bad taste was the additional $45/ per night resort fee which was a surprise at check in.

allReviews.title: Amazing family trip
allReviews.text: Our stay was excellent ,our rooms were very clean and spacious, beds comfortable,the service and staff was amazing , very polite at front desk and felt very safe the area is very convenient neat the strip and not dangerous at all , family hotel vibe .will come back definitely !

allReviews.title: The jack of all trades
allReviews.text: Excellent distance off the strip 10 minute walk. Great sushi/liquor store/hair and nails directly across the street. The restaurant is intimate and romantic at night, great food. Bar tenders are friendly and make stiff drinks. The pool is clean. Rooms were spacious. It was nice to have the mini fridge for leftovers and drinks during our stay. House keeping was always on it! New towels/ a fresh bed bath toiletries every day! Zero complaints. Price was right, place was clean, very quiet I slept amazing. I even won a few times in the casino. 10/10 will stay with Tuscany again.  I could see this place working for couples, tourist, family,  and business type trips it’s the jack of all trades and will fit into whatever Vegas vibe your feeling that day

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Very clean and spacious rooms. Many amenities available on site. Within walking distance to many places, especially the Sphere. Also next door to the upcoming Grand Prix. Would recommend to family and friends. Bonus is that you don’t have to walk through the casino to get to room or restaurants!

allReviews.title: Great play to stay
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites and Casino is by far our favorite place to stay when we are in Las Vegas for business.  Tuscany is very accommodating and has all of the amenities we need to enjoy our stay.  The staff is very friendly and professional.  It is always a pleasure to stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino.

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel, right across from everything
allReviews.text: Our stay was great, the front entrance was amazing. The guest were great, but I requested a coffee maker because my room did not have one. I had to call them twice on my phone because my room phone wasn’t working. When they did bring me the coffee maker it did not work and o never got my coffee ☕️, so bum.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay
allReviews.text: Very quiet and relaxing Staff were very helpful and approachable smiles all around The cafe was very delightful and service was outstanding and the food was very tasteful Will definitely be returning

allReviews.title: Good value for money.
allReviews.text: The room is large and quite comfortable with room for a couch, dining table and two beds.  But the room and bathroom are quite dim, particularly the bathroom.  Also the sink is small so you end up splashing water a lot.  The shower is tight as well which is ironic given how large the room is.  But for families with children, it's nice as there is a full size bath in the bathroom as well.

allReviews.title: Great!
allReviews.text: Super attentive, very quiet hotel in the middle of all the Las Vegas party, ideal to rest and be calm after a whole day of pure partying, the cleaning service was every day

allReviews.title: Great stay spoilt by unreturned deposit and extra charges to be paid on arrival.
allReviews.text: A pleasant stay marred by being asked on check in for a $150 retention especially for a 75 year old pensioner, not returned on check out and still not returned two weeks later and a resort charge not expected in the price. I will be contacting my travel agent Travel Republic to seek return of these unexpected charges. Las Vegas receives many overseas tourists from countries where the price you pay includes all charges, but it is a nasty shock. I also complained about a continuous hum in my suite which was not dealt with.However Tuscany Suites was a great place to stay, huge room with effective air con, pleasant staff, great surroundings and location and reasonably priced restaurants. European and Asian  visitors do not expect extra charges on check in when in other countries this would not happen

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: Fast check, attentive staff, great room, wonderful bed. Pool area is clean and has wait staff. Casino has nice brewpub with good selections. Casino is small but good variety of games. Smoking casino with small non smoking area

allReviews.title: Couples left with nothing…..
allReviews.text: I didn’t get the room I reserved on the Internet,, just felt like my needs wasn’t met. I wanted to propose to my girl and why did I had to pay more when they didn’t give me what I wanted. I travel from Oregon and they didn’t care….

allReviews.title: Great trip!
allReviews.text: Great place!  Room was very nice and clean. Bed was very comfortable.  Late night food at the pub was very good.  Pool area was nice.  Close to the strip and all the fun.   We would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great family trip.
allReviews.text: Check-in was quick and easy.  Rooms were extra large, extra clean and extra relaxing.  All of the restaurants were perfect.  Location is walkable to what we had on our agenda.  We even preferred to stay at the Tuscany and just chill.  It was a great trip.  The youngest two travelers, 15 and 10 said they missed it as soon as we left.  We will be back for sure.

allReviews.title: Tuscany earned an A+ from me.
allReviews.text: Superb service and accommodations. Clean, spacious and ample/free parking. When the refrigerator and television had some very minor issues, a service tech arrived in a flash. Another stellar stay, as usual.

allReviews.title: Great Spot right off the strip but still close enough to many casinos.
allReviews.text: Very roomy suite. I always try to book this hotel when possible. The casino is without table games, but we were so close to other casinos where we could play. Great spot! Our suite had a couch folding bed as well, so it could have fit 4 people if needed.

allReviews.title: Cars stolen and broken into
allReviews.text: Cars stolen from hotel as well as cars being damaged and broken into. Rude security and uncooperative management. Don’t stay at this hotel if you want a pleasant stay in Vegas. This hotel also requires you to be inside after dark.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel close to the strip
allReviews.text: We had a nice time at Tuscany! Our room was big and we could parc our RV almost next to the building. The staff was nice, friendly and helpful, too.  We can also recommend the food in the 365 Pub and went to the Casino, before we left. The pool area looked nice, too. Sadly we had no time to enjoy ourselves over there.

allReviews.title: Comfy and Inexpensive
allReviews.text: Excellent place to stay for an awesomely reasonable price. The room was clean and very roomy. It is close to the Strip, as well. There is a large bed, and a sofa that can be made into a bed if you should have overnight guests. Coffee machine with coffee pods are a serious plus!

allReviews.title: Overall a great stay
allReviews.text: Check in was quick and easy, food at Marilyn’s Cafe and Pub 365 was excellent, and our king suite was perfect. There were two thing that dropped the score from 5 to 4. First, being located in the last room at the far end of our floor in the back corner of the property (N building). It’s almost as far back as you can go. And the only entrance is in the back of the building. And we were at the furthest room on our floor. So we had to walk to the other end of the hallway, to the elevator, to the one door. There are stairs at the end we were at. But they lead down to an emergency exit you can’t use for normal entry and exit. We did learn after the first day, it’s a shorter trip to the pool, casino, and dining options, to take take your car around to the front and walk. Second was the wine selection at Marilyn’s Cafe. We would expect restaurants at a casino or fine hotel to have at least some wine options other than small individual serving bottles of Sutter Home. The prime rib dinner we had was fantastic, and deserved a better wine pairing than that. I know these are probably little things to a lot of people. But some might feel the same. All in all it’s still a great place to stay, and one of the more reasonable rates in town.

allReviews.title: Beautiful place to stay.
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel. Very well keep property. The pool is well-kept and clean. Spa was at a perfect temperature. We actually won a decent amount of money in the casino here. We will definitely be back to stay at this hotel.. We had a wonderful time.

allReviews.title: This is always our number one choice when staying in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Usually for business, sometimes for pleasure, we prefer the Tuscany hotel and casino for several reasons; it is consistently good, every time. It is clean. I am aware that when staying at a hotel, someone else probably stayed in the same room the night before - but I don't want any evidence of that. It is a good value, Just a mile or two from the strip it is often half the price of some of the popular hotels on the strip. Friendly, helpful staff. In an age where customer service is usually just lip service - if you are lucky - these guys and gals are pleasant and professional. On the rare occasions there have been issues, they are always handled promptly and satisfactorily. My only suggestion for the management; your staff is busy and there are many guests that need attention. We had a small problem upon check-in that was quickly handled, but while the gentleman with whom I spoke was very good at fixing problems, I felt he never really listened to me. Listening is key in customer service and it only takes a few seconds to achieve.

allReviews.title: Good place to stay
allReviews.text: I usually stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino because the suites are really nice and clean. The in house coffee shop always makes great coffee and the staff in every dept are always friendly and helpful.  I love the property being just a short walk to the strip and the ease of asking for things if needed. THIS visit, however, has almost lost my favortism due to a dirty bathroom counter, I won't specify anymore there.  The AC  was loud and not functioning and the tv remote wouldn't work.  We called for help and the AC and remote were tended to but the maintenance person dropped a screw, I stepped on it barefoot then my friend stepped on a bobby pin same evening. Thankfully we weren't injured. The outdoors of the resort are always immaculate and with the outdoor pools, it's a very nice place to relax. Food is excellent in all the eateries too. I would love to give 5 star, but this visit was barely 4.

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel for trips to Las Vegas Strip & MSG Sphere
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel which is ideally located if you are visiting Las Vegas Strip or MSG Sphere. The hotel facilities are great, the rooms are spacious and well decorated, the onsite restaurant has excellent food and the hotel's casino also has its own restaurant.

allReviews.title: Very convenient
allReviews.text: Exceptional good. Good service. very exceptional good food good service parking was amazing front desk was helpful casino was clean food was excellent services all together great I would invite family and friends to stay I would recommend it to all my friends at work

allReviews.title: Big room - have to take elevator
allReviews.text: Great hotel - mildly annoying that you cannot walk upstairs - you have to take the elevatorNice big room, friendly staff - everything else was great - cafe was decent, but we found better breakfast a short walk away

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Very large room! Great to have kitchenette area, full couch, chair and dining table! Friendly staff. We loved the pool and location away from the busy strip. Still close enough to walk to the action if desired.

allReviews.title: Great amenities and amazing staff
allReviews.text: The customer service and amenities at the hotel were excellent. We went to every restaurant during our stay and enjoyed the casino as well. Our servers at the Tuscany Gardens was amazing, his name was Kevin. My husband and I had agreed it was the best dining experience we ever had! Also my daughter and I spent the day at pool and our waitress, Davia I believe her name was, she was absolutely phenomenal and made she we had everything we needed througout the entire day. All of the staff were very friendly and helpful. Our only issues were there were two light bulbs flickering in the hotel room    And when I asked a maid for a light bulb she said the hotel didn’t have any 😳 Also the beds were not As comfortable as I had hoped. But we would like to stay there again  and we would likely get a room with bigger beds to help our own comfort.

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: Relaxing place. We enjoyed our stay here. It is just blocks off the strip, but that makes it much more calming and tranquil. It is clean and staff is very welcoming. We stayed 2 days here and then headed off for a week of hiking. After that, we came back to Las Vegas for 2 more nights and had a horrible night at another establishment, so luckily, we were able to get a room here and ended our vacation on a good note. We would recommend Tuscany Suites!

allReviews.title: Cleanliness
allReviews.text: Rooms and property could have been a little cleaner.  I use to stay here every week a couple of years ago.  Property maintenance and cleanliness has gone down hill.  For the price that we paid for weekend stay…I’ll be looking into other options next time.

allReviews.title: Clean, spacious, great customer service
allReviews.text: The hotel was nice for the price and nice trees and walkways. Good location close to downtown, great customer service, they helped me with a microwave that I needed in minutes and nice swimming pools and jacuzzis with clean water.

allReviews.title: NIce enough room
allReviews.text: There was a long line up on check in and only two people working the desk.  The room itself was clean and a nice size, shower was nice , the fan in the bathroom was very noisy.  The big issues was that well we were there the temp was around 100 all three days.  The A/C in the room could not keep the room below 75

allReviews.title: Relax
allReviews.text: I am happy with the hotel and the parking lot is very convenient that I can park my car and walk to the room and that's the way I like. Another thing is be a slot machine. You got to have like a lot of new one but it's okay and to be honest that's what it is.. I'll tell you the way it is. Thank you

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: Easy check in, love the rooms and amenities. Great staff and the grounds are kept up very well. Always look forward to coming back. Very close to where we have to go and there is plenty of parking. Try it!

allReviews.title: Happy experience
allReviews.text: The room was large and super clean.  The king-sized bed was comfortable and plenty of pillows provided.  I enjoyed having a 24-hr. breakfast menu available -- food was delicious! Beautiful landscaping added value to my stay.

allReviews.title: Quiet and near the strip
allReviews.text: We stayed here for four nights in early October.  check in was good , nice and fast and girls on desk polite and professional.The suite was clean and large.  We ate at Marilyns cafe and the food was good and reasonable price .The casino had very little atmosphere and like so many, we ended up playing at nearby Ellis Island and The Silver Sevens.   This maybe because all the table games have gone.   the casino we felt was a bit tight too.Tuscany, has lovely gardens with a few small pools and is a good place to relax and unwind.The Strip itself is about 20 mins walk away.I have to say i was a bit disappointed by the rude girl behind the counter in the coffee shop on Tuesday evening around 8pm, her manners and sarcasm toward the chap in front of me was down right rude to say the least.Apart from that, it was all in all a good stay and if you want a quiet off strip property, then this is the place. beware though ,of the  resort fee of nearly $50 with tax per night that will be added to you're room.

allReviews.title: Loved it
allReviews.text: We loved our stay everything was perfect clean rooms area staff was amazing casino was great and clean. Good good food and gift shop was so great I bought several items. Our stay was fantastic with Tuscany.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: It was a beautiful stay, I loved everything about it there. Room was amazing!!! Everyone even security was very nice. I was so relaxed and enjoyed myself (didn’t win any more tho lol) but really enjoyed my four night stay.

allReviews.title: We'll be back!
allReviews.text: My husband attended the 2023 TBMA Conference at Tuscany, so we booked a room to stay there for a few additional days.   Although we visit Vegas frequently, we'd never stayed here, but are looking forward to doing it again.  Not only was Rm J214 HUGE & very clean, but in a quieter wing.  Staff we encountered at check-in and throughout the grounds, casino, etc were all extremely pleasant & helpful, actually appearing to care that guests were having a good time.  We didn't require maid service, but when inquiring  if we could pick up a few extra coffee pkts for me while he was at meetings, it wasn't 5 minutes before someone knocked at our door with some. Grounds were well manicured with 2 pools & of complimentary parking.  Location was close for walks to the Strip and/or to see the new Sphere & we appreciated the minifridge to chill our wine.  Good eateries onsite or nearby as well.  Extremely reasonable for Vegas, even with the resort fee.

allReviews.title: The Tuscany Suites and Casino, Home from Home!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino, an ‘Oasis in The Desert’.  A welcoming well run, warm and friendly place to stay where Team Members offer guests a great experience. The resort offers plenty of amenities from Fine Dining at Tuscany Gardens to Cafes with all tastes catered for.  Pub 365 offers you an amazing choice of world class beers and great food also. Great live entertainment in the Copa Room where Martini Happy Hour and appetizers are offered. The rooms are amazing offering you space to relax and sleep before you enjoy the pool, lounge hotel entertainment, stopping for a conference, or a trip to the strip, which is close by before you do some gambling!  The Tuscany Suites and Casino, really is the only place to stay in Las Vegas, value for money and the all-round guest experience cannot be beaten.

allReviews.title: Great location, clean room, friendly staff, what more could you ask for?
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our three-night stay. Staff were all friendly. The breakfast cafe had great food at a good price. The room was spacious and clean. They brought new towels and made the bed every day. The pool was very nice -- clean and perfect temperature with enough chairs for everyone. I really like the location - quiet and close enough to walk to the Strip but not part of that crazy scene. We'll stay here again for sure.

allReviews.title: I love staying at the Tuscany
allReviews.text: Rooms are clean, cleaning service is fantastic! My only disappointment is the the carpet in the hallway smells really bad and the floor squeeks so I could hear the people above me walking around.  I stayed in Building C room 210.

allReviews.title: Avg stay
allReviews.text: The room was very far, the hotel is only busy with making money. Hotel need to see if older people are there and provide some assistance . Parking was free which is good. The casino was very average and was ok

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: Very clean and comfortable hotel. Not a giant skyscraper but rather a smaller more intimate setting. Swimming pool. Very nice- clean -and hot tub. Beds very comfortable. Italian restaurant on site. Fantastic. Late night bar very convenient. Ideal location.

allReviews.title: So relaxing!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Great service.   Coffee shop had the best avocado toast!  Large comfortable room.  Amazing massage at the Spa.  Gym was large and had a good variety of equipment.  Perfectly located a little off the strip.

allReviews.title: Old world charm
allReviews.text: You can walk to the strip without the traffic hassle. Rooms are big, clean, and comfy. Restaurants  are nice and reasonable. Good sized casino. Beautiful grounds. We always stay here and are never disappointed.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: I absolutely will stay at this hotel again! Very beautiful, very clean and the staff was very nice. We had a group function and they accommodated us all. The rooms are very spacious. They 100% take care of there guests.

allReviews.title: Private getaway with myself and spouse.
allReviews.text: Fantastic property rooms were nice amenities were great. I did not feel like we were staying in a hotel it was more of a small villa. Nice pool great restaurant. Walking distance to the strip as well as easy access for ride assist to other Las Vegas attractions.

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: Large spacious rooms, very clean, well kept property, restaurant choices on property are great. Close walking distance to the strip, but also good restaurants near resort.We are not really Vegas people but drove down from Edmonton and used Vegas as a basecamp to go see attractions outside of vegas

allReviews.title: Big suites!
allReviews.text: Really nice big suites with a mini fridge, and free parking. About a 10 min walk to the strip. Small casino with video gambling games, no tables, but it was nice and not crowded. Great food at the Pub and Marilyn’s Cafe.  Our room had a view of the new Sphere which was nice. Good location. We’d stay here again.

allReviews.title: More than I expected
allReviews.text: Rooms are comfortable exceeded my expectations easy to drive in and out with my truck and trailer... good spot for family and friends to get away, peaceful and quiet spot not far from the strip and near good restaurants!

allReviews.title: Family vacations
allReviews.text: Super quiet place for a good rest, my brother and I spent about a week in Tuscany and our experience was as expected. Super recommend for a family or a business trip.Keep going on with the good service

allReviews.title: Customer Service not there strong point
allReviews.text: The card reader for the door had a bad battery... so we were locked out of the room. Walked to front desk and they rescanned the cards and said they would call maintenance. Walked back to the room, waiting 30 mins before walking back to the front desk. Blah blah blah... "we dispatched maintenance" but I guess we were NOT a priority. Walked back to the room, 15 mins later maintenance showed up. They tried their fob with no luck. "We have to call security." No battery swap, no physical key? Another 15 mins security shows up and uses their fob and it opens.. 1 hour later. Security said having the card by cell phones will do that, BUT we just got the card re-activated. Since it worked, no additional work was done. The next morning, locked out again....

allReviews.title: Under the Tuscan Sun
allReviews.text: A different side of Las Vegas if you’re looking for a relaxing hotel with a resort feel, you can still visit other hotels / casinos if you want something more lively.Rooms are larger than most standard rooms, very clean and very well kept , and friendly staff.We have been staying somewhere else in Vegas for many years and after staying at The Tuscany will continue to stay there.

allReviews.title: Cozy Home Away from Home
allReviews.text: All the staff at the Tuscany were so welcoming, warm and accommodating.  Registration and check in/out was seamless.   We had take out for breakfast every morning from Marilyn's.  After the first day, Michael from Marilyn's  restaurant new my name and room number, what we like to eat, and made me feel like I was his best friend.  He made this review excellent. If you stay here, stop by and order from Michael and tell him Ms. McGee from O307 said hi.  He is excellent.  In fairness, the hotel rooms are a little outdated but they are super spacious. The casino was good but there was no live craps, roulette or black jack games.  The pool and fitness center is excellent.  Even has a hot tube and lap pool at the fitness center.  It's right off the strip so traffic is not bad but close enough to walk 1 block and be on it.

allReviews.title: An oasis in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We had a booking for 3 rooms. We had asked to be in the same building and floor but that had not been done.  Bookings were quickly reorganized to same building but different floors. Disappointing that the original request wasn't actioned.

allReviews.title: Vacations
allReviews.text: Very good  , enjoy with the family  , I will decently come again , and will recommend with friends and family , it was very peaceful and quiet place to stay , very clean we really love the room and the service , the only thing was that no one came to do room services , no one clean our room …..

allReviews.title: Great stay but be careful of your room choice
allReviews.text: Enjoyed Tuscany meals good service good but we’re disappointed with our room. Paid for a pool view room but our room was right behind 3 pool cabanas which totally blocked our view of the pool. Our room was also quite noisy from above.

allReviews.title: Nice and clean. Close to airport. Friendly Staff.
allReviews.text: Very friendly and non-intrusive staff. Enjoyed the cocktail lounge. Laundry was coin operated, hard to find and hard to find quarters for so I ended up packing a bunch of dirty stuff home with me. Restaurant (Tuscany Gardens) was delicious. BUT they put me in a room very far from the front and it was right next to where they were building the new F1 track...at all hours of the night. I sleep like a rock and I was still awakened multiple times for from the beeps and grinding. I also would have rather had one of the full kitchen suites, but they were sold out...supposedly, even though the place didn't seem very full. Also, it's right next to the airport, though I didn't notice a whole lot of air traffic noise. Just a few times.

allReviews.title: Good Hotel and Service
allReviews.text: Very good value for money, good food and a pleasant atmosphere. Spacious, well-maintained facility, good location (500 meters to the strip), spacious rooms, the only point of criticism is the very loud fans in the bathroom.

allReviews.title: 4 day - Business conference
allReviews.text: We enjoyed a great experience from check in to check out. The hotel, conference centre and other amenities were great. It is close to the strip and various restaurants. Since it is not a huge property, everything is very handy.

allReviews.title: Relaxing accomdation!
allReviews.text: Very comfortable rooms which is a big size. Also low rise building that you can get to anywhere by flight of stairs. Landscaping around the building is very warming & cozy. The pool helps you to relax & make you feel your a tourist.

allReviews.title: Perfect setting!
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Tuscany five times!  Love it.  Quieter atmosphere, beautiful grounds, large  comfortable room, service is good!   I'm a swimmer and love the lap pool.  Will hopefully come back in 2024!  Diane

allReviews.title: Couldn’t have ask for more
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino is in an excellent location just walking distance from the strip or a quick Uber ride.  The accommodations are excellent and the staff is marvelous.  A variety of great food and an inviting pool area.  When we return, the Tuscany will be our home base while in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Love the Tuscany! The smaller casino is just right and the people are extra friendly. The 365 bar has excellent food and drinks. Check in was fast and easy. Rooms were large and clean. The pool has plenty of room for everyone and the weather this time of year is perfect!

allReviews.title: Good Stay.
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay.   There are plenty of spaces to park, the rooms are clean, quiet and roomy.  The grounds are really nice and there are a few different food options.  The Italian restaurant is amazing with great service.

allReviews.title: Our stay at Tuscany was perfect!
allReviews.text: We loved the Tuscany.  It is only about a 15 min walk to the Strip.  So it very convenient without being in with the crowd.  Our room was spacious, clean and relatively quiet.  The restaurants were very good and the prices were much better than down on the Strip.The staff we came in contact with were very friendly and helpful

allReviews.title: Great hidden spot off the strip
allReviews.text: Great room, large and clean. Great pool. Staff was great. Below average gaming area. You had it right before covid, I would recommend going back to the set up you had then. Restaurants were also good.

allReviews.title: Quite elegance, spacious room and great service
allReviews.text: Loved it! Best we've stayed at in Vegas and this was our fourth time in Vegas!Beds were comfortable, everything we needed was available on site, so didn't have to venture into the chaos...unless we wanted to.

allReviews.title: Great hotel off the Strip for a great price.
allReviews.text: Great hotel just off the Strip. Not super fancy and garish like Caesers or any of the other large hotels, more boutique, just what we like. Our room was king non smoking poolside balcony (H308) was perfect. Large, clean and we could see the new Sphear through the trees. Great location for easy acess to the pool, restaurants and casino. Pool and hot tub area very pretty and clean. It is about 10-15 minute walk to the Strip. Daytime no problems, night time I wouldn't do it alone as a woman, but fine with a partner or a group. Overall we would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing
allReviews.text: Loved this place! So serene and beautiful amongst nature, away from the hustle of LA, perfect combination to come home to relax. Suite was big and spacious, and very clean. Close to strip for Uber or walking. Great all you can eat sushi restaurant right in front of the hotel.

allReviews.title: Since it was a discounted rate stay due to seminar taking place So I believe you get what you pay for.
allReviews.text: Since it was a discounted rate stay due to seminar taking place So I believe you get what you pay for.

allReviews.title: Retired couple get away!
allReviews.text: Staff is always so cordial and welcoming! Love the comps! When will "Hot seats" and other perks on Senior day be re-instated? Also, last visit the complimentary coffee was served up in a really tiny deposable cup!

allReviews.title: Amazing, book the room with the balcony
allReviews.text: Amazing stay, first time visiting Tuscany Suites, staff so lovely, resort and room beautiful,  so close to the strip.  The rooms are huge and we even had a microwave and our own private balcony which was so close to the pool. One of the best hotels we have stayed at in Vegas

allReviews.title: Best ever
allReviews.text: Loved it. Had a great time. Very nice.would recommend to everyone. Close to every thing. Could walk if you wanted to. Beautiful color changing ball you could see from Tuscany, Room was big and couch bar sink. Huge bathroom.

allReviews.title: Would stay again! Felt safe and comfortable
allReviews.text: I was a little apprehensive staying in Vegas alone for a work trip. I’m in my mid thirties but look more like I’m fresh out of high school which causes some interesting situations and makes me feel extra vulnerable. I arrived close to midnight and actually felt super safe (still had my mace in my hand just in case!) and the room was SO clean and comfortable. As is normal in most hotels, when people were talking and walking down the hallway I could hear them, and the people above me sounded like they were stomping until 3am, but I couldn’t hear them talking. I will say the number for room service never connected me, but when I called guest services they were able to connect me and I was able to get breakfast. The gentleman who delivered breakfast was exceptionally friendly and accommodating. My room had coffee but no cream or sugar and when I ordered breakfast they brought me a bunch of cream and sugar. I would 10000% stay again especially for the price! All I need from a hotel is cleanliness, a nice fresh bed I can sleep in, hot water, coffee, and friendly staff, and all of my needs were met. The hotel was better than I expected.

allReviews.title: Good choice for quiet hotel
allReviews.text: Nice clean hotel in a quiet area 1 mile from Ceasars Palace.Pretty pool area with good cafe & seating in the shade for breakfast or lunchBig rooms with small kitchenette, microwave etcGreat free parking

allReviews.title: The best hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We love The Tuscany Suites.  The rooms are huge and with only a short 10 minute walk to the Strip.  It also has tranquility that the other hotels do not have.  I’ve been here from the UK 3 times and wouldn’t dream of staying anywhere else. However the reason I have given it 4 out of 5 is because some members of staff only on reception and in the coffee shop were rude in my opinion.  My advice is if you hate your job/people etc, go find another job 😕

allReviews.title: Great stay. They have smoking rooms!
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel. Stayed at a place in the strip and here and I preferred here. Hands down.  Good room price. Not far from the strip. Booked a smoking room. Few places left in vegas seem to have them.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. It’s like having your own studio with kitchenette & living room. Love that you do not have to walk through a casino to get to your room. Easy to park next to your room. Easy access to freeways & strip.

allReviews.title: Perfect hotel for us
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our 4 night stay here for my husbands 30th birthday! The hotel is just off the strip away from the hustle and bustle - which was perfect for us! But you can walk to the strip in about 15 minutes! Rooms are huge, clean and the queen bed was extremely comfortable! All the staff was extremely friendly & attentive. A big bonus is that they have a cafe open 24 hours which helped for our early excursion to the canyon! The pool was lovely also! Clean and not overcrowded! We felt this hotel had everything & we would happily return!

allReviews.title: THE HANGOVER !!!!
allReviews.text: Very nice Suite & Casino !!!  From the bell hop to the Front Desk , they were total professionals. No room noise, totally silent. Cant hear people above us or around us. We played out music in our room with no complaints. Very large suites. We arrived around 5:30pm and still got a complimentary microwave. Fridge worked well. Bathroom was great, had toilet separate from rest of shower ,tub and spacious vanity /sink. Very close to strip. We stayed in Apartment B  room 1103, right by ice machine/soda vending and entrance to parking lot. Super close to valet. Did not go to pool, due to partying into hotel room till 930pm. Caught Uber to the Linq promenade, about 10.00 charge (don't forget the tip). Than it was The Hangover Part 4 for our Party of 5. I played the character Fat Jesus and Chow.  So for now......So Long Hay Boys !!!!!

allReviews.title: Tuscany suites
allReviews.text: Great property. Room was spacious and clean. Casino is small but delivered great service and affordable drinks. Only complaint was the beds were tiny. I thought I booked two queens but the beds were only doubles.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas gem!
allReviews.text: Excellent stay! Large, quiet rooms, beautiful grounds and friendly staff. We will definitely be back. We booked for a 3 night stay to attend the Life is Beautiful festival. The rooms are spacious, comfy and very clean. Housekeeping was quick to bring additional towels and blankets when requested and the front desk was friendly and attentive.

allReviews.title: Birthday at Tuscany
allReviews.text: A relaxed stay for my birthday celebration. Friendly and helpful staff! The dinner at Tuscany Garden was as good as any 5 star restaurant on the strip! we can hardly wait for our next time in Vegas and our stay at Tuscany Suites!

allReviews.title: Best hotel ever
allReviews.text: Good quality rooms a good price for the day, most of the famous hotel’s doesn’t have this price specially in weekends, is really hard to find a good price room for next day, usually they charge a lot just because you didn’t do it on time.

allReviews.title: Great.
allReviews.text: Great staff. Rooms were clean. Beds were comfortable. We really like being being off the strip but with easy access(app 15 minute walk). Smaller hotel/casino, with app 360 rooms, which is nice. Pool is not overcrowded. We've been coming to this Pro Seminars conference for 15+ years and have always been well treated. Great place to relax  after an evening of fun and frolic.

allReviews.title: For the most part I was comfortable and felt safe!!!
allReviews.text: I found the staff to be excellent in their jobs and made me feel welcome upon my arrival for a week stay.  They kept my room very clean throughout the week....Now for some improvements for your guests1) New shower faucet would defiantly help!!! Put in hand held faucet a priority for women and older population.

allReviews.title: Great place, quiet yet 10 min walk to strip (Caesars Palace)
allReviews.text: Several changes have taken place at this hotel since Sept 2022, that I am not so happy with. The biggest change is the reduced items available at Marilyn's restaurant, but the food is still great, reasonably priced, with large portions.The price increase at Tuscany Gardens, but food is fantastic!- Pasta and Fish Entrees: $30- $50- Steak Entrees: $50- $72

allReviews.title: It was a pleasant trip.
allReviews.text: The room was very large.  Room was serviced every day. Beds were comfortable and Marilyn’s restaurant was convenient and good food.Casino did not have table games which caused us to visit other casinos.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel near center
allReviews.text: Everything was great. We really enjoyed the pool. The AC was working well. The room was really spacious. All the needed toiletries were provided. There was even a small kitchen in the room, however some basic cutlery would be nice to have. The parking for guests was big and close to the hotel. The only drawback was the waiting time for the check-in, but this was mainly caused by one oppresive guest.

allReviews.title: Great room with a view!
allReviews.text: I got a fantastic room with a view of the sphere. I was totally surprised at how nice the room was. The entire staff was friendly and professional. The food at Marilyn's was delicious. The gambling was fun.

Room service was excellent as usual. Hotel amenities were superior, as usual. One thing very noticeable was the lack of service help in Pub 365. We sat down for lunch on Monday and waited for a waitress...or anyone to come by. After 10 minutes we walked out.

allReviews.title: Good Value
allReviews.text: I have been coming to the Tuscany for the Pro Seminars conference for the last 7 years.  Also enjoy staying at the Tuscany.  I normally would rate you a 5 but this time I was frustrated with the lack of fresh water to drink and the bartenders only providing waters that I had to pay for.  The odd bartender would provide it in a plastic cup with ice when ordering an alcoholic drink but was also declined  by many.  I remember there being water fountains around the hotel and looks like they have been removed.  Small issue but with the heat in Vegas fresh water is important for hydration.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Hotel and Suites, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great, helpful, polite staff. Rooms are big, spacious and well furnished. You have to request for a microwave though, I requested for one whilst I was booking initially, but this wasn't provided, so we had to ask again. We were initially booked into a room in a block that directly faced a huge construction site that was being built for the 2023 Las Vegas Formula One grand prix. Work was going on all night, and it was impossible to sleep. Thankfully we informed the front desk the next morning, and were moved to a much better room in a different block. Again, we had to request for a microwave to be brought up. Another important thing that guests should be made aware of, is the distance of the hotel to the Las Vegas Strip. It is a good 25-30 minutes walk for a fit person, so if you plan to visit Vegas solely or mostly to see the Strip, this may not be the best hotel to stay in as you'd have to get expensive taxis or drive daily if you don't fancy walking. Overall a good experience. I'd probably stay again if I had the option of hiring a car.

allReviews.title: Warning round the clock construction in the area.
allReviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany several times before and generally have been satisfied with the stays. However for my last stay my room was in the L building and my window  faced the 24 hour a day construction of the stadium for the formula 1 racing event that occurs in November. Needless to say the constant noise from the construction made sleeping difficult. I mentioned this when I checked out and was told they were sorry for the noise. I feel refunding the resort fee (which seems high given I don't use any of the facilities such as the pool, gym, etc.) would have been appropriate. As a minimum they should warn guests ahead of time for rooms on that end of the property and try to move you to a different room if the noise would bother you.

allReviews.title: September visit to casino very disappointing when compared to past visits.
allReviews.text: Accommodations and services were outstanding.However, the disappointing downgrading of the video poker to "poor rating" for "fair return on investment" AND the removal of LIVE table games greatly lower our incentive to include Tuscany Casino as a preferred destination in Las Vegas.We used to greatly look forward visiting Tuscany, however, Tuscany no longer exists as a "go to" casino.

allReviews.title: Outstanding stay !!!!!!
allReviews.text: Could not ask for a better visit. This casino has everyting to offer. Shows were great. Staff always offered to help. Clean rooms. Good size rooms. Very good food selections but close early (9:00 PM).

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Enjoy the size of the rooms, quiet and peaceful  surroundings. Good service with excellent restaurant along with the conference facility that is efficient and comfortable. The security is also evident which adds to the comfortable atmosphere enjoyed

allReviews.title: Love This Property
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this resort for years and find it amazing.  From the huge rooms, friendly staff, great dining options, excellent value, nice pools and manicured grounds.  A short walk to the strip and superb dining choices many of which are a short walk away.  Just ann all round place to stay.

allReviews.title: Extent service over al
allReviews.text: Staff very helpful .new  Teams liked the rooms  old teams also with bock price Marcella Sanchez excellent with services provided { Note) check in time 3 pm some players waiting till 5/530 for rooms other players got rooms within 1 hr but some people just impatient.  Talked to cleaning staff they don't let front desk know rooms ready till all rooms they have to clean r all done so some rooms were empty for 2 hours when the front desk could give rooms out sooner  and people wouldn't have to as long just suggestion

allReviews.title: Thank you Tuscany suites management and staff for another great vacation
allReviews.text: Our fifth stay at Tuscany suites,  always recommended to family and friends when visiting las Vegas. Large clean rooms, great pool, friendly staff, good restaurants and casino.On site security 24-7Great entertainment nightly in lounge.

allReviews.title: Conference
allReviews.text: I booked two king rooms in building C for my wife and I as well as one for my son and his wife well before our arrival. When we got there we were in two different buildings. Two associates checked in a day later and were in building CJust a little inconvenient otherwise a nice time as usual

allReviews.title: Clean & convenient
allReviews.text: This place exceeded my expectations! Parking was excellent. The place was clean and comfortable. The price was right. And the restaurant food was delicious . The casino was convenient. We were only staying for one night so it was perfect and no hassle with the hussle and bussle on the strip 👍🏼

allReviews.title: Great Facility and Great Location
allReviews.text: I was very impressed with the Tuscany Suites & Casino. From registration to checkout, the experience was positive and satisfactory. This was my first experience with the Tuscany and I will not hesitate to consider them for my next stay in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: It was horrible! I have stayed several years in a row with no complaints. This time was terrible. Leaf blowers outside our room at 7am. Safe issues daily (waited 90 minutes for maintenance). Wife was unable to charge to the room because name was not properly added, etc

allReviews.title: 51st Anniversary celebration
allReviews.text: We came to Celebrate our 51st Anniversary. This was our fist time staying here. We absolutely had an awesome time. Your Staff were very friendly & helpful. We will be returning again in the near future.

allReviews.title: Very kind and thoughtful.
allReviews.text: My husband was flown to a hospital from another state. This hotel could not have been more helpful to me. Everyone was kind an helpful. I was exhausted and alone and the hotel staff made sure that I was on the bottom floor and close to my vehicle. I appreciated that so much.

allReviews.title: Pro-seminars
allReviews.text: The stay was excellent..... this was my second visit and I really enjoyed the stay. The facility has everything that is needed - casino, bars, restaurants and the seminar halls. This location is excellent for big seminars or even parties of large magnitude.

allReviews.title: Nice off-strip property, hotel part of  experience disappointing .
allReviews.text: It was our tenth wedding anniversary celebration. Property including casino, bars and restaurants were very good. Food was good staff was friendly and lounge entertainment was good. Hotel experience was extremely disappointing. We reserved and paid for a pool view with lanai. (Picture of view from our room attached.) Management staff was very accessible through DM on social media and email though.   Offered a remedy of show tickets and restaurant credit.

allReviews.title: Large suites
allReviews.text: As always, the suites are very large. Plenty of space. Everything is pretty well up-to-date, and the room is very comfortable. The property is pretty sprawling, so if you are assigned one of the buildings toward the back, you’ll do a lot of walking. Although, the parking lots do allow for close parking of your car to nearly any building.

allReviews.title: Very pleased - Dan and Luan
allReviews.text: Clean, wonderful layout, many amenities, very hospitable, courteous and a beautiful room.  Restaurant, pool, casino were all excellent.....we'll come back and would recommend this property to anyone.  In all the visits over 50 years to Las Vegas - we agreed that this was the best, all things considered.  Thank you

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: Clean campus, nice ambience. Pools are in good shape, and exercise room is large and excellent.  There are good shows.  The strip and some good eateries are close enough to walk.  One suggestion: The suites could use a microwave.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: We had a great time at the conference. Our room was large and clean and the staff came in every day to make the beds and tidy. The food was excellent at the Italian restaurant. We would definitely come back to this hotel in the future.

allReviews.title: We stay 2 times a year for 4 days for the last 20 years
allReviews.text: we always enjoy our stay clean quite easy strip access. Good resturants and slots. we love the pool area and ease of stay. We have been enjoying the Tuscany for over 20 years now and we love that we get the same building every time we stay.

allReviews.title: Our Las Vegas Tuscany Getaway
allReviews.text: We enjoyed staying at Tuscany because there are a number of restaurants easily accessed and with high quality food.  There is a variety of gaming options and the Piazza Lounge provides quality entertainment.  The rooms are large and provide a homey feeling with a small kitchen and living room.  However, we have been disappointed to see some of our favorite items removed from both Marilyn’s and Tuscany Gardens.  How you have a cafe without a grilled ham and cheese sandwich or an upscale Italian restaurant with no Veal Parmigiana or Veal Marsala is a real head scratcher.  Your wine prices are really high.  Your new Tuscany Garden Manager was nice enough to comp us the $80 dollar bottle of wine we ordered but just as an example that is nearly 4 times the shelf price.  We also noted the musical acts that appear on a regular basis are really good.  The ones who are not regulars tend to be at a much lower level.  Your bartenders are outstanding.  We note with disappointment you have removed Straight Bonus Poker from the Piazza bar Video Poker machines.  We were happy to see you returning table games.  We basically find all your team members to be observant and helpful.  The grounds are beautiful and very well maintained creating a lovely relaxing setting especially around the pool.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino is a great place to stay
allReviews.text: I enjoyed staying at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. Clean facilities, good and friendly interactions with the employees. Will be back to stay at the Tuscany Suites & Casino when I return to visit Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Never disappoints
allReviews.text: I have stayed at The Tuscany now around 12 times, and it never disappoints. Staff is wonderful, rooms are great, pool is perfect, grounds are nice and it is quiet. Will be back again. The entertainment is fun, the bartender (Chase?) was friendly and took care of us well. He makes a damn good dirty martini!

allReviews.title: Great stay off the Strip!
allReviews.text: The staff at Tuscany Suites & Casino make the entire experience just that much better.  The rooms are big and well-appointed.  Bed is comfortable.  A few issues with some things being a bit dated or in need of repair (shower head, sink plug), but nothing terrible. Will come again for sure.

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay
allReviews.text: Great clean quiet hotel.  A little walk to the strip but it’s safe and we all need the exercise:). Seems to attract an older group but who am I to talk at 71 :).Hi security so I always felt safe.  I would recommend this hotel.  Also the price was very reasonable.

allReviews.title: Love the Tuscany!!
allReviews.text: We keep coming back to the Tuscany! Because of the fantastic staff, large comfortable rooms, relaxing pool, great restaurants.  It's a real hidden gem! Special shout out to Daiva at the pool - we love her!

allReviews.title: Generally quiet yet close to the strip.
allReviews.text: We very much enjoyed at the tranquility and beautiful landscaping of the Tuscany Suites. Our room was very large and comfortable. The one complaint I would have is that they expected you to be out of your room so early in the morning for cleaning. We constantly got notes under our door saying they were skipping our room because we had to do not disturb sign up this was at 10:00 a.m. kind of early to be out in vegas. Secondly on the weekend a group for a conference arrived and we're Extremely Loud and rowdy. They saved almost all of the seats at the pool prior to their arrival from their meetings so there was nowhere for anyone else to sit and relax yet those chairs remained empty for most of the day. That should not have been allowed. The comfort of all of the guests should be taken into consideration.

allReviews.title: Best Place to Stay !
allReviews.text: Best sweet hotel great staff good, really nice pool and very very clean. Definitely 10/10 better then the strip hotels this is near the strip cozy and calm. Also, it's not a huge building. It's very small buildings with Villa type sweets and they're very nice.

allReviews.title: Peaceful stay in a busy city.
allReviews.text: The room was perfectly clean, the shower was great and the room was quiet. Thank you for a great stay. Employees terrific too.  The mattress was very comfortable too. The location is great and Lyft drivers are able to easily pick you up and drop you off.

allReviews.title: Good but construction noises were loud
allReviews.text: The only bad thing about the stay was every 4:00 AM constructions noises outside is so annoying and disturbing. We stayed in the L building which was next to the construction site of Formula One Race. The management should have compensated the guest affected. We mentioned it to the person when we checked out and she seemed awkward about the situation instead of saying she would let the management know about it. They should stop using those rooms until the problem is resolved.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Trip
allReviews.text: We Loved having  the Lanai just outside our room!  It was so relaxing to sit out there among the Beautiful landscaping!  We also enjoyed the Marilyns restaurant alot, very good food.  The casino is just the right size.

allReviews.title: Needs better ways to check rooms and amenities i the rooms
allReviews.text: We go to Tuscany a few times a year and it’s usually very good. This time. There was a couple of hiccups that I hope that they will take care of before the next time we’re there.  They obviously got new towels for the hotel, which is a Plus however, they are soft but there’s so new that every time you use them all the white fibers from the towel come off on you whether it’s your hands or your feet or wherever  and then u need to wash off the white fiber after using the towels2) the telephone in the room did not work properly. I was able to dial was Housekeeping any other numbers dialed got a recording call could not go thru. that is not good in an emergency situation. I hope they fix the phone system as well.  3) I checked the sheets every time I go before we even use the bed and they’re always stained in one way orThe other so there needs to be better checking of those clean sheets beforeUsed on the beds.

allReviews.title: Great but could be better
allReviews.text: The hotel and room was good. The only part that I didn’t like was getting to the bldg from hotel lobby. Go carts (those used in home courses) that drop guests to their bldg will be a nice touch and will enhance your hotel experience.

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay away from the srip
allReviews.text: We stay at Tuscany several times a year.  Easy check in, convenient walk to the suites. Easy access to the casino.  Very comfortable and quiet. This stay was almost 3 weeks. Pretty steady payouts at the casino, friendly staff. Slot attendants are very sociable and helpful. Marilyn’s restaurant is terrific. The staff is outstanding. German, Gabriel, Sal, Angel and Saul are very attentive and remember your previous requests. Above and beyond customer service.

allReviews.title: A safe, beautiful and clean location, just off the Strip
allReviews.text: The front desk staff was very pleasant and helpful, able to secure me a quiet room and my request for a microwave came quickly. The room itself was impeccably clean and quite large. The A/C worked almost too well. Plumbing was good, no stopped up shower drain, just had to wait a minute for plenty of hot water. Housekeeping was excellent. Cons; lumpy pillows and an extremely firm mattress. Most people would like that, I suppose. I ended up sleeping on the sofa that had foam cushions. Close to the Strip and security throughout the property. As a solo female traveler I felt safe here (stay alert in the neighborhood though). The pool and grounds are gorgeous, food at the Pub quite good (I highly recommend the shrimp tacos). I did have a terrifying experience when I was mistaken for a person passing funny money because we paid with the same type of bill. I was truly horrified! Bartender in the lounge made me a wonderful, refreshing mocktail. Late Swing/Graveyard beverage service in the casino could use a bit of help. I had to track her/them down each visit for my water order (yes, I do tip). Overall, if the beds weren't so firm, I would definitely return on my next trip.

allReviews.title: went to a concert but every year we go for my birthday in july
allReviews.text: always good very clean rooms nice staff i ask for a especial room n yes we got the room we want n housekeeping very nice thank you see you next year or maybe in November we have 2 com nights every moths

allReviews.title: great time
allReviews.text: great room and casino. very nice people that made my stay enjoyable. food and servers were good. casino has a variety of slot machines and is returning table games to the casino. i would recommend the tuscany to anyone who wants a fun and relaxing vacation,

allReviews.title: Nice place but attention to major problems did not happen.
allReviews.text: The room was clean and maid service was great.  However,  the air conditioner in my room was not working correctly.  Every 28 minutes there was an internal banging noise coming from the unit.  All day and NIGHT.  It was very disturbing and kept me awake.  I complained to maintenance and was told they would look into it.  After another night I checked to see why it was still making the noise at the front desk. I was told they would take care of it.  The whole time I was there nothing was done.  It was not a good experience.  Anna Garmon room d106

allReviews.title: Run down and below standard
allReviews.text: Positive: the room was big.  Marilyn’s cafe was delicious and reasonably pricedNegative: the restHuge hairball on shower wall, shower faucet needs repair,  bathroom sink faucet didn’t have hot water, a nice kitchen cabinets with no silverware or dishes, only plastic glasses- just really low quality interior AC was basic loud wall unit.Loud hallway in a wood framed building

allReviews.title: Beautiful place
allReviews.text: It is a beautiful place. Good location, lot to see. You can walk all over and still feel safe. Staff is good and helpful. If I had one critique it would be how expensive the bar is. I bought my alcohol in the casino.

allReviews.title: Benefits for staying and being a loyal customer
allReviews.text: The service desk employees were fantastic. I also loved the fact that we were in B complex and on the first floor. Thanks for that. There is one thing I was disappointed with and that is myself and my son in law were each suppose to get 25.00 free play and 25.00 food voucher I got my food credit but Greg did not.  Also neither he nor I got our 25.00 free play. We checked with the players club and the lady told us that we had no free play. I said they told me at the desk that we did. She informed me that they don’t know what they are talking about. I thought that was rather rude. We have been coming to the Tuscany for the last 6 or 7 years except for one year in between.

allReviews.title: Great Hospitality
allReviews.text: Was there on business.  The venue was a conference at Tuscany Suites & Casino. Lance Pao was the event coordinator for Tuscany. Lance is great!  That man does not sit still for a minute!  Great hospitality.

allReviews.title: Great place for families and fun times
allReviews.text: Wow! What an amazing resort! The room was so spacious and clean. The pool was great! Tons of places to relax by the pool or hot tub. Good sized pool and open late. We loved how close the parking is to the rooms and the care taken to ensure that vehicles are safe. The casino was fun. Table games were not operational but coming back soon. There were lots of slot machine games. The location is super close to the strip and super close to the sphere. You can actually view the sphere from the front entry. We will recommend especially for families. Thanks Tuscany for the fun times!

allReviews.title: Spacious,Clean,Friendly and Tranquil!
allReviews.text: So pleased that we stayed at Tuscany Suites and Casino. Hotel is very clean, staff pleasant. Rooms spacious. Bathrooms updated and HUGE. Ate at the sports bar and also the "family restaurant" both had good service and food. Pool area was tranquil and beautiful. Hotel is only 10 minute walk from strip, near Bellagio and Ceasars. Recommended for couples and families

allReviews.title: Decent place to stay
allReviews.text: Very clean and quiet, off the strip yet close to the monorail.We were in Vegas for a convention.The walk to the strip is about 20 minutes, it was a nice central location.I booked 3 months in advance and paid a great rate.

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem Off The Strip
allReviews.text: The Tuscany has an "Old Vegas" vibe without feeling like it's days away from demolition. The resort is clean and well-maintained. There is free parking. The employees, from the bell hops and housekeepers to the front desk reps and security, are friendly and helpful. The rooms are nicely appointed and spacious. The casino is small but loaded with great games. While we did have some issues with service at two of the four eateries on site, it was overall a great stay. Would definitely consider staying here again and would recommend to others!

allReviews.title: Stay at Tuscany with IFCON group convention
allReviews.text: Greetings,I Reported Shower after my first morning shower. Water handle loose would not stay in place as rotate counter clockwise. So water either cold or too hot because handle drops all the way down to max hot water level (no tension).I Reported this via call to desk twice my first full day there no repair was ever made.Could not get room safe to activate initially.Elevator out of service from early 9/3 and still out when I checked out 9/4. Staff told me it would be fixed by morning but no,  when I went to use it around 10AM 9/4 still out of order. I am 70 and have back issues from 3 fractures. Only one bellman on duty and I was heading to checkout before farewell breakfast 9/4 so I carried my 2 suitcases and backpack down in 3 trips. Why is there only one elevator in the entire building?I was in H-303 by myself.I requested wake-up call (with a person at desk)  on friday 9/1 for sat morning 9/2. No  wakeup call was made. The in-room alarm clock is broken that did not work either.I was with a group of over 300 staying there multiple nights for IFCON. I have stayed at Tuscany previously with a large group and did not have any of these issues.Overall stay was a Fail. Would not recommend IFCON stay again. Would appreciate follow up.Sincerely,Byron H-303 8/31-9/4.

allReviews.title: Fun in Rain
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean, the staff were great, enjoyed the pool with drinks available. I loved that they had a laundry room, plenty of restaurants available around the premises, walking distance to the strip. It rained all weekend in Vegas but that didn’t stop us.

allReviews.title: fun vacation but accommodations need improvement
allReviews.text: Restaurants and Shows are great, Casino is good, rooms need renovation. The fan in the bathroom was like an airliner landing on the tarmac, the window air conditioner which goes on periodically to keep the room cool was like drone overhead. What made up for it was great staff, restaurants, shows, and casino.

allReviews.title: The staff is great and the food subpar
allReviews.text: The room was comfortable. The women cleaning our room, the front desk people, the waiters/waitresses and the bartenders were all great. The issue was the food at every restaurant. Every meal we had at every restaurant was subpar.

allReviews.title: good over all!
allReviews.text: My 4th stay... I love this hotel, the grounds & the staff!My only hitch was that my room request/assignment wasn't followed. I'm not sure who was responsible for that... the hotel or the group I was with?

allReviews.title: Quiet hotel
allReviews.text: It is a quiet, family hotel, it stands out for having spacious rooms with a refrigerator, laundry area and dining room. We asked for a microwave at check-in and they delivered it to the room in less than 15 minutes. Very good cleaning.The large pool, with many lounge chairs.It's about 4 long blocks from the strip, but I definitely recommend it.All the hotel employees were very, very friendly, especially one of the receptionists who I don't remember his name but he told me he was from Colombia, was very, very attentive.They also receive one or two packages at no cost.

allReviews.title: Highly recommended
allReviews.text: Lovely hotel in an excellent location , close to the strip . Easy to walk to main attractions or get a taxi . Huge suite rooms , fantastic restaurants and coffee shop. Clean and comfortable rooms for a good price

allReviews.title: Excellent Off Strip Resort
allReviews.text: Excellent stay, exactly what I expected and wanted of my LV trip - close enough to the action/half a block from the hustle bustle of the strip’s four corners, at a great well run clean laid back resort with great staff all around, I would definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: Loved it!
allReviews.text: This is truly a fantastic hotel in Las Vegas. You are not on the strip, but just outside it. I thought that was a big advantage, because the hotel is more quietly located than other hotels. The hotel had a very nice swimming pool with nice beds, towels and enough space. The room was very spacious and very clean. Someone also came knocking twice because a kitchen light didn't seem to be working and they wanted to solve it immediately. I would recommend this hotel to everyone!

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: Always a great time.Very helpful.There for a convention. Rooms are big.Great pool. Great bar, coffee shop.It isn't the glam life like on the strip but very very pleasant. I actually like it. A lot more calm and larger rooms than pretty much anywhere

allReviews.title: Last minute stay
allReviews.text: Called at 1:00 AM to see about vacancy and was in bed in the room at 2:00. After a flight fiasco, and no way to get out of Vegas that night, Tuscany Suites really came through. The rate wasn’t that high for a last minute stay. Room was clean and bed was comfortable. Slept really well.

allReviews.title: What a great property
allReviews.text: Had a great time. The property was very clean. Room was huge and very nice. Staff was very helpful. I was even able to park with my trailer. I would not hesitate to book again in the future. Thank you

allReviews.title: Will Be Back
allReviews.text: We love staying here, great room, and wonderful staff, food at Marilyn's is great! Several of our friends have stayed on multiple occasions, including search and rescue dog team, love that they accept animals.

allReviews.title: Good value
allReviews.text: Great location, spacious room and lovely pool, free towels and beds. Close to the strip, nice staff. Casino and restaurants next door with lots of options to eat. Not too expensive and of good quality

allReviews.title: Bad odds at video poker
allReviews.text: I have been going to the Tuscany for years along with members of my family.  We love to play Double Double Bonus Video Poker.  Recently, the casino drastically reduced the payouts for this game.  Love the rooms and the hotel, but the gaming experience is now too expensive.

allReviews.title: Love It
allReviews.text: Love it! Easy to get in, loved the spacious rooms, the pool was nice!  I liked not having to walk all the way through a casino just to get to your room the villa energy was great when you worked all day!  Plus it was across from my favorite restaurant, Fire Fly!

allReviews.title: could have been better
allReviews.text: nice property, could be better managed. check in /room allocation delayedloud as room opposite the construction site. Pub 365 : service not that great on 1st sept:- rude server- had to wait 40 minutes for the drinks, when reminded, the server was rude " said they had a big party in the next room so we should be patient".- the servers ask you load the app to get gifts , however the bought beers could  not be linked to the app so basically a rip - off.

allReviews.title: It is good stay experience
allReviews.text: Nice service,and clean room ,clean swim pool. convenience to strip, and shopping. The construction everywhere is only hold back. Front desk is very nice and helpful. Casino room smoking smell is very strong

allReviews.title: Hotel is good ,Casino is horrible,just take money.
allReviews.text: Room is good,service is  good,restaurants is good but casino pay is horrible,every month is worst more than before...slot machines are empty  people stay and play 10c because when sit they lost money and continue with 10c,20c.... can't go back home in a half hour ,just came...this is shame...looks like almost robbery...if someone got some jackpot this is usually turist,casino attracts them to come again.I am 3 times per week at casino and they never called me at tournaments for  free play from komputer but when I use room I was called,computer doesn't know who is from Vegas ,just selects guests...I love all workers,they are good but you guys who made paying,you are so greedy...casino is not secure ,3 times from me was stolen my two purses and one time debt card...You need to open machines ,don't be greedy,old Tuscany owner passed away years ago,he was businessman good,he wasn't too greedy like you....just let you know what players talking about Tuscany Casino's up stairs management!Have a nice day!

allReviews.title: Excellent solution to enjoy Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Located a few minutes walk from the heart of the Strip, it has huge free parking, swimming pools and gardens. It offers very large and well-kept suites, clean and welcoming. Excellent solution to enjoy Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best Casino Hotel to enjoy Las Vegas!!
allReviews.text: Very quiet, nice landscaping to walk through. My wife said it was one of the nicest hotels she has stayed in. Marilyn s Cafe had the best food close by. Pools were relaxing. Away from busy noisy traffic, Great to relax and enjoy Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: A great experience
allReviews.text: Great Customer service and clean rooms.The rooms are nice and big full with lots of towels and rags in the restrooms.The beds are big complemented by soft pillows. The staff there was great they help me with any issues I had.

allReviews.title: Tuscany suites hotel
allReviews.text: I alway there many times that is my favorite place. Also easy car parking first floor than building. This Tuscany suites hotel nice bedroom more space. Hotel is very quiet and cleaning hallway and inside bedroom too. I have no problem. Next time, I always reservation same Tuscany suites hotel period.

allReviews.title: Great for the price
allReviews.text: Overall it was good experience. Affordable compared to the strip. Quieter and very close. Service at all the restaurants and pool were pretty slow. The hotel feels dated. There is a lot of maintenance needed. Every single elevator was running slow, offline or had a broken button somewhere. Again it was okay but they need to invest some serious money back into this hotel

allReviews.title: nice hotel bland restaurant food
allReviews.text: The hotel was nice and clean. The room was huge for Las Vegas. However the food was not good. The dinner service at one place and it could be because they were training new staff. I can't believe that the restaurants got the Best of Vegas awards.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: Awesome customer service. We felt like VIP’s. Our room was serviced late in the day when we called because we were resting. Enjoyed the casino as well and the restaurants inside the Tuscany. We enjoyed the swimming amenity as well.

allReviews.title: Great Value!, Nice Hotel, Well Worth It!
allReviews.text: I was very pleased with my stay at the hotel. I found the front desk staff very accommodating. I did not realize I had booked run of the house rooms ( had booked 4 rooms for family members) and wanted 2 double bed rooms and 2 king rooms. When we arrived (at 12:30am) they could only provide 4 double bed rooms so we took that for the night and they made the change the following morning. Nice location, close to the strip, easy Uber to almost anywhere. Nice restaurants and coffee shop, good casino. Thought it was a very good value for the money. Rooms were spacious and clean. I would definitely use in the future. Price was so much more reasonable than on the strip and we were there Labor Day weekend.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites is a great experience.
allReviews.text: The rooms are very spacious with great amenities. The house keepers are excellent and thorough. The restaurants, Fitness facilities, check in staff, valet and Casino on site, were all top notch. The only thing is that I wish the whole casino was non-smoking. It's a short walk to the Strip.

allReviews.title: Bad Internet Services
allReviews.text: Over all, quite good .  Your WIFI set up is so ancient.  Offering free "low speed" then charging for an upgrade is so ancient and misleading.   Rooms are great though.  Very cooperative staff at the front desk and on the grounds

allReviews.title: Comfy but No Breakfast
allReviews.text: Room was very large and comfortable. Maybe a little outdated but still very clean. The complex is huge - multiple buildings. Our building did not have a front desk - if we needed something we would have to walk past several buildings. And, no breakfast was available unless we bought it. Water refill stations would also be nice - in triple digit temps it got very expensive to keep purchasing bottled water.

allReviews.title: Surprise hotel find off the strip
allReviews.text: First time staying off the strip, and I was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem.  About a two block walk from the strip.  Property was well maintained and had a very relaxing atmosphere for a Vegas hotel.  Nice pool area.  Great restaurants too.  Prices were very reasonable for a suite.

allReviews.title: Easy stay
allReviews.text: Loved how the casino was not over crowded and we even won a little.  Not too far away from everything else.  Las Vegas walkable!!!!!  Pool looked nice but we never had the time to get in it.  We will probably go back.  Beds are kinda hard, only draw back.

allReviews.title: Lovely stay at the Tuscany
allReviews.text: Wonderful from start to finish! Helpful friendly staff, very clean rooms, nice environment. I love the placement of the Tuscany. Not on the strip but close enough to easily go have some fun. Thank you so much we had an excellent sat and will be back.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel to stop at . Stayed 2 weeks and was well looked after . The casino is not the most exciting but your 6 min walk from the horseshoe . The pool is excellent and your well looked after by Dania the pool lady .
