allReviews.title: Fabulous place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful resort with a large pool. Friendly and helpful staff. Lots of food choices, live entertainment at night. Large, comfy, clean room. Quiet and peaceful, but only an easy 5min walk to the strip.

allReviews.title: Fabulous
allReviews.text: Great place to stay with fabulous entertainment Relaxing resort with lovely pool area.Rooms are large and comfortable Great food too ! Thanks to Daiva and all the staff for looking after us. Looking forward to our next visit

allReviews.title: Quiet, clean and friendly
allReviews.text: Stayed 1 night, arrived at my room and turned on the air conditioning. The unit put out only warm air, called the front desk and maintenance replaced unit. Instantly had a cold room. Love this place very quiet clean. The staff is very polite and professional.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: Staff was one of the best we have had on our trip, everyone was helpful, courteous, and friendly.  The room was superb, clean, comfortable, and quiet.  A great experience and would heartily recommend.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: The service, staff, rooms are great. The food at the Pub wasn't bad, but they can work on improving a Piña colada. However, you can hear every step taken from the floor above. It's very annoying at 4am.

allReviews.title: Relaxing and restful.
allReviews.text: As usual a top notch place to stay. Only three issue I had was a speeding towel delivery truck driver, a person possibly casing parked cars in the parking lot, and construction  traffic on Flamingo. It's my 3rd or 4th time staying there. I'll be back.

allReviews.title: Meet with friends
allReviews.text: The room(apartment)was great,clean,satisfied totally with my stay except that i have a lil misunderstanding about the price but everything was resolved in the end.The bathroom and bed was great,coffee in the morning,etc...

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Liked that the hotel and casino are in separate buildings.  It was not noisy and smoky on check in. There is a bar area in the hotel with live music and a couple of restaurants on site. Conveniently located. Plentiful parking. AC in room was very noisy but everything else was great.

allReviews.title: Our honeymoon that wasn't so sweet at first
allReviews.text: I had a horrible experience when I first got there. I was crying and hyperventilating in your lobby because it was my wedding day, and my make up and hair people were in the lobby waiting for me to get my room,so I could get ready but since I couldn't check in I had to get my hair and makeup in the bathroom of your hotel. I couldn't believe this was happening all because I didn't have a major credit card. But the kicker was after all of that to have my card used for my stay and all the hurt and embarrassment and stress and devastation and fear I experienced on the biggest day of my life could all have been avoid. Other than that the resort itself is perfect and beautiful. Very peaceful,easy to navigate, gorgeous pool and a very romantic fire pit. The restaurant are excellent and the location is EVERYTHING!!!! I would definitely stay again because other than the one manager who gave us a very hard time the staff was very friendly helpful and very nice and its literally the perfect location! Thank you for a lovely stay!

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: beautiful and friendly. very nice cleaning people. when in need for anything it was brought up immediately... thank you we hope to be back soon!!!!!beds and room where very lovely and comfy bathroom was spacious as we had four women together..

allReviews.title: Great Stay, Great Location, Fair Price
allReviews.text: the only thing that could have made it better was getting water from the front desk without a charge, it was nice to receive water to the room though! My group had a great time! We could see a glimpse of the Sphere from our room and walking out of the lobby it’s fully visible which was awesome!

allReviews.title: Lack Of Courtesy
allReviews.text: The hotel its self is not bad but they proceeded to do construction on room above me my entire stay, Not exactly what you want to wake up to in the morning is drywall repair and for the morning that I was not awoken by construction it was because they were washing my window with a water hose. Make sure you get to the pub before 1 even though its advertised open until 2 it closes at 1. This hotel lacks in common consideration and courtesy. I will not be returning.

allReviews.title: Awesome as usual
allReviews.text: Off the strip but walking distance to most places. Parking abundant and easily accessible with no fee and close to your room. Rates always great. For a cafeteria, Marilyn's food is better than most restaurants with better than average pricing. If you want an  upscale dinning experience go the the Tuscany Gardens. I've been staying at the Tuscany Inn for the last 5 years. You won't be disappointed.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites is a hidden gem and definitely underrated. The grounds are gorgeous and well kept. Many upgrades and refreshed areas. Most clean hotel in Vegas. Energy efficient all throughout property.  Ambience provides a European feel. Short walk/car ride to the strip. Family friendly and no shady characters in sight. Staff is so welcoming and friendly! Truly, a great spot and stay.

allReviews.title: Nice Digs
allReviews.text: A roomy and very comfortable Suite. The fact that the Buildings are apart from the Casino make the experience much quieter. Really enjoyed the stay.Will definitely consider planing my next trip, weather business of pleasure staying here.

allReviews.title: August Vacation to Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Despite rainy weather we had a great time in Vegas.  Love the lounge shows at Tuscany Suites.  Staff was amazing as always.  Location close to the strip is nice.  We would definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Awesome but resort fees ruin the over experience
allReviews.text: Overall great experience, nice room, clean.  My only complaint is the mandatory resort fees charged that we never use. I didn’t know these fees would be changed until I was checking in.  Booked online through 3rd party

allReviews.title: Pleasant and relaxing hotel-casino
allReviews.text: Free parking without the need for a valet. Several buildings of up to 3 floors. Our two queen room was huge, with a living room and kitchen. Tree-lined paths between the different buildings.Pleasant pool area. Several internal restaurants and cafes where you can dine or have breakfast.Not too far from the Bellagio fountains (about 10-15 minutes walk).Compared to the mega complexes of Las Vegas or skyscraper hotels, this hotel is less chaotic and more relaxing.I would definitely recommend it.

allReviews.title: Top Hotels!
allReviews.text: Top Hotel!!! Rooms as large as if they were a studio apartment and clean, large bathroom. Comfortable bed. If you want to have breakfast you can go to the "caffè bottega" which is a place inside the hotel. Good location. For me it is 10 in all this structure.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay
allReviews.text: We had an amazing and relaxing stay! Our room was big and comfortable. It smelled nice and clean. A dinig table and chairs plus a sofa made us feel home. There was a mini kitchen area but no supplies were provided. Although, we found the TV to be small for the room and the beds seem not for double. The pool was nice and enjoyable. Retaurants were available so no need to go out but near the hotels are several restaurants as well. We enjoyed staying here, we will be back!

allReviews.title: Complete
allReviews.text: Room were great , staff was very helpful and friendly t/o the property. Definitely will stay again. They had everything needed to just stay on property, only thing missing was table games . Restaurant was awesome as well

allReviews.title: Top
allReviews.text: Beautiful suite and minimal expense...it has a nice swimming pool, free internal parking, clean and beautiful...if I returned to Vegas I would 100% return here...a stone's throw from the strip, among other things in its most beautiful part ...very low figure indeed

allReviews.title: There for convention; and enjoyed every moment!
allReviews.text: The suites are huge! The beds, and bedding, wonderful.The food is spectacular; even the happy hour specials are first class!There is free live entertainment every night, and The Rat Pack is Back is so fun to flash back to the 60’s when Everyone was offended; and nobody cared!!!

allReviews.title: Perfect stay off the strip
allReviews.text: It was a quiet and cozy night’s sleep! Nice pool and the  room was spacious and clean. Would stay there again. Restaurants were close by and the cab ride to the strip was around $15 including tip. What a fun time we had!

allReviews.title: Rooms are old and smell
allReviews.text: Very disappointed!! We have been staying at Tuscany Inn for years. And always happy because rooms were clean and spacious. This time the room smelled so bad like cigarettes and it was a nonsmoking room. And everything in the room was so old. We won’t be back. 😡 And hotel staff was not accommodating or apologetic about the smoke smelling room. We checked out as early as possible and we’re out of there.

allReviews.title: Weekend get away.
allReviews.text: Disappointed. I’ve stayed several times and was let down because of no card tables. Beware that they add a 22% service fee at the pool. So do you still tip after the service fee? Well I did for the sake of the server.

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: Check in and Check out was easy and not in the casino. Room was comfortable with a nice view. Amenities included coffee in the room, a refrigerator and much more. Great cafe and live music in the evening in the lounge/bar. Would stay again

allReviews.title: The place is nice .
allReviews.text: The place is Nice without the hassle of the strip hotels. They need table games . The  grounds and pool area were clean . Pub 365 is Outstanding .The main hotel bar is what you would expect of a hotel in Las Vegas .

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: We like the hotel, the staff were really nice the pool was great and our room was clean and comfortable. It had coffee, a small fridge and table to sit at. It is close to the strip, and easy walk and much less noise. The only negative thing was we thought the lobby had a funny smell.

allReviews.title: My solo getaway
allReviews.text: It was a very peaceful solo vacation and spend time in prayer with Jesus. I was able to complete all of my Summer session in school. I purchased a timeshare for the first time. Very exciting decision for future vacation plans. Thank you 😊🙏🏿

allReviews.title: Amazing Hotel
allReviews.text: Perfect walk distance from Strip, easy parking, perfect pool, big rooms, very good bed. It is my second time in this hotel and I`ll come back for sure. Best value/benefit in Vegas. Very good amenities.

allReviews.title: The working vacation that was all play
allReviews.text: This was one of the best " Get aways" ever, it was so nice I stayed a few extra days..  Every morning when it came time to check out, I just couldn't do it, the Tuscany was very accommodating and I would add another day,, I did that twice and so now it's Monday morning and I must return to reality,, until next time ...

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Best hotel off the strip!  Our go-to forever when it comes to staying in Vegas.  Within walking distance of the strip but without all the craziness of the strip casinos. Gigantic rooms with lots of amenities, immaculate, awesome staff and great rates.   So happy we found you!

allReviews.title: Satisfying customer
allReviews.text: We enjoy our stay at Tuscany Suites. The staffs are friendly and the room is very spacious and clean. We like that it’s away from the strips but not too far. I recommend Tuscany to anyone, especially our friends and family

allReviews.title: In Las Vegas without the typical confusion
allReviews.text: Far from the confusion of the strip which can be reached with a twenty minute walk.Although small compared to the typical megastructures of Las Vegas, it lacks nothing of what you expect in the city of entertainment: swimming pool, casino, restaurant, bar, pub and nightclub.

allReviews.title: Return Visit
allReviews.text: Friendly staff, clean room. The food is great, and I love their cappuccinos. Always a pleasure. I messed up and made the reservation for the wrong date and they rectified the error and did not charge me for the mistake.

allReviews.title: Not the greatest visit
allReviews.text: Rooms were only ok Room was not spotless, shower would not maintain temperature. Shower valve was broken. Took over 2 hours to get batteries changed in tv remote. Customer service was untrained and didn’t know proper procedures.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: Like a big holiday village in the middle of Las Vegas. Very cheap, extremely comfortable beds, microwave brought immediately free of charge on request. 15' walk to the Strip/Bellagio/Eiffel Tower. Very nice staff, parking in front of the door, low additional charges, great pool.

allReviews.title: Nice, relaxing hotel
allReviews.text: We spent 4 nights at Tuscany’s, very nice , resort style hotel, more on the quiet, relaxing style, this was exactly what we were looking for,  to stay away from the crowds on the strip.The room was clean, spacious (avoid block A on the road side),  we spent 1 night in this block and we changed the room as it was noisy, we could hear the traffic outside), the staff was very nice and helpful to accomodate us.The gardens / patio are well maintained and the pool is clean with quality chairs & shades, towels are provided.We also enjoyed the food options at the hotel, Cafe Bottega was our favourite with delicious coffee, smoothies, sandwiches, muffins and salads!The hotel is at 10-15 min walk from the strip, which was perfect and we also used uber(good prices)  to go downtown or to further hotels.We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel and loved our Las Vegas experience, we will definitely return!

allReviews.title: A Person
allReviews.text: I love the Tuscany for its friendly atmosphere. I have a favorite machine  at which I sit. The employees are very helpful and the environment is clean. I always have a good time here. It is also not overcrowded.

allReviews.title: Short Vegas Trip To Visit Family Who Spends A Lot Of Time At Tuscany
allReviews.text: Our room was as described and the bed was comfortable, housekeeping was on top of everything....Service at Marilyn's was good as usual,  (German) was awesome and made us laugh... on Sunday  8/20, The Pub 365 was terrible,  our server Katrina was rude and the looks she gave me when I questioned her were unacceptable...if looks could kill, I'd be dead.  We talked to the manager at the Pub and he was useless as well...I understand wanting to stand up for your employees, but what about the customer?  We ended up speaking with the MOD for the resort and he took our statement and gave us 4 free drink tickets, offered to pay for our dinner at Marilyn's and ensured us someone from upper management would be contacting us since we were staying there....well, we paid for our own dinner, and gave the drink tickets to someone else since we were gambling and drinks were free...Five days later and still haven't heard from "upper management ".The 2 star rating is based on the Pub experience.

allReviews.title: Bad  Experience and Guest Service
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before and loved it so this time we decided to indulge ourselves with the upgraded Executive Pool View with Lanai as described on their website. My wife had planned on massage, and we love the restaurants onsite and the nightly entertainment. Well it all started shortly after we arrived: We arrived at 2:30 PM & we were told our room would be ready in 15-20 minutes, they were putting a rush on it. OK not bad as we were a bit early, at 3:10 PM, were were told yes they were in room cleaning another 15-20 minutes. At 4 pm, the front desk told us might be 5 or 6 pm. That's ridiculous. Room was finally was ready around 4:35 PM. When we finally  got into our room about 5 pm after moving car, (and waiting on valet service for luggage), the closet doors were off the track, and we had requested a microwave which was suppose to be in the room and wasn't. The biggest disappointment came when we opened our curtains to our lanai.  We had paid for the upgraded Executive Pool View Room with Lanai. We had a view of the backs of two huge lanais. All canvas Tents: NO VIEW AT ALL. The best they could do was move us to a cheaper room the next day, and charge us less. (They had an empty room next to ours with the view we paid for) that was empty, but later that night they checked someone else into that room. The first desk clerk called told us we could move to it, but another clerk called back later called and said we couldn't and didn't have a room with the view available.  We will never be back. Here is Tuscany's Description on hotel website:    Enjoy an upgraded suite, overlooking our resort lagoon style pool and lush landscapes.  Our Pool View Executive Suites offer a prime location within the property, offering even easier access to the resort and casino facilities.  (check out our photos of the room they gave us)! We had loved this place, and referred our friends and clients there. Never again. We booked a room the next morning at a larger hotel on the strip, received early check in, upgraded room with the view we paid for...same price.

allReviews.title: Humble and understanding staff
allReviews.text: Awesome experience here, staff and security were helpful and friendly. 5 stars. Huge room, was never bothered. When we needed help security and front desk staff was there. Fast wifi. Air conditioning worked great.

allReviews.title: Please refund 1 room on this Tuscan Hotel trip
allReviews.text: Hello ,we need a refund on one of the rooms ,we booked 2 rooms and we we arrived the hotel had a problem  and would only give us 1 room - it took an hour to get us in .and after driving 5 hours we were stuck with 1 room very uncomfortable and didn't sleep well  .This was business and the hotel situation was ruff .please credit 1 room .Thank you Richard West / Credit to Lena Andre card

allReviews.title: Pull Out Couch, No sheets.
allReviews.text: I stumbled in at 3am with no reservation. I told the front desk person I need a bed and also a pull out couch bed to accommodate my family.  I was told no problem. I got to my room and there were no sheets waiting for me for the couch bed. I was told by the manager the next day that I had to ask for them. I think it’s poor protocol to not have them sent immediately once it was clear I was using the bed. I as a customer should not have to ask for them a second time. I slept on the coach bed without sheets  because I was too exhausted to call housekeeping at 3:30am for something that should have been sent automatically. The manager did take of the resort fee which I appreciated but I think as a management staff your protocols need to change for this situation. Especially, when I’m paying that much money for one night and the check out was 11am. It was not a good experience and it could have been had your team thought through this vs. putting it on me to ask.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Tuscany. We ate at Pub 365 and it was delicious! We used the pool and the kids had a blast. The rooms were a nice size and the mini fridge was a nice bonus.  We will definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Spacious rooms
allReviews.text: The rooms were big and spacious which was a big plus. The only minor issue we had was finding  pair of socks underneath the bathroom sink which was probably left from the precious guest. Then we received bath towels that had brown stains on them.  We were on the 1st floor so it got annoying when the guest in the room above of us (their child) were running and jumping up and down. Next time I will request to be on a higher floor.  Overall it was a nice facility and will return again.

allReviews.title: Fun Visit
allReviews.text: We loved the size of the rooms, the pool was great, cabana service was excellent. Food was very delicious at all restaurants. Gift shop has everything you could need and more. Walking distance to strip. Casino was decent.

allReviews.title: Stay for tournament
allReviews.text: Was quoted one price over phone got charged more and power went out multiple times during the ATA tournament at the hotelIce maker was broke on our floor as well didn’t get in same building with friends

allReviews.title: Fun time
allReviews.text: I love the lap pool and gym. The Rat Pack show was great and soo funny. I am telling everybody about the show as it was that good. The rooms were spacious and very clean. Great coffee choices and sandwiches

allReviews.title: We found our new home away from home
allReviews.text: Only stayed the night because of a family celebration.A beautiful spacious suite, good staff, nice little casino.Stayed in a lot of casinohotels in the past, this one is excellent for a good price.We'll be back!!!

allReviews.title: Top hotel
allReviews.text: Good, clean and spacious room, spread over several low-rise buildings. At a relatively low price per night compared to other hotels. 2 blocks from the Strip, intersection Flamingo road. Free parking. Friendly staff.

allReviews.title: Clean Clean Clean
allReviews.text: Everything was awesome. I have told at least 20 people to book there next year. They gave a special price for the multiple rooms we booked for the conference. My room was clean in Building F, Third Floor. No smoke smell. And the keys worked as expected. The only downside is that I received an email asking when I wanted to check in, and I stated 1:00pm. I came from the airport and was told I could not check in until 4pm. Why ask your customers what they need if you have no intention of honoring their needs? The bellman did keep my bags so I was able to go get lunch and meet up with others. But I was not able to freshen up and had airplane clothes on the whole time...that was not the best.

allReviews.title: A Great Place at a Great Price
allReviews.text: The Tuscany is my hotel of choice in Las Vegas.  It is right in the middle of the 'action', yet less hectic and over-crowded than the high-rise resort-casino hotels.  I also love the free and ample parking, which is somewhat of a rarity in Las Vegas these days. The food, drink and entertainment was excellent!  Friendly staff, great rooms and good rates.  What more would anyone want in a resort casino hotel?

allReviews.title: The best price / comfort hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Tuscany Suites is a great place just off the strip, super friendly staff, big rooms nice pool & facilities and all at reasonable prices.The Casino is also big enough and they have regular competitions / events

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel for the value!!!!
allReviews.text: I was very impressed with this hotel! Came in for a business trip decided to stay off the strip, and what a great decision that was! The hotel was super clean, staff was wonderful, and my room was fantastic!! I got the pool view executive room 620 ft.² and it was the perfect choice. The price I paid I thought it wouldn’t live up to the photos I saw online it but I was wrong and it exceeded my expectations!!I highly recommend this to people who don’t want to be on the noisy Strip!!! It was an easy walk from the hotel to get to the Strip.

allReviews.title: Casino
allReviews.text: The place was awesome worker are nice and very helpful I will be back thanks again and the casino was good and very friendly and clean my wife said she had fun for her birthday and want to come back so we will definitely be back

allReviews.title: Great sized rooms in a quieter location
allReviews.text: Good location just off the strip. About a 15 min walk to Las Vegas Blvd. Low rise buildings.  Cafe is pretty good for food, unimpressed with the Pub (Pub 365) especially the food choices.Rooms are a great size with plenty of space to scatter your stuff

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: When I head to Vegas, I always stay at the Tuscany, I love the pool and all the surroundings of an old Italian building. I also love the fact that it’s a couple blocks off the strip so it’s not crazy 24/7

allReviews.title: Have stayed here several times
allReviews.text: Love this property.  Beautiful grounds.  Great home cooking restaurant with reasonable prices.  Nice casino.  Plenty of free parking.  Big room and bathroom that were quiet.  Our first room had a leaking air conditioner that soaked our carpet so we moved to a different room.

allReviews.title: Tuscany ... just ok.
allReviews.text: Overall the room was "acceptable"The couch is extremely uncomfortable 😫 The shades wouldn't close all the way. The screen door was broken and it took nearly a day to get the refrigerator to work.Your staff was friendly. Bummer your restaurant was closed. The Pub was a drag. Workers weren't great.Food was at times BAD and not a mention of "oh can I get something else for you" ... Paid alot for the 2 rooms. Not sure what I will do in the future.

allReviews.title: Great value and excellent Italian restaurant on grounds.  Nice pool.  Renovated rooms.  Ask for a top floor.
allReviews.text: Great value and excellent Italian restaurant on grounds.  Nice pool.  Renovated rooms.  Ask for a top floor.

allReviews.title: Had a great time!
allReviews.text: The set up was like apartments, not hard to get around. I liked that we didn't really have to leave the hotel to enjoy ourselves. Tuscany had it all...entertainment, restaurants, cafes, a gift shop, and close to the strip!

allReviews.title: Greats!
allReviews.text: Friendly staff! Room are big and great! Casinos amazing! Food is great! Easy to get around! Bars at the casino are Amazon! Highly recommended for the price! Quiet rooms! Had a great time here for 4 days!

allReviews.title: Large rooms and good service
allReviews.text: Staff was great, the size and the servicing of the room was perfect. The large guest room was refreshing since we were not crowded in. The restaurant was great and my friend loved he carrot cake. We will certainly be back.

allReviews.title: Nice room, friendly staff, quiet location
allReviews.text: A great place to avoid the noise of the strip. Everything there is nice, rooms are comfortable, and I always enjoy my time there, this is maybe my 5th or 6th time staying there while visiting in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: Check in was easy, very quiet and our room was spacious and comfortable. My only complaint is that we wanted a microwave, and we called while we were out seeing a show. They wouldn’t deliver it unless we were there. So we didn’t get back until 11:30 and then had to wait. But it was fairly quick and he was super nice. I will definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: Close to the Strip without the $$$
allReviews.text: The room was large and clean. Unlike other hotels in Vegas, the room had a kitchenette (with coffee maker and fridge), dining table, and a desk. Relatively close walk to the Strip, less than 15 minutes.

allReviews.title: Good option for hacker summer camp
allReviews.text: Great  location  off  the  strip. Good  options  for  breakfast. Very  helpful  staff. A little  bit  old, but quiet enough for reading on the pool and family-oriented. Extra bonus: you get a good view of the sphere.

allReviews.title: 5 Stars from the Family!
allReviews.text: The hotel is great! We 50th Annual Family Reunion there and it was amazing. The staff was so polite, kind, helpful and professional. The rooms are newly renovated. They are large and spacious!  The ballroom size was perfect for our family function. The pool area was so nice and kid friendly.  5 Stars!

allReviews.title: Great hotel!
allReviews.text: I really love staying at the Tuscany. It’s the third time I’ve stayed there. It’s a great hotel. I love the restaurants everything is very conveniently located. It’s only a quick walk about 15 minutes to some of the other places in the middle of the strip.

allReviews.title: Always a good experience, and a good price
allReviews.text: The Security BSides Las Vegas conference has been at Tuscany for many years, they've always been great to work with. The hotel rooms are large, and kept clean- and you can't beat the price. The location is right off the strip, and being off-strip means it is easier to navigate the rest of the city, on or off-strip.

allReviews.title: Nice property only blocks from the strip;
allReviews.text: Nice clean and spacious room, only thing missing was a microwave oven. I've stayed here many times and it never disappoints.  You get no noise from the strip traffic and the staff was very courteous. I look forward to another visit soon.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: This is an absolute hidden treasure! The prices of the rooms are very affordable. The rooms were very clean, as were the outside grounds. The only thing I would like to see is maybe some sort of shuttle for the buildings that are further away from the street and lobby.

allReviews.title: Mostly Good
allReviews.text: I've stayed at this hotel a few times and love it. During this trip I was a little disappointed as the bathroom was not fully cleaned. There was hair in the bathtub and hair on the shower walls. I had to wipe down the counter as well.

allReviews.title: My stay at was Perfect
allReviews.text: Excellent! We totally enjoyed our visit what we have talked about the most is our stay at your hotel! Thank you we would love to come again... Send your special deals we might come back sooner! Thank you for everything!

allReviews.title: I very happy staying at the Tuscany.
allReviews.text: I come to Vegas every other week for the last 3 months and I very happy staying at the Tuscany. Issues come up no matter what resort you stay at, but I really like the way the Tuscany handle them. Thanks for making my stays comfortable.

allReviews.title: Bad service for a wheel chair person
allReviews.text: You should train your employees better so they know how to deal with discapable people because I had a very bad experience with your service and how you did not help when it was needed or when I asked for it

allReviews.title: A nightmare
allReviews.text: The check-in was an absolute nightmare. The person at the reception did not give me the type of room I had booked. It seems he did not know which rooms have king bed, queens beds, extra sofa-bed. After a while I insisted to talk to a responsible person. Finally more than two hours after our arrival to the hotel, I got what I had reserved.Rooms spacious, but with many broken things.Housekeeping staff friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Just perfect; great location, beautiful grounds, lovely bars
allReviews.text: For the USA, this hotel is fantastic value for money.  The grounds are beautiful, our room was out of this world, so spacious.  It is fantastically located at the end of the 'strip' with just a 10 minute walk and you are into the action in Vegas.  If there was one disappointment, it was that the casino was all slot machines, so if you want poker or roulette etc. you'll need to walk to other casinos.  But all in all, would very much recommend this wonderful place.

allReviews.title: Evo 2023
allReviews.text: Overall great stay! I would stay again next visit! Very spacious room and the amenities super clean very accommodating and accessible.Thank you for a very comfortable stay, it really did make the trip worth it!

allReviews.title: Hotel Stay
allReviews.text: Great property-we liked the feel of staying at a "smaller" hotel instead of a big high rise.  Rooms are huge & spotless.  Good location too-off the strip but within walking distance of everything.  The restaurants are great too.

allReviews.title: A good time and some minor flaws.
allReviews.text: Bathroom shower door needs adjustment. No big deal. Towel holder on wall fell off. Toilet seat lid won’t stay up. Unable to lock main door due to misalignment. Other than that, I love staying there. Classy, low density, relaxing.  Will definitely return.

allReviews.title: Great hotel in a great location!
allReviews.text: Great hotel in a great location and at a fair price for Las Vegas! Small structure of several buildings of 3 floors each and surrounded by palm trees. It feels like you're near the sea. We're a 10-minute walk from the strip: so we have the advantages without the disadvantages. We are calm!!The bedroom and bathroom are super big and very chic! Everything is super modern and nicely decorated. We have a table and chairs for eating in the room. There is a large fridge, it’s great!The pool is very nice and they lend us towels! Plus it closes at 10 p.m.! So you can relax after a long day of walking.You can park the car for free in a car park which is closed at nightThere are restaurants at the foot of the hotel if you wish.The bedding is great too: we slept really well. Very well soundproofed roomsIf I had the chance I would go back without hesitation!!! It's just magnificent!

allReviews.title: Below average
allReviews.text: The fridge was off when I arrived and the carpet was wet. The uncleaned shower had old soap and the cold water never got hot. I have stayed here a few times but this will be the last time. It is quite dated and the standard has dropped significantly.

allReviews.title: OK hotel but bed too small
allReviews.text: Hotel well located next to the strip however bed too small for 2 (120 cm) for the USA it's surprising entertainment in the evening in the hotel however it was indicated kitchenette and no dishes we had to ask for a microwave oven so apart from a refrigerator there is nothing

allReviews.title: Very good price-performance
allReviews.text: The room was clean, the shower was hot and self-parking and WIFI were important to us!The pool is also good.You could see the Sphere well from our hallwayNext time we're in Vegas we'll book Tuscany again

allReviews.title: Good but too bad for the swimming pool
allReviews.text: The rooms are beautiful, spacious and comfortable. The hotel is very pleasant and on a human scale.The only negative point: the swimming pool, too small with many children and young people jumping and screaming in the water until closing at 10 p.m. On the other hand, many people swim dressed and I find that it is not hygienic, in fact the water in the pool was cloudy. In short, with the heat in Las Vegas in the middle of summer, it's a problem.

allReviews.title: Perfect accommodations
allReviews.text: Room was spacious and clean, even though we would still be in the room when cleaning was being done, we always came back to made beds and new trash bags. Great price for the area and the hotel itself had a casino, spa, pool, and restaurants. Close to the strip and the monorail at the Horseshoe hotel, which we used daily. Friendly and helpful staff. Easy check in and check out process.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel casino in Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice hotel and casino. About 10 minutes to the Strip. Free parking and nice pool. Everything very neat and clean. Very large rooms, ideal for families. Large complex with several complexes.

allReviews.title: Excellent for the price.
allReviews.text: Rooms were spaces and the staff was super friendly.   Only complaint, the furniture was a little worn.  The grounds were well taken care of and it would be a nice place to spend relaxing or taking in some casino activity.

allReviews.title: Terrible
allReviews.text: I’ve been staying at the Tuscany twice a year for the last 5 years ish. This last trip was the final straw.  Also there was a negative incident during our previous stay that forced us to move rooms I won’t bother outlining here.  Will never stay there again. I realize it is 110 outside in July but they should not rent rooms that don’t have adequate AC. Our room never got below 79 degrees at night. We were in Vegas for work and it was miserable trying to sleep and function the next day! Talked to Manager and maintenance and the solution was to swap the AC unit out for another antique beat up old unit, that worked for 5 mins then stopped producing cold air. These rooms with the old AC units should not be rented. Either spend the money to replace them or don’t rent the space! To add insult to injury the ice machines in the building (n) stopped producing ice. I complained to management and they did nothing for us. Nothing! No gestures of good will. It’s as if they didn’t care if we ever came back. I realize something’s are out of their control but I feel they don’t value my business so I’m done with the Tuscany Vegas.

allReviews.title: Not great for families of more than 3.
allReviews.text: You get what you pay for. The rooms were very spacious but the beds were tiny. 2-full size beds and no pull out couch. A family of 4 can not even stay comfortably. Room service was not great.  Our room was clean but our friends had to be switched rooms as they found dog poop under the bed. I didn’t realize when we booked that the property was like an apartment complex. To get to the main casino or restaurants you had to walk outside in the 115 degree heat so we chose just not to use our own hotel for those things. There are two pools but both quite small considering how large this property is.

allReviews.title: Beds are not queen
allReviews.text: This is our second time staying here and we loved it but we are currently staying here (check out is 7/31/23) and so far we requested a double queen room and the beds are clearly not queens! Definitely doubles!!! We have 2 teenage boys that are 0ver 6’2 and both have queens at home and they can barely fit on the beds that were provided in our room! Not to mention my husband and myself can barely fit as well!! The last time we stayed here the beds were a true queens!! This is a disappointment given the fact that we will be here for 6 nights!

allReviews.title: Inconsistent but somewhat enjoyable.
allReviews.text: Everything looks good, but it has to function well too. Fridge and hot water issues. Card was supposedly declined but I received a confirmation email in May. Why did I get it then? Debit not allowed... should be better.

allReviews.title: Attending the champs show..
allReviews.text: Room was ready in advance,Clean.. No complaints at all!’Food at restaurants were great Bellman was very helpful, the gift shop for same basics was a bit pricey …Would highly recommend a stay at the Tuscany

allReviews.title: Will no stay again
allReviews.text: Bath are to old, customer service is terrible, the company of no,every thing I asked for was a no no no . building to far from the lobby. No shuttle bus to the airport.Resort fees to high.Good location, very close to the attractions, was the best of my stay.

allReviews.title: Safety hazard!!!
allReviews.text: We stayed in room B311, an executive suite with two queen size beds. The room was nice, however the toilet was so low to the ground for a child! My 80 year old mom, sat down to use the toilet and went to get up, and fell forward onto her knees! Zero bar, too grab onto! My mom is in incredible shape, zero meds and weight trains! She’s not an elderly 80 year old woman!  I would never recommend this place ever, I filled out a complaint! I know this is a safety issue for future guests! They have yet to respond to our complaint!

allReviews.title: Nice rooms but go anywhere else for gambling and entertainment
allReviews.text: The front desk staff did their job but we’re not very friendly.The “half price” Happy Hour was great and the drinks were delicious. The bartenders were polite and friendly and made good drinks as well as good conversation. And then I got the check. There was a Happy Hour service charge which literally added back in the “half” I thought I was saving. NOT COOL!!The casino was small and kind of sad and there were very few people in there .

allReviews.title: Horrible Experience!!
allReviews.text: Our suite was dirty! Hair in the shower and sink! The compensation was a $40 food and drink credit for three adults. What are three adults going to do with a total of $40 in Vegas?!  Also, one of the rooms was supposed to have double beds, and we had a king size bed.

allReviews.title: Nice place.
allReviews.text: Nice clean room, good restaurants, nest to eat at the restaurant due to a $1 take out charge on every item. ATM fee was only $3.50. Not to far from the main strip and about  17 min walk to the big wheel.

allReviews.title: Excellent clean Hotel and full Casino, a real gem, just off the Strip!
allReviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino, believe me, is a pleasant surprise, a bit of a hidden gem 2 blocks off the strip ! I have stayed at most of the 4 and 5 star hotels in Las Vegas and it is so pleasant as you don't have the tumult of people that you have in almost all of the Strip Hotels.It is only a 10-15 minute walk to the strip, and at an excellent price, which you may not have the ultra luxury that you may look for, but ist has almost everything that most  hotels and casinos have, but scaled down.I highly recommend trying it out, I will use it exclusively for any work related business I often have in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Too hot to live here. Grateful for the ac.
allReviews.text: It was a fine place to stay in Vegas. Good food, mostly quiet in my room. Other than the hotel price being more that I eco, the only one complaint I had was with the bathroom. The sink was a little clogged and the toilet seat was broken.

allReviews.title: Week day visit
allReviews.text: Slots were decent, not much sports betting, we’re not able to get a king size bed but still enjoyed our stay. Also Marilyn’s menu is not as good as it used to be. We spent time on the strip and Fremont street as well to get some diversity.

allReviews.title: Black spot in bed
allReviews.text: I was disappointed when I checked in. When I got to my room, there was a black spot in the bed. I call the front desk. I  was told the only thing they could do was bring me new bedding. I would have to make my bed up myself. I informed the man that I was talking to that this is unacceptable. I do not work for the hotel I’m a paying guess.

allReviews.title: Great week!!
allReviews.text: The food was great and everyone is so nice and friendly. It was very relaxing time for us ! The only thing to improve on was the bed. It was too hard. It would be good to put a grab bar in the shower.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: No microwave in the rooms. Major delta for me with such high food prices and no way to heat leftovers. I would have loved to go a cheaper route with food purchases but it was impossible Not every family can afford over $150 per meal.

allReviews.title: Great Trip!
allReviews.text: We were able to check in to our room early and didn't have any issues during our stay.  The hotel was clean and the staff was friendly.  We enjoyed meals at Marilyn's Cafe and Caffe Bottega.  We will definitely consider staying here again.

allReviews.title: An oasis in the middle of the strip
allReviews.text: The hotel is ideally located near the strip but quiet. It felt like an oasis in the middle of the hôtels towers around. We felt like in tuscany for real! The suites are big, clean and comfortable. The only minor flaw is that the beds are a bit small for 2 adults. The staff was helpfull and efficient. We had a great time there. Thank you

allReviews.title: Best place to stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The past 8 years we have done a July Vegas trip.Most of the time we have stayed at Tuscany Suites and whenever we stayed elsewhere we wished we were at Tuscany Suites. It is a awesome place to escape from the craziness of "the strip".

allReviews.title: Canceled
allReviews.text: Usually love staying here, but they canceled our reservation for not having a credit card to use for deposit. Other Vegas hotels do not require them so it was unfortunate. Had to find somewhere else same day.

allReviews.title: The Tuscany Resort and Casino is a Fine Property but could be improved.
allReviews.text: We had a nice experience overall, and I particularly liked the fine evening entertainment and the Rat Pack show/ excellent dinner. Unfortunately, the poster for Wed. night's free lounge entertainment time was an hour off which caused us to leave the poolside an hour early to see the musical performance. Posted entertainment times should be accurate.I asked for a microwave at check-in, and when I made the reservation online, but the requested microwave never arrived. I could have asked a third time.The reservation process and service were great. The room was spacious, well-maintained and clean. However, we were disappointed that our 3rd-floor pool view windows were dirty. I paid extra for the pool view, which unfortunately had dirty spotted windows. Pool view windows should be prioritized and squeaky clean. Who wants to look out through dirty spotted windows when they've paid extra for the pool view? Other than this disappointing issue, the room was great.I didn't appreciate the included tip in the lounge tab total, which was undisclosed. A tip line on the receipt does not show an amount, so it appears as if a tip is not included in the total. However, a tip Is Included in the total, which is split among the employees. Imo, that issue needs to be addressed, and other guests I spoke with felt the same. It's fine the way it is as long as you don't mind double-tipping!They have nice, free poolside shade umbrella tables, but more are needed. Shade is welcome on hot Vegas days, and more available tables and shade umbrellas would be an improvement for pool users! Either that, or they should build more shade over the pool area.Overall, the Tuscany Resort is a clean, well-maintained property we would highly recommend to others. They have nice amenities, free parking close to the rooms, good restaurants and bars, reasonable Las Vegas prices compared to many other hotels, and friendly staff. They offer guests a secure, pleasant environment, and we look forward to visiting again.

allReviews.title: Shocking  behavior at this resort
allReviews.text: I stayed at this location  for a work business trip. My company has stayed there  for many years. This year the hotel decided  to shut down the pool for a private  party for five days. No info before  we arrived that the pool would be closed. The group that shut down the pool was called Big Bear. From what I understand, it was a male gay organization.  Not only was the pool shut down, but the amount  of noise out in the hallways at 4 am was ridiculous.  The pot smoking out at the entrance to the buildings by this group was sickening.  Advertisements were left on the room doors promoting a gay party in the fall was unnecessary.  I complained to the front dest that this solicitation was unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino survey
allReviews.text: The property was clean, homy with very professional employees.Unfortunately, having to leave early and coming back late at night or early in the morning, prevented me from discovering and enjoying everything the beautiful site had to offer.

allReviews.title: Delightful little resort-style getaway
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here, this was the first time staying Vegas purely for pleasure and family instead of business, and Tuscany was exactly the sort of relaxing, laid-back environment that served as an oasis compared to the heat and hectic bustle of the strip. Would absolutely stay there again on subsequent visits.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: We were very happy with our stay over all. Clean rooms friendly feont desk staff. On site security was on their game . Beds were a little stiff for our liking.  Other then that our stay was amazing. Will be booking again!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed in many resorts over the years, and this is our favorite resort and casino! All the staff were friendly and welcoming. The food in all the restaurants was delicious. We enjoyed the happy hours at the restaurants with deals on food and beverages. We are happy that they brought back a casino host Jennifer who was great! The perks/rewards for playing at the casino were appreciated!

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites
allReviews.text: Found this hotel to be excellent value, i was in Vegas to play WSOP and the location was excellent, also the food and drink in both the Bar/Pub and restaurants was excellent quality and price, the pool area was very good, i would recommend this hotel and will book again myself next year

allReviews.title: Staycation
allReviews.text: I stay here quite often but this time was the worse. The air conditioning was not working in our room, the pool was dirty and had debri floating around and sticking to you. Housekeeping kept opening the doors around 9a trying to clean the room before check out and scared my kids, MULTIPLE TIMES!

allReviews.title: So sn so
allReviews.text: Heavy construction in area no one told us about small beds no options to get a rollaway bed we had double not allowed breakfast was same fare tasteless food room service was slow to respond to our needs

allReviews.title: Tuscany Suites Rooms
allReviews.text: The pillows were very uncomfortable and made it hard to sleep well. Overall the team is simple and clean. It was a great spot when having a rental car since parking is free. The gym and pool are great bonuses with the hotel

allReviews.title: Dirty room
allReviews.text: Dirty room urine stains on un-flushed toilet seat. A lot of dust. I only rented the room for the night bc we were too tired to drive back so at 2am I wasn’t trying to call down and switch rooms. When I checked out they didn’t ask how my stay was so I didn’t say.

allReviews.title: We loved our stay!
allReviews.text: We've stayed at the Tuscany a few times. We love the room space. The food onsite is excellent. Hotel is always clean and staff is always friendly and helpful. Hotel is walking distance to the strip. Kitchenette with no microwave but can be requested. Pool is good size. Entertainment onsite. Free and easy parking. Beds are comfortable. Price is great.

allReviews.title: Clean
allReviews.text: The room cleaning should always stay the same, in the beginning of my stay it was awesome cleaning then the cleaners started being different not as greats as it was in the beginning, maybe they tired?

allReviews.title: Great value! Would book again!
allReviews.text: Amazing value for a 15 minute walk from the strip. Very quiet property to get some rest between the excitement of Las Vegas. The room was very large, clean, and had all the amenities of a traditional hotel room with a few extras!

allReviews.title: Another great stay in my favourite Vegas property
allReviews.text: I stayed 9 nights in Tuscany during the last week of June and the first week of July, and this was not my first stay at the property.  I was again so pleased with my overall experience.  The location is central, the property is safe, the rooms are large, they provide a fridge (and microwave on request), and free coffee pods/machine in the room, and housekeeping is automatically provided without the need to "opt in".  I find the property so relaxing when compared to the strip properties.  The gardens are nice and well maintained, and most of the staff are friendly.  And I find that the slots in the casino are usually quite forgiving compared to  strip properties.  A special shout out to Ryan on the check-in desk, and Sonny on the door, who are both excellent and always friendly staff.  I feel that when compared to many other properties, the Tuscany doesn't try to nickel and dime guests on every single thing, like some of the strip properties.  As long as they understand what guests like about their property, and continue providing that, then I will happily keep staying there as my main property during any visit to Vegas.  What Tuscany has is quite unique nowadays, and the best thing they can do is to recognise and protect that, rather than try to copy strip properties.  Most of the guests who stay there, are wise to that, and looking for exactly the value that Tuscany provides.

allReviews.title: This trip was for us to visit Nevada
allReviews.text: Great place to stay in Vegas we stayed two nights room was clean thing that impressed me most is how nice the staff was . This trip was us to attend a driving school for new corvette owners so we were in and out of Vegas .

allReviews.title: Not again
allReviews.text: My husband and I went to Vegas for our Anniversary to see Chicago.  We booked months in advance at Tuscany Suites.  We have stayed before several times and like that the parking is close, it is a smaller hotel, they have dedicated non smoking buildings and before this time easy check in.  Went to check in and there was a very long line with many unhappy people.  By the time we got up to the window we were told they were overbooked and didn't have a room for us and would be sending us to another hotel for the evening.  Other people were checking in, but they were bumping us.  Not thrilled at all.  They moved us to the Westgate by the convention center where you can't walk to anything.  Had to go there and check in and wait in that line and they didn't even have the papers yet, but the lady was nice enough to check us in with a deposit.  The Westgate was fine, but then we had to pack it up and move the next morning, why they didn't just put us up there for 2 nights since that is all we were staying, not sure.  Of course, the room wasn't ready to get into after check out from Westgate so had to check in later.  The front desk didn't care at all.  Tried to get ahold of the general manager, Grayson and talked with his assistant Vonya on 2 separate occasions asking for a call back.  Well 4 months later and still no return call.  Was approached by another family when we were getting on the elevator who asked us if we were bumped and when we said yes, they said they had booked months ago too and were very upset.  We believe they bumped us because they booked a convention after we had already booked.  Would have been nice for them to call us ahead of time and say we overbooked and are going to move you to another hotel.  Then we could have made a decision at that point.  I had even called a week before to confirm that reservation and not a word.  Will not stay here again and have told everyone I know not to stay here.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Large room with comfortable bed. Fridge and coffee maker in room. Two pools, one lap pool and other one full size. Staff was very friendly. Walking distance to the strip. Casino on site and restaurants with good food. Close  to the airport.

allReviews.title: Beware Rate Changes!!!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Tuscany for a high school reunion. Booked a room under group rates and then was charged DOUBLE the group rate without notice. We tried talking with the front desk and were basically told they couldn’t do anything about it.The room was ok, but the beds were not especially comfortable. Overall disappointed, even though the reunion was fun.

allReviews.title: Missed the mark on so many levels
allReviews.text: Room was not ready until 5pm, 2 hours after check-in despite completing online check-in the day before.  Was not provided the room I reserved king vs 2 twin and i was told non were availablesince i didnt arrive early in the day.  Completing the online check-in is pointless.  It does save any time at check-in and the front desk staff doesn't seem to have access to the information.   Interactions with the front desk supervisor missed the mark in a city known for hospitality.

allReviews.title: Unable to use the pool
allReviews.text: This was our second stay at Tuscany and this time booked 3 rooms in Block G one with Lanai and pool access. Our party was 6 adults and this was booked 12 months in advance. I’ve ready in other reviews that “we should of called in advance” to find out if there was a block out booking or advent. We have no issues with the LGBTQ community, our issue was after paying a premium for a room with pool access, only to be told the pool area was closed for a private function for Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday. The reception supervisor Max who has NO customer service skill just stated “it’s our hotel and we do not need to tell you in advance there is a function and if you don’t like it, leave the hotel now and we will refund the balance of your stay” the pool is normal open between 7am to 10pm, this function has a DJ (at VERY high volume) until 2am. One of the management team Kerry  actually apologise that we were not informed in advance of our 9 night stay and agreed to move us to 3 rooms that were away from the party and arrange for us to use the pool in the hotel next door, not ideal but at least she tried to help. Unfortunately we will not be returning to Tuscany Suites.

allReviews.title: AMAZING event during Pride Month!
allReviews.text: Stayed here in Late May / Early June for an event and the hotel did an amazing job to make sure we were all taken care of.- Rooms are huge and clean, Housekeeping is quick to assist when something is running low.- Pub 365, Marylin Cafe & Cafe Bottega were all great with friendly staff and delicious food.- Check-in was seamless as we checked in online and at arrival we just picked up our room keys and went to our room.- Hotel was off the strip which made it quiet and peaceful however it was a close 15 minute walk to the strip.I would stay here again and recommend to all my friends and family.

allReviews.title: My Tuscany Experience
allReviews.text: We were here for an LGBTQ+ event, and we had a blast! The Tuscany was overall very inviting to us, and accommodated us to the best of their ability.  Nothing is ever perfect though, and there were some snags. It is just unfortunate that some people need to display their discomfort and entitlement for nothing other than rage-baiting, and falsely communicating to others that puts a negative spotlight on our community. We need our safe spaces to be ourselves. Tuscany was able to hold an event to create that atmosphere for us.

allReviews.title: Hidden off strip gem
allReviews.text: Great Las Vegas choice.  If you want a large room, off strip and friendly staff, then consider the Tuscany.  I have stayed there multiple times and it’s very walkable to the strip.  The room was large, comfy and clean.  The staff was great from housekeeping to restaurant servers to the front desk.  I would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great place! All workers were very friendly and the rooms were pleasantly larger than most equivalent Vegas rooms.Pool was very nice although the pool deck was a bit slippery. Definitely fell one time but luckily wasn’t hurt.Would definitely stay again!

allReviews.title: June 2023 Stay
allReviews.text: From the time we checked in to the time we checked out, we did not have an issue. The staff that we encountered was pleasant and accommodating. The food was good and we did not experience an issue with any of the outlets. Our room was large and clean. Great job to the housekeeping staff! Very nice place to stay.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: This is my second time staying at this resort.  As a frequent traveler to Vegas if you are looking for a nice place off the strip then this place is amazing. The rooms are HUGE, the staff is so friendly, the food options are great too.  LGBT friendly at that.  Great job Tuscany, we appreciate you!

allReviews.title: Thanks to a Tuscany for hosting our event
allReviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for a LGBT - staff was so great .  Great pool, affordable food .  Rooms are nice and large with couches and refrig.  Only one block fromStrip.  Free parking .  Maids don’t bang on doors so early like on strip

allReviews.title: Love the hotel for promoting a LGBT+event and showing their support
allReviews.text: First and foremost the the front desk and helpful and friendly and our king room was so roomie and spacious. Secondly, I wanna give props and shout out to the Tuscany hotel for not only making it welcome and safe to host a LGBTQ+ event, not including a bear event!!  There is nobody dressed inappropriately, as I was a attendee at the event and almost everyone was in sort of swimwear from speedo and bikinis, to swim shorts. Now what was best part was tall the vendors and before anyone states that their hanging inappropriate banners (like I know someone else already did)  they promoted different vendors from the LGBTQ COMMUNITY for a full week for fun and enjoyment. No unsure how anyone would have purchased a room on the hotels website directly as the dates were blocked off and were able to be booked unless purchased through a third party( however whatever way, if someone didn’t  like it, they could have talked to the front desk and and either canceling with a full refund)  the point being this hotel showed that they cared about our community and had a full hotel packed!!!! The only one complaint I had was the daiquiris that I bout were the big ones but no one told us the price and was 84 bucks for 2 of them but BRAVO TUSCANY, for showing ur support and hosting us  and WE LOOK FORWARD TO FUTURE EVENTS SO BE PREPAIRED AMD CALL AHEAD BEFORE BOOKING

allReviews.title: Great place!
allReviews.text: I was able to stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino this past weekend for an event and let me tell you, it is a great venue and would love to stay here again for pleasure and quiet time.  The pool area was great space and lot of lounge chairs to pick and being able to relax in it.  Love the food options too, if you don't feel like walking to the Strip for convenience purposes.  Marilyn's Cafe was a great spot for brunch and lots of options to choose from and Pub 365 was another great spot to watch the Stanley Cup Finals too.  The rooms were huge and spacious to hang out or take a nice nap.  Overall, I enjoyed the experience and the bear event was amazing.  Highly recommend this hotel and if you want to make sure there are no special events going on for the time frame you are going, call the hotel ahead of time.  You can always seek out other options that are not on the Strip and all.

allReviews.title: Good choice for convenient outdoor parking
allReviews.text: Resort style, good for family, with convenient parking near the rooms. Although the interior is not brand new, the rooms are free of smoke smell, the environment is quiet.  Close to the Vegas strip street.

allReviews.title: Comfortable & Quiet Property
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for 9 nights in May 2023. The property is off-strip which was absolutely perfect to get away from the noise and chaos of the strip. It is a very easy 5 min walk to the Horseshoe which links with Paris. The property is tidy. The rooms are a bit old but they are tidy, clean, and functional. We loved the huge size of the rooms and coffee maker. The first 3 nights we were placed in a room which was at the front of the property - street noise was unrelenting, and we were outside the lifts which had mechanical equipment that would turn on at random times during the night creating a huge vibration and loud hum. The hotel were great and moved us to another room which was completely silent. I would stay here again. I liked the location in relation to the strip. The pool area is lovely, and so are the grounds. My only complaint (and this applies to most hotels in Vegas) is the overwhelming stench of old cigarettes which hits you even before you enter the Main Lobby. Thankfully this smell was not in ANY of the accomodation blocks.

allReviews.title: Do better, Tuscany Suites!
allReviews.text: Double room for self, wife and son.  Beds were so small - wife and I had to sleep in separate beds.  Son had to sleep in couch (not pullout).  Someone came inside our room and turned off our AC (90’s in Vegas now).  Called to inquire - was scolded to remove “Do not Disturb” sign when leaving instead of addressing complaint.  Funny thing is the “Do not Disturb” sign was off the entire day.  Terrible service!  Very rude!  The guest services rep I called stated she could not help and she would call maintenance/engineering,  the AC works fine - someone just turned it off.  We were also told restaurant was open until 2am - kitchen closes at 1 so we missed late night dinner one evening and were too tired to go back out or wait on a delivery.  I would expect that Tuscany Suites could do better - especially with the outrageous resort fees being charged.  But not up to expectations.  I have asked for management and executive follow-up.

allReviews.title: Great Service Clean Rooms Hot Slots
allReviews.text: Omg, what can I say. The slots were Hot and my whole trip paid. For starters. As for the checkin great start. Catherine is truly phenomenal and takes customer service to the next level. She needs a raise! Upgraded to a king bed smoking room, we don’t smoke and if smoke smells don’t bother you, the room was very tolerable. The sheets were perfect as well as the bed. Very spacious room and big bathroom. Room has mini coffee pot to start of your day. The hotel has everything you need at decent prices. The entertainments are nice. Maid service very helpful. Security abundant and cordial. Pool areas clean and towels near by. Just a great experience. In my opinion the 150 holding fee is not much it came back 2 days after our stay. Also resort fee not too shabby compared to on the strip. Tax is tax  what can we say that’s not Tuscany fault. I feel that the people we encountered that worked at Tuscany or its Affillates such as the restaurants, are genuinely happy to be there and to me that goes to show this establishment is ran well. Don’t forget to tip, stop at the Botega,see the shows, and play those hot slots.We can at the beggining of the week right before Memorial Day.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas hotel!
allReviews.text: Have stayed at the Tuscany Suites on three trips to Las Vegas. It is a wonderful hotel and a nice break from the stiff, gaudiness of the Strip. Tuscany Gardens restaurant is excellent! Going back to the Tuscany in September.

allReviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
allReviews.text: We were looking for a place off The Strip with a relaxed atmosphere and a nice pool area and came across Tuscany Suites & Casino on a Google search. My husband and I spent a week in May 2023 and absolutely loved our stay! The room was excellent, the casinos has lots of different slot machines, the player club incentives and draws were excellent, great dining choices and very friendly staff! We were most impressed by how clean the entire resort is and the gardening/landscaping is beautiful - just like a desert oasis! Thank you Tuscany for making our 30th Anniversary that much more special!!

allReviews.title: Unclear Cash Forward Rules Led to Misunderstanding
allReviews.text: I had an issue with The Guestbook's Cash Forward rules due to a lack of clear communication on their website. The misunderstanding arose when I found out that rewards earned at Tuscany Suites & Casino couldn't be redeemed at the same hotel, a rule not stated on their site but only revealed by Rochelle from customer service. Despite Rochelle's response, I felt my concerns were insufficiently addressed, leading to unnecessary hassle and disappointment. Future customers should be aware of this potential pitfall before using their service.

allReviews.title: Great Off-Strip Experience
allReviews.text: Just returned from a very enjoyable week at the Tuscany. All staff were helpful and cheerfully answered our requests. Restaurant service at all venues was great, as were the meals. The grounds were very well maintained and had a tropical setting with plenty of shade available around the pool The suites were spacious and perfectly adequate for our needs. This isn't a "luxury" strip front hotel, but that's not what we were looking for. It's quiet and tucked away a few blocks from the Strip, which suited us just fine for this short vacation. The only negative is the poor sound proofing between the floors. No issues between the rooms themselves, but when guests walked across the floor in the room above us it sounded like a band of bass drums being pounded on by manic drummers. Make sure you get a room on the top floor to avoid this issue. We had an otherwise wonderful stay.

allReviews.title: Great spot in Las Vegas to relax and enjoy
allReviews.text: This wonderful resort, just off the strip, is a great place to get away from it all. The rooms are very spacious, the restaurants on site are wonderful and the facilities have it all. We were there for a reunion with a group of 20 old friends and had a great time! The pool is lovely and the service all over the site was high quality.

allReviews.title: A calm oasis from Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Although I disliked Las Vegas, the Tuscany provided an oasis of calm to enjoy drinks by the pool and the sunshine. Parking was easy, as was the check in. The room was large with comfortable beds. Like most of Vegas, vegetarian food was limited but I was expecting anything different.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: This hotel is just a couple of blocks from Las Vegas Blvd. It is a smaller hotel but has everything you need. Restaurants..a bar..shows..casino and a really nice pool and outdoor area. It is clean,quiet and the staff are very nice. Will definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Exceptional experience
allReviews.text: Tuscany is a quiet oasis off the strip. Nice sized suites, offering a microwave ( upon request) small refrigerator and table seating in the kitchen area. Large sofa, chair and coffee table and nice sized beds. Large bathroom, separate tub and shower. Small, quiet casino that offers plenty of action. I’ve seen a lot of very large jackpots paid out here. The staff is exceptionally friendly and remembers you from previous visits. Marilyn’s Cafe food is great, and the staff is even better. It’s our home away from home. Love staying here.The gym is large and never busy. 2 pools are available, a lap pool and relaxing pool.

allReviews.title: Security lack of knowledge and accusing minors of stealing based of appearance
allReviews.text: Me my two brothers two sisters and parents booked the last weekend of April and checked in at 11 once we dropped our belongings off we left and continued with our day we came back to the hotel around 10:45pm we later on went to the gift shop for snacks around 11 pm when checking out a security guard (Raymond juarez) comes into the store and quickly leaves when we exit the shop he stops my 15 year old brother and asks to empty his pockets when he does so he says he was caught stealing on surveillance he then radios and asks which one of us and which pocket he then says that my brother put it down his pants and asks him to remove them thank god my brother had shorts under he removed them and shows he had nothing stolen from the shop our parents later take us back to the hotel and they leave to file a complaint whilst filing the complaint they have head security which is the same guy that accused my brother of stealing he says it was based off of surveillance footage of him picking up an item and leaving it in a different place he then goes on to say it was also based off of his appearance to accuse him of stealing never stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great meal
allReviews.text: We ate dinner here in the Italian restaurant. Fabulous. the best meal we had in Las Vegas. Soup, salad, fillet mignon steak and tiramisu. A bottle of pinot grigio. Perfect. Lovely helpful waiter. Thoroughly enjoyed our meal.

allReviews.title: Stay Away: Disappointing
allReviews.text: Nice property, difficult staff, lack of management on-site to address issues resulting in very poor customer service.Room type booked was not honored and worse still, despite verification of the room type and upgrade being presented by the customer, the ‘manager’ on duty lacked the ability to grant the necessary change. Front office manager was unresponsive and staff seems generally inexperienced, lacking in common sense and certainly not customer focused.We are trying a series of different hotels/resorts this week to review as part of our top ‘off Strip’ places to stay in Las Vegas. This was a poor start unfortunately.The room allocated was away from the main area, smelled of smoke and was in average condition.

allReviews.title: Great value hotel near the strip.
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel, wish we had stayed longer. Spacious rooms, lovely pool and splendid jacuzzi. Helpful staff. Would have been 5 stars had the pool not been closed for cleaning when I turned up at 8am on the day we were leaving. So disappointed!

allReviews.title: Exceeded all of our expectations and more
allReviews.text: Having traveled many times from the UK to Las Vegas, we have always preferred to stay mainly off strip. This time we chose the Tuscany suites and casino to finish off our last 5 nights in Las Vegas.What a great decision that was.Clean and spacious rooms are just the start, comfy beds, great restaurants and bars, shows and entertainment a plenty and friendly staff and great amenities abound. The thing we love most of all is just how clean the whole hotel and grounds are, the staff take great pride in how clean the place is and the groundsmen and women do  a fantastic job of keeping the grounds and plants looking just perfect, they are truly a credit to Tuscany and it’s management.We want to rave and rave about all the wonderful people who work there and the friendliness that they radiate which makes the whole experience so enjoyable.2 pools one quiet, one lively, your choice. Laundry room with washer and dryers, gym, spa, Italian restaurant, snack bar, shop and let’s not forget the Casino with its many promotions running frequently throughout our stay and last but not least Marilyn’s cafe where we enjoyed breakfast and evening meals on multiple occasions with a big shout out to Riza Mae our waitress who just put the cherry on the top of our stay with her smile and helpful nature.Would we go back, try stopping us. Booked 12 nights for June 2023 so we can soak up even more, I am sure we will discover even more in the extra time we have allocated for our next visit, we just can’t wait.

allReviews.title: Nice off the strip
allReviews.text: Very spacious rooms. Front desk staff was kind and helpful. Liked the pool area only wish hours were later. Rooms were clean and housekeeping always available for last minute needs. I will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Loved this Place
allReviews.text: This hotel is walking distance to the strip but it feels like a secluded little resort.  The pool area is beautiful.  There are sitting areas with fireplaces to help keep you warm on a cool night. The grounds are very well manicured.  There are a variety of places to eat from fine dining to a pub. They have a decent size casino and a lounge that features live music at night where you can dance or just enjoy the music.  The price was very reasonable.  The room was extra spacious with a little dining area and living area included. The bed was comfortable and so were the pillows. There is ample parking and it is free. We were so glad that we found this place.  We definitely will stay here again.

allReviews.title: We came to relax, well that didn’t happen!!!!
allReviews.text: When we checked in we requested a room close to the pool because we were recovering from knee surgery, apparently nothing was available. They put us in the furthest room, l102, which is furthest the last building in, across from the Racetrack that’s being built. We were in the ground floor and the guest above must of had multiple children with them, constant pounding on the ceiling, mo sleep for three nights, worst experience we ever had while staying at this resort hotel. We Won’t be back . Good riddance

allReviews.title: Beautiful grounds and rooms, at (comparatively) reasonable rates.
allReviews.text: Was ready to give an "excellent" review right up to check out.  The hotel grounds and rooms are beautiful, rates are competitive (although no breakfast included, the restaurant prices are reasonable).  It is more than a half mile walk to the Strip (probably why it is a good value).While we were carrying out our luggage and gear to the car, the guest management system disabled our keys and disabled the wifi.  It must have informed the cleaning crew that it thought we had left because she barged in to the room while we were in it, even though we had the "do not disturb" sign on the door.  We pointed out the sign and said we would be gone in about 20 minutes.  We then had to go get our keys re-enabled so we could finish carrying out.  The cleaning crew barged in again before we were done!  We reported this when checking out that this system needs to get fixed, and they did apologize.

allReviews.title: Total Rip Off
allReviews.text: Previously our fave off-strip friendly hotel.   Not any more.    Room rate quoted and accepted at $76 was actually $130.80 at checkout thanks to “lodging tax”, Resort Fee and resort fee tax.     The $135 night ended up as $198 !      In the Casino we each won vouchers for 20% discount off an entree in the Tuscany Gardens restaurant, usable that night only.    On presenting them we were told only one could be used.     As there was no indication of this on the voucher we disputed it.    One hour later after confrontations with three separate layers of management (and having refused the option of dining at separate tables !) a compromise was very grudgingly offered;  we had to have  separate checks.   Not a problem.  We delighted in adding our checks together and making a single payment.  Good PR ?   Consumer friendly ?   I don’t think so !     Will we ever go back ?    Never.

allReviews.title: Price Gougers
allReviews.text: I really want to post a good review because I do truly enjoy the Tuscany Suites. The rooms are nice. The casino is fun. The restaurant is superb. The Pub is a great place to hang out. I love the Rat Pack show. The reason for the bad review is because of their price gouging. We booked a total of 5 nights and paid, on average, about $400 per night for a 2-bedroom suite. We wanted to add another night to our stay because we don't have to be back to the airport until 8pm. They wanted to charge us $1,400 for another SINGLE night. That's preposterous. The girl at the desk said it's because the hotel is sold out. Well, obviously it's not sold out since our room IS available for that night, but they want to rape me for as much as they possibly can. So, even though I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely come back in the future, now they've lost a customer, and we usually come to Vegas at least twice a year. They also couldn't even give us a late checkout. Very unhappy.

allReviews.title: Worst hotel vacation stay of my life
allReviews.text: Do NOT stay here. They will steal your belongings.
