They will say you have checked out, have room service throw all of your wedding attire in a trash bag, steal your personal belongings and when you come back to a non working key to a room you reserved for a week in a block of 20 rooms for a wedding party they will tell you, I don't know what happened. It shows you checked out. They will not even call you. They can't tell you who checked you out when you're the only contact in the room.Then since there's three more nights and a wedding the next day when they give you your trash bag full of belongings, they'll put you in a smaller room to do inventory of your belongings. Don't worry they will take another payment up front, in full. You'll be told a security guard will come watch the inventory. The security guard will literally drop your stuff and say "that's not my job"Then you get the privilege of going through your own belongings just to find you're missing stuff and you get to go miss a before-wedding dinner and nearly cause the bride and groom to miss it as well.Don't worry though, I'll give you this cool little incident report to fill out and when you turn it back in and ask for a copy of it they absolutely ask like you shouldn't be able to have oneNow I get to spend my morning with customer service in the lobby instead of being with my brother, the groom and my familyThe gift shop sells packs of cigarettes for $20. Housekeeping with all of my other hygiene products and food stuff stole five packs of cigarettes.If you do the math they made $100 off of my cigarettes in the gift shop... They gave me a $40 credit for $200 worth of stolen stuff. They made more off of the cigarettes they stole from me than I got as a credit.Their system double booked me and sent me two confirmation emails at the exact same date and time and they told me that it was my fault that the guy at the counter canceled the wrong one and didn't ask. I have never felt like punching a guy over the counter that bad in my life. The general manager will simply smile at you and tell you that it is your fault because you used the wrong pre-check in email. I had only reserved one room so when I saw an email come in and i clicked it, I cannot tell you why their system online double booked me sending me two confirmation numbers at the exact same date and time.. in the end I got downgraded to a single room for me and my 18-year-old son. Instead of the double that I had booked for a week. I kind of gave up the fight on the wedding day being the third day out of 5:00 so that I could finally spend some time with my family.None of the 20 people in our party will ever stay here again. The beds are terrible. The staff is terrible and don't expect anything when they steal all of your stuff and kick you out of your room that you had reserved for a week because of their computers mistakes. They told me that they didn't charge me for the night that they kicked me out from our double that was reserved to a single room, but I have yet to see that credit.

allReviews.title: Here I wait…
allReviews.text: Flew  in to Vegas for a work conference. Got in about 930 am. Room wasn’t ready which was no surprise as Check in is at 3pm. I went and had breakfast at Marilyn’s then hung out in the lobby until 1pm. Then I started seeing people checking in and getting rooms. So I jump back in line and am told again my room isn’t ready and to come back at 3pm. Ok, no big deal. 3pm rolls around and I jump in line with 20 prime who are all getting rooms. AGAIN I’m told my room isn’t ready and to come back between 4 and 5 pm. Wtf?!! At that point, this was too much. How are prone getting rooms and I’m not? Well apparently rooms are pre-assigned and I’m just the unlucky fool whose room still isn’t ready. I tell them I’ve been here since 945am and am told that early check in isn’t guaranteed. Yeah, Esther, except I never asked or demanded early check in. I just want to be checked in at the stated check-in time!!!  So here I sit in the lobby. Still.

allReviews.title: In desperate need of a renovation
allReviews.text: Pros:- beautifully landscaped- easy parking- large room- quiet location away from the strip- nice coffee shopCons- rooms are dated with cheap quality finishes. Desperately in need of a refurbish. - good long 15-20 minute walk next to heavy traffic to get to the strip. - pool was closed so I can’t comment on that. - odd layout of disconnected buildings.Would stay here again only if they renovated and dropped the price.

allReviews.title: Tuscany inn and suites
allReviews.text: Great amenities and the location was perfect. Close enough to the strip, but away from a lot of the traffic. The room was huge and very clean. The casino was nice and the restaurant was very good. The grounds were very stylish.

allReviews.title: Loud rooms, very noisy construction and need a car
allReviews.text: Booked a King room for 2 nights but on arrival was told that a King was unavailable so they moved me to a double.  Was given Building M that faces the large construction project on the back side of the property and the construction goes on ALL NIGHT LONG with beeping trucks, low tone diesel truck drone and jack hammers.  The TV in my room did not work, the people above me must have had a child that ran around the room every hour on the hour.  The room was clean and roomy but pretty dated for today's standards.  The price was ok but by the time you add in the "resort fee" for internet and usage of items that I would never use in the winter in LV it was no different than a strip hotel cost.  The location is good if you have a car and parking was included in the resort fee.  The Casino is meh...ZERO live table games with only slots and automated Roulette , Craps and Blackjack.  I did not try the restaurants.  The drink service is spotty.  I would only stay here again if the price was lower than the strip hotels by a huge margin and the construction is done on the F1 place behind the hotel.

allReviews.title: Construction site right next, land drilling starts at 6am
allReviews.text: I notified the hotel about our late arrival - 2am. They still gave us our room in L block which is right beside the massive construction site which will last months if not years. 6am, and the drilling of land started and we could not get any sleep. Kids are grumpy, parents are mad. I’m never returning to this place for ruining our time in Vegas. The restaurants are overpriced; I scanned the Marilyn’s Cafe menu for room service, there is a massive up charge to that, so beware! I met an old guy who claimed to have been staying here for over 2 decades and was very upset about how this place has gone down in the last one year. When a loyal old customers say so, it kinda describes why you should avoid this place.

allReviews.title: Grandview LV Nov25 visit
allReviews.text: I enjoy the Grandview. This was not my favorite visit. The room cleanliness was below par, weather was horrible.

allReviews.title: Grandview Las Vegas okay, Southpointe & M Casino nearby are excellent
allReviews.text: Good location next to Southpointe Casino for gambling, movies, bingo, bowling & best $1.50 all beef hotdogs in Vegas served 11 am to 5pm daily. Short drive to M Casino  and resort to watch football & Hockey on screens all over inside the resort and patio outside by the pool in a newer, upscale atmosphere. Excellent food and drink/beer selection with $5 table minimum. The only place I could find that served Molson Canadian on tap in addition to multiple other above average tap selections.

allReviews.title: Like a serviced apartment
allReviews.text: We stayed here for a few weeks in November and really enjoyed it.  We were assigned to Building 9/"Iris" building with the "quiet pool."The room:The 1 BR looks exactly like photos--it was spacious, clean, and very functional for what we needed. The bed was a little creeky and lumpy but we slept ok. The kitchen had an oven and stovetop plus the cooking utensils we needed. It would have been helpful for them to have measuring spoons and salt/pepper, but we bought some during the trip. Having an in-room washer/dryer was really convenient, though we had to clean the washer and remove lint from previous guests. Wifi was strong - we had a router in our room. There is also a safe that fit our 2 laptops.A few watch-outs: the walls are thin. We heard our neighbors next door and above us throughout the stay. A/C worked really well until night time, when I think it shut down because of cooler outside temps, but we couldn't open the window so the room got hot.Inconsistent housekeeping was the other frustration. Apparently if you want housekeeping during the first week you have to pay for it(!) but thereafter, weekly housekeeping is included except you have to schedule it, none of which was told to us. When we got it scheduled, housekeeping was 30 minutes late and then rushed because we had to return to the room after an hour, and housekeeping forgot several items (washclothes, dishrag, detergent, sweeping the floors, etc). When we booked housekeeping after our second week, she arrived on time and did a great job cleaning. For our taste, weekly cleaning is too infrequent and likely causes more work for housekeeping in the long run. To that end, the hallways in our building didn't have the carpeting vacuumed enough--there was often visible dirt, crumbs and other detritus.The property:The fitness center, esp, the cardio room, is large and well maintained. The weight room, which had pulley weights, was clean and everything worked.  It was too chilly to try the pools but they looked clean and inviting: the staff did a great job maintaining the exterior of the property. When we were there, their arcade was closed for construction. In November, there is ample parking and security drives around regularly.  The resort is a good location for us as we split our time between the Strip and hiking.Check out is early - 10am, and the staff came at knocking 8:40!

allReviews.title: Work Stay
allReviews.text: Nice clean rooms. Has everything you need for a longer stay. Has washer dryer and dish washer in the rooms.

allReviews.title: Great place and location
allReviews.text: Incredible place, love the units, the amenities, their staff excellent. Very good place outside the crowd but in Las Vegas Blvd. Fabolous

allReviews.title: A couple get away
allReviews.text: This hotel is great for families. I love the fac there was a whole usable kitchen in the room. Save money on eating out and the shuttle to Walmart is great! The swimming pools looked great. We just went on a raining weekend and couldn't use them. I like that the bathroom was shut off from the bedroom and had a there was a different door to use to get in there and not anyone having to walk through the main bedroom to get to it.

allReviews.title: Nice get away
allReviews.text: The The property was cleaned. The rooms were clean. Very quiet. Space was able to get some rest without casino noise or people running up and down the hallway very nice getaway. If you’re looking for somewhere to stay this would be a good place.

allReviews.title: A week in Vegas
allReviews.text: Good time & convenient location next to the South Point hotel/casino. Room was nice & clean but 18th floor of our tower never cleaned hall ways or elevator waiting areas.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: The location and resort was amazing. I liked the set up of the room. It gave me a lot of privacy with my kids and comfortable. South point casino was right next door and has a lot of amenities to do for me and my family. I enjoyed my stay and would do it again.

allReviews.title: Overall poor quality
allReviews.text: Although we’re members at the Grandview this was our first stay here. We were disappointed. The staff were generally unfriendly and unhelpful. The cleaning people kept trying to come into our unit for the 1st 3 days we were there. I called the front desk after the 1st time but nothing was done (they don’t clean the until we checkout). There were no frying pans, the bathroom door handle kept falling off, the dryer stopped working & it smelled like sewage when the above unit flushed their toilet. So gross! I called to address these issues. They did send a frying pan but the rest of the issues did not get dealt with. We were very disappointed with our week there.

allReviews.title: THE BEST
allReviews.text: this property was more than I expected for the price. It had Security that roamed the property thru out  the day and night since the South Point Casino was right across the street. I will  definitely come back on future travels

allReviews.title: All the comforts of home
allReviews.text: It was so nice to have a full kitchen with all the cooking utensils and place settings and a full washer and dryer in the room.  We were there for a softball tournament so it was nice to have home cooked meals and be able to wash uniforms after games.  Disliked the smoking on the patio/bbq area but that is a personal preference.

allReviews.title: Grand Time at the Grandview Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Grandview puts their guests first in the way they welcome and make their guests feel welcome.The staff from the office to the staff in maintenance, to the grounds keepers and security all are experts in customer care and service.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Staff
allReviews.text: We Love Everything At The Grandview. Location /Parking/Friendly Staff..Bed was very comfortable .Nice and spacious rooms.

allReviews.title: Wonderful 2 Week Stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the Grandview many times.  They have upped their game.  We stayed for two weeks.  Our units were clean, spacious, the grounds were clean. we were very pleased.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Top notch.  No complaints.   Place was wonderful.  Will highly recommend to anyone wanting a real room with amenities, not just a bed and restroom.

allReviews.title: Our Room
allReviews.text: Was awesome I love every moment of it didn't wanna leave everything was amazing definitely planning on coming back in September for my bday week because its was so good to us next year September 2026

allReviews.title: Family Vaca
allReviews.text: Resort has everything in rooms but gym was too far the lobby was too far to grab golf supplies, the parking is terrible. We were prepared with a small cart they have carts available but if it's a busy check-in day good luck finding one and parking

allReviews.title: Beautiful, scenic resort
allReviews.text: Beautiful resort with scenery, plenty of parking, all workers very knowledgeable and helpful! It’s close to so many activities.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Good circumstance in room 1905 and cozy room. The good security of doors and enough facilities such as kettle, bowels and iron board.

allReviews.title: Vegas greed
allReviews.text: Now charging a Resort and cleaning fee.Furniture is old and uncomfortable. Units need a nice upgrade.

allReviews.title: Not great but not awful
allReviews.text: The room was large but the furniture was very uncomfortable.  You could feel the mattress springs while trying to sleep.  The bathroom was spacious and the hot water was instant and very hot.  Kitchen was unevenly equipped. My friend had a full complement of pots and pans but my room did not. The marijuana smell throughout the property was unpleasant.

allReviews.title: The Rooms are Great! The Parking...?
allReviews.text: If you're looking for great rooms, this is the perfect place. The rooms are spacious, modern ans clear. The beds were comfortable and the staff was mostly friendly. The problem is parking. For the price we paid and at a resort hotel (a reasonable price), I expect to be able to park. Instead, I drove in circles in the filled parking, until security told me to park at an area 3 blocks from my room. My wife is handicapped, so the lack of parking at a resort hotel, instead of a casino, is problem. Part of choosing the resort was for ease of parking. My wife is disabled, so ease in parking is a HUGE selling point when we travel. Limited parking is a problem. It wouldn't, necessarily ,stop me from giving this hotel another try, but it definitely changes a 5 star experience to 3.5 stars.

allReviews.title: Always a pleasure!
allReviews.text: I’ve never had a bad stay and it’s a great value fort all the amenities that you receive. Within walking distance to everything one would need.

allReviews.title: A nice stay.
allReviews.text: Nice large room and a comfortable bed.Free parking right in front of the building.Easy walk to South Point Casino.Everyone was friendly.

allReviews.title: Great resort in nice location
allReviews.text: Loved the pools, casino next door had nice restaurants at reasonable prices,drinks very reasonable. Great location. 12 minute drive to Stripe.

allReviews.title: Great Place!
allReviews.text: The rooms are very spacious and the access to the 4 pools, barbecue grills and Southpoint casino is awesome.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Facility
allReviews.text: We had twin rooms with their own separate bathrooms and kitchens. My son loved it as he had his own studio apartment. Rooms were very comfy and spacious.There are a few swimming pools, you can choose if you want a quiet or noisy area. You cannot smoke in whole facility except a few points.There is a cafe for fast food and snacks near the pool. The hotel is near a big casino, but far away from the city centre. You definitely need a car. There is enough space in the parking area and it is free.

allReviews.title: Unit are good size
allReviews.text: Our 2 bedroom unit was beautiful and good size for 8 people with complete kitchen utilities. never had a chance to use the swimming pool due to hectic schedule.

allReviews.title: Wonderful vacation experience
allReviews.text: The grandview is a lovely place and setting. It is very convenient to shopping and to Southpoint casino which has food, entertainment and sport books.

allReviews.title: We love the Grandview
allReviews.text: Always a great place to spend our vacation, and will keep going back as we are able.  it is located in a nice area of Las Vegas and has easy access to everything Vegas has to offer.

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: The trip was overall ok. One room was very comfortable. The other was dirty, there was trash under the sink and a dirty towel in the refrigerator.

allReviews.title: Where Custom service goes to die...
allReviews.text: ⭐️ 1-Star Review: If I could there would be a minus in front.My 65th Birthday Trip That Grandview Las Vegas Turned Into HeartbreakI’m writing this not out of anger, but out of deep disappointment — and a need to be heard.My three sons gifted me a stay at The Grandview Las Vegas Resort, November 9–14, 2025, to celebrate my 65th milestone birthday — a moment meant to honor faith, resilience, and a lifetime of overcoming.It was supposed to be a trip filled with joy and gratitude.Then the U.S. government shutdown happened — airports are closing, long delays and waits,  a situation no one could have predicted or controlled. My sons reached out to the resort with one simple, reasonable request: to reschedule my birthday trip for a later date. No refund, no special favors — just kindness and flexibility.Hey, so what We received a cold indifference.A robotic “actually we are going with our policy.”A dismissive “planes are still flying.”That was the response to a 65-year-old woman with arthritis, during a national crisis — from a company that claims to care about its guests.The Grandview Las Vegas didn’t show an ounce of empathy or understanding. They hid behind fine print instead of standing on compassion.This was supposed to be a once-in-a-lifetime celebration — my sons’ way of saying, “Mom, you deserve this.”Instead, it became a lesson in how corporate greed can eclipse basic human decency.To Grandview Las Vegas management:Luxury is not your marble floors or brand name.Luxury is how you treat people when life happens.You may have kept the money, but you lost something greater — integrity, trust, and respect.To every traveler reading this: when life throws a curveball, you’ll learn who truly values their guests.Sadly, Grandview Las Vegas made it clear — they don’t.#GrandviewLasVegas #65thBirthday #CustomerServiceFail #SeniorTraveler #LuxuryWithoutHeart #TimeshareTrouble #FaithAndResilience #DoBetterGrandview

allReviews.title: Loved My Stay At The Grandview
allReviews.text: Room was very clean and comfortable. Looked exactly like the pictures posted on website. Loved the welcome package.

allReviews.title: Excellent Place to Stay
allReviews.text: Upon my arrival, I realized I was not in any ordinary hotel, but in a home away from home. Staff were friendly, the room was spacious and clean, and the gym was a nice added touch!

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: The Grandview was a great choice for our stay.  Restaurants, shipping, freeways, and casinos are nearby

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We love this place, every time we need to or get a vacation, we always stay here. All the rooms are great, very clean, friendly staff, great price! You basically get an apartment for the price of a room in a regular hotel and sometimes cheaper…the pools are clean and beautiful. I 100% recommend this place

allReviews.title: Feel like home
allReviews.text: Grandview is a flat, with all you need available plus a mall in the side with many restaurants available, the free parking is a plus as well, gym, swimming pool and hot tube. The service is great as well!

allReviews.title: Off Strip
allReviews.text: This Vacation Spot is ideal for vacation, rest, Girls trip, and conferences. Guest appear to respect quiet hours and the Resort Staff overall appear to be very professional, kind and attentive to the Guest.

allReviews.title: Overnight stay
allReviews.text: It is a good value. Nice kitchen and seating area is a bonus. It’s walkable to the South Point Casino with all of its restaurants and shows.It was a little noisy. The walls are not exactly sound proff and when another nearby room filled their tub tub it was like a roaring waterfall sound in our room at 5:30 AM.

allReviews.title: Excellent service
allReviews.text: Good service and loved the resort. The front desk was excellent with explaining everything and housekeeping had the rooms ready and clean too

allReviews.title: Super Show
allReviews.text: The Grandview always delivers comfort. I am never disappointed when we stay at the Grandview.  Check in is easy and convenient.

allReviews.title: Great property, location and staff!
allReviews.text: I've been to this property several times. Great place and with the one bedroom full kitchen with utensils, etc. it's a home away from home. Right across from Southpoint Casino with a lot of amenities. One of my favorite resorts!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: We love being at The Grandview in Las Vegas in October as the weather is usually perfect.  Being away from the masses along the strip adds to our enjoyment.  And have the SouthPoint across the street is an added bonus.  We have been owners since the year 2000.  We do understand why The Grandview probably needs to rent out rooms as a hotel, but that does put a damper on our enjoyment as owners because those who are not owners, often don't follow the rules or care about taking care of the facilities.

allReviews.title: Not At All "Grand" At The Grandview

allReviews.title: Still love the Grandview but hoping for better next time
allReviews.text: We love The Grandview — the rooms, pools, and resort amenities are always wonderful, which is why we were excited to come back. However, this stay got off to a really rough start.We arrived late on Saturday night with our children, only to be placed in a room that smelled absolutely terrible and was located next to the trash area. The odor was so strong it made us gag. We went straight back to the lobby, and thankfully they moved us to another two-bedroom unit.Unfortunately, when we finally got settled (around 10 p.m.), we discovered there were no sheets or bedding for the pullout couch in either room. After calling down, it took over an hour for housekeeping to bring them. Our kids were exhausted, and after a long day of traveling, that was the last thing we wanted to deal with.The next morning, the second bedroom had a heavy smoke odor. We requested an air treatment before my elderly parents arrived, but it took 36 hours and over 10 calls to get it handled. That kind of delay and lack of follow-through was really disappointing — we’ve never experienced anything like that before at a resort.Lastly, there are simply not enough luggage carts, which made unloading food, coolers, and bags very difficult (especially with kids). On top of that, only one of the two elevators was working during our entire stay, so everything took forever.Overall, we still love the Grandview’s atmosphere and amenities, but this experience was far from the smooth, relaxing vacation we expected. I hope management can address these issues so future guests don’t have the same frustrations.

allReviews.title: Don’t Recommend
allReviews.text: Dear Grandview Las Vegas Management,I am writing to formally request a refund for one night of my recent stay due to a series of issues that made the experience extremely stressful for me and my three young children.I originally booked one night online for September 22, 2025. Upon check-in around 10 PM that evening, I asked to extend my stay to two nights. Instead of simply updating my reservation, I was told by the front desk that I had to book another night online. This was inconvenient and unusual, as most hotels are able to extend a stay directly with a credit card on file.The check-in process itself was slow and confusing, and the staff appeared inexperienced. After finally receiving my room assignment (Room 10–1104), I was not given directions. With three tired children late at night, I discovered that both the elevator and stairs were blocked off. Only after asking again was I told that our room was actually located in a different building, requiring us to walk outside to Building Four in the dark.The following morning, I was abruptly woken up by hotel staff saying I had to come down to the lobby to sign new paperwork for my second night—even though I had already paid online. Later, when I stepped out briefly, I returned to find that my room keys no longer worked. I was forced to walk in the heat with my children back to the main lobby (a 10-minute walk), wait in a long line, and re-sign paperwork just to regain access to the room I had already booked and paid for.This entire experience was chaotic, mismanaged, and unnecessarily difficult. Between the unclear booking process, lack of communication, repeated disruptions, and issues with room access, my stay was far from acceptable.Given the circumstances, I respectfully request a refund for one of my night stay as compensation for the poor service and the undue stress caused.I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and look forward to your response.Sincerely,Anh Lilly 626 485 7144

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: For one night just to sleep it's great but to spend days there no the parking is horrible and the amount of people smoking in front of building is unbelievable there were kids running around everywhere in and out the building I'm guessing the pool wasn't that far but should really consider a smoking area way from building entrances and do somthing about the parking.

allReviews.title: Saved the day!!
allReviews.text: We stayed here on a spur of the moment passing through!! I will make a plan to come stay for fun next time!!!

allReviews.title: Good for family vacation
allReviews.text: We like staying here with location near airport at end of Las Vegas Blvd. Close to strip but far enough away from the mass of people. We went to the Sphere, Arte Museum, Illusion Museum, kids Ninja Gym, Las Vegas Natural History Museum and The Discovery Kids Museum. All were great fun, interesting and would go all again. To top it off we ate at Gordon Ramsay’s Hells Kitchen. Great family vacation.

allReviews.title: Awesome Time
allReviews.text: I am a proud owned of a week stay  at the Grandview Hotel. My cousin and I stayed in building 1 close to the movie theater and a variety of restaurants.  The staff was nice and they have a free bus that takes you to the Walmart supermarket in town. I did another tour with my cousin woh I referred to RCI who really enjoyed the tour and decided to  become an owner as well.

allReviews.title: Great Stay at The Grandview Resort
allReviews.text: This is an excellent Resort with great nightly stay rates. I definitely will stay here again on my next trip to Las Vegas! I highly recommend this Resort.

allReviews.title: Best place to getaway
allReviews.text: This place was super nice, pools everywhere, great customer service, amazing rooms and at an affordable price!

allReviews.title: Best stay
allReviews.text: Had an amazing experience, the room was very spacious, loved the kitchen, the living area, and the bathroom. The pool felt amazing, there was also alot of parking space. Love everything about it.

allReviews.title: Needs new cleaning company.
allReviews.text: The resort is at the very South end of the strip. Not anything to see and it needs some updating and a new cleaning crew. The space is good in the units but feels a bit dirty and when we arrived there was hair on the pillows and bed. Yuck !!! They did not try hard to take care of the issue, other than sending new bedding for us to remake the bed ourselves. That was not the right thing to do in my opinion. However, If you are going to the horse shows at South Point it is very convienient to walk right next door.

allReviews.title: A comfortable stay, helpful staff
allReviews.text: Perfect for our family visit. Plenty of room for everybody. We were able to stay in adjacent rooms and the staff were very helpful with booking a rental car, printing items, and shipping a box for us. Would definitely recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Great hotel. I’d stay again and again.
allReviews.text: Work related trip. Needed to stay considering we finished late. It was such a great place to stay in such a last min decision to stay in Vegas

allReviews.title: Girls Only Vacation
allReviews.text: We had 5 women on our vacation. I loved the close access to casino, restaurants, the strip,The adult pool, shopping. We are already planning our return vacation!

allReviews.title: Decent pricing, dated furniture, ample supplies but lacking customer service.
allReviews.text: Stayed three nights, placed on 12th floor.  Living room furniture not comfortable for sitting.  Facility was clean, check in was not customer friendly and new policy for 4 p.m. check in even if room is clean was not courteous to people flying in.  This policy resulted in lines of people at 4 followed by being routed off to a pitch for timeshare viewing afterwards.    Fitness center weight room equipment needs updated as weights catch mid lift.  Pool area is nice, relatively quite facility and we felt safe.  Parking for our unit was good.  Elevator went out day two resulting in 12 flights of stairs having to be traveresed several times that day and no one let us know when the elevator was fixed.  There were no accomodations made for this so even if your 60+ you were expected to traverse the stairs without help or room switching.  The TP was cheap and very rough so bring your own.  Supplies of dishwasher tabs, paper towels and towels was nice.

allReviews.title: BOSWELL AKA BOSS
allReviews.text: Still a outstanding vacation spot in Las Vegas, No one can enjoy a better spot in Vegas being next to Southpoint and now enjoying a fun Bingo night and Karaoke night at the Grandview. It was fun and helps you to meet good people.

allReviews.title: Fantastic place to stay
allReviews.text: Always clean and great staff. Great pool areas and fitness centers.  Great location for events at South Point.

allReviews.title: Owner time share
allReviews.text: Our room was nice. Laundry in unit, shower for my handicap mom was nice. Did have to buy a shower chair since no seat in shower. Large soaker tub.

allReviews.title: True Freedom Week
allReviews.text: You can’t experience all the activity at 1-3 visits.  So make a yearly plan for sites of your interest

allReviews.title: Excellent property
allReviews.text: Rooms are furnished with all kitchen appliances. Easy access to casino and restaurants. Location is great l!

allReviews.title: Decent but there are way better options
allReviews.text: Resort could do better, no shuttle to strip is a huge inconvenience! They make it seem as only 6 miles but it was $25 each way in an uber, gets pricey! They only have 1 restaurant, it’s decent but not that many options. It’s very close to South point Casino which is nice and quieter than the strip.

allReviews.title: Fair Value for the Price
allReviews.text: This is a great spot to stay if you are looking to hang out and eat outside of the strip. This was our first time staying somewhere other than the strip and it felt quiet, peaceful, and somewhat isolated. We reserved a two bedroom adjoining suite and it was cool to have our guests nearby. The quality of people was less than desirable a this property and the next (South Point Casino) since smoking was allowed inside the casino, it seemed to be tailored to senior folks, and there was not really any night ambiance.

allReviews.title: Comfortable & Affordable
allReviews.text: The Room was like a Condo. Full kitchen, everything was clean & neat. Was great being able to cook. The pool was a wonderful place to cool off a bit.

allReviews.title: Best value stay in the Vegas Valley
allReviews.text: You're gonna smell weed despite warnings against it. But this place is next door to Southpoint and blows away their prices with "Suite" rooms. They got everything a family needs to be comfortable for a few days.

allReviews.title: Step it UP!
allReviews.text: Was a 9 to 10 Resort, currently 7 ish,need to use HOA fees ,and institute Best Practices, similar to Florida Resort.Thanks

allReviews.title: NEGATIVE ZERO! This place and staff has went to the crapper!
allReviews.text: This year was the absolute worst vacation of my entire life! I hate this place now and I have been an owner for 17 years! Has went downhill since covid. Very dirty and greedy place anymore. Too many bad things to type. Under new ownership even worse!

allReviews.title: Everything was great
allReviews.text: I love the resort was nice and beautiful I will come back. Will be back again thank you very much much.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Perfect for family vacation and would definitely come back again.  The pools were nice and clean and the room were spacious.

allReviews.title: Great location!  Nice rooms!  But this is a timeshare facility.
allReviews.text: Very nice and clean rooms with all the amenities!  Right across the street from the South Point.  Unfortunately, we had to sit through nearly 3 hours of timeshare presentations.  It can be fairly expensive, as we found the same room for next year at half the price.

allReviews.title: Not what I expected
allReviews.text: When I booked the two bedroom suite, I looked at the pictures, but could not believe this was what I was getting for the price! It was better than I expected!!

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay
allReviews.text: The apartments are very well equipped and cute. Very comfortable and spacious. The pools and quite spacious outdoor spaces

allReviews.title: Best resort in Vegas for family.
allReviews.text: The facility is so perfect for families traveling with kids and grandkids.  PLUS --- this staff is INCREDIBLE!

allReviews.title: Disappointed owner
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at the Grandview for my deeded week. I am not happy with the cleanliness of my unit. Hairs on the shower walls, mold and grime shooting out of the tub jets tells me the housekeeping staff aren't doing a thorough cleaning between guests.

allReviews.title: uneasy
allReviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom unit in a building that was on the south point side of the driveway.   This was probably the third or fourth time I've been there. Never had any complaints until this past trip.  It seems to me that it was more like an apartment complex for rehab people.  We got to ride in the elevator with people that were tweeking quit often, so enjoyable. Always could smell dope. Our room was not the cleanest. One of the guys from the hotel just came right in to our room twice. When I asked what he was doing he could not speak English.  I did call the front desk about that. Creepy. Soon after that call to the front desk there was all kinds of garbage outside our room in the hallway. Retaliation maybe?

allReviews.title: Stripping away the strip
allReviews.text: miles from all the mid strip action an extra costs this truly is a diamond in the rough! Together with South Point Hotel all your needs and wants are covered.

allReviews.title: Nice place for value
allReviews.text: Nice hotel however was not aware of the cleaning rooms policy of staying 9 days or more. Also taking own trash out those things were not told to us. However customer service at the front desk was nice and when towels were needed they were provided. The low mark is for cleaning service policy. Also elevators reeked of weed. Overall highly recommend the tub is very nice and great location.

allReviews.title: Grandview Review
allReviews.text: The Grandview is a nice place to stay for quick getaway (especially if you like the Southpoint Casino).

allReviews.title: August Las Vegas Birthday trip
allReviews.text: This was our 10th time staying at the Grandview. We come to Las Vegas about 3 times a year, and have always stayed here since we purchased our time share. We no longer own at the Grandview, but still stay here as this place offers the best options of anywhere we have stayed. The staff is always accommodating to our needs, the grounds are always well kept, and there are so many pools to choose from, as well as being walking distance to SouthPointe Casino. We already have another trip planned for December of this year.

allReviews.title: Hot room
allReviews.text: Room was great other than the AC not working and not being able to sleep. Called twice to get it fixed in the middle of the night but no one ever showed up. Attempted to talk to management but they were too busy to talk to me.

allReviews.title: Recommended Hotel for a big family
allReviews.text: The rooms are big. The staff are friendly and helpful. Shoutout to Azelia from Front desk and Ravi the Manager on helping us check in early. It’s 12 minutes away from the strip they don’t have casino in the hotel but they have good amenities for the kids to enjoy. They are next to South point hotel where you can just walk if you want to play casino where they have 24hrs Starbucks! Overall We enjoyed our stay here.

allReviews.title: It was relaxing
allReviews.text: My first time there it was my bonus week. I have never used my actual week. Which is the 23 rd week of the year.

Thank you 😊  for clean room stuff is very nice swimming pool is very clean kitchen. I love it. I really recommend it thank you for everybody to make everything clean and nice me and my kids will really enjoy it. We be here next year on the 2026

allReviews.title: Disappointed stay this time.
allReviews.text: Had always enjoyed our stays over the years at Grandview La Vegas with the the exception of this recent stay!

allReviews.title: RCI pay attention!
allReviews.text: The room looked tired.  The kitchen needs some attention regarding broken burners on the stove, the refrigerator was not cold enough.  The dining chairs looked dirty.  The sheer curtains were missing in the living area.  The door into the room stuck.

allReviews.title: Summer Getaway
allReviews.text: Great experience...Clean and spacious roomsMany poolsConvienient locstionPlenty of parkingFull kitchensFriendly staff

allReviews.title: GREAT PLACE TO VACATION!!!
allReviews.text: We had lots of activities  to participate  in everyday. Great  place for families  with children. BEST PART OF GRANDVIEW  IS SOUTHPOINT CLOSE ENOUGH TO WALK. The units have the home away from home feel.

allReviews.title: Not much to do there
allReviews.text: Wasn’t very clean when it came to wanting to book another night staff did not know what they were doing. Elevators were down was down. Needs updates at all pools.

allReviews.title: Nice enough if the elevators worked
allReviews.text: I'm in wheelchair on 9th floor with tickets to Casino Showroom next door for 7:30.   Elevators out of order from before 6 until after 10.  Could not attend show - forfeited tickets.  No recompense from Grandview.  No resort fee refund.  And why a $60 resort fee? Wifi?  Pool towels?    Which reminds me, I was swimming laps the next morning for my 1-legged workout when security kicks me out for, get this, "High Winds." Closed all the polls for winds of 25 mph.  I got buddies who've golfed Vegas courses in 30 mph winds.  It's an expected hazard in this high desert valley.   Grocery shuttle every morning is nice.  Location is decent if you are satisfied with South Point complex, which I am.  Mr Gaughan is old school finestkind.  $37 Uber to downtown and Circa. $23 to airport.  Surge pricing can double that. Been using South Point since 2017 super bowl.  This year more heavily inked, sagging, rude millennials.  Hopefully an anomaly, cuz I'll be back to the SP and maybe the Grandview if a newer building.

allReviews.title: I must've had bad luck with this stay
allReviews.text: I initially booked the stay in Expedia and it started off great with check-in at the main building being painless and quick while being assigned a one bedroom suite on the first floor of the tower closest to the entrance and across the street from South Point’s south entrance, an assignment that I’m grateful for as the layout can be daunting especially if inebriated (as what occurred with a poor fellow guest who I encountered in the evening!) It’s once I settled into the night that the cracks started showing.It started out with noticing that the bathroom had an accessible shower but the handle to hold the handheld shower head was broken and resting on the handlebar which meant for complicated showers. At around midnight the bedroom’s smoke detector gave off the cursed beep signaling a dying backup battery. Not wanting to wait for maintenance to come over I detach the unit and remove the battery while making a note to inform the front desk in the morning. Then at around two in the morning it sounded like the jacuzzi in the room above mine was on full blast which unfortunately could be heard downstairs.I’d honestly try this place again if the circumstances allow as everything else seemed fine. The room was otherwise kept and clean, the staff whom I interacted with, including Itzel in the front desk, were fantastic to work with and are probably the saviors that cushioned the blow of this stay being a complete dud. I was bracing for any timeshare sales talk or reps to approach me but that didn’t happen either (probably because I didn’t submit that raffle drawing ticket that came with the room key) which I was grateful for. All in all I really just want to chalk this stay up random chance giving me the short straw.

allReviews.title: Love the Grandview
allReviews.text: Love staying here, right next to South Point that has so many things to do.  The rooms are a great size, several different swimming pools, good for families or couples.

allReviews.title: Best value in Vegas
allReviews.text: When I was searching for a quick getaway to Vegas, I was shocked at the prices.Exorbitant Resort fees and parking prices. Expedia showed me the Grandview and I couldn’t believe the price Sunday and Monday for $200 all in no fees! Beautiful room with a full kitchen and a soak tub, convenient location next to South Point Casino, Only downside was the A/C was noisy, but maybe it was just my room. Recommend

allReviews.title: Wonderful resort
allReviews.text: We absolutely love staying here. Our daughter loves the pools. We stayed in the Iris building, which we probably would not do again.  If you want a taste of what living in a personal care home would be like, then this building is for you.  Not knowing the pool was “the quiet pool” at this building, we took our daughter down there to swim. There was one lady in the pool and before we even got to a chair she was chirping at us with her opinions and telling us that we couldn’t have a kid in this pool.  We literally were inside the pool fence for 30 seconds.  Needless to say, this building is for the 70+ crowd. Next time we will be going to another building.   Overall, this resort is well maintained, the staff is always so friendly and welcoming. The only thing missing would be a play structure of some kind for kids.  We can’t wait to come again…just not to the Iris Building (aka the senior home).

allReviews.title: A perfect stay for comfort and conveneince
allReviews.text: We absolutely loved our time at The Grandview Las Vegas. The two-bedroom suite was incredibly spacious—plenty of room to relax, spread out, and feel at home. The kitchen was a standout feature: fully equipped, clean, and perfect for cooking meals when we wanted a break from dining out. Having a washer/dryer and whirlpool tub added even more comfort to the experience.The resort itself is well-maintained and offers great amenities like pools, hot tubs, and a game room. It’s close enough to the Strip for easy access, but far enough to enjoy some peace and quiet. Highly recommend for families or anyone looking for a roomy, well-appointed stay in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Cozy Place To Stay
allReviews.text: Love this place. Very clean almost to perfection. Good value for money if you don't mind it's a little off the strip. Extremely friendly staff who checked us in.

allReviews.title: Dont Buy here
allReviews.text: Place is getting old. It was just bought out in 2025 by new ownership and it is really going downhill fast. I have been an owner at the Grandview for 18 years and have used it several times a year for the last two decades.  The three times that I have used the Grandview this year have all been very disappointing as an owner.   I would not advise anyone to purchase the timeshare at this location unless they turn things back around for owners. If you are using it with booking.com or some other website booking it is adequate if it is convenient for you.   Service was poor, staff are not courteous or helpful, and the place is really getting run down..

allReviews.title: Spacious
allReviews.text: Great place—perfect for escaping the busy Las Vegas Strip. Love to walk to the Southpoint Casino to play!

allReviews.title: Overcrowded and chaotic
allReviews.text: We checked in on SAT, JUL 26. I've been going to Grandview for over 10 years and this was the most crowded I've ever seen. The line to check in was out of the door. Parking was nearly impossible -- there were dozens of cars circling the lot looking for open spots. I had reserved 2 2-bedroom units. They  had one ready and said we would have to wait a while for the other. OK, that's fine. Checkin is at 4 PM. We waited and waited and waited...I called them from my room probably 10 times. Each time they said the same thing -- the room is ready and we'll bring the keys to you. Finally, at 7:30 PM they did it. We were exhausted from waiting all day to get in both of our rooms. Basically, we lost the first day of our vaca.  Then, they wanted to charge a $56 resort fee -- FOR EACH ROOM!!!I don't believe it is legal to charge resort fees for owners (like myself). Very, very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Poor quality
allReviews.text: When arriving, there was 2 long lines, one moved and the other didnt. There was no organization on how the next guest was being helped. If you picked the wrong line then you had to wait longer. The room itself was not very clean. Smelled like smoke, the phone didnt work, the tub was dirty, and there were ants on the night stand.

allReviews.title: Kitchen missing.a lot of utensils
allReviews.text: Shuttle bus for groceries is good.its better if you have shuttle bus going to the strip…and premium factory outlet…

allReviews.title: Not Like it Used to Be
allReviews.text: This has been my favorite resort in Vegas for many years. I’ve encouraged friends and family to travel there. This time we were met with terribly uncomfortable beds, a c not working correctly, phone not working, toilet running constantly, and unfriendly unhelpful front desk staff. I’m not sure if it is still considered a gold crown resort but I certainly don’t think it meets those standards anymore.

allReviews.title: don't stay at the Grandview in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We bought a timeshare in 2023 by being promised so many amenities and ability to use it. But we haven't been able to get any benefit from it. We decided to try to see what the accomodations at the Grandview are like this summer. So we visited. But we paid $432 for two nights at a run down poorly maintained low class building. Do not buy from these guys. They tried to make us pay more to upgrade our poor quailty timeshare product to the 'new' offering!!! Imagine: we can't use what we have at all and then we should pay more in order to get some value? They should have upgraded our '1 week' timeshare to their new points system FOR FREE. You have no idea how angry I am.

allReviews.title: Grandview timeshare
allReviews.text: Rooms are big and clean. Have everything you need for long stay. Pools are great for family lots to offer at resort. Only complaint is the bed wasn’t great and hurt my back as well as wife’s back after a while.

allReviews.title: The Grandview Resort is a dump.
allReviews.text: My husband and I contracted contact dermatitis from dust mites at the Grandview resort in June. It is now August (tomorrow), and I have yet to receive ANY compensation. It took weeks to get a reply about anything. As much as we like The Berkely as a FAMILY. We have decided to no longer spend our money with the company AT ALL. We have a very large family, half of which live in Vegas. This could have all been settled easily, yet I have been given nothing but the run around. The Grandview Resort is Trash. Save your money and go literally anywhere else.

allReviews.title: Family friendly
allReviews.text: Great for a family vacation. Not in the busy las vegas strip area. But has the casino across the street.  Lots for the family to do on property.

allReviews.title: Loved the 2 Bedroom Unit
allReviews.text: We went to Las Vegas with another couple/family. It was nice having the two bedroom unit because we had our privacy and they had theirs. It was great being able to buy groceries for cooking, and being able to store them in the full size refrigerator. The multiple pools on the premises made it a fun experience because we alternated. There was a very nice kid friendly pool for our friends’ kids. The gym was nice, but small.

allReviews.title: Family Resort
allReviews.text: Great place to stay and enjoy your time with your family. Definitely we will come back soon and enjoy all the amenities they offer.

allReviews.title: Worst Hotel Experience
allReviews.text: Im not typically a "reviewer," but this was just the worst experience. I traveled with my husband and 4 kids (12, 11, and 2 year old twins). On arrival, the bathroom floor had blood and the shower had mold in all the crevices. Called for housekeeping..never came...so I had to go buy bleach and bleach the entire bathroom and other hard surfaces. Then it was time for bed. The sofa bed had no linens or pillows in the room so I had to call for those (at 10pm)...3 calls and multiple hours later (around 1am) they finally got delivered (although no pillows).  2nd day, went to guest services for towels, laundry soap and to request 2 cribs for the twins. I was told it would be easier if I just called to request them, so I did. Again...never got delivered.  There's a game room, but you have to go to the concierge to request any supplies for ping pong, Pool, or mini golf. We went around 3pm and there was a sign that they would be back at 8pm. We stay in hotels pretty frequently for travel sports (about once or twice a month) and this was by far the worst hotel experience we've ever had.

allReviews.title: horrible. no linens no toiletries and mgmt doesnt care
allReviews.text: Do NOT stay here. the service and staff are pitiful. we arrived at 1am and had no sheets or pillows in our room. we had been up for 20 hours travelling and had to sleep with bath towels on the mattress because housekeeping only had one runner and we didn't get sheets until after 5am. nobody cared. we spoke to the "manager" at the front desk who had no power and didnt care and we were told we had to deal with the third party we booked with. when i called that number they said nope a quality issue is for the hotel to handle. went back to mgmt and they didnt care at all. the room was dirty outdated and the whole building smells.

allReviews.title: Comfortable, but average
allReviews.text: We went for a back to school shopping trip. We like that the location is away from the strip. The pools were overcrowded though and so we didn't get to enjoy swimming. The rooms were mostly clean, just some dust bunnies in the corners. Beds were comfortable. We enjoyed being able to spread out and have space. The check-in process needs some help and there is always a wait at the elevators.

allReviews.title: The Grandview hotel was a nice little retreat for our family. The resort had a lot to offer!
allReviews.text: Our stay at The Grandview in Las Vegas was a nice little retreat for our family. The resort had a lot to offer and made it easy for all of us to relax and have fun. We especially enjoyed the putt-putt course, the nearby golf, and of course, the pools—perfect for cooling off and spending time together. It was a refreshing break from the hustle of the Strip, and we’d definitely come back!

allReviews.title: Enjoyable
allReviews.text: Spent a week with my family. We had a great time. We had close access to SouthPoint to enjoy all the amenities. The staff at The Grandview were awesome. Very convenient transportation to and from hotel. Also provided trips to local Walmart. Convenience of room service from local pizza or groceries. We will definitely be visiting again.

allReviews.title: Disappointed Stay
allReviews.text: The shower and bathroom sinks would not drain, so I had to wait for maintenance to come.  The coffee machine and front burner of the stove were broke, so I had to wait for new coffee machine.  There were no parking spaces at night to park the car, if you came back after 10 pm good luck! There is no security, anyone can come on to the complex, no security coming on to property, no security in the building, anyone can come into the building. groups of kids hanging around outside. Felt unsafe walking around.

allReviews.title: Guest has to do their job to deleted prior phone messages! $20 to hold you hostage!
allReviews.text: Vacation  |  FamilyNo service worth to mention at all. The room’s phone has multiple undeleted/unlistened voice messages dating back all the way to before the 4th of July, which cost us over 5-7 minutes to delete since none of the messages could be deleted until you had to listen through each of them till its end. Without deleting those, the phone’s red light kept flashing that bothers us quite a bit. Never have we seen a hotel room being kept so sloppy. We were asked to sign up for a timeshare session at the time of checkin with a $20 deposit but when we asked to cancel the session the night before, they didn’t want to return the $20! Alas! $20, to hold us hostage so that we had to come back to their time share pitch another time. What a way to do business! The facility is more than 8 miles away from the Strip and quite some drive from good dining places, therefore is really not a good place to stay if you want to feel the vibe of the city. For the money, there are plenty places around to stay. Rooms: 2/5  |  Service: 1/5  |  Location: 1/5

allReviews.title: July 2025 review
allReviews.text: Fair resort over all. Casino next door offers convince, security and maintenance could use some updates but Good. Older buildings but clean.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Loved the rooms they were very spacious and had all the amenities you needed. Would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Stay at Grandview
allReviews.text: Overall our stay was great! Had a few small bumps but we would stay here again. The location was clean and the timeshare staff was great. We did purchase another timeshare while there to add onto our current one.

allReviews.title: Just the best place to stay for a family
allReviews.text: WE have been coming here for 8 years now and as a family we just love it here. Some much to do for every one.

allReviews.title: The unit we were in needed updating. The couch was old and worn. The floor was dirty.
allReviews.text: The unit we were in needed updating. The couch was old and worn. The floors needed to be cleaned and mopped. Something sticky was all over the kitchen floor. Stove was also in needed of replacement. Appliance different colors. Some white some stainless steel. I was not impressed.

allReviews.title: Stay at Grandview
allReviews.text: Enjoy our family vacation.  We were close to the strip without staying st the strip.  Enjoy being walking distance to the South Point.  Eating places were close also.

allReviews.title: Bad experience
allReviews.text: Arrived Wednesday afternoon around 4pm and Unit A had a really smell I contacted to let them know advise he would put it on record so we won’t get charged. Unit B was dirty. The floor was not swept and appliances were really greasy. I contacted Guest Services requested the following items toilet paper , bath towels and bedding linen sets for both sofa bed. I was told a ticket was submitted and the items should be at the door shortly. We received them our items at 12:30am which was 8 hours after my first call!

allReviews.title: Terrible stay!
allReviews.text: In building 6 the elevators were down all weekend. There was one working elevator and there were tons of people! Wait time was excessive up to 30 mins. We were on the 19th floor so the stairs were out! It was just a bad experience overall and staff could care less!

allReviews.title: Amazing place to stay
allReviews.text: Very safe and clean. I love my overall stay at Grandview. I was able to take a good rest  and loving all the amenities. I will definitely book here again.

allReviews.title: Nice little hideaway
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. It's away from all the traffic of the strip, but not too far to visit. The staff was friendly and the room was nice I enjoyed having the kitchen stocked with the appropriate dishware & cookware.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Overall great stay parking is bad at night and long  wait for staff tv outdated . Great pools clean room great air condition

allReviews.title: Stayed here numerous times
allReviews.text: This place is located on the south end of Las Vegas Blvd. The property is always clean, well lit at night & safe. The rooms are the size of a small apartment with all the furnishings. The bath tub is very nice & large. It is located in the room. The shower is separate & located in the bathroom. The living room area is a nice size with a recliner & sofa. The furniture & the bed are very comfortable. I have stayed at this property multiple times and it never disappoints.

allReviews.title: Great resort

allReviews.title: Always a good choice
allReviews.text: Me and my family had a great time as usual,but a couple of hiccups.we checked in on July 4th so was busier than normal.the check in agent (“Randy”new guy)was really rude and rolled his eyes at me because I stated that I put a request in for a specific building that according to him wasn’t available.i guess he was having a bad day but ok we got to the room and the floor wasn’t swept or mopped properly.there were eye lashes and crumbs on the floor in the kitchen living room and bedroom,house keeping was next door cleaning a room so a was able to get a vacuum and clean up what ever I saw but I never been thru that b4 so I’m going to chalk it up to them not having enough workers during a extremely busy holiday weekend.beside that everything was good. allReviews.title: Home away from Home
allReviews.text: I am a owner at Grandview and anyone who frequents Las Vegas more than a few times a year should consider purchasing their units. For me, it is a home away from home. The rooms are spacious and perfect when  traveling with young family members. I especially appreciate that there's a full kitchen with basic kitchen supplies to prepare meals in the room ,which I prefer rather than  eating out at restaurants several times a day when traveling with a family. Conversely if you travel with a lot of luggage be prepared to handle it yourself because the property does not offer bellman services. Also, the place is a few miles away from the strip but theres a casino next door. The Grandview is not walking distance from the Vegas lights but everything you might need is nearby.

allReviews.title: Grandview, you can do better!
allReviews.text: The toilet and shower were dirty with sludge. I called the front desk to request cleaning and was told it could be several hours before it was cleaned. I had to request expedited service as my family couldn’t wait that long for a toilet. The toilet did not flush well. The carpet odor was horrible. The room paint, wall and ceilings are outdated! The smoke detector had not been changed in what looked the be twenty years. The room was not dusted. Dust was hanging from all of the vents. It was obvious that it was months since the last dusting. The mattress was uncomfortable. There was no sheer curtain under the blackout curtain. I requested a sheer because the sun was very bright and blinding when opening the blackout curtain. I spoke with William who was rude and non- resolving. It took and extensive conversation to get the sheer. I was initially told that the property does not provide this anymore. When asked if I could have a room that still had a sheer curtain I was told no because there were other customers and I could not inconvenience them, and there was no guarantee that another room would have the curtain. When I asked to speak with someone else William repeatedly stated no, and that he was the only person that I could speak to. After refusing to accept that response he sent someone to hang the curtain. It took nearly 30 mins of back and forth to get it resolved. Housekeeping is nonexistent until checkout day. Check out time is 10am. They arrived at 8am before we checked out to clean the room. Other wise, there was never any service. The kids pool area was nice. We choose the property because of the kitchen , washer and dryer. The appliances worked well. The timeshare presentation trap was a horrible experience. It was described as a quick “walk through tour of new property”. I should have followed my intuition and declined, but was having an open mind. Our day after arrival was hijacked by this presentation. When we declined to purchase and decided to leave after a few hours the representative became upset and was using tactics to attempt to detain us. Our time was hijacked. The tour was a unit that was exactly the same as ours! Sitting through that presentation was like sitting through another marketing scheme. Overall families can benefit from access to cooking and doing laundry, but the units are dated and need renovation and the cleanliness needs improved.

allReviews.title: The worst resort experience we’ve ever had.
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at The Grandview from June 20th to 23rd, and to say we were disappointed is an understatement. We booked this resort primarily for the advertised five pools and the in-room jet tub. Unfortunately, both were major letdowns, along with the overall cleanliness and management’s complete lack of accountability.The Pools & Common Areas:The pools and hot tubs were overcrowded with unsupervised children constantly turning the jets on and off. Meanwhile, parents blasted their own music through portable speakers, making it impossible to relax.The Room:Our room was far from clean. There were crumbs on the carpet, children’s fingerprints smeared across the TV, and some kind of unknown liquid spilled on the bedroom curtains. The floors looked like they hadn’t been properly cleaned in ages. The in-room jet tub was unusable — as soon as I turned it on, black mold spewed out from the jets. Obviously, I didn’t use it after that.Later that night around 12:30am, I found a bug in the bed. Whether it was a bed bug or a carpet beetle, a bug in your bed is unacceptable. Upon further inspection, we found two more bugs. We immediately called the front desk, only to be put on hold forever, which seems to be standard practice here. Eventually, a security guard arrived with keys to a new room — meaning we had to pack up everything and move rooms at nearly 1am, ruining our first night entirely.Second Room — Same Story:We thoroughly checked the second room before settling in, only to find visible black mold already growing on the jets of this tub — no need to even turn it on. The shower had black mold, yellow stains, and someone else’s hair in it before we had even touched it. The sheets had old blood stains on them. Light switches were covered in grime, dirt, and dust. I couldn’t walk barefoot in the room because of how dirty it felt.Management:We spoke to a manager at checkout on the 23rd. He acknowledged the bed bug complaint, saw our photos and videos, and admitted this was “unacceptable” and that “something would be done” and we’d “be compensated.” We were promised a follow-up later that day — no one called.We had to chase them down repeatedly. When we finally got through on the 24th, another manager confirmed they tested for bed bugs, and while they “couldn’t identify the bugs,” they only test for bed bugs — so unexplained bugs in the bed are apparently acceptable at The Grandview.We also brought up the mold, the uncleanliness, and the major inconvenience of moving rooms at 1am due to their negligence. The manager told us we might get compensation but only after she emailed the general manager, who is “only reachable by email.” Two days passed — no response. We called again on June 27th, only to be told the general manager wasn’t available and they didn’t know when he would be.Conflicting stories, poor communication, and no accountability from management whatsoever. It’s now been nearly two weeks and we’ve heard nothing back.Bottom Line:We gave The Grandview every opportunity to make this right, but they’ve failed us at every turn. Between the bugs, the mold, the filth, the lack of professionalism, and the total disregard from management, this was one of the worst resort stays we’ve ever experienced.SAVE YOUR MONEY. STAY SOMEWHERE ELSE. Do NOT stay at The Grandview at Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Not so Grand
allReviews.text: The rooms were lovely, very clean, and roomy. Pools were very nice and the property had parking pretty near to the building. This resort is focused on a timeshare business, and it's clear that when you're a guest who doesn't participate in timeshares or anything to do with them, that you're not as important. My daughter was sick so we needed to stay a third night after having stayed for two nights. I understand that there's a two-night policy, especially during the summer season. I wanted to stay for a third night and the manager refused to allow it. He said I needed to stay two more nights, and that he could override it but that he wouldn't. He didn't care at all the reason. I also needed to get back to work and was driving a long way to get back. I wasn't going to make my daughter travel when she was sick. I was forced to stay two more nights, or just leave and lose the money for the fourth night. Also, if you want a second package of coffee, they charge you for it. I mentioned that other hotels will give you things like shampoo, coffee, and soap when out, and he said they were a timeshare and not a hotel. There is no regard for the customer at this place, only timeshare or potential timeshare owners.

From laundry detergent for the washer and dryer in the room to dishwasher pods for doing dishes. The unit had everything I could think of and more. Having the ability to go see the city in this heat and come back and wash all your things was a huge selling point for me. Free TV and internet didnt hurt either. allReviews.title: Below average for a Time Share-Disappointed
allReviews.text: The resort is easily accessible to the strip with just a 10 minute drive. Staff were friendly but the room was not clean nor was our kitchen supplied with the essential kitchen silverware, pans or baking dishes. The garbage disposal was broke. Housekeeping did come up right away and brought the needed supplies and the plumber came and fixed our Disposal.  Also the sheet set for the pull out couch was dirty but they brought us a new set. The room was not cleaned well and the not maintained. The vents were coated with dust, the curtain shades were also coated with dust and the room was not vacuumed. My son's bathroom tub was filthy. Our granddaughter has Asthma and started having trouble breathing in the room. I contacted William the manager at check in and informed him of the need to have the room cleaned. He said he would have housekeeping come up right away, but they never came to clean the dust. He did credit us our resort fee. I then sent an email to his manager to discuss the situation but he never answered the email nor did he call me. The resort is average at best. The pools were dirty and the water/soda machines at the pool did not work. I was not happy with this stay.

allReviews.title: Disappointed and we won’t be back
allReviews.text: We stayed here several years ago and I don’t recall the condition of the hotel to have been as bad as it is now. We checked in a day early for our two week visit so had to combine transactions and as a result,  had to move rooms because our floor was scheduled to be painted!!! Why weren’t we given a room that was available for the whole stay???!!! In the process of moving, we left behind a large plastic bag full of snacks for 2 weeks, including several pounds of beef jerky and chips. When we discovered the error, we asked to get access to our original room, but of course,  all the items left were removed and not returned by housekeepers! We stayed at IRIS this time because of the “quiet pool” which is certainly anything BUT that— full of kids and families. We had experienced A-LOT of marijuana through out the building but particularly in our first room due to a smoker in the adjacent suite. Nothing seems very clean inside and in the two rooms we stayed in,  and the decor is very outdated and the kitchen is set up with the bare minimum. We did enjoy having access to a bbq,  but only one side of the grill would light— another 50% positivity on that amenity!

allReviews.title: Good, but needs improvement!
allReviews.text: We stayed here two separate weeks. The 1st week, the resort was nice. The views from the honeysuckle building were great. But, make sure you don't wait to check in. We checked in around 6:00 p.m. and had to wait an hour in a line of people.The 2nd week, we checked in at 3pm and everything went very smoothly. We stayed in the honeysuckle building again, which continued to have great views; however, this unit was dirtier than the first weeks unit. The second week in a different room was full of problems. There was other people's hair on the floor in almost every corner of the room and shelves. There was even more hair in the showers and tubs of the private parts and head hair. Upon putting our things on the counter, we found that the counters were dirty and still have food particles on them. Therefore the counters were never cleaned. My wife and I ended up cleaning the entire unit. The dishwasher also had a footprint of a shoe on the inside of the door. We washed and cleaned the dishwasher several times due to this, wasting our own dishwashing detergent. Upon examining the dryer we found a lot of filth and three handfuls of lint came out of the dryer. We reported this and the resort did send housekeeping to clean the tub and shower. The kind man even took pictures of the hairs and lint and other things in the unit.The next morning we woke up to the bathroom smelling like marijuana. We spoke with Daisy the manager.  They did send janitorial stuff member named Jewel to spray some spray, alerted security, and sent maintenance to examine the exhaust fan.

allReviews.title: wouldn’t recommend
allReviews.text: I would not recommend staying here for your trip. Check-in was complete chaos and extremely unorganized—it took forever to get checked in and make it to my room. Then they offered me a 90-minute tour with the promise of a $220 Visa gift card afterward. What they didn’t tell me was that the tour would turn into a 4.5-hour sales pitch for a timeshare. I was extremely annoyed, as it ended up wasting my entire day before the concert I had planned that night.

allReviews.title: Complete Resort
allReviews.text: The Grand View at Las Vargas is an excellent facility. The location (off The Strip) provides quiet atmosphere but close enough to the fun. The rooms (suites) are spacious, clean and comes complete with furnished kitchen. The his and hers bathroom sinks is nice. The huge bathtub, separate from the shower is a plus. The bed is comfortable that affords good night’ssleep. The swimming pool and BBQ grille and picnic areas are great! In short, The Grand View at LAs Vegas is a complete resort!

allReviews.title: Disappointing Management During Peak Check-In
allReviews.text: Stayed during a busy weekend and was shocked to see over 50 people waiting in line to check in—with no communication or support from the General Manager, who was hiding in his office the entire time. Front desk staff did their best, but leadership was clearly lacking when it was needed most. A disappointing experience that could have been improved with visible, proactive management.

allReviews.title: Nice enjoyable spot

allReviews.title: Grand stay

allReviews.title: LV Review

allReviews.title: Cleanliness Concerns
allReviews.text: We were somewhat disappointed with the Grandview this trip.  The first unit we were assigned had multiple issues: missing pots and pans, floors were dirty, kitchen was disgraceful, windows were filthy, bathroom sinks held water, bedroom smelled like smoke, bedroom drawers wouldn’t stay closed and red stains in the carpet.  The property maintenance has not kept up with the aging property.  Be careful if you stay here and check your room thoroughly up arrival.  The staff were accommodating in assigning us another room, but management needs to do better with cleanliness of all units.  Over 20 years of traveling to Las Vegas and typically staying at the Grandview,  this is the first time we have ever encountered this situation.  It’s a beautiful property if well maintained.

allReviews.title: Housekeeping

If I smelled weed in the elevator ,hallways or pool one more time, I was leaving. Just a poorly run ship.Allowing non members to use timeshares. Loud music at the 'quiet pool'. Went and bought my own That's bull.Young kids running around and on the treadmills in the gym unattended...scum on the shower walls, and on and on... dirt swept into corners.Time for a change Grandview. allReviews.title: Stole my money and cancelled my reservation
allReviews.text: Due to a flight delay, I contacted the hotel on May 15th to inform them that my check-in would be delayed by one day. I spoke to a front desk employee who assured me that there would be no problem with my late check-in. I specifically asked if I could check in a day later and was told that it would not be an issue, as the hotel operates 24 hours. I received no indication that my reservation would be affected.However, upon arriving in Las Vegas on May 16th, I received an email stating that my reservation had been canceled. I immediately called the Grandview Hotel and was told by another employee that they had given my room away because I failed to check in on the original date. I explained that I had called in advance to notify them of my late arrival and was assured there would be no problem. Despite this, I was told there were no rooms available and no refund would be issued.When I asked for clarification, the employee asked if I had the name of the front desk staff member I spoke to, and I explained that I had not taken down her name. The employee then implied that it was my fault for not getting her name and insisted they could not assist further. I was informed that there were no available rooms and no refund would be provided.I then contacted the travel agency through which I booked the reservation (Expedia), and they filed a claim on my behalf. However, the Grandview Hotel was unreachable for several days. When they finally responded, they refused to issue any refund, citing that I did not check in on the scheduled date.I am extremely dissatisfied with the handling of my reservation and the refusal to issue a refund despite following proper channels to notify the hotel of my delayed arrival.

allReviews.title: Very disappointed!
allReviews.text: The service was terrible!  We tried to call several times, housekeeping, maintenance, front desk and they all went to a busy signal.  Our toilet backed up, after sitting on hold waiting for the operator for 15 minutes she finally answered.  It took several calls finally after an hour someone came up and fixed the toilet.  My wife had to walk two buildings away just to use the bathroom.  Any time of day all lines are busy, you have to walk to the front of the resort to ask a question.  This resort use to be wonderful but we will never stay here again.  In fact we are thinking about leaving early.
