allReviews.title: Disappointment Experience
allReviews.text: I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with my recent stay at your resort, specifically in Building 9. While my initial check-in experience was positive, the subsequent issues rendered my vacation unacceptable.My family and I have been loyal guests to your resort in the past due to its convenient location. However, this visit dramatically altered our perception. The room assigned to us was in dire need of maintenance and cleanliness. Beyond the general dirt and disrepair, we discovered dried blood on both the door and the floor. This presented a significant biohazard and a serious health concern.Upon reporting this to the front desk, I was met with an unacceptable response. The staff member attempted to shift the blame onto us for reporting the issue after a few hours, despite having checked in early with their permission to drop off our belongings and go grocery shopping as the unit had a kitchen. Despite explaining the biohazard risk and the need for a thorough sanitation of the unit, a satisfactory resolution was not offered promptly. I only received a room change after presenting photographic evidence of the blood.The replacement room, located on the first floor near the smokers' area and laundry room, was equally unsatisfactory. It was also unclean and lacked essential kitchen supplies such as pots and pans. The entire situation was incredibly stressful and overshadowed what should have been a relaxing vacation.Considering the significant fees I paid – an exchange fee of over $200, plus a security deposit and resort fees – along with the use of my timeshare points, the quality of accommodation was simply unacceptable. The lack of a sincere apology or any attempt at genuine customer service is profoundly disappointing.I request a full review of this situation and a commensurate resolution to compensate for the significant inconvenience and distress caused. I expect a more proactive and empathetic response from your team regarding future bookings.PS i waited 7 days for a  manager to contact me and nothing yet. I was told someome would contact me but i got the run arounds

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem Near the Strip That Truly Feels Like Home
allReviews.text: If you're looking for a peaceful Las Vegas stay without sacrificing access to the city's iconic nightlife, The Grand View is the perfect balance. Located just far enough from the Strip to enjoy restful nights, yet close enough for a quick ride into the heart of Vegas, this resort delivers the best of both worlds.What sets The Grand View apart is the genuine hospitality—every staff member goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome. From check-in to check-out, the attention to detail and kindness of the team create a home-like atmosphere that's rare to find.The accommodations are spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed like private apartments, ideal for relaxing after a night out or a day exploring. And as a major bonus, the resort is right next to South Point Casino, which offers more than just gaming—it’s home to one of the best buffets in town, a top-tier entertainment center, a rodeo arena, and so much more.Whether you’re in Vegas for fun, shows, food, or just a quiet escape, The Grand View is an unbeatable choice. We'll definitely be coming back!

allReviews.title: Exceeded our Expectations

allReviews.title: A bit disappointing
allReviews.text: Having stayed at a couple other Vacation Village properties and being an owner at one, I expected more.  Upon arriving at our room, the room was very stuffy.  Almost like there had been smokers in there and they attempted to get rid of the smoke smell.  I stayed in the A unit.  The sofa was missing a back cushion so I reported it because I didn't want them charging me for it.  You could see where something had been splashed on the wall and run down on the wall behind the sofa and I suspect thats what happened to couch cushion.  We noticed the toilet in our room was leaking slightly as there was water in the grout lines around the toilet.  We called and reported it and they were prompt in coming to fix it.  Only they had to return later because the water was worse and with a simple fix,  the problem was solved.  That night when we went to make up the sofa bed in the A unit, we discovered there was not enough bedding.  2 pillows with no pillow cases and a flat sheet.  no 2nd sheet or blanket so my daughter reported it and bedding was brought to us.The B unit had a garbage disposal that wouldn't drain.  We reported it at the same time as we did the toilet and they attempted to fix it, and while it was better than before, it still was not working as it should.  We also noticed the cold water faucet on the tub was leaking but we did not report that as no one planned on using the tub.Overall, the location is excellent.  I would stay here again but I really feel like the units needed a thorough cleaning.

allReviews.title: Everything we hoped it would be and more!

We also like the fact that the Grandview was a short distance off the strip and away from the hustle and bustle.  We were able to visit The Strip, check things out and then retreat to the quiet serenity of the resort.

allReviews.title: Hit or miss !!!
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at Grandview Las Vegas for work on two separate occasions, and my experiences were drastically different.The first time, I stayed for five days in Building 5, and everything was great. The room was clean, fully stocked with essentials, and overall, it was a comfortable and pleasant stay.The following week, I returned for another five days but was placed in Building 8, and unfortunately, my experience was subpar. Upon checking in, the room was missing basic necessities—no paper towels, no dishwashing liquid, only one roll of toilet paper, and an inadequate amount of towels. There was a broom but no dustpan, and the bathroom didn’t appear to be properly cleaned. Additionally, the pull-out couch had no linen or pillows.I requested these missing items, but it took hours to receive them, and I had to keep calling to follow up because some requests weren’t being fulfilled. As I was unpacking, I kept noticing more things missing, making it an overall frustrating check-in experience. The room itself also felt outdated compared to my previous stay.To make matters worse, the neighbors on my floor were loud, which made it hard to get a good night’s sleep.The stark contrast between my two stays makes me question the consistency in service and maintenance across the property. Based on my second experience, I don’t know if I would return for a third stay.

allReviews.title: BEWARE!!!!!YOUR TRUST, SAFETY, AND PRIVACY  ARE AT RISK AT GRANDVIEW LAS VEGAS
allReviews.text: Formal Complaint – Serious Privacy Violation & Security Failures at Grandview at Las VegasTo Whom It May Concern,  I am writing to formally address multiple egregious breaches of privacy, security, and professionalism during my stay at your resort on March 11, 2025. The incidents described below reflect a shocking disregard for guest safety, trust, and basic hospitality standards.  1. Unauthorized Room Entry & Lock ChangeDespite a clearly displayed **"Do Not Disturb"** sign, I returned to my room to find that staff or subcontractors had entered without my consent and changed the locks. When I politely questioned the subcontractors about this intrusion, I was met with dismissive and rude responses, including the claim that it was "not their job" to address guest concerns. This unprofessional behavior compounded the distress of an already unacceptable violation of privacy.2. Non-Functional Safe & Security RiskUpon arrival, I discovered the in-room safe was completely non-operational, leaving me unable to secure two laptops, a work drone, and a substantial amount of cash. For a resort of your caliber, a functioning safe is not a luxury—it is a basic expectation of security and reliability. This failure put my valuables at risk and caused unnecessary stress throughout my stay.  3. Management’s Complete Lack of ResponseEven more alarming than these incidents is theabsolute negligence of management in addressing my concerns:  - I contacted front desk staff three times—with no resolution.  - I emailed General Manager Joe Gonzales multiple occasions—no response.  - My phone calls were ignored.  This indifference demonstrates a blatant disregard for duty of care, liability, and guest safety.If a resort cannot ensure privacy, secure valuables, or even acknowledge serious complaints, it has no business hosting guestGiven the severity of these issues—and the resort’s refusal to take accountability—I will be:  - Filing a police report for unauthorized entry.  - Submitting complaints to the Better Business Bureau (BBB)*and the American Hotel & Lodging Association (AHLA).  - Sharing this experience across travel platforms to warn future guests and potential BUYERS OF TIMESHARES (DO NOT BUY)   FINAL NOTE TO POTENTIAL GUESTS!!!!  If you value privacy, security, or basic professionalism, reconsider booking here—especially if you’re a timeshare owner. allReviews.title: Dirty Condo
allReviews.text: After a long day waiting at the airport for a flight home that was canceled, I called the Grandview {as I am an owner there} to see if I could book 1 night as my flight was rescheduled for the next day. I was told no problem. So I called an uber and we went to the Grandview to book the room.    The Grandview charged me 202.00 including taxes for the night. We then went to the Silverton for a late dinner then back to the room to sleep for early wake up time to head back to the airport. In the morning as I was about to take a shower I notices a lot of hairs on the shower floor. Then I started to look around and the bathroom ceiling was collapsing above the shower. As I walked into the main living area the dresser drawers were open under the tv and one was broken. There was dirt all over the floor in several of the rooms, the fridge was dirty, the remote for the tv was filthy (with what I hope was only chocolate). The kitchen sink was dirty as were all the countertops.    As I left to check out. I asked to speak to a manager. I was introduced to Robbie. I shared all the pictures I took of the rooms condition and asked if the room was ever cleaned. Did I sleep in dirty sheets?  He assured me he was going to take care of this which I took to mean I was not going to be charged for this room. I said thank you. Nothing was done. After three days I called to speak to the general manager and was told he was not in but Robbie was going to refund half of my cost, which has not yet been done.    I am so sorry to say that I am a owner at this property and will be looking to sell as soon as possible. Due to the way I have been treated in this matter. I have stayed at Motel 6 in some of the roughest cities in the US and they were never as bad as THE GRANDVIEW OF LAS VEGAS was on Jan 31st to Feb 1st. 2025

allReviews.title: We Knew We Were in for a Rough Time When the Building Reeked of Weed
allReviews.text: Check-in went smoothly and the staff was friendly and accommodating.  There was ample parking by our building.  Once we made it to our condo building, we were hit with a cloud of weed in the air.  We do not use weed and so we were concerned about what our family's experience would be like.We stayed in 2-1 bedroom condos with a common entry.  The condos were worn and not clean, dried spaghetti sauce on the kitchen counter and what looked to be dried blood on the wall of one of the bathrooms.  The fridge door had not been wiped down.  There was black mold in the tile grout.  One of the condos smelled of cigarette smoke.  We notified the front desk and they attempted to contact management  Unfortunately, management never picked up the call and the call ended in a disconnected line.  Very frustrating.We decided to stay the night anyway.  The beds were comfortable and the rooms were quiet.  Beware of the hot water.  It is scalding hot! We left after we had made other arrangements for our lodging.We were surprised it had a 4 star rating and cannot recommend and will not stay there again.

allReviews.title: Terrible experience
allReviews.text: On check-in, I questioned why there was a $50 resort fee, instead of the $25. Also we are owners and have not had to pay it in the past. The clerk was very sarcastic, said we booked with points, we should have used the interval. I related we converted to the point system over 10 years ago, and this had never been an issue before. During this exchange, a gentleman in a suit behind the counter(I assumed a manager of some type), listen to the conversation, looked at us, shrugged his shoulders and walked quickly away. Next we had to see another agent to get the parking pass (an excuse for an attempt to get us to sign up of a sales pitch). I told him we are on vacation and not interested in hearing a sales pitch. He related that you get a free buffet during the tour so why not go, I again told him I was not interested, where is quipped “what you are on a diet, yeah”, tossed the parking pass on the counter and walked away. On arrival in our unit, we had to use the toilet plunger to unclog the bathroom sink and the kitchen sink. Had to do this more than once. The Ice Maker in the refrigerator did not work.  The fixture on this same bathroom sink was installed in reverse, to get cold water, you turned on hot, to get hot water you turned on cold. Maintenance never responded. We stayed for a week, and the resort was supposed to replace the towels and take out the trash after 4 days. This NEVER happened. Also there were no washcloths in the bathroom, had to use hand towels.

allReviews.title: Staffing shortages are hurting the property
allReviews.text: The building we stayed in was one of the buildings that have been redone, and the updates are nice. However, when we checked in, our room had not been cleaned. There was garbage left in the kitchen in shopping bags on the countertops and floor, the bathroom was a complete mess, and the bed was not made at all. I called the front desk, and it took over an hour for someone to come up to our unit to see what we had reported. Once they arrived, they were very apologetic, and quickly made arrangements for us to be moved to a different  unit, and personally escorted us there to make sure that the new room was ready and up to standards. This was the theme for our stay. Things were not quite where they were up to in previous stays, but when attention was brought to the issues, the staff were amazing at addressing it quickly. The impression we were left with was that they just didn't have enough people to keep up with the workload.

allReviews.title: Service Above and Beyond
allReviews.text: So my key card got deactivated because I held it in my pocket next to my phone and wallet. I didn't discover this until 10 pm.  I got into the lobby, and called the front desk from building 4 (4 buildings away from the office and front desk, a decently lengthy walk).  They sent someone right over, who made sure I was me (made me feel safe), then brought me 4 keys, but they didn't work correctly, so this kind man walked all the way back to the front office, had 4 new keys made, and came back!  They tested perfect, and the rest of the trip was flawless! Despite the heavy use of the resport, the rooms and interior remain clean, in very good and respectable shape (we bought 10 years prior, and they had just completed final construction), and the buildings are situated so that everyone gets a view.  We cannot be happier with our timeshare purchase!  RCI is a great company too, haven't had any complaints!  We've traded into Wisconsin Dells, Dominican Republic, and got a trip to the Bahamas too.  Definitely recommend!

allReviews.title: Really Good - and Pretty Bad
allReviews.text: This is my second time staying here, and it probably won’t be my last, but I’m in no hurry to return.Honestly, its best attribute is its proximity to my favorite casino (South Point). IF everything is working properly, their rooms are pretty nice, too, with thoughtful layouts, and there isn’t much noise from the hallway or adjacent rooms. The W/D in every room is a wonderful asset that allows for light packing. Room lighting is good. There are plentiful fast elevators, but they could use a couple more luggage carts.But there are significant problems. The key cards are the most temperamental I’ve ever seen. It wasn’t unusual to find two or three people trying to get my building’s outside door open. I had to have my key replaced due to total failure. The clock wasn’t set to the right time, the remote control needed batteries, the toilet ran until the handle was jiggled just right- minor problems like these add up.There is a closet safe, but you must lie on the floor to set the combination.A previous occupant’s shoes were under the bed.There is a lot of emphasis on the five HEATED pools and hot tubs. Temperatures were in the 60’s while I was there, and the pools were NOT heated to any discernible degree. Even the hot tubs weren’t hot enough. There were plenty of clean pool towels, probably because not many guests wanted to swim in ice water.One member of my group fell for the come-on “free” brunch and check for listening to a hard sell for their timeshares. We were late to an appointment because she was basically held hostage for three hours in order to get her $20 earnest money returned to her. There’s no such thing as a free lunch, people!

Hotel is dated,  elevator reeks of urine, and towels are scratchy. The rooms are spacious, resort quiet , and lots of restaurants and and stores nearby. allReviews.title: Great Accomodations
allReviews.text: Rooms and contents were all great, staff was extremely courteous and friendly, pools and hot tubs are nicely located and clean. Location is a few miles from the busy strip, but the resort across the street (4-5 minute walk) has a large casino and many restaurants/coffee shops/bars for entertainment. Onsite shuttle to stores (walmart, etc) runs many times in the morning to get food/necessities- very convenient. Best way to the busy "strip" is by ride-share- only a 10 minute ride. Can also take public transport from the casino across the street...public transport is cheap, but takes a bit longer.  Views from 3 sides of the resort is of flat plain to steep mountains that stand tall on the horizon-quite beautiful at sunrise/sunset. Good hub for day trips to Hoover Dam, or a couple of beautiful state or National Parks for sight seeing and hiking. You can get to the Grand Canyon within a couple hours, too...plenty of tours ($)  that will pick you up at the resort or nearby venues.

allReviews.title: A Grand Vacation With A Grand View
allReviews.text: Grandview is a gem in the desert. Close to everything and everywhere you might want to venure off to.  Or you can stay at the resort and stroll over to South Point for loads of activities and casino fun.  Minutes from downtown without the constant crowd and noise.  Family and Friends or All Adult Fun...it's all right here at Grandview.

allReviews.title: A week in Vegas
allReviews.text: Overall stay was good. Just an initial issue when we checked in as the unit we were given, the AC was not working and the bedroom was quite dusty.  We told this to the front desk and they moved us to another room, which was good and everything was working. We had a good stay. Used the pool and the shuttle service to Walmart which was helpful as we cooked most of our breakfast and sometimes brunch in the unit. The pool area was clean and the building common areas were kept quite clean during our stay.

allReviews.title: Nice condo, great location
allReviews.text: The condo was nicely decorated, spacious and clean. We had access to a car which made the location of the condo convenient -- on Las Vegas Boulevard -- 20 minutes from the strip and easy access to the Interstate and Airport. Plus, South Point Casino is next door where we ate several breakfasts and lunches. The pool area was also nice.

allReviews.title: Very nice property in Vegas
allReviews.text: Grandview is our home resort. We come here several times a year.  The best part is the location.  It is adjacent to South Point Casino, and is not far from the Strip.  Grandview provides a bus taking you to Walmart.  There's a public bus in front of South Point that goes to the Strip.  The Unit is very comfortable with nice size.  King size bed with 6-8 pillows on the bed.  Utensils are adequately provided.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Clean resort and friendly staff that met our needs. The microwave quit working and maintenance was here in less than 10 minutes to fix it. It’s off the beaten path but met our needs. We’ll be back.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Great resort off the main strip.  Quiet family resort in Las Vegas.  Amazing amenities next to resort at South point.  Movie theater,bowling alley,bingo and equestrian shows.

allReviews.title: Good Staff for Vacation
allReviews.text: A pretty nice hotel/timeshare south of the Las Vegas strip.  It was very quiet and had all the amenities we needed.  The bed was comfortable and had a nice bathroom. I really liked the security officer at the front of the property everytime I drove on to the property. There was a little push to get a free gift which we knew would be part of a timeshare sales pitch but we did not feel pressured to attend.  I'd stay here again.  No complaints.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: The location and resort amenities are wonderful. Everything you need is at the resort or right across the street at the South Point Hotel/Casino.

allReviews.title: So much to do
allReviews.text: We cant recommend the Grandview at Las Vegas highly enough.  The facility and casino next door have so many things to,do in addition to gambling.  The staff is so friendly and helpful.  The facility is very well maintained and everything is so clean all the time.  We always look for vacation villages when choosing a time share because their design is wonderful.  This resort is particularly great and we have stayed before and it’s one of our favorites.

allReviews.title: Perfect
allReviews.text: Great place. Always meets our expectations! Nothing better. Good location and away from all the busy parts of Vegas. Very clean and everything we need. A washer and dryer is a nice touch.

allReviews.title: Not the cleanest hotel. They need more amenities for a resort of that size.
allReviews.text: Not the cleanest hotel. Our first assigned room was not ready. The bellhop then got keys for another and it was not the cleanest either. Better training of housekeeping is needed. Also, they need more amenities for a resort of that size.

allReviews.title: Still a winner.
allReviews.text: The Grandview is, in my opinion still one of the top resorts in Las Vegas. It's location right nest to the South Point Casino doesn't hurt either. If you're going stay there a rental car might be a good idea though, as it is some distance from many of the other attractions. But it offers all of the amenities that the average traveler will need.

allReviews.title: vacation
allReviews.text: everything was good.The staff was helpful .South point casino is across the street.I don't have to drive to the strip.

allReviews.title: Affordable if other stuff is happening but meh
allReviews.text: Pros - the property is clean and safe. Rooms are condos so you have your full kitchen, stackable washer dryer, dining table, soaking tub . Across the street from South Point which is fun, lots of dining and cheap drinks. But also a different property haha Cons - check in sucks, it's slow. Your parking pass has to be received from "guest service" which is just basically used car/timeshare dude. He'll book you a $30 breakfast for a rotten real estate tour Keys didn't work. Huge line still, asked the front desk dude at the last station if he could do me up some keys, was informed he's "helping another guest " ok could've offered to do the keys after the people you were helping. After a long hot drive through the desert you just want your room. Not feeling the buy a timeshare vibe. Weird exterior door / inner door entry? Exterior doors to parking lot never locked?Housekeeping walked in on me nude at 830am.

allReviews.title: Resort appears to be cutting back
allReviews.text: We reserved 3 two bdrm units. Card keys were always failing, hot tubs were not hot, floors were not mopped. Resort appears to be cutting back.

allReviews.title: Poor customer service
allReviews.text: First of all this vacation started on the wrong path before we even left home. We made reservations in March 2024 at Tahiti Village for our September trip. Two days before we left RCI called us to inform us that Tahiti Village had cancelled our vacation because of a scheduling error.  The only options we had were to either cancel the vacation or to stay at the Grandview. Supposedly it was the only place available.  We were offered nothing else.  The Grandview is further down from the strip and has no shuttle service. We had to rush to rent a car. The check in was quick and uneventful. The customer service person at check in did sort of trick us into a sales breakfast. He presented it as a welcome gift. We are owners at Vacation Village so he told us it would be a quick review. That was inaccurate. The sales manager was rude when we told her we were not interested in buying.  So please do not fall for this trick. The B part of our room did not have hot water. We called maintenance every day and they could never repair. We were not offered any change of rooms. The one maintenance person told us it was good to take a cold shower. I will never stay at this resort again.

allReviews.title: South Le Baron
allReviews.text: The good thing is next to South Point Hotel Casino a good place to expend your time good restaurants cinema and service

allReviews.title: Excellent Vacation Destination
allReviews.text: Very comfortable and plush for the price. Everything you could want to do in Vegas is either on site or within a short distance and yet the room is quiet and relaxing.

allReviews.title: Nice resort
allReviews.text: It's a nice resort.  Next door to South Point Casino.  I was very pleased with the maintenance department as we had an electrical issue and they were very quick to fix it.   No sales pressure which I appreciate. Very comfortable bed. The resort is quiet.  It is a good drive to the strip so you'll need a car.

allReviews.title: It was okay..... I'd give it a 3.5 if I could
allReviews.text: The rooms are decent sized and clean.  We liked that our friends could join us with the A/B setup of the rooms.  The pools were nice but they ran the coolers well into the evening so the the pools were too cold to get into after sunset.  The hot-tubs were decent and large enough for ten or so people.

allReviews.title: Grandview is Falling Short.
allReviews.text: We've been owners since 2008, and we come all the time. Recently, it's been grudgingly painful to come. It's sad because I've given my home resort 5+ stars before. So to go from 5+ stars to 1 , that's not a good trend to fall this precipitously fast this soon. The only single reason why we come back is because it's always available,  and the only way we can afford vacations. That's it. As an owner, I feel entitled to call and make requests. Most often, our requests are not fulfilled, which is fine because we are warned that it may not be. This time, when I called, we requested a floor and a certain  building. The receptionist took our request and related the same response. Not only was our request not filled, but the whole building was under renovation. She did not relay us that information. If she had, we would have chosen a different building.  To me, that's a fundamental flaw from management in relaying what I think is important information.  Another inexcusable customer service is there maintance crew. We pay $910 a year in ownership maintenance fees. With that, I expect certain expectations from the resort. I went to the front desk to notify them, that our freezer ice maker wasn't working.  Got our room number, and asking permission to enter our room to fix it. Not only did they not fix the ice maker, they put ice in the catch tray from the communal ice machine that you use at a motel on state street, which I took as an immature lazy passive aggressive way in disrespecting owners at this resort.

allReviews.title: The right place
allReviews.text: This is a very nice and comfortable resort it has alot of stuff you can do the swimming pools were clean and plentiful and the rooms were spacious

allReviews.title: Easy to work with it, great xcellent service and clean
allReviews.text: Excellent service, nice personal, easy to work with it. I love it. Close to go everywhere.  Easy to.find it. Nice place. Has pool, barbecue and you can share and have fun with tour family. Alsonyou can spend time in the jacuzzi and amenities that they have

allReviews.title: Outstanding.
allReviews.text: This is my 4th time to stay on my vacation at Grandview and it has been great every time. Awesome facility and very quiet with no sirens or traffic. Only about 10 minutes from Mandalay and close to the Rent a car Center and across the street from South Point Casino.

allReviews.title: A Friend's Getaway!
allReviews.text: The Grandview is a a great place to chill and relax. They have great pools for everyone to enjoy. You will need a car to get around, but its not necessary. Grandview is  next door to South Point Hotel and Casino. You can just walk next door for all your entertainment needs and meals. The Grandview does offer shuttle service to the grocery store daily and your unit has a full kichen if you want to cook. You are about a 10 minute drive to the Big hotels on the Strip.We prefer the quiet end! We usually drive down for one or two nights, but we have everything we need right there at the Grandview. We look forward to our next visit.

allReviews.title: Rosa
allReviews.text: The only thing wrong was the room smell was horrible and this was for both rooms. I have stayed there before and the rooms were fine I don’t know why they put us in that building Rosemary.

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay.
allReviews.text: Grandview great spot to vacation at. Staff friendly and professional. Resort was clean. Check in and out was fast.

allReviews.title: Grandview experience
allReviews.text: The Grandview is perfectly located, off the congestion of the strip. Plenty of things to do right at the resort. Whenever I, my family and friends visit Las Vegas, The Grandview is our spot. Very family orientated. I will be back soon.

allReviews.title: Vegas vacation off the strip
allReviews.text: The Grandview at Las Vegas is a nice resort. The check in process was very quick. The suit was very nice, the bed was very comfortable. Overall cleanliness of the suit was not the greatest. Inside the elevators was not very clean. The grocery shuttle to wallmart was very helpful. My main issue was that they should have a shuttle to the strip and back at least 3-4 times a day. The distance from the strip is about nine miles. We took two trips to the strip during our stay.  Each round trip to the strip on Uber was $55.00, I think it's a little too much. Even if the Grandview charges few dollars per person for the strip shuttle it's worth it.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Overall enjoyed it. Will definitely stay again. Will recommend it to others for a visit.cant wait to visit again.

allReviews.title: Grandview vacation
allReviews.text: Check in was easy, staff is friendly. Security on ground at all times. So it was safe. Room service was also punctual.

allReviews.title: Great return to a favorite resort.
allReviews.text: The entire visit was just excellent. The staff in all areas were great. We noticed an exceptional refresh on the entire resort,the standouts being the rooms and the entire pool area at the Sage Tower.

allReviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We have stayed at Grandview 6 times and no surprises always a great time we will be back! Good well layer out space clean tidy and if any issues they are well looked after in a timely fashion pools and other amenities are well looked after and clran

allReviews.title: Suburbs of the strip
allReviews.text: Being off strip and yet have amenities right next door is great. All that needs to be done is a direct access point to the casino!!

allReviews.title: A great and economy place to visit
allReviews.text: Close to the world famous South Point Casino. Easy access to travel to the strip on Las Vegas Blvd. The staff here is very accommodating.

allReviews.title: perfect location
allReviews.text: Amenities and staff perfect for our needs with the South Point casino next door as a plus. The noise level was low and we could walk are drive to local restaurants and shopping. We were not repeatedly hassled by staff to sit in on a presentation. They accepted our NO on the first time. We appreciate that as we have been time share owners for 30 years. No need to sell us.

allReviews.title: Nice stay but had appliances not working
allReviews.text: Great place, free parking.  Bit of a drive to the strip and the Duce bus does not come down this far.  You need a car.

allReviews.title: Predictable mid range timeshare
allReviews.text: We have been staying at the Grandview, every other year, for about 15 years. Great staff, clean units, nice pools and hot tubs. No casino or restaurants but Southpoint Casino is right across the street. Great home base to explore Vegas.

allReviews.title: Grandview Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We always stay at the Grandview bc we get great deals through the Armed Forces Vacation Club.  Over the years, the Grandview has continued to maintain the property pretty well.  It's pretty kid friendly and they have a large multi-level parking garage if you want to park out of the Vegas sun.  They also also don't pressure you to sign up for a time share presentation when you check in - they try to get you scheduled, but they take no for an answer.

allReviews.title: Grandview Review
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean, but need updating, and customer service could improve. This was a getaway that was planned in less than a week so I’ll give it 4 stars.

allReviews.title: Unsatisfied stay we had. She made the best of it.
allReviews.text: What really go us was housekeeping never Came to clean our room. The staff at the presentation was rude to other customers. We ended up walking out. We have our times share at a different resort. So this was a sad experience for us.

allReviews.title: Another wonderful stay!
allReviews.text: We stayed in the Iris Building 1201B. It was clean and was fully stocked with everything that we needed for the week. We were given shampoo, dish soap, paper towels, laundry detergent, hand and bath soap. There were no crickets or other bugs in the unit. No one bothered us about listening to a timeshare spill but were offered to do so when we signed in. We kindly declined! The pool was clean and quiet which is why I like this building, because it has a quiet pool that is geared towards adults. I took the shuttle to Walmart, then walked across the street to get breakfast at Jack in the Box and next door to 7/11 to use their cash machine which does not charge me anything, nor my credit union. The only drawback is that you can only take out $200 per day, but in Vegas that could be a good thing!  Then went back to Walmart to get a few snacks. As soon as I walked out the door the shuttle arrived to take me back to the Grandview. They continuously shuttle people back and forth every 20 minutes.  We enjoyed playing slots at South Point and eating at the buffet and other restaurants. Thank you Grandview for another wonderful stay!

allReviews.title: The grand view
allReviews.text: The grand view is a really nice place to chill and relax away from the strip plus it has  the south point hotel next door if you want to  gamble or as we did ,we took our daughter to watch the Run for a Million competition that was on while we were there.

allReviews.title: Too Many Issues
allReviews.text: Even though guests sign a waiver no smoking of any kind in units, someone in a room close to us continuously smoked pot and smell leaked into our unit all hours of the day / night.  Security stopped responding to our complaints and did nothing.  The "quiet" pool was often filled with a lot of kids jumping, splashing and yelling - again security did nothing.  There are 5 pools at the resort but only 1 of them is "quiet" but some guests don't care and security didn't seem to either.

allReviews.title: Location, Location!
allReviews.text: The Grandview has been our go to place in Las Vegas when we vacation.  It is close to everything that we like...South Point Casino, the Strip, Planet Fitness, and lots of shopping!  The pools are wonderful and well maintained.  The units are missing a few items that I feel would be appreciated such a large skillet, 2 cup measuring cup....little things.  But overall this place is PERFECT!

allReviews.title: WORST Experience at HOME resort!!!
allReviews.text: Checked in on Aug 5 at around 2pm. Was given the option to have room in the new building which is the honey suckle building, this building has the power jets in the master bedroom. I had booked for two bedrooms. When I arrived to the rooms, one of the rooms was extremely hot and the other was at a good temperature. But once I checked both rooms, sadly they were not clean, floors had crumbs all around, one of the rooms has smudges of who knows what on the walls, coffee tables also had crumbs and finger prints all over them, and in one of the kitchens there was something spilled on it...again who knows what. Oh, and one of the bedroom sockets had a metal object sticking out of it. Quite bizarre!! I was quite frankly upset. My husband and I drove back to the lobby to speak with someone. I don't remember the gentleman's name but he apologized and offered us to switch rooms. He even offered us a bottle of wine. So we were switched to another room but in the same building. I didn't really care as long as the AC was working.On August 6 we left to venture Nevada and returned to a room with no AC working. The second bedroom was fine no problems. But I was just not happy that the AC was not working again. Like I mentioned before we were given new rooms and even in the new rooms the AC was not working in one of the bedrooms.My husband walked down again to the lobby and spoke with someone. They said they will send someone out so the AC could be looked at and repaired. It took quite a while and it forced us to stay in the resort, just to wait on someone to come over and take care of the AC problem. This caused us to change our schedule, which is not cool at all. Finally, someone came over and the AC unit was fixed.On August 7th, my family and I again ventured off. But now the bedroom where my kids were sleeping the TV in the bedroom was not working. Before we left the resort we drove up to the lobby and did mention it to the front desk people. They said that they will send someone to get that taken care of. Which they did but some how an iPad charger disappeared, not sure how that happened but I really don't like having strangers walk into my rooms with no on there to watch.Later that night, we came back to the resort with the same issue, AC not working!! This was quite frustrating. By the time we got back to our rooms it was really late. It was close to mid night. And once again my husband this time called the front desk. He was told that the building we were in, multiple rooms were having the same issue and that technicians were working on getting the AC to work. My check out date was August 8th...and we were told to hold on and that the AC will be fixed promptly. Not true!! My husband called once again...and this time it was with maintenance he spoke to and they just told him that they were working on it but that soon they will get it fixed. My husband and I waited until around 3am. No one came by and we just gave up. I told him lets just go to bed and just put up with this. We had a long drive back home in a few hours and we did need to get some rest beforehand. I told him to place the DO NOT DISTURB tag on the front door between both bedrooms. I did NOT want to be woken up or get my kids freaked out because some tech decided to go fix the AC unit that late night. Oh but the last call my husband did the female he spoke with said we can move to another room and to leave our belongings in the present rooms we were in. This was around the 3am mark, there was no way I was going to wake up my three children and have them walk to another building to another room. That is just pure ridiculous! She offered that instead of checking out at 10am we can check out later at noon.I'm sorry...I'm an owner here at this resort and I have stayed at the resort at least three times. I have never NEVER had a bad experience here. I just question myself what in the world do they use the annual maintenance fee on? To just replace any broken plates or missing spoons...it should be used to have the AC units up to date and working effectively during the hot summers in Vegas! This is just pure out ridiculous...I don't even know if I want to return to my home resort...What for? Just to be disappointed with the lack of urgency and be placed into unclean rooms with no AC working in them. Nope sorry but no!

allReviews.title: I'll be back!

In addition to the pool, we took part in various activities, like the casino, and shopping to maximizing our Las Vegas getaway to the fullest.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Although there was an issue with the first unit we checked into, the staff addressed our concern and moved us to another unit.  The rest of our stay was very pleasant.

allReviews.title: Old hotel without proper maintenance
allReviews.text: I had several problems with this hotel, like the kitchen sink clogged, air conditioning that didn't work, dirty and ripped sheets. What the reception did was exchange us four, but the problems remained the same... I stayed in 3 different rooms with the same problems.

allReviews.title: McClain -- LV stay
allReviews.text: This Las Vegas trip was a short stay; WE certainly enjoyed the customer service that was rendered, as well as the room! This was our second time staying at the Grandview and look forward to staying at a later time in the very near future.

allReviews.title: Grandview stay

allReviews.title: Excellent vacation
allReviews.text: The rooms are very spacious. The view is amazing, pools and putt putt  also fun the room service was very delicious also

allReviews.title: Excellent convenient unit next door to an excellent Casino.(South Point)
allReviews.text: If we com this way again in 2025, we plan to stay here again for at least 4 weeks.But you can bet that we will spread the word that a stay here is very worthwhile

allReviews.title: People friendly
allReviews.text: People friendly staff very helpful and courteous, homely atmosphere ideal for the whole family. Great place to spend vacation especially with young family, kids will enjoy all the ammenities.

allReviews.title: Not great for young families
allReviews.text: These rooms are not the standard 2 bedroom condo. They are one bedroom condos with an A and B side. The kids were on one side and we could not lock the main door that opened up to the inner rooms. If you’re worried about your kids escaping in the middle of the night this place is not for you. Another example of the lack of security is the main doors are accessible to anyone without a key through out the day. Lastly, we had asked for some additional supplies and the maintenance man brought them right in without knocking. It was pretty unsettling that anyone with a master key could enter our room at any time. There was hair left in the shower from the previous guest, the floors were filthy, a cabinet was broken and there were no sheets for the couch beds. We called at 10pm requesting sheets for our toddler. An hour later we tried calling back and could not get an answer from the front desk. Thankfully we had some throw blankets and were able to set up a makeshift bed. We paid a one time “resort fee” and parking was “free.” If you’re checking in on a Friday, keep in mind that everyone else is also checking in at this time and there will be a long line.

allReviews.title: The property was fantastic.
allReviews.text: The property was great. I just wish you had more free activities for kids. it’s a great investment only if you travel a lot, but we were definitely satisfied

allReviews.title: BEST VACATION
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed all the things that this property have to offer. I really like the home/apartment feel. The property was clean and friendly staff.

allReviews.title: Great location

allReviews.title: We only stay here because we're owners
allReviews.text: The best about this place is that it's close to the freeway. When you factor in all the fees, cleaning, Vacation Village and RCI it's cheaper to syst at a nicer place. I won't say Timeshares are all bad or a bad purchase, but I will say this one is.

allReviews.title: Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: This was the first time we went to Vegas and we had a great time. We got 2 connecting rooms in Building 5 Honey Suckle I think it was called. The rooms were very spacious and had everything we needed. There was a shuttle that took us to Walmart and back which was great. The SouthPoint casino next door was a fantastic bonus.

allReviews.title: Nice accommodations, enjoyed our stay
allReviews.text: We were very happy with our stay at the Grandview Las Vegas. We like the fact that it was several miles from the strip to get away from the busyness yet it had a large casino right next door within walking distance. We didn't feel that the amenities were much to talk about and wished there was a little more to do at the resort. There wasn't a whole lot of information upon check in So it would have been nice to know what activities they may have had going on during the day about the shuttle to the grocery store, and how to access pools etc. Overall we would stay there again But my choose a property that offered more to do. As a disappointing aside, our guests staying in the adjacent suite left their laptop and AirPods in the nightstand when checking out, and unfortunately of staff was not ethical enough to turn it in and instead stole it.

allReviews.title: Fun trip!
allReviews.text: The service is awesome! They provide whatever we needed. If you plan to grill, bring  an ID to borrow the bbq utensils. We had a 2-bedroom unit with a pool view and the rooms are spacious. My friend from North Dakota really enjoyed her trip with us. South Point Casino is next door. We walked and enjoyed the slot machines. Food is great too! Would love to go back.

allReviews.title: We Love the Grandview
allReviews.text: The Grandview is amazing if you want to do Vegas without the hype of the strip… I’ve stayed here with and without children and having South Point across the street is a game changer… Everything you need is right there

allReviews.title: Family Friendly
allReviews.text: We enjoy staying at the Grandview. We stay here at least once per year looking forward to our next stay.

allReviews.title: Love my home resort

allReviews.title: GrandView

allReviews.title: Sleeping on the sofa bed for vacation.
allReviews.text: I requested 2 bedrooms which is what I usually request for a vacation, but when I checked in at the resort, I was told that I only had a one-bedroom unit.  My guest was left to spend the entire vacation sleeping on the sofa bed. The time share people wanted to sell a second unit instead of providing he accommodations that had been requested.

allReviews.title: Sammer 2024
allReviews.text: Our trip was a success, we received the Grandview and we had a beautiful experience. The weather was acting up and  ruined some of the pool experience, but it was necessary due to safety reasons. I appreciate the fact that they close the pool when lightning is a possibility. My kids love the fact that they have many pools to choose from and they can cross street to go bowling or movie theaters

allReviews.title: Love the Grandview
allReviews.text: Everything about the Grandview is wonderful it is our home away from home. The units are amazing and the staff the best!!

allReviews.title: Great family fun in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The property is away from the strip but an easy 10 minute drive there if desired. The resort has everything needed for a great vacation. The choice of multiple pools was nice and the hot tubs are large. The casino next door also has extra activities for all ages like bowling, a movie theatre and an arcade! My family can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Very nice resort!
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas apartment
allReviews.text: Many good and bad issues.  Any issues we had regarding something not working were fixed ASAP.  Plus there is a free shuttle to Walmart if you want to cook for yourself (salt/pepper, butter, bread, eggs, snacks, etc) or forgot something.  These are one bedroom apartments with FULL kitchen and washer/dryers. They provide dishwashing and dish soap, also coffee. Plenty of towels.    Bathtub was HUGE (and comfy). Several pools to choose from.  I would be surprised if you didn't find one you liked. Super close to South Point Casino which has inexpensive current movies, bowling, and horse shows! Also has a lot of restaurants - some expensive and some not (Coronado's Cafe). South Point has it's own gift shop/store but a bag of chips is about $7.50 so take the free shuttle in the morning to Walmart!

allReviews.title: Never Again
allReviews.text: The substandard conditions of the Grandview in Las Vegas comes second to the inept , unprofessional, vengeful, hostile, and disrespectful staff. It is obvious the Grandview has serious management issues. This place is poorly run, employees are allowed to do whatever they want with impunity by mistreating the people that keep them employed. No considerations for persons with disabilities, for war veterans, and perhaps animosity towards persons that fit certain stereotype, in the assumption they would take the abuse.

allReviews.title: Cockroach infestation
allReviews.text: We have been timeshare owners at the Grandview for 19 years and this stay was the worst one we have experienced. There was a cockroach infestation in the rooms and even though they sent an exterminator to take care of it, the all-natural spray they used just made the roaches come out in full force for days. We had to go to the store to buy raid just to kill the roaches. It was absolutely disgusting and we will likely never stay at this property again. We left a voicemail for the general manager and never received a call back.

allReviews.title: Great Las Vegas resort

allReviews.title: nice stay

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: Definitely was expecting nothing less than a home away from home experience.  The rooms I reserved were phenomenal, clean, spacious and comfy.  Will definitely go back when time permits.

allReviews.title: Very enjoying the vacation with family. Love to come back again sooner or later
allReviews.text: Very relaxing vacation time with family, love the pool, love the customer service, love how clean it is, love what I see.

allReviews.title: Decent but not great
allReviews.text: For starters, we ended up calling maid service to come change the sheets because there were very “questionable stains” all over them when we pulled back the covers the first night. There were boogers on the walls I also had to ask them to remove. A homeless man was hanging in the lobby of tower 8 one afternoon and when we came home that evening, security was still searching for him since he propped a door open with toilet paper to gain access again. Didn’t feel very safe. The pools were nice and well maintained. A male employee was sleeping on the women’s changing table when we went to the rest room by the main pool not once, but twice. We had to kick him out of the rest room to go ourselves. The rooms are spacious and quiet enough. Just not the cleanest or safest resort!

allReviews.title: Great week at the Grandview!
allReviews.text: Another nice stay at the Grandview property in Las Vegas.  The apartment was clean and the staff were accommodating. The only negative is the grounds always seemed to have trash strewn about, despite being staff always around.  Otherwise, no complaints.

allReviews.title: Nice Resorts
allReviews.text: The unit is clean, the bed are comfortable.   The Resort is easily located to the strip.  Southpoint Casino and Hotel right across the street, plenty of restaurants and entertainment venues there.

allReviews.title: This trip only
allReviews.text: We normally stay at this resort everytime we visit LV. And normally this place is on top of there game. But this time was not so well, upon arrival my wife noticed the floors we not clean. Missing linen for our pullout bed. The housekeeping missed drawers that had junk inside of them. They also missed that the coffee machine was missing, and that there were a lot of missing plates, cups, and utensils. Apparently the previous people who was in this unit stole items that the housekeeping should've replaced before this unit was ready for us.

allReviews.title: We would definitely book here again - nice clean rooms. Building 5; 12th floor
allReviews.text: Our stay was really good. We stayed on the 12th floor of building 5. The rooms were really clean. We stayed 5 FULL Days (Not including arrival and departure - travel days). The staff was nice and we were able to change out towels throughout the week. We stayed in a two bedroom suite - my husband and I and our 21 year old - WHo had a WHOLE suite to herself next door to us - She loved that! The linen was fresh and our view was in the back BUT on the fourth of July we saw EVERY fireworks in the city - I counted at least 20 sets. We didn't get a pushy sales person and enjoyed a nice (mostly) quiet stay - only a couple times did we hear plumbing from next door and people in the hallway, but nothing major...we will definitely book again. ALSO, this is a good location to visit South Point Hotel and Casino - which had an equestrian show! Bowling Alley and nice SPA (and we ate at the Prime Rib place, which was really good). Oh, the only tiny thing is there was NO baking sheet in the rooms (we checked our daughter's room too) I like my  toast from the oven and had nothing to place it on....but that was minor compared to rest of the stay. Also, we were in and out so much that we can't talk much about other amenities. My husband went to the gym one time - and it was 115-120 degrees so not much pool time during the day. The parking fills up quickly, but nothing major, just a few steps.

allReviews.title: Need to be handicap friendly
allReviews.text: This was my 1st time at home.  There are so many mobile carts on the properties, but what for?  if no one can rent them, or use them.

allReviews.title: Overall good stay
allReviews.text: The room was nice.   Some of the appliances were dated and the tv not having built in apps or at least a guide was a little disappointing.  Overall a good place to stay.  The room was spacious and clean as were the pool areas.

allReviews.title: Not Extremely Grand but A Little Grand
allReviews.text: The Grandview is a good place if you want to stay somewhere off the strip or at least off of all the traffic and Bajillion people. The Grandview has several buildings which are nice. We stayed in the Iris building, which is technically the oldest building and it showed. The Iris building didn’t necessarily have good airflow or air conditioning in all the hallways that we walked through. But overall, it was semi-clean. The room that we stayed in was quiet and pretty clean although there were a couple of spots that could’ve used extra cleaning such as the couch and parts of the bathroom. But it was a decent room nonetheless; as for sleeping, the room sleeps 4 and the pullout couch is not comfortable unless it’s still a couch and if it is still a couch, it makes your back stiff unless maybe if you were a child. We were near the quiet pool which wasn’t always quiet because sometimes children were in there playing loud games, but the majority of the time people respected the rule. Staff was courteous every time we interacted with them. And check in and check out process was very easy.

allReviews.title: Improvements Needed
allReviews.text: Cleaniness of the rooms were an issue: 5 of the 6 bedrooms were not ready for move in;  Refringe was very unleveled in our unit; one remote did not work TVs ... we reported but maintenance never responded. Meet two maintenance works in the hall and ask if they could program the remote, but they told us to report to the front desk ( which we had already done). While has been our favorite resort to visit when in Vegas, there are improvements that need to be made for future visits.

allReviews.title: Great time at the Grandview
allReviews.text: We stay here every year with family and always have a great time.  It's very relaxing to be next to the Southpoint casino plus just a short uber ride from all of the action on the strip.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay!

allReviews.title: Grandview Resort

allReviews.title: The place where you are treated like an idiot by the staff
allReviews.text: We started having problems the second night of our stay. We asked to speak with a manager on multiple occasions and the front desk just ignored our request. Services tickets from the resort was issued and they closed the tickets without fixing the problems.  The front desk folks will talk down to you and try and intimidate you so you just accept the substandard conditions. When talking with the front desk it felt like they were protecting the resort manager and they shielded every item. I believe the front desk was ordered bt their manager not to bring any problems to them, I also believe that they have been trained to talk down to their guest.  The room safe never worked, The rooms were somewhat filthy, the card readers throughout the property worked sometimes and most times did not. By the pool ares several chairs were very unsafe to sit in and need to be repaired or just thrown away. Most of the hot tubs were turned off because they just did not work. I don't understand how they achieved a Gold Status from RCI.

allReviews.title: The resort has potential! They need new management that cares about the guests!
allReviews.text: I understand that things happen and sometimes you need to pivot and make the best of things. I don’t understand this resort blatant disregard to any of concerns. And the front desk has no problem talking down to you like your idiot. We rarely encounter this type of communication from the resorts we have stayed in before. We called in multiple items of concerns and they closed the tickets without completing the request. It appears ignoring the guest when a request comes in and talking down to a guest comes from the top down! I not understanding why RCI has an office there and we were prohibited to raise our concerns with them. Everyone only wants to hear the good news and you plug your ears on the bad stuff. What angers me the most is that I asked to talk with a manager several times and not once did anyone respond. Disappointed with the management and RCI at this Resort!

The only issues we had this time were the internet speed and reliability. At times, the internet was slower than dial-up, Overall, Grandview is always a good bang for your buck.

allReviews.title: Great Holiday
allReviews.text: We have been coming to the Grandview for close to 15 years and always enjoy our stay there.  They have always been very accommodating for our needs.  Having the Southpoint next door is definitely an added bonus.  The grounds and pools are well maintained.  We are close to the strip, groceries and there is multitude of stores for shopping should you wish to update your wardrobe.

allReviews.title: Great Location and Our Best Stay In Vegas
allReviews.text: I have stayed at other Vegas locations but Grandview was the best so far especially with South Point Casino being right next door. The first surprise was the double units when you open the door from the hallway. You are greeted with a foyer with 2 doors, A on the right and B on the left. I had requested a 2 bedroom unit. What we got was 2  identical one bedroom fully equipped apartments with full kitchens, large bathrooms., a king sized bed, living room, dining room, a soaking tub and washer and dryer. We could go back and forth between units through the foyer without going into the hallway.  Southpoint Casino next door has several  restaurants, fast food, ice cream, a buffet , bowling alley and loose slots. The Grandview has a free shuttle everyday to take you to the nearby Walmart shopping center. There’s also a city bus that goes up and down Las Vegas Blvd from Southpoint that’s $2.50 and $1.50 for seniors.  My BFF and I can’t wait to go back to Vegas and stay at the Grandview.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas experience
allReviews.text: The Grandview at Las Vegas provided us with an excellent base of operations for our trip to Nevada.  We were able to easily get an Uber to The Strip which took about 20 minutes and cost around $25.  The South Pointe complex was just next door so we were able to partake of the casino and restaurants there as well.  Easy access to the interstate for our various trips out of Vegas. Our rooms were a little dated decoration wise but they were clean and well cared for.  The pools were a little quiet for our taste but that was anticipated.

allReviews.title: Huge Resort Suitable as Base for Grand Circle Trip
allReviews.text: We used The Grandview at Las Vegas as a place to stay for a few days before we left to tour Valley of Fire State Park and Zion, Bryce Canyon, and Grand Canyon (North Rim) National Parks for several days. Our unit was very nice but it was in the building at the back of the resort on I-15, which was a long walk to any of the resort pools, including the main pool. Check-in was a zoo and took too long. The resort is much larger than when we stayed there several years ago. It's still well-maintained and the units are quite nice but it's a LONG way from most of what Las Vegas has to offer, especially considering most Strip and Downtown resorts now charge for parking. You absolutely need a vehicle unless you really just plan to stay at the resort and use its facilities (which are extensive, admittedly.) We returned to LV after our tour of the parks and stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations Paradise resort which is very nice and much better located to enjoy local attractions.

allReviews.title: Super clean and friendly. Lovely grounds
allReviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay here. Everything was nice and clean. Southpoint right across the way, can't even call it a street. Pools were kept up. Never did find the spa here...  but finally found all the pools. Rooms are spacious if you want to cook in. Kitchen is totally stocked. Want to bbq, there's bbqs to use and I saw them clean them every morning.

allReviews.title: Great weekend experience
allReviews.text: Love the resort.  Beautiful relaxing love every moment..looking forward to have many more wonder memories ♥️ thank you

allReviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Bowling they were able to put me in a building that was close to the south point so had super easy acces to the bowling center

allReviews.title: The Grandveiw at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Overall very good resort and good location!! Very convenient to the Southpoint Casino..Good restaurants close buy. 10 minutes to the Las Vegas strip!!

allReviews.title: Lacking customer service
allReviews.text: If check in is 4pm, the rooms are entitled to be ready. Sofa bed also had no bedding in the room, I had ring house keeping to ask for it. If the roim is a 1 bedroom for 4 people it isnt rocket science that linen should already be placed in the cupboard in case it is needed.

allReviews.title: Great stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Great place and location if you don’t want to be right in the middle of the strip! Unit was roomy and clean. Pools/hot tubs were well maintained and was like an oasis after a long day exploring. We loved being able to visit Southpoint next door and then retreat back to our nice, quiet smoke free resort! Can wait to go back to Vegas and we all agreed we would choose The Grandview again!

allReviews.title: No working AC unit and cleanliness
allReviews.text: AC unit went out the first night. Staff did not offer to relocate us to another room nor did staff offer to provide fans etc. Very hot and very uncomfortable. Also the unit was extremely dusty and remote control did not work.

allReviews.title: Stay for Bowling Tournament next door
allReviews.text: Perfect location for our needs. This was our 3rd stay there. Room size is perfect for 2 people. Loved having the waher/dryer in the unit. Made it easy to pack less clothes. Stayed in the Iris building and lived having the "quiet" pool at our building.

allReviews.title: Pleased Yet Again
allReviews.text: The Grandview at Las Vegas has been my only and favorite place to stay in Las Vegas.  Each and every year i visit it is always packed with great staff and employees who care about your vacation and your well being.  I recommend this location.  With the new rules of no marijuanna smoking on the site has been a breath of fresh air from not having to smell 2nd hand weed smoke.  Great Job.

allReviews.title: the grandview experience
allReviews.text: excellent place - far enough away from the strip to enjoy wider las Vegas but close enough to indulge if you want

allReviews.title: Belle's great customer service
allReviews.text: Thank you Belle for the great service. Everyone. Unmatched friendliness  and professionalism.  Keep up the great work

allReviews.title: Jet lives up to her name!
allReviews.text: Jet is the best!   11 people between the ages of 22 to 91 and 5 separate units!  She was pleasant, professional and smiled with all of our requests.  What an asset she is to your staff.  Thank you!

allReviews.title: Vacation at the Grandview
allReviews.text: I got assistance in making my reservation without worrying about whether there would be space available or if I had made the right choice. I was happy with the results.

allReviews.title: Pleasure trip
allReviews.text: Love this resort!! Everyone is very friendly and helpful!! I would recommend this property to everyone

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: Great value and friendly helpful staff.  Would highly recommend this resort.  The pools are great.  5 to choose from.

allReviews.title: friendly and accommodating
allReviews.text: Ravi Kumar and Belle Duran were amazing when we checked in. Very friendly. Feel like we are family every time we go back.

allReviews.title: Our Las Vegas/Grandview vacation
allReviews.text: A great vacationa nd visit to Las Vegas at the Grandview Resort. There are two woderful ladies at the front desk (check in) that are always the absolute best at helping us upon arrival. Their names are Mrs. Okema and Mrs. Bell. They deserve the highest of recognition.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Place was great.  5 pools are great, was always a lounger at any time.  One neg is after 3:45 pm most of the pools are in the shade except the two in the middle - a few seats on the end have sun till 5pm.  We were there 11 days and put in two requests for a cleaning and both seemed to get lost, so no cleaning happened.  They did drop of sheets and towels so we just changed the bed ourselves and cleaned it.  Staff was very friendly.  Nice to have a parking garage as an option to keep the car cool.  LOVED the casino next door, all the restaurants were really good!  And Bingo upstairs had LARGE jackpots and 2-3 free drinks so that was very fun.  We will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great location, resort, staff and other owners
allReviews.text: Grandview is always a great stay. The units are great, clean and it feels like an apartment. Staff are professional and the other owners are down to earth.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Fantastic resort. Large clean rooms, incredible pools and pool furniture. Staff is amazing and next door to casino. Highly recommended. Strip is 20 minutes away, free parking at Grandview. Two bedroom condo is two separate suites, fantastic value.

allReviews.title: Great resort great location
allReviews.text: It’s always a great stay at the grandview. Rooms are clean and well stocked. Front desk super helpful. Excellent location next to southpoint casino. Beautiful ground and feet pools

allReviews.title: Derby day!!! Soo fun, soo friendly!!!affordable food and drinks!!played Bingo!! Had a great time!! Uber was always fast/
allReviews.text: Derby day!!! Soo fun, soo friendly!!!affordable food and drinks!!played Bingo!! Had a great time!! Uber was always fast/

allReviews.title: Worst experience we've had at Grandview
allReviews.text: We've stayed at Grandview many times and it has always been good. This was by far the worst experience. Door under sink fell off when we opened it the first time. Bathroom sink was clogged. That was fixed then a couple days later there was a strong sewage smell in the room. We were moved to another unit. Our last night there housekeeping came and dropped towels and linens off at 3AM!!! That can't happen and is absolutely unacceptable!!

allReviews.title: Good despite pool closure
allReviews.text: It was a good location, good property, size etc.  It is getting old and we had a bunch of maintenance issues but generally good.  The only problem is they didn't warn us that they put us in building 9 and the day after we arrived, they closed the pool and hot tub.  As a person with a disability, this was upsetting as I had difficulty walking farther to the other pools.  This should have been disclosed at check-in and it wasn't.  This was disappointing but otherwise, it was a nice place to stay.

allReviews.title: I love the rooms here they Awesome resort I never have to leave to go home . The liquor is discounted and I love bingo
allReviews.text: I love the rooms here they Awesome resort I never have to leave to go home . The liquor is discounted and I love bingo

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: Wonderful two week stay. Property was clean and quiet. Unit was clean and without any issues. Very affordable and welcoming. A HUGE shout out to Shailaendra Pillay (supervisor/manager on duty) who was always such a great pleasure to converse with. As always, we will be back!

allReviews.title: Outstanding
allReviews.text: We arrived there and it was outstanding service and personal experience was great. Keep the good work 10+

allReviews.title: Love this place!
allReviews.text: The front reception staff have ALWAYS been great with us. They listen and respond! They truly go the extra mile for the guests.

allReviews.title: Great experience!
allReviews.text: The resort was very clean and enjoyable! The kiddie pool was the best!! Overall it was a great experience!

allReviews.title: Peace and quiet
allReviews.text: We stayed at the sage tower, close to everything you need and room was very clean lot of room great tub comfortable bedding great views and kitchen had everything

allReviews.title: Best Value in Vegas!!
allReviews.text: Located just 15-20mins from airport, The Grandview at Las Vegas is the best bang for the buck in the city. Comfortable living quarters with separated bedroom and full kitchen, along with washer/dryer inside your private unit. South Point casino full poker room & Sportsbook is a 5min walk away.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Great stay...great staff...superfast check in/out...very cleanEasy walk to southpoint casino...great gambling and restaurants

allReviews.title: Welcome to Vegas baby!!
allReviews.text: Great staff, big rooms, clean and great food. I love the full kitchen. The sushi place was amazing. Went back multiple times.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay
allReviews.text: I have stayed here many times over the years. It is convenient off the freeway and next door to South Point for some good food and poker. My only complaint was that they didn’t sweep the floor well near the dining room table, but everything else was great.

allReviews.title: Walking distance to Southpoint Casino
allReviews.text: Was there in April 2024 had a great experience. Grounds are clean and well kept. There is no maid service but they provide you with anything you need throughout your stay. You just call the operator and make your request   Our one bedroom was very nice and roomy

allReviews.title: Nice, Comfortable rooms
allReviews.text: Nice property, comfortable beds, great kitchen.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Do not get a room on the first floor, it is very noisy with equipment etc.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Always great Nice to be off the strip but still close to the action. Rooms are spacious and kitchen has everything you need. Family enjoyed the pools and hot tub.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: Easy to get to the strip.  Lots of activities close to the condo. Casino next door with many restaurants.

allReviews.title: That’s how you do Vegas
allReviews.text: I Love The Grand View . There’s no other way to do Vegas. The Grandview has everything we need for our trip. I love full kitchen. We saved a lot of money 💰 by cooking at The Grandview. Right next door is the South Point which is very nice and saves the trip and inconvenience to gambling at the Strip.

allReviews.title: Worth every cent
allReviews.text: We bought Timeshare here and I am very pleased. Can't wait for my next stay here <3They rooms are spacious, my 5 kids loved it so much.

allReviews.title: Going downhill
allReviews.text: While the property and location are great, the state of our unit was disgusting. It’s clear the cleaning and maintenance fees are not being used for their intended purpose.  We couldn’t even use the bathtub because it hadn’t been cleaned properly, there was dust and debris all over the floors, vents, and baseboards, bent towel racks, lightbulbs out, dirty utensils in the drawers, and hair in the bedding.

allReviews.title: Better Than Before
allReviews.text: We own at the Grandview Las Vegas.  It had been two years since we last stayed here.  We had a family reunion and my brother who had never been to the resort was astonished at the size of the condo and the resort in general.  The TV's had been updated since we were here last.  The condo was in great shape.  The staff was friendly and top notch!  Kat had not seen me in two years yet remembered my name!  It felt like coming home.  We had a great time.

allReviews.title: Old and Dirty!
allReviews.text: Don't waste your time/money!  This place is not kept up.  There was long black hair all over the shower and on the floors, along with crumbs and dirt.  The outlets did not want to keep a charger plugged in and my computer cord actually got really hot having it plugged in.  There was a lot of mold in the shower and shower door.  The main door to the unit squeaked and ever time we would come and go, we knew the neighbors heard everything.  It's old and run down, and even the timeshare people wouldn't recommend saying there, but to stay at their newer building (of course wanting us to spend $$$$ to join that one.

allReviews.title: Housekeeping review
allReviews.text: Twice I requested supply's for the room and twice I had to call back to get my request Not happy with housekeeping response.

allReviews.title: Travelled with friend
allReviews.text: Loved the stay, resort itself is very clean and close to all the amenities. Liked the shuttle service to get the groceries. I wish the shuttle could service to airport and strip. Overall, it was nice and would recommend people to go there.

allReviews.title: Golf vacation
allReviews.text: Great resort, very clean, very comfortable, great location. Staff was vey accommodating and amenities were terrific

allReviews.title: Impeccable Service
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect! The condo was very clean, the staff was great, the maintenance department fixed a breakage in less than half an hour. The view was splendid! We loved our trip!

allReviews.title: Loved it
allReviews.text: Book it you won’t be disappointed!!  Great for children and adults.  Close to SouthPoint!!  Will stay here again & again!!!!

allReviews.title: Grand Canyon Trip
allReviews.text: Great trip to the Grand Canyon and great place to stay!  Great value compared to the strip! Been there 5 X's now!

allReviews.title: i like the location and unit set up. Relaxed environment, good location,  Good customer service. I lkie the full kitchen
allReviews.text: i like the location and unit set up. Relaxed environment, good location,  Good customer service. I lkie the full kitchen

allReviews.title: High Marks

allReviews.title: Grandview overall
allReviews.text: Not very clean no more house cleaning on Wednesday need to call for everything walls doors are not very clean everything is not very clean they don’t wash it but just sweep i suppose card to get in works only 1 on 5 time than it decline need to walk all the way back to front desk.

allReviews.title: Our Stay at the Grandview at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Grand View is OK for an off strip stay.  Location next to the South Point Resort and Casino and not far from Outlet stores is good.  We are not sure what RCI Gold Crown means.

allReviews.title: Great location and accomodation
allReviews.text: Located close to everything Las Vegas. Golf, Food, softball and casinos. Played in a SSUSA softball tournament in Henderson.

allReviews.title: Great family friendly resort
allReviews.text: We love the Grandview , have been traveling to Las Vegas and staying at the resort since 2006 and we have had nothing but positive experiences each year we visit. The staff are knowledgable and assertive, accommodations are excellent and the South Point Resort and Casino is located next door,  there is so much to offer the guests of Grandview you never need to leave the area as they have activities for children. The Las Vegas Strip is just a few miles away for those who want to explore.

allReviews.title: Not a great stay, not relaxing resort, lots of loud guests
allReviews.text: This resort has potential, but I was dissapointted with the type of guests that were at resort. Lots of loud guests, not relaxing for us. The room was nice but the cleanliness was not great. Our pillows were very old, yellow and smelly. The pillow case was clean but I always look at pillow cover and they were so yellow. Gross. and shower had hairs from previous guests. This is unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: The is a great place to stay! Friendly staff, clean rooms and property!  Next to Southpoint👍. Not to far from the Las Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: Worst Trip Ever
