allReviews.text: I have been an owner for more than 20 years and the last 2 trips to this resort (My home Resort) have been horrible, this last being the worst. I had 2, 2 bedrooms and a 1 bedroom on this trip with my entire family. They put us in an older tower where the sinks clogged with water and hair still in the sink when we arrived, broken towel bars in all units, water damage to ceiling in 1 shower, there was mold present and paint was peeling where it bubbled, Counters dirty, built up dust behind doors, floors sticky, and most disgusted  "roaches"!!!. We ended our trip earlier once the roaches were found. My update meeting was focused on purchase to rent my units. Why? I purchased to visit. This is why the poor upkeep. Staff treated poorly (something I had never experienced), staff also misinforming people with information and not following through with what was expressed or promised. Very disappointed what has happened here and I will not be returning. I deserve to be respected.

allReviews.title: Poor Customer Service.
allReviews.text: First, When we booked we booked a room for 4 adults. We received a one bedroom and a pullout couch. Furthermore, they only left three towels and wash clothes. We requested one more of each for the forth guest and they stated they provide a washer and dryer and couldn’t provide. So, the expectation is that we wash laundry daily so we can handoff towels and wash clothes between people? We can’t each even wash our face morning and evening. Will not return and certainly wouldn’t consider a timeshare

allReviews.title: good
allReviews.text: It seems like member services has changed since I was there last time.  This time, cleanliness of the entire floor and our rooms was unacceptable.  I did not see any housekeeping doing anything.  The hallways got worse as we left.  No one check to see if we needed anything, and when we did, we were told that we have to call the front desk for services.  This ridiculous, I had to call to get extra towels and kitchen soap?

allReviews.title: Nice, But!!!
allReviews.text: The Resort is beautiful and the kids had a BLAST!! They need to Clean the units BETTER!!! FOUND HAIR every where and the tub was DIRTY, HAD to call the THE FRONT desk to have someone to come up to clean.

allReviews.title: Hollywood
allReviews.text: Carpet was outdated and seemed to be bloodstained also hot tub. It didn't bother mentioning it to front desk because my guess left to the dissatisfaction of the cleanliness.  I hope the Grandview make it right and reach out to me with a solution to make this right

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Grandview is Top notch!
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. Only a short drive to the strip. Great casino and restaurants on site and swimming pools are all over the place. It was chilly and we are old so we didn't swim, but there were kids enjoying themselves regardless! We had a great time!

allReviews.title: Great spot
allReviews.text: Always my favorite spot to stay vegas, the kids love it, family and friends love the size of the rooms and full kitchen. I'm an owner and love the things they do we are really taken care of its a home away from home.

allReviews.title: Outside much better than inside.
allReviews.text: I am completely underwhelmed with the interior of the building and my room.  The outside looks nice and the grounds seem pretty well kept.  The inside doesn't match the outside.  I am certainly glad I am not an owner.  I won't be back... there are too many other nicer choices in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Need some extra care!
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Grandview many times before. But this time the rooms weren’t very clean there was dust everywhere the dishwasher was leaking and must have been leaking for a while because it smelled in one room. One room was missing a sheer curtain. The toilet continuously ran Even after they fixed it. They need to focus on cleanliness. Staying at the Grandview is still better than staying at a casino.

allReviews.title: Another Family vacation
allReviews.text: As a family we have stayed at the Grandview resort 4 times, it has never disappointed. Everything you need is within close proximity and Vegas is always fun and entertaining. Have fun, be safe, and enjoy all Grandview and Vegas has to offer.

allReviews.title: Vegas trip
allReviews.text: Good stay! Hotel was easy to check in, friendly staff.. offered me a complementary service for timeshare members, but could not fulfill what promised, and did not refund my deposit! (Only $20 by the way) but still!!! The trims were great, very nice bedroom and size overall! Would definitely stay there again. Just a little far out from the strip! But great value for the distance and size!

allReviews.title: The Room smelled like trash had been sitting for weeks, The room was very dirty looked like someone just checked out
allReviews.text: The Room smelled like trash had been sitting for weeks, The room was very dirty looked like someone just checked out

allReviews.title: Amazing Three Week Stay
allReviews.text: We spent 3 weeks at the Grandview and had an amazing trip.   The unit was a little dated but it was clean. The bed was comfy and our location was great.  We stay in Building #2 Primrose and we overlooked the pool.  Within walking distance to the South Point casino where we ate most evenings.  The kitchen was equipped but we only used the coffee pot and the microwave.  During the 3 weeks staff would bring extra toileties.  We did not ask for cleaning while we were there.  The pools are heated but the weather was cold.  Overall we had an amazing trip.

allReviews.title: Belle is the best!
allReviews.text: Belle provides the best customer service. Very knowledgeable  and friendly. I would never stay at the Grendview if it wasn't for Belle's superior services.The rooms need some refreshing.  Antiquated furniture and appliances

allReviews.title: Inadequacy
allReviews.text: This resort was unable to house myself and 5 guests as we had planned due to the poorly maintained rooms. We lost 1.5  hours of our vacation dealing with this issue even after calling the day before arrival to make certain the rooms would be in good order.The management initially tried to correct the issue. Another manager completely failed to understand the real issue at hand which was making sure rooms were appropriately maintained, clean and in good working order BEFORE being assigned to owners and guests. This same manager had an argumentative demeanor and told me he would do this, this and this for me....all of which didn't address the problem at hand. I asked for my points to be refunded and he refused that repeatedly.  I am very disappointed in what the Grandview has become. I hope they raise the bar.

allReviews.title: Another enjoyable stay!
allReviews.text: We have stayed at Grandview Las Vegas several times and have never been disappointed. The location is convenient and within walking distance to South Point Hotel & Casino. A rental car is recommended as it is South of the airport and not really close to any other walking locations, however there are many pools and other activities on site.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We come back to the Grandview every year. The rooms are clean and spacious, and the check in/check out process has always been fast and easy. The Grandview is right next to South Point Casino. It's an easy walk over to Southpoint for gaming, restaurants, movies, bowling etc. You will be asked to go on a timeshare presentation at Grandview, but they will take NO for an answer if that's not something you are interested in.

allReviews.title: Nice place. Can be loud next to SouthPoint and the freeway. Very easy to get in and out of compared to others.
allReviews.text: Nice place. Can be loud next to SouthPoint and the freeway. Very easy to get in and out of compared to others.

allReviews.title: Grandview Resort, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Our one bedroom unit was spacious and clean. We overlooked a pool area from the 5th floor. The hall ways were quiet as was our overnight hours. Multiple pool and hottub areas. Also a "kiddy" pool and splash pad. A nice onsight mini put, though we did not play. There is a buisness area with PC's and printer for guests. Southgate Casino with all it has to offer is right next door. A great stay.

allReviews.title: Not like it used to be
allReviews.text: Rooms were dirty, dusty, appliances were either not working or damaged. THe hallways in building were filthy, was there an entire week and they never once vacuumed.  The elevators would take forever, then when they did open the staff with towels or other boxes would be taken up entire elevator.  The rooms are never cleaned even just once during our stay to refresh towels etc. we had asked for two lock offs close to each other because of small kids etc.  I had called twice over a two month period before arriving to make this request. Both times they told me no problem.  Upon check in they had us in opposite hallways no where near each other.  Front desk told me, they had no obligation nor guarantee that requests would be satisfied.

allReviews.title: Great resort
allReviews.text: The resort is somehat dated but very well kept. Everything is clean and works, the unit kitchen items are minimal, but they bring you what you need if you ask. Staff is friendly. They really want their guests to have a pleasant stay. The RCI timeshare sales tactics are awful, but Grandview Resort is a great place to stay.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: Another great stay at the grandview. Friendly staff, great amenities (multiple pools/hot tubs , work out room, convenience store(with short order kitchen ) , outdoor bbq’s, very clean resort, south point hotel/casino right across a very quiet street (numerous restaurants , theatres, bowling…..  great location for families, couples or you’re buddies on a golf trip

allReviews.title: Always a good place to stay
allReviews.text: This is my home resort & it is always provides the best of the best. I would recommend staying any time of year. It is about 5 miles from the middle of the strip, so a car is preferable. South Point Casino is across the avenue from Grandview & has lots of non casino activities..

allReviews.title: It was okay
allReviews.text: Not handicapped accessible no wheelchairs, no pots and pans in the kitchen, no sheets and pillows for the sofa bed.  Keys malfunctioned. Opened down stairs but not upstairs and Vice versa.  It was clean

allReviews.title: Clean and cozy
allReviews.text: Our stay was amazing staff was awesome and we loved jacuzzi bathtub.our one room was spacious and very clean. We were able to check in and check out very easily. The bed was super comfortable we traveled for family and our daughters were very comfortable and had a great time! Rooms were all smoke free which was very nice. We enjoyed the kids pool in our building as well

allReviews.title: Grandview Resort at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean and comfortable. The fitness facility was fantastic it covered all my needs.The pool and hottub were a nice place to relax after spending time on the strip. The beds and pillows were very comfortable. The kitchen supplied all of our needs and the service from staff was great.

allReviews.title: Worst Stay Ever
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Las Vegas Grandview Resort over 30 times in the past few years asa owner at Vacation Village  at Parkway. Last week I was  leaving that Wyndham in Austin, TX for the Grandview. I pre-coordinated my arrival for the building and room I wanted to stay in. I called ahead 3 hours prior to arrival. Upon arrival, the room was not ready and a different room was assigned. The room was missing several items  and took several hours to prepare for my move in. I contacted Ass. Manager Robby on several issues during stay: Missing items, uncleanliness, keys not working, rude staff, ect. I left messages, over several days but he never returned my messages. I had to personally walk to offices to get results. I later contacted Manager Joe Gonzales and was he  also failed to respond, and return calls or address issues in a timely manner. The place has gone to the dogs! The pools and hot tub almost never cleaned or had excessive chlorine  which burned eyes. Carts constantly left in hallways  and when reported, remained for days sometimes.I consistently complained about the rooms "foul smell and dirty linen before sleeping on sheets and pillow cases but never got feedback!I have been coming here for years. Since C-19 the staff is rude and unprofessional, managers unresponsive to complaints and fail to return calls or follow up on complaints, issues or concerns. I have written  several complaints on bookings, lack of service and unprofessionalism from resorts and RCI issues and always request following up and replays/feedback and have yet to get any!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Again, I want management to contact me : majorgstamps@gmail.com 210-992-8533 ASAP!!!!I have written  several complaints on bookings, lack of service  and unprofessionalism from resorts and RCI issues and always request following up and replays/feedback and have yet to get any!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Again, I want management to contact me : majorgstamps@gmail.com 210-992-8533 ASAP!!!!

allReviews.title: Again Very Dirty Unit
allReviews.text: Unit very dirty!! Unit maintenance is nonexistent.  Shower leaked all over the floor due to drip tray gone and is starting to rot the cabinet kick area.  Freezer leaks into freezer and refrigerator. This unit has had this problem for a long time. Not all burners worked.The positive they have nice check in personal and at least one very helpful security man.

allReviews.title: Nice lil getaway
allReviews.text: Super fast check in, rooms were nice kids really enjoyed the rooms. The kids really didn’t want to leave the room they were enjoying their time. We were not able to check out the pool due to a strong windstorm but the pool looked nice.

allReviews.title: Nice resort, but.....
allReviews.text: Resort staff very friendly, cleanliness of rooms not to be desired; toilet and tub filthy, walls need cleaned, vents need cleaned, air filters changed, windows cleaned.  Grounds were properly maintained.

allReviews.title: Great resort but not very close to the strip
allReviews.text: The resort was very nice and easy to arrive to. The only thing I would have liked to have was some sort of shuttle service to the strip. The resort is well-maintained and the staff was very courteous and helpful.

allReviews.title: Vacation for family
allReviews.text: It was nice just didn’t understand why we put at the back building I like being in the front buildings closer to the silverton but it’s always nice to get away with family the spaces was perfect for everyone to enjoy themselves the front desk check people were very nice

allReviews.title: Always as Expected
allReviews.text: It's always nice when you go to a place year after year that it's consistent.  The staff is always amazing,  They've kept the rooms upgraded and looking nice.  With the issues these days with staffing there has been some cleaning issues  but they always make it right.

allReviews.title: great place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Lots of parking and close to the South Point Hotel & casino yet away from the traffic on the strip. Convenient on and off ramp to the freeway makes for easy travel times. Staff is really friendly. Great resort choice for family vacation in LasVegas.

allReviews.title: DISAPPOINTMENT
allReviews.text: A little disappointed with the hotel, I have stayed many times and it is the first time that I have seen so many defects at the same time, from the drainage of the bathrooms in general, shower and sink, to the kitchen doors in poor condition and The lamps in the room were not working properly. I think they can improve since they are a very good option, but they have not received adequate maintenance.

allReviews.title: Their age is showing and nobody cares
allReviews.text: The size of the units were great but do not go here with kids, do not expect anything to work, and the staff just doesn't care. A 2 bedroom is 2 single units with no security or no access to both rooms. You would have to ask your young children to deadbolt themselves in and have no way to get to them. The washer was broken, the stove was broken, the dishwasher was full of water. We asked for a baking sheet and had 3 people walk into our room unannounced in 30 minutes and none brought the baking sheet. When they called later to confirm we got it, which we never did, they just laughed it off. We had 2 other occasions of staff just walking in our room when we were there so I can only imagine what happened when we were not there. We were asked daily to come and get our welcome gift, which was a presentation to buy there, typical time shares, but the rooms we were given would never entice us to buy. They were very rundown and dirty.We were very disappointed, definitely not what we expected for an RCI Gold crown resort.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay. Okay amenities
allReviews.text: Decent size unit for two people. Kind of weird having a tub in the bedroom that isn’t a jetted tub. Pools are shallow but nice. Don’t take them up on the “free buffet and gift card offer” unless you want to sit and eat the buffet with a timeshare representative. Buffet meal is okay but nothing to write home about. Overall nice stay.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas at it's best
allReviews.text: Have a great time with everything only a short walk from your room. The room itself is Exira large and up to date, the pool area is beautiful, and The South Point Casino Resort is steps away. .I highly recommend you check it out..

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: It's really nice to be able to check in 24/7. Our plane landed just after midnight and check in was quick and easy. The room had a view of the pool. The room was nice, spacious, and had a full kitchen

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: The Grandview at Las Vegas was a very nice resort, conveniently located next to where we were bowling. The check-in process was absolutely amazing and friendly. Every single time we called down for anything we had it within 20 minutes. Great service definitely would recommend

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: I love how you don't feel trap with limited space as you do in other hotels. This is basically an apartment. It's so quiet and spacious Would recommend especially with kidsAnd south point is cross the street with activities for the family like bowling and movie theater

allReviews.title: Comfy Stay
allReviews.text: Our favorite place to stay when coming to Vegas for our equine events. Located right next to South Point, we are within walking distance to the barn. We like having a “homey” place to say when staying in town for a week where we can prep meals if we want. Quieter for sleeping. And enjoy the large tub for salt baths after a long day of work and showing our horses!

allReviews.title: Fair
allReviews.text: Need more caring for the place and from the service. It used to be better than that. I had trouble with the key 3 times on the same day. Had to do 3 go and back to the front desk which is very far. At the 3rd time they sent me the security to make sure I was able to get in. I asked for compensation for all the trouble and get none.

allReviews.title: Resort is great but no shuttle to the Strip anymore
allReviews.text: One of the best resorts in Las Vegas. However, without a shuttle to the Strip, a rental car is now a must or be prepared to pay $ for taxi or ride share. The cost really adds up quickly. Staff is friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Kid Friendly for Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Grandview is a bit out of town but is a wonderful location to just have some family downtime. We would just travel to town and do our activities/shows for the day then retreat to our space here at the Grandview which was nice. Pools and hot tubs are great. There is one pool area just geared for smaller children which is a bonus. They also have on-site put putt golf. The "games" upstairs you had to pay for which was very disappointing since we were REQUIRED to pay a $50 resort activity fee. They need to do a better job at disclosing this. The service was slow. It seemed like there were always folks around but only specific people could help you. Always took a long time when going to the front desk.

allReviews.title: Close to the strip, but away from the hustle
allReviews.text: The Grandview is located south of the strip, within distance of a $15 Lyft ride. My husband and I used Lyft for 6 different trips downtown and feel we still saved $200 over a rental car. South Point is right across the street and provides 9 great restaurants, a movie theatre and a bowling alley. Plenty to do at this resort, even in the winter weather.

allReviews.title: Amazing Grandview at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I have been here numerous times and never been disappointed. Rooms are spacious and very clean. The staff and Manager go out of their way to assure your comfort. I love being away from the hustle of the strip but yet only a 10-minute drive to get there. I Will be staying here again and again.

allReviews.title: Family vacation
allReviews.text: Not enough amenities room was cold and did not have bed sheets was looking forward for hot tub jacuzzi but it has no indoor pool. Transportation was not available and not close to main attraction but overall good

allReviews.title: Average Stay
allReviews.text: Maintenance has certainly declined over the years and the rooms were missing lots of supplies and utensils. Drain issues all 8 days, sinks, washers, etc...  Sink disposal not working and suds galore when someone else did their laundry and the foam of suds blanketed our laundry area into the kitchen.  Unmade bed upon our arrival with linens stacked everywhere, weren't sure if it was clean or not...???  Always loved this resort in the past, unit sizes, convenience of the casino, etc...  Not overly impressed this time and would definitely consider other resorts next time.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great place people where friendly, service was easy if you needed something they brough it up on a timely manner. Would stay here again without a doubt. Smoke free great for families. Pools were clean

allReviews.title: Outstanding!!
allReviews.text: This is a very nice resort, with many amenities.  We booked through RCI because we had a few remaining points.  We were a single bedroom unit, and very pleased with the unit.  It had everything we needed (could use a pizza pan).  We loved that it is off the strip, as were here to do outdoor activities in the surrounding areas (Zion, Valley of Fire, Red Rock Canyon, etc.). The Southpoint Casino is amazing and has many activities as well.  We would definitely come again and highly recommended to couples and families.

allReviews.title: Convenient Vegas timeshare
allReviews.text: Resort is 5 miles South of the main Strip area so it is easy to get around without the congestion of the Strip but close enough if you want to go there. Right next door to South Pointe casino with several dining options, movies and bowling.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: I was very happy with the resort, check in and check out was very fast. The resort was clean and very quiet for the size of the resort. Close to restaurants, casinos. I would definitely go back the next time I am in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Enjoyable and comfortable
allReviews.text: I travel with my son and our expectations were exceed. The only small inconvenience is the location relative to the Las Vegas strip. However the value of the property offsets this. I would recommend this property to friends and family.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
allReviews.text: This is our repeat stay at Grandview Las Vegas. Like the location. Staff polite and helpful. Apartment large and well equipped (albeit this time a few equipment and utensils not working properly but quickly replaced) Would have preferred TV offers more programs

allReviews.title: Good property but staff issues
allReviews.text: Good property. Needs some updating. Staff unconcerned if you get hurt. They are only worried about covering themselves and not about the customer. I fell due to a sidewalk that was uneven due to tree roots. It was a bad fall and I was bleeding. They were more worried about taking a report than helping with the injuries. I have owned here for several years and am very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Great family location
allReviews.text: Great place to stay, very safe and offers many amenities and services. Southpoint Casino next door with huge casino, kid friendly, great entertainment and events thru out the year as well good variety of restaurants.

allReviews.title: poor upkeep for those high maintenance fees.   every room i had, had something wrong
allReviews.text: dirty rooms sheets on my bed had been slept on and had sec stains. then they changed it with sheets filled with lint balls.  One room had bowl in the toliet, one room stove was cracked.  another room wash machine was broke missing pans(they did bring new ones) our complaints were answered but it should never be that many.  Why pay high maintenance fees if the property is not kept up

allReviews.title: Relaxing getaway during Super Bowl Week
allReviews.text: We love staying at the Grandview! Close enough to the action, while being far enough away to partake in some tranquility. South Point right across the street with any amenity you could need! Can't wait for our next trip!

allReviews.title: Mixed Review
allReviews.text: I've visited this resort over the last decade several times and have been extremely satisfied. I question the advantage of being a Platinum member.  I reserved a 2 unit early 2023 for Super Bowl weekend. For the first time, I was not happy with my unit in Bldg. 6, unit 1208-B. The A unit was fine.  My B unit had a horrible smell and every drawer and cabinet was open.  The sofa bed was partially pulled and the pillows were on the chair.  The silverware was spread out on the counter in the kitchen area.  I called the front desk and was moved to the 21st floor. Upon checking in I was told my unit had already been picked for me.  A staff member told me that as a Platinum member, I should have been in Bldg. 5. As a Platinum I hope to get privileges since I pay for this status. I think it's time the units get a facelift. My 1 star cleanliness review below is based on the first unit with the odor... The room I was moved to on the 21st floor was clean and did not have an odor.

allReviews.title: resort vacation at the Grandview at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Resort rooms and facilities staff were wonderful The resort representatives were very helpful, courterous, and welcoming as well as efficiently dealing with any requests of them. wonderful time at the Grand View.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: Great service and amazing front desk. Really helpful and quick response. I love their fast service and they were very attentive to any issue that came along during my vacation time with them. Truly recommend

allReviews.title: Always a great stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed at The Grandview many times. It is conveniently located off of the Strip. The resort is beautiful, the rooms are comfortable and the staff are friendly. Definitely one of our favorite stays when we visit Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent resort
allReviews.text: We have been to the Grandview many times.  It is our favorite in Vegas.   It is very easy to find the dates and units we want.  Very nice accommodations and very convenient location.   Washer and dryer in the room and the full kitchen are nice.

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay
allReviews.text: Frequent Visitor.  Love the location near the airport m, casino in walking distance. Great for a group of 8 comfortably. Love the adjoining rooms. Set up for the Perfect fo Privacy. Looking forward to next time.

allReviews.title: Better Upkeep and Cleaning Needed
allReviews.text: Could be a beautiful resort except for roaches, below average cleaning, slow bathroom sink drains, However, the desk/management are very responsive to the myriad of problems.  We were move to a suite that was roach-free although cleanliness issues persisted (dirty bed linen, spare linen had not been exchanged after last guests, floor not cleaned until requested, slow drains that had to be plunged)

allReviews.title: Dirty, dusty, noisy…
allReviews.text: I am writing this review to express my disappointment with the recent experience I had during my stay at this hotel. As a seasoned traveler who spends approximately 20 weeks per year on the road, cleanliness and tranquility are essential aspects of accommodation for me.Upon arrival, I was dismayed to find that the room assigned to me was completely dirty and dusty. Furthermore, both the garbage disposal and the dishwasher were inoperable, necessitating a room change which did not happened. While I appreciate the swift resolution to this issue the initial state of the room was unacceptable and not reflective of the standards I expect from this establishment.In addition to the cleanliness concerns, I also experienced a significant disturbance during my stay due to loud machinery noises emanating from the floor above. When I brought this to the attention of the staff, I was informed that there was nothing that could be done, and I would have to endure the disturbance.As a loyal customer, I must emphasize that cleanliness and a peaceful environment are non-negotiable aspects of my stay. While I understand that maintenance issues may arise, it is crucial that steps are taken to mitigate disturbances and ensure a comfortable experience for guests.

allReviews.title: I would not go back…
allReviews.text: I used to come to this place a lot, it was a great economical option in Las Vegas, unfortunately on this occasion they gave us a very old and very dirty room. The staff was friendly and tried to help, however, the cleanliness of the place was definitely unacceptable and they couldn't be bothered to want to do it again.The dishwasher was not working and had to be completely replaced, the food grinder was not working either, in addition, all the time we could hear a noise coming from above and they told us that they could not do anything about this because they were machines that were on the floor highest of the building. Frankly I wouldn't return to this place. I know it is not a luxury place but cleanliness is non-negotiable.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel for a great price
allReviews.text: This hotel was my selection for my son's college graduation present. He wanted to visit Los Vegas and the Grandview didn't disappoint, the trip was great because of the care and attention of the staff and management. The room was very pleasant and comfortable. We had a 2 bedroom room and it was very nice and clean. This hotel is on the South end of the strip but worth the stay. Would highly recommend for families and couples. And last but not least, this hotel is next to the South Point Hotel and Casino. This casino is by far a hidden gem in Los Vegas it's clean, nice, and the staff was pleasant and professional.

allReviews.title: Clean, comfortable, relaxing
allReviews.text: We are repeat vacationers at Grandview. The units are spacious, we like the shuttle to Walmart, numerous pools with an amazing casino across the street (Southpoint) with several awesome restaurants, buffet, bowling alley, movie theatre, equestrian arena.  Other eateries within easy walking distance, buses to strip, outlet mall.

allReviews.title: A bit disappointed
allReviews.text: As owners at The Grandview we were very much looking forward to this stay. We were delayed due to a change in flight times and I have to firstly say that when I called to let them know the lady I spoke with was really helpful and lovely. Checkin was good, however when we got to our unit ( in building 5) when we opened the door we found an employee sitting on the couch watching TV. He quickly removed food from out of the fridge and exited. We have not visited for quite a few years now but noticed quite a decline in amenities. No paper towel, only one roll of toilet paper etc. it was also very obvious that the floor needed vacuuming, desperately. We found used soap in the shower stall, as well as a dried kitchen towel. We were in unit A, my sister and her hubby were in unit B. They found that the garbage bin in the kitchen had not been emptied and was stinking up the area, they took this to the garbage chute immediately. When they went to bed they found an empty carton of coconut water plus numerous empty candy packets under the bed. Quite disappointing to see the decline in standards and services when owner fees keep rising.

allReviews.title: Very Enjoyable Stay
allReviews.text: The Grandview in Las Vegas had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay.  The fully equipped kitchen allowed us to save money eating in.  We felt safer away from the strip a little ways, but were still able to travel there easily.

allReviews.title: excellent!
allReviews.text: Everything was very good, at a good price!!!, the hotel is well equipped, its areas clean, the room complete, the reception was fast, in general everything was very good and its prices are also very good.

allReviews.title: Relaxing Stay
allReviews.text: It was a very nice relaxing stay. It was clean everyone was very professional friendly and accommodating. Great staff shuttle driver Jerome was very informative and such an amazing personality. I enjoyed the crab & shrimp salad from the Oyster Bar Restaurant

allReviews.title: Cleanliness
allReviews.text: Yards/grounds cleanliness are well maintained and lighted. It is the inside that we noticed a problem. A small dog peed on the carpet. Owner did not even bother to clean and just looked around then left.

allReviews.title: Mecum motorcycle auction.
allReviews.text: Myself and friends were attending the Mecum motorcycle auction at Southpoint Resort and Casino across the street.  Perfect location.  We have done this three times and have had very trouble free stays.  We will be back.

allReviews.title: Pleasure
allReviews.text: The unit we rented was appointed well but needed attention to detail.  We had an issue with water pressure and water temperature in the shower, issue was taken care of but not until  management was involved.

allReviews.title: Great Service
allReviews.text: excellent location and service.  we didn't stay the full 7 days because other scheduled events but the time we were there was fabulous. We also got a chance to see the new improvement to the units and the customer service was top shelf.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Great place to stay, close to South Point with plenty to do even with children and great places to eat nearby. Walking distance to many places plus pools, gym, bbq grills and mini golf course. This was my first to this resort.

allReviews.title: grandview
allReviews.text: We stay at Grandview several times a year! Always enjoy it! Quick check in, nice rooms with washer and dryer, good parking. Next door to South Point casino which has lots of fun slots and keno and video poker.

allReviews.title: Home Office
allReviews.text: perfect trip - used the resort as home office - worked during the day, played at nightroom was clean.   it was close to the strip and Red Rock Canyon   Staff were very friendly and professional   I will return

allReviews.title: Stay at the Grandview
allReviews.text: The Grandview is very convinient property to stay at if you like to gamble.  Unlike other timeshares in Vegas, you have to get in your car and/or walk a distance to get to a casino.  The Grandview is also located close to family so this is our timeshare of choice when traveling to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Good stay but intrusive housekeeping
allReviews.text: Had a good stay but be sure to keep the latch on your door on checkout day. Housekeeping will try to get into your room before checkout time and you may be surprised. They knocked, waited 3 seconds, then tried to barge in to clean the room.

allReviews.title: Stay at the Grandview Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Overall very nice accommodations. The mattress needs to be replaced, isn’t comfortable at all. Even though there is a sign asking not to use the jacuzzi tub after 8:00 pm, some occupants decide to use it at midnight; it is extremely loud!

allReviews.title: Grandview Las Vegas Getaway
allReviews.text: Needed a room close to South Point Plaza, this was right next door.  Room was great, price was awesome. Loved having two separate suites. Would recommend bringing your own pillow, theirs were not comfortable!

allReviews.title: Wonderful place to stay away.
allReviews.text: They have Spacious rooms with a great view of the surrounding areas. Convenient as amenities are just a walk away. Clean facilities and courteous staff. Reasonable cost for the quality of facilities. We will choose to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Home away from home.
allReviews.text: I've stayed here many times with my family. I love the size of the unit! My boys are young men now so we booked a second unit. It was so nice to have separate spaces for music and watching shows. We love all the amenities. My personal favorite is the large tub to soak in everyday! Being next to Southpoint is great too! We will be back soon!

allReviews.title: Timeshare at Grandview
allReviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom adjoining unit as part of our timeshare exchange. Amenities were basic in line with a 3 star property. We had a few problems like non- working safe, torn curtain, and missing kitchen items but nothing too big. Overall a fine family vacation location, best when you can use the outdoor pools.

allReviews.title: Always our go to resort
allReviews.text: I have been using this resort yearly for the last 8 years.  I love that it's off strip but right next to South Pointe where you have access to casino, restaurants, movie theater, bowling, bingo......We literally never go to the strip.  We always get a 2 bedroom and it works for us but it is two 1 bedroom units connected with a small foyer so it's very private and you get two living spaces.  If you have young children however, it may not work for you. The units are always clean and stocked, however this is the first year we had no towels in one bathroom and no bedding for the sofa couch in either unit.  We called housekeeping and it was taken care of in a reasonable amount of time.

allReviews.title: GREAT PLACE
allReviews.text: UPON ENTERING THE ROOM I NOTICED THE APPLIANCES, AND FURNITURE, TV'S, ETC ETC. WERE ALL OLDER. i MUST GIVE CREDIT TO THE RESORT, AND THEIR CLEANING STAFF! The room was immaculate, The appliances were immaculate. Only place I could find any dust was on the blinds.We did not realize a two bedromm unit is actually two separate fully equipped apartments. When you enter, there is a small hallway which acesses A an B units. Both units have a bedroom, and sofa beds in the living room.We will definatly be back next time in Vegas. THANKS GRANDVIEW

allReviews.title: Fallen in cleanliness and maintenance
allReviews.text: Stains on the couch, orange peels under the front of the couch, dishwasher installed not level and leaking. Maintenance and house keeping needs a complete overhaul. This is our 3rd stay over the years and very disappointed the units are not being kept up.

allReviews.title: Dirty Room
allReviews.text: After traveling 12 hours, we checked into the Grandview at 2:00 am, and went to bed immediately. When we woke we found that we had slept in DIRTY bedding (Long hair on the sheets; Dried Body Fluids on the sheets and night stand next to the bed). There was also no Iron in the room, the coffee pot was dirty, the stove was missing one of the burner dials.  When we told the Manager On Duty they did send someone to clean the room. Bedding was changed, two (2) new irons were delivered, dial was replaced on the stove, and a new coffee pot was delivered. The "Body Fluids" on the nightstand were not cleaned. A second complaint was filed with the Manager On Duty. Again the nightstand was not cleaned.

allReviews.title: Vacation Stay At The Grandview at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I highly recommend this resort for a number of reasons:  it is right on Las Vegas Blvd;  close to the strip casinos; their is a casino within walking distance of the resort; and all services and service staff at the resort are excellent.

allReviews.title: Before new year trip
allReviews.text: we stayed here in End of December.   Grounds and pool were nice.  heated pools were nice in December.    Condo do show the age but were clean and well maintained.   would stay here again.   has a large tub in master bedroom.  Bath room has shower that is sep.    carpet older but clean    Southpoint is just accross the street short walk.

allReviews.title: Great Property
allReviews.text: Came in early for a work trip with two co-worker friends and we used my timeshare. This property was a very convenient location and great property. Staff very friendly and glad we chose this property.

allReviews.title: Building outdated
allReviews.text: Staff were very friendly and quick to resolve any issue. Disappointed with having to call for support to use the dishwasher. Our kids joined us on second day and there was no bedding for pull out couch.

allReviews.title: RECOMMENDABLE
allReviews.text: Very friendly staff when checking in, they looked for someone to assist us in Spanish. Very clear instructions and regulations. comfortable, clean rooms. well equipped kitchen. We had other very pleasant guests. We will stay at this development again. thank you.

allReviews.title: Worst Vacation Stay Ever! Never again will me, my family or friends will consider staying at the Grandview resort.
allReviews.text: Worst Vacation Stay Ever! Never again will me, my family or friends will consider staying at the Grandview resort.

allReviews.title: We love Grandview
allReviews.text: We had a great stay wouldn’t having any other way. Grandview has become our second home when we visit Vegas. Looking forward to many more trips with the family on future vacations. Very peaceful and relaxing

allReviews.title: Best time ever
allReviews.text: The overall condition of the property was nice, the close proximity of other entertainment. I will more than happy to encourage family and friends to join RCI. I've been a member for over four years now and I think it was well worth investing in the program.

allReviews.title: Fabulous!
allReviews.text: The Grandview has been a wonderful place for us while in Las Vegas.  We have served 4-5 rooms at one time, several times this year, for family gatherings.  The children love the “Kiddy Pool”, and my adult children love the quietness of the environment.  We stay at The Grandview at least 4 times a year.  It is clean, the personnel are kind, and we always look forward to coming back.

allReviews.title: The Grandview Resort
allReviews.text: Always like staying with the Grandview.  The apartment units are great at the Grandview Resort.  Their daily shuttle to the grocery store is wonderful and the customer service is always courteous and welcoming.  Definitely recommended stay

allReviews.title: Not the resort I remember
allReviews.text: The resort used to smell clean. Cleanliness is lacking. Dishes were dirty & pots were greasy. Stains on the woodwork and walls. Pot smoking was prevalent everywhere outside. Not enough handicapped sp.

allReviews.title: We're coming back!
allReviews.text: They accommodated us with our four rooms and whatever we needed they brought to us in a timely manner. Loved the rooms and accessibility. My mother in law needed her service dog which was not a problem for this hotel and it had disability access!

allReviews.title: Great New Year's Eve trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: We had a great time at the GV LV.  Stayed for 5 days over NYE.  Had 2 units connected by a small entryway.  The staff was great and the units are very clean and well stocked.  Having Southpoint next door was a huge bonus!  You can walk over for a very reasonably priced meal and gift shop that sold inexpensive alcohol.  Be sure to buy there and not at a liquor store on the way from the airport like we did.  The only drawback was the Ubers back and forth from the strip - very pricey during the holiday but not a reason not to stay again.  Highly recommend the Grandview.

allReviews.title: Home away from home.
allReviews.text: Took a short vacation and the staff here did a great job at making me and my family like we are at home. If we had any issues which we did, the staff quickly addressed it. Love this resort and it's location next to South Point.

allReviews.title: I really recommend it!
allReviews.text: I really like everything, I have no complaints, you have everything to cook, they give you ride to Walmart, the soutpoint casino it’s next door, is 10 min drive to the strip, checkout and checkin was super fast!

allReviews.title: great place
allReviews.text: Grandview is the best place to stay, overall clean! Had great time with friends.  everything is close to the property. you can just walk to Southpoint to have fun! a lot of parking space and free parking!!!

allReviews.title: fun New Year’s stay
allReviews.text: We  always love the Grandview- the rooms are beautiful and spacious with just about everything that we could need in the room.  anything extra we did need or any maintenance issues were handled very promptly with just a call to the desk. My sons room needed a new fridge as it was not getting very cold and they immediately brought him a new one up. we also asked for cookie sheets, and they were brought up immediately. We own a week at a sister resort in Florida  and never get the service or accommodations that we get here at the Grandview

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: This was a Christmas family trip. I made an error and had my days mixed up. I was a day early, but the staff was very accommodating. I was able to have my rooms (A and B) a day early and not have to move from my units. The office staff is very friendly and helpful. Finding the unit was easy, parking was plentiful, and it was very clean. The unit itself was very clean, and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.  We were out and about most of the time, so we did not use any of the amenities they offered. But we did see people enjoying themselves at the pool, jacuzzi, and playing mini golf. This property is about 25 mins from the strip and the outlet mall is on the main same street. There are plenty of restaurants in the area as wellMy only complaint is that, for the most part, the unit is soundproof, but if someone turned on their tub faucet from an adjacent unit, it was very loud! I was awakened around 12 am by the gushing sound of water in the pipes. It was so loud it startled me! Half of my family stayed in the other unit and complained of the same noise. Overall, our stay was great. I do recommend this property to others.

allReviews.title: ok
allReviews.text: Other than both bathroom sinks being clogged up plus very few cooking utensils we enjoyed the stay and will return here again.  Easy to get around or just relax. we found this location & the amenities to fit all our needs.

allReviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Accessible and very good accommodations for our family get-together. Excellent place to stay, close to shops, and dining facilities. Rooms are nice and clean. We will continue to stay at Grandview for our vacation trips to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Happy with The Grandview at Las Vegas resort
allReviews.text: We loved the double rooms for our family holiday gathering.  Plenty of space and freedom in the rooms.  Our only complaint were the family in the adjoining room that did not control their children at night.  The screaming and banging of furniture in the late night period was terrible.  We believe the parents went to the casino next door leaving the elder child in charge.  It was bad!

allReviews.title: Best value and great accommodations
allReviews.text: Luv the full kitchen and separate tub. No parking fee too. Best value. Luv being next to southpoint with casino, movie theater, bowling alley. Highly recommend.  Great for families. Don't forget the coupon book too

allReviews.title: Christmas vacation
allReviews.text: We were greeted by Santa clause when checking in very nice.the casino next door was very convenient as to there was lots of family things to do there movies ,bowling , the buffet had plenty of variety for everyone's taste.

allReviews.title: Great location just minutes from the strip
allReviews.text: Minutes away from shopping, restaurants and any thing you need for a great vacation to Las Vegas. There is a casino right next door. Units have everything you need. Washer and dryer, bbq grills pools and a great staff.

allReviews.title: Grandview
allReviews.text: Not to bad other than they couldn't find me a god view. overall I would say good. Everything else is just as they advertise. I can't complain. It's our 2nd time staying there. Its on the south side so its like 10 min from strip

allReviews.title: Christmas 2023
allReviews.text: The mattresses were wonderful. Everyone in our group enjoyed them. We would definitely stay at this resort again. I’m so glad we gave them a try. The units were split into 1 bedroom apartments with a single common entrance and a separate door to each bedroom. The setup was idea for relatives and friends because of the privacy it allowed.

allReviews.title: Lame
allReviews.text: We'd stayed at the property previously in 2017, which was a very enjoyable experience. Our return visit in December 2023, however, was vastly different and disappointing. First, both beds were horribly uncomfortable, with the springs sunken and worn out. After complaining, the hotel's solution was to rotate the mattresses, which of course did nothing. Second, our room was scheduled to be cleaned once a week during our stay, but someone came only after we'd called multiple times and waited several days. Third, the heating systems was terribly noisy, making enough racket to wake us up every 20-30 minutes throughout the night.We ended up checking out four days early, eating that cost, and they didn't even inquire as to why we were leaving, so we figured they knew it had been a lousy stay.

allReviews.title: National Finals Rodeo
allReviews.text: Lovely suites to stay with Friends and Family.  We go every year!  Love the location next to South Point Casino.  Great place to take Children as there are pools, fitness center, barbeque and picnic areas.

allReviews.title: Good for what it is
allReviews.text: Not super fancy but gets the job done. Lots of room. Washer and dryerIs a huge plus. Elevator was out of service. Other than that no other complaints really. Come here every time we go to Vegas. Always quiet

allReviews.title: Prepare to Hunt for Parking Each Night & Hike to Amenities
allReviews.text: Returning to resort after 8 pm you might not find a parking spot anywhere near the door to the high rise buildings.    Maintenance carts take up  3-5 spots at each building.  Walking to amenities in cold weather is not inviting. Why not have a scheduled shuttle pickup/dropoff to/from each building from 8 am to 8 pm.?

allReviews.title: If I already am an owner, why waste my time and yours by trying to upsell?
allReviews.text: I come to my timeshare for a relaxing vacation, not to be hounded and pressured by pushy sales folks.I had friends with me, one who was disabled, and no accommodations were made for her disability.  We couldn't even find handicapped parking 90% of the time and it was hard for her. I specifically wanted to be near the parking structure for that purpose, but was told no.

allReviews.title: BOSWELL AKA BOSS
allReviews.text: I love this place and its a outstanding experience! I tell people about this place often and always meet good people here. I would love to thank the staff of doing a great job at this resort area and love the Southpoint casino next to the Grandview resort.

allReviews.title: Great property and location
allReviews.text: We had 2 bedroom unit which is in fact two one bedroom units. So you have alot of room with not only two bedrooms/bathrooms but also two living rooms and kitchens. Dishes, beds and linens were great ....however I did have an one issue. Although counter tops, appliances and bathroom sinks/showers were clean, the cabinets, walls and floors needed a very good cleaning. Lots of water and dirt splashes on walls plus the floor needed vacuuming in the corners, behind and under the doors and furniture plus a deep cleaning of the tiles/grout. Think a light and quick mopping must be the norm....so maybe management should have someone inspecting more closely and regularly the cleanliness of the units.

allReviews.title: The Grandview at Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The resort is located next door to the Southpoint Casino which makes the location great. Also two minutes from the freeway and new restaurants just across the street. Just 10 minutes from the strip. Only complaint is very few handicap parking, considering many older people visit the resort.

allReviews.title: What a welcome
allReviews.text: Arriving for a peaceful vacation, only to be greeted by the need to search for towels and toilet paper, was quite disappointing. Upon entering, I found all the cabinets and drawers open, and the bed pulled out, which was not an ideal welcome.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Staying at the Grandview at Las Vegas was beautiful. The rooms are spacious. The views are beautiful. The staff are courteous and professional. My friend and I enjoyed our vacation at the Grandview. We plan to come back soon.

allReviews.title: AWESOME PLACE but FILTHY
allReviews.text: Appliance did not work, but replaced it Very quickly.Rooms are large ,Did not use any of the facilities but I'm sure were nice.Traveled with another couple so the 2 walk out rooms were wonderful.We traveled for the National Finals Rodeo and it's close to the South Point Casino so it was awesome to be able to walk from there back to our room.

allReviews.title: Family stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed here at least 6 times. Usually satisfied, great location to SouthPoint Hotel/ Casino. We will stay here again. We did not have all the supplies in the unit this time, but usually well supplied. It had just been a rodeo event next door, very busy.

allReviews.title: Fam Xmas 2023
allReviews.text: This resort used to be a really good one. We are saddened that the quality has gone south. Some of the appliances do not work. Beddings are missing. Utensils and plates are not properly washed and dirty. The gym needs new equipments. The exercise balls and mats need cleaning or better yet - replaced.

allReviews.title: Pleasant GetAway
allReviews.text: Great location. Best value for your money.  Spacious suites with all the amenities for a week stay, like having your home away from home.  Responsive staff and well mannered service providers.  Feel very secured staying here.

allReviews.title: Wonderful as always except....
allReviews.text: Love the Grand View. It is an amazing place. The units are awesome. I love that South Point is next door. The problem? Cleanliness this time. It just needed a deep clean. Spots on the walls, the toilet seat was not clean, counters, light switches, doorknobs. The washer and dryer were gross!  The dust, the blinds were thick with dust. Corners, vents, it needed cleaning! I happened to have Clorox wipes so wiped a lot of things off, but this was the first time we have stayed and it was not super clean!

allReviews.title: Get away
allReviews.text: Room was not completely cleaned when we arrived. Toilet not cleaned, floors and counters still dirty. Carpets not vacuumed. Units counter top edge broken off, door damaged in bathroom. Carpet in bedroom worn out. Windows very dirty. Was not impressed.Pool staff very rude.

allReviews.title: NFR Fun at Grandview
allReviews.text: Had another great stay at Grandview during National Finals Rodeo. Have stayed there several times for rodeo. Free shuttle bus to rodeo at Thomas Mack arena. Grandview is located next to South Point which is now the rodeo headquarters. The 2 bedroom units are unique because they are 2 separate 1 bedroom units. This makes it nice when there are two couples. Big thank you to Patrick the night manager. He assisted in getting me to our unit after I had an injury at South Point. Hope the midweek room cleaning will be started again. Only available with stays of 9 nights or longer. Hubby and I had an itchy rash from the sheets. Probably the detergent used. Also bring salt, pepper, and any seasoning if you plan to cook. Still the best place to stay during rodeo.

allReviews.title: Annual Stay
allReviews.text: As always during the NFR The Grandview is a very busy place. We book our  units and found everything very satifactoey. There was only 1 elevator working in the Sage building, which did cause some delays.

allReviews.title: NFR
allReviews.text: We go every year to the national rodeo and team roping. The resort has everything you need or want for a vacation you can cook in the room bbq on the grills, kids can swim in the multiple pools and relax in the spas, very safe for the family. It also has a casino in walking distance that hosts different types of things in there arena many are free. They have great restaurants and activities for kids also.

allReviews.title: Not Keeping Units Up to Speed
allReviews.text: Well, at least this time we didn't spend an hour while the check in counter located our Reservation which seems to be a problem every year..  Our Security Door at Building was broke and open the whole time of our trip So much for Security.... Units are needing work and things always seems to be missing out of units ... IE  Light Bulbs burned out - no extra bedding for pull outs - Carpet is Worn.

allReviews.title: Needs a deep clean
allReviews.text: I love the Grandview and South point. I was VERY DISAPPOINTED in the cleanliness of the rooms this time at the Grand view. DUST, HAIR, YUCK on the walls.  It is time for some super deep cleaning. I opened the blinds and they were covered in thick dust.  I was glad I had chlorox wipes. I pretty much wiped down everything .  The chlorox wipe was dirty when I was done. GROSS!  Yes, I will return but hopefully some cleaning will take place.

allReviews.title: Lovely Resort in Vegas!
allReviews.text: This place is an excellent place to stay and keep your peace! Feels and looks like luxury, the casino next door, South Point is one of my favorites! Overall super clean and friendly. The kitchen is my favorite part for when get left with leftovers from restaurants and can save you a ton of money while traveling with friends and family.

allReviews.title: The sheets smelt clean
allReviews.text: It's rare to go to a hotel and resort, climb in the bed and smell the sheets and they actually smell like soap. It was comforting to know that the sheets were truly clean. Even with rumors of other hotels and their poor practices of not cleaning rooms, properly towels and sheets and blankets etc. Dust was very minimal and everything we needed was available. There was even room service available at this property which is rare for this type of resort. I would definitely recommend and stay here again if in Vegas. Located on the Las Vegas strip but not in the center of it all so it's pretty easy to access the major strip hotels in casinos without having to be in all of the traffic. Plenty of parking if you're renting a car and within 10 minutes of the airport.

allReviews.title: SOSO
allReviews.text: Unit very uncomfortable. Bring your own pillows they only have small square pillows but a lot of them which does not help.  there is nowhere to really rest the couch is very uncomfortable and no place to put legs up.

allReviews.title: family reunion
allReviews.text: Great unit layout. Resort proximity to South Point casino restaurants is a benefit (if you can tolerate the smoke in the casino). Floors and shower were not as clean as we would have expected. Great value.

allReviews.title: NFR Vacation stay
allReviews.text: Great location, right across from Southpoint Casino, access to shuttle service. Easy accessto anywhere..lots of parking..staff at Grandview are extremely friendly and units are clean.  Checking in and out is a breeze...recommend staying short or long term

allReviews.title: Great location off Las Vegas strip
allReviews.text: PROS…If you don’t want to be in the frenzy of the Las Vegas strip this resort location works.  Love that South Point casino is just next door.  It has shows, restaurants, bowling, movies and rodeo arena. CONS…I have chosen this resort several times, and I’ve always been pleased. However, this time I feel the resort standards have changed. I was disappointed and how tired the furniture looked, it needs an update.  The cleanliness of the room was also disappointing.

allReviews.title: Always Enjoy our Stay
allReviews.text: We have been enjoying our stay at The Grandview at Las Vegas for many years and hopefully for many years to come. The Casino (South Point) next door is close and there are many amenities. Thanks for all the good memories.

allReviews.title: Excellent resort with quality service
allReviews.text: Silverton is a great resort with a cute western theme carried right into the room!! Excellent steakhouse there and value is far better than on the strip!!!

allReviews.title: 14 years and counting
allReviews.text: This is my 14th year in a row (Minus Covid years of course) The bed and the pillows are the best I have ever encountered. Housekeeping staff fast and efficient. Reception always smiling even when they are busy. Spent countless hours in front of the aquarium watching. Bass Pro is always a great place for Xmas shoppingBest place in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: This resort is amazing, it’s our new favorite please when we visit Vegas.  There piña colada  and strawberry daiquiris are out of this world best in Vegas

allReviews.title: Great place to stay and play.
allReviews.text: Checking in early at 1000am as a room was avaliable on the 2nd floor near the elevator was a great start to our stay at the Silverton.   The clerk was very nice and accommodating. The room was nice and comfortable. The food at all the restaurants were plentiful and scrumptious. Most of all the casino play was wonderful. As usual there were ups and downs. My daughter won an 11K jackpot a day before checkout on a slot machine. I have stayed here many times and can say that 'this is a good place to stay'.

allReviews.title: Another Amazing Visit at Silverton
allReviews.text: Thirty five years ago my husband and I were married at the Little White Wedding Chapel in Vegas, needless to say Vegas is our jam (4 hour drive!) Our three children have spent their 21st birthdays in Vegas, we have celebrated many things in Vegas...until the last few years. Vegas   has become way too expensive, every little thing that used to set Vegas apart now costs you. BUT THEN...we saw an offer for Silverton and decided to try it, nope it's not on the strip or downtown BUT that's the best part!! Rooms are large and beautifully decorated, parking is free (YES, even valet) their casino is fully stocked with all games...$5 craps and blackjack and all popular slots! Their pool has been completely renovated and is heated and designed for an all day stay poolside. Their restaurants are delicious (Mexican, steakhouse, sushi bar, diner, a REAL Starbucks (order ahead, use points, earn points) and a small type food court. Cocktail servers are friendly and plentiful - yep, free drinks while playing! Paying cash for a drink is totally reasonable and far less than the strip. Check in process is easy and WOW the employees actually behave as if they want to be at work and are genuinely happy to help you! While our last visit was just a couple of weeks ago, one name remains in my mind...Mai at the check in desk was WONDERFUL! Her smile, friendliness and jokester attitude absolutely set our three day visit up for a good time...Silverton did not disappoint.  Thank you again Mai and Silverton, see you soon! **One final tip, catching an Uber to the strip or downtown will run you between $20-30 dollars, with all of the money we save by staying at Silverton it more than pays for the rides.

allReviews.title: Professional staff, comfortable room, and a tranquil stay
allReviews.text: This hotel was a fantastic place to stay while in town on business. From the moment I entered the lobby, I was warmly welcomed by the hotel staff, and the check-in process went very smoothly. My room was warm, spacious, and very comfortable (the bed was the perfect balance between soft and not too squishy). I loved that the room had complimentary K-cups available; they came in handy when I had to wake up early for meetings. I especially appreciated that this hotel isn't on the Strip, so I got to avoid the chaos and have a more tranquil stay.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Experience at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.
allReviews.text: We had a fantastic experience at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  We stayed in a Suite, which was absolutely great, spacious, clean and very comfortable. We had a beautiful view of the pool and hot tub. Special thanks to Casino Host Fe'adolphus Curt for helping with this stay. Check in was swift and Mie, as well as Belinda, both Registration staff, placed us in a Suite, and our luggage soon followed. The suite was very much like three separate rooms between the bedroom, living area and breakfast nook, and the bathroom, complete with separate large shower area, a huge bathtub, and his and her bathroom sinks. Having this much space definitely helps a couple to relax. Two large screen television sets were mounted on the walls in the bedroom and living room.Of course the casino action was fun, and we did well. We are both player's club members, and there are a lot of perks that come along with that. We also visited the Su' Casa, and Sun dance Restaurants.  Needless to say the food and service was quite good.We have been visiting the Silverton often, mainly because it is off the strip, and not as hectic as strip locations. I use a walking cane, and accommodations for senior citizens we find refreshing. However, there are quite a handful of younger couples who stay there too, most likely because of the BassPro Shop entrance and the largest fish aquarium is located in the Casino, and there are mermaids that put on a nice show for little ones.Mike and Ester

allReviews.title: Great atmosphere, Great staff & fun gambling!
allReviews.text: The Silverton is our go to location when in Las Vegas. We love the lodge atmosphere, food & drink options & great staff! The rooms have been recently renovated and they are awesome. The king bed was super comfortable and we enjoyed Starbucks coffee each morning from the in-room provided  K-cup machine, and REAL coffee cups! I realize that coffee may not be a real important point to some, but when it is your 1st NEEDED ritual of the day, well you get the point, LOL. The rooms look great with that western lodge theme throughout. The staff at the Silverton have always made our stays much more enjoyable. We have always been treated with a smile and great service. We even had a casino host stop in to say hi and ask if we needed anything while the wife and I were playing video poker and enjoying some specialty cocktails at the Shady Grove Lounge. On our most recent trip we even took some time to relax in the newly renovate pool area. Jumped in the jacuzzi and pool, picked up a burger and fries from Johnny Rockets (located inside the casino) and enjoyed a little wine-down time by the fire pit. Was neat to see the aquarium decked out for Halloween and we always enjoy a stroll through the attached Bass Pro Shop to see what we didn't know we needed. We always enjoy our stays at the Silverton!

allReviews.title: Best of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Awesome experience all around (hotel/casino/dining). Staff was friendly and treated us like family. Cant wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Highly recommended
allReviews.text: Silverton hotel offers a superior personalized experience, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay. I will remain a loyal guest, impressed by the staff's professionalism, spotless rooms, and dedication to excellence

allReviews.title: Always pleasant stay!
allReviews.text: I really enjoy studying here. If you just stopping by and want to avoid the traffic and chaos the strip brings. This is the place, clean and newer hotel and rooms. Service is always great from the valet, to casino staff to cocktail waitress, etc.

allReviews.title: A Friendly Place, The Silverton Casino and Hotel.
allReviews.text: My wife and I were stranded, looking for a place to stay for the night and the first thing that came to mind was the Silverton Casino and Hotel.  I never stayed there before, but I frequented their establishment many times.  When I phoned their reservations desk, I was greeted by a female by the name of Christie.  She was so gracious and showed a great deal of concern with our dilemma.  After finding out that we were from Hawaii our conversation became more cordial.  She said she lived in Hawaii too.  She set us up with a room and to our surprise it was immaculate and very elegant looking.  Everything you could ever want in a room was provided, neat, clean and in it's right place.  The next day we went to eat at the cafe and the food was great.  Next, we were sitting in the casino and the security guard walked up and talked to us.  His name was Ron and he too was from Hawaii.  The atmosphere at Silverton is like no other, with the large aquarium, the sporting good store and the friendly people at the casino.  I also like the numerous restaurants, to which to pick from.  All in all I would rate Silverton Casino a go to place, and if you remember I said I never stayed there before, well I'm going to make it a point to stay there whenever I'm in Vegas.  I already told my friends about the Silverton and advised them that they should try it.  Oh, one more thing, the shuttle driver was also from Hawaii, go figure, if they work there, it must be a great place to stay.

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: Great time. Better then the strip, everything you want and need and they make you feel welcomed unlike the big casinos.Loose slots, good food, clean rooms.

allReviews.title: Stay Here and avoid Las Vegas Strip stress and prices.
allReviews.text: Had a great time staying at Silverton from the room, the ability to work and sleep in peace during the day and overnight to having a plethera of dining and gaming options really no need to go to the Strip when visiting Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: The Silverton checks all of my vacation boxes
allReviews.text: The Silverton Lodge and Casino is a perfect vacation spot in Las Vegas if you are looking for a beautifully appointed boutique hotel with the most welcoming and efficient staff. The western theme is throughout the cozy rooms and the newly renovated swimming pool and hot tub area. The resort has wonderful dining options during your stay. I have been visiting the Silverton since the ‘90s and have loved watching the resort evolve through the years.

allReviews.title: Birthday trip to Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I visited Las Vegas with my family and we stayed at the Silverton. I can tell you the experience was golden from the time we arrived until we left, our Host Curtiss F. set everything up in advance. The place is clean, inviting and the staff are so nice, did I mention the food is delicious in the casa restaurant. I would give the Silverton 5 stars and definitely recommend for your stay in Las Vegas .  E. Walker

allReviews.title: Always a great time!!!!! Great customer service!!!!!
allReviews.text: Great place to gamble or stay or all the above!!! Love this place and im a local and drive across town just to get here and have a great time!!! The very best rewards club nobody beats it!!!

allReviews.title: Graveyard Shift casino staff
allReviews.text: This review is not about the hotel or hotel staff because the hotel staff has always been excellent and still is. This review is about casino staff as in 2 bar tenders and 2 servers. I don’t mind naming these persons considering how they openly gossip about other coworkers in front of customers and complain about their jobs in front of customers. To start I’ve been going to Silverton since it was boomtown and years later became a club member. The current graveyard bartender Josh is nothing more than an ungrateful complaining employee and talks bad of his managers, coworkers, and the company he’s been this way a very long time around 15 years, when told we don’t want to hear it he still continues. Saying he hates his job and hates the place. Next is another bartender Bea who has not served the 5 of us at different times more than 3 times over 7 months and is very rude. Then there is Donna who has not served all 5 of us at the tables for over 2 years. Sherell a server has attitude and failed to bring change for a $20 back so now we refuse to tip her at all. Then there’s Noria who also talks about coworkers and customers in front of customers for gossip saying untrue comments. All of these persons talk and gossip where customers hear their nonsense and disrespect their own coworkers to the extent of taking tips from areas not their own as they say. Employee disrespect and bragging about what they do is not something customers need to hear. Bad mouthing the company they work for is a definite no no. Non of us care about their drama and anyone that hates their job needs to be replaced by good. Donna and Josh have been there long enough and should have better respect to customers but instead they think they are allowed to get away with anything. On the good side all the other employees are top notch and very respectful and appreciate their jobs. Managers have been informed before of this behavior but these employees don’t care or respect. These people are hired to do a job and not start or talk drama, if you are gambling you are supposed to be served not ignored. If you can’t do a job then get another job… it’s simple…

allReviews.title: Decided to change from going to reno to now coming to Vegas. You ask why? Because the Atlantis in reno downgraded me
allReviews.text: Decided to change from going to reno to now coming to Vegas. You ask why? Because the Atlantis in reno downgraded me

allReviews.title: A Place that Feels Like Home
allReviews.text: We couldn't have had a better stay. Our casino host, Curt, and all of the staff at Silverton are to be commended for their hospitality and welcoming atmosphere. We felt at home.Took a little while to get the lay of the land, but once we did it wasn't bad getting around at all. I actually made it to the far end of the casino the last night we were there and saw how big the place REALLY is! Everyone from the hotel front desk to the room attendants to the valet guys were just so accommodating and easy to work with. Then add in the casino staff and the cage folks and it made for a fun time.We normally like to make it down to Magnolia's at the 4-Queens. But with Sundance, we didn't miss it! That place has such good food and huge portions! Their breakfasts were wonderful. And the dinner we had was awesome. (the corn chowder is to die for!!!). Prices were very reasonable.Mi Casa was perfect for us our first night. We wanted something different and we got it there. The people were very friendly and the food was outstanding. It was a great culinary start to our week!  Prices were comparable to other places we've been Twin Creeks, what can I say about that place? The ambiance was excellent. The servers were amazing. And the food? Well, it pains me to say it but that was the best ribeye I've ever had. The sides were plentiful and tasted wonderful. We have found a new home at Silverton.

allReviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service
allReviews.text: Silverton Casino Host and.Front Desk Staff displayed “Exceptional” customer service throughout our stay.  The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly, the check-in process was smooth and quick, and the hotel/casino environment was nice and very clean. Overall, this experience will  have us returning in the near future.

allReviews.title: Great Off-Strip Vegas Option
allReviews.text: Renovations are really upscale, yet comforting - just like home - after a long haul on the road. Plenty of great in-house food and drink options and a good gaming room with all of the Vegas favorites including my favorite - black jack. After several stays over the past year or so, staff recognition is always a nice touch. Enjoy the easy access to business contacts since hotel is located conveniently off the Strip.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel off the the strip
allReviews.text: Silverton is truly a hidden gem in Las Vegas . I have gambled here for years but have never stayed here until now. This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at over the last 30 years of visiting Las Vegas . I have stayed up and down the strip at almost every mega resort on the strip , also I have stayed at numerous hotel in downtown Vegas as well other of strip properties like Green Valley , M Resort , Red Rock , they are all nice properties but when it comes to service,  quality  , and some of the most comfortable beds in town to the nice pool area , good food and now my favorite Casino Host I have had for years at others properties now calls Silverton home topped of the absolutely top notch hotel and service it was a perfect match for me and my wife.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Always enjoy our stays here. Very clean and friendly atmosphere. Great food at the restaurants. Staff is always friendly too.

allReviews.title: Best Casino Off The Strip
allReviews.text: This is my go to casino. My opinion is they have the loosest slots in Vegas. My money lasts for hours. They have really nice clean rooms. The beds are very  comfortable. The casino is clean and the staff is friendly.

allReviews.title: Good Times!
allReviews.text: We had the best experiences at Silverton on our overnight Staycation! We both won money, yje entire staff was wonderful! I even got called for the month end drawing, and won a nice prize! Looking forward to my next stay! Silverton,  my favorite!

allReviews.title: 10 out of 10
allReviews.text: I’ve always enjoyed visiting Silverton, typically on the way out of town. Since the remodel, Silverton has now become a place to stay. It is now our first place to visit, as we love going to Bass Pro Shops and Cracker Barrel. Besides the beautiful pool area and nice restaurants, the aquarium is truly an amazing fixture with the sea life they bring to the desert, probably the best content of massive aquariums I’ve seen.Lastly, the rooms are performed with a western theme. Silverton went all out in making the space a truly top tier room with solid professional designers who knew what they were doing.
