I hope you give yourself a chance to visit, as the service was very warm as well.

allReviews.title: Best relaxing and peaceful hotel/casino off the strip
allReviews.text: Best hotel/casino off the strip. Comfortable, quiet, relaxing, the pool isn’t crowded. Nice and peaceful place to stay. Clean and quick with room service. Free parking and free valet (donations welcomed)

allReviews.title: I highly recommend Silverton Hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is really nice, the staff was great from check in to check out. And everything in between. They had a wide variety of slot machines..The food was delicious and the mermaid show was cool

allReviews.title: Great tine with friends as h the silverton hotel casino
allReviews.text: I’ve been going to Silverton since the 1990s. I’ve seen it grow over 30 years I’ve always enjoyed my stay there great food and drinks and the rooms are nice and roomy and might I add they’ve just been remodeled

allReviews.title: Look No further, this is the spot off the strip.
allReviews.text: Love the Mermaid tank, even if the show isn't on, the beautiful fish from all kinds are so eye catching.  The big Bass Pro shop is awesome with all their great deals.

allReviews.title: Staycation at the Silverton
allReviews.text: I recently spent a few days at the Silverton Casino with my adult son and daughter for a quick staycation, and we had an awesome experience. From check-in to check-out, everything went smoothly and we felt totally relaxed the whole time. Belinda at the front desk helped us during check-out and couldn’t have been nicer. She asked how our stay was, chatted with us a bit, and sent us off with a genuine smile. It’s those little moments that really stick with you.The hotel itself was spotless, and our room was super comfortable. The beds were cozy, and anytime we ordered room service, it came quickly and the staff was always friendly. We also tried a few of the restaurants on-site every one of them had great food and really solid service.If you’re after a clean, low-key place to stay that’s still close to the action, Silverton is a great option. The casino was well-kept, the pool and hot tub area were perfect for relaxing, and the overall vibe was chill and welcoming. We’ll definitely be coming back again.

allReviews.title: Silverton stay was excellent
allReviews.text: Hotel staff are courteous and always helpful; hotel is well maintained and casino area is nice; Mexican and sushi restaurants are excellent…some of the best food I’ve had in Vegas

allReviews.title: Great Atmosphere
allReviews.text: Great atmosphere, awesome room and service, friendly check-in, clean, good food, variety slot machines and table games, gift store, aquarium, Bass Pro Shop

allReviews.title: Fun for everyone
allReviews.text: Love this place, there's an aquarium inside of the Silverton casino. Also, there's a bass pro shop for all fishing equipments and fishing stuff that you need. Hotel is awesome, large pool space to chill with bar and a big TV to watch as you swim. Rooms are great with the view of the pool, it's good for family to enjoy variety dinner choices, gambling for adults and aquarium for kids. Nearby restaurants are available if you don't like eating at the casino, it's close to airport easy transportation. If you are a first time stay at this hotel, you get 2 poker chips for wine tasting at the mermaid lounge.

allReviews.title: A++ start to finish.
allReviews.text: From start to finish we enjoyed our stay. The check in process was easy, the newly renovated rooms were very comfortable and well decorated. The Sundance grill had excellent food and great service. The pool was clean and also renovated. Every employee seemed like they were there to make your stay better. It is our favorite casino in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Silverton for a Work Trip
allReviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at Silverton.  I was there for work and the hotel was five minutes from the office.  The Hotel and Casino were very clean.  The service was great.  I ate at The Noodle house.  It was delicious.  I visited the store and found what I was looking for. The room was clean and decorated so cute. I loved the country western theme. The theme was everywhere throughout the casino and restaurants.

allReviews.title: The Silverton is GREAT!
allReviews.text: The casino is awesome! Lots of the newest machines and plenty of them. My room was HUGE and clean. The bed was very comfy - the bathroom great. And the pool area is very nice - loved the hot top. None of the "circus" atmosphere of downtown and not the insane traffic and crowds of the Strip. A nice, quiet area around the casino. Lots of locals gamble there and they know a good place to play! And all the restaurants surrounding the casino floor - good food, lots of choices and easy access for us old folks. Will definitely return!

allReviews.title: Highly Recommend
allReviews.text: Beautiful property, clean, friendly staff, excellent food for the price, clean casino, love the new pool area and the fitness center is clean and modern with nice equipment.

allReviews.title: Must see stay that helps unwind.
allReviews.text: Lodge Vegas is the place to go. The Strip can be a bit much, so we try to stay a couple of days at Silverton to calm down and relax. The casino is large but is chill. The restaurants are economically priced but fantastic, and the service and employees at Silverton are the best. The aquarium is also a must see. Will be staying there again soon since the rooms are also quiet and relaxing.

allReviews.title: New
allReviews.text: Hotel not on the strip, but a few minutes away (by car). It is not very clear the parking, whether or not you can leave the car Covered, but in the end I do not have great controls. We were assigned a room on the ground floor, too bad for the smell of smoke that hangs everywhere. You hear a little noise, but nothing too much trouble. Cleaning is not done daily or at least not in our room and we have not been informed of this. No breakfast. The room is very well furnished and very spacious. Comfortable beds. Nice bathroom, too. Pleasant swimming pool with jacuzzi. If you are not looking for a hotel in the center of the nightlife, but convenient for travel I recommend it.

allReviews.title: Super Fun and relaxing resort.
allReviews.text: Excellent casino floor, premium food selection and excellent service.  Clean property and rooms.  Great pool area and amenities. Fun and friendly atmosphere. Great hotel check in staff and area.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas resort without dealing with the strip
allReviews.text: What a great resort, a self-contained Vegas experience without dealing with the strip! Staff was very friendly and helpful, restaurants especially Twin Creeks (steaks) were awesome. Great pool that was not overcrowded, and the entertainment at the Mermaid lounge was a lot of fun too!

allReviews.title: Clean rooms and great casino with an awesome atmosphere.
allReviews.text: Everything about the Silverton was spectacular. When visiting Vegs I enjoy staying at the smaller casinos. Silverton has met mt expectations for al the smaller casinos in Vegas, I've stayed in a lot of Vegas casinos and by far the Silverton was very pleasant.

allReviews.title: Relax, play, and fine dining
allReviews.text: The ambience at Silverton was outstanding from their beautiful rooms to the relaxing pool and fine dining love every minute, specially the variety of slot machines that they have

allReviews.title: Great Resort
allReviews.text: From hospitality to amazing service we had such a great time everything about this resort was simply amazing. We cannot wait to visit again soon.

allReviews.title: A Staycation at its Finest
allReviews.text: The only hotel I stay at in Las Vegas is the Silverton. I have family that live there, so I visit quite often. It’s the perfect staycation. We always book a cabana for one of the days. Swim, eat, drink, and just enjoy a meeting place and drop zone. Poolside food and service is excellent. We also enjoy the fish tank and mermaids, the restaurants, (Mi Casa has the best salsa) and of course the Casino! The front desk personnel are always helpful, and I use the convenient shuttle to and from the airport. You don’t really need to go anywhere else. The Silverton has it all.

allReviews.title: Fun break from the heat.
allReviews.text: Everyone was so nice from check in to check  out. Food was really good and service excellent. Nice variety of machines, we had a fun time.

allReviews.title: Silverton is like my second home
allReviews.text: Silverton is always been my home , everytime I go to vegas that’s where I stay …I don’t like to be in the strips or other casinos because it’s so crowded …all the staff , servers , front desk they are all so friendly …like we are family …love that place ..

allReviews.title: If you’re tired of the filth of the strip but want or need to come to Vegas. This is the place to stay
allReviews.text: If you’re tired of the filth of the strip but want or need to come to Vegas. This is the place to stay

allReviews.title: No harassment in Vegas
allReviews.text: I love going to Silverton. It is right at the entrance of the heart of Vegas. No traffic or crowd to deal with. Wonderful Brandy, the Casino  host, took care of me beyond my exexpectation.  Love eating at the Sundance grill which opens 24 hours with every menu available at all time. LJ's service was impeccable as well being friendly taking time to converse with me. If you like to avoid the heavy traffic and simple hospitality,  this is the place. Thank you Silverton!

allReviews.title: Amazing place
allReviews.text: Amazing place to stay with family and friends, also very good hospitality with nice place to spend time. we shall also refer family and friends.

allReviews.title: Tired of waiting for my room
allReviews.text: Cmon.. try to check in and you have to wait over 3 hours???? After 3????I get they want me to spend money but I won’t come back here. Very hokey

allReviews.title: Silverton!  Thanks So Much!
allReviews.text: I was on a rescue mission with my friend.  We met my stepdaughter in Vegas.  She had gone on vacation in Colorado and ended up in the hospital after a plane ride.  Because she was on oxygen she couldn't fly so she rented a car and drove to Vegas, and we me her at the Silverton and drove her home to San Diego.  The Silverton was so accommodating!  They picked us up the airport and drove us to the hotel.  Everyone was so nice!  The valets were so helpful! They assisted getting her to the room. The room was perfect.  We had a most lovely dinner at the restaurant.  And we felt pampered beyond belief!  I would go again to the Silverton.  It was so non pretentious, quiet and refreshing!  The pool area looked amazing.  The Casino was so fun and not overcrowded.  it was a quick trip, but I would go again in a heartbeat.  Great Service, comfy room, great destination.  All You need!

allReviews.title: Best off the strip hotel!
allReviews.text: Always enjoy our stay at the Silverton. Exceptional staff, kind and outgoing. Rooms are comfortable, clean, and decor is nice. Comfy bed and linens. Will never stay anywhere else in Vegas.

allReviews.title: This is how a hotel should be!
allReviews.text: Well, when we arrived at the Front Desk, Ms. Joanna greeted us with a smile and friendly greeting. She then placed us into a suite which was so warm and comfortable, WOW!!We also enjoyed the Tomahawk Thursday special at Twin Creeks, which was a treat itself. As great as the food was, our service team of Brandon and Lorrena were very friendly and helpful, kudos!In short, thank you Joanna, Brandon and Lorrena for an amazing visit!!
Best experience start to finish from valet to front desks to housekeeping they are amazing really clean rooms amazing staff great location free parking

allReviews.title: very nice staff across the board. and as far as having an easy access for everything this is the place to be
allReviews.text: very nice staff across the board. and as far as having an easy access for everything this is the place to be

the most convenient resort to stay. parking is easy access. valet staff are awesome. aquarium is the main attraction. bass pro shop is huge . casino is clean and not crowded. food amenities is amazing . pool os awesome . friendly staff and i will recommend this to everyone especially for families that have kids. overall a bery nice resort to deal with.

allReviews.title: Silverton rocks!
allReviews.text: The rooms are new and very nice! The bed was sooo comfortable. The new pool and pool area was very nice with ample seating. The casino was fun and we did much better here than on the strip. We will definitely be back. The grill restaurant was delicious.  I had the prime rib dip and definitely recommend it!

allReviews.title: The land of milk and honey
allReviews.text: I was completely impressed with their professionalism and customer service.I highly recommend this business.The casino quality is consistently outstanding, exceeding my expectations. We'll definitely be back!!!!!

allReviews.title: A blast at Silverton
allReviews.text: The Silverton is our favorite spot to stop in Las Vegas . We enjoy all the amenities from the wonderful pool , the delicious food, the shopping at Bass Pro and the casino games are a blast . The people at Silverton from the time you check in to the time you check out make you feel like you are special to them and that they appreciate your business.

allReviews.title: Love this Casno Hotel
allReviews.text: When we first arrived I felt comfortable, well lit and clean at first sight.   Did not wait long to register and took less then 5 minutes.  Our room was clean and cool we slept in the most comfortable bed.  Loved the pool atmosphere and had the best waitress.   We did stay on a weekday. We ate at three restaurants Johnny rockets, Sundance grill for breakfast and dinner and Mi Casa fir dinner each restaurant was great. We loved being closed to Bass pro shop since we do RV camping and almost always need something.  We definitely will come back to Silverton!

allReviews.title: Great Stay - Best Pool in Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms are very cozy with a wild west vibe.  The front desk service was spectacular!  The greatest thing about this hotel is the pool area "The Swimming Hole".  What an upgrade!  We rented a cabana and had a ball.  The service was above and beyond.

allReviews.title: Our last stay was lots of fun as always!
allReviews.text: All the employees there are the friendliest from the helpful valet to the friendly check in desk to the café employees! Our return visit because of this reason.

allReviews.title: Great resort
allReviews.text: The resort is beautiful ,nice room the pool was also great and the bang bang shrimp at the pool side wasvto die  for great customer service

allReviews.title: Great time with the family.
allReviews.text: The service was great and the staff was excellent. The hotel is very nice and the staff is very friendly. I love it. The casino was excellent and I will go back again.

allReviews.title: Our home away from home.
allReviews.text: We've  been going for years, before Covid during Covid after your renovations. When finished. It's our favorite place to dine, play and sleep. Trey has not retired yet  Works as administrator for the school district.. We have to work around  his schedule and sometimes in wknds only. Or holidays. We will continue to keep on going..

allReviews.title: Can't wait to go back!
allReviews.text: The hotel remodel is beautiful.  The rooms are so nice and spacious.The pool area is exceptional, great food and drink. And of course, the casino is the most fun.

allReviews.title: Hotel off the strip free car parking,lots to do and see, very clean,great staff one of the best hotels we’ve stayed in.
allReviews.text: Hotel off the strip free car parking,lots to do and see, very clean,great staff one of the best hotels we’ve stayed in.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Experience
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean and welcoming. The staff was attentive and friendly. We also enjoyed the pool. Everything was easy and accommodating. I would stay there again!

allReviews.title: Staycation
allReviews.text: The staff was top notch, the room was clean and comfortable, we loved the Western theme, and the food was the best! We're locals, we had a weekend staycation at the Silverton, and can't wait to do it again!

allReviews.title: Get a way
allReviews.text: Couldn't ask for a better resort, seven restaurants, Bass pro, slots and table games,  exercise room, swimmin' hole, and the nicest staff. Off the strip, but close enough . This was my second visit this year.

allReviews.title: Perfect experience
allReviews.text: A beautiful property, with outstanding personal . We had the best stay, nothing could have been better. We can't wait to come back. Hopefully next time we can stay a little longer. The only thing that could be better would be winning lots of Money.

allReviews.title: Family-Friendly Gem Off the Strip
allReviews.text: This is a very accommodating, family-friendly hotel with plenty of options and great value—especially for Las Vegas. Every staff member we interacted with was genuinely helpful and welcoming. Not a single unpleasant encounter, which is rare anywhere, let alone Vegas.The rooms were well-appointed and comfortable, offering solid value for the price. The recently renovated pool was a great way to relax and pass a couple of hours.Highly recommend this hotel for both families and couples looking for a quieter, more relaxed Vegas experience. We’re already looking forward to coming back.

allReviews.title: We love the Silverton Hotel and Casino!!
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our room, which was very comfortable.  We found the a staff to be very friendly, from the hotel desk to the pool, bars, restaurants and the casino.  We ate at four of the restaurants and were pleased with all four.  We will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Best week in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Hubby and I went to Vegas to celebrate my retirement, we stayed at Silverton casino , we had a great time, it’s a nice place the staff is really friendly, food is delicious waking up to have some Starbucks coffee everyday wonderful!! no rush or noise the beds are so clean and comfortable. We did not go to the pool area but will go next time.Thank you Silverton we will definitely come back soon. 💞

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Very nice stay, clean comfortable room. Nice dining options at casino. Shopped at the Bass Pro shop attached to casino. Casino floor was very clean. Pool area was very nice, we didn't sit in the sun but walked around pool, very nice. Will return.

allReviews.title: Couldn't ask for more
allReviews.text: The best off the strip experience. Great, clean pool, attentive staff, easy in and out. Rooms are always super clean and ready. No long elevator rides up 20 stories. Covered self park with lots of handicap spots. Free gaming and food for loyalty customers

allReviews.title: MEMORABLE
allReviews.text: Everyone excels making you welcomed. The newly remodeled rooms are amazing and comfortable. The casino floor is welcoming and you will never have the overcrowded strip experience. The variety of restaurants give plenty of choices for a good meal. Great value.

allReviews.title: Absolutely wounderful
allReviews.text: Enjoyed everything about my stay friendly service I even won a jack pot it was a great experience. it was very clean and our room was perfect. we will be going back real soon. the swimming area is to die for. You will not find a better plae to stay trustme.

allReviews.title: Amazed! My favorite!
allReviews.text: I hate to say this because I don’t want to be waitlist to stay but Silverton is my favorite!  Clean, smells amazing, no over crowded pools,Good dining ( not way over priced) and great gaming floor selection. I have stayed in many places in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Amazing!!!!!
allReviews.text: The greetings from help desk at check in is amazing the Uncle that greeted was very welcoming and offered chips for winery and the pool area, which was amazing. Rooms are amazing the bed is soft and the pillows are soft! Silverton provides numbers of pillow on one bed. Eating at Sundance as amazing loved our waitress Faith she was amazing. We got her twice. Overall the workers there are very welcoming. Love how the hotel staff are so welcoming and smiling. This hotel is very family oriented especially for kids.

allReviews.title: Bait and Switch
allReviews.text: I find the number of five star reviews for this place highly suspect, and you should too. Tried to check in yesterday on an offer they emailed to me and was immediately given the bait and switch. I politely showed them my email which clearly stated  the offer and another email with my confirmation.  Another lady came out and both of them proceeded to very rudely shut me down and said the offer had “changed.”  My husband and I had stayed there on a very similar offer he received with no problems, so we knew what we were doing, but suddenly here it was my turn and they could not have been more rude. Well, I am sure they don’t care, but they lost a couple of good customers, as I was so offended that I will never step foot in there again.  The casino smells like bad carpet fresh anyway and there’s no vibe to speak of.  Keep driving and go to Southpoint, where they know the meaning of good customer service.

allReviews.title: Had a great time.
allReviews.text: Rooms were excellent and clean. The food and the quantity in the restaurants was excellent.Best part was the entertainment, such as the huge aquarium and the mermaids that were very entertaining and communicated with the children. Loved shopping at the pro bass shop.

allReviews.title: Vacation experience that is worth the stay.
allReviews.text: The hotel rooms very nice, well furnished, clean and comfortable.  One of the best I stayed at.  Also, the staff were friendly, nice and attentive to any needs .  Room service was easy to use and the food arrived timely and was a great meal.  The pool, fitness center and aquarium makes for a great stay.

allReviews.title: Silverton is pure rustic gold
allReviews.text: Silverton Lodge the hidden jewel in plain sight, easy on easy off the highway. If you must uber into the strip. However everything you need for Vegas fun is here. The newly refreshed rooms fantastic rustic feel my wife loves the bed, pillows and shower. The food choices are excellent too many to list. The customer service from front desk, bartenders to casino floor off the hook delightful. The Circa sports-book and its personnel is customer delight. The new swimming hole with a massive giant humongous enormous beautiful tv screen is pure oasis magic while splashing and sipping beverages in and around the pool.

allReviews.title: A great place to stay off the strip
allReviews.text: The rooms are excellent and the staff from registration and through out the casino lodge are very courteous and helpful. We've been staying at Silverton for many years and the upgrade of the rooms last year has made this hotel a truly great place to stay. We like it much more than the huge hotels on the strip.

allReviews.title: Best place in LV!
allReviews.text: The staff is accommodating and so friendly.   The rooms are lovely, western theme but classy.  The bed was great.  The pool is wonderful.  The lounges are cushioned and very comfortable.  The pool is heated and very relaxing.  The pool staff is very responsive and the food is great.  The food is plentiful in the restaurants and reasonable.  I tell all my friends that this is the place to stay in LV.

allReviews.title: Vegas Without The Hefty Price Tag
allReviews.text: We stayed here just to try it out as we have family that comes in to town a lot and they like staying close to our home. Check in was nice and easy, the front desk person was warm and very knowledgeable of what was going on within the hotel that night and our options around the hotel. They recently renovated the rooms and they’re absolutely gorgeous. It felt like you were staying at a nice strip hotel, but for a fraction of the price. We didn’t swim, but the pool area looked really nice as well. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you’re looking for a nice place to stay, close to the freeway to get to areas like the strip or downtown, and at a good value!

allReviews.title: A great place to stay
allReviews.text: The Silverton is a clean and friendly hotel and casino. The staff is attentive and courteous. It’s a great off strip option for anyone who would enjoy a more personal  experience. At check in I was given multiple room optionsBeverage service on the casino floor was in glass not plastic. I had an issue with my shower that was resolved in short order. I will definitely be staying here again

allReviews.title: Spring trip to Silverton
allReviews.text: We had a fantastic time at the Silverton , the pool is amazing , the rooms were so clean, the staff are so helpful and friendly. It felt like Vegas back when Vegas cared for their customers . We had a blast in the casino and enjoyed shopping at Bass Pro. Not to mention how great the restaurants were. We will definitely be back!!

allReviews.title: Great Lodge Experience!!!
allReviews.text: Enjoyed the backyard Oasis!!! I feel this Resort has a great Lodge theme and its beautifully layed out.  This is much better location to stay than on the Strip or Downtown, in my opinion.  Looking forward to my next month trip.  Ask for Pool view rooms.

allReviews.title: Love the Newly Renovated Silverton
allReviews.text: Love the newly renovated rooms upgraded bathrooms and comfortable beds. No more old carpet smell, but maintained the family-friendly atmosphere. The giant screen overlooking the pool added a very nice touch. We will be back and definitely recommend this place to family and friends

allReviews.title: Most Enjoyable Place
allReviews.text: Most gracious experience every employee I had contact with ,rather the front desk, the house keeping staff  or the casino host all made my experience exceptional , Even the cleanliness of the hotel ( Impressive) The Choice and restaurant selection  was a bonus, the food from SUndance, Mi Casa Grill, Su Casa Sushi Bar all was great and want to thank you for making my experience exceptional.

allReviews.title: What a great and fun place to be in Vegas, can’t say enough, rooms are great.Our family loves this place, friendly staff
allReviews.text: What a great and fun place to be in Vegas, can’t say enough, rooms are great.Our family loves this place, friendly staff

allReviews.title: Great Spring Break trip
allReviews.text: This was are first time visiting and staying at the Silverton.  We had a great time.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  Special thanks to the excellent valet service from Andres and Allen.  Also Brendon who we met in the the pool area was very kind.  We had dinner twice at Mi Casa and breakfast twice at Sundance.  We enjoyed all of our meals.  We decided to try the Silverton because it was near the mountain bike trails at Blue Diamond.  It only took us about 20 minutes to get to the trailhead.  Our favorite area was the pool.  It was so nice and new.  We preferred staying versus staying on the strip.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: Our standard king room was perfect. Beautiful, clean and new. We loved staying here so much. The wine tasting while watching the fish swim by was so much fun. The pool area and casino were very nice. There is a Starbucks which we visited every morning within the resort. There are so many restaurants and shopping areas within minutes. The strip was only a few minutes away and also the airport. I can’t wait to return!

allReviews.title: Great place we stayed in Vegas
allReviews.text: The room was super spacious and beautifully decorated. The bed was very comfortable and I slept soundly all night.   I enjoyed the bar at the casino and the hot tub. The service was excellent. Everyone was so nice and I even made some new friends at the pool.

allReviews.title: Awesome weekend
allReviews.text: Entire staff were super friendly.  Nice clean rooms with great beds. casino is not very Smokey. Pool & jacuzzi are newly remolded and awesome.  Highly suggest the steak house and cafe is excellent as well. We really enjoyed our stay and looking forward to coming back!!!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: The bed and linen were exceptional.  The room was clean and comfortable and quiet.  The pool water is warm.  You can order drinks and food at the poolside.  There is a hot tub also.  All the restirants are great.  I will definitely stay here again.  Staff is friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Recent stay
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Silverton. It is a Great location. We had a great time! It was a wonderful experience. Super clean hotel. Will definitely be coming back again. It was great parking as well a lot of places near by Great customer service

allReviews.title: Clean, Friendly, Great Food
allReviews.text: Thank you for the great experience, the food at the restaurants was all fantastic. The pool area and dining at the pool is first class. Clean, friendly and first class all around. I will definitely be visiting again. Tremendous value and 10/10 experience

allReviews.title: Springtime at the Silverton.
allReviews.text: The newly remodeled Silverton Casino Lodge was well appointed and comfortable. The large aquarium at the entrance was a beautiful surprise. They provided educational sessions and the occasional mermaid. Every staff member we encountered was very friendly and helpful. The pool area was inviting and very relaxing. I would highly recommend a stay at The Silverton.

allReviews.title: What an awesome hotel
allReviews.text: I love this property, the staff is extremely friendly and recognaized me for my Brirthday.  It starts with the arrival experience at valet to the front desk, F&B, and Casino. The rooms are clean and smoke free. The recent renovation was done well.  Can't wait to return soon!

allReviews.title: My most favourite place to stay!!!
allReviews.text: My Husband and I love the Silverton Hotel.  We have stayed here every spring and fall for 12 years.  It is always clean and has the most friendly staff. …  And the food at my Sundance Grill. .. never disappoints.  Psssss .. the pool rocks!!Thank you .. see you soon!!!!

allReviews.title: Awesome Experience
allReviews.text: Excellent resort. The place is super nice and very clean. Staff was very friendly and helpful.  I would definitely stay there again!  The front desk staff was very accommodating and helpful when I need to make a change to my stay. Thank you so much!

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: I enjoy everything Silverton has to offer, it’s an awesome place. The rooms are great, the restaurants are great, and the new pool and hot tub was heavenly. I love the aquarium and the mermaids. Having Bass Pro Shop next door is a shopping pleasure.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem in Vegas
allReviews.text: I've been staying at the Silverton Casino Lodge for the past 6 months and love it!  Why?  As a world traveler, I like to have certain "must haves" and like to haves in a hotel I stay at.  Here you!  Excellent staff members throughout the hotel and casino!  Excellent retention from my standpoint as I see the same team each trip.  There is not enough room to tell all of the good but let's break it down in pieces.  Food.  Excellent and multiple choices from Chinese, Mexican up to a high end Steakhouse, Twin Creeks.  Room types.  Excellent options and NO smoking in the hotel areas.  Casino, all of the table games you want to play and a huge selection of slots! POOL....did you want to talk POOL?  A newly renovated pool that is not only beautiful, but has a bar, restaurant and giant tvs to watch you favorite sport while soaking up some rays!

allReviews.title: Beyond my expectations
allReviews.text: The promptness of the staff  from checkin to check out was amazing and their attentive service was beyond my expectations.  Very clean hotel and many amenities the gym was great and located perfectly where I prefer by the pool. Definitely will return.

allReviews.title: Highly recommended
allReviews.text: They have the best customer service..thanks to Lori Mei and the rest of the team..three times I've been here and always have such a wonderful stay..this place is so clean and all staff are very nice and courteous...will probably be back next month..again thank you Silverton

allReviews.title: Feels like a village
allReviews.text: The room was very comfortable. The bedding was luxurious. The hotel is small enough to feel like a village but big enough to have 5 restaurants, lots of gaming, live music. and very friendly staff. Loved the in-room dining. We enjoyed the huge fish tank and shopping at Bass Pro.

allReviews.title: We love staying at the Silverton hotel Casino.
allReviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton Hotel Casino. The hotel rooms are beautiful! The beds have always been the comfiest. We love the size of the casino, and all the restaurants are delicious. The remodel of the pool area is very modern. We also love that the Bass Pro Shop is right there. 😊

allReviews.title: A must stay
allReviews.text: Silverton is a great casino to gamble at with new clean tables and fun dealers. The hotel has huge rooms with lots of amenities and smells great day and night. The rooms are nice and quiet as well. Overall is an excellent stay, will be coming here every time!

allReviews.title: The best trip ever
allReviews.text: The hotel luxury suite was the best I’ve stayed in and the room service and food was great. Whenever I get a chance again I will definitely come back. My wife and kid enjoyed the trip as well they love the room services and couldn’t get enough of the mermaids..

allReviews.title: Absolutely Loved The Silverton Lodge
allReviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at the Silverton Lodge.  The staff was exceptional and treated us with such kindness.  The room was clean and decorated beautifully.  The pool area was an absolute WOW factor and was so relaxing by the gas fire pits.  It felt like we were at a resort on one of the islands.  The staff in the restaurants were very friendly and the service was very quick.  We will absolutely stay at the Silverton Lodge again!  It was an awesome experience off the strip!

allReviews.title: So much fun!
allReviews.text: I have been coming to Silverton for years!  It is always a fun and happy time.  I feel comfortable when I stay and play and it is so much better than staying on the expensive Strip.  It is a casino for regular people who want to unwind.  The food is always good and does not break the bank.  The newly remodeled rooms are very nice and roomy.  Every staff member from casino hosts to the front desk (and bartenders and waitresses) are friendly and helpful!  The mermaid themed fish tank is mesmerizing to watch for hours.  My husband agrees with all of this and for someone who would rather be fishing in Wyoming than going to Vegas that says a lot!

allReviews.title: Amazing

The rooms are beautifully decorated and spacious.  The pool area is very inviting and they have plenty of seating.  I know there are so many options in Vegas but I highly recommend giving Silverton a look. You will not regret  it!

allReviews.title: Would Return!
allReviews.text: This was a last-minute, emergency booking. When we showed up the first night, there were no rooms available, but we got lucky on our second night and I was able to make a booking online (not from their website). It was cheaper than nearby hotels, and offered a lot more! The room was large and comfortable, but a bit dark. The TV also stopped working properly the following morning. The casino downstairs was also large, casual, and fun. I signed up for the casino's rewards card and got 50% off my breakfast the next day! The restaurant closest to the hotel room entrance was decently priced and offered quick service. The shop in the casino was also on the cheaper side (ex: $2.50 for a soda instead of the $5+ on the strip!)The pool area was lovely - if I had more time, I would have loved to actually use the heated pool! I saw several people enjoying it. I did get a chance to sit near the fire pit, which was so nice on a chilly evening. They do have a large aquarium where we saw the "mermaids" perform a couple of times during our stay, and we even wandered around the Bass Pro Shop. It's off-strip, so there aren't any good views of touristy areas, unfortunately. We didn't use this service, but they do offer a shuttle to the airport (which is only about 10 minutes away). You need to book 24 hours in advance though. Check-in and check-out was fast and easy. Free self-parking was right next to the casino.

After going here I would say stay off the Strip , Relax , and kickback here rather than dealing with the crowds and lines

allReviews.title: ADA rooms are sub-par
allReviews.text: Our experience was unique to our room and not an overall opinion of the lodge. At first glance, I thought the room was nice. We were placed in an ADA Room because they were booked and that was all that was available to accommodate us in a double. We have stayed in other ADA rooms and thought it would be ok since I have a pain issue and can use the bars to get in and out of the shower and the extra space for wheelchair access is great. The first night, we noticed that both beds were  very low to the floor and more importantly on a slant toward the middle of the room. Our daughter's bed was the worst. I slept in it on the second night and was at a severe slant but it was so late, we were in our pajamas, tired, etc., and didn't want to disrupt the entire room by moving or having furniture rearranged so I didn't call about it until the morning. Maintenance staff came immediately and I had already identified that the bed was completely out of the frame on one side. I asked them to check both beds for that issue. That evening, it was better. The next night, it came out of the frame again when I swung my legs over the side to get up. Out of 4 nights, I had one decent night of sleep. The other issue was that they installed a tub in the ADA bathroom with very high sides (the height of my knees and I'm 5'8"). I have low back and hip issues so getting in and out was difficult, even with the bars to hold onto. There is also an immovable bench installed at the back of the tub so the standing area was about 2' x 2'. Lastly, the TV is equipped with a narrator for the blind, and I couldn't figure out how to disable it. Watching TV and a movie was a new experience. These are items that I have not experienced in other ADA rooms. I understand that they are attempting to handle all types of disabilities, however, they missed the mark on so much and even caused my pain syndrome to flare because of the bed and shower issues.  My mother stayed in a different room (non-ADA) with comfy beds and a spacious walk-in shower. I will not stay in their ADA room again. I may give them a try in a different room.

allReviews.title: Newly Renovated Hotel
allReviews.text: This is my first stay at Silverton Casino & Hotel. It's not as convenient to staying on the strip, further away from downtown Las Vegas, but a lot closer to the Rental Car Center than McCarran International Airport. I'm fortunate to get industry rates and always take advantage of the fruits of my labor. Prior to this trip, I checked for available dates and for certain nights on one of the weekends in November which was perfect for my plans! Silverton is also affiliated with Circa. The hotel does charge a $38.41 daily resort fee which includes WiFi, Phone calls, Swimming Pool and other amenities. Fitness Center is newly renovated offering state-of-the-art Life Fitness Machine equipment and several cardio machines. There is also a LF Cable Motion Dual Adjustable Pulley that is super multifunctional. Fitness Center is open 24 hours."The Swimmin' Hole," is a new pool deck, open daily from 9am - 9pm. You can still dive into the warm, inviting waters of their heated pool and hot tub. The pool is kept at a cozy 86 degrees! No food & beverage service is currently available at the moment.You can watch Football on a 32-foot screen at The Swimmin' Hole. You can also watch most games at Circa Sports, Mermaid Lounge or Shady Grove Lounge.Self-Parking Garage and Valet also available. The room I booked was a Refined Lodge King Room. Upon check in, the front desk gal offered me a handful of Wine Tasting chips from 5-7pm which I wasn’t able to make it due to family commitments. Room was fully furnished and updated, in-room safe, mini-ref, large bathroom with large counter space, with a standup shower, living space, a closet, and lots of drawers too, this was way bigger than expected!

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: This is our second time staying at Silverton. We like being off strip where it isn't so crazy. Their recently renovated rooms are great. The beds are comfortable, loved the room blackening shade. The only negative for us was the shower set up. To turn on the water, you have to step into the shower. So, you either turned the water on and scooted out until the water was warm or adjusted the shower head to point at the wall and ducked under the spray until it was warm. I loved the rain showerhead though. There is a body wash/shampoo, and a conditioner mounted on the wall in the shower. There is an armoire with hanging space and drawers. That is also where the Keurig coffee maker is located. (They had Starbucks k-cups.)The casino has a large variety of games and tables, with 4 poker bars. (Hubby had a lucky streak and hit a progressive royal in the first 15 minutes we were there). The Sundance grill has an extensive menu with many options that should appeal to everyone. The beef barley soup was delicious. I had the "cup" which was huge (the size was like a bowl anywhere else). My husband had the prime rib french dip melt with fries. He said it was really good, and the portion size was perfect. We also had breakfast there, also good. They have this really neat aquamarine that is huge. Per the info it is over 100,000 gallons. It has a large variety of fish, and they put on "mermaid" shows throughout the day. There is a 2 story Bass Pro shop. Even if you aren't an outdoors fan, you have to go see it, it is truly unbelievable. All of the staff from the valet, hotel check-in, housekeeping, bartenders, wait staff in the casino and restaurant, were friendly and welcoming. We didn't use the pool but walked out and around it. It is heated and open year-round. They have a humongous tv that was broadcasting sports (hubby thought that was awesome).If you are looking for a great place to stay or play, without all the craziness of the strip, I highly recommend Silverton.

allReviews.text: Highly recommend if you want to stay off the strip.  Lovely property with clean attractive rooms (good a/c which we never seem to have on the strip & total blackout shades).  The aquarium & mermaid swims were fun to watch - so many beautiful fish!  Food at the restaurants was very good at a great price.  Huge Starbucks without the long lines you get in the strip.   Casino was all we needed.  The pool area is very important to us & we were very impressed.  All lounge chairs have deep padding - something you usually pay extra for on the strip.  The pool is heated and we enjoyed the huge hot tub.  Huge tv screen which was playing football.  We only stayed 2 nights & then moved to Fountainbleau for 2 nights.  Was very disappointed at FB that the hot tub is only open on Friday/Saturday & we paid a whole lot more to stay there. My only negative and it’s not that big of a deal is that the bathroom is a little on the small side with barn doors - prefer and a standard door.

allReviews.title: Great together time from California and Florida
allReviews.text: The silverton is a great place to enjoy some of the strip fun and great for business , your greeted with smiles , new slot machines and clean , the food is well portioned and tasty we have enjoyed both couples time and family reunions the Silverton is definitely one of our favorites . Thank you to all staff

allReviews.title: I had a great time with friends and staff at this resort and the Bass Pro shop.
allReviews.text: Friendly staff and a great experience overall, I highly recommend this Casino lodge for anyone coming to Las Vegas. The rooms were clean and the staff very friendly, my casino host was very helpful for getting my rooms reserved and made a point to contact me upon arrival.

allReviews.title: OUR NEW FAVORITE PLACE
allReviews.text: Our first time there, coming from the Wynn we were a bit worried but this is our new favorite hotel hands down. The vin of the room is interesting a mix of western and modern.Everybody is So friendly and the place is affordable as Vegas starts to price itself out of the market. We will definitely be back. Special thanks or should I say "Merci" to Oliver (Olivier) on the casino floor, he is extremely friendly and sure is an asset to the hotel, give this gentleman a raise he deserves it, he loves to work at the Silverton  :-)We went to the Mexican restaurant present on the premises and Franck there was also the best.Please keep up the good work!

allReviews.title: Kid friendly
allReviews.text: Family friendly. Great place to stay with kids. Free mermaid show and sting ray feeding. Everyone loves the Bass Pro Shop that is attached to the casino. Free parking. Free Valet. Lots of casino games. $5 tables on the weekdays. Clean casino. Great prizes for players.

allReviews.title: Great Time…
allReviews.text: I had a great time at Silverton Casino.  Checkin was fast, casino floor service was good.  We ate at the Sundance Grill which was delicious and the servers were on it.  I visited the small gym, it was a little walk outside which I would not do in the dark because it is open 24 hrs.I wish that smoking was restricted still, but all in all I had a great time at The Silverton Casino.

allReviews.title: Best hotel!
allReviews.text: This is the best hotel with the best service. They are very accommodating and make sure to treat you like family. I have always loved coming here and enjoy the atmosphere and the stuff. They all remember you by name too! The restaurants are all great too. Family friendly.

allReviews.title: BE VERY AWARE!
allReviews.text: Never been so disappointed in a place before! Second day of my vacation my Jeep wrangler was stolen out of there secure parking lot with security! Security policy is that apparently they can’t give to the video footage to the cops it has to be subpoenaed into court! To make things worse not one person from The Berkeley or the Silverton ever apologize or checked on us after this terrible incident! This was not the first car stolen out of there parking lot apparently happen few week before ours was  another SWV stolen! Be aware!!!

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Silverton Casino Lodge!
allReviews.text: Room was very comfortable and clean. Plenty of chargers for your electric car all free of cost. Sundance Grill was very pleasant for breakfast in the morning. Very clos to all the action that Vegas has to offer. Can't wait to come back and stay again!!!

allReviews.title: Must stay when in Vegas
allReviews.text: Every single person that works at the Silverton was so helpful and cheerful. We utilized the airport shuttle service and it was very easy to book online and our valet was so accommodating. The rooms were amazing and the beds were extremely comfortable. Blackout curtains were very helpful since we were adjusting to the time zone.  Our absolute favorite area was the pool. The ambiance is amazing with palm trees surrounding the pool and 4 giant screen TV’s playing sports related channels. Again, top notch service from Douglas, Oliver, & Monica! Trust me, book a gazebo if you plan on spending the day by the pool. There’s a mini fridge in each gazebo which is well worth it when it’s 100+ degrees outside. Multiple dining options available and it’s directly connected to the Bass Pro Shop. We aren’t gamblers so I can’t speak to the casino side of the hotel. I will say that they allow smoking in the casino, but the ventilation system is so good that you almost don’t smell the smoke. The aquarium with mermaids is a very nice addition and calming to watch. Highly recommend for people looking for the quieter side of Vegas. We will always stay at the Silverton when we return to Vegas based on this visit!

allReviews.title: Great time at the Silverton
allReviews.text: Had a blast at the Silverton. My the Host chris was amazing all the staff from the valet  to room service etc.etc.. Food was awesome at the SunDance grill The chef on duty was the best shout to the chef for the bomb loco moco. And Buffalo wings and to all the cooks on that shift.  Shout out to Nicloe the server she was very nice and polite as the server. But Most of all had a great time. The pool is to die for anyone headed that way to vegas stop in for a drink and a swim you won't regret it. Also the steak house twin creeks is fire recommend the fliet. I also recommend  the WuHu Noodle Bomb shrip fired rice. Anyway you all get the picture. Had a blast and once again shout out to Christopher for being an excellent host creating a well deserved trip and experience. Oh yeah and one more shout out to the ladies and Gent and the front host Desk very polite  and Great customer service.

allReviews.title: Read to the end to find out why we'll never stay here again!
allReviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located on I-15 -- away from all the traffic on the Strip.  The Front Desk was very efficient and helpful.  But we will never stay here again.   Our recently renovated room was very stylish, roomy and quiet.  The bed was extremely comfortable and the TV worked great. A few annoying things were:  1.  No microwave – but livable.  2.  The toilet paper – thin & cheap.  3.  The bathroom tissue was extremely thin (you could see thru it!) & too small – like 4” x 6”! The coup d’gras:  The shower was abominable!  To reach the shower’s water control handle -– YOU HAD TO STEP INTO THE SHOWER!  That means YOU GOT COVERED WITH A BLAST OF COLD WATER!!!!! Enuf said.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: Love your casino, Love the free play ,and food combs IGood place to take love one's and family, good room service, plan to visit again soon,thanks  for letting us know that you think about us,please send me promotion, want to spend time  play free play

allReviews.title: HDMI
allReviews.text: Very comfortable.  I stayed here because I read it was recently renovated.  Had a bad experience last time in another hotel that was "4 star" but was terribly outdated.   This one is "3 star" but definitely 4 star in relation to old 4 stars.  Just a tip about HDMI outlet.  You cannot reach it. I am an expert so I could reach it, but the TV is programmed to only accept HDMI from their system which plugs into HDMI and USB.  So don't bother bringing your Xbox.

allReviews.title: Can't wait to visit again... already booked☺️
allReviews.text: Silverton is great from the staff to the beautiful rooms our bed was so comfy. The night life in the bar with live music was great... of course gambling in always fun great machines! Our favorite is the SunDance Grill the food is delicious we both had prime rib dinners.

allReviews.title: Great getaway
allReviews.text: The new renovation is absolutely beautiful, the rooms are gorgeous, the pool is so relaxing and stunning, food was great and playing was spectacular. We’ve been going there for over 15 years and will keep on returning. The staff is great, some have been there for years so they remember us each time we visit, very personable and so pleasant to talk to.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!!
allReviews.text: We had an amazing stay at the Silverton from the front desk with amazing and caring people to the beautiful rooms to the wonderful food. The pool is absolutely beautiful with plenty of shade or sun whatever you prefer. Very clean and the staff were always very helpful. Great place to stay off the strip.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: We had an amazing stay at the Silverton, such kind and caring people all over the property, great dining options and The accommodations were great, very clean and the pool was beautiful, we will definitely be staying there on out next visit to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great stay, comfortable rooms & awesome pool
allReviews.text: Super nice rooms, very clean and spacious. Bed was really comfortable, good quality of furniture and linens. Pillows a little firmer than I am accustomed to but still comfortable. Pleasant check in and check out experience. Pool area is awesome and not crazy over crowded. Good food options. Overall a really great experience

allReviews.title: My New Favorite Off-Strip Casino & Hotel
allReviews.text: Totally surprised how nice this casino hotel OFF the strip was!  So relaxing, comfortable and just large enough to have everything you want/need and yet very walkable without getting lost.  Restaurants  were excellent!!  Customer service was way above average.

allReviews.title: Solid Option for Off Strip Stays!
allReviews.text: Silverton exceeded our expectations. We'd rate the property a 4.5.  The staff here are outstanding. The food options were solid. We especially loved Mi Casa and Sundance. We appreciated the free parking. Our room was clean and comfortable and the pool was heavenly. The only downside was we had no view whatsoever. We were facing their garbage area. Room 1025.  Luckily there were no unwanted sounds or smells.  We just closed the blinds and were fine. We will return!

allReviews.title: A great location off the strip!
allReviews.text: Silverton is conveniently located just off the strip, it’s a recently renovated facility with everything you need on site. The rooms are large and very comfortable and clean. The food options were great. We visited over Labour Day weekend at a busy time and still were able to use all the facilities comfortably.

allReviews.title: Home away from Home
allReviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to share my heartfelt appreciation for the Silverton, a place that truly feels like our HOME away from home.From the moment you arrive, the hospitality shines through—from the friendly Bellhops to the attentive housekeeping and welcoming Front Desk staff. They make you feel like FAMILY, ensuring that every stay is memorable.The Silverton is not only clean and affordable, but it also offers a family-oriented atmosphere. It's conveniently located for those who prefer to avoid the hustle and bustle of the Strip while still being close enough for a quick drive. The newly renovated pool is gorgeous.  Perfect spot to relax and unwind. I encourage you to come and check it out and book your next stay at Silverton.  I promise you'll love it!

allReviews.title: Great time in Vegas!
allReviews.text: First starting with the valet and the persons working there helping with our luggage, were very nice.  The attendant at the front desk was very attentive and helpful, as all the staff that work in the hotel  The room and bathroom were very nice and clean and the bed very comfortable.  The restaurants all are real good, Mi Casa, Wuhu Noodles, we tried the shakes at Johnny Rockets that were delicious and the food at the pool was really good too.  Of course we stay a lot of time in the pool and it was delightful.  The water was not too hot not too cold.  Plus they had those chaise lounges in the shallow water, very refreshing.  Plus the attendants there were very helpful and nice.Plus the machines were not that bad and we win some money, did not loose.  We had a great time.  Good ambiance, food and lodging .   I recommend this hotel all the time, give it a 5 stars.

allReviews.title: Not the Silverton I loved
allReviews.text: The Silverton Casino has been our go-to casino for 15 years.  We have loved this place.  On my recent anniversary trip based from a comp we experienced the Silverton with its new renovation.  Rooms are nice. Very cosmetic renovation but nice.  Since I go to gamble this was a disappointment.  Tables didn't open until 11:00am during our visit.  Only one table available for the blackjack I play.  Worse thing that happened was on check out.  I had 3 line items but was charge $50 more then what that added up to.  Strangest thing I every saw.  Anyway Credit Card company took care of it.  Stay away for now.

allReviews.title: Excellent experience! The hospitality is phenomenal. Every one really enjoys their careers here, it’s very apparent!!!!!
allReviews.text: Excellent experience! The hospitality is phenomenal. Every one really enjoys their careers here, it’s very apparent!!!!!

allReviews.title: Great vacation spot
allReviews.text: Comfortable, quiet, pool is wonderful , great location. Convenient to airport though shuttle doesn’t run for early morning flights. Restaurants at casino are great with generous portions. Free parking and plenty of parking. Great option for off the strip.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel and casino in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The bed linens and pillows are exceptionally comfortable.  The newly renovated  rooms and whole building is very clean and beautiful.  The award winning resturants and casino are top notch, clean and friendly.  The new pool and cabanas are so nice, you don't need to go anywhere else!

allReviews.title: HOMELY FRIENDLINESS COMFORT
allReviews.text: Wow going to the Silverton is like going to see family.  Hi everyone this is Vegas Fletch and I was in the Silverton and I went to the Sundance grill before playing.  I've been going there since the place opened.  Great location  3333 Blue Diamond.

allReviews.title: A pleasant hotel and great staff
allReviews.text: We didn't actually stay here but we called in to get a taxi here and have a look at the aquarium. A huge tank with lots of fish and has seating where we're sat down had a nice cool drink and watched the fish swim by  very relaxing  and cool down from the heat outside.There's a huge bass pro shop great to walk around . Customer service was great in showing us where to get a taxi from and the real reason I am writing this is the 2 valet guys . They were fantastic,they  chatted to us and shared their huge knowledge of las vegas with us and we sharing our irish sporting knowledge of hurling with them  till our taxi arrived . They were great which speaks volumes of the hotel and all the other staff too . Thanks guys

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Our experience at the Silverton was great!  It was very clean, friendly staff and really nice pool area called the Swimming Hole. We enjoyed the nightly mermaid show and they have a good selection of restaurants.  When in Las Vegas, we will definitely return and we highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Perfect for us
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel. It is beautifully decorated. Our room was perfect. Again, loved the decor, the bed and bedding couldn’t have been better. We were on main floor which also was perfect. It was quiet and so close to the ‘action’. Only complaint is the toilet paper, a little rough on the bum.Pool was gorgeous! Very resort like. The casino was great. $5.00 blackjack tables were perfect for us that are not willing to blow our life savings on poker. An improvement in dealers attitudes would have kept us at the tables a little longer. Their attitudes were a little off putting, kinda crabby. Bars are plentiful and service was good.Loved being off the strip. This will be our go to in Vegas from now on!We are an older couple not into crazy partying and blasting music. It was perfect.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!!
allReviews.text: The room renovations are fabulous!  Very modern bathroom with large walk-in shower.  Very clean and spacious room with a comfy bed, fridge with a glass door, and nice coffee bar neatly hidden in the clothes armoire.  The pool area is fantastic with lots of lounge chairs.  I will definitely again!!

allReviews.title: Weekend stay
allReviews.text: Stayed at Silverton for the weekend . It was the best . Really clean . Price was good . Staff was super nice . Wasn’t crowed like on the strip . Will definitely be coming back . Family oriented as . Bass pro shop next door was an added plus . The store was really clean as  well .

allReviews.title: Don't miss out on the Silverton Hotel.
allReviews.text: This is a great hotel to stay in off the Las Vegas Strip. The hotel was very clean staff was very friendly. There were several restaurants inside the hotel and right outside adjacent. The pool was great it had music a bar also a huge TV screen. The mermaid display was superb. The bar and grill Inside the Hotel at excellent entertainment at night. I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: We had an amazing time!
allReviews.text: The rooms are so nice and are also very clean which I appreciate since I do bring my kids and grandkids, the pool is warm, clean, and very kid friendly! The casino and restaurants were amazing, honestly everything was great, the front desk supervisor that helped us was really nice and the staff was so friendly.

allReviews.title: Pleasant Stay
allReviews.text: This place just recently renovated less than a year ago. Nice and clean and the front desk staff were very helpful. Our family always try to check out this place first and see if they have the availability before elsewhere. Will definitely stay here again. Thank you Silverton! See you soon!

allReviews.title: Awesome stay at the remodel  Silverton Hotel and casino.
allReviews.text: Just walking in and be greeted by the front desk with I smile I knew it was gonna ge a good weekend, had stayed in other hotels on the strip but they’re always too crowded that’s why we decided to try Silverton, we were not disappointed, in fact we ate at their restaurants and the food was yummy!! We didn’t even have to go anywhere else.

allReviews.title: The Silverton exceeds expectations
allReviews.text: The Silverton Hotel is truly Las Vegas hidden gem. Everything from the rooms to the Casino, Silverton Hotel is A+. Also, the staff does a great job at making you feel like family. The Sportsbook is top notch. The table games are exciting and well-maintained, offering a great variety for all types of players. The staff is knowledgeable, and always willing to assist, making the gaming experience even more enjoyable. Moreover, the pool area at the Silverton Hotel is a real oasis in the desert. The pool employees are attentive and ensured me and my family was taking care of while having a relaxing time by the pool. Their excellent service adds to my overall experience.Overall, the Silverton Hotel is my forever hotel in Las Vegas. I get everything I would at every other casino but without the large crowds and chaos. You have to give it a try for your next visit to Sin City.

allReviews.title: I was charged a "Resort Fee" that was not disclosed.
allReviews.text: I was charged a "Resort Fee" that was not disclosed.  When I got to the check in desk they said I could not check in until I paid a resort fee.  I complained that this wasn't disclosed.  They said that was because I booked through a third party.  I believe they should insist the third parties disclose the fee.  The "resort fee" is for things most hotels provide such as a coffee machine in the room & WIFI.  The WIFI was not working.

allReviews.title: We can't wait to return to the silverton. Front counter staff was very helpful. Got signed into my room early.
allReviews.text: We can't wait to return to the silverton. Front counter staff was very helpful. Got signed into my room early.

allReviews.title: Relaxing and Fun
allReviews.text: Right from the time we landed. Courtesy, Luxury Vehicle/Shuttle pick up and drop off back to the airport.Front Desk, Belinda and Staff were amazing and friendly!Casino/Resort/Swimming area was clean and the Different Food options were delicious.  Had a Blast!

allReviews.title: Best place to be in Vegas!!!
allReviews.text: Best beds in Vegas!! Beautiful pool beautiful!  Love the remodel!! Exceptional!!  Food in every venue was top notch! Staff was excellent in every area of Hotel & Casino.  We were there 4 nights and extended 4 nights due to the Global shutdown and everyone was so accommodating to us  just amazing! We can’t express enough how wonderful the Silverton Hotel Casino is just AWESOME!   Thank you and this is my new favorite place to be in Vegas!!

allReviews.title: Friendly staff makes all the difference at the Silverton Casino & Lodge
allReviews.text: First time stay for us at the Silverton Casino & Lodge in South Las Vegas was very relaxing. The Strip was congested and roads were blocked in prep for the up-coming Formula One event - so we welcomed the off-Strip calm at the Silverton. My wife maintains several salt-water aquariums at home so she was mesmerized by the aquarium inside the Casino at the entrance to the Pro Bass Shop. The odd combination actually works - taking a break from the casino games to shop in the Pro Bass store adds to the fun for all ages. The staff - from housekeeping to the table games - are all customer-focused and treat you with kindness and respect. My blackjack dealer was actually apologetic when she would pull off an incredible draw of 21 to beat my 20...LOL. And you know what they say about slots: The further away from the Strip you get, the higher the RTP rate. I can vouch for that!UPDATE: July 26 2024We returned to the Silverton for another enjoyable stay...in spite of the 100+ degree blazing hot weather. Thank goodness the AC at the Silverton was handling the heat without a problem. The only "heat" we experienced was at the slot machines: I was able to walk-away with enough of a profit to pay for my wife's new laptop!  So, all in all, just another fun stay at the Silverton.  We don't miss the Strip at all!

allReviews.title: Love Silverton
allReviews.text: Highly, highly recommend as a Vegas local if you want to stay off the strip but be close enough. Warning though the smoke smell is very strong here. Always enough parking. Machines are good. Restaurants are good. If my family wants to take a staycation, this is where we go!

allReviews.title: I love Silverton
allReviews.text: Conveniently located, good parking space, excellent casino host, excellent food options. Excellent stuff, More perks for clients, more promotions to get you playing. I've been to several casinos but I have made Silverton my home because they take care of me

allReviews.title: Amazing time at Silverton.
allReviews.text: Silverton is an amazing place. Love the new pool. The rooms are clean and new. Silverton has always been one of my favorite places to stay when visiting Las Vegas. The restaurants are amazing. If you like Mexican  or sushi, this is the spot. And the all American breakfast at the Grill is good way to start your day.

allReviews.title: Amazing staff and hotel - highly recommend!!!
allReviews.text: Great location, really pleasant atmosphere, good food/service and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a great place and experience to stay...was the staff. Everyone was so incredibly kind, gracious, helpful and patient with their time. My parents who are elderly, had an amazing time and under the circumstances [no AC at their home, with sweltering heat] one of the nicest places they've stayed in many years. I can not thank you enough!!!! [Review post coming from their daughter who lives in a different state and had minutes to make arrangements before heat exhaustion set in.

allReviews.title: The best place to stay.
allReviews.text: The best place to stay.  It's off strip, and that's not a bad thing.  I prefer it.Free parking, no traffic, great internal variety of restaurants to choose from, very accessible to outer fast food, and gas stations, etc...They seem to care more than other hotels.  Everyone, from the front desk, to everyone on the floor/ etc... are very helpful, if you ask anything.I love the fact that I can text any requests, or questions that I have.I've stayed here multiple times, and will continue to keep on coming back every time I come to Vegas...

allReviews.title: Hands down our favorite Hotel and casino
allReviews.text: The bed was the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in.  The machines were hot and Mi Casa was amazing.  This is my fiancé and I’s favorite hotel and casino in Las Vegas hands down.  We had an amazing experience with the new pool.  The weather was hot but the pool was cool and inviting.  I can’t wait to come back to the Silverton!!

allReviews.title: Hidden gem
allReviews.text: The renovations to this hotel are amazing.  Room was very comfortable, spacious and had everything we wanted.  The pool was relaxing and fun.   Staff was attentive and friendly.  The silverton is a great place to have the vegas vibe without the overcrowded craziness of being on the strip

allReviews.title: Hotel away from the strip
allReviews.text: Great rooms, nice amenities and very helpful staff. Overall great experience. They have an upgraded pool. I enjoyed watching a movie on the big screen while i was in the pool.  Their rooms are also remodeled and upgraded. The beds were comfortable and the pillows were soft. The prime rib at Sundance Cafe was delicious and the noodles at Wuhu are fantastic.  I would stay at Silverton again.

allReviews.title: The Silverton Casino Lodge and Pool is a beautiful place!
allReviews.text: The new pool, The Swimming Hole, is beautifully designed. It really is gorgeous. The servers were extremely nice and engaging. I sincerely can't wait to go back! The hotel rooms are large, the beds are comfortable. The Casino has all the latest slot machines. Plus there is a giant aquarium with Mermaids.

allReviews.title: Silverton - Favorite Staycation Spot!
allReviews.text: My family and I decided to do a staycation at the Silverton for the 4th of July weekend. What a wonderful experience. The new look is spectacular! From the perfectly decorated, detailed, comfortable room to the exquisite pool! Our stay was an incredible experience, with excellent customer service from all team members and yummy food at Sundance Grille, Mi Casa, Johnny Rockets, and the Swimmin’ Hole. Silverton you did not disappoint! Can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Great place to get away in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great overall place! Relaxing and great service. Off the strip but easy to get there and enjoy, then get away from the crowds afterwards. Beautiful upgrades to the rooms and pool area. Also, great dining place to go. I recommend for everyone to experience Silverton.

allReviews.title: Best off  the strip accommodation!
allReviews.text: The recently remodeled Silverton hotel/Casino our go to choice for lodging when visiting Las Vegas. The rooms are comfortable, clean and quiet. The staff is always warm and welcoming and service is outstanding. The new pool area is also relaxing and offers food and beverage service. It’s always nice to visit here!

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino is a hidden gem
allReviews.text: Everything from the beautiful rooms and pool, to the friendly front desk staff and bartenders , Silverton is a hidden gem. We will definitely be back! The casino is clean and smells good too! The Mermaids in the Aquarium are amazing! Twin Creeks Steak house was excellent.

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay with delicious food and great gaming
allReviews.text: Beautiful and comfortable rooms as the lodge had a complete renovation last year.  Restaurants serve delicious food and there are fast food restaurants inside the casino: Johnny Rocket's, Wu Hu noodle (restaurant quality Chinese food), and Starbucks.  Also able to walk to Bass Pro shops from within the casino. The casino is spacious, has a cozy feel with subdued lighting and numerous slot machines to keep you entertained.  Video poker is very good too.  Free parking.  This is a place to stay to get away from the noise and crowd of the strip casinos.  I am usually a downtown patron but Silverton casino is a better value.

allReviews.title: Highly recommended
allReviews.text: The best resort hotel so far for when staying in Las Vegas...rooms are newly renovated..staff are friendly and most of all the casino floor is very clean plus machines are very generous.  My 2nd time to book my stay here and will always come back.

allReviews.title: Great Place for family
allReviews.text: First trip to vegas with the family in a while and wanted to stay away from the strip. Absolutely happy we stayed here. New renovated rooms looked great, Sundance grill food was good, the new pool was amazing, staff and service was great. Kids loved the mermaids and Bass pro shop, we will be returning.

allReviews.title: Fathers day! Well spent with Family
allReviews.text: Room are spacious and beds are comfortable. Celebrated fathers day at the casino and well spent with the family. Food at the pool restaurant are delicious and affordable. All staff are very friendly and we are able to communicate properly with whatever our needs.

allReviews.title: Silverton Resort and Casino has been our best choice compared with some hotels and casinos we stayed before.
allReviews.text: Silverton Resort and Casino has been our best choice compared with some hotels and casinos we stayed before.

allReviews.title: Amazing experience. Had such a great time.
allReviews.text: Had the best overall experience ever. Casino floor awesome, pool was fun, pool staff amazing. Rooms are beautiful. Can’t wait to go back. We rented a cabana and it was perfect. The food and drinks were great, and a great value. All the staff was so friendly.

allReviews.title: A hidden gem!
allReviews.text: The room are comfortable and beautifully decorated.  The pool area was lovely.  Can't wait to stay again!  All the staff was welcoming and helpful.  The food in the cafe was excellent and the wait staff was friendly and prompt.  I like staying off the strip and away from all that hustle and bustle.

allReviews.title: Excellent get away
allReviews.text: Excellent place to go everybody is very nice excellent food and really nice Hotel very clean and the pool is very nice highly recommended make sure to check the Acuarios great place to take the kids so they can enjoy the mermaid show the Casino is clean and a good variety of Slots

allReviews.title: Minnesota Couple Vegas Often
allReviews.text: The new remodel has really refreshed the hotel. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful, perks are the best and we love the great choices in slots. Some of their penny slots we do not find in other casinos and the video poker is the best!

allReviews.title: Father's Day trip.
allReviews.text: We've visited for over 10 years. We just did a Father's Day trip for 2 nights and a pool day. The hotel and pool remodel are fantastic. Normally we would go out to Fremont or the strip but this trip we spent all our time at the Silverton. The property, staff  and food choices made for no reason to leave. Definitely a resort feeling!

allReviews.title: The best kept secret on the strip!
allReviews.text: This resort is a gem in the rough. The grounds and location were perfect. Near shopping and highway, easy to get around town.The facility itself was awesome, casino filled with great restaurants and connected to a bass pro shop that is like a museum. The room was warm and comfortable and had a cowboy vibe, it was great. The pool was beautiful and set up perfectly. The bar was inviting and THE BIG SCREEN TV WOW, I watched the hockey playoffs in the pool while enjoying my scotch! Great place cannot wait to come back and we do twice a year.

allReviews.title: Greatest hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: I had the greatest visit at the SilvertonLodge. My room was the best room I've ever stayed in . In Vegas period  I'm sure there may be others but Silverton lodge will always be my choice hands down. Also the pool was nice and clean and relaxing...

allReviews.title: My first visit to Silverton Lodge
allReviews.text: From the start, the friendly hotel check-in staff made me feel comfortable and welcome. My room had a delightful pool view and the beds were extremely comfy. I dined at 4 establishments in Silverton and the food and  service was excellent in each. Check out the sushi rolls and chile rellano  in Sushi Casa!

allReviews.title: One of the Best place to stay!
allReviews.text: This place is awesome! If you don’t want the traffic and chaos of the strip, this is the best place to go! Newly renovated rooms and a sparkling pool! A lot of activities to do in this place. With lots of loose machines! Restaurants are affordable and serve delicious food!

allReviews.title: GREAT stay, will return and recommend
allReviews.text: From the moment we walked into the Silverton, we were treated so kindly, felt they appreciated our business and went out of there way to offer guidance etc. off the strip about 10 minutes by car. We did not see much of surrounding area as our focus was relaxing n casino time after strip stay ( park mgm, see other review) and sight seeing to Grand Canyon, art 66, red rock etc. This resort was great and we chose it based off other reviews. I concur, book it! The resort was spotless, the staff Excellent from check in to wait staff to pool staff, bar staff, rewards/cashiers. Everyone was Happy to interact with guests. There are multiple restaurants within the resort ( we ate at Japanese/very good, Mexican Excellent, diner style, good food but too slow on service both times). There are other eats as well. The game play/slots were Very Good as I did limited tables, can’t comment on that. They offered various ( much appreciated) comps ( like 50 off meal, free slot play/free table bet). and even daily specials. I do wish there were More kiosks to check as one needs to use kiosk rather than at the slot to get some comps/extras. We saw security walking  inside, outside and felt safe and looked after. Must use room key to get into hotel area, pool area, and within elevators. The room was spotless, took a basic room no upgrade views and it was perfect for us. Coffee/fridge/closet/safe/drawers chair/table. Loved the decor/theme, the hall was a bit darker with tin ceiling but so cool.  Great decorator Chairs by elevators! The Huge aquarium with mermaid show was a nice view and fun to watch mermaid. Bass pro attached ( which we frequent) but having a great time in casino/pool, never even entered it!  The Pool area is beautiful and No crazy fee for big beautiful thick cushioned loungers with umbrellas!  The outdoor bar, drink specials, entire pool area, even had  water bottle filling station, spotless area and spotless well equipped bathrooms. The pool staff was Excellent! There is a food/drink menu.  They offer shuttle to airport which is about 10 minutes door to door. Great Stay and we will likely return. It was peaceful to be away from the hectic strip and greatly enjoyed our stay at Silverton Casino Resort!

allReviews.title: Best Deal in Town
allReviews.text: The best deal in town, if one plays. Better comps here than we got at others in Las Vegas. No heavy traffic to deal with and easy parking. The remodel was fantastic.
