The pool is just right, did not use this trip, but will be back in July. Food options are really good, WuHu is still good as always. The food in the Sundance is so good too, the chefs do a really good job. My brother in law loves the pizza. I must say it is as good as any place, and Sundance is not even a Pizzeria. We may not always win but the machines do pay.

allReviews.title: The Silverton Western-Themed Resort was a great place to stay, play, and relax
allReviews.text: We have played penny slots and card tables numerous times before at the Silverton on our trips to Las Vegas. When we heard the Silverton Hotel was renovated into a boutique type hotel, we jumped at the chance to stay.  We were happy we did.  Every detail had a western flair, and the decor was just right. Everything was comfortable and, at the same time, classy.Staff members were friendly and helpful. The swimming pool area was very well done with fire pit conversation areas and plenty of seating and shade.  Lounge chairs were thickly padded, and towels were easily accessible.The location is ideal for those who don't want to be in the crowds up north on the strip.  This southern strip location still has everything to offer.   The Silverton boasts a really huge casino, several restaurants and bars, fast food outlets, a gift shop, and a  beautiful,  unique tubular fish aquarium where mermaids swim among dozens of fish to the delight of young and old alike.  There are shows with various original entertainers and those who sing and play just like original artists.  There is an enormous Bass Pro Shop attached with great decor as well.  The parking garage is very large, with ample parking to handle various special events for sure. Overall, it was a fun and relaxing place to stay, convenient without all the noise and crazy crowds.

allReviews.title: WOW! Seriously BLOWN AWAY!
allReviews.text: WOW! My little family of three was BLOWN AWAY by the Silverton. The immense attention to detail is top notch, to a level I haven’t seen in Las Vegas in years. Remember when you were able to go to Vegas and there were tiny little perks that just amplified your whole trip? Look no further than the Silverton: free wine tasting (generous pours) upon checking in, $2.50 draft beers in casino bars ALL DAY, and free coffee service from 8-10am at the pool! And THE POOL-talk about luxury- clean, ample lounge chairs, huge TV that hangs over a stellar bar (shows movies Tuesday nights!) and again-attention to detail: the pillows at the pool even say, “Tan Your Hide!” It’s all just SO well done, cohesive, clean & chic. The pool has sun loungers IN the pool, too. The beds in the room are seriously comfy & the Western meets Vegas theme of the room is fun and tastefully done with just enough camp without going overboard. The curtains are BLACKOUT for some serious sleeping in & relaxation (like seriously-no detail was left undone). Great Starbucks down in the casino & WuHu Noodles was some of the best Asian food I’ve ever had. DoNOT sleep on the Silverton because it is “off the strip.” You will NOT be disappointed staying here & the strip is a cab drive away. Go, go, go!

allReviews.title: BEST HOTEL IN VEGAS
allReviews.text: The Silverton is home.  The staff is amongst the friendliest we have encountered. No need to leave the facility, they have it all !  Super good dining choices, Starbucks, Johnny rockets, sushi, cafe, grill ... all are amazing and easy.  The new rooms are quite comfortable and nicely decorated, the new pool is amazing.  Can't wait for our next trip!

allReviews.title: Worth the stay!
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Rooms were beautiful and the staff made our stay enjoyable. Food was excellent. Casino has lots of new machines!! Pool was great with 4 huge screen TV's and poolside service was a plus. Our stay finished up with entertainment from the Power of Love Band! Had a blast!

allReviews.title: Relaxing Resort Value
allReviews.text: incredible remodel. As a business traveler I look for ways to make my time away from home and family the best possible experience. I want easy, comfortable and enjoyable. Silverton checks all the boxes. Start with not walking miles between parking and getting to your room, or no hassle check in and out. The latest in Room amenities with AC that truly cools the larger rooms, and a Big TV that includes my streaming choices. Add to that never having to leave the property because it has everything you need including great restaurant choices with prices that are very affordable. The Sundance restaurant staff is always amazing at making you feel like you’re an old friend. Starbucks inside the lobby that even lets me order ahead. Entertainment is always available or I relax by walking through the Bass Pro shop or get lost staring into the aquarium as I eat my Jonny rocket burger I got just a few steps away. I didn’t go in the water but had to check out the complete pool remodel. Definitely an outdoor oasis with details that include phone charging stations and an outdoor audio system that somehow blends in to deliver amazing sound quality with balance and clarity.A location that’s not jammed in the middle of a convoluted transient mess. Getting away from the strip hustle and filth makes it truly a Resort style feeling. Being Surrounded by people that seem to be enjoying that same vibe helps build what separates it from the hype of other properties that tend to be hit or miss. I’ve tried the others and they just aren’t able to deliver the total experience I want. Why it’s my first choice: Relaxing, Staff, beautiful facility, clean, easy, safe environment with everything you need at a good value. It just adds up to make the difference over the normalize craziness that seems to be attached to other options.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem Off The Strip
allReviews.text: This hotel is the cutest little hidden gem resort. Off the strip and feels like a boutique hotel! Rooms are decorated so cute with much attention to detail, very cowboy chic. The rooms are very clean with luxury bedding. I don’t believe I will ever stay anywhere else when coming to Vegas. It’s a super easy Uber to the strip when necessary. The casino is super clean and new feeling and you can’t even tell people smoke in it. Every staff member we dealt with was amazing from booking over the phone, checking in, the server at the restaurant, even the players club cashier; all extremely friendly and helpful. Also, they may have the best steakhouse I’ve ever eaten at if you want to feel a bit bougie!We will be back! We want to try out the swimming hole!!!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay and play!!
allReviews.text: The remodeled rooms are beautiful. The remodeled pool area is amazing. Bar tenders and servers in the pool area were friendly yet professional while providing excellent service. Husband and I rented a cabana one day and received outstanding card and service. Staff members at this casino/hotel provide excellent service while being friendly and helpful no matter their position. Valet and bell cap service is great. Would recommend this hotel/casino to anyone. We have stayed here many times over the years and will continue to do so!!

allReviews.title: I would definitely come again definitely got my money's worth highly recommend this hotel
allReviews.text: Customer service was awesome hotel was beautiful rooms were clean and nicely decorated and housekeeping was honest got my items back that I had left there The aquarium is absolutely gorgeous valet parking very helpful help us get a taxi to where we wanted to go

allReviews.title: Silverton Casino Lodge, My number one choice in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Our 2024 Marine Corps Officer three-night reunion was a wonderful experience. I've been a guest at the Silverton Casino Lodge many times. This time it was the best. Newly refurbished rooms. Extremely polite and efficient staff. Maria for room service, Kelly in the restaurant, and the check-in desk help. And the Bass Pro Shop attached was handy for gift purchases.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas drstination
allReviews.text: We always have a great experience when staying at Silverton. The remodeled hotel rooms are always clean and comfortable, the food at the restaurants is delicious, the Casino is fun, and the remodeled pool area is wonderful and relaxing.  Finally, the service is 1st class in all areas.  Highly recommended by us as a destination when in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Jarhead13
allReviews.text: Everything is first rate in every respect. No leaf unturned!! Everyone went out of their  way to make everything enjoyable. The boat ride was great. Ed Roski and his entire staff made it a memorable stay!  I hope the decision is made to have it staged again in two years!

allReviews.title: Hit the Jackpot with this Casino Lodge!
allReviews.text: We were looking for accommodations off the strip as we are honestly not big Las Vegas fans! I booked this casino based on good reviews and we were not disappointed. The location was convenient right off the freeway. And there were lots of good amenities nearby. The check-in staff was most accommodating and very friendly. We were on the main floor and I was worried that there would be noise. I needn’t have worried. We didn’t hear a sound all night. The beds were comfortable and the linens were lovely. We consequently booked immediately for our road trip return! Convenient parking. I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Family Time!
allReviews.text: I ❤️ Silverton! Family members came for the first time. We had a beautiful room, the Twin Creeks experience was fantastic. I enjoy every time I visit, all staff is great! Chris in the giftshop is alway wonderful! 👍I share with everyone about my adventures at the Silverton!!!

allReviews.title: Very awesome experience
allReviews.text: Very clean and organized room. The front desk staff are friendly and courteous. The host manager helped me go thru my reservation with a lot of patience and support.  Many thanks to Miriam for all her unending help. And also to Lori, the front desk staff for her so being friendly and very knowleable in her job. She assisted me on my check out process painlessly.

allReviews.title: Stay at Silverton Resort
allReviews.text: One of the best hotel experiences I've ever had.  The room was gorgeous and super clean, the bed was comfortable,  the Casino was well organized and clean, there are many restaurants to choose from, the pool and area were clean, and the people that worked there were helpful and friendly.  My husband and I can't wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Just wonderful!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: I love the Silverton, I feel they always make me feel so special, it is my favorite get away place to go❣️ The Silverton has everything you need & is friendly and welcoming!!!!!!   From valet to the entire staff of employees!!Great place to spend your time, wether a local or a visitor from out of town….I never return home disappointed with my visits to the Silverton ❣️👵🏻❣️

allReviews.title: a good place you are looking for
allReviews.text: The hotel is very nice and friendly. the rooms excellent. the pillows were so fluffy and a few more than we usually use, my husband wanted to find the same pillows for home. This was a very pleasant trip . The room was excellent and  I requested an ADA room.I was able to get around fairly qell

allReviews.title: Very comfy but beware of add on
allReviews.text: Difficult to find.  The high rise with 'Silverton' on the roof is not the Silverton.  I know, right?  The entrance to the hotel, which is a four story, is around back.  The staff was very friendly and the room was very comfy except, the mattresses had no edge support.  The pillows were wonderful.  I wish I could buy one.  The pool area was very clean and again, very friendly staff.  My complaint is:  my reservation confirmation from Silverton had a total price (yes, it states 'total price') that includes the room rate and tax but the receipt at check out was about $40 more because they don't add the 'resort fee' to the 'total price' until it's time to check out.  The receipt indicates the resort fee is 'automatic' but the confirmation does not.  It should be included to the total price so that shoppers may compare true total prices with other hotels.

allReviews.title: Reunion
allReviews.text: Silverton is outstanding in all regards...amenities, gambling, dining, cleanliness, friendliness of staff, amazing aquarium, and overall service from check-in to departure.  During a three day reunion of over 100 colleagues with wives, the SCL treated us in exemplary fashion, bringing in special Polynesian entertainment with SCL providing an amazing pool-side luau, and ending with a superb formal dinner and beautifully decorated venue.  We highly recommend SCL, for its superb professional service, its friendliness, its beautiful casino, its cost, and its location close to but a quiet couple miles away from the hubbub and noice of Las Vegas Strip.  You will be delighted with the Silverton...enjoy.

allReviews.title: An great place to stay with no unpleasant surprises
allReviews.text: Really a great time from the moment we got there. Checkin was easy, redecorated and renovated rooms are very nice, everyone from waiters in restaurants to people working the bars were extremely sweet and efficient. Very happy to be going back in about a month.

allReviews.title: This is an updated and luxe resort at moderate cost.
allReviews.text: Two night respite away fromThe strip in this lovely resort. Pretty pool, nice and updated room, the whole place is beautiful. Service is friendly, and non-pushy. Loved the stay, you will too. They have good food and are within walking distance of Cracker Barrel.

allReviews.title: One night was enough to make an impression
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful hotel. The renovations are gorgeous, fabulous theme, modern but traditional. The room was a great size, absolutely gorgeous decor! The bathroom was soooooo beautiful. Tons of storage, lovely little extras, coffee machine with proper cups, free bottles of water and glasses to drink from. Staff were welcoming, professional, attentive and overall great. Lovely stay here.

allReviews.title: Great Place to relax
allReviews.text: I just love the Silverton Casino.  The staff is very friendly and the rooms are spacious, quiet and very clean.  All the restaurants are excellent.  You won't have a bad meal at any of their restaurants. I love room service, so we ordered in, and the presentation was great. The coffee was hot and delicious, as well as my eggs and pancakes.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay and play in Las Vegas hands down
allReviews.text: The rooms were amazing and the food was outstanding and the casino was really fun and were able to play all night with our free play and not breaking the bank like the bigger casinos. We loved going to the pool and all of the employees were awesome. It’s a must visit again in the very near future and my wife and I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Relaxing, uncrowded vacation for Mothers Day
allReviews.text: Just did a nice renovation, didn't go swimming but the pool area was really nice. At at their Steak house and dinner was fabulous and tasty. Big portions! We were staying on the Strip and left for 1 night to do something different for Mothers Day.

allReviews.title: Perfect stay
allReviews.text: Love this hotel! The rooms are beautifully renovated and we loved the pool. Water is perfect temperature and lounges are so nice, in and out of pool. I would go back for the pot roast at the sundance grill. The drink girl came around regularly at the casino. We also love shopping at the bass pro shop there. It was great to be picked up by their airport shuttle as well. Will definitely be back. Caren

allReviews.title: Silverton Casino need we say more!!
allReviews.text: We love the Silverton Casino and the entire staff. The manager, reservations , housekeeping, Starbucks, the valet are top notch!! They are professional, they are friendly and always willing to go beyond expectations to make your stay a memorable one. The players club, the restaurants make sure you leave happy. Housekeeping does an exceptional job. Rooms look very clean and inviting. If they see you in the hallway, they asked you if you need anything there’s something they miss. Please let them know. They truly care.. absolutely love the mermaids, to see the smile and happiness of the children is priceless!! The Swimmin Hole is awesome!!

allReviews.title: Clean, comfortable and stylish
allReviews.text: Accommodation is next level, it was clean, comfortable and very beautiful. Well designed rooms, with great wall art. The pool area was amazing, very comfortable and plenty of chairs and lounges.From check in to check out, we had a wonderful experience.

allReviews.title: The Best of the Best
allReviews.text: My husband and I truly enjoy the Silverton over any other hotel casino in Vegas. It’s beautiful and has the giant mermaid fish tank and we enjoy Mi Casa Su Casa restaurant and the Sundance Grill too. Twin Creeks is exceptional if you can afford it! They are very good to us for being loyal and we try to take advantage whenever we can. Recently we experienced their brand new 10 million pool renovation and it was amazing!!!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay.
allReviews.text: The room was comfortable and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The casino has a good varity of games and the restaurants are very good "especially The Sundance Grill". The pool is conviently located near the rooms. Will definately stay here again.

allReviews.title: Absolutely a place to go. Perfect
allReviews.text: It was amazing. What a beutiful hotel and casino. Beutiful rooms with perfect beds, coffeemaker, fridge and safe. During our stay there was the reopening of the amazing pool. Wow what a luxery. You feel yourselfe for a moment a millionaire. The check in was perfect and the employees were very friendly. Absolutely a place to go.

allReviews.title: Newly remodeled but the customer service was outstanding!
allReviews.text: Newly remodeled, The Silverton Lodge boosts a Country/Western theme.  I actually am a timeshare owner across the street at the Berkley, so going in and out of the Silverton for drinks and food is not unusual but this was the first time I actually goot a chance to stay as a guest. We only stayed for 2 nights, but every person we interacted with was so friendly, helpful, and charismatic. Upon checking in (her name was the only one I forgot🤦‍♀️) she was very sweet, full of smiles, and her friendliness was a ray of sunshine after an exhausting flight. Our luggage was scooped up by the valet for luggage service  and he gently guided me to my room showing in great detail how to access the hotel side while pointing out the areas where other amenities such as the pool and work out room were at. He could have just taken our bags to the room, but he went above and beyond. Poolside - renovations were beautiful! Loved the cabanas, fire pits and large screen above the bar. The towel guy, Douglas was the NICEST guy!! So attentive and Jada, our waitress at the pool was great!! The firecracker shrimp was on point! (Per, Jada's recommendation) Douglas gave us a quick detailed tour of the pool area and suggested dinner poolside. 👍👍👍 Bueno!We stopped at Sundance grill for some dessert. Couldn't make up my mind between Gelato or Strawberry Shortcake...wth, I got both! 🤪 (Don't judge, I'm on Vacation!)  One of the servers - Chris asked us what we wanted to drink, we said we were here just for dessert so we were just going to have water. He then proceeded to ask us if we wanted the "diet" water or regular water with the lemon. 😂🤣   Our waiter, Christian  joined in on the hijinks. These guys had jokes for days. What an awesome crew all across the board! From check in till the time we left, our short couple if days was fantastic! Great job! I will be sure to be back again!!

allReviews.title: Suite upgrade was well worth it!
allReviews.text: We've stayed here many times over the years and have always had a pleasant experience. This is our second stay since the hotel was completely renovated and upgraded over the last couple of years. Our first stay (post-remodel) a few months ago was in a standard room, which was very nice, and definitely a pleasant improvement over the original rooms. This trip, we were planning to stay in a standard room, but my wife asked if any upgrades were available and the desk clerk set us up in a two-room suite. The suite was essentially two standard size rooms joined together, where one becomes entirely living space with a small bar area (with sink and fridge), and the bedroom gets a much larger bathroom. The room was outstanding! The living space has a couch and two very comfortable armchairs, a large ottoman that can be shared by all, a 65" TV, large end tables with lamps - and the bar area includes a large table with four chairs. The bedroom includes a King bed, nightstands, dresser, a second 65" TV and a wardrobe, which includes a few small drawers and a safe for valuables. The bathroom is huge and includes a large shower, a large freestanding soaker tub, a large two-sink vanity and a roomy toilet compartment. Everything is still like new and well maintained. We were very comfortable and enjoyed our stay immensely.

allReviews.title: Loved Silverton. Would go back again.
allReviews.text: Great accommodations. Staff throught the hotel and casino were friendly, made you feel welcome. Casino and rooms were clean.  Resteraunts were good, staff warm and friendly. Valet service was great. Great variety of casino games. Loved the location off the strip.

allReviews.title: A jewel in Las Vegas not to be overlooked at all.
allReviews.text: I was very impressed with the entire property.  The incredible restaurants, cleanliness everywhere including the lovely rooms.   I would for sure stay here again as it was a off the loud strip and a delightful experience.    A+++ For sure.   Thank you especially to all of the friendly people that work there and made my stay so enjoyable.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel-casino
allReviews.text: Rooms are great, the gaming fun especially on Seniors and Military appreciation days. Restaurants and food great too.  cabelas attached to casinio and Crackerbarrel in walking distance.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel close to the Gran Canyon.
allReviews.text: Nice hotel close to the Gran Canyon. Very small bathroom. What dragged a lot down was the water in the indoor spa was very dirty, completely cloudy. Outside was nice though and a nice area. The hotel is particularly suitable for children, as various activities. The room was clean, but the window could not be opened, the safe did not work, the TV had no sound and the coffee machine was not ok. Everything was fixed, but not the window. Such things should be checked before new guests arrive.

allReviews.title: Great stay, great hotel, great people!
allReviews.text: From the moment of arrival at valet parking we felt the love. Our luggage was handed over to the valets who delivered it to our room as soon as we checked in. The staff at check in were friendly, helpful and quick about their business, but took the time to answer any questions we had.  Rooms are secure behind doors that required passkey to enter and the first floor room we got was clean and cozy. Air control was easy to adjust. Bathrooms and amenities were very nice and room decor was also very nice!  Pool area was just opening the weekend of our arrival and it was a beautiful oasis!   Overall stay was so nice. Plenty of restaurants and the casino is nice. Even a beautiful aquarium tank with mermaid included!  Also a Bass Pro Shop attached, which we thoroughly enjoyed perusing.  We so enjoyed our stay!!!

allReviews.title: Very good stay with one downside
allReviews.text: We stayed at this hotel in mid-April. The complex is very nice, quiet and completely renovated. It is essential to rent a car to get to the strip. There you will find a few restaurants, a casino and a great store selling sporting goods and clothing, hunting and fishing at the entrance. The only downside is that the rooms are not cleaned every day. Let me give some advice if you use your bank card to make your purchases: don't take your eyes off it because a smart guy has hacked my account for an amount of €1,400.

allReviews.title: The Best Place Ever
allReviews.text: Rooms are beautiful. Staff are amazing The stay at Silverton Casino Lodge was a 10 out of 10 ! Cant wait to go back ! The new pool opened while we were there so we got to enjoy it !

allReviews.title: Friendly people, great food, and a great place to stay and play!
allReviews.text: I travel to Vegas at least two or three times a year and one place I make sure I visit each trip is The Silverton Casino Lodge. Such a big fan of all the amenities they have to offer. Never a disappointment. The food at the restaurants is amazing, not to mention all the staff, and coziness. The casino has many games to offer. It's a great place to break away from all the craziness on the strip. I love all the renovations as well. My one and only issue I had on my most recent visit was that in the middle of the night, my thermostat seemed to go into lock down and I couldn't adjust it for hours. It was stuck on a hold position and I couldn't use it at all. All the buttons were disabled. So I was sweltering overnight while trying to sleep. I, unfortunately, couldn't get a hold of anyone at the front desk at 3am and had to suffer until it started working again at 10am. It was a smart thermostat controlled by their network, so I was at the mercy of them controlling it. Too much technology in the renovations caused that blip for my trip, but other than that, I would give them five stars!

allReviews.title: Love the Silverton
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean and modern. Check-in was a breeze. The team members were all friendly and helpful. The wine tasting was an added plus. The machines were friendly and paying out quite generously. The pool was out of this world. I would definitely recommend to family and friends.

allReviews.title: Awesome place
allReviews.text: This is my new go to. Silverton is a great place and has a wonderful staff.  Definitely recommend.  You will have a great time!

allReviews.title: The Silverton is Pure Gold
allReviews.text: We love the Silverton for its old-school Vegas charm. The Silverton is the perfect size casino and resort. It is big enough to have everything you want but small enough to feel like a valued guest. Renovated rooms are lovely Thd new pool is one of the best in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Stunning Amazing Lodge feeling
allReviews.text: What can I say. Absolutely AMAZING! the new renos are incredible. We have found our new Vegas spot! The Montana Lodge theme is stunning. As soon as you walk through the door, the water falls and that MASSIVE aquarium, no words! Very reasonable priced for what you are getting. The casino is great, plenty of eats, huge Bass Pro Shop. this is our new go to place.  Can't wait go go back. Only bad, I have to leave, I could live there!

allReviews.title: An Off-Strip gem!
allReviews.text: I had a fantastic time staying at Silverton Hotel and Casino. The newly renovated hotel rooms are cool, tasteful and beautiful.  The hotel staff is friendly, helpful, and professional.  There are terrific restaurant options , and the dealers at the tables are friendly and welcoming.

allReviews.title: New favorite Vegas hotel
allReviews.text: The newly remodeled Silverton is our new favorite stay in Vegas!  Clean, comfortable and excellent customer service.   The steak restaurant was fabulous. I would highly recommend staying here for business or a much needed personal vacation!

allReviews.title: The best of the best!
allReviews.text: If you want to elevate your Vegas experience, I highly recommend the Silverton for your stay. Impeccable service, amenities and restaurants are the best I have experienced!

allReviews.title: The true definition of a high end resort!
allReviews.text: This is an amazing facility with so much to see and lots to do! The aquarium is amazing to see there is also a bar right off the aquarium that has jellyfish! The food options here are plentiful. You will find some thing for everyone to eat. The gaming is great. Lots and lots of slot options. The table games when I went were very reasonable limits. You really don’t need to leave because they even have a gift shop with everything you need. I also visited the fitness center, which was very clean. Very neat with many options for working out. I would highly recommend the resort. It’s not near the hustle and bustle of downtown or even the strip . That’s what made it so enjoyable for me.

allReviews.title: Check out the new rooms
allReviews.text: The remodeled rooms are unbelievable, very cozy feel and comfortable, food is great every place their, and staff 100% for the guests good experience

allReviews.title: Stunning hotel worth every penny
allReviews.text: The suite is stunning and the pool area is looking epic, opens soon around Mother’s Day. You wont regret the suite, this hotel is the epitome of COZY, awesome casino floor and amazing food options. Wow

allReviews.title: Would not recommend.
allReviews.text: On the first night, walking through the hallways of the hotel itself, it smelled like someone took a dump and rubbed it all over the floor. What I didn’t realize was that was apt symbolism for the hotel’s customer service, which was dishonest and tried to gaslight my wife. Would not recommend.

allReviews.title: Bad info from the hotel
allReviews.text: Booked this hotel because I thought it would be a nice place to stay in Vegas with kids, because they were just about to open a beautiful new pool. I called and asked about the pool and was told when we booked months ago that the pool would be open by the time we checked in. A week before we checked in I called JUST to confirm that the pool would be open and was told specifically that there would be a soft opening on April 10 and the pool would be open by April 12, in time for our stay. Wonderful!  When we arrived the pool was CLOSED. I asked what happened and the manager said that those were the dates for the opening in MAY. Then the next day I spoke to her again and was told there is NO date for the opening! I am so upset!! The manager said she would waive only 1 night of the resort fee, and refused to comp a late checkout even though we had to walk far  that morning hey said we could use a pool at a different hotel nearby. Terrible experience.

allReviews.title: My stay at Silverton Casino
allReviews.text: Excellent customer service at front desk ..was very pleased on how the rooms were very clean and beautifully updated.. definitely will stay here again ..and most definitely will be recommending this hotel to our family and friends. can't wait for the new swimming pool area..

allReviews.title: 10 ⭐️’s!!
allReviews.text: Excellent Experience!!Great hotel, Great hospitality! Try the Steakhouse as well. Excellent food & service! The Silverton Casino is like a home away from home. Why go to the big casinos when you can enjoy this hidden gem off the strip!!!!!

allReviews.title: Self Love at its FINEST!!!
allReviews.text: The Silverton has been my Go To spot, for many years now. But this trip was the first time back, since the hotel renovations. And, if I must say so.. they OUT DID THEMSELVES!!!  The rooms were OUTSTANDING,  with the rustic feel. Including all the special  amenities.  Importantly,  the beds were so comfortable.  I woke up, feeling revived!I highly recommend  Sundance Grill restaurant,  the food was cooked to perfection. The chicken wings were DYNAMITE OUT OF SIGHT!!!Looking forward, on my next SELF LOVE TRIP..when the pool renovation is completed.  P.S  I can't forget the Valet and Bellmen department they were PLEASANT and "GOOD SPIRITED"#1

allReviews.title: Best experience
allReviews.text: Rooms were awesome and really clean. The food was excellent in several of their restaurants. The staff went beyond our expectations. I would personally recommend this Hotel/Casino to anyone that expects the best. Price was very reasonable.........

allReviews.title: Great renovation, really cool place
allReviews.text: Really epic renovation, we stayed in one of the new rooms just for a night but it was great - check in staff really helpful and the room was spacious, clean and comfy. The casino floor is really cool and the diner and ice cream place was great. Aquarium is a super cool touch, and this is a great location for a Vegas stay and to explore the state.

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: A wonderful place to stay that is full of fun, dining, and shopping. The rooms were updated but still had a rustic feel and look. It might be off of the strip and away from downtown but it is close to a lot of different attractions. Would definitely stay there again!

allReviews.title: Great for families!
allReviews.text: The beds were very comfortable and the rooms have been beautifully renovated. The employees at the registration desk were extremely friendly and helpful. I ate dinner at Wuhu Noodles which was very tasty, and my grandkids loved their cheeseburger and shake at Johnny  Rockets. Good place for families to stay.

allReviews.title: The best vacation ever.
allReviews.text: This was the best hotel we have stayed in a long time where the beds were comfortable, the pillows were just right, the hotel registration was the best, and booking department made you feel at home they were awesome, all of the restaurants were really good 5 stars, can’t wait to go back in August.

allReviews.title: Great Family friendly stay
allReviews.text: Excellent remodel! Great experience. Felt clean and inviting. We really enjoyed the personalized checkin process and were excited to see the new hotel rooms. We had stayed a few times in the past, but these new renovations made it look like a brand new hotel. Definitely worth the stay. Great food at Mi Casa as well!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Experience at Silverton Casino and Resort
allReviews.text: The resort has had an excellent remodeling. The rooms are spacious and the resort has excellent amenities. Try the Sundance Cafe when you visit, it is superb. The resort is beautiful and close to major attractions. We will definitely return.

allReviews.title: Renovated, Spacious Rooms for Less
allReviews.text: If you want to avoid the hustle and bustle with a spacious room, not crowded casino and excellent food for great prices, stay at the Silverton. We chose to stay here and Uber or drive to the strip as the hotel staff is very personable and makes your stay even better. The hotel is very safe and you never have to worry. The rooms are all renovated and huge!!!! This is our "go-to" hotel in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Silverton is the best!
allReviews.text: Staying there felt like home.  The linens are so nice, I fell asleep instantly!  The newly renovated rooms are 5 star.  The restaurants are awesome.  The Mermaids and aquarium are a must see in Las Vegas.  I can't wait to go back.  Everyone is nice and polite.

allReviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AN HOSTING
allReviews.text: Outstanding hotel! The attention to detail in all aspects including: room security, cleanliness, layout, ease of checking in an out, climate control through out hotel an convenience of eating selections. Most of all the staff! This After staying on the strip an downtown for years we will not miss the panhandlers an constant prodding of everyone trying to make a buck at your expense. The wait staff to the room attendants were so pleasant an happy an refreshing. The machines were loose an we won a few 5 an 6 hundred dollar jackpots on low denomination machines!We are so happy to have Curtis as our host as he is ever present taking care of any needs you have from transportation to an from airport to planing your next trip. Thank you Curtis an to the owner who knows what it takes to host an take care of people!

allReviews.title: Best hotel/ casino in Vegas!!
allReviews.text: Best hotel/ casino in Vegas!!free parking, courteous and caring staff.Close to the strip without worrying about all the crowds, and again, no parking fee's!!$10 mil. renovated pool (opening very soon).  You can also swim in 2 other selected pools nearby.Just like MGM Grand, and all of the other big names on the stirp, without the hefty price tag.They have a huge fish tank, with a mermaid (real human) swimming in it, and 2 motorcycles featured on TV.  Connected to a huge Bass Pro Shop.

allReviews.title: Top notch Hotel/Casino
allReviews.text: Celebrated my birthday with some friends , had a suite with connector for the whole weekend! The whole experience was awesome,  first the remodeled hotel was top notch, from the furniture to the comfortable bed! Great food in all the restaurants, and to top it all, I was a big winner in the casino, sure had a birthday to remember! Thanks Silverton Casino and staff, you made it memorable!!!

allReviews.title: This updated resort is over the top!
allReviews.text: Wow! Amazing resort. Great family place. Beautiful guestrooms. Great service. Free hotel shuttle to and from airport. Very nice dining options with great food and service. Several attractions at hotel-the living aquarium with mermaid shows and Bass Pro wildlife exhibits. Other restaurants within walking distance. The pool area will be outstanding-reno almost complete. Great off-the-strip location. Close to airport. Our event venue at the Veil was superb with great food. Loved the "western lodge" ambiance--just right, not overdone. Comfortable and clean. Coffee bar nice touch in room.

allReviews.title: Luxurious renovated rooms
allReviews.text: The Silverton casino is the best off the strip casino for gambling , rooms and food. The newly renovated rooms are luxurious and you also have a coffee maker in the room, which is a bonus. The casino smells like apples and cinnamon, not smoke. The Silverton casino is a great casino for everyone!!

allReviews.title: Very relaxing stay at the Silverton. It had a nice, calming Southwest vibe
allReviews.text: Room renovation was great. The rooms were functional, cozy and had a very good southwest vibe to them. The lobby, casino floor, and the rest of the hotel grounds had very good atmosphere. Staff were exceptionally friendly and service at both the front desk and valet were excellent.

allReviews.title: WOW!  Remodeled and Fantastic!
allReviews.text: The remodeled rooms are spacious and comfortable.  While the pool are wasn’t finished, it’s looks amazing and we will definitely go back to check it out.  As always,   the casino is clean and the dealers are friendly and helpful.  Food is good.  Would highly recommend as an off-strip stop and stay!

allReviews.title: Awesome  Casino
allReviews.text: I recently went on a stay to Silverton Casino Lodge it was very relaxing and restful stay the food and service was  excellent we did not have a problem at all everyone of the employees was courteous and respectful clean environment very safe I did not have a worry at all off the strip free parking what more can I say

allReviews.title: Memories with my 100 year old Dad.
allReviews.text: My 100 year old father had a wonderful time. The lodge rooms is nicely renovate.Room has refrigerator and coffee maker.The valet and bell desk were very helpful. Registration awesome especially Mei and Belinda.Thank you for all your assistance.

allReviews.title: Good value at Silverton
allReviews.text: Lower table limits than the strip. Nice dealers. Nice progressive draw poker games. New pool opens soon. Gym isn’t much but ok for a hotel.  Overall good value, actually it was comped so great value.  Nothing beats free rooms. Looking forward to the new pool.

allReviews.title: Best hotel Casino off the strip
allReviews.text: The overall atmosphere at Silverton is next to none, optics are one thing but the staff, hosts, dealers etc really treat you like family. The renovations done the last 2 years were strategic and amenities next to none. Hotel rooms modern and high class. There is no other casino in Vegas I got to religiously than Silverton. Oh, and best kept Secret, best sushi in town at Su Casa!

allReviews.title: Silverton Casino Hotel - We loved our stay.  It was a very comfortable stay.
allReviews.text: New remodeled room where we stayed was great, excellent, very clean, roomy.Staff from the Reception Desk up to Housekeeping were very professional, efficient & excellent, very friendly, very courteous.Restaurants are all great & accommodating.  Staff were very polite & efficient.  Food is great.  So many to choose from.Gaming slots were great & many to choose from.

allReviews.title: Quick Family Get Away.
allReviews.text: My HOME away from home is the Silverton Casino Lodge.  I love to stay here mainly because of the Silverton Staff, from Reservations, Management, Porters, Front Desk and Housekeeping.  Everyone here always has a smile on their face and is very helpful.  We've been coming here for over 20 +years.  Even if we're not staying here, we make an effort to do our gambling and dining here.  Silverton, we love the remodel and we're looking forward to the Pool renovation.  Can't wait to take a swim in the watering hole.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel
allReviews.text: Rooms are beautiful, large and clean. Loved the bathroom. Excellent front desk, responsive and friendly. Enjoyed access to the many restaurants, especially Sundance Grill and MI Casa Grill Cantina. Also, we rented an electric car and the hotel/casino free parking garage had  chargers that were also free.

allReviews.title: One of our go to off strip casinos
allReviews.text: Silverton is a quiet comfortable place to stay. The casino has a nice mixture of older slots and a lot of the newer ones.  The restaurants have a good variety with excellent friendly service.  Monthly players perks are outstanding and certainly help at the restaurants.

allReviews.title: Vegas get away
allReviews.text: Excellent place to go to have fun with family really nice rooms variety of restaurants to choose from and really clean the staff is very courteous highly recommended if you want a place to visit and have a great time this is the place to go away from the Strip

allReviews.title: Great Place To Stay!  Beautiful rooms and friendly staff.
allReviews.text: This is our first visit to the Silverton since the rooms were refurbished. The rooms are beautifully designed and thoughtfully planned with the guests in mind. The hotel has all the amenities without being too large and overwhelming. There are plenty of restaurants and a friendly and accommodating staff. The aquarium with live mermaids and the Bass Pro Shop was definitely a plus. I highly recommend the Silverton and will stay here again in the future. The swimming pool was under construction and it appears it will be beautiful when completed. Parking was a breeze with free valet and self-parking.

allReviews.title: Renovated Rooms/Great Cust Service
allReviews.text: Rooms beautifully renovated - very nice! Front desk very helpful! Bellman, Vallet, Shuttle Service extremely friendly & helpful!  Thank you for working with us! Sundance Grill has delicious meals & very friendly & efficient service! We enjoyed our stay!

allReviews.title: I have always enjoyed my stays at Silverton. A super place. Don Rapp
allReviews.text: I have going to Silverton Casino for over 15 years. They recently finished a complete remodel of ALL of their rooms. They were always nice but now are really outstanding. The most friendly staff you will find at any Casino, just delightful. The Sundance Cafe is incredible, great service and Marvelous food. The Casino has a great mix of Games and Slot's.

allReviews.title: Overall fun staycation with husband
allReviews.text: Nice place with beautiful updated rooms.   Mermaid lounge was fun to play a machine and watch the fish go by.  Quick and easy check in.  Mi Casa had great Mexican food.  Bartenders are great and friendly.  Large variety of fun slots that pay as any other casino in town.

allReviews.title: What a great experience! Amazing hotel and casino! A hidden gem for sure!
allReviews.text: I stayed 3 nights and was so amazed at the size and cleanliness of the hotel rooms. The casino is large with many of the newest slot machines. The food in the restaurants was very good. I happened to see the tribute band "Petty Party" at the Veil concert theater, they were extremely good. Everyone was so friendly. I have always stayed downtown on Fremont Street, this is my first time staying south of the airport. There is so much to do and see. The Mermaid Bar was cool with the huge fish tank and the live mermaids was a welcome sight. I have to give a shout out to Feadolphus Curtiss, my casino host that invited me to see his new place. Thank you so much. Customer service is definitely number one for Feadolphus. This will be my number one spot to visit in the future. The Silverton Casino Lodge is building a new pool area that looks like it will be lots of fun to visit when it opens. Awesome place! Can't wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Comfortable friendly Las Vegas experience.
allReviews.text: Off strip location.Free parking.There is a free shuttle to take you to the cacophony of the strip,  if the urge presents.Lodge and Casino staff are helpful, friendly and pleasant. Bedding sheets and comforters were spotless and soft.The facilities are freshly remodeled. My goto place to stay in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Giving your kids an amazing experience without any compromise.
allReviews.text: Everyone should stay and experience the amazing silverton mermaid school. The kids had a blast swimming with the stingrays and getting to dress up and be coach with the best real life mermaid! Not only was the swimming experience a lifetime experience the in depth teaching of the in and outs of the aquarium itself and the amazing fish habitats to feeding schedule. Highly recommend! The hotel is the most classy and family friendly mix. I could take the kids for johnny rockets burger and grab myself some excellent wuho noodles and end the day with the most amazing gelato.

allReviews.title: Friendly and professional staff, newly renovated rooms are comfortable, and just being treated and respected like Ohana
allReviews.text: Friendly and professional staff, newly renovated rooms are comfortable, and just being treated and respected like Ohana

allReviews.title: Rooms are very comfortable and there is even in room coffee. A great place to stay with family
allReviews.text: This is perhaps the cleanest and most friendly casino in Vegas today!. The food and gaming atmosphere are great along with reasonable prices.  I even hit a jackpot over $10,000 during my stay making it even more fantastic. They also have a pool making this the perfect place for a family vacation.

allReviews.title: Just WOW!!!
allReviews.text: Just WOW! The newly remodeled rooms are Glam cowboy spa. Beautiful! With many nice touches. Keurig. Naturally scented bath products and air freshener. Great for us with chemical sensitivities. Step in shower. High end touches everywhere. Check in with Belinda was wonderful! Ate at WooHu and it was sooooo good. Breakfast at Sundance. Great service and food. Shuttle to airport was quick and courteous. This casino/resort is a little off strip with free parking , safe and quiet. Slots were fun. Some old and new. Our definite new place to stay.

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay
allReviews.text: It was better than what i expected.  Felt very secure and the rooms are extremely comfortable.  You can tell they invested heavily in the overall experience of the customer and it shows. I would most certainly recommend and the next time i come to Las Vegas, NV.  This resort will be at the very top of my list!!

allReviews.title: Lynn’s awesome
allReviews.text: Lynn went above and beyond to help us. Thanks Lynn!!  She worked every angle to make sure we were taken care of for getting our reservation completed. She took it upon herself to make sure that all of the problems were resolved, and that we were ultimately able to get checked in.

allReviews.title: Dinsky
allReviews.text: Beautiful decor and very comfortable bed and fluffy pillows, very cleanI slept really good Love it .. I would recommend  my friends definitely to this hotel Excellent customer serviceExcellent food at Wuhu Rest rooms are not hard to find I will definitely go back again Thank you ..

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I love staying at the Silverton Casino.   I used to come and stay here before the remodeling project, and the Casino and Hotel staff were great, very friendly, and helpful.   Now, after the remodeling, it's even better. The rooms are spacious and quiet, and the beds are comfortable and very clean.You can't go wrong eating at any of the restaurants. They all have friendly staff.  My favorite place eat is The Sundance Cafe. It has a big variety of food to choose from and it's all good. They also have a variety of slot machines and table games.The front desk valet and bell hops are also very friendly, and it seems to me that everyone who works here enjoys their job. I didn't meet on person who was not friendly. The entertainment and wine tasting was also great.  The atmosphere here is very calming and homey.So if you want to come to Las Vegas,  but don't want to deal with all the craziness of the strip, head to Silverton Casino Lodge.  You won’t regret it.

allReviews.title: Vegas Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: This hotel is perfect! Everything’s new and customer service is superb!! I’ve stayed 6 times so far!! Beds are so comfortable along with the pillows and comforters. They even have a coffee cupboard that greets you with free Starbucks pods and water!!🤣😍❤️

allReviews.title: Great rooms
allReviews.text: I grew up in Vegas and pretty picky about where I stay. We love everything about the rooms here at the Silverton. The staff are all friendly and say hello and good morning or evening.  We will stay again and highly recommend you stay here. It smells amazing in the halls

allReviews.title: Silverton visit
allReviews.text: Great assortment of Slot machines and great noodles!!! Staff is very friendly and willing to help any time of the day or night ! Rocky , the senior host is excellent! He is attentive to your needs and always willing to help in his capacity,,  luv him!

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: This place is beautiful and their renovation is a huge success.  Probably one of the nicest hotel rooms we have ever stayed in and that includes some 5 stars that were super expensive.  We ate at Mi Casa and the food and service were fantastic.  All the people that work there seems to be really committed to the hotel and casino.  All in our cost for the room with the resort fee was only 140.00.  They also have a huge pool and cabana area under construction that looks like it will be pretty cool.  Supposed to be done in May.  This will be our spot to stay when we go to Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Silverton Visit
allReviews.text: The Silverton has done a nice job renovating their hotel. The hotel feels clean and new, however the bathroom doors are a problem because the doors do not slide well.The hotel has a Pay- snack tray in the room which is activated if moved.   Beware, they will try to charge you for the snacks on your bill, so you need to challenge the bill if they try to charge you for snacks that were never taken.  (We asked them to recheck the room and the snack tray bill was taken off) . The snack tray-Activator is a real problem!!!   The Silverton is a distance from the Las Vegas Strip so it is advised to had a car.  Good Luck in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great hotel reasonably priced
allReviews.text: Hotel has been recently refurbished and the rooms are great. Decent size with all the amenities you would expect including usb charging on bedside tables. Bathroom is beautifully done with lots of bench storage. The hotel does charge a resort fee but parking is free of charge. We self parked but the doorman advised valet was part of the resort fee. The hotel is only 4 levels and located off strip but not too far from everything. We had issues accessing the wifi but was fixed up with help from their IT team. Overall the hotel is very good and very reasonably priced. Would recommend and we would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Relaxing Fun place to Stay❣️
allReviews.text: Silverton Hotel has been completely renovated. It is absolutely gorgeous. They have enacted more safety protocols for entering their hotel rooms and pool. The Staff continues to be very friendly and helpful. Truly recommend staying there.

allReviews.title: Small boutique Hotel with a hometown hey Norm fee.. Clean comfortable rooms.. see The amazing Host Rocky..
allReviews.text: Small boutique Hotel with a hometown hey Norm fee.. Clean comfortable rooms.. see The amazing Host Rocky..

allReviews.title: Wonderful!!!
allReviews.text: The rooms at Silverton are absolutely beautiful and modern.  To say they gave the hotel a face lift is an understatement because they have completely revamped the look and feel to a whole new level of beauty and comfort.  The casino is very clean with many choices of both modern and classic slot machines.  The many choices of food options was also very delightful.  This is now my favorite place to play, stay, and dine!

allReviews.title: Newly remodeled rooms are great
allReviews.text: Spent two nights at the newly remodeled Silverton lodge. The room was small but had everything we needed. Very well appointed. The bed and linens were great. Black out shades on the window. New pool coming this Summer they say. Would stay here again for sure.

allReviews.title: My Stay at Silverton Casino
allReviews.text: Loved the shower & the bed. Overall was a fantastic stay Mermaid Tank was awesome, Bass Pro Shop was really nice also.  The staff at Silverton Casino was great & very.  I hope to stay at resort again!! Please know our experience was only one night!!

allReviews.title: Staycation for Valentines Day
allReviews.text: Had a  Great time at the Silverton Lodge for Valentines Day. The remodeled rooms were well worth the wait while the hotel was closed all those months. Helen Schmidt my host was more than accommodating. Dinner at Twin Peaks Steakhouse was top notch as always and Brandon our server was the best!

allReviews.title: Silverton stay is a success!
allReviews.text: The updated rooms at the Silverton are spacious and well furnished, loved the tile detailing in the bathroom. The staff on property is so friendly - the casino hosts go above and beyond, thank you Rocky! Overall, the property offers a variety of games, dining options and of course...has mermaids.

allReviews.title: “ALL IN “ ATTITUDE!!!!!
allReviews.text: This place is the best kept secret in Vegas, it’s close to so many local restaurants and shopping malls. The new renovations and TOP Notch Twin Creeks Steakhouse are Unmatched forQuality, The people and I mean all the people from the Valet parking staff when you arrive to the time you lay your head down are so darn friendly. If you gamble you can expect a friendly face and attitude asking you if you want a drink every few minutes. I’m very happy to have met Rocky who always makes me feel like I’m always welcomed and really goes over and beyond with his professionalism and kindness. I can go anywhere and I prefer this beautiful place.

allReviews.title: Pays To Be a Silverton Rewards Member
allReviews.text: Always a Clean Awesome Environment. The Staff is There To Serve You. Slot Machines, SportsBetting, Card Tables, Bars and Actual Restaurants Inside The Hotel, So You Don’t Have To Really Go Anywhere Else. The Actual Strip is just a Few Minutes Away. The Rooms Were Just Renovated. Everything was Brand New. Also, I should Include, Being a Rewards Member Really Pays. They have the Best Comps I Ever Seen. I just stood there 3 free nights, $150 in Free Slot Play, $50 Food Vocher and they Invited Me to A Huge Super Bowl party with About 4 Big Huge Screens with Free Food and Drinks. I Really Felt The Love. Me and My Wife Loves It Here and We are already making plans to go again.

allReviews.title: Amazing experience!
allReviews.text: Where do I start, I love this Casino! The experience here is so amazing, rooms are comfortable and very clean. I played table games and had a great time with their dealers. They are extremely friendly and make it fun by interacting with us players. I've dined at the Cafe and MI Casa, the food here is so delicious. I always make sure to order dessert at either spot, super yummy! The Silverton by far is my favorite place to hit the slots! This month alone, I've seen a few jackpot winners, literally right next to me, ugh!!!! I will hit it soon!! Lol. Make sure to get your players card, I was offered 3 nights Super Bowel Weekend  they gave me 2 tickets to the Super Bowel Viewing Party that was off the hook!!! Free food and all you can 🍸 and eat! I made sure I had 2 drinks in my hand the whole night so fun! My friends loved it. I always make sure to visit at least 2x a month, great atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: After closing it’s hotel doors for a year, the newly renovated rooms have seen a significant upgrade from its past. The hotel describes the new look as “Rustic-lux” boutique hotel rooms. This Rustic theme is highlighted at checkin where figurines of cowboy hats, wagons  and horses are displayed on shelves along with rugs on the floor resembling cowhide. Upon checkin you’re provided with one “Wine Time” players chip allowing you to sample (3) wines from 5-7pm. This was a nice jester and very much appreciated. The checkin process was extremely smooth and the staff were very friendly and personable. The room was spacious, clean and had  very rustic cowboy type vibe. The bathroom was nice but I felt the design and color of the tile clashed with the overall theme. The bed was extremely comfortable and free WiFi was available. The fitness center is ample size and was equipped with all the necessary exercise equipment normally found in a hotel. Overall, I thought the renovations were done well and I would definitely recommend you consider booking a stay.

allReviews.title: Great mini-vacation spot
allReviews.text: Stayed Superbowl weekend and it was great. The room was nice and had plenty of space to relax. Twin Creeks Steakhouse was awesome too.  My host, Rocky Brandonisio, took care of everything and I got to enjoy a relaxing mini-vacation.  Great place for an off-strip stay!

allReviews.title: A wonder trip
allReviews.text: The room were  very nice everyone was friendly.  I will continue staying there and will bring friends and family. I received assistance from Rocky who was very professional and nice. Rooms and casino was very very clean. Can not say enough about my stay

allReviews.title: Great remodel
allReviews.text: I love the new remodel. The rooms are so nice and the set up is first class. Our only complaint is the barn doors going into the bathroom stuck and the handle came off. We notified the front desk but nothing was done about it. A little disappointing. Other than that we really enjoyed our stay

allReviews.title: Won't be back
allReviews.text: Disorganized at the front desk and very rude servers.  Clean room - when you eventually get one despite a reservation.  Top notch Valet service!  Mermaid lounge and aquarium were nice.  Darkest casino I've ever been in.  I booked for 2 nights but checked out after 1.

allReviews.title: Freshly remodeled "Cowboy Kitsch"
allReviews.text: The hotel has been completely remodelled. The cowboy motif is a reminder of the past, but without the musky smell of older "Cowboy" themed hotels. There are plenty of outlets, both power and USB, for CPAPs and electronic toys. Nice mini-fridge with glass door, so you don't forget stuff. Only thing missing is a microwave.

allReviews.title: Nice weekend spent !
allReviews.text: The new renovated rooms of the hotel was really nice and clean , and so glad there’s no smoking in the rooms ..and the restaurants we ate at were really good .food taste and service excellent ..and most of all the staff , host were so nice and very accommodating ..and the best part was the invite for the Super Bowl game ..the casino  venue was nice with unli food and drinks …and of course the casino ..love  playing there

allReviews.title: An oasis  in the midst of the superbowl craziness!
allReviews.text: The staff are lovely (thank you Nicole, Taylor and Karen!), the room was large, clean,and well-appointed. The breakfast was yummy and our waiter was delightful. The valets were all super helpful, and special thanks to Kai for shuttling us to the airport and back.

allReviews.title: Comfort and Style!
allReviews.text: This hotel was really NICE! From the time you enter the lobby, to the hotel staff and the rooms are well decorated. The huge aquarium was so relaxing to sit and watch during my dinner in the mermaid lounge and I got to see live mermaids!But the BEDs!! Oh my goodness! I didn’t want to get up they were so incredibly comfortable! I plan to come back for sure!

allReviews.title: Had a Great Time!
allReviews.text: The Silverton Casino and Lodge is fantastic! They have modern clean rooms. The restaurants serve delicious food. The staff, bar service, and drink girls are attentive and super friendly. The gift shop has beautiful souvenirs. There is also an aquarium with divers and mermaids. I’ll be staying here again and checking out their new pool coming soon!

allReviews.title: comfy spot
allReviews.text: The room decor is fun and functional.  They let me get an early check in!  The casino area wasn't overly smokey and I am very sensitive.  Recommend the Sundance restaurant, especially for breakfast.     Easy ride share location too.  Very nice two night stay.

allReviews.title: Must stay hotel
allReviews.text: Absolutely stunning hotel. Brand new western style modern clean refreshing. Amazing bed mirror closet everything was exceeding my expectations. We loved it so much we stayed an extra night! Mermaids swimming restaurants awesome. Guest services very helpful. Bass pro shop was a whole experience. We absolutely will be back in a few months and will only stay here.

allReviews.title: Don’t stay or park there!! Costs you a ton!!!
allReviews.text: Super Bowl and Vegas visitors. Don’t park you car here and go anywhere else for a few hours. The towed a ton of cars in one night. Notice on cars said they would be towed on the 3rd, they were towed on 2nd. This is a scam with the tow company. DO NOT STAY HERE!!! Employees laughed and were no help!! Shame! Shame! Shame!

allReviews.title: Definitely one of favourite stays in Vegas .
allReviews.text: Beautiful remodelled room . The coffee station and fridge  nice and welcome .very comfortable bed.  Lots of restaurants. Nice swimming pool .Casino is not as tight as the ones on the strip. About 15 min by car to the strip. Nice and quiet area.Shopping centre just across the street.Definitely will stay there again.

allReviews.title: The Silverton is absolutely perfect.
allReviews.text: The Silverton Resort is absolutely fantastic. The rooms are luxurious and comfortable. The restaurants have exceptional service and wonderful food. The casino is clean and  well maintained.  The ventilation system is so good that you would never know that there is smoking in the entire casino. I would definitely recommend this resort for your next stay.

allReviews.title: Great location off the strip plenty to do without leaving
allReviews.text: Silverton hotel and casino is a great place off the strip, close to where we needed to be, room was clean and comfortable for us, secure from the rest of the property. Plenty of locations inside to get a bite to eat. Of course a lot of slots and table games!

allReviews.title: Horrible experience
allReviews.text: Terrible hotel to stay at if you’re traveling for business. Worst experience I’ve had in a long time. Ended up asking for a refund after being harassed by security about the parking. Do not book this hotel if you have a vehicle larger than a sedan. They have oversized vehicle parking, but won’t let you use it. Absolutely insane

allReviews.title: Very nice stay
allReviews.text: Highly recommended hotel, recently remodeled, beautiful, clean, smells very good, very good service, every day they do your service, the rooms are very nice as well as the facilities, I would return without thinking about it, the pool is under repair

allReviews.title: Silverton - great off-strip lodging and casino!
allReviews.text: This is a great casino to stay at if you are interested in being away from the crowds on the strip.  There were many dining options - we tried the WuHu Noodle shop, Twin Creeks Steakhouse, and Sundance Grill and all were great - the service at the Steakhouse is top notch.  The rooms were recently renovated - nice and spacious -and we look forward to returning when the pool reno is complete later this Spring.  The gaming floor is huge and the beverage service was outstanding.   Our host Curt was awesome to work with too!  While it is off-strip - the Uber/Lyft to the strip (We took in the Sphere Experience) is reasonable and very quick.   We do wish they would put regular bathroom doors in their rooms (they have these kind of barnyard door sliders which are super neat to look at and go great with their theme - not so great for privacy)

allReviews.title: Great Stay.
allReviews.text: From the valet who greeted me when my taxi arrived to the maid service, everything was exceptional. I plan to stay there the next time I visit Vegas. The bed was so very comfortable. Enjoy the overall stay.

allReviews.title: We love Silverton!
allReviews.text: Always love staying at Silverton. Always clean and welcoming.The staff is friendly and attentive.There are plenty of restaurant options and the quality is always top notch.The upgraded rooms are great.Can’t wait till the new pool area is completed.

allReviews.title: Awesome and relaxing
allReviews.text: This is my favorite place evenmoreso that the rooms have been renovated. You get a cabin,rustic feel in each room.  The slots are loose. They have good food choices and make sure you sign up for a player's card. Silverton is very generous in their comps and you will keep coming back. My drink hostess knows me and keep me hydrated while enjoying my slots. You can't go wrong staying here. Kids are welcome.  So excited for the new pool !!!!

allReviews.title: Next time on the Strip
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and offered a friendly welcome. The view from my room was awful, but everything was there and clean. The location is OK, but Uber/taxi to the Strip is quite expensive!The management is not accommodating at all. I wanted to shorten my booking by a day and since I booked through booking.com, the hotel was very inflexible even though I was still within the time frame of the cancellation-free period allowed by the hotel. It was a disgrace!

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Silverton Casino and lounge. The renovated room was beautiful and quite comfy. The only problem I had, was I didn't notice the coffee maker that was in the wardrobe, which I noticed in some photos online. Other than that I had a great stay and even won a few on the slot machines.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great trip love the new casino and rooms ❤️. The staff is great and very helpful .  When you are in the casino everyone is the best.  Love love love We love to stay at the Silverton because it’s not quite as busy so it’s very nice to be able to just relax and either stay in your room or play in the casino

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: The new remodel Silverton Hotel Casino did an outstanding job with their new renovation of their hotel. The room were excellent with all the amenities provided. To top it off we celebrated our 48 year anniversary with an excellent diner at the Twin Peak restaurant. To all the employees, we thank you. We plan to return in the near future. I highly recommend this hotel to everyone.

allReviews.title: Had a great stay in a really comfortable good looking room. Gaming tables were great and didn't have to gamble elsewhere
allReviews.text: Had a great stay in a really comfortable good looking room. Gaming tables were great and didn't have to gamble elsewhere

allReviews.title: Great staff and stay
allReviews.text: Love the new rooms, comfy beds, as always the staff were great, food is awesome, whether you like American Mexican or Chinese it’s great. Place has a local feel and is relaxing, we actually had our car stolen at another place, when I told the girl at check in, I truly felt her compassion it was appreciated

allReviews.title: Great Makeover - Yeehaw!
allReviews.text: GREAT Make-over.  The room I had was a KING bed, very comfortable. The pillows were fantastic.  The décor and carpet were all western themed which was very nicely done.  The bathroom was also very nice, the towels were really good.  The elevator lobbies were very nice and welcoming as well.  The hole makeover they didn't with the western theme was very well done.  Definitely my go to place now when I go to LV.

allReviews.title: Best Family Enjoyment
allReviews.text: By big numbers, the best stay in many years of staying at hotels in Las Vegas, Laughlin , Nevada, Arizona and  California hotels. We were  really amazed of the cleanness, the decoration, and the comfort that you fill that makes you think you found the best place to enjoy your free time.

allReviews.title: Very happy with our stay
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed for 3 nights during New Year’s and we were very happy with our rooms, the comps, the location, and the dining options. The newly renovated rooms are nice and parking was convenient whether in the garage or surface parking. It was easy to get in and out of, being right off I-15, close to shopping, and close to the Strip. The portions at the Sundance Cafe were huge and it’s a great late-night option. We also ate at Mi Casa (excellent fajitas!) and Wuhu Noodles (twice). The New Year’s Eve dinner was exceptional, with king crab legs, steak, and a show. Silverton Village is right next door with many more food and bar options but we had what we needed right in the casino. The aquarium is a fun touch and entrance to Bass Pro connected which is fun to walk through. Wish we did better in the casino but that’s why they call it gambling. The comps are much better than in the strip casinos. I would recommend it if you want something less hectic and less expensive than the Strip but want a convenient jumping off point.

allReviews.title: Always have an extra time at the Silverton. My favorite table that's the black deck table.
allReviews.text: The filter is a great hotel to visit. They have a friendly and relax atmosphere. From the beginning thought it with the valet the bellhop the check in desk the service the restaurant and the road everything is nice. The something about favorite Hotel in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Top 5 places to stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Greatest experience here . So much to do inside casino and rooms were so pretty . Best customer service . Such a beautiful place . My favorite place to stay in Las Vegas . Away from the chaos of the strip but only 15 min away if you like that .

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: Everyone was fantastic... Everything was great, people are very helpful and courteous. Enjoyed the food and the aspect of the mermaids in the tank. Th room was beautiful after the remold. Housekeeping was very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Wonderland
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Silverton me and my family stay there for Christmas Eve it was wonderful feeling ,beautiful hotel and the staff was very kind and friendly. I am looking forward to returning in the near future.

allReviews.title: Couples getaway!!
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience, the hotel accomodations were excellent. Had fun and some luck playing in the casino. Liked that there were plenty of food options too. Will definitely be staying there again on our next getaway.

allReviews.title: Silverton Christmas season visit
allReviews.text: The Silverton at Christmas is amazing with all the inside and outside decorations. This was our 2nd year to go to the pop up Christmas bar, Bad Elf. The remodeling of the rooms was a pleasant surprise. The guest rooms and hallways were tastefully done and super comfortable. Can't wait to see the pool remodel later this year!

allReviews.title: Try it you will definitely like it!
allReviews.text: A great place to relax away from the STRIP… renovations are great and well done.  The casino is well played out and the table games are in par with Las Vegas Casinos. Excellent choices in restaurants.

allReviews.title: Great new place
allReviews.text: Had a great stay at the Silverton. All the rooms were updated to a southwest vibe. Beds are very comfortable nice big pillows. Ate at the  restaurants every meal was great, Steak house was really good.  Staff were very helpful with anything that we needed. Will be staying here a lot more.

allReviews.title: Silverton stay
allReviews.text: The silverton resort was great. From making the reservations, to the front desk and even the hospitality of housekeeping had a good touch to a nice stay. The room was clean. No complaints at all. It was easy to get from the casino to the room and back. There was also hardly any noise from the outside as well. Id stay again!

allReviews.title: Really impressed and loved it!
allReviews.text: I was so appreciative of the front desk gal that helped us to check in early so our trip had no glitches :) She was from Hawaii which gave me more of a less stressed experience. I stayed there two years ago and the renovations are awesome!! So first class! The new security feature to go into the room area is great! The rooms are so updated and worthy of strip ratings :)

allReviews.title: Silverton is the best!!
allReviews.text: The Silverton is the best place for food, gambling and mermaids!! The new renovation is fantastic and can hardly wait for the brand new pool!! We stayed in the Cowboy Kitch room and it was very nice. Love it!!

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Amazing, friendly and welcoming service.The service with every staff member was above and beyond.The people make every visit feel like home, enjoyable and memorable.Their customer service is an intangible.My room was very clean, comfortable and peaceful.The Silverton is my favorite hotel and casinooff of the Las Vegas Strip. A beautiful retreat away from the busy city.I look forward to every visit and always depart in good spirits and rejuvenated.

allReviews.title: Wouldn’t stay here
allReviews.text: I’ve been coming to LV for over 25 years and recently decided to try some different properties.  Well, let’s just say that idea backfired with Silverton.  From poor service to uninspired food, my weekend was a total bust (especially bad considering I did ok at tables).   The only positive came from an interaction with a security guard but bottom line I would NOT recommend staying here unless you love Bass Pro Shop.

allReviews.title: BEST GAMING EVER!!!
allReviews.text: ROOMS ARE THE BEST. HOTEL HAS BEEN RENOVATED SO BEDS AND PILLOWS ARE BRAND NEW AND EXTREMELY COMFORTABLE. SHOWERS ARE THE BEST. LIGHTED MIRROR THAT COMES OUT OF WALL, SO I CAN ACTUALLY SEE WHEN APPLYING MY MAKEUP.  THE STAFF IS SO FRIENDLY, WE CAN'T WAIT TO GO THERE IN A COUPLE OF WEEKS. WE ATE AT CANTINA MEXICAN GRILL AND WENT BACK AFTER ONE WEEK. CANT WAIT TO TRY THEIR SUSHI RESTAURANT. THE BARS ARE THE BEST. WE SPENT MANY HOURS PLAYING VIDEO POKER AND KENO AT THE BARS. THE TABLE GAMES ARE ALSO FUN. MY HUSBAND SPENDS MANY HOURS THERE.  IF YOU ARE DRIVING IN FROM CALI, IT IS THE MOST CONVENIENT PLACE TO STAY. CLOSE TO STRIP AND VALET IS GREAT.

allReviews.title: Awesome staff. Great food. Comfortable and quiet rooms.
allReviews.text: The wife and I love the silverton and all the employees who do their best to make things work for you. I have never had a bad thing to say about the silverton UNTIL THIS TRIP. I make a couple checks of our vehicle each day last night went down to check the vehicle and found the parking area barricaded for a "special event " and a note on the windshield telling us to move it or loose at our expense. If signs were posted stating that parking area would be closed I would have gladly moved to another parking spot. But no notification and a move it or loose note did not make me a happy camper. Desk personnel and valet didn't even know about the closure but had to feel the heat. The closure could have been handled alot better. Sorry to those who got yelled at who ever set up the closure do a better job next closure.

allReviews.title: 35th year Anniversary
allReviews.text: We had a great time celebrating our 35th year Anniversary@Silvertoj.we love the new room and the staffs were very helpful and professional... Thank you very much for the accomodations and we'll be coming back soon...

allReviews.title: Amazing place to stay! The rooms, the steakhouse and the staff are incredible!
allReviews.text: The rooms are so modern and cozy! The bed is absolutely so comfortable! The staff was amazing and so welcoming and made our honeymoon wonderful! We loved the steakhouse Twin Creeks! The food was so delicious!

allReviews.title: Great location off strip!
allReviews.text: Clean rooms, beds were so comfortable, shampoo, conditioner and body soap (full bottles) in the shower! The room decor was super cute with a cowboy theme! Don’t forget to get a rewards card for generous offers!

allReviews.title: Pleasant Stay!
allReviews.text: We wanted to stay off the strip, and we found this place.  I must say this exceeded our expectations.  It is in a nice location next to different shops and restaurants.  The hotel itself was great.  The front desk was very pleasant from check-in to check-out.  I even received a welcome gift!!  The room was very clean and spacious.  It had a nice size TV, and the bed was very comfortable.  The casino was nice and the food at the Mermaid Bar was great.  The bartender, Dre, was excellent!  Overall, this was a great hotel and I recommend it if you're looking for something off the strip.

allReviews.title: A Nice Las Vegas Option for Lodging
allReviews.text: The room accommodations were very nice. Definitely would stay again. It's off the strip but it was good for our family. Felt safe and inside they have the aquarium, a sight to see. Overall a nice option when traveling to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Boutique room
allReviews.text: There were 7 large pillows on each queen size bed.  The beds were high off the floor.    An added light fixture by the mirror would be perfect.  The toilet paper dispenser should be to the left of the toilet and not to the left back almost touching the ground.  No grab bars in the shower.  Otherwise this Boutique room was excellent.

allReviews.title: Most pleasant getaway!!
