allReviews.text: This hotel was beautiful.  Room was gorgeous.  The bed was so very comfortable..  The restaurants served excelllent cuisine and the staff were very pleasant and friendly.  Everything was excellent as was our stay.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience
allReviews.text: The rooms were really decorated nicely and were very clean.  The Bed was super comfortable.  We enjoyed the food in all the restaurants we tried and the staff and all the servers were super friendly, down to the cocktail waitresses on the casino floor.  We didn’t have to wait longer than 30 minutes, if that, for service.  The casino barley smelled like smoke and was very pleasant.  We will definitely  come again.

allReviews.title: Beautiful amazing awesome hotel rooms
allReviews.text: This is rooms are so amazing they are beyond belief absolutely gorgeous we have been coming there for years and have became friends with Lori the hotel check-in young lady she is so awesome and I wish I could remember the other girl's name that is there she is so friendly and so nice those two make your check-in experience unlike no other they are so outgoing and so friendly we were there one time and it was Lori's birthday and we brought her some cheesecake she will never forget it anyway can't say enough about this beautiful place

allReviews.title: Hotel renovation  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
allReviews.text: Best renovation ever ~ great crew members, from the front desk staff to the casino hosts, a must stay in this incredible hotel/casino.  Twin creek restaurant  5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best birthday stay ever 🎂

allReviews.title: GREAT FOOD HOTEL AND CASINO
allReviews.text: Great hotel remodel and my favorite casino in the Las Vegas area. The food is great, too. I been going there for better than three years on my way to and from Texas and California.  I even did my Christmas shopping at Bass Pro for 2 years in a row. I'm not a LV Strip person so this is a great alternative

allReviews.title: Silvertons casino is zcwimner
allReviews.text: The suites are amazing / affordable/ casino is not crowded and they have draft beer ! They need a cigar lounge but are connected to Bass ourtlet for all your fishing and hunting needs also the steak house is excellent .

allReviews.title: Friendly staff makes all the difference at the Silverton Casino & Lodge
allReviews.text: First time stay for us at the Silverton Casino & Lodge in South Las Vegas was very relaxing. The Strip was congested and roads were blocked in prep for the up-coming Formula One event - so we welcomed the off-Strip calm at the Silverton. My wife maintains several salt-water aquariums at home so she was mesmerized by the aquarium inside the Casino at the entrance to the Pro Bass Shop. The odd combination actually works - taking a break from the casino games to shop in the Pro Bass store adds to the fun for all ages. The staff - from housekeeping to the table games - are all customer-focused and treat you with kindness and respect. My blackjack dealer was actually apologetic when she would pull off an incredible draw of 21 to beat my 20...LOL. And you know what they say about slots: The further away from the Strip you get, the higher the RTP rate. I can vouch for that!

allReviews.title: Amazing Trip ..
allReviews.text: We had such fun Hotel rooms are excellent so beautiful elegant very clean and pristine, I love having four pillows on each bed, I love the style of the rooms. Hotel front desk people are amazingly friendly, I had good laughed with a few cuz their very friendly and all ears. The food on restaurants are great.  It can never disappoint. I'm going again!! Come look ets all have fun in the Casinos as well, so many people are winning and I'm in due to win the Mega Grand!! Let's gooo have fun!!!

allReviews.title: One of the most relaxing hotel experiences ever!
allReviews.text: The Silverton Hotel has recently been renovated. I had to share how great the rooms are! It's my first time back in a few months and today's visit has been great. We had great service in the casino while playing some of the games & also had great service at The Sundance Cafe. We loved our dinner of chicken parmesan and the ribeye steak dinner. Everyone was very nice including the wonderful lady Amelia at the register.David & Natasha at the front desk are awesome they helped with our reservation needs and are very accommodating, kind & patient.If you are looking for a fresh, clean, quiet and off the strip hotel with great food & great customer service within walking distance to the 99 cent store for any necessary items you may need. As well as shopping centers and many other places to eat. Then I highly recommend booking a stay here.Thank you all at the Silverton for such a great stay.

allReviews.title: Amazing remodeled hotel rooms!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the newly renovated resort/ hotel and wow! The rooms are amazing, and very chic and comfortable.  The check in staff was very attentive and nice and we enjoyed the stay from top to bottom.  Can’t wait for the pool remodel to be done and will be back!

allReviews.title: Yet another great stay
allReviews.text: Have just returned from Silverton where I have stayed for the last 25+ years. It is an absolute gem of a place away from the strip and has everything you could want from a vacation in Las Vegas.  All of the staff throughout provide a friendly and professional service and nothing is too much trouble for anyone.  It has great restaurants and bars to suit all tastes and at reasonable prices.  The refurbished rooms are beautiful and the beds are so comfortable you are guaranteed a good nights sleep.The casino is a great place to spend a few hours and has all types of slot machines and gaming tables to suit everyone and the cocktail waitresses are always around to provide drinks.I cannot recommend Silverton highly enough particularly if you want to get away from the madness of the strip.

allReviews.title: Great first stay at Silverton!
allReviews.text: Hotel rooms have beautiful, thoughtful decor.  Most importantly, the beds and pillows are amazingly comfortable.  Too many properties get one or the other right, hard to find a place where decor, beds and pillows are all on point.  Will be back!

allReviews.title: The visit was beautiful and cozy
allReviews.text: The staff everywhere were really helpful and nice. I was handicapped and everyone was so kind. The room was beautiful and comfortable, from bed, pillows, bathroom, even the cute little coffee hutch. I really loved we did not have to walk far to the Sundance cafe.

allReviews.title: Celebrating 🍾 life
allReviews.text: This is our go to place to celebrate special days.  My niece and her family came from Australia, my sister and her family from Vegas helped us celebrate my Husband's birthday and being diagnosed as cancer free.

allReviews.title: It was "ok".  Not "great", but "ok"
allReviews.text: It was "ok" overall.  Pros were: the renovation which has made the property very nice.  The food at Mi Casa was also good.  And the players club benefits on the day I joined were very generous for an over-50.  The Bass Pro Shop was also huge, and a highlight.  Cons to me were: Staff, a few of whom were unnecessarily surly, and also the Sundance, where I thought both the food and service were both actually pretty bad.  Joining the players club as a non-American was also made unnecessarily difficult, even though every other players club (including South Point) just routinely wants your Driver's Licence, and doesn't make a big deal of things.  Slots I found tight for an off-strip casino, but I don't judge on that, as I get that the player experience can vary from day-to-day, and machine-to-machine.  Bottom line: I wouldn't rush there again, but it was ok for a one-time visit.  For me though, it wasn't good enough to draw me away from South Point or M-Resort or GVR, etc.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Silverton
allReviews.text: We had a great time at the Silverton Hotel.  All of the staff that we had contact with from the bell hop, check in, and the cafe were great.  They all made us feel very welcome.  The rooms have just been completely renovated and they are gorgeous.  We love staying "off the strip" because there is much less traffic and much less hassle.  Wish we could go more often.

allReviews.title: Hotel renovated!
allReviews.text: Great discovery! The hotel is ideal if you are looking for peace and quiet far from the strip. completely renovated, the interior is magnificent with a cowboy themeAll the staff are friendly. We also appreciated the very clean and quiet room with quality bedding. Having taken breakfast, dinner and the services of the bar near the aquarium we found the prices to be good value for moneyVery large and free parking and direct access to the adjoining Basse Pro Shop

allReviews.title: Agreat place to stay!!
allReviews.text: This Hotel and casino was just remodled and the redo was great as the room that I had was a step up! The prime rib was great for all of us! Hotel and casino together is a great place to stay!!! Food-casino and hotel needs for  all to check out a 10++!

allReviews.title: Sketchy
allReviews.text: DO NOT STAY HERE! .. we had a very sketchy experience here, so much so we packed up our belongings and moved to a different hotel.. I would never recommend this place. However, front seat were very friendly.

allReviews.title: Girls getaway!!
allReviews.text: Renovations of the rooms are complete and they are beautiful and inviting. Beds are super comfortable and slept like a baby. Everyone was so helpful and accommodating from checking in to check out. Can’t say enough of the staff everywhere we went from restaurants to bartenders to valet attendants…all friendly and smiling. Will be going back soon and will definitely be staying at the Silverton.

allReviews.title: OK stay at the Silverton AKA Boomtown
allReviews.text: Check in was easy, and the lady who checked us in was pleasant.  With our room reservation we were given two free wine tastings, and half off dinner so that was a bonus we didn't expect.  We were on the first floor, and I was a little apprehensive about noise etc, but they limit the hotel hallways to people with room keys so there wasn't a whole lot from there.  There was a ton of noise from the room above us though!  We have stayed in lots of hotels and this was the first time we ever really heard people moving around above us, and they weren't working out or anything - just walking around normally and we heard it all especially at 3am.  The renovations are nice, the room decor was nicely done and still smelled of paint when we got in it.  There is a fridge and coffee maker in the room, which is wonderful - I wish more hotels did that!  Overall my biggest complaint is that we were a little taken aback when after we had settled in, two people just opened the door and walked in?  They quickly retreated and explained they were construction people and were checking the room.  Not a great way to start the night! After that, we went down to Bass pro shops to do a little shopping, then back to the bar for the wine tasting.  Wines were OK, nothing great but for free they got you going in the right direction for the evening.   Went to dinner at Sundance, the pork chops were over done a bit but tasty.  Hubby had the steak, he said it was tasty.   The mermaid bar was neat, watching the lady swim around and the fish was entertaining.  Other than that, there isn't a lot to do, the pool is under renovation and closed right now.  I would stay again, its a nice hotel to spend a night or two in especially if you are headed towards the dam or doing some hiking outside of the strip.

allReviews.title: Great remodel
allReviews.text: We had come over to check out the new remodel. Spent 4 nights and it was worth it. The rooms are great and of course brand new, surprised they did carpet in the rooms. I would have thought rustic “wood”, easier to clean. The new security features are good, you need your card to access hotel.  The comps and food were all good, Sundance was better than I remembered. The pizza here is really good for an non pizza restaurant.Nice to be able to use Senior Monday and Vet Wednesday, we used the half off for WuHu, which is always good.  I liked the wine tasting, my wife does not drink, so I took advantage of the extra night I got.  Some have made comments that the slots are tighter, I did not find this to be the case. Sure we spent money, but it was all worth it. We will be back in December. The pool is being redone, and there is a sign saying “Our 10 million dollar new pool, seems a lidttle high.

allReviews.title: New opening is a WOW!
allReviews.text: Silverton's Lodge new renovation does it right.  All of their choices from the carpet to the fixtures say we went first class.  This is a western lodge so if that is your comfort zone, this is the place to stay.

allReviews.title: A Weekend Stay at Silverton Casino
allReviews.text: Checkin at the hotel was very quick.  The room was nicely finished and clean.  We have dinner at WuHu Noodle and breakfast at Sundance.  Both services and food quality were great, and prices were very reasonable.  Unlike other casinos, the gaming floor was not very smoky.  The dealers were friendly.  The best attraction was the aquarium with all the beatiful fishes.  My 4-year old grand daughter loved the mermaid swiming in the aquarium.  A must see for the kids.

allReviews.title: Super nice!
allReviews.text: The rooms were awesome, spacious and very clean.   The bathroom was also super nice, clean and lots of room.  The coffee closet was an added bonus.  The added security to inter the elevators and the rooms was also a bonus.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The lodge is beautiful. The rooms are nicely decorated and the beds are comfy. I felt safe and secure in the hotel with having to use my card to gain entry to the hotel entrance and elevator. The staff is amazing, they make you feel at home. From the front desk to the floor crew, everywhere we went a staff member would greet us with a smile and conversation. I would highly recommend staying here whether it's business or pleasure. Plenty of great and affordable food options. The best place to stay and play.

allReviews.title: Feels like home
allReviews.text: Rooms are excellent, staff is responsive and friendly.  We've been going to the Silverton for over fifteen years and it is our favorite overall. There is a reason the locals love the Silverton. The remodel is beautiful.

allReviews.title: Best Lodge ever
allReviews.text: This is the best remodel ever.hands down..I wanted to say this I got a room (palms) somewhere else in the beginning of the week and I was not comfortable. The room was not clean and It had flies, the sink was stopped up and the shower looks like it needs to be repaired. I was not pleased I had to change rooms and the next room was no better. This goes to say that the remodel was to my standards and excessed my expectations..they did a excellent job..I finally had a good night of rest. I can't stop raving about this hotel.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: The Silverton is such a hidden gem. We have stayed here numerous times. The new update to the rooms is absolutely incredible and beautiful. The staff is above and beyond the best! I highly recommend staying at the Silverton the next time you come to Vegas. I can't wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Silverton is the best place to visit
allReviews.text: You won’t regret staying at the Silverton Casino . I can honestly say , I have been staying with them for years and never have I had a bad experience ! The hotel clerks are fast , efficient , extremely courteous and very professional . The food at every restaurant offered at the Silverton is delicious. The offers you get with the players card are better than any casino on the strip !

allReviews.title: EXCEPTIONAL CUSTOMER SERVICE
allReviews.text: Exceptional Customer Service, friendly and accommodating Staff, Clean and pleasant environment.  Silverton Casino Lodge Staff (The Lodge Host Miriam & Brian (Manager)), Front Desk Staff and Manager, VIP services  Rep, Housekeeping and  Valet Staff (Chris), The Casino Club Staff, and Sundance Restaurant Staff, are all genuinely “Awesome.”   Our stay at Silverton is worth our travel from San Diego.

allReviews.title: Nicest place I stayed at in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The room was absolutely perfect! I loved the decor! The staff was amazing and very friendly. Reseasonable pricing and only a few min drive from the strip. The twin creek is absolutely delicious! highly recommend having dinner there.

allReviews.title: Perfect Welcome Back!
allReviews.text: We have not been back since 2021.  Chris @ Valet parking was very welcoming & joking around.  Upon checking in, Darrius let us know all the changes happening!Thank you Chris & Darrius for the warm welcome back!

allReviews.title: Sad Situation!
allReviews.text: So, I've been coming to this Casino on occasion (Monthly) for over 30 years. I really hate to give bad reviews but, this place has become and absolute joke and deserving of less than a one rating. First,  about a year ago the (management/owner) decided to reprogram all the player machines to pay for the newly upgraded hotel rooms, swimming pools and carpet. They totally screwed over the locals that keep this place alive. In my opinion the so called improvements, are like putting lipstick on a pig! Let me give you some examples.. There is still no hot water in any of the restrooms. they smell, they are constantly out of supplies or closed. The faucets, flooring dividers, walls and fixtures are all in need of repair or replacement. They are just "down right nasty".  The last time I was there  it had been raining so they had mop buckets placed around the Casino to catch the water running down from  the leaky rood onto the new carpet and player machines. C'mon Man Really!. Most of the original staff have left for better opportunities at other Casinos (Southpoint/Durango). Very Sad Situation. Ok, a few positive comments. The waitress/servers are excellent. The restaurants and gift shop are nice. The Bass pro Shops is right next door and they don't (as of yet) charge for parking.

allReviews.title: A Happy Place To Stay & Play
allReviews.text: The Silverton remodel was impressive, the room decor was inviting.  The bath with the walk-in shower were perfect for me. There were more than enough fluffy pillows and the bed super comfy. All the amenities you could want.  The room service menu was more than ample and my pre-ordered breakfast arrived on time and Hot. The Silverton was a great stay away from home.

allReviews.title: Friends Staycation
allReviews.text: We would highly recommend staying at the Silverton Hotel. The newly renovated rooms have, style, charm and were very comfortable.  I love the location, it is easy to get to The Strip if needed but has everything you need onsite. Many great restaurants to choose from and the staff is always top notch!

allReviews.title: Phenomenal Visit
allReviews.text: The recent renovation is top notch - they definitely went above and beyond with every detail. We had 5* service from the moment we arrived at check-in to the moment we checked out. Team members greeted us in the halls or common areas and ensured we were enjoying our stay. The rustic chic details in the rooms are truly a unique touch. I personally loved the black make up towel in the bath room for ladies to use to remove their makeup. Another huge perk of the new rooms is a fully functional mini fridge to use. For those who travel often, especially on the Las Vegas Strip know that mini fridges are far and few in between for personal use.We also dined at Twin Creeks for dinner that evening. Was very impressed from the bread table side selection, to the carpaccio appetizer, and delicious wagyu ribcap. Cant wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Silverton Amazing
allReviews.text: Outstanding job on the remodeling The rooms and service exceptional The food and in room dining was fantastic The decor was warm and welcoming Looking forward to seeing the completion of the pool on my next visit

allReviews.title: Come stay in  the New Hotel Rooms!
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Silverton lodge last weekend.  The new rooms and suites are well designed with all the comforts! The beds were comfortable and the pillows just right! The staff from check-in to check-out was friendly and efficient, the service was top notch everywhere we went.  We had never stayed there before but we will be back and will recommend it to our family and friends.

allReviews.title: Overnight stay at the Silverton Casino
allReviews.text: The room was beautiful and setup perfectly to accommodate me and my wife who are both handicapped and have trouble walking. The front desk staff were there to answer all my questions and made it to check in and out. I would come back again

allReviews.title: Great remodel
allReviews.text: Everything is new and upgraded. Rooms are decorated really nice, with lots of little extras. Friendly and helpful front desk staff. Breakfast special at the Sundance restaurant is great Thanks for an enjoyable  stay.

allReviews.title: Bring a sense of Zen to your life..stay in the new rooms at the Silverton
allReviews.text: The new hotel rooms are simply beautiful. They captured a real feeling of Zen in each space of the new hotel. The casino floor has lots of the new games and is very spacious. All of the team members are friendly and helpful. Lots of good food choices and I’m ready to book my next vacation.

allReviews.title: Staying at the Silverton
allReviews.text: Everyone was so welcoming from the valet to the check in. Belinda was so friendly and she explained everything in detail.  It was so nice to be welcomed by such a lovely person. The new rooms are beautiful!  My husband and I love all the extra touches and amenities, fridge, coffee maker, amazing bathroom.  We are looking forward to our stay, and plan to come often.

allReviews.title: A Grand Reopening
allReviews.text: Truly enjoyed our stay. Will definitely return. Not too many place you get both good vibes and good food. Until next time!!!The decor is amazing! Can’t wait to redecorate my bedroom….Gambling was about the same as other casinos.

allReviews.title: Cozy, comfortable, natural farm - country ambiance
allReviews.text: The western country feel, combined with the charming farm design and rustic barn doors! The use of natural materials and earthy tones made it feel like a countryside retreat, it had a unique charm to the space. Everything was so comfortable from the moment you step through the elevators and it smelled so clean !

allReviews.title: Worth the wait!
allReviews.text: The newly remodeled rooms are excellent! Everything is brand new, from the mattress,  tv, to the decor.  The bathroom features new tile, sink, cabinets, and most importantly, a beautiful walk-in shower!It has taken some time to complete, but worth the wait!

allReviews.title: Remodel is beautiful  !
allReviews.text: Always stayed here in the past but they were closed for about 13 months to remodel. My wife just stayed there and we were very impressed.  The rooms are beautiful and seemed to be way quieter then before. The fridge and the kerug are nice additions.  The beds although new are still comfortable.  The staff was very friendly and helpful. I recommend The Silverton if you want to stay away from the strip and all that chaos.

allReviews.title: I will be back!!
allReviews.text: From the moment I walked in and saw the beautiful mermaid/fish tank I knew I found a new happy place. Staff was incredibly friendly and professional. Even though there was a slight mishap with my original room, the issue was handled quickly, efficiently and with excellent customer service. The rooms are spacious, clean and beautifully decorated. We had a AMAZING dinner at Twin Creeks, seriously one of the best meals I’ve ever had. I can’t wait to return!

allReviews.title: Five Stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
allReviews.text: Hotel is adorable and looked like we were the first to use the room (we had a more Western theme).  Steak house dinner was DELICIOUS and the staff were so attentive.  Watched them clear a table next to us at the steakhouse and it was like a choreographed dance of cleanliness and aesthetics… very detail oriented which was par for the course of our stay.  Loved the aquarium and the mermaid, I could have watched that for hours.  Very easy to get in and out of this hotel.  Next trip will have to be longer so I can enjoy it all… oh and they’re putting in a pool! Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: A must visit in Vegas!
allReviews.text: I was thoroughly impressed! The upgraded decor, modern amenities and entertainment have transformed the entire experience. The rooms were spacious and beautifully designed, and the casino floor was vibrant and inviting. The dining options were top-notch ( I highly recommend the Tomahawk steak), and the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. It's clear that the Silverton has invested in making this a fantastic destination. I can't wait to visit again!

allReviews.title: Clean and Beautiful
allReviews.text: From incredible staff to the beyond gorgeous rooms my stay was amazing. Darrius at the front desk was friendly and knowledgeable, and checkin was a breeze! When I got to the room it was incredibly clean and beautiful. The fun wallpaper and funky tiles paired beautifully together. Opening the armoire to find a cute little coffee bar was a very nice surprise. The huge TV not only gives you all of the resort information you could need, but you can also sign into your own Netflix account! Perfect for if you have kids or just want to stay up on your binge watching. The TV also allows you to clear your logins before departure, which was a very nice touch. I decided to order room service, and the menu has so many options! I ordered Loco Moco and chocolate cake, both of which were amazing. Service was fast and friendly! I put my tray out when I was done and it was picked up promptly. The bed was very comfortable and I slept like a dream. In the morning I drank one of the complimentary cups of coffee, and headed down to Starbucks at 7am for a pumpkin spice latte. Checking out from the TV was so simple, and I was on my way. All in all, I definitely recommend Silverton for a stay whether you’re on vacation or visiting family. You won’t be sorry!

allReviews.title: Nice renovation makes the stay fun
allReviews.text: The new renovations make the Silverton rooms visually appealing and comfortable.  All amenities are modern and give the experience travelers are looking for.  Of course this is attached to a nice casino with warm and welcoming staff.  It was the staff that really made the stay special.  They were friendly all the time and quick to respond when we asked questions.

allReviews.title: Most Amazing Experience Ever!!!!
allReviews.text: I stayed in the Ranchero suite and it was amazingly gorgeous. The quality and craftsmanship of everything in the room exceeded my expectations. The sunken tub was so beautiful and enjoyable along with the oversized shower. The bed and the linens were top quality and extremely comfortable I felt like a queen. I especially loved the coffee maker and all the comfortable robes, slippers, hair dryer provided because those are the things I usually forget to bring when I travel.The valet and front desk experience was awesome everyone was friendly and treated you like family.We were here celebrating my brothers to your wedding anniversary and the wine tasting experience was absolutely phenomenal. Dylan the Shady Grove Bartender brought my family all the tasting samples and explained to them about each different wine. Dylan is the most friendly bartender and he even provided my family with all the stuff needed to have fun playing pool and Bowlingo.The best part was definitely the dining experience was at Twin Creeks restaurant.  The GM  Jeremy Yoza went above and beyond to provide our family with a private table to enjoy the celebration and Chef Jamie Pepe came out to check on us to ensure the quality of the food was met which it was. Both my sister-in-laws said that the food was the best and most flavorful experience they have had. Two comments made about the food was "this is the tenderest filet mignon I have ever eaten" and "this is the best prime rib I've ever had" and my favorite dish, rack of lamb was on point!!!! All of our servers exceeded our expectations and we're very attentive in providing us with the best and friendliest service.

allReviews.title: A New Breath of Fresh Air at Silverton
allReviews.text: My family and I recently stayed at the new and improved Silverton Hotel. It is so beautifully renovated in a country/rustic meets modern theme. We booked a Ranchero Suite with a connecting Rustic Modern double queen room. To say we were thrilled with our experience was an understatement. Firstly, the check in experience was superb. Leona was amazing and very welcoming. They also have a Sundries cabinet stocked full of anything you may have forgotten at home, along with a business center to print your boarding pass or surf the web. The rooms were spacious, luxurious, and had every amenity you could imagine. We had complementary coffee in room, along with bottled water, lotion and vanity kits. The TV looked like a picture frame displaying beautiful rotating pictures. You can order room service via the TV or by scanning a QR code. Super user friendly. The bed was like heaven - so comfortable. I just wanted to sleep in all day! Luckily I was able to sneak out of bed and experience the spa-like quality of the bathroom and shower. There’s also a soaking tub in the suite. Just grab a glass of wine and it’s perfection. We were able to dine at Mi Casa and Sundance as well, which is located conveniently on property. Delicious food, service and all-around experience. The waitstaff is attentive and eager to please. You won’t regret your stay at Silverton. Don’t forget to visit the aquarium. Perfect for kids and adults alike. The have daily stingray feedings and real life mermaids! 10/10.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay, comfortable bed, delicious food. Great experience!
allReviews.text: Our room was beautiful, with a cozy "lodge" feel that's a stand out in Las Vegas. The bed in our room was SO comfortable, I miss it already! Every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful, and the steakhouse was the best I've had! (Try the filet and an old fashioned) Overall we had such a fun experience and will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: The entire hotel has been renovated and it is beautiful. Large rooms that have all the amenities. Very friendly staff that seems to care that you are staying at thier property. Highly recommend the Silverton for your next stay in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Absolutely excellent
allReviews.text: The Silverton shut down their hotel operations over a year ago so they could completely remodel the facility. They are in the process of opening back up and we stayed in one of the new rooms.  Obviously anytime you stay in a brand-new room you expect it to be nice but the Silverton went well past that. Our room had a western décor that couldn’t help but bring a smile to my face.  It had all the standard amenities such as a refrigerator, Keurig coffee maker, iron, and a great lighted shaving/makeup mirror. The bathroom featured a glassed-in shower and good quality soft towels. The décor and tiling was especially sharp.It had plenty of built-in USB charging ports. Each side of the bed had a ceiling mounted reading light. There was recessed lighting behind the headboard to give atmosphere. A lot of thought went into the design process.So we were pretty impressed with what Silverton has done. I would certainly recommend staying there when in Vegas.  The Silverton is located a few miles south of the Strip and is where many locals play.

allReviews.title: Best family stay-cation!
allReviews.text: Our family staycation was perfect at the Silverton! The newly renovated hotel was quiet, relaxing, and wonderfully decorated. It was fun to take a step back in time in the old west that included all the modern amenities. The staff welcomed us with a friendly and quick check in. There were plenty of restaurant choices that fit our family and we will definitely be back soon!

allReviews.title: Most down to earth hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Silverton is the quietest, most relaxing hotel in Vegas. The staff and management are extremely knowledgeable ,friendly and helpful. The newly remodeled rooms are luxurious with a down home western feel. The steakhouse was out outstanding. Overall experience in Excellence without taking you out of your comfort zone. We will be staying here as our first choice in Vegas. Out of the noise and chaos of the strip this is just relaxing, calm and a sense of home away from home . We very much enjoyed our stay at the Silverton

allReviews.title: hotel   experience
allReviews.text: I have been going to this hotel for many years.  My hotel experience has always been pleasant.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone.  The staff is very friendly.  I feel very comfortable staying  at this  hotel.

allReviews.title: Great Time
allReviews.text: Everything was great.  Sunny, warm , breezy weather.  Enjoyed Silverton.  Staff was friend;y, helpful.  Rooms are spacious, clean..  Nice to have free valet parking.  Food prices are reasonable.  Food quality is great.

allReviews.title: Vacation 2019
allReviews.text: Love it here this my go to hotel whenever we are in Vegas.  I love the Buffett especially on Friday nights my husband loves it cause of the bass pro shop next door. Go and check it out if your ever in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great stay, once again
allReviews.text: I really like staying here. You have taken away a few of my favor slots, double top dollar in the high limit, and a few others. I know changing th ok ngs around is good, but we have our favors. I would like to see diamond queen...

allReviews.title: Great Hotel off the Strip
allReviews.text: Very clean and quiet. Nice Farmers Market out front on Sundays. There are plenty of restaurants and Bass Pro Shop is right next door. Very close to the freeway and only about a 15 minute drive to the strip.

allReviews.title: Vision expo
allReviews.text: Great hotel for the price and lots of free parking. A little surprised no table service in the mermaid lounge or at least no service after 8 pm. Other then that a great hotel. Close enough to the strip but still far enough to miss the traffic

allReviews.title: Wonderful 3 Day Stay
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel and casino experience. This is our second stay but have visited the casino in years past. Always enjoyed the casino atmosphere. Your staff is always friendly and helpful. Hope to visit again.

allReviews.title: Canadians-Beware of the Deposit Fee
allReviews.text: First allow me to congratulate Lori at the Front Desk. She is very professional and was of great assistance to me.Second....the hotel requires a $100 USD deposit fee and the DO NOT accept cash. Therefore I can put down $100 USD on my credit card which will show up as a $135 charge on my statement due to the exchange rate. When I checked out the deposit was refunded to me but I will only see a $125.00 Canadian refund...again due to the exchange rate. I realize that the difference is only $10 but its the principal of the thing. I am being charged for a room...plus $19.00 resort fee plus tax and then lose an additional $10 because the hotel does not accept Cash as a form of a deposit. I spoke with the Manager on duty and was told in a very unsympathetic manner. "it's our policy". No attempt at trying to make the guest feel happy by offering a free breakfast or some other small token. Other hotels, (Golden Nugget), accept cash as a deposit. Beware.

allReviews.title: Back again ... another good and relaxing stay at Silverton
allReviews.text: I just came back from Vegas for a 4 night stay.  I stayed at Silverton last August and since my stay was great I decided to go back this September.  I was not disappointed. The main hotel is older but it is well kept and maintained.   My room was cozy, clean and I had a great view of the poolside area.    The slot machines are good combining the new machines with the older ones.  There is nothing fancy about the restaurants but the choices are good.   Right across the street they have IN and Out burger.  There is free shuttle service to and from the Airport and the Strip. Barry and Laslow will take good care of you. Many thanks to the friendly hotel staff and in particular to Arnold at the Front Desk and Cynthia in the office.   I hope to be back again soon,

allReviews.title: A little older but very nice and comfortable.
allReviews.text: Very nice and peaceful place to stay.  Great staff.  Good restaurants. Clean gaming areas.  Not on the strip but close to everything and shopping.  Very easy to find and get to.  Nice covered parking.  Have stayed be and will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great value for hotel accomodations but poor customer service.
allReviews.text: Poor customer service at the front desk, as we were made to wait about an hour and a half past appropriate check in time because our room wasn't ready.  Uncleanly conditions and rude customer service by our waiter at Mi Casa restaurant, which is inside Silverton Hotel. Our room, however, was very clean and comfortable.

allReviews.title: Great casino, mediocre accommodations.
allReviews.text: Our room was old and dirty. Trash behind the bed, dirty floor, hair on the bathroom counter, and a pair of socks near the safe. Awesome casino to visit and great restaurants. Fun atmosphere and nice dealers.

allReviews.title: Overnight
allReviews.text: Did a single night to check out the accomodations. Clean, comfortable room with view of the Strip from our room.  4 story hotel with casino on ground level.  Lodge ambience is homey. If walking a distance is a challenge, request a room near the elevator! Our fave feature at this hotel is the Seasons buffet.  Staff is happy and helpful, foods have unique flavors, loved the bbq ribs, lentil salad, grilled asparagus, Chinese long beans,and pecan pie ala mode. Parking is free and easy.  The "tub" crap table is unique! The floor to ceiling aquarium at the entrance is mesmerizing for folks of all ages!

allReviews.title: Large rooms at a good price
allReviews.text: Rooms a quite large and well maintained. Valet parking and bell services were very helpful. Easy check in and out. Several dining choices and large casino make this a complete one stop destination for us

allReviews.title: My review
allReviews.text: just ok, the hotel/casino is on the south end of the strip & very quiet.  the food is ok & the special seafood buffet on Friday was very good.  I enjoyed the low key friendliness of the dealers & the staff for the most part.

allReviews.title: Avoid this place
allReviews.text: Came here to spend some nice time in the casino. Unfortunately staff here is very unprofessional and unpleasant for foreign tourists. There is plenty of other places around if you want to spend your money. Stay away from this place if you can.

allReviews.title: internet not working
allReviews.text: I have stay here many times without complaints except this last time i had the last room in the hallway and the wireless internet was too far and couldn't connect the whole time(laptop,tablet,phone) and was never fixed.  Very very inconvenient.

allReviews.title: Wonderful place, great location.
allReviews.text: We have stayed here many times and keep returning.  The staff is extremely friendly and always have smiles on their faces.  The bartenders are outgoing and very efficient.  You never have an empty glass there.  An additional benefit is having a large sporting goods store attached.  Parking is always free and the resort fee isn't that bad considering what other places charge.  I would recommend Silverton to anyone.

allReviews.title: Great hotel!!
allReviews.text: I can always rely on this hotel to be a great value , well kept and beautiful with a friendly staff and comfortable feeling that feels like home when im there Great food at a great value! great experiance overall . I will say this my mother went as well and the beds were a little too high for her.... Shes not very tall lol might be something to be looked at. Thanks again

allReviews.title: Our first stay at Silverton Resort
allReviews.text: A fun and relaxing getaway for the two of us at a place we haven’t stayed before with very good food and a shuttle to and from the airport and to the Strip, The room was very nice with comfortable beds and very quiet.

allReviews.title: Business stay.
allReviews.text: Business stay.  Everyone was very nice and professional.  The room was very comfortable and the pool was exceptional.  The restaurants, and I ate in all of them, were inviting and the food was good.  Overall experience was excellent.

allReviews.title: Best in the West
allReviews.text: The Silverton is like a place no other,its very comfortable,plenty to do,and great food.They treat you like family there,which with the mermaid tank,and with Pro Bass Shop there,there is something for everyoneI will never stop going to the Silverton,they make you feel right at home

allReviews.title: Great Casino, Rooms....not so new
allReviews.text: Food was great, especially at Twin creeks, everything else was ok. I liked the casino and the shopping area. The rooms need to be updated, I felt like o was staying at an old motel, but location is good if you’re looking to stay away from the strip

allReviews.title: Eh
allReviews.text: Gaming experience incredibly poor. Played other places and actually won. Just donated at silverton. Worst gaming experience we have ever had there, although the last time wasn’t great either. My husband and I decided we may stay there again, but will NOT game there

allReviews.title: Family
allReviews.text: The Casino was fun, dinner at Twincreeks was awesome! Mi Casa was great and bartender awesome! The Aquarium was over the top! Kids tools pictures with the mermaid! Cabana keeper us cool! The whole family will be back.

allReviews.title: Great Service
allReviews.text: A great hotel for those who don't want to deal with the Strip.  I have stayed here 3 times while visiting family. The service I have received is excellent.  I wish there was a coffee machine in the room.  Starbucks is downstairs.  It's convenient to use their shuttle to the airport.

allReviews.title: Good stay and price
allReviews.text: This hotel was decent and very close to rental car return and the airport. Not close to main strip for vegas shows or activities. Food was excellent though and staff very friendly. Nice walk through the attached outdoor store and the cool aquarium.

allReviews.title: Friendly and Helpful Staff
allReviews.text: From the Shuttle Driver to the Security Manager, all the staff are friendly and helpful!Although the hotel and casino are a bit old and worn, the rooms, washrooms, and casino are clean.Really enjoyed my stay and will be going back. (Best Rewards membership around)

allReviews.title: Like to gamble? Don’t stay here
allReviews.text: We often stayed at MGM properties as invited guests and decided to try a new hotel, Silverton. We were comped in our stay, however there is no host on duty, 8:30pm on a SATURDAY - so no one to clear bills , check play and deal with standard host type stuff. Why should we come to a hotel and spend money, when it isn’t even acknowledged? This is VEGAS - I cant even believe there is no host on duty at 830pm on a weekend to take care of people who are invited guests! The room is dusty, literal layer of dust on lamps and etc - dirty and outdated ! Staff is rude, guy at check in lectured me on 3pm being check in time and treated me like awful...... Take your money elsewhere - they don’t appreciate or need it here apparently!

allReviews.title: Kathy/Vegas Labor Day
allReviews.text: My husband and I love staying here, Great staff and very friendly yet professional. Great service and we always enjoy our stay here!! Reasonable rates. Love that there is a Starbucks in the Casino. Twin Creeks Restaurant is amazing both food and service.

allReviews.title: Surprisingly Excellent room!!
allReviews.text: Surprisingly Excellent room! It was much bigger than I expected especially for an offstrip property.  I lived in Las Vegas for over 50 years and come back from time to time for business and have seen the Silverton evolve from the old Boomtown to today's first rate resort!

allReviews.title: JP
allReviews.text: Carpet needs replaced in certain areas. Overall we enjoy our stays there. Restaurants are very good. Staff very friendly. Convenient location to many things, especially the Airport. I enjoy the Bass Pro Shop being attached. The Mermaid and fish aquarium is awesome! Nice pool area.

allReviews.title: They owe me money
allReviews.text: Last time im staying in silverton if they dont return my money!My total was suppose to be $266 for 2 nights. I was charged $134 four times. They returned only $134 back once. So my total reservation was said to be $266 but i was charged over $400. Havent received my money back!

allReviews.title: Awesome Location
allReviews.text: Great place to stay Mexican Food was good service at Restaurant sucked service everywhere else great love it being able to access Bass Pro Shop from casino, only stayed one night but next time I stay in Vegas I will not need to check other hotels I will just stay here.

allReviews.title: Comfortable stay
allReviews.text: My family and I are always happy staying here because the  hotel room is very affordable and good location, very close to the strip. I love their buffet, it’s very budget friendly and the food are great!

allReviews.title: Always the best hotel experience!!
allReviews.text: I come here with my family all the time.  It's very kid friendly, lots of activities, we don't rn have to leave the hotel and the kids have a blast. We speak to a host, Helen, all the time to book our stay and she never disappoints. She is very accommodating! Great rewards  program, very easy to earn free dining.

allReviews.title: The Best Resort in Vegas
allReviews.text: If you enjoy great service, great food, overall great atmosphere without the crowds on the strip then stay here.  The have a shuttle to the strip as well if you want to explore a bit.  The Silverton has all the slots, table games you need as well as a great sportsbook.  I have never dealt with a friendlier staff.  Once you stay here you will only want to stay here.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Thank you to all the staff, to our host Maria. She is very nice and very professional and go way back when she worked for buffalo Bill's.  The food was excellent. Love the mermaid attraction and aquarium is so pleasant and peaceful.

allReviews.title: AwesomeNess
allReviews.text: Arrived Friday Morning & I Was Able To Check In Early Which Was Awesome, Our Stay Was Wonderful, Great DJ At The Pool, The Season Is Always Our Favorite For Sunday Brunch, Valet Team Is Always So Amazing

allReviews.title: Mermaid School Graduate
allReviews.text: My daughter is a mermaid school graduate. Yes that;s right. She swam with an "official" mermaid in the huge aquarium located in front of the Bass Pro shops at Silverton. Among all the many species of fish. She was with one other similar age (9-12) Mermaid apprentice  I have never seen bigger smiles. For 90 minutes we toured the hatchery and facilities in the back  and even experienced the oceanic version of the petting zoo.  Then on came the tails and into the tank for a good 45 minutes. Talk about awesome video for the family memory archives. Sure, it was $100 but maybe the best $100 I ever spent on daughter and great thing  for the family version of your Vegas trip.

allReviews.title: Mini Vacation
allReviews.text: Love all the new changes around the property.   Each time we go back we see new and exciting additions.  Forgot to mention Barry the Silverton Shuttle driver also the very best and knowledgeable.  He makes the suttle fun.

allReviews.title: Smelly room
allReviews.text: Our stay in the smelly room!  We will Bemba k September 17 let’s hope it’s a better stay. I like the friendly staff but if any friends ask will have to explain about the smell in our room. The front desk staff could not have been more helots.

allReviews.title: Dave and Debbie Duty review
allReviews.text: Bathroom is small with the door opening into the bathroom. Employees were very pleasant. The restaurants (Wu Hu noodles and Mi Casa) are top notch. Sundance Grill is average at best and a bit over priced. Four dollars for a cup of coffee is a bit much.

allReviews.title: Good for the money
allReviews.text: Nice hotel for the money.  Plenty of things nearby.  My kids wished the pool was bigger. Room was fine.  The little farmers market was nice. The pond waterfall thing at your entrance was refreshing to watch after coming in from the Vegas heat.

allReviews.title: Okay Place to Stay
allReviews.text: The Silverton hotel was fine. Although I would not stay there again. The room was clean. There is no in room coffee in my mind that is a sin. The valley service was superb and getting our luggage to and from the room.

allReviews.title: Fast and Satisfied
allReviews.text: The Buffet place is really good. They need more entertainment. We did not get a tour of the poolside. Beds were super comfortable. And they have shuttles. Its next to that humungous store which has really nice things in there.

allReviews.title: Starting to show some age.  Just like me.
allReviews.text: Carpet fraying I notice in the hallways.   Could use a good cleaning.  Was a clean room and comfortable.  Music one evening was for a younger crowd.  Not to our liking.  I wasn't able to get the promotion for locals but the next day I was offered a huge cheese board that I couldn't get home cause it wouldn't fit in my suitcase.  Wish I could have gotten the smaller item.

allReviews.title: The great hotel
allReviews.text: My stay was wonderful I will be back again the people where so nice. The pool was beautiful I can not say anything bad about this place also the mermaids are the best attraction watching all the fish in that beautiful tank

allReviews.title: watresses
allReviews.text: we go to vegas often to visit our girls,we like to stay a couple nights at casino to gamble a lil ,eat etc, this trip we stayed 2 nights at silver ton, only complaint we had was the waitresses and drinks, we have have been coming to tiverton since existance off and on, this trip was worst ever had at any casino to get a beer while gambling, in the 2 nights there we stayed gamblin at least 5 -6 hours, received 3 beers each from rude watresses, we spent plenty to compensate for beers, we couls easily have gone and ate a luxury meal with many drinks for what we spent, i suggest if you want to keep people coming back, you take a look at this, i know management wants to keep a lot  of profit, but come on guys!!!!!

allReviews.title: Girls trip
allReviews.text: Again we had so much fun. It was a hoot. Some of us won and some didn’t. But the laughs kept coming. We flew in from different cities and met up. We love to eat and the Silverton offers every kind of cuisine.

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Stay at the hotel and was very nice, pleased with the room and the convenience of the location.  Service was very good...one small thing some of the towels were worn.  I would stay there more often cause I live in Pahrump and the long drive is a killer. As long as I get good rates I will stay more often.

allReviews.title: stay at Silverton
allReviews.text: suggestion:  refrigerators and coffee machines in the rooms would be nice.   The availability of the hospitality host would be nice if it was available more hours.  The hotel itself was very nice, friendly atmosphere and will definitely stay again!

allReviews.title: Not the best
allReviews.text: If your not a regular there then they treat you like crap.  I will not be back.  Housekeeping doesn't vacuum the baseboards in the rooms or hallways.  Filthy!!! Didn't use the pool or restaurants.  Valet staff was great.

allReviews.title: Small and very good
allReviews.text: Silverton is great local hotel and casino, great food specially the Twincreeks.Enjoy Silverton away from the strip.Many good restaurants nearby specially the newly opened Panera Bread.Good gaming as well with friendly dealers.

allReviews.title: Quick trip
allReviews.text: Just came to Vegas for the night great place to stay off the strip Have stayed here before always good food and clean rooms  Friendly staff always willing to help. We received offers for discounts on food and drinks

allReviews.title: Great quite retreat
allReviews.text: The most helpful, friendly front desk on the planet. Very professional, fast to get us the room and our special request. We got a large room with super comfortable beds. I will return again for this restful stay.

allReviews.title: Thank you!
allReviews.text: Great for the price! If you’re looking for a hotel that is off the strip and easy to get in and out of this is the place. The staff is very friendly and they always have new machines to play. Thanks again!

allReviews.title: Fantastic!
allReviews.text: My sister and brother-in-law said we would like this place.  We loved it!  By far the nicest and happiest  staff we have ever experienced!  Room was nice, clean, and a great value.  Dylan, bartender, was awesome!  We will.be back!

allReviews.title: Vegas Luxury Without Luxury Cost
allReviews.text: I stumbled upon Silverton by happenstance a few years back, after many stays “on the Strip”. Definitely a more peaceful night’s sleep at a very reduced cost. The hotel shuttle provides easy Strip and airport access too!

allReviews.title: get away vacation
allReviews.text: this was our first time staying at this hotel, we had a really good time and the beds were the best. The next time we plan a trip back to Vegas we will come back to stay at the Silverton Hotel again..

allReviews.title: Great location, great value, great staff!
allReviews.text: I enjoyed the ease of getting in/out of the hotel, everyone from the valet staff to the hotel staff was fantastic! I had dinner at the steakhouse and it was FABULOUS, I plan to return***** I am not a fisherman but I even found the "Bass pro shop store" that is attached to be REALLY NICE and really nice merchandise. If you have children, the HUGE aquarium with the mermaid that swims with the fish is FABULOUS!!!

allReviews.title: Greatest casino  in Vegas. No need to go anywhere else!
allReviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas. Room was terrific and bed was extremely comfortable. Staff was so helpful, friendly and accommodating . Food  was wonderful at buffet.  Can’t wait to return again soon! The kids took pictures with the mermaids and had the best time ever!

allReviews.title: Silverton's
allReviews.text: A very clean and comfortable place to relax & have fun!  All of the staff are polite, helpful, friendly, & courteous!  Have stayed here many times and have never had a bad experience!  They have a nice choice of restaurants too.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: I had a great stay, the room was very clean and the bed was great. The guest services (Teddy) was very helpful. And food was excellent we did not eat off property because there were so many good choices.

allReviews.title: Great Trip
allReviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed our stay. We would like to return based on the staff and the environment.  I regret not getting a player's card but I will next time. The pool is peaceful also. Lori and Markelly at the front desk were very accommodating as well

allReviews.title: Down home feel
allReviews.text: Great Casino and Hotel.  Easy to get onto the i-15, the Vegas Strip, or the Outlet malls. The have close buy shopping, quick eats and attached to the Bass Proshop. Rooms are fairly nice and if your a gambler the slots pay out most the of time and there is table games as well sportbooking

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: Comfy beds, too many blankets, glasses in halls not removed daily, no refrigerator in room, good valet, good staff, friendly, good aquarium.  ac in room noisy, has gift shop, restaurants great location near outlets, freeway.  was quiet.

allReviews.title: Silverton stay
allReviews.text: A great location and a very nice hotel. I like that the ac keeps the room so cool when it is 110 outside. The casino has a tremendous amount of machines especially video poker which is my favorite. There is a great variety of eating spots.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: If you don't care to be on the strip you are going to get much more value staying at the Silverton. The casino is clean and has a great ventilation  system for us non-smokers. The food selection is wonderful and the beds are ridiculously comfortable. Every time I come to Vegas I stay here because the rates are affordable and half the price of what you will pay for on the strip not to mention the hotel and rooms are 100% better than anything you will get on the strip too.

allReviews.title: great four days
allReviews.text: Excellent location, value and room. Loved the decorations.  Could walk just few feet to casino, food and shopping.  One of the stop signs in front of Bass pro is blocked by tree  Could use more sign directions for parking behind the lodge.

allReviews.title: Nice place off the strip
allReviews.text: It was nice not being on the strip and away from the loud chaos. Great staff and food was really good. We are not drinkers or gamblers but it was busy dishing all those things out. Nothing got to wild nor to boring

allReviews.title: Terrible Rooms, Great Food!
allReviews.text: Terrible rooms that looked like they were from the 1970's. I had to go looking for toilet paper one day. Only had half rolls when I checked in,lol. Check-in and check out was a disaster. They could not produce a room bill for me to review at check.out and I was told that it was normal. I have worked in the hotel/resort business for 30 years and no it's not. There was holes in the shower and the bath tub drain was clogged and hardly moving. No refrigerator, no coffee maker, no table to sit at. The air conditioner just kept turning off every night at 1 in the morning and I had to get up and turn it on, even it was very noisy at times. The good thing was the food, hats off to Ashley Archer the Executive Chef and his team for the great food. My advise is to stay at the South Point and come to Silverton to eat.

allReviews.title: Time to get away
allReviews.text: We have always made a decision to stop and play at Silverton .Good location, good food, and good luck has always been the norm. We have recommended to friends and family members to stop and visit Silverton . The rooms and accommodation are excellent  no complaints here . Looking forward to another visit sometime soon

allReviews.title: Awesome Hotel great service.
allReviews.text: I love this hotel the rooms are clean and comfy. the staff was friendly and cannot wait to return. The resort fees are reasonable and even free parking!!! The casino doesn't smell like smoke either, most other casinos your clothes smell like smoke.

allReviews.title: Pleasant stay
allReviews.text: Overall clean and very comfortable  valet service and bellhop quickRestaurants good could be a little faster on serviceWould be nice to add Italian food. Love the Starbucks so convenient Cocktail waitress service very courteous and accommodating

allReviews.title: good
allReviews.text: room was clean, was able to check in early. overall was a good stay, I wonder why the water at the pool was so cold?? hotel staff was friendly all around, seasons buffet was awesome.(as a suggestion, I don't think a 7 year old kid should pay full price for the buffet)

allReviews.title: Room and Customer service lacking
allReviews.text: We checked into the Hotel with no issue and went up to our room without issue, however when we got into the room the Air Conditioner wasn't working.  I called and they sent up a technician in a timely fashion.  The technician reset the air conditioner and it worked for a bit but stopped so we called back down, rinse and repeat on the 3rd call they decided to change our room and this is were things went from Bad to worse.First, instead of sending someone up with a Key to our new room or meeting us at the new room (we were on the 4th floor and our new room was on the 4th floor) we had to pack up and head down to the lobby to get the Key.  When I questioned this at the desk they said they needed to confirm my ID.  I stated I had it on me and they could have checked it upstairs, no response.We headed upstairs to our new room about as far away from the elevator as you could get.  The room smelled and felt like a damp basement.  We were tired and I didn't want to go through another round so we decided to stay.  We turned on the TV to watch a little before bed, the TV lasted about 20 minutes and then just stopped working.The bathroom is another area that needs help, the shower head is fine if you are say 5' 9" but at six feet I couldn't stand under the shower head.After a not so good night sleep I decided to check out the Fitness Center.  The equipment if you can call it that looks like they bought it used in the 90's.  And for such a large space there is really not much to be called equipment.  A few aerobics pieces (treadmills, etc) and no real weight equipment.At checkout the front desk asked me how my stay was, when I responded that it was not a good experience the clerk literally responded with, Thank you have a good day.Customer service failure all around for at best an average hotel room.

allReviews.title: Revitalizing Weekend
allReviews.text: Staff & Crew were on point, comfort and care provided during our stay. I found Silverton did leave a sparkle in my eye seeing so many treasures in one location. I also highly recommend the 50'd Dinner for their scrumptious steak burgers.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Place was clean and beds where very  comfortable. Will definitely stay again. Restaurant food was good, cafe breakfast was excellent. The staff where very friendly, check in with no problem and checked out pretty quick, no hassle and no hidden fees. All in all great place to stay.

allReviews.title: You get, what you pay for
allReviews.text: 1st room smelled like moldy towels left in the room for days on end, second room smelled like something we cannot describe, the diner took for ever to get service and it wasn't that great for the price regrdless of getting a 50% off coupon for signing up for their card. The bathroom was falling apart and mold every where, the carpets look like they never cleaned them at all. Will not stay here again unless we stay for free.

allReviews.title: Missed out on the mermaid experience.
allReviews.text: Purchased the swim with the mermaid experience and it was canceled. Pushy people at the door wanting you to sign up for promotional items. Guest services could handle identity theft issues a little better.

allReviews.title: SILVERTON CASINO #1
allReviews.text: Always the Best Casino! Overall, great experience with all the staff. They provide professional customer services and are always very friendly. Silverton is my #1 casino when I come into Vegas. I love my promo offers! Free buffet, freeplay, food credit and hotel stays are a value to me. I dobt get that with other casinos. That's why I choose Silverton! Thank you Silverton! I ended my trip for another week..so see you later!

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: I like that it is located close to the airport, the casino has a lot to offer and that is mostly why I continue to stay, I also liked the pool area and the fire pits outside. The comps I receive are great also.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay.
allReviews.text: Everything about this hotel worked for us. The location, the parking, the check in. The room we stayed in was furnished extremely comfortably and very nice looking. The casino was a good size with a lot of different things to play. Many restaurants available. Will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay!
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here at Silverton and I look forward to my next visit... hopefully with my family.My room was clean and welcoming.  The entire staff was friendly and helpful during my stay.  I recommend eating at Mi Casa restaurant inside the casino... the food was amazing and the prices were reasonable considering the awesome service I received from the wait staff and the manager.   There is lots to see and do here if you like to gamble, eat , or just relax.

allReviews.title: Sucked ass
allReviews.text: Was charged for an issue caused by the staff. I would never go back.As far as the food the lobster was okay but the wait was 2hrs just to pay then 30-40 minutes to pay and 15 minutes to wait to get seated.Do your self a favor and stay somewhere else and book a reservation at the Bally's Sterling Brunch while twice the price the quality is so far beyond this place it would be worth it.

allReviews.title: stay
allReviews.text: stayed with family and its a nice place to stay but food is not so tasty. I hope you do something about the buffet. the food here is terrible. and it is not worth the money. other than that the hotel is a nice place to relax

allReviews.title: Friday night Seafood Buffet is OUTSTANDING!
allReviews.text: Get there early, there is a typical 2 hour wait but well worth the wait, Go ahead and play some slots while you wait, they do pay well. Sign up for the players card and receive a 50 % off the buffet and all you can eat Lobster Tails!!!

allReviews.title: Great Little Big Casino Away from the Chaos of the Strip
allReviews.text: We have been here a few times and always love the vibe. The staff are all so friendly and helpful. The rooms are big, quiet, and the beds are sooooo comfy!!!! We didn't go to the pool, but they have a nice pool area with cabanas. There is even an area, Shady Grove, to take a break from gambling where you can go inside an airstream and bowl with mini balls in mini lanes. In the same area there is a pool table and a Foosball table.  There is plenty of action, however my only gripe is that there is no non-smoking area and we have asthma and my eyes were burning. The food is really good. We enjoyed the Mexican restaurant, but were a bit apprehensive as there were two restaurants in one Mi Casa Mexican food, and Su Sushi, Japanese food. But the Mexican food was really good as were the margaritas. I suggest the pitcher, it is a value.

allReviews.title: Outstanding
allReviews.text: Everything was as great as usual! Alectra provided outstanding host support and the front desk was great especially Lori. I look forward to our next visit in September and hopefully can get a luxury king room again.

allReviews.title: Boating trip
allReviews.text: Overall great, could not get a descent night sleep because of the guest right above our room. They were running, jumping and dropping heavy items onto the floor.  It was so loud I thought someone was violently being hurt.

allReviews.title: No non smoking rooms available
allReviews.text: Not really happy with the service ☹️ made a reservation for a non smoking room and the employee wasn't very helpful. We didn't sleep well with the smell of smoke and the smell of weed through out the hotel.........

allReviews.title: Great Las. Vegas location
allReviews.text: From our check in to check out we love this hotel.  Their prices are reasonable, the location is not far from the strip.  The rooms are spacious with comfy beds.  Everyone from the valets to the house keepers are super nice and helpful.  We enjoy shopping at the attached Bass Pro Shop, the restaurant’s are all good as is the gift shop.  Our room could use a bit of updating but was clean and had everything we needed.  I understand they are in the process of updating the rooms.  We will definitely stay here next time we visit Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great getaway location
allReviews.text: Great hotel and price. They have really great food choices. Would stay again for sure. Not to far from the strip. Outsides stores and markets within less than 2 miles. I love this hotel casino! I enjoyed myself at the pool which is a nice getaway from the hot sun.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: First time at this hotel, and my daughter and  i were impressed.  It was a very nice and clean hotel.  We were visiting my niece and this location was great! The aquarium and swimming mermaid wereally awesome.

allReviews.title: Silverton hotel and casino fantastic atmosphere
allReviews.text: Thank you for the comped room the Jacuzzi was great got to gamble and relax service was great the hostess is a very nice lady great food very nice atmosphere I am from ridgecrest California Silverton hotel and casino is fantastic I will be frequently visiting

allReviews.title: SILVERTON WEEKEND IN AUGUST
allReviews.text: Alectra Edison, my host was excellent.  Alectra responds to my questions and takes care of my needs.  The stay was great and all were very friendly and helpful throughout the property.The rooms could stand to be renovated/updated, however, I was grateful for the room so can't complain and they were clean and neat.  When you renovate have more convenience outlets available close to the bed....overall a great experience and I will use Silverton for my business stays when needed.  Thanks you!

allReviews.title: Silverton LV
allReviews.text: Great place.  Really like the restaurants.  Friend staff at the bars.  Love the gift shop and proximity to Bass Pro Shop.  The only place we haven't been is the pool. We will return as soon as possible. We appreciate the great value.  You might consider upgrading the elevators.

allReviews.title: Very nice
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel, friendly staff and very comfortable and clean room. I enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere of the casino . Also the buffet has a great variety of options for all of your favorite foods. I will stay with them again.

allReviews.title: Smoky and stinky
allReviews.text: Stay clear of staying at this ‘resort’.  The rooms and corridors stink like smoke and mildew.  Not sure what rooms were ‘renovated’ but certainly nothing on the floor we stayed on.  Everything is an upcharge, not even a mini fridge in your room.  Pool area is nice, however didnt have a chance to use it as we checked out early.  Restaurant on site was great.  Would not ever stay or recommend this accommodation to anyone. Stay clear!

allReviews.title: Getaway with the grandson
allReviews.text: We had a enjoyable stay here. Rooms are always clean. Staff is welcoming and helpful. We ate each day at a different restaurant at the hotel. Used the pool and exercise center. And of course shopping at Bass Pro Shop. Is convenient to freeway and the strip. Hopefully will be back soon!

allReviews.title: Great facility with tons of extras
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean and tons of room, the staff was friendly, and the Buffet was really good. Silverton’s rewards program was awesome as well, giving me some extra money to play with on the slots so check it out. I was hitting on some tables and slots so I can’t complain about the casino either.

allReviews.title: The Silverton is my fav!
allReviews.text: Best place for table games. $5 crap tables! Good food at the Buffet & Mexican restaurant there. There is also a Starbucks with great employees and free parking! Close to the freeway, Bass Pro shop & Cracker Barrel. Love the friendly employees here too! There is also a free shuttle service that takes you to Aria or the airport! We always stay here when we come to Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Good price and location for what we need!
allReviews.text: Nice place to stay and staff was great to work with! We had a mix up on check in date but staff was helpful and  resolved our issue quickly and kindly!! The buffet is great quality but not as big as most with less variety but the items they do serve are very taste and cooked correctly!!

allReviews.title: Summer trip
allReviews.text: Great family vacation, friendly place , off the main strip so the crowds and traffic is not as bad ! A lot of the staff has been there for 15 years plus and they welcome you back year after year ! We will be going back !

allReviews.title: Veges trip
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our trip to the Silverton.  Clean rooms.   No music at the pool.  Friendly staff   didn't win any money  We stay here a couple of times a year.  Close to the strip.  Great shuttle service   Pro bass shop has some great items on sale.

allReviews.title: Relaxation
allReviews.text: I prefer to avoid hustle and bustle of the strip, but is very easy to get to from the Silverton. Right next to our favorite restaurant (Cracker Barrel) and literally right next to the freeway. Will stay at the Silverton again and again...

allReviews.title: Helpful staffs
allReviews.text: All employee are nice and helpful...room are clean and tidy except they dont have portable fridge in the room....wuhu and buffet restaurant have lot of good food selection...valet parking Attendant are excellent..

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: The Silverton is our home away from home. We stay on average 3 weekends out of the month there. We prefer to stay off the strip yet we are  so close for all events taking place on the strip. The Silverton staff is so friendly and accommodating. From the front desk to the hostess to casino floor personell, the maids and restaurant staff. And best of all the beds are heaven!

allReviews.title: Smoking room was discusting
allReviews.text: The only room available was a smoking room.  There was full nicotine on the walls and every piece of furniture in the room.  The hair dryer was full of the sticky mess.  Very gross!  The sheets were very clean and the bed comfortable.

allReviews.title: Comments on last visit
allReviews.text: I love the free parking in Silverton. Nice, smoking rooms and great beds. Very friendly staff. Only thing is, I wish out of towners like is from California can get more comps. I played quite a bit during our last day and I did barely get any free play money in my players card.

allReviews.title: Wonderful place to stay.....
allReviews.text: Very clean, great service and the gambling is wonderful, won a lot this trip!  The restaurants are delicious, to Sundance, Twin Creeks, and Mia's!  Great property to visit, which we do on a yearly basis and sometimes more.  I have to say my best part of this Casino is the food!!

allReviews.title: birthday trip
allReviews.text: great trip, staff are great, casino is very good, bass pro has a great store, I have stayed there many time and will in the future, food and dining options are very good, just like the size of this facility, less hustle and more relaxed

allReviews.title: A welcome visit
allReviews.text: We stay at The Silverton each time we visit Las Vegas and it never disappoints!  From the friendly service, fun gaming, comfortable rooms, amenities, and various dining options, we always have a fun time.  We look forward to planning another visit in four months.

allReviews.title: Frequent visitor
allReviews.text: The best casino in Vegas . We have been visiting Las Vegas for more than 25 years and we have stayed in this family casino every time . Is clean , rooms are clean, spacious and they have great service. And since is a hotel with 3 floors there is not too many people and the pools is never too full . Great service in the Pool also. One thing , Pool can be expended hours of service to midnight. Other then that is a great hotel we recommended .

allReviews.title: My stay
allReviews.text: I think it’s very important that you guys off rooms on weekends. For some of us that’s the only time we have available besides our vacations. This casino  became my favorite and is the only one I stay at now.

allReviews.title: Silverton stay
allReviews.text: Stopped on our way home and were lucky enough to get a room. Usually stop and have breakfast but decided to try the buffet. It was not disappointing,We also liked their slot machines. They had a great selection of the machines we like to play which are becoming hard to find  at the big casinos. Looking forward to our next trip there.

allReviews.title: Room noise
allReviews.text: See comments on previous page. It sounded like the ceiling was falling down.  We did not sleep well because of the noise that sounded like loud footsteps.  They did not stop until after 2pm.   Along with the loud footsteps it sounded like the ceiling was cracking.

allReviews.title: Nice area, less smokers
allReviews.text: Loved this location , good place for dining, hangout ,relaxing, lots parking, great staffs , great customer services, good tables games, enter high way so easy, lots shopping new by, slots machines great paying back, lots fun at this place

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean and neat.  I booked a smoking room with a king bed for 2 people.  When I got there, reservations told me they didn't reserve the right room but they took care of all that and I had a smoking room with a king bed!  The food was good, the slots and tables are good.  I gambled, I won, I lost and I won again!  I will be back.  Loved the restaurants, the games, the shopping.  My favorite was the large aquarium near bass pro shop!

allReviews.title: Good stay no problems
allReviews.text: We like staying here due to the location off strip and hominess of the property. Friendly staff, good restaurants, close shopping, and nice uncrowded pool. I like that the pool is family friendly. I didn't mind taking my granddaughter there. Loved the ease of check-in and check-out.

allReviews.title: I can't recommend this place
allReviews.text: We had staff issues checking in. One of the beds had a sticky substance on the bottom sheet when we  was we turned the bed whichthediwn our first night. The maid service did come to the room and strip the bed and remade it with clean sheets. Our breakfast the next morning in the hotel restaurant was okay at best. The service was lack luster with our beverages not being refilled without asking. Our waiter would go missing for quite a long time. My recommendation is don't stay or eat at the Silverton.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
allReviews.text: I had been on the road for weeks. This was the cleanest, freshest, and most pleasant hotel on my travels. It was a wonderful hotel. The restaurant had variety of choices. I enjoyed my food especially the cheesecake and berries.

allReviews.title: Get away from the Strip .
allReviews.text: Awesome stay away from the Strip- great staff and everything you need under the Silverton roof. I have been there numerous times and I’m thankful you have updated the rooms well. I will be back soon thanks!

allReviews.title: Relaxed Atmosphere, Good Food and Coomfortable Rooms.
allReviews.text: Very good value for the money, and no real issues with anything.
