A long while back there was one buffet server who didn't seem to notice our table, but that was an isolated incident I now believe.The atmosphere is much ore relaxed than on the strip, and not as crowded and cramped as downtown. If the snack shops like WuHu Noodle stayed open an hour or two later, we'd have nothing but praise for the place.

allReviews.title: Stay in July
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a great time without all the noise then this is your place to stay. We came to the Silverton for a great time which is exactly what you will get if you stay here. Great music, food and most of all the crew that works for the Silverton Casino.

allReviews.title: Summer Vacation
allReviews.text: I cannot sleep very long in a bed, due to health reasons. Had to sleep in the chair!!!! Availability of a recliner in the room or by request would have been great. Also, increase the schedule and the locations for the Shuttle Service.

allReviews.title: Rude management
allReviews.text: I think this hotel has the potential to be “that nice little place” off the strip but the management is horrible. I called and booked my rooms over the phone with Fransisco. He took ALL my information. My card number - everything. I used my husbands credit card because it has great rewards. Anyways, when I checked in, Francisco refused to take the same credit card that he took just a few days before over the phone from me, because my husband didn’t come. I told him to call my husband or call the credit card since I’m an authorized signer but he refused. He kept telling me that I was committing an illegal act. Now, let me tell you I am very familiar with Idaho law but the way he was acting and carrying on I thought maybe Nevada law was different. It is not!!! I have researched it and Nevada Code Section 205.760 states that it is only illegal to use a credit card that you have FRAUDULENTLY taken!!! Francesco wouldn’t take any steps to verify this was not fraudulent! So my advice to you Francisco is stick with what you know and that’s booking people in at the front desk! Also I believe he treated me unfairly because I’m white! Now listen to this part! He wanted to charge me and additional $40 a night for my 10 and 12 year old!!!! Now remember this people! He took my booking!!! He knew I was coming for my daughters basketball tourney! Why wouldn’t I have my kids! But here’s what happened next! I watched him check in a very large Hispanic family after me (his nationality) and not once did he even attempt to count heads and start charging extra. Listen we travel a lot and I’ve never been treated so rude. Also, the Starbucks doesn’t care if you have your Debit card and personal identification number they still want your license - which is actually a violation of my personal rights which I will be looking into more.  The beds are comfortable, but not worth the hassle of the hotel. I will never stay here again and would not recommend it to anyone else.

allReviews.title: vacation
allReviews.text: the place was clean, one of the nights bartender took a while to get me a drink, but next night was different bartender and was much better, maybe pool can stay open till 11pm during summer timethat could be an option, the sink in the bathroom drained slow but water went down eventually,overall was good two nights

allReviews.title: Love this hotel
allReviews.text: Friendly staff comfortable beds love the casino. Everyone treated us so well your hotel is a family favorite of ours and we love staying with silverton casino. I can’t wait to come back for another visit!

allReviews.title: Happy customer and would definitely endorse telling everyone I know if you want a great hotel experience stay here.
allReviews.text: Happy customer and would definitely endorse telling everyone I know if you want a great hotel experience stay here.

allReviews.title: off the strip and very nice
allReviews.text: The  food and accommodations were very good, the bass pro is really fun to visit as is the reasonable gambling , would recommend and will stay again. Also location is easy to reach much less congestion then the strip....

allReviews.title: local stay and loved it
allReviews.text: We had a great stay.  Room service was awesome, rooms were very clean and spacious, we are locals and would defiantly stay again. oh and the prices were crazy cheap. you can walk down to Bass Pro and see the mermaids with the kids too

allReviews.title: Vegas in July
allReviews.text: Seating in the room not adequate. 2 office chairs in the room would be a big plus. One to work on and one to put make-up on.We asked for one but were unable to attain one. Your staff was very friendly. valets, bell hops, dealers, check in clerks.

allReviews.title: Another great time
allReviews.text: Great suite, steak dinner and vacation. We also had a great sushi dinner that was reasonably priced and delicious. Housekeeping good and staff as well. Not great luck this time at the casino, but still enjoyed our visit.

allReviews.title: Always an enjoyable stay
allReviews.text: Silverton never disappoints me !  The staff is always friendly and welcoming, beds are comfortable. and the rooms are clean. Great variety of reasonably priced dining options. Truly a hidden gem if prefer to avoid the busy strip, and just relax and have fun.

allReviews.title: Clean, fun, and a great local hotel & casino
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here as a staycation as we are vegas locals and do this from time to time.. The staff was friendly and quick to any request, helpful and polite. They have done some remodeling and has a great vibe and feel. Food was tasty and hotel rooms modernized and clean. Slots were not so nice to me, but the wife did ok.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a great experience same from what other more expensive hotels have the same thing of, with better service and more local feel. Great choice..

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: This was our 2nd time staying here. We enjoy the rustic atmosphere. Staff is friendly, courteous and professional. Loved the restaurants! Visited the Bass Pro Shop which is always fun. We will be back!

allReviews.title: Review
allReviews.text: Great experience and will stay here again. Fair amount of diversity in the table games but could have additional games. Recommend SWITCH and more FREE BET tables for example, but with higher betting levels on the coin bet. Enjoyed the aquarium views as well. Very impressive.

allReviews.title: Local Casino with tighter slots than the strip.
allReviews.text: Usually the off strip casinos have a little better pay back, but this does not appear to be the case at the Silverton.  The bonuses didn't seem to come up as often and when they did they paid less than the same machines I played at the Wynn.  It wasn't just me it seemed that everyone in our group thought the same thing when we left.  The only good thing about stopping there was the Mexican restaurant.  It did have good food.

allReviews.title: July 4th
allReviews.text: I will stay here again, even though I couldn't connect my iPad to the tv and there was no fridge in the room. I was told not all TVs in the hotel are equipped to connect to devices via USB. Overall, I will be staying here again

allReviews.title: Just okay
allReviews.text: There is hardly any signage to show where the entrance is. The high rise building with the silverton name on it is not the right building, but it is the first place you can see. Doesn’t get any better on the inside with everything so cluttered together. Smells awful with a mixture of cigarettes, alcohol and whatever else folks are smoking or vaping. The rooms were clean.

allReviews.title: Never ever staying here again
allReviews.text: Key card did not work three times. Each time I had to go to front desk bringing all the kids and luggage with us. Hotel manager refused to come to room to speak with me and instead wanted me to go down for a fourth time to discuss. Lousy customer service and hotel manager to lazy to go upstairs to discuss a problem. Bathroom floor was dirty and shower curtain needed replacing. Also USB charging ports did not work.

allReviews.title: Buffet
allReviews.text: Large variety, very fresh fruit! The staff is very attentive. Clam chowder is delicious. Large selection of food, italian, latin, chinese, fresh salads. Many sugar free desserts. We go once a week. Recently moved here from Texas. The brisket is pretty good.

allReviews.title: Very Disappointed
allReviews.text: Used to be one of our favorite spots in Vegas Now we are considering other accommodations.Strong smell of weed in the halls and gust areas as well as wrong reservation type and also had poor quality food at the Buffet.

allReviews.title: Great Little Off Strip place to Stay
allReviews.text: Great Hotel/Casino off the main Vegas strip to stay with lots of amenities and quiet rooms. Valet staff was very attentive even though service was free and all they asked was for tips. If you enjoy Bass Pro it is next door.

allReviews.title: Silverton Review - Girl's Trip # 32
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel, great accommodations, friendly staff and great value.  Great restaurants, the Sundance Café is very good and the Mexican Restaurant was excellent. We stayed in newly refurbished rooms (2), I highly recommend this casino.

allReviews.title: Extra Special Hotel
allReviews.text: Super friendly staff including housekeeping and everyone who got in the elevator with us.Very kid friendly.  Love Bass Pro Shop attached and the best mermaid show!  Yummy restaurants, and outdoor area..

allReviews.title: It Could Be Better
allReviews.text: The check-in lobby needs improvement.  Your staff does well with what they are working with.You need more staff and better management.  Better customer service.  I am not asking for much.  I need more characters for my review, while I am disappointed for a casino that needs business.  Oh - I like your self parking garage.

allReviews.title: Independence Day
allReviews.text: Perfect 👌 everyone and everything was really good and nice my kids and my husband and I had a wonderful time we dient win any money at the slots but maybe next time will have a better luck thank you for having us

allReviews.title: Honesty
allReviews.text: planned a getaway and was given a different room for my anniversary.this was unacceptable. wasn't able to discuss with supervisor.  Made our trip boring as if we were traveling with the kids.  Staff should of tried harder to find a room.

allReviews.title: The only place we stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: A great place to stay in Vegas.  Myself and my better half like to be away from the strip these days.  We are close enough however, to head down there for dinner or a show if we feel the need or desire.

allReviews.title: Dirty Sheets
allReviews.text: Make sure the sheets are and blankets are clean also offer coupons and better Customer Service.The location was good and they had some good restaurants.  The slot machines could be a bit looser to make it more fun.

allReviews.title: Another Great Stay
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Silverton several times in the past and as in the past this stay was great. This is not a "top end" property but it's clean, well maintained, has easy parking, a nice casino and is a very good value. I had no issues during my 5 night stay and I'll be back in the future.

allReviews.title: Clean, modern rooms
allReviews.text: Our one night stay was great ... nice room, friendly staff.  Buffet was good, nice selection of machines on the gaming floor.  Would definitely stay again,  Security was helpful wit parking our oversized vehicle.

allReviews.title: Welcome Home
allReviews.text: My stay at the Silverton was fantastic! Checking in and out was simple and pleasurable due to the knowledgeable staff. Our room was clean and comfortable. We ate at the Grill, the Buffet, and the Steakhouse and all meals were very good. The Buffet offers an abundance of choices. The Grill has an extensive menu. I ordered a BLT that was out of this world. As a matter of fact, you could have probably made two sandwiches out of the amount of bacon that was in this sandwich. YUM! We made reservations at the steakhouse and were not disappointed. The service was exceptional and the prime rib melted in your mouth. The layout of the casino area is comfortable and inviting. I love the penny KENO games that are offered. If you like to play multicard KENO, you won’t be disappointed. I also love the idea of having a Starbucks on the premises. Sipping on a Mocha, eating hot pumpkin bread and playing penny KENO... who could ask for anything more? I even managed to pull myself away from the casino long enough to go shopping at the Bass Pro, which is conveniently attached to the casino. Overall, our week long stay at the Silverton was fantastic and I can hardly wait to return. When I’m at the Silverton, I feel like I have all the comforts of home.

allReviews.title: Bass pro
allReviews.text: I would go for bass pro not to gamble , rooms are ok nothing outstanding, small casino , not many people there when we were there. Maybe if more people were there payouts would be better. Bass pro excellent store large and very we’ll stocked.

allReviews.title: Affordable lodging, with several caveats
allReviews.text: The Silverton is affordable and has some beneficial amenities; however, that is all I can say for the positives.  The walls are paper thin so it made it challenging to get a good night’s sleep.  The toilet leaked and the room had an odd smell to it.  They had challenges checking me in and out with billing.  The Silverton has a very large aquarium which at first seemed neat, some of the fish and sting rays looked rather unhealthy; one of the largest stingrays (See photo) appeared to have had its tail cut off.  That made it hard to feel good about staying there.  It isn’t the worst place, but I don’t know that I’ll be going back.  It served its purpose for a business trip.

allReviews.title: Good place to stay
allReviews.text: Not the top notch, but affordable and nice place overall for the money spent. I've stayed at most locations in Vegas, but this one I feel has great value and we always get a good deal. The fish tank alone is great, but add the fact you can walk through Bass Pro Shops, it's a good deal all the way around. The rooms are older but there is a new addition with newer rooms on the property. Cracker Barrel is right there for food if you don't want the casino food.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: I always like staying at the Silverton quite off strip with easy access to strip.  Pool is generally quite so its easy to relax and get away. Onsite restaurants are good and there is plenty places close to eat.

allReviews.title: Gem of a Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: This is our 4th stay at the Silverton. The staff is always top notch. The restaurants are delicious and the rooms are very nicely appointed. You are far enough off the strip to avoid the hustle and bustle. It’s like a boutique casino.

allReviews.title: Silverton Stay
allReviews.text: I have stayed at Silverton several times in the past and always found the rooms to be comfortable. This stay we were put in a room that had a deer's head mounted on the wall. It also featured a photo on the wall of a hunter proudly standing over his trophy--a dead moose!!. What disgusting decor!! I would have asked for a different room but was only staying 1 night. Also was not offered any discount coupons for the casino eateries upon check-in. Silverton would always include these discounts in the key packet in the past.

allReviews.title: Relaxing at Silverton
allReviews.text: The absolute beat place to stay in Las Vegas. Very friendly and helpful staff. The steakhouse,  the buffet, Mi Casa, Wuhu Noodle, the Mermaid lounge, and Season's Grill were all exceptional!  Even won a little money.

allReviews.title: THEIR TOWELS ARE DISGUSTING

allReviews.title: Not a kid friendly or a well kept Hotel
allReviews.text: This Hotel is not kid friendly and was dirty and not well kept. Pool equipment was broke in several areas (not safe) and the casino had no ventilation, so if you were to just walk through to get to your room and you dont smoke, hold your breath. My family and I stayed for 1 night and left with soar throats.

allReviews.title: FOOD INFO
allReviews.text: could use more late night food/desert options. lines are long/wait time and staff seams a bit overwhelmed. Very little kid options. VERY BRIGHT SIDE 4TH OF JULY pool party great all aspects. See u all soon!

allReviews.title: Pleasure at the Silverton
allReviews.text: we had a Relaxing time at the pool & service was great.Service at the check in was great & friendly & helpful service Rooms were clean and beds were comfortable tooWe will stay here next trip out to Vegas

allReviews.title: Great Las Vegas Casino Hotel
allReviews.text: Though far from the Las Vegas strip, this hotel offers s nice room, pool, restaurants and gaming experience (though I do not gamble).My room was large and comfortable and the staff was helpful (though when I arrived and also during my stay, there was only one front desk person on duty).I will stay here again when I visit my friends in the Las Vegas area, and I recommend it for everyone else!

allReviews.title: Our favorite hotel in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: This is the only hotel we will stay in in Las vegas. We love the location, the Casino, and the staff. The only downfall was the dismal internet speed. We had almost no cell phone service in room 1007 and really needed a decent internet speed for communication purposes.

allReviews.title: So good
allReviews.text: All around the stay here was phenomenal. I had left my wallet downstairs and went back and security had already received it and took good care of it. Cleaning crews were constantly moving around. Smiles on everyone’s faces and guest services was perfect

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: I have enjoyed my stay at this hotel, the rooms are very comfortable and the noise is low, that is why I continue to stay at Silverton Hotel.  The food at Twin Creeks has always been excellent and priced just right.

allReviews.title: Good, Except for Kids in Casino & No Mini-Frig in Room
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay except for a few things. The first thing we noticed was “Why no mini-frig in our room?” We’ve come to depend on them as a place to store our medication. Also, get the kids out of casino!

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: This is a great location if you want to be slightly off the strip and have easy time getting in and out of the hotel.  It is a smaller casino but I enjoy that as you don't have to worry about having a hard time locating your friends.  It is a casual casino so no need to dress up.

allReviews.title: Road trip 2019
allReviews.text: Want to stay someplace that makes you feel like your part of a family, off the Strip? Then this is your place! We visit Las Vegas 2 or 3 times a year, but never stayed here until now. From now on this will be our place in Las Vegas!!

allReviews.title: Our stay

allReviews.title: great time!
allReviews.text: great time excellent casino i will be back again  loved the food, the atmosphere the staff all but one craps dealer he had an awful attitude  i left the table among others till he was gone then we went back to playing but had a good time

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Silverton for only one night coming back from a visit to the Grand Canyon. It was close to the airport and a very reasonable rate. However we had a challenging time finding the hotel. There is a tall time-share in front which was confusing, but we eventually found the hotel. Then it was finding check in. It is not by the door so one has to look around for signs and directions.The room on the fourth floor was spacious and quiet. There was a lack of plugs so I had to unplug a lamp to plug in my c-pap machine to sleep. There is also no fridge or microwave in case of dinner leftovers. The bathroom was small for the size of the room. The toilet takes up half the floor in the bathroom. In the main room there is a comfy two person couch with a coffee table as well as a desk chair so plenty of places to sit. Overall this is a good choice for a visit to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Couples weekend
allReviews.text: We prefer to stay at silverton rather than at the strip like the rest of the party because we always have great experiences as we always do. The fact that theyre next to bass pro shop is an icing on the cake since our family loves going camping as well.

allReviews.title: Anniversary Stay
allReviews.text: Excellent time had by all! Clean, friendly, and any small issues were handled with ease.Food was excellent and a great value in Twin Creeks.  The cabana was clean and the poolside  service was excellent.

allReviews.title: Silverton Stay was Fantastic
allReviews.text: Great restaurants, clean rooms, friendly staff and absolutely the easiest and quickest check-in on any hotel casino I've experienced. I was in and out in less than five minutes.  We ate breakfast at the hotel instead of waiting an hour at Cracker Barrel and was very please with the food quality and price.

allReviews.title: very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Fun

allReviews.title: Another great stay.
allReviews.text: I really enjoy the lodge atmosphere here. The relatively smaller size of the property allows for a more personal experience in my opinion. Very nice pool area, a decent fitness room, a really good buffet, and parking only a few minutes away from the room are all great perks.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Very much enjoyed our stay....loved the aqurium ! We enjoyed the food at the coffee shop, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. The price was great and my husband liked the proximity to Bass Pro Shops.

allReviews.title: Great Off-Strip Locale!
allReviews.text: Had visited Silverton on a previous trip to check out the property, see the awesome aquarium, and play in the casino. The general lodge-styled feel is accented with contemporary flair in some areas, and redneck charm in others. Speaking of which, Bass Pro Shop is directly attached to the casino. The staff is great. The food is above average. Our room was very nice. Great location off the strip! We will be back.

allReviews.title: viist
allReviews.text: I enjoy coming to Las Vegas to get away from everything since last year i couldn't go anywhere because i was going though chemo so this year I'm traveling and getting my life back. We always go to the Silverton because we like the promotions. Hope that we can still get them or try another place

allReviews.title: 1st stay
allReviews.text: Good free parking, not too crowded, away from strip, good looser slots, good customer service, carpets are worn down, you can hear footsteps from top floor, resort fee reasonable, $5.99 steak and eggs after midnight only for guests 21 and up (what!!!) Sorry kiddos! They ran out of poke last time we ate at the Luau buffet.

allReviews.title: Best Value In Town...
allReviews.text: Best Value in town... friendly staff and free drinks aplenty. Stay here every time and they never disappoint...good gaming and food variety not to mention the Bass shop for a shopping excursion next door.

allReviews.title: Great off strip Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Been staying for past 6 yrs on Fremont Street at the Downtown Grand.  Booked The Silverton at a friend's recommendation.  I think I have found my new hotel and casino.  Great casino, and a mermaid bar that's incredible. Oh ya and Bass Pro shop.  I will definitely be staying there more often.

allReviews.title: Great Value
allReviews.text: The hotel is off the strip but close. Everything is nice and cheaper than on the strip. If you don’t care about the buzz of the strip, it’s a great hotel/casino to go to. There’s nice rooms, a good casino with all the tables and slots you want, a big sports book and a nice resort style pool.

allReviews.title: Silverton vacation- great location and easy access from car to room.  Don’t have to do the maze walk to get to room.
allReviews.text: Silverton vacation- great location and easy access from car to room.  Don’t have to do the maze walk to get to room.

allReviews.title: Great vacation
allReviews.text: Excellent place to stay and relax for vacation. Hotel provides lot of promotions, food and slot credits. The lobster dinner is best though you have to wait for more than four hours. Slot tournament is exciting, and prizes are generous.

allReviews.title: A GEM in the Desert
allReviews.text: I like this place for its location and service as well as value.  They have nice restaurants with variety of food.  The Chinese Restaurant has great food and service.  Buffet was excellent on Friday and Saturday.  They should limit the smoking near the restaurant area.  Wifi can be improved.

allReviews.title: Staff problem
allReviews.text: Overall it was an ok trip. I was there with family and I was with a large group of people we were gambling on tables and slots near each other and when some of my family were getting drink at the table I ask for drinks too and was deny

allReviews.title: We love the silverton
allReviews.text: The silverton is a great place to stay. The restaurants are awesome and have great prices, the rooms are clean, the pool is so nice. We have stayed at the silverton each time we go to Vegas and we look forward to staying again!

allReviews.title: Best Place to stay off the strip!
allReviews.text: Sliverton has the best restaurants in Vegas. Also there beds are comfortable. Drinks at the bar are fair priced. The staff are friendly and willing to help any of our needs. I will definitely come back soon

allReviews.title: Aquarium is awesome!
allReviews.text: Love the ambiance.  The mermaid aquarium is amazing!  The Sundance grill has the best midnight menu in town.   I like the atmosphere and location to hang out with clients or friends.  It's a great local place close to but off the main strip.

allReviews.title: crap stay
allReviews.text: i stay here 4 to 5 times a year i got hurt was not able it here the last here but h i'm healing i real like there but needs little fixing i;ll stay there again but it a little work food needs work on it sucks to pay for a meal i can eat

allReviews.title: Silverton Sane Comfort
allReviews.text: Been staying here almost exclusively for a few years now. The rewards program is a must to use, pays great dividends.P in every way to avoid the craziness and idiots often associated with Vegas!! I love the casual easy vibe and mellowness that is like staying qt a country resort.

allReviews.title: frequent visitor
allReviews.text: nice hotel, great location away from the strip. nice comfortable rooms. . Beautiful aquarium inside and connected to Bass Pro Shop. They routinely have band playing at the pool on wknd nights.Front desk staff is great

allReviews.title: Celebrating my sixty-seventh birthday, with my husband, Joe, at our favorite spot to stay, The Silverton Hotel and Casin
allReviews.text: Celebrating my sixty-seventh birthday, with my husband, Joe, at our favorite spot to stay, The Silverton Hotel and Casin

allReviews.title: Best bed on the planet!
allReviews.text: Went for a relaxing week. Hotel has great restaurants and a gorgeous aquarium & art exhibit. A very fun bar called Shady Grove Lounge that has Ladies Drink Free Happy Hour Sun-Thurs 4-6. Got to try some wild Concoctions. Great service everywhere.

allReviews.title: Anniversary trip
allReviews.text: As always, the staff is amazingly friendly and helpful (especially Lori at the front desk) and our food is always excellent at Sundance (Country and Bananas Foster French Toast), Mi Casa and especially Twin Creeks.

allReviews.title: Hotel street view is misleading.
allReviews.text: As you approach this casino/hotel you will see a nice new looking high rise building that looks like a hotel and it has a huge lit sign on top spelling " SILVERTON" which leads you to believe that is where you will be staying as a guest.  It is not! The actual hotel is much older and in need of updating. However, the room was clean and the bed comfortable. The ground floor level hallway had a musty smell. Check-in went smooth and employees friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great place always have a great time when I stay here staff are friendly and helpful it's a great place to meet friends and family. Love the location easy to get to without all the traffic that downtown Vegas has.

allReviews.title: Excellant Casino
allReviews.text: Fun place to eat, sleep, and play.  Location is great also.  :))  can't say enough good things aboutthis hotel and casino. this is why every chance to get to take a short vacation, this is where wehead for.  forgot to mention that the rewards are a super push for us to go. thanx  :))

allReviews.title: nice peaceful place to relax for couple days
allReviews.text: Very relaxed atmosphere and can still have fun......games are improving to latest and greatest.  Enjoyed the pool area with lots of umbrellas.  Restaurants are surprising very good, always love the mexican food place.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Our room was clean and the bed is soooo soft, we love it. We regretted not able to bring out swim wear for the pool and workout outfit for the gym. We had buffet for dinner and played at the machines. We enjoyed our stay.

allReviews.title: UN-SAFE And UN-EASY Worst Trip First Time to Silverton
allReviews.text: Un-Happy AND Our Worst Trip and First Time to Silverton ....Not Sure if we will Make it back To the Silverton... The food Was Fine..Not The Best The Layout Was Fine the Room was Fine.. the Bathroom was Better than Fine & the Bed Was GOOD...Drink Prices were alittle High and The Lounge had NO room to Dance

allReviews.title: Fun time
allReviews.text: Had a great time, love that bass pro shop is adjoined to it. The all you can eat tacos and beer was awesome and it was great. Can't say enough about the sushi, delicious. The slots were a little tight but we played for hours and it was great

allReviews.title: 48th Anniversary Celebration
allReviews.text: We stayed at Silverton for our 48th anniversary.  Clean, comfortable, & very roomy rooms.  Very friendly hotel staff.  The casino also has very friendly staff. Plenty of different kinds of gambling machines.  The Mermaid lounge had nice entertainment.  So glad we went there.  The only disapproving thing was the lobster buffet.  We waited 3 hrs in lines only to get cold & dried out items.  The lobster itself was good.  The sushi station wasn't as great. Will definitely go back but not for the lobster buffet...

allReviews.title: Harder to find but worth it
allReviews.text: Terrible hard to find hotel check in!!!  Parking is a challenge, too much smoking in the casino but neat aquarium, attached to Bass Pro Shops, lots to do and see, friendly staff, room was very weirdly shaped and nothing special,rates sound good until they add all their resort fees and such!  No free breakfast or even cheap breakfast on premise.

allReviews.title: The Silverton Hotel and Casino is a Great Place to Stay
allReviews.text: This is an overall, hands down, great and pleasurable place to stay.  The staff, restaurants, and other amenities are quite pleasant and desirable.  The early Am breakfast is tremendously great.  I think anyone, single, couple, or family would do great staying here.  The Mermaid feature is a good extra treat for all of the family!!

allReviews.title: Away From the Hustle and Bustle of the Main Strip
allReviews.text: What I like most is the location. It is away from the hustle and bustles of the main strip. The surrounding and ambiance was calm and suited for a vacation which I was able to have. I also like the fact that the ventilation was also very good because being a non-smoker, my sinuses is trigerred by the smell of  cigaretter smoke. Unlike the other lodges where I smell the cigaretter smoke as soon as I enter the facility, Silverton has a very good air ventilation system.I will come visit again and I will make sure to return to your lodge.

allReviews.title: Great base for our Road Trips.
allReviews.text: To be clear, this was a 5 Star stay at a 4 Star casino.  The Silverton has something the strip casinos does not have and that is a laid back atmosphere and some much needed peace and quiet.  We did road trips to Death Valley and Joshua Tree and the Silverton is right at 160 (to Death Valley) and I-15 (to Joshua Tree), so it was the perfect place for us to stay in Las Vegas for a few nights.  Service was very good.  The front desk was very nice.  We ate at the buffet one evening (different review) and everyone there was nice too.  The casino didn't do me any favors.  I was up a little and then I wasn't, but that's the way it works.  You win some, you lose some.  We did not use the pool.  It is on the small side, but nice looking.  The Mermaid Bar looked cool, but I was with my teen daughter, so I didn't make it in there.  There is also a huge Bass Pro Shop attached to the resort, which is worth a look.The room itself had comfortable beds.  The TV was good.  There was some empty space in one of the corners of the room.  It really could have used a small desk area and a chair.  It was wasted space.  As with most Vegas resorts I looked at, there is a resort fee.  Parking was simple and plentiful.  We parked around back and there is an entrance you can go in right by the elevators, which was very nice.Our stay was really good.  I would not have a problem staying again.

allReviews.title: Famiy safe stay
allReviews.text: Very good for family and my wife and I property was in excellent conditionThe family enjoy the mermaid and the diapers. who 1300 hundred fish in one tank,the staff was very congenial.  The whole experience was very pleasant.Bass pro shop family look and purchase smoker,fishing  iuehr"s and more.

allReviews.title: Lobster Buffet - great offer needs process improvements
allReviews.text: We recently visited the Silverton on their Friday night Lobster buffet evening. We waited in line for a full 2.5 hours which is fair enough as this is obviously a very popular sitting. However I question the time people who were already seated were taking - wouldn’t it be better if the Silverton put a time limit on how long people could stay at their tables this would surely make the line move quicker. The food was excellent and outstanding value. However I had indigestion as shortly after being seated we were told that we had 25 minutes left before the food would stopped to be put out. Clearly this wasn’t fair as early stated previous dinners were taking a great deal of time.

allReviews.title: Silverton casino Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very nice casino, beautiful pool deck, lucrative food comps based on your previous stay and play. Free parking and free shuttle service to the strip and to South Point casino. Excellent location close to the strip. Easy access to Interstate 15 and Interstate 215

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: very good. I will come back again soon.  We love your place especially if we win something.  Thank you very much.  Hope to stay again soon.  My thanks to all the Silverton Casino and staff. You are the number one. Thank you for everything.  Mahalo and.

allReviews.title: SILVERTON STAY
allReviews.text: THE SILVERTON is always a GREAT place to stay ...Wu Hu Noodle , Sundance Grill, ALWAYS THE BEST FOOD & SERVIVE !! As far as Twin Creeks goes - the SERVICE WAS VERY GOOD but the Steaks were very subpar - Honestly -I can get a better cut of meat at Costcos !!!

allReviews.title: Never again
allReviews.text: The only plus was the bed was comfortable. The food was awful. There are no waitresses anywhere. You are allowed 1 drink and it needs to be completely empty before ordering another even if it takes the waitress 30 minutes to return.  Very tight machines.

allReviews.title: Family Fun!!!
allReviews.text: It was a family trip in total my group rented 6 rooms. We had a blast gambling as well as the children in the pool. We were able to eat all 4 days in the hotel. Did not really have the need to go out of the hotel. All amenities were there. We are planning to go back soon .

allReviews.title: Quality Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Thumbs up all the way!  Probably in my opinion one of the best Hotel and Casinos out the Las Vegas Strip.  Weather you are visiting, passing thru or vacationing in the Vegas area, I would highly recommend the Silverton, you will not be disappointed!

allReviews.title: None
allReviews.text: We selected Silverton Hotel and Casino because it is near our home and it was the first time for our son and his family from Hawaii to stay there They usually stay in another hotel whenever they come to visit us.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: We recently stayed five nights at the Silverton, visiting family in Vegas.  The service at Silverton was top notch, from making the reservation over the phone, to the front desk, to the bartenders and serving staff at the restaurants, everyone we encountered was helpful and friendly.  The front desk is a bit hard to find, tucked in to the casino.  Our room was dated for sure (as other reviews have stated) but extremely clean and housekeeping was spot on.  I do miss the coffeemaker/fridge/microwave in the rooms, though.  It was fun to shop at the attached Bass Pro Shop and the Silverton maintains a massive aquarium which is fun to watch.  Free parking was a plus too, as was easy access off I-15.  It seemed family friendly.  The pool is great, I wish the pool bar was open later. The ladies staffing the pool bar were fun and friendly.   Somehow, you can not hear any noise from the freeway when you are in the pool area, even though the freeway is just over the fence.  Great landscaping throughout.  I think we hit all the restaurants, food was great, although the service was spotty at times, like someone called in sick and the server was struggling.  We can't wait to return!

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay!
allReviews.text: Once again, a great place to stay! Everything from the value, casino, restaurants, beautiful pool area, staff & location were great! The Silverton has been our favorite place to stay in all of Vegas. Looking forward to my next stay there.

allReviews.title: Great place!
allReviews.text: Clean room, comfortable bed, polite staff, fun pool, and good restaurants. I highly recommend Su Casa, their sushi is excellent! The hotel was also very quiet. I didn't hear any noise. Overall, a great and fun place to stay at!

allReviews.title: Great deal. Get a player card!
allReviews.text: Solid for price. Having a player card helps with food costs. Good restaurants. Bass pro shop provides a little shopping break. Starbucks located in the casino is nice. We enjoyed the aquarium. Its a good value for the price

allReviews.title: Good time!
allReviews.text: We were in town for our granddaughter dance performance. We didn't want to stay on the strip so this Hotel was recommended by a friend.  We had a great time. The mermaids were a big hit.  Service was excellent, all the employees were very friendly.  The only problem we had was the bathtub would not drain.  But, we would definitely come back .

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel
allReviews.text: We were in the second floor with private patio overlooking the pool. Shout out to my casino host Meriam! She’s great and very pleasant to deal with. I would definitely recommend this hotel.  Great staff.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay
allReviews.text: This hotel is quite a nice place to stay. Rooms are comfortable, restaurants are good. I'm not a huge gambler but the casino has plenty of variety. Easy access to the Strip. My husband and I enjoy shopping at the Bass Pro Shop.

allReviews.title: Little gem and such friendly employees!
allReviews.text: We were only here for a very short stay (arrived at 3 am after a delayed flight!) but from the second we pulled up we were greeted with top notch service. Our vallet Reggie was exceptional, the front desk staff was super nice, the beds were cozy, and the aquarium was awesome! We plan to stop back to see the mermaids before we fly back to PA. Also- super affordable!

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel 100%
allReviews.text: The location and the free parking is a WONDERFUL perk! The quietness of the pool and the staff are great. Price is good. Plenty of good places to eat and the Casino is just right. Not to smoky like others.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: On a positive note the new Su Casa is amazing! The service was excellent. On the negative side, someone should check the headboards on the beds in room 2055, I had to cover them in order to sleep because they were so disgusting, unacceptable!

allReviews.title: Very basic hotel room
allReviews.text: The double queen room we stayed in was accommodating for our four night stay. There was no refrigerator,  no microwave, And no coffee maker. There was not a vending machine on our floor. It’s hard to stay in the hotel rooms for longer stays without the simple accommodations.

allReviews.title: Quick Low Cost Getaway
allReviews.text: We had some comps so we took a quick trip here. Casual typical older casino attached to Bass pro shop. We stayed 3 nights and used this as a base for our VEGAS trip. If you are looking for a low key location this is it. Be sure to check out the giant aquarium.

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: We loved that you are off the strip. Pool bar Sway and staff Lawesa & Tiarra were the best ! The mermaid bar food and drinks were good. The food at buffet was disappointing as everything was bland and not hot enough. Valet staff was very friendly !

allReviews.title: Silverton Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great little casino with friendly folks. A good value for your funds. Casino Hosts a little Stingy though. Great Buffet for the money. Connected to Bass Pro Shop. Best Bass in the world and worth the trip to see the store. Great aquarium too.

allReviews.title: Will be back
allReviews.text: Came for my cousin's wedding at the Veil event center. Everything was beautiful and nice. The room was amazing, location is ideal and I enjoyed myself. I will definitely come back with my husband. The event center was awesome and beautiful. The food was delicious as well. Wonderful experience overall.

allReviews.title: Fun time at the Sliverton
allReviews.text: Spend one night and half a day at the Silverton Hotel,  room was neat, clean and was very comfortable.   Food was very good at all the resturants and staff was friendly and made you feel welcome.   This place is just off the Strip and has a wide variety of machines.  Could you a few more 5 blackjack tables.   If you join the players club you get lots of comps and often a free room.

allReviews.title: Nice calm place
allReviews.text: I like the Silverton as it is not on the strip and it is much calmer than those that are.  I am not in favour of the resort fees charged by hotels in Las Vegas as they are sometimes more than the cost of the room.

allReviews.title: Off Strip Casino Runs a Good Craps Game
allReviews.text: If you're on The Strip playing Craps the table minimums are $10, $15, $25 even $100. With that they only let you take two times odds - somes three, four, five times; but, that's it. You go south just a little way to the Silverton and find craps games with $5 and $10 minimum bets and 100 times odds. It gets better: 12 in the Field pays 3 times instead of two on The Strip. There's more:$10 bets on 4 or 10 are automatic Buys that pay $19 instead of $18. If you like to get ripped off, play Craps on The Strip. If you want something close to a fair game check out the Silverton.

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: The hotel is a great value. They have great staff, great customer service and great restaurant options. Only negative would be that the rooms don't have great soundproofing and people tend to be up late at casinos.

allReviews.title: Off the beaten trail but great place to go
allReviews.text: I usually stay at Silverton Hotel when I go to Vegas as it's not so crazy like the strip and offers great restaurants and gaming.  It seems as though more locals go there.  They offer shuttles to and from the airport and that is a deciding factor for me.  Always friendly drivers that take care of you. Rooms are a bit dated, but clean and pool is smaller than other places but staff is friendly, drinks are good and they have a nice variety of restaurants.  If you eat at Twin Creeks Steakhouse it will be hard not to eat too much bread.  It is absolutely the very best bread I've ever eaten with an excellent variety so crusty and delicious!!! and (homemade).An added perk is the Bass Pro Shop and Aquarium.

allReviews.title: Qualitier
allReviews.text: Avoid the congestion and madness of the strip with quick car access to shopping, interstate, and other casinos.   Always have a pleasant hotel stay and prefer playing in the casino over those on the strip. Staff friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Best start to a vacation
allReviews.text: Very inviting when you walk in. (The kids loved the fish tank). The staff and service was excellent. The staff  always greeted us and thanked us when we left. Plus having bass pro right there I for one couldn't be any happier! Only downside was no fridge.

allReviews.title: Peacefulness in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My favorite place to stay in Vegas.  Never had a complaint in all the times I've been there. The food is great.  The games are fun.  The aquarium is nice and Bass Pro Shop always makes a for a great shopping experience.  It's the only place in Las Vegas that I feel comfortable being at.

allReviews.title: Memorial Day Weekend at Silverton
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful time from arrival to end we loved this place is really clean and all of the staff are very helpful and make you feel comfortable Love the Bartenders they’re great and the Restaurant’s are really good can’t wait to go back

allReviews.title: Heading out a Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Stopped in to the Silverton cuz it's directly connected with Bass Pro Shops. Nice and clean inside the casino have a huge aquarium little entertaining people. Wasn't very busy for a Friday afternoon. Looked into the possibility of staying there but 1899 Resort fee kind of dissuaded me. It was a nice location for my wife who had a royal flush on her video poker machine.

allReviews.title: DISAPPOINTING TRIP
allReviews.text: Not very good ,kids running around above us ,reported to Security,no obvious action taken ,kids still jumping off beds,Service was unacceptable at Mi Casa,unable or unwilling to seat our large family gathering of 16 .

allReviews.title: Cosmo's Factory
allReviews.text: Very clean hotel and casino inside and out.  The staff is very friendly (except one, don't know her name) and  accommodating.  Good choices for dining.  Twin Creeks is fine dining.  The food is excellent there.  Good late night breakfast specials. The smoking rooms are the furthest away from the elevator on the second floor.  I'm a smoker and I don't use one. Too much of a hike!

allReviews.title: Family trip
allReviews.text: I love staying at the Silverston and so does my family.The beds are very comfortable the pool area is very nice the front desk staff amd the reservation staff is wonderful. The restaurant are are the bar staff is very nice.

allReviews.title: Not too satisfied
allReviews.text: Very hard to win.  They changed the point accumulation too.  Housekeeping services were not good.  Got sick at the Twin Creeks restaurant.  I have been here many times and it seems to be getting worse not better.

allReviews.title: Stay at Silverton
allReviews.text: I love Silverton.  I am fond of the friendly staff and the warmth of the atmosphere.  I love the size of the casino as I am not a huge crowd person.  Food is exceptional at the Sundance café.  Buffet has such a variety. Slots are current.  Will continue to stay there.

allReviews.title: Great stay for a little staycation
allReviews.text: Big room, super comfy bed, and not much outside noise.Enjoyed the Happy hour at Twin Creek Steakhouse-great prices and very good food.  Too cold to use the pool but had a DJ outside and a food setup-great deal brisket sandwich, soda, chips, and mac  salad $5.  Plenty of bars and lounges to just have a drink or set and gamble.   Loved the big aquarium and watching the fish and the jellyfish aquarium behind the bar.  Silverton also has a huge Bass Pro Shop with all kinds of cool things to check out.  With had a fantastic time.

allReviews.title: Great beds and value
allReviews.text: Always enjoy staying my only annoyance is the cigarette smoking in the casino. I truly enjoy the pool & playing slots there! Love Twin Creeks but didn’t eat there this time. The Seasons buffet has a very nice offering. Friendly staff at Silverton!

allReviews.title: Family  Vacation
allReviews.text: The Silverton  casino  is  a Awesome place to stay and employees  make you feel at home and they our really  friendly  here. And there hotel is very Beautiful  and clean Rooms and Good places to Eat with friends

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: Your casino offer different kind of table games. dealers are friendly and professional. Room is very clean. restaurants are good, with choices for customers. Location is convenience, with shops in the nearby area.

allReviews.title: family vacation
allReviews.text: Stay here everytime im in Las Vegas always love it. The staff is always friendly and helpful also love there restaurants especially Wu Hu noodle and of course they have a Starbucks I recommend this hotel to everyone I know

allReviews.title: Silverton stay
allReviews.text: Comfortable beds, the hotel and casino needs updating.  It's a crazy way to get to hotel/casino parking and entrance.  Rooms are large. Bathrooms are small, but there is a tub, which is a must for me. Also, a full length mirror is nice.

allReviews.title: Great Service at a great price
allReviews.text: We had a great time in your Hotel and Casino. We were there for only one night unfortunately, but when I come back, I will come back and stay at the Silverton again!! The housekeeping was really friendly and helpful and took time to help us with questions and even showed us how to manage the air conditioning in our room which was really great for my grandma.

allReviews.title: Wife's birthday
allReviews.text: Have a great time took the wife out for dinner at the Steak House the food drinks and the service was excellent love your location off the beach not on the Strip was crazy and crowded always have a great time at the Silverton thank you very much

allReviews.title: Kindness above and beyond.
allReviews.text: at home.  Cozy beds.  Very affordable food.  Rewards are substantial.  A little out,of the way but great shopping close by.   Always a treat to view the aquarium.  Sundance cafe is our favorite breakfast meal.

allReviews.title: Visit
allReviews.text: My stay at the silverton was great. I stayed at the hotel with a group of friends for my 22nd birthday and we loved it. The hotel was beautiful and the staff was very helpful, I would recommend anyone the stay here.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and Pleasnt.
allReviews.text: When we discussed the room, we said, oh just give us the Best and Nicest room, and that is exactlywhat she did. Dining was excellent.We enjoyed the Casino but did not have much Luck.We are looking forward to our next visit, maybe our Luck will improve.

allReviews.title: Best Las Vegas place to stay
allReviews.text: Easy to get to. Easy to park. Easy to check in. Easy to get players card replacement. Elevators close to check in. Comfortable room bed bath climate control water pressure good in shower. Wish mini fridge was included

allReviews.title: Cozy friendly home away from home.. gambling and food is great
allReviews.text: I love visiting I go no where else. They treat you like a VP when you just common. Make it feel like a vacation you have waited for all year. Thank you for that.. I have been many places and either the staff or food or rooms are horrible. This place has it all.

allReviews.title: Great visit
allReviews.text: Just was there overnight, but everything went well.  Was visiting to celebrate my Aunt's first anniversary of her death.  She died at 105 years of age on May the 18th of 2018. She was living with my cousin and her husband in Pahrump, Nevada.

allReviews.title: The Unexpected
allReviews.text: This was my very first time staying at Silverton and it did not disappoint. The staff were courteous and helpful.  The rooms where very clean and the food at the hotel was very cheap.  They even have steak and eggs for 6 dollars from midnight to 5 a.m. If you are a table person, this is the place to go.  There are less stupid players here then on the strip.  Also their side bets are only 1 dollar compared to the strip which is 5 dollars.  I will definitely come here again.

allReviews.title: Great Location
allReviews.text: We love the Silverton and the Bass Pro Shops. The staff has always been friemdly and the beds are very comfortable. We spend most of our time there on visits and sometimes take a short Uber ride to the strip.

allReviews.title: Loved the Casino, Hated the Room
allReviews.text: I like to play the older style slot machines.  The Silverton has a good selection of both older and newer machines, and I was ahead a few hundred dollars when I left the casino.  My room was a big disappointment.  The mattress was so worn on one side that it was like sleeping on a slope.  I have only stayed overnight at the Silverton one time, so I hope my room was not representative of all they have to offer.

allReviews.title: AS USUAL
allReviews.text: We have stayed here numerous times . always a good experience. the staff is very professional. close to the freeway  and you can miss all the traffic and take the tram if you need to go into town or the airport  always like the bass pro shop and the aquarium.

allReviews.title: Will Return
allReviews.text: Love staying here.  Check in was quick.  Room was immaculate.  Prices are great and it's easy to get around town.  They have shuttles to the airport and to the Aria.  Otherwise you need a car.  Plenty of restaurant choices here.  We ate at the cafe and at the buffet.  Both were great.  No complaints.

allReviews.title: Best kept SECRET of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This is the place to stay while in VEGAS! The staff is outstanding. This place is what vegas use to be like.Off the strip quiet! But, close to everything. The restaurants are all GREAT and the food is OUTSTANDING! All the video machines you could ask for and about the best KENO machines anywhere I have been. Great COMP's!

allReviews.title: Quick trip to silverton
allReviews.text: Quick trip to vegas so we stayed at our favorite hotel and casino. The Silverton is always a great place for us. The steak house Twin Creeks has an amazing happy hour and the food is top notch. I recommend the lobster avocado!  Yum!

allReviews.title: Another great trip
allReviews.text: As with our other trip to the Silverton, we enjoyed our stay.  Fun playing the slots, great meals at the restaurants and nice room. The staff are always helpful and pleasant. We look forward to our next trip.

allReviews.title: Survey for 5/15 stayed at Silverton Hotel. Excellent!
allReviews.text: Room access was very convenient from the casino. Enjoyed the table games. I wish the resort fee is cheaper since we never use the swimming pool. We both don’t swim. We don’t use the gym either. Our intention is to play slots and table games.

allReviews.title: Great property.
allReviews.text: We stayed for one night and the room was good. Window opened witch was awesome for some fresh air. Bed was super comfy and good fluffy pillows. Check in and check out was fast and easy. Good value. We enjoyed the casino and restaurants during our stay. Comps are good.

allReviews.title: Nice uncrowded place to stay. Not as hectic as the Strip
allReviews.text: I booked the Silverton Hotel because of a concert that was to be held there. It was a great experience and the staff was wonderful. The location was well off the strip and was not as hectic as I was expecting it to be. I will definitely recommend this place to others.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: Friendly staff and room was very nice.  Love this Hotel and have stayed there many times.  Great value and very nice restaurants.  My wife and I have stayed at this hotel many times and love to go and stay there for a little get away from Kingman Arizona.

allReviews.title: Nice room
allReviews.text: Enjoy our stay. Restaurants and Starbucks and pool hours could stay open later would be nice. Review is a bit annoying when it requires a minimum of 200 characters. I already said all I need to stay so this is stupid that I have to keep typing to get it to 200. Oops past 200 good bye

allReviews.title: Lunch with my son.
allReviews.text: As always, my stay was great. Everyone I delt with was so kind and helpful, starting with shuttle driver to the cashier that helped me out. The only thing is if I could have won some money. I'll be back to try again.

allReviews.title: Little gem off the strip
allReviews.text: Friendly and accommodating staff, many eating establishment ‘s to choose from, central location for experiencing many sites that Las Vegas has to offer, and very close to McCarran airport. Will definitely return!

allReviews.title: Casino was great.
allReviews.text: Casino has a lot of various slot machines. They even had .75 cents ones. Staff was very friendly. They also had various of national restaurant inside of casino. Also next door is the very big Bass Pro Shop. Plenty of parking on the outside.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: everything was great, food, casino, service, I love the fact that the casino does not smell so much when people smoke, love that the air conditioner is always on even if its cold outside that helps the air not to smell so much like smoke

allReviews.title: BEYOND  GREAT
allReviews.text: Rooms are very comfortable and clean. Everything else from staff to food is GREAT,and  BEYOND GREAT.  We stay there all the time and LOVE it.. Cant find a better BUFFET three times the money. Go hungry.  Off the strip on Las Vegas Blvd half way between strip and airport. Just a short ride on lift to where ever your going. Rooms are  always VERY clean and comfortable, Not fancy.

allReviews.title: Fun Trip
allReviews.text: The room was excellent and in an ideal location. Beds were the best. All amenities were great, got ref. which came in handy.  Ate twice at the buffet and both times food was well prepared and hot. Also ate at the Sundance rest. and again the food was excellent. The pool and hot tub were also very good.

allReviews.title: Nice small Las Vegas Hotel. Excellent customer service and good selection of restaurants on site.  customer service..
allReviews.text: Nice small Las Vegas Hotel. Excellent customer service and good selection of restaurants on site.  customer service..

allReviews.title: Loud plumbing pipes
allReviews.text: Brought my child with me asked for a rollout bed never showed up, Plumbing Pipes made up loud noises all night long could not sleep. Front desk said  they knew there was a problem and would have maintenance check it out

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem off the Strip
allReviews.text: Best place to stay off the strip! Friendly staff, great food and very clean! The pool is awesome and is kept nice. The restaurants had a nice variety of foods. Best value for the money - also free shuttle to the Strip and airport!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel Experience
allReviews.text: The staff are courteous and helpful,  The rooms and entire hotel is very clean.  Large pool area.  Quiet, restful environment.  Great food in the restaurants.  I would recommend this hotel for everyone.  We stayed 4 days and looking forward to our next visit to the hotel.

allReviews.title: Helping a Homeless Veteran.
allReviews.text: From Helen to Leona. The staff provides a service that is rare in Las Vegas. Some people like to be on the Las Vegas strip. To have a better perspective and appreciation, I would recommend staying at the Silverton to keep a breath of fresh air, while enjoying your potentially, once in a lifetime trip to Las Vegas. Whether you try to recreate "The Hangover", "21", "Casino" or any of the other Las Vegas produced movies, you have experienced.

allReviews.title: Wi-fi trouble
allReviews.text: Could not get good wi-fi connections anywhere  on the proberty or near.  If you need wi-fi to work or for any other reason (and who doesn't) you might want to try somewhere else.  Everything hooked up and worked fine at three other hotels in the area.  We will be staying elsewhere in the future.Everything else was excellent but without wi=fi, we cannot stay there.  Even if it was a unusually situation, it took way to long to correct.  All 3 days it was not letting my wife connect to her VPN for work  She was there to work and meet with friends but working had to happen during the stay and was a real problem.

allReviews.title: Vacation getaway
allReviews.text: Great offstrip atmosphere!It’s very comfortable place to stay and close to shopping and other casinos ,the pool and the hot tub  are small but very nice. The casino action is very good ,you always feel you have a chance to win!

allReviews.title: Exceptional and Friendly
allReviews.text: This property is a all round value. Friendly, professional and knowledgeable staff. Rooms are exceptional nice. Very nice and varied available restaurants. Air circulation is top notch, hardly able realize the smoking atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Book if you like unified guests entering your room at any time.
allReviews.text: Keys were intermittent, had people walking into my room with actual keys in the middle of the night, no one believed me until I found the intruder. Terrible experience I would no longer recommend even though I have stayed before. Lots of pot smoke in the hallways.

allReviews.title: Overnight
allReviews.text: Quiet and convenient to the airport   Staff was helpful when I explained I had a very early flight and preferred a room on the first floor close to the front so I didn’t have too far to go early in the morning

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: We had a fabulous stay at the Silverton - the staff was excellent. The food was excellent.  We were there for 5 day and did not have any complaints.  I'm sure we will return our next time in Las Vegas. There was a lot to see in the hotel and Bass Pro shop.

allReviews.title: complaint
allReviews.text: We stayed in the Silverton hotel on Sunday, May 5th. The bathroom shower was moldy. The air conditioner did not work so someone had to come in and fix it late that night. They put us in a handicap room which we did not ask for. The was no ice bucket in the room, only a lid which we thought was odd. . . but all we wanted was a good nights sleep and to get on the road early the next morning. Much to our surprise we got a phone call the next day from a guy named Francisco. He accused us of stealing the ice bucket and was going to charge us $59 for it. We told him we did not take it and were appalled that he would say such a thing! He was rude and would not back down so we went above his head. In an email we explained everything that went on and how we do not steal the ice bucket. She never got back to us even though we called and left a message too. So, we are going to try and talk to the owner next. This is not over. We want an apology for being accused of something we did not do. It's so sad the way customer service has declined over the past ten years. We will "never" stay at this hotel again!!!

allReviews.title: A reasonably priced clean, comfortable hotel off the strip.
allReviews.text: Silverton is a fine place to stay off the strip. Clean rooms, comfortable beds. We ate at several restaurants including Johnny Rockets, Sundance Grill, and Mi Casa. They all had good food and were reasonably priced. We didn't gamble so I don't have any input on the casino.

allReviews.title: Marine Corps Reunion
allReviews.text: Among the smaller hotels/casinos of Las Vegas, the Silverton staff is without equal in professionalism and friendliness.  In all regards... from the front desk, to valets, to restaurants... the Silverton focuses on, and delivers, exceptional customer service and satisfaction.   One of the finest small hotels we've had the pleasure of enjoying.  Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Always a great stay
allReviews.text: Staff is friendly, pool and rooms always clean. Rooms always smell fresh. Restaurants are great food is AMAZING. We've never had to make a complaint about anything. Plus the comps are the best, if you have a chance stay at Silverton you'll love it.

allReviews.title: Outstanding hotel and casino!
allReviews.text: We had an exceptional time at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  The staff is extremely friendly, the rooms are clean and spacious and the food was delicious!  It's a wonderful place to stay and I highly recommend it.  The Bass Pro Shop is also a nice, interesting place to visit while staying at the Silverton.  It's connected to this hotel/casino.

allReviews.title: SUPERB !!!!
allReviews.text: A superb experience. The hotel staff are exceptional. The food was wonderful. The housekeeping staff were pleasant and responsive. Everyone seemed truly concerned for our comfort and enjoyment. The wait staff were attentive and cheerful.

allReviews.title: KBay reunion 2019
allReviews.text: Excellent spot for a large gathering.  Good food, excellent rooms, lively casino.  Our Marine Corps reunion was very well organized and supported by the staff.  No problems at all.  Would highly recommend this resort and casino.

allReviews.title: A Very Friendly Hotel
allReviews.text: Everyone we came into contact with had a smile on their face and assisted us in every way possible. This is a culture others strive for, but few attain the way Silverton has. Our room was very clean and all meals at the hotel were excellent.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect.  The room was very clean, bed very comfortable.  Away from the hustle and bustle. The service was great.  Liked the least, no coffee pot in the room.  Liked the bed the best.  Good drinks in the casino.

allReviews.title: Great place but Check for reunions first!
allReviews.text: Love to stay here but had some amenities not available due to a large reunion that was being hosted there. They have a great variety of gambling. Love the aquarium and the Bass Pro Shops attached to the casino.

allReviews.title: A Wonderful Home in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great location!.  Great facility, with all  options available (food, gambling, swimming , entertainment).  Wonderful, friendly, helpful staff such as we have not seen matched anywhere else!  When in Las Vegas, the Silverton will always be our choice, as it has been in the past.  The management of this place has got to be truly superb!

allReviews.title: Norm K-Bay 63
allReviews.text: I found the Silverton to be first rate in every aspect - food, service, facilities and atmosphere. I particularly liked the aquarium bar.  The staff was very attentive.  The attached Bass Pro Sop was an interesting sidelight to the Las Vegas experience.

allReviews.title: Outstanding Experience
allReviews.text: My wife and I had an outstanding experience in our stay at your hotel, from beginning to end. Your employees are all friendly, courteous, helpful, and very competent. You are fortunate to have such quality people who act as our hosts.

allReviews.title: A first-class Experience!
allReviews.text: Can't recommend this property too highly! Everything about our stay was beyond expectations. Rooms were soundproof despite  close proximity to the airport.  Staff was exceptionally friendly, cheerful, and helpful.

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: Staff were most cordial and willing to see that your stay would be memorable.  The food served at all of our reunion gatherings were five star.  Cruise on Lake Mead was awesome and again, the staff were outstanding. Silverton Hotel/Casino is the place to go for reunions--they know how to do it!!!

allReviews.title: STAY AT SILVERTON CASINO/HOTEL
allReviews.text: What a great small casino/hotel.You get  bang for your buck staff are great.This hotel is small enough to give you personal attention. And the pro bass store attached to it is really great.We have stayed at a lot of hotels on the strip, and prefer to stay here.It is not on the strip but close, and they do run a shuttle.Plus you don't have all the lookie' loos coming in.

allReviews.title: March 2019 trip
allReviews.text: Bathroom is old.  The water in sink and tub slow to go down the pipe - plumbing.  Location is excellent near the freeway.  Room was clean except when using the sink and the tub, water was so slow to go down onto the drain.

allReviews.title: Home Away from Home
allReviews.text: We have been coming here for a very long time on our twice per year visits. It is so familiar to us, and we always have a great time. The restaurants are wonderful, the pool stays open in the evenings, beds are comfortable, and the rooms are good-sized. After 40-plus trips to Las Vegas, we don't care to be on the Strip anymore. Silverton has old and new slot machines, employees are friendly, and we just feel at home there.

allReviews.title: Wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for comfort.
allReviews.text: Room was hot and you couldn't control the air conditioning.  Furniture was uncomfortable and the room had a mildew odor. Casino was great but room was not. Over all hotel just looked old and looks like it lacks TLC.

allReviews.title: Annual visitor
allReviews.text: We enjoyed the shuttle service and found the slots were fun playing and not just taking our money quickly.  Miss the refrigerator in the room, ice machines need filters or changed if they have one,: funky tasting ice. Coffee on the casino floor was day old and tasted burnt, had to go somewhere else to get good Irish coffee.

allReviews.title: Second stay
allReviews.text: Our stay was ok.  The shuttle to Aria needs more frequent trips.  The pool side bar needs to be open more often during the week.  The beds are a bit on the firm side but the sheets had a nice feel.  All in all we had a decent time staying at the Silverton.

allReviews.title: Vegas
allReviews.text: Another pleasant stay at the Silverton. No issues and just great service all around. Had a few requests and all were met without any hassle's. Love this place. Easy in, easy out. Will be back in the fall, maybe sooner if possible.

allReviews.title: Buyer beware!!
allReviews.text: At first glance this place seems like a decent budget friendly motel. The casino is decent sized and reasonably priced, there is a good variety of food and the pool is very nice.... however BUYER BEWARE.  Apparently the resort rents out the pool for "private events" closing it entirely for all guests. There is absolutely no notice that this is going to occur prior to your arrival or when you check in for your weekend stay.  Instead, the hotel slides a note under your door at 3 am to apologize for the "inconvenience" of the closure for all day Friday and Saturday. The hotel helpfully (read sarcasm) let's you know that you can use the pool at the resort next door instead. What they don't tell you is that the hotel next door has no amenities in their pool..no bar service but more importantly absolutely zero access to towels. And when talking to guests at the next door hotel, it is clear that this resort doesn't provide those amenities because their guests don't pay the daily resort fee of over $20 per day, but YOU will pay the fee regardless of whether you use or even have ACCESS to those ammenities. So remember that when you drip back to your hotel room at Silverton, towel-less and irritated because the pool next door is not near the quality or caliber of the one you actually paid for.

allReviews.title: Another great stay at the Silverton
allReviews.text: This was our third stay at the Silverton Las Vegas. Everything was as expected... GREAT! Right from the minute we entered valet, through check in, the great room, the casino and restaurant staff, everything was wonderful. Thanks to Anthony, Alectra and all the staff for making this visit another memorable one for us! See you again soon guys,

allReviews.title: Silverton 7
allReviews.text: Need more outlets available on the dresser or some sort of outlet or plug strip. If not that a small side table so as to put the coffee maker on, so you don't have to put coffee maker in the bathroom and take the space from your vanity mirror.

allReviews.title: Wife's birthday getaway
allReviews.text: We had an awesome time at your resort, thr atmosphere is always friendlier that most casinos on the strip. My wife had a blast and we even invited my wife's family to come a d enjoy meals with us a few times. The noodle house was so delicious and fresh .

allReviews.title: Off the strip
allReviews.text: If you want to be away from the hustle, this is a good place to be.  Liked it for the family feel. Liked it was attached to Bass Pro. Also, nice pool area and outside areas to hang out in.  The Sundance restaurant was hit and miss.  The Noodle Restaurant was really good.

allReviews.title: We lOVE the Silverton
allReviews.text: We love everything about the Silverton, restaurants good variety,  rooms very comfy, slots loose enough to play if not walk away winning, location close to everythingThe staff is courteous, friendly, and accommodating.WE LOVE THE SILVERTON

allReviews.title: Kid friendly
allReviews.text: The employees were friendly, the restaurants were very good and kid friendly but my room this time was very disappointing. Have stayed here multiple times and has always been awesome! The pool is small but very nice and love the fact that you can shop at Bass Pro Shop which is just off of the casino.

allReviews.title: The Best Little Hotel/Casino in Vegas
allReviews.text: Thanks for a great stay.  We loved the rooms, the bed, the late checkout time, the friendly staff and the food.  You have our vote for an excellent, clean and well maintained property. We loved the pool and all the amenities you have to offer.

allReviews.title: We will be back!!
allReviews.text: Very friendly staff, front desk, players club, bartenders,housekeeping and restaurants. All of our needs were met. Our room was very comfortable. We like the restaurant choices and Starbucks in house. I just wish Starbucks would open earlier.

allReviews.title: Bad Smells
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Berkley next to the Silverton Casino.  If you want to spend time in a place that smells like your chain smoking grandpa's clothes that he never washes - but sprays with Fabreeze everyday - this is where you want to be. We gambled with Blackjack and slots and I have never seen such tight slot machines.We were never offered a complimentary drink.The only bright spots there are the WuHu Noodle Restaurant and the aquarium.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel! Great Location!
allReviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton! It is so relaxing and nice to be away from the crowds on the Strip. The front desk associates are great! Lots of dining options! It is a well kept property. The free shuttle is also a big plus!

allReviews.title: Beware of Guest Services entering your room.
allReviews.text: I put a "Do Not Disturb" sign on the door only to have a maid bang on my door around 9 AM standing there with a key card ready to enter. WTF? I asked why she banged on the door when the DND sign was there and she said " I wanted to see if you wanted the room cleaned" and walked away. That is not cool and odds are I won't stay at the Silverton again because of that occurrence.

allReviews.title: Wow this hotel needs some serious refurbishing
allReviews.text: Hotel is dark, worn and not clean! The hotel is way past the time to have been refurbished. Bathroom had hairs in the shower and on the counter. The location is convenient to the airport but unless they put some money in redoing the rooms, they can’t compete with nearby hotels

allReviews.title: Silverton Stay
allReviews.text: Loved the friendliness of employees in restaurants, gaming tables, and room service.  Have recommended the Silverton to friends and family.  Like that the casino is not filled with smoke.  Also important is the gaming tables are priced reasonable.

allReviews.title: Best hotel
allReviews.text: Quiet hotel with little to no kids which is nice. Farmers market on Sunday was great to get some fresh snacks for our room. Check in and out was quick and easy. Good variety of food and restaurants to choose from.

allReviews.title: Convenient location for my trip
allReviews.text: Great location, friendly staff, food was very good and the bed was extremely comfortable and the room was very quiet.  I was there on business so I really didn't utilize the bar service but having a Starbucks inside was awesome

allReviews.title: pleasure
allReviews.text: Silverton is unique so many casi8nos Hotels in Vegas ...but the Silverton is like your House incomparable   just extremely the Best I been in a lot of hotels in Vegas I learned the Lesson only the Silverton satisfy my need thank you Silverton staff

allReviews.title: Great location. Good table rules. A old fashioned casino and the best beds anywhere. This casino has everything.
allReviews.text: Great location. Good table rules. A old fashioned casino and the best beds anywhere. This casino has everything.

allReviews.title: One night edge of Town
allReviews.text: Loved the easy on and off I15 access. It was not as overly smoky in the casino, staff was very friendly and helpful. Buffet was very good value for the money, food tasted fresh,  not frozen.  Pool looked inviting. Room was clean and quite, on the side away from I15.

allReviews.title: Our stay at the Silverton
allReviews.text: Very comfortable pillow top beds, clean rooms.  We have been here a few times due to these reasons.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  We always enjoy are stay here since it "feels like home".  We had a wonderful time as always!

allReviews.title: My review
allReviews.text: I enjoyed your hotel. We loved the pool the service in the pool area was excellent.  The room was ok the bed was very comfortable. But you need to provide a coffee pot, microwave and refrigerator in your rooms

allReviews.title: Spring vacation
allReviews.text: Great location off of the strip.  The staff, from the front desk to the restroom attendants, are always very friendly and helpful.  We have been staying here for over ten years and have never had an issue that wasn’t resolved.  We will continue to stay here in the future. Great job Silverton!

allReviews.title: Worst hotel I have stayed at in a long while!
allReviews.text: I cannot think of one good thing to say about this establishment.  STAY AWAY!!!!  There rooms do not have coffee makers.  You must pay $15 to have a refrigerator in your room.  There was absolutely no excitement from the gaming floor.  Very disappointing!

allReviews.title: guest room problem
