allReviews.text: toilet plugged  and flooded the floor after first used.had to push hard to get a room changed ,this inconvenient almost caused us to  miss our booked show! This hotel doesn't provide any cup for teeth brushing!They will deliver to your room if you request.Spacious room but only 1 chair in it .

allReviews.title: Solid comfortable casino, just a bit out of the way
allReviews.text: Silverton Casino understands its clients well.  Not really for the crowd on the strip, but a good fit for this couple.  Lots of gaming options, some elbow room, good restaurants (including a midnight steak and eggs deal).  Staff are consistently available, helpful and upbeat.

allReviews.title: Tired
allReviews.text: Once a favorite, the Silverton is “tired”. Clean and friendly staff, but room smelled musty/smokey. AC unit issues. No refrigerator in room or hooks on bathroom door. Cafe understaffed, took a half hour to get bacon and eggs.

allReviews.title: The Unknown
allReviews.text: Would have been nice to know that the pool was closed due to construction from the building across the parking lot.  Visited 2 years ago and seems that the restaurant prices within the casino are much higher than before.

allReviews.title: HIDDEN GEM IN VEGAS
allReviews.text: We have been going to Silverton ever since my children were kids.  My husband and boys  love to go to Bass Pro Shop while I do the slot machines.  Food is great , specially food at Twin Creeks. The promotions are great for members.

allReviews.title: Silverton April 2019
allReviews.text: The Silverton is a great value in Las Vegas. With all the amenities that you need to enjoy visiting. For us the value is the location the great food choices the lodge atmosphere and the hospitality of the staff. We have been coming and staying for the past 10 years and the property keeps improving.

allReviews.title: Connie
allReviews.text: Super comfortable beds and nice clean rooms. Great location. Great restaurants and fun things to do close by. My granddaughter loved the mermaids and my grandson and husband loved the bass pro shop. Would definitely come back.

allReviews.title: Silverton Casino is our home away from home
allReviews.text: I would tell anyone to come stay here but don't want to cause I don't want it to get too crowded, love it the way it is!! The beds are the most comfortable beds anywhere we took the info so we can get one like it!

allReviews.title: Wind Noise
allReviews.text: In between homes at present time.  Therefore, needed a place to stay for a couple of days. The room was clean, bed comfortable, shower water hot, & fluffy towels.  The only issue, the wind was blowing so hard that the wind noise kept me awake longer than desired.

allReviews.title: Love this casino and hotel!
allReviews.text: This is my favorite casino in Vegas. The hotel was affordable and comfortable. They gave us coupons upon arrival for their restaurants and stores. The noodle restaurant is our favorite. They also have great incentives if you like to gamble.

allReviews.title: April 2019
allReviews.text: Very pleasant and helpful housekeeping and registration staff (Lori). Have visited this hotel many times and feel very comfortable with everyone we have had contact with. Most restaurants very good.Would recommend to anyone.

allReviews.title: Ok for a one night stay
allReviews.text: We stayed here on our arrival night in Las Vegas. It was a short ten minute easy drive from McCarron airport. Check in and out were efficient. The corridors were a bit dark and dull and the carpet edges were pretty dusty. The room was a decent size but again quite dark and dull, with a view over a delivery area. The bathroom was small and outdated, in real need of modernisation. The bed however was fantastic and the linens and towels were fresh and of good quality. The TV was also a great size. The ice machine was located off the corridor in a large room which appeared to be a bit of a dumping ground for stuff. Not really the nicest place for guests to go to to get their ice. We never used any of the hotel facilities as we only stayed one night. However, the pool area looked really nice. Parking was free but the dreaded Resort Fee was added to the bill.

allReviews.title: Nice Casino and Restaurants - Room just average
allReviews.text: Stayed for 4 nights.  Rooms are nothing more than a Motel 6.  Just average.  Lots of highway noise as well.  Put room service card out for 4 nights in a row and it wasn't picked up any night.  Casino is clean and low-key.  Restaurants are good.  Ate the buffet and Sundance.  Entrance to Bass Pro is a plus.  A little ways from the strip, but close enough.  Pillows are like sleeping on a bag of hard foam cubes.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel and casino
allReviews.text: Check in was very easy, unlike the strip hotels.  Room was very clean and inviting.  Lots of variety in food choices.  The buffet was excellent.  Although the hotel is not close to the strip, the hotel offers shuttle service.  I did not use as only stayed one night.

allReviews.title: Pretty nice
allReviews.text: The price if the hotel was very good, although I do not like the ‘resort’ fee.   Just make the price more for the room instead of sneaking it in with the ‘resort’ fee which is for what?? Nothing.   It’s not honest and I know it’s what the other hotels do there but you don’t have to follow them.  Room was fine and staff was nice.  The food at the buffet was not good but for the price it’s what was expected.

allReviews.title: vacation
allReviews.text: It has always been a go to destination that isof value in a great location, easy in and out, great service with the valet and is hassle free environment.It has always been a go to destination that is of value in a great location, easy in and out, great service

allReviews.title: Great value at a beautiful hotel/casino just out of town.
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at Silverton very much.  Everyone was so accommodating and friendly.  All services were excellent and the free shuttle back to the airport was a nice way to end my vacation.  The casino offered great gaming and a wonderful selection of slots ( and I came out ahead) There were 10 different eateries to choose from and a nice pool outside.  This will be my first choice whenever I return to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Friendly Staff, Good Location
allReviews.text: If you don't need or want to stay at a big flashy hotel on the Strip, the Silverton may be the place for you.  The price is right, parking (valet too!) is free, the staff is friendly, and the casino is just as good as anyone else's.

allReviews.title: Great Service all around!!!!
allReviews.text: This is my second stay and my spouses first stay. We used the fitness center, swimming pool and the hot tube. The staff is top notch. The restaurants have a great variety of foods. I highly recommend the Silverton to my friends.

allReviews.title: Not bad but not great either
allReviews.text: Rooms were adequate, nothing out if the ordinary. The big building you think is the hotel is actually timeshares. The hotel is only 4 stories and off the casino. Check in is not adequately marked and is hidden, we walked by it three times. The mattresses in our room we're in need of replacement. They sagged pretty bad. The rates are great during the week but too high for what you get on the weekend. Optical illusion...not close to the strip. Like most other properties, the machines are tight... I don't think we witnessed anybody win more than a couple dollars our entire stay.

allReviews.title: Good, not outstanding
allReviews.text: Granted I have not tried other hotels in Las Vegas, so my benchmark is the hundreds of hotels in other cities in which I’ve stayed. The Silverton is ok, but not outstanding. Trying to find where guests checkin was a small task - the front desk is surrounded by casino, so you really are forced to ask. I used the free valet parking - a great amenity - and they directed me to the desk. Whether you use the “resort facilities” or not, you’re charged $18.99 + tax for the privilege. What’s with that? Even though my floor of the hotel was non-smoking, it had a mild smell. The hotel may be ripe for renovation. My room was fine - the bed very comfortable and I got a good night of sleep.

allReviews.title: Honest Reivew
allReviews.text: Overall experience was good. Bell Man, Santiago was very friendly and helpful. Rooms could be updated but were very clean, Beds and Pillows are the best. Casino was clean and welcoming with a variety of slot machines. Dining is great.

allReviews.title: Stay Cation
allReviews.text: Home away from home. Always enjoy my visits to The Silverton, weather it’s for shopping and eating or staying for a couple of nights. Everyone is always friendly and greets my friends and family with smiles. The Silverton is great!!!

allReviews.title: Off the strip, value and great staff
allReviews.text: Staff is great! They are welcoming and don’t have the normal unhappy attitude of “I live here and have been dealing for 20+ years, just Let me do my job.” I accidentally booked in a smoking room, and didn’t mind so much cuz the room had the hint of smoke but wasn’t overbearing for me to complain. I enjoyed my stay and already booked my next trip, this time in a Non-smoking room!

allReviews.title: Great Business Trip
allReviews.text: Excellent clean hotel. Minutes from strip. Great parking and easy access to I-15. The casino was one of the cleanest I have ever been too. Air quality was great for people wanting a casino not filled with cigarette smoke.  Highly recommend

allReviews.title: Personal review
allReviews.text: Great stay look forward to returning in the fall. Always a pleasure to stay at the silverton the valet service is one of the better assets they always remember me and take awesome care of my vehicle. Thank you

allReviews.title: Low key and quiet
allReviews.text: Low key and quiet. Not just the hotel and casino, but distance from The Strip also added to the calm. Additionally, when our room became flooded from the room upstairs, this at about 5:30 AM, the staff responded quickly to the emergency, and also to our comfort. We were immediately given a new room, right down the hall, but becasue we had an ADA room, they acknowledged the new room did not meet our needs, and by 11 AM, way ahead of the expected time, we were given a new ADA room. Very good. Oh, and it is worth mentioning that our walk from our parked car to our room has been the SHORTEST of ANY hotel we have every stayed in while in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Good value for the price
allReviews.text: Bathtub was not very clean.  Pipes made noise every time the water ran.  Decor is dated with wallpaper peeling off.  Sofa cushions were very worn.  Restaurants food was excellent.  Ample parking.   Very quiet.

allReviews.title: Silverton yes
allReviews.text: We were very happy with our stay.  We were able to win enough to have a good time.  Not too flashy but nice. We rented a car so it was very easy getting in and out of the facilities.  Very good off the strip stay.

allReviews.title: Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Always stay at the Silverton.  We like it very much. This time we had a slight problem. The bathroom doorknob looked like it had recently been changed, unfortunately it was put on wrong with the locking part put on the outside, so couldn't lock the door. Didn't bother to report it until we checked out because didn't want to have to change rooms and be inconvenienced while they fixed it

allReviews.title: Fun times!
allReviews.text: My wife and I just love your place! we feel its our home away from home! We usually have good luck in casino but we got skunked this time but we still had lots of fun. We will be back when it gets warmer as we like to sit out by pool and enjoy the warm sun. We also like the selection of placeces to eat at The Silverton.  The brunches are very good and very reasonably priced! The service at the bars and cocktail waitresses is also top notch.

allReviews.title: Awesome beds and bedding
allReviews.text: Slept really well, the beds and bedding were wonderful.  We like the atmosphere there, with the huge aquarium and outdoorsy feel, connected with Bass pro Shop....(my husband's favorite place, of course).The grill restaurant has a really good surf and turf dinner.  Not too smoky....all in all, was very pleasant and worth the price.

allReviews.title: Always a Pleasure
allReviews.text: Nice resort casino with good gaming and friendly staff.  Been coming here since it was previously known as Boomtown.  The restaurant selection is excellent ranging from casual to fine dinning.  The Bass Pro shop attached is a very interesting place for young and old to browse.  Will definitely visit again.

allReviews.title: Sportsmans Paradise
allReviews.text: Having Bass Pro Shops attached is major plus. Food & Lodging was wonderful as well as the gaming, The rooms were very clean with comfortable pillows and plenty of them .Will recommend this Resort /Casino to all .

allReviews.title: Check it out
allReviews.text: I have worked Vegas for 40Years . I have stayed everywhere. If you want a good deal with very nice restaurants and very reasonable rates try the Silverton. Great restaurants especilalat the steakhouse Twin Peaks. The pool isnice and your family willHave a good time especially if you are in a budget. Try it you won’tBe disappointed or go back. To strip and spend way more theYou need to.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton. Always have a great time. A little far from other casinos but there is no need to leave. The food is good the room is comfortable and the casino is full of both old and new machines.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: My husband and I traveled there on 3/28-3/30/19 so that we could experience the Big Garage and antique sale. We are pickers that buy and sell on eBay. We were so impressed with the size of the sale and organization. I felt like a kid at a candy store. We shop at Swapmeet’s every weekend. It was worth the drive from San Diego. Everyone at sale was nice and courteous. It exceeded my expectations. Thank you and we will be back for this sale when scheduled.

allReviews.title: All was well
allReviews.text: But the drink servers well one specifially was nasty I made sure I went out n bought my self a big gulp just not to deal w ther servers just nasty asked  me where the other play was cauz I ordered two coke soda pop

allReviews.title: You're screwing it up.  Get off the path of the strip casinos.
allReviews.text: Stop changing the things that set you apart from the big groups.  You will lose the most loyal of your base.  The deal at Ultimate HoldEm has changed to increase the house edge.  Cigarettes are just as expensive as the strip, and comps are less friendly.  The "new sheriff" is about to push out.  We booked at the Rio next trip. Knock it off!

allReviews.title: Great All Around Place
allReviews.text: The Silverton is just the right size.  Many of them are to large and you have to walk a mile just to get to your room. The restaurants are excellent as are the bars and casino.  The staff are friendly, outgoing and are always there to help in case you need something.  The rooms are comfortable and the location is great.

allReviews.title: Bad Experieance
allReviews.text: room as super noisy walls are paper thin you can hear the 15 freeway like it is 10 feet away.  The only thing good about this place is the Bass Proshop Which is a must see.  Go see the Bass Proshop but don't stay in the hotel

allReviews.title: OK Place because of good staff
allReviews.text: Stayed here for three nights on a biz trip primarily due to location.  It was quite easy (and free) to park there and the checkin was great.  Very friendly and professional person did the honors.  That turned out to be the standard for staff in the casino, the shops, etc.  My room was on the first floor, unusual for Vegas, and the hallways were not all that well lit.  The room itself was spacious and very clean.  My only gripe is the bathroom which while clean was very small and had no ventilation at all.  The little grid in the ceiling did nothing about toilet odor or shower steam.

allReviews.title: Nice less smokey casino off the strip
allReviews.text: I was having a hard time breathing with the dense smoke at MGM.  We met some friends here for dinner one night.  It was considerably less smokey.  The restaurant was fantastic and seeing the mermaid was very neat!

allReviews.title: stay
allReviews.text: Overall stay was great, just wish there were fans in the bathrooms.  Also, cafe service was way too slow. We love staying there, would be more convenient if we could walk around with our 1-year old but security pushed us long every time.

allReviews.title: Get off the Strip and enjoy Vegas at the Silverton
allReviews.text: The restaurants at the Silverton are awesome. The players club is generous and the rooms spacious and clean. And there's the Bass Pro Shop and the huge aquarium too. Great service and decent slot payouts.

allReviews.title: We left thirty minutes after we checked-in.
allReviews.text: The title of the review pretty much says it all. My husband and I had a three night reservation with the Silverton based on the recommendation of an older family member but we checked-out on the first night. We arrived around 10 PM and check-in went fine, but as we started walking towards our room I started to get a sinking feeling. The hallway on our floor was very dark and felt musty. When we walked into our room, my heart sank further. I've stayed at La Quintas that have nicer rooms. It felt very much like a budget hotel room that hadn't been updated within the last two decades. Everything was brown, beige, leather, and old. The deal breaker, however, was the mattress. The mattress had absolutely NO support. It was like a bag of marshmallows. My husband is a larger man and sleeping on a mattress like that would have definitely caused him to wake up in the morning with back pains, if he was able to sleep at all. I called down to the front desk to ask if they had rooms with a different kind of mattress. They do not. After a scramble online to find another hotel with rooms available, we made a reservation at The Flamingo on the Strip for almost exactly the same price we were paying to stay at the Silverton and checked out that same night. It was the BEST decision we made our entire trip. We had to eat the cost of one night at the Silverton, but even with that loss, we were practically giddy with relief when we checked into a hotel that was well lit, well maintained, and in a much nicer area of town. If you want absolutely no frills for about the same price that you would pay to stay somewhere much nicer, then the Silverton is for you, I guess, but otherwise I would look elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Stay as usual
allReviews.text: We had a great stay as usual.  Lots of things to do, good restaurants, great Sportsbook and lots of free stuff for playing.  Only thing was the bed was way to soft and felt like sleeping on a water bed (which it was not).

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay
allReviews.text: Good stay at reasonable price and I just love it. I shall stay there again soon on another business trips and the food ay Wuhu was excellent and reasonable. The only set-back during the stay was that there was no microwave and small fridge. The staff had been kind and attentive and never had any discourteous services except that they forgot to email me the receipt and I had to call to request one.

allReviews.title: Small Hotel, but Big VALUE
allReviews.text: Nothing fancy about Silverton. Small hotel, that offers clean rooms, good food, good service, sport book area and lots of offering to their players. No faking, not trying to be something they not. Just a simple little hotel that treats you right.

allReviews.title: Nice time in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Had a nice time Sliverton Hotel was great....pool was good....gym/workout area was small and outdated....but other than that and one rude front desk clerk having a bad week everything and everyone else was good.....

allReviews.title: Well pleased with stay @ the Silverton
allReviews.text: From the time we checked into our room, until the time we left, we were very happy. The lady @ the front desk  Belinda was so nice & helpful. The bell service was great valet were very nice & helpful as well. The staff were courteous  & knowledgeable,  definitely would stay again

allReviews.title: continuing value
allReviews.text: the staff and my casino host  continue to value me and my visits I will be returning in September 2019 with the confidence that I will be treated well. I have been coming to the Silverton for over six years, and look forward to returning.

allReviews.title: Silverton Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: The most comfortable beds !!   Have stayed there many times......perfect every time.  Food service is exceptional!  Valet parking very courteous!   The whole experience is wonderful!  Twin Creeks restaurant is outstanding!

allReviews.title: Silverton
allReviews.text: Nice place, great restaurants.  Needs a little face-lift.  Staff is very friendly.  We enjoyed our stay.  The Silverton just needs a little sprucing up.  There's a shuttle to Aria 4 times a day which is very nice.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: We loved the hotel, atmosphere, staff and food. We have stayed before with my dad. He is who recommended this hotel to us. We will definitely be back again. We are looking at returning in April or May.

allReviews.title: Come to play and eat, not sleep
allReviews.text: Overall, I loved the hotel. FYI, there are no refrigerators or coffee makers in the room. The walls are paper thin and you can hear EVERYTHING!! BUT the redeeming thing is the food. The restaurants ALL have fantastic food. Can't explain just how good it is. Bar was serving great drinks. I didn't win this time, but they do have a good variety of slots. Nice, relaxing place to be.

allReviews.title: Improve the Nice Accommodations
allReviews.text: Good casino with all the amenities you would need (food, beverages, gaming, close to airport).  Never felt I had to go to The Strip to have fun.  Would like to see continued improvement on the hotel rooms; otherwise, the staff was very professional and helpful to all questions.

allReviews.title: Silverton is Special
allReviews.text: Pleasant, polite and cordial staff.  Clean rooms in a comfortable setting.  Very fair slots and poker machines and an open casino floor offering a variety of gaming machines with various denominations.  The restrooms were always sparkling, service was friendly, gracious and helpful.  We enjoyed ourselves and our guests did also.  Thank you again Silverton for another wonderful Vegas experience.

allReviews.title: Great Stay Again!
allReviews.text: Great stay! Birthday trip, great free offers, bed very comfortable, shuttle, close to airport, good selection of restaurants, love the aquarium, quiet and clean, have stayed multiple times and will be back again!

allReviews.title: Family Business
allReviews.text: Me and my wife had some business to take care of in Las Vegas, I have always wanted to stay at the silverton. We had a really great time. The staff was excellent and being able to go to the bass pro shop was awesome. We will be staying here again.

allReviews.title: Best Beds in LV!!!
allReviews.text: Silverton is off the strip making it so peaceful and relaxing. Just minutes from the airport. Very clean with the most comfortable beds in Las Vegas!!! Great selection of tables games and slots that keep me coming back!!!

allReviews.title: Quality of stay
allReviews.text: All in all it was pretty good especially the free play and buffet.  Really would have been better with free comp rooms too.  Next time I come out to visit my family I would like to have the opportunity to spend time at the silverton instead of going down to the strip to gamble ,the silverton is not so fast paced you can really enjoy it.

allReviews.title: Very pleased
allReviews.text: First time staying with you, we're glad we did, we will return again soon, the stay was relaxing, we are non smokers and the gaming area wasn't full of smoke and ash trays were pretty much emptied  after use

allReviews.title: Love the proximity to Bass Pro Shop
allReviews.text: great place to stay and play single deck Blackjack was the best, had a great time in the slot tournament. We come up with family every year always have fun. Mi Casa mexican restaurant is fantastic.We look foward to coming back.

allReviews.title: Shelby Bash
allReviews.text: I've stayed at this location for several years now up until this year have had no issues and have been treated very well I don't know what happened this year but it just seems like the hotel property or management was not very receptive during our organization using them as our Host hotel

allReviews.title: Fun Time
allReviews.text: This was the second time staying at this hotel and I have gambled here many times.  I like it because the casino staff are so friendly and professional.  The dealers and cocktail waitresses are always pleasant.  The rooms are clean and the beds are comfy.  They don't charge for parking.  The Seasons Buffet is good along with Sundance Grill.

allReviews.title: My Review
allReviews.text: Complimentary midweek rooms were not complimentary! We were given a special rate that was reduced but we were under the assumption they were complimentary during midweek. The card we received in the mail was misleading!

allReviews.title: Relaxing at Silverton
allReviews.text: I dined at Mi Casa, Wuhu Noodle, Sundance Grill, and Twin Creek Steak House  were all a 5 star experience.  Service and food were exceptional, especially at Twin Creek. Adrian at check out was awesome. Steve in the footwear department of Bass Pro Shop treated me like I owned the place.  He sold me a very comfortable pair of hiking boots. A relaxing place to stay.🍸

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel and casino.
allReviews.text: Always enjoy our stay here.  Restaurants are excellent and casino is spacious and not smokey.  Employees are helpful and friendly.  Close to the airport and entertainment venues.  First time to try Johnny Rocket's hamburgers......excellent.

allReviews.title: vacation
allReviews.text: very nice place to stay. Not the best place to gamble .The rooms are nice the food is very good we have been staying at the Silverton  for years. We don't spend a lot of time in the room we go to gamble

allReviews.title: Great Hotel and Great Experience
allReviews.text: This was my second time staying at The Silverton and I was just as pleased as the first time. I originally chose because of its close proximity to the car rental return at the airport. I also like that it is located a ways away from the strip, but still very close. You fee like you are in your own world at The Silverton. I ordered room service and was pleasantly surprised by the huge portions, as well as the reasonable pricing. My room was spotless on arrival, and all hotel staff I came in contact with were very pleasant. I am taking my husband and kids with me next time, and I know they will love it.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Stay
allReviews.text: We had an incredible stay! You have the best beds & pillows. Had the best sleep ever! Food was excellent, especially Su Casa & Gilma who kept our room spotless & comfortable. The front desk staff were excellent, friendly & personable.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: Silverton is nice, inexpensive if you want to stay for a few days and have access to a casino without being on the Strip.  Nice aquarium and restaurants also.  Casino is fun and has enough machines and was not too smoky.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: Hotel is very Clean and well kept. Great stay for fun and casino enjoyment. Great stay for the family. Restaurants are delicious. Service could be better. Overall great place to and enjoy the Las Vegas experience.

allReviews.title: Silverton Experience
allReviews.text: Great place to stay off strip, machines are loose and just an overall great place to stay.Buffet has a variety to select from.  They make the best Pesto!  Polynesian night  - Don't pass that up on a Saturday night.

allReviews.title: Little Gem in the Desert
allReviews.text: Came to have some fun for the weekend. It was perfect!The staff is so helpful and nice.  From the moment you drive up at valet until you walk into your room, the staff is very welcoming!It's a perfect spot for that Vegas fix without the stress of staying at the busy strip.Just a great place!

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: Room was drab. It's like they updated all the rooms but ours. Need a small fridge and coffee maker. Bed was horrible. Main issue was that bed. Lay down and your feet are higher than your head. Pillows were rock hard. Stayed here years ago and it was great. That's why we chose to come back.

allReviews.title: How I enjoyed staying there
allReviews.text: I did enjoy staying at your hotel it was very nice. Too many people it was a perfect Hotel to pick I would stay there again and recommend people to stay there and I enjoy my staying there it's very clean like my room like the restaurants that are there and the cleanness and I would really go back to stay there thank you for everything I really enjoyed staying there

allReviews.title: Shining
allReviews.text: First I would and will stay here again, however not in room 4048.  At end of long hallway and did not feel safe.  There is an exit door right next to room.  The room was spacious with couch for relaxing also TV was nice and large with tons of viewing options.  Which is nice if you don’t gamble. They have a 24 hour dining area with tons of options.  My server Stephanie was fast pleasant and came to check on my several times. I would recommend it’s a nice hotel with friendly staff.

allReviews.title: A Great Experience!
allReviews.text: Great friendly staff in all areas of the Silverton.  Room was comfortable and clean.  The food at the Sundance is excellent - really enjoy their breakfast.  Easy access from the freeway. Very nice parking garage. Wonderful service at the front desk.  Everything was smoothly completed from check in to check out.  Am looking forward to returning.  A very nice and pleasant experiene. A++++

allReviews.title: Hotel experience
allReviews.text: This is a great hotel to stay at if you like to be able to open your windows. I love to have fresh air at night when I sleep. Also for sports and clothing shopping with the Bass Pro Shop attached. The aquarium is very beautiful to sit and which! The casino is not too big which makes it more personable.

allReviews.title: Cozy and chill place
allReviews.text: We've been coming here for years because of the chill and laid back atmosphere. It's also more affordable than strip location hotels but still a nearby 10 min drive. Only bummer is, there are not a lot of food choices to select from. The Mexican restaurant is a bit overpriced and closes early at 9. The cafe menu needs to updated to included better more relevant options. The Gelato Counter is great, when it's open. They shut down 1 day a week for cleaning, but don't know what day and it really should be done in the early am so that we may enjoy gelato at more times of the day. The Buffet is just ok, it used to be good but it seems they've gotten a bit basic and cheap. Johnny Rockets does not impress me, nor does the Wu Noodles place. Starbucks speaks for itself, but prices are a bit inflated. Would love if they would update their look & dining options, bring some excitement and newness into the place. The employees are great, friendly and helpful.. Overall the atmosphere is great! If you wanna chill with no craziness, bring your peeps down for the table games, they are always poppin with life!

allReviews.title: Perfect
allReviews.text: Always stay at the Silverton when I’m in Las Vegas. I’ve been staying here for years and will never stay anyplace else. I never have any complaints and if there is something that needs to be addressed, it’s done fast efficient and correct. Thanks you Silverton for a another perfect stay! 😊

allReviews.title: Best comfortable hotel
allReviews.text: Best stay. Once again Silverton excels at what they do. Staff is always welcoming and helpful. We were there for a proposal and they took care of us. Arnold, Lori and Katie were the best. We were lucky enough to get a last minute room and they did everything possible to make it as comfortable as they could. In the end everything worked out and it was the best.

allReviews.title: Great hotel@
allReviews.text: Great staff! Very friendly! We have stayed there a few years and love it! We would recommend it to all our friends and family! The hotel and rooms are very clean and quiet! It's nice and close to some great restaurants and shopping.

allReviews.title: Family reunion
allReviews.text: It is hard for all of us to get together cause of work, etc. therefore being at Silverton made it veryspecial.  we have been staying here many times each year. thank you for taking care of us.the YFI is a little slow. ( the only negative thing)

allReviews.title: Room needed serious TLC
allReviews.text: Our room had holes in the carpet and looked pretty rough. The cafe in the casing was great. The food was good and not overly expensive. Our bed was uncomfortable & noisy.  And the room needed to be totally updated.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Excellent service & great value for your money! Great location, near my mom’s apartment. Close to the strip without the traffic. No parking fees is a plus! Love Seasons buffet! Even when we don’t stay in the hotel, we always got to seasons! Great selection of food.

allReviews.title: Poor experience.
allReviews.text: The rooms are overpriced for condition and need update. Resort fee is merely a hidden way to increase price for commonplace amenities. Desk staff was dismissive over disagreement regarding resort fee, not even offering to ask management, if anything could be done. Will not go back.

allReviews.title: Very Disappointing
allReviews.text: Run down room. Room need to some TLC. Foot of bed was higher than the head of bed. We have stayed at the Silverton over the years. We went back because we new we would be getting good service, reasonable prices, off the strip and next to the Pro Bass Shop. Wow this trip was very disappointing.

allReviews.title: Rooms need refurbishing!
allReviews.text: Please train the front desk not to lie about the amenities just to get guest to stay there!Need to put coffee makers and makeup mirrors in the rooms. Updating and repairs needed in rooms.Heat the outdoor pool please.

allReviews.title: My favorite place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: I was originally introduced to the Silverton by a friend many years ago who lived close by. I began staying here before it was remodeled to its current state and before they built the adjoining Bass Pro Shop. I have always loved staying here and have brought many friends & family with me. Everyone I bring loves it as well. From the staff to the rooms to the atmosphere, the Silverton is a great value in Vegas. I prefer to stay off the strip yet if I want to go to the strip, it’s just a short ride to get there. I highly recommend staying at the Silverton!

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino visit Feb 2019
allReviews.text: Nice hotel in a good location. Friendly staff. Good casino. Our bed was very comfortable. We enjoyed Twin Creeks steak house, our meal was excellent.  Seasons buffet was well kept and had a good variety.  Shuttle for hotel guests to/from the airport and the strip was convenient.  Will visit again.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable and Crazy
allReviews.text: Enjoyed the first two days of our visit. Room was clean and comfortable, the food was great, the folks at check in where vary helpful. Day three not so good. The hotel lost power around 10am till 6pm at no fault off Silverton hotel & casino. To make a long story short there was no way to shower, all the restaurants where closed, couldn't play the slots and had to get a Uber to take us to a restaurant for dinner. Other than that third day we enjoyed our visit and look forward to our next visit.

allReviews.title: Good value.
allReviews.text: The rooms are spacious and clean. Beds comfortable. The reception staff are friendly. The Free parking. A good players club reward program. The Sundance Grill is great value and staff are good. A free shuttle bus runs to the strip and airportI.  I love the fact it adjoins Bass Pro Shop.

allReviews.title: Silverton Hotel/Casino
allReviews.text: Pleasant atmosphere. Excellent food. Very good gambling. Convenient location near freeway, but not in the congestion of the Strip. Easy check-in and check-out. Staff friendly and readily available. Quiet, clean rooms although not a lot of amenities.

allReviews.title: Inconvenience not addressed
allReviews.text: Orher than the power outage inconvenience not being addressed,our stay was pleasing. Staff, outside of the registration manager, were very nice and I liked that people were walking around passing out water when everything was closed.

allReviews.title: February Stay
allReviews.text: Great place to stay if the power does not go out. I have stayed at Silverton many time I think I'ts a great place to stay love all of the dealers and pit bosses front desk are all great. But Feed guest when power go's out.

allReviews.title: Always a Great Time!
allReviews.text: This is a well kept secret where mostly locals tend to frequent. The rooms are simple but clean and the beds are fantastic. Nose is very minimal and the staff is well trained, courteous and helpful. If you would like to visit Vegas on a budget you can't go wrong at the Silverton.

allReviews.title: Stay with ease
allReviews.text: I love the Silverton.  We (My family & friends) have been coming for multiple years and love the convenience of the hotel/casino, location, cleanliness, hospitality and most of all the staff.  We have not had a bad experience at all.  One time we checked out left our jacket behind and informed the staff and they wasted no time in retrieving it for us.

allReviews.title: very professional
allReviews.text: The silverton has one of the best front desk agents.  sorry I did not get his name when we checked in but he was very friendly and professional.  When we checked out, he was at the counter along with a hawaiian girl and I received the same or even better experience.  It was my birthday and they wished me a happy birthday.  In hawaiii we greet everyone as uncle and aunty.  She addressed me as uncle and told me happy birthday.THE BEST STAFF EXPERIENCE EVER.....

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: This is a great hotel for the casino and the hotel. There is a cracker barrel in the parking lot of the facilty and their Casino is pretty good. Their mermaid show is entertaining and they have free parking. They have shuttles to and from the strip. I love the Silverton and will continue to stay here.

allReviews.title: Best casino/hotel
allReviews.text: Staff is great.Rooms are a bit dated but kept spotless by housekeeping staffPrices are goodCasino floor is not as loud and crowded as many of the strip locationsI come to Vegas most every February and Silverton is my first choice to stay

allReviews.title: Just ok this time
allReviews.text: I have had much better stays.  Disappointed in the guest service.  Staff was not very helpful in a problem that arose.  Guests were left to fend for themselves.  No help with somewhere to eat no water offered.

allReviews.title: 2 night stay
allReviews.text: Will stay again, the only problem we had was poor service in restaurant.  We did breakfast and dinner in the same restaurant and service was poor both times.  The food was good.  Where in town for a NAPA convention.  Photography seminar.

allReviews.title: Viva Silverton.
allReviews.text: Have been there three times so far. Good experience each time. Free parking and the next door Bass Pro Shops are a plus for me. A small casino where the dealers keep their tips. I wish a particular dealer would not talk politics while I am having fun loosing money.

allReviews.title: Weekend Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Vegas Weekend.  The closest entrance near the hotel elevator is a little wonky and hard to find.  Long walk to the room.  No coffee maker but quick room service.  We would stay again as the price was right.

allReviews.title: Changes going bad.
allReviews.text: I'm not sure if there are management changes happening with Silverton, but it is showing in the changes in their shortcuts.  The rooms are not as comfortable as in the past with the beds.  I use to love the comfort of their mattresses after a long day of gaming and sightseeing but it seems as though Silverton has changed their mattresses to ridiculously lumpy uncomfortable mattresses. Silverton has always been my first choice of hotel in Las Vegas because of its many great amenities but if management is going to start making cuts around comfort and the staff, I will be looking to other places for my stay.

allReviews.title: love the silverton
allReviews.text: we enjoy staying at the Silverton it's away from all the hustle and bustle, everyone is super nice and accommodating plus I always come home with money, we go there every year for my husbands birthday, it's a plus for him that the bass pro shop is right there. will be back next year.

allReviews.title: Decent hotel away from the strip mania
allReviews.text: The Silverton hotel is very adaquate. It is a nice place, but be aware that you do not get a microwave, coffee pot, nor refrigerator in your room.  The room was clean and supply of linens etc. was satisfactory. No frills, and there is a $20 resort fee tackled onto the room. We use it for a stop over before and after the airport. We don’t use the casino and like that we don’t have to go near the strip. We found the buffet in the casino to be excellent for both breakfast and dinner.

allReviews.title: Avoid the strip and just enjoy a great local property.
allReviews.text: Silverton is my first choice for any Vegas trip.  Have been traveling to Vegas for 40+ years and this property just gets it right!  Friendly, great service and comfortable accommodations.  One of the best rewards programs in Vegas for out of town visitors and locals.  Pay attention to the days where point values are increased, weekday visits.  Reservations are a good idea if you want a great steak dinner at Twin Creeks on Friday or Saturday nights.

allReviews.title: Satisfied
allReviews.text: Pretty much as expected and was what I needed.  Staff and facility good to very good, but not exceptional.  Hotel is actually hard to find if you haven't been there before as its entrance is buried in the casino.  Rooms are clean, quiet and OK.  No coffee in room.  I was there only for one night as it was a place to stay so I could catch an outbound flight fairly early the next morning.  Am not a gambler.

allReviews.title: Our stay at Silverton
allReviews.text: We have been staying at Silverton since 2011. We discovered it when our son started attending UNLV. We visited often and at the time we found the Silverton to have reasonable rates, wonderful rooms, helpful and friendly staff, location from the strip, food choices, shopping opportunities in Outdoor World which it is connected to, and the buffet where we had a couple of events. Love the Silverton!!

allReviews.title: Great Customer Service
allReviews.text: Valet, Bell Desk, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Dealers, Cocktails, Restaurant Staff, Buffet Staff, every employee we interacted with was great. Friendly and helpful and most of all made us feel appreciated for being at their property.

allReviews.title: Stomping overhead
allReviews.text: If staying at this property I highly recommend you get a top floor room or hope the person above you is respectful. Mine were not they stomped on the floor all night. I got no sleep was very miserable.

allReviews.title: Relaxation & great food. The machines pay also!
allReviews.text: We will be back in May for our anniversary and my husbands bday. We cant wait. Everyone we bring with us has had the same wonderful experiences as we have. They are also hooked on Silverton. We LOVE the Bass Pro Shop! Great close & great all-round experience inside.

allReviews.title: Nice Digs Off Strip
allReviews.text: We stop by here almost every time we're in Las Vegas.  We have also stayed here.  The "Free" Mermaid show is a must.  Great photo op!  The Bass Pro Shop is also something you should venture into.Check-in was fast, when we stayed.  No complaints about the room & the pool was great.  Self Parking was still free, when we were there last.  Free Parking is fast become extinct in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent Secret
allReviews.text: Silverton is a gem among Goliaths. Beds/bedding is awesome, rooms are very functional and spacious. Great selection of food choices at reasonable prices. Parking is easy. Staff is friendly and truly appreciate your staying there. Will definitely continue to use this property when staying in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Easy access, no mile long walk to your room, great breakfast at the Sundance
allReviews.text: I have been here twice for business and I really appreciate the location, easy parking and it's a short walk from my car to my room.  The on property Starbucks is a nice perk and the breakfast at Sundance is better than most table service breakfasts I have had.  I'm not a gambler but the casino floor was clean and well laid out.  The staff was always friendly and I enjoyed the aquarium while I waited for my other people to arrive downstairs.

allReviews.title: My stay at the Silverton
allReviews.text: Great deals, nice rooms, excellent rewards program, plenty of gambling, excellent restaurants, helpful lobby, clean throughout. Near the Las Vegas strip and the airport. Plenty to do twenty four hours a day. I would definitely recommend this hotel casino.

allReviews.title: Stay while waiting to pick up at trade show
allReviews.text: Very good place to stay. Although we thought parking a semi truck would be accommodated. We did spend quite a bit more than any winnings at casino. Restaurants were good. Twin Creeks was excellent!will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: silverton hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Wonderful stay as always.  Love the staff and the pillows, too.  Always have a nice meal.  Love the house coffee especially.  Not crowded with 20 year-olds.  We are locals so we enjoy being off the strip.  Thank you Lori at the front desk and Marguerite the housekeeper.  Great work.

allReviews.title: First time at Silverton
allReviews.text: If your looking for a hotel/casino off the strip with more to offer, stay at the Silverton.  They have a good variety of restaurants to choose from, and having the Bass Pro Shop connected was a huge plus!

allReviews.title: Great price but the rooms aren't great
allReviews.text: The bed is comfy, the price is amazing. Realize you are off of the strip. The mermaids are super fun. Just the overall quality has gone down hill. I've stayed here three times now, due to it's easy access to Blue Diamond and the trails. And it's an easy 10 min drive over to the strip. But the downsize: bathroom wasn't very clean and didn't drain properly, the hallway carpet is getting very worn, and the overall quality was weak. Probably choosing a different deal next time.

allReviews.title: Great place and location!
allReviews.text: We stayed one night as we were headed to Utah. This place did not disappoint! Very nice décor, clean rooms. Staff was very nice and helpful. They have lots of restaurants with different menus and prices. Hubby loved that it was connected to Bass Pro Shop!

allReviews.title: A good time was had by all.
allReviews.text: We came because the promotional offers were outstanding. Then that didn’t matter as much as the fun and relaxing time we had. The slot machines were fair. Not always easy but fair. The meals were good. The place was relaxed. Few hassles.

allReviews.title: Relaxing place to gamble and vacation
allReviews.text: The Silverton is a great hotel and casino. The rooms are nice. The staff and dealers are friendly. My spot when I visit Vegas. They have a great Buffett and Mexican restaurant as well. The location is perfect !

allReviews.title: Great!
allReviews.text: Everything was wonderful. Mermaid bar has the best bloody Mary’s & we tried the food for the first time & it was yummy! The rooms were super clean, and beds super comphy!!!! My family was very happy with the choice of hotel/casino! We are not strip people, but still enjoy the casino atmosphere!

allReviews.title: One and Done
allReviews.text: Room had a bad smell in it. Definitely needs updating as everything besides the bed and the TV appear to be quite old. You can tell the cleaning staff only do a quick surface clean in the rooms as a closer look at anything reveals dirt, dust, grime and stains. Check in and check out were quick and painless. We were only there one night and will not return unless there is a remodel or update to everything in the room.

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: Staff was ultra friendly, food at the buffet and Sundance Grill was wonderful and priced reasonably. Lots of slots to choose from. Location is close to outlet mall and any restaurant you ca think of including a Cracker Barrel!

allReviews.title: SERVICE
allReviews.text: The Silverton made our trip a success!  Went there for a family wedding.  It was fantastic!  Everything was great!  Arnold at the front desk was very nice and helpful.  We would definitely go there again.  Thank you!!

allReviews.title: Vegas get away!
allReviews.text: Hotel was clean and the bed was very comfortable! SAtaff was friendly and helpfull. The table limits are very low and slot machines seem to pay a little. The resteraunts had out standing food and good prices.the buffet resteraunt had a good selection and the food was ok.

allReviews.title: I love the Silverton Hotel & Casino
allReviews.text: It’s a Vegas experience w/o the traffic & drama of the strip. Having the Bass Pro Shop & 2 Starbucks close by is also a plus. The staff is always so welcoming & friendly. Also this casino has the big tank which is awesome to see the mermaids.

allReviews.title: Average
allReviews.text: I will stay again but I will not gamble inside the hotel and I will not book another room for smoking a few of the card dealers I have was very rude and smart mouth because they were tired and was ready to go home  they was not a respectable person

allReviews.title: MY ESCAPE FROM EVERYDAY LIFE
allReviews.text: Overall, it was a very nice stay. Check-in was pleasant and quick. We were pleased that we were able to keep the same room even though it was under two different names, and  dates. The room was clean and quiet. I felt comfortable going back and forth from the Casino/restaurants to the room by myself.The food selection in the Buffet was excellent and surprisingly quite good. Only complaint would be that I wasn't able to stay longer.

allReviews.title: mini vacation
allReviews.text: Nice place to stay and I would recommend it to others. They have the games I like to play. I was also appreciative that they gave me an extra complimentary night and was moved up to platinum level. Thanks .

allReviews.title: My Opinion
allReviews.text: Could be updated and cleaner......Sorry!  I don't know what else to say as I answered your questions in the survey. When I first went to get money through my checking account the girl wasn't very informed.  She told me that I was not eligible to get any as there was none available.  I missed going to Vegas last year as I had open heart surgery and had to cancel so I wasn't in you system and when I went to the cashier I hadn't gambled yet.  Subsequently I did qualify but she didn't explain.

name: South Point Hotel Casino and Spa

allReviews.title: South Point Adventure!
allReviews.text: We didn’t stay at South Point but went to play Bingo. We’ve been to other places to play Bingo but it’s not the same.We also enjoy the variety of Slot Machines there as well.

allReviews.title: First Visit At South Point
allReviews.text: Fleew in for two days to celebrate my Mom's 70th bday. I was warned this hotel is far down the strip, but you know that is totally ok with me. I arrived and we greeted by Concierge asking if I needed help, I thanked them and said no, my Mom was coming down to get me. Hotel is super clean can tell that the staff really care about where they work. Lots of smiles, there wasn't any elements of that guests, or issues going on with over drinking. The bathroom is spacious, especially if someone has a walker, or wheelchair. Larger mini fridge for all your drinks and treats. There was team penning going on, which I loved seeing the full equestrian area. Probably more amenities than I saw. This hotel is wonderful with easy access to the strip via Lyft or Uber. I enjoyed my few days at South Point, will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Best Ever
allReviews.text: Been going there since it opened in 2005!, clean, so much to do and best food ever!! Just got back tonight. Will be there again soon!

allReviews.title: Awesome experience
allReviews.text: Hotel is amazing.  Wear comfortable shoes.  I was getting 10,000 steps a day  just walking around the casino floor.  So much to see and do. Movie theater ,bowling ,bingo, pool and sp much more.  Rooms are super clean and BIG.  Most comfortable bed I've ever slept in.   The only bad thing was on my second day, security knocked on my door doing a wellness check.  I didn't like this.  They claimed I haven't left the room in 3 days.  I was out of my room a ton without the do not disturb sign off.  I had housekeeping in the day before, so I don't know.  I think front desk should have called first.  Anyway still 10/10 and I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: this has got to be the busiest place in all of vegas.....
allReviews.text: just like what vegas used to be--affordable--never saw so much action in vegas--they have $5 table games also--free valet parking with a tip-- $1.50 hot dogs--reasonable buffet--after midnight really cheap meals--if you stay here they have free shuttles to the airport which is only 5 miles away--we were really impressed.....

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay, with no downside
allReviews.text: My wife and I just returned home to Ireland after staying here for the nascar event. Free parking or airport transfer if needed. Check in/out was fast and easy with a warm genuine welcome from all staff. Everyone we met was friendly from the bell hop desk to check in staff and even other guests we spoke to (unlike other resorts on the strip). Rooms were big and clean and comfortable.   Food options were plentiful and varied from quick eat places to sit down steak house and food we had was top top quality (dont miss out on the hot dogs, great value gap filling snacks). Pool area was great with no shortage of comfortable sun loungers and music volume was just perfect. Not too noisy but loud enough to enjoy. Plenty of entertainment for everyone no matter what u want. We used to stay on the strip with the big brand hotels and venture out to independent hotels/casinos to escape the madness of the Strip. But from now on we will be basing ourselves at southpoint as its such a wonderful place. Big shout out to the girls serving drinks when we played slots, they were really friendly and fast with the drinks. We never had an empty drink glass in front of us. We attended the nascar races on both days and it was our first time at something like that and found it amazing. We got the free transfers to and from the hotel to the race track which ran like clockwork and very comfortable fast and easy. As we are not locals we wont get back to play for the points for the southpoint need for speed jackets next week so we are disappointed about that, but we did get a blanket each and got one of each of the bags on the promotion they are currently running. We are both gutted about not getting a jacket each as we know we would have earned enough points for 2 each. But that's the way it goes. Would love it if they could post us out one each...There is no downside to staying here. The place is just perfect for us and we can't wait to stay again.

allReviews.title: Cheap Gamblen
allReviews.text: A big casino hotel, much cheaper than the Strip. However, quite remote from the attractions, rooms are clean and large.  Buffet at the hotel is mega large and very cheap by Las Vegas standards

allReviews.title: Nice hotel overall
allReviews.text: Nice hotel. Good restaurants.The room had 2 beds and one was sloping. We paid extra for a view which was disappointing as the windows were dirty and we looked out on a roof. But the room was  nice and clean.

allReviews.title: Very nice place
allReviews.text: South Point is off the Strip, so it's calmer and less noisy.  We enjoyed a morning there.  They have a great variety of machines to play.

allReviews.title: Great Garden Buffet at South Point Hotel Casino
allReviews.text: We make a point of always visiting the breakfast or lunch Garden Buffet when we are in Las Vegas. I personally prefer the breakfast buffet. You get a discount if you use a Players card (available for free). There is a large variety of main food dishes, salads and desserts. The line moves very quickly as there is a large seating area. Parking is free.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: South Point is our favorite hotel to stay at when we are in Vegas.  Yes, it’s a bit south of “the action” but you can drive or take a taxi and be in “the action” within 15 minutes.  Our room was very spacious and extremely clean.  The bed was comfortable and the a/c worked great.  The bathroom was large and the shower provided instant hot water.  The doors are heavy and have a tendency to slam, even when we closed the door ourselves we still got a slamming noise.  The hallways can be very loud, especially on the weekends.  There is about an inch to inch and a half gap between the room door and the hallway which attributed to us being able to hear all the activity in the hallway.  Our last night (a Thursday) I put one of the bed pillows at the bottom of the door to shut out some of the noise.  All of the eating establishments are great, we never waited in line for the cafe for more than 3 minutes.  We love the “old school Vegas” feel of this hotel and are extremely grateful that this isn’t part of some corporate conglomeration.

allReviews.title: Bad Customer Service by front  desk manager
allReviews.text: I've been staying at South Point for years and have always enjoyed my visits until this past weekend, which completely changed my opinion of the hotel. Due to the appalling customer service I received from the front desk manager, John Ionnoti, I've decided I will never return.I was there to celebrate my birthday with friends and brought my fully documented service dog, as I have on previous trips. Upon arrival, I was shocked when Mr. Ionnoti claimed my dog was not an "approved service animal" and told me she could not stay. I calmly explained that she is a legitimate service dog and provided the appropriate documentation, but he refused to acknowledge it.His attitude was not only dismissive, but downright rude and condescending. I was left standing there, nearly in tears, with no place to go. When I asked if he could suggest a nearby hotel that accepts service animals, he coldly replied, "Google it," and told me that if I was seen with my dog on the property, security would escort me out.When I requested a refund, he responded with a degrading tone: "I'll give you back your $83," as if my experience and concerns were meaningless.I have never encountered such disrespect and lack of professionalism especially from someone in a management role. This experience completely ruined what should have been a special weekend. I'm still in disbelief that South Point allows someone so dismissive and unkind to represent their customer service team.This was not just poor service it was a complete disregard for basic decency and ADA protections. I hope South Point takes this seriously and addresses the behavior of this manager so that no other guest has to go through what I did.

allReviews.title: We got robbed at this hotel
allReviews.text: We got robbed by someone that had access to our room, we contacted the front desk and filed a police report. No one called us or contacted us the next day to tell us that they were sorry and they were handling the claim. We tried to get a copy of the paperwork that was submitted when we filed the police report and they refused to give us part of it. The manager did not care about anything that we had to say and was very rude.  Do not let anyone come and clean your room.

allReviews.title: Nice rooms, not kid friendly.
allReviews.text: We came with our family, including two children ages 7 and 3. Convenient for the event we were in town for. The rooms are a nice size and I appreciated the laminate floors. The employees were friendly and kind. However there was not one restaurant that had a children’s menu. It seems ridiculous to pay 20-30$ for meals that they eat 4 bites of.  And the pool is just ok. Not sure we will be back.

allReviews.title: Early check in fee.....for what?
allReviews.text: I have an issue with early check in fees. I can pay extra to check into my reserved room that is all set, or wait one hour till 2pm, and not pay the fee for the exact same room, while starting my stay with a bad taste in my mouth.

allReviews.title: Le Garden Buffet of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Garden Buffet is one of the best places to eat no matter what time you go Breakfast Lunch or Dinner it is by far the most reasonable price anywhere And don’t get me started on the Friday Night sea food buffet For the price you will get more than you can expect Over 25 times my wife and I have been there We have always left more than content If we could eat there on a weekly basis and could afford it Yes we Would Maybe it may not be to your expectations Well there are others but be prepared to pay double Enough Said

allReviews.title: Meal saved by Dina!!
allReviews.text: My wife and I dined at Southpoint Casino at the Coronado Cafe. We live here and bowl at Southpoint. A few weeks ago, we had to bowl a make up match in the evening. We decided to eat dinner early. My wife did not finish her dinner, but did not want to let the food go to waste. We asked the waiter if he could keep the food cold until later that evening. He said no! I saw a woman who looked like a manager. Her name was "Dina." I explained what we wanted. She said no worries, and we could keep our food in the fridge in the back until we returned. We returned after 9:30pm, and Dina brought our food back to us. What service! She was so nice and friendly. She is a credit to Southpoint!! Darold and Renee Cornell,Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Avoid barbershop at all cost
allReviews.text: Look, I have nothing bad to say about the hotel or resort.. just DO NOT get your haircut at the barbershop on site. They charge 100 for a shave and haircut. The shave was good but the haircut was possibly the worst haircut I've ever received especially at that price point. Had to get it re cut somewhere else that same day it was so bad. John was a super nice guy but it might be time he hangs up the clippers.

allReviews.title: Perfect for Families!
allReviews.text: Excellent Customer Service So many great people Pool was Fabulous! Bowling was crazy busy but fun once they got us inBartender at Pool was great especially with the Mock tails for kiddos Life Guards were helpful From Check In to Check Out the service and amenities were on par! Definitely be back and recommend to family and friends! Free Parking too!

allReviews.title: Perfect place to stay safely
allReviews.text: Great stay, free parking, not too expensive to stay safe, pretty sure rooms have had a make over, we have stayed here many times as don’t like being on strip, but still just a short drive up Blvd. Staff were very friendly, booked on line with Trivago, so was a little bit cheaper.Only downside side was Breakfast buffet was $73 as we didn’t have a members card, (but the new Denny’s across the road was perfect for $35). And there was a bit of a queue at times for elevators, but nothing spoilt our stay for the night before we flew home, car rental return just up the road on Gillespie and gas station on way to fill back up, all in all a perfect stay.

allReviews.title: A real authentic casino!
allReviews.text: After doing all the casinos in the strip I arrived at the South Point and I was not disappointed. Free parking, cinema, bowling, poker room... it's all there.The Garden Buffet is amazing and very reasonably priced. It is possible to play at gaming tables for $5. The place is perfect to escape tourists and crowds from downtown Vegas.

allReviews.title: Not Bad, Not Great
allReviews.text: The good: - quick and efficient check in, benefiting from an online checkin process if you choose to use that;- Del Mar deli is actually pretty good - not amazing - everything is served in styrofoam, including soup - would benefit from a sit down potential with real plates and bowls, but the soup and sandwich was till pretty decent - not New York deli decent, but not bad;- They have several restaurant choices, including a Steak and Shake, Japanese restaurant, steak house, Mexican, and Italian.- Nice sports book and horse racing betting lounge- 6 movie theaters on site along with bowling alley- nice pool areaThe less good:- room smelled of marijuana for 3/4 days… air conditioning made it worse it seemed, so, we shut it off and last day was not horrendous- a bit of a stretch to get to the strip, so you’ll be spending a few dollars on Uber’s- room, aside from the odor, was dated- elevators in the mornings were horrendous… 20 to 25 minutes to get to the lobby one morningNot the worst, not the best.

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here.
allReviews.text: Horrible!  Had to wait in line for elevator - half didn’t work.  TV in room broken.  Refrigerator broken -  needed it to keep meds chilled.  Made my reservation through 4/7.  On 4/6 I got a text to be out of my room by noon - check out time.Awful, awful!  Definitely do not recommend.

allReviews.title: This was not what I expected when I booked a Junior Suite
allReviews.text: We booked a Junior Suite for our recent stay. When we checked in the young woman at the desk told us it was on the 7th floor. Knowing that is a very low foot in Vegas I asked for something on a higher floor since we were paying for a suite. NOPE, can’t do it. We made our way to the 7th floor. As we exited the elevator we were greeted by a cloud of dust. Over half the rooms in our wing were in some state or disrepair due to a renovation. We arrived at our room, end of the hall, and the door was propped open by the latch. We knocked a few times went in, looked around, and called the front desk. They assured me it was our room. Part of the room looked newly renovated; the furniture looked like they went to a warehouse, took out a few things to place in the room, and called it a day. I then went to check out the view from our Junior Suite. We were overlooking the arena roof, had the parking lot on the right, a South Point tower on the left, and a gigantic billboard set front and center.  I went to the bathroom to freshen up before dinner. I called my husband in and asked him what was different about this room.It then occurred to us they had laced us in an ADA suite. We were running tight on time for our reservation at the Silverado steakhouse so we shrugged and went downstairs. Meal was very good as was the service. We decided to gamble for a big. 13000k+ points later (did not spend that much of my money but got to play on some of theirs) we went back to the room. Given the time, mowing it was for one night, we stayed.  We were there for an artist show. We were supposed to go back for one more night (we only live about 75 minutes away) but decided to stay at home and fight traffic rather than go through that again. This hotel is not worth the kind of money we paid for our room. I have had better comped rooms in Vegas than this one. BEWARE of where they send you.

allReviews.title: March Madness!
allReviews.text: You think you know Vegas. You think you’ve seen it all — the marble palaces, the chandelier-draped lobbies, the perfume of wealth wafting through hallways at the Wynn and Palazzo like some opulent cologne you’ll never quite afford. But then you check into South Point — and suddenly, everything you thought you knew gets flipped on its head, like a good steak in a hot pan.South Point doesn’t try to be hip. It doesn’t chase trends. There’s no mixologist here named Skyler muddling foraged herbs in a barrel-aged Negroni. What you do get is service — not just good service — generational service. The kind that remembers your name, your drink, and probably your kid’s birthday.During March Madness, South Point becomes a church — and Steve Stallworth and Bill Purcell are its high priests. These guys don’t just manage events, they orchestrate experiences. From the cavernous arena turned basketball sanctuary to the perfectly timed beer taps and betting windows, this isn’t amateur hour. It’s a masterclass in crowd control, hospitality, and knowing what makes sports fans tick.And let’s talk value. This is not “cheap.” This is smart. No $28 cocktails served with a wink and a side of regret. No half-assed buffets hiding under heat lamps. South Point is first-cabin service without the pretense. It’s the casino for people who remember when Vegas gave a damn. And thank the gambling gods — these guys still do.South Point, you sly devil. You’ve ruined me — in the best way.

allReviews.title: fun is here.
allReviews.text: I’m a local and I love this hotel, 11 restaurants, 16 movie theaters, 64 lane bowling alley and decent service.the south point arena is a big plus for me, bull riding and horse shows,the showroom always has something going on and don’t forget Kate’s korner ice cream and Del Mar deli. check out Steak ‘n Shake and my personal favorite don Vito’s.slot machines pay fairly well and the waitresses are pretty good, I tip when I win quite a bit of money. Sports book is a must, football games.check out this casino, very clean.

allReviews.title: Why this hotel gets four out of five stars is Is not rooted in reality
allReviews.text: I do not understand how this hotel could have 4 out of 5 stars. I recently brought my wife out on a business trip for a trade show with my company and we were all asked to save as much money as we could. Years ago We used to stay at the Luxor Hotel which back in 2002-2006 was a very good Choice for a hotel that would not break you especially if you could stay in the pyramid which we always chose. This time there was an overwhelming majority of reviews that said this hotel had gone way down in quality and had lots of pictures to show. Using TripAdvisor we found South Point Hotel and casino with almost 6,500 mostly positive reviews and figured that this must be a great hotel to stay at. We booked through my wife's work and in the confirmation showed that we had breakfast included in our room rate. When we were waiting outside of the airport to be picked up there was confusion among almost 20 passengers who were also waiting as to where we actually would be standing to be picked up by the shuttle bus Several people received different conflicting Locations as to where the shuttle bus would actually stop. I asked another shuttle bus driver who was stopped in the same area and he informed me that that shuttle would stop there. It did after a 15 minute delay from The programmed time. When we arrived at the hotel to check in we were told that no Breakfast was included in their room and that we would have to deal with my wife's company. Good luck on a Saturday afternoon. (I did receive a print out from my wife's work on Monday stating that breakfast was included but the hotel said they did not honor that). Starting on Saturday night through the following Thursday the 12 elevators for the building consistently kept breaking down. At any one time, there was only three to five elevators working for 24 floors for many hundreds of people trying to reach their rooms. At one point security had to be called to break up a major fight from people cutting in line and had to post security for the rest of the night because there were only two of the 12 Elevators working. When I asked several people over the course of our visit about the elevators they said that it was a common issue with that hotel.  I asked why would you keep coming back here and their simple explanation was they received free rooms for gambling.  Our room was okay however when my wife went to take a shower that first night, the water would not drain from the tub. Try 5 inches of swill water while you're trying to get clean.  I called the front desk and a service tech did come up within 15 minutes and dug out a large clump of hair from the drain.  It mostly worked after that.  Every day after 10:00 AM they were jackhammering the floor above us And above other rooms on our floor as they were renovating bathrooms all during the week. We ate in the buffet dining room for several meals and it was pretty good for the price. My wife did use the female salon and had her Hair and nails done and she was happy with the service. The one day I did not have to be at the trade show to open, I went down to the male salon to sit in the hot tub and was told it was broken. Overall the hotel was not a total disaster even though many nights we had to stand for at least 15 minutes to get up to our 8th floor. After being in Las Vegas almost a dozen times over the last 20 years for trade shows I have noticed and confirmed by taxi drivers that many of the hotels have Have fallen into disrepair after COVID wiped out most of the maintenance budgets of many of these hotels that were Affordable.  All you need to do is look at the price discrepancy between affordable hotels and the higher end hotels which are many hundreds of dollars a night more.  This was the only time our company had a booth at this trade show and my wife and I will not be back to Las Vegas.  Oh, One last point, between taxi And Uber rides to get to and from the Convention Center Because South Point is so far away $89.00/day, I would have spent almost the same as a $300 a night hotel. Therefore we did not save any money for the company as anticipated.

allReviews.title: Stop before the Strip
allReviews.text: We stopped here before heading to our hotel on the Strip.  It is a great local place.  It is big and wide open and very clean.  We had very good service at all the slots we played.  It was a fun time for the three of us for a few hours, and we will go back again.

allReviews.title: Very disappointed
allReviews.text: Smoking room an infection odor impregnated throughout the room and no possibility to ventilate Cleaning not done you have to ask Hotel very disappointing You have to love the crowd to go For those who love the casino there is what it takes I do not recommend

allReviews.title: Go for the NFR
allReviews.text: Respectful and friendly staff. Enjoy the all you can eat brunch when I go during the National Finals Rodeo. A lot to do in on spot especially for the equestrian community. Worth going if you choose to go to Vegas. I was able to get a coupon book for things around the Hotel and Casino that helped me save some money since I was staying there.

allReviews.title: Document your check out!!!
allReviews.text: Check out beware. I was there for collegiate bowling tournament my daughter was in with my 78 yo father with me. We left Sunday morning. While I’m sitting at airport they charge me $200. I called they said housekeeping report marijuana smoke smell in my room. I don’t even smoke period let alone marijuana. Unbelievable

allReviews.title: Room dirty
allReviews.text: So upon my arrival i go to my room and the first thing I see is a used condom on the bathroom floor behind the toilet. I reported it to management. Nothing got done, so make sure you inspect your rooms. I've been coming here for 4 straight years. Based on my overall experience, I won't be back. Management could have done something different other than roll their eyes at me and say sorry you want us to complete it unbelievable

allReviews.title: Fun place for the NFR watch parties
allReviews.text: Fun atmosphere!  loved the nightly watch parties for the NFR Easy  to navigate even when there were so many people attending events!. Clean, lots of food options. Clean restrooms!   Downside was just the parking garage and trying to leave events.

allReviews.title: 10 Points for South Point!
allReviews.text: We needed a last minute one night hotel in Las Vegas and South Point had a great deal.  The room had obviously been completely updated, the king bed was incredibly comfortable and all amenities were perfect for us.  We are locals in the winter and would never hesitate to stay at South Point again.  Our expectations were met and more!

allReviews.title: Stayed here pre flight home; would do it again!
allReviews.text: We rented a room for the day since we had a late night flight to go back home.  We'd come in from Death Valley and wanted a place to relax.  I'd recommend this for the proximity to the car rental return/airport.  They had a good happy hour at their restaurants and bars.  Lots of gambling areas, room was decent sized and comfortable.  Free valet parking was helpful too.  Staying here meant we could clean up, not worry about luggage, relax and get some gambling in before heading home!

allReviews.title: Great trip, One complaint
allReviews.text: Everything was great with one exception. Did the raiders shuttle and had alot of fun. We were told ahead of time that we got two drink coupons for each shuttle purchase. When we checked in they did not honor what we were told or what was advertised.. The check in employees said we only got two drink tickets for three reservations. There were six of us total. We were not happy with the false advertising, or the supervisors attitude. Two of us wrote to the Southpoint website, only to receive offensive response. We've decided that, if they don't get it figured out, we will try something else next time.

allReviews.title: Good Night Sleep Before LAS Flight
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here on our way back from Death Valley National Park. We were just in for one night to rest up for a morning flight out of LAS. We're not casino people. We just needed a nice bed and their hotel was the best deal in the vicinity of the airport.Check-in/out was an absolute breeze. They had a self check-in kiosk so we were able to get our room keys with no wait in line. We were also able to check out on our room TV, making both processes quick and easy.As for the room, it was spacious and the bed was super comfortable. We got a great night's sleep. The only issue we had was the bath spout didn't fully switch to the shower head when we pulled up on it, so it made for a little bit of a standing in a puddle while in the shower.
