A minor issue that didn't affect the quality of our stay. We would stay again.

allReviews.title: A Transformative Las Vegas Experience: Embracing South Point Hotel and Casino After Decades of Loyalty to Caesars Palace
allReviews.text: A Transformative Las Vegas Experience: Embracing South Point Hotel and Casino After Decades of Loyalty to Caesars Palace

allReviews.title: Only 2 working elevators!
allReviews.text: Only two elevators working for the higher floors. This is dangerous for many reasons. There is NO communication from the hotel staff regarding this. Plan ahead if you have a flight to catch as it could take you more than a half hour to get an over crowded elevator . This is a very busy weekend and week to come so wear your patience pants if you plan to stay here!

allReviews.title: Stay away
allReviews.text: We checked in for a week. The room next to us was under renovation. We called on our first day to check how long and they said it would last 8 hours but only for that day. The next day it started again. We called the front desk and the manager was the rudest person I’ve talked to in customer service. He told me it was a 24/7 casino and to deal with it, they wouldn’t move us rooms, offer a discount, or anything.

allReviews.title: Nice Casino and buffet!
allReviews.text: I have family that lives in the area and always bring us here when we visit from Florida. Not so much smoking, which I really appreciate. The buffet has always been very good every time we visit. Will we be back? Of cource we will. I'm sure you will enjoy your visit.

allReviews.title: Another great stay
allReviews.text: Our home away from home. Love the rooms, comfy beds. Cheap eats, midnight special of steak and eggs for $6.45. Lots of gaming options. Free comedy show Friday nights, dirty at 1230. Free airport shuttle. Movie theatre, bowling alley, pool, spa, bingo 5 times a day, this casino/ resort has it all! We have been to Vegas many times and don’t want to stay on the overpriced strip. Stay here. Oh yeah, free parking. We play table games and hardly have to pay for food with our comps. Will be back in April!

allReviews.title: Cheap Bartender on staff after 10pm on Friday, October 4, 2024
allReviews.text: South Point Hotel & Casino is a wonderful casino and the restaurant staff & food were great!  The only issue my family & I had was when my brother asked for a bottle of water (these are 8 oz. or less) - the bartender on staff stated that it would be $1. Yikes. After spending so much money at this casino and its restaurants, the guy couldn't give my brother 1 bottle. Wow . . . really stunk!

allReviews.title: South Pointers for Life!
allReviews.text: This is not our first stay at South Point; however, it was the best!  My husband and I visited Las Vegas for the Steelers/Raiders game.  The hotel offers game packages that include transportation by charter bus to the game.  We used it last year without any issues.  This time the wheelchair lift malfunctioned and we were not able to board.  The head valet assisting the bus driver informed the Front Desk Manager John about the situation.  They immediately began to look for a cab that allowed a power wheelchair to ride into it.  He had difficulties finding one.  My husband and I decided to sell our game tickets, but just as I was about to hit sell – John and 4 security officers appeared.  John offered us a solution to get to the game.  The security officers would load the wheelchair onto one of their trucks and they would use one of the cars for VIPs to take us to and pick us from the game.  It was his out of the box thinking that saved our vacation.John was awesome to work with and staff said the same.  We enjoy staying at South Point. The location is great.  There is not a lot of noise, the facility is always clean, the staff is friendly and knowledgeable.  And I assume it must be a good place to work because we see familiar staff faces each year.  Thank you again John, the valet staff and security officers for making this trip the best yet!

allReviews.title: A Hidden Hotel Gem in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: We discovered the South Point Hotel & Spa a few years back and anytime we come to Las Vegas we stay here! This is located just south of the airport (a quick 10 ish minute ride from the airport) and has 11 restaurants, 2 bowling alleys, 16 movie theaters, a large equestrian center (they have rodeos here) a huge Bingo Hall (but this ain't your granny's Bingo - you can win big money here), lots of slot machines, plenty of table games and lots of parking (if you drive here or rent a car). They are very affordable, clean, and comfortable! Rooms are spacious with large bathrooms and the hotel staff is wonderful! Do yourself a favor and book massages at the spa... wonderful! See you guys in April for the Glass Expo!

allReviews.title: South Point didn’t disappoint.
allReviews.text: Great time at South Point.  Room was clean with a pool view.  We were able to check in early.  All the meals we had were awesome.  If we had a complaint it was the pillows.  We prefer a flatter pillow.  The 2 pool bartenders (Daniel and Bearto (sp?) were polite and provided great service!!

allReviews.title: worth a stay
allReviews.text: if you like us have visited las vegas  numerous times or you want somewhere quieter to stay than on the strip yet minutes away by car this is the place . Can,t fault it even though it was extra busy we found we could always get sun loungers at the pool ..  food was never a problem with loads of options to  try . whether table gambling or slots . this is a well run locals and tourist hotel well worth a stay here   .

allReviews.title: Extraordinary
allReviews.text: Pension in Vegas. Huge, but super comfortable.Nice pool, restaurant(s) very good. Bowling great, casino great.Well located about 15 minutes drive from the Strip.Large room, well equipped, however we had a view on a wall. No big deal for us, we had so many stars in our eyes. If I go back to Vegas, I go back to South Point.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: Starbucks located right inside the front door.  Full menu. I only got iced tea because it was so hot and it was the only thing that was going to quench my thirst. Pleasant staff and good quick service. Might be back tomorrow as it is right next door to my hotel

allReviews.title: Absolutely First Class!!!
allReviews.text: 100% impressed!!  Don’t know where to begin…Starting with checking in : we were welcomed like family .. no rush .. the hotel and amenities were explained in full with no confusion The room was absolutely spotless!!!No odd smells in hallways or room at all ..Beds were extremely comfortable with some of the best pillows on the planet !!The pool:: extremely clean pool and lounging area..the pool bar/deli was welcoming and ready to please  Casino :: some of the nicest dealers and casino management I have ever met / it was my fiancés first time playing roulette and the management was more than patient and accommodating Buffet and restaurants:::, Again, spotless!! Food was beyond the standard buffet fair and of course the servers were amazing !!Housekeeping deserves 10 stars !!To sum up our experience :: I will always stay at South Point ! I have never been treated so well in Las Vegas.. please give this hotel your business.. I promise you will not be disappointed!!

allReviews.title: A visit worth taking
allReviews.text: This is our favorite hotel for the last 10 years or so we have been coming to South Point. We were not even checked in when my brother won a jackpot on the Evel Knievel machine. Everyone here is very nice including Michelle in Host services she helped us when we checked out. Sarah is awesome in bingo. Ana and Robert in Coronado Cafe are excellent. Sarah Ochoa and Gabby in the business office we're very nice and helpful in wrapping some of our items to pack to come home. Roulette dealer Therna  was very accommodating in spinning the numbers that I had been betting on. We especially wish to thank Kelly in the cashiers box, we've seen her and said hello every time we've been for the last 4 to 5 years. It's always our pleasure to visit with her for an extra minute or two. She's very nice to deal with. We thank everyone that we dealt with during our two stays at the South Point.

allReviews.title: IM IN VEGAS 6 months a year! THAT IS MY FAVORITE PLACE
allReviews.text: From the moment we arrived, we were greeted by the warmest and friendliest host, making check-in a breeze. Our room was ready well before 3 p.m., setting the tone for an unforgettable stay. We were there for the photo booth convention, and I instantly fell in love with the hotel. The rooms were impeccably clean, and the service was both swift and welcoming. Everywhere you go, the bartenders are there to brighten your day with their friendly demeanor. And of course, I have to mention the oyster bar—my absolute favorite! Their happy hour is unbeatable, with talented chefs who spoil you with delightful little samples. Since February, I’ve returned four times, and I know it won’t be the last. Can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Hidden gem off strip
allReviews.text: Fun clean place that in all reality you dont have to leave. Many food and entertainment choices. Clean and modern feel. Front desk was awesome to deal with and very informative.  Parking garage on ground and easy to navigate.  Only drawback, the casino is very smokey and smells of it.  Not terrible but detectable. Unlike many Las Vegas Casinos.

allReviews.title: Great stay - we would love to come back!
allReviews.text: - large room- beautiful view of pool landscape and mountains (22. Stock)- nice, uncrowded casino - Bowling alley and small arcade available - to the delight of our son- Restaurant selection ok (but we were mostly eating outside the hotel) - Parking garage and parking for free! - The pool is nice and big and the whirlpool is great - Coupon booklet (which we didn't use - somehow there was nothing for us) - For us the location was great - for the activities we parked at Luxor, Sphere, Fashion Mall and Freemant StreetWhat we didn't like so much: - no refillable care products - a shame - the garden buffet is good, but from 9 years old the full price should be paid - that was too much for us (a child can't eat that much at all) - here a coupon would have been nice especially for children that they can at least eat for free or for a small price at the buffet (so we were outside the hotel for dinner) - at breakfast we ate a few times anyway at the buffet

allReviews.title: No Grace, Rude Management
allReviews.text: Rude and Arrogant management. Our reservation had us on the 20th from the 1st email. Somehow in the matrix it was altered to the day before. At checking the reservationist did not give us a receipt. In the confusion we asked to pay for the extra day and the management wanted to charge us 2 times our initial price. We hadn’t learned about the error until we were getting kicked out. Never will go back. DO NOT RECOMMEND. Casino/Hotels make a ton of money. A small price adjustment would have been a small price that would made a world of difference compared to what was Offered in wanting to Charge 2 times more, (then on their site it was $20 less). If Pissing people off is more important. Well done!

allReviews.title: Best Hotel/Casino in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: South Point is quite simply, the best place to stay, play and eat in Las Vegas.   The hotel is old school and has lots of loss leader food and drink specials.  My favorites are the buffet which serves quality prime rib, the hotdog cart which has the best hotdogs I have ever eaten for $1.50 each and the Coronado Cafe which features a fantastic $19.95 complete Porterhouse steak dinner available 24 hours.   The hotel and common areas are all extremely clean and they work very hard to keep it that way.  Beds are very comfortable and rooms are quiet.The casino is always extremely busy because of great odds on video poker and table games.  The video poker inventory is without equal in the state of Nevada and South Point boasts hundreds of games paying back well over 99%.  This was my third visit to the property and it has become my "home" casino.  It is privately owned and does not have to please shareholders, only the customers so it can offer great deals as loss leaders.Employees are all very friendly and genuinely go out of their way to help.  Bar service is the best I've ever had in Las Vegas.  This property is a far cry from the corporate-owned megaresorts on the Strip where they think they're doing you a favor by letting you in the door.  Ripoff food, hotel and gambling so common on the Strip does not exist at South Point.

allReviews.title: Not going back and not recommending
allReviews.text: Tri State uses this venue every year for their seminar.  I have not been here in 5 years and I won't be coming back.  They close the pool and hot tub area at 8 pm.  They didn't close it so early in the past.  Not only do they close early in this hot summer, but at 7:55 the lifeguards are running everyone out.  I won't come back just for this reason.  I'll go somewhere else where the pool and hot tub stay open much later.

allReviews.title: Atmosphere, amenities, restaurants awesome.  Slot machines, terrible.
allReviews.text: I would rate the variety of food and fun, and atmosphere of the overall resort, a 5 out of 5.  It's a very lively place to be, with something to do for everyone.  A 24-hour Starbucks with an ice cream parlor right next to it is a very nice touch.This review, however, is from a locals perspective on slot machine gaming compared to the rest of the Vegas casinos.  And with that, I can tell you that South Point has some of the tightest slot machines in the entire Las Vegas valley.  Go for the amenities, play the tables, enjoy the restaurants, cafe and buffet, but don't expect to see much in the way of winning if you are there to play the slot machines.I've seen old reviews, posted by South Point, on how they supposedly decided to run with looser slots, and that is absolutely not true.  My wife and I have played approx. $50-$60k per year ($1-$4 bets on all types of slots) across all the casinos in Vegas, for the past 15 years.  Southpoint is one of the few casinos where you can play a few grand, betting only a few bucks a spin, and not have ANY action whatsoever for the entire session.  You end up having a very short night, which is a terrible experience.   It's happened so many times over the years that we've decided 2024 is now the year to cut South Point out of our list of places to play.  We only stop by South Point to run in to grab a Starbucks late night before a long drive.

allReviews.title: Family stay for USBC Open, disgusted by filthy room floors and lack of housekeeping services for 3 night stay.
allReviews.text: Family stay for USBC Open, disgusted by filthy room floors and lack of housekeeping services for 3 night stay.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Always a good experience at south point!  It is annoying how they Market Price the rates so it goes from 89/night to 300/ night in a flash.. I have been booking other places as they get pricier and pricier.  Shame as it was my go to place for years.  A lot of the older vegas hotels are upping their game so if you don’t have a horse or want to bowl you can get better value on the weekends elsewhere..

allReviews.title: Totally Great Experience!!
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the South Point for the first time for a quick trip to Vegas. So glad we did! The atmosphere, food, room, and staff were great. Plus, the slot machines were very hot!! We usually stay on the Strip but we will be returning to South Point in the fall.

allReviews.title: Good place to stay!
allReviews.text: Great hotel with a clean room and awesome restaurants. Also, a plus that there is a Starbucks right inside the hotel. A downside is that it's just far enough away from the strip to be a little trip getting to and from. The bowling ally and movie theater are also nice to take a break from gambling.

allReviews.title: Always A Good Experience
allReviews.text: Always a good stay - have to know when to eat at different places at the hotel to avoid long lines but that is to be expected.  Jewel and Wangy who write reviews in June and July of this year seem like whiners - have stayed many times at South Point and not experienced ANY of the alleged stuff they claimed happened so their reviews should probably be thrown out along with really anyone complaining about this hotel and casino.  Speaking of casino, whining about not paying out just means you don't know which machines and what time to play them.  Payout is pretty average in Las Vegas for slot machines so people complaining about that should just find somewhere else to stay and somewhere else to gamble.  I'll be there again next month I think anyway so looking forward to it.

allReviews.title: What a gem!
allReviews.text: First time staying at South Point and no regrets!  If you want the Vegas experience with scantily clad women and drunks walking up and down the Strip, then this is not the place for you. We have stayed in many of the strip hotels over the years, so this was a refreshing change.  Check-in was easy and fast - only took about 10 minutes at 4:00pm on a Monday.  Had a king non-smoking room on the 22nd floor with a view of the pool and stayed 4 nights.  Beds were comfortable. We had a fridge and a coffee maker with free coffee pods!  That is unusual in Vegas.  Bathroom was nice with a separate area for tub and toilet. There was a lighted make-up mirror on the wall.  Shampoo, conditioner, lotions and soaps were good and plentiful.  Housekeeping was prompt each day.  It was 116 that week, so we were happy that our room stayed cool. There is a safe in the closet and plenty of USB ports/plugins on each side of the bed.  The room as a little dark, but if you turned on all the lights, it was fine.  We didn't hear any noises at night and did not smell smoke on our floor.We had no issues with the elevators, but there were times we saw people standing in line waiting for one - mostly in the evenings.  It was very easy to get from the rooms to the pool area and fitness center.The 24 hour fitness center was great - looks out on the pool area and has all the machines and equipment you could want, plus towels and sanitizers to keep things clean.  Treadmills had a blue tooth connection for airpods.The pool area was nice even in the excessive heat - there was shade in the first part of the day and again around 4:00pm.  It was nice that it stayed open until 8.  We used the hot tub also -it is in a shaded area and had jets that were forceful!  Towels were easy to get and loungers were easy to find and move into shade if needed.  They have a gazebo area that is shaded with tables and chairs.We did have a rental car and the parking garage was free and they were actually cleaning the floors one of the days! It is an easy walk to the casino from the garage - a little farther to the room elevators.  They have a free shuttle from the airport (unheard of in Vegas!) so you could go without a car if you were not going anywhere else.  It's pretty far south of the Strip - probably 15 minutes.We ate breakfast and lunch at the Garden Buffet several times - food was better than we had last March.  We used our loyalty cards and points to get some $$ off, which made it very affordable. Great omelets made to order, great French Toast and plenty of other variety. The snack bar in the Bowling Center was a pleasant surprise - sandwiches and salads for very reasonable prices.  We ate at the Steak and Shake late one night, and it was good too.  Coronado Cafe has great late-night specials from midnight to 6:00am, but be prepared to stand in line.We also did the Senior movie for $4 at the cinema - nice experience!This hotel is well managed - overall it was a great experience. The crowd is mostly bowlers, locals or rodeo people.  Not the glitz and glamour of the strip, but a clean, nice, respectable crowd.  Felt very safe here and we will stay here again!

allReviews.title: Superb Adult Vacation
allReviews.text: This was the best adult vacation destination I have ever been to.  Every member of the staff was wonderful.  We were treated as valued guests and enjoyed the property immensely.  The only complaints we had were the bath towels are too small and the pool closed TOO EARLY (8 pm)!The Rigatoni with Italian Sausage at Don Vito’s was the VERY BEST pasta dish I have ever eaten!!!!!We only ate off the property one time because the food variety and quality was excellent!!!  The breakfast and lunch buffets have something for everyone and the Coronado Cafe has superb Prime Rib!  Also, try their Rodeo Wrap with fries-you won’t be disappointed!!!!!  Even the hot dog and BBQ at the bowling alley snack bar were excellent!  We just can’t say enough about it all!!!!!!I can’t wait to return to Vegas and South Point!!!!

allReviews.title: Smelly and Dishonest Customer Service
allReviews.text: Where do I start? Hmmm. Check-In. We advised hotel months in advance we had a late flight. They confirmed our room would be available. We paid for a "Premium View" room. Well, if you call that looking at the side of condo towers next door and the pool. No strip or mountain view rooms available at check-in! Wow! We still paid full price! They said we could switch rooms two days later. Hard to do with kids and stuff already unpacked. And they allowed :30 to do it. We missed all the fireworks with our view. Not the plan after spending $3k to get to Vegas.Customer Service does not care a bit about anyone!Next up. Non Smoking floor? Well, the hallways smell like ciggy smoke. Weird? Smells? If you like smells, this is the place for you. Casino floor smells like urinal cakes. No doors on bathroom entries by restaurants. That is really bad! Pool area smells like a horse barn from the horse arena next door. Two times there were piss puddles in the elevators. Plenty of drunks here for the price point. Lots of dirty people from south of the border. May explain the pee?Parking ramps always full. Arcade for kids, yes. But each game costs 2.25 to 3.50! Not kidding! Your kids will lose more money than you will gambling! FACT! We did!Lots of bowling going on. Never a lane open for family fun. Always full of pros. So you wont be bowling here either!In all, not a place to take a family! Not affordable! Poor customer service! Did I mention the slot machines dont payout? That too! Only good thing was the food at the mexican restaurant! 10/10!

allReviews.title: Good place
allReviews.text: We like stopping at the South Point casino and playing there.  It has a calm, fun atmosphere.  The sports book is very good.  They have a huge variety of slots and table games.  The casino floor is spacious and open.  It is not as wild and crazy as the Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: Staff hospitality, staff training, and biased management towards staff
allReviews.text: Experience at the garden buffet was terrible. They insinuated that we didn’t pay and hospitality of the staff was very unwelcoming. The way that your staff acts shows the atmosphere of the hotel as a whole. The training of all the staff overall (pool, food staff, hotel front desk, etc) was a bit off. They should be retrained.  During our experience at the garden buffet the staff didn’t let our kids go eat. We paid for them and they said that they weren’t allowed to let us in due to us “ not paying". We showed them the receipt that we paid for everyone but they said the manager had to come confirm us in. The other people around us were allowed in no question asked. When explaining  to the women who lets the guests in I said " my kids are hungry we paid can you please let them in?" she replied with "no I cannot".  When the manager confirmed, they let us in and we just let the situation go. Another incident took place at the pool where a family was accused of dropping feces in the pool when the family who did drop it left as soon as it happened. The pool staff called security on them and was very aggressive. Never going to this hotel again do not recommend!

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: My favorite hotel in Las Vegas. It is clean and comfortable, and most of the employees are happy, helpful and professional.  Michael Gaughan has created a home away from home.Host Jamie Lewis , Bartender Craig Bauer and Steakhouse Server Lito are just a few examples of the creme de la creme that Mr Gaughan has secured to represent his establishment.

allReviews.title: Thank You South Point
allReviews.text: Hotel was great,food reasonably priced and good. Has that Vegas feel without the chaos of the strip. We rent a car everytime so not a big deal the distance to the strip. Security is also top notch. We left a voucher in a machine late at night after a few cocktails and I walked to cash it in at a redemption close by,realizing I did not have ticket and went directly back to the machine I was playing and somone cashed it out! Could not have been more then 15 seconds. So ,I found security and they were on it.  All this within about 4 minutes total. Luckily I was using my player card,they tracked the ticket number down by number and canceled it in their system before the person cashed it in. They hand paid me the amount of voucher! THANK YOU SOUTHPOINT SECURITY TEAM! It was our first time staying there and will not stay anywhere else from now on. Staff is excellent.

allReviews.title: Great place for gaming and to relax away from strip
allReviews.text: First time here and will be back. As a former local this is the kind a place I would visit. The crowd here is a mix of locals and older people. This is not a LV strip experience but rather a Vegas experience.Check in was easy and staff were great.Room is where I had some issues. First of all, while it was clean and spacious, there was a noticeable smell of cleaning products which eventually faded. Second issue was that the curtain did not close all the way so light started coming in as soon as the sun came up. Lastly, not sure if it was because we were on a lower floor (4th to be exact) but it was noisy and got a lot of noise, mostly from what sounded like a leaf blower. Other than that it was fine. Nice touch was that there were a couple pair of Southpoint slippers (not top dollar but appreciated) waiting for us. Not sure if it was because it was our first time or they do that for everyone.Bowling alley was fun and reasonable I think. Paid $63 for 4 people and 3 games. Included shoe rental. They have food there however we did not try any.They have plenty of dining options and we choose Steak and Shake. Was not that good over priced and would not go there again.Gaming. Loved playing here. This is was Vegas used to be. 3:2 black jack with $10 minimums. Hand shuffle and not like 8 decks. Sat at a table and was able to play for some time. Went up and down bet from 10 to 50 but I was able to stay on the table and enjoy myself unlike on the strip. Other table games had the lower minimums as well.And staff was great. Asked for extra pillow and they were brought right up. Left clothing in the room and they kept it and was able to get it back from lost and found 2 days later.

allReviews.title: Short trip but nice
allReviews.text: I arrived Tuesday around 10pm the staff got me checked in quick, the room was clean and affordable. The poker room was good action but low key. Abigale at the desk is on point as were others, the burger in the bowling alley was 10.99 and very good, and the midnight specials are super cheap. I will stay there again next time.

allReviews.title: Fun place to stay
allReviews.text: Southpointe is a nice place to stay if you don’t want the craziness of the middle of the strip. Fabulous amenities..many slots and poker tables. Outstanding restaurants and all of the staff are so very nice. Our room was large and comfortable. The only thing I found objectionable..and it is a personal opinion..is the outfits the cocktail waitresses have to wear are ugly..sleazy..and exploitative. Time to stop catering to men ogling and get them something pretty to wear. Wearing something classy is way more appealing and tasteful.

allReviews.title: Get Your Eat On!
allReviews.text: Joined family at the Garden Buffet for lunch!  Food was filling and a great variety to choose from.  Great atmosphere and service. Reasonable prices 7/$126.  We weren't guest of the casino/hotel, but we did play slots and enjoyed their buffet.

allReviews.title: Memorial day 2024 Family Getaway
allReviews.text: As I am writing this, Ive just arrived home from Las Vegas and I had to immediately post a review of this hotel. First off, I came with my family for my 40th birthday celebration weekend, and from the start, I was a very good one. Upon coming in from the parking structure and into the casino, I noticed that the casino was very big, however , everything was within reach from starbucks to all the eateries. Second, checking in was a breeze and I have to say, very very secure by scanning your ID. The front desk lady, who I cannot remember her name, was very kind to move us from the 17th floor down to the 5th, thus taking away my families fear of tall buildings. She was very pleasant and extremely helpful. Customer service for the entire 2 night stay was 5/5 stars all the way. When it comes to food, we did try the Coronado cafe. The food was pretty good, however if there was ever any complaint about this hotel, is that the beef barley soup had zero flavor to it, and my chicken in the cesar salad was very cold. With that said, we did eat at Zenshin that evening for dinner, and to be honest, the food served there had some of the best ramen Ive ever had in my life. I am half Japanese, though not a ramen snob, but for a place like this to serve noodles in this fashion? That was pretty amazing. I also ordered the salmon skin salad, along with a freshly fried soft shell crab tempura style, and I was blown away. The room was gorgeous. The hardwood floors made it feel very homely, and the bed and beddings smelled fresh and very nice. Bathroom wise, nothing to complain about at all. The tub , toilet and sink areas were all extremely clean, and very nicely polished. All in all, I would and will definitely stay here again. When  we got there , there must have been some type of bowling tournament happening, and it was neat to see all the folks get ready to do their thing. Keep up the amazing work South Point.

allReviews.title: Top stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with Casino, Swimming Pool, Spa, Bowling, Cinema, and several restaurants at the gates of Las Vegas. Large and free parking, large and comfortable rooms, the only flaw is the 70s bathtub, but otherwise really excellent! Very organized for baggage delivery and parking, quick check in despite the queue. Highly recommended!

allReviews.title: Best Ever!!  No more strip hassle!
allReviews.text: Well, this was our first visit to an outside the center strip area in 50 Years. We had a nice room overlooking the pool on the 15th floor.Housekeeping was great. Keurig in each room was a surprise. AC worked great and room had a refridge. Only downer was the bed was not the best and pillows the worst. South Point was self contained. Great casino with low bets. Restaurants were many options. There were deals to be had at all of them. Bowling center, Equestrian arena, sports book, and a GREAT pool area "could use more shade". We will NEVER go to a strip hotel again. South Point is ours now. Thank You to all.Jerry The K

allReviews.title: Beautifully remodeled!
allReviews.text: Beautiful room, nice amenities. Friendly staff. Stayed overnight to visit friends. Did not visit the casino other than to walk through. Ate dinner with friends, so didn’t get to dine at lodge, nor use pool or spa. Would stay again, and for more than one night.

allReviews.title: Housekeeping issues
allReviews.text: Pay a lot of money wFor a room. Asked at registration if we wanted housekeeping. I said yes No housekeeping was done. Had to call for towels etc and then waited quite some time for them to arrive.  Other than that,  this resort is great. So much to do.

allReviews.title: South Point is Our Vegas Home
allReviews.text: Just returned from a Monday-Friday (April 29-May 3) stay at South Point. This is the first time we've stayed there rather than the Grandview condos across the street.  We've never seen the place so busy except maybe for the first rounds of March Madness. It was nuts. All casino hotels in Vegas should study South Point to see how they do it. There was a huge bowling tournament, a Towing Industry convention, and a five-day radio controlled car competition.  By Friday the Derby crowd was showing up. The Race Book was full to overflowing, and there's a ballroom viewing party today (Saturday).  The casino was busy every day, morning, noon and night. Drink service on the floor was good once a server found us, but it sometimes took awhile to get an order because it was so busy.  We had pretty good luck this trip, though of course that's not always the case.South Point has been our gambling/entertainment hub for several years.  We really appreciate the stability of the employees, many of whom have been there since it opened.  They say they are well treated and are generally happy and helpful.   Our room was on the 24th floor and was great.  It had a very comfortable king bed, two upholstered chairs, a small table with two chairs, and a desk with chair.  Maid service was daily with fresh towels and bedding if you choose.  Toiletries were above average quality and there were even two sets of slippers, nice enough to bring home. Though the hotel was full, we didn't hear our neighbors. Just the usual slamming doors and occasional talking of people in the hallway. Wednesday two or three elevators (there are six) were out of order and lines got quite long at times. Other days it wasn't an issue. Our room looked west over the pool. We only visited the pool once.  Nice pool, separate kiddy pool, and large hot tub.  It opens at 10 am but after 11 there's very little shade. It closes at 6 pm, which seems too early.We ate at Don Vito's, Primarily Prime Rib, the Coronado Cafe, and had the breakfast and lunch buffets. Prices continue to creep up (inevitable with food inflation being so bad) but the food is both tasty and high quality in the restaurants and the buffet. It's all still a very good value. Yesterday was Seafood Buffet night. It opened at 3 pm. We had to leave for the airport at 3:30, but people were lining up for the buffet at 1:30. They even brought their own folding stools! We talked to a few waiting in line. Mostly locals for whom it's a weekly, monthly, or whatever event. They consider it a real bargain.South Point provides a free shuttle to and from the airport. We used it coming and going. The schedule is available on their website.  Few Vegas hotels offer one.  It's a money saver, since without it cab or Uber fare to/from South Point can range from $20 to $40.  It would be nice if there were better public transportation options from South Point.  A bus comes right to the casino, but getting to the strip using it requires a transfer and a fair amount of time.  Ubers and Lyfts are generally hanging out in the parking lot, quick to arrive if wanted.  The "bottom line" is that SP continues to be our first (and only) choice, whether staying there or at the Grandview. We didn't leave the property for our entire stay. I sure hope they keep it up. The success of their formula is evident in the crowds. My only complaint (and I mean this as a compliment to them) is that the place has maybe become too popular!

allReviews.title: Family comes 1st
allReviews.text: When in Vegas Southpoint is my one stop playground.  I’m 72 and my children live in Vegas…we all love the convenience, hospitality, bowling center, theater, and Coronado Cafe. I wish I cold win in the casino once in awhile but that’s not on you SP

allReviews.title: A pretty good overall experience; would return.
allReviews.text: This place is obviously off the strip and has little of the "glamor" of those mega-properties. But that has advantages: It's not small but "smaller" so you don't have to walk two miles to an event or to your room.  The elevator service is good (an amenity not to be overlooked in the mega-hotels). The rooms are nice and large at about 500 sq ft. The furnishings are modest, not new or high-fashion, but fine really. The bathroom could use a bit more light but has a water-closet area for the toilet and shower, so two people could use it if need be.  The casino is fine (not a huge gambler) and they have what you'd want.  Friends liked that there were lower limit tables if that's what you prefer.  The sports book is pleasant. Several bars. Valet service quicker than most places, which is big!   Unlike many Vegas hotels, this had ample front-desk help for check-in.   Very good price-point, even over SuperBowl long weekend. And this location avoids the annoying strip-area traffic, while still being fairly close to the stadium, golf course(s), whatever.  I would definitely return.

allReviews.title: My stay at South Point Casino
allReviews.text: I enjoyed the restaurants for quality and variety.  Liked the fact that both Coronado Cafe and the gift shop were open 24/7 for convenience, versus other hotels.  Casino provided comfortable environment and l loved all the video poker machines.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Great hotel, got everything you need, 2 small problems, the wi/fi is not good and is you win over 1200 bucks they do not offer any taxation help which as I am from UK would have been good. The bar staff are all brilliant and the buffet is excellent (big shout out to David at the egg station, really nice chap.) In modern Vegas it is probably the only place I would stay, proper old school.

allReviews.title: Wonderful!
allReviews.text: We have stayed here several times, and we always enjoy it because it is not on the strip, so the hotel is newer, and the pool area is not as crowded. The casino, restaurants and rooms are always clean. The spa and restaurant staff are wonderful. Plenty to do right inside the hotel like movie, bowling, gambling, and watching sports. Plenty of free parking and it's easy to order an Uber to go downtown. We have never had any problems here whatsoever and I really recommend trying this hotel/spa.

allReviews.title: Good times at South Point Hotel
allReviews.text: A group of us stayed at South Point to watch the football playoffs and to have some good times. We could not have stayed at a better hotel, from the excellent cuisine to the clean and comfortable rooms, you can’t go wrong!

allReviews.title: Great weekend
allReviews.text: This hotel and casino is top notch. The rooms are big and clean with no carpeting which is great. The casino although they allow smoking was relatively free of smoke. All employees I talked with were very friendly. My only complaint was with the elevators I literally waited 15 minutes to go down to the casino at 810am on saturday because it seemed like only 3 elevators worked out of 6. With all the hotels we have stayed at this was the best. I would definitely stay here again .The resort fees were cheaper the all others plus free parking.

allReviews.title: My favorite buffet in Vegas
allReviews.text: South Point only proves covid did not kill buffets, greed did. When I am in Vegas which is alot I eat breakfast there everyday or brunch on the weekends, the staff is exceptional, have become friends with Dave who makes omelettes as well as most of the staff there, great people. But i really like the food and price as well, I get an omelette then top it with mushrooms from one of the stations, then off to the fruit for a full plate of the variety they have there, then their bakery for the deserts has to be one of the best in the entire city, I get banana cream, coconut cream, or chocolate cream myself but they have alot to pick from. And as good as that is, I like everything about the South Point from gambling to bowling, it is it's own little city in one location. Just hope they do not change everything good about the place like a few others I could name have done in the name of greed. Which is why I go here now instead of some bigger strip places that I used to go to more. Keep up the great work South Point. Thx.

allReviews.title: South Point has a lot to offer
allReviews.text: I really impressed with all the activities that South Point Casino had to offer for all guests.  I personally really enjoy having breakfast at their Garden buffet.  Still very good and Still priced reasonably...This place has something to offer for most people....

allReviews.title: If 0 stars were allowed
allReviews.text: ( this should be a half star or no star) On Friday January 19th 2024 I was playing high limit video poker and was approached by a slot attendant named Lyn she started talking to me while playing 75 dollars a hand. She stood over me  and continued to talk, I did not reply after ignoring her I just "shoed" her away.  I asked for a supervisor and asked him to tell her to please stop bothering me while i am gambling. On Saturday morning I spoke to the slot dept manager Mr. James Brown. He assured me that he would address this issue.Well I go saturday night the 20th for dinner with my wife. I go back to high limit and play hit a small jackpot and I go elsewhere in the casino. After 45 minutes I hit another jackpot. Waiting to get paid the shift manager Shelly , Lyn and Casey all from the slot dept came over with a security guard  to pay my winnings and I was told by Shelly I am no longer allowed to play in the slots at the  Southpoint I guess my money is no good in slots at the Southpoint Casino..

allReviews.title: It's hard not to like South Point
allReviews.text: What you see is what you get at South Point, and it's hard not to like their good value, non-pretentious vibe, and fair offerings.  They have a large facility, plenty of free parking, loads of good value food outlets, an excellent sports book, poker area and slot machine selection, and the rooms are always fairly priced.  That's probably why the place is always crowded.  And as a business, they earn that repeat custom fair and square.  While it's a place largely focussed on locals, I also find that they do a very reasonable job of looking after regular visitors to Vegas like myself.  When I recently stayed a few nights at Mandalay Bay at the start of a 12 night trip where I stayed across several properties, I didn't even bother to gamble a penny at MB, and just did all my gambling during that part of my trip at South Point.  That will blow my future comps at Mandalay/MGM for a while, but that's ok, I'll just stay at South Point instead.😉.  I like it here, and I'll definitely be back.  Back for the good value, the real atmosphere, and the fair deal they offer.

allReviews.title: Great Option Off The Strip
allReviews.text: We needed a comfortable place to spend 2 nights prior to an international flight. We are non-gamblers. This hotel was just right. Situated south of the strip, the hotel offers spacious, quiet, comfortable rooms and beds. The self-parking is ample, with valet-parking available as well. There are 6 in-house eateries, ranging from all-you-eat buffet style to more fashionable restaurants. Checking-in/out was a breeze. We will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: First time staying: we will be back!
allReviews.text: Quick overnight on a Thursday. It was our first time staying there, and we very much enjoyed it. Our room was a Premium View King, and it was lovely. We liked the layout, appreciated the fridge, and liked the express elevator for floors 14 and up (we were on 17). The bathroom was roomy and bright, the bed was comfortable and the pillows were just right! We explored the hotel amenities (bowling alley, equestrian area) without partaking, and they were hopping! Gambled a bit on the slots, enjoyed solid drink service, and then called it a night around 11:30. Enjoyed the buffet the next morning

allReviews.title: 10 STARS, The best place to stay. Very clean and exceptionally nice rooms.
allReviews.text: Exceptionally clean and gorgeous hotel and Casino. Rooms are very large and very nice. Super nice furniture and bed is amazingly comfortable. Casino is huge and so many nice places to eat inside. High quality furnishings and nice bathrooms.

allReviews.title: Good value, clean and comfy
allReviews.text: Our first time back in years as we stayed a few times when the hotel first opened, then moved to the strip for subsequent trips. Decided to try South Pointe again as the strip has become more expensive, parking a hassle etc. We were very pleased. The premium king was a good size room, wood floors, free slippers. Clean. Bed comfortable. Parking free. Only complaint is bathroom drains very slow, especially the shower, also old shower head with no adjustment. Plenty of hot water though. Food is mediocre but lots of choices. Overall a good value.

allReviews.title: The best casino off strip and my favorite in vegas in general
allReviews.text: South point is a great casino, been there multiple times since 2015.  It has pretty decent rooms, pretty much vegas standard at the very least.  Southpoint has great lighting, a really really good buffet which is important after covid and they have other great restaurants inside as well as one of the only few steak &shakes around.   They also have rodeo events sometimes and they hold nascar when its around.    The casino area is really nice, has lose slots, love the coloring and there's a lot of great staff.  They also have some of the best cocktail waitress uniforms and babes around if that's your thing, here's hoping they never change their uni's.  They pretty much have it all, and its the best off strip casino bar none.

allReviews.title: Humid Rooms, no fans in bathroom
allReviews.text: This is my second time in one month staying at South Point. I live about an hour away, but like to stay in Vegas when my work schedule is busy and I am too tired to drive home. I have stayed on the 6th floor and the 4th floor. Both times the room is sort of humid and has no airflow. Yes, there is AC, but no circulation. The bathroom and sink area, although separate, do not have fans to help with moisture. I called down to the front desk and asked for a fan, of any kind, and they said they don't have any. Guess I will have to pack a small desktop fan for my next stay.Other than that, the bed is comfortable, it's relatively quiet, the parking is free, and there's a Starbucks in the lobby.

allReviews.title: Good value stay
allReviews.text: We stayed for four days following the labour day weekend. There is ample free parking and it is well connected to get around whether that's to the strip or out to some of the national parks. The rooms are large and well appointed if a little dimly lit. The beds were super comfortable and there was a good sized fridge in the room. The cleanliness could be improved as there was a lot of dust in the room but nothing terrible. The pool is nice though has no umbrellas so you need to bag the chairs that happen to be in the shade. There are lots of restaurants of different £-£££ depending on what you're looking for. All in all we had a really nice stay there and would stay again.

allReviews.title: perfect
allReviews.text: free parking and lots of it. reasonable price and clean great room.  buffet is reasonably priced as well.  close to the strip and everywhere else.  its my go to hotel when in vegas.  except when i have to be close to the lake.  then i stay at the campsite

allReviews.title: I'll keep returning
allReviews.text: This was not my first stay here and it definitely won't be my last. From the Valet to housekeeping everything is top notch.  Breakfast Buffet on the weekend was delicious. No waiting and plenty of food at the stations. The pool was spectacular. The pool bar service exceeded expectations. Gaming wasn't good to me but it won't prevent me from returning.  Great job!

allReviews.title: A casino with horses!
allReviews.text: I can't believe theres a casino with horses, if I knew this we would be staying here instead of our hotel. Cheapest hotdog  deals, plenty of extra activities for a variety of group types. And in the future rodeo!

allReviews.title: Wonderful perfect stay. Perfect location. Beds super comfy. Will be back
allReviews.text: I am giving this 5 stars because the hotel is consistent with the price charged. We used to stay at the Bellagio with the high prices and fancy priced restaurants but we have not been back since Covid and decided to come here because we had a business delivery and it was so hot in Vegas and we knew this was a one stop city unto itself. We did our business trip and then came to the hotel. Our room was fine. No carpet on floors and nice soaps and lotions. Towels fluffy. Comfortable bed and the air conditioning was cold. In a good way. We played slots a little and won more than we lost and then ate in Don Vitos Italian restaurant which was VERY reasonably priced. Use the coupons they give you when you check in. We got a free bottle of wine. Then we decided to go to the movies. They have EVERY popular movie there is. We saw Sound of Freedom still packing theaters in the fourth week.  There is so much to do here. Lots of fun slot games. LOTS of restaurants. Couldn't get into the buffet or cafe Sunday morning so went to the bar for coffee. Next time I will order room service. I will go to the oyster bar next time. Our room was very quiet. 236 in floor 2 non smoking floor. The cigarette smoke in the casino was not too awful.

allReviews.title: Worst Blackjack in Vegas....
allReviews.text: I can concur being an AP that they use a severe form of an offset shuffle coupled with a tight wash (in the beginning) to group like cards together forming clumps to subvert BS... which is how most people play and they know this.  1/3rd of the deck is shuffled ... the upper 1/3rd only... and bottom half isn't mixed at all... this is done 3 times. Now some dealers shuffle the entire deck 3 times... but there are other (cool off dealers) that do the shuffle which starts to clump up the deck over time thus giving the player poor hands. Doesn't matter how many players because the cards become pooled together in respective groups. If 12 10's come out... everyone pushes thus taking them out of the deck legally. If all the low cards come out with 8s and 7s mixed in... the dealer always makes a hand leaving everyone who didn't hit and those who doubled (receiving another low card) losing... this happens repeatedly. Low cards following low cards... you don't want to split either.  I would stay away.  You don't play where they purposely perform a tight wash and perpetuate card clumping via shuffling. This has been done by many casinos for years. This is why they want you to but at least  1/4 of the deck because if the dealer (and I know first hand) can group 10s and keep them at the top of the entire deck/decks... most people cut them out of the play to the bottom (thin to win motto). Try this at home you'll see what I mean if you don't believe me. Tables are overcrowded since you get a lot of locals who live right across the street (you'll see all the developments) who play and eat there. The food was good, but the place is run down and has become a vaping smokehouse.

allReviews.title: Get to The Point!
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel. Top quality and clean. Staff was friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Everything from check in to leaving was pleasurable. With 11 restaurants, a bowling alley and multiple entertainment options, it’s a city in a city. No need for the strip when you can stay where everything is within one building.

allReviews.title: Good place for a business stay
allReviews.text: The rooms were great! We had a king size room. The room seemed bigger with just the one bed. It was extremely nice with wood flooring & not gross carpeting! Comfortable beds also. I was there on business so was in the convention center a lot of the time I was there. That space was good. We used all the space up there for different classes and events. The casino, I cannot believe Vegas allows smoking indoors. For me it was awful and I had a headache most of the time. I suffer from migraines & also had covid bad in 2021 so my lungs suffered also. The good thing about the casino was there are so many places to eat! And the Steak n Shake there was so much better than the one back home! I also liked the text to check out. All in all it is a good place to stay.

allReviews.title: SHH. A shout out to Vegas' South Point Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: For a Casino, Resort, Entertainment Center - with 11 resturants off the strip, I wasn't sure what to expect. However, the rooms are large, the staff is friendly, the meals in every resturant are affordable (find out about the 7 dollar steak deal) and they have something for everyone. Rodeos, Bowling Tournaments, Singing, Dancing, we had a blast. And I was there for business! My husband was with me during the stay and we want to return this fall. They are minutes away from everything else Vegas as to offer.

allReviews.title: Great stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: I'd come back here again!! The rooms were spacious and clean with a comfy bed. The service was impeccable and friendly!!! Awesome change of pace from the strip but conveniently located to get anywhere you wanted to go. The 11 options for restaurants satisfied any craving I had.

allReviews.title: Must Go
allReviews.text: My go to hotel casino.  Always clean and happening!!!  Best black Jack options and slots pay.  Must go if you have under 21 as there is large theatre and game area.  The pool is also huge and amazing. Lots of food options and reasonable prices.Stuff they’re always friendly and welcoming.

allReviews.title: I wish it were better.
allReviews.text: I stayed at the South Point hotel due to a work conference that was held there. While the rooms are spacious, the walls are thinner than a cheap apartment. I could hear my neighbor moving their chair and a ton of doors slamming at all hours of the night. Even with the comfortable bed, don't plan on a good night sleep. The casino does smell like smoke, although it isn't the worst one compared to the ones on the strip. The drinks at the bar are very reasonably priced, but if you plan on eating at any of the popular restaurants or getting ice cream during peak times, be prepared to wait in line. The staff was friendly and helpful- But you have to ask. I stayed for 8 days and the only time they came to bring new towels, bring toilet-paper, or empty the garbage was when I called and asked.

allReviews.title: Great place to play and stay.
allReviews.text: Very comfortable room. This is a locals casino and they offer great value. Check in staff was quick and friendly. Lots of places to eat from cheap to high end steakhouse. Lines for the buffet are long but evidently worth the wait. Lots of stuff to do.

allReviews.title: This place has plummeted downhill from what the great fun place it used to be
allReviews.text: We have stayed at South Point several times— used to be a decent mid-level hotel— but too many children screaming, running down halls, but never again after the last time of having NO sleep with a couple fighting all night and a baby crying  next (I’d cry too with parents like that.)  And something going on in the hallway (?)  it did not feel safe.  There is no one checking for room keys at the elevators so anyone could be in there!  We never booked a room there again— why take a risk when there are so many other places to stay.       But we usually do visit the casino frequently and have always had fun playing at South Point. Until this time.      After this last trip, we will not be back.  Hotel OR casino.  Ever.  (Even though we won!).     I won’t go into detail, but i will just say that the behavior of a casino dealer was just over the top too much. Disrespectful, OFFENSIVE, threatening, and unacceptable at any level.  Regardless of age, gender, or race.       I am sure it was not reported to anyone and would be overlooked by management.      What was once a must-visit casino stop is now a parking lot and stack of bricks to us.      Done.

allReviews.title: Stay here for your business travel needs and conventions
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel two years in a row for my companies international travel convention. I have yet to be disappointed. The food at the restaurants is high quality and there is a wide variety of foods to choose from: American, Asian, Mexican, Dessert, Oyster Bar, and several bars/lounges. I highly recommend finding the ice cream/smoothie shop and the little hot dog stand.The rooms are quite spacious and come with a bathroom that looks nice and was very clean. The beds are very comfortable in comparison to most hotels I have stayed in making it easy to fall asleep and get a good night's rest. I also ordered room service which was cooked and delivered in under 30 minutes and again was good quality. Since this hotel is off the strip, there was concern the first time I stayed here that taxis or Ubers would be a longer wait but it is only 15-18 minutes from the strip and an Uber/Lyft arrived within 5 mins consistently. The hotel is so large that their truly is so much to do. There is a spa, pool, bars, casino, restaurants, gift shop, and even the largest horse/equine arena in the United States.The bell desk as well as the airport shuttle both were efficient with friendly and accommodating staff. Check in and check out was very smooth and the staff I interacted with was personable and very welcoming. The only complaint I have is that housekeeping opened my door without knocking first and did not announce themselves walking into the room. However it is partially my fault because I did not have the Do Not Disturb sign on the outside of the door.In regards to the convention halls, they get very cold so be prepared for that. However besides that, everything was clean and well organized with the staff and they were all very friendly. During meals in the convention halls, staff were timely and provided excellent service.Overall an awesome experience and am happy to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Lackluster stay
allReviews.text: Stopped being customer friendly, they used to have shuttle service to the Vegas strip they Stopped that so now ro stay there you really need a car. Next year I don't know if I will stay there. Rooms were ok but if not for bowling rate would have been overpriced

allReviews.title: GET To THE POINT!
allReviews.text: Okay where do I start.. This place is just FUN!The second you step inside it’s Candy to your eyes and ears!!! You walk into the casino and the bars and the Starbucks and restaurants and music!  I like the demographic… you have the older crowd activities ( like bowling leagues and equestrian shows) but also the younger groups have stuff to do there as well. There’s the bowling alley and a huge movie theaters that stays open late. The pools are gorgeous and they have an amazing fully equipped gym right across from the spa center.  South point has Shake Shack and Starbucks on  premises, along with a really nice Buffet, diner and other restaurants right there.,  I’ve checked them out. There are restaurants Mcdonalds and Dennys, and Japanese restaurant across the street. The ice cream parlor and Krispy Kreme is also on the premisesThe only thing I would say that was negative duringmy stay is sometimes you get a slight smell of cigarettes from the vents in the room.  If you have a Smoker next door. Also, played around those slots in April and May and noticed that not only was I NOT winning.. Those machines take your money back SUPER FAST.Listen Southpoint, you gotta give a little to get a lot.I’m headed back for business next week, and will be staying at “the Point “again.. I’ll post  on my experience there in July.

allReviews.title: Yummy!!
allReviews.text: Great food, friendly service, nice atmosphere!! Pricing not too bad. Food was truly yummy. Prime rib and mashed potatoes were excellent!! Wide varity of foods. Choice of all cultures. Desserts to die for. The keylime cheesecake rounds..AMAZING!!

allReviews.title: Large and nice
allReviews.text: We stopped in South Point for a short while on our way to Mesquite.   It is a large, very clean casino.  It was morning, so it wasn't too crowded.  They have a big, very good sports book.  Next time, we will stay there and check out their rooms.

allReviews.title: Staff was friendly and helpful
allReviews.text: The Resort was clean and the staff was very friendly and helpful. We were there because I was bowling in a tournament and were pleased with our stay. We were happy with the restaurants to choose from on premises and were thrilled there is a Starbucks!

allReviews.title: We would stay her again .
allReviews.text: We have stayed here several times . Check in was easy, and free parking in large lots.  Close to airport, and has shuttle to the airport, but no shuttle to the Strip.   It is a larger motel/casino  so does take some time to find check-in desk, and then elevators to your room. Lots  of nice places to eat inside, along with movie theaters and bowling and casino games . 10 minutes to car rental and airport, easy and quick to drive yourself.  Excellent value for the price and room. There is a  small resort fee.

allReviews.title: Bowling tournament stay
allReviews.text: We stayed here because of the convenience for the bowling tournaments. They room is very spacious, clean, and comfortable.The buffet, cafe, and Steak ‘n Shake were all very good places to eat. Gaming was pretty decent before the weekend, slots were spotty on the weekend. Nice variety of slots and table games

allReviews.title: It is all about the staff
allReviews.text: I wanted to say THANK YOU to the hotel front desk staff ! My daughter is staying at the hotel for the PCCHA REYZIN THE CASH DERBY. She needed assistance with room rates and access to the barn area. The women at the front desk was super helpful and kind to her. In this environment today it is all about the people.

allReviews.title: Local favorite
allReviews.text: Overall experience was very good. Staff were very kind and attentive. Special mention to ladies working at club desk and at showroom. We came for Sheena Easton's performances at showroom. It was well worth of travelling 6000 miles from Finland too see such a world class talent, vocalist and pop legend like Ms. Easton. We felt well taken care of during our 8 night stay. Hotel is super clean and has very good security. I highly recommend if you want to stay away from the Strip.

allReviews.title: the best off strip Casino/Hotel ( also still with the Garden Buffet each day)
allReviews.text: The Hotel/Casino is of course on the Las Vegas Boulevard but don’t let the distance to the Strip fool you: it is 15-20 minutes by car but for is that is not a problem.Very nice hotel, good rooms , most of them with fridge , clean bathroom and reasonable pool area, nothing special.Casino with lot of buzz, always busy, wide variaty of slots , old and new. Foodies will be pleased with more than enough different restaurants AND still the Garden Buffet for breakfast, bruch and dinner .And don’t forget the Arena with lots of ( horse-) events, always free of charge.For is the Orleans hotel/casino was the best off strip stay fot the past 15 years but we switched to South Point this hear.

allReviews.title: Initial Encounter to Southpoint
allReviews.text: AMBIENCE:  Large crowds with several venues for everyone.   RESTAURANTS:  Large selection with acclaimed buffet.  Steak N Shake and 24 hour Starbucks as well.GAMING:  Plenty of slots, tables and video keno machines to choose from.ROOMS:  Nice, clean and well-appointed.   Keurig coffee makers, safe, and refrigerator in rooms.LOCATION:  South Strip, away from the madness.SERVICE:  Overall, friendly and accommodating staff.OVERALL:  BEST choice for location NOW.  Casino is tight and Payouts rare.  However, only my 2nd visit.  To be continued...

allReviews.title: Great rooms but slots are out dated
allReviews.text: If you like slots, this is NOT your casino.  The worst selection…. I even asked to see if I was missing something.  Nope.  And even though I didn’t like them, I still through my money at them…. Bad choice for day one.  But it’ll save me the next two nights, because I won’t be gambling unless I can grab a seat at Pai -gow.  1*I’ve dined at Michael’s-  expensive and top notch-  my group won’t spend that kind of money- so won’t be enjoying that. 5*Rooms are fabulous!  A little warm for me, although I dropped the temp, they must have it on auto as I woke up and room is hot again.  But one of the nicest rooms-  lots of room (I have a king single- normally I’ll get double queens just to have the extra room…not necessary). and a great bathroom!  5*Bell desk is adamant that they won’t drag our bowling balls up to the lanes-  if I’m willing to give them $20, they should be.  They’ll drag them to my rooms, so I see no difference- 3*Still here…. Maybe dinner will be wonderful…. But, I’d I’m not going ti Michael’s, I doubt it.

allReviews.title: Good Casino
allReviews.text: South Point is a good local casino.  They have an enormous amount of slot machines and a very good staff.  This was my first visit, so I signed up for a players card.  They have nothing for new players, which is rare.  Overall, this was a good experience.

allReviews.title: Business laced with fun.
allReviews.text: Hotel is like a city made of restaurants and entertainment. Plenty of room to roam. The room was beautiful and cleaned by housekeeping each day.  The convention I attended was in a vast area with several meeting rooms. Lunch was served on this floor as well. No complaints about the food and the service. One negative note, my view from the 7th floor was a brick wall.. Very disappointing. Also, I have a suggestion for management - Please look in the bathroom on the wall between the shower and the toilet; it is a perfect place to put a hook to hang the bath towel.

allReviews.title: You can’t beat south point casino.
allReviews.text: south point casino is really becoming my go to place. it gets better with every visit, I love the bowling alley, since I’m on a league. I enjoy the Cinemark movie theater. I go almost every Friday and I love don Vito’s. great Italian food. the slots are very fun. I only play a few selected games. the sports book is my place to watch football. yes it’s off the strip, but not far away. rent a car or shuttle. Strip buses are great also. south point casino is my place to have fun. You don’t really need to leave. great staff as well. young people come here as well. south point arena a big plus in my book,

allReviews.title: Security needs training to keep players playing instead of being 5'2 tough guys
allReviews.text: Vegas local from across the city. I like playing South point because I usually do pretty well there and if I lose I don't mind losing it to southpoint. Plus it was my birthday.  I play in the middle of the night when it's less crowded. Every once in a while I'll go out and lay in my truck get a power nap and come back and play again so I don't have to drive 40 minutes back across the city. Last night security treated me like a homeless thug as I took a little power nap in my truck. They beat on my windows with what sounded like a nightstick and started yelling at me like a little man, tough guy, power trip that I couldn't sleep there. All they had to do was ask what I was doing but they wanted to be wanna be cops. I didn't argue with them, started up my truck and drove home. I will never Gamble at southpoint ever again nor will I ever spend my money on the movies or building or a show which I frequently do. I am a grain of sand to them put a grain has a dollar sign to it that they have lost mine.

allReviews.title: Business trip
allReviews.text: The hotel is affordable and nice. Lots of good food options and very clean. While I was there several conventions and events were taking place including the National Bowling Association and the Nevada High School Rodeo Finals. I never felt crowded and with the variety of restaurants lines but no long waits

allReviews.title: Comfortable, quiet room.
allReviews.text: Nice place to stay. Comfortable, quiet rooms for a good price.Excellent food in the cafe for a good price. Free parking garage or valet parking if you want it. We have stayed here a few time and enjoyed it every time.

allReviews.title: Out of the way but  convenient this trip.
allReviews.text: Good news is that Don Vito’s was excellent. Good, service and price. The Oyster bar was also very good in both price and service. The only complaint here is pass on the crab cakes. Too much filler. Get the crab cocktail instead. Room service was much too expensive. Going to the Cafe, open 24 hrs was inexpensive and all around wonderful.Our Jr suite was large and fairly priced. It got that way by furnishing the cheapest toilet paper money can buy and annoyingly no water in the room. You had to buy bottles even with this suite. The super duper shave and haircut was  a big disappointment. Besides nothing special it was impossible to get the guy to shut up about all his fabulous reviews etc. Not warranted in my opinion for $90.00 not counting tip. Overall, everyone was friendly throughout. Finally, make sure you make reservations, even during the week. I didn’t think I’d have too and didn’t. Consequently, we didn’t try the other restaurants.

allReviews.title: Decent hotel off strip
allReviews.text: This hotel was good for the price point. Off the strip (about 20 minute drive to the Strip). Valet was amazing. Free (besides rip, obviously). Rooms were decent but still some cleanliness issues (hair in shower). Restaurants close early which is a bummer. The one 24 hour was very limited because they moved locations to another restaurant at a certain time. Chose this hotel for its pool yet the pool was closed due to windy weather. The next day, they re-opened it but instead of the sunny side, it was just the shady side. Pool isn’t heated so that made zero sense.

allReviews.title: Wonderful anniversary trip
allReviews.text: Went for anniversary trip. Thoroughly enjoyed our three days there, room was comfortable to be in as well as the beds, slept good. Played slots and table games, I didn't  win much but spouse was consistently winning and kept us in the money. Ate at a variety of restaurants, they were all good, no complaints. The Primarily Prime Rib was the winner of all of them we tried, fantastic dinner and service. There is an abundance of things to do at this casino, stayed busy and entertained the whole time. Would recommend to anyone. Looking forward to going back in July for big bingo tournament.

allReviews.title: Overall a pretty decent stay
allReviews.text: The hotel rooms are adequate and pretty nice for the cost really. The beds are super comfy as are the pillows. The room is very clean and the hotel offer nice shampoo/conditioner/soaps foe the room.there is a safe as well. Now for the cons. The hotel was repairing 2 of the 6 elevators wh8ch you would think would be an issue but it really was .it took more than 20 min to get up or down. Additionally the didn't staff appropriately for Easter weekend so half of the pool was closed as well.after speaking with the management they basically said sorry stuff happens. No offers of any compensation were given . Lastly the restaurants we went to (buffet) was pretty decent as well. No complaints for the food.the hotel gift shop had a great selection. As well. Overall I would recommend but the small inconveniences bugs a little.noy enough to not stay again or give a good review .

allReviews.title: Good value but not a 4 star experience
allReviews.text: The best way to describe this hotel is that it is a good value, and it is ideal if you are looking for a place south of the main strip in order to visit Joshua Tree or the Grand Canyon the next day.  There were many things we liked such as the ample free parking and larger rooms that were decently appointed.  However, in typical Vegas fashion, you must cross through the casino (where smoking, vaping, etc is allowed) to get to the elevators. This is but the most pleasant thing for those who don't smoke or have kids, but I know there are many that do this.Yet, my biggest complaint would be that this is about as far from a 4 star experience as I have had at a hotel. While I have since learned that 4 star and 5 star ratings are more about the amenities and size of a hotel in Vegas, the lack of service was remarkable. While nothing was unpleasant, we had a marginally engaged reception worker and then just a vague point towards the escalators as my travel wearied family drug our bags through the smoky and outdated casino area. Nothing about it said...I am glad you are here.Yet, I must admit as I started, that it is still a good value based upon the price. I might stay here again for one night, but I would not stay much longer.

allReviews.title: Missing amenities!
allReviews.text: Beauty property. Rooms are spacious. Pool advertised as heated. The pool is not heated. No microwave or laundry facilities for guests to do their own laundry. Several restaurants to choose from. Slots are very tight though advertised as "loose".

allReviews.title: One of My Best Casino Stays
allReviews.text: I loved my spacious room. The view was spectacular. The room temperature was easy to regulate. Having a large number of dinning choices decreased my concerns, related to my food allergies.  The variety of gaming option made for a totally fun experience. I loved their BINGO. there was excellent all-around services and courteous staff.

allReviews.title: Great property!
allReviews.text: Excellent stay! This was our 2nd stay at South Point. The first time was because our flight was cancelled, and our airline put us up for a few days. Our 2nd stay was even better! Our room was immaculate. I have never stayed in such a clean room! This was our 13th trip to Vegas and we travel all over the U.S.  so I know what I am talking about. They have 11 restaurants on site, a bowling alley, movie theatre, and bingo! You don't have to leave the property at all, there is plenty to keep you busy. All of the staff we encountered were awesome. I really appreciate all of the security on the casino floor. I felt very safe late at night gambling after my husband went to bed. Their sportsbook is great, very comfortable chairs. They have a great deli and a Starbucks near the sportsbook for quick snacks and drinks. We plan to come back soon. We are gold with MGM and get comped rooms, but we loved this property so much, we will come back and pay for our rooms.

allReviews.title: Huge hotel lots to do
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel and so much to do that you don’t really need to leave. So many restaurants, reasonable prices on everything. Only downside is the walls are thing and we spent a couple nights listening to the neighbor next store coughing and blowing his nose. I do wish they did have more gift shops besides the one. But, other than that I would stay back here again. Oh and for all the coke drinks steak and shake has it which is a huge blessing in Pepsi town

allReviews.title: Good gambling and food options.
allReviews.text: Lots of gambling and several restaurants in different price ranges. Asian, burgers, buffet, cafe etc. Helpful staff too! Very clean and well maintained facility. Steak n Shake has tasty burgers at reasonable prices. The Garden buffet was really good too with a large selection of different foods and free mimosas at lunch!

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: Attended the special bingo event and stayed 3/12 - 3/15/2023.  Have always enjoyed the casino and really like the multiple options of things to do.  Unfortunately, there were many areas that could use improvement.  Never saw anyone clean/wipe down machines.  Hand sanitizer dispensers were empty or not functioning in many places.  The bathrooms were not as clean as they have been in the past with numerous bathrooms smelling like weed.  I know that gambling is at your own risk, but this casino always seems to have very tight machines and this stay was no different.  Can count on one hand how many times I got into a bonus or needed to use a machine to cash out a ticket.  The bingo event was held in the exhibition halls.  The employees selling were wonderful and very patient. The bathrooms were filthy.  The smoking directly outside the doors was horrible!  There is a sign that says no smoking, but apparently that was only on the other side of the sign placement closer to the arena. It makes no sense.  It was ridiculous and annoying.  There needs to be a better exit strategy for after the sessions are over.  Is there only one elevator available for people to use?  Is there another stairwell or escalator that people can use? If there is, can there be better signage and instructions on where to access these?  The situation with the elevators to get back to our hotel room was absolutely ridiculous. The long lines and security personnel just yelling at everybody seemed a little over the top. It was extremely busy during our stay, but that is to be expected with big events going on.

allReviews.title: Local treasure
allReviews.text: I have started staying at this hotel due to a group who has a residency on site.  Have to say when priced right, this hotel is a gem.  Complimentary airport shuttle if needed, large and very comfortable rooms. Amenities including multiple restaurants that won't break the bank. Affordable gift shop for water etc.  Movie theater is great too.  Love the Keurigs in the room and having a mini refrigerator.  Room service at this hotel is still as room service is to be.  Most on the strip have it only packaged to go.   24 hour Cafe.  Some cafes in other hotels only open till 3:00 pm.  Staff is so friendly and welcoming.  Very popular hotel when Nascar, Rodeo, or Bingo come to town. Sells out often. Rates can go up .   Highly recommend this hotel.  For me, when I stay to see my favorite group, I have to stay put.  Ride share to/from the strip can get too costly for me and I am solo and don't have a car when on property.  But between the movie theater, bowling alley, etc there is plenty to do - or even just relaxing in the room.  Thank  you South Point.  My next visit might be June. Contemplating.  Might be spending a milestone birthday time frame with you.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: We had a suite on the 25th floor. It was fantastic view and was a huge room with a small kitchen and huge bedroom a big bathroom with a very large shower. The king size bed was very comfortable. The room was very clean and the hotel staff very nice.

allReviews.title: This place is awesome!!!!!
allReviews.text: We are locals and this is the BEST hotel and resort off the strip yet 5 min from all the glamor of Vegas!!The owner Mr. G is all about pricing and the old school affect!! Keep it inexpensive throughout the resort and they will come back!! The hotel has EVERYTHING  a couple to a family would want!!We just left the PBR/Tuff hedeman rodeo in their beautiful equestrian arena and wow!!, food unbelievable price! Drinks unbelievable price!
