What we paid for all food and drink there, would have been 1 beer at a strip arena and concert!!!Compd drinks thru out the bars on video poker!, restaurants top notch and high quality!! This is the ONLY RESORT that hasn't gotten greedy!!!Great job Southpoint!! U r a locals and visitors gem!! Please don't ever change!!!!

allReviews.title: Fantastic Stay
allReviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for 3 nights. The rooms are big and the amenities are really fun - bowling lanes are a great feature! We also played a few slot games and the coupon booklet helped us make our dinner choices more easily. It is a bit further from the strip, so we ultimately decided to get a rental car, but it was nice coming back to a quieter casino after long days on the strip.

allReviews.title: Great Las Vegas Stay
allReviews.text: We usually stay on the strip when visiting, however due to the timing of our trip we were in Vegas just before Superbowl. The rates at strip hotels were in my opinion unreasonable. We opted to stay at Southpoint. We had stayed cursed befire and enjoyed our stay. The rates are more than reasonable. Free parking. I use their Vaket parking and don’t mind tipping for the service. Bell luggage service the same way. Room was beautiful. You have a choice of 11 different dining options, as well as a multiplex theater and bowling alley. If you are into gambling they have slots and table games. It’s off the Strip, so if you are going downtown, you drive yiur car, cab or Uber . I’m 75 and find the ease of driving to Southpoint easier.I stayed Two days for less than one night at Ceasers.

allReviews.title: Disappointing!
allReviews.text: This was my first visit to South Point after many visits staying in various other Las Vegas hotels. The room was nicely appointed with two queen beds, a desk, table and two chairs, armchair with foot stool and side table.  Bathroom was divided with shower and toilet separated by a door from the vanity.  If my rating was based on the room alone, it would be much higher. However, the housekeeping was very hit and miss.  On check-in we were asked whether we wanted daily housekeeping and we confirmed that we did. In our 8 night stay we had housekeeping only 3 days.I found the quality of the food in most restaurants and the buffet to be very poor, with some exceptions. Fresh seafood from Big Sur Oyster Bar and Italian dishes from Don Vito's were excellent.  I was surprised to see that there was no security at the entrance to the hotel elevators and that anyone could access these and reach the the guest rooms.I would not recommend this hotel and will not return.

allReviews.title: Happy to return after many years
allReviews.text: Great large room with two queen beds. Large bathroom with vanity separated from toilet and bath with a door. Working table + table with 2 chairs. Comfortable armchair. Complete commodities including Keurig Coffee Maker. Safety deposit box and a telephone in bathroom. Much storage capacity.

allReviews.title: Nice one night stay
allReviews.text: Large hotel at the southern end of Las Vegas Blvd with all the amenities including a movie theater. Nicely appointed room at a reasonable price - less than $100.Multiple restaurants and bars. A buffet. Less traffic. 10 mins by Uber to the center of the strip.

allReviews.title: Casino slot machine problem
allReviews.text: When I was playing on slot machine 6550 the machine got disabled. At the point of time I bet maximun snd lost $800. The machine got disabled and and ask me to cash out. I called the manager slot machine to explain why the machine stopped all of a sudden and did not come back to operation. Once I I cashed out the balance. The machine came back to opertational. This is the first time I had in my life time  such experience in casino slot machine. This is a mystery to kickoff the player in between when you you are playing and lost heavily on the machine. The manager could not explain the reason why the machine stopped instead  he called the security. This is very bad part of casino management of South point casino Las Vegas. They insult the customers.  All customers please be cautious while playing high/max  bet in South point casino.They have the control to kick you out of playing slot machine when you loose more on any machine. In casino world this may be new scam. Please be careful and ask management to give proper solution when you come across such situations

allReviews.title: Best Overall Value in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I've visited South Point many times to gamble, but this was my first stay at the property.South Point is located at 9777 S. Las Vegas Blvd, which is a little over six miles south of Mandalay Bay.  It is owned by Michael Gaughan who runs the place like casinos in Las Vegas used to be run:  Good gambling, cheap food with large portions, very reasonalbly priced hotel rooms and very clean.My room was on an upper floor and faced south.  I had a view of the M Resort and I-15.  The rooms have no carpeting, just hard floors which probably is easier to clean.  The room is very large and spotless.  No problems with the A/C, shower, sink or toilet.  Extremely quiet.  Beds were very comfortable and I got a great nights sleep every evening.   In addition I received a funbook that gave me multiple free drinks.The gambling is exceptional, one of the very best, if not the best in Las Vegas.  Video Poker reigns supreme at South Point.  Literally hundreds of machines that pay back up 99.8%.  Most casinos don't have video poker this good and if they do, they limit cash back and comps at the best games.  Not at South Point.  Easy to earn enough points for buffets.  Half point days on Mondays at all dining places.  Hot Dog cart serving $1.50 dogs during the day.  The biggest bowling alley I have ever seen and another bowling alley that is used for professional tournaments.  Also has a movie theater.Excellent bar top video poker and the best bar service I have had anywhere.  Just sit down and the bartender is there immediately.  Most bars will make you play a while to get a comped beer, but South Point gave it to me immediately.  I spent a lot of time playing VP at the bar.       Sports book is open 24/7 and doesn't have the "pay for the seat" nonsense found at Strip casinos.  Excellent deli near the Sports Book.  Buffet is the best value buffet in Las Vegas.  I'm sure it loses money, but it's a loss leader that brings in customers.   I also ate at Primarily Prime Rib, which is exceptional.   South Point is run the way most casinos were operated 20 years ago.  Actually gives a fair gamble.  The casino is very busy because of the good gaming odds.  I ran into casino workers from Wynn and Venetian who go to South Point after their shifts.   Amazing seeing the crowds there and the ghost towns of Sam's Town Sunset Station which have eliminated cheap food and drinks and tightened gambling odds.  I have been going to Las Vegas over 30 years (39 trips total),  and this is the best-run operation in town.  Since I always rent a car, I've been to every Strip, downtown and locals casino.   This is unquestionably the best overall experience I have ever had.  Michael Gaughan is old school and he knows how to get customers in the door.   South Point will be my home casino from this point forward.

allReviews.title: vegas has changed
allReviews.text: we arrived about 1:00 pm. went to check in line. was told check in is at 2:00 but for 20.00 we could check in early. already NOT feeling like a "GUEST" so they did not get the 20.00, I had to wait in line twice. they just dont care......... the resort fee is a scam, ohhhh but you get internet !!!! which is free for anyone on property. Vegas will now try and pry every cent from anyone they can. I dont see any need to come back to vegas cause its not the same. vegas used to want to make you feel welcome...... those days are past

allReviews.title: DO NOT GO HERE
allReviews.text: These people have no regard for the livestock they PROMOTE and keep outside in excruciating heat. When we were there, there was one small water bowl for probably 50 cows. Absolutely no shade either. Smallest pens ever. Have some empathy and respect for the animals you parade around and force to be shown. Disgusting.

allReviews.title: Mixed Bag but Overall Good Value
allReviews.text: We stayed for a horse show in the summer in Las Vegas so mainly stayed within the resort for six days.  The room was spacious and very clean,  bed comfy and view amazing so a great value for the price.  If you are not a smoker and come for another reason than gambling it’s def a mixed bag as its smoky from early morning on and the restaurants on site although the food is good,  get very crowded especially at mealtimes which can mean long lines and waits.  The Japanese restaurant Zenshen was very good as was Don Vitos and Primarily Prime.  Breakfast is the worse time to try to eat as there is one place offering a full breakfast and Starbucks in the very large crowded hotel.  We ordered room service a few days which was over an hour but better to be in the comfort of our room than smoky wait adjacent to the casino in line. The staff was super nice and especially the cleaning team.  Our room was refreshed everyday.  All in all fun for a long weekend but with some caveats to non smoking non gambling folks.  The horse arena is wonderful with bars and snacks all around and comfy seats (as much as possible).

allReviews.title: Do NOT stay here
allReviews.text: This place is disgusting. There are dozens of better hotels available for better prices on the Strip, so do NOT book here if you want to enjoy Las Vegas. There are few dining options, parking is a mess, the pool is boring, our window opens to a view of... a wall. If you want to enjoy shows or nightlife, you have to drive 10ish miles to the Strip. It's better than Motel 6, but Motel 6 is at a much better location, soooo... Just don't bother with this place.

allReviews.title: 3 nights 7/31-8/3
allReviews.text: 5th stay here after staying at many strip properties over 25 years. The restaurants are outstanding ( Coranado Cafe) for the money and the staff is top notch. Won’t stay anywhere else but here and looking forward to our next visit.

allReviews.title: Great value but surly staff.
allReviews.text: Last minute get away. Airport shuttle makes convenient if you just want a quick trip.  Great value for food and drinks. Average buffet. Other restaurants, all good. Good gambling and busy casino. Average pool with good food and drink prices.A very notable negative, which cost 1 star for the eating.......among the non-friendliest staff I have ever seen in a casino/resort setting.  I dont need coddling, but this compliment of staff, very bad.

allReviews.title: Back from a Great Casino Collectables Convention at the Sound Point
allReviews.text: June 2022 attended and decided to stay this year at the South Point during the Casino Collectables Association Show at the Property.  The rooms were very nice and spotless. The Restaurants were all very good and enjoyed the shows in the evening. Looking forward to a return trip next year !!

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here if room type is important to you.
allReviews.text: Checked in around 2 pm. Made reservations almost two months ago for 2 queen beds. When we checked in, the lady said we had a king. We let her know we booked way in advance and needed two queens as there were three of us. She said the best she could offer was a rollaway for $30 per night-  and we were staying 3 nights.Their hotel policy is bed types are NEVER guaranteed, per the clerk that checked us in. No waiving of fees for the rollaway. The rooms have no couches and hardwood floors. No options for three or four people, except more money. And they were sold out. She proceeded to tell us that it was our fault for booking during multiple events. I understand we’re just one family, but we’ve been coming here for years and never had this type of problem. I’m not sure if she was prejudice or she just didn’t like us. Another bowling mate next to us checking in with another rep was told we were all on same floor with pool view. We got the same floor alright, but a view of the roof and some type of trash or something. To top it off, more bowling’s mates of our (both Caucasian) checked in 2 1/2 hours after us. They too were given a king room upon checkin; however miraculously for them, their room was switched over to two queens with a pool view, same floor. I wouldn’t recommend this hotel if room type is important to you.  There are too many options to choose from. And their management not taking care of the issue, even comping a rollaway, putting us on a different floor, something… and again, doing it for others hours later was a slap in the face. Very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Family Reunion with 200 Guests
allReviews.text: I can’t say enough about this hotel not only did they have bowling and movies but we had a huge group of us playing in the High Limit Slots and the crew was cheering for us to win. Then we went to the tables and again the crew was so welcoming and excited to see us win. We always felt safe here and never had any problems finding our way around. Restaurants were excellent and so helpful and accommodating trying to keep us all together. I would stay here any day. Such a relaxing vacation. Blessings to all who work here.

allReviews.title: "Amazing"!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: Everything was awesome from the room to the food!!!  Went there to see the Righteous  Bros Show which was amazing to see. Last time we seen them was in 1995 at the MGM Grand.  The food was amazing as well.  The shopping and casino was great.  Would stay here every time we are in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great for families
allReviews.text: Stayed off strip to be closer to family and I don’t think we’ll ever stay on strip again. The rooms are spacious and clean, the hotel has a ton of things to do for adults and kids, and we don’t need to leave the property for anything. We had the bowling alley, arcade and equestrian center for the kids, and adults of course get everything else lol. Also loved that it doesn’t cost anything to park or valet (but of course tip). The pool is also very family friendly and if you don’t want to be around kids, the hot tub area is 16+ only.

allReviews.title: Unexpected fun!
allReviews.text: The airline sadly cancelled our flight until the next morning and gave us all  room at this hotel. We were pleasantly surprised at what a nice stay we had. The room wasn’t fancy, but still a step up from a typical Holiday Inn or Comfort Suites. We didn’t hear a peep from anyone in other rooms or the hallways. Coffee maker in the room was a plus. There were plenty of open, inexpensive restaurants with great service. Staff was friendly. Every person we encountered seemed to be friendly and genuinely having a good time. What we enjoyed most was the casino. They had several Ultimate Texas Hold’em tables with a table minimum of only $5. If you have ever played this game, you know to play each hand, you need to bet at least 3 times the table minimum. So for $15 a hand that isn’t bad considering most tables on the strip were $25- some even $50-meaning just to play a hand you had to risk at least $75. We ended doing well and played a long time. I enjoy staying at the upscale hotels on the strip but next time we will definitely consider a stay here, and if we don’t stay we will most certainly come here to gamble.

allReviews.title: Big Beautiful Clean Room !
allReviews.text: I arrived from the free airport shuttle around 11:30 a.m. and they immediately checked all of us in and I was in the room before noon. (glad I did not have to wait til 3:00 check in time). The room was huge! I loved how clean and spacious it was! The elevators were non stop people but the elevators moved quickly. It was a very busy Easter weekend but I just avoided the huge Buffet line and my friend and I visted most of the other restaurants. The only complaint I had was the smokey casino. It was better when I went later that night and when I visited the casino early in the morning. Just a better ventilation system would be great! I would return! I enjoyed being at the hotel.

allReviews.title: Big Sur Oyster Bar
allReviews.text: Did a trip to Vegas over the Easter weekend. We had an early flight in before hotel check-in time so decided to get something to eat. All restaurants and buffets had long lines due to Easter but Big Sur had open seating at the counter. The service was amazing and friendly and the cooks engaged with you while preparing meals. We had the Clam chowder which was great followed by the Lobster Roll and Clams with Linguine. All the food was delicious and well prepared and tasty! Thank you

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: Th cocktail service is the worst. I simply just wanted some water.  I had to leave my game and walk to the bar to get my own drink.  Thankfully there was a casino porter to watch my game. When spending good money now days the service should be GREAT. This was NOT my experience. Find another casino for your buck.

allReviews.title: Not Las Vegas Glitz, BUT…….
allReviews.text: Let me start by saying that I was here for a conference. My wife and I have been to Vegas a few times before over the last twenty years, and we love visiting this wonderful city.I felt it would be good to write this review for those who have visited Vegas and those who have not. So here I go!I’ve stayed at the Hilton for business and the Venetian and Caesars Palace for vacation. So if you’re coming to the South Point Resort, understand immediately that this is not Las Vegas. It’s not the glitz and glamour that you’ll find at Caesars, the Bellagio, the Venetian, Cosmopolitan and Aria. Those places have the “Wow” factor. Not at South Point. Those places have the well-known four and five-star restaurants coupled with a celebrity factor. Definitely not at South Point. The glitzy Strip Hotels have incredible  artwork and beautiful lighting. Not here. The Strip hotels have beautifully designed rooms with spacious bathrooms that have a separate shower and separate jetted-tubs. Not at South Point. Finally, South Point Resort is 7 miles from the Strip. It doesn’t take long to get to the Strip from here, but be advised it will cost you $40-$50 dollars via taxi (tip included). Also, other than South Point, there’s it much else out here. Your room may have a nice view of the nearby mountains, or it may be like mine: a view of the backside and the roof of the Casino. I mentioned BUT……this is what I mean: I don’t think South Point  is trying to be any of the previously mentioned glamorous Strip hotels. South Point is affordable. It’s clean. The customer service is excellent throughout. The restaurants are affordable. They are not 4-star to 5-star places, but the food is good and in large portions. There are numerous amenities. A very large and attractive pool. A large, well-maintained workout center that has 24/7 access. A large casino area that includes a large poker room and sportsbook area. Easy automotive access in and out and straight onto the Expressway leading into Las Vegas and the Strip. Large hotel rooms that are more than adequate. Standard bathrooms that are beyond adequate.Quick cons: the doors to the hotel rooms are thick and heavy. That’s ok, but they automatically close and when they do it’s very loud and can be felt in nearby rooms. Honestly, I’ve never experienced this kind of noise and vibration at the many hotels I’ve stayed. It’s quite shocking and will wake you up while sleeping. Next, the Casino allows smoking, but it would be good if this Resort could figure to circulate the air better. Last, the colors are dark. Everywhere.Pro: awesome attention to cleanliness. The sanitary conditions of the public restrooms are on the level of what you see at Disneyworld and the Bucces stores in Texas. Their ballrooms and meeting rooms are as good and in some comparisons better than other facilities nationwide. Very spacious, accommodating, and clean. An excellent facility for large conferences.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable as usual
allReviews.text: I just returned home from Las Vegas which i stayed at the South Point Hotel* Casino*Spa,and it was a great time as usual.South Point never has a dull moment,from all the machines,tables of all sort,restaurants,and great rooms so if you want nonstop fun action then the South Point is for you,...spend time there,you won't want to leave

allReviews.title: Would not stay here again
allReviews.text: There is always a line to access the elevators to your room, well less of a line a more like a crowd of people waiting to get on the elevator. There were also no extra blankets in the room, we had to call and wait for them to be brought up, I assume they are short staffed, and I felt bad for even asking.The walls are also thin, we could hear a phone alarm going off at 5:45am. We decided we were awake now and I went make the coffee, using the machine in the room the coffee was sour, the machine was dirty. The front desk offered to bring up a clean one, but based upon how long it took us to get the blanket, I declined and went downstairs to Starbucks.  This place is not for me, I don't like waiting to get to my room, when I want to rest or shower or whatever. I don't like a dirty coffee machine, as one wonders what about the rest of the cleanliness of the room?

allReviews.title: My go to Vegas Casino Hotel!
allReviews.text: We stay here in January every year.  We stay for good hotel most of the time.  However we have learned to love eating here also.  The steak, italian, prime rib, mexican, cafe and buffet are provide really good value for Vegas.  Suggest making reservations since there are a lot of conventions and events that fill places up.  I like how the resort fee is lower than most, parking is free and its fun to have some much to do on a whim.  My hot tip is to be sure to check out the coupon book the join the players club.  In early 2022 the coupon book had a lot of free drinks in different places.  Be sure to join the players club for a discount at the Garden Buffet.

allReviews.title: First Stay at this hotel
allReviews.text: Very nice facility. Bell Desk service was excellent. Front desk was ok. Room was not completely cleaned before we checked in and not cleaned at all while we were there. The toilet would not flush on our first day, but maintenance was thee to fix it in less than 15 minutes. The clam chowder is wonderful at the oyster bar. Overall, it was a good two-night stay. It is a bit off the strip but not too far if you want to visit the strip and it has all the amenities there that you will need. Loved the riding carts to help you get around and the rooms are large enough to park at least two and not stumble around. The k-cups were decaf.

allReviews.title: SouthPoint is On Point!
allReviews.text: My gal pal and I recently stayed at SouthPoint which is an awarded locals property located on the far south end of Las Vegas Boulevard (The Strip). We had a brief stay at SP in the past, but this was our longest stay - 4 nights. Are you looking for a low-key casino vibe with a property that has it all? If so, then SouthPoint is definitely it! Upon check-in each registered room guest receives a FunBook which is great for dining deals. In the hotel we have had both the City/Mountain and pool room view, I would suggest the pool view. We were located on the 11th floor, and the elevators were quick and smooth. The hotel rooms are well appointed, extremely clean and well maintained. Also, in the room is a mini refrigerator, safe, ironing board, iron, hair dryer, and a Keurig machine with complimentary k-cups.  For breakfast we ate at the Garden Buffet for $5.39 w/tax each with a player's card and the 50% off coupon from the funbook. Online reviews tend to be largely negative, often not stating any positives. Our visit to the Garden Buffet was on point, full spread breakfast options-bacon, sausage, hash, fruit, etc., an omelet station, and bottomless bloody mary's (which were just vodka and tomato juice, but hey, you can't beat the price!).The food options at SP are another on point feature of the property. The 24-hour Coronado Cafe has everything with an exceptional Chinese food menu and a Late Nite Specials menu from Midnight to 6 a.m. Craving Mexican food? Baja Miguels has it going on, however, it's only open Wednesday-Sunday. While at Baja Miguels, be sure to check out the Lunch Specials menu from 11 a.m. - 3:30 p.m., my friend and I each had an entree and margarita on the rocks for $10.78 w/tax each. We were craving crab legs and sadly due to the high market price of crab legs the Big Sur Oyster Bar was not serving the advertised crab leg special. A sign indicating such would have been appreciated at the host stand, but we had a lovely dinner nonetheless. We often parked ourselves at the many bars and played lots of bar top Keno. SP has numerous bars, with plenty of seating. And the cocktail service was on point! Our favorite was the 24/7 hour bar-Catalina Island Bar, and the 400 Bar which opens at 4 p.m. The casino vibe is that mostly of the 30+ age demographic and are respectful and courteous to all. Some hoots and hollers were heard on the casino floor which always add to the Vegas casino experience. There were a large number of Keno and Video Poker machines and the slots range from the old school 5-liners, to several of the hot new slots including Rakin' Bacon, Miss Kitty Wild Ride, Wonka Dreamers of Dreams, and Madonna. Also, the comps are easily accessible for those willing to reach out to a Casino Host at SP.During our visit in late November/early December there were sunny skies and temperatures in the low 70's, so we soaked in the resort's hot tub, which is spacious and private. It was nice to walk down to the pool area in my complimentary slippers provided in each room. The pool area was open 10 a.m. - 6 p.m., and we largely had the area to ourselves during the off season. Other great features at SP are the Bingo Hall, Bowling Alley, and kids Arcade located upstairs. Need to stretch your legs? Be sure to go outside of SP and walk the perimeter of the property. Given its location in a desired residential area you can feel safe and not be hassled by street beggars or tourist sales pitches. Also, there is a gas station just across the street as well as a McDonald's and Denny's if that strikes your fancy.SouthPoint definitely caters to a more mature clientele, however the resort, customer service, and locals casino odds are worth making the trip in my opinion. I love SP, and found my new favorite casino and look forward to returning again in February and discovering more of the property.

allReviews.title: first time staying off the strip
allReviews.text: We stayed in one of the suites. Tons of amenities! our room was like a small apartment. We had fridge, plates, and a dishwasher. The room had two rooms --one the bedroom with a large tub and a big living room. bathroom was huge --big walk in shower. the property is big so it was a little hard to find the pool. I would stay again

allReviews.title: One night stay but was ok
allReviews.text: Even though it was only one night stay, I really like this place.  It was away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas but yet still close.  The room I have was spacious and I like the wood floor than the carpet; which eliminate odor like smoke from the casinos.  They have so much to choose from to dine in.  Bell service was outstanding helping me with my luggage.

allReviews.title: This Resort Has Everything!
allReviews.text: First trip to Vegas since pandemic started.  Was pleased to see that all amenities were open at the South Point.  Room was great, food was good, and always found a place at the blackjack table.  The shuttle to and from the airport was on time.  Staff very friendly.  Will be going back in the future.

allReviews.title: Relaxing week in Vegas
allReviews.text: We visited for my hubby's birthday  we wanted to be off the busy strip and enjoyed the casino and restaurants we also had a great time in the jaccuzzi and pool. Housekeeping came everyday while we were out and the facility maintained good covid protocols. The week we were there was also a rodeo competition and we met great people during our stay. we took an uber to the strip for about 20 bucks but were happy to be back at the hotel since the strip was extremely busy even on a weekday...good all around and we will be back. the 24 hour starbucks was a dream come true

allReviews.title: Great Resort with friendly associates
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights.  It has everything you need!  The casino is huge and even pays off at times.  The dealers, hosts, and every employee we came in contact with was very friendly.  The restaurants were good.  We ate at the Steakhouse, and a bit loud on this night, but the steaks were cooked to perfection.  The Deli serves good snacks, and the seafood place was very good.   Buffet and coffee shop were good.There is free parking.  The Sportsbook is huge, has good odds, and many TV's to watch the games.  Rooms were very clean, beds were comfortable.  The free shuttle service runs on time to and from the airport.    The VIP host we use, Pam Wisdom, treats us well and is a pleasure to work with.  She is an asset to this organization.  Had a great trip, great resort, and will return again.

allReviews.title: Loved South Point
allReviews.text: Stayed for 6 nights. Room was large and clean! Our beds were comfortable and room quite. No issues. Housekeeping came only when requested which was fine with us. If we needed towels, garbage removed, etc we called the front desk and someone came right away.We had a view of pool and mountain landscape from the 19th floor.We enjoyed all the various restaurants, pool area, and the bowling alley! Having a 24 hour Starbucks was a plus!! You never have to leave! They have everything! If you forgot something it is most likely in the shop on the first floor.We took a quick 10 minute taxi ride to the strip.Hope to return in the future!

allReviews.title: Horrible service
allReviews.text: I arrived to the hotel for the first time ever, after booking through a third party website. I arrived to the hotel room and was given a room with no view....I'm literally looking at a back alley and a wall. I called to the front desk and was told that they are completely booked and we arrived early. They also said that's what I chose on the site, I clearly chose mountain view. I called back and Shelly the manager was very short with me and said like I said we are sold out, call back tomorrow. There may be availabilities.  I think her this is mu birthday weekend and I'm completely dissatisfied.  I will Never stay here again.

allReviews.title: USBC Bowling Championship Tournament Family Trip
allReviews.text: Stayed for USBC bowling tournament as South Point was the host facility. The amenities were fantastic, from the movie theatres to the restaurants. The pool and spa are the best in Las Vegas. All staff were friendly. When calling front desk to get any item, such as extra towels or coffee for the room, someone came immediately up to our room every time. Outstanding restaurants! Our favorite: The Del Mar Deli in the Casino Food Court  is like nothing in the entire Dallas, TX area we live in. It's like a New York authentic kosher deli, with homemade soups, even matzo ball soup! They have giant meaty sandwiches, and many unbelievable homemade desserts. Fresh baked bread, awesome sides like potato salad are all made fresh. The portions are huge! We couldn't eat it all and took food to the room each time! Amazing value! We look forward to Del Mar Deli and all the other great eating places at South Point every time we visit! Finally, the slots were loose and we won good money! $$$$

allReviews.title: South Point stay 9-19 to 9-22
allReviews.text: Arrived for my stay with my wife have stayed here several times without any problems. When checking in had a very rude clerk while checking in I asked for my 10% discount with my AARP or AAA she told me could not receive this discount because my discount was the coupon book. Will never stay here again. Stay was 9-19 thru 9–22

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: I haven't been to Vegas in about 5 years, due to the shooting and covid.  So it was time to come back.  Stayed 9/20-9/24.  I need to get out and see other people again.  Vegas was cowded.  I guess everyone has the same idea. I stayed here several years ago.  Decided to come back again I liked it then and they don't  charge for parking. Not happy with resort fee.  It was a good stay Liked the room. No carpet, more hotels should follow this.  Clean comfortable. Like the bed, pillows Two big ones and a small one.  Like the two chairs. They were comfortable.  The bathroom vanity was large. Toilet and shower in a seperate room.  Only problem with shower is pressure isn't good.  Like being sprinkled with fairy dust. The tub does not drain well.  I oped out for maid service.  I lke not having someone in my room.  I don't make a big mess so no maid service is not a problem.  Hotel is making up for lost time on food and other services.  Prices higher on everything.  There was a problem with someone at the buffet, waited 15 minutes before paying and there was only one person ahead of me. Something didn't go through on the register and the other person tried to help.  Don't know??  The rest of hte line backed up.  Food was good .  I like trying new things.  Also ate at Steak and Shake and Del Mar Grill.  Peaked at Star Bucks  to see what sweet rolls available for breakfast didn't see anything worth the high priced coffee.  Long line there.  Casino was good had a lot of video poker slots my game.  The casino was always crowded.  Masks a must have. Did not go swimming but looked at the pool.   I will return

allReviews.title: Celebration Staycation
allReviews.text: Las Vegas local here. Just got back from staycation at South Point. Was able to get an AARP discount! We got a suite - special occasion! They've recently done some renovations to the rooms - not sure if it's all of them, but our suite was really nice. No carpet in the room - less germs! AC worked extremely well. Ate at Steak 'n Shake (always good!), Coronado Cafe - twice (big portions, great food, highly recommend the Chinese chicken salad!), Big Sur Oyster Bar (oysters on the half shell and New England clam chowder were awesome - wasn't too crazy about their gumbo), and Baja Miguel's (great food and, again, large portions!). Didn't win in the casino but had a great time. Cocktail service on the casino floor is great - of course, we tip generously. Every employee we spoke with was nice, friendly, and courteous except the bell desk folks - unlike other properties we've stayed at, the bell desk folks didn't seem to want to interact at all. Valet is complimentary and well worth the tips. Hoping we earned some follow-up comps - would love to stay here again. Our usual go-to is Sahara - love Sahara! Now we have TWO go-to's!!

allReviews.title: Don’t room charge!!!
allReviews.text: Nice rooms - friendly service - very convenient for horse comps.  Be careful charging to your room - to easy to over charge you upon check out.  Had an experience w extending our stay and getting over charged.  Disappointing because we really enjoy the arenas and competing here…

allReviews.title: Resort Fee
allReviews.text: Be aware of a “resort fee” which is ridiculous.  You aren’t told about it until you check in.  I won’t be returning to this establishment.  It includes things that you would normally receive with the room, coffee, weight room, etc.

allReviews.title: Rude valet
allReviews.text: This our first trip in over a year to las vegas and our first time staying at south point hotel! Upon arrival at south point, I parked in the valet parking and waiting a few minutes for a valet to come. No one in sight, so after, a valet passes by and I tell him we are checking in and he's response is " that's nice"! The nerve of him and he could at least say do you need help, as I was going to say can you help us with parking, but he just continued on his Merry way! First day at south point, no brownie points for you!!! Terrible service!

allReviews.title: The smell of smoking is disgusting
allReviews.text: This is a nice appearing place, but going inside you are overwhelmed with the stink of cigarette smoke,  Humorously, the announcement says “Masks are mandatory and must be properly worn at all times.”  All you see are unmasked smokers. The stink is omnipresent and nowhere on the casino floor can you escape it.  When you sit at a slot machine, sure enough a smoker will sit right next to you and start hacking unmasked. We will never go to this joint ever again

allReviews.title: Very nice stay!
allReviews.text: I had a nice stay here! It was my first time staying here. Reception was fast and super friendly. A lot of things to do here: bingo, bowling, movies, lots of restaurants. Spa was nice. Rooms very nice and clean. Really nice pool. Sort of nice to be off strip for a bit, I could see doing a whole weekend in this area: South Point, M, the mall, etc.

allReviews.title: Best visit to Las Vegas in forever
allReviews.text: Room was neat and clean, well appointed.  Had a great meal at the buffet, the prime rib was excellent.  The Mexican restaurant was also very good.  The food here was good all around.  If you are interested in horses, rodeo and that sort of thing I would highly recommend this hotel.  My only complaint is that I had to wear a mask thanks to the Nevada governor's mandate.

allReviews.title: Poor quality
allReviews.text: Room floor was dirty, towel has blood stain scary! And they want you to reuse towels over and over again. If only i was able to book ahead i would have other better hotelChoices. I will never use this hotel again!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Stay
allReviews.text: From check in to check out, this property was fabulous. It was located off the strip, but only 10 min away. It has a beautiful bowling alley, theater, Bingo, arcade, rodeo, and many eateries and gambling. Had a lovely stay and will stay again.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: I have stayed at South Point twice now. The price is right and it's located right off the strip. It has a shuttle to and from the airport. There is an assortment of fanastic restaurants, many of them offering Happy Hour specials. We spent much of our time for 4 days in the hotel for a children's tournament. It's very child-friendly with a bowling alley, movie theater and of course the nice pool. You really don't need to leave! The staff is great and they really do take pride in their hotel. It's the reason I'll keep going back!

allReviews.title: shows and garden buffet are excellent
allReviews.text: for several years we have attended show here at Southpoint.  Every show has been excellent.  the staff is friendly and very helpful.  Sandy and her supervisor at the ticket office go out of their way to help.  We also visit the Garden Buffet. the food is so good.  and the staff is wonderful.  South Point is very clean and  and parking is easy to find and FREE.  WE LOVE SOUTHPOINT

allReviews.title: Somewhere else next time
allReviews.text: We were staying here only because it was a convenient place to stay on a trip home from Colorado. The price was good. If you have any luggage at all you will need to valet park as that is the only way to get a cart. I paid extra for a view room. The room is large, but you can hear everything in the hallway. We do have a view of the swimming pool and we are on the 8th floor, but this morning the gardeners started blowing at 7 am and it was noisy all the way up here. Had dinner last night at the sushi place and while the food was good, the service was rude. Our waiter overcharged me for a glass of wine that was not what I ordered and then argued with me about it. I had to involve a manager. If you are there because you love the casino or you are attending a function there it is probably fine, but there isn’t anything that would make us go back.

allReviews.title: Rude Casino Dealer(s). Shame you and talk trash about you if you aren't tipping enough!
allReviews.text: Welcome to my review of my experiences at SouthPoint. First I am a local, therefore I frequent this property quite a bit. Today unfortunately I chose to play Ulitmate Texas Holdem and was graced by a dealer by the name of Elizabeth from Cuba. This was on her nametag and is the only identifying info I have.2nd hand playing I get a flush and decide my third hand I will "toke bet" on the Trips spot the following hand. While looking at my cards in a very normal manner (I am a dealer myself Pit games along with a pro poker player, I understand cards.) Elizabeth called on me to not "pick up my cards like that" in a very rude manner. I asked how I am hurting them and she found an issue with it, so my tips ceased. The next hand between hands 4 and 5 I pulled out my phone to check my screen below the table and again, Elizabeth chewed me out saying "no phones at the table." Her cell phone was actually on the table and she slowed the game often checking it. (I guess SouthPoint allows their dealers to have their own phones on the table..) Moving on...I win a few hands in a row for a couple hundred bucks and Elizabeth from Cuba notices I have not tipped anything since her first outburst. She began to make snide remarks to other players out loud, far louder than normal voice saying "oh thanks for the tip try" "dang we didn't win our tip, unfortunately only one player is actually winning, and looked at me while using these disrespectful and snide remarks." I advised the table I too am a table games dealer in Vegas and completely understand her remarks and why I am not tipping. A couple hands later I kid you not, I am in seat 2, Asian man in seat 3 was sporadically toke betting, this man is ON HIS PHONE TALKING during a hand, Elizabeth from Cuba says NOTHING TO HIM. Player in Seat 6 (Caucasian male) was also on his phone ABOVE THE TABLE and again, Elizabeth from Cuba DID NOT SAY A WORD. Moving onto other times she singled me out... I asked another player if I could gift him $5 and he plays it on his Trips spot (since he wasn't playing it) and he said sure. Elizabeth from Cuba elected to stop the game and call a floor and tell the floor what we did and stop us from betting more money?!?!? That's insane. I have dealt in multiple casinos and cannot believe how she chose to target me for not tipping and ostracize my movements.In moments where her floor would come over again, she would look behind her (against policy) and talk to her floor in Spanish. Unfortunately for her I know some spanish and understood she was speaking negatively about me to her floor who responded back in Spanish. Zero positive customer service from either individual. I am appalled by the lack of professionalism from the dealers. Elizabeth from Cuba also argued with me saying "You are a dealer you should know the rules." The worst part of all of this was when I was having a conversation with a player in Seat 5 about my experience and how I find this targeting by Elizabeth to be poor service, she interrupted our conversation to tell me "We didn't have any problems with anyone until YOU came!" I am blown away that a dealer can talk this way to a frequent guest. I HAD to write this and bring it to the attention of tourists so they can make a calculated decision on where to stay. From my experience at SouthPoint. If you see Elizabeth from Cuba on a table, I do not recommend playing with her. She will make disrespectful comments to you, about you to others, and shame you for not tipping when you're already down hundreds.

allReviews.title: Had to book a room due to circumstances
allReviews.text: Lines were long which was expected but the lady jasmine that checked us in was very rude and had no personality, she was just very rude and thought she knew better then us. very disappointing. rooms were clean and very nice. also the cocktail waitresses downstairs are very rude, they take forever to come around to take orders, one cocktail waitress in particular went around taking orders and we asked for two beers and she said she would be back but just ignored us after telling her multiple times, that is unacceptable and very poor customer service, we spent 4 nights there and spent lots of money to be treated that way is not right. i was very disappointed in the customer service. smh.

allReviews.title: South Point jewel
allReviews.text: South Point is very close to our place in Southern Highlands, it stands out, its beautiful, they have steak and eggs for $5.99 from 12am to 6am, its really worth it, you will like it, you should check it out, service is great,  its a great place to bring visitors

allReviews.title: Long lines
allReviews.text: This was my first time staying at South Pointe.  Overall, the nonsmoking room was pleasant.   Pro: off the strip, which is less traffic and noise. Pro: plenty of parking in the garagePro: Starbucks opened 24/7Pro: hardwood floors in the room made it coolerPro: Housekeeping daily was great Pro: Check-in and out was easy and fast Cons: The walls are thin, so you can hear the noise in the hallway and the hotel doors are heavy and are loud when they shut.  Cons: A few kinks of repairs while we were there, but they came and fixed them right away.  Cons: The TV remote was not working all the time, so we just didn't watch tv that much.  Cons: The shower pressure is very light.   Cons: Buffet and Cafe restaurants on-site always had the longest line.  Up to an hour wait.  Cons: The filtration system in the casino area was poor. Lots of people smoking. Cons:  Elevator floors were filthyCons: slots were not very loose.  Cons: The pool was nice, but not too many shaded areas.

allReviews.title: Great place for a relaxing get away to Vegas
allReviews.text: I've been going  to the South point for years. Lately, they've really cut back on my comps, because I've had a few good trips. That upsets me, but I keep going back because I like the casino/hotel/race book.  The race book is top notch and the people working there always make me feel welcomed. So if you are a horse player this is the place for you. They have a good selection of machines and table games. The silverado cafe is great, so is the oyster bar and the coronado cafe. Good food at nice prices. I love this place. It's just has such a laid back feel to it.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at South Point and plan to return.1.   Check in and check out were extremely quick and easy.2.. The room was clean and it was nice to have housekeeping daily.  A free refrigerator was appreciated.3.  The casino has a lot of slot machines that were not on the Strip.4.  Everyone we encountered was friendly and happy.5.  Corando Cafe has outstanding food and wonderful service.6.  The food at Garden Buffet was delicious and so much better than the one at Caesars.7.  Taking the shuttle to the airport was an unexpected and welcome surprise.I look forward to returning soon.

allReviews.title: Suites designated as Non-Smoking on the website are actually Smoking rooms
allReviews.text: We booked a Specialty One-Bedroom Suite on the 25th floor, the largest and most premium room available at the South Point Hotel and Casino. We specifically booked a NON-SMOKING room (which shows as such on our confirmation, and still shows that description on South Point's actual website). When we arrived, the front desk staff also initially confirmed that it was a NON-SMOKING room.However, when we entered our suite, we saw at least four ash trays with matchbooks in various places around the room, and the room had a subtle stink. So we went downstairs to ask the front desk to move us to an actual non-smoking room.This time we were told that the suite wasn't "technically" a non-smoking room, but rather a SMOKING OPTIONAL room. (Yes, that is actually what the staff said!)We asked again to be put into a NON-SMOKING suite, not a "smoking optional" room (since that just means it's a smoking room, obviously). We were told that "all suites are "smoking optional." And that was that. No apologies, no consideration, nothing.So if you don't like being lied to, don't enjoy the stink of smoke in your non-smoking room, and don't enjoy smelling like burnt tires after walking through the smoke-filled public spaces (which are all adjacent to the restaurants, causing them to smell bad too despite not allowing smoking in the food establishments), then this probably isn't the hotel for you. There's a reason the most expensive suite in this dump is only $235 per night!It's especially disappointing because this hotel has the best restaurant in Las Vegas – Michael's. It's expensive, but for good reason... absolutely the best service, best food, and best atmosphere in the area. It's a shame Michael's patrons have to walk through all the filth, stink, and stupidity to get to this spectacular steak house.

allReviews.title: Pretty Darn Good!!!
allReviews.text: I recently traveled to Vegas for a training, and the South Point was a recommended hotel. I could have stayed closer to the Strip at one of the higher-end hotels (for 3+ times the price) but decided to stay here instead - and I'm glad that I did!Friendly Staff - The very first thing that stood out right off the bat was just how friendly and warm the staff were - from the front desk at check in, to the spa, to the waitstaff, to the ladies in the gift shop, to the folks who took care of the wake-up call, to the airport shuttle driver - (well, ok sure, there was that one waiter at one restaurant who was all business and rushed us a bit, but that was the exception) Overall, the staff provided a welcoming, down-home comforting vibe that you just don't get at most places.Room - Very surprised at how nice the room was! I got a premium King and the room was HUGE and VERY clean. It had a mini fridge, a Keurig coffee maker (with lots of coffee pods provided), hairdryer, soap and shampoo/conditioner and lotion, and LOTS of towels (although oddly, total number of towels provided on the rack was inconsistent each day). I really liked that room had two easy chairs as well as a little dining table with two chairs. Note: Room did not have any tea or glassware/coffee cups, just paper cups in case that matters to you. My fav "nice touch" was the complementary slippers : )  Tip: Get a room further away from the elevator because the area close to elevator bank is noisy and can be quite warm with the high temp weather. Overall, loved the room.Gym: Delighted at just how nice the gym was  too - tons of great modern equipment, weight machines, treadmills, elliptical machines, pull-up bar, water station, air conditioned (Tip: you can also buy bigger bottles of water and Gatorade at the fridge in the Spa right outside the gym). Everything you need for an awesome workout.Variety of Dining Choices - I'll admit I was a bit concerned that there weren't many outside restaurants super close by - but it turned out there were more than enough choices at the South Point. The prime rib restaurant was by far my fav - also loved the burger spot (special line for to-go orders) and the ice cream place (get the peanut butter crunch smoothie!). All were quite good and reasonably priced (except the steakhouse) Tip: Be sure to make a reservation for the sit-down restaurants well in advance through the hotel website via Open Table: the reservation process was super easy, and I'm glad I didn't have to wait in those very long lines on Friday night. Tip: Get to Starbucks EARLY in the morning, especially if you're headed to the airport - the line can be really long.Gift Shop /Liquor Store - The shop had great amenities -clothes. toothbrush, toothpaste, lots of  clothes, sparkling waters and even kombucha and a few snacks. I wish there had been some yogurts and some fresh fruit options (but they did have a few things like that at the deli.... and Krispy Kreme upstairs had yogurt and even cups of sliced vegetables - who knew?) Shuttle - Loved that they provided an airport shuttle. Wish that it picked up at the airport more frequently since I missed the one I had reserved and ended up paying $30+ for a taxi. But glad they had a shuttle available on day of departure. Tip: Bring small bills for a tip for the Shuttle driver - thanks for lifting all those heavy bags in the 112 degree heat!Overall: Is it super fancy and glamorous? No - but it's a fun, relaxed comfy, local vibe. Can you bring your family there? Yes, saw lots of families with kids out at the pool, and several groups of tweens and teens running around in packs looking absolutely giddy with delight near the movie theater, ice cream, and arcade. Would I bring my parents/grandparents here? Yes, for folks who want some fun but don't want to be on the Strip, this is a good place to come for a fun weekend. Did I need to bring that extra bag of super fancy clothes? Not really - most folks were dressed nicely casual, and some did dress up a bit for dinner. Do I wish I'd brought my darkest sunglasses and worn them inside? Yes! It was so bright on the main floor, I thought my eyes would bug out (Tip: bring your blue-blockers!) Did it get a little crazy at times? I hope so! Hey it's Vegas, not Sunday school, right?  Sure there were a few super rowdy group as expected, but everyone was having a blast. People overall were quite friendly and everyone just seemed really glad to finally be out! (Also, there were lots of calm security folks around keeping an eye on the elevator bank) Would I stay here again? Definitely - it's a pretty darn good place!

allReviews.title: USBC 2021
allReviews.text: This was our 4th stay here over the years..  We were in a handicapped room which was not needed but that was OK.  Very inconsistent with number of towels daily.  Started out our stay with 2 bath towels and 2 wash cloths.  No hand towels.  Toward end of stay towel amounts and variety increased (we hadn’t requested more but we were glad for it).  Rooms clean.  Coffee in room..  Some also got tea.  The addition of tea was appreciated by those who got it.Glad for added security asking for room key before boarding elevators at night.Restaurants always busy.  Assuming they are short of help like everywhere else.  Make reservations early into your stay.  Long lines at buffet and Steak n Shake as well as Coronado Cafe and Del Mar.  snack at bowling alley (where doubles and singles were played) really slow…..

allReviews.title: Garden buffet at South Point Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: We visited my sister in law in Henderson last week-end (June 25,2021),  and told her that we missed Las Vegas buffet.  She and her husband took us to Garden buffet at South Point hotel.  We're all surprised of their price and the variety of food they have. Their food are high quality food, their services are exceptional.We highly recommend this buffet to anyone who loves buffet especially in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Never again
allReviews.text: Decided to do a staycation and went with South Point since there’s so much to do at this property. Rooms where clean and spacious. Machines were a little tight didn’t win but love the fact they have a variety￼ from old to new machines.Overall was a good experience until today in the morning!! When checking in I requested a late check out. At 10am housekeeping came into our room. We were very surprised since this has never happened to us and any other property. She was very loud and was making so much noise outside our room came again 1 hour later to knock and trying to open the door again. Finally got up getting ready to leave housekeeping again Tried coming inside so I called front desk to confirm I  had  a late checkout and then spoke with Shelly the “director” who by the way was the rudest person.  I asked if i had a late check out she said no but she can go ahead and add it I told her their no point now since it’s 12:45pm and about to leave.  She then told me your a local and you should know housekeeping starts cleaning rooms early I told her I actually do work at a casino property on the strip and that’s not what we do. Check out at most hotels are at 11am and front desk always communicates with housekeeping to notify what rooms are checked out and what rooms need attention not go knocking at all the doors and see which ones are empty. Because of this I will never return! My staycation started fun but because of Shelly she ruined my weekend. Never again!

allReviews.title: Love this casino and hotel.
allReviews.text: We love this place. This is our 4th time staying there. We come to bowl nationals and this place is perfect. It’s off the strip which is great. They don’t make you pay for parking which is sooo great. We love the bingo there. We go several times a day. The ladies that work there are so nice and knew us by the end of our visit. The staff is so great and so nice. We love it and will be back next year.

allReviews.title: Away from the strip but still nearby
allReviews.text: This hotel is on the strip but a couple of miles south of the busy strip area.  This hotel is lovely - clean, comfy beds, quiet, with all the amenities you would expect at a Las Vegas hotel.  There is a casino, a bowling alley, a movie theatre, several fine restaurants, a spa, shopping, etc. We stayed here on the busy Memorial Weekend 2021 when the whole world was reopening after the pandemic.  Everything seemed to be running smoothly even though it was the first big holiday weekend, so hats off to the management and employees who were working so hard to meet everyone's needs.  This was my first trip ever to Vegas. If I ever return, I'd stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great place great staff
allReviews.text: I have been in the South Point many times over the years but this was my first time staying there.  I had a complete wow experience.  Every single staff member I encountered was polite , smiling and helpful. This place is huge and it is really well cared for and clean.  Pool area was great.  The rooms are great.  The bed was super comfortable.  Loved the wood floors in the room.  The room was spotless looked brand new.   There are a lot of great food options.  Don Vito's was great. Loved the prices and after midnight menu at the Coronado cafe.    I highly recommend staying here and will be back there soon.

allReviews.title: Great hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: This is our go two hotel off the strip!  We love the room looked renovated food always good at the buffet prime rib and Coronado cafe steak and eggs after midnight for $6.95 you can’t beat that !! Great service they have bowling alley movie theater Starbucks  great service !!! My family came in for birthday celebration they love Southpint !! Can’t wait to return in fall !!

allReviews.title: Everything you need
allReviews.text: Well my wife and I booked this property because it was off strip and figured we would avoid the big crowds.  Well that really didn't work out because there was a 2 month bowling tournament going on.  Place was packed.  But it was all good.  The place has plenty of places to eat.  I had Steak and eggs every morning for cheap.  Everyone working there was incredibly nice and respectful. Between midnight and 10AM they did intense cleaning everyday.  The rooms are spacious and comfortable.  The worst part was trying to get into the buffet.  The line at anytime was at least an hour wait.  Never got to try it.  Nothing is worth waiting an hour for.  But it must have been good because it was busy.This place is like a small city with some really nice folks working there.  Book it you won't regret it.

allReviews.title: Was just ok not like the strip at all
allReviews.text: We were there for 3 days it was just okRestaurant Coronado we had to get up and leave because the service was so bad . We went then to zen shrine restaurant they had terrific lobster  the employees were ok some better than others . Food was excellent Played slots a lot but no one was winning very much so went to the room . So I’m guessing staying on the strip would be a lot better . We had room service but  was overly priced!  We paid 79.00 a little extra it was good but very pricy  We will not ever go back to this casino !

allReviews.title: Mistake Corrected
allReviews.text: I was celebrating getting my 2nd vaccine with a Vegas trip, but made the mistake of booking another property for my 5-night visit.  After the second night, I realized that I should have gone with my old stand-by - The South Point.  Nearly all staff at my first choice were some form of cranky, however, when I got the South Point, I feel that my vacation actually started.  I've stayed here many times before, and was once again treated to exceptional professionalism, a clean facility and all the comforts I've come to expect from past visit.  It was good to see that unlike most other properties, they also had all of their restaurant open, including the buffet.  I wish I had scheduled my entire stay for the South Point, but I'm glad I cut my losses after two nights and moved here for the last part of my stay.   I won't make that mistake again.

allReviews.title: A great long weekend get away
allReviews.text: We took a long weekend (Wednesday to Sunday) family trip to the Southpoint and had a great time.   The staff was friendly and the room was clean and well appointed.   My kids loved the bowling and arcade, my wife and I enjoy the sports book and great bartenders.   High recommend the Del Mar Deli, a lot of great food at good price. Already looking forward to our next trip back.

allReviews.title: Amazing first trip
allReviews.text: My husband and I took a last minute trip to see family. We were amazed at all the things to do there. Since covid everything has been crazy, all the staff are very good at keep everything clean. They have several restaurants that did not disappoint, have rodeo events, bowling, a movie theater, bingo, along with all the casino games. We went to a race one day and they have a bus that takes you back and forth to that. Everything was very well organized. We will be back for sure.

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: What a great time!!  The rooms were spacious and clean, you never need to leave the resort.  We ate at Zenshin's, Steak and Shake, Coronado and Baja Miguel's and would give them all 5 stars.  Great service and wonder food.  Where else can you get $1 Bloody Mary and Mimosas?  We will definitely be back, this will be our go to place when visiting Vegas.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend
allReviews.text: I love the Southpoint! Staying here was so much fun and felt very safe and clean! Friendly staff and so much to do. They made sure everyone was wearing mask and social distancing! Would highly recommend!

allReviews.title: A lot to do and great values
allReviews.text: I have stayed here before and not noticed that they have a bowling alley- and it was open! A movie theatre, that was also open!  Sadly the pool was not open even though I called a couple days before arriving and was told it was open. They give you a coupon book at check in and we got a buffet- that was great for 2 for $10. The other restaurants are very reasonable and the Shake Shack has many half off times. Best alcohol prices, $3 for wine $4.50 for beer. I was just annoyed that in the fitness center there was someone there who was supposed to be cleaning and making sure people were wearing their masks.  He obviously hated the job, he rarely if ever looked up for whatever he was looking at, he didn't even notice that there was a man who wore his face mask around his neck the whole time.  I kept looking over at the attendant to get his attention but he never looked up.  After watching this guy for 30 minutes walk around without his mask, I finally walked to the attendant and asked him if he was supposed to monitor masks, he said yes. Told him one guy was not wearing his, there were only 3 people in the fitness center and I had to point him out to the attendant.  He finally said something and finally got up and started cleaning equipment. The other annoying thing was that our room keys kept not working.  Really annoying to keep having to get new ones at the front desk. Other than that I really like this hotel, it is nice and quiet and has a lot to do.

allReviews.title: Only buffet opened in Las Vegas 7/7 with great prices.
allReviews.text: Congratulations.  They are the only buffet opened 7/7 offering breakfast, lunch, dinner, special holiday meals, seafood night, champagne brunch and prices are reasonable.  The only other buffet that just opened for limited hours is the Wicked Spoon and their price is around $45.  South Point offers family friendly prices.  It is off the Strip, but that also means less crime.  Someone was recently killed on the pedestrian walkway between Bally's and the Cromwell and I believe he was a police officer with an Asian girlfriend.  South Point is SAFE!  Free parking. Asians welcomed. I am Asian. But there was one problem and it was the St. Patrick's day buffet.  What a waste of good food because it was cooked improperly.  Almost all the meats dry and over cooked -  the little steaks I couldn't cut with my knife, brisket all dried out a was the corn beef, trout, salmon, turkey, lamb, brisket - so I had almost a meat free meal.  And on the other hand vegetable under cooked and rubbery and hard to cut - cabbage, broccoli, carrots.  But the Mexican and Asian station are always consistent and the food is good at those stations.  Salad - you can't go wrong there and no problems with the dessert station.  Their red wine is very good.  The price is excellent - $12.99 for the St. Patrick's hotel buffet which included one glass or wine.  Service is great.  Atmosphere is comfortable.  A great place for families, seniors, and even single people.   The casino was busy and not deserted.  A lot of other restaurant facilities are also open so you do have a choice but what makes the buffet extra special is that while 39 other buffets have closed, this one pushed forward to open and it is part of the Las Vegas experience.

allReviews.title: Bowling nationals USBC
allReviews.text: We like staying at south point hotel and casino .. we have never had any trouble with our stay here , the management has always done everything they could to accommodate us even when our flight was changed we were comped 2 nights to help us ! Great pool and lots of entertainment in the hotel .. 2 bowling Alleys and anything else you want to not leave the property ! The dates were not March 2020 but many times and several years back to back .. the app wouldn’t let me change the date that far back ..

allReviews.title: Las Vegas trip
allReviews.text: A friend stayed at this hotel and we visited. It is children friendly has more activities for them so it nice for the family. All you need is here. Nice rooms. Fun slots. Kates koner ice cream shop was tasteful. Coffee shop was convenient and prices weren't ridiculous. Security is on it. If you are load and obnoxious you will get dealt with. Be sure to have your face mask on cause if not security will tell you if you eating after drink or eating must pull mask up or after smoking must put mask up after each puff.

allReviews.title: A great place to stay and relax
allReviews.text: Very comfortable , well maintained with very helpful staff and  a very secure atmosphere. The restaurants are as good or better than a lot of the other "strip" hotels and the casino has a relaxed feel along with free parking this this hotel and casino has everything you need for a great stay

allReviews.title: Great Value!
allReviews.text: This Casino is the best value in Vegas. The Casino has a wide variety of new Slot Machines as well as Gaming Tables,and Betting.I hope that you enjoy catching a movie, or bowling a few games on the well maintained lanes. Multiple bars, Dining, Cocktail Waiters and jackpots await. Price to lodge here is very reasonable, and standard rooms are well appointed and spacious.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Stay, The Best
allReviews.text: My wife and her friend stayed here while playing a golf tournament in Primm NV., after leaving the Primm Hotel which was a terrible place.  Everything about this hotel, casino was great.  The rooms were superior, the service was great and the restaurant  we ate at, The Steak House was very good.

allReviews.title: The Casino is ripping people off when cashing out tickets at the Kiosks
allReviews.text: Was playing some video poker on Saturday evening and when we were done, we cashed out our machines and put our tickets in the redemption kiosk and the machine provided all my paper money, but it did not provide the coin money.  It is literally stealing people's money a quarter at a time, etc.   It printed out a ticket, which thankfully I grabbed and walked the block and a half to the Cashiers cage.  I didn't even have to say anything to the employee at the cage. As soon as she saw me place the receipt on the counter, she slid my quarters to me and never said anything at all.   So this is what they are counting on.  That every customer that has coin left on the redemption ticket, that doesn't want to be bothered with walking all the way to the cashier, the casino keeps that money.  This is stealing!   For me, even though it was only 50 cents, it wasn't the money, it is the principal of the thing.  We put our money in your machines to play, but when you cash out, they steal your change.  This is not right so please beware!

allReviews.title: Great pricing
allReviews.text: A little disappointed the rewards account didn't offer any free slot play but impressed it offered discounts on dining. I took advantage of that.Enjoyed the atmosphere and the pricing was right. Will come back!

allReviews.title: Nice independent casino
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed this casino.  We were not winners, but our money lasted longer than other places.  They have a lot of different games, that I’d never seen before, which is always fun for me.  Plenty of places to eat.  Very friendly staff and a nice bar in the middle to sit and watch a football game, with no pressure to spend on drinks.  We had coffee.

allReviews.title: relaxing fun
allReviews.text: This hotel is beautiful,clean and has everything you could want for a visit without being in the crowds on the strip.  The pool is beautiful for a quick dip or just to lay in the sun.  They have many restaurants to chose from and the buffet was great.  We will go there again on our next visit.  the sanitizing stations were plentiful and always at your finger tips.

allReviews.title: I wouldn’t stay here again
allReviews.text: Unfortunately on our first full day we were awaken to a horrible sound. Turns out there was a fire under us. Our boys wanted to use the gym equipment as they are student athletes, even with our presence they were denied access. We couldn’t go back up to our room it was 6:30 in the morning and pretty much forced to leave. Considering we didn’t want to sit in a smoked filled casino. It was 6:30 am and our options were limited. I voiced my complaint to the front desk and was told there was nothing that could be done. We later returned and was given a refund for resort fees, really? We were also disappointed that the shuttle service wasn’t available. I understand our stay is during covid, the hotel is open, the Buffett is open, exactly what more of a risk to run the shuttle. My husband and I played bingo with my Mom, the staff in the hall was very helpful to us. Our housekeeper made sure our room was cleaned daily. Each day our room was cleaned well and smelled amazing.  Our boys enjoyed the bowling alley and game room. While in the casino we asked for drinks, the girls never came back on multiple occasions. We would rate our overall stay ok. I don’t think I’d ever stay here again. We only stayed here this time because my Mom loves the bingo hall. Not the worse stay but definitely not the best. The beds are a little hard. The hotel is clean but the casino is a cloud of smoke.

allReviews.title: WONDERFUL OFF-STRIP HOTEL AND CASINO
allReviews.text: Just returned from a six night stay at South Point Hotel and Casino.  Wonderful stay!  The rooms were clean and spacious.  Having a Keurig coffee maker and a frig in the room is an absolute plus! Due to Covid-19, there was no daily housekeeping, but the housekeeping staff were always quick to respond whenever we needed any clean towels, more coffee, etc.  The casino is nice, well-lit and bright.  They also have a bowling alley and movie theater.  The food at all the restaurants we visited was tasty and reasonably priced.  Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone planning a visit to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: The worst customer service....EVER!!
allReviews.text: We stayed for an equestrian event from Sept 3 a Sept 6 and we accidentally left a medication in the room fridge. When we realized and called to have it picked-up or shipped, we were told it had not been kept cold since being found! Obviously, at this point it is no longer good. We were basically told by the Director of Hotels, Shelly Essex, ‘Well, you should not have left it in the room.’ Well, if we could all be as perfect as Ms. Essex, what a world it would be...huh!!?? Her lack of common decency/customer service was astounding. I will most likely making other arrangements in the future.

allReviews.title: South Point Plus and Minus
allReviews.text: As a local we decided to head over to South Point for a few nights - we had stayed there when the casino first opened and wanted to see how things progressed.Room Notes: South Point rates are decent and the rooms are large, they offer Keurig coffee makers, a frig and a safe.South Point checks your temperature at the check in desk but not for anyone entering the casino?  We found this to be odd since we have been going to numerous other casinos and the protocol has always been to check everyone entering.I was hoping to give South Point a higher rating, actually its a 3-1/2 stars because of the cleanliness of the elevator board, room and hallways.Lets start with check in and the casino.The Staff was Outstanding, Covid-19 compliant.Front desk accommodated us right away - the casino is clean with attendants handing out masks - friendly and very kind.The Casino was fun and we played the tables and slots.The tables offer low minimums which is nice also the waitress staff was always around. Plenty of modern slots - a real plus for South Point.Our room however was a different story.It had been poorly cleaned, with remnants of the previous occupant.Under the bed you can see debris that were never vacuumed, the floor with partially wet from moping & the floor wasn't even really cleaned. After walking around my shoes were sticking to the floor.In a pandemic world you would have thought that the room would be sanitized and spotless - I was afraid to touch things, so we cleaned the room ourselves including wiping down the floors. (Gross)Note: there is no daily room service in any hotel - so you have request new towels and amenities if needed.The hallway leading from the elevator to the room was also not vacuumed.There's a seating area between the elevator and hallway, it had cigarette ashes on the floor for two days .  On our last night someone just left a beer can in the same area that wasn't never picked up & was still there when we left the next day - it made the room experience very dumpy.The Pool area and service is very good, The pool waitress Destiny provided excellent service and was helpful with pool info questions.  As in the Casino there were attendants passing out masks to anyone who needed them.Buffet:  It's open and sanitary - at least when we went in the mornings for breakfast (it was still early) -so there weren't many peopleThey provided hand sanitizing stations throughout and everyone was wearing a mask.  The food is served for you by kitchen attendants (wearing masks and gloves) - all the food is protected by glass, this will probably be the future of buffet's for some time.Overall a number of good food choices, we didn't notice any bagels or toasters but we weren't looking for them.The omelet guy was a bit unfriendly and had an edge - my wife ordered eggs Sunnyside up, he barely cooked them and when she questioned it he said "this is what Sunnyside egg is" - that was horrible service, he should just said I'll cook them a little longer, what a jerk.I don't think well ever come back - if your looking for a discount it's ok

allReviews.title: 3 1/2 Stars
allReviews.text: Let me start by saying there is nothing wrong with South Point. I would rate it 3 1/2 stars or a little better than average. The room was clean and roomy. The staff was friendly. No complaints except that in my view, the bed was not all that comfortable. There was nothing that I experienced in the hotel that set it apart from others in the same price range. It was pretty average. The shower is a tub/shower combo which the newer hotels have moved past. I’ll likely stay here again as I enjoyed the poker room. The casino amenities and food options are a plus but that’s to be expected in a Las Vegas hotel.

allReviews.title: Really nice hotel
allReviews.text: We have been to South Point before.  It is clean and fully operational--valets, bellhops etc. The buffet was open and very good.  No wait to use elevators. Really a nice casino and experience.  Everything clean and nicely maintained.  Very professional, even during Covid.

allReviews.title: Many Photos added. Excellent stay.
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the South Point on a Sunday stay. Large room, supper comfy bed, great shower and good choice of channels on the TV. Easy parking. Fantastic pool and gym. Great bowling center, casino, Race Book, Sports Book and restaurants. Super friendly staff. Management should be proud. Keep up the great work! Excellent stay and I will return.

allReviews.title: Family Funeral
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the South Point Hotel. We stayed at this hotel seven years ago for a wedding. We remembered how nice the hotel was and how friendly/helpful the hotel was. So we decided to stay at the hotel again. Happily I’m glad to say that the hotel hasn’t changed. The rooms are spacious, clean, and affordable. The beds are comfortable. The showers have excellent water pressure. The room has great amenities with plenty of room in the closets. The hotel is not on the Las Vegas strip, so if you plan to go to the strip you will need to make arrangements. The hotel restaurants are excellent. The only problem I saw with the hotel was the following. When we stayed here last time, the hotel was relatively new. The air circulation was a lot better. Since the restaurants are not enclosed and next to the casino, you tend to get more cigarettes smoke than normal while at the restaurants. Otherwise the stay was worth the price and I still recommend the hotel.

allReviews.title: Terrible
allReviews.text: 2/515 hours ago on  GoogleWell this trip to South Point started on the wrong foot. We were towing a car in a trailer. They had us park across the street with the big rigs. The giant parking lot was empty. You could have parked 100 trucks pulling trailers sans a concern for space, yet at 106 degrees we had to walk across the street to get in the casino.
