Then with only 3 people in line, we waited 30 minutes to check in. At 4:30 on a Friday night they had 1 person working the desk. This was when they first reopened during Covid. They would clean the credit card machine but made no effort to clean the counter everyone was leaning on. Then the room. Semi clean with papers left from a prior guest. So we wiped everything down. We were given discount coupons for drinks or a small % off a meal. We went down to try to get a drink and a meal with the coupons. Every bar and/or restaurant they gave us a coupon for was closed. What was the point? After we were told there was cocktail service in the lounge. So we went. Waited 20 minutes and had to go to the bar to ask for help. They were dismissive. Eventually a waitress came. When we ordered a second beer we were told we had to close out because she was going off shift. So the end result is the staff was dismissive, uncaring and the service was poor. The rooms are average, but be careful if they are or aren’t properly cleaned. They got 2 stars for price. But beware. The price bring the best people. Can’t wait for a Raider game. Therefore I am done with SP.

allReviews.title: Spa Coastal Del Sur ( hair salon) inside southpoint
allReviews.text: Koryn G (licensed Cosmetologist ) professional, the BEST. She took the time too listen an understand my needs in what I wanted my hair too look like.Set by far one of the best hair salons I've been to in quite some time. Well done and excellent job Koryn. I would highly recommend coming here and asking for this particular person to help you out on what you're looking for in your beauty look. Did a fabulous job. Thank you, thank you. Go see Spa Coastal Del Sur inside South Point Hotels and Casino.  Again thank you Koryn ( I'm always coming here for my hair, It's a long drive but it's worth it coming here southpoint. 😍😘

allReviews.title: Good value for Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We had a large room with a faux wood floor, a small table with two chairs, a desk and chair, dresser, and lounge chair.  We appreciated the Keurig.  The toilet/shower were separate from the sink.  The bathroom had poor lighting, but the lighted makeup mirror helped.  The shower head was good.  The bed was comfortable but sloped to one side.  It was quiet at night.  We got a  half-off breakfast buffet coupon.

allReviews.title: First COVID-19 travel experience
allReviews.text: While in line to check in for our five night stay our temperature was taken by a fixed scanner. Mine was taken again when I stopped at the front desk to ask a question. I find it odd that temperature was not taken for casino guests. Our room was clean and comfortable and we felt safe with the listed safety measures. Our only complaint with the hotel facilities was that our hallway did not appear to be vacuumed during our.The restaurants that were open appeared to have proper social spacing.The casino had every other slot machine turned off and the table games had half of the seats removed but less than fifty percent of the casino patrons wore masks.

allReviews.title: Late Lunch
allReviews.text: With five hours to killand with restaurants having only opened in the last few days, I thought it might be a good idea to have a leisurely lunch in Las Vegas. The strip hotels I stayed in I just enormous and beyond that, it costs a fortune to park.  I had heard good fast from locals about the south point, so I headed off to that casino. I found a parking spot next to the handicap area on the second floor. It was just a few feet to the elevator which opened up very close to what I believe is the main steakhouse. It did not open until 5 p.m. so I walked on several feet to a large Cafe. With my foot in a cast, distance was an important factor in my choices.  I couldn't have made a better choice. From the moment I walked in and was greeted by the hostess, everyone I encountered was very pleasant and helpful. Service was excellent!  my iced tea was replenished without my having to ask. My server as well as other staff members stop to make sure everything was okay. Not too often, just right.there were specials that truly were specials. As an example, chicken fried steak was about $18 or as the special prime rib was $14. I ordered that cut medium rare and enjoyed a simple but fresh dinner salad while waiting for my entre.I was pleasantly surprised when a 1 inch thick slab of meat carefully trimmed and cooked to just the right temperature was put before me.  It had to weigh a pound. It was so tender that I suspect it had been dry aged.  It was accompanied with baked potato and a saucer that held butter, sour cream and a horseradish sauce.  Not only was the restaurant stuff for light but so was the security officer I asked a question of as well as I believe a janitor type that directed me to a ticket cashing machine where I salvaged some of the money I had put into a slot machine!This was a large casino and there were many other restaurants and I'm sure shops that, due to buy condition, I was unable to explore.  But I'm anxious to return with my wife and was our daughters and their families when they come visit.

allReviews.title: Stay away if you are afraid of covid - hotel is not ready to reopne
allReviews.text: So it is opening day.  there are no body at the doors checking temperature or giving out free masks like at the orleans.  tables do not have sanitizer.  there are some additional sanitizer throughout the casino, but they are hard to find and see.  if you want a free mask you need to go to hotel check in area.  around 80% of people are not wearing masks.  the place is crowded.  it looks like people are making up for lost time.  every other slot machine is turned off.  i play poker so i went to the room.  they are 5 people games.  around 20 tables going,  the wait list was around 18 i gave up after an hour.  i tried the rewards kiosks all of them are off.  i was told there were no promotions at the moment.   the sanitizer in the casino is sticky.  better option is the orleans to gamble.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel/ casino
allReviews.text: Everything you could want under one roof! Great food, comfortable rooms, lively casino.  Don't have to go to the strip to have fun! Tour bus picked us up at hotel to go to Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam. Great sideline excursion!

allReviews.title: south point best in vegas
allReviews.text: south point best in vegas cant wait till covid 19 is over and we can go there ,great food ,great rooms ,good pool ,good gambling ,freindly staff ,from valet to waitress to bar tenders ,cleaning ladies,bingo staff ,gift shop,box office and special thanks to security staff who make you feel secure while on property , over all i want to be there yesterday but again covid 19 have to stay safe !!!!

allReviews.title: 20 Time Customer
allReviews.text: We watched South Point being built  as we drove into Vegas and we promised each other we would stay there when it opened, we’ll it opened and we’ve stayed there ever since. We’ve read reviews from other people but I have to say we haven’t experienced a bad stay yet.We don’t take advantage of the Gym or the Pool so we can’t comment on those. We always get a room with (2) Queen beds and  ask for a refrigerator, the room is 500 sq ft and plenty big enough for the two of us.We also stay on the lower level rooms so we can’t comment which rooms have a good view..We do take advantage of the Race and Sports Book and the Slots, the Horse betting area is one of the largest and have smoking and non smoking areas to sit and bet..We take advantage of the Fun Book they offer when you check in and use it at the Garden Buffet for Saturday Brunch ... We always have dinner at the Silverado Steakhouse Saturday night and stop at Steak and Shake for a late night snack..Parking your own car in the parking lot isn’t bad and it’s not much of a walk to the Casino or you can park in the parking garage..Before Southpoint we’ve stayed at the Frontier, The Stardust, Monte Carlo,The Aladdin, The Golden Nugget, The Silverton and a couple of hotel’s we’d like to forget on Koval between Tropicana and Flamingo ( I think they’ve been torn down).We are looking forward to our 21st stay when they open back up...

allReviews.title: Visitors
allReviews.text: Had a wonderful time.  Had to leave early through no fault of South Point.  Will be returning at the first opportunity or as soon as we are able to visit again and as soon as the Coronavirus pandemic allows.

allReviews.title: Great casino and hotel
allReviews.text: The Southpoint is located south of the airport on the strip. It is a very clean place with very friendly staff, free parking, many nice restaurants, cool things to do and reasonable prices. They have a large bar, the Grandview, as well as other bars on the premises.We stayed across the street so we were in the casino many times to eat and fool around. We can recommend Silverado Steakhouse, the Asian restaurant, the prime rib place Primarily Prime Rib, and the shops. The only place we would not recommend is Steak and Shake, please see our review for further details. We would have no hesitation staying at the Southpoint in the future.

allReviews.title: Pool never open
allReviews.text: On our last night, the pool was closed due to "poor weather", despite the weather being fine with blue skies and same as the previous day when the pool was open. Staff didn't care that our last day was ruined as we were unable to relax in the hot tub and instead had to wait in our room. Price we paid was not worth it as we were looking forward to enjoying the hot tub and pool. If visiting in the future beware, as you could be paying full price for a hotel that doesn't offer full amenities with a closed pool and hot tub due to poor weather even if there are blue skies and average temperatures. The only conclusion we can come to is the pool is unnecessarily closed for cost cutting measures.

allReviews.title: Poor
allReviews.text: Currently staying at South point hotel and casino. I usually visit this hotel due to the long opening hours of the pool and good facilities, have been visiting for years Sadly on this occasion standards have slipped. Foul smell on whole floor (22) Pool is currently 'closed' due poor weather despite it being sunny outside and no rain When asked if it will be open later - staff stated no and could not give a reason To top it off, we were told that there would be no discount on the resort fee as the pool is 'complimentary' - who knows what the resort fee actually covers here then Will be staying back on the strip from now on .

allReviews.title: This place was a really good stay
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a photo-booth convention and i was blown away by how convenient everything was. The food places where fairly priced, the customer service was very good, instead of getting liquor from a liquor store they have there own liquor store inside the hotel which had really good low prices . The room was nicely sized with a good view (13th floor). It was just really cool.No microwave in the rooms which is wack! but other than that 5 star rating.i would def come back to chill the strip was like $16 dollars away if u take uber but they have shuttles for that 2!

allReviews.title: Dinning was Horrible
allReviews.text: We stayed 3-1-20 thru 3-4-20. The room was OK nothing to write home about, even won some money on the slots however very bad drink service. Sports book is very good made some bets on this years Masters and was given three drink tickets which was very nice. The dinning however was another thing, went to the Buffett Sunday night and it was the worst food ever had in Las Vegas and been coming since 1985. I like my prime rib rare but what I was served was raw, I mean blood running all over the plate tried to cut a piece and could not. I contacted the sever and he appeared mad that I complained. Tried other things such as beef fajitas and the where too tough to eat. My wife also said all of the seafood items she tried were cold and horrible. Then are second meal was at Big Sur Oyster Bar for lunch on Monday. I had the Lobster roll and it was like a Tuna fish it was horrible could not eat it. My wife the Linguini & Clams and it was also not eatable. We paid the bill and got out of there and went down to Steak & Shake to get something we could eat. When we check out told the front desk clerk and she could have not cared less.

allReviews.title: Very nice!
allReviews.text: I had a very short trip through South Point but can't wait to go back. Off strip, but it has everything you might need.  Plenty of restaurants and gambling. The rooms were very clean and I felt safe and secure.  The doors are very solid, and shut very loudly so that look some getting used to.

allReviews.title: South Point is awesome!
allReviews.text: We stay here often and always love it!  Plenty of Restaurants to try.  The pool area is great.  If you have children with you but you would still like to play then They ALSO have activities for them.  Bowling and Theater right in the Hotel.  It's a very quick drive to the strip if you want to do some sight seeing.  I personally love to take my exchange students to Hershey Store, M&M world and Coco Cola store.  The price is right and you miss the horrible traffic of the city.  Enjoy!

allReviews.title: More 3.5 - interesting stay
allReviews.text: I stayed at the South Point for 4 days over the February NASCAR weekend and, for a "non-Vegas" guy, it was a very interesting stay.  I booked the highest end NASCAR package, which included race tickets and transportation to and from the track.  The casino is owned by the family of a long-time driver and many of the teams/crews stay there during the weekend, leading to some completely random interactions.The hotel is about a $20.00 - $30.00 cab ride from the airport (depending on the time of day) and about $35.00 to the strip.  Parking is free at the hotel and it is a crapshoot (pun intended) when it comes to renting a car.  There is a scheduled airport shuttle, but it does not operate for late night departures or arrivals.As for the hotel, registration is to the right from the main entrance and amidst the rather large casino floor.  The staff was pleasant and explained the aspects of the package and I received 2 coupon books good for food and gift shop discounts and multiple free drinks.There are multiple restaurants with a wide variety of cuisine.  I ate at Baja Miguel's (fine), Primarily Prime Rib (disappointing and expensive) and the less formal but very good Big Sur Oyster Bar (right on the casino floor).  The Garden Buffet was actually very good at a very reasonable price (which is discounted for club members) and the Coronado Cafe was also fine.As for the casino, there were numerous table games, with a sprinkling of $5.00 tables, but most were in the $15.00 - $25.00 range and there were also multiple slots and video poker machines.  It was relatively crowded the entire weekend and it was very low intensity.  The sports book was tucked off the side of the floor and while there were multiple screens, it was a little forlorn and could use an upgrade.As for my room, I was on the 16th floor and, most notable, it had a wood laminate like floor with no carpeting at all.  The bathroom had a full tub and shower and there was a mini-fridge which could be stocked at the gift shop downstairs.  The bed was fine and there were multiple charging stations.  The best description of the room is probably "functional".The pool area is rather large and quite attractive and the hotel also features a 16 screen movie theater, a huge bowling alley, bingo hall, a medium-sized arena (a horse show was taking place over the weekend) and multiple conference rooms.During my stay, the resort was bustling and this is a good off-the-strip alternative to downtown.  I would absolutely stay again for NASCAR weekend.  For other stays and in my personal circumstances, probably not.

allReviews.title: Easy place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at South Pointe. It is friendly. Nice to be away from the busyness if the strip. Easy free parking. I enjoyed the yoga classes Friday,Saturday, and Sunday. The pool and hot tub were a great temperature and very relaxing. Plenty of lounge chairs and good music there. We ate breakfast at the Garden Buffet which was huge and very good. Did not like the smoke in the casino itself. We would stay here again. The rooms were great.

allReviews.title: Business and Pleasure
allReviews.text: I recently attended an industry convention at the South Point Hotel. My husband accompanied me. The room was spacious, well designed and the bed was very comfortable. They have a fantastic pool and hot tub ( it’s more like a hot river that encircles an island-very nice). We don’t gamble but the casino was huge and surprisingly not as smoky as I anticipated. I never felt “yucky” after walking through it. During our free time we saw a movie in the giant theater complex ( clean and comfy), and went bowling ( 70 lanes-largest bowling alley I’ve ever been in). One night we took advantage of happy hour (4-6) at one of the many restaurants. This one was the bar attached to the Mexican restaurant ( great food-we had dinner there). Margaritas ( very good, not the super cheap ones we’ve seen on other casinos), well drinks and beer were $3 each and bar food was half off. We had three drinks, chips with beans and guacamole and two tacos for $17- such a deal! For horse lovers, the hotel has a huge area and stadium seating and hosts completions and horse shows there. This was an unexpected feature that we found very interesting. Overall, we thought the hotel was great on all levels-cleanliness, service and and amenities. Good for business and pleasure.

allReviews.title: Varied restaurants for diverse tastes.
allReviews.text: Lovely, large casino.  Very clean, pleasant atmosphere,  Staff is very professional and friendly.  I would return anytime. The restaurants provide varied menus and each has lovely surroundings.  Many varied forms of entertainment available.

allReviews.title: Our First Time to Stay at South Point
allReviews.text: We have been going to Las Vegas for over 20 years and have stayed at numerous hotels.  We decided to give South Point a try and we were not disappointed. We arrived on a Tuesday around noon and were surprised that our room was ready and no extra charge for this.  Great news.  Our room had hardwood floors with soft plush towels and bedding.  Ample electrical outlets and numerous tv channels.  They have an airport shuttle but we did not use it.  The casino is bright and very large.  They have a great variety of slots, video poker and table games.  You will need a car if you want to go to the strip or downtown but you can’t go wrong with staying here.

allReviews.title: Just an overnight
allReviews.text: Stayed at south point hotel on a trip back from SAN diego. Was pleasantly surprised. Very clean, staff was courteous, and casino was fun. When back in Vegas would not hesitate to stay there. A little off the beaten path but nice.

allReviews.title: Everything in one place
allReviews.text: Was here for a convention (one of many annually in Vegas). For some one who doesn't need the "strip" this is the place. Multiple restaurants (prime rib, Mexican, Italian, Deli, Oyster bar to name a few.Ample tables and slots for the gambler, movie theater with current movies and a bowling alley and a horse arena with regular event.Rooms are big and clean1 of the best shoe shine stands anywhere!!!$15.00 Uber to the strip or Fremont street.great spot no matter why your in town!!

allReviews.title: It’s always a good time
allReviews.text: South Point is always a stopping point or a place to stay whenever we are in Vegas. First we really appreciate the parking lot across the street for RVs or semi’s. (I’ll touch on this later) The rooms are clean and staff is always friendly. For the most part we can usually use our comps for our stay even during the busy times. Another key part is that they offer free parking. Not like the other casinos on the strip that want $20 to park.  In my opinion if I’m going into a casino I’m going to drop more than that in slots and the $20 to park takes me away from entering those other casinos. Since we are on the subject of parking. There has be a couple times that the parking across the street was closed off for an event so we saw some other RVs parked in the main parking lot. So we fell suit and parked with the rest and found out as we where leaving that we can’t park there and the security told us to park on the street over. I mean he was totally cool but I think they could have told us since they saw us pull in. But none the less I always enjoy staying and playing here. See you soon.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Shoot
allReviews.text: I recently attended this venue of over 8000 attendees, and both the hotel and conference staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure my stay was excellent in all areas.  My only complaint is that there were parts of the hotel with an abundance of cigarette smoke around, but this is to be expected at a Vegas casino resort.  My room was terrific, clean and with a great view.

allReviews.title: A Cool Buffet
allReviews.text: I was disappointed in the lack of heat for most of the dining choices. I alerted the manager, who seemed disengaged with my conversation. She said she would have it checked. I was leaving the buffet when I finally got her attention. I was worried about the health situation of food not being at the proper temperature, especially since I had attempted to eat some. The snack bar has enjoyable convenience food at great prices.

allReviews.title: Comfortable night just outside vegas strip
allReviews.text: Beautiful clean an d spacious room. Disconcerting to walk through lots of slots and casino. Would I go again? Maybe. It is a massive hotel. Service is good but very American. Lots of restaurants and bars but we did not use them

allReviews.title: Great Casino
allReviews.text: Was staying at the Grandview next door but spent a lot of time in South Point. Fantastic and reasonably priced dining options, enjoyed the movie theatre and bowling alley. Great poker room and slot club too.

allReviews.title: Budget-Friendly Vacation Option in  Vegas
allReviews.text: South Point offers a respectable room product and wide variety of dining and entertainment options packed with a number of valuable perks that make this property a great option for budget-conscious travelers.   The hotel offers free airport shuttles and discount drink and meal vouchers at check in as well as a resort fee that is 50% less than the major strip properties.While it lacks the glitz and glamour of the resorts in the heart of the city, it offers all of the gambling options and many other entertainment options including a movie theatre and bowling alley for room rates that are priced well below the strip hotels.So for a Vegas experience at savings that can approach 50% or more compared to the mega MGM / Caesars resorts, this is certainly a property that merits a look

allReviews.title: South Point Warm, Comfortable, and Quiet Relaxation Oasis
allReviews.text: Our annual Mecum Motorcycle Auction visit to the South Point brought us back for another weeklong visit January 20-27, 2020.  After five years, each visit is better than the last.  Nothing much changed since our last long visit, the hotel staff is quietly efficient, everything is spotlessly clean, and the many restaurants are all in good form.  We have a lot of business to take care of during the auction, so we rarely leave the hotel when it's time for a meal.For us and our many friends, we find it hard to beat the Coronado Cafe, which has a very large menu, reasonable prices, and very good food with service to match.  This is a large place with a high meal volume (especially for breakfast) but the line moves fast and the wait never too long.  We also made time to eat many dinners here (look at the Daily Specials) and there is a full Chinese menu available too.  Everything is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,  and if you're dining alone there is a nice long counter with bar stools to sit on.The rooms are very clean and well serviced every day by an attentive staff.  A lot of the rooms on the North side of the building have nice views of the downtown skyline.  During our visit we also ate excellent dinners at Asian Fusion, Don Vito's, and the Mexican place upstairs off the casino floor.  Every meal was perfect.  We all enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning every January to the South Point.  Highly recommended!

allReviews.title: excellent review
allReviews.text: South Pointe is a excellent Hotel and Resort for the whole family.  It has all the amenities for the whole family (great spa, swimming pool for adults, teenagers, and little ones,movies threatre, bowling alley, arcade area, great shows for adults, and a variety of great restaurants.

allReviews.title: This has got to be the best casino in Vegas
allReviews.text: By comparison to the larger chain casinos this one is the best.  It has something for everyone to do, if you like to gamble the odds are better than most.  Like to bet on a game, large sports book, play holdem large poker room.  Rooms are nice, I like that they don't have carpet, so you know what  you are stepping in.

allReviews.title: Great rooms & good food
allReviews.text: Pleasantly surprised at the high quality at South Point! We had not stayed here for several years, as we usually opt for a hotel on the Strip. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and look great. The restaurants exceeded our expectations; the quality of the food and service was very good, especially for such reasonable prices. We had a fantastic meal at Zenshin during their half-price happy hour (and the meal would have still been a great value at full price). We would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Southpoint Casino
allReviews.text: Good casino away from the madness of the main strip has great facilities and Don Vito restaurant is a must. Plenty of parking which is free unlike many on the strip.Has a bowling alley and cinema that offer discounts for over 55's

allReviews.title: Nice getaway
allReviews.text: We stayed here on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. The hotel was decorated nicely. The rooms were spacious and they even gave you slippers to wear. The staff were courteous and attentive. We would stay here again.

allReviews.title: The Coronado Cafe
allReviews.text: As locals, we and our friends, enjoy eating at the Coronado Café at the South Point Hotel and Casino.  Both the food and service keep us coming back!  Had lunch there again last Thursday.  Bet and our guest had Chinese, and I had the Prime Rib Special.  Too much great food at a more than fair price.

allReviews.title: Mecum auction visit
allReviews.text: We stayed here last year, great hotel, not as busy as the strip, check in and out was friendly and easy, plenty of nice restaurants, bars, gambling, hostesses are attentive, Don Vito’s serves the best Lasagna I have ever had, room was clean and tidy, comfy bed, nice products in the bathroom. Hope I get to visit again soon.

allReviews.title: Excellent All-Around, Would Stay Again
allReviews.text: We were very impressed with our stay at the South Point. The customer service was excellent, our room was very spacious, quiet and clean, and the location was perfect, being close to the Strip yet just far enough to way to be out of the chaos. We found the hotel to have everything we could need as well. We took advantage of the movie theater, there was good variety with the restaurants, and the cost-effective buffet definitely hit the spot each morning. We will definitely stay here again on our next visit!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: The room was clean,  housekeeping did a good job. There are a diversity of restaurants (Italian , Mexican, Chinese, seafood, steak houses, huge buffet), The customer service was great, and the have a wide variety of arena events. There also is a spa, pool, bowling alley, and movie theater and gift shop.

allReviews.title: Had a great time
allReviews.text: Casino was busy so did get smokey. Restaurants were great! We especially enjoyed Zenshin. Loved the bowling alley and movies on site. Beautiful pool and hot tub area. No complaints about our room at all.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: It’s a very nice place to stay while visiting the Mojave National Preserve, which is about 60 miles south of South Point. They have several excellent restaurants and a very large casino. Their staff is helpful and very accommodating. We always stay there on our trips to the desert.

allReviews.title: Awesome Day!!!
allReviews.text: Decided to take a break from the Strip and 6 of us headed to South Point.  Plan was to grab some lunch at the Cafe and check it out.  Ending up staying there until midnight.  Cafe breakfast lunch/breakfast was great!  Played blackjack for hours.  Good table minimums and pays 3/2.  They also have double deck pitch was is my favorite.  A couple of us decided to enter the 2 p.m. poker tournament.  Well run, great room!!! Cashed!!  Hit the tables again then we decided to grab dinner at the Silverado Steak House which was recommended by one of the dealers.  Great dinner, nice ambiance, good wine and service,  very reasonable compared to the strip.  Hit the tables again for a couple of hours before taking off.  I believe this will be my new "Go to".  Next trip we will stay here and take the trip to the strip for a day.  Love SP!!!

allReviews.title: Off Strip hotel with Strip feel.
allReviews.text: Large hotel with casino off main part of strip in Vegas. Rooms are large and nice - mine was clean and I liked that they don't have carpet. There was a small fridge in the room. The casino isn't as large as what you would find on the strip, but is brighter and cleaner than those downtown. Drink prices were reasonable. Hotel got mixed reviews from others at the conference I was at, but I didn't have any problems and would stay there again. The only negative from my perspective was that the ventilation system in the casino here doesn't seem quite as good as most of the larger casinos - there's quite a bit of cigarette smoke smell. It isn't overpowering, but if you have respiratory issues it's something to be aware of. There's also a movie theater and a huge bowling alley on site which was fun.

allReviews.title: Rooms Good - Far From Strip
allReviews.text: Stayed during CES 2020. Rooms were large and clean which is the main thing. It is a distance from the main activity and if this suits then it is ideal. The Casino is the usual as expected but is good value for Alcohol versus the strip Casinos. I probably would not stay again but this is only because of the distance from where I needed to be.

allReviews.title: 1 night stay.
allReviews.text: thank you so much for the opportunity to stay in your beautiful and  well known HOTEL AND CASINO.and a  favorite   of so many not only locals; from all the other states and tourist all over the world..   more power.

allReviews.title: Massive hotel
allReviews.text: We got put here last night as our flight was delayed. Very fancy for us, huge place!! Didn't get to experience much just two restaurants. The meal vouchers we were given were a major pain as buffet restaurant had to enter them individually which took over 20 minutes. Then the one place wouldn't take them for breakfast. The smoothie place needed a printed copy so we had to go to the business centre to get them printed! The lady in there was super helpful & fabulous!! Couldn't book seat on shuttle as have to 24 hours in advance, we weren't there 24 hours in advance! Had to laugh as my 15 year son was waiting for his Dad to play his $2 on the slots & told he couldn't watch as under 21. So he took one step back & played on his phone! No problem!

allReviews.title: Steaks and shakes
allReviews.text: I only walked in to kill time but found a restaurant named Steaks and Shakes. An unexpected find that had a really good chili dish. The 5-point chili. It had everything. And they served it over spaghetti noodles. As it turned out, a brilliant decision. Smothered in grated sharp cheddar cheese and cooked to perfection.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Place with fantastic people
allReviews.text: This hotel and their people (staff and hosts) will make you enjoy your stay every time.I've been going to this casino for over 10 years now......never stay anywhere else. We go on average 2 or 3 times per year.  I am a poker palyer...and love their poker room,  My wife loves the bingo hall....and is there almost every session while we are visitingThe people (staff and hosts) are so friendly....and we have made friends with most of them. A lot of them know us by name immediately when we see them....and are always trying to make our trip as great as possible.Want to know how great a hotel is?  Find out what the employees have to say!  All the ones that we talk to have nothing but praise for the owners and managers of the South Point Casino and many have been working there for years and years.Also, if you are a "casual" gambler.......you will be able to eat at the buffet, diner or cafe for next to no cost. They will likely not refuse you this benefit......all you have to do is ASK!!!.   My wife and I have been enjoying this perk for over 10 years. ....and we are not huge gamblers. There point/cash back system is the best that we have found.  Always take advantage of their offers.  My wife always enjoys her Monday bingo sessions because her points have "double" cash value on that day.  She can play bingo almost all day at no cost .. from points earned playing while we were there or maybe points carried fwd from the last trip.....Your points never expire!!!  that I've noticed  anyhow.

allReviews.title: Good if your not interested in strip or downtown.
allReviews.text: Place was clean and the rooms were good sized.  Food is typical, dried out tasteless crap as every other casino.  There is no concierge, there is no shuttle to the strip, which is 10 miles down Las Vegas Blvd.  probably will not stay here again.

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: This is a late review due to holidays and being busy. We originally booked another hotel, which fell through.  I literally booked with south point, the Sunday before Thanksgiving and just 3 hours before we were destined to arrive and I was a able to get in with out a problem. In fact, I was able to cook 2 rooms.  The rooms were phenomenal.  So spacious,  comfortable,  newer looking and quiet.  Since we were staying for a few days, there was so much room to move around and not have to be kn top of one another. I utilized the gym every day, which was awesome. One of the best hotel gyms I have ever seen. It was so nice, clean, roomie and had every piece of equipment along with more than enough treadmills. Usually it's tough to even find an available treadmill at other hotels. We also utilized the spa and barber salon. The staff at the salon were super friendly and my 11 year was happy. We were able to go the movies and had a variety of eating places to choose from. We also were able to leave the kids in the room and feel safe about it while we went to watch games down at the bar. I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone and will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: D3 Hoops Tournament
allReviews.text: No need to leave this resort unless you want to! Plenty of restaurants to choose from, casino, movie theater, bowling alley and bingo. Equestrian arena and sometimes basketball arena. Comfortable clean rooms. Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: A Great Overall Experience!
allReviews.text: Checking in was quick and easy and the girl at the registration desk was delightful.  The room was beautiful, clean and comfortable.  Restaurants were a wide variety, from burgers to steak houses to pasta and even sushi.  The movie theatre was well worth the visit, with large recliner seating and extreme digital (a little loud for me and I had to put cotton in my ears, so beware of that feature)!  Gambling was up and down, as it is in most casinos, but their tables were constantly full and people seemed to enjoy themselves.  The price was right around $100 a night for the room after all the fees were added.  I would definitely stay here again, and because they had so many things available right there, we never left there the three days we stayed!  The coffee shop had excellent coffee and the Coronado Cafe was a great breakfast start to the day.  Enjoy!

allReviews.title: One Night, no more
allReviews.text: Spent one night because weather delay on i15 turned back traffic to CA. Good venue for craps, $5 table, double odds. Crowded, traditional casino format. Cattle-like food courts, prepare to stand in line for mediocre food at mostly every restraunt. Front desk, matter of fact, not friendly but not antagonistic either. Found a lower rate on internet, they made me register on that site to get a 13 dollar difference. This underscores my point. They push people in and out. If you stay, don't anticipate customer attention. In fact, don't expect much, and then you will be OK. Rooms are mediocre, like the beds. Our bed had seen better days. Won't be back here to stay, but then again hadn't really planned to stop here in the first place. Regulars probably like the bingo and movie theaters which is a draw. But then again, the theatre seats are not too comfortable. So, you get what you pay for.

allReviews.title: Not so much
allReviews.text: Although the staff was friendly and the room was nicely laid out, I wouldn't do it again.The bed was really hard and unwelcoming, the pillows matched.  Most importantly, and most disturbingly, the shower produced nothing better than not-quite lukewarm water.Too be fair, when we reported that at checkout, they did drop the $21 resort fee, which was nice.  I'd rather have had a hot shower.We had dinner at the Mexican place.  It was...adequate.

allReviews.title: A Nice Place to Stay
allReviews.text: I'd say it's out of the way, but one can get anywhere from anywhere in Vegas.  This hotel is a few miles from the Strip but we were fine with that.  We stayed at the South Point because it was the venue for a Basketball Tournament we were there to see.  The hotel, itself, is clean, nice rooms, decent restaurants.  We liked that there were movie theaters on-site, as well.  The room was large and mostly quiet.  There were a lot of high school kids at the hotel for various tournaments.  The casino was very kind to me and I came home with my gambling money and then some - even after expenses!  We'd stay again.

allReviews.title: Southpoint December 2019
allReviews.text: As always the Southpoint didn't disappoint. I was in town for a convention and they took great care of us as they do each year. I hadn't tried the deli until this year and I had several meals there and they were all delicious. As well, the banquet food is fabulous even though you wouldn't think serving 800 people could be. No disappointment!

allReviews.title: Thanksgiving 2019
allReviews.text: Great hotel and casino.  Quick check-in.  Large, clean rooms.  Casino had everything you would need.  Great food choices also.  Friendly staff.  I would recommend this hotel and casino for all types of stay.  Family friendly too.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: Our trip was great, the stay was great and the casino was the best, we didn't have to go to another casino the whole 6 day stay. Our next trip will be in Jan or April and we will be staying there. The restaraunts were great places to eat. The staff was helpful and we had a great time.

allReviews.title: BEST HOTEL IN LAS VEGAS
allReviews.text: We absolutely love the South Point.  The Rooms are spacious and renovated; Excellent Variety of Restaurants, Tremendous Equine Events, Courteous Staff, Movies and other activities. We have stayed here since it opened and never been disappointed.

allReviews.title: Awesome as always
allReviews.text: SouthPoint Casino always delivers the best family experience in Las Vegas. There is always something to do there with the family.  Even without the kidos, we always stay at Southpoint.  Best restaurants,  best entertainment,  best payouts on slots!!!! Always come home a winner from Southpoint casino!!!

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: Last minute booking just to break our trip to Grand Canyon.Hotel is not close to the center, about 15 min driving. A bit old but at least the room was clean.More then one night don’t think I will chose this one

allReviews.title: Poor customer service Dated 1bedroom suites
allReviews.text: First I would like to say this is an honest non bias review of th Southpoint hotel. Pros: In house amenities like a bowling alley, movie theater and numerous restaurants. Clean rooms. Free self parking.Cons: Discriminatory,Judgemental service and front desk staff. Poor customer service. Hotel is far south strip. One bedroom suites are very dated. Poor players card system.Poor security, shady characters walking about property.We stayed in a one bedroom suite at this hotel Thanksgiving weekend. I was so excited to get a 1 bedroom as this would be a different experience. As soon as we get to the front desk to check in, the clerk made us wait so she may help a caucasian couple behind us. When she did help us she was very condescending when she spoke to me and my husband. She treated us terribly. Ate at baha Miguel's and the waitress rolled her eyes at us and made an ugly face like she did not want to help us. Then made us wait 20 minutes before she took our order. We ended up canceling our order and walked out. To top it off every time we walked to our room there was a security booth next to the elevator and security kept hassling my husband and making grunting sounds and scratching their throats loudly and asking to see his room key every time we walked to our room as if to say we do not belong there. We did not observe this type of behavior with any other individuals who were not a minority. I have more to say but this review would be too long. I would like to give them another chance but I would recommend staying at another hotel or at least consider other options before choosing this hotel.

allReviews.title: Business and pleasure trip
allReviews.text: Very comfortable hotel, reasonably priced and $2.00 drinks. It’s about a $15.00 Uber ride to the center of the strip. The staff at the South Point is very friendly and helpful, they have good restaurants there anything from a deli sandwich to top of the line restaurants. Highly recommend the South Point.

allReviews.title: Love It!
allReviews.text: I travel to Las Vegas for business each quarter. This has become my go to. Great value, friendly staff , comfortable rooms and great restaurants! I have even caught a movie or two. Love the race and sports book and have even won money on the slots each of  three  times I have stayed there. And don't miss the M Town Review-wow, what an amazing show! Looking forward to my next stay in March!

allReviews.title: Buffet
allReviews.text: We decided to go to a movie and make an afternoon. Lots of choices and always clean. Do we go to a restaurant or buffet?We chose correctly with so many options. Vegan, Vegetarian, halal, paleo and so many varieties.Come on down?

allReviews.title: Another nice experience
allReviews.text: My 3rd visit to South Point Casino. An amazing place. The Italian restaurant, "Don Vitos" was excellent. Even the buffet didn't disappoint. The staff were all courteous, and there is a lot of security, which I always like to see.

allReviews.title: Amazing Casino-You’ll never want to Leave
allReviews.text: South Point has EVERYTHING you need! Well lit casino, beautiful entrance. Great slots, they pay out well. You have a movie theater, bowling, bingo, 11 restaurants, bars, tables, shows, etc! Valet parking is free. It is NOT on the strip, nor is it walking distance to the strip. Youndo need to drive, Uber, left or catch a shuttle there. If you want a place away from the noisy hustle & bustle of The Vegas Strip—this is the place to be!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino!
allReviews.text: We had stayed here previously and returned for a quick getaway!  The rooms are very nice and large and have hardwood floors throughout.  There are 11 restaurants and the buffets are very good.  The Cafe has a late night menu that is less than $5.00.  Lots of slots and tables in the casino.  The price is great if you're not looking to be on the Strip.  (Uber costs about $16 to get to the Strip.)  Definitely recommend.

allReviews.title: A great place to stay with plenty of dining choices.
allReviews.text: The room was spacious enough and while the decor was not "modern", it was neat and clean.  I especially like the fact that there was no carpet in the room (I'm one who believes in strange critters living in hotel carpets).Bathroom was spacious.  Separate sink in one room and toilet w/shower & tub in another room (with door, for those who prefer extreme privacy).AC/heater was working properly and not that noisy.  Check in staff was quick and polite.Hotel/casino was close to the airport.  There is also a plethora of dining choices, and if you're into video poker, there are plenty of those.If you want to be close to the Strip, then this is not the place for you.  Otherwise, I have no complaints.  I try to actually stay away from the people and the strip.  Pricing for food and drinks are also substantially lower here too,

allReviews.title: A chimney
allReviews.text: This place is a Chimney horrible.  A smoker's paradise  and  with food being served  inside a casino do the math.  I just got in town and its  despicable  I will tell everyone  do not come here if you do not  smoke. You will asthma  or bronchitis  after you leave or lung cancer after you leave. 2nd hand smoke is real bell men are pathetic Las Vegas is very overrated

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We have been staying at South Point Hotel and Casino for 8 years or more and have never been disappointed.  The staff are wonderful, helpful and very friendly.  This is a very clean hotel due to the fact they are constantly cleaning everything, including the slot machines.  We would not think of staying any where else in Las Vegas.  The convenience of the location. Easy to get down town.  We do recommend this facility to anyone.

allReviews.title: Ongoing relationship with South Points.
allReviews.text: My wife and I have been visiting Las Vegas yearly for over 15 years. We've been everywhere and seen everything that Vegas has to offer. We love South Pointe because it has everything we look for on our visits. Fine accommodations, great restaurants of every variety, a great casino whether you're a high roller or novice, and a friendly helpful staff. It is not directly on the "strip" but we've done the strip and no longer get excited being in lots of foot traffic and the automobile traffic. Bowling, movie theater, spa and pool area as well as entertainment are all there at South Pointe.

allReviews.title: Our new go-to Vegas destination!
allReviews.text: Loved this place-highly reccommend. Had everything we needed and wanted. We go every year and this year was the first at South Point. For our interests it was perfect. We wont stay anywhere else again.

allReviews.title: Don't leave valuables in your car at Southpoint Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: We stayed at your hotel 11-8 thru 11-11 for a baseball tournament my son was playing in.  On Saturday evening we heard an announcement over the casino PA that our car was broken into.  We contacted security and went to where we parked our car in the open lot outside the hotel.  Our back window had been broken out and they stole my sons baseball bag.  Security told us that the event was caught on camera and recorded the people drive up and smash our window and remove the bag.   I am aware of the signs posted all over the place that South Point is not responsible for damage to any vehicle of theft of items left in the car.  The troubling thing to me is that both on Friday and Saturday when we returned to the hotel we witnessed multiple cases of people hanging out in cars and smoking pot while listening to music.  The security guard also told us that this type of theft happens all the time.   If this is the case why does your casino not employ more strict controls for people entering and leaving the parking lot.  Also, why are people allowed to loiter in your parking lot while security patrols the lots regularly.  The theft happened shortly after we parked the car.  It seems that somebody might have been watching us with my son in his baseball uniform leave our car without his baseball bag.  Why else would they randomly break our window out of all the other cars in the lot.  You are not doing enough to prevent this kind of theft.  You easily could put security points at the exits to the lot to prevent people from doing this.  Again, your security guard said this happens all the time yet you are doing nothing to prevent this. The value of the contents of the bag was nearly $1000 not to mention the cost to replace the window which is coming out of our pocket since it is below our deductible. You should make your customer's even more aware of the potential of theft since it seems to happen often.  Yes it is my fault for leaving the bag in the car, but I thought the risk was low since you seem to be  reputable hotel in a seemingly safe area.  This event really put a damper on an otherwise memorable weekend for my son and family. Hopefully you take this problem serious and do more to protect the property of your paying customers.

allReviews.title: Beautiful casino
allReviews.text: Truly loved our family stay here. It’s very friendly environment. The pool area was beautiful! Loved all the food choices the breakfast buffet with check in coupon is $4.95 it was really good. Steak and shake had 1/2 price milkshakes from 2-5 came to $2.19 for a great mid day snack. The bowling alley and movie theater were great again for a snack in coupon book is a free popcorn don’t have to see a movie to get it. We got to watch a bull riding show in equisetum really big cool place BIG. We took Uber trips to strip there are drivers parked outside never had to wait more then 2-3 mins to get a driver came to $18 RT beats parking fees and driving through the crazies the drivers know short cuts if traffic is bad. It’s right across the street from a McDonald’s and Denny’s but we loved eating at all the choices the hotel had. There is a fridge in room water will cost you $3 a bottle. Big safe and TV in room! I would def recommend this casino it truly has it all.....

allReviews.title: A Week of Bulls and Cowboys, The PBR Finals
allReviews.text: This is a refreshing change from the insanity of the strip and Fremont Street.  Located away, but not far from the strip and the airport it is an excellent location.  We were at the casino during the Professional Bull Riders Final.  A nice sized arena featured bull riding, miniature bull riding and bull fighting finals.  There was a large expo area that was filled with shopping opportunities for the PBR fans.   The staff and dealers are friendly and efficient and everything is clean. Good selection of machines and tables.  For your food- coffee, ice cream, burgers, sushi, steaks, seafood, deli, bakery and buffet.  Bowling alley, large movie theatre are also available.  Most prices were very reasonable.

allReviews.title: Vacation in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I visited South Point an had a wonderful buffet dinner, the service at this hotel is 5 star.I will be their again in December and can't wait.Also the Hotel is so clean.The door man are so polite and friendly, plenty of parking facility, my Grand kids had w wonderful time in the games room, they where their for 2 whole hours.

allReviews.title: very entertaining venue
allReviews.text: their's so much to do there, we when bowling, then there was a rodeo going on and we went there, saw a movie in the afternoon, plenty of places to eat and then we gambled a little later, plenty of bars, easy to get a drink, had a starbucks if you prefer coffee. a hot dog vender for a little snack when you get hungry

allReviews.title: This place is awesome!
allReviews.text: This Casino is just off the Strip, and well worth the drive! The casino is huge, the machines are user friendly. The rooms are comfortable and roomy. The price isn’t bad, and the valet parking is free, just tip the attendants. If you’re tired of the crowds on the Strip, this is the place you are looking for!

allReviews.title: Not accommodating at all!
allReviews.text: This was by far the least accommodating hotel I've ever stayed at. The front desk staff and the front desk manager were not willing to work with me to help me in my situation, not even to come to a halfway point. They were very rude when we were asking what they could do to help. They even suggested that I find someone to go and pack up my stuff in the room. Really?! They were more worried about the next guest checking in than they were about trying to find a way to help me. I will never stay here again. With all the hotels you can choose from in Vegas, do not choose this one.

allReviews.title: Great buffet/ bunch.
allReviews.text: Good omelets they have everything you want in a good buffet. Good pies to, I took my 87 year old mom and they sat us close to the food, I haven eaten there several times. Will stop again well worth it

allReviews.title: An Accidental Discovery
allReviews.text: My husband, a friend, and I were sent to South Point by American Airlines when our flight home was delayed for 20 hours (not that American told us the extent of the delay for a LONG time, and they never admitted that the plane had mechanical difficulties).  We found the casino to be well-lit and clean, with lots of restaurant choices.  Our room was beautiful, far nicer than the rooms we had had at the other two places we had stayed.  (It did smell odd; I think that the flooring was probably newly installed.)  I would consider staying at South Point again, though I would probably play video poker elsewhere.  My only complaint was that when I called to inform the hotel that displaced American passengers were numerous enough to require a second shuttle (as we had already waited 45 minutes for the next one), the woman to whom I spoke refused to send another, so five people had to wait nearly two hours (after already sitting at LAS for 8+ hours) for the next "courtesy" shuttle.  Furthermore, the morning shuttle did not depart early enough to convey us back to McCarran.  (Admittedly, American Airlines should have called the hotel to ask for more frequent shuttle service, but AA's customer service leaves a lot to be desired.)

allReviews.title: Great place but very busy
allReviews.text: We stayed at the South Point in Mid October while in town for an event. The lobby was clean and well kept, staff very friendly at check in which was pretty quick considering how busy they were. Room was great and pretty big, quiet, bed comfortable and large bathroom area. However; there are no towel racks except over the toilet. We had to hang our hand towel and wash clothes on the door handle. The in-room safe also came with a fee. They gave us two coupon books to use around the resort during our stay and they amounted to a nice savings on food and beverage. Casino was nice, but tons of smokers (I really didn't think that many people still smoked) and super crowded even at 0100 in the morning. The two days we were there we couldn't even get on a table. Open slots were far and few between too. Buffet was very good, tons of choices not just for breakfast but dinner also. Fast friendly service and [limited] free adult beverages. On the first night we ate at the Mexican place inside the hotel, food was good, priced reasonable, but the service was super slow and they were not busy. Hotel is a ways from the strip and Freemont, (cost us $22 for Lyft each way to the strip) but I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Spacious Rooms
allReviews.text: Great big room at reasonable price comparable to other hotels in Vegas for a Saturday night.  It could be that it’s a 10-15 minute drive to the strip.  A little away but not far at all.  The room was huge and so was the TV.  A lot of dining options to choose from in this place.  Free parking.  Would not hesitate to stay again.  Had a great time.

allReviews.title: Terrible bed!
allReviews.text: Overall great place to pay, eat & drink but the beds are always awful! I’ve stayed here several times now and finally learned my lesson this last time. ADA room was roomy enough and clean though. Coffee maker in the restroom definitely was a bad idea by who ever thought that up, I would NEVER trust any in room coffee makers and especially not one in the restroom.

allReviews.title: Great venue close to The Strip
allReviews.text: Attending 2 day meetings at Southpoint.  Easy access off highway and near airport. About 5 miles south of the Center Strip so not as busy. However very large property that basically is self contained with very good entertainment and food choices.  Plenty of free parking and valet available.  Meeting rooms are comfortable.  Clean property.  Pleasant and friendly staff.

allReviews.title: Wonderful place to stay
allReviews.text: South Point is a great place to stay if you want to stay in Las Vegas, but don't care for the crowds. This place has everything: Several restaurants, wonderful spa, a multi-screen movie theater, a bowling alley, and more. The casino is one of the best for being clean and not over-crowded. Our room was comfortable and quiet. This was our second time staying here, and we would come here again.

allReviews.title: Very clean, easy to get around inside
allReviews.text: We've stayed at South Point twice and enjoyed our stays both times. It's a smaller establishment, but that works well for us as it's easy to get around and meet up with friends at the different bars and restaurants. The rooms and the entire hotel/casino are very clean. While they do allow smoking in the casino and some bars, the air is evidently well filtered and I never felt like my clothes smelled like cigarette smoke. The Del Mar deli has great deli sandwiches, breakfast platters, and sweets for a good price.  I think it's a good value for the money in Las Vegas and would happily stay there again.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay off the strip
allReviews.text: Stayed there one night and found room and accommodations very nice. Casual dining restaurant was very nice with good food and reasonable unlike many hotel restaurants in Las Vegas. Hotel rates are also reasonable and casino, sports and race book also available.

allReviews.title: great hotel
allReviews.text: We didn't spend too much time here but the room was newly renovated and it was spacious. The staff was friendly and accomendating. The coupon book that we were given upon arrival was a welcome surprised.

allReviews.title: Nice property South of strip
allReviews.text: First time at the hotel  i was there on business for a couple days and found the South Point to be a good location.  The hotel is large with many dining options. Staff were all friendly and helpful with a nice pool area and pool bar/cafe.  Not much of a gambler, the casino was not as smokey as most which was a pleasant surprise.  Rooms also spacious and modern.  I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Fabulous Visit
allReviews.text: Took my wife to the South Point casino and had a great time.  There was a free horse show in there arena and we visited their many restaurants and they were all excellent . We’d definitely go again!  The service was great and the rates were very good, we even won some money!!

allReviews.title: Anniverdary
allReviews.text: We stay at the Grandview hotel - next door. South Pointe is right across from there. Full service hotel.Cute shops, good places to eat, clean and friendly.They have a good coffee place, gambling, and not so crowded like the other hotels.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel off the Strip
allReviews.text: I stayed here for my convention and was glad it was off the strip. I found $5 Black Jack tables and that was a wonderful way to spend my two evenings there.  The people were friendly and fun at the tables.  The food we were served was very good for a convention.  The room was large and clean and very comfortable.

allReviews.title: Fantastic value for money
allReviews.text: We normally stay on the strip but circumstances meant we had to have one night at southpoint..and we didnt want to leave. What a gem of a find.The best buffet we've had from any strip casino and half the price. Great choice of slots and better payout. Smaller pool than we're used to but SO many sunbeds and room to spread out, whereas at Mandalay Bay you have to hunt for a sunbed and virtually sat on top of each other. Great frozen cocktails from pool bar, again half price of the strip.Cinema, huge choice of restaurants, shows, free parking, really friendly, down to earth staff and a much more laid back atmosphere. Quick and easy to get to car and close to I15 and retail outlets.We will 100% be back but for a longer stay. Maybe it's as we are getting older but the main strip is getting too frantic and expensive for us.This has more of an old vegas feel and service which we loved

allReviews.title: A great hotel and friendly staff.
allReviews.text: We stayed here in late Sept. 2019 for 5 nights and loved it.  Newly remodeled rooms that are spacious and very clean.  Love the restaurants, Baja Miguel and Coronado Cafe. The Garden Buffet is also good.  We love that this hotel has really cool things like an Equestrian arena, and we saw a Quarter Horse show for free.  Also saw a movie as this hotel has a movie theater in it.  Giant casino and Free Parking which we love.

allReviews.title: A Great Stay
allReviews.text: This was my first time visiting here. The hotel has easy access from the highway. There’s no traffic like on the main strip. The convention rooms were near the hotel rooms. There’s so many eateries at the hotel. There’s even a movie theater and bowling alley. The staff were friendly. The hotel rooms are huge. And the rooms were clean. I had a great room facing the main strip.

allReviews.title: good hotel for transitioning outside of Vegas
allReviews.text: This is our second stay, so obviously we were satisfied the first time ! But i would not recommand long stays, just for the smell of the lobby ; the smell of smoke (Vegas style) is pretty strong. But we book this hotel because it is a cheap and CLEAN stay when transitionning out of Vegas. The room is very spacious, clean and beds are confortable. Also near grocery if you need anything (Whole foods).

allReviews.title: It's worth the drive to South Point
allReviews.text: South Point is a newish hotel and casino at the very south end of the Strip on Las Vegas Boulevard.  After our first brunch which was excellent we returned for two more meals. The Sunday Brunch Buffet was superb.  The PRIME RIB roast which was part of a full complement of various cuisines and breakfast items is one of the best I have had in any restaurant (and this is at a buffet!). All the food is fresh, constantly replenished.  The dining room is large with the tables a generous distance from each other so diners can enjoy privacy, ease of movement and quiet. The lunch buffet a few days later was also excellent and at $15 one of the most reasonable of the large casinos.  We had a late evening meal at the Cafe.  One of the specials was Prime Rib or Porterhouse Steak for $14.95.  Having been so pleased with the Prime Rib at the buffet I opted for the Prime Rib.  I was not disappointed.  The Prime Rib was perfectly done to order, accompanied by a fresh salad, a large bowl of au jus, and a baked potato with all the trimmings. I can't wait to go back and try one of their restaurants name "Prime Rib".  We did not stay at the resort, but it is definitely worth considering (a modern, clean,airy, easy to navigate casino), all the services of a large  casino and yet one that is welcoming, straightforward  (they don't send you through acres of slot machines to get to registration) and has reat service from all staff.

allReviews.title: Prime Rib Restaurant inside South Point Casino
allReviews.text: South Point Casino is located way south on the Strip...which was nice because it was easy to get to with little traffic...finding a place to park was a different story.  Gaming inside cover all types.  We went mainly for the dining experience in one of several of the Casino's restaurants.  Prime Rib was very good!!  Wait staff was excellent and ensured we never had a dry glass or lacked for anything on the table.  Its worth the trip at least once if you like good prime rib at a reasonable price.

allReviews.title: enjoyed the amenities
allReviews.text: South Pint is off the strip - part of what it nice - the food prices and serving sizes were very reasonable. The food was quite delish - Asian, The Deli - desserts - The Turkey wraps - the Steak n ShakeIt wasn't too smokeyLARGE conference - convention spaceHorse and Show arenaBowling alley and movie theatre alsoLovely pool

allReviews.title: Getaway
allReviews.text: Stayed here a few days ago.This is the first time here. The rooms were very spacious and nice.Pretty views. Large casino and nice movie theaters. Looking forward to my next visit.Buffet was really nice with a pretty good selection of entrees.Free parking is an extra perk.

allReviews.title: Great variety of food restaurants  !
allReviews.text: Good room, good food, rodeo in the hotel, 64 bowling lanes !!! Reasonable prices ! All under  ground shaded valet parking.  Fast service from valet.   Pretty far south on the Vegas strip, but worth the trip if you have a car at your disposal.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Stayed at the South Point last week in September, Check in was quick and easy. Room was good, very clean, as was the bathroom and toilet. The room had a pool view which was nice. The most disappointing thing about the hotel was the pool area, it wasn't up to the usual standards we have had in the past. The pool wasn't very clean, lots of dirt and small pieces of concrete which had come from the pool surround. The sleeve over one of the hand rail was tattered and torn, and there was lots of cans and rubbish around the back part of the pool area. I have never seen this in the past, and that is one of the reasons we returned. So come on South Point get your act together.

allReviews.title: SIMPLY INCREDIBLE
allReviews.text: Wow, what a breath of fresh air this place is!!!From the VERY CORDIAL staff, to REAL DEALERS behind black jack and roulette tables, to an EXTREMELY CLEAN FACILITY and a SUPERB OYSTER  BAR.This place is A MUST VISIT casino in Vegas.The registration staff the casino cashiers staff could NOT GET ANY BETTER....I had a chance to talk to one of the staff members about the owner and she said “he is an incredible and kind man”.My hat of to this gentleman, for an incredible operation and what a compliment from his staff (I have 70 staff, so I can appreciate this comment!This is where I book from now on when I am in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Gregg Austin's M Town & More is a great show
allReviews.text: This review is about the show at the South Point.  Half-price tickets are generally available.  The casino is 7 miles south of the major hotel area on the strip.  But if you are in the area of the South Point, don't miss this show.This is not just a "Motown" review.  It's a review of popular soul music from the late 1950's through Whitney Houston.  The entire experience was good.  Great seating, a dance floor, energetic wait staff, good bar snacks, good drinks.  Of course the major draw is the Motown and more music.  (The only negative, and this was hardly noticeable, is that the band did not have a horn section, and horns have been a big part of this genre.)  All the musicians and singers were great.  We were particularly impressed with the range and precision of William Jordan.  Go get those half-price tickets!

allReviews.title: Always amazing
allReviews.text: We have stayed many hotels in Las Vegas. South Point has everything without the problems of the strip. The strip  great for people watching,  shows and glitz. South Point  has great staff, clean spacious rooms, food burgers to anything you might want .  The pool, showroom, arenas, bowling, movies, arcades are all top shelf.  Hope to stay at South Point many more times.

allReviews.title: Roll on
allReviews.text: South Point this is a very nice place it has everything. The room was very large it was so quiet up on the 17 floor you hear nothing just quietness. When at the Grandview you can use your room key over to get in the pool and so many activities The tv real don't have any god channels watch. This place has so much do check it out.

allReviews.title: We're Back
allReviews.text: Great complex for a short getaway.  The rooms are spacious and newly refurbished.  The airport shuttle was on  time and easy to reserve.  The staff were very friendly and the various restaurants served good food at reasonable prices. The pool area was very clean and had plenty of towels.Great place for a short stay. We will be back.

allReviews.title: Short stay on road trip worst hotel ever
allReviews.text: The vents in the room kept putting out dust and other foriegn debris all over the room, bad for your health. They changed my room and the same thing was happening in that room as well.  If you value your health,  I would stay away for the hotel. The manager promised to waive my resort daily fee for use of the facility amenities. But when I checked out I only had one day waived. The health department in Vegas needs to look into the poor practices that this hotel has. I will definitely be reporting this to the BBB. and the health department

allReviews.title: John H                      Perfect
allReviews.text: I've stayed at many places in Vegas about 15 different ones, there is no place I would rather stay then Southpoint. The place is just set up perfect from the pool area to the casino to the rooms. Parking is free.  The rooms  have a refrigerator which alot of places don't, the toilet and shower are separate from the vanity. The only think I would change is the shampoo and conditioner are in fancy dark tubes which are hard to tell which one is which, they need to have a C or S on the top so  you can tell the difference while in the shower.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel and Staff
allReviews.text: Great Service, Casino, Rooms, Resturants. This is a great place to stay. Away from the Strip but close to everything. Steakhose had Great food and was not out of line in price. Buffet had a large selection of food that was very good. Big rooms with almost instant hot water for showers etc. Resort Fee includes WIFI and parking. Casino had friendly staff that would help you if needed any games explained. Bowling Alley, Movie Theater, Equestrian CenterArena and Pavillion. I will stay here again. Friendly Check in/out and everyone else.

allReviews.title: Negligence
allReviews.text: My father stayed at this hotel. Due to a medical situation he NEEDS a refrigerator. When requesting it from the front desk - I was told, they don’t offer “complimentary” refrigerators. Even after explaining that it was medically necessary  - their response remained the same. They couldn’t/didn’t offer an alternative solution. Seriously, how much would they charge my dad if he needed handicap access? It’s not about the money, it’s about the principle. My father needs to keep his medication refrigerated. But, instead of displaying good customer service - they chose to treat him like a 21 year old that is just trying to keep his beer cold. In my opinion, is absurd! I have never experienced any other hotel that chose not to accommodate someone or anyone. But, especially with medical needs! Are you kidding?It’s unfortunate that in a big city; like Las Vegas, this corporation is unwilling to step up to the competition or have some parallelism in customer service. Particularly with handicap, disabled and/or people with special needs. Absolutely disgraceful- Not that this  means much - but as a family member of someone or anyone that needs “a non-complimentary item” PLEASE, Be Warned- DON’T STAY HERE!

allReviews.title: Easy going!
allReviews.text: Place is huge with lots of sports fanatics and every big screen with every sport for betting. Great place to sit back and have drinks on the house while watching some sports and poker 3/2 table.Food is good and plenty of cocktail waitresses. Great time.

allReviews.title: Very good off the strip casino
allReviews.text: On Las Vegas Blvd but South of the airport. Easy parking or valet. Like their Blackjack tables - two deck or shoe, less expensive tables than the “strip” casinos. Friendly vibes. Good collection of restaurants, don’t have to walk a mile.

allReviews.title: really nice room!
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay.  Very nice.  Other then the lobby/casino getting pretty thick with smoke smell toward the afternoon, the room and amenities were really nice.  I appreciated the new laminate flooring in the room.. Hotel room carpet grosses me out. :/   The floors are CLEAN!  Very clean.

allReviews.title: Hate the vinyl floors
allReviews.text: I was surprised with the vinyl hardwood look planks on the floor of the room instead of carpet It made the room feels like an office and not very comfortable!I’ve stayed here before and it was very nice and that is why I chose this place!We also tried their brunch buffet and was niceI give the buffet a 3.5 starsBut the room 1 star all because of the floor

allReviews.title: Great location south of the strip
allReviews.text: Closest Las Vegas resort to LA.  Great atmosphere and best of all.   Morning breakfast like steak and egg under $5 before 6am.Each room have a kurig single cup coffee maker.  Do bring your favourite to have in the morning

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay off of the strip
allReviews.text: This hotel casino was nice to place to stay away for the hustle and bustle of the strip.  The room was large and comfortable. We ate at the breakfast buffet a couple of times and it's worth the price, lots of choices.

allReviews.title: Great Atmosphere, Service, Food and Shows
allReviews.text: We stay at the Grandview for a week whenever we go to Vegas, which is right next door to the South Point.  As a result, we spend a lot of time in the South Point casino, enjoying their restaurants and shows.  The food at the Delmar Deli is wonderful and we really enjoy having breakfast every morning the Garden Buffet. The shows in their showroom is always excellent.  We have seen Debbie Reynolds, Frankie Avalon, Crystal Gayle, George Wallace, Bob Anderson, Bee-Gees Tribute and Frankie Moreno there, just to name a few.  We saw Frankie Moreno six times now since he is such a great entertainer.  We enjoy him so much that we are going back to Vegas to see him again on New Year's Eve at the South Point, which should be a great show.

allReviews.title: Convenient Location, Great Stay
allReviews.text: As a local, we frequent SouthPoint often because it is convenient to access.  Parking is ample, both complimentary and valet.  It offers a great assortment of entertainment activities in addition to the gambling available.   We enjoy the movies, restaurants and showroom.  Love the showroom as it is intimate in that it is small and the entertainers can easily interact with the entire room as often they do by going into the audience.    We have not recently stayed in the hotel, but when we did the room was very nice and comfortable.  Since then they have renovated so I have no doubt it is just as nice, if not better now.

allReviews.title: Whoooooooooo!
allReviews.text: What a great place to stay OFF the strip which is exactly what my husband and I wanted for his birthday trip to Vegas.  We had a "standard" king size room.  My husband said he just wanted to whole room back home...LOL!  The bed was extremely comfortable, the casino action was awesome and we had plenty of options of eating either in the hotel or we found your routine eating establishments just minutes away (for the budget minded).  The refrigerator in our room was a little small and we wish we ha a microwave in our room.  We valeted our vehicle at every opportunity (no charge) and the bellhops were also EXTREMELY helpful as well.      The ONLY issue we had which we have no control over is the smoking which because it's not contained had a tendency to be super overpowering.  Other than that, we had no complaints and we had a blast!

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Won a free night here and was glad I used it! Friendly staff, beautiful clean rooms and casino floor. Was given a voucher for the buffet and it was the best I have ever had. Every thing tasted great, right temperature on foods and friendly staff.  Had a voucher for a free show and it was entertaining enough. Valet service was excellent too. I would definitely recommend staying here when in Vegas or just stop in to play! They go out of thier way to make sure your happy!!

allReviews.title: Huge but comfortable
allReviews.text: First time to Vegas. This hotel complex is massive, but then everything in Vegas is big and brash.  Room huge (of course) and comfortable, though we had constant thrumming from some machinery. We were on 11th floor. Takes a while to work out where everything is and how to use coupons for free drinks and half price meals. 20 mins from strip but don’t think I’d want to be there anyway, short visits to gawp is enough.  Not into gambling so can’t comment on the casino, apart from to wonder why people do it!

allReviews.title: Dated hotel, needs updating
allReviews.text: Disappointed in this hotel. It was overpriced. While other hotels seemed to have figured out how to filter out the smoke from the casino area so that you don't notice it; this one hasn't, so if you have allergies, it would be best to look elsewhere for accommodations. The pool area was a nice highlight of the trip, but the bar in the pool area closes early. The rooms are spacious, the beds are comfy, the lighting in them is lacking. This is a great hotel if you have an event to attend in Vegas and won't be hanging out at the hotel or, if you're a gambler  who smokes, this is a great hotel for you. This hotel seems to be an island on it's own, so exploring anything 'close by' isn't an option as it is for hotels on the Strip or Fremont.

allReviews.title: Good value for money
allReviews.text: Big hotel with Casino at the south entrance to Las Vegas. It is far from The Strip but just for that reason we choose it. Large comfortable room. The hotel tries to keep you inside the hotel casino by providing a coupon booklet, which gives you good value for money dinner, drinks, and breakfast. If Las Vegas is not your final destination, but you are just on your way to one of the national parks, this is a good choice

allReviews.title: Great place tostay
allReviews.text: One of best hotels in Vegas.  Plenty of activities, movies, bowling and, of course gambling.  Rooms all kept clean and pleasant.  Numerous choices for eating with buffet, Italian, Mexican, steak and cafe all providing tasty food choices.
