allReviews.title: awesome time,
allReviews.text: this was my 1st visit to Vegas... OMG.. I plan on going back at least twice a year from now on.  Beautiful hotel, buffet was crazy delicious.  I didn't get a chance to gamble, because I was there for a basketball tournament. but next visit... going to try some of the fun games !!!

allReviews.title: Fun entertainment off the strip.
allReviews.text: We were looking for a way to avoid the 110 degree Aug. heat and decided to catch a movie. We chose the theater at South Point because it has those very comfy recliner seats. Score! Not knowing what to expect, I was really impressed with the entire place. The theater was clean and very comfortable, the casino was was nicely laid out (I’m clearly not a casino connoisseur, but I would gamble here) and there were a variety of restaurants and non-gambling activities. I would definitely look into staying here next time i’m In town visiting family. I only gave 4 stars because I can not speak to the hotel part of the casino.

allReviews.title: Always worth it
allReviews.text: Great amenities with lots of choices. It is truly an entertainment center and not just a casino. Lots of free parking nice food choices. Great location and easy to get to. Have stayed there many times.

allReviews.title: South Point Stay
allReviews.text: We love staying at South Point every year during the NFR.  We also stay there during the year when we have business in Vegas.  It's off the strip so it's quiet.  The spa is amazing!  Beautiful pool and hot tub and plenty of places to eat and activities on site.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel and casino.  Get best price at front desk.  Called their in house reservations and was told only suites available, went to the front desk and recieved a regular room at 1/3 the cost of the suite!! If you go when equine events are taking place it's a very nice set up, vendors too.  Food down there is not great but restaurants in hotel are amazing.  Great casino with slots, poker and table games.  Will definitely stay there again. Oh! You can watch events downstairs on tv in your room too. And the pool is gorgeous!!

allReviews.title: Big clean rooms
allReviews.text: We recently enjoyed our stay at Southpoint. The rooms were a great size and clean. The air however lacked as it doesn't blow towards the beds, bummer since it's 110 degrees outside. We ate at Coronado Cafe and Steak n Shake, both were great! We didn't have any luck on the slots but enjoyed our stay and will be back!

allReviews.title: A stay at the South Point Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: This is a great place to stay in Vegas far enough away from the crazy strip but close enough to enjoy all Vegas has to offer. The hotel is Hugh and the staff is all friendly, good casino games and lots to do for the whole family. The Prime Rib Restaurant is Fabulous, rooms are clean and well supplied. I Give This Place a 10

allReviews.title: Nice facility, lousy craps crew
allReviews.text: My buddies and I were doing a quick Casino hop the other day. We decided to start with South Point since we had all heard a number of good things about the place. The casino seems nice, clean and well-lit. Drinks service was quick enough. My big knock on the place was the surly craps crew. If you want gamblers to play there, perhaps you should have better dealers. I don't mind if you have to tell me that you want me to change something about the way I'm shooting, but do it in a nice way. No point in being a jerk.Yes, I was tipping, by the way. We weren't going to be there long but my tipping would most certainly have dried up given the behavior of that crew.

allReviews.title: Vegas Break!
allReviews.text: Have stayed here several times. Everything is here in one resort!  You can easy spend your time here for several days. Several price point restaurants.  Always have had excellent food and service. Beautiful pool. My upgraded room was freshly done and spacious!  If you’re into the highest 4 star hotel this would not be your choice.  You may want to rent a car or be prepared for taxi fees!  I’ve been to Vegas so many times and many hotels!  South Point I keep coming back to! Their promotions are excellent!

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Was visiting from the UK and stayed 6 nights at planet Hollywood, our flight was cancelled and the airline put us at the south point hotel for 24 hours, I have to say it was fantastic, I enjoyed staying here more then the strip, had a real American feel rather then tourist areas of the strip. Swimming pool was great, food was good and also much cheaper. Thank you for making our last 24 hours in Vegas a great time

allReviews.title: I could have spent my whole vacation in this place.
allReviews.text: If you want a great time in Las Vegas without the hassle of the Strip, South Point is the place. Beautiful hotel and casino.  Room was spacious and very comfortable.  Six restaurants.  From expensive to very reasonable and all the food is about average.  Includes bowling, movie theater, and a full equestrian arena.  Favorite restaurant was the Coronado.  Name entertainment in the showroom.  We will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: The good and the bad under one roof !
allReviews.text: This venue is teriffic, with amenities for every class. Quiet, many restaurants, good Uber,Lyft and taxi services, shuttle to and from McCarran.HOWEVER, spending $1,300 on a dinner for 8, Michael's will be the last on our list of destinations. Food was absolutely excellent.  To be affronted with the arrogance, bum's rush to vacate, derision by wait staff who cannot speak English,do not know what Vodka or Gin are, let alone labels available in the house, and hurried presentation of courses to bring our event to a close....My advice: go to the Silverado...at least THEY appreciate clients, and at 1/3 the price.Michael oughta try an incognito arrival.  Reservations mean nothing, too. My money is as green as anyone's, and I expect the same respectful accommodation I afforded your house, playing by your rules.Avetque Vale.

allReviews.title: great time
allReviews.text: My friend and I stayed at South Point for the first time.  When we checked in we were given a room that overlooked a dumpster.  We immediately returned to the front desk and were given another room with a better view. The dinner and breakfast buffets were delicious and varied.  It was a nice touch to get a coupon book at check in for 1/2 price off the buffet along with many other savings.  There were a lot of slot machines that aren't in any other casino.  A special thank you to Randi at the front desk.  We look forward to returning soon.

allReviews.title: Fantastic for families
allReviews.text: We have just returned to the UK after spending 2 weeks at the south point. Myself, fiancé and 2 boys aged 6 and 13.The hotel room was lovely and spacious, we had a room that has just been renovated on the 7th floor. The pool area was clean and there are plenty of sun loungers available. Entrance is by proof of room key so only hotel guests can use the pool. Towels are provided and there was always plenty. The south point it ideally located if you don’t want to be on the strip and Uber’s we’re always available and not expensive to get to and from the strip, malls and entertainment. Whilst at the south point we enjoyed the cinema, bowling and the Namco amusements for the children. We also ate at a lot of the restaurants, we used the buffet every morning for breakfast and occasionally in the evening. The buffet was fantastic, always a huge selection of fresh hot food so everyone was happy. We also dined at primarily prime rib and the silverado both restaurants were amazing and really reasonably priced. We try to visit Las Vegas every 2 years, this will definitely be the hotel of choice.

allReviews.title: South Point
allReviews.text: On this trip we used South Point for are finale stop before getting into California.  I like the location of the hotel as I am on the south part of town and traffic not as bad.  We arrived early and got in quick (people who arrived later on this Friday night not so lucky).  Room was clean and I had not issue.  It appears there is a lot of remodeling going on.  I also am a fan of there parking garage.  I do not understand why other business do not use the plan.  The only issue I have is that when you are exiting a floor the sight is somewhat restricted, which could be fixed with a minor adjustment.I also like the room rates, hope the remodeling does not change that.  Sorry to say I didn't win a thing.

allReviews.title: Nice and convenient
allReviews.text: I stayed at the South Point Hotel and Casino for a training seminar. This hotel has a very nice fitness center that has cardio, some free weights and exercise machines. The pool is nice but pretty shall. There is a bowling alley and theaters upstairs, and they have a $4 movies for people over the age 50. Parking is free. Overall the hotel is great. Beds are comfortable, rooms are quiet, and spacious. The buffet was good at a reasonable price. There is a great early bird breakfast.

allReviews.title: Great entertainment.
allReviews.text: Went for the evening entertainment and also enjoyed the casino and dining. They have a wide variety of live theater shows one can take in. The location is out a bit but worth the trip! Try it for yourself.

allReviews.title: My New Favorite Place to Hangout
allReviews.text: How to start , hmm. First off I wish I had memorized all the helpful superior customer service Employees that made me decide to drive 3+ hours 1 way (weekly) to spend time there. I will make sure to get them in my next review. DJ I did happen to remember, My morning started off at the Rio where I had went down to gamble at 10 am. We had to check out at 1 pm and I was hoping to get 2 good hours in before I had to leave. When I got to the tables, they were all closed down except for a scam table to take your money. I asked for them to open up another table and they said no. Not till 12. I was playing with 4k on their tables pretty solid the night before and when I asked for some food they also declined me. I had 8k in my pocket to play with that morning. So grumpy, I drove to south point hoping I could get 1 and a half hours of play before leaving. When I got there, i asked for a max bet limit to be raised and they declined (South Point). I decided to play anyways . After a few hours, somehow I got into a conversation with the dealer and was explaining about being declined for food. DJ overheard and interjected, offering to help with request. He helped me get a comfortable rate for the night and provided outstanding service. The rooms are good size , clean , some have nice views. Ac works well, they have room service. Some of the reasons I love this place are, Its right off the freeway- easy to exit/enter. There's little to 0 traffic in the area. Less likely to get pickpocket as it's not as crowded. There aren't any hookers roaming the floors( sorry for some guys) family safe. No one is peddling sex fliers anywhere near the hotel . They have a awesome juice , icecream smoothie,  crepe place. They also have a nice cafe (Stay away from the filet mignon ewww) breakfast was good and chicken noodle soup. Very reasonably priced (won't be walking crooked leaving this place) there is also a nice spa (massages little over priced but very good) I haven't eaten at the Steakhouse yet, but the fact they have one is awesome. The only thing I could hope for that they don't have is a Smoke Free pai gow room or card room. Imo this is really the best place to stay in Las Vegas. Sincerely Aja Shaw.

allReviews.title: Nice place for a stay-cation!
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed the South Point.  First, really nice room - it was immaculate and very spacious.  Our room overlooked the pool area.  We appreciated that the bathroom had two rooms to it - one with the toilet and tub/shower, and the other with the sink.  And we could still close the door at the sink area to have some privacy from the room.  It wasn't open like most hotels.  The food was fantastic, the drink service was ok however we thought they catered to the tables (we are slot players).  But overall it was a nice stay.  Very nice property.

allReviews.title: Unique Casino with an Equestrian Arena. Show: Gladius.
allReviews.text: For the most part we enjoyed the beautifully appointed hotel. The room was spacious and clean (but had a lousy view of a wall). Our initial impression was negatively impacted by the inability to make the airport shuttle hotel connection which was stated to be included in the resort fee. We called on arrival at the airport and were given poor directions to the meeting point. (The shuttle leaves only from terminal 1 and we landed at terminal 3 but this was not clarified until the second call to the hotel.) The next shuttle was not for another hour and a half. Really? Taxi's are not inexpensive in Las Vegas but waiting around the airport for so long was not acceptable.	We went to see a fabulous equestrian acrobatic variety show: Gladius the Show, in their great equestrian arena. There appear to be many  shows in this unique venue. 	The casino was large and not crowded but still was noisy and smoky. Many restaurants at various price points are available. I spent a few minutes in the large freeform, outdoor pool and although the water was cool it was quite refreshing.  I find the practice of charging a large resort fee to be unacceptable  (especially when we were not able to use the included service of the airport shuttle) although this seems to be the norm in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
allReviews.text: Our original booking for Las Vegas was with a different hotel on the Strip. We decided last minute to go a day early and leave a day later. Our initial hotel couldn’t accommodate us on these extra dates so we decided to book a different hotel for these two days only. We found an exceptional deal for South Point on Hotwire inc resort fees for our first night. We were so impressed with the refurbished bedroom, the child friendly floor with bowling, cinema and arcades on the second floor that we decided to return for our last day in Las Vegas also. Unfortunately, on our last day we checked into a room on the 6th floor that was dated and had a terrible odour. I called front desk to say how disappointed I was as we had only booked to return because of the nice room we had during our first visit on floor 10. Front desk explained that their refurbished rooms are only on floors 9-19 and if I wanted to move I had to pay an extra $10 plus taxes. I explained that I had the same room rate for both bookings so why two different rooms? He said there was nothing he could do even though he said there was lots of availability. I paid the extra money because my family and I couldn’t have spent the night in the room.  We changed to a refurbished room on floor 19 which was great although I could definitely smell smoke on this non-smoking floor.Hotel is very affordable, has a lot for kids to do and the pool is huge!  It is a good 10/15 min drive from the main Strip and be aware of the rooms that aren’t refurbished yet!

allReviews.title: Comfortable and clean
allReviews.text: This is my yearly solo trip to Las Vegas.  For the last 3 yrs. I stayed downtown at the Golden Nugget and was very disappointed in it last year.  It's gotten really sleazy and dirty down there--I needed a change.  To be honest, I was a little worried that I might feel a little isolated or even bored at South Pointe because it's a distance from the strip.  I did not--I loved it! Nice, clean room (premium room w/view); good food (reasonable) excellent blueberry pancakes; very generous poker machines (VERY GENEROUS)!  Everything was great--one of the  cleanest casinos I've ever been in.  VERY comfortable.  I didn't even get a chance to go to a movie or play bingo, I was doing so well on the machines.  I hope I didn't just jinx myself.  I am looking forward to coming next year, if not sooner.

allReviews.title: Nice Rooms, Great Value
allReviews.text: This hotel is about 2 miles south of the Strip, but could just as well be on the Strip, in terms of size, massive casino, huge buffet, clean, well appointed rooms and so on.  However, because it is off strip, expect everything from dining to entertainment to be more budget friendly.  All in all this hotel can be great for a business trip of a family vacation.

allReviews.title: BEST SPA DEAL IN VEGAS
allReviews.text: My friends and I meet up in Vegas several times a year and we always get in a few massages each trip.  I’ve been to all the major Hotel Casino Spas.   I always stay at the Wynn.  This is the second time I’ve been to the South Point Spa and while the hotel is not for me, the spa is in my opinion the best deal in Vegas. This trip we also went to the Four Seasons Spa and so we were able to witness a back to back comparison.   South Point was vastly superior to the Four Seasons. Shockingly the Four Season Spa offers no Safe for your personal valuables, the lockers are just thrown into an open area and the “lounge” is in the middle of a hallway where you are left to stare at a Colin with utility lights and a switch. There is no television and no magazines. And no door. The South Point facility offers a jacuzzi, steam room, large and very inviting lounge with beverages, televisions and magazines and so. I hope more. The clincher was the quality of the massage and mani-pedi. Joanna is an exceptional massage therapist and really knows here stuff. Claudia is equally proficient with her services.  I look forward to returning frequently and will definitely request Joanna and Claudia.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Fantastic place for reasonable price. Big rooms with Harwood floor, refrigerator and enough room to welcome 4. Clean, great service and only 12 minutes from main strip. If you have rent car don’t waste your money to book hotels on the strip get better deal and service here for affordable $$

allReviews.title: Nice place if you’re not dragging bags
allReviews.text: Nice rooms. Great staff.   A pool that stays open in the evening.  A book of coupons including half off a buffet.The major drawback is how far you have to drag bags on carpet to get to the rooms.  It is forever from the front desk or parking lot.

allReviews.title: Great hotel just off the strip
allReviews.text: I went here for a trade show at this hotel but also stayed here and it didn't disappoint. HUGE place, lots of restaurants with real nice food at a low cost (compared to anywhere else in vegas) breakfast was nice and staff are all friendly. An uber into the strip is about $14 so very reasonable. Gambling, good food, friendly staff, & very comfortable spacious rooms. What else is needed. When I'm back at the show next here I will be staying here again!

allReviews.title: Great place for smokers
allReviews.text: The renovated room was very nice, on a non smoking floor.  Everywhere else, ick.  Have to walk by people smoking playing slots in the halls on the way to restaurants, going up escalator to convention center has smoking area right where you the escalator ends.  Pool wasn't crowded, but the lounge chair covers were either worn and faded or stained from other peoples sweat.  Trade show at same location next year, won't be staying there again.  My throat is all scratchy and feel like crap after 3 days there.

allReviews.title: Family Friendly Place
allReviews.text: I did not stay at the hotel this time but I wanted to see what this casino had to offer for a possible future visit/stay.  Heard about it through a friend so I wanted to check it out during my most recent stay in Vegas.  First, the front desk clerk allowed me and my companion to view a room.  She summoned a security guard to escort us up to the room to view.  Both, the desk clerk and security guard were friendly and supplied us with lots of valuable information on when would be good times to return and when to avoid.  The room was newly remodeled and very nice!  Nothing on the luxury end but very nice and comfortable looking room.  The room that we viewed actually had hard wood floors!!!  Never saw a hotel room with hard wood floors. That's a plus for those with allergies.  We then had Sunday brunch at the buffet.  The price was very reasonable and they had a huge selection of items for brunch including bottomless mimosa's made fresh (which was complementary with the buffet).  They were very good and I believe I drank 6 of them!!!  The buffet items were very tasty especially the carvery station.  The prime rib was tender/juicy and they would cook very generous portions well done upon request.  I am a huge fan of Seattle's Best Coffee and they had a coffee bar with that brand (Rare Find).  It is a nice change from all of the Starbuck's everywhere.  I do plan to return for Thanksgiving and stay at this property.  Close to the heart of the Strip but far enough away for some quiet.  Shoppers will love that it is only a few blocks from a premium outlet mall!  Minutes from the airport and highway access!

allReviews.title: A Pleasant Surprise After a Cancelled Flight
allReviews.text: We ended up at the resort due to a cancelled flight. We stayed in a 2 queen bed room that was newly renovated. Very nice view of the mountains. The resort was very big. Lots of restaurants, bowling alley, movie theatre and pool. Can highly recommend the ice cream shop. made and excellent milkshake.

allReviews.title: Family friendly
allReviews.text: I stopped here with my kids as a half way point on our way to Southern California. I had been wanting to stay here for awhile due to all the amenities offered and how family friendly they are. We just stayed one night but really enjoyed it! The pool was huge and a very nice relief from July temps. The shallow wading pool for younger kids was nice too. We did stay on a Thursday night and is probably why it wasn’t super crowded. Also why I got such a great rate for the room too! The room was huge!! Just your basic hotel room but very comfortable and spacious. The buffet for dinner was great too. Lots of options and a good price! I wish we explored the arcade, bowling, arena space, and movie theater but we were all very tired after swimming and dinner. I would stay here again! We travel through Vegas a lot so this will be on our list to stay and explore more!

allReviews.title: Meh...
allReviews.text: It is a nice enough hotel/casino, but that's just it. There's nothing that really, "Wows"! That said, if you wanted to, you wouldn't really have to go anywhere else, because this place has everything on the property.Now for the bad part. The room I was assigned was, well let's just cut to it,...bad! It was just barely clean enough for me to say screw it, I'm only sleeping here anyways, but I was not impressed. If I wasn't involved in a tourney at another property and would be gone for the better part of 16+ hours, I would have complained and requested another room. My point is, why should I have to complain about what is supposed to be your best effort anyways, in the hopes of maybe another random room will be better maintained and clean?I think not. Not when there are a dozen or so properties on the strip and a couple downtown that would definitely have you going WOW! for the same price. Just sayin'.Oh, and the pic attached is of the maintenance guy who came by 10 min after I get in the room, to clean the A.C. coils, ...yay!

allReviews.title: Great Place, Everthing under 1 roof
allReviews.text: Stayed there for the first time this last trip. I have been to Vegas Many times and have stayed at some of the best places on the strip. I will always stay at South Point every time I go going forward. The rooms were great, very clean and spacious. The staff was wonderful and very helpful at all times. From what I understand, there is always a lot going on there. This trip there was 2 bowling tournaments and a beauty contest as well as a western Convention/Show. You don't have to look far to find what you are looking for.

allReviews.title: Not a good value
allReviews.text: Checked in with a Priceline reservation and are now in a room overlooking their garbage dumpster with a 25 minute wait for our luggage to arrive to our room. Save yourself the hassle and book somewhere else. A call to front desk indicated we can pay more for a better room. Will not come back here or recommend.

allReviews.title: Good times roll!
allReviews.text: South point is a great casino with many restaurants to chose from. The buffet offers many fish or seafood options. Fresh clean veggies and fruits. The gaming is awesome. Many machines lots of tables. Always attentive staff.

allReviews.title: It was fine...
allReviews.text: You get what you pay for....What I like about South Point was it was affordable and off the strip.  But...it was very plain.  Nothing blew me away.   We stayed at the Mirage earlier in the week, and I found the Mirage to be cleaner and more upscale.  At the Mirage, we had a room with 2 kings.  At South Point, we can only get 2 queens, and they felt like 2 doubles.  My wife and I basically both had to speed sideways.   I will say, I did like the feature of the South Point room bathrooms, where the toilet area was sperate from the sinks and mirror.   As far as the casino, I found it a little more smokier than most.  The dealers were professional and there was prompt servers.  I also found the in house restaurants to be adequate.   The pool was nothing special.  No slides or fun area, and the pool was ice bucket cold.   Like I said, the South Point was fine...but nothing was great.

allReviews.title: South Point Buffet
allReviews.text: We have visited this casino many times in the past ten years, usually staying at the Grandview next door.  We visited again last week, meeting several friends for their lunch buffet.  The buffet is huge and offers many choices[, from soup to seafood.  It's clean, well organized and has a pleasant atmosphere.  I will not hesitate to vist here next time in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Many photos added.  Excellent stay
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for one night.  Large room, nice bathroom, comfy beds, many TV channels, great 24/7 gym, great pool and very friendly staff.  Our room had a great  view of the pool.  Many great restaurants, nice bowling center and movie theaters. Very large casino with low table minimums.  Great Race and Sports Book open 24/7. I will return.  I added many photos of or stay.

allReviews.title: South Point 7/1 - 5
allReviews.text: Best value in all of Vegas, good eats, plenty of 5.00 tables, great pool and unlike the main strip, you won’t gouged. Movie theater a nice break away from the action along with a bowling alley if that’s your thing. 2nd trip here and will never stay on the strip again.

allReviews.title: A nice stay at a pretty nice hotel
allReviews.text: My family (6 in total) stayed here from July 4-July 7. We needed a handicapped accessible room for my mother and called the hotel directly to arrange. We told the hotel rep that in the room we needed some type of comfortable chair for my mother to sleep (she's recovering from a broken shoulder and not able to sleep in a bed). The hotel rep assured us that the handicapped room had that.The room itself was very big and had a roll-in shower, grab bars in the shower and next to the toilet, and lower light switches (and even a lower peephole in the door) to accommodate someone who would be in a wheelchair. What it didn't have was a comfortable chair. The chair provided was uncomfortable and not suitable for sitting for long periods of time and the hotel said I must have misunderstood what the hotel rep told me. They were willing to provide a rollaway bed (which wouldn't have really helped us) at an additional cost so we improvised but felt that perhaps our needs had been misinterpreted or misunderstood by the hotel.The positive things were that when we checked in about 4:00 pm on July 4, despite having about 30 people in front of me at the check-in counter, I didn't wait more than 10 minutes to check in. They had a lot of staff available to check guests in and their process was very quick. It would be nice if they also had check-in kiosks like other hotels (the Rio and Harrahs, for example) do for someone who didn't want to stand in line. It's a fairly long walk from the check-in desk to the elevators and it's right through the casino (unlike some other Vegas hotels we've stayed in). Both bell service and valet parking were great and very quick. My mom was using a walker and when she became tired, we called bell services who told us they provided complimentary wheelchairs to guests which was a huge help in getting my mom around the hotel and into restaurants. We've stayed at other hotels that charged up to $25 per day to rent a wheelchair so this is a lovely perk that South Point provides.The pool area, although crowded, was clean with plenty of chairs and lots of room to move around. Another nice touch in South Point is that they have a movie theater with about 8 screens showing movies all day long (although we experienced an aftershock from the LA earthquake while in the movie theater on July 5!) There are plenty of food choices and I particularly enjoyed Steak and Shake, which is not available when I live. Delicious burgers at reasonable prices.There's also a great ice cream shop and a breakfast/coffee bar close to the entrance of the hotel at pretty reasonable prices.Although not on the strip itself, South Point is a fairly short drive to the strip. It was reasonable priced and they treated us very well. When we needed extra towels or to have our room serviced by the cleaning staff later in the day than normal, they were very accommodating.We'd definitely head back there again if we were able to get a slightly better price than we did for this long weekend.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Nationals
allReviews.text: Having the arena attached to the hotel makes the stay SOOOO convenient!...we have a 16 month old baby and if she gets tired or crabby my wife can easily take her up to the room. Also having the event on the TV’s in the room let’s you know where you’re at so you know when your next to go race...and the Southpoint is a very new place and is very nice. This is our 5th time staying at the Southpoint, we like it very much. Although one thing that bothers me is that I am refused the room rate at which others have been given. My fiend was given a room for $88, I have to pay $146, and the person at the person at the front check in desk was very much a smartass about it saying I “wasn’t enough of a high roller” to to be given that rate...

allReviews.title: Yes but actually ... no
allReviews.text: Pros: Several things to do: spa, movies, "restaurants", outdoor pool (closed in February)Big casino Fast check in/outCons: Room: Old rooms smelling old carpet. No balcony and it was impossible to open the window. I paid an extra fee for the "mountain view" and all I got was parking view. The worst: Far away from the strip. A shuttle bus is available, but it's not free (9 US per person), that means: 36 US for 2 people to go and come back from the strip. Since last bus leaves by 1 am, forget the party in the strip. There's nothing interesting around the hotel, we wanted to go for a walk, but we were back 15 minutes after. I was not looking for a fancy hotel, but this old carpet and cigarette smell was disgusting. Lesson learned.

allReviews.title: Loved this place
allReviews.text: My parents, my husband and I stayed here for a bowling tournament. This place did not disappoint! They have everything you could possibly want and give you service with a smile.We utilized the airport shuttle transfer and had no problems with that at all. They tell you where to be and you can’t miss the big blue shuttle. Check-in was super easy and the hotel held our luggage until our room was ready. We were actually able to go to our room before the check-in time so that was a big plus. We stayed in the spacious 2BR 2BA suite. Nice layout with a living room/kitchenette separating the two bedrooms. Kitchenette has a small sink and small refrigerator but enough room for what we needed. The refrigerator was stocked daily with complimentary sodas, juice, and water. The living room area had a comfortable couch and chairs as well as a large dining table. Each bedroom and bathroom, living room and kitchenette had its own TV for a total of 6 TVs in all. One bedroom had a king bed. The other had two queen beds. Beds were very comfortable. The bathrooms were huge and beautifully designed. The windows were huge and provided beautiful views from the top floor.Plenty of good food choices, though the prices are on the higher side. We tried each restaurant at least once (except for the oyster bar because we don’t like oysters.) All of them were great and gave us plenty of food. We were so stuffed that we usually ate 1 or 2 meals a day and just had snacks the rest of the time. We also prefer Pepsi products and had no problem finding the best drink ever, Diet Mtn Dew, lol.Gift shop was nice and had t-shirts, souvenirs, and plenty of candy, snacks, and beverages.My father had his shoes shined. The guy did a great job and someone regularly staffed the lobby to provide this service.We walked around the equestrian area, the fitness center, salon, and pool even though we didn’t utilize them. My husband and I saw a movie at the on-site theater. Plenty of typical movie theater food, comfortable seating, and lots of options for current movies offered at various times. There are two bowling areas. One for amateurs that has a snack bar. The other is for the tournament which is where we spent most of our time. The seats were very comfortable, nice layout, and venues for t-shirts, bowling supplies, and snacks. Bring a jacket if you’re cold-natured like me.We are not gamblers, but had some fun watching those that did. The casino is in the center of everything but we had no problem getting around it or through it to get to where we needed to be. I am very sensitive to the smell of cigarette smoke, but this casino does a great job of filtering the air. Unless you are right next to someone who is smoking, you probably won’t even notice.There are also plenty of escalators, elevators, stairs, and bathrooms. Occasionally, the elevators were full or we had to wait, but most of the time this was not an issue.I really can’t say enough good about this place. I describe it as a cruise ship without the ocean - they have everything you need to have a safe, fun trip without ever having to leave the hotel. We did leave to do some sightseeing, but the majority of our time was at the hotel. We will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Amazing complex
allReviews.text: This casino has gone to another level if you enjoy equestrian events and bowling for fun and bowling in Tournaments. Obviously there are aspects such as great rooms amazing places to eat and gambling.  The bowling plaza is host to the National Bowling tournament and many other Pro and Amateur Events. Reno was the first to house a complex (satin) for bowling quite an amazing facility and now South has that same type complex exclusively for tournaments. Not to be left out if you wish to bowl recreationally the casino also offers bowling in a complex for fun. The buffet, Coronado restaurant , and two more exclusive eateries r amazing. I was a Video Poker lover and did well on 5 machines which offered triple Double and they took them away.  They offer a variety of slots.

allReviews.title: A Great Casino in the Tradition of Old Vegas
allReviews.text: We saw this place on our way back from the Grand Canyon yesterday and their sign outside caught my attention when it claimed 99 percent payback on slots. We visited South Point Casino today and loved it! The casino was clean, paid out a few bucks,  and has a great buffet. The food was hot and tasty without exception.  And it didn't cost an arm and a leg like strip casinos do. I wish we has stayed here this week instead of the lousy strip pyramid (take a guess) we stayed at, with no evidence of anyone winning anything on ANY slot. Finding out the hard way that SP had breakfast for a only few dollars was a revelation to me, after paying $33 for coffee and a pastry at the place that Sphinx (take a guess). Great Job, South Point! I wish we had found you sooner!

allReviews.title: A hidden Gem in plain sight
allReviews.text: Went for the USBC Bowling Tournament held at South Point. Have been to Vegas many times and have never heard of this place, boy wish we would of heard of it earlier. It's going to be a stop everytime we are in Vegas. Spacious, very clean and all the staff were very helpful and happy to do it. Very large facility that holds many events all year long. Rooms were at a nice price and very roomy and clean. The restaurants which were many inside, were all great and some being fantastic. Glad we found this hidden gem and will return next visit.

allReviews.title: Renovated Rooms with new EV Chargers
allReviews.text: Full disclosure, I spent 2 nights comped based on my wife's slot play (she was with me).  We have been a few times before but this was the first stay in the renovated rooms.  I do like the new flooring.  The rooms will stay and smell so much cleaner now with floors that can be deep cleaned and will dry so fast.  The rooms were as usual uncannily quiet even for a weekend.  I slept great.  The bathroom was fine but I did not use it because I was in the Spa the whole time.  My last review I wished they put in EV chargers and they did.  3rd floor now has nice big clearly marked 4 spots of EV charging.  It appears to be complimentary.  It is a fantastic touch and now makes South Point a "go to" hotel in Vegas if only because I can wake up to a charged EV for the day (my work).  We also had great service as usual from the staff.  I had a great stay and will be returning.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Our stay was great!  Affordable, clean and friendly people (specially housekeeping) I asked for some extra sheets and towels and they were very helpful, in other hotels most of the time housekeepers are rude and they always seem to be overwhelmed but, here they are actually nice. The food is delicious with many different options. We also loved the discounted movie tickets on Tuesday.Thank you so much

allReviews.title: Everything you need in one place!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the South Point for the National Bowling Tournament.  The room was great, we ate at 5 different restaurants and the food was good at every one (there were more but we didn't get to them), and the slots eventually paid off well. The shuttle to and from the airport was pleasant, but I thought it could have run more frequently for such a big hotel.  The weekend brunch at the buffet included mimosas and they were delicious.  The only real drawback is the location - being so far away from the strip and downtown made it hard to leave (which probably was the intent) but I think providing a shuttle to and from a few times a day would give guests an option that would increase the overall rating for the facility.

allReviews.title: Lots of things to do inside this hotel
allReviews.text: The room was very nice, and the view was great looking at the mountains. There is bingo, movie theaters, bowling alley, various restaurants and of course slot machines and poker! The staff is very helpful and friendly.

allReviews.title: Don’t play the slots
allReviews.text: The table games were okay. No bonus bet on craps. The slots were so tight could have turned coal into diamonds. You win $20-25 and loss $50 right after before winning a couple cents. Didn’t stay in the rooms. Our club card failed most the time so I’m sure we didn’t get very many points.  Very disappointing.

allReviews.title: Quick Getaway
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our clean & quiet room, free slippers & dining options.  They were even able to check us in early since we had an early arrival! We didn't gamble much since we were in town for a memorial. Close to the freeway. Lots of activities on site(movies, bingo, events, etc). I'd definitely stay here again if I wanted something off the strip.

allReviews.title: Top notch!
allReviews.text: First rate casino, restaurants, bars, and hotel. Rooms were real nice, all the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful, the food was good, everything clean and well maintained. I can’t wait to go back again.

allReviews.title: Stopover after cancelled flight.
allReviews.text: Stopped here because we were put up here after our flight was cancelled.If it was for this fact we would have probably enjoyed the hotel.It is a big hotel with many places to eat but we didn't get to try any of them. The casino is large with many games but we didn't get chance to play any.The room though, was huge and very nicely finished. The bed was comfortable and everything was very clean. The room was far bigger than the standard rooms in the Vegas strip.In other circumstances we may have enjoyed the hotel but we only had enough time for a nap and a freshen up.

allReviews.title: Large rooms and excellent convention facilities
allReviews.text: The good:  large rooms, nice pool area, many restaurants to choose from. The okay:  Five miles+ from Mandalay Bay and the Strip The bad:  Housekeeping was not at their best for this trip.  When I arrived at my room, there was a small box filled with empty alcohol bottles outside my room.  My room was cleaned late each day (even with the please clean room tag inserted one day).  Today I was out of my room from 7 am to 3 pm and the room was not cleaned.  The person who knocks on all the doors in the afternoon (for some reason), knocked on mine and I told her my room had not been touched.  Although she had her clipboard with her, she seemed surprised.  I asked for just a couple f towels and if the trash could be emptied.  Tonight I realized that I was out of Kleenex.  I called housekeeping and was told a box would be brought up.  After an hour I called again and I finally received a box, from an individual who was rude  to me.  I hope that Housekeeping gets back to where it once was here, as this experience dampened my overall stay.

allReviews.title: Intimidation of a Child & Discrimination
allReviews.text: I feel that it is imperative that you are aware of the harassment and inappropriate treatment your lifeguard and security staff are giving to your PAYING GUESTS!!We decided to give your hotel a try and bring my family here for my daughters 21st birthday celebration. While the front desk staff was mediocre, the rooms were actually very nice. Unfortunately this review is NOT to compliment ANY of the staff at your hotel / casino. Not only were we HARASSED AND INTIMIDATED by your security staff who was brought on by your “lifeguard” who felt she was above all rules and regulations posted at the jacuzzi.  They were so abrasive that my child became EXTREMELY upset and terrified.  There are CLEAR SIGNS posted AT the jacuzzi that children under the age of 12 must be accompanied BY AN ADULT. BOTH MY HUSBAND AND MYSELF were IN the jacuzzi WITH my son. THEN the lifeguard went over to interrogate my 10 YEAR OLD who was sitting in a chair OUT OF THE AREA!!The security staff (5 in total) went on to get in my husbands face and terrify my son DEMANDING that we shown them my sons ID!!!  No one under the age of 18 HAS a valid California Identification Card unless they travel. WHICH MY KIDS DONT!!The lifeguard placed herself IN MY WALKING PATH which made it difficult to get away from the security guard who was pushing his shoulder into my body as I was trying to leave with my children!!!This will NOT be the last of my communications on this matter and it WILL be posted to every social media site, travel site AND hotel review avenue that I can possibly locate!!Never have I EVER been so insulted, discriminated or over all ABUsed in my life!!SOUTH POINT IS NOT A FAMILY FRIENY HOTEL AND IT IS DEFINITELY NOT ANYWHERE ANYOME SHOULD STAY OF THEY PLAN TO ENJOY THEIR TIME ON LAS VEGAS!!!

allReviews.title: Great hotel etc
allReviews.text: This place has so much to offer.  Nice hotel, spa, bowling facilities, movie theater, many restaurants even ice cream and great coffee. I had a very nice pedicure. The Mexican restaurant is good too. Buffet is not bad. Only downside is it’s not right on the strip but not a big deal for us.

allReviews.title: Will stay again
allReviews.text: We usually stay on or near Strip but this trip we were heading south to Palm Springs. Just wanted an overnight southbound. Easy access from McCarren car rental building. Also easy access on/off I15. Large self parking facilities but we used valet. Quick check in. No surprises. Very generous coupon book at check in. Third floor room was spacious and clean , no view but that’s not a big deal for an overnight. Lots of elevators. LOTS of food choices, we had Mexican. Very good, friendly service. Waitress encouraged us to sign up for players card, said they are generous with perks. Slot machines were a little tight but lots of them. Clean casino floor not too smoky. Three or four large bar/seating areas. Nice sports book. Movie theaters, bowling, equestrian venue, bingo room. The advertised entertainment looked great, wide variety coming up. We didn’t use pool or fitness room but they both looked very comfortable, guest friendly. We plan on returning some time!

allReviews.title: Good Vegas Experience
allReviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights with family and friends. Occupied 3 rooms. Rooms are rather large. Can actually accommodate a family. Check in and check out is easy. Facilities are ok esp for the casino. Food is the usual buffet. Prime Ribbis very filling and great. They have this midnight promo for steak and eggs pegged at $5.95! You see people lining up just to eat! Didn’t really go around to check the facilities but they have a lot to offer: bowling, shows, pool, etc. Dont forget to ask for more coupons to get discounts!

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Friendly staff. Easy and fast check-in and check-out. Clean and fresh room. Comfortable room. Enjoyed the buffet with plenty of choices. This is a smoking casino so everywhere I went there were smokers which I did not enjoy and causes coughing spells for me. Registration desk. waking to the elevators from the parking garage to the hotel elevators, gift shop, and restaurants require you to walk in the casino witg exposure to smoke. Wish there was a smoking and non-smoking area and even better having this a nonsmoking facility. Other than the smoking issue, I enjoyed my stay.

allReviews.title: Suite with a huge tub
allReviews.text: We are locals and wanted a quick stay-cation in town that had a nice room, soaking tub but also had things to do other than gamble, they have a bowling ally, quite a few restaurants and a movie theater. great stay! and the tubs in the suites are HUGE!

allReviews.title: Awesome Buffet n Everything Else
allReviews.text: This buffet was awesome! First off I had the breakfast meal and the variety was fantastic! Everything was laid out in an orderly and neat fashion. Several were in my party and all had great things to say about the taste and the freshness. You get your moneys worth here! This place is fantastic. I only wish we would have stayed here. The location is excellent, there are two bowling alleys, a movie theater, restaurant, pools, casino, n fabulous gift shop! I will be staying here from now on! Thank you for an awesome experience!

allReviews.title: nice hotel
allReviews.text: Nice rooms and good pool. also appreciated the free slippers in the room. Just wasn't happy that I used the iron for a dress but the iron was dusty so it burned the dust into my dress, not close to the strip costs about $15 to 20 to get to the strip by lyft.

allReviews.title: Clean, Spacious, Great Restaurants, while Affordable.
allReviews.text: Great experience, room was excellent, quiet, spacious and comfortable. Casino was not too smoke filled.  Restaurants (11) offer great choices in eating, from delicatessen to top tier gourmet. Even has a spacious bowling alley and numerous movie theaters. Like a fun city under one roof.

allReviews.title: Went to participate in the National Bowling Tournament being held at this Casino
allReviews.text: There is a lot to say about how comfortable this Hotel is, we were stayed for 5 days and found that the staff is very friendly and hrlpful. there are plenty of places to eat and a nice pool area with plenty of seating and a place to grab a drink or snack right there. there is a movie theater and bowling alley, also an arena where they hold differant functions.

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: I stayed at southpoint for years still great quality , large remodeled rooms.Great buffet , and during Memorial day free buffet for veterans. This is a great jester. Large rooms less exspensive food . And a free trip to and from the airport .Prices of the rooms are great .

allReviews.title: Very Surprised
allReviews.text: I lived in Vegas for 10 years yet had never came to this Casino/Hotel, I flew back for a visit last week and stayed here due to the location of the event I was attending. I was extremely happy. Service was great, room was recently remodeled and clean and I tried the buffet for lunch and was great. You do get a coupon book when you check in and it has a half price buffet. Great buffet for less then $7.00 with the coupon. Only bad thing was I didn't win anything at the tables...:)

allReviews.title: Best way to go off-Strip
allReviews.text: This hotel is the best place to be off-strip.  The room we had was recently refurbished and just beautiful! Very comfortable for a week's stay. The casino is great (and we even won a little!). Easy to navigate. Lots of great restaurants for every budget.  It has a large convention space and there is always something going on - we were there for the Bowling Nationals. I found the whole place to be clean and the employees to mostly all be very friendly and helpful. Just a very comfortable place to be.  Did not find the smoke to be overwhelming at all - except when someone would sit down next to me and light up a cigar.  Ugh.  Free parking and lots of it.  The pool is great - just wish they had cabanas to rent so you could spend the whole day out there. Poolside bar and grill was good and not too pricey. All-in-all, will definitely be back!!

allReviews.title: Bowling Tournament Participant
allReviews.text: The rooms have been renovated. There are plenty places to eat. Room service can be ordered by using your remote control. Two bowling alleys, a movie theatre, spa services, etc. I visited the location three years ago for a tournament. Less than 15 mins from the airport. Even shorter distance to the “main strip”. GO TO THE DELI AND GET DESSERT 😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

allReviews.title: Rob Schneider was excellent
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the Southpoint Casino before we found a home to purchase.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The choices of Resturants are excellent.  The Garden Buffet is AWESOME.  Tonight we went to the casino to see Rob Schneider. The show was fantastic. He is such a down to earth person and for 1 1/2 hours, you find yourself laughing and having so much fun.  We also see the Frankie Scinca show,it is fantastic.  Southpoint really knows how to provide quality rooms, great food and  quality entertainment.  WE LOVE IT HERE.

allReviews.title: Just not......
allReviews.text: So it was another one of these off the main strip large, smokey and endless hotels in Vegas.  We wanted something less expensive as we were only staying one night.  After parking and registering, it was a forever walk to the elevators through a smoke-filled casino.  We were annoyed about a $21 dollar a day resort fee, but their coupon book had discounts for a rather plentiful and tasty breakfast.  The room was a long corridor away from the elevators but was comfortable and quiet.  It showed signs of wear and tear.  If you're looking for a true Vegas vibe, go big time.

allReviews.title: I love this place
allReviews.text: South Point is the only place I want to stay in Vegas.  Not on the strip, but ride share can get you there easily. There is so much to do here like movies, bowling, bingo and the casino, so I usually don't bother leaving.  The restaurants are extremely affordable and a great value.  Best part is the staff.  They are very friendly and helpful.  I can't wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Frequent visits
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the South Point numerous times since it first opened, but more recently our visits have focused on dining, drinking, gambling and entertainment.  My wife spent 2-3 hours daily playing video poker during our vacation in order to take advantage of the good pay schedules offered plus the current Spin to Win prizes promotion.  Another ongoing promotion that we were able to use was senior Mondays when 1/2 points are charged for meals.  Our filet mignon meal at the Silverado Steakhouse proved to excellent while the seafood pan roast at Big Sur Oyster bar disappointed. We also attended the Thursday afternoon Dennis Bono show, complimentary for slot club members, twice on this trip.  Each show features a number of local and visiting artists, but be aware that the show is very popular so picking up tickets at the box office on the preceding Wednesday is highly recommended.  Lastly we enjoyed a couple of adult beverages there including a pair of $1 bloody Marys available before noon at any of the bars plus happy hours at Miguel's Tequila Bar and Zenshin.

allReviews.title: We highly recommend the South Point Hotel & Casino
allReviews.text: We had a plane to catch in four hours and did not want to stay at the airport.  Thus before we took back the car rental ....we went to South Ponit Hotel & Casino. The place is very nice.  Very clean and the employees very helpful.   I was not a big winner at the slots but my husband was quite pleased with his winnings at the blackjack tables.  We opted to eat lunch before we left and stopped by the Coronado Cafe (inside the casino)...Our waitres Maricel was very courteous.   I got the Chicken Fingers and they were quite good.  My husband opted to get the Meatloaf and he managed to woof it down in record time.   Yes....We would like to return to the South Point Hotel & Casino next time we are in the area.   We highly recommend it.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
allReviews.text: Our stay at South Point was amazing. From the minute we drove up we received prompt and friendly service.   The line for check-in was a little long, but moved along very quickly. The bell hop was very helpful and brought our luggage to our room quickly. Our room, a king premium was very nice!  I liked our room with no carpet....they also provided complimentary slippers! There are so many restaurants, however, we only went to the Coronado, Steak-n- Shake and the buffet, all 3 good. The casino is your typical casino, but very friendly and always offering drinks.  We found out that my husband bowled earlier in the day which made it possible for us to leave a day earlier than planned and the front desk was so helpful and kind advising us that if we checked out before noon, we wouldn't be charged for the room for that night.  Everything about South Point was amazing, however, the most amazing thing was that I left my 2 Kindle tablets in our room and discovered it at 10 pm the night we left.  I immediately called the hotel and housekeeping knew exactly about it . I completed the claim form on-line and talked with a gentleman the next day, who was so helpful and understanding of the situation. They sent my tablets via USPS to me. I still can't believe that I left them behind, but I am SO THANKFUL for the honest and caring staff at South Point. I would stay at South Point anytime over the hectic craziness of the strip hotels.   THANK YOU SOUTH POINT!!!

allReviews.title: Disappointing From All Views
allReviews.text: This property has one of the worst ventilation systems I've seen yet in Las Vegas. Upon walking in the main entry you are overcome with the smell of smoke. I will admit being from Washington state we are no longer exposed to smokers when we go out to eat or to the bar so yes a bit more sensitive. That said the majority of the casinos have excellent ventilation systems and/or a non-smoking section within the main floor. This is not the case at South Point. Even the rooms you can tell at one point were smoking even though we were on a non-smoking floor. The food is simply okay, there is nothing to write home about. Sadly I'd tell you the SBC was likely the best thing we had all weekend.  We tried to go to the one 'nice' restaurant, Michael's, and the host was so rude about my husband wearing shorts. We did not realize there was a dress code and gladly would have changed but he essentially told us they were booked when my husband walked in. I made a reservation on Open Table (very easily which should have been my first clue) and when we walked in to be seated the same host was rude and said my husband was not welcome due to his attire. What a shame as we were with a group of six and would have gladly changed but this guy definitely did not want us there. The pool is nice. They did a nice job curving the pool so that a large number of guests can sit pool side. The gym is decent, although the bikes are not intended to actually be used beyond a lackluster workout. We did not try the spa or salon. The rooms are very plain, the linens extremely cheap. One extra role of toilet paper, no extra towels of any sort. Everything in the room seemed as though a) they were just giving you enough to get by and b) really didn't anticipate you being in the room that often.  This is fine and typical Vegas but at the same time I came to relax, I did not have my kids with and I'd like to have a dry towel to take a shower after a work out as well as after I come up from the pool.  Also the fuse blew in our bathroom twice and half the outlets in the room did not work. It wasn't awful it was simply nothing to write home about and feel they could have done quite a bit more to make this hotel really stand out.

allReviews.title: Excellent 2nd Stay at South Point
allReviews.text: This is a great, clean, friendly property away from the busy sections on the strip yet conveniently located to shopping, good restaurants, and all access roads.Our room on the 24th floor had a nice view of the pool and was serviced daily and nicely by the housekeeping staff. Any requests for supplies, etc were handled promptly and courteously. The hotel offers several good dining options, a nice movie theater, and friendly slots!Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Came out here for the US bowling Congress open tournament. The people here are friendly, staff is courteous, very accommodating. The casino is huge and the hotel is even bigger, it's clean and the rooms are huge. I would definitely recommend it.

allReviews.title: Casino and Buffet review
allReviews.text: We stayed next door at Grandview next door so I can't comment on the rooms at the South Point Hotel. Grandview was easy to get around, rooms a good size, clean. Elevators fast. However there was not a balcony to sit on; all our other timeshare places have it so we really missed that. No ceiling fans but windows did open a bit. Casino is roomy. They don't squeeze machines and chairs in every space so you had room to go up and down. Didn't smell smoke either. They don't allow cigars in certain places like the sports book which is great. A nice variety of machines unlike some of the casinos what have mostly Keno and Poker. We had the buffet breakfast several days.  With the card it was only $10. And... they have fresh donuts !  No watermelon though.  Nice variety for breakfast. We had dinner there one night - the Prime Rib night. It was just okay but they have a nice variety. They have a theatre and bowling alley but they also have a professional bowling alley with tournaments.  We didn't know the second alley was there. They don't have much recreation things at the hotel though but I guess they think you want the casino. Place was clean, neat, big, and roomy. Was nice to be away from the Strip. However, if driving to the strip, many places you have to pay to park. We found Trop doesn't charge and Planet Hollywood did not the last time. We parked at Tropicana and bought the 24 hour bus pass to go up and down the strip. We like the Trop for the casino so it was an easy choice. Yes casinos charge for more than 1 hour - can be as high as $15 for the day. South Point did not charge that I could see. Again, we really liked the Casino because of the roominess and no cigarette smell.  They have a Steak N Shake inside !

allReviews.title: Pleasant surprise
allReviews.text: I want to start this review by saying my husband and i have stayed at every high end property on the strip. The Wynn is my favorite. Since we received a free offer at Southpoint we decided to give it a tryIts not a five star property but we were pleasantly surprised at how much we enjoyed our stay there.PROPERTY: easy check in and check out Free shuttle to and from the airport. The only stops were at the airlines people on the shuttle were using. The property has several restaurants in varying price ranges. We ate at the deli, Primarily Prime Rib and Don Vitos. All we good. The property also has a bowling alley and a movie theater. You can purchase pop corn there without seeing a movie.  There is also a great hot dog cart by the sports book with hot dogs for $1.25!I have always complained how the strip casinos gouge you for water. Not Southpoint. $2.79 for a large bottle. ROOM:  i noticed someone complained about laminate flooring. I was happy to see it because its easier to keep clean. Our room was spotless. No, it didn’t have 5 star furnishings but what they did have was clean and comfortable. The bed was comfortable and the pillows were better than adequate. I hate cheap wimpy pillows and thin towels. Not a problem here. BATHROOM: the tub had a safety bar which is a must for me. The towels were nice and fairly thick. My only complaint here was the toilet paper! It was like tissue paper. I could forgive that because of all the positivesCASINO:  we found the casino great for our needs. Plenty of slots with different variety. The casino area was clean and slots gave me lots of play. We also found the staff at the club desk very polite and helpful. Other people may have different experiences but for us it was a very nice stay with only a toilet paper complaint!! LolWe look forward to staying there again. Thank you Southpoint

allReviews.title: Eh
allReviews.text: It’ll do but nothing special, not really worth the rate. Rooms were really hot and mattresses not that great. Housekeeping entered the room in the morning without even knocking while everyone was still in bed, huge no no in the hotel room

allReviews.title: Second time was as good as the first
allReviews.text: This was our second time staying at southpoint and we would stay again if ever in Vegas, our room was large and spotless clean and very quiet which is saying something with all the people in the hotel and casino we were there for a bowling tournament so this hotel had to be full, I also like its off the strip only thing I didn’t like was the resort fee with all the money you spend in Las Vegas no hotel should charge a resort fee.

allReviews.title: Easy to stay in one place
allReviews.text: We stayed here as we were participating in the USBC bowling tournament and could minimize hauling bowling balls around. They also offer a discount if you book through the bowling tournament website. Our rooms were spacious and fairly clean. Also, parking is free, even in the deck. There are multiple onsite restaurants and they offer a coupon book to help keep you on-site. The downside is getting from the parking deck to your hotel room. It would be nice if we didn't have to go through the casino. Due to our busy schedule, we didn't get to make use of the pool but the area is beautiful and spacious. We did use the hot tub and it was pretty nice. Not sure I would stay here again as I like to have a refrigerator and microwave in my room for extended stays (5 nights) and a refrigerator was only available for an extra fee. I did hear one guest say they are doing renovations and adding refrigerators, so may reconsider staying here.

allReviews.title: Dirty Room
allReviews.text: I was reluctant to stay at South Point because it is so far off the Vegas strip. But because I had been invited to speak at a convention and due to the fact many of my clients were there I decided to stay. I wasn’t expecting too much, but even at that I was sorely disappointed.  This morning I had scheduled an appointment with a client to get a coffee at a coffee shop in the lobby called “Seattle’s Best” but unfortunately due to a flood in there back room they turned us away.  They directed us to their Deli around the corner but the line was very long.  Had to reschedule the meeting. After my meeting I joined my wife at the pool and had plans for dinner with another client around 6:00.  When we arrived back at our room at 5:15 we were disappointed to find that our room hadn’t been cleaned and all our towels were dirty.  I called the front desk spoke to Gregg.  I told him I had an appointment and we needed to get ready.  He assured me that someone would be to the room within 15 minutes.  I told my wife to hold off on getting ready for dinner until the towels arrived.  15 minutes came and went.  After 30 minutes I decided to go to the Front desk.  On the way to elevator I ran into the house keeper and asked her if she was on the way to my room.  She was very nice, but showed me a list of approximately 15 rooms that needed to be cleaned. I was nowhere near the top.  I continued to the desk, and the young lady at the desk and she called housekeeping and told them to prioritize our room, but explained there was still a couple rooms in front of me. I asked to speak to the front office manager Jillian Catillo. That I had to cancel my appointment with a client and that my wife was forced to dry-off with dirty towels.  Her response was “well they are your dirty towels- right”. I was applauded at that response.  In the end she was willing to take $47.00 off my bill for purchases I had made.  Needless to say I missed dinner with my client.  My room finally got cleaned at 6:45. The house maid explained that they only had 11 housecleaning staff on for the entire facility.  I would not recommend this place for any sort of business.

allReviews.title: Clean, large rooms, beautiful pool area.
allReviews.text: Off the main strip, but really has everything you need right there!   Great pool area, we enjoyed the back adult section, and good food options.   Keep in mind you need to haul luggage thru the casino to get to the hotel section - not a big deal unless you are only staying one night and have 10 days worth of luggage (like me).  Easy parking, easy check-in.  Excellent breakfast buffet for about $15.

allReviews.title: Friendly and convenient
allReviews.text: Stayed for 3 days on way home from a busy trip to the states. Just wanted to chill out and get some sun and laze by the pool. It was great. Free shuttle from airport. The room was massive almost a suite. The pool area was clean.  Lots of sun beds and a jacuzzi and pool side bar. The only downside was the food. I only really enjoyed the salad bar which was fresh and lots of variety. The rest of the food was so so. But you got a book of vouchers for a couple of free drinks and offers for the restaurants so it was pretty generous with the quantity if not the quality. If you want somewhere off the strip I would recommend it.

allReviews.title: I'm staying there again
allReviews.text: This is one place you must visit and stay if your in Las Vegas. It has lot of attractions and it is located close to the strip. The people working there are very kind, wonderful, courteous, and very helpful. Dining facilities, gaming, and the rooms are nicely cleaned and easy to find.

allReviews.title: Nice property for work stay
allReviews.text: A very well kept, up to date property, at the far bottom end of the Strip.  Front desk staff was nice, efficent and upbeat.Room was very spacious, clean, and well amenitied.Eat dinner at the Coronado Cafe.  Horrible cold fries.  Pastrami sandwich described as "piled high on rye bread"; was no more than a thin sandwich you would expect to find at a gas station.  Disappointing

allReviews.title: Cowboy Place
allReviews.text: Nice stay. Hydraulics to improve. Efficient workers. Several options for meals. Fantastic bowling. Hats and horses. It's Vegas, but more quiet. Could explain lots of senior guests. To people that know what matters.

allReviews.title: Out of the way
allReviews.text: South Point is not on the main strip or Fremont Street, but we really enjoyed our stay here. It is a large hotel/casino that contains 2 bowling alleys, an arena where they hold horde shows and numerous other conference areas. While we were there for the national bowling tournament, the World Cup Arabian horse show was going on as well as a gymnastics tournaments. The outdoor pool was beautiful and well kept with a bar & snack bar. The casino was nice, well kept & I think there were 5 bars on the casino floor. There were also 7 restaurants at this facility to meet everyone’s tastes. This was our second stay at South Point and we will stay here the next time the tournament is in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: So much better than the strip
allReviews.text: We go to Vegas about twice per year.Spend about $2-3000 per trip..For the 5 years before finding South point. we went to the Strip (different hotels each time ) and were treated like dirt.. Rooms not ready. Lied to about rewards, and much more. Outrageous prices and horrible  service. Nickel and dimed for everything imaginable.Finally went off strip to Southpoint. Great room, great service, good prices. Finally treated like a human being..If you want to go to the Strip, take an Uber.  Will not cost more than the outlandish parking fees now demanded by all strip hotels

allReviews.title: A ton to do there!
allReviews.text: I was impressed that parking was super easy and open.  They also have underground parking.  There is a great theatre inside with $5 movie nights on Tuesday.  A nice buffet, Shake Shack, and rodeos going all the time.  I never stayed there (because I live in Vegas) but we go almost every Tuesday for $5 movie and snack night.  Not overly crowded either which is great.

allReviews.title: Loved the Spa
allReviews.text: I was rather impressed with the Spa area of this casino.  Granted the air quality wasn’t as desired but it’s a casino where smoking is allowed.  But the Spa massage, jacuzzi area was amazing.  I can’t recall who I was with but he definitely was worth every moment.

allReviews.title: All in one
allReviews.text: We visited Southpoint to watch the wrestling championship. It has a lot of restaurants, gaming and other activities. They have a bowling alley, movie theater and a lot of events. They have specials when you use your club card on certain days. We earned free meals and the food was great.

allReviews.title: Low-End, Smoke-Filled, Old-Feeling dive of a hotel.
allReviews.text: We knew the minute we walked in that we had made a mistake. They promoted themselves 180 degrees from what they are. Filled with local-types - all smokers - who come for the free self-parking and lower table stakes. Room was tacky, poorly-appointed (still with the low wattage flourescent light bulbs) crooked lampshades, dingy thin towels. We just needed a one-nighter for a close-by meeting so thought we'd give this a try. Never again.

allReviews.title: Horrific Experience.
allReviews.text: This hotel is dated, gross and the staff in literally insane The staff will not help, or do anything to go out of their way. They actually act like you are working at the hotel and not them. They are also liars and tell lies about guests. Completely disgusting experience

allReviews.title: Big and nice regional casino
allReviews.text: Easy access off the 15 freeway. Lots of free parking.  Huge casino with many restaurants and features including movies!   Clean and well kept.  A bit Smokey.  Several good restaurants to pick from.  Big stop on the rodeo tour as well.

allReviews.title: Big plave
allReviews.text: We got stranded here after our airline oversold the flight home. It’s a big enough place that one can be entertained well without leaving the property. Great spot for people watching... lots of restaurants. Bed was hard but room was quiet. Excellent staff.

allReviews.title: Stay there just don't eat there.
allReviews.text: Great Room for the price. Very disappointed with the food. The buffet was pretty standard. Baja Miguels was just bad. The regular salsa was bland, The hot salsa was fiery hot but no flavor. Carne Asada was bland. Service was good.

allReviews.title: South Point At the Top of My List
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay for a national bowling tournament
allReviews.text: Stay here for five days recently with five guys bowling in the national bowling tournament. Great homebase as all the activities for bowling are in the same facility. Very convenient and no love in your balls in and out of taxis. Rooms are nicely updated with large bathrooms and good showers. Water pressure was great and air-conditioning worked well. Cleaning staff to the next one job and the beds are fairly decent for a hotel. Pillows are foam Which is nice. Would stay here again the next time the tournament comes to town.

allReviews.title: Away from the strip
allReviews.text: Excellent casino hotel away from the strip in nice part of Las Vegas. Close to airport, restaurants, pharmacy, grocery stores and much more.  South Point is large but not overwhelming.  Plenty of gambling opportunities.  11 restaurants that include fast food and upscale dining in addition to great buffet. There is also bowling and cinema within South Point.   Location is great to visit other activities in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Stayed here April 6-12. This was my tenth stay at SP and enjoyed my stay. Check in staff was very friendly and accommodating. Was a lot going on while the hotel was sold out and with good reason. Bowling tournament team roping was fun to watch. Coffee shop Baja Miguel’s and the buffet was very good and well priced.

allReviews.title: Saving money.
allReviews.text: We stayed at South Point because of the price point, but there are certainly nicer hotels and resorts on the strip. While the resort offers much for families, including movie theater and full bowling alley, there’s really no shopping or other excitement that compares to, for example, the Bellagio or Venetian. It’s also very costly to take a cab, Uber or Lyft to the strip. Stay here if you “don’t” want to be near Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice Economical Vegas Hotel Casino
allReviews.text: I've stayed here 6 times now for an annual convention and This time was better as the hotel has recently undertaken a remodel on rooms. Now they have removed the carpet in the rooms and installed a laminate floor. Its a bit noisy but is so much cleaner than old carpet. Rooms are large and bathrooms are huge although it doesn't appear these were updated. Never a problem with hot water either. I enjoy staying here as there is plenty to do and is away from the action on the strip. The casino is large and the slots pay well *most* of the time. The on site restaurants are very good especially Silverado Steakhouse and Don Vitos. The only thing thats  not to my liking is the need to flash your key in the evening to get to the elevators. No key means you're not getting past security. It also means visitors need to be met in the casino. There is a nice gift shop and I love that I can buy a bottle of Dom Perignon for a very good price. I'll be back again next year and will enjoy it again.

allReviews.title: Bowling Tournament
allReviews.text: Great place to stay! Rooms are spotless, food is very good! Casino is nice! Not a lot of smoke! They must suck the smoke up in the ceiling! We loved it! Everyone who works there is pleasant! Would definitely go again!

allReviews.title: A Great Remodel & Buffet
allReviews.text: The buffet was remodel a few months ago. It looks great, but the food is really great after the remodel. They have a whole extra salad/soup bar that is great. We really like the improvements. Plus the gamling at South Point is gret.

allReviews.title: Fun Time
allReviews.text: South Point is a fun place to stay.  Lots to do even if you don't gamble.  I enjoyed movies, bowling and excellent food while the men were playing golf.  I enjoyed sitting by the pool and sipping cold drinks.  South Point has something for everyone!

allReviews.title: Business
allReviews.text: Great Place to stay.No Casino has a better Sports Book.  They are the best of the best in a Business that is very competitive.  For example they actually have Pens to write with.  The Westgate is cheap and leaves out pencils.  I’m just saying that it’s the little things they do to take care of the clients who go the Book to place Wagers.

allReviews.title: One night stay
allReviews.text: We had a offer for 2 free nights but only could stay 1' The check in was good real fast. The room was big,clean and updated. The people at check in were pleasant and friendly. We met friends at bingo and had a good time. I would stay there again the next time we are in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The people are very friendly and helpful. I was very impressed with the spa. The restaurants are very good and a large assortment. I plan to stay here again. Everything was very beautiful and well kept.

allReviews.title: Management is the only issue
allReviews.text: The rooms are nice and roomy, just wish they left more towels instead of having to ask all the time. They have plenty of things to do in the hotel.  I do wish they had a dedicated desk person to help existing guests as it could take a long time in line to ask for something as easy as another room key.  I had an issue with shipping some items to the hotel and the hotel would not budge in trying to assist me.  I was basically called a liar and when they asked me for my room number, did they not think I knew why they asked?  I know if I was a guest who stayed there a lot and paid full price, then they might consider helping me, but knowing I wasn't, they basically blamed the booking site, which had nothing to do with my issue, as it was not booking related.  Just so coldly handled.  Please do not ship anything to them.  Just ship it to the local UPS store as they don't charge for that.

allReviews.title: Off the busy strip
