allReviews.text: We stayed here for our 20th anniversary quick get away.  It has lots of amenities that you can find at all the other casinos in Vegas at a fraction of the price.  Great customer service.  The bed was awesome!  I even emailed to find out what brand, type to get us one.

allReviews.title: Great as always
allReviews.text: We stay at the South Point every year for 5 nights.  We stayed in a remodeled room this year and it was very nice.  The hotel is very smokey but the $1.00 Mimosas and Bloody Mary's made up for it! Service was good as always.  Elevators are always a problem for The Vegas Shoot.

allReviews.title: Great find off the Strip!
allReviews.text: We go to Vegas about 6 times a year, staying a week or so each time.  We usually stay on the Strip. Our friends recommended this hotel, and because we always get a rental car it was no big deal to stay off the strip. We love this place!  It sure beats the busy Strip.  It sort of feels like home, nice relaxing atmosphere.  The prices are great. Asides from gambling there is bowling and a huge movie theatre, an arcade for kids. Also they host a lot of equestrian events in their arena which really appeals to me ( free to watch).  When we checked in they gave us a free coupon book, which helped for discounts at restaurants there etc.  The buffet was fantastic and so cheap! (Especially with the coupons!!). We met with a Casino Host who can potentially comp us rooms etc based on our gambling. I love the poker room there, it’s huge and they have tournaments every day including different games like PLO etc. A great find. We are forsure coming back. I’m also going to take my dad here this year for a weekend as our annual Vegas trip.  PS: Nice to not have to pay for parking!!

allReviews.title: Always stay at South Point
allReviews.text: I have been visiting Las Vegas once a year for many years. I stayed at 3 other properties before discovering South Point Hotel Casino and Spa, and have stayed here ever since. This hotel is comfortable, clean, and fun. The restaurants are great and the recently updated Garden Buffet is better than ever and still a good deal. I love the omelet station at breakfast and the chefs worked hard to keep the line moving. The Coronado Cafe is a staple 24/7 restaurant that is always open and always delicious. The steak special and graveyard specials are especially good. I have always loved the large clean hotel rooms, but I really enjoyed the new Premium room I booked. The wood floors and new furniture were beautiful. I loved having a refrigerator in the room, and the hi-speed internet worked like a charm. South Point has an amazing showroom with reasonably priced events such as The Letterman. Free tickets to The Dennis Bono show are a must if you are staying on a Thursday, as it is one of the best shows in Vegas. South Point also has a fitness room with a wide variety of equipment and a large pool and jacuzzi for relaxing. There are newer slots and the Sports and Racebook are comfortable. The only critique I have is that the casino is crowded on the weekends ( because it is so good) and internet access is weak in the casino. You will enjoy your stay at South Point.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: This  is our second time to stay at Southpoint hotel casino and spa. I can’t say good enough things about this hotel. Everything you need is right here. The rooms are nice and clean, comfortable beds, the buffet is pretty good, they have a really nice pool even though I didn’t use it because it’s a little cold today for my liking. The staff has been very pleasant.   If you want to go downtown or to the strip it’s easy to just hook up an Uber driver. This will definitely be where we stay every time we come to Vegas

allReviews.title: Very good hotel
allReviews.text: Nice hotel with clean, new and well decorated rooms of decent size. Abundance of good restaurants on site. Very good for conferences and meetings. Quite remote from the city though, circa 15 drive to Strip.

allReviews.title: Basketball MAC Tournament
allReviews.text: Everything I needed, variety of foods,games, movie theater,etc.They accommodated us (UNM) FOR PEP RALLIES.   WE used our courtsey cards to get discounts at buffet and discount at theater on designated days.The room was as ordered, in the middle of Galway and not far from my friends!

allReviews.title: No Hype
allReviews.text: Quick and easy check in by pleasant staff.  Very comfortable, clean room & nice hot shower ( a real shower , not a watering can!). The casino has something for everyone. Everyone having a good time. Good restaurants & sports bar as well as an oyster bar. If you want the glitz & glitter of the strip, this is not for you. this is not a "touristy" extravaganza ....just a great hotel to somewhat get away from it all but still have some fun. It is however easy to get to the strip if you must go there. If the casino is not your attraction, then enjoy the pool, the movie theater, the bowling, entertainment and sports book or race book and also the spa. They have it all.

allReviews.title: Hotel has everything that you need in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: W back in 4 monthse had the Casino; Bowling; Movies theaters; spamany restaurants.Casino has the best Slot machines in Vegasthey do pay.the person next to me won switrh $2.00 $10,000.00my wife and I we played an average of $100,00 a day after 7 daysof many hours playing we only lost $200.00great place we will be back in 4n months

allReviews.title: Great hotel for the price
allReviews.text: The room was very clean and spacious.  A good selection of restaurants in hotel.  Located south of the strip so rental car necessary to visit the strip area but motel offered free parking. Front desk personnel very helpful when my party had to stay an extra night due to flight change.  The only negative is having to pass through casino to get to room area....smoking allowed so we had to smell/ breathe the odor.

allReviews.title: Unified Bowling Special Olympic tournament
allReviews.text: I wasn't impressed with the Garden Buffet, but the Coronado Café served a variety of meals and they were good.  Baja Miguel's was very good. The Casino was all right.  I wasn't impressed with the smokiness of it though.  Also, they did not offer shuttle service to the Strip.  You had to take an Uber.

allReviews.title: Friends getaway
allReviews.text: Great hotel and casino. Restaurants were good.Had a great time.Went to some shows at southpoint.The spa and gym were excellent. Will definitely come back.We stayed there the whole time. WE had fun at the bars .

allReviews.title: Unexpectedly wonderful!!!
allReviews.text: We stayed for four days with my daughter and 2 grandkids.  Amazing stay.  OMG It has a cineplex theater with 14 theaters, a huge bowling alley, restaurants for all ages and so much more.  The kids enjoyed it.  We enjoyed it.  We never had to leave the hotel.  Highly recommend it.  Will likely always stay here when in Vegas from now on.

allReviews.title: Best Off the strip Hotel Casino & Spa
allReviews.text: This is our all time favourites off the strip hotel. I think it has the best spa/swimming pool area that i have seen so far.Plenty of free parking on site. Shuttle service is available for the airport. There is also a shuttle service (chargeable) to the strip (stand is next to the front entrance)If you can go for the upgraded rooms. They will have a coffee maker, Refrigerator and a Safe. The floor has been upgraded from carpets to wooden laminated wooden type floor.It can get very busy, so book early. I have always found the staff to be very friendly and helpful.This casino has everything i.e. bawling, Cinema, spa, pools, restaurants, theatres, buffet dining and a gym etc etc.This casino is off the strip. You will either need a rental car or take the shuttle or take a cab to the strip.There is nothing near the casino that you can walk to, apart from MacDonald's, Danny's  and few other restaurants.I would rate this hotel casino 10/10 and we will always stay here in the future.

allReviews.title: LOVE this resort!!!
allReviews.text: This has to be my favorite resort in Vegas...bar none.  The atmosphere, space, quality of the restaurants and bingo room..and the rest of the countless amenities are all superb.  It's a little out of the way if you're looking for someplace close to everything to stay or play..but worth the trip.  If I had to make one minor quibble, it would be that the rates are sometimes a little high to stay there.  The rooms are nice...but not spectacular.  Nevertheless, this is a minor quibble..and overall I LOVE this resort.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: We have always stay at Mandlay bay and cosmopolitan but south point came under the recommendation of a friend, now we will always stay here..Service here is 5 star, room was so nice and the hotel is close to many things..We had dinners in all the restaurants but Micheals and the service and food was really great.There was a great variety of resturants..Thank you South Point..We will be back..

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel/Casino in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Have stayed at South point Hotel/Casino on several occasions. Far enough from the strip if looking for less excitement and overall volume of people and traffic, yet close enough to be a part of it.   Many Amenities offered including shuttle bus, plenty of variety of restaurants for all tastes and price ranges, Variety of gambling options, entertainment etc. Most importantly, the staff is superb at all levels. Very attentive to your needs, informative. ALWAYS willing to do whatever it takes to make your experience there a pleasant one.   Rooms are great, Always neat and clean and very reasonable. Cannot say enough good things about them

allReviews.title: If you like the smell of smoke and awful food stay here.
allReviews.text: Flight was cancelled and the airline put us up at the South Point Casio.The place was awful, all restaurants and our hotel room smelled like smoke.  Nothing is near by and I felt like I entered a redneck convention.  The airline gave us vouchers for meals at the casino. We are at the Mexican restaurant and the margaritas were so sweet that they were not edible and the food was equally as bad.Biggest mistake was not getting into a cab and checking into a different hotel.  I would have been better off paying for a better place to stay instead of taking the free room from the airline.

allReviews.title: Awesome Horse Show Facility
allReviews.text: They have just upgraded the rooms, and they are very nice! Everything you could dream of as a horse show facility. Good food, good gambling, nice movie theaters. Awesome stalls, arenas, wash racks, vet, shower, all indoors.

allReviews.title: Business Conference
allReviews.text: Well done South Point.Nice surprise.  Flew into Las Vegas and it was snowing, go figure.  Took cab from airport to south point hotel and spa. It’s about 8 miles south of strip on Las Vegas blvd.Check-in was quick. Got to room and was pleased.  Very clean, spacious, and did not smell of cigarettes.  Bed was comfortable.Conference set up was phenomenal. Close to hotel elevators are the conference rooms and presentation areas. This is the exact opposite of every conference I have attended at strip hotels, where hiking boots are required for the trek.Food was exceptional. Buffet was quite nice. Gaming floor was well run. Open tables were always just enough to accommodate players. Not so happy with reduced craps odds (2,2-1/2,3x) but dealers were friendly.Restaurants were great but I do not recommend the deli.  Bottom line is that South Point did such a great job that we never let the property for the entire 3 days of the conference.  Kudos

allReviews.title: Really great place to stay and gamble
allReviews.text: This is a long way from the strip or downtown and we found it best to stay within the hotel. There are plenty of things to do other than gamble but most of our time was at the tables. The rooms were great and we really felt at home here.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: Gave it a try. Was nicer than expected. No parking fees, comfy quiet rooms. Casino is easy to get to and from. Plenty of options for food. Beds were comfortable and nice bath towels, large tv to watch for local news. Would stay here again.

allReviews.title: South point has everything
allReviews.text: South Point as the names implies is South of the airport and out of the "Strip".  That has its good points and bad.  First the good.  Off the beaten track which means less hassle and bussle.  Many restaurant to please all.  There is even a Steak & Shake for the budget minded Gambler.  Meal range from the $4.00 Steak & Shake to $60.00 q plate French Restaurant.  They have the ever popular Buffey and a good everyday restaurant like a Bob Evens or Dennys.  Many, many slots and all the good table games.Now the bad.  Off the the dtrip means you will miss all the excitment, the shows and the stores.  Of course you can get a cab down for an evening but the cab will cost you about the same as a car rental which is not a bad idea.  That way you can take a drive to Red Rock Cannon or down to Hover Dam for a tour of this most impressive sight.This was not my first time at the South Point but my 5th.  But with that said, I was there for meetings and saved time for sight seeing.

allReviews.title: Cigarette Smoke Everywhere
allReviews.text: It's like stepping back in time. The whole place reeks of cigarettes. There are no laundry facilities. They do not sell Febreze in the gift shops. All they offer is expensive dry cleaning which takes a full day. You can't get to the room elevators without going through the casino. The hallway carpets emanate Eau de Ashtray. The only refuge was my room, which had laminate floors.The hotel does have a full Cinemark movie theater which was nice and a bowling alley. The restaurants were not worth bothering with, considering how many awesome places there are to eat in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Better than it was 2 years ago
allReviews.text: Room was clean and in good shape.  Beds were comfortable. Food in the restaurants was ok but too expensive. Staff was helpful and friendly. Bowling alley was clean and in good shape. The things that were not good:  that horse arena just stinks and the hotel has chosen to pipe in a perfume smell to cover the arena stink.  It is not working!One night we had prime rib,  the color of prime rib was orange, not edible!The Deli was excellent. The  ice cream shop was good. Coffee shop was good. The bars were excellent.  Although lines to get into get food was were all long.The hot tub still has awful raised grates on the bottom.  You can't help but stub your toes multiple times.  I went to the pool one time and there were no clean towels.I would stay at this hotel again. The staff makes it a really family friendly place.I have to give a shout out to the housekeeping staff.  Many hotels do not clean the bath tubs because they think no one takes baths just showers.  This hotel cleans its tubs and I was able to enjoy a bath.

allReviews.title: Its ok
allReviews.text: We go yearly for a work trip. Have been going since 2012.  They've done some room Reno's on the past year.  It's a decent hotel. Has a bowling alley, large arena, lots and lots of slots, decent restaurants, a movie theatre.  It's off the main strip though just as a warningThe pool is nice with fake grass! I go because I have to but there are worse places to be at!

allReviews.title: Great Stay and Resort
allReviews.text: Great location, resort, staff, rooms, AND the BEST, Quickest, sportsbook around 24/7.All restaurants are top notch. Casino staff are very friendly.The rooms are clean. The pool is good.All amenities including movie theater, bowling, spa. horse arena help make this place an amazing resort that you do not need to leave

allReviews.title: SuperBowl weekend festivities
allReviews.text: This facility has everything any person or family could want to have near during this "Humongous" happening.  Tremendous food, music even a movie theatre to pass the time before THE GAME.  Four days made me feel like I wanted to move to Nevada just to be closer to the fun.

allReviews.title: World Championship Archery Hotel
allReviews.text: There is plenty to do in the casino/hotel. Slots, movies, betting, poker, and bowling is available. Most of the different kinds of food. Actually over a 4-5 day stay, I rarely leave the property. Food is a little pricey, but normal for Las Vegas today. I recommend getting a player's card and noting the special offers and times for the buffets.

allReviews.title: Food Allergy friendly resort
allReviews.text: I have a child with a plethora of food allergies.  Before coming to stay at South Point, I followed the website’s request and emailed them the allergies.  This put me in touch with one of their chefs who communicated back and forth, notified all their restaurants and gave us information on which restaurants were able to handle allergies and which weren’t.  He even followed up with us during our stay.  The result, my son has never eaten so well while at restaurants.  He was taken such good care of.  If we go back to Vegas, this will be our first choice of places to stay. The rest of our stay was delightful too.

allReviews.title: A nice hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: My husband had a work trip there for a week in January and I joined for three nights and enjoyed the property .  We had one of the larger renovated rooms they were very nice and we’re glad to see coffee maker in the room  We had dinner at the Italian restaurant and the steakhouse and lunch in the sushi and buffet we enjoyed all of our meals .  The Italian being our favorite .We used a coupon book they gave us a check in and enjoyed complimentary wine in both the Italian restaurant and the and steak restaurant .I was fortunate the weather was very nice for January at almost 70° and was able to sit and wait by the pool . I used their fitness room which was very nice with lots of equipment I was one of only a few people  each time there was plenty of towels and water . They also had a complementary shuttle to and from the airport we Ubered there but I shuttled back. If they have their meeting there again next year I will be back .

allReviews.title: Hotel was nice but not family friendly
allReviews.text: We stayed at the South Point because my son was shooting in the Vegas shoot. We were reluctant to go to Vegas but this was a wonderful opportunity for my son. The website states it is family friendly. However, we got there around 10 a.m. and there were half naked women/waitresses in the casino area. The Casino area is in the middle of the hotel and reaks of smoke. You had to go through that area as you enter the hotel to get to the restaurants. I get people think these half naked women are appealing, but why have them out during the day???? Its sad these women feel the need to dress like this to get attention and South Point obviously is an advocate of this trashy behavior. I would have expected this at any other hotel in Vegas but because South Point advertises that they are family friendly.....this is what disappoints me. Also walking through the Casino area to get to the bowling, we stopped to watch someone on the slot machines and a worker told us the kids couldnt be in the gaming area????? You have to go by the gaming area to get to the bowling area??? Why put these machines there next to the kids area if you dont want kids watching????? And lastly, the hotel room smelled of smoke. I'm sure due to all of the smokers in the Casino. This is my fault, I didnt research to see if this was a smoke free Casino. I just assumed. But the half naked women and the slots next to bowling/arcade is ridiculous. Children have to go right by them to get to the "family friendly" events the hotel advertises. The hotel was clean and really nice outside of the concerns stated above. The resturants were a bit spendy. We went to Steak and Shake, Coranodo, and Dennys across the street (which was our favorite and kids eat dinner free). All of these were family friendly and on a family friendly budget. The Garden Buffet looked nice but they wouldn't discount our kids so we didnt eat there. There was NO way our kids would eat $13 of food. For dinner the buffet was $35 per person. Shew! We plan to go back to Vegas to watch my son shoot the Vegas shoot next year, but we will be staying next door. South Point just isnt as family friendly as it advertised. It's sad we trusted their website only to find this wasnt the case.

allReviews.title: UPDATED room, VERY nice, loved our stay.
allReviews.text: First let me clarify, we stayed in a newly renovated room...so that's what my review is going off of. We haven't every stayed here previously. But our room was SPOTLESS and very nice. It was roomy, had a fantastic view, nice furnishings. The staff was friendly enough, valet service staff were VERY friendly. The restaurants in this hotel are great. The pool area was very impressive to us, it was clean and well-kept and looked beautiful. We loved our stay here and would return!

allReviews.title: Disgustingly dirty and super tight slots
allReviews.text: We're locals but had never been to this place until last night. We went just to check it out and gamble. All I can say is that I will never go back. The gaming area was jam packed and dirty. I used the ladies room and there were feces smeared all over the floor! The slots are the tightest that I have ever seen. I have played at nearly every major casino in the city and I can honestly say this was the worst. We didn't stay overnight. Maybe the rooms are nice. If they are you wouldn't know it judging by the casino floor.

allReviews.title: family vacation
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  staff is always willing to assist Beautiful rooms!   Great pool area and great place for adults and kids to enjoy. Highly recommend The South Point Hotel to anyone wanting a quality staying experience!

allReviews.title: Same terrific advantages while in Vegas, but getting old...
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before because of the great attributes it has:  Far from the Madding Crowd of the Central Strip area which is now swamped with Chinese tourists so you can regroup and rest up for your next foray into the shows and venues, but close enough and simple enough to drive in.  Parking is FREE, on the strip they are charging extortion rates to park--$30 for evening Valet Parking????  Used to be free!  Not here though.  Safe, clean, with good activities and always some special event going on.  On the other hand, the prices are bouncing up, there is an insane "Resort Fee" all the hotels charge for essentially delivering Nothing, $21 here, up to $25 in other resorts.  You spend your money in the hotel and they charge you to do it!  The carpet need replace, the walls could use a wash.  The place is still fun and worth it.

allReviews.title: Mecam Motorcycle auction visit
allReviews.text: Had a great stay here, check in was seamless, friendly staff, room was clean and spacious,all you would need, great coffee machine. Good shower and nice bathroom products. pleasant of restaurants to chose from, bars were good with friendly staff, overall we really enjoyed the stay, typical American casino hotel. Excellent and not too far from the strip for a visit, Taxi rides are reasonable, but to be honest, there is more going on at the tables as the hotel is a little isolated, so why leave? Will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Super Bowl Weekend at South Point
allReviews.text: We stayed at the South Point for Super Bowl weekend. Room is nice, could use an update, but all in all a decent room for the price. Gambling was fun, actually won money and took some home. Would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Rooms are good enough
allReviews.text: I just spent 4 days at the South Point for a convention being held at the hotel. I decided to stay here vs the strip because the hotel itself is one of the 2 hotels farthest from the strip and I didn't want to commute back and forth every day. Cabs and ubers tend to be more expensive here and I didn't want to rent a car. The hotel is HUGE. I'm a pretty fit person but at the end of the day walking around everywhere my legs were feeling it. As for the hotel itself it's pretty much what I expected from photos - no surprises anywhere. The rooms are good enough - big but clean and bed comfy enough. Really nothing special. There are many restaurants in the hotel so you never even have to leave. I was too busy to visit the pool or spa areas and heard that there's even a bowling alley somewhere... so if your in town for business and need a moderately priced hotel just to rest your head it's not a bad place. If your looking for a more "las vegas" feel and have a bigger budget I'd recommend you look elsewhere on the strip.

allReviews.title: Off the Strip but has it All
allReviews.text: Stayed at this property for a recent business event.  First timer.  Staff was excellent from start to finish.  There is a lot to do at South Point and everything was clean and well organized. There are 11 restaurants and everyone we went to was very good.  I highly recommend the Steak House. Rooms were nice, clean and spacious.  If you decide to stay here you should not be dissapointed!

allReviews.title: Recently refurbished rooms
allReviews.text: This is my fourth stay at South pointe,  I stay here for several reasons mainly due to bingo and being out of the craziness of the strip.   Rooms have been recently refurbished and well appointed.   Love the non smoking floors.  Casino area is spacious and feels less smoky than many others that we have visited, which we really appreciate.   Also Uber drivers are able to pick up and drop off under the canary at the main door instead of in parking garages like the strip hotels.

allReviews.title: overnight stay
allReviews.text: we enjoyed our 1 night stay. the room is huge,  very beautiful , very clean and everything is perfect.we hoped we could have stayed  a little longer.  we will recommend   our friends and other family if they will be here in LAS VEGAS. thank you so much for the wonderful  opportunity.

allReviews.title: Family fun with a twist
allReviews.text: A great getaway for all ages! What a wonderful hotel with something for everyone! There is plenty to do for all ages from movies in the theaters to bowling! The kids loved that! The arcade kept them entertained for hours. The 11 different restaurants were delicious and each offered us something different! There was a spa which offered us much needed treatments and the workout room was always accessible! The staff catered to our needs and made our trip one we will be continuing annually!

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: We had a great time at South Point!  There for a bowling tournament and had a great time.  Excellent room, good food at the Coranado cafe and great food at the Silverado Steah house!  Can’t wait to go back in June!

allReviews.title: Clean and comfortable Hotel with all the amenities
allReviews.text: Never have to go too far to find a good restaurant, entertainment or casino play. Very courteous and helpful staff. Sports book is large and has plenty of variety, horses to soccer. Clean and comfortable rooms at a reasonable price.

allReviews.title: Stopped in for a night
allReviews.text: Nice place w/ excellent service.Check in was quick and courteous , very professional.Nice clean room, quiet all night.Casino floor was busy which usually means it’s a popular spot to go.Plenty of parking and a variety of food venues.They always have some kind of show going on .

allReviews.title: One night stay
allReviews.text: Rooms are big, clean and comfortable. Casino is huge but filled with all old machines, Disappointed they didn't have all the new VP games like the other casinos. Prices a little high. Overall we liked the Bingo and the food selections.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
allReviews.text: Our family of four, along with two other couples stayed at South Point for four nights this past weekend and really enjoyed it! The newly renovated rooms are nice and clean. I would suggest better bedding as I found it to be rough and scratchy, but otherwise the room was great! All staff were very nice and helpful. We only dined at a few of the restaurants on-site and they were okay. We didn’t love the restaurant options, although the kids loved the ice cream shop! I’d love a restaurant with some healthy meal options. We also enjoyed the bowling lanes, although had to wait 2 hours on Sat night to get a lane, which was frustrating. Kids enjoyed the pool even though it was freezing! Would possibly stay here again for a family friendly hotel off the strip.

allReviews.title: Security was great and appreciated!  Front Desk was friendly and helpful!  Bed extremely comfortable.
allReviews.text: Security was great and appreciated!  Front Desk was friendly and helpful!  Bed extremely comfortable.

allReviews.title: Dirty comforter
allReviews.text: We were Getting ready to go to bed and discover dry blood on our blanket. Then it takes them 25 minutes to bring clean one. I was never contacted by management  For an apology or to follow up. So gross

allReviews.title: Hotel
allReviews.text: Really Like this Place. Rooms are simple but Great . They have plenty of Black Tables. Decent poker room with tournaments Daily . Free Parking and Free Valet . Real Friendly Staff.. Movie Theater and Bowling Alley On Premises and Plenty Of Places to Eat . They have a Steak and Shake on Premises . Highly Recommend

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: Enjoyed my stay here. Everything is close together making it easy to walk around. Many restaurants to choose from to eat dinner. The salon did a great job doing my hair and makeup. Parking was free! Rare find in Vegas now.

allReviews.title: A great place to stop for the night if you want to avoid the STRIP
allReviews.text: I've stayed here twice for a Convention and it has a lot of the appointments of hotels further up the STRIP. A spa, pool, internet, restaurants and a Casino. Take note though, if you like LIVE KENO games, they don't have it.

allReviews.title: Very nice property
allReviews.text: Rooms are spacious and clean with comfy beds. Several restaurants serving different cuisine. Johnny Rockets is really good along with a buffet offering different foods. Spacious clean gaming area. I really like the open room feel. It has free parking and the resort fee is reasonable. Show room offers pretty good entertainment too! My husband and I enjoy our stays here.

allReviews.title: Too many kids running around, but if you like that.......
allReviews.text: Too many kids running around, mediocre food, overpriced mediocre buffet. The rooms were adequate, the place was clean, I think my favorite thing was the hot dogs for $1.25 right outside the sports book. I won't return.

allReviews.title: WHY I WOULD NEVER RETURN TO SOUTH POINT - AND WHY YOU MIGHT CONSIDER ALTERNATIVES AS WELL
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: My one night stay
allReviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for one night on Jan-01 after our flight was delayed for 24 hours for technical issues. The cost was 320 $ per night !!!! despite the fact we checked at 03:00am in the morning of Jan-01. The receptionist did not want to reduce the price and was not very polite. There was no internet connection at the reception, and this was shocking for such high rated hotel. I was disappointed. I would not recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: new year bash
allReviews.text: Flew in on eve to be with friends for new year. They had ushered in 2018 and recommended highly, excuse enough to join them for this year's party. Had a package deal for dinner and party with the Spazmatics. Good time had by all, good band and open bar. Stayed two nights, rooms updated from our last stay. Comfortable stay, quiet room and clean. Enjoyed casino and movie theater, Sunday buffet was very good.

allReviews.title: Great  place with more ammenities than the big guys!
allReviews.text: We stayed at Southpoint because it was one of the only places we could find that had vacancies for 10 days at Christmas through January 4th. But boy were we pleasantly surprised! The room was very spacious and clean, and the rest was also excellent!With at least 12 eating establishments (that we counted), the movie theater ( we saw 5 movies during our stay), the spa and the casino we were very happy.  We weren’t sure about it because of the distance to the strip, but it proved not to be a problem. We ate at the Café (HUGE Cobb salad), Seattle’s best (great croissants) , Oyster bar , Mexican, Primarily prime rib, and all were great!  Primarily prime rib even served us when they were only 10 minutes from closing and we were the last two people there.  They never rushed us and were very gracious along with having fantastic food!We are not spa people but decided to do the couple’s spa day. We were there for 4 hours!  Going from Jacuzzi to steam and relaxing in the quiet environment.We enjoy playing the bar-top slots while we watch a game at the bar.  All of the bartenders were so friendly and nice and even remembered our names and drinks! And by the way…you can still get a free drink at their bar even if you don’t bet the maximum on each roll.

allReviews.title: Great Vale and It’s Got It All
allReviews.text: South Pointe Hotel Casino is located on the south end of the Strip - way south.  If you want a place to stay that has everything in one place, South Pointe is the place. Gambling, restaurants, Shops, Movie Theatre and Bowling Alley - they are all here.  Never have to leave the complex.Parking is free, rooms are big and reasonably priced, and they are clean.South Pointe is a great value!

allReviews.title: Came on Business and had such a nice stay came again on Personal Trip.
allReviews.text: This was the first time I stayed at the South Point.   I came on Business to see how it was.   They are very friendly and it has many dinning options.   The rooms are very roomy and views are good if on upper floors.   I had such a nice experience that I came back again on a personal trip.

allReviews.title: Very nice
allReviews.text: We are locals and this place has everything you could want from bowling to theatres and about 8 different restaurants.. even when we gamble here we are somewhat lucky. What ever kind of restaurant you want they have here.

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: We booked a 5 day get-a-way and I’d read a few positive reviews about updates etc- well we sure didn’t experience  updates. We’ve been to Vegas many times and I thought SP looked good. We stayed on the 12th floor of tower 2 in a King suite which was tidy but very dated. The king bed was like sleeping on plywood and the sheets were rough. The resort fee is high 21 per day and not worth any of the things it is supposed to cover- coffee isn’t even available in real cups. The buffet is always good and we did enjoy the hotel coupons for a New Year’s Day brunch. Staff was friendly but the ventilation system in the casino must really need an upgrade as it was SO SMOKEY that it was impossible to escape- not just over New Years but the whole time we were here. Bowling alley is good and would be a hit with teens I think. A big DISAPPOINTMENT was the one not cold day we had,  we wanted to sit outside in the pool courtyard to enjoy some smoke-free air and  that was closed 😡 when I booked nothing was said about that or pool maintenance and my rate was certainly not lowered. Rooms are a good size but I would not choose to stay here again. Stay elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Review was approved and removed after 5 min by Expedia upon 3/5 rating (was that upon the hotel's request?)
allReviews.text: Review was approved and removed after 5 min by Expedia upon 3/5 rating (was that upon the hotel's request?)

allReviews.title: Disappointing Experience
allReviews.text: We were sent over to the South Point after our flight was delayed. The hotel and rooms are dated looking but the beds were comfy and we just wanted the sleep. The next morning when we were trying to ask for information and assistance about the airport shuttle the staff were not only not helpful but the “supervisor” Desiree was extremely rude and told me they don’t help airport stranded passengers as a general rule. I was so upset by her comments and the experience I felt the need to leave this review. If you are looking for a cheap place to stay this hotel is not bad. If you are looking for any sort of customer service look elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Outstanding !
allReviews.text: Extensive travel.  Hotel Rooms gigantic, remodeled, very clean.  Great slot play!  Lots of winning!  Outstanding spa!   All day spa complimentary with massage.  Food fair price and good.  Quality restaurants with great specials for holidays!  Totally happy!   Negative:  Uber or bus to strip.  Good news Catch bus 5 minute walk on Las Vegas blvd at Del Taco.  ( not south point bus stop because that is long way around to bus station first.). Best to take Uber to hotel at night.

allReviews.title: Very busy
allReviews.text: It's been awhile since I've visited Southpointe. After almost being run over by a non observant driver whilst I crossed we within a crosswalk,  I entered a very busy casino. Dozens mulling around the entrance and I would guess sports teams. Casino is fairly large but smokey.

allReviews.title: Er, no free WiFi?
allReviews.text: I feel like any respectable hotel in Vegas should have free wifi available to everyone. I'm a local with family in town, and it's quite surprising to realize this. WiFi generally keeps people around longer, especially those who aren't as inclined to gamble as much or at all, and is almost an expectation of anyone visiting a major casino in Vegas.

allReviews.title: WHAT a PLACE!
allReviews.text: AMAZING property.  There are so many restaurants to choose from.  The casino is big and pretty clean.  We went out there to watch World Series Team Roping during NFR. There was also a nice "Cowboy Christmas".  If you don't want to stay on the strip I am sure this property would be a good OUT OF THE WAY place to stay.  We were very impressed.  Spoke to people who were staying there and they said they loved it.

allReviews.title: The Place to Be During Pro Rodeo Finals
allReviews.text: This Hotel has it all! The Women's Pro Rodeo Luncheon is an absolute must.  Then they have an onsite rodeo bazaar and live team roping.  Off the main strip but the hotel provides a free shuttle nightly to the rodeo and a couple big screen rooms to watch the finals live if you can't afford to go to the actual event every night..  One is for family viewing and the other for adults only since liquor is served

allReviews.title: Great for a fun trip OR the family (weird, huh?)
allReviews.text: When I think of Vegas, I don't normally think "HEY! I'll bring my children" However, this truly is a great place to bring the kids if you are just wanting to get away with the fam for a while. The pool is great! They have bowling upstairs and a movie theater, as well as a great arcade for all ages. The restaurants are also great (we are partial to Steak N Shake)Adult side: Awesome sports book! and the casino feels a lot cleaner than most.

allReviews.title: I loved it. The place has everything and prices are great.
allReviews.text: This place was amazing. Poker room was awesome with great promos and fun staff. Tons of $5 blackjack and $5 craps, 100 play video poker, cheap roulette too and fun slots. Drink prices are low, even mixed drinks. There's a Steak and Shake, a bowling alley and a movie theater. There's even a hot dog stand with $1.25 hot dogs. I stayed there a week for a convention on the strip and the drive was simple, 7 minutes door to door. Covered parking is free and plentiful.

allReviews.title: Always a pleasure to stay at!
allReviews.text: Everything from the room to dining was very good.  The room was clean and comfortable, especially glad for the recent upgrades.  The buffet is always a excellent choice for dining along with the coffee shop. And playing video poker is the best in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Clean large rooms
allReviews.text: We recently stayed 3 nights at the hotel. Room was roomy and beds comfortable. Have stayed many times before.  Thought rooms were a bit pricey and 20 extra per person per night a little much. Prices used to be better and don't remember having that extra charge for an additional person. Most likely would stay again of just the 2 of us but not if 3rd person was going.

allReviews.title: First 2 Day Stay to Try the Hotel
allReviews.text: Given a special rate room at the long end of a deserted hall on the 3rd floor. Never heard or saw another person. We thought we were in the movie "The Shining". Very poor room service, we did receive a new towel. Never saw security on that floor. Someone tried to open the door late at night when we were asleep. .Very scary. Door locked from inside and the door was ajar about an inch in the morning. Never heard a knock.The room was old and not remodeled but clean. . Very disappointed. We did not feel welcome here. They reply I received when I completed their survey was cool and calculating and not personal at all. Told what they are told to say in rote form. I guess the resort fee is for no service.

allReviews.title: Always Excellent Service
allReviews.text: We have been using South Point as our destination of choice for many years. Got tired of the crowds and mess of the strip and do not even go down there anymore.The services provided by the hotel are exemplary and the food is varied and great at all of the many restaurants.We look foreword to many more trips to South Point.

allReviews.title: My first choice.
allReviews.text: It is always a pleasure to stay ion the South Point.  The rooms have been upgraded, the restaurants are plenty with good food, free entertainment, movies, slots, and a quick easy access off from the freeway after a long drive from Los Angeles.  They have some of the prettiest cocktail waitresses around. In all of my dozens, and dozens, of trips to Vegas I have never used the bell staff  with me preferring to carry my bags myself.  Not any more!  Bell staff is a real pleasure and convenience.

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel
allReviews.text: This was the second year I’ve stayed at the hotel for the NFR.  The check in line seemed long when I arrived, however, they are so efficient when checking in that I didn’t wait more than 5 minutes.  Very quick and easy check in.  Each visit I’ve been on the 22nd floor, this is a great view of the city and the strip at night.  The room is so spacious, the bathroom is updated and is nice.  The main room is updated, has a desk and updated fixtures.  The buffet is very affordable, the value for the price you pay.  They give coupon books for each guest and it has a 50% off coupon, so when applied the weekday buffet was only 4 bucks. Very good food and an excellent selection of food.The staff is so very kind, I had one unpleasant encounter which was the gal in the buffet who seats everyone, however, I never said anything as it wasn’t ruining my vacation or fun so it didn’t matter to me.  If you want a hotel that’s off the strip, this is the hotel for you.  It’s just a short Uber ride to the strip if you want to go.  My Uber trip from south point to the Linq was only 15 dollars including a tip.

allReviews.title: Excellent off strip property
allReviews.text: Been to Vegas quite a few times and the thrill of the strip is long gone. I'm more interested in getting value for the dollar. That is exactly what you will find at South Point. Inexpensive rooms that are sometimes comped, along with inexpensive food and better gambling odds will keep me coming back. And just because it doesn't cost as much doesn't mean it's not as nice as some of the strip properties.

allReviews.title: Stephen &  Alma Gray
allReviews.text: Excellent stay!  Great customer service!  Our first choice for stays in Las Vegas.  I play Poker, Alma plays Bingo.  She is very pleased with the courtesy and friendly staff in the Bingo room.  I am very satisfied with the same from the staff and dealers in the Poker room.

allReviews.title: TI'MS BIRTHDAY
allReviews.text: Casino is well lite. Yo can park right outside the front door and walk in or you can park in the covered parking lot and it's all free.  The restaurants are all excellent. The rooms are spacious and clean.

allReviews.title: Meeting Family and Friends
allReviews.text: The South Point Hotel and Casino is an excellent place to meet family and friends.  There are lots of restaurants.  There is ample shopping and quite places to visit.  The motel rates are great.  The facility is clean and has fairly loose slots.  The parking is free!

allReviews.title: Quick Weekender
allReviews.text: Took a quick weekend trip and enjoyed the hotel. It was clean and comfortable. The cafe was good with good service and food. The casino was pretty tight and seemed to suck the money right out of our  pockets. That’s Vegas.

allReviews.title: NFR 2018
allReviews.text: Had a great stay this year.  Made a buck. Saw drunken cowboys. Hoards of people. Redecorated rooms were good. Food at Oyster Bar my favorite  but Steak and Shake a close 2nd. Will return for Nascar race in March and NFR 2019.

allReviews.title: GARY PUCKET AND THE UNION GAP IN THE SHOW ROOM
allReviews.text: The venue has seating for several hundred people at tables, booths or small tables. If you have trouble with mobility just ask for a table of booth set aside for you. The stage has great visibility from all vantage points in the show room. Drinks and popcorn can be purchased before and during the show. Your ticket allows you a complimentary drink at one of the bars after the show. There are two monitors for additional video feeds but you can see the entertainers easily from all over the room. Acoustics were great and not so loud that you ear drums feel like they'll break. I've been to many shows in this casino and have never had a bad time. Entertainers always meet and greet after the show.

allReviews.title: It's got everything the strip offers and free parking to boot
allReviews.text: I agree that the hotel casino and rooms are showing their age but it's still a heck of a place for both families and singles. You don't need to leave the grounds for anything if you don't want to. The freebies and discounts are great and if you are a veteran or active service person, you've got to go there on Veteran's Day. The buffet is free and has just about anything you would want to eat. If you are football fan and like your beer, go there on a Sunday and cozy up to any bar for your $1 beers from 10 AM to 4 PM. Fortunately for me, I was both a veteran and a beer lover and stayed at South Point on Veteran's Day. Needless to say, I was quite happy with my choice of a place to stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Spa Day
allReviews.text: I had the pleasure of spending several hours at the spa. It was a great experience. Once you pay for a service you have the use of the facilities for the entire day. They have a stream room, sauna, cool pool, hot tub and a room you can relax in. I recommend this to anyone. The staff was very pleasant and the prices were very fair.

allReviews.title: Buffet Under Renovation
allReviews.text: One of our favorites for convenience and reasonable pricing.  Recently the buffet area has been under renovation, but despite it the food selections have been adequate.  Service is always been consistent with quick and efficient attention.  Salad bar is usually stocked with many choices, but this visit it was limited.  When the area is fully finished with the renovation, it no doubt will be back to par.  Because of the renovation, 'renovation' prices were available.

allReviews.title: Rooms still nice, but starting to show some age.
allReviews.text: We spent 4 nights at South Point as we favor local properties and like the mix of gaming and non-gaming amenities.  It has been about 5 years since our last stay, and while the rooms are still large and in relatively good shape the bathroom and furnishings were starting to show a little age.  Just feels like they could use a little paint and some new linens.Our room on the 4th floor overlooked the pool and was very quiet.  Very rarely heard any noise out in the hallway, and the weekend we were there the hotel was nearly full for the rodeo.  Beds were comfortable and it was nice to have pillows with some loft.  Plenty of closet and drawer storage for clothes and incidentals.  Good shower pressure, liked that the shower warmed up quickly.  We did miss having a refrigerator in the room, and will get an upgraded room with one when we return in the spring.  Hubby does not gamble all that much, so it is nice to have the big pool area and fitness center and movie theater to keep him amused.  We also like the choice of restaurants, a lot of variety depending on what you are in the mood for.  Just wish service was a little quicker at the Del Mar deli.Overall a good stay, still our favorite locals property.  Will be back in early May for a quick stay after visiting some family on the mainland.

allReviews.title: Glad we discovered South Point
allReviews.text: We have not stayed at this hotel (yet) so this is just a review of the casino. For years we have been loyal to Boyd properties during our Vegas trips 2-3 times a year. But Boyd has made drastic changes to their players club. We are looking for a place that welcomes all customers not just the high rollers. The first thing we noticed was how spic and span clean the property was. The second thing was how friendly the dealers were (Sunny and Mary) and the bar staff, especially Jessie. We were trying to sneak a peek at the Equestrian Center which was closed. The security guard was kind enough to give us a guided tour! The buffet was reasonable and delicious.The resort fee is steep but I guess that is everywhere now in Vegas. We hope to return soon!

allReviews.title: Our Destination-Go to Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: When in Vegas we always look forward to our stay at Southpoint.  This time visited the Oyster Bar for perhaps the 7th time, had to order Oysters Rockefeller again,  and had Jambalaya for first time (as good as New Orleans), loaded with various large chucks of fish, shrimp, healthy amount of well-spiced tomato base sauce.  Sue had lobster roll. Large, a good portion of lobster and tasty. Went to see Chubby Checker perform all of his hits from 60’s. Sue got to do “The Twist” with the master.  Did a “meet & greet” with the star and purchased one of his CD’s.  Saw “The Green Book” at the Century theater complex within the hotel (highly recommended)Experienced Another meal at the Italian Restaurant.  Best veal Scallopini I’ve had in years.  Same comment for the gnocchi (shared as an appetizer)and eggplant parm (Sue’s main course).A short two day fun packed get away.  Will return soon.

allReviews.title: Unexpected stay
allReviews.text: We got put up in this hotel by the airline because our flight waa delayed until the next day. This hotel was very nice. The room was very clean and roomy. The staff was very welcoming and friendly. There is lots of activities to do besides gambling. They hve a movie theater and bowling alley right on site which is wonderful.

allReviews.title: Just Average
allReviews.text: This hotel is just before you get to the strip. Easy to get to, right off the freeway. Kid friendly. The rooms were nice, clean and spacious. The Casino wasn't much of anything. Needs a bit of updating, and a more powerful ventilation system. I know they can't do anything about smoking customers, but if the ventilation system was strong enough, it would remove much of the smell. The restaurants were pretty average as well. Since the hotel was so far from the strip, we didn't have much of a choice for dining, but they weren't horrible.

allReviews.title: Nice casino with friendly staff and not too smoky
allReviews.text: We hadn't been to South Point in years, but a friend convinced us to return.  We're glad we did.  It has improved greatly.  There were more tables, and the staff was great.  We had fun playing there for a couple of hours. We would have stayed longer if we hadn't needed to return our rental car.  They need to have have shuttles running to the strip since we only keep our car for 1 day.  I didn't check the bus routes. We would like to return.

allReviews.title: Perfect place to be
allReviews.text: We stayed here because it is the best hotel with the most restaurants. We enjoy the size of the room, plus all the extras to be used. We love the poker room and bingo hall. Its all to be available and enjoyed.

allReviews.title: Lovely hotel and grounds
allReviews.text: The hotel is huge has a lot to offer.  I was there with my daughter and granddaughters.  The facility has a movie theater, bowling alley and lots of restaurants to satisfy everyone.  The rooms and hallways are well lit and maintained.  It is far from the strip and shopping, so be prepared to rent a car or uber it.

allReviews.title: Real people at South Point.
allReviews.text: Spent half a day st SP. Sports book for NFL Sunday was very prepared and did not disappoint. Go to the Mexican restaurant for lunch. $9.95 including a drink. Server was outstanding during our lunch.would I recommend and return? Heck ya

allReviews.title: Huge rooms
allReviews.text: Great huge rooms although no view.2 queen size beds.2 tables.long full length mirror.huge bathroom with double doors.iron & board provided.no fridge.good size closet.Good food in the Garden Buffet.Quite a smoky hotel though.Shuttle provided to airport.

allReviews.title: Nice Casino Hotel if you don't need to be in the action on the Strip
allReviews.text: I stayed in this hotel for 4 nights for a conference.  It's fairly far south on Las Vegas Blvd so you need to drive or take a taxi/Lyft if you want to go to the Strip.  But the rooms are big and clean, wifi was fast, and parking is free.  I didn't eat that many meals at the hotel, but I will say the banquet lunches I had there may have been the best banquet lunches that I've ever had.  I also had a sandwich at the NY-style deli in the casino which was very good. The fitness center was large and well equipped.   I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: improving
allReviews.text: we own next door at the Grandview Resort where we go twice a year, we have gone to South Point many times this year was the best yet, the food was very good, there are renovating the buffet but the food was the best ever, they always put on the Canucks games for us, just really like the place, look forward to going back in the spring.

allReviews.title: If you like the smell of cigarettes and horses...
allReviews.text: Had to stay here for a convention.  Can't stress enough how important it is to avoid this place unless you're into rodeos.  Place smelled like smoke, thin towels, and way off the strip.  Rooms desperately need updating.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: South Point  is a great location away from the crowds on the strip.  There is plenty to do there with arena, movie theaters, bowling alley and excellent variety of restaurants.  The casino has many different slots and gaming tables.

allReviews.title: So much to do
allReviews.text: This 25 floor hotel is  off the strip. It is clean and the staff is so friendly. The slots are below average but the spa, bingo, bowling, movie theatre, is superior. This week they have  world class Horse jumping championship . There are many places to eat. I do t really care for the quality of food but I am a hard critic. The rooms on the upper floors are all redone and are clean. The bed is too hard, I mean way too hard for me and because of that I will never stay here again . I had a wonderful facial this morning and had access to a beautiful spa and showers. There is a shuttle to and from the airport. If you take a taxi it will cost about $40.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel/casino
allReviews.text: South Point is an excellent choice if you are OK with being off the strip. They do have a shuttle that willTake you to the strip- so that works out fine!  They have great choices for restaurants and offer some great entertainment options. They have many equestrian and rodeo events which I love. Try it- you’ll like it!! Another positive- NO CHARGE for parking!!

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel/casino and movie theatre too
allReviews.text: We visited here for dinner, hang in the casino and took in a movie. Really nice place away from the main strip area. We highly recommend the area for easy access to the northern amenities. Makes for cheap Uber from here to all the exhibits and events.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Resort
allReviews.text: This resort is amazing. It has everything you can possibly think of. It has a very nice movie theater, bingo hall, bowling alley, fitness center, hair salon, barber shop, pool, ice cream shop, gift shop, and of course GAMBLING. You can self park or valet park for FREE. The staff is quick when bringing your car, just don’t forget to tip. We stayed in regular room which was cool. It was clean and the bed slept good. Downside is we did not have a refrigerator but you can upgrade to the newer rooms that have a refrigerator in it.This resort also is big for it’s Equestrian stable which draws a lot of older people but overall it’s a great place to be.It has several restaurants from a burger joint to finer dining. It is approx. 10 minutes from the strip and a popular strip mall.The casino fee is most like the cheapest you will find at just $21/night.Overall we had a great time, just wish I could have explored more of the resort. We were so busy with pre planned things we only got a chance to go to the movie theater but hopefully when we go back we can check out the other things this resort has to offer. If you book here you will not regret it....Trust Me!!!!!

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience -- I am a pool person - and their pool was delightful - outdoors - in perfect condition .
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience -- I am a pool person - and their pool was delightful - outdoors - in perfect condition .

allReviews.title: I wont stay any other place in Vegas from now on!
allReviews.text: This Hotel Casino Arena is South of the strip taxis & shuttles available if you want to go to the strip or old town.Staff is awesome, rooms a cut above, small enough to have the old Vegas feel!Attended ABBI event (American Bucking Bull Inc)Bulls were housed on the property nice arena...I just can't say enough about this location....it is Fantastic!!!

allReviews.title: Not expensive good time, but smoking everywhere
allReviews.text: Room is nice, big clean.Slat machines let you enjoy playing. The new plasma-tv let people enjoy even other people’s winnings.The all-eat buffet is cheap and extremely good. You feel like on some all-inclusive resort.The down-site is smoking in the casino is more than you can see in the other places. Casino should improve the fan system – in the morning it is OK, but in the evening this secondary smock is way too much.

allReviews.title: Great place: have excellent restaurants; large bowling alley; theaters.
allReviews.text: A family friendly place.  Great food at the restaurants and great service.  A lot of activities for families.  The parking is easy; can park outside or on a ramp.  We go here anytime we have visitors at our house.

allReviews.title: Sema 2018
allReviews.text: Another SEMA Show week in Las Vegas and South Point shined as usual! I recommend SP to all my friends heading to Vegas! Now newly remodeled rooms with refrigerator included was very clean. My only negative was The Garden Buffet food could be much better as could Wait staff. I recommend any other restaurant in SP.

allReviews.title: Reasonable Getaway
allReviews.text: Provides good quality entrainment and food at very reasonable prices.  Good gambling facilities.  Varied show programs, ample free parking and good customer relation.  Rodeo and bull riding in arena provided good entertainment value.  You are off the Strip but have reasonable access to it by public transportation, taxis and Uber.

allReviews.title: It was OK
allReviews.text: We did not get one of the newly renovated rooms during our stay. The room was decent enough, clean and the beds were semi comfy. The bathroom was a bit rough with peeling wallpaper, a hole in the wall from where the door handle went through and the shower drain needed some serious shaking (you would in ankle deep water by the end of your shower). The price was right and wasn't too far from the strip which is where I spend most of my time. I would probably stay again but this time get an renovated room.

allReviews.title: Great Place but has some security issues
allReviews.text: Twice in 5 days someone entered my room with a key. 6 am one morning and 2 days later at 3 pm when 2 men took out my Do Not Disturb key and opened my door. I was in my room to keep them out. All front desk staff said was sorry. This is a big issue; something seriously could have happened; theft or worse.

allReviews.title: Clean rooms!
allReviews.text: We opted for the non-renovated rooms as they were a little cheaper and our room was completely clean and looked new to us!  This is a massive hotel with 11 restaurants and a huge, smoky casino. It is on the edge of downtown which makes it nice too to stay a little out of the craziness.

allReviews.title: Great spot
allReviews.text: We stayed here a week , it’s a very nice hotel . We stayed on the newely remodeled side they called it an out room is very large, clean . The staff with the exception of the deli was very good. The movie theatre was nice and I use the gym daily - it’s small but newer equipment and clean . Our room had sink issues they said they fixed it but it clogged again the next day and the water pressure in the shower isn’t great . For make up wearers the lighting in the bathroom is aweful for true look at your make up . The biggest down side is the buffet , we aren’t buffet people but my husband does them for breakfast at the hotels we stay at , the day made no difference nor did the time - he always waited in very long lines with very long wait times in the food area and he was disappointed with that . The deli is horrible, the Asian place was awesome. The steak house is very good as well . The valet is efficient and friendly.  We prefer to stay off the strip a bit as it seems less crowded . Last time we were ln the thick of it an there were upsides to that but over all the crowds get to me to fast in that situation.

allReviews.title: Honeymoon
allReviews.text: Thank.you for making our honeymoon so nice here. It was quiet and plenty to offer with games movies and bowling. The food was great as well and we loved the buffet.  The room was cleaned everyday.My only suggestion would be more plugs for cell phones and ipads in. Also more areas of non smoking for people who.want to play.  It made it hard to play at times with everyone smoking around me and i have asthma.  Even one section would be nice. Other than that thank you again

allReviews.title: Can Handle a Trailer
allReviews.text: I usually visit Las Vegas on a camping excursion to the Southwest.  Almost no Hotel on the strip can handle a trailer if you want to stay in the hotel. South Point was recommended to us.  South Point is technically  on the strip but is located a few miles south of the airport.It is a typical casino hotel.  A large casino with a few dining options scattered around. It does have a livestock arena which is one reason it has a separate parking area for trailers.The rooms are nice, spacious, working desk, comfortable bed, quiet, pricey for the location.A few caveats - The web site mentions shuttle service to the strip.  It is NOT offered. when we inquired were given a well rehearsed summary of the city bus an Uber.  The free shuttle service to the airport is nice, but does NOT run early enough for the early flights.

allReviews.title: Bowling trip
allReviews.text: Stayed at South Point for just over 2 weeks. Nice and quiet hotel, away from the strip, with friendly staff and spacious rooms.If staying during Thanksgiving, make sure you book a table in advance.Will be back.

allReviews.title: One night stop
allReviews.text: We stay only one night passing through Will try to book again tomorrow if I can . We like it nice and clean good and easy to park your truck and trailer great breakfast restaurant and had good supper too !!

allReviews.title: Golf trip and more.
allReviews.text: We, (sixteen) guys stayed here for a golf outing to Las Vegas. The National Indian Rodeo competition was also happening and the facility was very busy. All of the staff seemed very accommodating. The bellstaff handled our golf bags each of the four days, the casino crew was quite friendly, restaurants were all good and we all had a great visit to Vegas and South Point. Only gripe was the large hot tub was over-chlorinated....

allReviews.title: Very Good Casino Hotel with Amenities
allReviews.text: First time staying at South Point (Weekday), even though I’ve been going to Las Vegas since the late 80’s, it was an enjoyable stay. Upon arrival, we drove from California, the Resort signage is clearly marked and the Valet is very expansive. Registration was very quick and the clerk gave us room location choice.  There was a Rodeo Event going on, but there was still plenty of options.  A quick stroll through the casino on the way to the elevators, the layout is pretty well thought out. Stores, Eateries and entertainment are on the outer perimeter while the tables and slots makeup the interior.Our double-queen room was spacious and clean. The Wi-Fi was good and the in-room Coffee machine worked well.  We didn’t need to use the safe even though one was provided.Back down in the Casino, there are plenty of Slots and Table Games, but since we didn’t win, I’ll say they were “tight”, lol.We ate at the Garden Buffet for Dinner and for the price, it was a good deal with above average food items and choices. The best deal is in the coupon book you receive at Check-In. There’s a 50% discount on the Buffet for Breakfast, Brunch, or Lunch. Since we were leaving before Noon, we had breakfast, which cost less than $4 per person with Coffee, Tea, juice and a wide variety of food items. They do have an on-site Bowling Alley and Movie Theater, so the Resort is pretty self-contained.  If your looking for that “Strip” experience then stay elsewhere,  it if your looking for a good deal and be close to The Strip then South Point is a good value.

allReviews.title: Refreshing change from The Strip
allReviews.text: We've been visiting this hotel/casino since it was the South Coast way back in 2005 and it has kept well. Our recent stay was in a newly refurbished room: wood floors, new furnishings, little slippers, big screen TV, nicely appointed bathroom. Everything is nice and clean. The casino is spacious though I find it difficult to stay there very long due to the smoke (by Las Vegas standards, it is not oppressive but I am allergic). My husband is O.K. as long as someone doesn't light up beside him. The Garden Buffet was being worked on, so I'll be interested to see the result. The cafe, as always, was excellent. Parking is free and plentiful. The equestrian center is world class. There is also a movie theatre and bowling alley.

allReviews.title: Very reasonable Las Vegas stay
allReviews.text: We spent 3 nights at South Point and enjoyed every minute of it.  The room rate was very reasonable - $79 / night with a resort fee of $18.  There are promotions that reduce that rate even further.  Despite the rate, the room was large and very clean.  All the typical Las Vegas amenities are available including free wifi, a good gym (access to the lockers and spa is an additional fee - typical of most Vegas hotels).  It has a good sized pool with lots of seating.  Probably the nicest surprise was the quality of the food.  The Italian and seafood restaurants were  especially good and prices are, once again, reasonable.  The gaming is good; I love poker and their poker room was busy and well run, although there aren't many big money games (which is fine with me).  All in all, we had a very relaxing and pleasant time.  Will definitely go back.

allReviews.title: VERY NICE CLEAN HOTEL
allReviews.text: The hotel is quite large and has plenty of restaurants, a bowling alley, bingo hall, movie theaters and much more. The employees are nice and friendly.  It's clean and reasonably priced.  The rooms are large and comfortable including the beds and pillows. Housekeeping provided extra towels when needed. The casino is large and has plenty of everything to choose from when it comes to gambling. They do not charge for parking which is a big plus.

allReviews.title: I hope to be back!
allReviews.text: This is a reasonably priced hotel with spacious, clean and quiet room.Staff were friendly (at reception, restaurant, housekeeping) and when we informed Reception that the safe in our room was not working, someone arrived within ten minutes to fix it.Complimentary wifi with strong signals for unlimited number of devices.In addition to several restaurants, there was a bowling plaza, a large Bingo hall and a cinemaplex so you're almost certain to find something to do.

allReviews.title: 2nd stay cant wait for 3rd
allReviews.text: This was our 2nd stay and so glad we chose South Point again.  We split all our Uber costs with another couple which makes this a no-brainer place to stay for us.  When we want to strip or downtown we spend the money to Uber then come back to the quiet of our room.  There's plenty to do here too.  On Sunday the guys watched football while I took in a movie.  We were in an upgraded room..loved it.  Beds comfy with nice crisp sheets.

allReviews.title: John Anthony Olszowy
allReviews.text: I had my hair cut and a facial done on my birthday at the South Point Casino on October 8th 2018.The South Point Casino Barber Salon in the South Point Casino.Hair Stylist John Taddio did an outstanding job on my hair.Thanks for the Flat Top John.Love it, Love it, Love it.I give John Taddio Five Stars (*****).Thanks Again.Internationally Known Ombudsman (Ombudsmen) John Anthony Olszowy (Allsway).

allReviews.title: “Never again, unqualified personnel, no accountability!”
allReviews.text: Extra charges when checking out that are still not clear for me today. 1st night was under 100 USD, second night over 150 USD plus an extra charge of 78 USD, still unexplained at check out - Telephone had no ringtone when I tried to use it the next morning so I couldn't order breakfast and had to go down to tell the front desk. They called engineering who didn't show up for the next 3 hours that I was up in the room to watch the Ryder Cup. When I had to leave for the day, around midday, I went back down to the front desk to tell the problem is still not solved and they said that they contacted engeneering and will check again! When I came back in the evening the front desk said they had no message from engineering so it should be fixed. So I said this is not a good customer service because if it still doesn't work I would again have to come back down etc... Fortunately it worked when I was back in the room. It's sad that there was no communication and excuses!

allReviews.title: South Point Hotel
allReviews.text: Room was very inviting, very clean, very comfortable. Hotel dining choices were many. We did not use the pool while there but it looked nice. This hotel was right near a freeway entrance & exit which was extremely convenient. Our visit was short & spent with family away from the hotel. We would stay there again if needed.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with great service
allReviews.text: I stayed at this hotel only for one night but would consider that for my next trip to Nevada for sure. I'm not a gambler and that was not the purpose of my trip to that state but I enjoyed my stay. The only thing that I would consider for the next time (and you should too if it'd possible) is to get a room at the north side of the hotel and one of the last floors.

allReviews.title: Concert visit
allReviews.text: I haven't stayed here but myself and my husband were at a concert and my son visited the casino.  We had a lovely evening, even although the concert was very short but that is not down to the hotel, that was down to the star in concert.

allReviews.title: The whole package
allReviews.text: Moved here because we tried another hotel on the strip and wasn’t impressed with the quality of room and staff of the other place. Got a room no prob. Fast check in. Rooms are nice, I’ve stayed here during the rodeo several times. Pool is salt water pool and there’s a bar and deli right there with poolside service. Big sur oyster bar. Friendly, great portion of crab legs. Oysters were delicious. Goes good with oysters shot. ZenshinI cannot remember the names of the rolls we had but they were better than I thought they’d be. Pork belly was also very good. Try the mussels. You won’t be disappointed. Coronado cafeBig variety of foods. We ate here everyday and enjoyed each meal. Lots of home cooked meal classics. Bowling alley was also very fun.

allReviews.title: Great slots
allReviews.text: Stopped again this trip. We so enjoyed casino and buffet four years prior, so why not.On the boulevard but very removed southerly from center strip. Worth the drive if you have a car.Great slot selection and one of few casinos in town with penny Cashman, my wife's favorite. Many other good selections we enjoyed. They have a great buffet we very much enjoyed and happened to be there on a Saturday. The brunch featured bottomless mimosas, too. Great cocktail service which is very lax these days in many of the casinos in town. Their ladies were very attentive and were among the most attractive in town. Parking is ample, too.Highly recommend when in town and look forward to returning next trip to town. Also, many dining choices in addition to their great buffet.

allReviews.title: It is not a Vegas Strip Hotel, But it was perfect for us.
allReviews.text: Room was clean and very comfortable. Water was hot, bed was perfect for both of us, and the Keurig worked great. Nothing fancy. No comforter on the bed but we called and that was fixed in 5 minutes. All people from Valet to Hostess to checkout were kind and professional. The sports book was comfortable. The food was much better than expected. We loved the hot tub at the pool area as well as the theater and bowling alley. The airport had 18 dollar a day cars and was very close to South Point. We were 12 minutes from the Vegas Strip when we wanted to go. Really a best bang for the buck kind of place.

allReviews.title: Allergy Friendly -- Awesome!
allReviews.text: I was at South Point to cover the Andalusian World Cup 2018 for my podcast, Because of Horses. I figured the horse facilities would be great but, although I had seen nice photos online of the rooms and amenities, I didn't really expect much. I'm very happy to say the "human" facilities were really nice -- very clean, fresh, nicely decorated, and comfortable. I loved my room (a king with tons of space, a huge bathroom, and everything I could need for the week I was there). And I was right -- the horse facilities were top of the line and right there, all under one roof and easily accessible.But what made the trip great for me was how incredibly helpful the restaurants and room service were in working with me and my ridiculous food allergies. I travel a good deal and this is not at all my experience -- at the "good" end of the spectrum, the waitstaff makes a note (olive oil and salt only in preparing the food)... and at the other end, they'll be impatient, rude, and even challenging. But the South Point staff was phenomenal -- so friendly, helpful, understanding, patient, and meticulous in making sure that I could not only eat while I was there, but that I could relax and really enjoy my meal. I'm actually tearing up as I write this, because... you just have no idea how huge this is, if you don't have potentially life-threatening allergies. Usually, I just fill my hotel room fridge with food that I Uber to Whole Foods or Sprouts or Trader Joe's to buy, then eat cold throughout the stay.So -- to the staff at South Point and to your managers -- you have my very sincere appreciation! (Especially room service and Primarily Prime Restaurant) Thank you so much!

allReviews.title: Cheap bets in a large casino
allReviews.text: Have not stayed. Impressed with South Points Casino.  $5 minimum bets and lots of choice in tables and slots. Worth a trek out if your looking to learn how to gamble.  Also close to the airport we visited on the way home.

allReviews.title: Conference
allReviews.text: I went for a conference that was being held here. The hotel was really nice. I stayed there for easy access to the conference, and the discount we got for booking there. The restaurants were really good. My favorite was the Japanese restaurant, we went during happy hour, and they had good specials. I would recommend this property to anyone. It wasn't near the Strip, but the Lyft ride wasn't long to get to the strip.

allReviews.title: Excellent!!!
allReviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised 😮 Great value for your money!!! The spa is my go to every time I visit Las Vegas. The gambling is even reasonable Lololol. Good area for cheapy souvenirs. Staff was welcoming informative and friendly!!!

allReviews.title: A True Vegas Gem
allReviews.text: Went to the South Point for a meeting and the Frankie Avalon Show.  I have been to LAs Vegas over 25 times in the last 20 years and this is my first trip to the South Point and I wish I had discovered it earlier.  Hotel room had been refurbished and was excellent.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.   Also, the prices for water, beer, etc in the gift shops are ridiculously low.  Bottles of wine / alcohol were cheaper than my last trip to a liquor store.  The price for a diet Pepsi was less than 1/2 of what I paid at any other hotel on the strip.Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Nice place. It has everything you want!
allReviews.text: We stayed here on the final night of a Denver to Vegas (via the Grand Canyon) road trip. I wanted to be near the airport for the flight home and thought one night in a poker room in a casino would be fun. And they were running a special.Our room was great. (We use ADA rooms. This one was fit the bill nicely.)They have it all. Slots, table games. A nice and busy poker room.  A variety of places to eat.  Free and plentiful convenient parking. A huge pool.The poker room had a variety of tables and plenty of low stakes options. We were seated within a few minutes.  The players were friendly---lots of them seemed to be regulars but certainly willing to take my money :o)  Dealers were friendly. Servers made the rounds regularly.  It was a Thursday night and still plenty of action. I really wanted to stay an extra night.
