allReviews.text: Nice that this is off the strip.  Wish we would have gotten one of the new rooms since they have hardwood floors and a refrigerator.  Our room was huge and it was nice.  Lots of things to do.  Casino is slow to give multi games on the slots but if you get one you do get paid for it.Loved that there is a bowling ally, movie complex, and even horse shows.....family friendly.  Pool was ok, not as big as it looks in pictures.   Lots of resturants for many different tastes.  Be sure to use the coupon book you get at check it for some more freebies.

allReviews.title: GREAT stay at the South Point !!!
allReviews.text: Our family (me,my wife and our 16- and 12-year old) stayed at the South Point for 3 nights before checking into our week-long timeshare at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club on Paradise and, to be completely honest, we enjoyed our stay at South Point a lot more than we did the Hilton property.We paid on average $120/night for Wed-Fri night and the $21/day resort fee included in that price gave us a coupon book which we used to save money at the onsite Garden Buffet (we enjoyed a great breakfast), the onsite bowling center, the onsite bingo, and the onsite Cinemark movie theater.We had the 2 queen deluxe mid view unit and it was a bit more roomy than a typical 2-bed hotel room as others here have mentioned.  My wife enjoyed the fact that the bathroom actually had decent counter space (see attached picture).Aside from having the casino downstairs, there are several onsite restaurants with various price ranges.  Our family enjoyed the Steak n Shake a couple times during our 3-night stay and we even came back for the afternoon Happy Hour (2:00-5:00pm weekdays) 50% off milkshakes during our subsequent stay at our Hilton timeshare.  In addition, the Garden Buffet breakfast was really good.  And what made it better was that we signed up for a South Point Club Card (which was very easy to do) to get the $8.95 discounted price and THEN used the 50% off coupon from the coupon book that we received at check-in.  Nice!We also enjoyed the bowling center (50% off in the coupon book) and the $5.25 all-day price on Tuesdays at the onsite movies.  And the swimming pool was huge and the pool area was really nice.  The only issue if that there isn't a lot of shade by the pool so we waited until early evening to avoid the strong sun.  Oh, and my wife actually won some $$$ one night at the onsite bingo room!  :)My wife and kids thought the casino was a little smoky but I didn't find it too bad.  I would have liked to see the Motown show at the onsite theater--maybe next time.So in summary, there's a lot to do at the South Point.  And the prices are very reasonable for what you get.  I will gladly look to book here again on a future trip to Las Vegas.  Highly recommended by this reviewer and his family.  Well done, South Point!

allReviews.title: Great price!
allReviews.text: Overall, a good "non-strip" location with all the normal amenities. Great price for a person going through town but more than enough "stuff" to do on site. Good buffet and AMAZING movie theater. (discounts on Tuesday's and/or in coupon book provided at check-in)

allReviews.title: premium rooms
allReviews.text: We booked 3 premium rooms for our extended family for a weekend in Vegas. The difference between the deluxe rooms are the floor having a carpet and hardwood floors on the premium rooms. The premium rooms has a mini fridge and located on higher floor which means having a better view. Our room was clean, staff are friendly and easy checking in and out.This is a family friendly resort offering a theater, arcade (although small), bowling and the pool area is huge. There are multiple restaurant ranging from buffet of course to snack stands. They also give a booklet of offers at check in with my favorite which is a 50% off buffet. This resort is not in the strip (south) but has a shuttle to the strip and it's about 5 minutes drive. It offers free valet and self parking which is a plus since most if not all strip hotels charge for parking fees these days. A $21 resort fee is not bad as compared to $35 to $40 resort fees to the hotels on the strip.

allReviews.title: Very Good Value, Nice Rooms if Upgraded
allReviews.text: South Point is off the strip. These are the least expensive hotels rooms in Vegas and they give you a good value if you get an upgraded room. We were on the second from the top floor. The room was large with two lounge chairs and a table and king size bed. The bathroom is a little on the small size. The bed was comfortable. There is a small under counter refrigerator in the room. The upgraded rooms are only about $10 more a day but well worth it. The hotel has many places to eat. The buffet is good. Avoid the Mexican restaurant as it is awful. I have not tried the others. They have a large pool and a spa but finding a chair on hot day can be daunting. Seems like there were less chairs than people. Join their player's club to get some 2 for one coupons and other stuff. I have stayed her twice and was not disappointed either time. But prepare to walk. It is a huge hotel and it is a long walk from the casino to the rooms and from the parking structure to the casino. I suggest that you find places to eat outside the hotel if you are willing to drive a little.

allReviews.title: Great Value Exceptional Quality
allReviews.text: I stayed here two nights for business on my first visit to their property and was surprised by clean well appointed room at such a great rate. The room was decorated with modern touches and very big compared to most standard Vegas rooms.   Mr. Vaughn clearly prides himself on the property and it’s reputation—which in turn benefits each guest. The eating venues are great with quality food at great prices. Although it is off the beaten strip path it is only a quick $15 Uber rider to the heart of the strip. I will definitely return here on my next Vegas trip regardless of my business based on my the quality and cleanliness!

allReviews.title: Decent Place to stay
allReviews.text: Stayed on my way through Vegas on a work trip.  Room was nice, clean and comfortable.  Went down to the pool for a little relaxation after a long drive.  The pool area was nice with a decent amount of seats available although it was a Sunday afternoon.  The pool itself wasn’t exactly clean, leaves dirt and debris was visible everywhere.  Now I know its difficult to clean a pool of this size and all but its seems that a better jib could be done.  All in all, I still think its a nice place if you don’t have the desire to stay on the strip proper.

allReviews.title: Great value for the money
allReviews.text: Whatever you plan to do, we get back to South Point. Makes it easy to have everything around. They have great deals. The rooms are clean and we noticed they are remodeling. The pool area is awesome.Great restaurants to choose from.  Lots of options for things to do. 5 min away from the airport, easy access to the Strip, but staying away from the madness.

allReviews.title: Great accommodations!
allReviews.text: Found this on Hotwire and will definitely be back. The rooms are huge with tons of room for a hotel room.  Hotel staff was great, gave tons of extra coffee when requested, easy check in/out not a huge wait.  Beds super comfortable and rooms were very clean. Hotel has live free comedy Friday nights, casino isn’t filled with smoke like most of the hotels on the strips and seems to be more open and bright. Lots to do just in the hotel.  Pool and hot tub are are decent and roomy. Very relaxing atmosphere around the hot tub especially with it being 16 and over for hot tub. Shuttle service was great and on time as well. A+ i will be back!

allReviews.title: Excellent value and good for off-strip hotel
allReviews.text: If you are not coming to Vegas for the Strip and are looking for good value then the South Point is a good option.  We booked this for 1 night as an addition to our stay on the Strip as our plans changed and we needed another night at the start of our stay in Vegas.  Our other hotel was going to be $300-$400 for 1 night and this hotel was about $45!We checked in with 4 friends, each of whom had booked a Queen room and they all got upgraded to a King Suite on one of the top floors, yet when we checked in next, we still got the Deluxe King we booked on one of the bottom floors (5).  Not to mention, we were the only actual couple - so not sure how they work their upgrades.We had a king bed which was comfortable in a huge room.  The bathroom was off the main room, but then within this there was another door to the shower and toilet.  This is great if someone needs to use the sink while someone else is in the shower/toilet.  The shower pressure was amazing - always a great thing for a hotel room.  Consequently, when you opened our curtain, we had a view of a fence about 1 metre from our window.The hotel has a shuttle to and from the airport and this was easy to find and very good.The resort fee had gone up to $21 a night (this was after our booking).  This hotel is a good budget hotel and you can definitely tell this from the clientele of the patrons in the casino.  The buffet restaurant was good for dinner and very well priced.  You can also get a reduced rate by getting a membership to the hotel as well (which is free).The location is definitely not within walking distance to the Strip at all and other than the hotel, there is not much around the local area.  Saying that, the hotel does have a range of restaurants, bars, activities and even shops.

allReviews.title: Good location for a conference
allReviews.text: Hotel has convenient access to Interstate and Las Vegas Boulevard, but without traffic congestion. Convenient parking. Meeting rooms were flexible and well-suited to accommodate large or small gatherings. Staff handled well the refreshments and food service needs of meetings and banquets..

allReviews.title: Great Value, location and no parking fees!
allReviews.text: This is an excellent hotel. It has all the amenities and the rooms are very spacious and kept up. The bathroom is 2 separate rooms. There is a coffee maker in the room as well. No parking fees and it's close to the strip. Large casino, many restaurants to choose from and large pool area. Very quiet in the guest rooms.

allReviews.title: Brilliant
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 2 sets of 2 and 3 nightsIn between went to a conference and Grand Canyon The staff at reception are so friendly Valet parking helpful We had a fabulous stayPlenty of choice Thank you South Point

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel - great value
allReviews.text: We stayed here for a few nights whilst visiting Las Vegas, check in was very quick and the reception lobby is very impressive as it leads straight onto the casino floor. The front car park is huge but fills up very quickly in the evening. This may be due to the casino itself but also possibly due to the 16 screen cinema complex located here. We were given a room on the 22nd floor and were surprised that we had to drag our own bags through a very very large casino hall, right to the back of the property to where the lifts are located. Dragging wheeled luggage and hand luggage across thick carpet isn't easy. This to me is a very strange set up. However, there are lots of lifts and it doesn't take too long for one to arrive. The rooms themselves are a very nice size and looked fresh. bed was super comfy and large. We had a front view across the huge flat roof onto the parking lot. if you need snacks or have forgotten anything there is a gift shop / mini mart on the ground floor along with coffee shops, cafe, a Krispy Kremes and other food outlets. This place has it all! We were disappointed by what we were told was a courtesy bus that never arrived after waiting 45mins and we had to Uber it into the Strip. Taxis were asking a lot of money for what was a 15 minute journey ($37-45) and we paid the Uber guy $12 for the same trip - to Mandalay Bay. We booked this hotel through booking.com and had a great room rate $66 per night and the rooms were being advertised at the hotel for $200 per night. So a bargain using the app. The hotel is very close to the South side Designer Outlets and there are also restaurants and coffee shops here too. This journey in the car was 5 mins. The hotel has a number of entry points so just remember which one you need and use the same one - this place is so big its easy to get confused and then you'll have a long walk to the reception lobby. Wifi is free, strong and uninterrupted.The room has an iron and board, safe and a tv. Wardrobe had plenty of space with hangers and bathroom was well equipped.

allReviews.title: Good Location, value for money
allReviews.text: We booked this a hotel for a very good price through booking.com for three days. The hotel is close enough to the strip to be there in a matter of minutes. The hotel offers a shuttle service three times a day but the once that we tried to use it, it never arrived and we booked an Uber instead which  cost about $13.There's a lot to do in the hotel itself like bowling gambling or watching a movie. There are also plenty of coffee shops and snack bars in the hotel. The staff were very quick for check in and check out and friendly. There is lots of parking on site for free. We had room on the 22nd floor which had views of the strip. The hotel also has a swimming pool which looked amazing but unfortunately we didn't get tie to use it instead we wondered off to the shopping outlets five minutes down the road.

allReviews.title: Huge Complex that needs attention to detail
allReviews.text: We were staying at the Southpoint for a conference. We were told we could check in at 12 and then upon arrival we were told the room would not be ready until 3. Ok we were in a casino so we went to grab lunch and check out the resort.  There are several restaurants but only a couple were open for lunch. Looking at all the menus though we came to the conclusion that the hotel must think it has a captive audience because it is so far off the strip that it can charge huge prices for what I consider medium to fair food.  Going back to desk to check in at 3 and we were told another hour. Geez Louise. So the next day I had a pedicure scheduled.  I arrived and the lady was there ready for me. She seemed personable. I have had years of mani- pedis.  I was somewhat confused by the steps this person took. She first removed and then applied my polish (gel). Then she soaked my feet and exfoliated my skin so hard that I had actual sores form.  In my opinion this was the absolute worst pedicure I have ever had. The rest of our trip was blah and I spent most of my time just sitting at their pool. That is until a boys wrestling conference started and all of the kids and their puffed up parents arrived and over crowded the pool area. By Thursday we checked out and moved to the Venetian.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel casino
allReviews.text: Two weeks stay great room floor 24 overlooking the pool,good check in with a pleasant smile from the desk gaming was good a great sports book and hot dogs $1.25 each brilliant,buffet brunch with mimosas unlimited with great food even put your beef on the grill when asked been staying here for the past 7years and always had a great time with all that work there and the pool is large with plenty of sun beds!

allReviews.title: Away from strip
allReviews.text: This hotel is away from the strip making it easier to weave out of traffic. Rooms are big and equipped with a fridge upon request (extra charge per night). Didn’t like the smoky smell of walking to and from restaurants.

allReviews.title: Great Value for Your Money
allReviews.text: Our room was on the 10th floor. We enjoyed it because it was very quiet. We had a great view of the sun risoing very morning. We ate everyday at the Coronado. Great food, great service and friendly staff.

allReviews.title: South Point Hotel Hits High Review
allReviews.text: I loved all this hotel had to offer from Krispy Kreme Doughnuts to bowling or a movie right on site especially if you are traveling with kids under 21. The food was good too, calamari was probably best I have had at little place right inside casino I cant remember the name of it.

allReviews.title: Hard to beat
allReviews.text: For those who value the entertainment part of a stay, the South Point Hotel Casino and Spa is hard to beat. Families will definitely find ways to enjoy their stay, plus adults on their own can try their luck on the huge Bingo hall that offers lucrative games throughout the day. Drinks are on the house, of course, honoring the old Vegas tradition intended to keep all kinds of gamblers on the happy side, or should I add the inebriated side, for a tipsy gambler is more open to try winning more often. Families can enjoy the swimming pool in those hot days, which are plenty. Movies are big deals on their theater, which boasts like 16 screens? All latest releases available some times at bargain prices, and who among us doesn’t like a good movie (who amI kidding here? Once inside is rather tempting to catch an extra show! Sshhh what happens in Vegas, you know...), there are all kinds of events going on such as Rodeos, Comedy Shows, and do not pass on the huge Bowling center where after midnight cost very little to play. The reason i give it 4 Stars instead of 5 is because of some limitations on their dining deals, which can and should improve specially on the Buffet sometimes. Not to say that a person can not eat to their heart’s content. Rooms are adequate with in room safes available. Sometimes one doesn’t have to leave the property to have a good time. 4 Stars.

allReviews.title: Father’s Day Gateway
allReviews.text: Spent the weekend here.  Spacious deluxe king size room.  Bathroom was spacious too.  Only drawback was the towels were of lower quality than them the hotel classification (4.5 Star)And there was limited quantities.  They should at least provide 3 towels each instead of two for the king size rooms.  Love their restaurants and the price was reasonable and brings back memories of Vegas once upon a time when Vegas meals were around $3 - $4 for NY Strip Steak😄.

allReviews.title: Lots to offer!
allReviews.text: Wide variety of things to do right inside Casino. Conveniently located off strip. Comfy rooms. Responsive staff. Big pool areas. Many restaurants to pick from - coffee houses to FABULOUS deli to fine dining.

allReviews.title: Bachelorette trip
allReviews.text: Perfect place to stay.  Spacious clean rooms!  Restaurant options are fantastic. The pool is nice.  Time at the spa is a must and I highly recommend a massage.  This is my 5th stay at South Point and have never been disappointed--well minus the bad luck at the casino :)

allReviews.title: A city within a city
allReviews.text: Clean rooms, efficient and friendly staff. Complimentary valet for vehicle and room. Many amenities, 11 restaurants especially the excellent buffet. Only drawback is no refrigerator in our room. Do have some rooms with them. Situated away from the strip. Was not expensive for the room, do have resort fee.

allReviews.title: Love everything about this hotel!
allReviews.text: We love NASCAR and this is the best place to stay during a race weekend or just anytime.  Great restaurant choices.  Rooms are nice and clean.  Easy parking.  Nice location with free shuttle to the Strip.  No complaints.  Planning on staying again this October.

allReviews.title: Strange Feeling... Not good or bad
allReviews.text: We needed a place to stay for one night and the prices were pretty good for the evening and we always wanted to give South Point a try. We did and I don't know what to think. Parking and check-in were easy as well as finding the room. The room was big and clean albeit a view of a wall, literally. We didn't eat here, but food looked okay. The hotel just had a strange feeling. Maybe the color scheme or layout. The pool was okay, nothing great but clean. Something just felt off and we couldn't relax. Much different feeling than staying on strip.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel!
allReviews.text: Very clean! Spacious rooms! Many delicious food selections! Large variety entertainment within the hotel! Friendly staff! Beautiful pool! Nice views! Large and clean fitness room! Relaxing hot tub! Insulated walls (can not here others in next room)

allReviews.title: Very Nice Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Stayed here just one night in May because it was close to the airport and we were leaving the next day after a trip to the Grand Canyon.  It was about 5 miles south of the main hotels on the Strip.   The hotel and casino were bigger than I expected and it was fairly crowded. The room was huge and had all of the amenities.  Ate at the buffet after joining their club to get the $4 a person discount.  Couldn't use any of the discounts in the coupon book and they were a waste.  The buffet was excellent and had anything you could ever want, including oysters on the half shell.  I believe the price we paid with the discount was $15.99.  The breakfast the next morning at the 24 hour café was good and very reasonably priced.  The casino was great and no problem finding a $5 blackjack table.  We both played for about two hours and between us won a grand total of $6.50 which we were just pleased to come out ahead.  The check-in was easy and everyone at the casino was very nice.

allReviews.title: Reasonable resort fee
allReviews.text: I stayed one night at the South Point casino and hotel. If you are flying in there’s a shuttle, but it stops running at 9:30 pm,  and you need to make reservations in advance. The staff from what I experienced are all very friendly. The room was Spacious, and the bed was comfortable. If you like breakfast the Coronado restaurant runs a special from Midnight to 6:00 am (don’t be late) Last and probably least among other resorts,the resort fees are only 21 dollars a day. I will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Great time at the South Point!
allReviews.text: A great place to stay about 10 minutes south of the crowded Vegas strip. Rooms are very clean and spacious. Plenty or room in the casino. The staff was great! The pool was fantastic! You could go out there ant time of day and get a couple nice lounge chairs and a cool drink and relax.  We also enjoyed a day in the Spa which was fantastic. The Del Mar Deli located in the casino had great sandwiches and the food over all was good. I definitely recommend this place forn a more relaxed visit to Vegas....oh yes free shuttle to and from the airport!

allReviews.title: relaxed and friendly
allReviews.text: We stayed off-strip and decided to check this place out - glad we did.  We only went in to do a little gambling and found the staff very friendly and the overall environment pretty relaxed.  It was nice to have free parking right out front and a very clean casino.  Definitely recommend this place if you are south of the strip and looking for some relaxed gambling fun.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!  Great place to stay....
allReviews.text: We stayed at this casino for a wrestling tournament.  The wrestling venue was amazing. It has a very friendly staff.  Maid service was excellent.  We really enjoyed the buffet especially the Mongolian style grilling station.  The movie theatre was a bonus after a busy night it was fun to catch a good movie.  Was a located about 5 miles from the main strip so the drive took a little time.  The pool was very nice, bar prices were decent.  Would recommend this casino for a quieter Las Vegas vacation.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas with Commotion Optional
allReviews.text: South Point is about 15 minutes away from the Strip and this is a blessing. All it took was one visit to the Flamingo to see a show and we gladly skedaddled back to the hotel. There's an equestrian center (yes, horses), a bowling alley, a spa, pool and fitness center as well as places to eat and snack. Bars and a casino go without saying. All this wouldn't be so great if everything was outlandishly priced, because it could be. They were reasonable for the area and perhaps less expensive in some ways. (Not sure.) We would not go back to Vegas, but we would definitely go back to South Point.

allReviews.title: New Premium grade rooms are worth the price
allReviews.text: The hotel is currently in the midst of a conversion, to upgrade existing "Deluxe" grade rooms from the 24th floor and working on down gradually to lower floors, to convert rooms to the new "Premium" grade room category.  They gradually began the conversion process at the beginning of the year in the first two of the three towers that comprise the hotel.  Towers 1 and 2 (which run North and South, and are parallel to Interstate 15 and Las Vegas Blvd.) have had the conversion completed.  Tower three's conversion is to take place over the Summer.  I had the opportunity to one of the first few guests that were allowed to be booked into the new "Premium" room category over the past Memorial Day Holiday weekend.  When you open the door to a Premium room, the first thing you are pleasantly greeted by is the dark wooden flooring instead of carpeting.  Also, to match the room's wooden floors, the furniture is also new in a much darker wood grain.  The furniture pieces are all dark brown, withdark brown or black painted finishes such as around the mirror or around the bed sconces.  The typical settee next to the beds has been replaced with a rich, cream colored leather highback chairs and a foot stool.  I liked the new dressor drawers at the foot of the bed, because it not only had ample and deep drawer space, but now the center drawers conveniently conceal a small working refrigerator (which in the standard "Deluxe" rooms is an option, at $15 per night).  The bathroom sink and vanity areas also got an upgraded bronze- colored lighted and adjustable make-up mirror, new hair dryer that has a circular holder that also doubles as a circular l.e.d. night light, as well as a new vanity mirror with darker wood accents.  The high speed room internet service (which is one of the many benefits included in the $21/day resort fee assessed) was easy to connect to, and was reliable and fast.  Right now, depending upon the season and day of the week, these new Premium room categories are only (on average) an additional $20 per night than the Deluxe rooms.  Its worth the price for a higher floor room as well as having a refrigerator in the room.

allReviews.title: Fun
allReviews.text: This hotel is awesome. Everything you need for a family vacation is there. Movies, bowling, bingo, restaurants, and casinos. The staff are friendly and carando cafe prime rib is the best. I will definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: More Value..........
allReviews.text: This hotel is far from the strip, but has everything the strip has. Great prices, clean spacious rooms, many different resturants for every taste. Wonderful service at check in Bell Service, Valet........now the bad.......The bartenders at ALL the bars are lethargic, slow, hang with the locals, in other words they are pitiful. I could have gone behind the bar and made my own drink and I don't thing anybody would notice.......

allReviews.title: Best in Vegas
allReviews.text: Just excellent Hotel and Casino. Superior personnel through out. Plenty places to eat, drink, be merry and play and the slot machines pay. Love, love love this venue! There is ample parking. Check in and check out is a breeze. It's far enough from all the traffic on the Strip and close enough to get there in minutes.

allReviews.title: Jerry
allReviews.text: Had a great time; even won some money.  South Point has an awesome array of gaming machines.  Video Keno is our game of choice and they are spread throughout the casino.  We ate at the Big Sur seafood restaurant, unbelievably delicious.  We will definitely return to South Point!

allReviews.title: Perfect in every way
allReviews.text: We have been coming to Vegas for thirty years and have stayed in most of the hotels/casinos. This is now the only hotel which we stay in. This hotel/casino goes out of its way to make the visitor feel welcome and appreciated. Not the usual 'take it or leave it' attitude from the strip hotels now adopt. We wholeheartedly recommend it to all who visit Vegas

allReviews.title: Great resort with lower resort fees.
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel & casino. Lots of restaurants including a great buffet reasonably priced, cant beat it!! Located on LV Blvd a few miles south of the airport but right off Interstate 15 so if you want to get to the central strip it takes only a few minutes. Southpoint also has a beautiful pool. Friendly staff throughout the resort.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: I really liked this hotel.  I had initially booked the hotel for an extended stay for a equine event which unfortunately was cancelled.  However, I decided to stay one night anyway for business, and the reservations agent made it very easy to make the change, no hassle!  I definitely appreciated it.  My room was very clean, and spacious.  I used the fitness facility which was open 24 hours (thank goodness!  So tired of those hotels that seem to think people only work out between 9-6 pm!) and nicely equipped.  And the restaurant I chose had excellent service, huge portion, and a comfortable vibe.  Finally, parking was free!  I will definitely stay at the hotel again.

allReviews.title: 2 week trip
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before, and spend a lot of time here during the NFR, because this is where it all happens during that  time.  The rooms are clean and quiet, but they are starting to show some wear, they are needing to upgrade the rooms. But as always it is a fun place to stay with the gaming, places to eat.

allReviews.title: Still decent
allReviews.text: I've stayed here many times over the years.  I personally don't care for staying in casinos but this one is a different experience than the mega-casinos on the strip.  It's worth staying here and was a good experience.

allReviews.title: Stay overnight, nothing outstanding
allReviews.text: We were on the way to San Diego. The room we had was spacious but not very much different than a regular hotel. We had to walk through the casino area in order to assess to accommodation area. The hotel is far away from the strip, so if you are not visiting Las Vegas, you can avoid all the traffic on the strip and leave the city easily. Gas station is nearby, gas up then go.

allReviews.title: Shuttle and facilities were as expected---good
allReviews.text: The shuttles from the airport were good, the overall facility is very Las Vegas. You walk into a casino which is busy. South Point is full of bowling lanes, movie theatres, stages for shows, and 13 Restaurants. There is a $21.00 Resort fee for the WI-FI, shuttles etc..Huge complex, but it was enjoyable and room was very quiet. Would stay here again.

allReviews.title: 5-day stay
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a work conference in April. Very nice facility for this. Large conference rooms with great a availability. Ate primarily at the garden buffet, which was good. Overall stay was good, only drawback is the remoteness of the hotel. About 14 miles +/- from the hotel to downtown.

allReviews.title: Another relaxing week at South Point
allReviews.text: We have stayed at South Point every other year since it opened as South Coast.  Our experience has ALWAYS been one of excellent service and value for our dollars.  We value knowing our stay will always be a great one....and value NOT having to worry about... well... everything involved in staying at a different property.  Parking valet, luggage delivery, check in, housekeeping, casino, cafe staff, steak house staff, ..... in every instance where South Coast personnel were involved, service was delivered with courtesy and a smile.  How nice it is to have everyone greet us as if they were glad for us to be there.Aside fromt the one small disappointment of the food quality at that buffet (which we felt had slipped a bit... or they were just having a bad day).... everything was 5 stars during this trip.We look forward to our next visit... and...now that we're retired, we'll perhaps change our frequency of trips to once per year.  We're not sure we want to wait 2 years to return.

allReviews.title: Fun at South Point
allReviews.text: Excellent value. Great staff. Great selection of slots and table games. Arcade, bowling alley, movie theaters, fine dining and a pool. Family friendly. Also offers entertainment for the adults like shows.

allReviews.title: Great place for a massage
allReviews.text: *This review is specifically for the spa services at South Point.* When I am in town and I have the time, I schedule an appointment with Cynthia at the Spa at South Point. I have had many massages and, by far, she is the best massage therapist I have visited. She is thoughtful, professional and friendly. I have really tight shoulders so I always ask massage therapists to target that area. Not only was she responsive to my needs, she really was knowledgeable on how to loosen up that problem area. Afterwards, you can enjoy the spa and all the amenities which is an added bonus. Thanks Cynthia!

allReviews.title: Mini Vacation
allReviews.text: The room was large enough to be comfortable ... the a/c did not cool very well... the noise from construction woke us up every morning ... maid did not replace incidentals on a daily basis ... staff were friendly and helpful ... slots no better nor worse than others ...Food at the Coronado Cafe was awful !   Best mode of transportation is Uber, definitely !!!

allReviews.title: Big Resort with a lot of options
allReviews.text: My family of 7 recently stayed at South Point Hotel for a cheer competition being held in the arena. There was plenty of room in the arena, and the hotel/casino was very spacious.  I use a mobility scooter and had plenty of room to maneuver about. The pool was nice, although it was incredibly windy while we were there so we didn't stay in the pool for long.  There was a wide variety of food options, the buffet was decent with a lot of options, the desserts were very tasty, not your everyday puddings and ice cream. The beds were roomy and I appreciated the accessible shower in my room.  Valet was fast and efficient.  The Bowling Alley's snack bar was our best bet for breakfast.  Their bagel sandwiches were HUGE and fresh made.  Affordable food that filled you up.

allReviews.title: Cheap Hotel
allReviews.text: South point.This hotel is a long way from the strip and it appears to be wholly  aimed at gamblers.There is no foyer as such, you enter straight into the casino where you are met with half dressed hostesses with there buttocks showing covered only by thin black tights. Not a sight for young children in my opinion, there were a lot there!The hotel is enormous and it takes you a while to get to the rooms. It also has a lot of other facilities, a bowling alley etc. what ch we did not use.The food in the restaurant was ample and the waiting staff varied from very helpful to the opposite.I have requested a room with a roll in shower and adjustable height bed (they have them in  the Mandalay Bay) so we went to our room.The bed was not adjustable and was far too high. The bathroom had a roll in shower but the lip of the shower intruded in front of the sink so it was difficult to reach the sink on my mobility scooter.Secondly the shower hose was not adjustable so my partner had to hold the shower at my level in order for me to was and there were not enough grab rails.The light n the bathroom was very poor.The pool area was lovely.I would not choose to stay here again!

allReviews.title: Spacious, Accessible, and Convenient from the Airport
allReviews.text: This hotel provides complimentary shuttle service from the airport near which it is conveniently located--not too far or close.  Guest parking is convenient, too, and the hotel also provides valet service.  The restaurants, cafes, rooms, and casino floor were expansive.  The casino and restaurants were busy, but never seemed congested, and we were there on the weekend.  This is a family-friendly hotel well-suited for casual vacationing, but it is not within walking distance to the Strip.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Stayed here from April 22-27 for the 10th time and as always had an excellent stay. Funny enough a lot of hits on the penny slots and none on other denominations.As a cigar smoker  I preferred to sit outside and enjoy my cigar. Bummed out that they don’t allow smoking in sports book but allow cigarette s.

allReviews.title: Love it here.
allReviews.text: Best casino in Las Vegas! Love everything about this place! The only casino that actually caters and take cares of their customers. Much respect to this casino and their staff. Every restaurant and bar has friendly staff and service. It's great place for locals, pai gow, bowling and sports books are my favorite there! Of course the oyster bar as well. Always looking forward for another visit.. Enjoyed our stay and always will be staying here.

allReviews.title: Great Venue off the Strip
allReviews.text: The South Point is a great venue for family or business. The hotel has a pool, hot tub, theaters, bowling and a dozen dining options with diverse cuisine and prices for a variety of needs. The rooms are over sized, clean and comfortable.

allReviews.title: If it were not so smoky I would have played much more.
allReviews.text: This place is a busy, local smoke filled casino. The pool is nice and large as is the hot tub. Hot tub is adults only. Of course there are rude parents who feel that they can bring their infant to the adult only local. Not cool and rather rude of the parents. But keep in mind this is a cheap local hotel with nothing else to do but gamble or hang by the pool. The fish restaurant in the middle of the casino is good. Go there.And like all the other places without telling me upon check in , I learned upon check out that they tacked on a $21.00 nightly resort fee. Again I ask, how can I use your resort or consider it fair when your teaser rate reflects almost a 50 percent resort fee.Enoug. Include the fee with the rate. I will feel less nickel and dimed.Hats off the Esteban at the front desk for placing me in a perfect quite room.

allReviews.title: Enjoying the South Point
allReviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our recent stay at the South Point and are scheduled to return in Nov. 2018. Am looking forward to staying in an upgraded room. Enjoy early morning coffee and love the ice cream service. The cafe is very nice, my husband looks forward to the daily specials.

allReviews.title: first time here,not my last !
allReviews.text: really enjoyed my stay, poker room,sportsbook, in- house entertainment, very good ! casino bars were all outstanding,priceing on food(restaurants and buffet),were reasonable and the quality of the food very good.

allReviews.title: Love Southpoint
allReviews.text: We love staying at South Point. The rooms are spacious and comfortable and very affordable. The hotel has a movie theatre, bowling, casino, and a Steak & Shake as well as several other restaurants. The coupons you get are also very generous. If you have a car this is a great affordable place to stay off strip with lots to do inside the resort.

allReviews.title: Fantastic!
allReviews.text: I cannot say enough about the friendly professional staff and high quality facilities at the South Point Casino and Spa.  Food, gaming and amenities were all top-notch. Parking and shuttle services were great.  Very impressed.

allReviews.title: Ok hotel, great staff
allReviews.text: 4 couples stayed here 3 nights. 3 got standard rooms & we got a junior suite.ROOMS:The suite was spacious but had coffemaker only. No microwave, fridge, etc. the bathroom was quite large with a garden tub- no jets though. The towels, toiletries, bedding, etc were mediocre. & the TVs needed to be bigger. The bed was very firm.POOL: the pool area was good- the pool had different offshoots to provide separate areas instead of being in one big square pool. There were no shade umbrellas though. There was a bar/snack area but we never saw roving waiters.BUFFET: at check in we got a coupon book which had half off the buffet so we tried it. I liked the salad bar but the hot food was mediocre. My husband said it was the worst vegas buffet he has ever had.LOCATION: this hotel is several miles south of the main strip area. There is a shuttle you can book to get there but it is $12 a person round trip. We found it cheaper & easier to take uber. There is a movie theater & bowling alley here but we didn’t patronize them. The staff was great though. I called housekeeping twice for items & they responded promptly.Overall unless you are attending an event here I don’t see the draw of staying here.

allReviews.title: They have it all
allReviews.text: They have a movie theatre, bowling, etc.....Its all here. Only problem is distance to downtown Las Vegas. With traffic it took up to 35 minutes to get into town for the Beatles show at the Mirage for a 9:30 show. They raised the shuttle price so I drove in. This is my 3rd time staying here. They need to update rooms since they are now charging resort fees

allReviews.title: VERY NICE PROPERTY
allReviews.text: The first thing I noticed when I walked into this hotel is how fresh,clean and modern it was. The parking was excellent and easy to get to. The service and servers where friendly and attentive. The gaming floor was spacious and the sports book was excellent. The food and beverage prices were inline with other hotels.This an exceptional off strip hotel and I would certainly visit this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Great place a little out of town
allReviews.text: We saved some money and had a couple of nights here before moving up to a luxury property on The Strip.We loved it and didn't mind the short drive up to the end of the main Strip. This is a lovely hotel and casino. The staff are great. The room we had, high up could not be faulted and we had a great view looking south.We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and will be back! Recommended.

allReviews.title: Friendly staff and well kept property
allReviews.text: I had a five night stay at South Point for business.  I had gambled here before but never stayed here.  The room was  perfectly satisfactory. Housekeeping did a great job. If I were to nit pick I would wish for a larger TV with more channels, but not a big issue.  I'd also wish for a refrigerator, but I heard those are coming in more rooms this Spring.  Every staff member at the South Point I talked to told me how much they like working for the Gaughan family.  It's nice to stay at a place where the staff knows the owner instead of it being some mega corporation.There's a nice compliment of restaurants on site.  You could do worse than just sticking around for your meals.  Everything from Steak 'n Shake to seafood to Asian to prime rib.Given the reasonable room rates here, this is a good option. Especially if you have a car.  If you are without a vehicle the distance to the heart of the strip might be an issue.  But the Uber fares weren't as much as out would have cost to park at the major resorts.The complex also includes bowling lanes, a movie theater, and an equestrian arena.

allReviews.title: HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
allReviews.text: Excuses EXCUSES.... stayed here and were never told that we were given a room with a WALL VIEW!!!! Customer service desk could HAVE WARNED US AND ASKED IF WE WANTED A DIFFERENT ROOM FOR A HIGHER PRICE... but she didn’t. So I paid the same for a room with a view. I of course called and had us moved rooms!! In the “NEW ROOM” the shower faucet was BROKEN the service man cane repaired some of it so that we had water with low pressure very low pressure and said it would take an HOUR TO repair it correctly - we couldn’t wait as we had somewhere to go... we tried to iron and the IRON WAS BROKEN!!!! upon checking out and PAYING FOR ALL THIS NONSENSE.... I let the supervisor know and she apologize and stated that the HOTEL/RESORT SPA IS OLD AND IN NEED OF MANY REPAIRS... she CHARGED ME AND SAID “HAVE A WONDERFUL DAY”!!!  THANKS FOR A GREAT EXPERIENCE AFTER GAMBLIMG THERE EATING THERE STAYING THERE AND ALL WE GOT WAS “SORRY THIS PLACE IS OLD”

allReviews.title: Nice Place to Stay
allReviews.text: The rooms are  a little older considering the carpet and all otherwise just needs a little better maintenance.  They moved me from a room facing a wall to the 25th floor for a small fee.  Turned out to be a two-room suite.  I could have fit 50 people in this room.  Food at the buffet was good, the prime rib restaurant was excellent with good prices.  The casino was very crowded, but good for them.  Free shuttle service but you MUST make a reservation.  Nice pool area.

allReviews.title: Southpoint is great!!
allReviews.text: First time at this hotel. It was great, no parking or valet fees. Rooms were great, had a living room, bedroom and bathroom. Shower was great. The hotel had 11 restaurants, work out room, pool, bowling, theater, arena. One stop shop if you didn't want to leave the premises. I would recommend to anyone staying in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Should have been called Smokey Point instead
allReviews.text: I understand that smoking is allowed in the casino only but first of all, you need to walk through the fog there no matter where you want to go. And their ventilation system is not capable of keeping the smoke limited to that area only. Bottom line, attending a 5 day conference with allergies flaring up all the time. But I guess that’s what you get for $69/night. The room was nice and big, though.

allReviews.title: Decent
allReviews.text: The positives:- Breakfast Buffet was reasonably priced with a good selection.- Drink prices were moderate- Pool was clean- Room was largeThe not-so-positives:- Bathroom wallpaper was peeling- Was told by staff there was no shuttle to The Strip, but other reviewers said they took the shuttle.- WiFi (that was charged for in the Resort Fee) was unreliable.  I gave up and used my data.Hotel is located 10-15 minute drive from The Strip.  This can be good or bad, depending on your perspective.

allReviews.title: A great stay
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at South Point. We were looking for the Vegas-experience without paying the high prices on the strip—SP turned out to be the perfect solution. We found the room very comfortable and quiet. The pool was really nice and the majority of the restaurants were pretty good at a reasonable price. The casino was decent size. Additionally, it was only about a 10-minute ride or so to get to the strip. My only “ding” is that the hotel shuttle to the strip seemed a bit pricey ($14/day/person). Other than that, I have no complaints, as we really enjoyed our stay. We definitely recommend SP and would gladly stay there again.

allReviews.title: Reasonably priced, good sleep but far and smoky
allReviews.text: This is a hotel casino located away from the Strip (15 minutes driving). Like many hotel casinos the lobby is noisy, rowdy, crowded and smoky. I would have liked it if the reception area was separate from the game floor so you could avoid the crowd and the smoke. Unfortunately, that is not the case. Fortunately, the rooms are away from the noise and very quiet. I found the room to be very spacious, clean and comfortable. My king size bed was large, clean and comfortable. The room came with a standard flat TV, refrigerator and good Wi-Fi coverage. Large windows bringing in plenty of sun lights as well as the view of faraway mountains. The shower was decent, clean and well equipped. My only complaint is the amount of smoking all over the lobby and the gambling floor. The hotel also offers several bars (some equipped with slot machines) and restaurants. They have a breakfast buffet which is worth trying using the voucher coupon they offer when you check-in. Over all it is reasonable if you don’t mind being away from the Strip for a short period of time.

allReviews.title: Great Property
allReviews.text: Went for two nights comped.  Really quiet room given the young crowd at the event center.  Room was really nice and clean.  Nice view to the strip.  Great service at check in and check out.  Pool area was really nice and couples spa is worth it.  We stuck to the buffet when we did not leave to go out to eat.  Love the free parking but definitely needs EV charging.

allReviews.title: Out of the way
allReviews.text: The hotel itself is nice and reasonably priced but it’s nowhere near the strip or anything else fun for that matter. The pool is nice and has s few decent restaurants.We only stayed here due to a convention there but would never stay here if it wasn’t work related. Far better options out there.

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: My latest stay was April 19-25,2018. The Hotel is generally pretty well maintained and clean very important to a frequent traveler. The staff is friendly and generally helpful. The purpose of my stay was for business.  Some of the properties down falls are the casino area's ventilation is poor and full of cigarette smoke. It was not always like this. The second strike is poor food quality. There are much better places to eat. During my recent stay the hotel had a water problem which I am not blaming them for because things break. However the way that it was handled with the guest in effected rooms left a lot to be desired. I woke up to no water not seeing the notice thrown on the floor stating that they had to make a repair from 1:00 am to 5:00 am. Of course as when you repair things it doesn't always go as planned, again not the hotels fault.I called the front desk and was told by the hotel operator that they were short staffed and the desk couldn't take my call this was at 7:00 am . No shower no teeth brushing that morning right before a business presentation. I went to the front desk and was told instead of being offered a room that had water to shower was told we are waving the resort fee which by the way is a scam to make money and provides no value. I ask to speak to the GM and was givien  women's name who was not the GM but represented herself as the GM. Upon researching on line found that she was in fact not the GM. And long story short she was unprofessional and not in the least sympathetic or even apologetic. They new enough to place notices in the room with the normal  housekeeping duties but they didn't move guest or leave a message on the phone in the room. The long and short of this is there are plenty of good hotels in Las Vegas with much better customer service. Also my tube was left with dirty water on the last night of my stay, I guess a remnant of the water problem. I generally don't leave reviews like this however the hotel was unresponsive so this hotel should be avoided.

allReviews.title: Another Wonderful Stay At South Point
allReviews.text: Began staying here in 2016 and have never been disappointed. The entire staff is very accommodating.  The rooms are large with great amenities.  Pool area is terrific.  There are a variety good variety of restaurants for every taste.  We especially like Don Vito's. We celebrated my wife's birthday there and Roxanne and Francesco gave us excellent service.  Free shuttle to and from the airport is great.  I could go on and on about how nice South Point is.  It's not downtown or in the action, but it is a wonderful, accommodating and relaxing hotel.  Won't stay anywhere else when we go to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Plush mattresses??
allReviews.text: They advertise plush mattresses. FAR from it!!  The mattresses are AWFUL.  I have slept on better than these a discount motel chains!!!   This is our first night here so far the food has been good.  Hard to get over this board I am currently laying on and already prepaid for for the next 3 nights.

allReviews.title: Shelly  was wonderful
allReviews.text: Shelly was wonderful she helped above and beyond the elevator is too hard for someone with disabilities.The restaurants were good. the gambling was good but couldn't get into the poker room without a long wait.

allReviews.title: Nice.  Ok not great for vegas
allReviews.text: South Point is the southern most hotel before the strip I believe.  They do have a shuttle to the strip I didn't try it so can't comment. Parking is plenty so no worries with free valet and self park available.Rooms are ok. Clean and good TV and no complaints. Casino is fine not huge but has most what u want.But I have to say blackjack dealers are generally not the happiest people. They all just seemed to have attitudes especially last night April 21.Internet is horrible.  It works ok when u are in a room but everywhere u go u have to sign in again to another wifi like pool, bar, poker room, etc.  really a pain if U need internet access.Facility is quite nice with bowling, horse center, 11 restaurants, sports book, etcNegative is not on strip. For sure car ride.Getting drinks while gambling is also a problem. Very slow service stinks.  Playing $25 tables and always waiting for a server.  Not good for players wanting to have a good time with friendsLower price rooms is good

allReviews.title: Great quality for a better price than the strip
allReviews.text: We stayed on the top floor in a two bedroom suite and it was fantastic. We had a view of the strip and mountains. The rooms were super clean and the beds were comfortable. The bowling alley and movie theater are top notch and super cheap. The cafe food was really good and we could get two meals for less than 20 bucks. The casino was clean and we never had to look for a drink girl. I had a really bad blister and asked the cashier at the gift shop if they had flip flops. They didn't, but they opened the pool gift shop for me so that I could grab some from there. Everyone was super friendly.

allReviews.title: First time at South Point and certainly will not be the last time.  Hotel/Casino very open, aerie and welcoming.
allReviews.text: First time at South Point and certainly will not be the last time.  Hotel/Casino very open, aerie and welcoming.

allReviews.title: AWFUL EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: I was VERY DISAPPOINTED with this hotel. This hotel with 4 stars is a BIG lie.I arrived around 8pm on the first day of my stay. The room and the furniture looked old and I was able to see the dust. The bed was not comfortable.The WORST part of the story was when I uncovered the bed and there was PERIOD BLOOD ON THE BLANKET!!!!WAS SO GORSE!!!!!!My wife and I almost threw up because of what we saw.When I spoke to the manager regarding this matter, he almost made it as it was our fault because they usually clean up the rooms after every stay. The staff including the manager were very rude.They did not offer any compensation except cancelling my reservation even though it was at the end of the day. They also did not care if I leave a bad feedback regarding my stay when I told them that I will do soI had to look for another hotel and paid extra because it was a last min booking.I strongly do not recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Good for locals
allReviews.text: It's a bit of a hike from check-in to the elevators. Several great restaurants and a [pretty good buffet.Rooms are nice and comfortable. Great sports book and bar. There is an arena where various rodeo and equestrian events are held.

allReviews.title: The usual Vegas hotel
allReviews.text: Lots of gambling, lots of overpriced restaurants.  Hot tub was used by entitlement type young kinds “attended” by parents, needs better rules.  The staff was very courteous, helpful, and attentive.  Plan for meals, places are always busy.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: This was like an indoor city type of place. Nice rooms and very clean! They had really good food here and cheap prices. It’s a nice size hotel. It’s about 15 minuets away from the strip. I highly recommended this hotel if you want to be away from the strip.

allReviews.title: Ok stay
allReviews.text: After reading so many reviews about he place and seeing the 4 star rating we decided to book it for a night. The price was decent, parking and WiFi free and room was a good size. However, despite being on a non smoking floor the whole place smelled like smoke. Pool was closed which was disappointing because we were looking forward to it. They charge $30 to use the fitness center for 24 hours. If I had known that there were others hotels in the center of Vegas for the same price and better amenities & location I would have definitely booked somewhere else. But this was our first visit to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: VERY UNFAIR
allReviews.text: To play the "super gala bingo" is impossible. When I call after the last super gala they say the same thing over and over that its sold out, each time I ask when they were sold out always within a week after the the super gala. So they sell to the same people over and over not giving anyone else a chance, what's even worse is they have the nerve to still post their ad for the next super gala 4 month late on their web page. I've had this problem for the last 3 years and no longer want to waste anymore time looking at Southpoint. Plaza's super bingo is by far the best there is in Las Vegas, 5 tournaments a year, great prices and deals, rooms and beds are better quality, the location alone isn't isolated like southpoint giving you lots more to do and many choices of places to eat on Fremont street. Better customer service as well.

allReviews.title: Instead of being in the pool I'm writting this review ..what a shame
allReviews.text: April 12th the sky is clear and it's wonderful out side .The pool is inviting. But here at South Point the pool is closed ...Bad weather they say. But the can have a man doing work on an out side building ROOF! Looks to me like the guest count is down and today they need to cut some costs. No you cant' even sit outside and read a book on this glorious day. There are other Hotels with pools open. That's our search now. Shelly the manager on duty is trying her best to explain why a guest can't sit outside and read a book at South Point. It's a sad situation. Had my review been Wednesday It would have been 3/4  stars. Read on because until today things were great. In fairness this is a great spot. You just need to understand they can and will close the pool for no reason. So don't count on it being open. Other wise this is a fine Hotel ..Buffet food is 2 stars. Beside the child that closed the pool, the staff is 5 stars. Parking staff is 5 stars. Casino staff 5 stars.. We can't weigh in on any other food options because at this point we won't invest another dime here. It's been 2 hours and Still no wind at the pool .Since I complained the man who was working on the roof is gone. Maybe the wind blew him off..

allReviews.title: Beware of  the  buffet
allReviews.text: This is  our 4th visit to this  hotel.  While  the  rooms are starting to  show signs of  aging they are mostly clean and  the  staff are  good. However  the buffet is  not worth your money.  You are  better off  going off site.  They leave the  food on  the  warming tables too long and  the  food  becomes unpalatable.  The  desserts are  mostly dried out and  do  not match what is displayed in the  cases.  Overall the  quality is  just not  there.....  And  it  has  become  worse over the  years.   Also we decided to  try the  Restaurant on  site on  the  right side of  the  cashiers  booth.  That  was  worse.  The  4.95 fruit cup which is  just  about  8oz apperared to be left overs from the  buffet.  I ordered a toasted English muffin, and  although  it arrived  quickly to  my  table it was  soggy and  rubbery...  The  oatmeal was  tepid at  best.  For  instant  oatmeal I would  have  expected  more...and  st  5.95 a bowl...it left  mush to be desired.

allReviews.title: Excellent value
allReviews.text: We ave stayed here about 6 times. It is clean and comfortable. Check in staff, especially Desiree, have been outstanding. We checked in early without an additional fee. There is no parking fee. If you don’t have a car, think about this hotel carefully. There is nothing close by. There is an annoying resort fee but we recouped some of it with the coupon booklet. There are a couple excellent restaurants: Primarily Prime and Don Vito’s.

allReviews.title: Worked out well for what we needed
allReviews.text: Stayed here just 2 nights for a event outside of town we attended. Checked in around 7 PM on a Wednesday night. There were 2 people checking in the line of 20 people, The counter was way understaffed for some reason. Once we get in the room was very clean and nice. Room felt a little larger than typical. We had 2 kids with us and this seemed like a good place for them a little away from the strip. We tried the pool both evenings but someone pooped in the pool and it was closed both days. Obviously a parent issue not a hotel issue. A short 10 minute drive to the strip if that's what you're looking for. The free parking was nice unlike most other locations in Vegas. I did not get to enjoy the casino or food much because I was gone most of the time. Staff was nice and helpful. Know that there are not mini-fridges in most rooms and no microwaves anywhere. I at least expected a mini-fridge.      All in all it was a nice location away from the mess of the strip. Easy access in and out, easy free parking, and kid friendly.

allReviews.title: Good with a few flaws
allReviews.text: My room was clean, quiet and the beds where very comfortable. I appreciate that fact the bathtub was clean. A lot of hotels think people only take showers so they don't clean the tub. This  housekeeping staff took the time to clean the tub everyday.The pool area was clean. The pool bar was excellent. The drinks had plenty of alcohol , other hotels tend to water down their drinks.  My only complaint was the hot tub with huge grates on the bottom. These grates are so high that you will stub your toes. Be careful!We were staying at the hotel for a bowling tournament. The bowling areas(2) were clean and in good order.You will smell horse poop in different areas of the hotel due to an arena inside the hotel.Now for the flaws.  The transportation to the strip and the airport was spotty. We ended up taking uber back to the airport after waiting for over 1/2 hour for a bus.There was 3 airports shuttle buses parked in the designated area but no drivers. The strip shuttle does not run between 4:30pm and 8:00 pm. The shuttle is 12 dollars a person. If you want dinner on the strip use Uber. All in all this is a great hotel if you don't want to go anywhere!

allReviews.title: Good place to stay, but away from the strip
allReviews.text: Stayed 3 nights at the South Point, having prebooked on booking.com. Rate was $98.10 for Sunday night & $71.10 for Monday and Tuesday nights; very reasonable. There is also a $21.00/night resort fee, including WiFi, parking was free. The room was clean & the bed comfortable. The only drawback in staying at this hotel is that it is way out of the way(beyond the airport), far form the main action on the strip. If you don't have a car, I would not recommend staying here; unless you want to stay put. There are many restaurants to choose from on the property, with plenty of bars & gambling options.

allReviews.title: everything smells like cigarette smoke
allReviews.text: if you enjoy the smell of cigarettes - then by all means, stay at South Pointif not, suggest you try someplace elsewhile the staff was friendly, and the rooms reasonably enough priced, there MUST be better options in LV for the non-smoker

allReviews.title: Great place for families
allReviews.text: We went here for our spring break with 3 year old and 6 year old child. Clean rooms, nice pool and you don't feel out of place there with kids. Excellent value and nice facilities for the price. We didn't want to leave! Has gift shop with reasonably priced everyday items (milk, alcohol, snack food), so we didn't even rent a fridge. You are about a $16 uber ride away from the strip if that is important to you. Free shuttle ride to and from airport (tip the driver).

allReviews.title: Great property away from all the chaos, but still close by
allReviews.text: The beds were comfortable, the rooms were clean, our breakfast at the café was delicious.  The casino was perfect for my husband's gambling.  It was a perfect location and easy to park (free) and wifi (free) to get there and back from other locations.A perfect place to stay when passing through Las Vegas.  We usually stay in Vegas as our final destination, this time however, we were headed through to Utah, but still wanted to participate in Vegas activities, but not be in all the chaos of the Strip.My only complaint is the pool was freezing, beyond freezing.  I don't know if it's because it's so soon in the season, but there was no getting use to the temperature.  We had our kids this trip, but even if we didn't, we love and enjoy pool time during the day and this pool was shockingly cold.We would have loved to enjoy bowling with our kids, but we weren't there long enough and we also left on a Tuesday, too soon to enjoy $ 5 movies....all day...that would have been a huge plus!

allReviews.title: South Point - Great Stay
allReviews.text: We visit South Point each year for March Madness and Football games and love it there. They have a good set up when it gets crowded and there is plenty to do there with bowling, movie theater and restaurants.  Having a more reasonable food source would be good but there is a new McDonalds straight across the street, which is perfect.  Only complaint is the resort fee when we don't use the pool(too cold) or gym (no time).  The Jacuzzi is never hot either, its just luke warm which isn't a good experience.

allReviews.title: Our Favorite Hotel!!
allReviews.text: We are regular visitors to Las Vegas (we go 4 or 5 times a year) and have stayed at numerous hotels.....South Point is our FAVORITE!!!  We love that is NOT right in the middle of the strip...just 5 miles south of Mandalay Bay because when you’re tired and done with the Vegas crowds, South Point is a great little retreat from it all!!  They make up for it with all the activities available to you at the hotel, as well!  For example, Bowling....sure why not!  The bowling alley is ginormous and pretty cheap (the hotel gives you coupons for free games)!  Feel like playing some arcades, yup they got one of those too!  Favorite part though, the full-size movie theater....we love taking a couple hours outta our day to watch a movie and on Tuesdays, all movies are $5.75!!!  The swimming  pool is awesome and I love the fact they have a separate pool for babies/toddlers!  There’s a cabana with drinks and food and they also have a pool store for sunscreen and such things!  As for the casino....they got some of the loosest slots in Vegas!  Even if you ain’t staying here....come and gamble!  As for food and drink,  they got lots of those to choose from too....with some the lowest prices in town, especially the buffet!  Our favorite is their Japanese restaurant located by the Steak & Shake!!  The only thing that bums me about South Point, there’s no Starbucks inside the hotel.....but they have a Seattle’s Best (which is actually owned by Starbucks)!  Best part of this hotel....LOWEST RESORT FEES IN TOWN!!!!  Also, this hotel is still old school Vegas when REWARDING their loyal customers....that’s why we’ll continue to stay here!  LOYAL LIFETIME PATRONS!!

allReviews.title: Too Smokey to handle
allReviews.text: The hotel and casino look awesome from outside. How can you beat the gold windows that match the mandalas bay and trump tower!?! But once you go inside it is a different story. The crowd seems much older and heavy smokers. Most of the casinos on the strip seem to have great air handlers that keep a lot of the smoke smell down. The cheap buffet that gets great reviews was below average to me and my wife. I wouldn’t recommend planning most of your vacation here unless you are a smoker or can handle the smell.

allReviews.title: Business and Pleasure
allReviews.text: Had an opportunity to stay at one of the older hotels in Vegas. South Point was worth the money, big rooms, plenty of good restaurants and activities for families, including movie theater, bowling and a big rodeo arena. It hosted multiple events at the same time but it did not feel overcrowded. My wife an I attended an anual convention always held at the South Point, we enjoyed ourselves.

allReviews.title: Far end of the Strip but WORTH THE STAY
allReviews.text: THe first thing I noticed about South point was in the booking. They do not gouge you There are no hidden fees. Booked in for a very reasonable price.  THe rooms are new. They smell great. THe Bathroom has the sink and mirror separate from the toilet and shower so Sharing a room is easy. Beds are comfortable and the Maid service is top notch. Free Wifi and valet parking. I do not gamble much. So When I drink and pay at the bar it is reasonably priced. THe food is excellent and not overly expensive. The ATM fee does not gouge you either.I am not a smoker. THe Hotel Casino allows smoking, but the ventilation is incredible. I can't say that I could smell any smoke. Smoking rooms are separately ventilated as well and I saw them changing vent filters in the rooms and they are changed before it is needed. THis hotel has a Huge Bowling alley Small Arcade and a Large Movie theatre I think at least 8 screens. THe movie prices are reasonable.I will stay here again and again

allReviews.title: Ate at the Zenshin—4 stars there
allReviews.text: We were passing through Las Vegas and wanted to avoid the strip. We saw the South Point, one of LV's combination casino/restaurant /entertaining/hotel complexes (including couples rooms with private sauna, steam, Jacuzzi, pool, lounge and spa services) expressed externally in gigantism. Starved for supper, we stopped, mainly for the supreme ease of parking and the realization that we would probably find an assortment of decent restaurants there. One has to walk through the casino to get to the restaurants at the back edge of the first floor—I suppose I can't argue with a business model that seems to work in LV. Once past the gauntlet, we had a good choice of eleven different places to eat—Baja Miguels, Primarily Prime Rib, Don Vito's, Silverado Steak House, Coronado Cafe, Michael's, Del-Mar Deli, Big Sur Oyster Bar, Zenshin Asian Restaurant, Steak 'n Shake and Kate's Korner Ice Cream Parlor. We chose Zenshin, whose Asian offerings seemed mainly to be Japanese. The food was fresh and flavorful, presentation was attractive (a salad came garnished with a small orchid), portions were large, the cost was  moderate considering the quantity and quality. The days of nearly or truly free meals in LV of the 1950's may be over, but it was a pleasure having supper at the Zenshin. The ratings for service, value and cleanliness are for only Zenshin, as we didn't use any of the other areas of South Point.

allReviews.title: A Great  Place to Stay
allReviews.text: We absolutely love the South Point. So many restaurants to choose from and delicious food in every one and at reasonable prices.  EVERYTHING at South Point is reasonably priced.  FREE parking! The rooms are clean and spacious. Employees are courteious and eager to please.  No crowds to fight with. Because of parking fees and outrageious resort fees and humongous crowds, we will NEVER stay on the strip again. Great for families with bowling and movies available and a beautiful pool area. One would never have to leave the hotel to enjoy a stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: You cant a word the management staff tells u
allReviews.text: i recently booked a biz trip from vegas to chicago  based on the info i was told by management that valet parking was discounted for preferred guests   .then i found upon making a reservation the fine print said that parking offer was only for 7 days ( i needed 9  and i was staying at the hotel coming and going)  so my car would have been towed..l i would have left from Phoenix if i had gotten accurate info ...typical Vegas hustle...you cant trust a word the hotel casinos tell u

allReviews.title: Nice but Location is Ok
allReviews.text: The hotel is not new though there are many activities to do like the slots, gaming tables, bingos and kids amusement room etc same as any other hotel casinos. It’s somehow more or less 15 min drive from the main strip of casinos. Our room was spacious, cleaned daily by housekeepers. Silverado lounge was good to chill and have drinks. Our stay was going well except for a young woman working on the game floor serving drinks. Me my dad and my sisters were in the slots playing and called her for us to order. She looked for our ids and I said I don’t have in which I complied with going back to the room to get it. When I can back she wasn’t there so we waited for a long time and decided I’ll order straight up to the bar, showed my identification. We were drinking while playing in the slots when I saw her looking at us while passing by and just a short while a floor manager other was an American and another was a Filipina asking us our ids and the man looking like he is ready to take us out of the floor. Well anyways provided the identification a false alarm for them. Apologized and we were pissed somehow but carried on.

allReviews.title: hvac conference
allReviews.text: I was nice to have some options of to do will staying at the resort. my wife and I went to a movie, played bingo, watched some of the horse show, and my wife learned how to play craps with the free lessons that was offered.

allReviews.title: Solid hotel with lots of activities
allReviews.text: The South Point has good comfortable rooms. The hotel has many different activities that will appeal to a lot of travelers. Don't be fooled by the large amount of people who gave this hotel casino 5 stars because I suspect most of these people have never stayed in a top hotel. This is certainly NOT a top hotel. It is a good hotel. The casino floor and common areas have an overwhelming amount of unpleasant cigarette smoke. The food choices are adequate. The buffet was average. My feeling is that the clientele stay here for all the other activities. They will be pleased for sure. The hotel is good without being great, but that's OK. You could do a lot worse than the South Point. The resort fees in Las Vegas are really an insult to the traveler however.

allReviews.title: Plenty of activities
allReviews.text: While on Las Vegas Blvd, not really on the “strip”..rooms are nice, big and clean...check in not too bad..20 minutes. Plenty of activities, bowling, big theater, arcade, pool. Bowling is really morning and late night activity due to leagues, theater has all the popular current movies...buffet is really mediocre but price is less than strip hotels. Best is snack bar at bowling alley. He is nothing else to do in the area but hotel has a shuttle to the Strip. No problem with WiFi, but it is open access so can’t use any sites with a password...cell reception was weak..VerizonOK middle of the road Vegas hotel with comparable rooms. Old style ventilation handling system in Casino, so if a non smoker will have to wash everything when get home.

allReviews.title: Safe and spacious
allReviews.text: So grateful to have found a place to stay in Vegas that was quiet and felt safe for families. It had a lot is space and was worth getting to (and probably quicker to get to than somewhere off the strip, even though it seemed more out of the way at first). We were just there one night, but they’d have everything you need to be comfortable for more time there, and the value was great for the amount of space there.

allReviews.title: Great family stay
allReviews.text: Had a very nice stay with my family,  we all enjoyed the pool and hotbtub and were happy to have  a kitchen, dining table and a living room area to hang out.

allReviews.title: More than I expected
allReviews.text: I didnt know what I was getting until I arrived. It was just supposed to be a hotel room. It was so much better. Great service and a large space. Clean and very comfortable!

allReviews.title: Overall a very nice experience
allReviews.text: Staff service and friendliness was great, nice pool and hot tub, visited to attend a concert on the strip and while it was a 15 minute drive, I don't need to stay close...

allReviews.title: RCI exchange
allReviews.text: Unit we were assigned was on first floor, right off the resort check-in parking lot.  Given the unit locaiton we found the unit lacking privacy curtains.  The master bedroom mattress was noisy and somewhat uncomfortable to sleep on and needs to be replaced. Television wifi signal frequently dropped out.  We liked the size of the unit (two bedroom).  It was clean.  Resort staff are friendly and responsive to requests.  We enjoyed the resort's pool amenities.  There is a regional transit bus stop just around the corner, which we used to take the bus to the strip and back. Would recommend staying on a 2nd floor unit as the sound of foot steps of the guest staying above us was very loud and at times detracted  from the ability to enjoy the peacefulness of our unit, such as while watching TV.

allReviews.title: Nice place to get away
allReviews.text: Grate place for the value.  Great service.  Wish I would have stayed longer.  Will definitely book again on my next trip.

allReviews.title: Relaxation
allReviews.text: Out near the mountain and quiet and relaxing. So different than being on the strip in Las Vegas! Area felt safe and more like a neighborhood. Nice streets with side=walks for walking. Close to grocery and restaurants if you want to go out to eat!

allReviews.title: Short Familytrip for the Sema show and other Attractions
allReviews.text: it was a very nice stay at the cliffs at peace Canyon. Big rooms with all what you need. Best price and service. And the best you have an shuttle service to the strip and the redrock casino.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and Spacious Unit
allReviews.text: Only 2 story units and no elevators; we are okay with that and prefer the upper floor. Got a quiet unit (or maybe it's off season and we were gone most of the day for family events) but clearly the property is older and could use some maintenance in the unit. The bathroom grout (by tub and walls) needed grouting. Grounds are clean. Bathroom sink drained a bit slow, but there was good water pressure for shower. Bath amenities just ok. W/D also older as was the coffeemaker with a lid that was skewed and had to lift lid so that coffee didn't spill all over when poured. Only used coffeemaker and did not cook. Staff was professional and accommodating. We had early access which allowed us to be ready/changed and be on time for a 4:30 event.

allReviews.title: Felt like I was at home.
allReviews.text: The cliffs is amazing. The staff, the room, the service, and the shuttle system to get to the strip. The cliffs made me truly feel like I was on vacation.

allReviews.title: Peace was found
allReviews.text: What an amazing weekend getaway! The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was the perfect spot to unwind and recharge. The resort is peaceful and beautifully kept, with plenty of space to relax.
