Our suite was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed, including a full kitchen and a cozy living area.The atmosphere was so calm and refreshing compared to the busy Strip. The staff was super friendly and made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.If you’re looking for a quiet retreat with all the comforts of home just minutes from the action, The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a hidden gem! Can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Must stay !
allReviews.text: ​I recently completed a stay at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon and had an absolutely wonderful experience. For anyone looking for comfort, space, and incredible value, this is the place to book.​We stayed in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment, and the amount of space was truly remarkable. Having two full bathrooms and separate living and dining areas made the stay feel like a true home away from home—it was comfortable, private, and perfect for relaxing. The apartment itself was clean, well-maintained, and had all the amenities we needed for a stress-free trip.​However, the most impressive aspect was the amazing price point. To get a spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath unit of this quality for such a great price is practically unheard of. The value is truly unbeatable, especially when compared to booking two separate hotel rooms or even a standard suite elsewhere. It felt like we got premium accommodations without paying a premium price.​If you’re planning a trip to the area and prioritizing spacious, high-quality lodging that won't break the bank, look no further. Highly recommended—a solid five stars!

allReviews.title: One of the nicest hotels
allReviews.text: The price is so great considering the spacious room, kitchen, restaurants and grocery stores around. Staffs are uber nice, free parking, it is more like a vacation home rather than a hotel.

allReviews.title: Filthy floors
allReviews.text: Floors were so dirty I had to wipe everyone’s feet multiple times a day and the wipes/towels were black afterwards. Literally black. We also all have about ten bug bites and I don’t know from what… we were glad to be done staying here.

allReviews.title: Vegas get away.
allReviews.text: The Cliffs is a great central place to stay. Clean, quiet and relaxing. They have great amenities. The gym and swimming pool were very clean. We landed early and the reception desk was very accommodating and let us check in early.

allReviews.title: The Place to Stay When in Vegas
allReviews.text: I've stayed here four or five times and absolutely love it! It's way off the strip but the resort offers shuttle services there, and to a local grocery. There are two major casino resorts within a short drive, and the outskirts of the Las Vegas valley are right there for hiking or golf. It's kid friendly too. The gym is a welcome place to work off some of the partying, and the BBQ and fireplace areas are very inviting.The pool and hot tub are a great place to spend the day with a good book or some earbuds and a cold drink.

allReviews.title: Expect to pay more than you bargained for
allReviews.text: The stay was nice and comfortable. What leaves us with a bad after taste and negatively affects our stay is the simple reason of not getting your deposit back. We’ve stayed there twice in one month. Our first stay was at the beginning of October. The deposit they charge is $ 150.00. Expect to add this to the cost of your stay seeing you will not be refunded. The front desk will tell you they’ve refunded you, but they have not. Then they will tell you it takes up to 14 working days, not true, plus it’s been almost 20 for me. And then they tell you to call management. But seeing we’re calling from a different continent, that would mean it’ll be pretty pricey so that would make my stay even more expensive. All in all, we paid almost a thousand bucks to stay there for 6 nights. But have to add two security deposits of $ 300 in total. And not even to mention all the time and effort you have to put into communicating with the resort to get your money back. Thanks for giving a nice family trip the worst aftertaste.

allReviews.title: Good size and maintained  well
allReviews.text: Nice place. Something in the room bothered my partners allergies. we requested an ADA room and a handicap parking was right outside the room

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Relaxing, restful, calm, organized and clean. 10/10 recommend. I would definitely stay here again for my next visit.

allReviews.title: Shar's Experience
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed how spacious the tub was. I enjoyed sitting on the balcony relaxing and getting a peace of mind. My stay overall was great.

allReviews.title: Worth the money
allReviews.text: Love the area, space, and amenities. The home was clean, and the room was big enough for people. The loft was overlooking the main in-town street.

allReviews.title: Pictures of the property is true!
allReviews.text: I was skeptical of visiting the property for the first time. Everything that was advertised was truthful and pleasing. The rooms were nicely furnished and really clean. The blackout curtains in the bedroom was a win for me.

allReviews.title: Family Vacation
allReviews.text: Had a great stay. Went out from Connecticut for my daughter’s wedding. The location was great,right between where she lives in Vegas and where the wedding was held.  Will stay here again next visit.

allReviews.title: Sr Wood
allReviews.text: Lovely accommodation, great location, beautiful pool area, and offers peace and quiet being off the strip.

allReviews.title: Great value, lovely accommodation except for loud AC
allReviews.text: I enjoyed the peaceful environment in a residential area several miles away from the busy Las Vegas Strip. The apartment is large and extremely well-equipped, the staff are friendly and the pool area was relaxing. However, the AC unit is extremely loud and made an otherwise comfortable stay rather uncomfortable.

allReviews.title: Clean and Large with Free parking and shuttle service!
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Cliffs. Staff provided superior service, our room was clean and had all the comforts of home (Hawaii) except for a rice cooker, but we were able to cook rice in a pot so no problem. We used the shuttle to the grocery store and to Red Rock, what a convenient surprise! Our family enjoyed the pool and bbq area. Overall, we enjoyed our stay!!!  Would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Home Away From Home
allReviews.text: During my Vegas eating and relaxing adventure we didn’t want to stay on the Strip so looking for great ratings and reviews we chose The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  This place was an excellent choice.  It is about a 15-20 minute drive from the Strip but it feels like a home away from home without the hustle and bustle and high energy of the Strip.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: Was a lovely place to stay.  Clean. Well stocked with basics in the suite.  Enjoyed sitting out on the balcony.

allReviews.title: Beautiful, quiet, and friendly place to stay
allReviews.text: Always enjoy the Cliffs. It is a gem located off the strip but a gret place to stay and take day trips all around the area. W have been staying for years and we still have so many places to explore!!!

allReviews.title: Cute Apartment
allReviews.text: Very cute apartment. Master bedroom was good sized with a large ensuite. Beds were comfortable, as was the living room sofa. Nice big, full ktichen to cook and save money eating out. Pool was nice and open late. Rooms did not have any hot water at any point which was the main downside of this location. Ideal location if you want to go to a Knights practice or out to Red Rock Canyon

allReviews.title: Details lacking
allReviews.text: Maintenance needs to be more on top of things - more thorough,  Especially when you are pitching timeshares.

allReviews.title: Another excellent stay
allReviews.text: Spent another 2 weeks here at our favourite Vegas resort.  Condo was perfect and so relaxing to just unwind.  Pool was a very chill atmosphere with lots of comfy chairs and umbrellas.  Condo has everything you need to make a big meal, although we didn't really do any cooking, we're on vacation after all.  Shuttle is such a convenient service, with all shuttle drivers very friendly, and offered great tips and conversations.  Love the shuttle to Red Rock, where we once again took it to the Saturday Summerlin market which is just a couple blocks away.  Stocked up with enough for our second week.  Can't wait to return here many more times, and next time we'll bring another family member with us.

allReviews.title: Just Average
allReviews.text: This is our 3rd stay at The Cliffs and we were disappointed compared to the other times.  We were not able to get in at check in time and had to wait until 5:00 to get into our unit.  My sister and I are both handicapped and I requested a unit close the pool, and even though I had the request, I expected that we'd be able to get in at checkout time.  During out stay we noticed that the blinds in the bedroom were worn as the strings had lost the ends and were fraying.  I had trouble with the dishwasher as the gasket was loose (we had to line it up in place whenever we opened it) and the wheels on the bottom rack kept falling apart.  We were sure to mention it before we left but compared to our other times we've stayed there, I was kind of embarrassed because we had guests staying there with us.

allReviews.title: Azwetah
allReviews.text: This place is situated in a quiet location and easy to get to all the attractions. The property is clean inside and outside.The staff at the reception desk were not always helpful due to their language barrier. They spoke limited English,

allReviews.title: Good location and pool
allReviews.text: The Cliffs is usually a great place to stay and love the location in Summerlin.  The units are good size and usually maintained.  The pool is nice size but people today like to play their music which gets annoying.  Also wish they would ban smoking.

allReviews.title: Week at the Cliffs
allReviews.text: Decent place to stay in LV area. Quiet but convenient to strip, especially via shuttle. Nice pool and hot tub and area.

allReviews.title: Peace at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: We have stayed here twice and both were great experiences. We were changed to a first floor room when we requested, pool was refreshing, parking easy and location was perfect for visiting family.  Love the kitchen, living room space in the units, and great AC in the room! Staff were helpful.   Was a quiet and wonderful space to stay...we will be back.

allReviews.title: Peaceful and close to everything
allReviews.text: My first time at this location but so far my favorite place. Less than a mile to shopping centers, food, grocery stores, gas stations, etc . The place was clean, staff was friendly, pool was great, it was quiet, parking steps away. Great place!

allReviews.title: September Getaway
allReviews.text: 3rd time at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon and as always, an excellent vacation experience.   Stayed in a 2 bedroom, 2 bath that is a spacious condo with all of the amenities needed.  Clean, safe, dedicated parking, responsive staff, pool, hot tub, - the Cliffs at Peace Canyon delivers every time.   Can't wait to visit again.

allReviews.title: Review of the unit
allReviews.text: Unit was nice except some issues need to be addressed and fixed.  The weed smell was all day long every day, it was awful and could barely sit on the balcony without getting a headache, needs to addressed.

allReviews.title: Quiet getaway in Vegas
allReviews.text: Quaint, clean and quiet. Beautiful pool in nice part of town. Great location to hit Death Valley and Red Rock Canyon. Away from the strip

allReviews.title: Relaxation!!!
allReviews.text: This resort is perfectly located off the strip... No heavy travel and quiet. Great restaurants within walking or driving. Easy access to major highways. We've stayed here 4 times and always  look forward to the next get a way.. feels like a second home.

allReviews.title: Off the Beaten Path
allReviews.text: We enjoy staying at this property because of the size of the units and location away from the noise of the Las Vegas strip.Perfect for traveling with friends who enjoy their privacy.

allReviews.title: Very relaxing
allReviews.text: Full kitchen and laundry room was very nice. The balcony was beautiful for breakfast each day.  I used the workout room instead of traveling to the gym.  The neighborhood was safe to walk in. Shopping was only a few blocks away.

allReviews.title: Peaceful stay at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Lives up to it's name, perfect place to stay away from strip madness but easy enough to take the free shuttle to and from the action when needed. Well equipped apartments, clean and in safe neighbourhood. Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Almost like home!
allReviews.text: This was such an easy place to stay.  We unpacked and acted just as if we were at home.  Cooked meals, worked on our computers, slept in comfort.  It was terrific

allReviews.title: Great space outside the strip area
allReviews.text: We were visiting family in the area and wanted an apartment style place to stay for the week. This fit the bill. Good value off the highway which allowed us to go gambling when we wanted and travel with family around the area.

allReviews.title: Great location. Kinda needing upgrade
allReviews.text: Old Analog TV's with crappy picture made this a not so enjoyable stay. But we've always enjoyed this location. We've been here multiple times and for some reason the TV situation seemed much worse.

allReviews.title: A place I definitely want to return to
allReviews.text: It's amazing to find such a beautiful and quiet resort just off the Las Vegas Strip. It's the perfect place to enjoy both the excitement and relaxation of travel.

allReviews.title: Very nice place but thin walls
allReviews.text: This is a very nice place to spend your time in the Summerlin area or LV In general.My one complaint was being able to hearthe neighbors TV until after 2 AM.

allReviews.title: Nice family stay
allReviews.text: My family was comfortable staying in the 2-bedroom apartment. There were plenty of linens for showering and sleeping. Each bed had 4 pillows plus there was a bed set in the closet for the living room pull out bed. The kitchen was stocked with enough basics that we could have morning tea and coffee, make bacon and eggs, reheat nachos- pretty much anything I could want to cook during the stay would have been doable. After check in I was left to my own devices. I am sure if I needed service it would have been provided, but we enjoyed a quiet weekend. There were shuttle services offered to the strip and I believe another location, but we didn't use them. It is in a quiet area, and the property itself was quiet. We enjoyed taking a walk around the property and using the pool and gym area. There is also an activity center with old fashioned skee ball and shuffle board, ping pong and foos ball. I really have no complaints. Plan enough time at check out to remove your garbage and gather your linens and push start on the dishwasher.

allReviews.title: It was remarkable.
allReviews.text: I had a blast, I enjoyed everything. It was clean and omg the pool with Jacuzzi was amazing. I recommend.

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon Review
allReviews.text: The pool's perimeter edge was dirty, the safe in the room did not work, not enough hangers in the master closet and there are no storage containers to store leftovers.

allReviews.title: Convenient Location
allReviews.text: The grounds are well kept with a nice pool and patio/firepit area.  The units are a bit dated but clean and the location was perfect for us with a reasonable price for what you get.  We would stay again.

allReviews.title: Great value for price.
allReviews.text: The place is clean, the pool is nice. When we stayed, it was quiet. The other patrons were respectful as well.

allReviews.title: Excellent property!
allReviews.text: Along with an awesome pool/hot tub and fully equipped suites, the resort shuttle is free and takes you to the Strip, Freemont, RedRock and the local grocery store! And the drivers were all amazing!

allReviews.title: Great property for the value overall.
allReviews.text: Great value for Vegas. Unfortunately my trip was left a bit bitter because we accidentally got double booked for the same night and didn’t realize until we arrived. They would not refund the second reservation so we paid additional $90 to check in early and twice the charge for the same day. We would have appreciated more understanding in this situation as it was a difficult situation.

allReviews.title: Business trip
allReviews.text: Nice apartment style resort.  Perfect for my stay and will definitely stay here again when I travel to NV for work.

allReviews.title: Peaceful stay at Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: From check in to departure, this was an enjoyable stay. We had a 2-br unit that was spacious, open concept. Full size washer and dryer in the unit was great. Nice pool and and gym located right outside our unit. Only disappointed when asking for extra coffee from the front desk they charge 1$, still cheaper than Starbucks or McDo and it was pretty good coffee. Location is good with plenty of restaurants and shops near by. Just off the 215, access to Vegas strip is easy with resort shuttle or a short ride down Flamingo or Tropicana

allReviews.title: Terrible place to visit if you understand what quality and safety is
allReviews.text: The highlight was leaving.  The timeshare person was too pushy and did not listen.  The neighboring unit AC unit was loud and me and my son could not sleep all night.  When I called the office, they said a technician will come in the morning and we have to deal with the noise so the first night we had no sleep.  The main pool has some sort of filter that protrudes so high that I stubbed my toe on it which still hurts.  The main pool has salty water instead of different taste...if I wanted the beach I would have gone to the beach.  The room's air filter is inside the room which make a really loud sound.  There was wall edges that looks like it can use some remodeling from cracking wood.  The house cleaner left dirty food chunks and particles inside the dish washer where I had to clean it out from the previous people in the unit.  The mattress beds are way too soft and cheap...I have the Macy's Hotel Collection mattresses at my home.  Why would I stay in your hotel if your mattresses can't even acceptably compare to the comfort I am used to.  My back hurts and I have a crook in my neck from your king size mattress.  The showers in both bathroom were actually nice.  I did enjoy the showers. 08-05-2025 Tue

allReviews.title: Not a resort for families
allReviews.text: Staff is not helpful… shuttle service sucks…. Not kid friendly at all… no activities for kids… Gary was rude when I inquired about a receipt after checking out… I was also given incorrect deposit information when I called ahead prior to my trip

allReviews.title: Spacious and clean but you do a lot of the cleanup
allReviews.text: I must’ve missed the part where you have to do some tedious work at checkout including stripping the beds and putting all linen and towels in the tub, load and run the dishwasher, and take out all the trash. These are no-brainers at home but not something I expect to do on vacation unless it’s an Air BNB. The room was clean but they definitely needed maintenance on the AC filters and remotes did not work for 2 of 3 rooms. These were reported to fixed at checkout. Overall, it was clean, quiet, and spacious and in range of basic necessities.

allReviews.title: We thorougly enjoyed our visit
allReviews.text: Our stay at The Cliffs was great.  Beds were comfortable. Showers were just right.  Apartment very spacious.  We had all we needed and more.  Shopping and good restaurants close by.

allReviews.title: Great for Big families
allReviews.text: The whole place was clean, the rooms weren't next to eachother,I liked that. Kitchen had everything, y loved the Big bathroom ando Big bloset

allReviews.title: Great Value
allReviews.text: Great place to stay away from the strip. This was our second time staying here in less than 1 year and we will definitely stay again the next time we are in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Very Nice Resort
allReviews.text: The location was easy to get to. The resort was very nice and the staff was friendly and helpful.  It is far enough from the strip and downtown to be quiet but close enough to get to.

allReviews.title: Disappointing Customer Service
allReviews.text: We have stayed at this resort numerous times. This time, was our most disappointing: the staff was not helpful; they seemed bothered by our presence in each interaction. The WiFi went out during our stay and the property nor the WiFi technical support was able to fix it. All we received were apologies. After day 3, we were offered to relocate to another building, meaning repack and unpack at a new location.

allReviews.title: Dirty Room, Broken Promises — Not Family-Friendly
allReviews.text: I booked a one-week stay because the hotel offered a room with tile floors, a kitchen, and a crib — ideal for traveling with a baby. But shortly after check-in, I realized the room was far from clean. The floor was so dirty my feet turned black just walking around. The dishwasher had leftover food particles, the laundry machines were filthy, and there was dust and dried food all over the floor.I contacted Expedia right away to shorten the stay. The hotel told them I could check out on Tuesday with no penalty and receive a refund for the unused nights. When I went to the front desk Monday night, they confirmed this. But Tuesday morning, they acted like they had no idea and told me to go through Expedia again. Expedia reached out and was told we had to email the hotel — and once we did, they refused the refund entirely.The room wasn’t clean, and the hotel didn’t keep its word. I wouldn’t recommend this place, especially for families.

allReviews.title: Basketball Tournament
allReviews.text: Stayed at this location off the strip for a basketball tournament.  Staff was super friendly and let us stay 1hr extended when our game time got moved.

allReviews.title: Terrible customer service, tried to cancel with plenty of advance notice, t
allReviews.text: I booked this through booking.com on the wrong date. Being the busy working mama that I am, I realized pretty soon after what I had done and unfortunately the property was not willing to work with me. They told me they couldn't do anything over the phone and that booking.com would need to email them in order to put in the request. Booking.com called them and finally emailed them, but they did not reimburse me. I had a total of 3 phone calls with them and one of them they told me verbally they would reimburse me for this mistake. It never happened. It is very corporate unfortunately and I have no idea what the accommodations actually look like because I never stayed there.

allReviews.title: Somewhat Lacking
allReviews.text: This property is a vacation time share, for rent condo, and VRBO (and probably more).  Unit was clean and ready upon arrival.  As we like to cook, we found the kitchen equipment LACKING.  Kitchen cabinet and drawer fronts were scratched.

allReviews.title: NOT AS EXPECTED.
allReviews.text: I reserved here because of the good opinion it has but I did not like it. It was not a clean property. Outside the room was garbage in the floor and inside the sofa was very dirty so as the sheets of the beds and also they were ripped. There is no housekeeping in the middle of the week so...also they have a salle pool, not as seen in the photos, it was dalty, for me a good option but it was crowded...and a family has 12 inflatables inside the pool so we did not have space in thr pool to do nothing. They also had 3 inflatables in the jacuzzi!  They were playing very rudeza hitting and splashing themselves but they did nothing to take care of other People and that happened all week, so we decides not to going to the pool. They were very rudeza and I think it was respondability of the hotel to make the rules respect...but they did nothing. The hotel is Updated, but the price was good. I chose it because of the good evaluation on trip advisor, but I would not return.

allReviews.title: Great value stay for family vacation
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Cliffs as a family of 5. Amazing value for money: I think we paid roughly $100 per night which included free shuttle to the Strip (worth $100 in Ubers alone!). The children loved the pool area and free coffee in the lobby area was so useful too. Apartment had all we needed: clean kitchen and bathroom. TV. Can’t fault it!

I've reviewed this hotel previously - it is a place that I book often as it is near where my mom lives.  The front desk staff and Cori the manager are wonderful and the pool is well kept. I think since I stay here so often, I do notice more things that need to be attended to - the gym needs upgrading (and equipment needs fixing) and the floors in the units urgently need to be steam cleaned.   Definitely the cleanliness of the units have declined - my last visit items from the previous guest were left in the kitchen, the appliances were dented and again, the floors were dirty.  That said it is still a choice for me though I now always bring slippers to wear and expect worn and dented appliances.  I am going again end July 2025 and hope to get a cleaner unit.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Experience
allReviews.text: I was traveling with 2 toddlers and needed a clean and spacious place. This hotel did not disappoint.

allReviews.title: Edward M Trevino & Deborah Trevino
allReviews.text: Lovely peaceful, family friendly.  Super clean location was perfect for us. We were close to family and easy access to the 215 Highway.

allReviews.title: Great vacation home. I will patronize them again
allReviews.text: Love this place. Supper clean and well spacious. My friends also enjoy the place and love the location.

allReviews.title: Dirty carpet
allReviews.text: The pool area was exceptional. The rooms had poor bed quality and the carpets were very dirty. The location was ideal and safe. The surrounding restaurants were not too pricey.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas’ Most Misleading Mirage
allReviews.text: If you’re looking for luxury, comfort, or even basic cleanliness, The Cliffs in Las Vegas is not your destination. From the moment we arrived, it was clear this “resort” is clinging to a reputation it hasn’t earned—or maintained—in years.The showers didn’t work, the bathrooms were borderline unsanitary, and the mattresses and bedding were so stained and worn, we genuinely questioned if they had been changed this decade. The furniture was in equally deplorable condition—tattered, sunken, and grimy to the touch.This wasn’t rustic. It wasn’t minimalist. It was negligent. And calling it a resort is an insult to resorts.Vegas may be known for illusions, but The Cliffs is not one you’ll enjoy. Save your money, your skin, and your sanity—book elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Peaceful out of the Vegas Craziness
allReviews.text: We chose to get a place that was out of all of the craziness of Vegas.  We were not disappointed.  It was never too far of a drive from anything we wanted to do.  We had a nice ground floor 2 bedroom condo, plenty of room.  The rooms are on opposite sides of the condo as well which was nice.

allReviews.title: Excellent family stay
allReviews.text: Property was ideally located for what we needed; there were plenty of shops within a 5 minute drive.  We loved the dedicated and covered parking space.  Our room was spotless and seemed to have a fully equipped kitchen (which we didn't use).  The spa and pool were amazing and kept the kids very happy.  We loved that the room was equipped with both bath and pool towels.  It took several tries to get the Wifi to work the first time; after that it was reliable and strong.  Oddly, our room had plenty of table lamps but none had light bulbs, so we had to rely on overhead lighting.  We will definitely book again next time we are in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Great property
allReviews.text: Property is very clean and well maintained.  Check in was seamless and easy.  Very highly recommend choosing this property

allReviews.title: Clean and Quiet
allReviews.text: The rooms was very clean and washed equipped with everything we needed for the stay. Property was clean and quiet. The front desk appearance need to be updated. Those blue shirts need to go. Looks tacky. Friendliness and attitudes of the staff needs to be refreshed as well. First impressions leave an impact.

allReviews.title: Perfect place for my medical recovery!
allReviews.text: We were there because I was having surgery and needed to recover before flying home and I am so happy we decided to stay here. It was peaceful and perfectly furnished. Everything we needed was already there. We didn't need to ask for anything more.

allReviews.title: A quiet place to stay away from the strip
allReviews.text: 2 friends and I headed to Vegas to play golf and poker. We did not want to stay in a strip hotel because we wanted the extra space the 2 bedrooms and full kitchen the condo provided. Around the condo there are many very good restaurants that are not expansive that cater to locals.

allReviews.title: A getaway from the hustle and chaos of the strip!!!
allReviews.text: Home away from home has all the amenities that will make you feel like you were at your own spot. Close to a lot of restaurants. Easy access to the freeways and not that far from Red Rock canyon. So if you're ever in Vegas and want to get away from the strip, check out the Cliffs at peace canyon!

allReviews.title: REVIEW OF STAY
allReviews.text: The overall stay was ok.  The grounds are nice.  The layout of the rooms are wonderful.  The resort is located in close proximity to numerous stores, gas stations, restaurants, etc. and not far from the strip.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon in West Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great location in West Las Vegas close to shopping and restaurants.  Property is clean and well kept. Unit was clean and all was comfortable and working.  There is also a van that will take patrons to The Strip and pick them up.

allReviews.title: Family place
allReviews.text: Our stay here was great. We enjoyed the pool/hottub after long walking days. Beds were comfy. It was great to have laundry in the room and I could hang up clothes in the closet. It is in a good and quiet area. Also not far from a target store.

allReviews.title: Better than a hotel
allReviews.text: Staying here was like staying at a home away from home. Very close to a grocery store and several restaurants.

allReviews.title: Nice resort away from the strip.
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our stay away from the madness of the strip. If your goal is quiet and close to Red Rocks Canyon, this is the place.

allReviews.title: DETAILS MATTER
allReviews.text: We booked our reservation out 9 months in advance in order to take advantage of the April weather.  The accommodations were nice, but a little outdated, but we didn't mind. We had a 2 bedroom, which really worked well for us.  We arrived early and the resort was very accommodating and we were able to check in a little early. Though the unit was a little outdated, it suited us perfectly.  The only issue we had was that the tile floors were filthy.  When any of us walked barefoot or with socks, our feet and/or socks were black.  I never did get the dirt out of my footies. I believe management needs to ensure that housekeeping is changing the mop water after each unit, or even possibly more often as needed! Other than that, our beds were comfortable and the kitchen was outfitted adequately to suit most vacationers needs.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  The location was perfect for us, since we were there for the parks and not the glitz.  Wasn't able to enjoy the hot tub ... always full with a younger crowd when we were ready to chill (we're in our 60's), and didn't wish to join in the crowd.  No problem for us. Will definitely  keep them in our queue for any future visits.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs Resort At Peace Canyon Las Vegas Nevada
allReviews.text: This resort propIerty is located approximately  13 KMS west of the Las Vegas Strip .  It is a small resort but has spacious Units, one or two bedrooms including a pullout queen size sofa.  Full amenities in each unit.  There is also a nice pool area, gym. and complimentary shuttle  to the Strip, Red Rock Casino, grocery store, and also Fremont Street Experience daily.  This is a Timeshare  Resort but is also open to nightly rentals.  Perfect for families, couples, solo, and business trips.  Many restaurants are closeby, the new Durango Casino, and also 2 minutes to the Las Vegas Sports Massage, if you are looking for the best massage, single/couples.  During my stays I go weekly for massage or they are mobile and will come to the resort ( ask for James).  There is also excellent shopping closeby  for the ladies.  All in all a good place to consider to stay.

allReviews.title: Maintenance issues
allReviews.text: I have stayed here 3 times before and loved it. We were looking forward to another trip. However, the air conditioning did not work in the first unit. We moved and the air conditioning and the refrigerator did not work in the second unit. We moved and the dishwasher did not work in the third unit. We asked for compensation for lost time waiting for maintenance and moving. They told us to send an email. We did. They never replied.

allReviews.title: This is not a 4 star resort, it is a 1 star rental!
allReviews.text: This is by far the worst place that I have ever stayed in Las Vegas.This is not a 4 star resort, the reviews must be fake.This is a 1 star rental that should not be rented out.For starters, when you check in, you have to stand in two lines, one for check in and the second one for a parking pass (they also try to get you to buy tickets for various stuff that you have no interest in).The upstairs tenant starts dragging his/her furniture at 9:30PM promptly every night (we stayed two nights) and runs back and forth up to 11:30PM. We complained to management, but the noise did not stop.  They promised to speak with the unit upstairs, but I do not believe that they did anything at all.As for the apartment, when you walk in there is a horrible smell that does not go away.The couch has disgusting stains on it (you do not want to sit on it). The mattress is the cheapest that management could obviously buy.This is a bring your own pillow place. The shower/tub combo is dated and appears to be stained from years of wear and tear.The toilet was loose (so bad that we did complain to management), the towel hanger had some white powder all over it (so you could not hang anything on it) and the microwave blew a fuse after the first use.Lastly, the carpet was so gross, that you had to wear your shoes the whole time!Not a

allReviews.title: Felt Like Home
allReviews.text: We stayed in a very large two-bedroom unit with dining room, living room, large open kitchen plus two bedroom and 2 baths. It was perfect except there was no visitor parking and due to cable problems no tv for two days.

allReviews.title: Home from home in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at peace Canyon is a superb facility well run and managed. We were fortunate to meet Jen the manager and Irene who checked us in as they immediately made us feel welcome and at home.We stayed in a 2-bedroom apartment which had its own designated parking spot close by the unit. The unit was very large, clean and had everything we needed for our stay, It was like a home from home.The facilities location is out of town which suited us as we wanted to visit the surrounding area as well as the strip. Its location made it easy for us to access these natural wonders as the road network is new modern providing access to all areas of the Nevada state.There is a Target close by and gas stations which are reasonably priced. There are also plenty of places to eat close by which made our visit to this area not just accessible but affordable.The facilities on site are good especially for the younger element who did not just have the games room or gym facilities but a games room to keep them occupied.If you wanted to visit the famous strip, there is a shuttle which goes all day every day to both the old strip and the new one which is free of charge except for the tip for the driver!!There was no pressure of a time share “review” which was welcome as Jen and her team are committed to ensuring that all her residents have a great time. This is a well-managed/run safe facility and I would certainly go back there again.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Wonderful Unit and property as a whole was above pare. Beautiful resort! Off the Las Vegas strip. Quiet and serene!

allReviews.title: Cliffs at peace canyon stay
allReviews.text: Resort was very well maintained rooms were clean and up to date Pool and hot tub were very nice Shuttle service to casinos were prompt on departure and pickup Plenty of shopping and dining around Summerlin area very close to red rock canyon Great stay!

allReviews.title: Sunny Scottsdale
allReviews.text: Great location close to shopping restaurants & hiking. Walkable for us and the grandchildren Walked for ice cream  multiple time. Games room was fun, pool  was  good, needs for chairs though.

allReviews.title: Great resort away from the strip
allReviews.text: We were there for a golf trip and the resort had all the room we wanted and the hot tub we enjoyed. Easy access to the 215 means you can be anywhere within 20-30 mins.

allReviews.title: Our stay a Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: we were there for the sites and activities beyond the Las Vegas Strip and we were not disappointed. The resort was nice, clean, and very pleasant. We enjoyed the Hot Tub, Pool and outdoor cooking opportunities for the limited time went spent at the resort. The location, 20-30 minutes from downtown was perfect and the availability of a free shuttle bus was an added bonus. we did have a rental car and explored Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, Ice Age State Park, Hoover Dam/Lake Mead and other sites. We will definitely return .

allReviews.title: Peaceful retreat
allReviews.text: Love staying at the Cliffs. Much more peaceful than the strip. Easy access to a main highway. Can easily travel to other sites of interest. Resort has shuttle service if you prefer not to drive to the strip. Heated pool and hot tub are very nice.

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: We stayed for 5 weeks. Had to move units after 3 weeks as per policy, but no big deal. This location is close to everything we wanted including hiking and biking. Could walk to restaurants and bars. Pool and hot tub were great. Our 2 bedroom unit was a great size and very comfortable.

allReviews.title: winter vacation Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very nice resort in a quite area that is still close to everything from the Strip to the Red Rock area.

allReviews.title: Nice Location Away from Strip
allReviews.text: The resort is pretty much in Summerlin which is a world away from the traffic congested strip and all its craziness. This upscale Vegas suburb has everything you can think of (less expensive than anything in the strip) and is a short drive away from Red Rock Canyon (and yes, also Red Rock casino if you like to give your money away to them). The 2-bedroom is spacious and comfortable. Kitchen is fully equipped. Bathrooms are large but their shower fixtures are old and don’t work very well. Pool is nicely heated and very pleasant. The AC works well and so is the heating although quite noisy. Most parking spots are covered which is nice on hot sunny days.

allReviews.title: Been Scammed
allReviews.text: This is the worst hotel establishment my family and I have ever been to. They scam people for their money and hide fees from you. They are liars and use a bait and switch method. While we were here we saw them scam several other families and we were very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Horrible bait and switch!!!
allReviews.text: Absolute worst customer service I’ve ever experienced, STAY AWAY!!! I would not wish this on my worst enemy. Everything is designed to be a bait and switch. Do not be fooled by availability, cost, or promises of a good experience. They essentially call their customers liars even when we have data and documentation otherwise.

allReviews.title: Fails to live up to its potential
allReviews.text: The resort fails to live up to its potential!- Aesthetically pleasing and quiet atmosphere, but the frills stop there.- Fitness center is exceedingly outdated:    - Universal weight machine is antiquated and in need of maintenance.    - Candy and soda machines inside the fitness center!?! I would recommend moving them outside under a cover and use the freed up space to add dumbbells & rack.    - I would recommend replacing the universal machine with a power rack and free weights with a minimum of 310lbs    - Would add a flat bench, as there is only a decline and incline bench.- The smell of marijuana was pervasive at the resort, which was fairly annoying for those of us that don’t use the drug.- The technology in the suites is significantly outdated, e.g., dumb tvs that don’t allow streaming (you should make sure to have an adapter and HDMI cord to connect your smart device.)  The facility has dvds and players, but the latter is not included in the suites - more on that later.  Otherwise, you will a) not know what shows are playing (there is no guide), b) be inundated with commercials.- Wi-Fi is spotty throughout the facility.  We had to change rooms to manage virtual work meetings, as the business center isn’t laid out in a manner conducive to virtual meetings.- The larger bed in our suite was fairly uncomfortable, which led to restless sleep.  It probably was well past its useful life by the time we used it.- The kitchen was decent and made for cooking meals relatively easy.  Appreciated the gas stove!  Grocery stores are close to the resort making it easy to stock the kitchen this saving on eating out every day.- The overnight/morning crew seemed bothered by our requests.  As an example, we walked up to the front desk and asked for a dvd player. The receptionist indicated they’d have maintenance drop one off.  Several hours later we called and were told by the receptionist they’d check on it and call us back, but we never heard from her again nor did maintenance ever show up.- The shuttles are good but drop-offs and pick-ups are limited.  You should also have small bills ($1s) on hand, as there is only drivers expect a tip.- Pool area is very nice.  Be careful of the steps into the pool because they can be quite slippery.  Ask me how I know!

allReviews.title: Our usual 14 day stay.
allReviews.text: This was our fifth time at the Cliffs. We were there for 13 days one day shorter than was booked on account of the snowstorm coming for our flight home, so we decided to get out early. We were hoping the Manager Jennifer would have been more accomadating on us asking if we could have our unit longer and leave later than 10:00 in the morning. When I went to the front desk and asked for her, she refused to come out and talk to me. My husband then went down, and demanded that she come out to talk to him. She said it was Company policy not to change times on checking out. There are always exceptions to rules and it was so quiet and not busy at all. Our flight was leaving at midnight.She wasn't pleasant, nor helpful at all. We miss Daniel the manager previous to Jennifer.Christian the Maintenance gent came to repair the broken dishwasher, and Hood light over the stove...he was polite serviceable and was so fast. Big thank you! And for Mamin at the front desk, so pleasant and always hospitable. We love staying at The Cliffs. We did request a unit we really liked with all our other past visits, but supposedly it was under renovation..although we never saw any work being done?? OUR unit was perfect although no view of the pool, distant mountains, we saw more of the next building next door.Overall it was a wonderful time, exception was Jennifer the Manager.Will be back next year!

allReviews.title: DIRTY and OUT dated - not a recommended place
allReviews.text: The place was disgusting, pull out sofa was not only stained but had tons of food in it. Toaster was dirty, floor was dirty. The countertop was falling off in the kitchen. Light bulbs were out. Very outdated overall where the cabinets were warn off, shower molding was coming up. We could hear the neighbor above us all times of the night and morning as if they were staying with us. We only stayed two nights out of the 7 days because it was so bad.

allReviews.title: Needs updating
allReviews.text: Overall good stay.  Grounds are well maintained and staff are friendly.  Unit was clean but "well worn"  Definitely could use some updating.  Would probably stay again as it was quiet and away from hustle and hustle of the strip.

allReviews.title: A Nice change of Pace in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is nestled in a quiet neighborhood, yet only moments away from all of the shopping, dining, gaming, and entertainment that Las Vegas has to offer. The Cliffs is a lodging option where you can enjoy the nightlife of Las Vegas without the noise and commotion of the strip. It is a change of pace venue where your dollar will go much further if you choose to visit the local casinos and restaurants nearby.

allReviews.title: Quiet and away from the strip
allReviews.text: We came to Vegas to visit Red Rocks and Mt Charleston. This place was quiet, clean and pretty empty overall. We came to get away for some peace and we definitely had it.

allReviews.title: Nice resort in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a very peaceful resort in Vegas off the strip. We were participating in a soccer tournament and the fields were close to the resort. The shuttle service to three different casinos was great. The resort is very clean and the front desk personnel were very friendly and courteous. The pool and gym were well maintained.

allReviews.title: Clean Comfortable Quiet
allReviews.text: Close to Red Rock Canyon. Quiet location with daily shuttle to and from the Strip if desired. Heated Pool, Hot Tub, Gym and high end BBQs were a pleasure to use.  Staff were pleasant and helpful.Large units with everything you need just like at home. .

allReviews.title: Superb timeshare, convenient location
allReviews.text: Wonderful accomodations, very helpful and friendly staff, swimming pool and exercise center, midway between Red Rock Canyon and the Las Vegas strip.

allReviews.title: Had a great vacation at the Cliffs!
allReviews.text: This resort is very nice. The location is perfect, as it is away from the strip (close enough to visit easy enough) but very close to restaurants and shops.  It is very close to Red Rock Canyon!  The units are large and well appointed.  Beds are comfortable. It is so convenient having a washer and dryer in the unit since we were hiking every day and got very dirty. It was our first visit to this resort but we plan on returning.

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The resort is very clean, rooms are spacious, and the people that work there are professional and helpful. The resort is in a residential area about 20 minutes from the strip and 10 minutes from downtown Summerlin which has a lot of restaurants, shopping, and Red Rock Casino. A free shuttle to the strip, Red Rock Casino, and Fremont Street is provided which really helps anyone who stays there get around town stress free. It is very quiet with a nice pool, hot tub, and other amenities not too far from all Las Vegas has to offer. I really appreciated the lack of sales people hounding you for a presentation, I would stay there again just for that. Overall I really enjoyed the stay and it was perfect for my trip.

allReviews.title: Red Rock
allReviews.text: This resort is very close to Red Rock canyon.  Unit was generally clean except for filthy windows. Pool is very nice albeit small and in need of some aesthetic maintenance. Exercise room is low quality. Small. Broken and old equipment. Filthy windows. Needs a good scrub down. They have junk food vending machines in fitness area instead of more equipment. I had to repair Universal machine several mornings. Internet/wifi is low grade. Drops all the time.  Units need a refresh.  $50 resort fee is not justified for lousy internet and exercise room that is way below standard.

allReviews.title: Great Time
allReviews.text: Unit was good Check in was easy Staff very responsive to needs,.Grounds were clean and well maintained.Love the closeness of. The Highway and easy access to the Cliffs Good time

allReviews.title: Great place to stay off the strip in Vegas
allReviews.text: If you don't need to be right on the strip this is a very peaceful and will stocked place to stay. I enjoyed using the shuttle to the strip so didn't have to worry about parking. But doing this will require quite a bit of walking unless you're happy to just stay around Treasure Island.

allReviews.title: Third visit and still good.
allReviews.text: This was our thrid time staying at this hotel-resort.  It is in a great location, about 20 minutes plus from the strip, close to grocery stores and shopping and easy accesss to golf courses,  This time they were able to accommodate our request to be close to the pool gates and we were literally steps away.  Thank you to the check in staff for arranging this.Our 2 bedroom unit had all the amenities we needed including a small patio (we were a ground floor unit, per our request to avoid stairs).  We had trouble with the main tv and after a call to the front desk, someone came within minutes to fix it.  Excellent service.The grounds are well maintained, the pool lovely and there is also a large hot tub.  No street noise is heard at all.The resort does provide a shuttle service to a number of areas, but we didn not use it on this trip.  Easy access to Red Rock Canyon and the Hoover Dam via the highway which is close by.  We will definitely return here when visiting Las Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great location, wonderful pool and hot tub. 19 minutes to the strip with shopping centers are right down the road   This was our 3rd stay and hope to come back.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas Getaway
allReviews.text: Beautiful serene place nestled near the mountains. Wonderful view of the mountains from the room with a porch that we enjoyed our meals taking in the fresh mountain air. The pool and hot tub were clean and enjoyed them daily. It’s close enough to the strip yet nice to get away from the bustle of Vegas. There are many nice restaurants and shopping centers close by. Red rock park is very close, this, you have hiking and nature as well. Nice balance!

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a winner for us!!
allReviews.text: This resort is always clean, the staff very friendly and the location works well for us.  We have stayed at this RCI facility several times.

allReviews.title: Great Off-Strip spot!
allReviews.text: Really enjoyed my stay here! They were doing road work; which was really loud, during our stay. We also needed a first floor room due do a disability and they only had 2nd floor available, which made it difficult for us to enjoy the property. We had an extremely loud refrigerator but the room was very nice outside of this. Great spot to stay at off the strip and the hustle and bustle. Would love to come back on the first floor!

allReviews.title: Spacious!
allReviews.text: Good location especially for our outdoorsy/non casino wk in Vegas.  Close to freeway access and various places we visited such as Valley of Fire, Red Rock, Lake Mead, etc. We chose the property as it was close to Red Rock where we would be running a trail race and spending a 2nd day hiking.  Best location based on our activities. They have a free shuttle to the Strip. We didn’t take it but drops off at the Tropicana.  This could be a pretty lengthy walk depending on where you want to go, your skill set, weather, crowds, etc…..If staying here you really need a car IMO Good size 1 bedroom condo. Soooo much more spacious than a hotel.  Many amenities to the property and well tended to except the gym.  The gym doesn’t appear to get cleaned every day based on the dust on the equipment and the dirty floor.  Both ellipticals need maintenance.  They work but not correctly.   Typical hotel gym.  Would recommend they add a few hand weights.   I used the gym daily for a wk and only saw 2 other people in there with me.  Good choice for us and a fair price.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Over all we really enjoyed our stay at the Cliffs but we needed a car but other than that it was very nice

allReviews.title: ENJOYED OUR STAY
allReviews.text: Clean and spacious unit. 4 stars just due to the kitchen needing an upgrade. Nice pool, hot tub, fireplace and grills. Easy parking. Shuttle to the strip and grocery. We didn't use it, as we rented a car. I recommend finding an easy route and sticking with it to get to the Vegas Strip. GPS took us a different route every time and it was about 30 minutes away. We got lost a lot. It was a good central location to take day trips to Red Rock Canyon, Fire of Valley and Hoover Dam and the South Rim of the Grand Canyon. Enjoy!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed being outside the strip but close enough to take the shuttle provided by the property.  We are talking about going back again to enjoy some shows we missed.

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff.  Great location.  Great restaurant near by.  La Madre. Near by attractions were great.  Fire canyon and red rocks and emerald cave.

allReviews.title: Family Reunion
allReviews.text: I love that we are not on the Strip side of town. We were near stores for shopping and restaurants for dinning. Facilities are great.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Comfortable, good furniture, updated appliances, W/D in unit are full size, great pool.  Easy location.  Dedicated parking spot right outside the unit.  Street noise can be an issue, but it is Las Vegas, nothing is quiet here.

allReviews.title: Great apartment!!!
allReviews.text: We found this resort (far from the Strip) and caught a relatively inexpensive week. There are one and two bedroom apartments, each with a balcony or terrace. The kitchen is very well equipped and there is also washer/dryer, ironing board and iron. Everything you need to live very comfortably. There is a TV in every room. The couch can be turned into a bed and is actually cozy and comfortable. In the middle of the complex is a large saltwater pool, a hottub and enough sunbeds and tables. There is also a fitness centre. The facility also offers complimentary late night shuttle service to the Strip, Freemont St. and Red Rock Casino. Grocery stores are nearby. We loved this property so much that we will book it again.

allReviews.title: Very peaceful at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Excellent, fast, early check in available.  No hassle to receive parking pass and she accepted my reasons for not wanting their "free breakfast".   Unit is very clean and comfortable and it was easy to get additional supplies when needed.  We spent a lot of afternoons by the pool which was the exact right temperature for 103 F days!  The spa/hot tub was also refreshing.

allReviews.title: Another Wonderful stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: We just finished our stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon and had another fantastic week. The units were clean, had everything we needed, and were comfortable. The pool was wonderful, and there was lots of seating for everyone. The staff was very accommodating and friendly. A big shout out to Debra, the night person. She was fabulous! We can't wait to go back again. This has been our go-to for Vegas for years.

allReviews.title: LOVELY, QUIET VEGAS VACATION
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at The Cliffs. This lovely resort is situated in a nice residential area about 20 minutes from the strip. The apartments are roomy with a full kitchen. We especially appreciated the full size GE washer and dryer after traveling the week before and bringing loads of dirty laundry.The staff was friendly and courteous, especially Deborah who checked us in. The shuttle bus to Treasure Island on the strip was welcome and timely. We had a rental car but never needed to drive to the strip with the great shuttle service provided. The shuttle would also take riders to a local grocery store or another nearby casino. All of the shuttle bus drivers were polite and kind. Shout out to Philip and Lance, two great drivers. I wish I’d gotten the names of the others as they were all top notch.If there were a downside to this property, all I could say is that you would need to figure transportation to and from the airport as the shuttle doesn’t go there. Otherwise, I whole heartedly recommend The Cliffs! We’ll be back!

allReviews.title: Outdated, and dirty
allReviews.text: Do not stay here, the floors were dirty and sticky furniture is dirty, air conditioning filter on the ceiling was falling down and a screw fell and hit me in the head. I have pictures of all issuez.

allReviews.title: My Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: The Cliffs was a beautiful place to stay, it was not only very roomy, but very clean.  The staff were very courteous. I would definitely come back here for another stay.

allReviews.title: The Cliff is Fine, but...
allReviews.text: The cliff is a great property. Great service. But RCI is a very irresponsible company.  They changed their policy half way thru the year forcing guest to alter their travel plans with a total disregard to the consequences. Use to be that you're able to book as many cash weeks as you desired, the in August, the the geniuses at RCI decided to limit the number of weeks to 8 weeks/ year. Without giving us any heads up by phone or emails.  Totally irresponsible  on their behalf.When we purchased the time share it was for unlimited weeks of cash vacation.I'm done staying at RCI and will not pay any more frivolous fees. Enjoy your new policy

allReviews.title: wu
allReviews.text: It is a very good resort for a week. In quite and safe area. but you need to rent a car. My friend also enjoyed the resort.

allReviews.title: Vacation to The Cliffs
allReviews.text: Very well run and maintained. Had to call maintenance twice for items and both times they were there within minutes and resolved the problems promptly. Great size to the units and always in very good condition. If you want to go to the Strip, or Old Town, the shuttle is a great way to go. We love this place and have been coming here for over 20 years!

allReviews.title: Stay away
allReviews.text: We flew in late on a Friday night. I immediately became aware of 3 maintenance issues. The ac fan was making a loud noise, the unit had an odor, and the primary bedroom tv was not programmed for channels available on the living room and secondary bedroom. I reported the problems first thing Saturday morning and stated that we were leaving but they could enter and fix the issues. When we returned, the only issue repaired was the ac fan. Housekeeping had sprayed something they thought would removed the odor, but it didn’t work. I sprayed two different products over 2 days that also didn’t help. Housekeeping wanted to spray the same thing again. Then they wanted us to burn candles to cover up the odor. We refused. Maintenance left a card stating they had fixed the TV, and that I should give them a 5 star rating on the RCI survey. The TV wasn’t fixed. Maintenance returned and I showed him the difference in channels available on the other TVs compared to the one needing programming. I asked how he thought he had repaired the TV. He stated he got a channel to come up and thought it was fixed. He did show me that he fixed it, but he continued to work on the TV and messed it up again. He said he couldn’t repair it and would have to call the cable company. The resort manager called to review the maintenance issues. She stated she wanted to offer us a late checkout due to the problems. I stated that a late checkout did nothing for us, since we had a 6am flight out. She made no other offers. This is not a 5 star resort and I would not recommend it to anyone.

allReviews.title: great area
allReviews.text: If you dont like all the chaos of the strip then Cliffs at Peace Canyon is your place...its quiet and in a residential neighborhood. There are plenty of fantastic  places to eat and shop within minutes. you can be at any of the casinos on the strip within 20 minutes...Red Rock Casino is closest and its about 10 min. away...its our favorite. Everyone at check in was very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Very Relaxing Stay!
allReviews.text: Pleasant stay! It was really hot so lots of pool time. Special shout out to Dunia .... a very welcoming and accommodating host!

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: My family stayed at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon over the Labor day week and loved our experience.The staff are some of the nicest and  professional people in the hospitality.   The rooms are very clean and well maintained The grounds are immaculate, we had a wonderful time and will definitely be going back next year

allReviews.title: Great place but should be smoke free
allReviews.text: Love the size of the units and most are well maintained.  The pool area was kept clean and neat.  Did not like smelling cigarette smoke in the pool area as it is suppose to be a smoke free facility.  Love the location as Summerlin is a great area and close to Red Rock for hiking.  Had a nice drive up to Mt. Charleston and it was 20 degrees cooler there.

allReviews.title: This in not a resort
allReviews.text: This is not a resort but they charged us $50.00 resort fee. The pool was dirty and disgusting. Our 2 BR 2 BA unit still had empty pack of cigarette box and used cigarette butts on the ashtray on the balcony table We found a ball of black hair behind the towels on the towel rack in one of the bathrooms in our unit (it looked like someone cut their hairs and left them on the shelf behind the presumably clean towel). This was the most disgusting experience we have had with RCI booking thus far. This place was also quite far from the Las Vegas strip. The only reason we chose this place was because of the good reviews, but it was truly disappointing for us. We brought these concerns to the front desk personnel, and their suggestions were that we email the manager with the pictures who was on vacation at the time. We had a horrible experience at this place, which probably could have been avoided if the cleaning was up to the standard. We will definite not stay here again.

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The condo was very clean, and spacious!! We also enjoyed that the complex is located in a very nice community. We were able to access very nice near by restaurants and retail shopping. The complex is also a more peaceful location not far from the hustle and bustle of the strip, yet with in a short distance from major Vegas venues.

allReviews.title: Decent resort just north of the Las Vegas Strip with nice pool and free shuttle to Strip
allReviews.text: I stay at the Cliffs a few times a year as it is located near family in the area.  I have stayed in both the 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom units - this trip was a 2 bedroom unit.  The pros include a great resort manager, helpful front desk staff, beautifully kept grounds and pool, a washer and dryer in the unit, good air conditioning in the unit, and a free shuttle to the Las Vegas Strip, Red Rock Casino, and local grocery store.  The units are a little tired - even the 'upgraded' units - and could use a refresh and in some cases new appliances. In addition, if you have a first (ground) floor unit, you will hear the people above you.   That said, I recommend this resort if staying in Las Vegas area.

allReviews.title: Fahily
allReviews.text: I had a good time and, I got all the help I needed from the people that worked there. The room was clean service was good and big. I will come back to Cliffs at Peace Canyon. A good location

allReviews.title: Very nice gold crown resort in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We had  booked a week of time share at this resort and had enjoyed the 2 large bedroom unit with a full kitchen .  The rooms are large and comfortable . The two full baths are clean and nice. It is quiet and peaceful at the resort . The resort , the pool and the fitness center are well maintained. Irene at the front desk is helpful and courteous . We have used the shuttle bus daily to  go to the LV strip and the grocery store . Rocky, the bus driver, is super nice and helpful . We will definitely come back to this resort in the spring time with our families .

allReviews.title: Needs updating
allReviews.text: The unit needs updated TV s. parking and location is great. very famliy friendly. Has a shuttle but you need to make a rfesivation the day before. It will take you to the strip, downtown and some local casinos.

allReviews.title: Very good vacation
allReviews.text: The place is really nice, clean, the reception people were really nice, close to everything a lot of restaurants, stores and bars

allReviews.title: Kay
allReviews.text: A vacation for four of my grandsons.  We were 10 steps from the pool.  They enjoyed the resort to the fullest.  The pool table kept them occupied until it was time to leave the resort.  The shuttle drop off is also a plus.  Rocky was nice and gave good information to get to activities outside of the resort.

allReviews.title: The best resort
allReviews.text: Again, The staff were very helpful and polite. We definitely recommend this resort to anyone traveling to Vegas

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: I have enjoyed staying a week almost every year over the past 15years. It is quiet and relaxing. good transport provided when needed and friendly staff.

allReviews.title: A quiet place in the city with noise pollution.
allReviews.text: We have visited Las Vegas over 100 times in the last 65 years, and found the cliffs to be an excellent example of how good time sure can be. Because it is in a quiet zone yet minutes away from theaters, casino, action, and outstanding restaurants.

allReviews.title: Favorite place in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The resort is so pleasant, off the tourist path but still convenient to get anywhere in Vegas. Love the location, the room, the amenities and property.

allReviews.title: Perfect for a family or a couples getaway. I will be staying the
allReviews.text: I will be staying there again asap. Plenty of privacy in the unit. Perfect for a family with space for fun and games. Separate laundry room in unit. Large kitchen and bathrooms. Closet space galore, even walk ins. Can't say enough about this one.

allReviews.title: Clean and quiet property
allReviews.text: We stayed in an updated room and it was clean, comfortable and quiet. The mattress was more comfortable than ours at home!  The employees are very nice and are there to assist us in anyway they can. We chose this resort because it was close to family and away from the strip.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs in Vegas
allReviews.text: Big 2 bedroom condo. Free shuttle to/from the strip which is 20 minutes away. Didn’t need a car. People working there were very nice.

allReviews.title: A very good choice to stay with family
allReviews.text: Safe, peaceful, friendly people, helpful staff. Free shuttle to the strip or supermarket. Very convenient. Big size of the whole apt.

allReviews.title: Location
allReviews.text: Loved the location. It kept us out of the heavy traffic areas and was easily accessible from the interstate. Restaurants were close by with many options.

allReviews.title: Dave and Carol
allReviews.text: It took 4 phone calls to get some of the things that we wanted like paper towels and garbage bags. The ceiling fan was dirty in the living room. Some of the bowels in the cabinet were dirty. Carol had to go to the front desk to get cooking tools.

allReviews.title: Quiet location and away from the downtown area
allReviews.text: The Cliffs was used as our homebase for EDC and other travel in the Las Vegas area. Very quiet and close to many stores/restaurants/malls. Pool and sauna were nice - we were there when it was not fully occupied, so everything was easy to use. Unit was clean and all appliances worked well - king bed was very comfortable - couch was large and also very comfortable, We will use again!

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Property clean, and very conveniently located. Room very spacious and comfortable. Check in and check out were very efficient. Jared extremely helpful and friendly during check out.

allReviews.title: Clean, Comfortable, and LOVE the Shuttle Service
allReviews.text: Great to have a shuttle that goes to strip, downtown, and Red Rock Casino! Rooms are large and comfortable. I only wish they had fluffier, more comfortable pillows...they used to.

allReviews.title: Resort is showing its age
allReviews.text: Large comfortable suites.  Though there are many maintenance issues that have not been properly addressed.

allReviews.title: Fabulous stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Cliffs of Peace Canyon for our trip out west.   The resort, and our 2nd floor unit #2027 had a great mountain view.   The area was perfect for shopping and and lots of choices for meals.    The main reason for staying here was because we were doing National Parks.  We were able to do Valley of Fire for a day trip.   We also did Zion and Bryce, but stayed in Kanab UT for those parks.   We loved that the resort had a shuttle to the strip and to Fremont.  So although we paid a $50 resort fee, having the shuttle more than made up for that fee.     The resort was quiet, and clean.  Parking is covered and the pool had enough chairs for all of the guests.   If we come back out west, we will definitely stay at the Cliffs.  ( We did happy hour at William B's in the Suncoast Casino.  Great value!  We had dinner one night at Echo and Ridge......a perfect Rib-Eye and you can bring your own Bottle of wine.   Also found a great italian spot off of Durango....Guiseppes.   Delicous food and reasonable prices.)

allReviews.title: The quieter side of vegas
allReviews.text: 15 minutes from the strip. Large unites and a great pool area. Very nice resort. Under 200 units. No elevators to wait for.

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: Good place to stay within easy range of the city but not close to the hustle and bustle.  The unit was spacious and the amenities were good.

allReviews.title: The Cliff's at Peace Canyon, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Review Of the Cliff’s 042724 Stay.Initial impression was that the resort is an older property and was it really a gold star resort?  The check-in process was fast (may have been the time of day).  Staff at desk were OK and to the point.  Visited the parking pass desk/timeshare sales lady, just told her not interested as my wife and I wanted to experience the resort we were at.  First impression of the room was a bit skeptical, again the feeling of an older unit.  It was a big unit (2-bedroom) and had a lot of dated, but nice amenities.  The 2nd floor was a bit of a challenge with our heavy luggage, but we managed OK.  The unit seemed clean except for the outdoor balcony (if thats what you call it). Had to clean the table and chairs (didn't sweep the floor). Turns out the outdoor balcony was our favorite place to sit and relax through the whole trip.  A few minor complaints like the hair dryer kept shutting off in the main bedroom, my wife would use the second bath hair dryer. And the sink faucet in the master bath was loose (nice faucet but seemed rinky dink). But all-in-all we really liked the unit.  My wife said the pillows were somewhat small but we agreed that the bed was comfortable.  We also agreed it was very peaceful and we would stay there again.  Recommend a little more maintenance and a little more cleaning (the outdoor balcony),  Other than the few negatives we really liked the stay and would stay again.  We have gone to Vegas about 30+ times over 30+ years and stayed at many resort there.  We rank the Cliffs very close to the top of all we have stayed at.  Management should focus very closely at the outdoor terrace or balcony as it is the hi-lite of the unit.

allReviews.title: Wow! Truly a beautiful and peaceful place to stay!
allReviews.text: We were thrilled with this resort!  It is truly named appropriately. It is very peaceful and beautiful environment to relax. While it feels remote, it is very close to the strip and Red Rock Canyon and many other entertainment options. We would HIGHLY recommend this resort!

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: This is a nice resort of the strip about 12 miles. You are close to the action but far enough away to enjoy yourself with some peace and quiet. Beds weren’t that comfortable but everything else seemed to be ok.

allReviews.title: Relaxing at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The Cliffs is located close to Hwy 215 so it's easy to get anywhere in Vegas.  It's well off the strip which is ideal if you're planning on spending a week or more in Vegas.  The units have plenty of room and privacy for two couples with all the amenities to have your own meals and 4 large outdoor grills/barbecues as well.  The pool and spa(hot tub) are located in the center of the complex for easy access.  The two water spouts in the pool provide a nice touch and can be also as an impromptu shoulder and neck massage after a day of hiking, golfing or shopping.  The staff are very attentive and responsive.

allReviews.title: Slow deterioration
allReviews.text: Precious stays at this property were amazing. This stay left a bit to be desired. Our unit needs upgrading - damaged kitchen cabinets and peeling wall paper.  We also had an issue with waste water from cleaners in the upstairs unit raining down on us and our laptop while we used the patio. Apologies from housekeeping manager who was going to get the general manager to contact us. We are still waiting.The location is about 15 minutes from the strip, close enough but also far enough away from the action. It is close to shopping and restaurants and to the west side of the city. While there is a regular shuttle to and from the strip, a car would greatly increase your mobility.

allReviews.title: Needs Updating
allReviews.text: Old, uncomfortable furniture. Smelled bad. TV not working well. Left after three days. Staff was friendly and place was overall clean visually. The smell of furniture and uncomfortable, noisy bed everytime I rolled over made me consider paying for a hotel instead of staying there.

allReviews.title: Only 15 minutes to downtown Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice rooms, clean and friendly staff.  It's only15 minute drive to downtown Las Vegas and far enough away from all the noise.  Rooms were nice, main family room and kitchen with two separate bedrooms with separate bathrooms, one attached and one shared.  Covered car ports was a plus.

allReviews.title: Great Place for a Family or Couples
allReviews.text: Very clean, attractive property.  Well maintained.  The resort location is very accessible to the area wide attractions of the total Las Vegas area.  We would booked this property again in the future for either a couples or family get away.

allReviews.title: Vegas outside the strip
allReviews.text: We had never been to Vegas outside of the strip before.  It is beautiful with lots of hiking options.  This resort was well equipped for a comfortable stay.  I could have packed less since there is a washer and dryer in the unit.

allReviews.title: Wonderful, peaceful resort in West Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Wonderful resort with heated swimming pool, twin waterfalls and spa. All of the amenities and a handy shuttle service. Very comfortable and peaceful. Highly recommended. Off the noise and hassle of the strip and close to several state parks worth visiting.

allReviews.title: good stay
allReviews.text: This resort is in the west suburbs of Las Vegas .They have a comfotable and reliable shuttle to the strip and freemont st. There is a nice pool and gym and even ping pong and pool table. Our two bedroom unit had comfy beds atruly full kitchen and spacious bathrooms There was 3 tvs and a large dining table We have been here before and would recommend it to people who dont need the bright lights or gambling 24/7

allReviews.title: Excellent!!
allReviews.text: Incredible place to stay in Vegas with quick access to Red Rock Canyon.   Beautiful location, very nice pool which is heated year round.   The BBQ area is also great!The area is less busy than the strip.  In fact, traffic around this location is particularly quiet which makes commuting quite easy.  There's also several grocery stores like Walmart, Target and Smiths just several blocks away.

allReviews.title: Vacation away from the craziness of the city.
allReviews.text: This was a 3 generation vacation. The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was about 20 to 25 minutes off the strip. It a beautiful quiet neighborhood. There was a free shuttle that started at 10. The city but was just around the corner about 1 block walk. We took ubers at time due to parking and driving issues in the city. The condo, we had a 2 bedroom was well appointed with a full kitchen. The shuttle will take you to grocery store and to a drop off at the Mirage.  We ate breakfast and usualy 1 other meal in kitchen each day. Beautiful heated pool and hot tub and game room. Comfortable beds and staff was welcoming. My father-in-law was impressed by the shower. We had 5 but it could sleep 3 couples and someone on couch. We had a wonderful trip.

allReviews.title: Excellent Resort
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a beautiful place.  Free shuttle to the strip, grocery store and Fremont.  All staff members are extremely friendly and welcoming.  We will definitely stay here again. We love staying at Vacation Village Resorts!

allReviews.title: Parks
allReviews.text: We had planned this trip because of the proximity to many of the parks we wanted to visit.  We were able to see all of those on our lists and a couple of extra county and state parks as well.  We had a wonderful time, the staff was very helpful with any and all questions that we had.

allReviews.title: Ok
allReviews.text: Very disappointed. Rooms were old needs to be updated. Pool and hot tub were abt the only thing good here. The location was good we were away from the strip. That was nice. Was quiet. Grandkids went to play ping pong they only had one ball . Which was split. Went to target to get some. They were 6 bucks. Really???

allReviews.title: CLIFF AT PEACE CANYON -QUITE NICE
