allReviews.text: Nice Quiet place away from the strip with free shuttle to it when you want to go. save on. parking costs. the heated pool, hot tub, fitness room all nice though not enormous.  Grounds were well kept. the unit was clean and well equipped. comfortable beds, good baths and showers.  A PEACEFUL PLACE

allReviews.title: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!
allReviews.text: London Bridge is a favorite. Lake Havasu City has pleny of good places to eat, you can take a short ferry ride over to the casino on the other side of the river for a few hours or hike in the desert. The resert is clean, the pool area is spotless and there's SUN almost every day! Lots to do and see.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay
allReviews.text: Highly recommended place safe quiet environment services were provided as needed area is in great location store and market shopping center within walking distance safe for children in playing areas pool is clean.

allReviews.title: A relaxing stay…
allReviews.text: This was one of the best RCI-referred places I’ve ever stayed.  The location was perfect; close enough but not near the Strip, closer to Red Rocks area with beautiful views.  In a suburban, residential area close to stores and little traffic.  A place where you can relax after a long day.  The grounds were neat and clean and the staff extremely courteous and efficient.  I’m looking forward to returning.

allReviews.title: Quiet and comfortable rest
allReviews.text: Although The Cliffs is not close to the Strip, it makes up for it with a convenient free shuttle service, it is a cozy place with clean and well-maintained facilities. Very good service from the staff.

allReviews.title: Vegas Staycation Bliss: Three Weeks of Chill at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: This year, I kicked back at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon for a solid three weeks. It's the perfect spot if you're looking to chill but still want to hit up the Vegas Strip or check out the nearby casinos. I especially loved the new Durango Casino and Resort – such a cool place. And taking a drive out to Red Rock Canyon? Absolutely worth it for the views.The Cliffs is basically my go-to for a Vegas staycation. I stayed in a 1-bedroom the first week and a 2-bedroom for the last two weeks. The rooms have everything – a full kitchen, washer, dryer, and the comfiest living room setup. The people working there are amazing, too. They've got a bunch of great places to eat and shop close by, so you're all set.Being close to the Strip but having my quiet spot at The Cliffs is the best of both worlds. Whether I'm feeling the casino vibe or just want to enjoy some nature, it's all easy to get to. Honestly, The Cliffs is my top pick for a laid-back Vegas stay.

allReviews.title: Great access to local sites!
allReviews.text: We loved th location! It provided nice view of the mountains away from the bustle of downtown. It also provided great access to local parks, recreation and restaurants. The free shuttle to the Strip, Fremont Street and Red Rock Canyon was a game changer! The entire staff were gracious and informed.

allReviews.title: Good Resort Overall
allReviews.text: 15 minutes from the Strip/Freemont, lots of basic shopping needs very close.  Resort was clean and set up nice.  Pool and hot tub were small but in excellent shape.  Inside of room (2 bedroom suite) was very clean and ready upon arrival.  Furniture/beds were outdated but in excellent condition.  Showers were clean for the most part although shower heads were really old and there was some caulk work that was messy and dirty around the tubs.  They only give hotel shampoo/conditioner/lotion/soap bottles so be prepared to go buy or ask for much more is staying longer than a weekend.  Master suite has a very large walk in closet that would hold weeks worth of clothes in addition to the dresser, etc. Staff was friendly and check in/out was easy.  Overall a great home base, close enough to plenty of great golf, the Strip/Freemont, as well as 15 minutes from Red Rock Canyon.

allReviews.title: Nice and courteous staff, dirty resort
allReviews.text: Stale cigarette smoke is throughout the entire unit, damaged kitchen cabinets, hair from previous guests covered the bedding, stained couches, outlets in both bathrooms did not work, dirty: walls, vents, blinds, curtains

allReviews.title: Vegas golf trip
allReviews.text: Wonderful resort close to some nice courses. Units were large and very clean. This unit is approx 20 min from the strip but there are some nice casinos near by. Plenty of restaurants near and a few within walking distance.

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here
allReviews.text: The room was stayed in was so dirty(beds had random hairs all in them, pull out had food and garbage and the mattress was stained, sinks and mirrors still had the last guests spit, and some towels were dirty too) and smelled of old smoke. On our first night we ended up getting fresh linens from the front desk and remaking all the beds ourselves. I reached out to management and they didn’t even offer to refund one bit of our stay, not even the cleaning fee.

allReviews.title: Best place
allReviews.text: This place have a great staff This place very  clean surroundingThis place you have your own parking spot and kitchen, living room, bathroom and the bedroom super clean.The swimming pool and Jacuzzi and the gym great perfect location, My daughter goes swimming and my wife do cardio at small gym and the Jacuzzi only few step from the gym, and we still can see each other

allReviews.title: Enjoyable stay at Cliffs at Peace Canyon!
allReviews.text: My week long stay at the Cliff at Peach Canyon was a comfortable and enjoyable. It was close to everything you need. This resort is 20-25 minutes away from the strip. This location is great if you want to be in Las Vegas, but away from the strip. It close to Red Rock Canyon. There are other casinos and shopping centers that are in the area. The gym was well equip to workout. The pool is heated. The jacuzzi was a nice size and worked well. The front desk was able to grant my request for a bottom unit due to my family members who had walkers. The staff were excellent. Check in was quick and easy. They were able to give me my room before the check in time. The hospitality department was very attentive with anything that I needed for the room or issues that I had. The issues were resolved quickly. The staff at this resort wants to make sure you will have an enjoyable and comfortable stay. They are top tier. I will stay here in the future again.

allReviews.title: Glorious retreat close enough to the strip.
allReviews.text: We loved our stay at this resort. The grounds are beautiful and the pool and hot tub were warm and clean. We made good use of the bbqs and pool table. The staff attended to any needs swiftly and pleasantly. It was walking distance to restaurants and Smiths grocery store with all that we needed. We had a car to get to the Hoover Dam and the Grand Canyon which we loved. We also took advantage of the shuttle which was convenient. Our condo was spacious and beautiful and our balcony was heaven. We want to come back. What a great place to stay if you want a little oasis near and far enough from the strip.

allReviews.title: The best
allReviews.text: The Cliffs is the place to be in Las Vegas Our location is excellent and the unit is spacious and spotless full kitchen has stove great sleep and HBO the transportation to and from the strip is excellent and timely and friendly

allReviews.title: A True Gem
allReviews.text: We absolutely loved this resort. It was super clean. The staff is amazing. Shuttle to and from the strip. A peace of heaven 15 minutes off the strip. We couldn’t have picked a better resort. This is 5 star all the way.

allReviews.title: Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great location for those that want to stay off the Strip. But close to all including the parks hiking malls concerts etc. Very well kept time share, clean huge 2 BR complete free parking. Nice upgrades. Pool, hot tub, BBQ etc.

allReviews.title: not satisfied
allReviews.text: The front desk that checked us in doesn't even smile, the resort is not a resort but just like apartment complex. No activities for members. there is a bus that will take you the strip vut you have to make a reservation. The only good thing is the pool are heated.

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Place was nice. Heated pool, nice for year round use. Shuttle was great! Rooms nice, furniture outdated. Would have liked fireplace in our unit, but not available in all units. Trash removal at 7:00am disturbed sleeping.

allReviews.title: Outstanding
allReviews.text: Cliff are excellent place to stay. Convenient location, great units and grounds and outstanding staff. Nice area on the west side near Red Rock Canyon, the strip and downtown. A shuttle to the strip, shopping makes it easy and convenient to get around. Nice pool/spa area and easy to access.

allReviews.title: Great location off the strip
allReviews.text: This is our favorite timeshare exchange in Vegas. It's a clean, small quiet complex far away from the madness of the strip. The pool is heated and the spa is always hot. Every unit has a washer/dryer and an assigned parking space. There is plenty of shopping, restaurants, and local casinos nearby.

allReviews.title: A peaceful sojourn
allReviews.text: This resort met all of our needs.  The condo was decent.  The furniture was a bit dated and worn out, but no weird smells.   The condo was clean.  We booked a one bedroom, but we got a 2 bedroom when we arrived, no complaints there!  We went to the strip 3 or 4 times, we mostly spent times in parks.  We had a rental car, so we did not take the shuttle, although that would have saved money on downtown parking.  All in all, it was a good trip.  The pool and hot tub are very nice!

allReviews.title: Fantastic Base for trip to Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Stayed in 2 Bdrm. Amenities were excellent. Pool, hot tub and BBQ area were awesome. Cooked for self most nights. Front desk staff were REALLY Terrific and friendly.Notified me when packages arrived immediately.Great place

allReviews.title: Lovely pool area.
allReviews.text: Staff very attentive.  It is a nice quiet resort within driving distance to many attractions.  We had an issue with first room and they were quick to move us to another unit upon request.  Grocery stores and restaurants nearby.  Be sure to visit Red Rock Canyon National Conservation area.

allReviews.title: Love the quiet are and the beautiful ground of the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: I love the location of this resort. It's away from the noise and traffic of the strip, yet only about a 20 a 20-minute drive, if you want to go there.  The resort does offer shuttle service to the strip as well, as part of their $50 resort fee.The grounds are very well cared for and there is plenty of parking close to your unit.The only complaint I have are the interior furnishing of the rooms. They need to be updated and brought out of the 1980's. It would be nice if they offered a recliner as part of the furniture grouping.The beds are comfortable, and rooms are always well maintained. Staff is friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Great trip to Las Vegas and surrounding area
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is perfectly located for our visit to the Las Vegas strip as well as Red Rock Canyon and the Hoover Dam. Access to a wide variety of restaurants near the Cliffs at Peace Canyon were helpful. I would definitely return!

allReviews.title: great location
allReviews.text: Would definitely stay there again. Red Rock Canyon is a beautiful place to visit. We were there on business ,so did not get a chance to use amenities , but the pool area looked very nice. Hopefully will get back sometime to just have fun and enjoy the sites.

allReviews.title: Close to the strip
allReviews.text: I really like how close the resort is to the strip and all the attractions but not by the craziness. The units are very nice and very clean the property as well cap for the time it’s been around.  The size of the pole, for the resort is great.

allReviews.title: Great Condo
allReviews.text: The resort is located near Red Rock Canyon, a quiet and beautiful place close to amenities like restaurants and grocery stores and the staff is great.I highly recommend this resort

allReviews.title: Fine, not great
allReviews.text: The pool area was great. The unit itself was dated and dusty. Overall felt rundown and not well maintained. The location was good for all we wanted to do in the Vegas area. Would we stay there again? Not likely.

allReviews.title: Big but dated
allReviews.text: There were things in the unit that needed fixed or updated. I found the $50 resort fee a little bit cray considering it's an old apartment complex. It's ok if you need to be in Summerlin. There was no housekeeping service offered midweek. The pool towels were very threadbare. The bed was uncomfortable and the ice maker didn't work.

allReviews.title: My stay
allReviews.text: Would stay again shuttle doesn’t follow schedule they say strip but should say one location. They only drop at one location on strip not a prime location so you end up still taking an Uber lyft would stay again if I don’t want to go to the strip other than that nope

allReviews.title: A very pleasant stay
allReviews.text: We used to stay at the Desert Paradise Resort but we were unable to get booked since it’s been taken over by the Hilton so chose this as it’s a similar proposition. We had a nice stay, nice and quiet, pool and hot tub very nice and staff were pleasant. In a good location with shops and restaurants nearby. We had an issue with our safe and a leak under our sink which we reported upon arrival, but no one came to take a look. My husband went back about the safe a few days later and someone came out to sort it straight away. The leak under the sink however was not addressed. We cooked a lot in the unit and had most things we needed, a few more utensils might have been handy such as wooden spoons et cetera. I didn’t feel the unit was as clean as it could’ve been, however this didn’t detract from our stay. I also wasn’t aware you now have to pay for housekeeping, but on the other hand, it was also nice not to be disturbed. We had a hire car for our stay but did make use of the shuttlebus one evening which is very handy. We also made use of the outdoor barbecue which was very nice. Would definitely return.

allReviews.title: Total Relief
allReviews.text: I've been with RCI over 20 yrs and I never had a problem, great customer service. All of my friends and family that I let use my RCI, aways had great things to say. The value, the resorts, the location's and the people behind the scenes. I thank you in advance. Love aways a valued customer 😍

allReviews.title: Fairly Pleasant Stay
allReviews.text: This is the fourth time I have stayed at The Cliffs.   My unit was not as well kept us as in prior years, nor as well stocked with the basics such as laundry soap, etc.  The unit and some of the dishes appeared less than clean with sticky substances on the cupboards.  The "gym" was minimal with the one piece of weight bearing workout equipment dated and pretty useless.  On the positive side, the staff was pleasant and the grounds were well kept.

allReviews.title: Dirty rooms and unresponsive management
allReviews.text: We travel to Vegas annually sometimes twice a year. We arrived a little after 5pm the check in process was pretty easy. $50 resort fee and $150 deposit which is pretty normal. We went to our room located on the 1st floor and immediately upon opening the door the room smelled terrible like a strong chemical, cigarettes and dampness. We thought maybe we could open the doors to let the smell out while we checked the rest of the room. The guest bedroom had the biggest dip, hole in the middle of the bed at that point we decided this room isn’t going to work. The employees at the desk changed our room to 2057 which appeared ok had the same disgusting smell. The master bedroom had 2 blankets as a mattress cover hard as a rock uncomfortable and stained pillows. The guest bedroom bed was a little better. The bathtub was filthy, soap scum EVERYWHERE. We didn’t want to waste time moving again so we went to Walmart purchased cleaning supplies, bed pillows, linen and blankets. We only used the fridge for soda and water there was hair in there. We couldn’t even use one of the bedrooms The oven wasn’t clean the pans were nasty. We ate out for all meals for the 8 days and 7 nights we were there. We asked to have a manager contact us so that they can see the condition of the room and discuss with us why the room is like that. NO ONE ever called or came by. We stopped in the 3rd day and was told someone would call us.It’s important for those that plan to stay there to be prepared to possibly have to purchase linen, cleaner, pillows and more!

allReviews.title: Family reunion
allReviews.text: We were very pleased and happy had 4 units booked for family reunion. Very ,very pleased with staff and management. The place is very nice, clean and taken care of.  The Las Vegas strip is easy to get to. Shopping and restaurants nearby. Also have a shuttle you can book.  We will definitely return .Thanks to you all.M. Rasmussen

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was one of the nicest resorts that we have stayed at. It was clean and the grounds were very nicely maintained.  The pool, hot tub, and gym were all very nice. The free shuttle to the strip was a surprising bonus.  The resort is about 15 minutes from the strip which was perfect for what we were looking for.

allReviews.title: Pros and cons
allReviews.text: On the plus side, we were upgraded to a 2 bedroom which was nice considering we had a guest with us. Rooms are a good size. Warning, though, they are not very sound-proof. If you're on the first floor, it can sound like a herd of elephants are above you at times. Also, even though the rooms are smoke-free, people can smoke anywhere on the grounds, including the balconies; so, we did smell smoke a couple of times in the unit. The pool was nice but smallish for the number of units. The exercise room was decent; some of the equipment; though, seemed sub-par. Overall, the stay was decent but I wouldn't be likely to stay there again.

allReviews.title: We ❤️ the Cliffs
allReviews.text: We own 5 timeshares and have been to many that we go to with points and the Cliffs is one of our favorites. It is located off the Las Vegas strip far enough to be peaceful yet has shuttle service to stores and casinos

allReviews.title: Nice Accomodations, But...
allReviews.text: The rooms at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon were very nice and large.  However, there are no restaurants on site, and no activities either.  There is a free shuttle to the Las Vegas strip, but we had a rental car, so we didn't use it.  We put 330 miles on our rental car, also going to many locations off of the main strip.  We had a chance to choose the Grandview resort, and I wish we had, as there is a casino resort next door with reasonable restaurant options and prices.  I could have walked across the street to gamble, not an option at the Cliffs.  Don't get me wrong, if you want nice accommodations away from the hustle and bustle of the strip, don't mind using the hourly shuttle, and don't plan to go anywhere off the strip, I'm sure this will be fine for you.  Everything on the strip has gotten very expensive (no more free parking or cheap meals at the big casinos anymore), so the next time, I'll go to a resort with a smaller casino somewhere off of the strip.

allReviews.title: If you’re desperate, stay here
allReviews.text: Pros: Friendly staff, spacious units, quiet, full size washer/dryer Cons: Dated, over crowded with furniture, showers quite disgusting, units need deep cleaning (blinds are filthy, hair in bathrooms, fingerprints on furniture and appliances), units need general maintenance (broken blinds, bedroom TV would not work)

allReviews.title: The ceiling
allReviews.text: Fantastic place to breathe and enjoy the peacefulness of the cliff. The cliff offers an ideal place for freedom  from the Las Vegas strip. It is farther enough away to enjoy the solitude and refreshment of the canyons. However, it is close enough for you to enjoy the nightlife, daylight, and total refreshment Vegas and all of Vegas events offers.

allReviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
allReviews.text: Parking is shaded which is soo important for Las Vegas weather. Small pool area but perfect for my family. Easy access from my unit regardless of where the location is. The location is away from the strip but closer to shops that I am interested in Staffs are all pleasant and easy to work with whenever we have request.

allReviews.title: Great location! Great stay!
allReviews.text: We were in Vegas for a conference that wasn’t located on the strip. This location was fantastic, close to amenities and only a short drive away from the hustle and bustle. It wasn’t a fancy place but hit all the marks to make for a great working vacation.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed the time we spent there, very clean and quiet. Resort is close to everything you need and only 20 minutes away from the strip. We highly recommend this location. Staff was friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Good pool and hot tub.  BBQ grills worked great.  Usually pretty quiet. Good location for shopping in Summerlin and access to Red Rock Canyon for hiking. There is a shuttle that will take you to a grocery store and the strip.

allReviews.title: Anniversary Weekend Stay
allReviews.text: Everything was very nice and peaceful. The staff was amazing.. Room was very spacious. Especially the closet space. It's off the strip which gives a more peaceful at home vibe. We will definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay.
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Front desk was very nice and helpful with making plans for our day. The bus drivers  were the best. they took you to the strip and picked u back up on time. The pool and hot tub were nice.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great place. Pool and hot tub area really nice. With it being off season the resort did not have a lot of guests which was nice. Staff friendly and helpful. Resort is clean. Shuttle to strip is very much appreciated.

allReviews.title: Stayed for 7 days and loved it!
allReviews.text: Great location, spacious units with good furniture and appliances. Friendly/helpful staff on all shifts. The only thing I would suggest is cleaning the pool/unit floors more often. Loved it and would return.

allReviews.title: Repeat Visitor
allReviews.text: Love the the Cliffs! My GoTo rental in Vegas! Love that they have the shuttle and you don’t necessarily need a car to explore. It’s away from the strip, but a beautiful place away from constant noise when you want to relax!

allReviews.title: Great time At the Cliffs of Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The provided Unit was well maintained. Everything was in great shape.Yes it was Hot in Vegas July 15th. but that was expected.Great Experience. I Suggest you have your own mode of transportation (car)near the 215 highway.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: The staff was super friendly, the location was great, and we really enjoyed our stay. Loved the water fall devices in the pool. Each morning the staff made sure the pool area was cleaned up and ready for the day.

allReviews.title: Family Vacation R&R
allReviews.text: We used our free week with the exchange fee to stay at the Cliffs and were not disappointed. Having stayed at timeshares before there are often quality issues based on construction materials chosen for the units. This timeshare felt like there were sound proof walls and double-pain glass installed. Our unit was overlooking the pool and despite the extended hours (closes at midnight vs. typical 10pm) we were not bothered by the people in the pool. The only improvement opportunity is the beds seem to have an excessive amount of noise on the matrices, think haunted house sounds, and the couch material felt like sand paper.

allReviews.title: AAA EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: We had an excellent stay at this resort and the staff was extra knowledgeable and friendly. we were not in the hustle and bustle of the strip, and we also enjoyed a nearby resort and casino that I would also recommend named South Point, we loved the bingo there, I am a bingo enthusiast.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: My review is not as good as it used to be at this resort.  The management has changed.  We stayed for a week and requested to have our room cleaned on Friday.  We arrived on a Tuesday.  Normally that isn't a problem, having someone come clean at least one dime during our stay. Went to the front desk to make the request, the person there appeared to be putting it in the computer and said ok.  On that day we left early and came back late, nothing had been done, dirty towels were on the floor, bed not changed.  Went to the front desk the next day and they said, there was nothing in the computer AND that they didn't have anyone there on that day to clean normally.. Another change was to take everything dirty (towels and sheets) and place them in the bathtub when we leave.  We've never taking sheets off the bed.  Also requested that we throw away all trash.  I mean we could do those things but nothing else seemed to be done either......like vacuuming.  I just sprayed everything with lysol.

allReviews.title: Another good week at The Cliffs
allReviews.text: We've stayed here several times and appreciate the size and location of this resort.  It has everything a family needs.  The staff is available and friendly.  The shuttle took us to the Strip so we didn't have to deal with the difficult and expensive parking there.  We will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Just not that great
allReviews.text: We like having free parking and not paying a daily resort fee at most Vegas hotels; and we like to preparing light meals and snacks in the full kitchen.But, the cable service went out for about 24 hours, and the staff didn't seem too excited about it, and when asked, they didn't say any version of "I'm sorry, we're working on it," but rather, "There's nothing we can do about it." The pool went "down"--closed because of chemical imbalance? Caused by failing parts of the pumps or filters? We never knew the cause. We requested late check out past their 10:00 a.m. regular time. We were given one hour, otherwise there would be "a charge." The air conditioning unit was noisy, but, hey, it worked, and with temps over 100 every day.When the pool was open, it was full of kids--not much room for adults; and the pool is small for the number of units in the complex.Just had the feeling, like some other reviewers, that this place is way past its prime and the staff just doesn't have the attitude you'd want at a hotel or resort.

allReviews.title: Good location
allReviews.text: My go-to resort. Quiet and peaceful. Buildings are on the older side and shows their age.  We reported a leak from upstairs bathroom. Quick response from maintenance. They offered that we move to a different unit instead of moving the guests upstairs.  We decided against moving.  The upstairs guests of course used the bathroom throughout their stay and the leak continued to drip in the walls.  Maintenance came back on my check out day.

allReviews.title: Great Stay; Peace Canyon was Peaceful
allReviews.text: We stayed in a large 2 bedroom/2 bathroom unit.  Very quiet location in Building S, Room 1073.  Full kitchen we used, especially for breakfast, and I used the washer/dryer.  Shuttle bus was a great benefit including rides to/from the Strip on a published schedule.  We were able to reserve 1 hour in advance instead of 1 day in advance.  Shuttle drivers Rocky, Steve and other man were very good and accommodating.  Would have been great to have 2 beds in 1 bedroom, but I used the sofa bed in the living room that was acceptable, since my son used 1 bedroom and my brother used the other bedroom.  Quick and efficient check-in and check-out.  Would have preferred to be closer to the Strip, but we made it work with Shuttle and Lyft or Uber.

allReviews.title: Desert oasis gem that is a must stay
allReviews.text: We are Hilton Grand Vacation Club owners and we highly recommend staying at this property if you are looking for something off the Vegas Strip and near the Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area.  You can hitch a ride on the complimentary shuttle to the Vegas Strip, Fremont Street or even the grocery store. You can plan hikes and check out the rock formations. The best of both worlds. My family had a great time and look forward to coming back.

allReviews.title: Family time
allReviews.text: I like coming to this resort because of the location being really close to Summerlin area.the resort is very clean and has a good vibe.The rooms feel very cozy relaxing, the pool time at night is one of my favorites things to do .

allReviews.title: Nice and Relaxing
allReviews.text: Very nice resort in a great location.  Plenty of chairs and tables in the pool area.  Covered parking was nice. Quiet and inviting. Great access to restaurants, the strip, shopping and other areas of interest in and around the Las Vegas area. We will stay there again.

allReviews.title: Repeat visitor
allReviews.text: We are timeshare owners in Florida.  Every three years, we have a work convention and rather than staying in a stuffy one room hotel room on the strip with everyone else, we exchange for Cliffs.  Plus we like the resort so much, we have exchanged for an actual vacation here.  We have been coming here for over 10 years and are so happy to be "home" every time.  The resort is always well maintained.  The units are very nice, big kitchen (gas stoves for those that care!), washer and dryer in unit.  Wonderful patio or balcony.  Try to get a unit that overlooks the pool/grills/fireplace.  Someone is at the desk 24/7 and there is a security person on site at night.  Highly recommend any time of the year.  For those that are interested, there is a shuttle to the strip.

allReviews.title: Positive experience with some room for improvement.
allReviews.text: Our family enjoyed the Cliffs at Peace Canyon. The size of the 2 bedroom unit was very nice and comfortable for the family of four. There was nothing lacking in the unit. The resort itself is a bit outdated but well maintained. The pool is quite average and it looks better in the pictures.The front desk staff is trying to be helpful; however, there is definitely room for improvement. The shuttle service to the strip is very convenient but not always reliable as they seem to be short on drivers (no airport service). The shuttle drivers were great though, knowledgeable, friendly and very accommodating.Overall, it was a pleasant stay and we would consider going back.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: The condo was very nice and had everything that we needed for our stay. The location was very centrally located and we were able to get around quickly.  The staff was very courteous and knowledgeable. I really enjoyed staying here.

allReviews.title: 4 Day get away
allReviews.text: My first time here, wanted To be away from strip in quiet safe location, it was all that, pool was a bit over run with kids splashing about, furnished nicely, had a signed parking and close to Red Rock casino and Rampart, overall was pleased with stay.

allReviews.title: Perfect location
allReviews.text: Lovely, quiet resort just minutes from "The Strip" and more importantly to us-just minutes from Red Rock Park and about 45 minutes from Valley of Fire, both of which were incredible.Stayed here to attend a conference at the Mirage and it was perfect.

allReviews.title: Staying at the Cliffs
allReviews.text: what I like about staying at the Cliffs is that it is a quiet resort, Family friendly and perfect if you just want to get away from the crowd. The one bedroom apartment was comfortable with a nice balcony on which to eat a meal, a full kitchen, comfortable living room. The resort has a nice. pool,  jacuzzi, and a small fitness center. I enjoyed myself

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great place to stay if your into a depressing 70's retro unit.1st attempt at check-in 98F drag luggage to unit, unit under renovation, told to return after 4Pm. 2nd attempt staff generally disengaged like 1st attempt was our fault. Did not take luggage this time opened door overwhelmed by a musky smell, mold on wall. stains in corners of mattress we leave, check out they keep amenities fee staff is indifferent. So, after 3.5hrs with this 6pm in Vegas had to find new accommodations. Found La Quinta on west Saraha, last room available. Very clean, great room, and great staff. Immediately booked our room on back side of our trip as we were headed to Cailfornia.

allReviews.title: Housekeeper enjoyed our patio.
allReviews.text: Stay was going well until our weekly cleaning was scheduled.  We waited in the pool clubhouse area while our unit was being cleaned.  After returning four times in more than 3 hours, we finally entered the unit to figure out why it was taking so long for an abbreviated cleaning.  We found the housekeeper sitting on the patio eating her lunch and on her phone.  She had the audacity to tell us she wasn't done cleaning the unit with her mouth full of food still.  She preceded to move the chairs on the patio as if cleaning.  However, all her cleaning supplies and tools were inside the unit.  We grabbed our car keys and left for lunch ourselves.  When we returned, she was thankfully gone.  Disappointing!

allReviews.title: Great quiet and relaxing location!
allReviews.text: I had a great family vacation here.  Very convenient to see all nearby attractions! I would definitely choose the cliffs at peace canyon again! My favorite things we did was the grand canyon west and the hover can!

allReviews.title: Great resort
allReviews.text: Very nice, quiet, and clean resort with a friendly staff.  The location is quite awayfrom the Strip and Downtown hotels, which could be a plus or minus. For our purpose it was a great location to the parks that we had to play softball at. A plus for us.

allReviews.title: Very comfortable and quiet resort
allReviews.text: We tried to contact the resort prior to check-in due to my husband's disability. RCi also was unable to contact the resort. An email was sent with our concerns to the resort. No response to me or rci. However getting to the resort 2 hours before check-in revealed they got the email and upgraded us to a two bedroom downstairs.  We will stay hete again. Nice neighborhood away from the strip

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: The staff at "The Cliffs" were very friendly and helpful.  We used the shuttle to and from the strip on several occasions.  It was very convenient and the driver was great.  The condo is in the middle of a residential area which is different from other sites where we have stayed.  The grounds and common areas were well maintained and the pool was nice.

allReviews.title: Spacious suites, fun spot off the strip!
allReviews.text: We loved our stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon. We only stayed there because we needed to be out of our house for a few days, but this is a hidden gem where we will likely stay again! The unit was huge--two bedrooms on opposite sides of the unit which was great for separation from the kids. Large kitchen with full fridge saved us $$ on food. Pool and hot tub were great. The shuttle to/from the strip is an awesome amenity, although we didn't use it. Highly recommend this place for people visiting Vegas who want to see more than the strip.

allReviews.title: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is wonderful!
allReviews.text: The front desk staff was all friendly and helpful and efficient. The entire resort was very clean. The pool and spa area were especially clean and inviting. The unit size was amazing. Fully stocked kitchen with all appliances, full fridge, oven, stove, microwave, pots, pans, dishware, silverware, ice maker, disposal, etc. A nice hairdryer was in each bathroom. TVs in each bedroom and living room. Separate entry for each unit. Parking was great and free/included. WIFI is included in the reasonable resort fee. The gym was nice and clean. The resort is close to lots of shopping and restaurants. Shuttle service is available. GREAT resort. I have been before and will come again to The Cliffs at Peace Canyon, LV.

allReviews.title: Nice Place
allReviews.text: Nice place, have stayed here before. Smaller which is nice. Staff are great. Some of the condos need to be upgraded. We like to hike so close to red rock. You can walk to some shopping and restaurants and bars. You need a car but they do have a shuttle to some attractions. Overall, we will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Perfect for our needs
allReviews.text: Rent a car so you can experience all the area has to offer!  The outdoor sights are stunning.  The colour of the rocks against a clear blue sky are memorable.  Also, check out a Vegas show - spectacular!

allReviews.title: Great quiet resort
allReviews.text: Great location, quiet resort. Away from the strip yet close enough to enjoy a few visits to Casinos and attend shows. Also, near enough to drive to a few beautiful and historical sight: Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, Hoover Dam, Nelson Ghost Mining Town.

allReviews.title: spacious with private patio
allReviews.text: Resort was clean, good location to red rock and 215. Spacious rooms .pool and hot tub were great. They want 200 characters. Check out desert national refuge and Mt Charleston as well as Henderson birding preserve

allReviews.title: Awesome quiet resort.
allReviews.text: We have been RCI members for 39 years and this is one of the best properties we have stayed at.  All employees are great.  Special thanks to Dunia, front desk supervisor, and the resort shuttle drivers, Steve, Rocky and Victor for all you do.  We plan to book another stay soon!

allReviews.title: Quiet area, outdated hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel is in a quiet area about 20 minutes from the strip. The area appears safe and clean. The hotel itself needs to be renovated badly. I would be hard pressed to consider this even a 2 or 3 star hotel. Everything was old and breaking down. Appliances needed replacing, doors and windows needed to be replaced, cabinets were falling off and varnish had been gauged off, the patio appeared to not have been swept ever, paint could use refreshing, kitchen appliances/utensils looked like they were from goodwill. I would never stay again.

allReviews.title: the Good, and the Not so good
allReviews.text: The Good:        An EXCELLENT location outside of Vegas (the Strip is 24 min), near the Red Rock Canyon(20 min) - quiet & secure yet a few blocks from restaurants, shopping & easy access to highways to Grand Canyon(2.2 hrs), Valley of Fire(1 hr), Zion National Park(3 hrs). Staff was awesome, friendly & polite, room was like a 1000 s/f house - 2 bed 2 bath, full kitchen, w/d - clean! comfy beds - quiet privately positioned. Easy access to rental car (Enterprise from Fort Apache road will pick up and drop off)...      …and we hit a perfect week of weather: sunny, low 80’s, no rain..NOT so Good:        Expectations for this, our first "resort", weren't fully met because amenities were minimal in my view [room, pool, barbque grills avail...that's it; no bar, no food]. Then again, Vegas is quite close. But there is a free shuttle with Rocky/Steve, super friendly drivers; shuttle runs from the property to Vegas Strip (only to the Mirage Casino and NOT to/from the airport); although free, it does NOT run on continuous loop, and each trip and return trip must be "booked" 24 hours ahead with the front desk for each use, so reducing flexibility; also we’d called before the trip and were advised to get to the strip, then call for shuttle; but at our Vegas arrival the shuttle return from the Strip  was only available for pick up 5 hours later; that required an Uber to get to the Cliffs property. Shuttle DOES stop for local shopping center and once a day to Red Rock Casino, nearby.       The suite/rooms were made up on arrival, but I expected the staff to freshen it up occasionally- they don't; and you're required to run the dishwasher and to carry out the garbage to a dumpster (or get up charged).  Then small items add up: Only one (1) coffee filter with 1 coffee; the hot water flowed very slowly in kitchen although good in bathrooms; no soap, shampoo in bathrooms; furniture is kinda vintage (older style and a bit worn) so whole room could use an upgrade. Most guests were not visible and thus we assumed all go out daily. Overall, we enjoyed the trip and the stay overall…thus: Conclusions:         I believe this is top-rated “Gold Crown” by RCI/Trip Advisor, but see my above comments for reality; this was my first stay at a “resort”; makes me wonder what the rating criteria are. I rate it above average (just average for amenities, above average for room size, location, and for service friendliness.

allReviews.title: one of the best places we have ever stayed at - we will be back
allReviews.text: From the get-go - it was an EXCELLENT location outside of Vegas, near the Red Rock Canyon - quiet & secure yet a few blocks from restaurants & shopping and highwyas to just go (Grand Canyon, Valley of Fire, Fossil Canyon, Death Valley). Staff was awesome, friendly & polite, let us check in early & our room was like a 1000 s/f house - 2 bed 2 bath, full kitchen, w/d - clean! comfy beds - quiet privately positioned. Great clean pool area w/ bbqs~ gym even. Shuttles to Fremont, Strip, Red Rock (or the grocery store) on the hour (we got a rental car & we'd never been there before so we spent most time out driving to Canyons) but next time we will take advantage of the shuttle (great driver/"Rocky" was also super kind & friendly, just met him walking around getting a feel of the place). All in all - one of the best places we have ever stayed at and no pressure sales stuff/no Las Vegas weirdness. Clean. Comfortable. Kind. Non-pretentious. Welcoming. 5 stars.

allReviews.title: Off the strip resort
allReviews.text: A nice, quiet, and clean resort that is close to amenities! We enjoyed our stay, took advantage of the free shuttles to the strip and Fremont street. We appreciated free parking and we were close to drive to myst see attractions like red rock canyon and the Hoover dam.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Nice roomy unit for two couples.  It was updated with nice furniture and bedding.  It was just far enough away from the Vegas strip to have some quiet time at night.  We went because we like hiking and all that Nevada offers in trails and natural beauty.

allReviews.title: A must see and stay
allReviews.text: The Cliffs is a quiet, friendly, and easy access resort. I highly recommend you trying this resort. The shuttle service is five star! I’ve stayed at three other timeshare resorts in Vegas and this one is by far the best place to stay, if you are looking to access Red Rock Canyon or Valley of Fire. Easy access to rental car (Enterprise on Fort Apache road) and to 215 highway.  We will come here again!

allReviews.title: Not a Gold Crown
allReviews.text: Staff was great, grounds where nice. It is off the strip and close to Red Rock Canyoon which was a plus for us.  Unit was in terrible need of updating. Had to clean everything upon arrival including fingerprints and sticky spot on kitchen floor.  Not a Gold Crown in my book.

allReviews.title: Peaceful, Quite, Friendly place you want to be at.
allReviews.text: Peaceful, Quite, Friendly place you want to be at. It is  away from  the main hustle and bustle of Las Vegas (15-20 min by bus), shopping centers within a few blocks, dedicated free bus to Las Vegas main strip and red rock casino.

allReviews.title: Family friendly, superb location, comfortable accommodation, gym could use an upgrade !
allReviews.text: Location: 20 minute drive to the strip. Everything you need is within a 5 minute driving distance: restaurants, coffee shops, groceries, drug stores, Walmart , target etcThe 2 bed room apartment was very comfortable - appreciate the super warm showers !!!Heated pool was great, spa was super hot and much appreciated especially with below seasonal temperatures!Gym needs to be upgraded - need dumbells and yoga mats please !!!

allReviews.title: great place for the more introverted
allReviews.text: Loved this place! Quiet location off the strip, right near a major route that takes you out of the city with ease. We rented a car and went for hikes in red rock canyon, saw the Hoover dam and Grand Canyon. The resort Shuttle to and from the strip is efficient and frequent. Drivers Rocky and Steve are awesome! The strip is an obvious must-see, but we preferred Red Rock casino for a more classy, less crazy experience. Thank you cliffs! You’ll be our choice when we return!

allReviews.title: Great Condo with even Better Pool Area!
allReviews.text: We’ve stayed here before and really liked it. Large condo, very clean. Easy checkin/checkout. Really quick and easy to get to the Strip. They even run a free shuttle to the strip and Freemont street. Last time we were here the pool and hot tub was closed for renovation. But the wait was worth it!  Super nice pool with waterfalls and large hot tub, nice weight room and grill area. They even had an outdoor Fireplace with Androck chairs!

allReviews.title: Quiet, off the strip location that needs a refresh.
allReviews.text: This place is off the strip and very quite. Suites are a good size parking is great the staff are grate but the place is very tired looking. Everything works but it’s in much need of a fresh coat of paint, a deep clean and some modernization. The ratings are quite good on this location but we have stayed in many timeshare location in Las Vegas and this one is tired. We would stay here again but it would not be our first choice. I have to ask where have the “maintenance fees” been spent? If you want a super quiet place off the strip then this may be the place for you. It looks like an apartment complex that has been converted to a time share. The pool area is very nice and well protected from any wind. So in closing there is nothing wrong with this place it’s just old and needs a good clean.

allReviews.title: Family time
allReviews.text: Our weeks stay was amazing very close to the STRIP. Great amenities and excellent customer service. Overall it was a great week had time for fun and relaxation. Our teenagers enjoyed the pool and the gym.

allReviews.title: A Good place to stay in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: The resort is clean, well maintained, and the staff are friendly and helpful. The location is out side of the city in a quiet neighorhood, but may access many stores closed by. However, if you do not have your own car, the shult service provided by the resort is not as good as one may expect.

allReviews.title: Quiet location in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The neighborhood is out of the downtown area and much quieter. It is a better location for visiting family and friends if you are not spending time on the strip. The pool was heated so even though we are swimming in March in 60 degree weather, we spent more than an hour in the regular pool with the children.

allReviews.title: Convenient location
allReviews.text: The unit size was good.  Could have had more things in kitchen for food prep like a simple cookie sheet or pizza tray. Salad tongues .  Our view was not good. Looked out to another unit.  Granddaughters did enjoy the pool and hot tub.

allReviews.title: Good resort but needs a few fixes.
allReviews.text: We like the location of this resort in Summerlin and overall it is quite good.  Housekeeping and maintenance needs to keep up with some of the smaller details, like checking inventory (missing wine opener, for instance), and multiple holes in the wall above the MBR headboard where something was removed.  There is a noticeable smell when you enter the unit and there is a slight smell of gas that needs to be checked.  Smoking is allowed on the patio, which is more friendly than many other timeshares.  Bed was worn and should be replaced sooner than later.  The toilets were too small and too low, as if designed for children, rather than adults; the seats were the wrong size for the bowls (too small).  There was a DVD player in the living room but not the bedroom, so we bought one to use.  The heater runs for hours in order to raise the temp only a few degrees, so it is in need of service perhaps.  Only one of the two treadmills was working when we arrived, but they did get one fixed in a couple of days.  We actually liked the resort in spite of these flaws and would give them another visit.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable family stay!
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon. It was close to everything in terms of stores and eateries, our 2 and 9 year old loved the heated pool, and we loved it and the hot tub! We used the shuttle to the Strip, and thought it was easy and really convenient. We rented a car and felt like it was a reasonable drive to Valley of Fire State Park and Hoover Dam. The dishwasher stopped working while we were there, and the front desk had someone come right away and fix it in just a matter of hours. The staff were courteous and helpful when we needed anything.

allReviews.title: Vegas BABY
allReviews.text: A quiet get a way, far enough a way from the the city but close enough to access all entertainment activities to be enjoyed.  Excellent staff, clean rooms and property.  Highly recommended for both family and business trips to the area

allReviews.title: One of our favorite places to stay
allReviews.text: Last room we booked was extremely worn out. Cabinets worn, dishwasher lower panel was on the floor unattached. Place needs a refresh to be back to what we've enjoyed. This is our 8th stay here. Great office staff. Quiet place to stay off the strip.

allReviews.title: Excellent resort, staff and facilities!
allReviews.text: I can't say enough about the place. The staff were friendly and efficient. The rooms were clean, well decorated and fresh. The resort is impeccably maintained including rock solid internet. The shuttle is handy to get to wherever you want, so renting a car is not really necessary unless you are doing out of town sightseeing.We will definitely stay here again the next time in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Resort and fabulous staff
allReviews.text: My spouse and I stayed there for a week I know it wasn’t their busy season, weather wasn’t the best ( that’s mother nature’s gift)But everything else was the best you could ask for. The pool was heated, comfortable while the weather was much cooler Hot tub was the very best. Room was excellent, clean, spacious and well equipped. We enjoy cooking most of our meals so this was great. Bbq grills were like new and area was super clean  Shuttle bus was fantastic and staff were amazing

allReviews.title: Good place to stay away from the strip while in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Our room was clean, and upkept, the bed in unit 1072 needs upgrading, but you can sleep unless you're just bougie and never been camping. The surrounding area is modern and nice with plenty of eating places.  The freeway is close, also nearby is the Red Rock casino if you don't want to head 20 mins to the strip.

allReviews.title: nice condo off the strip
allReviews.text: Nice quiet place with shuttle service to grocery store and strip..   enjoyed the condo without having any pressure to buy!!   Without the shuttle service I would t stay as would be expensive to Lyft all the time.

allReviews.title: Nice and Quiet location
allReviews.text: As always the Frontend Stall were Pleasant and friendly.  They tried to answer my questions the best they could. This was my 7th time coming out to Las Vegas in the last10 years and after confusion and $244 later( RCI messed up reservation and cost me) we were assigned our room  The next day is when it went south, for a little, after going to store we returned home to make Breakfast.  This is when I found out we had no working Electrical outlets along the Kitchen counter and at cleanup time is when found out that the Dishwasher wasn't secured to the counter and thought it would come out of opening. Plus a few much needed utensils missing and finally the Bathroom Faucet was quite loose.

allReviews.title: Quiet Location
allReviews.text: Stayed a week Nov 2022, very friendly staff, arrived early and was able to check-in late morning! 2BR (split plan), huge living/dining area, patio (2nd floor, walk up), 2 large baths, large well equipped kitchen, full size washer/dryer. I asked and got a unit facing the pool as it's on the inner court and as I suspected no traffic noise. The fitness center has a weight machine and cardio equipment, but no free weights or dumbbells. The unit is well suited for long stays.

allReviews.title: Switch and Bait
allReviews.text: This was not a resort - it was more like a low rent apartment complex  or storage unit converted into rooms - I stared at night at the ceiling wondering why the ceiling had only been painted around the bed and not over it - There were no grounds outside the pool area.  With the now escalating fees _ I wonder WHY?  My trip was in October of 2019 - still feel cheated. No cleaning service was available.

allReviews.title: nothing fancy; good location for off-strip activities
allReviews.text: very basic resort that was mostly empty during our Thanksgiving week stay2BR was roomy and adequatekitchen had the most basic supplies but not much else and were cheap qualityquiet, off-strip location suite our needs

allReviews.title: Will be happy to return in the future.
allReviews.text: Very nice resort with good facilities and accommodations.  Located in Summerlin, which is a beautiful community adjacent to Las Vegas, hosting numerous high quality restaurants.  Easy access to the whole area with good highway and surface street flow.  This allowed us to enjoy our vacation without getting bogged down in the heavy strip traffic.  We look forward to returning in the future.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Vacation
allReviews.text: We had an absolute fantastic time at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon. It is a very short drive to the Strip. We loved the peace and tranquility of this location.  Not much traffic in this area, security was a high priority, felt safe the entire time. The pool and hot tub were a great finish to each day. If we were coming back to this area we'd definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Great Resort - Poor Internet
allReviews.text: We wanted to stay away from the noise of The Strip and The Cliffs at Peace Canyon seemed to fit the bill.  They did not disappoint. We loved our stay there with the exception of the poor internet service.  As we were trying to work remotely this was a greater concern for us than it may be for some.  The provided internet did not require a password (less secure), was slow, and spotty at times.No other complaints about the resort. We would definitely stay there again as our mobile hotspot worked. Comfortable beds and quiet area resulted in a great night's sleep. SHUTTLE: The shuttle worked well. Plan on about 25-30 minutes each way to and from The Strip. Pleasant and efficient drivers. Just make sure to schedule in advance as directed as it doesn't run if no one is scheduled to ride. Shuttle drops off and picks up at the Mirage. They leave the resort at the top of the hour and leave The Strip on the half hour. Can also make arrangements to be dropped off and picked up from a grocery store that is close to the resort. (Smith's on Flamingo) Less frequent runs to the Red Rocks Casino are also available.KITCHEN: Kitchen was stocked with basic cooking gear and well-stocked with plates, cups, and utensils. All appliances worked well. Full-size washer and dryer available in our 2-bedroom unit.GREAT RESTAURANT: We thoroughly enjoyed Giovanni's Pizzaria and Mediterranean Grill. It's about a 2-minute drive from the resort.  They also deliver. We loved their pizza, calzone, and lamb kabob with pita plate. Truly exceptional food.ACTIVITIES: Red Rocks National Park is a less than 20-minute drive from the resort. We went hiking there or in the surrounding area several nights after work and especially enjoyed the Calico Tanks hike in the park and First Canyon hike outside it. We also enjoyed driving to Mt. Charleston and were surprised by the beautiful fall color of the golden aspens amid the tall pines  on this mountain drive.  Such as change from the surrounding desert! About a 40 min drive (one-way) from the resort.Our unit was good sized and very comfortable. We loved our stay with the exception of the internet and look forward to returning. Highly recommend -- and hope they improve their internet service between now and then! :)

allReviews.title: Using credits
allReviews.text: Very quite resort off the beaten path. Easy to reach from freeways but still close enough to the strip. Pool was a bit on the cold side but the spa was very relaxing. They offer a shuttle service which is nice if you don’t have transportation

allReviews.title: Excellent place to vacation
allReviews.text: Staff was always available and helpful. Units were spacious and clean and fully stocked. Nice size outdoor pool, warm spa and sufficient exercise room.BBQ grills were clean and well maintained.Shuttle to Fremont, strip and mall was a huge plus!

allReviews.title: All the convenience of home and a world away from the Strip.
allReviews.text: Location was perfect for us. Far from strip, quiet and serene, located in a residential neighborhood. It’s basically an apartment complex with full kitchen, 2 bedrooms and 2 baths. Pool was peaceful and never crowded. My major complaint is that the unit above us had a leak and the ceiling started dripping. Maintenance came in less than 15 min, shut off the water upstairs and reassured us we didn’t need to move and they would fix it after we checked out a week later. Surprise! All day today- banging and grinding upstairs. Why not knock on my door? Warn me? Ask us to move? Or, as promised, wait til we leave (complex was maybe 1/10 full so it’s not like they needed the unit). My call to front desk was met with “they never tell us where they are working”. Not good. We loved the place until today.They have a convenient shuttle, and will even take you to the grocery store (the full kitchen and laundry in-unit are so nice). We didn’t take the shuttle- but I suppose you could get away without a car- except for the long cab ride to/from airport. We drove to Red Rock Canyon so needed a car. The location (near Summerlin) is very nice.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs
allReviews.text: Excellent resort.  Clean, well kept.  Had a large kitchen, living room, & dining area.  Large master bedroom.  Pool area was very nice, with several bbq grills available.  Staff was super friendly.  Was out away from the Strip.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Shuttle service to/from the resort and the Las Vegas strip, Freemont street, outlet, and supermarket is super convenient. Friendly service. Front desk is very professional and efficient. Grounds are well kept and pool/jacuzzi is clean and inviting. Gym is well maintained and equipment is new.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas adventure 2022
allReviews.text: Excellent location for visiting all areas of Las Vegas and day trips.  Secure location and very quiet.  Have shuttle bus to and from downtown regularly daily.  Beds were very comfortable although linens could have been better quality, a little scratchy, but we made it through just fine.

allReviews.title: Great place in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We came out to visit family in the North Las Vegas area and this resort was close to everyone. The room was nice and large and clean. We went to the pool and there were plenty of seating available. Very quiet at night.  Not too many people at the resort this time of year which was quiet and felt like we had the place to ourselves.

allReviews.title: Not RCI quality resort
allReviews.text: Very disappointed. Upon arrival the unit was not thoroughly cleaned, Hair and rubbish on the floors, refrigerator had liquid and food spills, kitchen cabinet handles have what appears like dried food, smudges and finger prints on the dining table and large mirror, used fake nails (at least 6) in the night stand drawers in the master bedroom, and hairs in the tub. We notified the front desk numerous times and was promised they will send someone to clean, but never did.I was embarrassed to take my family of 10 at this disgusting resort. We stayed only 4 of the 7 nights… and it’s too long.

allReviews.title: The worst place ever!
allReviews.text: Bugs in our unit, inoperable appliances, noisy AC without proper airflow. Worst resort I’ve ever been to. How can this be Gold Crown? Asked a staff member for information & was told “that’s a Google question”!! Stay elsewhere!!

allReviews.title: Great staff and location
allReviews.text: The rooms were clean except the bathroom.THE BATHROOM COULD HAVE BEEN CLEANED BETTER. ESPECIALLY THE TOILET. The furniture is outdated. The staff was friendly and accommodating.  I had left some clothing in dryer. I called to see if I they could retrieve items. Clerk said she would call  me back. She called me back to say she found items and I could pick up anytime.The manager on duty even came out to greet me. He gave me his crd and told me to call before my next visit if I have any special needs.. I thanked him for his srvices.They solved all my problems without hesitation or complaint, The shuttle bus drivers were very helpful with places to go and see. It is convenient to the strip, shops and restaurants. Everyone who worked there was very  pleasant and helpful. I have not one negative comment about front desk staff.This is my 3rd visit here and I will visit again.

allReviews.title: Amazing time at the Cliffs!
allReviews.text: Rooms, beds were clean and comfortable.  Pool was amazing, staff was quick to accommodate  our needs and questions!  Shopping, restaurants and Red Rock Casino was nearby!  The Cliffs provided shuttle to the casinos and shopping too!  Looking forward to our next stay!

allReviews.title: Bad Management
allReviews.text: Children are running the place Keanna their has very little training no customer service skills she hung up on me when I corrected her for not having respect toward those that check in we requested linen because of a wk. Stay it took her 2 hrs. HRS. Before we received  them, the unit needed sweeping when we moved in so we did it. The washer when used sounded like it was falling apart, the shower tub when you stepped into it it bubbled  under not safe I called them maintenance came and said it was fine. That they would fix it after we checked out. As owners were  is our maintenance fees going. People in the pool til 12:00 midnight pool always dirty. Never seen anyone cleaning it during our week stay. Where is the management interest and dedication  to THE CLIFFS AT PEACE CANYON!

allReviews.title: Excellent stay!
allReviews.text: I stayed a week and have -0- complaints.  The property is very well maintained, everywhere.  The pool and spa were clean and very nice.  My condo was clean and well furnished, the beds were comfortable.   The surrounding area is nice with a lot of restaurant options.  I will definately be back!

allReviews.title: My review
allReviews.text: Bed bugs in master bedroom. There were bed bugs in the master bedroom. In the master bedroom of the two bedroom suite, there were bed bugs. My wife was bitten 6 times. It was most unpleasant. Also the DVD player didn't function. The RCA cables were bent and looked broken.

allReviews.title: Great place to relax in the outskirts of Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Beautiful property that is still close to everything you need but not in the middle of the concrete jungle of the strip! Very quiet neighborhood, close to great shopping and the casinos are not too far away if that's where you're headed. Size is amazing and everything works well. Staff is extremely friendly and the property has everything. Pool table, gym equipment, BBQ's, an amazing pool with waterfalls, parking is under shade and close to your unit!

allReviews.title: Great Condo and perfect location
allReviews.text: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is in a perfect location.  Close to hiking, shopping and lots of restaurants.  Full laundry room in each unit and updated rooms.  Pool and hot tub are perfect for the size of the condos.

allReviews.title: Units need updating
allReviews.text: Nice safe area. The property is clean and we were lucky enough to have a covered parking spot. The units do need some updating though. Our counter tops were starting to peel, the cabinets are old and scratched up. For a family of 5 though we had plenty of room and it was comfortable. I would call and ask about a pet policy if you have a dog. The blind on the door to the patio had been obviously chewed by a dog. We would have brought our dog along had we known pets were allowed.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs
allReviews.text: Resort was quiet and near Red Rock Canyon and a 15 minute drive to the strip. The unit was clean and  with 2 bedroom and 2 baths worked great for us. The pool was nice but crowded at times. They offer a free shuttle to and from the strip which we didn't use but it is definitely a nice convenience to have. Location was also a few blocks from Target, Smiths, Chick Fil A, Dutch Bros Coffee as well as In and Out Burger so it made those all a quick trip. Would definitely return.

allReviews.title: UNCOMFORTABLE BEDS!
allReviews.text: The beds in both rooms were very uncomfortable. They made loud crunching noises when one tried to adjust to a different position. They were very hard and were killing our backs.We checked-out a day early because of the "bed situation".We will not be inclined to return to this Resort, unless the mattresses are replaced.

allReviews.title: Great resort close to the strip
allReviews.text: Plenty of room and space to kick back and enjoy. Full kitchen with stove, large eating area  and living room. Bed was comfortable and my unit was very close to the pool. Assigned parking, so it was easy to park each night. Very close to the Vegas strip. About a 20 minute trip.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Cliffs at Peace and Canyon
allReviews.text: Very nice clean room, staff was friendly and helpful. No food offerings on site but located close to many restaurants. Kitchen fully equipped, great if family wanted to cook. Beautiful pool area, and had shuttle to the Las Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: This place was terrible.  It was a sad attempt to transfer an apartment complex into a resort.  Pathetic little pool, dirty sheets, couches, chairs, and just "old" everywhere.  We were so disenchanted with it that we only stayed one night and left to check in the Marriot (much better).  RCI should NOT have this on their lists of resorts.

allReviews.title: Away from the Strip!
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Away from the strip. Very spacious units and a very clean facility. We came for a business/personal trip and we were pleasantly surprised by the size of our unit. The area is very nice with a lot of hidden gem eateries.

allReviews.title: Nice Resort
allReviews.text: My family was very satisfied of our stay at the resort. We were able to use most of the services offered by the resort. The staff was also respectful and all helpful. I would definitely recommend this resort to friends and family.

allReviews.title: All In The Family Vacation
allReviews.text: Wow!  We reserved two, two bedroom units to have our first family vacation.  That involved an 87 year old and a 16 year old.  Wonderful units with pretty much anything you'd need.  I had called to alert staff that we preferred to be next to each other.  We got an upstairs/downstairs combination.  No problem.  We even used the resort pool - super!  And the grilling area - amazing.  Neighborhood feel in Sin City is pretty nice too.  Only small issue was the "event center" that surprised us.  Random vehicles parking us in and all kinds of people mingling around.  Fortunately the resort responded immediately and it wasn't an issue at all. This resort deserves its high rating!

allReviews.title: Stay at the Cliffs in Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Excellent Resort. Nice Pool.  Good location. AC in unit worked very well in spite of it being hot.Only thing i can think of to improve is the Shuttle bus to downtown Vegas could run later at night during the week

allReviews.title: Worst place ever!
allReviews.text: Took a sister trip & thought this would be a nice quiet, clean place to hang out for the week. We tried 3 different units and each was more gross and dirtier than the other.  Hair in the bathroom , bugs in the tub & kitchen, large nasty stains on the furniture - looked like they should have been in a guys dorm instead of a Gold Star resort (not so much). They didn't offer any compensation or apologies and acted as if they didn't care one wit about it at all. We ended up having to stay in a hotel 2 nights.I called the Grandview, where we normally stay, & they were super helpful and apologized for the horrible Service. Maybe The Cliffs were short staffed, not sure, but the Units should not have been rented out if not clean. Won't be staying there ever again.

allReviews.title: Family atmosphere approx 20 minutes from strip
allReviews.text: Cliffs is located in a residential area approximately 20 minutes from strip.  We trade for a 2 bedroom with 2 full baths .  The kitchen is convenient for making meals .  The pool is on the small side however enough to accommodate anyone who wants to come to the pool .  There is a business center , pool table and gathering area by the Lobby.  Not luxurious by any means .  Nearby parks to take little ones .  We enjoyed the Childrens Museum, Red Rock movie theatre , Pet and Magic shows at the V Theatre Planet Hollywood and a 2.5 hour drive to Grand Canyon West.  The only reason I didn’t rate with 5 stars is the tile in the unit needs professionally cleaned .  Bring slippers lest your feet pick up the grime . The mattress are firm .

allReviews.title: Great home base away from the crowded strip.
allReviews.text: Love the Summerlin area which is a newer community away from the strip but close drive down Tropicana or Flamingo.  Large 2 bedroom units, full size washer/dryer off kitchen, covered parking spaces, pool centrally located in middle of the complex.  Down side is activities have not been restored.  Helpful staff helped me unload and reload my ice chest which is too heavy for me traveling alone.

allReviews.title: Red Rock - Cliffs at Peace Canyon - Golf Trip
allReviews.text: Excellent location and very nice facilities.   The rooms were clean and very accomodating.  The pool, hot tub, firepit, and workout areas were very nice and we even caught a game of pool and the from lobby area.   We definitely appreciated the gated community and the overall resort.  RH

allReviews.title: Very pleasant experience
allReviews.text: I am truly grateful to the staff of cliff at peace Canyon. They are very accommodating with guests, eating,  addressed  all issues or requests that you may have. They are very friendly, rooms are roomy, clean and it feels like a 2nd home. I had to also work so I appreciate the wifi they have available in our room. My son and husband enjoyed tge pool and it was a really great time bonding with our son without having to deal with the strip crowd.  Enjoyed our vacation in this facility so  Thank you so much and we will be back

allReviews.title: Quiet Place
allReviews.text: Wonderful place to stay "off" the Strip. The rooms were very large and the bed was comfortable. The pool area was nice and uncrowded.  Easy to get checked in and helpful staff throughout. Many very good restaurants and ample shopping near and in all directions. Due West of the Strip about 7 miles.

allReviews.title: Peaceful
allReviews.text: No cliff, no canyon, but something better... Peace!  Close enough to the strip to enjoy, far enough away from the strip to escape.  Free shuttle (or reasonable Uber/Lyft) to get you there and back.  Nice pool, too!

allReviews.title: nothing spectacular
allReviews.text: The front desk folks were very nice, the computer system was down so we couldn't check in until after six pm. Our room was clean but as we found out at night the 4 way stop outside our window which is ten feet away was like sitting in the stands for a drag race. Half of our fixtures didn't have light bulbs in them, the one bedroom didn't have shades, the brackets were there. The pool broke down on one of the days we wanted to relax. On a different day we came back from seeing the sites, the police were in the parking lot because of a domestic situation, not sure who owns these units, but it sure didn't seem like a very controlled place, they have a security guard in a booth when you come into the property, but we were never stopped, they have no gates to keep people out. AFVC considers this a premium rental, no way, we talked with some folks that had been there before and they claimed that most of the units hadn’t been rented in a while so management was taking stuff from the vacant units and using it to fix the other units that were going to be rented, obviously ours was one of them. As I am writing this, I remember that when we were checking in, there was another couple at the desk checking out, management keep telling them, if you would have told us this, we could have corrected it for you. It’s clear that RCI has done nothing to ensure that all their rooms meet the standard of what they promote. The pool area lacks tables with umbrellas for you to enjoy the hot weather, there is only one table where the grills are so you have to cook your food then walk back to your room and eat it, really bad setup, we had heard there use to be multiply tables and chairs but management removed them. I would highly NOT recommend this place to anyone.

allReviews.title: Great off strip location
allReviews.text: If you want a quiet resort to enjoy the Vegas weather and avoid the strip environment The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a great option. Is you like hiking it’s close the Red Rocks park as well.  The resort also offers 2 bedrooms on the same unit which was ideal for my friend and I.  Having a rental car is probably a must here if you fly in as there isn’t a lot within walking distance.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay at the Cliffs
allReviews.text: We had a very nice stay at the Cliffs. The Rooms were clean and comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped and the balcony was very nice. Check-in was fast and the staff was attentive. We will stay again next year.

allReviews.title: AWESOME LOCATION
allReviews.text: The best RCI location that i have stayed at so far. The location was so good that i can't even explain it. Great spot if you don't want to deal the strip in Vegas. Ideal spot for rest and relaxation. There were great food places around the Cliff at Peace Canyon. Excellent access to the freeways. Area nice and clean suburbs of Los Vegas. No noise or any kind of malarkey. Just peace and relaxation. Love it !!!!!!

allReviews.title: A Week at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.
allReviews.text: I loved the location of the resort, and the staff was always pleasant and very helpful. I found I could easily find my way around the city quickly. The shuttle was a surprise and one of the best things about going to the strip--no parking issues!

allReviews.title: Off-Strip Las Vegas Resort
allReviews.text: Cliffs at Peace Canyon is located near Red Rock Canyon, a popular scenic area.  It is away from the hustle and bustle of the strip, which we found appealing.  Still, it is in the city, so one does hear some traffic noise and the occasional overhead aircraft.Units are being updated with granite countertops and new cabinets.  We were offered one of the updated units, but declined, so as to be located further away from the pool area and further from larger, busier streets.  Our building was near a residential area and was quite quiet for most of the week.  Also, for most of the week, we had families with young children near us.  When Friday came, things changed, with more young adults moving into neighboring units who kept late hours, and much louder traffic noise.  Fortunately, that was our last night at the resort, so the disturbance we experienced that one night did not outweigh the relative peacefulness of the previous six days.One thing about the units that is very appealing is that the bedrooms are on opposite sides of the living room and kitchen, giving privacy to each bedroom.  There is a washer/dryer in the unit and three televisions.  The dining room chairs are especially comfortable, having padding on seats and backs.  We were able to replenish supplies upon request.  There was no sales pitch at the resort.  Staff were responsive and pleasant; cheerful and helpful.In the center of the resort was a clubhouse with a lounge area, another common area with tables and chairs, and a business center with four computers and a printer.  The pool area was open from 9 AM to midnight.  A nearby fitness center had a weight set, two treadmills, two elliptical machines, and two stationary bikes.  There were also four outdoor grills.  The resort provided shuttle service to the strip, another casino, a grocery store, and Walmart.Some additional perks that were available included electric vehicle charging stations, covered areas for parking to shade cars from the sun, room-darkening draperies, sharp knives in the kitchen, and honest-to-goodness blankets for the beds.  (So many resorts have gone to comforters only, which always seem too hot.)  We cook in our unit a lot, and appreciated having good cutlery and a decent-sized cutting board, a good set of cookware, and ample, clean dishes. In addition to visiting Red Rock Canyon, the Valley of Fire is a little over an hour away, and Death Valley National Park is 2.5 to 3 hours away.

allReviews.title: A perfect Property
allReviews.text: The pool and spa area are larger and more inviting than the pictures show.  The property is immaculate and the room was perfectly cleaned.  The checking process was seamless and quick.  The spa is huge and can easily hold 12 people without people being packed in.

allReviews.title: cliffs at peace canyon
allReviews.text: decent resort, needs some updating (especially kitchen area, countertops, cabinets) no activities running or offered (stopped with covid and never started back up)  easy to get to, and quiet.  they offer shuttle to grocery store, and 2 casinos, but if you want to enjoy area a car is needed.

allReviews.title: Weather and shuttle were great
allReviews.text: Large two bedroom condo, lots of room for two couples .  Shuttle was very convenient to go to the strip.
