We explored the beauty of nature in Vegas--Red Rock Canyon was gorgeous and just a short drive away.  Costco and the beautiful Summerlin community with its resort, casino and upscale shopping district is a 10-15 minute drive.  I'm not the easiest person to please, but I was well pleased with my stay at Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Not Disappointed!
allReviews.text: We have been RCI members for 15+ years. When booking I always pay attention to the rating (gold crown,  silver crown, etc.). We most always stay at a gold crown resort for obvious reasons.  The Cliffs did not disappoint. The 2 bedroom unit was very clean, spacious and felt like home. Staff during checkin was very efficient, courteous , and knowledgeable. On-site swimming pool was very clean and a good size. My husband used the fitness room which was equipped with 2 treadmills and weightlifting machines with multiple stations .  Outdoor gas grills were located near the pool area. I was impressed how clean they were.  The resort is located approximately 20-25 minutes from the las vegas strip so it was close enough to get to the strip but far enough away from all the hussle and bustle of the strip.  Exactly what we were looking for.  A free shuttle service is available to the strip for those who do not want to attempt driving on their own.  The shuttle also provided service to Fremont and the grocery store.  The resort was very peace after a full day of seeing the nearby sites. Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, Hoover Dam and the Mob Museum are within a  reasonable driving distance away.  All in all,  were very satisfied with The Cliffs at Peace Canyon.

allReviews.title: Peaceful retreat in west Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This is the second year we have stayed at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon. The staff is friendly and helpful. The resort is well cared for with beautiful grounds and pool area. The resort is located on the west side of the Las Vegas metro area, away from the hustle and bustle of The Strip. You can still get anywhere in town quickly because of the resort's proximity to Hwy. 215 and to W. Tropicana Ave.and W. Flamingo Rd. There are Smith's and Albertson's grocery stores nearby, along with good restaurants such as Ohjah Japanese Steakhouse and Lindo Michoacán Mexican restaurant. We would stay here again in the future.

allReviews.title: NCguy
allReviews.text: The unit was updated and comfortable.  Convenient to the pool, workout, and grill area. Resort is a nice size, walkable to pool area.  Conveniently located to shopping, golf, and groceries.  Staff is very helpful.

allReviews.title: Loved This Place!!!
allReviews.text: Where do I begin? Let’s start with Steven, the Manager. From my phone calls prior to arriving to checking in, he was very helpful and accommodating.  The condo was perfect. I had requested the back of property, 2nd floor and that’s what they had for us. The unit was clean and had everything we needed. Great pool and bbq area too.  The shuttle drivers, Steve and Rockie were the best!!! We used the shuttle everyday and they both were informative and funny! The evening driver (can’t remember his name) was hilarious! What a pleasure just to take a shuttle! Can’t say enough about the entire staff. We will definitely be back!  I’d like to take the time to mention about the timeshare breakfast that you will be offered when you check-in. If you have no intention of purchasing a timeshare, please do not waste the time of these hard-working people just to take the free gift that they offer you. It’s not fair to them. My husband and I went to the breakfast with June and so glad that we did. We ended up purchasing a timeshare. June was absolutely amazing!  So needless to say, we will make it a point to go back to the Cliffs. Thank you to all of you. Gail and Ed (or Julie and Geronimo according to Steve the shuttle driver).

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay off the strip
allReviews.text: Be early for the shuttle they will leave you if you are 1 minute late.Resort and rooms very clean. The shuttle driver Steve is the best, funny and familiar with the area. We enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere of being away from the strip.

allReviews.title: Great Stay!
allReviews.text: We were wonderfully surprised by this resort.  It is in a great location.....away from the strip but there is a free shuttle to take you there.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  The pool area was wonderful but it could use some more umbrellas for shade.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Awesome check-in experience with me arriving after midnight. Kind enough to put us in a ground floor unit. Unit was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed including washer/dryer. 2 bedroom/2 bath. Was able to get clean clothes and a mid week cleaning. Further from Strip than I thought but had free Shuttle service to the Strip, Fremont St, Wal-Mart and grocery store. Used the pool and hot tub which were both clean and accommodating.

allReviews.title: Peace at the cliff
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a place that is quiet, no water park because you are an adult and you want relaxation, The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is definitely the place to go to be away from the strip of Vegas but close to everything

allReviews.title: Nice Resort off the Strip
allReviews.text: I found the resort to be clean, quiet and comfortable.The kitchens are well appointed and the grounds are well kept.There is a shuttle, but since the resort does not have a resturant, I would recommend a car to get to nearby shopping and resturants.

allReviews.title: wonderful place to relax
allReviews.text: This resort has easy access to the action of the strip and the surrounding area activities, but allows for a peaceful restful vacation.  Most places to visit are within a half an hour drive.  There are places to buy groceries and other items.  The grills at this resort are a plus as it allows for another meal type option.

allReviews.title: Cliffs of Peace Canyon is the BEST kept secret in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: I love this time share.  the rooms are well kept and the resort staff is extremely helpful.  The rooms are all closely surrounding the pool which is small and intimate.  People are always happy and willing to get to know you.  My two favorite people at the resort are Steve, the shuttle bus driver, and Danny at the welcome desk.  (Danny has recently moved to the Grandview.  He will be missed.)   This resort is the BEST kept secret in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Outside Vegas, but they have a shuttle!
allReviews.text: We stayed a  the Cliffs for a week. The check in was quick and you immediately were sent to the time share people to get your parking pass. It was OK, no pressure. THe activity fee was $25 which includes the shuttle and Wi-Fi. It was worth it the wi-fi is strong and the shuttle is great. The grounds were perfect and the pool was a great relief the hot days spent in Vegas. The hot tub was very nice and it was hot. They have a shuttle and they give you a schedule of times that they will drop you off either at Fremont Street or at the Mirage Hotel. It also has the pick up times. You must sign up to go or come on the shuttle. The resort is located in a nice residential neighborhood. There are gas stations and food store very near and the shuttle also go to Walmart on certain days. We stayed in a two bedroom. It had a very large living, dining and kitchen space as well as a patio. They have a very large flat screen TV and the bedrooms have TV as well. The ups: The unit was very nice and the mattresses offered good sleeping. The furniture in the unit was in excellent shape and the L shaped couch was nice to spread out on. The dining table was big with six chairs. The appliances were good and they were clean. There was also a nice selection of utensils. The downs: The countertop in the kitchen was dated and was separating in the corner joint. This no big deal. The cabinets could use a replacement in the near future. The only thing that was not acceptable was the carpet in the Master Bedroom. The carpet was gold and the path between the bedroom door and the bathroom were black with dirt. It was so bad you could not see the gold color. Also around the baseboard in the room was a dust line which means the carpet had not been cleaned in a very long time. I think tile would be a better choice when the carpet is replaced. The pillows need to be replaced. All in all it was a great stay. The staff were very pleasant and nice to interact with. If we return to Vegas we will stay again! Thank you for the great time.

allReviews.title: Bed Bugs !!!!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: Checked in and that night was bitten by a bed bug on my face . Reported it to management who called bug specialist who confirmed they had bugs. Some staff said it wasn't the first time. We were not satisfied with how we were treated. The place  had dirty floors and our room number had a sticker that said BUG OFF #211 which kind of says they knew and rented to us anyway.

allReviews.title: Beautiful peaceful resort
allReviews.text: Mountains all around   7 miles to Vegas strip   Peaceful sleep   Bennie was awesome who drives the shuttle   Very clean resort   Nice pool and spa   Rooms great   Roomy   Accomodates handicap   Pleasant friendly employees

allReviews.title: Relaxing resort
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The resort is centered away from the strip, but shuttle service available.We were  close enough to go to Red Rock Canyon, shop, restaurants, Hover Damn, and Lake Meade.Everyone very friendly.

allReviews.title: Nice Quiet Place
allReviews.text: We were in Vegas to see a friend's musical show.  I ride road bike and got in three great rides directly from the resort.  I went out to Red Rock Park and along the 215 bike trail.  Nice good restaurants and lots of shopping nearby.  We will probably stay again on our next trip to Vegas.  They also have a shuttle to the strip and Fremont St which we took advantage of.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas off the Strip
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon was a wonderful way to have access to the strip via car or their shuttle with just a 20 minute drive away.  We preferred staying in a more peaceful resort, with easy access to Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire and other outdoor recreational attractions.  The resort was beautifully maintained, on the smaller side.  Only downside for some may be the lack of any type of restaurant on the premises.  It's very close to grocery stores and numerous restaurants within a 10 minute walk for 5 minute drive.

allReviews.title: Annual Vegas vacation
allReviews.text: Enjoyed the week sitting by the pool relaxing and reading.  The surroundings are usually peaceful except when they need to use the blowers to clean the sidewalks of leaves daily.  There could be more tables with umbrellas but the pool area is the main reason I visit.

allReviews.title: mr kermit hansen
allReviews.text: everyone was very helpful.  The shuttle were very helpful in so many ways.. I can not say enough about the resort GREAT GREAT GREAT///////// o k I just coouldn't  think of more good things to say. If I go back to Vegas I will stay at the same Place.

allReviews.title: The Best of Vegas and It's Not The Strip
allReviews.text: The Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a wonderful, quiet resort in an excellent location away from the Strip.  The staff, with the exception of one person (there's always one) were friendly, polite, and responsive.  The shuttle to the Strip was excellent.  We couldn't have been more pleased with out stay.

allReviews.title: Pleasant stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed being off the strip, unit had everything we required, although a little outdated.  Kitchen cabinets could definitely be replaced as well as the mattress.  Pool and surrounding area was nicely maintained and staff was fantastic . Shuttle service is a plus although we also rented a car to see some other sights and do some shopping.

allReviews.title: Great Location on Westside
allReviews.text: Easy access from both directions of the 215.  All kinds of shopping within a couple of miles.  15 minutes from Red Rocks Conservation area.  Convenient shuttle service.   The pool area is great for relaxation and socializing.  Our one bedroom unit was clean, comfortable, and quite.

allReviews.title: Nice resort, but location of our unit had issues.
allReviews.text: The resort was very nice, but 0ur unit was right on Peace Canyon Way and was very noisy from the street traffic.  There were some loud cars that seem to race down the street.  It was nice weather, and we could not keep the windows open for the breeze.  We put up with the noise for about 3 days and then asked to be moved to another unit.  The resort said that it was too late, that they would have to charge us.

allReviews.title: Quite nice
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Cliffs at Peace Canyon.  The photos were representative of the property.   We had a 2 bedroom unit because there were 4 of us.  Our unit was nice but happened to face the street so not real conducive to using the patio.  It wasn't enough to make us move, but next time, I'd request one with more privacy.  This was a perfect place to stay since we did not want the hustle/bustle of the Vegas Strip.  We did use the free shuttle to go to the Strip one night.  That was nice.  This was a hiking trip for us and it was a great location--so close to Red Rock Canyon.  The pool is small but not crowded when we were there.  Although I wouldn't classify this property as

allReviews.title: A great place to stay
allReviews.text: Quiet, clean and great pool!  Best value RCI has in Vegas compared to other properties.  We've been coming here for over 10 years and I appreciate the maintenance on the rooms and grounds. First timne we've had a too worn mattress but we lived and it will probably be replaced soon.

allReviews.title: Base Point
allReviews.text: We used this resort as a base point to see sites in the area.  We don't gamble.  The rooms were nice but the housekeeping needs a refresher course.  The refrigerator was not emptied from previous guests, the counter tops seemed gritty.  I know this seems picky but they really need to wipe down the base boards and vacuum the carpet next to the base boards.  Had dust growing.  I call on the refrigerator and counter tops and they were very prompt in cleaning them.  The staff were very pleasant and even though we did not use the pool, workout room etc.... they seemed very nice.  I would recommend going back to this place.

allReviews.title: Vegas and Golf Trip
allReviews.text: Stayed at resort for a week of gambling and golf. Resort is a comfortable 15-20 minutes west of strip near Red Rock. Traffic was never a problem and you are situated near the freeway entrance and two main roads leading to the strip or Red Rock Casino.  Very easy check in even when early.  Had four guys in 2 - 2 bedroom units that were plenty big and very comfy beds.  Between the four of us we tried the complementary coffee in the clubhouse, pool and hot tub during the stay.  Also used the shuttle service which was always on time and delivered guest to grocery area or the center strip at the Mirage.  Situated near shopping center with numerous options for dining if you want something good away from the strip.Recommend highly.

allReviews.title: Near Red Rock Canyon
allReviews.text: This resort was located close to the Red Rock Canyon where we went hiking. We also love to go to the Red Rock Casino to gamble, bowl, go to the movies & eat, so the location was perfect for visiting that casino. The resort staff was super friendly & accommodating, even if it was 2:30 in the morning. The 2 bedroom was huge & gave us plenty of space.

allReviews.title: Property off the strip
allReviews.text: the resort was not too busy. Plenty chairs at the pool. The resort was also very quiet, easy to relax. The shuttle was a great advantage, since the casino are charging now for parking, it was east to get to the strip. The shuttle drivers were very polite and personal. All over it was a great place to stay, I would stay there again anytime.

allReviews.title: The cliffs
allReviews.text: Really beautiful units, nice quiet pool, about 20 min from the strip but lots of restaurants around, great staff.  JP at the front counter was amazing, always smiling and willing to give tips on places to go..  they also have a $500 draw every Saturday for one lucky guest to win

allReviews.title: Liked this resort, the area, would definitely recommend!
allReviews.text: Beds were comfortable, shower heads are great!  Pool towels are provided.  No frying pan or spatula.  If you plan to eat around the pool buy some paper plates.  Our family stayed in a 2 bedroom, there was plenty of room for all six of us, everyone liked the set up, enjoyed the little patio outside the room.  Grounds were clean and well groomed, pool and surrounding area was clean, very well maintained.  The online pictures represent the area very well.

allReviews.title: Cliffs At Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: Approx. 20 Minutes from a the Vegas Strip. Quiet location with plenty of shopping and dining nearby. Nice pool area with a large hot tub. Outdoor grilling area available. We had a one bedroom unit which was large and comfortable, small deck with table and chairs off the dining area.The kitchen was not as well stocked with extra utensils etc.. as other places we have stayed but it was sufficient. This was our first trip to Vegas and this was a good choice. They do provide a shuttle service to the strip but you have to plan ahead and reserve a spot.

allReviews.title: Bad Experience
allReviews.text: This is not a gold crown resort. Proceed at your own disappointment. Unit was very dated. Matress and pillows worn, no whirlpool ion master, a/c fan noisy, unable to read cup level on coffee pot, smoke detector yellow.

allReviews.title: Resort Disappointment
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a quiet & relaxing resort away from the crowds and secluded.....this may look the place on paper....but it is NOT that.  It is on a Main Street right in the heart of Las Vegas subdivision.  The best part of the stay was the staff who were very helpful and try hard to make our stay a good experience....Thanks so much Jasmine!!!They say they are away from the Strip but with traffic it really is about 30 mins away, which if it was, as advertised by RCI....that would have been okay but in reality the location didn't come close to what they promised sadly!!The unit itself is soooo far from a GOLD STAR unit!!  The kitchen cupboards were loose and uneven, the floor was in terrible shape.  It is all stone tiles but all the ground was broken and crumbling between the stones so they banged when you walked on them and the floor had a constant dust on it.  The AC unit was soooooo loud you have a hard time sleeping with it on.  The balcony is small and looks out at the building next door.  The bed was really hard too.  It did have ensuite laundry which was a bonus and a full kitchen....but didn't have some of the basic things you need.  We arrived Mon and left Sun and never had housekeeping....which was okay but surprising.It is in need of a MAJOR upgrade to the units.

allReviews.title: The Cliffs
allReviews.text: The property was just as described.  Very clean, well kept, Pool, jacuzzi and exercise  room wer all fantastik.  We checked in at 1:30am Saturday night and the night staff was very helpful and accomodating.  The information they gave us was very informative.  As we walked the ground the next day, their staff was genuinely interested in our experience there. Kitchen was well equipped  and the outdoor grilles were very inviting.  Next time we will have more time to use them.

allReviews.title: Good to be off the strip
allReviews.text: I arrived at the Cliffs 4/9 and will leave 4/23.  It is in a residential area, and there are stores and restaurants you can walk to, or a short drive.  I basically wanted to get out of the cold and be somewhere warm.  There are two story buildings around the property.  There are no elevators.  I asked for a room on the first floor close to the pool.  It is close, but I cannot see the pool from my unit.  My room is very depressing.  I love the sun and the light, and at home I let all the light I can in.  When I walked in, it was like coming into a cave.  They have wooden blinds on the windows.  I went around opening all of them.  Unfortunately, I don’t know if the windows have ever been washed, but I at least got some light, but not what I wanted.  There are simply not enough windows.  They are not very soundproof.  The people upstairs are constantly dragging chairs, which is quite noisy.  The pool is small, but fine.  There are an adequate amount of chairs, but not a lot of people out there, but that could be because I am from Ohio, so I am happy to be out when it is 63.  The shuttle goes to the Mirage every hour, and will drop off at the grocery store on each trip if desired.  It also goes to Freemont Street a couple of nights and leaves you there about three hours.  It also has trips to Walmart and Red Rock Casino a couple times a week.  You do need to make reservations.  There are not many scheduled activities.  One thing that would be nice if they had a small store for essentials.  There are some vending machines in the work out room for some snacks though.  Overall, it is very basic ... not a great room, not great landscaping, could use some updating, but the people are nice.

allReviews.title: Almost 2 weeks at The Cliffs at Peace Canyon
allReviews.text: The location was ideal for the type of trip we had planned to Vegas.  Very little time on the Strip but good access to Hwy 215 allowed us to get everywhere quickly.  The resort itself was very relaxing with just a short walk to the pool, hot tub, exercise room and Bar BQ's.

allReviews.title: great uuits,location, and extras at the Cliffs
allReviews.text: was a  great place to stay and convieniet to las vagas.  units were well maintained and staff was very helpful.,grounds were well done.also handicap parking was appreciared.was also convient to eating and business places.

allReviews.title: Excellent resort!
allReviews.text: The entire resort is clean, spacious and the staff is friendly and courteous.  The bed was comfortable an resort was very quiet!  We were very happy with our condo!  Cliffs at Peace Canyon is a wonderful resort and we will be visiting again!

allReviews.title: Relaxing and Peaceful.
allReviews.text: I was a little concerned initially about the distance from Strip but the Resort is an excellent location with lots of restaurants.  We had a rental car but utilized the shuttle to go to the strip and downtown.  If you want to do Vegas and relax w/o the crowds this an excellent location.  We had the 2 bedroom so we could spread out and have family over to visit. The bedroom were comfortable enough ...pillows kinda soft though. We were on the go a lot so the bed wasn't a major concern.

allReviews.title: Spring Break
allReviews.text: This was our first trip to the Cliffs and we will return. While this is an older property our unit looked completely updated with very nice new furniture. The rooms were clean and quite large with plenty of space to spread out and store your gear. We really liked the sectional sofa in the living room. The pool, hot tub , BBQ and outdoor fireplace provided great outdoor living. We took advantage of the free shuttle to the strip- the drivers were very nice and accomodating. What a great vacation!

allReviews.title: Needs updating
allReviews.text: The grounds are very nice as is the pool area. Check in went smoothly without the typical time share pitch.It is away from the strip which means it is quiet and there’s a shuttle ( which we did not use) .The unit itself was another story. Everything appears old and worn.There was an odor in the room ( not sure why) . It dissipated after a while with Open windows and febreze.  The air conditioner did not work though once reported was fixed. The dish washer did not work properly. Was given “ new dish detergent “ to try.  That did not work either. It probably needs to be replaced.  I would not recommend this property. We will not come back.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: We loved this resort- 2 bedroom lower unit- plenty of space for a family of 4. Full sized washer/dryer in a lundery room off of the kitchen. Big walk in master closet- with plenty of space for luggage and clothes. Good living room set up- great pool and grill/ fireplace area in the center of the resort. Assigned covered parking right next to the unit... it was great for us- we wanted to be off strip this time- went to the grand canyon, Away from the congestion- but close enough to get their quickly.  This was a perfect resort for a family that wants to relax, but is able to get to the fun and thirlls that Vegas offers in a hurry. Staff was great... resort was full, but it did not feel crowded. They appologized for not having a

allReviews.title: Wonderful Las Vegas Vacation
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Cliff's at Peace Canyon resort using our RCI membership for the first time.  We could not have been more happy with the entire experience.  The staff was great, the unit was clean and well stocked with everything you would need for your time, and the shuttle capped off a really wonderful stay.  This was the first time in our many years of travel that we could actually use the knives provided in the unit, they were sharp!!  The kitchen was well stocked as was the bathroom with plenty of towels and other necessary items.  We used the shuttle to travel from the resort to the strip every day which worked out great.  No need to drive our car and try to find parking on the strip.  Can't say enough about how much fun we had and the resort was the main reason, wonderful place to stay and see the sights.

allReviews.title: Family Fun
allReviews.text: Wonderful place to stay if you want a great location to avoid the strip. Only problem there elevators were terrible and out of order most of our stay.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: I will be back here, my second time here and fits my needs perfectly. Convenient to stores, food, casinos, rest safe feeling all the time being a solo traveler.

allReviews.title: Relaxing place to stay
allReviews.text: Nice kitchen, the temperature of the room was perfect, and the views were great. Parking was free and plentiful. The location is also a plus.

allReviews.title: Well worth every penny!
allReviews.text: The Berkley is a gem of a stay, off the strip, but with a Casino & really nice food & multiple shopping options just steps away.  Enjoy resort style living, in the quite, large, all suite rooms of the Berkley.

allReviews.title: We will be back!!
allReviews.text: The best hotel to stay in Las Vegas, away from all the hustle and bustle yet close enough to shows, restaurants, casinos and all what Vegas has to offer!!

allReviews.title: Love The Berkley
allReviews.text: We like the location with free parking. You're surrounded by shops and near by casinos without the hustle and busel of downtown or the strip. The view of the strip from our room was enough for us to enjoy.

allReviews.title: Hotel visit 11 dg
allReviews.text: our visit for 11dv was fantastic. Because we had to cook ourselves because of food this was fantastic. Beds were lovely and no noise.

allReviews.title: Trip
allReviews.text: Enjoyable experience and pleasant staff. Shuttle needs more available times. Wish it was closer to the strip.

allReviews.title: Best property and location near the airport.
allReviews.text: If you haven't been there you should give it a try. You can't beat the two bedroom unit. It has a washer and dryer. Also a large kitchen with all the ammenities.

allReviews.title: Love this Property!
allReviews.text: Value, rooms, location all excellent. My family and I had a wonderful time at The Berkeley. Would definitely stay there again!

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great staff and convenient location to all the best shops and eateries. You won't be disappointed in your decision

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The accommodation was excellent, the cleanliness and comfort were very good, and the best part was the kitchen

allReviews.title: Excellent value
allReviews.text: Rooms were quiet, very comfortable and stocked properly in the kitchen.  Wasn’t happy they claimed my pullover wasn’t left behind.

allReviews.title: Comfortable Stay - Felt like Home
allReviews.text: I love being able to stay at a place that has home amenities. The fact that I could cook breakfast in the morning and make my own coffee with creamer in the fridge was excellent. We were able to wash our clothes prior to leaving so no laundry at home. The bed was comfy and the view was excellent. My wife especially loved getting ready for a wedding in her own little space with her own sink. The location was perfect. A lot of restaurants and shopping but also very close to Sphere and the Strip.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and huge tandem suite rooms
allReviews.text: One of the best suite rooms we've to and value for the money. The room is equipped with cooking amenities and kitchen stuff.

allReviews.title: Property needs a refresh
allReviews.text: While I enjoyed this property it does need a refresh. Furniture showing wear and tear. Room needed a few minor repairs. Kitchen faucet not attached. Shower head finish was peeling. Had to ask repeatedly for towels and wash clothes. Love the location. Short walk to Silverton casino. Great pool area which was still open in November. Huge hot tub.

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay!
allReviews.text: This hotel was awesome for a family stay. It had everything we needed and it was super clean. I just felt so comfortable and I would definitely recommend to family and friends!

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: Comfortable rooms and great location! Only downside are the only 3 elevators are very slow and overcrowded!

allReviews.title: Super
allReviews.text: Value for money super nice staff, nice spacious hotel apartments, nice beds, fluffy towels, good clean.

allReviews.title: Loved everything about our stay at the Berkley!
allReviews.text: In all the twenty plus years we have visited Vegas this was the first time we stayed off of the strip & our stay at the Berkley couldn’t have been better, & we were so happy to have found this place. Everything was so nice & it was a quiet, calm & peaceful place to stay. Easy check-in & checkout with friendly staff. The parking was great & it was just a short walk to the room. The room was clean & comfortable. We loved staying here. Hope we can make a return visit soon.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Room was quite large and very comfortable. The housekeeping staff were terrific.It was great that there was plenty of parking. My only comment is that the elevators are quite slow and the shower needs more water pressure.

allReviews.title: Very pleased. I would return on future visits.
allReviews.text: I was very pleased with this experience.  I would return again when I visit family again. I appreciated the spaciousness and the amenities,  including free parking. The full laundry  in the unit is very useful for longer stays. Only real improvement would have been a dividing door between bathroom and bedroom area.

allReviews.title: Clean and quiet
allReviews.text: Nice, clean and quiet for a one night stay. Nice room with decent beds. Thank you for all your additional accommodations to my requests

allReviews.title: Sema business
allReviews.text: We went for sema business and had a great stay, easy to get to the convention centers. Parking was plentiful.

allReviews.title: First and certainly LAST visit.
allReviews.text: This was my first time in Vegas and a special trip for my birthday. From the moment I arrived, I was given false information about my room accommodations and stay. There’s also an extra charge for EVERYTHING you would expect within a  normal hotel visit. I truthfully wanted to check out the following day but was explained the process for that was lengthy so I endured. The service was horrible but the room was nice. Wouldn’t recommend, much better options in Vegas for stays.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Silverton close by for food meals and entertainment. Great parking. Rooms nice but bedroom carpeting needed shampooing. AC and heat worked well. Love room darkening. Fair TV with no tv guide for times to watch or what’s playing.

allReviews.title: Great place!
allReviews.text: We love it. Perfect for my family. It’s was big clean enough room for my family. Everything was close by if you need restaurant or target, gas stations.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Condo Accommodations
allReviews.text: This is the perfect location at an incredible price point. Nothing better than traveling condo style. It has perfect strip and mountain views . Highly recommend

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Very pleasant stay. Not far from the airport and next to the Bass Pro Shop. Had a great kitchen with cookware and utensils for cooking your own food (good money saver).

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Our first time to experience staying at "The  Berkley" & it did not disappoint. Booked via RCI & we  were most pleased . The resort is nicely situated , not so far from the strip yet it is so quiet. The 2 rooms that were assigned to us were  so spacious & private. They are actually 2 separate units each with one master bedroom  , full kitchen, living room , bathroom . Staff were friendly & accommodating. Couldn't ask for more. Our week long stay was quite comfortable. Looking forward to more future stays in this wonderful resort !

allReviews.title: Great option for families
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect. There was plenty of space for our large family. The rooms were clean and had everything we needed. Great location.

allReviews.title: GREATNESS in one place
allReviews.text: It was so convenient to stay at this centrally located hotel.  The best thing is that it provided enough space for the entire family with no one bumping into one another.  We were in town for our son's baseball tournament so having access to do laundry is a must.  What better way then to have 2 stacked washer and dryers available.  We even did some cooking for dinner and breakfast so very cost efficient when traveling.

allReviews.title: Dog hair everywhere!
allReviews.text: I’m not sure the rooms are being properly cleaned at this property. This was my see one time saying here and I got a 1 bdrm suite. There was dog hair on everything the bed. The couch, the chair, the carpet and rug areas. There’s dog hair all over my and my man’s belongings and we DO NOT HAVE DOGS. I also had to clean the kitchen and bathroom prior to use because it didn’t seem clean to me

allReviews.title: One happy guest!
allReviews.text: it's such a refreshing change to stay in a resort like this away from the casino hotel.  The location is fantastic, with all the shops, restaurants, gas station & Silverton casino right next door.  The property location is south of strip, much better area than north of strip between downtown Fremont Street. The value for the money is unbelievable, there are NO resort fee or parking fee like the hotels on the strip, yet it's very close to the airport and car rental agency.  This is a hidden gem people may not know about when visiting Las Vegas, definitely should check it out and see it for yourself.

allReviews.title: The Berkley - A Great Vacatiob Place
allReviews.text: We just spent a week at the Berkley at Silverton and had a great time. The rooms were clean and quiet, and the staff was always friendly and helpful. The pool, hot tub and exercise room were great. Most rooms are a full one bedroom, with a separate living area. Each unit sleeps 4. If you get two rooms together, you can share the space and sleep 8. The hotel is located right next to the Silverton Casino and the Bass Pro shop. I highly recommend this resort for you next vacation.

allReviews.title: Awesome Stay at The Berkley
allReviews.text: This was my second time staying at The Berkley and each stay was amazing. I love the area away from the Strip and this hideaway was quiet and surreal. The rooms are fantastic, very clean and felt like home. So like home, I cooked breakfast 2 out of the 4 days we were there. I also love the fact that having a washer/dryer inside the room was fantastic. No dirty clothes went back home. I truly would recommend The Berkley Las Vegas to friends, family and everyone!

allReviews.title: Good hotel, AMAZING room!
allReviews.text: The room that I stayed in was actually an apartment, with a living room, a kitchen, and a suite. It's a bit strange that the pool area is between the building and the parking lot, especially cause it's a see-through fence, but the pool area is really good as well.If you don't have a car with you, be advised and prepared to spend some time and money on transportation, because you'll most likely be using Uber/Lyft, and it costs, on average, $20 to ride between the hotel and the Strip.

allReviews.title: Beautiful place, convenient, and friendly staff
allReviews.text: Overall a great space for our party of 3 adults. Next door to Starbucks was great. A few minor repairs need to be made to the sinks, but it didn't disrupt our stay. Beds were comfy and staff was stellar.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at The Berkley.  The hotel is a convenient driving location to The Strip and other attractions, as well as there are many stores and restaurants nearby that are easy to get to by foot. Our room was spacious and we were glad to have a full kitchen and washer/dryer in our unit during our stay. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was roomy with the design of the 2 sink areas. We were completely satisfied with our hotel location and experience. We would definitely stay at The Berkley again.

allReviews.title: Awesome for the price
allReviews.text: It was super convenient for my son who loves bass pro shop, for parents who love to gamble and for the price it was perfect

allReviews.title: Amazing experience
allReviews.text: my husband and I loved this studio. Very well cleaned, comfortable bed and fantastic shower. Near to Casino and good restaurants.

allReviews.title: Romantic staycation
allReviews.text: A wonderful deal for a weekend trip. The hotel is easy to access, super quiet and clean, and much more spacious than the suites at hotels on the Strip. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: NEEDS UPGRADING IN APPLIANCES
allReviews.text: Great over all Services were wonderful.. Appliances were outdated. Over all quiet every worker did their best to help us in every way

allReviews.title: Berkely Las Vegas stay
allReviews.text: Great rooms at very affordable price. Excellent resport and place to stay. Would be even better if shuttle service is provided to/from the airport; and a m ore reliable car/van shuttle service to town.

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here if you want to sleep in on your check out day
allReviews.text: Love staying here because it’s always clean and rooms are worth it They did not let me add late check out even though they kept sending me texts and emails about it

allReviews.title: Great place off the strip
allReviews.text: Great location not to  busy not  too far but not  to close to the strip right next to silverton casino bit to crowded at all

allReviews.title: Affordable Long Term Stay
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Berkley for 6 nights. We loved how affordable it was, the free parking, the pool, and the friendly staff. Our room was spacious and our bed was very comfortable. It really helped to have a kitchen so we could cook some meals. With a few grocery stores nearby, we saved a lot of money during our stay. We felt the location was great, making it easy for us to access the strip, Red Rock canyon, and all the other places we visited. A few negatives were that our first room smelled like smoke and we had to be moved to a lower floor with not as great a view. Staff handled it really well but it was late and we were tired from a day of traveling so we were disappointed. Also, our dishwasher had to be fixed during our stay, and our garburator didn’t work either. We also had to buy cooking necessities, like spices and had to ask for extra toilet paper, dishwashers tabs, laundry detergent, etc. Despite these drawbacks, we did enjoy our stay and we very likely will choose the Berkley for our next long term trip. Staff members were super friendly and helpful and our issues were addressed right away.

allReviews.title: Don't go there!
allReviews.text: Rooms need updating and help is almost impossible to get! If you want any real service, you have to go to their sister resort- The "Grandview".

allReviews.title: Excellent stay
allReviews.text: No tips or guidelines-everything went well. Good location & easy access. Walking distance to Silverton Casino.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Rest and Recover
allReviews.text: We went to Vegas to see the Wizard of Oz at the Sphere. We would normally stay at other properties on the South Side of the Strip as there is plenty of available restaurants, grocery stores, and the outlet mall to keep expenses somewhat lower. The property is easy to access and only a few minutes to the strip whether you take the freeway or Las Vegas Blvd northbound from the property.

A great place to visit if you really want to relax away from all of the business of the strip. It's accessible to grocery shopping, clothes shopping, and household needs. The apartment is equipped with a full kitchen & basic cooking appliances. The restaurants at the Silverton (next door) are also amazing.

allReviews.title: PERFECTION!
allReviews.text: Everything about this place is PERFECT. It's FAMILY FRIENDLY. Clean. Comfortable. Welcoming. Has everything you need inside Unit, besides your extra amenities. I was happy and satisfied, and will be back!! :)

allReviews.title: Location, Location, Location
allReviews.text: This is a "GREAT" location. Clean room and I had a amazing view. No parking fees, no surprise fees - although, they should consider removing the resort fee since they do not have a spa or business center. They do not have room service or food delivery services; but they do have shuttle service to the Strip and Downtown.  Good restaurant choices in surrounding area and "Silverton Village".

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: This is clean, spacious property. If not stay at the Strip I would book again next time to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great location, friendly staff, good size room
allReviews.text: The location was perfect, close to freeway, airport, The Strip, the stadium, and Red Rock. Easy to get to all these places without the traffic. Plenty of stores, gas stations, restaurants, and fast food places close by. That was nice if you want to save a few bucks, because eating on The Strip can be pricey. Staff was friendly and it was nice to have a condo type room for comfort. The only reason for not giving 5 stars was the uncomfortable bed/pillows and cleanliness of room. I noticed something splattered on the bathroom wall and pocket door as well as on curtains in bedroom. Looked like it had been there a while. Overall, nice place to stay, just needed to be cleaner.

allReviews.title: Lovely Place
allReviews.text: The Berkley was perfect for our business trip. The rooms are really nice and quiet and well equipped. I would highly recommend them.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: I had spent with my families and it was very good memory.even though the location was not in the strip, other things were all more competitive and covenient only except the location.

allReviews.title: Great Gateway with family!
allReviews.text: This hotel resort was a great option as I was looking for a family friendly set up where we had accessible rooms for a family of 7 traveling with children. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout our state. There were great dining options across the resort. The parking was accessible and convenient. It was great to be away from the resort and we had a relaxing weekend getaway.

allReviews.title: Great service .  Clean  place
allReviews.text: Very happy clean place safe nice enjoyable.  I would Stay again here people are awesome and the shittle. Driver was great shimelli I believe is name is.  Thank you

allReviews.title: Great place for the price
allReviews.text: Great place for the price. We loved the town home concept of the room and it was located right where we wanted.

allReviews.title: PERFECT
allReviews.text: Great stay in a very spacious apartment hotel. The staff is friendly. The hotel is large and clean. The room was very well equipped, a real big comfortable bed, a big sofa bed a little noisy. Tv, oven, fridge, microwave oven, washing machine and dryer, coffee maker, toaster... Shower and bathtub. Beautiful and large swimming pool with shade corners. Jacuzzi. Shops and restaurants nearby. Large free parking. 15 minutes from the strip. Quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Free shuttle 3 times a day if you want to go to town without a car. We loved it and will be back next year.

allReviews.title: Great stay, especially for a week or more
allReviews.text: This is like being in your own apartment and it comes equipped with everything you need. They offer shuttles to the strip if you want to go. But if you just need to be in Vegas and want peace and quiet you never really need to leave. IT is in a great area close to shopping and restaurants with everything you need!

allReviews.title: Deluxe suite stay
allReviews.text: Spacious suite with full kitchen, comfortable bed, in-suite laundry, view of Vegas, and enjoyable outdoor swimming pool.

allReviews.title: Go to place if you don't want busy strip
allReviews.text: Lovely hotel although a bit far out for those wanting the strip. This property is timeshare which I didn't realise at the time of booking so had to go on 90 minutes tour which turned into 6 hours!!! Three different sales people all trying to sell ridiculously high priced weeks holiday. Checkout time too early 10am..... then housekeeping knocking on door at 9.30 to see if we're ready to go. Technically self catering service so no cleaning offered. Could have done with a mop or something as the place got a bit grotty after 8 days. Git a mid stay clean but she only made the bed in main bedroom

allReviews.title: A beautiful discovery in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: A very clean and well equipped accommodation.We appreciated the provision in the accommodation of a washing machine and dryer.Perfect for a family trip.

allReviews.title: Great stay at The Berkley!
allReviews.text: The villa was very spacious. The bed was so comfortable and it was close to restaurants and 10 minutes from the strip. Plus they provide a shuttle to the strip if you wanna go.

allReviews.title: Rude and Disrespectful Night Shift Desk Clerk
allReviews.text: The Night Shift front desk clerk was rude and disrespectful I lodged a complaint, the manager was in a meeting, the manager never acknowledged my complaint and the behavior continued throughout my stay

allReviews.title: Not my Choice for Vacation
allReviews.text: The Berkley is more hotel than resort, is small with nothing to offer other than one pool which is always full of kids, the night shift front desk clerk is rude and disrespectful and management is non-responsive to complaints

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: Just do your homework when it comes to finding the best hotel. Look for a hotel that will be good for you and family or friends

allReviews.title: Modern Studio Has Everything You Need
allReviews.text: Clean, modern and comfortable. The kitchenette has everything you need to prepare meals. The full size refrigerator with an ice maker was very convenient.

allReviews.title: Birthday celebration 🎂
allReviews.text: This place is well worth the stay the 5 stars and everything. Lije any other establishments you have a few minor issues like ice maker didn't work in one of the adjacent units but for the most part it's an amazing set up for if you're traveling with a large group or family. Also, I'm big on cleanliness and this definitely met my cleanliness standards.

allReviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
allReviews.text: We had an awesome time at The Berkley. The resort was centrally located not far from the Las Vegas Strip and the resort provided shuttle service to various points of interest such as the Las Vegas Strip and Freemont Street.

allReviews.title: NOT A GOOD EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: This property needs a serious change starting from front desk, maintainace , securtiy, shuttle, etc.Front Desk: the front desk personnel show a high level incopetency- you ask for something, they confirm they did it but yet they did not. Maintainace- they come after 2 days Security- had serious concerns about my safety and my child's safety in the  swimming pool as adults and children were aggressively jumping and diving in the hot tub and swimming pool. Addressed the issue to security, he did a quick walk around and that was it and people continued jumping and diving. They show no care for other people's safety- safety is not their priority.Shuttle- often late or does not show up at all

allReviews.title: Great place to stay, smells amazing.
allReviews.text: As soon as you walk in the smell takes over and you feel comfortable! Rooms are spacious and having a washer and dryer was an extra bonus. All staff are very friendly and helpful. Jacuzzi was amazing.

allReviews.title: Such a lovely resort!
allReviews.text: Honestly, this resort was fantastic! We are not shareholders or anything, just booked a 5-day vacation through a third party website, and it was great. It was our first time here. The staff was friendly, the hotel was sparkling clean, and the first thing my little guy noted in the lobby was that it smelt really good! We didn’t use it but they have shuttle service to and from the strip. By car, the strip is approximately 10 minutes away; the airport is approximately 8 minutes away. Everything you could need - target, gas stations, restaurants, shopping - is accessible by car within 5-15 minutes. Housekeeping isn’t done every day but they can come up upon request, and the front desk is available for amenities 24/7. I had a maintenance request and they arrived within minutes. We had a great time in the pool to cool off on a hot day, and although we brought our own towels, towels were available I believe under the sink in the little powder room off of the washroom in the suite.Our two-unit suite was just lovely, with each unit having its own bedroom + kitchen + washroom + living room. That was a surprise as we thought the kitchen, washroom, and living room would be shared with two closed-off bedrooms. As we were extended family vacationing together, this worked out well for us.All I can say is book the stay. The resort is on the Silverton property, which has a casino and a (free) aquarium which we didn’t get to visit but looked really great - they apparently have stingray feedings and mermaid shows. Although a family vacation with kids to Vegas sounds contradictory, it was an amazing time. We didn’t want to come home, and are already thinking about when we can come back just to stay at this hotel again!

allReviews.title: Recommended apartment hotel just outside
allReviews.text: Well equipped apartments near the interstate. We found everything we needed. Service a bit cumbersome: Rooms are not cleaned during the stay. If there is a lack of toilet paper, shampoo or something else, you have to pick it all up individually at the reception. Parking free of charge right outside the door. And since you have to travel by car anyway, all the highlights of Las Vegas can be reached in a few minutes.Good Price quality ratio and friendly staff.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: Excellent value for money hotel apartments. We are very happy to be here again. Whether it's the room layout or the kitchen kitchenware, washing machine and all the amenities, it's really great. Parking is very convenient and the internet is good. Reservations are also convenient. Very satisfied in short! The only shortcoming was that there was no spare toilet paper, and many guests had to go to the front desk to ask for it. This is embarrassing.

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: I checked in online and when I arrived I had to register again online.  The desk was understaffed with long waits and the greatest i. The back just sat there looking at you.  They need to be trained to help check in guests when they are understaffed was very un happy

allReviews.title: Quality size rooms!
allReviews.text: Spacious rooms, huge bathrooms with hot tubs, couches and chairs are nice. Fridge is great and stove and microwave so you won’t have to eat out every meal. Breathtaking views from the higher floors.

allReviews.title: Summer Vacation
allReviews.text: Had a great summer vacation. Went to Summer League, Silverton Casino next door. I am not sure why Sundance Restaurant has 2 stars but it was an 8 to me.

allReviews.title: Would not stay again
allReviews.text: Staff are uneducated and not helpful. Property is not well maintained. 2 of the 3 elevators were inoperable. Shuttle service is unreliable. Rooms are nice enough. Beds are terribly uncomfortable. Fold out couches are basically useless for sleeping. Don't waste your time. Find another place to stay. Vegas is a big city. There have got to be hundreds of better options.

allReviews.title: Home for 3 weeks
allReviews.text: Came to Vegas for our daughter’s dance competition and had a great stay at the Berkeley. In room laundry was probablythe best thing as well as the fully functional kitchen that we made full use of. Location was nearby all the essentials you need including tons of food options. Would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Excellent Experience
allReviews.text: The service, the staff and the premises was beyond what you could ask for the only complaint I do have is they do not have a shuttle to walmart and the shower needs to have a lift, but am I holding experience outside of that was exquisite!

allReviews.title: COMFORT
allReviews.text: Excellent location, price-benefit ratio. We had a wonderful vacation and experience in Las Vegas. I will definitely return to this resort and recommend it to my friends.

allReviews.title: They need to double check reservation no.
allReviews.text: To make sure to double check the booking or checking in. Someone with the same name as me and they gave my reservation to that person without looking at the reservation number. I had to wait for a while and mind you we came from a long road trip so we were tired. Otherwise room is clean. We only spent 1 day just to rest and go to another roadtrip.

allReviews.title: First time visit to The Berkley
allReviews.text: My wife and I are new owners and our first visit was simply OUTSTANDING and we’re sincerely looking forward to our next visit.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Enjoy Life at The BERKLEY aren't you can just go stand and walk around outside on the Street I Mean Strip

allReviews.title: I love it here!
allReviews.text: Great place to stay! Clean! Great parking ! Easy access to the strip! Always smell good! Pleasant staff!

allReviews.title: First time great, Second time awful
allReviews.text: Vents in the room were disgustingly dusty, I’m talking thick chicks of dust. I am pregnant and was sneezing and coughing. The shower constantly clogged up. The AC cannot be controlled by guess so I was forced to be hot and pregnant. 2/3 elevators did not work in an 18 floor building. Again, I’m pregnant and either had to wait forever for one elevator or take the steps to my room on the 9th floor. Everyone trying to checkout at 10am was insane with the elevators. Also charging $150hr for a late checkout is insaneeee!

allReviews.title: REVIEW
allReviews.text: Had to beg for towels -when we finally received them, they were left outside of the room in a garbage bag. Was charged $45.00 per day for cleaning but room was not cleaned until the day of departure.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: Nice place and right next to casino.  Liked everything but their policy that you must leave your license to get a luggage cart.  Seem petty.

allReviews.title: Not a gold crown resort
allReviews.text: I am honestly shocked and disappointed that this is considered a gold crown.   It needs to be re-evaluated.  Although room is modern and clean, there were several disappointments.  Things to know:  Hot tub does not work and is not hot.  They know and say they have been trying to fix, but was not working entire stay.   The GFI outlets in room are super sensitive.  I had to blow my hair dry in the living room as if I did so in bathroom, the breaker would go and leave us with no electricity.  This happened multiple times throughout stay.  The maintenance team was very responsive, but said it is a well known issue, but no resolution other than wait for them to reset. The pool is dirty with leaves in it.  The pool cushions are outdated and so bleached - I personally would not sit on them as they looked dirty as well.   There is also no concierge service - they send you somewhere else that is not helpful for suggestions.   It really needs to be better maintained to be considered a gold crown.

allReviews.title: Unsatisfactory experience
allReviews.text: Accommodations are not accurately represented.  Our rooms were clean but the hotel was lacking in many aspects.  Would not visit there again. Too far from the strip, taxi about $35 one way, shuttle is a joke.  Not the drivers, but the inconsistency of pickup/drop off.  Staff at this location is untruthful.  Staffing is underwhelming.  Descriptions of rooms is inaccurate.  There are no multi bedrooms, what they have is separate apartments, with a connecting mini lobby.  Hotel is difficult to locate, adjacent to a casino that hides it from view, separated by only a small parking lot.  We would not visit here again.  They call themselves a "resort" and charge a fee for that.  It''s a hotel with a pool.

allReviews.title: Nice resort but bad services
allReviews.text: Booked 1 BR at Berkley. Bathroom shower not working... doors and locks giving statis shock, toiletries are bad quality and gave rash

allReviews.title: Nice place but needs better service
allReviews.text: Booked 1 BR apartment at Berkley. The apartment was spacious and well planned. Parking is available, and plenty.But noticed few problems... and spoiled our stay.Shower was broken and doesn't work well, toiletries not good quality cause skin rash... doors and looks had static current and always shocked us when we opened it. We were worried each time we opened door 🚪.

allReviews.title: April in Las Vegas, nice hotel and great weather.
allReviews.text: Our fourth or fifth time staying at the Berkley and we have always been satisfied.  We rented a one bedroom apartment.  (There are also two bedroom apartments available).  If not brand new, it was fully equipped, nicely maintained, comfortable, and well sound proofed.  We never heard our neighbors.  Plenty of free parking, and the staff was pleasant and friendly.   A very convenient location.  Two minute walk to Silverton Casino, five minute drive to the strip, and two minute drive to restaurants and shopping.  There is also a lawn with chairs.  Not common in Las Vegas.   Two concerns.  Not the hotel's fault, but it was spring recess and there were a lot of families with young children.  The kids were reasonably well behaved, but they were a big presence in the common areas and pool.  As a cranky senior, I prefer things a little more tranquil.     Second, what was the hotel's fault, one of the three elevators went out on Friday and was still out when we left Monday.  It slowed things down significantly over the weekend.  Long waits and crowded elevators.  On Saturday I asked a maintenance worker about it and was told the repair service wouldn't be available until Monday.  I did bring it up to the front desk, their response was polite but unconcerned.   A pleasant place to stay for many reasons, but I was disappointed in their non response to the elevator problem.  Things can and do break down, but they should have been more proactive in correcting it.

allReviews.title: Bed was good - but won't be back
allReviews.text: Not going to return.  Elevator was broken, which happens, but the staff was also rude, room was not the greatest and absolutely the worst experience of all the properties in Las Vegas that RCI offers.

allReviews.title: It Was Really Nice
allReviews.text: I highly recommend staying at The Berkeley.  The resort is not too large; it is family-friendly, and the suite was very home-like and spacious. I stayed there because it was minutes away from a bowling tournament I was participating in with friends.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: We loved our trip. Great location as it was an easy walk to the store and quick uber to the strip. We appreciated the wonderful staff. We would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Bad location
allReviews.text: This hotel was in direct route to airport planes fly over inch away from hotel. We would never stay here again. plus zero activities and the fitness room was dark and dingy

allReviews.title: A needed get away.
allReviews.text: Great location to the Casino and shops. The room was spacious and clean but the bed could be updated.  The only downside was the hot tub was broke so we couldn't go in there to relax.

allReviews.title: The Berkley
allReviews.text: Overall very good with the exception of the hot tub being broken the entire week and no estimate of it being fixed anytime soon.

allReviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas Stay
allReviews.text: We love the Berkley.  Great location to the Strip (just a short Uber ride to any of the South Resorts on the Strip.  The Silverton Casino next door has great restaurants and a nice casino.  The Pool & Rooms at the Berkley are super nice and its great the pool is open from 8:00 am - 10:00 pm every day.  Nice to be able to go soak in the hot tub after a day on the Strip or after the NASCAR races which is why we stayed at the Berkley.  Lots of free parking for the Rental Car.  Already looking forward to our next stay there.

allReviews.title: Great place but beware!
allReviews.text: This resort is wonderful! ❤️ However, my husband Drivers License was given to the wrong person after he returned the luggage carrier!!!! We called to contact the Front Desk manager to hopefully help others not to experience this HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE and she was very unavailable to speak with us after we were guests here during our 3 week stay. Lastly, we had a late check out and came back to our room to find out the housekeeping staff through away hundreds of dollars of our personal items, sheesh!!!We're very unhappy with these experiences....

allReviews.title: Nice resort everything you need.
allReviews.text: Very nice resort and look after you needs very well. Nice to have a casino right on the property. I recommend this resort.

allReviews.title: Location, Location, Location
allReviews.text: Great place if you don't want to be close to the strip but not in the middle of the traffic and craziness.  The freeway access is great as the property sits right at the 215 and I15 exchange so you can easily get to any part of town quickly (I spend a lot of time in Summerlin and Henderson and the access to both is great). Rooms are big and nice enough with washer/dryer and full kitchen which is nice when u are staying a full week.  Grocery store right around the corner so easy to load the fridge up with essentials and not have to pay ridiculous resort prices for drinks and small meals (just being able to cook a quick breakfast or lunch each day probably saved me $1000 for the week). You are less that 10min to the strip, 10min to Green Valley area and under 20min to Summerlin. The Silverton casino sits on the same property so you can access their gaming and restaurants as well.  Overall, I like this place and have stayed there twice.  If you want to be in the middle of the strip and use a timeshare week try the Trump or one of the Hilton properties but if you plan on renting a car and doing stuff around town this is a great place.

allReviews.title: Location was perfect for my business & leisure visit.
allReviews.text: Very comfortable stay. The 1-bedroom unit was wonderfully laid out. The view from the 17th floor towards the city was great. Easy access to parking lot and casino next door was in walking distance. Very close had been nice restaurants and other convenient retail locations. I enjoyed staying in a non-casino accommodation for my visit. I would definitely reserve this property in the future again.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and peaceful
allReviews.text: In silence, close to the city centre and the airport. Well-meaning receptionists offered us apartments with views of the city centre and the Sphere, against a backdrop of beautiful mountains. It was a very comfortable modern apartment with all the usual amenities, a great mattress on the bed in the bedroom. In the small kitchen you could cook breakfast at any time, wash, iron (there was everything you needed). Free parking. The long one-story building across the street is a casino, fish and mermaid aquarium and a unique, beautifully decorated shop for hunters and fishermen. There are plenty of cafe-restaurants in the casino if you don't like cooking yourself. We recommend visiting the Sundance Grill : waiters are hospitality gurus (special thanks for Lisa), chefs are professionals, cook very deliciously and serve large portions beautifully. The hotel has a heated swimming pool and a luggage room, which is very convenient. If we're in Las Vegas any longer, we'll stay at this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Great location!
allReviews.text: We loved this location, especially being next door to a full casino with restaurants. A Front Desk staff name Bre was a lovely person who rendered us outstanding customer service!!!

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Really nice resort and grounds. Absolutely nothing to complain about. There is a shuttle to the strip and Fremont street, but we did not use it.

allReviews.title: Looking forward to my next visit
allReviews.text: Excellent staff on board... always ready to help you...cleanness of the rooms, facilty and grounds shows the staff takes great pride working there

allReviews.title: Nice timeshare
allReviews.text: Everything was nice about this resort. Across the street Silverton casino with mermaid swim. Updated room, nice hot tub outside. Envigorating shower. Cooked breakfast a few days in room. Did not cook lunch or supper.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay at The Berkley Las Vegas, NV
allReviews.text: The Berkley was our upgrade from the Grandview in Dec. 2023. Here in Dec. 2024 we love our decision! All Units in only 1 bldg. Great Security inside and outside driving around the Parking Lot. Very clean inside and outside. Unit configuration excellent, bedding excellent. Berkley staff very nice and supportive with all our needs. Very quiet and a very short walk over to the Silverton Casino.

allReviews.title: Exceptional Stay
allReviews.text: I had an exceptional stay at The Berkeley, Las Vegas. The staff were welcoming and attentive, ensuring every need was met. I’d like to add a special mention and thank one of the receptionists, Ms. Ophelia Cogat, as she went out of her way to help us with any and everything related to our stay and travel in Las Vegas. The pool area was clean and inviting, ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring. You get free parking and its proximity to shops and restaurants makes it an ideal location for staying.

allReviews.title: THE BEREKLY
allReviews.text: Great resort, clean, well maintained, staff friendly and helpful, good location to restaurants and Vegas activities without the crowds,

allReviews.title: Silverado (now the Berkeley)
allReviews.text: Room was great. Tub and shower were still a little dirty. Hair around tub.Overall, the photos are most likely from when the Silverado was first built. Not a new hotel at all.

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: The berkley is our home away from home.  We definitely always look forward to staying here.  It's quiet.  Close enough to the strip but not too close.  Not crowded.  Plenty of FREE parking.  Silverton casino offers a variety of restaurants.  The berkley is close to shopping and other adventures.

allReviews.title: I would appreciate if you could make sure that the washer and dryer’s are clean and in working order please my room had
allReviews.text: I would appreciate if you could make sure that the washer and dryer’s are clean and in working order please my room had

allReviews.title: Anniversary trip
allReviews.text: Amazing location, very friendly staff, very clean and well priced.  Concierge was extremely helpful as well as registration staff.

allReviews.title: Holidays in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great location for those who are by car and do not recommend travel ara Vegas and do not rent a car, spacious fit, amazing view to the Strip in unit 1408.

allReviews.title: Hotel Excelente. Away from the strip and is ideal for that
allReviews.text: This hotel is close to an Amazon Locker, a few shopping malls, less than a 5-minute drive from an AMC (Cinema), and a 15- to 20-minute drive to the Strip.The hotel is new, very beautiful, the complete room with everything, kitchen, lava clothes, bathtub, etc. And as we wanted to make tours close to vegas that catches road, it is better and easier to access than every time having to get out of the straw of the strip.And in the days we went to Las Vegas Blvd, we stopped at hotels with free parking.The hotel is perfect. We will definitely return and recommend. Foi top.

allReviews.title: This was a great choice for us!
allReviews.text: Two friends and I stayed in a one-bedroom which included a kitchen, comfortable bathroom, and washer/dryer. The bathroom had a large tub and a large shower as well as a separate sink/vanity outside the main bathroom which is always handy. The room was clean, comfortable, and updated with quality fixtures. Parking was easy in the garage next door. There was no housekeeping service during our stay but we were directed to just ask if we needed more supplies. We did not visit the pool or fitness areas. There are plenty of shopping and restaurant options nearby but you would want a car. We had an excellent room for a great price and all three of us were happy with our stay!

allReviews.title: Very comfortable stay
allReviews.text: This was our first time at The Berkely, and it will not be our last time. We liked the location. Away from the Strip, close to the airport. Easy access to freeways. Grocery store less than a mile away. The 1 bedroom condo was very comfortable and quiet. The kitchen is fully stocked for cooking. Staff are friendly. As you approach the resort, it is a little confusing because the only large signage is for the Silverton casino. But the tall high rise is the resort. The casino is actually behind the resort itself. We were here on a timeshare trade. There is a sales pitch when you get your parking pass, but it is not too pushy.

allReviews.title: Comfortable stay close to everything yet private
allReviews.text: Very Charming active resort yet quaint and away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas Central. Great Casino on Property with much shopping on site and nearby. The staff was friendly and helpful. Loved my stay there!

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: This was a great place to stay off the strip. Huge rooms with a full kitchen. Easy parking and close to everything. Bathrooms had two vanities and lots of space. We would stay here again! Hot tub temperature needs to be turned up...it is not warm enough.

allReviews.title: Good spot
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: Don't believe them when they say they can accommodate an early check in!
allReviews.text: After a pre- requested early check in, we were turned away to return in 6 hours..Security then made us leave the property since we were not checked in yet. He recommended parking at mcdonalds across the street until we could check in..

allReviews.title: The Berkley is a Great Place to Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: This facility is Clean,friendly,efficient and close to all resorts yet away from the madness and crowds and traffic. Can’t wait to return.

allReviews.title: Decent place
allReviews.text: The resort is showing wear and tear. It needs to be updated and the bathroom needs a good cleaning. Most of the staff were pleasant.

allReviews.title: TMK
allReviews.text: The Berkeley is at a nice Location. It's near the Silverton Hotel & Casino. All the Front Desk Staff Employees are Super Nice and Ver Helpful too, especially, Alexis and Adam too.

allReviews.title: Nice Time At The Berkley
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: The Berkley a Great Resort
allReviews.text: The Berkley in Las Vegas is a small timeshare resort, consisting of one 18 story building, with around 500 units. The building is in immaculate condition. The staff is always friendly and helpful. Although you don't get room service when staying a week or less, you can always ask and get clean towels, soap, and paper products if needed. They have an excellent weight/exercise room and a nice pool and hot tub. It is located next door to the Silverton casino, which provides several restaurants as well as a good gaming facility. Although it is next door to the casino, there was no issue with parking or crowds. One of the biggest, nicest Bass Pro Shops is connected to the casino.  It is off of the main strip, but only a 10-15 minute drive to get to the south end of the strip. Although not necessary, I recommend having a car when I stay.

allReviews.title: The Berkeley
allReviews.text: The customer service was awesome, the staff was super friendly. the view was breath taking and location was so convenient.

allReviews.title: Spend the extra $50 and go somewhere else
allReviews.text: On the plus side it was mostly clean. Super loud, partiers coming and going all night screaming/dancing/running through the halls. Hard and uncomfortable bed. Leaking shower, drips/drains 24/7 after using. Apparently they also close down half the parking lot for weekend events and lock you in. The worst was no internet. The staff are aware, they try to play the game that they are unaware but after giving you very specific ways to connect (step outside your room, then fully connect, then try to use in your room) when that doesn’t work - you get a phone number to call and try to troubleshoot yourself (also doesn’t work)

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel away from the Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Berkley in a 2 bedroom suite.  The rooms were large, beds were comfortable and each room had it's own kitchen and living room. Hotel was across from the Silverton Casino and away from the Vegas Strip which was exactly what we wanted.  We were only 15 minutes from all the action and far enough that it was peaceful and away from the crowds.  The parking was free and we were charged a one time $75 total resort fee.  Would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: good times
allReviews.text: Great lock out unit right next to an elevator made it easily accessible. pool was lovely and casino, Bass Pro shop and Cracker Barrel were within walking distance plus the grounds and fountains were very nice and broke up the extreme heat with shade and benches

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: This was a great stay. Friendly staff. Close to everything but not too close. The unit had everything you need! The only complaint we had was that the carpeting in the bedroom was very dirty!

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: It was a nice resort, just not with all the bells and whistles. If we needed anything extra, like soap or blankets we had ro go get it ourselves. Everything else was nice. It was clean, pool was nice and relaxing and the staff was really nice. I loved that the casino was in walking distance, plus the local food places are cool. It's a great hotel to relax and get away from the business on Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best vacation place ever
allReviews.text: Everyone was very respectful and loving the place an amenities were great, the casino opposite Berkley had amazing restaurants and enjoyable food. Can’t wait to revisit

allReviews.title: Love the location and facility
allReviews.text: The facility was large and clean. Right off of the freeway away from the traffic of the strip. The pool and staff were fabulous! The only downside was the Silverton Casino, which is not associated with the facility, but located right across the parking lot, shutting down their gaming tables due to their new policies. So if you want to gamble after midnight you will need to drive elsewhere. Yet it is a very close driving distance to other casinos.

allReviews.title: Hotel from hell.
allReviews.text: There were 3 of us ladies who stayed at the Berkeley for 10 nights. Everything was good until 2 days before we were due to leave. Our room was accessed by someone unknown to us while we were downstairs and stole all our money.  We went straight down to reception once we realised what had happened to report it. We also phoned the police. Staff were very nice and sympathetic but we knew that once we returned to the UK that would be the end of it. I have emailed them on numerous occasions, but nobody wants to help. My advice to anyone staying at the Berkeley is watch your bag/purse like a hawk. DO NOT TRUST THE STAFF. We also know that this isn’t the only time something has gone missing. While we there, there was another issue with one of the owners. Would I go back there - not a chance.

allReviews.title: Berkley Love
allReviews.text: We had a WONDERFUL time staying at this resort!  The staff was very friendly!  The rooms were very clean and comfortable!  I loved the A & B rooms!  My grandbabies enjoyed watching the airplanes come in on the way to the airport!  The pool are was very nice and clean.  We loved all the amenities they offered and what they did not have we just went to the store to get it, example, laundry soap.  I washed everyday!  We also loved that it was away from the strip!  The Berkley is one of our favorite resorts to stay in!  Looking forward to going back!  I will be asking for the same room number so my grandbabies could watch the planes come in again!!

allReviews.title: 1 week vacation
allReviews.text: Although the Berley is well off the Strip, it was very enjoyable.  They have nice restaurants and a nice, but small, casino.  The place was nice and quiet during our stay, so the R & R was nice, too.

allReviews.title: Relax in Vegas
