allReviews.text: Great resort to relax by the pool, enjoy the casino and restaurants within walking distance. Free parking Rooms are a good size with comfortable beds and well stocked kitchen. Staff is friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Problems
allReviews.text: No luggage cart ramp on the side where the main parking lot is located.  Dishes weren't clean.  No whirlpool bath.  Showe drained extremely slowly.  Laundry soap, dish soap, toilet paper, etc. handed out like it was a prize commodity, had to request refills then pick them up yourself at the front desk. Had to wash your own towels.  Impossible to find without calling and getting directions because technically it was the Silvergate, the Berkely sign was impossible to see until you knew you were actually going to the Silvergate. Very dissapointed!

allReviews.title: Great stay for the familyl
allReviews.text: Will stay here again. The only thing is one pool for the whole resort other than that is perfect. Quiet and it has a casino across the way which is great to avoid driving to the strip.

allReviews.title: Vacation Berkley
allReviews.text: This was a nice vacation for me & my family. Only need a shuttle service to save people $ on transportation I had to pay $20+ to & forth to the strip.

allReviews.title: Facility fee vs lack of house keeping!!
allReviews.text: Stayed for a week. Had 3 towels, wash clothes and hand towels in the unit. After 4 days I requested new hygiene supplies. Was informed that the unit has a washer dryer unit and that I need to wash any supplies that I need.. I  was about to slap the lady as I explained to her that I had a facilities charge which should cover house keeping and that I did not come on vacation so I could learn HOUSE KEEPING SKILLS!! She explained that they would be delivered when house keeping came on staff. !They never delivered the face clothes. Thus we will NEVER COME BACK!!!

allReviews.title: Vegas Girls Trip
allReviews.text: First time visiting The Berkeley in Vegas and found the building and unit very nice and clean!  Nice decor in the units and SO very clean!

allReviews.title: Location
allReviews.text: It was located close to downtown but far enough to avoid a lot of traffic. Right next to Bass pro shop and the Mermaids.

allReviews.title: Smell of cigarette and strobe light
allReviews.text: Being in a resort with the cigarette smell is like to be in a hotel.Resort personal that don't care about their deficiencies are unacceptable

allReviews.title: Depends of your trip itinerary
allReviews.text: This was a ladies 5 night trip.  We had a great time.  However, we would not stay at this location should we visit again. We had to ride share everywhere ie, supermarket, strip, restaurants.  However, if you're visiting for the walking distance Silverton casino. Great location. We liked the room and amenities although the furniture was a little soiled. Not the best room view. Was moved from 1st room to a second. Surrounded by parking lots.  However, beautiful night view. Not a bad idea to bring extra face clothes ladies and families. When asked for more was told that's all we get.  ummm...... The front desk did offer extra laundry detergent. But we required more.

allReviews.title: Our getaway at the Berkley Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: I didn’t realize how special of a getaway this was because I was so used to the hustle and bustle of Vegas. But,when everything was going at a smooth pace and the weather was perfect . I realized that I had been uninterrupted, unhurried,  and I had everything I needed at my fingertips I was so happy to have been able to do this in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Fun in the sun
allReviews.text: Very clean, no smell of smoke, and amazing pool. Close to strip without being on the strip. Quiet pool and very relaxing.

allReviews.title: Graduation in Vegas
allReviews.text: Had fun and enjoyed our stay but the accommodations, like the ironing board were less than impressive, It fell apart when I took it out to use it.

allReviews.title: A Vegas Beauty!
allReviews.text: Comfortable, convenient and relaxing. We had family over. and they were extremely impressed with the facilities. The Berkley elevated our stay!

allReviews.title: Not worthy of RCI "Gold Crown" rating.
allReviews.text: A very basic facility, rooms were clean but a bit outdated. Horrible location, in the middle of a large, paved industrial area. No views, and under the flight path of the airport. One pro: Silverton Casino is next door, good restaurants.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Great place-friendly staff -great location- quiet location- would stay there again plenty of restaurants around to pick from for meal times.

allReviews.title: The Berkley, I'm as Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Berkley from April 28- may 2, 2024. The Condo is very nice, clean, quiet, easy check in/out with everything is within walk-in distance. We used to stay on the strip but now, we want the quiet and lay back atmosphere and the Berkley offered all the amenities of "home away from home". But you must have a vehicle to get to other area of Las Vegas and easy on/off the highway. But don't expect daily cleaning. It's extra

allReviews.title: Happy in Vegas
allReviews.text: This resort was really nice. Overall, being off the strip was good. Rooms were spacious, clean and updated. Security on duty at all times. A casino was out the back door. No shuttle service to the strip.

allReviews.title: Our 60 wedding anniversary
allReviews.text: We were here to celebrate our 60 wedding anniversary and dinner at our favorite restaurant. First time at Berkley. We were pleased with the hospitality. Everyone friendly.

allReviews.title: Great condo. We will come back.
allReviews.text: Loved this property. About 5 miles from the strip. Easy access to airport, highways, shopping and strip. A car is a must haveWe stayed 6 nights. Great smaller pool. (Needs to be heated!  Water was freezing so you could only set on the edge)This is a condo property and our 1 bedroom was quite large, great kitchen. Bathroom was huge and there was a separate makeup area with sink. Across from that was washer and dryer. I have never seen this setup. Very clean, great staff and no pressure to take timeshare tour. They asked politely, and we declined. Next to Silverton casino which was quite nice. Lots of restaurants there or you can drive to multiple other locations. We ate at Oriental it it was really good. We split and entree and appetizer and took some back to our condo.

allReviews.title: GREAT TIME
allReviews.text: Everything was great we really enjoyed our stay very clean, and the staff was super nice and kind. We will book here every time we come to Vegas now thank you.

allReviews.title: Nice and clean!
allReviews.text: The Resort is very well kept.  The Resort was very clean and the staff was helpful and accommodating.

allReviews.title: Great week at The Berkley
allReviews.text: Spent a wonderful week at The Berkley.  The staff was amazing, especially Irene and Alix at the front desk.  Everything was clean, the view from the room was spectacular, and it was my home away from home for a week.

allReviews.title: Silverton
allReviews.text: The top of the building has a large sign that reads "Silverton". which is somewhat confusing as it is the Berkley. The Silverton Casino is directly North of the Berkley. and in the same building as Cabela's which is a must-see.

allReviews.title: Great rooms, helpful staff, handy location
allReviews.text: Really lovely and clean rooms with great amenities and everything you could need. Lots of space, large beds, washing machine and dryer, dishwasher etc.Generously let us check in early. Easy to park and great area near to the airport and easy to access The Strip by car, as well as go for day trips out of town. The attached Silverton Casino has just been renovated and is really nice inside, with restaurants and an aquarium. Pool and gym need an update and could be bigger, but otherwise no complaints at all. Staff all helpful and friendly.

allReviews.title: Perfect vacation.
allReviews.text: Perfect location, almost opposite a shopping complex, TARGET, pharmacy and next to the Casino. It is 3 miles from Premium Outlet South. I will come back for sure. It has excellent value for money

allReviews.title: The Berkley
allReviews.text: The property by enlarge was not bad. There is a resort fee of $50 that I don't recall was made aware to me before arriving. I wish that had been clearer. I did speak with management and expressed my concern about said fees. I had never stayed at the Berkley and was truly looking forward to it. I cannot say for sure that I will want to stay again.

allReviews.title: The Berkley Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Great property in Las Vegas that is south of the strip but an easy drive up for events. The property is clean, parking is easy and the staff were very helpful.  Also, very easy access to the airport. We will definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Good for the cost!!
allReviews.text: This is not a 5star resort, but it is good for the price. It has a great location if your driving. It is close to interstate 15 and 215 plus all stores are within a short driving distance. Easy access to a Casino, and the rooms are a nice size. Maintenance and hotel staff are very responsive. Furniture and appliances need some updating.

allReviews.title: Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: The room was not that clean. I washed the placemats because they were gross, there was a long black hair on the table and good in the garbage disposal. We have stayed there before and it was cleaner than this trip. A car was broken into in the parking lot. They only had 2 out of 3 elevators working on a busy weekend. It took 20 minutes to catch a ride and the service people were using the same ones with their big carts.

allReviews.title: Clean, spacious and well-appointed
allReviews.text: We felt very comfortable here. The suites were clean, spacious and well-appointed. It was nice to have a fully equipped kitchen with full size appliances, a nice bathroom with a soaker tub and separate shower. The entire property was very clean.

allReviews.title: Fantastic location
allReviews.text: Great resort, close to everything!Clean and staff is great!Room has everything you need to make a weekly stay wonderful and easy.Just steps from the Silverton Hotel, great slot play and great food selections

allReviews.title: Quiet & Modern Luxury.
allReviews.text: Quiet & Modern Luxury. Plenty of free parking and easy access to the highway. Friendly staff and beautiful room. This is my 2nd stay iin 6 months and beats another stay that I had at Grand View hands down.

allReviews.title: Very nice for the rates!
allReviews.text: The Berkeley is clean and the rooms well stocked with everything you need from cookware down to complimentary laundry soap! We will definitely return and recommend it to our friends and family!I love that all the shops and grocery stores are just a block away and we were able to go get snacks, wine and get toiletries we needed for our stay!

allReviews.title: Good location for gettng around
allReviews.text: Resort is close to strip but also sits on the I-15 / 215 interchange so if you want to get out and explore it is extremely easy access to every part of town.  Room was big and relatively well kept and clean for this type of property.  Lot of close restaurants, convenience stores and shopping if you need essentials.  I was there for business and pleasure and this place worked out great.

allReviews.title: My Go To in Vegas Now!!!
allReviews.text: This resort located at the beginning of Vegas like close to southpoint, clean , nice , excellent staff and casino not overcrowded, restaurant award winning and the strip or fremont not far away so you can still do the nightlife

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: If you want a great place off the strip the Berkley is a great value! The Condo was clean and well stock with everything you need! It is close to everything and would recommend renting a car! Thanks Berkley!

allReviews.title: Best property
allReviews.text: We have been coming to Vegas every year since becoming an owner at Vacation Village’s and thought this property was the best.  Have stayed at Grandview and Peace canyon and were extremely happy with those locations also, but The Berkeley was our favorite!

allReviews.title: Great Location!
allReviews.text: Everything about this place was excellent…Room, view, dining options at the Silverton and distance to the strip!Would recommend this for someone wanting a weekend getaway or a family vacation looking to relax poolside.

allReviews.title: Great place in the LV!
allReviews.text: Great location to stay away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas but close enough to enjoy its amenities.Thank you Berkeley for a fun and relaxing place to stay on our family trip to Las Vegas Nevada.

allReviews.title: 3 night get away
allReviews.text: Room was clean and spacious , but at $40-$60 each way Uber to the Strip it became a little costly. I hate the fact that each time you arrive at these places you are instantly hit with the “attending the Time Share Presentation” spiel. Nice enough place if you like quite and  don’t need to go to the Strip every day

allReviews.title: Nice Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Berkley is 6 miles from the strip - which for us was great.  Close enough to get there for the shows but far enough to get some peaceful quiet evenings too.  The interior is a little dated but the rooms are spacious.  The w/d was helpful to have in the rooms too.  Would come to this property again in the future.

allReviews.title: Feb 2024 visit to Vegas
allReviews.text: This property is about 10-12 minutes off the strip and an Uber ride of less than $20. ( could add up if making multiple trips to the strip). I am picky when choosing resorts and hotels; this property exceeded our expectations. Large clean units with a window in the living room facing the mountains to the left and the strip straight ahead. The staff was extremely friendly. The Silverton facilities were in the parking lot with a casino, food court, and a Bass Pro shop. While it was too cold for the pool, it was clean. I would stay at this property again.

allReviews.title: Treated poorly for checking out late
allReviews.text: RCIWhen we check in, they say ‘welcome home’. We did not feel welcome at the end of our stay. We made a mistake thinking our check out time was 11, when it was in fact 10. Definitely our mistake. We were given a ‘courtesy’ extra 30 minutes. At 10:35, a security guard was sent to our room to make sure we were leaving. Not housekeeping, a SECURITY GUARD, sent there to make sure we were leaving the premises. It was extremely embarrassing as our guest was still there. I felt like I was being treated like a criminal. We were clearly trying our best to get out of there as quick as we could (front desk even called to make sure we were leaving at 10:45). I already had a big cart loaded up that the security guard could see and it did take me 2 trips. He stood there the entire time (again, like I was a criminal in trying to stay longer). My guest told him that room B was clear and ready to be attended to and he didn’t even acknowledge her speaking to him. Very odd behavior. I’ve never felt more offended at a place that I’m an owner at and have spent over $12k to ‘enjoy these services’. My wife and I will NEVER stay at the Berkeley again. We’re really considering if we want to continue being owners with this company if there are other properties that are going to treat us like this.On a side note, another thing that bothered us, is that we weren’t even allowed to have extra towels. We were told ‘this is not a hotel and you have to wash your own towels. Come down and get laundry soap’. I’ve never been told that at any of your properties and we’ve stayed at several. The fold out couch mattress was very poor as well. My guest has booked a massage for tomorrow to help with how awful her sleep was

allReviews.title: Clean and quiet room
allReviews.text: The room was clean and quiet.  The main problem was the power kept going off every time a hair dryer was used.  No lights would work and we had to ask for maintenance to come reset the breaker.  Finally gave up on using the hair dryer.   Location is good.  Restaurants and casinos close by.

allReviews.title: My 1st time at The Berkley! Loved it!
allReviews.text: This was a first time visit to the Berkley and it was an overall excellent experience. A few minor but still important points were the overly starched, rough bath towels, the internet was below standard and I was disappointed to realize there was no streaming capability when I had previously called and told there was. I'd love to stay here again and take my whole family and friends. It was nice to feel like a local but still visit all my favorite stores & restaurants.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay in beautiful property minutes from the Strip
allReviews.text: The Berkley, Las Vegas is a beautiful property only minutes by Uber from the Strip.  The accommodation is amazing.  It was the best property we have stayed in whilst vacationing in Las Vegas.  The washer and dryer were very handy as was the full kitchen.  The beds were very comfortable.  We would highly recommend this property to everyone.

allReviews.title: Disgusting
allReviews.text: Spiders in the room. Unsanitary dirty rooms. Many things are broken and not working in the room, including hot water in the shower. Staff is not friendly and not helpful. The “heated” pool is not heated. The pool is dirty, full of debris and bird feces. Not sure why a resort fee is charged for this gross place. Horrible.

allReviews.title: Not new as described, outdated and needs maintenance.
allReviews.text: In the RCI description it states that this is a newer resort - but it is not. It was purchased from another resort and rebranded a Vacation Village Resort.  It needs updating and some deep cleaning. Furniture and carpet is stained. Also, there are no shuttles to the strip or to downtown area.

allReviews.title: The Berkley Great Christmas Stay
allReviews.text: The Berkley is so nice and peaceful.  I love the Sulverton next door we had a great time with our family. We celebrated my birthday and it was also Christmas time the decorations are nice and the people are so friendly.

allReviews.title: Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: This is a newer, smaller, less known resort that was a fabulous discovery. It was as close to perfect as you can get. The views are to die for, the condos seem brand new and are well designed, and it is the perfect distance from the chaos of the Strip. It is literally in the parking lot of the Silverton Casino which puts everything you need right at your doorstep, but if you want to see the rest of Vegas a car would be very helpful.

allReviews.title: Great Vacation
allReviews.text: Overall this was a great vacation destination.  We were able to have the grandkids and great grandkids over to swim for 3 days.  I would recommend Vacation Village to all my family and friends.  Although the toilet paper was only one ply and was used up quickly.

allReviews.title: A bit far from the strip, but one of the cleanest rooms we've ever stayed in
allReviews.text: Location is a bit of a stretch from the strip/Freemont or anything worth seeing in Vegas, but if you have a rental, it's not an issue - you can park at Treasure Island for free and walk around the strip.  As for the property itself, parking is free and there's a LOT of spots all around - not something that is common in LV.  It's a very quite property, very family friendly and perhaps the somewhat remote location makes up for the quiet sleep.  It is also located right next to a casino plaza with many restaurants and shops including Bass Pro with their own theme and entertainment.

allReviews.title: Trip of the decade!
allReviews.text: A great timeshare, very close to reasonable food and the great activities that Las Vegas offers. Great staff, top notch facilities. Near to the interstate, 15 minutes from the airport. <$20 to midtown Vegas, A nice casino across its parking lot.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised!
allReviews.text: Whenever we travel to Las Vegas in the future, it will be here!  Perfect location, so easy to get around, incredibly relaxing!  Yet we still went to the Strip a few times (easily).  Found free parking at Tropicana and Treasure Island.  Took in a Show, NBA Tournament, FlyOver, and Fremont Street.  Thoroughly refreshed!  Ed and Suzan

allReviews.title: Great location the Berkeley
allReviews.text: I would recommend this place to everyone. Customer service was on point. There is an aquarium right behind the hotel and a casino. A bunch of food places with great food. So yes I would recommend the Berkeley to everyone.

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: Visit to LV for a football game and a concert on the strip. We own at the Berkeley. When we purchased, our representative told us there was a shuttle service available.  When we got there , we were told there was no longer a shuttle service This was a strong selling point and we are 😞  it I no longer available.

allReviews.title: Best Timeshare Ever!
allReviews.text: The staff was amazing. They catered to our every want and need. The entire team was polite and courteous with a professional attitude. I do not see us staying anywhere else in the future. They are the number 1 resort for us in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Berkley 2 bedroom unit
allReviews.text: This place was nice. It’s not walking distance to the strip but it was not very far away either. The place was clean and the staff was friendly. The units are a great size with 2 separate sinks in each that makes it easy for a group of girls to get ready

allReviews.title: Totally Disappointed
allReviews.text: Very poor experience during our last visit. As we were staying for an extended period for a special occasion I had requested a room with a pool view but what I got was a view of the parking lot for 2 weeks. When I asked could I be relocated to another room that not only had a better view but one that was quiet due to being constantly disturbed with car alarms, trash and deliveries at very early times in the morning I was told yes no problem for $75. After the amount I was paying for the stay and the bad experience the hotel staff didnt care unless I paid this fee which of course I was not prepared to do. They advised me that I should have rang to request, so what cost would that have been from the UK!! And what is the point of a messaging service.  Now to continue the waste disposal was not working on arrival with a terrible smell omitting from the sink, the microwave didn't work due to the wrong size glass plate fitted, both TV remotes were flat, the windowsill was full of dead moths so clearly had not been cleaned. Long black hairs in the vanity area and fridge! The shower area was dirty and mouldy.One elevator out of service the whole visit but not an issue as the hotel was was not busy and more of a reason why they could have moved me to a better, cleaner, functioning room, and to top it all off check out is 10am and housekeeping came to the door at 9am and asked to come in!!Totally disappointed with the whole experience

allReviews.title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
allReviews.text: TERRIBLE SERVICE from the receptionist I just (Oct 29,2023 @2:00pm) went to ask someone to check my room because the door gives us strong electric shocks!! every time we tried to open it and his response was that it is normal because of the carpet!!! They didn't even try to send for maintenance.THIS HAS NEVER HAPPENED TO ME IN ANY HOTEL, I work in hospitality and IT IS NOT NORMAL!!!!

allReviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Spacious and Relaxing.
allReviews.text: It was our first time in Vegas and this place was awesome. I personally liked the fact that it was away from the strip about a 15 to 20 minute drive to the strip by Lyft or Uber. It was super quiet and clean. We stayed on the 18th floor in the suites with the kitchen and the washing machine and dryer. It was the perfect setup. The bed was comfortable. The room was clean and spacious and the view was amazing. There was a shopping mall area with stores for convenience right up the block all accessible by walking. Oh yes and an In and Out burger restaurant. They did not offer room service and the only real complaint we had was that a couple of the days the elevator took super long to get down to the lobby. Would not mind staying again. Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Quiet
allReviews.text: We have stayed here many times. It’s perfect for us. It is smaller and quiet. Not to far to walk to casino and many restaurants. Pool is smaller but perfect for us. It’s a little busy during the weekend. But during the week it is perfect.

allReviews.title: A Wonderful Vacation Experience!!
allReviews.text: We were off of the strip, but that was okay because we uber back and forth; and coming back to The Berkley was refreshing and relaxing from the nightlight of the strip. The suites were cozy, clean and beautifully decorated. We enjoyed the resort and plan to return!

allReviews.title: Disaster at the Berkley, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Staff has no customer service etiquette. They do not care about any of your concerns. They charged housekeeping fees for services not rendered. We had to laundry our towel daily. No fresh linen or toiletries no towels for the pool. Horrible.

allReviews.title: Nice place/ Bad service
allReviews.text: 1st time at the Berkley Las Vegas.  Nice with large rooms.  Clean and comfortable.  A few issues with the front desk staff.  Upon arrival 4 clerks were seen but 2 were busy chatting with each other as people were standing in line to check in.  Then after we were checked in we had to go to another line and wait for a parking pass.  We asked for a luggage cart and received one with a flat tire that was impossible to push.  Later in the week we asked for 1 extra kitchen dish towel and were denied any towels.  Were told they did not have any extra towels other than the ones in the room.  A gold crown resort with RCI and not even one extra kitchen dish towel???  The staff was not helpful at all.  One package of dishwasher soap was provided.  We rented a 2 bedroom for 4 people.  We were there a week.  Staff was not friendly or helpful.  The security person was on his phone or on a smoking break most of the time.  Just not Gold Crown service I am used to.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable week
allReviews.text: Liked the resort as it is much smaller than others, our room was great and the location worked for us. Nice pool and hot tub and is right next door to Silverton casino as well as a nice Bass Pro store.

allReviews.title: Excellent Getaway
allReviews.text: This is my New best place to stay. Clean and sanitary all items. Great location and easy together any where in the valley.  Front dest was very helpful with everything we needed. We will be staying here again and again.

allReviews.title: Excellent Vegas Option
allReviews.text: We have travelled to Vegas many times , and this was our first off strip stay. Our accommodations were excellent; good size rooms, very comfortable and clean, well furnished with a well appointed full kitchen. Property is exceptionally maintained, and the outdoor seating area was a quiet welcome refuge at the end of the say. Being right next door to the Silverton Casino with their great selection of restaurants was an added bonus. Quick Uber ride to the strip…we never waited more than 5-10 minutes for a ride. After this stay, we have no plans to stay on the strip again.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay!
allReviews.text: We were thrilled with our stay at The Berkley.  Friendly team members.  Good location.  I have one request for future guests that is a simple fix though...for the love of Pete...PLEASE put a dampener on the pool gate door.  It sounds like someone gets shot everytime it slams shut.  That is all.  Thank you!!

allReviews.title: Checks all the boxes!
allReviews.text: This place has everything you need for a stay in the Vegas area. Accommodations are great, location is good, on-site food and entertainment is quality, and it is quiet.  There was plenty of room for all four of us. The full kitchen was handy for prepping food when we wanted to eat in. The food at the Silverton casino restaurants was tasty. We lacked for nothing during our stay.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: Convenient location (if you would like to stay off the strip, short drive from supermarket and outlets), good parking, good size rooms, quick check in/check out. 1 out of 3 lifts was out of order during part of the stay which wasnt great. To use the luggage cart it was required to leave ID (not something I had to do before in any hotels). There is a small pool which overlooked car park and nearby casino.

allReviews.title: If you want to be away from the chaos, stay here
allReviews.text: Convenient location to lots of stores and chain restaurants.  Nice to be away from the chaos of the strip. Either Uber or drive to the strip. Relatively clean, amenity-filled kitchen, uncomfortable sleep sofas, only one elevator working at check out time.Note: the building says “Silverton”. Nowhere does it say “The Berkley” on the building.

allReviews.title: Convenient and large unit
allReviews.text: Beautiful unit and enormous for 1 bdroom. Convenient to many restaurants and stores. Easy walk but a bit dangerous if you don't cross at cross-walk. If you are looking to gamble, the casino across the way isn't great; lots of smokers and smells.

allReviews.title: The Berkeley
allReviews.text: This timeshare is located blocks from the stadium and close to the strip. Great purchase!! Great accommodations and great staff!! I stay here once a year and it's definitely worth the stay. And the pool is open year around.

allReviews.title: Vegas holiday
allReviews.text: Nice property. Freeway close making easy access to get around town. The only real issue is the property has elevator issues. I have stayed here twice in the last year and on both occasions at least one if not two of the three elevators were not operational. It’s very frustrating to only have one elevation operational for 18 floors of guests and staff.

allReviews.title: Good deal
allReviews.text: We are very satisfied with the location of the property and enjoyed the service. We will surely plan to return and e joy once more the fscilities. The pool area and the activities ce ter plus the gym are great addtions to the fun stay.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Wonderful updated newer rooms.  Spacious and comfortable.  No restaurant on premises but just a short walk across the back there are several different restaurants and a casino.  Just a short ride to Vegas strip with many restaurants and department stores in area of The Berkley.  Nice pool just out front door

allReviews.title: Girls trip
allReviews.text: Everyone was nice and careless. The rooms are very clean. The staff was awesome. I felt safe while I was there. And even though it rained the whole time I was there I still had fun. The only thing I can take away from that is I think they need to include the entertainment there. Because when it does rain and flood like it did this past weekend. At least the guests will have some kind of entertainment that the strip have. Where if it's a club or live band. Because there's nothing that's really going on we was in bed by 9:30 in Vegas. And also I think they need a shuttle on some kind of car service to get you back and forward to the airport or something I don't know. I think that's something you need to think about. Will I go back yes I will stay again.

allReviews.title: The Berkley is Great
allReviews.text: We checked in very quickly. Went to our single bedroom suite and crashed.  The beds were comfortable. There were TVs in the bedroom and the living room.  Good view looking towards the South Point casino. Kitchen was well equipped. The bathroom had a nice shower and big tub. All in all it was a vert nice unit.

allReviews.title: Vacation 2023
allReviews.text: This property was very accommodating. When we needed a taxi, they had their own service that was very attentive.  The staff was very friendly and helpful. The rooms were spacious.  The bed was very comfortable.  The view was amazing.

allReviews.title: RELAXATION WEEK
allReviews.text: Had a wonderful stay for a week.  Loved the room, pool and the hot tub.  Glad the casino was near so when we did not want to go to strip we did not have to go far for entertainment and food.  The majority of the staff was wonderful and very polite, however there

allReviews.title: Best Vegas resort.
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful resort that is close to the strip but still offer privacy.  I love the fact that it sits right next to the Silverton hotel.   The resort is clean, beautiful, The pool is clean and relaxing.

allReviews.title: One of my best vacation
allReviews.text: I had an amazing time. The bad weather did not bother me. The staff are amazing. Casino walking distance. Lots of fun things to do walking distance if you want to drive And not drive. I wasn’t able to use the pool due to the rain and lightning. But I still had a good.

allReviews.title: Great amenities for a family in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Even without being in the chaotic center of Las Vegas we decided to stay out a little and we were happy about it.The kids appreciated the swimming pool, which was easy to access and their mother was happy that there was a washing machine so they could always have everything clean

allReviews.title: Peaceful
allReviews.text: Peaceful and quiet off strip stores around private entry, Security is a little intimidating like military, that’s not good. But the staff was willing to assist even when I lock keys in room.  Thanks for peaceful stay.

allReviews.title: Exceptional
allReviews.text: I had a wonderful stay. I love the home away home feel. It was clean, accessible to and from the strip. My second time at this property and I will definitely be back. I love the concept of having peace and tranquilty and then when I want to venture into the madness I can. The only thing I'm hoping for, is for the shuttle service to come back.

allReviews.title: A good hotel located off the Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: The hotel is clean, fully equipped, cooking utensils, washing machine. Restaurants are about a 500m walk away with many crossings by car. When checking out, we do not accept luggage for guests to wait for their flight. My family had to send their belongings to another hotel. That is too bad.

allReviews.title: Vegas trip
allReviews.text: Overall was a good trip. We tried saving money by booking here, which was a great deal compared to strip. The only downside was the money saved from rooms was off set by transportation fees across the city.

allReviews.title: Great location.
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before. Love the location. Not for from all the things we were interested in doing on this vacation. Love that you are still at a resort but not right on the stripe. Still able to have some family time with children.

allReviews.title: great location /reasonable prices /great rooms
allReviews.text: Our stay at the Berkley was wonderful-great room with view of the strip. Rooms are clean/roomy/well supplied and great staff.   The price is very reasonable. The pool is well cared for and the pool chairs very comfortable.

allReviews.title: A Wonderful Stay!
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at The Berkley, Las Vegas! We had a one-bedroom unit with an awesome view of the strip. The unit was spacious and extremely clean. Parking was plentiful. We were in Las Vegas for business and drove to the strip every morning - the ride was an easy 10-15 ride. The Berkley is on the same property as the Silverton Casino which offers, in addition to gambling, some nice restaurant choices - we enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and the steak house. We were happy that we stayed at The Berkley and would stay again as well as recommend it to friends.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay visiting Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very nice resort.  Well appointed.  The rooms were beautiful and comfortable.  We were next to a nice, large casino.  The restaurants were fabulous.  We had a great steak dinner one night and seafood the next.  The resort is easy to get to and there is access to all of the Vegas sites.  We had a wonderful time staying at the Berkley.

allReviews.title: Leaving
allReviews.text: For 160 a night it brings nothing to the plate. Nice view but to far from the strip. All restaurants in casino were closed so nowhere to eat breakfast. Nice place just is nor worth the money.  Changing hotels

allReviews.title: Grossed Out
allReviews.text: The good...The staff was very pleasant upon arrival, and we did not have to wait to check in, even though we arrived at noon. Refurbished rooms were decent. The bad...Most of the furniture was dusty. Stains on the walls that housekeeping should be catching. Carpet in hallways smell dirty. The pool is small for the size of the hotel. Old food up under the tv stand.The ugly......I almost broke my neck when I saw a roach run across the bedroom dresser. I've stayed in a lot of places and I must say, this was a first. I still have two nights left, and I'm already ready to go home. I'm on the 7th floor, so I can only imagine the first. Never again. It's going to be a long weekend.

allReviews.title: 10/10 for The Berkley Las Vegas!!
allReviews.text: The staff at The Berkley set the tone for our stay at this resort. They were all great!!! Patty, the manager, front desk Alex and Leo were extremely helpful and patient with our unique situation. I would say the entire staff are to be commended for the work that they do at this resort. Thank you to all! Highly recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: The Berkeley of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Close to everything like going to the freeway, gas station, grocery stores, restaurants, Starbucks and of course the Casino. Few minutes drive to Las Vegas Blvd going to the strip. Las Vegas vacation is not complete without visiting downtown Fremont Experience.u

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort
allReviews.text: We had a double, which is two singels with a shared entry. The room was very roomy, the bathroom and shower are great. The staff are very friendly and helpful. We have stayed at several resorts in the same area of Vegas. It's very convenient to the strip and other attractions. We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Berkley Weekend
allReviews.text: Perfect conditions, we will return. Plenty to do in the general location of the resort. The rooms (2 bedroom lock off) were perfect for us. Quieter location, not right on the Vegas strip but only 10 minutes away from the lights and glamour of Vegas

allReviews.title: The perfect vacation spot
allReviews.text: The staff was very friendly at check in and throughout the stay. The location is close enough to the strip to partake in the nightlife, but far enough away when you need a break. The pool is huge, clean and barely ever occupied by more than a few people. They put us on the 14th floor with a beautiful view of the the Las Vegas skyline. We’re definitely coming back again in the future.

allReviews.title: Pretty Good Resort
allReviews.text: Clean Resort, friendly staff. Should have car to enjoy the area, Resort does not have a shuttle service to anywhere. Wish they offered shuttle service of some type. This is not a resort issue, but the Silverton is limited, as far as restaurants & entertainment. Wish there had been pool towels down at the pool & you didn’t have to bring pool towels from your room & then take wet towels back to your room.

allReviews.title: Very clean resort
allReviews.text: This resort was very nice and clean. The pool area was a lot smaller than expected. We were not satisfied with this resort because when we checked in, the room that they provided us with was already occupied! We really hope this is something that doesn’t happen often but we won’t be returning to this resort again!

allReviews.title: Good location
allReviews.text: Close to lots of dining and shopping optons and walking distance to Silverton Casino/Bass Pro Shop. Room was clean and furnishings were nice and up to date.  Room was well equipped with all necessary kitchen needs plus an in room washer and dryer..

allReviews.title: Great Location for Family Vacation
allReviews.text: The Berkely Las Vegas is next to Silverton Casino and Bass Pro Shop.  It is not too far from shopping area and restaurants.  Great location for family vacation. It has swimming pool on site but swimming towels provided at swimming areas.  Towels are at your room.

allReviews.title: Family friendly
allReviews.text: Brought my entire family (16 of us) to stay at while we traveled to different nation parks and they felt at home and everything was conveniently around us. A lot of on-site amenities were family friendly as well as things to do for adults.

allReviews.title: Loved the Berkley
allReviews.text: Love the place will be coming back clean nice pool rooms are very nice would recommend it to friends  loved it , nice location lots of stores around it nice work out facility and it's very quiet not a lot of noise staff was excellent , didn't like the Silverton casino but it's very close to our fav Southpoint  which always pays well. Will be coming back here next time we come to Vegas

allReviews.title: R&SM
allReviews.text: The place was very clean, updated, near many eateries, 2 wonderful outlet malls and the staff was exceptional friendly. It is convenient near the airport, several great places inside  the casino behind the building.

allReviews.title: Good Stay at The Berkley Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Good location, and property. Will come back again. The Bass Pro Shop is near at a walking distance and also the Silverton Casino. Restaurants and shoppings around 5 to 10 minutes driving distance. I recommend.

allReviews.title: Las vegas
allReviews.text: Staying here is always great.  The place is in perfection location.  Close to the strip and fremont.  Silverton casino is next door so no need to venture to far out if you wanna stay in.  Will always come back here for sure.

allReviews.title: Great hotel and casino
allReviews.text: This hotel was great. Collocated with the casino. Was given some exceptional coupons to use for food from the casino. Variety of restaurants was excellent with great meals. Casino was a plus that was unexpected

allReviews.title: Nice spot away from strip
allReviews.text: A ways away from the strip. Pool is small but still nice and quiet area. Next to casino and a couple restaurants. Quick check in. Not bothered for resort tours as in some stays. Rooms we nice and in good shape

allReviews.title: Not looking for a Strip Experience
allReviews.text: Really enjoyable stay, the unit is spacious and nicely appointed.  Staff very friendly and accommodating, helpful with suggestions.  Everything we needed was on hand and available in unit, pool towels, extra tissue, paper towels, etc. The unit is comfortable for a couple or small family.  Nice and roomy bathroom with a separate vanity is a perfect addition to the unit.  The kitchen is well stocked with good appliances and cookware.  Ample parking and easy access to the garage or out door lot.   Driving or walking is convenient to many food places, shopping and casino.

allReviews.title: Amazing resort but beware of the special lunch
allReviews.text: During the check in I was told I had earned a free breakfast or lunch at a buffet at the south point casino and hotel. I was asked to pay $20 to reserve the table. Mybhusband and I were really excited. When we arrived at the wrong address it was a mission to get to the correct building. Then we found out it was a timeshare presentation. The lunch was rushed they gave us 20 min to eat and then we took 3 hours to do the presentation we ended up purchasing the timeshare but no thanks to all the miss leading information we were fgiven at check in. Everyone was so nice and the resort was amazing. It was very clean and no cigarettes smell. Recommend 100% but be careful and ask questions.

allReviews.title: Great stay off the strip
allReviews.text: Had a great time at this resort. Quiet enough with many amenities on site and in walking distance. Only flaw was miscommunication of the mid week tidy. It ended up being one day earlier than scheduled and expected so we had to wash our own towels throughout the week after that as we didn’t get a chance to exchange them. Very good setup and convenient location off the strip.

allReviews.title: Awesome place away from the busy strip
allReviews.text: The Berkeley is a great hotel away from the strip. And, Silverton being right there made the experience worthwhile. Starbucks is walking distance. Rooms were clean and the staff were nice. The only drawback was not enough shade by the pool from the scorching sun. Will definitely return

allReviews.title: Worst Evil Staff Ever
allReviews.text: The worst staff in the history of customer service.  The manager Asia supported calling the police and kicking out an owner (me).  Who kicks someone out for no reason and then have the audacity not to give a refund they have no class  and no ethics. The staff was clueless didn't know how to fix the computer, didn't know there was a  bbq grills, refused to all the customers to use the scanner machine and didn't know there was a scanner machine.  When I pointed out the machine they lied said it was company policy not to allow guest to use it.  You just said you didn't have one now that i point out the machine it policy not to allow customers to scan one page.  They were rude, evil, overweight, had homosexuals working the front desk.  Only clean the room once a week. Charged resort fee.  Asia the manager refused to give me upper management contact information, she and her staff member hung up the phone on me when asking how to fix the business center computer.  I would highly recommend not staying at this rude, disrespectful, evil, lazy, ignorant, and useless staff's resort.  Management and staff terrible it's as if they intentionally tried to provide poor service.  My Name is Charles Williams

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: This hotel was very clean and a great priceI would definitely stay here again just because of how nice the hotel is the one thing I did not like was that it was off the strip, but it still wasn’t too bad to get to the main part of the

allReviews.title: Quiet and well maintained resort
allReviews.text: It's nice to be just outside all the hustle of Vegas, but near enough to enjoy it.  The resort was very well maintained and clean.  I would recommend this facility and there is a casino on the property.

allReviews.title: I’m divided
allReviews.text: I want to give it more a better rating because overall it was pleasant. I just wish the first guy at the check in who couldn’t find our reservation would have tried harder instead of making us feel so embarrassed like it was our fault. But, the other guy made up for it when he finally found the reservation and everyone else was friendly and the room was nice.

allReviews.title: The Berkley was the Bomb!!
allReviews.text: Great place to stay and excellent location to everything. We decided to become owners at this particular property because of the location and the growth happening around it. The time we spent with Nancy, Diane and Cee was also just as rewarding. Thanks

allReviews.title: Great Vacation At The Berkley!
allReviews.text: Ny wife and I have stayed at both sister properties (The Cliffs at Peace Canyon and The Grandview) previously, but this was our first stay at The Berkley. We really enjoyed our stay here. The setup is similar to both sister properties, but The Berkley is the newest property of the three. We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Berkley Hotel stay
allReviews.text: We enjoyed the room and the view (15th floor).  The unit was comfortable, roomy, and well appointed.  It seemed like we were the only ones there since we rarely saw other guests but the staff said they were fairly full.

allReviews.title: Roomy, off-the-strip accommodations
allReviews.text: We wanted a quiet place with nice accommodations and easy access to the Strip and outlying casinos, and the Berkley delivered. Nice, roomy VERY CLEAN condo, comfy beds. (Pillows were pretty lumpy tho!)  Leo at the front desk was very helpful at check-in. Pool is small but looked nice - we didn’t use it at all for this trip in January. We will definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: November Stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Very nice modern resort. The distance to the strip is a lot longer than stated on their website.  IT IS nothing  IN WALKING DISTANCE!!!!  20 minute drive. Clean pots and pans in the clean cabinets.  Extra large bathroom was very nice as well.

allReviews.title: Better Choices In Vegas
allReviews.text: A little out of the way,.  Need a car.  No shuttle.  Silverton is not a destination casino.  The Berkley is just a building with rooms.  I would not even call it a hotel.  It has no amenities other than a tiny pool, with no landscaping, adjacent to the parking lot.  Not very appealing.  Craker Barrel, Blaze & Starbucks within walking distance.  Bass Pro on site, has a nice aquarium.  The best thing that happened is that I discovered Dutch Bros Coffee, just up the street. (drive-thru only).

allReviews.title: Wonderful Vegas visit
allReviews.text: The Berkley was conveniently located.  Plenty of parking. Easy in and out.  The rooms were spacious and quite comfortable.  Nicely appointed.  Next door is the Silverton -- fine restaurants, casino and wonderful aquarium.  It was easy to travel around the city and return to this beautiful resort.  We will definitely visit here again.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Berkeley for three days and it was perfect. Great, quiet location, off the strip but only $15 Uber to get there. Room was very comfortable, clean and updated. Beautiful bathtub. Friendly staff.

allReviews.title: Absolutely wonderful - Can't wait to stay again!!!
allReviews.text: Over the past 10 years, I've stayed at quite a few properties in the Las Vegas area, and this is my new favorite. It was a great location, wonderful layout with a nice kitchen, comfortable bed, and bathtub to die for.. There was also a beautiful view, well appointed and comfortable, and super private and quiet. There are plenty of stores and restaurants in the area, as well as the Casino if that's your thing even though its not mine. I  have no negative comments, and will be staying here again for sure.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Excellent staff and accommodations. Would definitely stay there again. Unit was clean, staff was friendly and professional. The manager, Patty, and the other staff were kind and considerate when I had a car emergency. Their efforts were very much appreciated.

allReviews.title: Well equipped studio.
allReviews.text: The Berkeley in Las Vegas is a block of apartments adjacent to the Silvertown casino. The block is a long way from the Strip, so you will need a car. There is a bus but it doesn’t come more than once an hour, even though they are scheduled every 30 minutes.The apartment itself is modern, clean and well laid out. There’s a comfortable queen sized bed and quality bedding and pillows. There are also 2 tv’s with a range of American only channels. The kitchen has a dishwasher, 2 x electric hob and a large fridge freezer. (Studio apartment). All cutlery, cups, plates etc are supplied and are in good condition. There’s also a free guest laundry on the 4th floor with a washing machine and a tumble dryer and a vending machine for soap powder.The reason I’m giving 4 and not 5 starts is because I specifically asked for a quiet room and one on the ground or first floor as I’m afraid of heights. I was put on the 5th floor, where there’s floor to ceiling glass and the room was the nearest to the 3 lifts that were running day and night. The room itself is soundproofed so you can’t hear your neighbours but the front door isn’t and the traffic and noise was endless. The Berkeley doesn’t have any restaurant facilities but the casino next door has a number of fast food and restaurant options and there is a garage  with a convenience store attached nearby. Just cross the 8 lane interstate at the end of the road, which has a pedestrian crossing.Would I stay here again? Probably not. It’s too far out and unless you have an apartment at the end of the corridors, the noise would be prohibitive for me.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: Attractive newer suites in a pretty good location- walking distance to many stores & restaurants. Right beside the Silverton Hotel/Casino with several good restaurants.Excellent outdoor heated pool but a very limited Fitness Centre. Great Staff & Service.

allReviews.title: Underwhelmed
allReviews.text: 1 bedroom suite was comfortable - nice to have washer/dryer, 2 tvs and a full kitchen. However, furniture was beat up, some lights didn't work, shower barely drained and housekeeping was non-existent. Hotel is far from the strip. We didn't use the pool but it was very exposed to the parking lot - it looks much more appealing online. We wouldn't return.

allReviews.title: Pleased again
allReviews.text: Love this place every time we stay here. Very clean, great location, great views and the friendliest staff.  Within walking distance across the parking lot to the Silverton Casino and close to a few restaurants. We look forward meeting up with Eugene or Dennis in the building as they are both so friendly and genuine on asking how our stay is. We’ll look forward to coming back.

allReviews.title: Very nice place - highly recommend
allReviews.text: This is a great property just off the strip to the south with a casino adjacent.  It is clean with friendly staff and all the needed amenities.  I love the off strip location and the Cabela's that is on property.  Nice pool and they promptly take care of all needs.

allReviews.title: Relax in Vegas
allReviews.text: We have traded out Mexican timeshare for the last few years , we have traded to the Berkeley and Tahiti village. For us the Berkeley fits best. We are older and like the peace and quiet, the pool is smaller but perfect for us. The casino in close walking distance is great. The restaurants in the casino are good. Tahiti village is better for families, the pool is awesome and has a lazy river. But you need transportation to do anything.

allReviews.title: Family Time
allReviews.text: We usually stay at this resort, but it seems like some things need to be updated.  A few complaints during my stay is the drawer that we had on our bedroom, kept opening and sand did not want to close should be replaced.  Also, during this stay the pillows for anyone staying on sofa bed were too small. Other than that, we usually have a great experience the each time we stayed, and still love the resort, but maybe need to reserve

allReviews.title: Relaxing Vegas
allReviews.text: The Berkerley is one of the newer properties with very good sound insulation.  We did not hear adjacent units nor airplanes.  Very generous with detergents, coffee, paper towels.  The unit was cleaned more than once.

allReviews.title: Great option for families
allReviews.text: The Berkley was a great fit for our family trip, 2 1bdrm units side by side. Decor and furnishings were in good condition. 2 washers and 2 dryers helped out. Close to 99cent store and gas station is conveniently near by, entrance/exit to freeways easily accessible including the Las Vegas strip and nearby Mall. Staff was great, a bit on the quiet side, not much to do at the pool. No room jacuzzi like our home resort offers. Love the drive up area in the back and easy access to elevator to get unloaded from your car to the room and settle in. Overall a great choice to stay with family and if you don't want to be in a casino. Silverton Casino is a quick 2-5 min walk. Not much luck there at the casino. Bass Pro shop is in the same lot. Great views

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Used to stay at Grand View this is 100% improvement on it. Easy accessible to the strip using uber. Clean and quiet. Pool never too busy. Would recommend to friends. Just don't try to use the elevators if you are in a rush around 10 - 10.30ish on a Monday it's check out time and we waited on the 15th floor for 6 minutes!

allReviews.title: Fall week in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We spent a week at the Berkeley, the units are appropriately sized for a couple with a full kitchen. 10 - 15 min from the Strip, the new football stadium, airport and most major venues. The Silverton is a short walk from the lobby and staff was very good. The Berkeley is a great off the strip stay for those who do not need all lights and glitter of the strip every second every day.

allReviews.title: Excellent Las Vegas stay
allReviews.text: The check-in process was super fast and - best of all  - no high pressure tactics to sit through a timeshare presentation!   Units were clean and well appointed.   Pool was nice with plenty of seating.  Exercise gym was adequate for travel needs.

allReviews.title: Always a great stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed here several times in the past 2 years and will continue to return.  The room is clean and spacious.  Staff are very friendly and helpful.  It’s located just steps from the Silverton Hotel, which is the reason we stay here.  The only mild negative is the elevator seems slow and definitely avoid it during check out times; this was because one of the elevators was out of service.

allReviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Beautiful, clean , spacious rooms. Beautiful grounds, located across the driveway from Silverton Casino and just a few minutes from the main strip. Great location. If your room faces the North, great view of the strip. Easy to get to when you travel around Vegas. The pool isn't too exciting. No food or beverages available at resort, only vending machines.

allReviews.title: Great view
allReviews.text: Good location although not on strip.  Handy access to I-15.  Casino on sight with Bass Pro and Cracker Barrel.  Handy to Strip.  Berkeley is like new building and what you would expect for Vegas.Casino has a number of various brands of restaurants.  I don’t recommend any except the Chineseit was good food and large portions.

allReviews.title: Needs improvement!
allReviews.text: Only 2 of 3 elevators worked to accommodate 17 floors! Ice maker in freezer never worked. Only ice machine is on the 1st floor. (We were on the 16th floor and ice was melting by the time my husband got an elevator to come back up!) Uncomfortable living area furniture.

allReviews.title: Availability
allReviews.text: We were very disappointed this year because although we got our allotted points for this year we did not even have enough points to stay at our home resort the Grandview. We have been owners since 2012 and go approximately the same time every year and this was a first for us.

allReviews.title: very  nice
allReviews.text: We loved our stay at The Berkley.  Our two connected suites were roomy, comfortable and had a great view of the city and the mountain range.  The only downside was that the pool was small and the gym needed more equipment.

allReviews.title: Fun Fun Fun
allReviews.text: Resort is very Nice and Quiet. Only wish there was Ventiliation in the Bathroom. The Towels pattern is rough to the touch. The location is Great right next  to Silverton Casino. The pool is small for the size of the resort.

allReviews.title: Home away from home.
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a place to stay in Vegas and like ample free parking, a spacious bedroom, living room, and full kitchen with washer and dryer, a one time resort fee and adjacent to a Casino (Silverton) with great restaurants and gaming, this is the place to stay.

allReviews.title: The Best for me and Kids loved it!!
allReviews.text: It was a very good experience . we are already looking for ward to out next vacation . Upon  arrival , They spent very little time checking us in to our rooms.  The only hiccup was having to replace key cards because the first once did not work. All the same , the rooms were very clean  , enjoyed the view  and was an excellent environment for my family.

allReviews.title: The entire front desk staff needs customer service training
allReviews.text: This was the worst customer service that I have ever experienced at a resort. One of the selling points at the optional timeshare presentation was the complimentary airport and area shuttle. I asked two different front desk employees about the shuttles and they both acted like they had never even heard of a shuttle. We primarily chose this resort because of the shuttle so it was ver disappointing to have to spend hundreds of additional dollars on transportation. The front desk staff was rude and unaccommodating.

allReviews.title: Property is great, check-in not good
allReviews.text: The rooms are fantastic for size, decor and comfort. Biggest issue was the check-in guy basically tried to talk us out of having daily room service (towels, bed make up, etc.) by painting a dire picture of the hotel FOGGING the entire room for COVID each time. Well it worked. We turned down the service since my wife has allergies. Then we found out that we couldn't get towels exchanged (sorry sir, only provided with full service). Ridiculous. The hotel was just trying to scare us so they could cut costs by not doing any room cleaning period. On a minor note, there aren't enough dishes and glasses for 2 people, let alone the 4 that our unit could sleep.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Resort off the Strip
allReviews.text: Resort is slightly off the strip and close to Silvertone Casino.  The resort was in a very scenic location surrounded by hills all around.  The view form the bedroom in the morning was very nice.  The resort had everything you need to make your stay comfortable.  There was minimal room service available every day.  Normally, you get them once a week.  So that was was a nice benefit.  The staff were providing any supplies we needed with a smile (washing machine soap, dishwashing hand soap, coffee pods, etc.) .  The parking was free.  There was a swimming pool and Hot tub available.  We did not use it but looked clean and not too full.  Las Vegas was hot (close to 40 C), but the Air Conditioning in the room were working well and kept the rooms cool.  Overall, we had a nice stay.  Will recommend it as a nice resort for all ages.

allReviews.title: Nice property. Management was a nightmare.
allReviews.text: Property is updated and comes with a lot of amenities. Had an issue with someone walking into my room. Manager Patricia, was extremely rude. I understand people may not like their job but we should not have been treated this way when we were completely caught of guard by a stranger walking in my room while i was getting out of the shower. She was completely dismissive, had an attitude and simply did not care. She made it seem like we were asking for too much to have our keys remade. Wont stay here again. Went on a tour and were going to purchase timeshare but wont pay this property my money to be treated this way.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay at The Berkley, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Berkley was very clean, the staff had a great attitude and it was conveniently located near several eateries as well as a Target store.  Excellent location for a quiet getaway relaxing by the pool or trying your gaming without having to go to the Las Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: Came here because of points, definitely would NOT pay money for this place.
allReviews.text: Picked it as it was rated 4.4 stars on RCI website. First 24 hours in Vegas we immediately felt it was worth 1.5 at best. It is away from all activities and good locations in Vegas, we did not get the free airport shuttle from the hotel because we stayed at the "vacation village" portion not the "hotel and casino" portion.- Kitchen sink smelled like a sewer for the first few minutes of its use, which thankfully went away (and we didn't get sick so I guess this was just a fluke situation and not a health concern)- Shower only had scalding hot or freezing cold - there was no in between- Ice maker in freezer did not work- No service elevators for staff, so they all had to use the guest elevators, which left them crowded all the time- Only 1 of 3 elevators worked our entire trip, so we waited over 30 minutes for one to stop at the 14th floor for us several times before just giving up and taking the stairs.- Bed was not the greatest, but I guess it works for a short trip - if you stay longer than 4 days then you may end up with back problems.

allReviews.title: Spacious 1 bed suite
allReviews.text: Excellent base for exploring- loved the Silverton Casino being right on the doorstep. The Berkley is a  lovely property with a great pool & offers peace & quiet from the madness of Vegas.  It was great to have fridge so we ubered to Walmart & stocked up.

allReviews.title: Good structure, size and clean.
allReviews.text: Beside the distances from strip the hotel offers a very good structure, the rooms are very clean with a good space. Until know this was the best cost and benefits in Vegas for us.The Silverton cassino is also a good option.

allReviews.title: Loved it
allReviews.text: We traded into this resort. Stayed a full week. Staff was very friendly. Room was very clean. Everything we needed was included.  Cracker Barrel is walking distance.  Silverton Casino is next door and many dining options there as well.  Kitchen well stocked and we used it for breakfasts and many dinners too.  10 minutes to the strip.  Ample free parking.

allReviews.title: Nice off-the-strip place to stay
allReviews.text: The one-bedroom layout was great- full kitchen; bathroom area with a large shower, tub, two sinks, and stackable washer/dryer;  sizable bedroom, and sizable living area.  One thing to note:  A two-bedroom is actually two one-bedroom units.  There is one hallway door that gives access to two units (Example: 1100A & 1100B).  So, for the most part, you need to go through two doors to get into your one-bedroom unit.  There is a pool area (pool & spa) and a gym, as well. The Berkeley is next to the Silverton, but the building says Silverton on the top.  There are restaurants in the Silverton and a Cracker Barrel nearby, as well.

allReviews.title: Nice off the strip resort
allReviews.text: Nice, clean units.  Nice, warm, quiet pool if relaxation is what you’re looking for.  Convenient location to grocery and shops.  Good size unit with extremely comfortable beds.  Daily towels replaced if you wish. Well kept, clean buildiing, pool area, and grounds.  Seems like a very safe resort.

allReviews.title: Been here, done it and will do it again!
allReviews.text: We really like the Berkley, it's location and easy access to all our needs: restaurants, shopping, highways.  The Berkley is clean and attractive, comfortable and quiet.  It is our preferred location off strip.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: This resport was a really nice place to stay. The unit was roomy and had all the amenities. It was close to the Las Vegas strip (driving) and was quiet. There was a casino there as well. We would definately stay there again!

allReviews.title: NICE HOTEL/ NOT RESORT
allReviews.text: Very clean and nice unit. This is a nice hotel but NOT A RESORT!  One vending machine and one ice machine on the first floor, and the pool is out front in the parking lot. Not a single amenity to call this a resort.Staff was all very friendly.Fine place to stay if you are doing other things and want a clean nice place to sleep but if you are planning on staying and relaxing at a resort not your place.  Best there is a small casino next door.No idea what gives this place a gold crown from RCI.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel, poor service
allReviews.text: Pros:  nice quiet location off the strip, lots of stores nearby, well kept propertyCons: maintenance issues first room had a leaking sprinkler head over the TV we were then moved to another room and the kitchen sink drain was clogged which required three visits from maintenance to finally correct by snaking the drain, requested additional pillows upon check in on Saturday but we were told housekeeping was only available from 8 to 4 and to leave a note to them in our room after several requests we received the pillows on Thursday, the web site for the hotel was not updated to reflect that shuttles to the strip have been discontinued and that grills are no longer availableOverall while not the worst experience we were disappointed in the property and will not return

allReviews.title: Nice Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: My family and I spent some time vacationing in Vegas.  The Berkley's location is ideal, it is right off of I-15 / I-215.  We were not in Vegas for the Strip and casinos, so The Berkley provided a nice place to stay.  The staffs were very professional and helpful.  Resort is new and modern and very clean.  The view from our room was awesome.  Check-in and check-out were a breeze.  There are plenty of space for parking.  Silverton Casino and Bass Pro Shops are right next door.  There are many many restaurants, shops, and stores along Blue Diamond Road.  It was also an easy drive (< 10 min) to hit all the restaurants and shops along Rainbow Blvd.   Red Rock Canyon is right down the road via Blue Diamond Road.  The airport is < 10 min away.  You can go to Henderson, The Strip, or Summerlin all within 15 min drive.  We enjoying staying at The Berkley while in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice but Disappointed
allReviews.text: I am an owner through RCI at The Berkley. Imagine my surprise when I got treated just like jo schmo who booked their room through Travelocity or whoever. The grills did not work and we found that out only when we wanted to use them so I had to cook hamburgers in my condo. Our whole condo smelled like hamburgers all week. When we checked in we had one simple request, that we be put in the same room number sides a and b with my brother in law and sister in law. We both called multiple times before we traveled and then asked when we got there and guess what apparently it was impossible to accommodate. I find this funny as the girl at the front desk told me if we would have arrived the same day they would have put us together. I will say the resort itself was nice. We love the location and the view from the condo. Silverton casino is right next door and has great restaurants and was not as crowded as the casinos on the strip.

allReviews.title: Berkley overall great a few small things need adjusting.
allReviews.text: Resort is about 12 minutes away from the strip and costs about 15-20 bucks each way by Uber -we thought it was closer. Units are fantastic and new! Pool and whirlpool are excellent but there needed to be more pool furniture for people to sit by the pool. They turned off all of the ice makers in every unit so it was super inconvenient to go to the only ice maker on the ground floor to get ice-irritating. On top of that the beverage machine was broken for the entire 11 days we were there. There are a few shops close to resort including Bass Pro Shop but for the most part you need a car or Uber to get everywhere.The resort is located right next to Silverton Casino which has a few restaurants and a Starbucks but to get to a grocery store or Target you will need a car.

allReviews.title: Modern and clean
allReviews.text: This was my second stay at this resort.   It was just as clean and nice this stay as it was on my first.  On site casino was ok but this resort is not near the strip so a car is needed.  We always rent a car in Vegas so we were fine with it.  In fact, I kind of like the slower pace vs. the crazy crowds downtown or on the strip.   You can drive the strip in 10 minutes or down town in 15 minutes.   I had some problems with coffee maker but staff resolved on the 2nd attempt.   Cablevision has a good selection but it went out in the whole building one night for several hours.   I will return again.

allReviews.title: Rigid Front Desk Policies
allReviews.text: I traded for 2 Units at this property because of a Trade Show nearby. One unit was for my daugh0ter and the other for an employee. My employee was allowed to take his family with him. I paid for a Guest Certificate in his name, Due to an airline problem, his arrival was delayed until 11PM. His wife's mother and sister arrived in mid-afternoon. He called the resort to give permission for them to enter the unit without having to wait 8 hours for his arrival. They front desk refused to allow it. He called me and I called the front desk and was told to call RCI, but it\ closed early on Sunday. I went online to RCI, but no latye changes were allowed by their computer system. I called again and got a very unsympathetic response. Requiring a 70 year old woman to wait until midnight was both unnecessary and inhumane.

allReviews.title: GREAT place for a getaway
allReviews.text: Traveled to LV for an extended weekend.  The Berkley was a nice place to re-energize.  Was a little too far from The Strip for my liking but we made it work.  The area around us had some good food and a nice casino.  Would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Nice Off Strip Location
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed this place.  It is next to the Silverton casino, which has amazing restaurants.  The Berkley suites are very nice, we put our daughter and her partner here and they were very comfortable.  Nice tub, shower, kitchen was well appointed, and they enjoyed the comfy king bed.The Sundance Grill had the best breakfast we had the entire time we were in Las Vegas, and a great price.  We also loved the Mexican restaurant, Mi Casa Grill.  Excellent food and the Cadillac margarita pitcher at $28 was the best drink deal by FAR.  Great service at every meal.The aquarium and nature preserve were awesome.  The mermaid lounge was awesome.  Loved them all!Best thing of all was that there are no resort fees… just one $25 charge for the stay.  We saved about $250 just on that one item.  We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Not worth it
allReviews.text: Not sure who they are paying to try to negate all the poor reviews but do yourself a favor and read them for details - I should have.Like others, I was initially impressed with the facility, it's a nicer timeshare hotel with full kitchens. Unfortunately there were too many problems and the staff is terrible which makes it as bad or worse as other properties.Had to contact them three times (not counting initially being charged 3x for the resort fee):-First time - asked for no maid service that day but could we have some new towels. Was told "if you refuse maid service you refuse it all" but they would see what they can do (huh?)-Second time (after letting them service the room the prev day) - told them we didn't need it that day, but that the maid didn't replace the tp. Was told I could come get some myself at the front desk.(wow)-Third time - called to ask why the maid was knocking at our door at 830a? They said "did you signup for maid service?" I said sure, which you said was from 10a-4p? She said she would have to call back. Called back to tell me they made a "mistake" (that woke my whole family) and meant the room next to us (A suite). I asked why they would be servicing the room this early right next to us? They said because it was vacant.The staff was argumentative, unapologetic and unhelpful. On top of that, as others have stated, beds were terribly uncomfortable and the jack and jill connection to the one bathroom was a hindrance and not a help. A couple of the electrical outlets didn't work and they have a ton of unintentional nightlights in the rooms. The fridge icemaker didn't work and there was no ice bucket for the one machine in the lobby.  They also only have one little pool for over 200 rooms.

allReviews.title: Great but beware if you need decent internet
allReviews.text: The staff was very friendly and the rooms were well furnished and clean. However my wife and I both do remote work, at least some of the time, and the internet was so terrible we ended up leaving a day early and checking into another hotel so that we could have decent internet to "work from home."

allReviews.title: Nice Layout
allReviews.text: While off the beaten track, "i.e., strip" a bit, The Berkley is very nice.  In close proximity to a large Casino complex with a number of restaurants, it works out great. Easy freeway access makes it convenient for trips out or in to town.

allReviews.title: Trying to Rip Us Off
allReviews.text: This place was honestly very nice when you first walk in. Huge suites, literal full kitchens, nice-ish view. But that's were it ends. This could have been a 4 star review, we liked it there despite the flaws and were being very nice and forgiving. BUT they are ignoring us.We staying in room 1005A/B from the 24th to the 28th and here were the issues in increasing order:- Beds and pull out couches weren't comfy, but you kinda expect pull outs to be bad and my back requires firm mattresses so I will leave this as the least of all things.- The lock on the main door doesn't exist, they told us it's cause the 2 doors to the A and B suites do and sometimes they are booked separate so that's where you lock. I understand the logic I guess.- The sliding door to the bathroom from the bedroom side on side B (the right side if I am incorrect in which was A or B) was slightly misaligned and made it very difficult to lock the door so our roommates wouldn't accidentally walk in on you using the facilities.- The main door to the bathroom from the kitchen side on side A (or left) didn't have a lock period. It didn't exist. Basically everyone on that side had to announce their intention to use the bathroom so no one came in on accident.- Coffee wasn't replaced, and towels and A side weren't replaced as often as ours's on B side. This prompted the person who booked the room to go downstairs and politely ask for some coffee and also to bring up all these other issues since we were enjoying ourselves and these weren't deal breakers for now. She also brought up this last issue while there which is the most egregious.- BROKEN TV FROM DAY ONE THEY ARE CHARGING US FOR DESPITE PROOF. The TV in side A was broken. I don't not know how, but it broken the second we turned it on. But the TV on B side worked so we didn't care, we just all used B to hang out as the larger group. We just TOOK A PICTURE and told them about it... TWICE. I was the one who gave the front desk my ID in order to borrow a trolley for our bags during check in. When I brought it back down to get my ID back, I told them that the TV was broken and didn't want them to charge us since we found it that way. The lady said was incredibly apologetic and wanted to get a maintenance crew up right away. I said we will be gone in the city by noon the next day (the 25th) and they can do it then.
