The TV was STILL broken upon our return after the convention we came to town to go to. We didn't care in the moment. On the 27th the person who booked the room went to get the coffee and tell about these issues like I already said and mentioned the TV AGAIN. Now here's where they get a ONE STAR REVIEW: THEY ARE ATTEMPTING TO CHARGE US FOR THE TV AND WILL NOT ACCEPT OUR PHOTO PROOF! They said they only have the report from the 27th the day before we checked out and NOT from the 24th the day we checked in! I was the one who did it on the 24th! ME! And more so we have literal proof, we took a photo, it's time stamped in the meta data showing it was like that since we moved in! And yet they refuse and want to charge us anyway. We were willing to forgive so much of these small but very annoying issues cause the room was "nice" and we had fun, but now I feel like if this is how we are getting treated that maybe if we pay that much then we shouldn't of had those tiny issues in the first place either! Zero out of ten!Guarantee we are disputing those charges, if you wanna deny reality cause you can rip us off, then suffer. The staff was nice, the management were awful. No photo here cause it was my friend and the reservation owner who took them... but it wouldn't matter cause you probably wouldn't accept it here either.

allReviews.title: Great location.  Close but not too close to the Strip.
allReviews.text: Great parking. I really like the smaller size of this resort.  Close to Silverton Casino and close to the Strip.  Unit was quite nice and very comfortable.  I will definitely stay here again in the future.

allReviews.title: Classy name for a classy resort
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Berkley.  The atmosphere of the resort, the staff, the exterior and the surroundings in the areas made my visit sooo pleasant.  Our unit was bright, the king size bed was comfortable in fact the entire decor of the unit was comfortable.  I give this The Berkley 5+ star. I am an avid traveler and have stayed at many resorts.  I know quality when I am in it.

allReviews.title: Awesome view!!!
allReviews.text: Clean, unit was current wasn't outdated looking didnt have a 80's-90's feel to it thank goodness. Great staff all around. Convenient to a lot! Only issue was carpet always shocked us in touching the handles to each door. The water oressure in shower was extemely low but the were able to fix after.

allReviews.title: Very disappointed
allReviews.text: We decided to try The Berkley as our resort for this trip to Las Vegas. We were extremely disappointed from the front desk staff to the size of the unit. The units are very small. When it came time to exchange our towels for fresh ones, we were told that we had to sign up for full housekkeeping duties or we couldn't get the clean towels?! The staff in my opinion, was extremely rude when I tried to explain that all I wanted was clean towels.Also when we went to launder some close we found that we were only given enough detergent for 1 load. We will NOT stay at this resort again!

allReviews.title: A Covid week in Vegad
allReviews.text: A nice accommodation off the strip in Las Vegas.  Easy access to I-15 and 415 to get to all areas of Vegas.  Bass Pro Shop on site.  Spacious accommodation with full kitchen (well supplied).  Even a powder / make up area with separate sink.  We enjoyed our stay. It was Covid times - keeping to CDC requirements at resort was a positive.  Timing did not allow us to take full advantage of the amenities - pool, hot tub, gym, and casino (next door).  We will return in non Covid times for the full experience.

allReviews.title: A very nice & new resort
allReviews.text: Well maintained & new resort; excellently located next to I-15 and near walking to shops but signage is poorly labeled where to go to unload and park because it is where Silverton Casino is co-located.

allReviews.title: Unknow Las Vegas treasure
allReviews.text: Berkley is lovely property with great views Of the Las Vegas surrounding area.  It is conveniently located near freeway entrance.  Conveniently located very near huge Bass Pro Shop and large casino.Once you park you can walk to everything.

allReviews.title: Could be better
allReviews.text: Room not cleaned as stated for covid cleaness as stated.   Washer leaked twice to no avail. Too many poi ts used for equality of room.the toiletries were in a plastic bag left on the kit hen counter and not put in pla e by room service. When i asked for the room to be cleaned it was done poorly....?..

allReviews.title: Love this unit
allReviews.text: Love the size of this unit and its proximity to the Silverton Casino. The Casino has many nice restaurants with really good food within walking distance of the unit. This is one of our favorite spots in Las Vegas. Away from the crazy strip. The only downside is the incessant music in the parking lot. I really don't need that all hours of the day and night. Other than that pretty perfect. And they do charge a resort fee (so what else is new), but $25 for the week, not a daily fee.

allReviews.title: A restin place!
allReviews.text: 11/25/21. After 3 weeks in Hawaii, I want to slow down before heading home to New York! This was my first time at the Berkley, I was pleasently surprise, it was well appointed, loved the BIG tub! there is no fresh air, recirculated air was dry! tempeture control was adjustable and  on point pool, jucuzzi and excercise room was great! NO ONE used them, I had them all to myself!! DELIGHTFUL!  The Diamond mall is a block away and Smith supermarket is a mile away! Silverton Casino is in the back yard! Lyst seems to be the car servive of choice.

allReviews.title: Nice to have an apartment instead of a hotel
allReviews.text: Because we had a car and have been to Las Vegas many times, staying in a apartment off the strip was what I searched for online. The Berkley was perfect for us. Complete kitchen, dining area, living room with comfortable couches, very large bathroom with walk-in shower and oversized tub, separate area with sink and makeup table and bench. We stayed 4 nights and it was honestly the best sleep I’ve had in ages. Super comfy king sized bed, lots of pillows, extremely quiet. We were on the second floor overlooking the pool and hot tub area. The Berkley and Silverton Casino are part of the same property. There’s tons of free parking all around the resort (but no resort fees), nice grassy areas with fire pits, Adirondack chairs to lounge on, a few restaurants in the casino. Because the Berkley is far south of the strip you do need a car or taxi to get anywhere. There are plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, gas stations, etc, across Blue Diamond Road but it’s a hefty walk. The odd things were - you had to agree to housekeeping during your stay but every day you have to call and request no service. During COVID, I don’t want strangers in my room. If you don’t agree when you check in, then you cannot get fresh towels or whatever. There’s a washer and dryer in the 1 bedroom apartments. They leave 1 box of laundry soap for 1 small load but if you want more you have to buy it from the vending machine. They do not offer late checkout. They will allow you an extra half hour but that’s 10:30 AM. Doesn’t help if you have a late flight. I had booked a 2 bedroom suite but it turned out to be 2 one bedroom apartments, mirror images of each other. Walk in your door from the hallway, then there are apartment A and B doors. Not adjoining. Not a big deal, just odd. Regardless, we loved our stay at the Berkley and will definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Spacious
allReviews.text: New, clean and spacious units.  Would have given a 5 star but pool was too cold to enjoy.  Stayed for a week but they never attempted to increase the temperature after numerous guests complained.  Flexible room cleaning available, didn’t need daily housekeeping service and preferred not having them come every day.

allReviews.title: Ed Wisdom  a one time guest
allReviews.text: This review is the direct result of the lack of care, concern and compassion  I received by the manager "Kristen" at the Berkley.  Despite having the ability to help. Her refusal spoke volumes. Our flight was canceled and delayed by 8 hours. We reserved the room for ourselves and another couple, the room was in our name.  The couple was not allowed to check in.  I contacted the manager explained the Situation  and she could have cared less that our friends will be on vacation  holding and carrying their suitcase for 8 hours...... you see they would not allow me to check in over the phone or anything.  Because they couldn't verify it was me......seriously, who knew there were phone bandits who had been hijacking rooms or had called ahead to inform of a situation.  I had offered to video call, zoom, fax, etc.  She claimed she did not have that technology available.   We weren't asking for anything more than for them to place their suitcase in the room.  Now they sId the only way they would change it was if our booking agency authorized the change...well guess what they said they authorize the other couple to check in however that wasn't good enough for the manager Kristen. It sucks that I'm already dreading going to the Berkley.  This will be my first and last visit to Berkley based on the lack of human care and concern, their obvious lack of passion for their guest or future guests speaks volumes.

allReviews.title: Berkley Resort
allReviews.text: good location, easy access to any area in Vegas.  Nice view of the strip and nice pool.  Gym was small but all new, modern equipment. Staff not always helpful. Room was very nice, most of furniture was ok. some was old.

allReviews.title: Nice units and away from the crowds
allReviews.text: Unit was GREAT and I liked the location. The building is a little away from all the strip action, which I enjoy. The Silverton was a GREAT casino to play in and the food credits were fantastic. I was very surprised at the quality of the food at the eateries in the casino. The staff of the Barkley could be a bit nicer and learn to smile a bit more, maybe act like they are happy that you came to their resort, instead of quoting company policies for the silliest things.

allReviews.title: Boring Timeshare.
allReviews.text: Absolutely no activities,  nothing to do. The Silverton Casino is old and smells awful.  Walking distance to a store is about half a mile or more. They do not keep up with making sure the vending machines are filled. We had ran out of water, no water in the vending machines, the front office would not give us water.

allReviews.title: Enjoyment
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Beautiful Berkeley. This was the best vacation ever. The room was beautiful amazingly clean and spacious. The bed and pillows were so comfortable I didn’t want to leave my room. When you are in Vegas there’s no time to sleep. The staff made my stay extremely welcoming and treated us like family. I look forward to my next trip soon. I would definitely recommend anyone who’s look for a great location and fun atmosphere to stay at Las Vegas Berkeley.

allReviews.title: Feedback on Vacation Village at Berkley
allReviews.text: Ice makers in both rooms did not work the entire week.  Drawers in bedroom dresser opened on their own. Leg was broke on right rear of dresser as you faced it.  Cleaning staff was excellent; new towels every day. Great location; close to Target, and Silverton was next door.

allReviews.title: unhappy with cleaning
allReviews.text: If you don't mind sharing blankets with previous guests then this the place for you ,housekeeping make sure you have clean door handles but if it's not visible to thee eye put that blanket back on the bed

allReviews.title: Peaceful Resort.
allReviews.text: Berkley Resort is a very peaceful resort. We stayed here for 3 days. From Berkley Resort we can go to any other place casinos nearby The resort is very clean, front desk is friendly, . Especially the parking space. I don’t have to drive around to looking for parking space like other resort . The room is beautiful, big, clean, and nice view…From my room I can enjoy the whole view of the strip’s lights at night.Cross street is Silverton casino you don’t have to walk far to gamble…My wife and I really enjoyed and had a very good time at this Berkley Resort. I would like to recommend to all Resort owners.

allReviews.title: Home away from Home
allReviews.text: I look forward to my getaways every year, and this place is all I need to be comfortable.It is truly a home away from home. Everything I needed was there. It is spacious, clean and quiet.The staff is very helpful.

allReviews.title: Wasn't that impressed
allReviews.text: Of all the vacation village resorts we have been to this one ranks the lowest.  No bottled water available on site the whole time we were there (with temperatures over 100 degrees outside).  Vending machines  not working and the casino next door was out also out.  Staff not always very friendly or helpful.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: The staff was great, and the room was clean. The only downside was that the jacuzzi was down for safety reasons. Its located about 4-6 miles outside of the strip, so not so busy. Because its not on the strip parking is great and its next to the highway so easy on and off to wherever you need to go. The location is just perfect if you have a vehicle. There's gas stations and a grocery store literally down the street. Great view of the mountains, it was just a great stay.

allReviews.title: Great Choice will stay there again!!!!
allReviews.text: The Berkeley  Resort  had a great location for all the destinations we attended. And the Casino was an added plus, that had great  restaurants. Will go there again.The staff gave extra, in assisting with app applications . And all inquiries.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay, relaxing...
allReviews.text: I reviewed it as excellent simply because the Berkley was away from the hustle and bustle of the strip. Only a short drive from the Berkley to the Strip by uber.  Also dining was across the street at the Silverton.  But a shuttle to and from the hotel would have been nice, also a convenience store close by instead of all the way to the nearest gas station would have been convenient. Overall, it was still excellent. Front office staff ( I forgot the name of the agent) was excellent, thorough, and friendly.

allReviews.title: Nice location, clean but public area smells
allReviews.text: Pros: clean, large rooms, nice bathroom, staff are professional/helpful, easy to locate, around good dining.Cons: small crowded pool, not so great crowds stay here, public areas especially elevator/hallways reek of marijuana smell. It's a nice hotel but definitely will choose another hotel since the smell of marijuana was a major turn-down.

allReviews.title: Vegas Vacation
allReviews.text: We had a Great time ,the staff was very helpful clean. ,We made the mistake and came to Vegas one day early thinking our vacation started on Saturday, The staff helped us find a place to stay that night and we were very thankful.

allReviews.title: Third visit in the last eight months
allReviews.text: My wife and I have spent over 4 weeks at the Berkley since October 2020, so we really enjoy staying there. It's close to the strip, but not walking close, but away from the traffic & noise of the strip.

allReviews.title: Beautiful View and Convenient Location
allReviews.text: We loved our stay at the Berkeley! The resort is conveniently located near lots of shops, restaurants and has a beautiful view overlooking the mountains (maybe 10-15 from the strip). Our unit was very spacious, had all updated appliances and exceeded our expectations for a memorable stay! The staff was very friendly and were accommodating with any requests and made us feel that our health safety and enjoyment was top priority.

allReviews.title: Great place to visit
allReviews.text: The Berkleys is a great place to visit,  perfect location with all your needs, didn't miss going to the strip.  Berkley has a wonderful staff, professional, helpful,  courteous and kind. Grounds are beautiful and clean at all times.We were on the 12th floor and had a spectacular view.   Keep up the good work, will be back in September!

allReviews.title: Kudos to the Berkley Staff
allReviews.text: Great service attitude of the staff. They were always cheerful and very helpful. The rooms are large and very comfortable. The bathroom is spacious, with a large tub and separate shower. This is a great location that allows me to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the Strip.

allReviews.title: Berkley is the best
allReviews.text: The staff from Zach the security to the ladies at the front desk to the gentleman who opened the elevator for us were awesome. They were courteous and kind. They cared. They made us feel like we were family.

allReviews.title: Very Nice Property
allReviews.text: The Berkley is location on the same property as the Silverton Casino. There is gaming, dining and shopping at Bass Pro Shops all in walking distance. There is also a Cracker Barrel restaurant nearby without leaving the facility. Other Shopping and dining are nearby as well.

allReviews.title: away from the strip, but still very nice
allReviews.text: We stayed in a 1 bdr unit through RCI exchange.  The unit was nice and roomy with a full kitchen and its own washer and dryer.  The decor was updated and tasteful, clean and well maintained.The Berkley is right across from the Silverton Casino which is nice if you are looking for some tables with lower minimum bets.  For those outdoor enthusiasts, the Bass Pro shop is attached to the Silverton Casino and shares a parking lot with The Berkley.  You will need to drive if you want to go to the LV Strip, but there are some nice restaurants near by.Keep in mind that right now, d/t COVID the hot tub is closed and their is no access to ice in the hotel (either through your own freezer or hotel ice machines), so if you want to make some blended/mixed drinks in your unite, you will need to buy ice.  OVERALL: Would stay here again if interested in being away from the Strip.

allReviews.title: Convenient and accessible
allReviews.text: We found our 1 bedroom condo comfortable and well equipped.  I do recommend checking the shower pressure, and all appliances before unpacking.  We ended up having to change rooms because of the shower head and the washer not working.  Maintenance came quickly to repair the concerns.  The Berkley is a short drive to the strip and is next door to the Silverado Casino.  It's also close to restaurants and gas stations.  We spent one day travelling to Death Valley and another at the Valley of Fire which were both worth the short drives.  The pool is open but apparently because of COVID, the hot tub was closed.  I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great Location!
allReviews.text: Love The Berkley's location that next to Silverton Casino and very close to shopping area and outlet mall.  Easy access to 15 north and south.  Swimming pool was closed due to pandemic.  The power was out for 3 hours, but the resort has back up power for doors, telephones and elevators.

allReviews.title: Spacious quiet spot but still close to action
allReviews.text: The Berkeley was spacious and well appointed. It was very quiet and a nice place to come home to. Unfortunately the pool was closed which was disappointing. They offered use of a pool at another resort but could not answer questions about that property. We turned down cleaning while there but they should be able to provide clean towels.

allReviews.title: Short Trip
allReviews.text: The Resort is newer and I like the location right next to the Silverton Casino.  Because of Covid a lot of amenities were not available.  I will come back after Covid to enjoy the resort and area more.  It was also short driving distances to many golf courses in the area.

allReviews.title: Excellent Vacation stay at "The Berkley, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Don't have any complaints. wonderful stay. Kids had a wonderful time. I recommend you bring the whole family. The rooms are clean and the staff are very helpful. Everyone on our trip enjoyed their stay.

allReviews.title: visit family
allReviews.text: was very nice and close to lot of things.  unit was clean but would have liked couch to pullout for sleeping. and table was big but wobbly.  cleaning staff were friendly and other guests that we met were very pleasant

allReviews.title: Don’t miss Berkley of Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Berkeley is an upstanding resort other RCI members should take notice of..people eho are particular with sheets n towels changed everyday will love the place..i think this place is undernoticed n underscored since i was talking to other owners of Berkeley and nobody seems to know what it is and where it is located..

allReviews.title: Highly Recommend!
allReviews.text: My daughter and I really enjoyed our stay. The facility looked and smelled clean. We didn’t have any health or safety concerns. It’s new, it’s modern so we loved it! Location is GREAT! I would stay again, as I travel often to Vegas for business. I highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Nice room/suite
allReviews.text: Very clean , handy to casinos, restaurants, strip. Nice Pool/Hot tub area. Had a special request for a ground floor room and that was handled perfect. Thank you to manager Johnny for making it happen. Also had a Motorhome we needed to park, and that was also handled to our satisfaction. Will come back.

allReviews.title: Amazing service orientation at the Berkley
allReviews.text: We've stayed in numerous timeshares through the United States including several in around the Las Vegas area.  Without any hesitation, the Berkley was one of the best experiences we've had. A vehicle is an absolute necessity to travel given the Berkley's location.   However, you will not be disappointed with the quality of the rooms, the cleanliness and the attention to service.  We had an issue with the shower head and this was immediately dealt with when we explained the situation to Caesar at the front desk.  We also did not have ice in the refrigerator and a bag of ice was delivered to our door with minutes.  Outstanding service!

allReviews.title: Lack of Security
allReviews.text: The property is nice but it lacks real security which can be an issue in Vegas. We were located on the 16th floor and were approached by a street person when we got off the elevator to go to our room. It took 2 calls to security before she was removed. Not a very pleasant experience.

allReviews.title: Nice Room with a few issues.
allReviews.text: Overall, the room was nice.  Lots of room with a full kitchen that was fully furnished with pots, dishes, etc...  The towels however felt like drying off with a piece of sandpaper.  I have never had a towel that was so rough.  Also, when you walk into the lobby it looks shabby.  There is not a single decoration, picture, or anything.  I have seen more nicely decorated lobbies in Super 8 motels   Pool is small.  For a place that is listed as a 4 star facility they need to make some improvements.  Staff and check in were great.

allReviews.title: Relaxing stay
allReviews.text: We were treated very well. Everything was comfortable and enjoyable This resort is very close to everything we like about Vegas. Restful relaxing quiet and friendly staff We would stay there anytime we can get away First class all the way

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: The location is Village of Silverton with access to restaurants, bars, casinos s. Our suite was very nice and very clean.Great view form the 17th floor. The location is conveniently off the strip but very easy to navigate. We definitely the Berkley resort Las Vegas to couples who is looking a good time home a way from home.

allReviews.title: The Berkley
allReviews.text: Nice room very clean and well organized.  The pool, however, has no shade and the direct sun makes it uncomfortable to use.  The Casino is great with lots of restraunts, drinks were very good while gambling.

allReviews.title: BOB & EVIE
allReviews.text: Great place with casino, food and shop, off the strip.Great view form the top  floors, with the rooms very nicely appointed. the staff was more then helpful on what ever you needed.  Being off the strip, but you could drive to the center of the strip with in 15 minutes. All the major hotels have parking available at a reasonable cost. .

allReviews.title: Great all around
allReviews.text: The room was very nice and very clean.  The overall feel was that it was new and hardly used.  The location is off the strip but very easy to navigate to any where you want to visit either on the strip or a day trip.  Highly recommend this property!

allReviews.title: Pleasure vacation
allReviews.text: The Berkley is great Same condo and layout we are a custom to. It’s like being at home. Nice lock off unit for our friends. Casino and restaurants right next door. Shuttle service ti the strip and close Uber ride to Smiths grocery store. Highly recommend The Berkley

allReviews.title: A great place off the strip.
allReviews.text: Everything was very comfortable and clean. A safe neighborhood with shopping and a casino not far. If you are staying for a week the bedsheets are replaced. The staff was responsive to our requests. Great restaurants and coffee nearby.

allReviews.title: A place to rest your head
allReviews.text: So a couple years ago I wrote a review that was pretty bad for this place. We decided to give it another chance and had a somewhat better experience. The positives: room doesnt have a normal hotel smell. Staff was very friendly. Room was pretty clean and quite. Location was very ideal if you're looking to stay off the strip. The negatives: they said the bed was a queen but there is no way that small thing could have been a queen. If you try to plug in ANYTHING you cant get it into the wall plugs so good luck. Very cold water in the shower for the first couple minutes. Otherwise a decent hotel and if the price is right we may stay again.

allReviews.title: Excellent apartment, value for money
allReviews.text: This maybe outside of the strip but worth it for the savings on the apartment & lovely pool & sauna area. Apartment would easily sleep 4 but you could hold a party for more...... large bathroom & kitchen equiped with all you need.

allReviews.title: Grand Canyon Vaca. 2019
allReviews.text: The Berkeley is a great vacation resort. We loved that it is located a short drive off the strip. Convenient drive to lots of attractions. Area is more residential. Quiet, clean, great staff, surrounded with a great variety of restaurants and casinos, easy to navigate,... Just a great overall experience.

allReviews.title: fabulous laid back resort with an incredible view!
allReviews.text: Quiet resort just steps from the Silverton casino, which has great dining options. Good sized rooms with plenty of amenities. Nice pool, set at bath water temperatures. Recommend a high floor with a view of the Vegas strip!!

allReviews.title: Great property! Please fix privacy issues!!
allReviews.text: There needs to be a door between washroom and bedroom. I can’t believe a door wasn’t added when these units were built! Guests in the bedroom are disturbed by Anyone using the washroom at night! This makes no sense whatsoever! PLEASE FIX!!

allReviews.title: Las-Vegas_Berkley
allReviews.text: Great place off the strip...  Very nice Casino (Silverton) right next door...   If you are looking for a quiet place to relax, and still have access to the hustle/bustle of the strip, this is the place to be.

allReviews.title: Great vacation
allReviews.text: I travel with my sister our last visit to Vegas was 10 years ago there are a lot of changes. Our stay at the Berkeley resort was great it’s clean staff was very friendly and accommodating and with access to Silverton Casino Resort especially shuttle service we had a very unstressful week we would definitely recommend the Berkeley.

allReviews.title: Great stay at The Berkley
allReviews.text: Just finished a 1 week stay for my 25th wedding anniversary and it was great. I told them it was our anniversary when I booked it and they put us on the top floor with a view of the strip. And they wished us a Happy Anniversary when we checked in. Staff was friendly throughout and it’s a really nice resort. Silverton Casino across the street is very convenient for gambling, food and some good deals. Shuttle to and from the strip is a nice perk. Overall it was a great vacation

allReviews.title: Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Away from The Strip, but close enough if you want to go there.  Casino next door is large, clean, and doesn't stink too bad from smoke.  Easy to get to Death Valley and Red Rocks.  Short drive to the airport.  Close to decent restaurants (Bootleggers, South Pointe).

allReviews.title: Beyond Expectations!
allReviews.text: We stayed for a week. The Berkley is a relatively new, high quality, hi-rise condo complex. We got assigned a three room and 1½ bathroom condo. It is conveniently located off of three north/south routes near the LV strip: I-15, South LV Blvd, as well as Dean Martin Rd. just a few miles south of the strip at Blue Diamond Highway. The facility abuts the very nice Silverton Casino Resort, so one can walk there easily from your unit. For some reason we were lucky enough to be put in a top floor (18th floor) unit.  Some of the views from up there were spectacular and they had abundant and fast elevators so getting up and down 18 stories was surprisingly fast and efficient.  Surface parking was also conveniently located, abundant, and free.The condo unit included a granite-covered countertop kitchen with a full-size kitchen table and was fully applianced and fully accessorized. In addition, the unit featured two large flat screen TVs, one in the living room and one in the bedroom and there was a private washer & dryer within the unit with detergent and an iron and ironing board provided.After getting settled in the condo, we took a quick trip to a nearby Smith’s Supermarket on South LV Blvd. to get breakfast and other items such as coffee, milk, bagels, cream cheese, soft drinks, snacks, etc.After the long trip that day flying from the east coast, and the time change, and a large lunch before checking in, we were very happy to just stay in our unit the first night of our trip here.  We would stay here again if a unit were available here again.

allReviews.title: Short Walk to the Casino
allReviews.text: This is a great place to stay the 2BR lock out gives you two one bedroom full apartments. Each with its own Bath & Kitchen. Staff is great and very helpful.and the Pool & Hot Tub are great and not at all crowded.Its a very short walk to the Casino and Dinning at the Silverton.

allReviews.title: Very Nice Las Vegas Property
allReviews.text: We stayed at this location in September of 2019.  Vacation Village has a very nice propery here in Las Vegas.  The rooms were what you would expect for a Gold Crown property; nice, clean, quiet, private, etc...  Everything felt like it was new and very well maintained.  Nice big bathroom with a shower and a jacuzzi tub.  The bed and pillows were very comfortable. We would absolutely stay here again.  The swimming pool and hot tub were great!  It is on the south side of the building and it has sun on it most of the day.  You can lay out and get a good baking and then cool off in the pool.  The grounds are very clean and maintained. It was nice to be across the street from the Silverton Casino and the BassPro Shop (easy walk).  They have a shuttle that will run you down to The Strip, so you don't have to worry about parking down there in that mess and you can have a great time (drink a few) and you don't have to worry about driving back. We had a great week!

allReviews.title: What a trip
allReviews.text: Checking in was a huge PIA (pain in the a$$) but the rest of the stay was amazing. The suite was clean and comfortable. The rooms are very well laid out and quiet. My suite was really great. They have kitchenettes and nice large bathrooms as well as sitting area and very comfortable bed. I was happy that I had the opportunity to speak with a manager because she was able to take care of the issues that the staff were not as far as checking in went. Over all, my stay was really great. I highly recommend this hotel and will stay again!

allReviews.title: Finally able to stay
allReviews.text: i have been wanting t stay there since they opened. I loved it. They only have one pool but it is perfect to hang out in. The hot tub was the  biggest I have ever seen. The room was spacious. Our family loved it.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Our last visit to Vegas was 30 years ago and boy has it changed. We are not gamblers but there is so much to do and see. We ventured out to state and national parks in the day and took in shows at night.  The Berkley was a great home base.

allReviews.title: What a great place
allReviews.text: Super  clean and quite. Staff are excellent. Out of the vegas crazy strip area. Lots of nice places to eat at the silverton next door.  Highly recommended. Excellent parking and the AC works great! We will definitely be back soon. Much nicer than the Grandview. The location is superb if you want a relaxing time in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Booking experience so bad, I ended up not even staying there!
allReviews.text: If I could give this hotel 0 stars, I would. The rating and experience is based on the booking process before the stay. In fact, it was so terrible that I didn't even end up staying at the hotel, hesitant to drive 6+ hours to find out my room wouldn't even be available or something of the likes.I lost all hope in this company after they gave me the runaround with my reservation for a "free" stay that I "won". I am ashamed to say I fell for their marketing scheme at first, but quickly realized I was being scammed. It took weeks to receive my confirmation, the details were wrong (and took several attempts to correct), the GM of their sales/marketing office was extremely rude and degrading to me when I tried to rebook or get a refund for my stay, and the experience was so horrendous overall that I have cancelled my stay and taken the $50.00 loss. It's not worth any more of my time to deal with such an organization, daring to scam people and take advantage of customers.I was told I could rebook or change my reservation "with no problem" but then that turned into me having to jump through several hoops to reschedule with or without a fee, due to a medical reason. I will never stay at this resort or any associated property.USE CAUTION IF YOU BOOK A STAY WITH THIS COMPANY!

allReviews.title: My Berkeley stay
allReviews.text: Clean and very good location & excellent staff. Rooms are clean with all appliances. Microwave was a good size. Happy to see a a dishwasher and washer and drier combo. Enough parking space next to the building

allReviews.title: yes to berkeley
allReviews.text: the bekeley was very clean wonderful experience staff went out of the way to make sure the experience is wonderful  great location great window views not crowded next to the casino stores and eating area close by

allReviews.title: Nice, Clean and Meets Your Basic Travel Needs
allReviews.text: We stayed August 4th-10th.  Front desk staff was pleasant (contrary to previous reviews) and we quickly were able to check in.  Parking was excellent (although it did seem occupancy may have been lower mid week).  Room was comfortable, good size and bed was also comfortable!  Bathroom was huge with deep soaking tub.  Also we found it quiet.   View of the strip and airport in the distance was nice. View below of truck parking across the highway was not.Only big con for us was that the hotel must must add card key guest entry only access to the doors at night. My husband had a strange encounter at dawn walking over to the Silverton with a person who appeared to have come out of the hotel resulting in in the casino calling security on the person!Otherwise it was a convenient location close to casino, fast food and grocery.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend!
allReviews.text: It’s a bit off the beaten path, but a nice change of pace from the bustling strip. Our 1 bedroom unit exceeded our expectations. It is steps from the local Silverton Casino and it’s varied dining options.

allReviews.title: I would say again
allReviews.text: Our over all stay as a family was a good one. We stayed from Thursday-Sunday.  The hotel was always clean the staff was very helpful and friendly.  The rooms are very spacious and come equipped with everything that you might need.  The beds were very comfortable. There is just a few minor issues that I did have... One was that electricity in the bathroom and bedroom kept on shorting out every time I used my hair dryer. Second Checking out on Sunday was a challenge...the elevator was packed with others, all trying to check out at the same time. Took up 10 minutes just to get on the elevator to get down to the lobby. Last check out is at 10:00AM

allReviews.title: Berkeley Las vega
allReviews.text: satisfied , because  it's quite, clining and the employee very friendly I recomende other people to visiting Berkeley Las Vegas.Also now I am refer my friend with name Horacio I hope he enjoy that place like me

allReviews.title: BFF bday Celebration
allReviews.text: Beautiful place to stay. Loved the rooms plenty of space & had a great few. Close to everything. I had a blast we visit again. Had to separate fully equipped rooms which was great. The management staff was great. Thanks for a wonderful experience.

allReviews.title: 2 weeks in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We recently stayed in The Berkley Las VegasWe stayed in an apartment on the 16th floorWe found the apartment to be very well equipped and very modern in the standard of fixtures and fittings The bed was very comfortable The bathroom was large and included a deep bath and a shower The location was very quietly and they do a free shuttle to the Las Vegas Strip, you get dropped off at the Aria Casino There is a Casino next door called the Silverton Which serves good food at a reasonable price$18 for a All You Can Eat Buffet in the Seasons restaurant

allReviews.title: Horrible customer service
allReviews.text: I booked a room at the Berkley resort in Las Vegas. Unfortunately, I came down with pneumonia and was told by my doctor not to fly. I tried contacting Vacation Village in time to cancel, but they weren't open during the hours I needed to speak to someone. When I finally reached them and explained my situation and asked if I could reschedule, they told me it would be another 50.00. I tried to get a refund, and they said it was out of the question. I even offered to get a doctors note. I can't believe how rude and unprofessional the staff were. Buyer beware and don't take any deals they have to offer! Never again! Very disappointed!

allReviews.title: Good Place For A Family Or Couple
allReviews.text: We stay at this location from July 4 thru the 9. Our room was very clean, except for the carpeting in the master bedroom and the entry way into the unit.  They both needed a little shampooing. We did contact the front desk and they stated they would informed the maintenance department.  We were close to shopping dining and the Las Vegas strip.  The area felt safe and secure.  There is a pool on site.  The staff was always friendly and helpful.  They did not charge for PARKING .  And there were no so called RESORT FEES.  And we were given coupons for a daily free breakfast. It help to have some form of transportation.  We will stay at this location in the future. We will like to give a big thank you to Patricia who was working the front desk when we check in.

allReviews.title: Overrated & POOR Customer Service
allReviews.text: My family and I decided to give The Berkley a try considering all the hype I head about this resort. First off, the reception staff (especially the short Hispanic feminine male) is EXTREMELY RUDE!!!! They could certainly use a training or two on how to provide better customer service!After checking in, I overheard a few guest talking about how this property was part of some sort of timeshare in which they paid into. We were not owners, as we booked directly through the resorts website. Nonetheless, after checking in, we were advised that they do not provide daily housekeeping or anything else for that matter. Anything we needed (i.e. laundry detergent, soap, lotion, trash bags, etc.) we would have to come down to the front desk to ask for it. Which took us by surprise considering we were charged a $25 resort fee per day (for an entire week).  The few times we had to go down to ask for items we were greeted by the short Hispanic male that had a bit too much attitude for me; and smacked his lips and rolled his eyes every time you asked him for something. I thought it was just him and his hateful demeanor towards his job...but to my surprise, everyone that we encountered that worked for the hotel did not speak or appeared to be mad at the world! If I was remotely interested in becoming an owner in timeshare, and The Berkley was one of the resorts listed, I would IMMEDIATELY DECLINE!The hotel itself is situated in a centralized area in close proximity to local stores (i.e. Target, .99 cent store, Big Lots, etc.) and close enough to still enjoy the strip but not deal with the traffic and madness on the strip. The location itself was the only plus about this property.The hotel room itself was clean (we had a 2 bedroom suite on the 7th floor), however, we went to open the linen for the pullout sofa, it had mold on it! Granted, we could have washed it but we were too grossed out to even take it out of the bag. Therefore, we improvised and used linen from off of the other beds. The AC in the room barely worked in on of the bedrooms which was very uncomfortable at night.Needless to say, I would not refer this hotel/“resort” to my worse enemy! If you’re looking for a suite type property, there’s nicer in the area that provides better customer service and cleaner rooms!

allReviews.title: First visit
allReviews.text: I was extremely pleased with the resort as well as the staff. Upon arriving at the resort and the staff greeted me with a professional but most of all a friendly greeting. Each time I went out or entered the building I was greeted with a smile and well as making me feel so special. I was on the 18th floor and my husband call it the penthouse. The room was decorated great, clean and a great view..

allReviews.title: Few days in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The room was great! We were on the top floor so we were able to enjoy the city views. The amenities were good and complete. The room was cozy and loved the bathroom because it has both a shower and a tub

allReviews.title: Nice weekend stay
allReviews.text: Visited for a weekend (2 nights) with 2 adults and 2 kids. My husband and 6 year old slept in king bed. My 3 year old and I slept on pull out sofa. The room was sparkling clean. The kitchen was fully stocked with dishes but we didn’t use them. The tub was clean and amazing. The laundry in the room was great but we didn’t use it.The parking was easy and free.We didn’t use the pool, but it looked ok- it’s basically in the parking lot.We knew we would be arriving late so we asked if we could have the pull out sofa set up and made with bedding ahead of time. We we checked in around midnight I was happy to see it was set up.Only complaints: they use some sort of strong essential oils or air freshener that gave me and my kids a pounding headache and blood red eyes. The pull out sofa is easily the most uncomfortable bed ever (but I get it, it’s a sofa bed), and the people in the room next to us partied loud from 1-5am (I get it, it’s Vegas) but I wished the walls were more insulated. With the kids, we were able to walk around and explore the fish tanks Mermaids next door. It’s close to restaurants and shopping. We didn’t go to the strip, but it was close to hiking and local parks.

allReviews.title: Nice place, but heavily dependent on its surrounding amenities
allReviews.text: The Berkley is a nice place, with very nice, comfortable suites. As a destination, it lacks a bit, only having a pool and not much else. It does however, have the Silverton Casino just 100 feet away, along with Bass Pro Shop and a Cracker Barrel within walking distance. It will probably be a little better in the future if they manage to sell to more owners, and decrease the freebie weekender traffic.

allReviews.title: Great get-away in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The property is excellently maintained.  The unit was spotless and provided with dishes, cutlery, utensils, pots and pans, appliances that would have made it easy to prepare and serve meals if I had wanted to -- I didn't.  Everything was spotless and looked brand new.  The location was great because it was away from the hustle and bustle of the casino but yet close enough to allow for that activity.

allReviews.title: The Berkley
allReviews.text: Very nice property.  Your biggest expense is transportation if you do not have your car.  The area around the property is very sparse but the building and units are clean, nice, and comfortable..The area is surrounded by busy highways.  We walked to Target and were very happy to get back safely!!

allReviews.title: High Quality luxury units
allReviews.text: Although a 3-year builidng, rooms looked brand new.  Very comfortable beds and fully furnished kitchen.  Location is 15 minutes from the Las Vegas Strip.  The Silverton Casino adjecent to the Brekley and the SouthPoint Casino 5 minutges down the hightway were nice alternatives to the Las Vegas Strip. Definitely book again.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Berkley Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This was our first time staying at the Berkley in Las Vegas.Our stay was from Wednesday to Wednesday, The Berkley is just off the Las Vegas Strip but still close enough to be on the strip in minutes.We arrived Wednesday evening and right away we notice how much parking was available, very nice and convenient.Next, we went into the lobby to check-in (no line) and was greeted with friendly and very helpful staff, you couldn’t ask for nicer and very accommodating people.We got to our room on the top floor it was beautiful with an awesome view, very homie feeling. It was just my wife and myself, but the room will sleep, 4 guests. We stayed at the Grandview before which the same Company owns but I think for us The Berkley was a bit nicer and newer and wasn’t near as hectic as the Grandview. The rooms at The Berkley were super clean and the kitchen was stocked with all the pots and pans, utensils to cook a huge meal. Enough plates and settings for 4 people.The stay was very calm and relaxing. Plenty of room in the lobby and by the pool. The Silverton Casino is just right across the walkway. The Bass Pro Shop is connected to the Silverton Casino and is a super cool place to visit, they have so much, and prices aren’t that bad.  We were in and out going places in Las Vegas all the time.We meet some staff throughout our stay, and everyone was friendly and helpful with great attitudes.Overall this was a great time, you can be as relaxed or as busy as you want. My wife and I would absolutely recommend The Berkley Las Vegas for a getaway or family vacation.

allReviews.title: Relaxing get away
allReviews.text: A home away from home atmosphere.  The room provided a relaxing vacation. No disturbances from any neighbors. The kitchen was well organized and provided adequate supplies for the week stay. A very comfortable bed and other furniture was too. The casino was next door provided various eating restaurants and an excellent Buffet.  Location was far enough away from the Las Vegas Strip, but close enough for any day or night activities. Perfect for anyone wanting a quiet and relaxing vacation.

allReviews.title: CES January 2019
allReviews.text: Was in Vegas for the CES show in Jan 2019Shared a 2 bedroom suite with a friend.  Was pleasantly surprised that it was actually 2 separate identical room entrances.  Each with their own key.  Great for parent that need a little alone time and have teens. Would not suggest for families with children under 10 as the doors are heavy and there is no passthrough.  Each room had its own kitchen and dining area.  The staff was so helpful.  Parking was really convenient, directly in front of the hotel or in the multi level garage which is shared with the Silverton Casino and Hotel.if you need to use acd or dvd player make sure to reserve one asap and put your name on the wait list, if one is not available.  they only have a few to loan out.Make sure to get a players card as the eating bonus come with the card.  If you are there on a Sunday make sure and go to the restaurant with the large buffet and get the sushi.  I don’t usually go to buffets, this one has begun to change my mind.Booked thru my time share, but can also book a room on hotels.comIts way off the strip, so smoke and crowds were minimized.  When football season has started at the new  stadium this may change.

allReviews.title: Now this is how to enjoy Vegas!!!
allReviews.text: We booked this thru our Vacation Village Voyages and it was well worth it.  We wanted to be away from the strip but still close by, this was the place.  You could get to the South Strip or the Fremont Experience in minutes.The girls at the front desk were very helpful and accommodating.  When we got in and needed some ice to have a libation, there was some in fridge...awesome.After visiting with friends, came back went to the pool and it was great. The hot tub was not hot and that was the only draw back.The rooms we had was a king on the 17th floor and it was great...could use better pillows, maybe memory foam instead of soft ones with no support.  Beautiful rooms though.The Silverton Casino next door with a great aquarium for all to enjoy. Great place and when we return, it will be to this place.

allReviews.title: Self contained little Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Everything I needed was just outside the door on the property but the location was removed from the chaos and hustle and bustle of the strip but yet just a 2 minute ride away. The staff was very accommodating and the rooms were spacious and clean. Would recommend for anyone that wants to be in Vegas without having to be in the chaos of it all.

allReviews.title: Fun time in Vegas
allReviews.text: Me and my friends are not gamblers but we like the excitement surrounding it, drinks, music and entertainment so we picked a spot off of the strip but with a casino on the grounds. No regrets! The studio and two bedrooms are spacious and very clean. The front desk check in process was quick and accommodating. Right behind the hotel is the Silverton Casino where we received a free Buffett and $50 dining credit just to sign up for the players card. Everything is perfect except for the weather. :( It’s 60 degrees.

allReviews.title: Nice Place
allReviews.text: This was a very nice resort. The staff was friendly and helpful as well. The room was clean and toiletries were full. The bed was very comfortable and with a separate living space and kitchen one could sleep in peace while the others are socializing. If you are looking for a nice resort off of the strip but close enough to Lyft or Uber for cheap this is definitely a great option.

allReviews.title: Pleasant stay @ Berkley
allReviews.text: Location: convenient to airport, Strip, and other eating places outside of resort; plenty of parkingBuilding: unobstructed view of mountain range (from our 17th floor unit); AM/PM sun not hitting unitCleanliness of unit is excellent.

allReviews.title: New  -working out the kinks ?
allReviews.text: This served our purpose as a quiet place to stay in Las Vagas. It is not on 'the strip'. Tours don't pick up at the Berkley so we had to drive to other location to get tour bus. Only one bank of elevators (3 cars) for 18 floors. One check out day we had to wait 20 minutes to get down from the 18th floor at 10am! - bad design of building.

allReviews.title: Week get away
allReviews.text: Away from the strip but close with easy access to everything you need to see or do. Right next to Silveron Casino,. Nice casino with great restaurant selection and smoke free gaming floor. Also recommend Deans Place restaurant off the back side of resort.. Excellent all you can eat ribs on Wednesday night. A hidden gem.,

allReviews.title: Beautiful Property
allReviews.text: Very nice building and the units were great. Staff was good. Location just fine. My only complaint are the elevators. We were on floor 18 and the time it took for the elevators to get to us was very frustrating.

allReviews.title: Very Good Resort
allReviews.text: This is a pretty new resort property and the grounds are well maintained.  The 1 bedroom condo had everything we needed and we cooked in our unit about 4 nights out of 7.  We were on the 16th floor and I believe I may have had two birthdays in those elevators!  Kidding of course, but my point is there are only 3 elevators and they seems to be occupied by cleaning staff on every ride.  They stop nearly on every floor which makes a ride to 16 very slow.  The employees on the elevator were very nice.  My opinion - one of the elevators should be closed to guests and staff have access to one exclusive elevator during their busy cleaning hours.  The pool area is very busy and they post there is no lifeguard.  There should be a bigger security presence in this area.  We saw a lot of glass bottles in the pool area as well as smelled weed there everyday.  I realize it is legal in Nevada, but not at a public pool area. We were there with our Interval getaway.  We did not attend the vacation village promotion but heard from several guests that it was quite excruciating.  Our experience was - all in all - very good.

allReviews.title: Pool
allReviews.text: We booked this thru our RCI trade for our Mexico timeshare. We wanted a pool and hot tub. A getaway from the cold northwest.Lyft lady was confused on where to drop us off. Kept taking us to the Silverton Casino.The girls at the front desk were awesome. I don’t understand the comments I’ve read about them being rude. Our flight got us in early, I didn’t expect a room right away. But she said our room was ready and we were in our room by 11 am.Put our things away and caught a lift to the Target store for some supplies (alcohol) we ask where we could get ice and they gave us a big bag.Came back went to the pool by 2pm. Pool was great. The gate did have problems the lock to get in. Maintenance man came right away and got us in.The rooms we had was the king suite. Beautiful rooms. 17th floor great view.This place is off the strip, was fine for us. Has the Silverton Casino next door with all the restaurants you could want. Great place

allReviews.title: Could easily be so much better!
allReviews.text: First things first; we were not here as part of a timeshare promotion, simply booked this hotel as a hotel room with a kitchen.We arrived on a Thursday and were initially very happy with our choice.  We had a strip view room on the 8th floor - not bad!  The room, a 1 bedroom, was very nicely appointed.  Great choice, and then it went downhill ...We don't wear shoes indoors, should really rethink that at The Berkeley.  The soles of our feet were black very quickly.  The carpets had been vacuumed, but not cleaned in a very long time.  The tile floors were swept over; clean to look at, but filthy in reality.  The towels were like sandpaper, but we knew that going in from a prior review.  A quick stop at Costco on the drive in fixed that problem!Then came the weekend ...Friday is when all the timeshare presentation victims arrived for their free 3 day/2 night stay.  I don't know where the marketing occurred, but these people are NOT buying a timeshare!The door slamming (it was as if drug dealing was going on next door - the doors were slamming every 5-10 seconds), yelling kids, loud music and constant pot smoking (this is a non-smoking hotel) was unbearable.  We were "hot boxed" for 2 days.  Management didn't really seem to care; as if this was normal for them.The pool - loaded with kids on Saturday, free weekend folks!  Maybe the hot tub?  No, broken all weekend.  Upon checkout I asked to use the luggage cart.  They required I leave my driver license as collateral - who is going to steal this?Pros - free parking, coupons for breakfast (nice surprise), decent location.They did not try to rope us in to a timeshare presentation, which was much appreciated.Cons - disgustingly filthy floors, uncaring staff.  Noisy, noisy, noisy!Maybe this would be okay during the mid-week, but DO NOT book over the weekend!Hotel Management - apart from what I already said, maybe book your hotel guests on separate floor or wing than the timeshare guests!  Also, invest in some soft door closers to prevent the door slamming.

allReviews.title: Vaca in Luxury
allReviews.text: My stay at The Berkeley was nothing short of amazing. As soon as I found out the pool was heated, I ran out to the shopping center (which is nearby) and purchased a bathing suit. After that, the choice was to unwind in the deep jacuzzi like tub or walk-in shower large enough for 2 people. The resort is quiet and gave me a much needed break from the frenzy of NYC. This is my 2nd time staying here and I am positively going to return soon!

allReviews.title: Wonderful modern spacious unit
allReviews.text: Extremely satisfied with our unit, bed was comfy, everything was clean.  Check in was a breeze.  Amazing view from the 17th floor.  Grounds were well kept, staff was very helpful.  Would definately stay there again!

allReviews.title: Girls Casino Getaway
allReviews.text: This was our first  time at the Berkley and if was fabulous. It was clean and fresh inside and out. We had a one bedroom unit with a full kitchen overlooking the pool area and the city lights in the distance (great view). The staff was awesome, very helpful with all a questions. The Silverton Casino was right next door with it's bars, restaurants, gift shop and of course casino. It was great to find that the one bar had ladies drink free from 5-7pm nightly. We had a fabulous time and would definitely return. We ate out some time and cooked some of our meals in the kitchen other nights, BBQ's are also available if you desire. We shopped At Albertsons which was very close to where we were staying (they sell liquor and beer also).

allReviews.title: Berkley Review
allReviews.text: We had a great time at the Berkley. Recommend a stay at this resort. Gambling was available, golf is close and the restaurants  are very accesable. Recommend  going to the buffet, thet had great food for a reasonable price.

allReviews.title: Nice clean property minutes away from Vegas strip
allReviews.text: The 2-bedroom apartment suite was more than I could ask for. All amenities, new and modern. Rooms were very clean and I like the fact that the living room is tiled flooring, not carpeted. Everyday maintenance was cleaning the property and frontdesk very accommodating. The area is quiet and cozy, and really there is no need to visit the main strip, there is a Bass store, casino directly across from hotel and a weekend farmer's market. But if you do want to visit the strip it's about 6 min by car.  When in Vegas, I will add the Berkley again to our destination.

allReviews.title: Berkley
allReviews.text: Place is new beautifully decorated.All the amenities one would need.Easy to get anywhere from here .Weather was not the best but no one has control of that.We had 2 full units for 2 of a and b both beautiful spacious and clean.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: I had a studio which was very clean with a large bathroom. All amenities were provided including a sitting area, small kitchen, two flat screen TVs and free Wifi. It was very quiet. If you don’t mind being away from the madness of the Strip, this is a great alternative.One caveat, they were going to charge me a one time “resort fee” of $25 until I pointed out that their Web site specifically states no resort fee. Check this out before you just automatically say okay to that charge.

allReviews.title: Great Rooms
allReviews.text: We had a great 2BR Lockout (Which is Two One Bedroom units) We had 4 of us in the group. They had a room with kitchen and bath. My wife and I had a room with kitchen and bath. When we wanted we could open the door and move between the two units.The Staff was great. The Pool and Hot Tub where to die for.The Silverton is just a few steps away.The Food at the Silverton is wonderful.

allReviews.title: Spacious and big innsoace but small in heart
allReviews.text: As one checks in to this far away lonely hotel, the sky rocketing "vegas" expectations are groundedThen a soft welcoming voice tells it all- breakfast complimentary, no house keeping,  no room service, if toiletires needed get it from front desk.Disappointed as i enered the room... it was not a room, it was a suite, fully loaded kitchen (utensils and gadgets, not groceries) a living room and a cozy bedroom with a BIG toilet/bathroom. Just awesome space configuration and the missing elements are covered upThe only disappointing element that remains is the preset three item breakfast (just nothing for the vegetarians except bread toast) without a beverage of any kinds and if desired one has to pay.Location from the strip is far but the kind of spacious suit one gets is well compensated. (Uber/lyft is just 5/7 minutes away)A Value proposition- i would say

allReviews.title: Great Place & each suite feels like your own condo!
allReviews.text: My spouse and I stayed here for a week pending the close of our new home here in Las Vegas.  We just relocated here from NC in November 2018.  The suites are very nice, clean, and you feel like you have your own condo.  The staff is so friendly and always willing to lend a hand or offer what we needed.  Thank you again for your hospitality. My spouse and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again or recommend to our family & friends.

allReviews.title: NIce place to stay if you don't need to be on the Las Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: Located a few steps away from the Silverton, there is a casino and a few good places to eat nearby.  Nearby is a Cracker Barrel restaurant, if you like.  The huge Bass Store is also attached to the Silverton.  The Berkeley has one bedroom suites that are nicely furnished; the bedroom has a king bed and there is also a queen sofa bed in the living room.  The kitchen is fully equipped and has all the pots and pans along with the silverware and dishes and glassware.  The bathroom is large and has both a tub and separate shower.  There is a washer/dryer in the unit.  The Berkley provides bathroom and kitchen soap and detergent.  The front desk will replenish if you run low.  The Berkley has a nice pool and gym.  There is a mid-week refresh of towels during your one week stay.  Also there is $25 Resort Fee added to your stay, even with an RCI Exchange.

allReviews.title: The Berkley - Vegas away from Vegas
allReviews.text: The Berkley is not walking distance of the strip, you will definitely need a vehicle. The hotel's location is right across from the Silverton casino hotel and Bass Pro shop, the area is quiet.  Also, not being near strip will afford you to see life outside vegas, like the Hoover dam, grand canyon helicopter ride, train ride and ghost towns; etc.   Booked a two-bedroom suite and was quite impressed, it was clean, awesome amenities and the suite was set up like 2 separate apartments that only shared a common entry door, also loved that the living room was not carpeted but tiled flooring. It's obvious that the hotel desires a good reputation because the lobby/common areas were mopped and cleaned every day, staff was friendly and no hassle for timeshare seminars. For all guests there is a gym, pool, Jacuzzi, computer room and plenty of parking. (The parking lot also serves as a location for the weekly farmer's market.)  I'm impressed so I will not hesitate to stay again. Great job Berkley! (Only complaint was that the entry door common area's carpet needed cleaning.)

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: The units are well equipped and still feel and look new.  Love the access to the Silverton and easy drive to South Point.  Be sure to have a car as it is a necessity and learn how to travel on Dean Martin to get to strip or downtown.Only complaint was they only left one dishwasher soap in unit but girls provided extra mid week.Beds were very comfortable and pull out in living room served us well for friends to stay an extra day.

allReviews.title: Berkley @ Vegas
allReviews.text: Housekeeping was great but not as scheduled and had to contact front desk twice to get clean linens and towels. GREAT VIEW of the strip if you get the higher floors with a north or strip view! We were on the eigteenth floor north side. BEAUTIFUL NIGHT VIEW OF THE STRIP! Not much to see day or night if you have a south view room. Rooms are clean fresh and new.

allReviews.title: I don't even know what to say...
allReviews.text: I booked this hotel on bookvip. What a mess. Bookvip added charges that were not supposed to be changed. That was a headache to get refunded. Bookvip told me I had to show up with a credit card. They told me I had to attend a 30 minute conference on timeshares. I had to wait about a week to call the Berkley to verify all the info. They said I didn't need a credit card any card would work and it was a 90 minute conference. We showed up a day late for our stay but had checked in the night before, before we left for our emergency. The gentleman that checked us in was great. When we arrived back in the am we asked a lady that walked in with us who walked to the opposite side of the check in desk, where the elevator was. She completely ignored us. :/ The room was great. Cons: bathroom fan didn't work. Ice maker didn't work. Ironing board was broken. Picture in the bathroom almost fell. Pros it was stalked with everything we needed to cook and do our dishes. Room was quite lovely. We never got a call to meet about the time share conference. We parked on the backside of the hotel next to the Bass pro shop so we could see our vehicle. Bad idea. After a certain time they look those doors. Completely odd when guests use that door to use to go to and come from the casino. It was a bit confusing because no where on the building does it say Berkley. It says Silverton. Needless to say they lost a potential timeshare customer. I'll stick with the timeshare I have available through my job. I called the front desk to ask if I could extend my stay A because I really wanted to hear about the timeshare and B we decided to extend our stay in Vegas. She quoted me over $170 but told me they were booked. I paid $150 for 3/4 nights. I found a few sights that showed they had availability. :( I asked for an extended check out she said no. I told her we had to change hotels and it would be helpful since she declined to extend our stay. She extended it to 11am and told me anytime after she'd charge me over $170!!!! Upon check out I put my bags outside of the room while my daughter tried to quickly use the restroom so I wasn't over charged. This place is very uptight. Unless you're a millionaire be ready to feel out of place. Like they check your credit and base their guest treatment off of that. Next time I'll stay at another timeshare I have available to me.

allReviews.title: Simply wonderful!
allReviews.text: We are in Vegas for 11 days, staying at three different locations due to costs especially on Halloween.  The Berkeley is our second location and I love it.I'm writing this review from the activity center at the Berkeley.  This room has three computers, a printer, a vending machine, tables and chairs for group activities and a bathroom.  It requires a room key for entrance.My husband and I typically stay at timeshare resorts and this one did not disappoint.  It has the comforts that we appreciate.  The layout is different in that all of the "action" is next door at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  The Berkeley hotel lobby has no chairs, tables or couches.  If you have to wait for your room, you go outside and enjoy the lovely shared grounds of the Silverton and Berkeley.Nevertheless, the Silverton has the restaurants and bars. It also has a mini art gallery and aquarium near the Mermaid Bar.  There's also a huge nature/outdoor sporting shop.  It's gigantic and is incredibly decorated.  My husband said he went to the zoo.  There are lots of actual scale replicas of various animals.  This store can really substitute as a zoo experience.The Silverton has Ladies Night daily 5P - 7P where women drink for free.  The Silverton also has a free shuttle that seats about 20 people that takes you to the Aria Hotel and Casino.  We took it yesterday and had a great time sight seeing in the Aria.  This a MUST DO.I know this review is for The Berkeley but all the action is next door.  You just sleep and enjoy your suite or 1BR unit, which is VERY COMFORTABLE.  We had a GORGEOUS view of the mountains.Besides a particular Mexican resort which shall remain nevertheless, The Berkeley is now one of our favorite resorts.

allReviews.title: Respite from the hustle & bustle of Las Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Berkeley in South Las Vegas area. Couple year old new resort. Location is next door to Silverton Hotel & Casino. Plenty of free outdoor or garage parking. Clean and kept up well both inside and outside. There was an outdoor pool just as we entered the lobby. Nice folks, courteous, smiled & greeted us regularly, efficient, not pushy, and very accommodating. Coffee, hot water for tea, and ice water were available in the lobby. There was a small gym. Inside furnitures were well maintained, not beat up. Bathroom has all the amenities you would need. We had a view of the Las Vegas Strip in the distance. From our window, we can see airplanes regularly coming down to land at McCarran International Airport. The resort was not directly under the flight path, but close. Good soundproofing. We could hear the airplanes, but noise was not loud enough to bother usYou would definitely need a car, taxi or ride share to get anywhere. Around 15 minutes drive to get to the Strip when taking the 15 Freeway. Half an hour with surface streets. There were no restaurants on site, but there were several restaurants inside the Silverton Casino, just a two minute walk from the resort. Adjacent to Silverton Casino was Bass Pro Shops, a “supersize store” selling every outdoor toys you can think off. The South Premium Outlets Mall was 10 minutes away by car. There were many restaurants there and nearby if you don’t want to eat at the casino. Overall you would stay at The Berkley to relax, to get away from the hustle and bustle of the Las Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: Worked well for us
allReviews.text: Spent a week at this property while visiting family in Las Vegas.Why it worked for us Week long stay - Enjoyed the extra room it gave us. Separate bedroom plus living room. One can sleep while the other watches TV etc.Avoid the congestion - The hotel is located a few miles south of the strip so you don't have to fight all the trafficFree parking - Got to love thatModern & clean rooms - Furnishings  were up to date and in excellent conditionHad the basic necessities we wanted - Pool, jacuzzi & exercise facilitiesFood options & gaming close by - At the Silverton Casino you have choices of half a dozen restaurants from quick options like Asian and burgers to sit down restaurants like the buffet & their steakhouseWe would definitely stay here again if we were looking to be away from the strip.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel If you don't want to stay on Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: Just returned from a 4 day stay at The Berkley.  Very comfortable, clean and friendly staff.  The only things that we didn't like was it was like pulling teeth when we asked for additional toilet tissue and when we asked for a cart for our bags, which was kept behind the counter, we had to leave a driver's license.  Other than that we enjoyed our stay.  The Silverton is right next door and was very nice as well.  If you want to get away from the strip this would be the perfect place.

allReviews.title: First trip staying off the Strip. Amazing!!!!
allReviews.text: Wonderful Stay. I recommend renting a car and staying at The Berkley resort. You can avoid being stuck on the stip your. We come once to teice a year, and wanted to get away from the Strip. We rented a car and enjoyed the spacious accommodation, loved bein able to do laundry and cook if need be. The pool was never overwhelmingly crowded. The hotel is steps away from the onsite casino which has loads of dining options. The strip is a nere 15 minute drive. Will be back again in a month or so.

allReviews.title: Not for Business travelers - this is not a hotel.  It's a timeshare.
allReviews.text: You can either be a timeshare - or you can be a hotel.  In this reporters opinion - you cannot be both.  I understand that by the nature of timeshares - you can't treat timeshare guests like hotel guests.  The bad news for The Berkley is you cannot treat hotel guests like timeshare guests.I show up at 9 o clock at night.  Have a perfectly acceptable check in experience until I'm directed to go over and see another woman on the other side of the lobby to get my parking pass 'validated'.  I surmise after hearing the woman speaking to another couple that the woman will try to interest me in their timeshare program.  I leave and go up to my room.I wake up the next morning, have a nice workout in their perfectly acceptable (but nothing special) gym, and then I get a phone call at 10:11 am from the front desk informing me check out is at 10 (to be fair - I did not look), and that I needed to vacate immediately.  If I did not do so, I would be charged another full days room.  After some complaining on my part, I was extended a courtesy to 11, which was positioned as the biggest favor anyone has ever done for me.  I showered as quickly as I could, only to be greeted by housekeeping around 20 mins later asking me when I was leaving.Everything on property is the same state - perfectly acceptable, but not great.  It's nice to have a room with a kitchen, but nothing is stellar.I strongly suspect the glowing reviews here are procured via some other means.  This is not a hotel.Maybe as a timeshare it is great, but as a hotel the pricing was no bargain, the location is decidedly non-central, and the treatment was not OK for a business traveler who paid a fair (but not cheap) price for a hotel room.  If the hotel was 1/2 the price, or there was some nod to having to sit through a presentation to receive a discounted room - then fair enough.  That is not how the Berkley is represented on Expedia.  It's represented as a full service hotel.  If you're looking for a 'perfectly acceptable' timeshare 20 mins from the South end of the strip - this might just be for you.Note to staff: Please spare me the auto 'thank you for reporting your experience and we're sorry you had a...' response.   As a hotel guest - I find the whole experience perfectly unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Relaxing Stay Away from the Crowds
allReviews.text: We recently stayed at the Berkley for a week. We were in Las Vegas for a family trip. The rest of our family members were staying at a resort on the Strip where we all usually stay, but it was sold out when we tried to book our room. Someone recommended us to stay at the Berkley and we are happy that we gave it a try, we had a wonderful stay. It's a very quiet and relaxing hotel, away from the noise and with a great view of the Strip. The building is nice and simple, nothing too fancy. We were really happy and comfortable in our suite. It was really spacious and nicely furnished, we had almost everything we needed. There was not much to do at the hotel tough, there are no restaurants or bars in the building, just the pool, a great hot tub and a small gym. It was awesome to have the Silverstone right across the street. We went there almost every day as they have a nice casino, good restaurants, bars and a Starbucks. There are a lot of stores and other restaurants nearby which was really convenient. We kind of missed being right at the Strip, tough. We like to go there every day and it's like a 15 minutes drive from the Berkley. I'd recommend this hotel for people that want to have a relaxing stay away from the crowds of the Strip, better if you have a car.We'd definitely stay there again, maybe not on our next visit to Vegas, but some day im the future.My suggestions for the Management would be to heat the pool, get more equipment for the gym, decorate the lobby area where the Front Desk is, it looks too empty. Also, it would be niceif during the mid-week housekeeping service they cleaned the floor. We didn't have a mop to clean it ourselves Special thanks to Asia at the Front Desk, she was really helpful and courteous. The housekeeping staff was really good too.

allReviews.title: Amazing Stay!!
allReviews.text: What a beautiful hotel. I was there for 3 nights with my mother and was pleasantly surprised with this hotel. It was very busy over the weekend with multiple concerts going on and I was concerned about the noise. We never heard a peep from anyone. The beds are amazing and the staff are always smiling and there to help if needed. We rented a car as you are a bit off of the strip. There is a Target close by and lots of shopping close by. I will totally be back!!

allReviews.title: Surprisingly Great Resort
allReviews.text: I stayed a week at the Berkley.    I had never heard of it but the reviews on Trip Advisor were good and of all the timeshare exchanges I qualified for---this seemed to be the best.  I really was pleasantly surprised with how clean the unit was, how comfortable the bed was and the view of the strip in the distance.  It is right next door to the Silverton casino which has nice restaurants and a great fish tank with a mermaid show.  The Berkley is less than 2 years old and the newness shows.  I visited with friends so I did not use the shuttle which goes to the strip (about 2 miles away) so the fact that I did not have a car was not an issue.  I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Fun at the Berkley
allReviews.text: Smaller resort, which makes it easy to get around and a comfortable feeling. Close to freeway and off the strip! Casino with restaurant easy to walk to for good food. Covered parking a plus. staff is friendly and very helpful.

allReviews.title: Berkley Resort - Fun Times Off the Strip
allReviews.text: My first stay at the resort was with my daughter from May 12-18. My 2nd stay was this past weekend (September 12-16) with my daughter and son-in-law. Both visits were wonderful! There were no issues. I had a quick check-in and the reservationist and other staff members were professional and courteous. My room was very nice! Loved it! I have stayed "on the strip" multiple times, but this was my 2nd time staying "off the strip." Very nice and quiet. Most importantly, NO SMOKING!
