I was offered a free buffet, but I failed to go downstairs to obtain the voucher. The intention was very good and I thought it was a warm gesture for staying at the resort. I received two calls from the front desk inquiring about my stay.. On my 2nd trip, I visited the Silverton casino which is a very short walk from the resort and had lunch and drinks. Overall, I would rate this resort a 4 out of 5 rating.P A Garner

allReviews.title: Manipulative time share scheme
allReviews.text: The hotel itself and the room was very nice - new, clean, and no issues. It's a great location - close enough to the strip and surrounding areas for driving. We would have had no complaints except that when we asked about the "free breakfast" for which we saw a sign, we were told "yes, there is a free breakfast, but it's in another hotel (South Point) just a few minutes away. And you also get a $100 gift card or another gift for attending. All you need to do is look at a room, get an update, and you're good to go." We had limited time the morning of the breakfast, so I asked if there would be a "time share presentation," because we were not interested and were already "owners of a time share." She informed us that because we were already owners, we did not have to go through any presentation, and it would only take a few minutes. When we showed up for the "free breakfast" and signed in, we shared what we had been told, to which our guide for the morning said "Ha, that's not true! The presentation takes several hours." I informed them what we had been told and that we only had 1 hour max. We were then informed that we would not get our "$100 free gift" unless we went through the presentation. I said as long as we're done in an hour. Bottom line - the "free breakfast" is a time share presentation in disguise. We were never told this, and when we asked about how much time it would take we were lied to. I had to let our guide know many times how much time I had remaining, to which she rudely replied that it most likely would not be possible. At the end when we already said "no" to the timeshare, she then called her manager who came over and proceeding to go through the presentation again! When we told him our time was up and we needed to leave - he ignored me and said it would only take a few minutes. I had to stand up and almost walk out. When he finally signed off, they sent us down to get our "free gift," which mean talking to one more "corporate representative" Yanelis Carmenell who was extremely rude when we told her we were out of time and needed to leave. She once again ignored our request and proceeded to go through her "Survey" which she told us only had 3 questions - but had 6 question - lied to again! And then tried to talk us into buying their timeshare one more time. This was a miserable experience and basically wrecked what would have been a wonderful stay at The Berkley. So, unless you're looking to buy a timeshare, don't sign up for the free breakfast.

allReviews.title: beautiful hotel
allReviews.text: the room was amazing, great kitchen, beautiful and clean! The one downside is they do not have housekeeping services daily; they come in every few days and change your towels (they actually just took our dirty towels, we had to go get clean ones). The bed was so comfortable and the view from the room was great! the pool & hot tub were great as well

allReviews.title: Vacation while staying at the Berkley, Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Me and my wife had an excellent stay at the Berkley. We were right next door to the Silverton Casino and we got perks for food & gaming for both Silverton and South port Casino's. The Berkley just opened and we received gifts and fruit baskets from their staff almost everyday.

allReviews.title: Rooms are good, everything else not so much...
allReviews.text: Unfortunately, I experienced too many negatives during my stay here to leave a positive review. It all began at check in. My flight arrived early and I arrived at the hotel around 10am, and even though check-in wasn’t until 4 pm, I checked to see if it was possible that they had a room available. I really didn’t except for them to have a room ready, but I did expect them to at least let me use the pool or work out room while I wait for my room to become ready. The woman at the front desk was extremely rude and said ABSOLUTELY no check in’s until 4pm and I wasn’t allowed to use any of their facilities until that time. This astounded me as any other place I has stayed has at least let me choose the facilities while I wait. I said, “Well, will you at least call me when it’s ready?” She told me no, to come back at 4pm. I was forced to waste 6 hours next door with no car at a restaurant and casino. Never had any hotel so rude about check-in. When I finally got checked in, I didn’t have one single wash cloth. When I went to the front desk to tell them, her response was, “Oh yeah, we know— we ran out of wash clothes.” Ran out? How does a hotel run out of wash clothes? So she offered me hand towels to wash my body with… They have three elevators for 18 floors which is pretty good, but during the week of my stay only one elevator was working the majority of the time. At one point we waited almost 20 minutes to go to our room. We went to the pool and saw that everyone had stripped towels to indicate those were “pool” towels. We didn’t have any of those in our room, so we went to the front desk to ask about them and they said, “We ran out of pool towels, so we put extra regular towels in your room.” Just another thing they ran out of. The front desk told us that housekeeping would come mid-week (Tuesday) to clean the room and that would be the only time she would come by. She did that while we were out and she did a good job. However, on Thursday (2 days before check out), we were in our room and she randomly comes in the room with us just sitting there—no knock, no words, no anything, just barges in. I didn’t appreciate that at all. Other than all this, the rooms were nice and updated and it was fairly quiet for Vegas…It's located within walking distance to the Silverton Casio, which provides quite a bit of food options which is nice. Not within walking distance of the strip, but that wasn't an issue for us. I am somewhere between a poor and average rating. I wish I could give it a higher rating, but the cons outweigh the pros here.

allReviews.title: Adequate Resort
allReviews.text: The Berkley, Las Vegas is located upon the Silverton Casino property.  The pedestrian trail is approximately 250 feet.  Covered and open parking is plentiful.  The units are basic, but adequate.  Restaurants are available inside the Silverton Casino and nearby.  A free shuttle runs a few times daily to the Aria Hotel & Casino, which is located in the South Center of the Las Vegas Strip.  A few planned activities are available for participation at the resort.  There is an activities room, with an internet café.  Tables are set-up in the room, so one could play cards or a board game.  Children are likely to find the resort boring, as planned activities are limited.  When one enters the building, you are in a corridor, with elevators on the right.  The registration is in a separate room further down the corridor on the left.  If you are going to Vegas to experience the Strip, I suggest you consider a timeshare closer to the Strip (such as the Marriott Grand Chateau, or the Hillton Grand Vacations at the Elara).  If you are considering a casino-hotel, I suggest you consider one of the numerous hotels-casinos near or on the strip.  Be prepared to spend a lot of time parking and walking from the self-park garage on the strip to the casino of choice.  Of course, valet parking is always an option (for a fixed price).

allReviews.title: Well worth small drive outside the strip
allReviews.text: Hi we are a family of 5 so got 2 interconnecting suites. They were spacious and clean. Hotel was modern and comfortable. No problem driving into Las Vegas and getting free parking at Treasure Island. Only criticism was that the ‘complimentary’ breakfast was very limited as only 1 meal available and wd cost about $20 dollars just for soft drinks.

allReviews.title: Remodeled Casino Hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel used to be the Silverton Casino hotel, in fact the sign is still on top of it. It’s about 10/15 minutes from the strip the unit that I stayed in had to be remodeled recently everything appeared to be brand new. I went for the MAGIC convention this past week. For my purposes it fit the bill. The pool is ok not great, this place is definitely great for families as the units are large in size.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay
allReviews.text: Great location right next to a casino yet is not at all like a casino hotel. Outstanding rooms with full kitchens and roomy baths. Only negative is our ice maker does not work and there were some amenities were missing. I still recommend this as a great place to stay.

allReviews.title: Frustrated - not great for the business traveler
allReviews.text: The property is a time share property, so no hotel services should be expected.  The family apartment is actually two apartments with an adjoining private hallway.  So if your taking small kids you’ll have to split up the family.  While I was there 2 of 3 elevators failed and the building has 16 floors of people with probably ~24 apts per floor, so we had 15 min wait times for the elevator car, which 10 people rushed to get in to with varying conditions of dress like dressed for dinner, hiking sweaty, and lots of wet kids and adults.  I asked for a luggage cart 4 times and never was able to get one.  The pool is way over crowded and likely will make you ill.  The kitchen is stocked with average materials, but you’ll have to shop at target or Walmart etc to get food and seasoning, etc if you want to use the kitchen. My power went off in part of my room while I was there.  It was blamed on a hair dryer in someone else’s room. They charge for the stay up front, likely to prevent early abandonment.  In general it must have been a discount week while I was there, based on the class and manners of the other guests.  Trash dumps are on 3 of the 16 floors, and ice for the fridge is only on the first floor.  There are 2 TVs but only one remote. I had the air turned down to 68, but my temp probe said it was 73.  The rooms are clean, smoking isn’t allowed in the building and parking isn’t bad, but I won’t stay here again or recommend it to anyone else.  While smoking isn’t allowed inside there were plenty of smoking and 420s outside on the sidewalks. I’m not bothering to ask for any comps, because I’m sure they have any.  I have stayed at the Silverton casino several times, and it was better, even with the casino tobacco odor.  For the price go to a real hotel.

allReviews.title: Very nice resort away from city center.
allReviews.text: The resort is good, with in unit washer and dryer, it is very convenient especially during extremely hot summer months. it is a bit far from the city center but a lot quieter. It is a bot hard to find because the sign

allReviews.title: Great resort!
allReviews.text: Our stay at The Berkley was great. The staff was friendly and courteous. Would definitely stay next time. Amenities were wonderful the gym had everything for a quick work out. Didn't get in the pool but it looked refreshing. Great hours for the gym and pool. We were in the 17th floor and the view was spectacular. The room was really nice it was just the perfect size.Kitchen had everything as if you were at home. Very comfortable stay.

allReviews.title: LIKE NO OTHER!!
allReviews.text: First time in Las Vegas with my teens and husband for a basketball tournament. The Berkley, Las Vegas exceeded my expectations! Located next to the Silverton Casino and a few steps away from Cracker Barrel, this was a perfect location and a pleasant experience. Rooms are very spacious, beautiful, with modern decorations, flat screen TV, lovely kitchen and large bathrooms! We stayed in a 1 bedroom King size bed with Queen size sofa-bed unit. It’s approximately 15-20mins  from The Luxor and Mandalay Bay. We did not rent a vehicle  as Uber and Lyft were easily accessible which saved us a lot of money in rental and gas as well as time. Not being from the area and this being our first time, this was our best option. Staying at The Berkley-Las Vegas was an awesome experience and although being in Vegas during the Summer with temps in the 118 degrees was tough I would return (maybe in the Fall) and stay at The Berkley again. I would definitely recommend staying here especially if you have young children.

allReviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We spent one week at the Berkley and it was great.  The unit was very nice and the bathroom was really large.  Check-in was fast and we really appreciated not being approached about a timeshare meeting.  I had read in previous reviews that the icemaker did not work, so we just made a quick trip to the dollar store (about 5 minutes away) and bought a set of ice trays.  Problem solved.

allReviews.title: CLEAN!!!!! Is my first impression.
allReviews.text: I highly recommend this resort ( no pressure - no solicitation) As I walked into the expansive lobby to register I was pleased with it's cleanliness the visual effects partially brought about by the sparce furnishings.There is complimentary coffee and lemon water available. The workers are VERY pleasant but don't let your guard down, they are not that bright. You will come to see later in this review what brought about this negative opinion. But one good thing, HR is not wasting money on hiring college grads as desk personnel.After we checked in we went up to our suite and again found the word CLEAN to describe our accommodations. We had an exquisite view of the strip.I will add at this point that this resort is VERY convenient to the two major expressways and parking at the resort is plentiful and easy to find.Back to the room: there is a washer and dryer combo which makes this a delight for light packers and families with children. A full service kitchen helps to save money on not having to rush out for breakfast or order in. The nearby Silverton casino has great food service and a shuttle and groceries and fast food joints are within a miles drive. The room is contractually cleaned once, midweek through your stay. Days and times are flexible.Herein lies the problem we experienced. Asha, the desk personnel who checked us in forgot to put our suite on the list to have the room cleaned, not only once but twice during our two weeks so, the "resort" fee of $25.00 per week ( which came as a last minute surprise and check in) was to be reversed or credted back because our room was not cleaned.Do you hear the ball dropping?When we checked for our first week I agreed to pay the suprise resort fee and initialed the line on the upper right hand corner. FYI: the Cancun monarch on last Vegas Blvd also has a resort fee. But it's older and the rooms smaller. The Tahiti Village on Las Vegas blvd does NOT have a resort and is perfect for a families with children because of its beautiful and spacious pool and water works. However, parking it not good compared to the Berkley.Back to the problem: even though Asha said our room would be cleaned midweek on Wednesday at 2:00pm and wrote that on our contract she did not write it on the clipboard or notifiy the cleaning service vendor.At the end of our first week we had to "checkout" and reregister for our second week. At this time I complained about the lack of cleaning and asked that I not be charged the resort fee.When I filled out the second week's contract I DID NOT INITIAL the upper right hand corner agreeing to the resort fee and scheduled a cleaning for Tuesday at 2:00pm.As it turns out this "box of rocks", again failed to notify the cleaning contractor and furthermore was charged a resort even though I had NOT authorized that charge.Manager Joy Watson to the rescue..........not really, she made empty promises and a month later had to recontact another manager at the resort to look into this matter.Now, Iresha to the rescue and YES! She did put through the credit for the unauthorized resort fee charged AND reversed the resort fee for the first week. Now that's what I call customer service. HR got their money's when they hired her.Will I go back? A resounding yes. My stay was comfortable, the resort convenient, and Iresha did what no one else could. Thank you, dear.

allReviews.title: Very nice option
allReviews.text: I booked a 1 - bedroom suite for a week. The rooms are large and tastefully decorated. The kitchen was decently appointed. The bathroom was very large with separate tub and shower. Given the heat wave I appreciated that the air conditioning was efficient and quiet. Parking was provided south of the building and was monitored by security from the Silverton Casino. The only amenity is a swimming pool that was well used on weekends.

allReviews.title: the berkley at silverton casino, las vegas
allReviews.text: huge condo with full kitchen, separate tub/shower, big bathroom, living/eating areas, 2 vanity sinks (one in main bath, other as makeup area), 2 TV's, sofa bed for additional 2 people, king size bed, lots of drawer space -- next door is the silverton casino which provides a complimentary shuttle to the aria casino on the strip, location is a bit south of the strip, nearby is a chipotle restaurant, a 99cents store for groceries, jack in the box, mcdonald's, target witin 10 min walk.  has a nice pool, gym, ice, snack machines.property is 2 years old and units are clean and well maintained.  this is a time share property and if staying for a week will get one "pickup" session a week -- linen gets changed, garbage taken -- that's it.  resort fee is $ 25 for the stay.great for a family stay.  business, was a bit of a hassle to get to the strip in the mornings having to take a taxi as the shuttle starts at 10 am

allReviews.title: This is a really great place to stay in Las Vegas if you do not want the hassle of the Strip.
allReviews.text: I wasn't sure what to expect given some of the reviews, but thought I'd try it.  I was in a one bedroom, condo-type unit. I stayed for a week on a timeshare getaway.   It was brand new, very impressive contemporary furnishings. Have to say I had a rental car so it was easy for me to navigate around. But if you like the strip, I understand there is a shuttle.  The strip is only a few miles away.  I hike in Red Rock Canyon so this was a very convenient location.  The staff was superb, very willing to answer any questions.  Coffee and tea available in the lobby 24 hrs.  To those who complained about no ice machine in the frig, get over it.  Go downstairs and get all the ice you want.  You will not be catered to as far as housekeeping, but you can get anything you need at the desk. The views are fabulous from the big picture windows.  i will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Almost a 5
allReviews.text: Very nice place away from the crowded Las Vegas. You definitely would need to rent to figure out your transportation needs. It’s next door to The Silverton Casino for your dining and entertainment. I would definitely a do over.

allReviews.title: Outstanding Value
allReviews.text: I hesitate to say how much I enjoyed this place for fear that it will get booked more often and I won't be able to keep coming here. But I have to say that it is one of the nicest hotels we have ever stayed in. Rooms are very large and comfy. The layout of the hotel allows for easy access to all amenities. Parking is free and close to hotel entrance. And it is close enough to the strip to visit without being so close that you have to endure the crazy traffic and party animals. We will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: relaxing resort
allReviews.text: new everything at the resort. next door to the casino. lots of free parking. easy on and off from the freeway. very nice pool. but lacking furniture in the reception area and all the in room ice makers not working

allReviews.title: Clean and spacious new hotel
allReviews.text: The Berkley is very new and the place is clean and spacious. We were on the 18th floor so we had a wonderful view of Las Vegas. My only concern is we kept getting shocked with the key card while trying to open the room door. Maybe because its a new hotel with the carpets. The staff tried many times to rectify the problem but no luck. Hopefully, when I return again to The Berkley that problem can be solved because it was getting really annoyed and frightening being zapped all the time. Tip: walk over to the casino to get the free shuttle to the strip.

allReviews.title: NICE TIMESHARE PLACE
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights last week.  I have stayed at a few timeshare places in Las Vegas and this place is very nice.It is located off the strip about a 10 minute drive to the strip.  I did not see if they has a shuttle.  It is located on the grounds of the Silverton Casino and although it does not have direct indoor access it is literally a 1 min walk into the casino.  For a off strip casino Silverton is very nice and not like other off strip places it is connected to a big bass pro shop retail location on one end.We had a one bedroom unit it was very nice well appointed and the beds were comfortable.  The living room funiture was a little hard but I know they do that to make sure it lasts.  The kitchen layout was one of the better ones I have seen.The pool location is out front right beside the parking lot.   This resort is new so the plants have not built up yet when they do you will have more privacy in the pool.There was a festival running in the parking lot on one end on the resort when we arrived which was very loud and have live bands playing.  The first night music went on to early morning so I had to wear ear plugs to sleep.  In the future should the hotel have an event like that next door they should inform guest at booking and also supply guests with ear plugs.A few weird things we noticed.  When you arrive there is just one pod for the dishwasher / no ice in the fridge ( although there is a auto ice maker it is disabled and you have to go down to the lobby to get ice) one roll of toilet paper and one roll of paper towels.  They will supply you with more but you have to go down to the front desk to get it.  I am sure they are trying to feel out where things fit as a new resort I just found it a little odd.This place is worth staying at and very reasonably priced.

allReviews.title: UNBIASED Review!!!
allReviews.text: Ok.....let me make this short so you wont lose interest. The hotel is nice and clean. I love the large bathroom and the fully loaded kitchen! I did not realize that room service is not provided and you have to wash clothes yourself during vacation....this should be posted on their website clearly! The first night there I asked one of the associates behind check-in for 10 bags of coffee to try to save them time and myself from having to ask for a few packs daily. You would have thought I asked her to help me bury a body! She acted is if I was trying to hoard/steal the HOTEL coffee! She said she could give me 5 packs and I could come back the next day....what I was trying to avoid! This hotel is not on the strip, it is about a 10 min ride from the heart of the strip! There is some really good restaurants next door to choose from......"Seasons" was very good and cheap! There "free shuttle" only goes to one or two locations and it runs only every 3 or 4 hours! I don't think I would stay here again unless I was given a really big discount! I hope I helped!

allReviews.title: Tired of broken promises
allReviews.text: Tired of the broken promises!  Promised jetted tub in room,not! Full kitchen and while cooking notice they have no knifes! Go down to front desk and they tell me tomorrow,meanwhile my food is cooking have to tear my steak open with bare hands,and last ,wake up  the next morning around 0627am no cable ,no tv for at least 6 hours I had it with them never again in life!stay away from the Berkeley hotel unless you are basis,and for my $$$ im not basis sorry if you on the phone with th Berkeley hotel don’t fall for there promise I’m out! Larryg5573@yahoo.com

allReviews.title: One mile to the strip... not exactly!
allReviews.text: First let me clarify... this is a great property. Clean, quiet and very well maintained. With a nice casino right next door... The Silverton. As for The Strip... you are one mile from it,but it's the south end... about 4 miles +_ from Mandalay Bay which is really the first property at the southern end of the real Strip. So, you'll need a car or be prepared to Uber or Lyft or taxi if you want to see the real action. Fremont Street is probably 15 miles..Walking to any type dining other than the casino is probably a half mile at least and it will be fast food.. McDonalds etc.So, be sure to rent a car...and be sure to have GPS

allReviews.title: Good place with huge rooms
allReviews.text: Ended up there as our airbnb had been cancelled las minute. We had a suite for 2 people. It is basically 2 large apartments with kitchen, washing machine and everything you’d need for a few days in Vegas. Only strage thing.... no knife in the room.About 15mn from the Strip (15$ with a lyft or uber)

allReviews.title: Excellent rooms excellent service
allReviews.text: If you get a dbl suite understand that this is a suite where everything is duplicate and can sleep 8 comfortably. Not one complaint from my group of 6,and we've been all over California, Miami and Las Vegas

allReviews.title: The Berkley
allReviews.text: The property is well located for being away from the strip, but everything is easy to get to airport ,I-15. The Strip, etc. The rooms were very comfortable and well furnished, the size of the rooms was awesome.  liked being next to the Silverton for gambling and eats.  Close to a shopping center which is handy.  We were on 17th floor facing strip so could see lights.  I'm sure we will be back again because of the easy parking, location and just being comfortable for place to stay. And price is not bad for what you get.

allReviews.title: Doing laundry on vacation is AWESOME
allReviews.text: I will definitely start with the good and then it will all go downhill from there. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The location was nice because it was far enough away that we didn't have any noise really. The parking was free and the hotel didn't have a gross smell. It actually had a washer and drier in the room that you didn't have to pay to use. The oversized bed was comfortable and the view was amazing. Now for the negatives. When we got there only one light worked in the bedroom. I went to unplug the lamp that did work and when I tried to plug it back in it wouldn't go. Turns out all the outlets were like this so every time we needed to plug something in you had to push on it as if we were going to break it. The towels were very starchy and scratched your skin so bad. It felt like I was drying off with a Brillo pad. Then after two days I inform them I need more towels because we were almost out. They informed me that they don't replenish the towels. That the washer and drier in the room was so YOU can wash them. Are you freaking kidding me?? So on vacation I had to wash my own towels so their lazy cleaning staff didn't have to do anything. We stayed there four days and was never visited by housekeeping. We had to once again go and ask for some more shampoo and whatnot. I half expected them to give us the ingredients and expected us to procure the products ourselves. Oh and on the way out only ONE elevator worked for 18 floors of people. We were on the 17th floor so once we finally got on it filled up by the 15th floor. Then it stopped at every single floor and we had to tell them it was full. That was the cherry on the cake. I don't think I will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Niiiiice!
allReviews.text: We booked 2 adjoining rooms for 6 nights. I tossed up between spending the same amount for a small room on the strip to The Berkley, which was almost 3 times the size and which meant we all got our own space.LOCATION:  It's less than a 10 minute drive to the strip. There's heaps of parking available if you have your own car. We used UBER the whole time we were there. Also, there are discounts if you use LYFT. Note: The Berkley shares the same building and entrances as the Silverton Apartments. So when you are driving there for the first time, look for the SILVERTON signage at the top of the building as there is no big Berkley signage, apart from the signs on ground level. This confused some of our Uber drivers as well. There are also 2 spots for pick up - front (MAIN) and back entrances. CHECK IN: We arrived straight from the Airport at about 1pm. Check in is 4pm. Luckliy there were 2 adjoining rooms available so we got those rooms early at no extra cost. That was a big relief after travelling 16 hours from Australia. We were on the 7th floor.Shout out to Iresha at reception for being ever so awesome during our stay there :)ROOM: Perfect! The housekeeping team have done a great job. I didn't find anything that was dirty or out of place. Our room was facing the non-strip side, but still, the views of the mountains were pretty cool. Everything in the kitchen looked brand new from the small appliances to the fridge. It had all that you needed in an apartment. The bathroom is really pretty. Clean towels, bathroom amenities, hairdryer & iron provided. The shower is big and hot/cold water + water pressure were all good. The washing machine & dryer were easy to use and washing powder is provided. The bed was soooo comfortable! Pillows were comfortable as well. There' s a lot of storage space for clothes inc. a cupboard, large chest of drawers and side tables. There's a flatscreen TV in the bedroom and the other in the lounge. The sofabed in the lounge is pretty big. There was little noise from outside our room. Even though the apartment is next the flight path, it didn't bother me (and I'm a light sleeper too). IN THE AREA: There's The Silverton Casino next door with a couple of restaurants + shops. There's a Starbucks and one of the restaurants is 24 hours.Less than 5 minute drive away are: MacDonalds, Target, Ross, In-N-Out Burger and the rest I can't remember - there's a full list of what's around in the room. GROCERIES: There's a big grocery store 5 min away called SMITH'S which is located at Desert Diamond Plaza >> See Google Maps. It was our first stop in Las Vegas. We stocked up the fridge and pantry. You can save a lot of money eating in (which we did half the time) rather than eating out for every meal of the day. WIFI: Free, strong signal & no dropouts. GYM: Open 5am to 10pm which I thought was pretty decent. Good range of cardio machines and more.  All equipment was in good working order and gym was clean. OTHER AREAS I DIDN'T USE: There's an activity/computer room. I stuck my head in, looked well equiped with a few computers and printers. Pool - I only ever saw it busy once during my stay. There are also 2 vending machines opposite the lifts. Ice maker on ground floor too. CHECK OUT: We checked out at 9am and it literally took less than 30 seconds. Really happy overall with our stay at The Berkley. Would highly recommend. Yes it's away from the strip but I was happy with the location cos sometimes you just need some quiet chill time away from the hustle and bustle.

allReviews.title: Very poor service.
allReviews.text: There were two women who worked the desk who were wonderful and wish I had their names but they were the best part of the stay. Very kind. The others, weren’t helpful very rude and not every accommodating. The rooms were dirty, pillows had stains on them and we had to swap out outlet cards several times bc the room keys stopped working. The construction that was going on went on late at night but they locked the automatic doors so you had to walk all the way around.  They provided us with two rolls of toilet paper. After that, you’re on your own. They wouldn’t give us more pillows or extra blankets and wouldn’t give more towels. Since there is a washer/dryer in the room you have to wash your own and they don’t give out extra. The pillows felt like sandpaper on your face. Home staff wasn’t very helpful and we were just left to fend for ourselves. I wanted to like this place. The pool was nice.  You have to use the shuttle at the silverton which is directly behind us.   I wouldn’t stay here again.  Next time, I will try somewhere else or just stay on the strip somewhere.

allReviews.title: All In One Accommodation
allReviews.text: To tell the truth I was not really too sure what to expect booking this location. As a solo traveller I was at the end of a vacation travelling around and wanted to find a place I could be near to the craziness of the Strip but far enough away to remain sane.The Berkley is next door to The Silverton Casino approximately a ten minute drive from the southern end of the Strip and very close to a huge Bass Pro Shop.The two high rise buildings house a number of suites that are very nicely appointed and offer all amenities to stay comfortably, whether you'd like to self cater during your stay to eat out (restaurants in the Casino). The suites are set out as self contained apartments offering secure privacy.I stayed two nights and paid a fee that would have purchased a single nights accommodation of a 4 star hotel on the strip with the bonus of a 'home feel' and the ability to cater for myself if required. Everything seemed almost new. Lovely. Access points were wide and I'm sure that people with disabilities would find this compliant.The only downside was that the building is in the flight path to McCarran Airport and at times during the day the plane noise is repetitive.I slept soundly.

allReviews.title: Beautiful rooms and clean hotel all around
allReviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 nights, 4 days. I would say that we had a great experience staying here. We stayed on the top floor, giving us a great view of the strip. Inside the room was beautiful and clean. It was nice that they do not provide housekeeping because, while we were not in the room, we were not fully comfortable with strangers entering our room. With that being said, the rooms do provide a fully stocked kitchen, plus a washer and dryer if you need to get any laundry done while on vacation. Not only was the staff friendly and helpful, they have a very nice pool with chairs actually in the water. The casino is right behind the hotel, providing a decent amount of food options. The only complaint that I have, is the shuttle to the strip. It was a little inconvenient that it only operated four times out of the day. Meaning that you would have to request the shuttle and it was a first come first serve thing. Fortunately lyft is available, we relied on that a lot and it was only about $10 to get there or back.  Other than that, I highly recommend staying at this hotel!

allReviews.title: Birthday trip
allReviews.text: The hotel itself it very quiet and clean. I have zero complaints. The room was clean, everything was as described.  It's definitely a place for families or people looking for a home feel. I would stay again

allReviews.title: Pretty looking but once you check in it's Grey Gardens
allReviews.text: Property just changed hands so the staff in the Lobby blame a lot of the issues on this. When we checked in to our 2 bedroom suite one side didn't have working light switches. We found the locked circuit breaker panel and had to call down to have a maintenance person come up (was told it would be 20 min). After waiting 30 minutes we were already heading out and stopped by the lobby to tell them our plan. That's when the Gentlemen said "1. Who did you speak to? 2. Well the maintenance team leaves at 5pm so you'll have to wait until Monday." I was DUMBFOUNDED. It was a woman who answered the phone, I don't ask for names for such a basic request, whoever answered your phone. None of the women in the lobby spoke up. This is a 17 story property, they can't have someone flip a circuit breaker? We were leaving Sunday. He actually asked me if the lights that weren't working "were very important?" I asked my friend to pinch me because I couldn't believe that this guy was NOT joking. On our last day the hotel had problems with the electric sliding doors. They locked them and put a sign on up that said out of order. I had just walked through one 10 min pervious to get a Starbucks at Silverton. There was a guest who didn't read the sign and tried to push the emergency release bar (doors were locked). I asked at the Lobby if this was a fire hazard and they said "Nope there are other exits," and she pointed to a single door on the West end of the property, a good 300 feet down the room corridor.

allReviews.title: WONDERFUL STAY!!
allReviews.text: My experience with The Berkley Las Vegas was a very positive one. The staff was very professional and the rooms were more than accommodating and huge! Full kitchen and washer and dryer were a great touch and would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone !!

allReviews.title: Best Hotel ever
allReviews.text: I won the hotel in a radio show in NY was a little skeptical at first but the room was first class it came with a full kitchen and even a washer and dryer in the room housekeeping doesn't clean the room until you check out but it was just so great the pool n everything was clean and I really enjoyed my time there

allReviews.title: Fantstic for our large family
allReviews.text: We had 16 people ages 8 months to 92 years gathering for a family reunion. The Berkley was perfect for us.  We were able to reserve several suites, which gave us a lot of common area to spend casual time together, but also separate bedrooms for privacy. Staff was fantastic.  Everything was new and CLEAN. Bathrooms were GREAT, big tub, big shower, 2 sinks in each bathroom.  Nice, clean pool & big hot tub.  The only cons we found were small details - only 3 sets of bath & pool towels in rooms for 4 people, ice makers didn't work in the new fridges in any of our suites (the only ice maker in the resort is on the bottom floor), no ramp into main lobby which is a pain w/ luggage, only 2 luggage carts for the entire resort which had to be checked out w/ a driver's license - DEFINITELY not nearly enough (check out was ugly), no salt/pepper, etc. - all very little details. We would definitely go again!

allReviews.title: family time at a resort that's not a resort  yet
allReviews.text: The 1st night was ok, the rooms are nice. but going into the next night the Bluetooth speaker didn't work but nice David got it working, also both toilets were backing up we called and they told us that the plungers were in with the washer and dryer, no one came to check on it. Also they only have 3 elevators and one ended up braking down, that was not fixed, since they are selling this as a resort I can't believe no room or maid service. when leaving we needed a cart to take our things down they only have 2 so it took us at least an hour to check out. Also some of the clerks customer service was lacking, I tried to enquire how we could get a better deal with me being and RCI member, they said nothing could be done because my niece had already booked it through booking.com they will have to do a lot before I stay there again ??

allReviews.title: Great place!
allReviews.text: We found The Berkley at the last minute, but can't say enough about how much we enjoyed our stay!  There were two families (3 people in each family) and we reserved a suite.  Each family had a one bedroom condo with a little "foyer" area that connected our individual space together.  The staff were all very professional and courteous.  The rooms and common areas were exceptionally clean and our condos were well stocked.  We're thinking of making this our "go-to" place to stay the next time we visit Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay, but a few things should be changed.
allReviews.text: The property is very clean, and the rooms are perfectly maintained. This is brand new (opened around October 2016). Large units, well appointed, with large bathroom. The front desk staff was very friendly and helpful, except for the check in and check out time restrictions. My only issue was with the check in and check out times. I got there are 3:40 PM (check in time is 4:00 PM), and was told that it was not possible to check in before 4:00 PM "Because all the rooms are assigned at 4:00 PM". So I walked around for 20 minutes, then returned and had to wait as others were trying to check in. Then my room keys were pulled from a pile that was obviously ready before 4 PM. On the day of check out (check out time is 10AM), I get a call from the front desk at 9:25 AM giving me a "Friendly reminder" that check out time was "Before 10 AM". As I am getting ready to leave my unit at 10:20 AM, I have a security guard knocking on my door to make sure I am leaving. This felt pushy and unprofessional.

allReviews.title: Can't Say Enough Good Things
allReviews.text: From the second we checked in, the experience was 5-star. The staff was uncommonly kind and accommodating. The rooms were beautiful and fully stocked for everything you need to have a great stay. Two TV's, full kitchen, gorgeous shower and vanities, living room. It really is a mini apartment. The location was also nice. We had a great dinner at The Silverton's steakhouse called Twin Creeks and my husband spent hours at Bass Pro Shop next door. We really enjoyed the hotel's spa and pool. Overall it was a fabulous stay.

allReviews.title: Response to Liz A 1 rating
allReviews.text: I have stayed at other locations of this resort. It is called Vacation Village. The Vacation Village Resorts® family of properties includes Berkshire Mountain Lodge, The Cliffs at Peace Canyon, The Colonies at Williamsburg, The Grandview at Las Vegas, Massanutten Resort , Mizner Place at Weston Town Center, Palm Beach Shores, Patriots Inn, Vacation Village in the Berkshires, Vacation Village at Bonaventure, Vacation Village at Parkway, Vacation Village at Weston, Wilderness Presidential Resort at Chancellorsville, Williamsburg Plantation and our newest resort, The Berkley, Las Vegas. We also have more than 40 Affiliated Resorts throughout the United States. All of these resorts are top notch and I have enjoyed every stay with them. Try putting the Do Not Disturb sign on your door. The employee was probably just wanting to exchange towels and empty trash.

allReviews.title: Web of Confusion & Forced Entry
allReviews.text: So... how was YOUR Valentine's Day?! Ours? Oh, ya know, my husband and I were taking it easy in our suite at the Berkley-- which is NOT a resort, if you happen to have been under that impression, ya know, since that's how it's marketed-- and someone used a room key card to open our door. There was no knock and no announcement for housekeeping (which would not have made sense anyway since daily housekeeping is not available here-- it is actually a timeshare property). The only reasons the person was unable to get inside were that a) we happen to have been there and b) we happen to have had the manual interior latch engaged. Incredulous-- and having just prepared to hop in the shower-- I did not make it to the door in time to see who it was. I immediately phoned the lobby and asked why someone would be trying to enter our room with a functioning key card. The receptionist asked whether the person knocked or announced that he/she was a member of her housekeeping staff, and I informed her that the person had not knocked and had not spoken. She assured me that she would look into the issue and phone me back. Several minutes passed with no return phone call, so my husband made a trip to the lobby and spoke with the general manager, who informed him that the individual was, in fact, a member of the housekeeping staff contracted through a third party vendor and that as a result of the error she had been sent home. At the request of my husband, the GM did eventually make her way up to our room to personally apologize for the mistake, though had my husband not ventured to the lobby I have my doubts about whether anyone might have followed up with us at all. As a peace offering, she provided us with a voucher for the buffet located within the Silverton Casino, and while I explained that we appreciated the gesture, I told her it was unlikely we would spend our last night there. We didn't. We booked a room for $66 through Travelocity at the Monte Carlo. On the strip. From the moment we *attempted to* check-in, this place was a fast-talking nightmare of confusion, as we had been informed through our booking agency that check-in time was 3PM, though according to staff at the Berkley it was actually 4PM. Despite the fact that the place was visibly [alarmingly] vacant, we were forced to adhere to the 4PM check-in time AND were told that in order to retrieve the show vouchers guaranteed by our purchase of our stay, we would need to travel ELSEWHERE to the Berkley's sister property and that while we were there, we could schedule a meeting to discuss the timeshare schpiel with someone. Fortunately for my husband and me, none of the available time slots worked with our schedule since a) no one ever mentioned this aspect to us and b) we had been looking forward to this trip and had our days mapped out already. Having been awake and traveling since 1AM local time and with no feasible transportation between the properties (apart from a shuttle that ran in 2-hour intervals-- just enough of a window to be swindled into attending a previously undisclosed timeshare sales-pitch) and having already been royally screwed by a taxi driver, we opted to skip what would have been additional leg to our already miserable journey. In summary-- if it is not yet obvious-- I assure you that apart from the Berkley's beautiful room finishes, you have plenty of reasons to look elsewhere for accommodations. Stay. Away.

allReviews.title: Off the Strip
allReviews.text: On a recent visit to Vegas for business I was only too happy to leave the craziness and standstill traffic of the Strip behind. The apartments at The Berkley are brand new, clean, comfortable and spacious, all with beautiful views. My weeklong stay was great and I enjoyed having a fully operational kitchen in the suite. I would only advise to ask about maid service because it is not routinely provided in the price of the suites. The building also has a pool ( smallish) and a gym. Free parking space is provided and it takes only about ten minutes to drive back into the insanity of downtown Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: 3 nights visit
allReviews.text: Booked this hotel based on good reviews for reasonable price for nice suite with separate rooms. We got kind of small apartment with fully equipped kitchen, washing machine etc.. which we didn't need, but it was nice to have. Location was ok, since we used car or lyft/uber service all the time. The hotel is new which is great. At the same time it makes troubles to find it for some.

allReviews.title: AVOID
allReviews.text: My original review was deleted. Dirty hotel. Rooms are gross and very outdated, all the dressers, cabinets and lamps were broken. We called to have our room cleaned again and no one came with any urgency, we packed up after an hour and left to another hotel. Everything about the room and hotel felt and looked dirty. Location is trash too

allReviews.title: Amazing service from Sara the bartender!
allReviews.text: Sara the bartender was the best - she took such great care of us at the Rojo bar and lounge.  Her recommendations were spot on, the food and drinks she made were amazing. Thank you for the incredible experience, Sara! We will absolutely be coming back again  and again while we are here. Love, Sam and Angela

allReviews.title: Palms Place - Quit, Relaxing, Private Feeling
allReviews.text: Alberto provided excellent service with a wonderful attitude. The assigned room offered a magnificent view of the strip. However, the sliding door to the balcony was locked, and I did not have the key, likely for safety reasons.Please note that there are two separate Palms properties: one for the hotels and another for the Palms Place, which is generally quieter, more tranquil, and offers a relaxing atmosphere away from the strip's commotion.Overall, it was a great experience, and certainly a wonderful place to spend the night.

allReviews.title: Best
allReviews.text: Went in for F1 weekend palms place was amazing Natasha at the front was more than amazing! Amazing great stay great place can’t wait to be back

allReviews.title: Rude and unsanitary
allReviews.text: The rooms were dirty. The hotel is kinda dirty itself not a lot of the features in the room work or outlets. On top of that staff at the front desk are really rude especially the men who check to see if you have a room key by the elevators they are so rude and they yell at everybody coming in. No one ever says hello. No one is ever in a good mood. Just a very unwelcoming hotel. It’s like they don’t want you there.

allReviews.title: Stunning
allReviews.text: Since I Left Vegas In 23 When I Visit I Stay Here and Even When I Lived In Vegas I Stayed Here A Few Times and It's Always Pleasant but This Time Was Even Better bcuz Of The Young Lady at The Front Desk Was So Helpful and Made Sure I Got Exactly What I Needed 4 My Stay... Her Name Was Natasha and 2 Be The Prettiest Woman In The World She Had The Best Attitude and Went The Extra Mile 4 Me! I Appreciate Her and Next Time I Come She's Getting Flower's From Me and Respectfully She Deserves A Raise!!! These Companies Must Understand That The People Who Greet Customers Make The Company and Not The Other Way Around and She Makes The Company Better... Thanks Again Tasha

allReviews.title: Quite simply the worst hotel I have ever stayed in.
allReviews.text: Where do I start? The staff were rude and surly from the outset with no form of welcome.They took $500 at the beginning of our stay for incidentals when we were never going to spend this amount.The pool that was advertised was closed resulting in us having to buy a pool pass at another hotel.The restaurants were poor quality and had only basic decor; they were also located at the other side of the casino in the main Palms complex.The hotel did not provide any form of room service, so no rubbish collection, clean towels, toilet rolls or fresh bedding. When questioned they said they would only do it if we paid a further $100.The whole experience was an absolute joke and despite emailing the owners they have just ignored any messages.

allReviews.title: Felt Unsafe and Ignored by Hotel Staff
allReviews.text: I stayed at Palms Place on Oct 18, 2025, and had an alarming experience I would never expect from a hotel of this standard. I was traveling alone. About 15 minutes after a man with a cart knocked on my door (unannounced), someone tried to enter my room using a keycard. Thankfully the bolt lock stopped them.I called the front desk immediately and was told security was on the way but no one came for 2 hours. When security finally showed up, they were rude and dismissive. I filed a written statement, and no one followed up. I was not moved or contacted, and I felt unsafe the rest of my stay.I hope the hotel takes guest safety more seriously in the future. This was unacceptable.– Alia V.

allReviews.title: AVOID - False advertising, misleading pictures,  NO POOL or DINING, unprofessional staff
allReviews.text: I want to warn other travellers to AVOID this. I checked in and within a few hours, checked OUT to change hotels. Problems as follows:1.Room: dark, poor lighting, confusing set up, could be cleaner, air quality POOR very STUFFY. Okay fine, not thrilled but it's fine.... then.....2. We found a typed but undated letter on the desk: "sorry we're turning off the water tomorrow from 11am-3pm on floors X-Y." I immediately went downstairs to ask to change rooms because we'd need the shower that day before going to our events!... 3. Interaction with front desk staff: "I found this note", "Oh that can't be true we don't do that we did that last month I don't think it's true we've never heard anything." "Well can you ask your manager to confirm?" *Comes back* "Oh yeah sorry it is true". Bad news and bad communication. It gets worse.. 4. I overhear the clerk telling the guest next to me "Our pool and dining are closed for the season" (!!!) Well, you can imagine my reaction - I wasn't told this about an hour earlier when  I checked in. I said "what?? that's not advertised on the website". Clerk: "I dunno we don't manage the website" (!!!)Oh no no no. It was also an uncomfortable atmosphere. Guests appeared to be young people in their 20s having parties. No warm welcome or greeting from any front desk or room staff, there being only 4 people there when we arrived, it was a large empty lobby. To check in, one person stepped slightly forward of the "wait here" sign, yet nowhere remotely close to the front desk/other people/transactions being made. An angry ?security/attendant staff barked at the guest "STEP BACK". I was horrified.All this culminating to generally not feel safe, helped, able to trust the future and wanting out asap.I spoke with the manager and front desk staff to let them know I was very disappointed, frustrated and stressed out to have to find new lodgings that night. Because of their FALSE ADVERTISING. Their reaction was along the lines of "sorry that sucks, you can leave". Zero consideration for guests, for booking a lengthy (2 week) stay on site.

allReviews.title: Alberto & Aretha Are Super Stars of Palms Place Hotel
allReviews.text: The initial Check-in Rep I submitted my ID to at check-in was unhelpful.  His attitude and unwillingness to help was off-putting, after 3 attempts to check-in I was at a loss, until  Alberto came to the rescue.  He was investigative, asked the right questions and ultimately determined what the issue was, and I was able to finally get checked in.  The issue was minor, but I truly appreciated Alberto’s efforts.  Unfortunately,  I did not get the name of the other Rep, but he is the reason the rating was downgraded from Excellent.  Everyone else we encountered was very nice and accommodating.  Aretha was dutiful and made it a point to make our dining experience enjoyable.  I can tell she has a high standard of service & ethics and should be commended.  As for the Palms Place Hotel, it is a great place to stay.  I loved our room.

allReviews.title: Excellent stay
allReviews.text: 2nd time staying at Palms Place-upon check in at 3pm the lobby was full-however check in process was seamless and quick with service from Alberto. He was uber professional and pleasant. The attendant at the bell desk (Hawaiian gentleman) was equally friendly and helpful--we enjoyed meeting him as well. We were staying overnight for a fundraiser next door. We will definitely return next year!

allReviews.title: Servers at pool are LOVELY
allReviews.text: Was mainly here for the classy residential pool and it was so nice and relaxing. Pool is perfect temp and they hot tub is so nice to sit in after.It's clean out here and all the servers are so nice and friendly to you no matter what! (It came get a little windy up here since it's 6 stories, but the servers and lifeguards do an amazing job remaining professional.)Jaleeia (or Jaleea I believe) was my server. I was with my family, and she checked up on us multiple times, and brought out the best drinks! She made us laugh a ton too!

allReviews.title: Awesome Condo
allReviews.text: Want to shout out to South who greeted us and was very professional and helpful. The condo and pool were amazing.  There is only two things that was not mentioned when making reservations.  1.  If you are making reservations  for a one bedroom suite facing the strip, what they fail to advise is the doors are locked to the balcony. You do not have access. This was one of the main reasons why we selected this reservation was to sit out on the balcony at night to take pictures or sit and have a drink or eat.  2.  You have to call to get any utensils or kitchen amenities to cook with.I would suggest this be mentioned with the reservations.

allReviews.title: Felt at home at Palms Place 😍
allReviews.text: Went for the Backstreet Boys concert and couldnt be happier with our stay. We booked the one bedroom suite and the place is HUGE! We went to the pools, casino and buffet and absolutely loved our stay. Shout out to Ruthy R. At the frontdesk who made us feel so welcome on the get go and made for the best vacaction ever! We are thinking on returning soon for more concerts so we will absolutely book here again and are recommending it to all our BSB Army friends here in Mexico.

allReviews.title: Laguna Pool House & Kitchen
allReviews.text: I took my family of 8 to Palms Place last month and we loved the Laguna Pool House and Kitchen! The atmosphere was nice and calm and overlooked the pool outside. The food was amazing and our server, Aretha, was AMAZING!!!! Sweet, so fun to chat with and definitely took care of the whole family! I actually remembered her from a previous trip to Palms Place and LPH earlier this year and was so happy to have her take care of us. She was so great I wanted to make sure I made the effort to leave a great review- because I don’t do it often. Thanks, Aretha!

allReviews.title: Great time with friends and our server Jaleesa
allReviews.text: Had an amazing time at the pool today with my friends. Jaleesa was our server and she was so awesome. Very attentive. Always made sure out drinks were full and kept the food coming right on time. Thank you for taking such great care of us.

allReviews.title: Check in issues
allReviews.text: When I arrived for my stay there was unfortunately a hiccup with my room and I was unable to check in. Understandably this is very frustrating as I was tired from traveling; however Lexi was very empathetic and understanding to our situation and ensured that she would get the problem resolved. As more groups were coming over to check in she continued to check on my group and made sure to give us updates and continued to keep us comfortable until our room was ready. She kept a light positive attitude throughout all of it and joked around with us and did everything she could to help expedite the process. I was so happy to have someone who was so willing to help us and prioritize our comfort. She really helped turn around a potentially frustrating situation.

allReviews.title: Great service and personality!!
allReviews.text: Davion the Bartender was great, professional and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back. Thank you for your great hospitality.

allReviews.title: VIOLENT FOOD POISONING
allReviews.text: The hotel itself is fine and the presence of staff is helpful for quick asks, however, that is where all average enjoyment stops. We planned an anniversary stay with the expressed desire to go to AYCE for their acclaimed Lobster Dinner followed by Cirque O. The service at the buffet was sub optimal-even with a reservation the hostess was unwelcoming and curt-boarding in dismissive. Within 30 minutes of eating a plate of lobster my husband became seriously physically uncomfortable. We finished our meal about 30 minutes later and my husband was immediately violently ill with food poisoning. The violence of his food poisoning cannot be understated and caused us to miss the Cirque O show. He was so ill dehydration set in and he is still not recovered after 23hrs despite care.The hotel front desk made us file a security incident report and said they “might” follow up in 7-10 business days. We cannot believe that they haven’t even offered a refund for, at minimum,  our dinner. The genuine lack of care or awareness is as horrendous as their lack of food safety adherence. The combination of uncaring staff and the loss of $700 ($200 dinner that caused explosive illness and $500 in show tickets) will keep us from ever returning nor will we recommend Palms to or fellow travelers.

allReviews.title: Palms Place - Laguna Pool House and Kitchen

allReviews.title: Be aware!!
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Palms Place this weekend for a birthday celebration. I booked my reservations through American Express travel. Unknowingly, my room was reserved with Strip View Suites. The experience was absolutely terrible.From check in to check out. The room was not functional, filthy, and smelled the pungent stench of sewage. Strip View Suites at Palms Place wanted to know about the experience, and it was absolutely awful. Here are pictures!There are plenty more to share. From broken TV's, broken bathroom fixtures, all appliances in the kitchen not working, ripped curtains. The list goes on. Not to mention, Crystal refused to help, hung up on me when I called, then sent my call to voicemail each time I called back. I do not recommend this business or the Palms Place. We should have stayed at the motel 6, as the accommodations would have been much better!The staff at the Palms Place helped as minimally as possible. Awful experience.

allReviews.title: My birthday trip stay had me frustrated and disappointed
allReviews.text: 1/5This was my first visit to the Palms for my birthday celebration, expecting a luxurious and seamless experience, but unfortunately, it was far from that. I will say the location is great, taxi’s are always available. SEND noodles was great!! the clerk at AYCE was rude and the buffet was 2/5. Everything was cold. First, the one-bedroom suite was disappointing—poorly maintained and not up to the standards expected at this price point.  Black out curtains in the bedroom were torn and ripped from the ceiling. The drawers kept getting stuck so you’d have to almost break the door. The lighting in the bathroom kept flickering on and off. To make matters worse, the dryer didn’t work, making it incredibly inconvenient for us. Maintenance never showed up, but Justin the front desk clerk was notified. The staff was disorganized and lacked communication. Simple requests took forever to be addressed, and it seemed like no one knew what was going on. Every interaction was frustrating, with delays and miscommunication at every turn. Security would you see walk by/greet you and then asked to see your room key card. Management attempted to compensate by waiving resort fees and offering a food credit, but when I checked my bill, the food credit was nowhere to be found. This just added to the overall lack of professionalism and attention to detail.For a hotel that presents itself as high-end, the service was anything but. Broken amenities, unresponsive management, and empty promises made this stay disappointing, especially for a special occasion. There are far better options in Las Vegas that actually value their guests. I celebrated my 35th in Vegas.. I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

allReviews.text: Fantastic stay! One of the best attributes and qualities about staying at Palms Place is that you are away from the casinos and the inundation of busyness and the chaotic energy of the Strip.  However, you will be close enough to everything that it's still extremely convenient to get to and from destinations in and around the area. From the concierge to valet, everyone was professional, friendly, polite and very efficient at their jobs. Tom and Jonathan with the valet we're timely with our vehicle and very kind. Will and Breanna at the front desk were incredibly personable and provided top notch service.The rooms were very clean and orderly. The rest of the hotel staff including room service and the cleaning crew were very hospitable and respectful.I highly recommend staying here for your Vegas trip, especially if you're not looking to stay in a casino and searching for something that's away from the nightlife (that can be overwhelming to some) when coming into Vegas for business or something other than gambling.10/10 would recommend and stay here again!

allReviews.title: Awesome pool day!
allReviews.text: The pool experience was a vibe. Friends and family enjoyed themselves very much. Daph was amazing we all had a great time! The lifeguards were exceptional and very kind. All the staff was very professional with great customer service. Thank you all!

allReviews.title: Best service ever
allReviews.text: After having a not so good morning, I decided to go down to the pool at Palms Place. The entire staff was amazing, but Melissa outdid herself. She went out of her way to refill my beer and water buckets with ice about 4 times, to keep my beverages cold- gave me amazing recommendations(spicy mango marg is delicious) and was overall so polite. She made my Sunday so much better. Very attentive. If you’re lucky enough to have her as your server, she won’t let you down. Thank you again Melissa. I look forward to my next stay.

allReviews.title: 5 stars for Natasha
allReviews.text: This review is specifically for Natasha at the front desk. I come here a lot and she is amazing. She is very straight forward and knows Palms Place well. She has a great energy every time I see her. I’ve heard that sometimes she will sing Lady in Red if you’re really nice and dressed well.

allReviews.title: Overpriced Airbnb dump
allReviews.text: The original review written 2 wks ago is gone. I repeat, Palms Place is NOT a hotel & spa. It needs to be advertised for what it is, a dingy filthy outdated privately owed overpriced airbnb/condo connected by a 2nd floor tunnel & escalator to Palms. The pics are misleading, they must’ve been taken decades ago and they should leave the Palms pics out of it altogether. No paper towels or utensils-only a blender and tea kettle, Both the bathroom sink and shower clogged, rug & towels look like car wash rejects, couch looks like it came from good will, balcony deadbolt locked with a sign prohibiting furniture on the it. Confusing separate elevators for higher floors. The tub jets were noticeably bright sunburst yellow in stark contrast to the tub, venturing into it wasn’t even a thought. The soles of brand new slippers only worn in this room are now black. It needs a full renovation from the studs up or to be totally leveled for additional parking. It should be reported as a health hazard. Save your $$$ and stay on the strip or elsewhere at a lower cost with better accommodations and surroundings.The one and only positive is the staff were nice.

allReviews.title: Stay in a private condo
allReviews.text: We stayed in a private condo which was spectacular. Unfortunately the service around reception, concierge desk and security let the whole experience down. The staff only seem interested in their own business, chatting with each other and blatantly ignoring any issues around them. The pool staff are fantastic in comparison. Attentive and proactive. We booked a condo one day which was a very nice experience. If you stay in a private condo through the likes of air b n b, you get to use the balconies which offer spectacular views from high floors.

The check in at the front desk with Joseph was easy and fast considering there was a long line. His attitude remained professional and patient. He was very informative, helpful and nice. We’d come here again for the hospitality and comfort.

allReviews.title: The service begins before I checked in
allReviews.text: I took an early flight into Las Vegas and wondered how I would pass the time to await check in timeMy experience began with the excellent service of the bell staff who kindly secured my bag while I explored the hotel and the area.The  bar ..pool and wait staff ....who lavished wonderful service on myself and other guests..Daphne…Penelope..Davion…Tyvion..the pool staff were amazing Thank you for taking such great care ..give them all a raise

allReviews.title: Chill Vegas Vibe
allReviews.text: Truly a great Vegas experience!! Beautiful view from our room 34th floor balcony. We spent a day at the pool Daphne was our waitress.  Great service…food was great…limited menu at the pool but delicious…drinks did not disappoint either.  Connects to Palms Casino…approximately 5 min walk.  The food and service there also phenomenal.  And can Uber to the strip for less than $10 depending where you want to go.  The rooms have fridge and microwave.  And the shower/tub setup is great too!!

allReviews.title: Palms Place/Suites Room disappointment
allReviews.text: After traveling across America, we were excited to reach Las Vegas, our final stop. We chose Palms Place based on online images of the suite room featuring a balcony, a large Jacuzzi and in-room washing facilities. Unfortunately, our experience did not meet expectations. Upon arrival, we found the room lacked cleanliness, with dusty furniture and empty toiletries such as the body wash bottles that were never replenished. The Jacuzzi also malfunctioned, making loud noises throughout the night. A major letdown was the locked balcony doors, which were not disclosed as inaccessible during booking, despite being a key reason for our choice. Additionally, the washing facilities were locked, which was inconvenient given our heavy luggage. We informed the receptionist of these issues upon checkout and suggest these details be clearly communicated online to avoid future disappointments.Very disappointed. Caitlin 🇬🇧

allReviews.title: Best experience we had at a Las Vegas restaurant
allReviews.text: Thanks to our server Leo for making this a great experience at the palms Leo was very intuitive and also helped us out with some photos. Food was delicious the best we had that week in Vegas I highly recommend this location and hopefully you’ll have Leo as your server

allReviews.title: For the Money and Luxury, what a place
allReviews.text: Had an absolutely amazing time at the Palms Place. We’ve stayed at about four hotels here in this by far was the nicest, most affordable and most luxurious in a way. Our room had a kitchenette, which helped us cook home-cooked meals versus eating out every single meal. Also, Jesse Mae at the front desk was incredible each time we needed something. She simply was a joy to work with from start to finish. Thank you for the awesome customer service Jesse and to the rest of the staff including valet for 5 star service.

allReviews.title: Palms Place - Best weekend getaway!
allReviews.text: We had a little issue with our Expedia booking that potentially would’ve tanked our plans. Thank you to Joseph, Palms Place hotel manager, for saving the day! We got to enjoy our plans as intended and thank you to Julissa at the Laguna Pool for the top-notch customer service at the pool the next day. This is a great hotel, with great accommodations and most importantly, the excellent customer service that is expected in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Unreal Experience!
allReviews.text: Staff are lovely and so welcoming! Joseph at reception was a great help and made us Scottish girls feel very welcome when arriving early and just landed. The staff at the pool were great. Thank you! We are looking forward to our stay at Palms Place!

allReviews.title: Love This Place!’
allReviews.text: This place is the best stay!! From the booking with a lady name Angie K. She was awesome super friendly and really helped me. The conversation alone made me feel like I was speaking with my Mum. The front desk clerk Priscilla was super friendly, went above and beyond to help us, she was great!!! Smiling, great attitude. Stay here trust me.

allReviews.title: Disgusting Conditions!
allReviews.text: The condos are no well kept and are dirty.There was blood on the couch and walls.We found a used condom in the couch.So many safety hazards ! You pay for a room and the tub doesn’t work the refrigerator is broken and dirty. The water was coming out yellow from the sink!!

allReviews.title: Excellent pool service
allReviews.text: We came to the Palms to use the pool as it was rated with the best reviews for the use of the Cabana. It was a very beautiful place, very great staff, good drinks, and Daphne VanDaele was exceptional. The water was refreshing, the pool was very clean.

allReviews.title: Amazing Girls Day!
allReviews.text: My friends and I rented a cabana in the beginning of August 2024. Jaleesa took care of us from the moment we walked in til the moment we were walking out. She constantly checked in on us, even while we were in the pool to make sure we were well accommodated. The food, drinks, and service were all 10/10. The only thing I wish we had were optional curtains to help shade the cabana if it got too hot. Would rent again!

allReviews.title: Cabana Amazing
allReviews.text: Jaleesa was super helpful and attentive for our cabana. She always came to check up on us and brought us everything!She’s an amazing person and she made everything smooth and stress free. You will be lucky if she is your cabana host! Thank you so much.

allReviews.title: Great bartenders
allReviews.text: The rooms are very nice and the staff is great. Love the pool area and staff. Cool vibe. Casey and Sarah are amazing bartenders. And Ruthy at the front desk is super sweet and helpful. Best place to stay to get away from the crazy strip but still close enough to jump back into the action.

allReviews.title: Good Vibes
allReviews.text: Aretha Has To Be One Of The Best Servers I’ve  Have Came Encounter With. I Will Be Back Again Mostly Because Of Her. Thanks For The Good Vibes Helping Is With Our Food Choices And Most Of All Thank You For The Birthday Wishes To My Lady. Have A Blessed Day.

allReviews.title: Great time at the Laguna
allReviews.text: Aretha was such a great server at the Laguna! Very attentive, kind, and helpful. She made great suggestions and accommodated in any way she could! She even went above and beyond with our meals. Made my birthday dinner a great experience, I’ll definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Brunch at Laguna
allReviews.text: We are locals and ate at the Laguna Kitchen. Leo was our waiter. Very nice guy who knows the menu, knows the hotel and amenities they provide. There was a DJ spinning vinyl from the 80's. Don't see much vinyl anymore but he was great!  The food was also great and Leo was more than accommodating. We will be back. Can't wait to see the lunch and dinner menus.

allReviews.title: Laguna Pool House & Kitchen at Palms Place
allReviews.text: I had lunch at the Palms Place Kitchen and have to write a review for our lovely server, Leo!!! He made my colleague’s last day before her flight magical. I am a frequent guest of Palms Place but had no idea how wonderful the Pool House & Kitchen experience would be. Thank you Leo!!!!Love,-JACQ

allReviews.title: So much yes
allReviews.text: Amazing deep bathtub, fantastic shower! Comfortable bed. Amazing Mountain View. Good sound control neighbors didn't hear us or complain that we were being too loud. Fast service, super friendly staff. I can't say enough good things. If you haven't stayed here you should!

allReviews.title: Laguna Pool Review
allReviews.text: I want to shout out the host Mary. She was amazing in helping me set up my sister’s birthday celebration. She was personable and answered all my questions. Mary set up our cabana reservation at the Laguna pool. The pool is a roof top pool with beautiful views. It’s all ages (family friendly) and more of a “chill” vibe, compared to the palms pool. Our server was Jaleesa. She was also amazing. Even brought out the birthday girl a special shot. All the food was great, don’t skip on the chicken fingers were my favorite. Thank you to both Mary and Jaleesa for making our experience a great one!

allReviews.title: Great quick trip!
allReviews.text: Great experience at the Palms place hotel. From the moment Rick took my truck in valet, to Jay with my luggage, and Breanna at the check in counter, everyone was courteous and kind. Breanna was very helpful with checkin, we had a minor issue with the reservation we made via a different website, but she was amazing and got the problem resolved in a timely manner and we were in our room almost immediately. Highly recommended hotel.

allReviews.title: Sunday Brunch Smile
allReviews.text: Hubby and I went for Sunday brunch. He had been already and wanted me to check it out :)  The ambience was abso beauty.  Restaurant had direct view of pool. Fireplace, tables and everything was very nice.  Even had a private room for additional event space. Best part was the music and DJ. The food was delish!  Suggestion is to offer more of it!  The waiter Gabriel was awesome. Professional and attentive. The other wait staff were great too. Highly recommend for a quiet cozy spot to enjoy food music and company at the pool lol.

allReviews.title: Great visit to Palms Place
allReviews.text: Good trip & good service from Alena & staff. I use to stay here from time to time while refereeing summer high school basketball tournaments a few years back. And I hadn't been here nor to the Palms hotel since. But I was happy with the price point, amenities & service we received on our long weekend getaway

allReviews.title: My New Go To Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: My wife and I visit Vegas at least once a year and have always stayed on the Strip.  We chose to change things up, largely because our interests and dining choices are no no longer strongly strip-centered.  In short, my wife and I ADORED our stay at the Palms Place and we WILL be back.  A few things stood out:  1) Cleanliness (the room was spotless on arrival).  2) Service (every single person we encountered was pleasant and helpful, this included the hotel and the casino/restaurants staff), 3) Room features (from a full fridge with an ice machine, to a dual head-shower and jacuzzi tub for two, Palms Place was a home away from a home) 4) Free parking (and it was directly adjacent to the hotel...no schelp across miles of casino and retail to the parking deck here) 5) Quiet tower away from the Palms Casino floor (its a short walk down a purpose built interior corridor).  We had a mountain view room on a high floor and the view to the west was spectacular and mesmerizing.  Thank you to everyone at the Palms Place.  If I could give you six stars, I would!

allReviews.title: Kevion is amazing 👏🏾
allReviews.text: My family and I had the pleasure in being hosted by Kevion. He was very attentive in checking on us which was truly appreciated. Kevion customer service was A-1, Palms you have to recognize him for his exceptional customer service. Thanks you again Kevion

allReviews.title: If you’re looking for the Palms hotel and casino, you’ve come to the wrong place. Don’t make the same mistake. I did.
