allReviews.title: Great customer service, Jaleesa
allReviews.text: Jaleesa did an amazing job ! So fast always checking up on us and getting our drinks in a timely matter. Thank you so much ! The experience was great! I’d definitely come again, food was amazing- shrimp tacos & fries… let’s not forget the fruit !

allReviews.title: Unwanted pest in our room.
allReviews.text: Our first stay at the Palms was marred by a significant issue. While the hotel is beautiful and the bathroom impressive, we encountered roaches in our room. My husband saw one early Sunday morning, and I spotted another later that morning, which I killed and photographed. Upon checkout, I reported this to the staff. The response was disappointingly lacking in empathy or concern. The employee merely said she’d inform the cleaning department, offering no apology or compensation until I specifically requested it. Even then, only the resort fees were waived. This experience was deeply unsettling and ruined our stay. I’m sharing this to alert management about both the pest problem and the need for better staff training in handling such situations. A hotel of this caliber should maintain higher standards of cleanliness and customer service. Thank you for allowing me to share my experience. It was room 11-303 on June 8, 2024.

allReviews.title: Enjoyed myself!
allReviews.text: The aesthetic by the pool is really gorgeous. A beautiful oasis! I went about 3 times during my stay and enjoyed each time. Brunch was my favorite. The DJ was grooving! Lol the food choices are minimal but the food is good. And the drinks are cute and strong. I love this hotel, kinda a hidden gem 💎

allReviews.title: Great food & service
allReviews.text: Service was amazing thank you to Gabriel. He went above & beyond to make sure we were taken care of. We came back 2 mornings in a row. Food was great. Nice pool side views. I will definitely be coming back here when I visit Las Vegas again. Highly recommended ! 😊

allReviews.title: Great spot  for food, drinks ,pool and relaxing
allReviews.text: Had a great time with family and friends had got a cabana at the Laguna Pool on the 6th floor with a deal for locals and had a wonderful time! It's a great location if you want a quiet, fun experience with friends without overwhelming crowds. Our server kevlon was very cool and diligent worker , drinks were delicious and Highly recommend for a hot relaxing day!!!!.

allReviews.title: Peaceful and enjoyable
allReviews.text: The pool staff were very accommodating and attentive to our needs. We will definitely be back as this was a great vacation and brought some peace to us all. We really enjoyed Kevion as he went out of his way to ensure we were being taken care of at all times.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Penelope campos and Davion Curry are the best bartenders! They were extremely attentive, friendly, great conversationalist,  entire area was clean, food was good, drinks were amazing. The bar area was not overly crowded. Truly a great experience!

allReviews.title: Loved

allReviews.title: Enjoyable poolside cabana for locals
allReviews.text: I recently enjoyed a fantastic time at our poolside cabana at Palms Place, thanks for our outstanding server, Jaleesa. Her warm personality and professionalism made our visit memorable. Highly recommended!

allReviews.title: Great Service,  great drinks, even better staff!
allReviews.text: We stayed at The Palms and decidws to walk over to the The Palms Place and site see. We came across The Laguna Kitchen and Bar. The bartender was so kind and very knowledgeable of the area. It was our anniversary and she made us feel very special. Not to mention her hype woman Jaleesa ;)

allReviews.title: Great spot for cabana day with friends
allReviews.text: We rented a cabana at the Laguna Pool on the 6th floor, and had a wonderful time! It's a great location if you want a quieter, upscale experience with friends without overwhelming crowds. Our server, Daphne, was awesome, drinks were excellent, and they had a locals discount running! Highly recommend for a relaxing day.

allReviews.title: Wonderful front desk staff!
allReviews.text: My friend and I came to celebrate her birthday and stayed at the Palms Place.  We ran into some issues with a third party company.  Priscilia and Que at the front desk, went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of.  They stepped up when we needed the help.  We can’t thank them enough.  Thank you Priscilla and Que!  You are wonderful and deserve the recognition!

allReviews.title: ENGAGED AT THE PALMS
allReviews.text: To LEO, an amazing server who is so genuine and thoughtful and the perfect photographer/videographer! To DAVION, an absolute kind hearted, gentleman who serves the perfect shot! To RAFAEL, (sorry if I spelled it wrong) from the eggs to the dessert, you definitely made this the best treat! Manager JOSEPH, thank you for an experience/day I will never forget! (So sorry your name is skipping my mind) I had an amazing experience and I’m thankful for the staff for helping make that happen!!

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: Leguna was a hit Davion and Penelope was a vibe and a time!!! Go see them!! Redhead Pink! It was such a good time and service was worth while! Theyre friendly and turned our stay around. Letsss goo!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Palms Place spa and pool
allReviews.text: I recently visited the pool at Palms Place and had an incredible experience, thanks to the outstanding hospitality of Host Mary and Server Jaleese. The pool itself is stunning, with a pristine layout and a relaxing ambiance perfect for unwinding. Mary greeted us warmly and ensured we were comfortably settled, while Jaleese provided impeccable service throughout our stay. Her attentiveness and friendly demeanor truly enhanced our visit. From the refreshing drinks to the serene atmosphere, everything was top-notch. I highly recommend the Palms Place Pool for anyone seeking a luxurious and enjoyable poolside experience.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: Casey and Penelope were dope!!Your mom stinks, she lives in rock bottom where SpongeBob went when he missed the bus back home. Casey is the bartender of the year and he should be promoted to manager. Palms is a great hotel overall. Thank you and goodnight

allReviews.title: Don’t miss a stop at Laguna Pool House & Kitchen
allReviews.text: I’m really actually here to rate the Laguna Pool House & Kitchen inside the hotel (6th floor, I believe).If I could give our experience there a 10, I would. The staff was friendly, helpful, fun, and very polite. ***I do NOT want to suggest the precedent that this would or should happen everywhere***However, in our recent stay my sister and I went down for a late brunch. Unfortunately at the time it was not available, and we mentioned to the server that we were hoping for brunch items (we just misread the dates - it’s only on weekends). Our server kindly replied that she would check with the chef and see what he could do to accommodate us. The chef himself came to our table and offered to make us eggs with toast and homefries - from scratch!! Our server brought coffees and the food came shortly after. This was followed up by the most delicious and beautiful French toast - had edible flowers, wasn’t too sugary, was crunchy and fluffy.Oh my goodness. For everything we experienced: the presentation, taste, experience, vibe. It was all there. I know it seems simple but because of how helpful and kind the staff was, this felt like truly one of the most magical dining experiences for us. Not only did the chef and staff go above and BEYOND to meet our requests, but it was literally the most delicious meal we had our entire week in Vegas. It was cooked properly, seasoned perfectly, and really affordable. Thank you to our server Aretha - you light up the room with your positive energy!! Thank you to our chef, Rafa - you ensured that we had a delicious meal and a wonderful experience!!!!We ate there twice (first meal was in our room but outstanding no the less!! Try the Fried chicken sandwich and the passion fruit crème curler) and went back the next day for drinks and again, delicious and perfect.

allReviews.title: A Serene Oasis: Palms Place Hotel And Spa
allReviews.text: Nestled amidst the vibrant energy of Las Vegas, Palms Place Hotel And Spa offers a tranquil retreat from the bustling Strip. Palms Place Hotel And Spa offers a luxurious escape in the heart of Las Vegas. Whether you're seeking relaxation, excitement, or a bit of both, this hidden gem delivers an unforgettable experience.

allReviews.title: Palms Place Pool Cabana
allReviews.text: Came to palms place with the family for our anniversary and we got a Cabana by the pool and Jaleesa was our server and she was amazing, she made sure that we were taken care of and constantly checked on us and every order was delivered very prompt. Management is lucky to have an employee like her.

allReviews.title: Poolside getaway with the fam
allReviews.text: Jaleesa was amazing! She was very attentive and made sure my family and I were fully taken care of. We appreciate the quick and timely accommodations. We will happily return again soon. Thank you for your exceptional service and kindness during our time at Palm Place Pool!

allReviews.title: Better than staying on the strip wree parking!
allReviews.text: Rooms are luxurious and the stay is much more relaxing than a strip property. The best part is the beautiful pool and exceptional service! Jaleesa at the pool made sure we were always taken care of with the best poolside drinks in Vegas!  I highly recommend a trip to Palms Place. With the $40+ per day you save with no charge for parking, you could be using it at the pool bar. ; )

allReviews.title: Amazing service
allReviews.text: Went to visit the Laguna Pool house and kitchen, and the food was delicious. We met our server Aretha, and she was such a joy. She recommended the greatest foods and made us feel like apart of the family. She is what made the experience eating here amazing. So shout out to Aretha your awesome and hope everyone appreciates you like we did.

allReviews.title: Average at best
allReviews.text: No housekeeping on my first day. No hot water on my second day. Average at best … leaning toward poor. Also the blackout curtains didn’t function properly. Probably will not go back. And I paid for a very expensive suite!  Not good folks … not good.

allReviews.title: Just to relax and get away
allReviews.text: Comfortable, affordable, get away from the hustle and bustle, you don't have to worry about noise, it is quiet and relaxing, and the pool is a great place to relax and unwind.  Grab a bite at Laguna, sip a craft cocktail pool side, soak in a jetted spa tub and recharge!

allReviews.title: Dining in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Went to eat at the Luguana at the Palms. I had a great time the scene was very pleasant it had a real nice beach side restaurant vibe. The white tables and fire place gave it a cozy feeling. Our server was Aretha she was very friendly and smiled all the time. She asked if this was our first time and we let her know it was. She put on a full court press when it comes to service. She keep our glasses full made recommendations that were glad we followed. The food was amazing I had  shrimp tacos and a classic burger. Looking forward to going back soon.

allReviews.title: Jaleesa is Top!
allReviews.text: Jaleesa has always been lovely to myself and the girls I bring to the pool. Im a Las Vegas local native and Ive been coming to the pool for 3 years summer round now, and I got to experience her last summer 2023 and this summer 2024. She always has a smile on her face, first one to greet you at the pool, very attentive in getting you what you want, and makes sure her guests are taken care of. Everything is nice there, the only opinion I have is it sucks that you guys got rid of locals being able to come to the pool for free. Nonetheless, Jaleesa still deserves her flowers and thank you for providing a wonderful experience every time I go.

allReviews.title: Relaxing Poolside
allReviews.text: In town celebrating an anniversary and attending a couple shows, and Palms Place was a terrific choice to stay.  The sixth floor pool was incredibly relaxing, and Melissa provided outstanding poolside service with a smile and personality to behold…thank you Melissa!

allReviews.title: Top notch service
allReviews.text: Visited here to celebrate. We received amazing service from Casey at Laguna bar! The drinks were amazing the food was really good and he is great company. Informed us of many things to get out and do around the city. We will definitely be returning and you should definitely see him if you decide to stay here!

allReviews.title: Great Pool Area - Awesome staff
allReviews.text: The pool area was really nice! Way less crowded than the other pool and the staff was very kind and funny. Kailah kept me and my daughter laughing and was very sweet and professional. We will definitely stay here again. Thanks for the Aloha Kailah!

allReviews.title: Terrible Hospitality
allReviews.text: The Palms Place is just ok, in terms of looks and atmosphere. There was no way to walk from public parking to the lobby.....or at least I was not told where. I wasn't told because the Front Desk staff chose to ignore me as I stood at the desk......the only person in the whole lobby, waiting to ask my question. A minute goes by, two minutes, three, no acknowledgement.  When I noticed the clerk start to acknowledge a man walking up to her. I decided I was done there,  put my keys down at her station, and said I was checking out. She decided to tell me I could have dropped them off elsewhere. "I had question", I replied. She then saw me off with a snarky, contrived "You have good day". So I decided to let her know, loudly in the lobby, "You acknowledge somebody, say hello, I'll be with you in a minute. It's not hard." And it's not. She's just terrible at her job in hospitality. I won't be back. This happened between 10:30 - 11am, May 9th. She was wearing a black blazer, magenta shirt, black hair pulled back.

allReviews.title: perfect day
allReviews.text: i actually have lived in palms place for 7 years but now they offered owners free cabanas.  so i grabbed one.  my host mary - got me cabana 7, brought me. bucket of ice waters.  checked on me.   also jackie served me.   i had a burger and fries.   it was great.   great day here

allReviews.title: Great poolside experience!
allReviews.text: Mary and Jackie from the Palms Place Laguna poolside bar were absolutely amazing, the service was great, and the food was delicious! Quick, friendly, and responsive. Mary had our cabana ready when we arrived at the pool and Jackie our server was ready to help us with anything food and beverage related!

allReviews.title: Daphne Rocks!
allReviews.text: This review is specifically for Daphne Van Daele who served us in the pool area.  Although is was a blustery day and we didn't get the sunshine we were hoping for, Daphne made our experience outstanding through her bright and cheery attitude and her exceptional service.  Please give this girl a raise... she is undeniably an asset to your organization!

allReviews.title: 5 stars
allReviews.text: Loved this spot! The pool is beautiful and chill. Daphne our pool server made our time there extra enjoyable. She's the best!

allReviews.title: First Time At Palms Place and It Was Worth It
allReviews.text: My wife and I were in Vegas from 4/15 - 4/18 for the NAB conference. And hands down, all of the staff there made the experience worthwhile. I feel bad because I want to acknowledge them by name, but I didn't write their names down. But just know that the staff there at Palms Place Hotel and Spa will take care of you, are very professional and friendly. And that is EVERYONE from the valet team to the check-in team, cleaning staff and everyone in between.Thank you for making it a memorable experience.

allReviews.title: Amazing customer service (Oscar)
allReviews.text: First of all front desk worker Oscar was so helpful checking us in, super nice & patient. Awesome customer service. Hotel is beautiful! Very clean & luxurious, so many food options & entertainment. Gambling is a for sure win here! Super recommend

allReviews.title: Laguna pool house and kitchen
allReviews.text: Kacey did an amazing job and had amazing service at the laguna pool house and kitchen. Couldn’t have had better service and experience!

allReviews.title: Great service at the laguna pool
allReviews.text: Our server Daphne Van Dyke at the laguna pool was exceptional. She went above and beyond to help us with our childs food allergies. She was sweet attentive and had great energy. I cannot wait to come back and see her again. Thank her for making our experience truly memorable.

allReviews.title: Daphne
allReviews.text: My day at the Laguna pool was everything I needed.  Daphne VanDaele was my server and she was the best.  So friendly and accommodating.  She was very attentive.  I really enjoyed talking with her about the menu and what was the best.  Thank you!!!!

allReviews.title: 2/10 Stars. DO NOT RECOMMEND!
allReviews.text: Very beautiful rooms. Very beautiful atmosphere. The best part as far as the employees went were the vallets. These amazing men and women were always on time and had my car ready and warm for me. Unfortunately the rest of the staff were either very incompetent or very rude! I have never experienced being left by the bellhop.Counter for twenty five minutes waiting for 1 employee To check my bags as they would not let the group check in to the motel due to it not being cleaned yet from a previous resident. (At this time I will mention that they had an hour and a half to clean the room before we were passed our time of check in). When this inconvenience was pointed out, the staff was ballsy enough to tell me that we could be patient!! Every time we left our room and went down to the counter or other in resort locations, Security would stop us and ask for our room key! Even if we had literally walked ten feet away to the convenience store (located on the main level of the resort) and back to our room! And when they said they did this to everyone I can prove them wrong! Save your money, go somewhere else!

allReviews.title: Daphne was amazing.
allReviews.text: Daphne Van Daele was outstanding at the Laguna pool and spa, others there were rude and condescending.   Seemed employees are burnt out or that's just how locals are, one (male) bartender was rude when he couldn't find my name in system.   Valet was amazing and so was Otis for security.   Front desk girls seemed to be angry and rude.   Daphne, valet, and Otis made it worth the stay.

allReviews.title: ROACHES! ROACHES! ROACHES!
allReviews.text: ROACHES! ROACHES! ROACHES! Broken plastic/glass in the kitchen sink! Tables/Counter tops not cleaned! Rotten egg smell in the bathroom!I thought this would be a great experience,  but it wasn't. At least not when we're coming home to this. I will most likely not stay at Palms Place again.

allReviews.title: No amenities, no spa, no Rojo bar
allReviews.text: Used to be nice, went down hill. Spa out of business. Pool closed. Laguna lounge had reduced hours, rojo bar closed, zero amenities in suite, housekeeping was late even when requested earlier (twice). Exorbitant resort fee of $44 per day for nothing.  Finally I had to recheck my bill to see if the resort fees were removed for lack of services and they weren’t, so the nice lady at the front had to run the folio again. Consider relisting the hotel amenities for those that are actually in the Palms Place Tower.  It’s a long walk to the casino for a cup of coffee and a massage.

allReviews.title: Great service by the pool! Ask for Daphne
allReviews.text: The pool was wonderful. I took my family here for a quick little get away. Pool was modern and atmosphere was fun. I must say the best part was the service. Our pool server daphne  went out of her way to accommodate us. The spa had been closed for some reason and it was a stormy day. We noticed it was warm and asked for the spa to be opened back up. Well, Daphne went out of her way to find the proper facilities manager, and ensure that our experience was wonderful. She was able to get them to open the spa back up per our request and we found ourselves having a wonderful time in the midst of so so weather! Will definitely be coming back and looking forward to ordering more drinks and food by the pool from our new favorite pool host!

allReviews.title: Needs some work
allReviews.text: The room was great. Be sure to specify with the cab that you are at Palms Place not just the Palms. If you don't you will have to walk all the way through the casino to the other side to check in. The room was big and the views were pretty cool, but they could do a more thorough job cleaning. There were grease smears on the wall and food/etc stuck around on the stove. Anything we used I washed first. Also we could not get the hot water to work for the tub.

allReviews.title: Christopher FIgs
allReviews.text: Penelope and Daphne are amazing bartenders and servers. I would definitely be back. Great drinks/food and conversation. The pool is amazing and the restaurant space is very luxurious. Visit here it you want good food and drinks. Make sure you tip your bartenders.

allReviews.title: A Review for Palms Place Owners
allReviews.text: I want to do a special shout out to Jazz and her co worker Q at the Inner Circle! This review is for the Palms Place Owners. My family calls Jazz the firemen she puts out every issue that our guests run into. They always make everyone feel special and the chat with them always makes you leave with a smile on your face.!

allReviews.title: Price performance still ok
allReviews.text: I had a room in the Palms Tower for 2 nights, which is probably the oldest of the 3 towers that make up the Palms Casino complex. The room on the 10th floor was very large but the furnishings, whether it was the kitchenette, bed or TV, had seen better days. The cleanliness also left a lot to be desired. The complex is quite a distance from the Strip. One positive thing was that valet parking was free.

allReviews.title: STAYCATION 💕 VACATION
allReviews.text: I was greeted very nicely by a lady named ruthie on a friday morning. She was very fast and explained the rates thoroughly. I would highly recommend coming in for a small vacation or a one night to get away. There are no other options for this bang for your buck!

allReviews.title: Very good customer service
allReviews.text: I come to Vegas for business I choose to stay at palms place as I know the employees are polite and professional! I use all services especially valet, I’d like to say a special mention for Erick in valet who is always professional, curteous and always goes above and beyond to make my stay better!

allReviews.title: Palms place and Valet were amazing!
allReviews.text: Stayed this last week at the Plams Place Hotel for the second time! I love it. Did valet for thr first time and it was an extremely good experience.  Erick, Tom & Ricky took great care of my Rolls Royce and Bentley Supercars. Was worried about valet handling them. These guys were excellent and I felt at ease the whole time. Top notch 5 star VIP service!!! Tip them well, they deserve it!! I'll be back soon!

allReviews.title: Good Times
allReviews.text: I loved my hotel! Plenty of activities in the hotel to keep busy! Staff was super friendly! Close to the the strip as well! Dispensaries literally right across the street! It was on the bus line you can ride route 202 which ran maybe every 30 minutes back and forth to strip for I think $2! Will be back!

allReviews.title: PALMS PLACE FOR EXCELLENCE OF SERVICE
allReviews.text: I have been traveling to Vegas for the last 10 years and I always stay at the Palms Place… it is located off the strip on Flamingo which I like, because I don’t like staying on the strip - it’s too congested, and it’s too difficult to get in and out of the properties. When I go to the Palms, I am always greeted by the valet team, which always address me by my name , welcome me to the property and take excellent care of me and my vehicle.  ONE  of the longtime employees,  Erick ,  has been helping me for years. He is so professional and pleasant and makes me feel very comfortable and my car I feel is very secure. The entire entire valet team is so professional. I hope that you can acknowledge them when you go to the Palms.  The rooms are very clean and the strip view is very exciting to be able to look out every day and in the evening it’s a stunning view. I enjoy walking over to the casino in the evening and having a nice meal as well.

allReviews.title: Cool place!
allReviews.text: Our suite was huge! With an amazing view of both the mountains and part of the strip.  Front desk service - Ruthy R was so kind and accommodating.   Thank you Ruthy R!!  😊  Restaurant staff were also super friendly.  We'll definitely be coming back!

allReviews.title: Most awful hotel we’ve stayed at. Never again.
allReviews.text: Rooms 15320-15322 Let’s start at the beginning where my family and I decided to go to Palms Place early to see if our rooms would be ready a little earlier than the 3 pm actual check-in time. We got there at 10 am and asked the lady at the front desk for early check-in. This isn’t our first go around with Vegas suites and penthouses so we know normally rooms are not always ready by 3 pm and this was fine for us in the beginning. To our surprise though the lady at the front desk said our room should be ready within 30 mins to an hour. We left again for a bit to get some things and have our son, diagnosed with Autism play and exert some energy since he was in the car most of the day. We came back around 2 hrs later (lunch time) and was told our room are not ready but apparently the lady at the desk said she would put a rush order as well. Mind you each time we checked on the status of our room you had to go back in line which was a long one each and EVERY time. Came back after lunch to check on our rooms around 2 pm and they still said it was not ready (okay it’s still not 3 pm so I was still okay at this point) and we decided naively that it’s probably not that long from here, right? We stayed in the lobby for another hour and a half or so. The weird part is we started seeing other people who had come after us getting their rooms as soon as they went to the front desk. So we left AGAIN and didn’t come back until 6:30 pm, got back in that long line of people “checking-in” to see what the status of our room was. To no surprise they said the room was still not ready. My husband was not happy to hear, “I’m sorry and I don’t know when it will be ready,” for the 10th million time. My husband told the front desk this is not okay and how negligent the staff is here for not being prepared. At this point our Autistic son was also not happy with being made to wait all day for a room and it’s not like they didn’t know we asked at 10 am. We said we would wait at the desk until they found out instead of this indefinite answer they were giving us. We asked for the manager who was already at the desk and she even confirmed that a rush order was done at 12 pm but again didn’t know what happened. So it wasn’t just us who were upset while waiting for a room we thought may not ever be ready - another gentlemen in the lobby had the same concerns as us. Before you know it, security is standing 5 ft from me which is hilarious because it really shows me the nerve of this place and how you guys feel about brown people. Trust me, I could’ve gotten rowdier with the level of disrespect I saw from this place and demonstrated restraint. We finally get into our room - it only took getting upset to make it happen. I thought this room is worth the wait right? NOPE. Looks like they weren’t kidding when they said it wasn’t clean because it really was not. The master toilet had yellow stains around it on the floor. One of the doors had collected dust like none other. The thermostats were temperamental and you could never figure out what kind of temp you would get. The balcony doors had no locks on one of them so our son could’ve easily went out on his own and fallen from the 15th floor if we didn’t just block the balcony door with our things. The lights or should I say lack of lights as well as lack of CABLE on the TV. Some staff person even called my parents room to say we had a check at the front desk waiting for us which were like no way…so when my husband called to ask about it (3 different times) he got 3 different answers - what are you talking about? The manger wants to talk to you. Or our phones are broken. Oh and did I mention the WiFi was also not working. Also bring your own toilet paper and towels. They will send it you…for a delivery fee. They advertise a washer and dryer that don’t even work.

allReviews.title: Palms of Gold
allReviews.text: Great place to be while in Vegas, location was great, not to far from everything, but not to close for more relaxation, elegant suites and great views. Joseph G. At check in was very helpful and professional. Gave us an upgrade we saw fireworks like kings. Thank you staff for a great stay. Definitely would come back. Andrey.

allReviews.title: Palms Place needs serious work
allReviews.text: 1) Booked a Strip View Studio, was given a Mountain View.2) Room was dated and mattress old and spongy. 3) Dog food Kibble found in closet.4) No maid service was provided for entire stay. I was told I had booked a private condo with no service. This was not noted in reservation.5) Laguna restaurant dark on Monday & Tuesday and never open for breakfast. No breakfast room service either.6) Only coffee in the room decaf. I requested regular and was told it would be sent up by front desk. Regular coffee never delivered.7) Spent 10 minutes checking out on screen only to get error message at the end. Called front desk to finish check out, no one answered. Downstairs on my way out at front desk, 2 employees chatting to each other said the phone didn't ring.8) Overall vibe horrible, will never stay here again. Too bad, this used to be a great property when it first opened 10 years ago.

allReviews.title: Stay away!
allReviews.text: The front desk is far too busy and unresponsive. The music and bass from the club outside was louder than my TV could get in my room and rattled the walls on the 25th floor until after 2am. I asked for a room on the other side and they told me they were busy and still had people to check in. The casino staff is rude and confronting to new guests who may not understand to exchange chips at the roulette table to cash them in to the point of swearing and violence. The odds at the slots are horrible and most everything is closed. The mini bar is their fridge and you cannot put things inside without a fee and the cleaning staff does not appear even when you page them. Call the front desk for help or questions and you will wait 30 minutes on hold and hang up. Anything in Vegas is a $20 Uber ride away. We told them we came for our wedding and not a bottle of wine or champagne was to be found which is breaking tradition especially of a city demanding and reliant on it. Stay away from this hotel. Go to the strip and enjoy one that understands how to treat its guests. THIS PLACE WAS CLOSED FOR YEARS FOR A REASON!

allReviews.title: Filthiest Hotel I have been In
allReviews.text: Me and my family paid for a one bedroom two bathroom suite for three nights. When we got there the room was filthy and still had other peoples belongings that were left there. The second night we found baby roaches in both bathrooms which we were on the 21st floor. The hotelOnly offered one night free! Would not recommend completely a filthy hotel and uncomfortably stay!

allReviews.title: Not what I expected
allReviews.text: Never again...I frequent Vegas and took a  chance booking this spot to avoid the construction and traffic of F1.  I normally stay at Marriott Grand Chateau, Elara,  or TheD if on Fremont. My room at Palms place is not very  clean so I had to go buy supplies to clean for my stay.  The waitresses at casino could are lackluster in service and  seem to frequently go to same people to accommodate, but I sat spending my money for over an hour and couldn't flag one down to get water.  I am stuck here for a week but lessons learned...all that glitters on the internet ain't gold!

allReviews.title: No third party apps
allReviews.text: It was terrible because we used a app to book it and they didn't give us room service or any towels that's why I recommend booking directly from the site or just going to the many other hotels in las Vegas

allReviews.title: Best front desk service
allReviews.text: The hotel was fine.  Not what i want to write this review about.  Maria at the front desk was perhaps the kindest hotel employee I’ve encountered in my life.  She went above and beyond to help sort out some issues with our short-notice booking.  She was a blessing to my wife and me.  She is a credit to Palms Place.

allReviews.title: Really loved the service I received here.  Ruthy R was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Amazing! Thank you
allReviews.text: Really loved the service I received here.  Ruthy R was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Amazing! Thank you

allReviews.title: Perfect weekend
allReviews.text: Stayed at the palm place for my brothers wedding reception, the hotel was very clean, beds were comfortable, and anything I needed I would call the front desk and they were quick to bring it. Front desk was very accommodating. Would come visit this hotel for my future visit to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent customer care
allReviews.text: Attended a work conference and had last minute changes that were quickly and kindly made for me by a customer care representative named Lorraine.   She expedited my changes and provided me reassurance that my attendees would not have issues checking in.   All turned out smoothly and my stay was great.   Thanks Lorraine.

allReviews.title: Great FOH
allReviews.text: It's my first time staying there. I got in earlier than my colleague,  and Natasha,  FOH, helped coordinate our reservations.  She was very helpful and tried to make notes for both of our reservations. Only downside were, a guest went to pool and

allReviews.title: Amazing restaurants and gambling experience
allReviews.text: Amazing accommodations and an excellent place to escape. Our host Erno Mabin went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken cared of. You can find him strolling on the gambling floor interacting with all the players and ensuring his players are having a good time. I highly recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: Best hotel
allReviews.text: My host Erno Mabini always take care of me when I visit. He is very responsive and beside my host, the hotel is very clean and great staff. I been coming here weekly for a year plus and had never had a bad experience. I highly recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: Horrible
allReviews.text: Not as I expected.1. I booked online through the hotel website for the Palm hotel ended up with the room at Palm Place the adjacent “extended stay” hotel next door.2. Had to walk through a through the casino, upstairs (escalators were broke the entire 3 day stay) to a long corridor that has the nerve to have one of those airport walking escalators to another long corridor to get to the Palm Place extended stay. Mind you, you have to do this every day all day to get to the main hotel for casino, food or entertainment.3. You must carry your key card with you EVERYWHERE. There are security checkpoints everywhere in the Palm Place which makes me think was I even safe there. You have to insert your key card on the elevator to get to your floor which made everything frustrating. If people have to hold on to the key card everywhere why not provide a lanyard or a wristlet or even a wristband like on cruise ships.4. It’s pretty much dead at 7 pm that’s when the pool closes also the pool in Palm place is kid friendly so the few times I went to the pool it was kid over load and also the pool side service is extremely slow. Several time I had to ask staff for the check or even to place an order.5. TRASH EVERYWHERE. Trash bags left in elevators, trash left near room doors for days and I had to complain about trash left in the elevator waiting area on a friends floor. You know what happened? The trash was swept to the side instead of being picked up and thrown away. I informed the hotel on my way out for the day and came back to the friends floor later that night and that’s how I found the trash swept to the side.6. There was calcium/lime built up on the shower heads.7. Mold/bacteria in the ice.8. A/C was not cooling - but that was fixed9. Room door does not close shut behind you. Must yank and pull door close.10. Find another place to stay honestly it’s not worth the price.11. Balconies do not open!

allReviews.title: Terrible room check in and customer service… they downgrade my room without telling me and could care less.
allReviews.text: Terrible room check in and customer service… they downgrade my room without telling me and could care less.

allReviews.title: Review for Natasha
allReviews.text: Review for Natasha:I stayed at Palms place for my birthday weekend and Natasha was so down to earth and cool and made sure that I had everything I needed for my stay!  Quick and efficient. Will definitely be coming back as long as she still there. ☺️

allReviews.title: Palms Place Hotel & Spa (10’s across the board) excellent hotel
allReviews.text: Review for Jeanette at Palms Place, Las Vegas:"Staying at the Palms Place was a delight, in no small part due to the exemplary service provided by Jeanette, their hotel desk clerk. From the moment we checked in, her warmth and professionalism shone through. Jeanette went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable and memorable. Her pleasant demeanor and genuine willingness to accommodate our needs made us feel valued and taken care of. In a bustling city like Las Vegas, it's truly refreshing to encounter such outstanding customer service. Kudos to Jeannette for setting the bar high. I definitely will return soon, and we hope to see her friendly face when we do!"And I must add the hotel was absolutely beautiful, the pleasant fragrance when you walked in the hotel lobby is breathtaking, and the rooms was amazing and the spa tub was very relaxing.. I give the hotel 10 across the board. Signed Happy  Customer Tiashawn Ezell

allReviews.title: A Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: Palms Place Las Vegas provided the perfect setting for my 55th birthday celebration. I booked through Hopper, but some of the pertinent booking information was inaccurate, leading to some initial issues. However, thanks to the exceptional assistance of Mr. Garavi, the manager, everything was promptly resolved, and he displayed professionalism, kindness, and genuine helpfulness.Throughout my six-night stay, every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to assist, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. My room, 51-309, offered a breathtaking view of the mountains and was both clean and spacious. The only drawback was the lack of access to the balcony.Palms Place's serene and tranquil ambiance provided a pleasant contrast to the bustling Vegas scene. Although not directly on the strip, it was conveniently close to all the action.Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and can't wait to return in the near future. Palms Place Las Vegas left a lasting positive impression, making my birthday celebration truly memorable. Thank you!If you're looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the Las Vegas strip, this is the perfect location.

allReviews.title: Pretty good
allReviews.text: There were several things that I liked about the hotel. The pool was really nice the suite was big clean and had a great view. There are many places to eat on property that were pretty tasty. I was disappointed with the TV and Internet service. The TV had a black screen or glitched most of my stay which was disappointing when it was time to relax I wanted to watch a few shows.

allReviews.title: We will be back again and again!
allReviews.text: We took a week staycation as locals and started at our favorite getaway, Palms PLACE for two nights. I was so impressed with the service at the front desk where Yvette upgraded our room. We had an amazing view of the entire length of the Strip. Our only goal that week was to enjoy pool time, great dinners, cocktails and clubs. We stumbled on Rojo, the lobby bar at the front desk! P.J. and I talked marketing and what makes a great bar. Fun guy! We think they should call it P.J.’s and give him carte blanche with his creative marketing ideas and cool cocktail promotions!In the morning, we hung out at the pool where Treena kept our cocktails full with a smile and anticipated our needs with obvious experience! Our teenager had gone across the street to race go karts and when he came to join us he couldn’t get past security - good looking out guys! Our son called us to meet him in the lobby. As I left the pool, I asked if it was possible to call the front security. Better still, the security personnel, Khalil, offered to personally go meet our son and bring him up! Wow! That’s service! I went back to my spot at the pool. Mid-week, just to change it up, we did try another off Strip resort. The room was nice but the pool experience didn’t measure up so we stayed again Friday night at Palms Place. I was hopeful that earlier in the week wasn’t just a lucky stay, but once again, we were pleasantly impressed! Amber got us another great room with a great view and the pool experience was, once again, stellar! Jelessa, who claimed she was in training, but seemed like a pro to us, read our eye contact requests for a refill. At one point she saw us needing help with opening an umbrella for shade and quickly stepped in and handled it with a smile.We have traveled far and wide and have very high expectations for customer service being Las Vegas locals for over 30 years. I asked for a manager because I felt like recognition was due to these employees who went above and beyond the usual expectations. Hotels will all have challenges with as big as our properties are in Vegas. It’s about how they handle any challenges with professionalism, grace and prompt, customer-focused resolution. Palms Place hit the mark in every category! We will be back soon! Thanks for maintaining a great property, Joseph! We are spreading the word!!

allReviews.title: Barf Place
allReviews.text: I was excited to see my room because I had heard they are spacious and well designed. But my room had dried vomit on the carpet and couch. There was also a ball of hair in the bathroom. The hotel was very reticent to give me a new room. I am not at all impressed. The service recovery was almost as bad as the problem. See photos 🤮

allReviews.title: Great hotel and casino BUT
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel, room and casino. Pool was beautiful BUT unless you want to pay 150.00 to reserve a place to sit - it’s very limited availability- even on a Thursday. Food was very good, everyone friendly.

allReviews.title: Not the best
allReviews.text: We stayed at a studio suite at Palms Place for 3 nights in April 2023.  Upon arriving, the Bell /Valet staff were great. They were very helpful in assisting us in unpacking the vehicle of our belongings, luggage and bags and subsequently getting the items to our room.  The young lady at the front desk who assisted us was very friendly and helpful.  The studio was on 50th floor. Upon entrance, the room was very nice; there was a full kitchenette area with a stove top refrigerator, microwave and dishes, large bathroom, with a huge shower with a sauna tub in the shower area, two televisions mounted on the wall, but that is where the positives ended for me.  Because of the amenities, this is a very expensive room, which is fine except that it is very outdated.  I feel when owners of airbnb's and suites are charging a lot of money to stay in the properties they own, the least they can do is provide some updates, even if minor.  First, the bed was the most uncomfortable bed I have ever "tried" to sleep in. Continuous sleep did not happen as the mattress was so cheap and uncomfortable both me and my significant other woke up frequently with aching backs.  There were two older model tv's mounted to the wall, but only one worked, which is fine if it worked properly. The signal cut out frequently and the television would just go black. There were not many plugs to charge smart devices or sleep machines, on one side of the bed there were no outlets at all. Other hotels now have accomodations to either plug into an outlet in the night stand or USB ports. At the very least provide a cheap alternative  like a power strip.  We never had a person come in the room to clean or even to check and see if we needed anything so we kept the same ONE facecloth and towel, luckily I packed a few of my own. There was ONE roll of toilet paper. i have never stayed at any hotel/suite where there wasn't at least one spare roll of toilet paper for convenience. We valeted for convenience, but the valet staff hours were inconsistent. We came back to the property at 10pm one evening and no one was there to valet and it was closed but when we went back downstairs a little later, there were several valet/bell staff congregating, chit chatting outside, with valet open again. This happened more than one night. OVERALL, it was not worth the money we paid to stay in the suite.

allReviews.title: Fantastic 10/10 Hotel and Staff
allReviews.text: My stay at the Palms Place was absolutely amazing! Marites was the staff who had helped me check-in and checkout of the hotel and was very helpful and kind throughout my entire stay. It was my first time visiting Vegas so she let me know about all the amazing restaurants within the hotel and recommended popular attractions and shows in Vegas as well! Palms Place and their staff deserve the highest possible ratings in every category!

allReviews.title: Great hotel and casino resort off the strip
allReviews.text: My family and I stayed in a 38th floor two bed room suite. The Palms Place staff were extremely friendly and helpful during our stay. The attached casino was well equipped and the restaurants were excellent quality and value. As a hotel located off the strip, the area was very quiet and provided for good nights sleep.

allReviews.title: DON’T STAY HERE!!
allReviews.text: So disappointed in this hotel. I did a lot of research and saw photos. It is nothing like what I saw. I had to change rooms twice (and I’m not one to complain). The first room was so dirty I couldn’t imagine walking barefoot in there. Second room was blazing hot because the air conditioner was broken. Finally settled in a room because it was late. None of the TVs worked. When I complained when I checked out I was told “wow sounds like you had a bad trip”. Because it’s March madness the rates were crazy too. So this made it even worse. Stick to the strip.

allReviews.title: The Palms Place is the BEST!!!
allReviews.text: My family has stayed in the Palms place since January 16th. It is the best when it comes to location, customer service, amenities, and food. We would like to send a special thanks for Joseph, a manager at the front desk at Palms place, he was most helpful when we extended our stay. He made the chore of checking in and out not a chore at all. Also I'd like to thank the lovely housekeeper Esmeralda for her excellent service.

allReviews.title: Great Place to stay
allReviews.text: I could not say enough great things about our stay. When we arrived we were greeted by Marites and immediately felt welcomed. She recommended many attractions, restaurants and must do places. She definitely set the tone for a fabulous stay! We arrived earlier than our check in time but were able to be accommodated and got right into our room. We stayed on the 52nd floor annd  our room was clean and beautiful. Our view was amazing. The buffet was delicious with a great variety of food. Every staff member we encountered from front desk to maintenance emptying trash on the way to the casino was friendly and always said hello. Being close enough to everything and yet far enough from the loud night life of the strip was great! If we ever come back to Vegas this is where we will stay again! Thank you for a great visit.

allReviews.title: Palms Place Hotel
allReviews.text: My partner and I checked in and was helped by Mr. Joseph at the front desk. He was amazing and even got us checked in early. The room is clean and spacious. Wish we could go out on the balcony but other than that it’s beautiful!!! THANK YOU JOSEPH!

allReviews.title: Don’t stay
allReviews.text: Do yourself a favor and stay on the strip.  Fell short in relaying any information on the property.  Amenities are a joke and don’t ask for any, they wont deliver!  And when you make a complaint, they don’t care.

allReviews.title: Never again.
allReviews.text: First of all they gave my room away before I arrived and then gave me a similar room where there was a broken  ice maker. Seems like a small thing..but they do not deliver ice and there is no ice maker in the entire hotel.  They kept offering to subtract charges, but money isnt the point, if I couldn't afford the price I wouldnt have booked the hotel. Then balconies are locked. Why book a balcony hotel and then have no access to the balcony.  Rooms are basic ( even the suites, dont fall for the professional photos) and linen had human hair all over it . Not impressed at all. Will never stay here again. And be clear this isn't a luxury hotel. It's not a hotel at all. It's a condo rental business with no or inconsistent amenities.  Stay on the strip!!!

allReviews.title: Mostly okay, but it’s the small things that kill it
allReviews.text: Comfortable, relatively clean and roomy.  The staff were all very kind and always smiling. BUT, so many little things annoyed us enough that we cannot recommend Palms Place. For example, the is no information in the room about the hotel, spa, room service (there isn’t any, I found out after calling and talking with room service), restaurant times or menus, pools, fire safety, nothing.  Also, the coffee shop in the lobby doesn’t open until 9am. The gift shop dose doesn’t keep regular hours. There doesn’t seem to be a spa menu anywhere except perhaps at the spa itself. We asked for toilet paper twice in 3 hours and eventually just hunted down a cart in a hall and got it ourselves( it was delivered at some point after we had left.) Our suite had an incredible balcony, but no balcony furniture. Security was good when is was present, and nonexistent , of course, when they were not.

allReviews.title: Do not book
allReviews.text: Terrible service. Room was not ready at check in and the reception seemed to not care at all.Rooms have balcony’s that are LOCKED. Absolutely ridiculous. Stay somewhere else and have a much better experience.

allReviews.title: Excellent Environment
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Everything we needed, spacious, and clean. Front desk service made it easy to check in...Natalie was very friendly and super helpful. Would stay here again. Excellent experience all around.

allReviews.title: barking dog and disrespectful housekeeping
allReviews.text: Palms Place was my usual go-to for an off-strip stay. I've stayed here maybe 6 times in the past couple of years while the Palms was undergoing renovation. Its main charm is how quiet and peaceful it is, how huge the suites are, and the added luxury of their deep soaking tubs. Unfortunately, those charms couldn't make up for the nightmare stay last night.Last night was my 3rd night of a 4 night stay here. Apparently there was a new tenant (?) who checked in last night across the way who had a dog that suffered from major separation anxiety. The hotel policy states that there are NO PETS ALLOWED (aside from service animals), but this pet was barking and scratching at its door from 10pm-4am... I doubt any trained service animal would be left alone in a place for that long, let alone one that suffered from such huge separation anxiety!I went down to complain 3 times, and each time, because the owner wasn't there, security and front desk couldn't help. And trust me -- this dog suffered from HORRIBLE anxiety -- not something anyone could sleep through or ignore. So I had to listen to this poor dog barking and scratching until 4am when the owners finally arrived.Anyhow, earlier that evening (before the dog situation), I went down to the front desk to extend my stay an extra night. Everything went smooth and they told me to come back down again the next morning in order to finalize my reservation. At 10:45AM the next morning, I went to the front desk and went through the whole reservation process again, then headed back to my suite...Not long after that, I get a knock on the door and before I could answer, housekeeping came in. I was stark naked on the bed, about to go back to sleep, and here's a housekeeper staring right at me. She didn't even declare that she was housekeeping and didn't even wait for me to say anything, just barged in! I jumped out of bed and hid behind a corner and told her, "I don't need housekeeping and I have DO NOT DISTURB on". She goes, "we still have a right to go in" and I was like "ma'am, I'm still here, I extended my stay, and if you don't mind..." and she continues arguing that she had a right to be there and asked if I'd even paid (?????)... all while I'm still standing there naked!!This was one of the most embarassing situations I'd ever been in -- and also startled the heck out of me! So I went down to the front desk immediately to complain. The lady (she was so sweet) completely understood what I was going through, between the housekeeper arguing with me while I was naked and dealing with a howling/barking dog all night, offered me a $50 food/beverage credit, which the manager then upped to $75.OK, so while the gesture was sweet, I really don't think $75 credit for food and beverages at the PALMS (not Palms Place, so I have to go across the parking lot for this) really makes up for lost sleep and being visually assaulted by their housekeeper.Tonight might be my last night staying here. While some of the staff are sweet, they could do better. If pets aren't allowed in hotel, this should apply to EVERYONE. And if someone has DND on their door, housekeeping should respect that (or double check with front desk about someone extending their stay instead of arguing with a naked tenant -- completely disrespectful!)Oh -- the other thing that's happening is that the hotel will try to charge you for every little thing. They no longer have free wifi -- was charged $12.99 per day PER DEVICE. And was also told if the bellboy were to accompany me with the luggage trolley to bring things to my door, they would charge me $10 (and no, I was not allowed to use the trolley on my own). They do not offer complimentary water either, as almost all other hotels do.

allReviews.title: Penthouse Paradise
allReviews.text: I spent 4 great days with my sons in the 56th floor Penthouse and it was Vegas luxury at its finest.  Two bedrooms...three bathrooms...a  theater room...spacious kitchen and living room plus a wonderful outdoor balcony and terrace with a glass enclosed hot tub that juts out over the edge.  The views during the day are great but at night...spectacular.  I've stayed in very nice places in Vegas before but being able to go outside into the sun and fresh air is a real plus.  The suite has a Foosball table...a huge Jacuzzi tub in the main bathroom plus dishes...glasses...cutlery etc. to make your stay perfect.  The decor is very upscale and modern with unique sliding walls so you can open the bedrooms up to the main room or slide them closed for privacy at night.  Lots of big screen Smart TVS and WiFi included for your entertainment needs.  The second bedroom has two Queen beds and a large soaking tub by the balcony glass doors if you want to relax and enjoy the view.  This has become our new favorite place to stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best Service in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My family of 5 stayed at the Palms Place and can’t wait for our next visit back. Check in went very smoothly Danica and Joseph at front desk were very nice. Also the bell service attendant Jeff was fast and attentive along with the Valet Jonathan! Jonathan had a conversation with our children and they enjoyed him. After check in we headed to the pool which was beautiful and clean, the bartender Daphne was incredibly sweet and made us a delicious mango margarita pitcher. Our room itself was beautiful and spacious with an breathe taking view of the strip, our bed was so comfy and the shower/bathtub was amazing!! Overall the Palms Place exceeds our expectations with their customer service and amenities and will definitely be returning soon for our next visit.

allReviews.title: A very unpleasant stay I do not recommend this place to anyone
allReviews.text: I’m very disappointed with this location. The location is advertised as a suite and it is more of an extended stay hotel. The rooms are run down. The bathrooms are dirty and they do not clean the rooms each day. There’s a button to request for housekeeping, but apparently does not work. When we return back to the room the room was the same way as we left it, and housekeeping had not clean the room, I called front desk and I was advised they do not clean the room during the stay unless requested which I did. I advise the represented that request was made by pushing the button by the entrance door and he advised me that the button does not work and I had to call the front desk to have them clean the room. With Covid going around I would think they would clean the rooms each day but unfortunately they do not care for safety and health of customers.

allReviews.title: Mr. Jones
allReviews.text: Awesome experience! Chanel was excellent and outstanding customer service. I would recommend this hotel. The view and room itself was impressive compared to the other hotels in the area. I loved the connection to the casino and the pools.

allReviews.title: Amazing front desk service Jeanette
allReviews.text: I’ve been staying here twice a month for about 18 month. It is my go to when working in Las Vegas. Jeanette is amazing as always. Kind, professional, friendly, capable, and helpful.  It’s nice that she remembers me. When you travel as much as I do, a friendly helpful face is always refreshing.

allReviews.title: Fa
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay in Palms place the moment you walk in, it smells amazing and the atmosphere is relaxing. I had the best check-in experience with Chanel she was amazing! All the other staff were very nice as well. I don’t think I have ever been to a place that has it all together like Palms Place.

allReviews.title: Nice Vegas room with strip view!
allReviews.text: Had the pleasure of checking in with Shanice. She was very helpful with getting us checked in early and picking out a great room with a nice view. Welcoming personality and professional. Very satisfied 😊

allReviews.title:
it was okay. but there is definitely room for improvement
but Chanel at the reception was super friendly and helpful
allReviews.text:
it was okay. but there is definitely room for improvement
but Chanel at the reception was super friendly and helpful

allReviews.title: Racquetball tournament
allReviews.text: Great location, great price, clean room, great view, and Chanel (the person who checked me in) was very nice, professional, not to mention very knowledgeable about the area and the property. I plan to visit again.

allReviews.title: Great check-in experience
allReviews.text: I had the good fortune to have Chanel check me in and she did an amazing job of describing the amenities of the resort.  The pluses are no resort fees, great valet car service, a spacious condo with good views, loved the huge shower with rain head and we also had a washer and dryer in the unit.Things that could be better: The patio doors were locked and we had no access to this huge patio to enjoy the views, the kitchen isn't stocked with anything so there was no way to prepare even a simple snack, the parking fee is $40/night which seemed high.

allReviews.title: Front desk
allReviews.text: Chanel was amazing!! Very helpful and so kind we had an issue when we got to the hotel, with our room, and she moved us without any problem! Then followed up with us to make sure the new room was all we needed!

allReviews.title: Front Desk Service!
allReviews.text: Palms place was nice and decent the rooms could be a little bit more cleaner, but it is what it is, very neutral on the room. Overall experience was great because of Chanel who worked in the front desk. Exceptional customer service, very welcoming and knowledgeable. She’s the only reason it was a good experience

allReviews.title: CHANEL
allReviews.text: After arriving to the luxurious palms hotel during the check-in we are greeted by a fantastic, sophisticated, and professional host named Chanel. From the beginning of the trip this is what set the expectations for the rest of the vacation. We wish every hotel had someone like this to make everyone's day a little bit better

allReviews.title: Amazing service!
allReviews.text: Best service ever! Chanél was really helpful and made us feel comfortable during our stay! she answered all our questions and gave us great tips! Our room was beautiful and the view was great. Definitely the place to be when coming to Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: unprofesional security personel and lack of human skills
allReviews.text: left my name and address at security booth. and do not curse the clients.as handicap veteran me finding my car keys  took time until i realized they were in the engine. 6 screaming 3 with sprayer pointing at me and accusation of consuming alcohol . i hired a personal injury attorney ,he will tell you all that happened.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas Spot
allReviews.text: Excellent space for the four of us and across the street from a dispensary 😉Check in a bit rocky but lovely personalities willing to help.Great views of Vegas and well appointed suite. Huge sectional slept two of us. All in all a nice change from huge Vegas hotel circus!

allReviews.title: Won’t go back
allReviews.text: Not super impressed.  I travel for a living and although I really did like the rooms (aside from the horribly dirty windows) the staff was not on their game. The pool was supposed to open at 10… it finally opened at 10:40 while staff buzzed around not acknowledging our existence.  Once at the pool… the deposit that I had to pay at the front desk obviously was meaningless as I had to pay cash and couldn’t charge to the room. After going to the front desk to straighten that out (they told me everything was taken care of) I got a phone call later that day telling me I had to return to the pool to sign. Ugh.   The rest of the stay was right along the same path.  I won’t be returning.

allReviews.title: Great stay, clean and spacious room!
allReviews.text: We had a great stay at Palms Place! We arrived a bit early and the front desk staff, Errie was able to get us in before the check in time, there is a charge for checking in early but we didn't mind as we were tired and wanted to relax already. She was very helpful and informative as what is included or not in our room. We stayed in a suite and it was perfect! Very clean and spacious. The only thing we wished was included is the balcony being open. For some reason that day, the door to the balcony was locked and we can't go out but Errie did tell us about that being close temporarily. Overall, everything was perfect!

allReviews.title: I don't condone the disrespect from the front desk
allReviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay from StripView Suites. I have left my fair review with them about our stay. Cleansiness is one thing. But the hotel front desk itself, in person I had a easy time but when you're tracking down your secuirty deposit. It is a hassle. I called the day after check out and was told I would get the deposit 5-7 business days (per usual) Understood. I simply called a week later and a respresentative Sandra I believe picked up the phone, I kid you not she already had an attitude, she was sighing all over the place on the phone. Once I mention about my security deposit she sighed LOUDER! She asked me about my last name, first, and last 4 digits to card. I provided the info and she said it was deposited into my bank account May 26th. The first day I called after check out. I told her I haven't recieved anything.. she had the audacity to interupt with a laugh/giggle/chuckle over the phone. I asked her what's so funny? She said "It will take 5-7 business days" I asked, but did you not just admit and told me it was deposited on May 26th? and she laughed again. I asked her again why she's laughing I asked her a simple question and I don't condone the disrespect over the phone it is unprofessional and she hung up the phone. NEVERRRRRRR in my life have I experienced HORRIBLE customer service from a hotel. I work customer service all my life and this was absurd! I am condsidering on not coming back because of this ONE representative that was so rude and unprofessional. DO BETTER!

allReviews.title: WREAKS OF MARIJUANA
allReviews.text: I highly recommend against staying here.  There are a lot of residents that smoke marijuana regularly and many of the rooms smell terribly because of it.  I booked a room through StripView Suites who refused to cancel the remainder of my stay.  I would highly recommend looking elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Lovin it in Vegas
allReviews.text: The sfaff was friendly and they had on-site security. The rooms were a bit dated bjt spacious. Our room had a queen-size bed, a sitting area, a d a kitchen with fridge and ice maker. The bathroom was huge including a rain attachment and a very large jet tub for two. The hotel itself was quiet and views impressive as we were on the 19th floor and had views of downtown north to south.  This may be making way for the A's stadium so don't wait to take advantage of its fair rates.

allReviews.title: Fully Priced, Half of the Amenities & Services
allReviews.text: I had to clean things on my own in order to even feel comfortable. The shower was filthy.   The TVs are outdated, you can't stream anything and you can't connect a Chromecast because the outlet is blocked.  The radio does not have a way to play your music from you phone, it only has iPod connectivity....I haven't seen this in years.  Balconies are closed, I know the reason but due to legal reasons, I won't say; however, it is not disclosed prior to booking.  I wanted this hotel due to the balcony.  The casino is closed!!! Do not go here thinking you will gamble there. The pool was closed for 2 days.  Valet no longer exists.  At this point, I have no clue what I paid for and the resort fees were still on there. I think I paid for the gym that I had no intention to utilize and I didn't.  Prior to booking, you should be warned about the changes that have taken place and amenities that will not be available during your stay.  I paid full price and was not able to enjoy anything.

allReviews.title: Not as clean as you would expect.
allReviews.text: Had to change rooms 3 times. Not all what I expected. Also seems this is the place to come smoke weed cause the hallways and rooms reeked of it. Finally was moved to a room that wasn't nauseating. Look at the pic i took of the inside of the coffee pot. Yuk!

allReviews.title: Half functional, full price
allReviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Palms for 3 nights. We arrived a little after 3pm and when we tried to check-in we were notified that the room wasn’t ready. So after twenty minutes we were called to the counter and checked in. It was a bit disappointing to be charged for the full daily resort fee on top of the reservation considering the casino, bars and spas were still closed due to covid. At first glance the room was very nice and matched the photos we saw online. What sold us on this hotel was the jets in the bathtub, but once we settled in the wear on the room became apparent. There was holes in the curtains, tears on the chairs, scratches on the table, tape hanging from the ceiling that was from a previous party, no cups in the drawer and worst of all when we tried out the jets in the tub within seconds the water to smell like a sewer and we immediately got out. During our stay the room wasn’t turned down so we ran out of towels. The first day we had do not disturb until noon but after that we had the housekeeping button on. No sign of them. Overall, the stay was okay but could of been better. We were excited to stay at this hotel but became disappointed very quickly.

allReviews.title: Great price, great rooms, no casino.
allReviews.text: This place is very clean, including:   The rooms, elevators,  pool, lobby, restrooms, etc..The staff, hands down, excellent.   They were very friendly, professional, courteous,  and helpful. Anything we needed, we had it right away.I didn't  care for the pool, it is very small and closed early.  As of July 1st,  you no longer had access to the balconies.  That was disappointing.  Everything isn't fully functional yet. There is no casino because the Palms casino is closed.  The guests are young and urban. Not my cup of tea. Next visit I will stay at one the resorts I normally frequent on the strip.

allReviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
allReviews.text: I stayed in a suite for three nights on a business trip. I had extremely rude service while staying here. I went to hang out by the pool to wait for my flight for just a few hours, & the tone of the man running the pool was very disrespectful. After spending my money for an entire week for a suite at that, I figured it would be okay to sit by the pool to have a drink for a few hours until my flight. I was told I could pay $45 to store my luggage for two hours or I couldn’t be near the pool. Very disappointed in the customer service or willingness to help as I would’ve paid to store my luggage or have it with me. I wouldn’t recommend anyone staying here. Highly recommend you find new staff for people working by the pool. I personally won’t be staying here ever again.

allReviews.title: Great views, beautiful property.
allReviews.text: My girlfriend and I decided to stay here as there are few hotels with balconies available that are inexpensive in Vegas. Our favorite is the Cosmopolitan or the polo towers on strip. This was our first stay here. The property is very pretty and clean and not as crowded as the strip. These rooms are condos and not the actual palms hotel. We have stayed off the strip before and this hotel was very easy to get to and leave from. We got a strip view balcony room on the 51st floor. Amazing views from here. The room had more amenities than most rooms on the strip. It even had a dishwasher. The room itself was a little beat up (broken light fixtures, mirror, and several bulbs out, broken fridge) and the bed had a hair in it as well as stained sheets. This is the only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars.. I expect a clean bed at a nice property like this. I also found marijuana in the room (it’s Vegas and it didn’t bother us but still) which makes me question how thorough they actually clean these rooms. I loved the jetted soaker tub and the rainfall shower. Great kitchen and comfortable bedding and furniture. The big balcony could use some furniture but we were spoiled at the Cosmo with a sofa and chair and ashtray on a table. Overall it’s a good value for what you get. They have nice toiletries and they included a loofa and sewing kits. We would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: The View is the BEST!
allReviews.text: We stayed only 1 night at The Palms Place but it was a great experience.  Check in was quick and easy.  The room is amazing.  Very large with a King Bed and a sectional sofa.  We also used the sofa bed and it was also remarkably comfortable.  The balcony view from the 52nd floor was spectacular.  The truly best part was the jetted tub.  Large and relaxing.   We would have liked a couple of chairs on the balcony and better signage upon arrival on where to register, but other than that, a great stay.  Clean, comfortable and well decorated.  We will return for a longer stay.

allReviews.title: BUYER BEWARE
allReviews.text: This hotel is a joke. There is nothing open yet. Not even coffee. The place is dirty and they overcharge for their dirty rooms. The staff is bare and they don't have a manager on site. No services here. Just dirty rooms and a dirty hotel.

allReviews.title: Late review aka Amazing Stay!
allReviews.text: We stayed at this Hotel in 2018, we were upgraded at check in to an amazing suite with a stunning view. The hotel is a little off strip but still in walking distance of everything. I truly enjoyed the staff & and ambience of this hotel. It was an excellent choice. We will be back!

allReviews.title: The owner who sublet this place is a thief
allReviews.text: He kept my money after I did not want to stay there due to his dilapidated condo.  Bodily fluids on rundown furniture.  Completely filthy inside and outside on balcony.  Missing handles from outside to be able to get back inside.  Several different people had keys/access.  Dirty laundry in bags still through out condo and kitchen appliances had foul order.  It was unsanitary and unsafe to stay there.  Floor plugs were sticking up and out of floor causing potential trip and fall or potential electrical shock.  Be weary of renting from this property at all as this owner said he has several rooms there.

allReviews.title: COVID HAS TAKEN THIS HOTEL DOWN!!!
allReviews.text: It was the worst experience I've ever had at the Palms!!! My advice would be to SHUT IT DOWN! Your hotel is NOT up to standard. Your hotel is FILTHY! Your Hotel Service is not even up to Motel 6 standards! I've stayed at the Palms Resort several times and NEVER could I have imagined this beautiful Hotel would turn into a dump.....especially during COVID! 1. No room service (no food, but overpriced liquor is available) No even a pack of freakin crackers) 2. No customer Service - (1 person at front desk, line out the door)3. No housekeeping (WTF! No clean sheets, no clean towels. So due to COVID you can't even leave it for me daily...not even in a bag, at the door, thrown in the room, left at a pickup station, nothing! TRIFLIN!) 4. My room was filthy (Tub with visible dirt ring, clean sheets to cover a dirty stained duvet comforter, hair in bedding, seating (bar stool) stained with what looked like blood, residue of something on countertop, dust EVERYWHERE!5. Room amenities broken (hair dryer BROKEN, makeup led mirror BROKEN6. "Resort services" Pool available NO FOOD but all the alcohol your liver can stand! So you're telling me due to COVID you can't have food but you can serve liquor???? Ridiculous!! oh and no you can't bring outside food cause Palms needs you super drunk to not recognize that they haven't cleaned or sanitized a darn thing since MARCH! 7. No bell service, No luggage carts - Of course.....Due to COVID you can't simply sanitize carts for guest after each use?? So due to COVID, bell service, valet, room service, housekeeping, customer service, concierge, cleanliness, IS ALL UNAVAILABLE! Is COVID also the reason you also can't notify guest BEFORE arrival the your service is crappy too? COVID broke your computers and your fingers so you can't send emails to arriving guest? But......luckily COVID didn't mess with your payment processing system!! Dang COVID even let your company charge me $88 for a resort fee? I just want to know for WHAT resort, cause I was at a freaking SUPER 8! SHUT IT THE HECK DOWN PALMS!!

allReviews.title: Great stay.
allReviews.text: Though this is not a new hotel, it appears as new.  We rented a condo 18th floor, room 306 through Airbnb and it was spectacular!  It was furnished beautifully and the beds were quite comfortable...it was exactly we advertised. But be aware, because of COVID-19 there are no bellmen and the drive through to the registration area was blocked. Also there is an ice maker in the small fridge but we could not get it to work and the hotel has no ice, so buy ice before you check in. But don’t let the Covid problems stop you. This is a great place to stay...with free parking and an easy walkway access to the Palms casino.  I would absolutely stay again.

allReviews.title: Nightmare
allReviews.text: The Palms hotel was just ok..IT IS NOT WORTH THE MONEY. The service from the moment I walked in was trash. I was half a** greeted by an employee that was sitting on a chair doing absolutely nothing but running her mouth and laughing with other employees. She told me to check in at the kiosk instead of greeting me properly and taking my information although no-one was in line behind me. The (one) pool was over crowded each time I tried to go out and relax. The initial room they put us in had old ripped furniture and the sheets were dingy. The room also flooded no sooner than we put our bags down. Water leaked from the ceiling all over the floor. We were moved to another room that was exactly the same..Then the hotel charged me an additional $200 for incidentals (aside from the resort fee) that was not at all in the fine print of my agreement. Lastly, the hotel over charged me for the resort fee and it took a week to get someone on the phone from the hotel to correct the error. The representative Josh was not at all apologetic on behalf of the company and simply gave the number for the corporate office to file a complaint about my dissatisfaction.

allReviews.title: Epic
allReviews.text: I highly recommend this place. This is where it’s at in Vegas! They have some upscale bars and restaurants in there; so many food options even for late night. We had the luxury suite and it was everything. Very relaxing with an amazing view. Comfy beds and a spacious bathroom with a huge tub.

allReviews.title: Best view ever
allReviews.text: Very nice and clean and the view over the Strip is amazing and the balcony view is lovely, its fully furnished and they have ice maker and cooler it equipped with full kitchen and stove and they valet parking

allReviews.title: It’s the principle.
allReviews.text: Booked a 1bdrm suite for 2nts for my bfs bday.Only 1 agent so there was a long line each time I came. The kiosks werent helpful. Room wasn’t ready @4, or when I returned @435 but it was being rushed. It was ready the 3rd time I came @630 once we returned after eating. The agent agreed to waive 1nt of resort fees & gave us a free 12PM late check out because we waited so long. I verified with someone that I should get a refund after our 2nd night ended. She confirmed when booking me ANOTHER night that the charge would fall off. At this time I was satisfied w/ the stay, the initial issues had been made up for, or so I thought, and there were only minor issues in the room (old trash and bdrm tv out).10 days later, no $.
