allReviews.text: The female manager at the front desk brings negative reviews to this hotel because of her attitude. While checking in I asked for her manager/supervisor to speak to since I wasn't happy with our room but she said I don't have a manager and don't report to anyone, she told me if I amNot happy I should walk away and there is no refund!!! The room is clean. No coffee, water and conditioner in the room but overall the room is good except the manager.

allReviews.title: HORRIBLE...DO NOT BOOK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: First off, let me start by saying the whole place is under renovations! When we arrived to the hotel, and walked in, half the casino was blocked off with construction men EVERYWHERE. We walked around the entire casino just to get to the front desk area which was a small little room. We explained that we did not know the whole hotel was under construction and are disappointed. The manager replied "well its stated on our website"...oh I'm sorry, I didn't book through your website, I booked through a travel site where it is NOT LISTED!! Next we go to the room and put on our bathing suits because the thing we do most at hotels is swim and sit in the hot sub/sauna. We call downstairs to ask where the pool is located and are told "sorry it's under construction". Um ok...WHAT! Then I ask where the hot tub and sauna is located and am told that it's an additional $25/day to use that!!!! None of that is listed! Now I was anger because literally the main thing I wanted to do on my vacation was relax by the pool and hot tub! So disappointed. Now let's talk about their buffet, which is a joke. It took 30 minutes just to get in which there were only about 10 people in line and on top of that, the food was terrible! (Breakfast was ok, but lunch was TERRIBLE!) if you have ever been to a buffet in vegas like the wynn you will know what I'm talking about...When going out at night and coming back, we were pretty much interrogated by a rude lady to give her our room key to prove we were staying there...so I had to dig through my purse for 5 minutes before I was even allowed on the elevator. I could go on and on for hours of why NOT to stay here. Low class hotel with low class service. We have stayed at many hotels that would comp the stay or allow us to use facilities at no charge should a website not state various information, but not this place. Management was anything but accommodating.  Be smart and shell out a few more bucks a night to stay at a nice hotel with good service, you don't want to ruin your whole vacation by staying here!!!!!

allReviews.title: Great hotel / apartment
allReviews.text: Huge room, staff very friendly. A short taxi to the main strip.Used this for a business trip, having the kitchen facilities was useful and having the separate living area makes a nice change to single room hotel rooms.

allReviews.title: Very different
allReviews.text: As a Palms property this hotel is very different from the rest of the palms properties! The staff, rooms, and overall environment is exceptionally great! With staying there for weeks at a time. I will also add the spa is great.

allReviews.title: Stayed in 1200 Sq Ft Suite; Strip View over Christmas.  Excellent
allReviews.text: Excellent Stay.  Rated stay at palms ivory tower as 4 from this July.  This was certainly five.Check in staff was great and allowed us to upgrade to a 1200 sq ft corner suite that overlooked the strip and mountains with two balconies for only half a bill more per night.  Very well appointed and luxurious suite.Room was well appointed but had some issues that were addressed 99% within 20 minutes, and 100% within a few hours. The maintenance man who helped us 'fix' our sliding door off the hinge was wonderful.Elevators fast.  Maid was great.  Housekeeping kept us stocked up on dinner sets, breakfast sets and pots and pans at a simple request.Suite well appointed with L couch with pull out, seperate off the master bedroom with jetted tub next to bed, vanity mirror, numerous closets and a double vanity with a 360 degree shower system with dual removable shower heads.TV in bathroom was nice touch.  Three TVs total in suite.  Nice sized half bathroom for guest(s).  Kitchen is well appointed sub zero fridge with high end electric cook top, exhaust hood.  By default the suite has coffee maker, toaster, blender, and tea pot.By default the suite also has washer and dryer and a nice three sided view gas fireplace.  Upon check in was given option of direct strip / side mountain view on 12th floor, or a mountain view with partial strip on a much higher floor.  We took the former and appreciated the option.Resort fee sucks of course, but at the price we paid it still is an incredible value.  Front desk was great, valet was great, housekeeping was great and room service was great.Maintenance men were superb.  5 star suite / 5 star experience.  Only con is the slow WIFI, and the fact the included room smart DVD/Blueray players don't have Netflix due to slow internet stream speeds.

allReviews.title: From Good to Great!
allReviews.text: Booked last minute on Southwest Vacations.  Resort fee was disclosed but not the $100 per night security deposit or $30 early check in fee if you arrive before noon.  Expressed my concerns to manager, Sherae and she responded with compassion.  Since my husband was not feeling well, we paid the fee so he could lay down.Studio Suite is spacious and modern, with a king and queen sleeper and sectional for our adult children. Best features are icemaker, lots of outlets, kitchenette and two closets.  Was able to store meds, full bottles of wine and lots of water in the mini frig.  Nice view from 30th floor and 6th floor pool area is intimate  yet vibrant.    As a person who books rooms for groups all over the globe, this alternative off-strip, no casino venue is a nice option.   Very little walking, 24 hour room service and even Pizza delivery is available. The Uber pick up area is great and we were able to get supplies from nearby Smiths at a fraction of the cost of those items on the strip.Looking forward to our next few nights here.  Sherae's compassion has taken our experience from good to great.

allReviews.title: Go have fun !
allReviews.text: Travel to the Palms Place during Christmas of 2017. Had a wonderful time there very nice accommodations, very nice staff. Views of the strip are excellent. Being just off the strip provide use he would not normally get. Fun things to do in the area that you can walk to if you choose. I had a sweet towards the top floors that had a full kitchen. No utensils or plates or anything else. Very strange for a unit with a full kitchen. This was just a minor setback and otherwise wonderful experience at the Palms Place. I hope to visit again.

allReviews.title: Great bang for your buck- midrange price, luxury feel!
allReviews.text: The location is literally the only con about this condo rental/hotel- no, it's not on the strip. Otherwise, the suite had huge upgraded bathrooms along with an awesome view of the strip. It's fair to say I'm borderline OCD and I loved it. A lot of other reviews are mentioning their service, mentally I went into the unit as a renter so I guess my expectation was different. I wasn't expecting a toothbrush at my door at 8 am, just nice living quarters and that's exactly what I got!

allReviews.title: no service to unit, rude valet guy
allReviews.text: We stayed here in Oct, because our friend happened to own a place here.  The check-in was pretty smooth and met with a smile.  However, that's the only service we've got without pulling some teeth.  One more pro: free parking.  I guess this is a huge amenities in Vegas.I didn't realize that these units are mixed owner-owned and hotel-owned.  It feels like hotel coming in, but they give you very little service after handing you the key.  The unit was pretty clean so I was very happy when we first got in.  However, the fridge was leaking water inside and were only provided with like few towels that wouldn't last us the entire 5 nights we were staying there.  We were family of 4.  There was no daily housekeeping in light of true Airbnb style.  In fact, we had no utensils initially to use in our kitchenette.  We usually fully use all kitchenette whenever we check into a condo.  So it was confusing when we didn't have utensils and barely any pots/pans.  I asked housekeeping for utensils and didn't get them.  I was really confused why there's a kitchen but no utensils.  I had to dig through our luggage to find plastic ones and had to get them from Starbucks.  I think we finally got a set 2 days before we took off.  They also refused to give us extra towels and not even blanket that wasn't stocked in the unit (for some reason, they never had the extra blanket where it should've been).  It's not likely that we would've lied about its existence.  Maybe previous people took it?  I have no idea.  But they had to consult my friend whether they can give us one.  We had the option of renting one for $5/night.  If this was the case, I wish I knew about it so that we could've brought our own!  Kinda ridiculous, though.  My friend relied on the hotel's housekeeping to stock certain items that you'd expect in the unit.  I think even he was disappointed.  They often had to consult the homeowners association to see if certain things were allowed to be given to us, which really increased the time we'd get anything.  We did score a roll of paper towel so thank you.Anyhow, I'm super grateful for my friend for the unit, but I saw how Airbnb customers would get treated and didn't seem right.  I thought Palms management was hired to provide services for those checking in, but it's quite minimal.  The common areas are wonderful, clean, and beautiful.  But even this one valet was rude to us when I tried to use the cart to bring in some groceries, because we had so many bags that we had to lug from our parking space FAR away.  It wasn't like he was trying to help us with the bags.  He just scolded us for trying to use the cart, because he mentioned that "This is a premium hotel."  Seriously?  Most premium hotels would've offered to help me with the bags.  I was with my 4 year old so the help would've been really nice.I would've given this place 1 star, but I really do like the free parking (even though it's quite a walk from there to front door).

allReviews.title: Time for updates
allReviews.text: Could be a great hotel but seems to be going downhill instead of up.Updates needed,I have stayed at this hotel many times but now they need to replace and replace the following,beds need to be replaced,feel old and lumpy,chairs in room are all torn,looks terrible,room feels tired in general.I asked for plates,knifes,pots as it is a full kitchen and it took 3 days to finally get to my room good thing,I was there a week.Staff at front desk okay but a lot of the staff seems as they just couldn't care at all.Bathrooms are very nice ,way above the rest of the room.

allReviews.title: Needs work
allReviews.text: The unit that I rented was through AirPads and it had an awesome distant view of Las Vegas Strip. The bed was very comfortable the room however lacked drawer space for clothes. There was hanging space but then it meant everything had to be on hangers instead. The room itself was nice and roomy. The sofa space was nice a comfortable. The furniture looked a little outdated and could use a change or repair from the little dents from years of use. The room overall was very clean. The kitchen area with the stove top which I never got to use was nice although I think they really don’t want you to cook as there really was just 1 pot and 1 pan. No cutting or chopping knives only butter knives. Also no drying rack for cups or dishes used, although we finally found on the next day that there was a dishwasher but it was hidden under the table. You kinda have know to move the big chairs and then slide the table in order to open or know that there was a dish washer even there. Also it made it inconvenient every time you needed to use the dishwasher. With us since we didn’t really cook it was a hassle just to open and close to put a cup or two there to dry when they could have easily supplied a small dish rack for drying. So although they do advertise a kitchen you it really isn’t stocked or laid out well to do any cooking. When we checked in we were told that there was a balcony in the room and please don’t move inside furniture into the balcony. So worries I thought. But it turned out the balcony was locked and needed a key. A key that the housekeeper had only so that means bothering them to lock and unlock every time you wanted to step outside on the balcony. Unless you’re okay with leaving the balcony forever unlocked while you were staying there, which I did not feel secure enough to want to do.

allReviews.title: This is a big place, but they make it feel like a boutique
allReviews.text: I don't really know how they pull it off, this is not a small hotel, and is actually part of 3 giant towers (although quite a distance from the other two). But it really does feel like a small boutique.Rooms are beautiful, and have full kitchens (although they do not include silverware unless you ask for it). Pool is year-round. The bar and restaurant is good and reasonably priced.The only downside right now is the casino (which is a bit of a walk anyway) is under an extreme level of construction and is barely functional. Tables are set right by the front door so on a chilly night anytime someone walks in or out you're blasted with cold air. Not pleasant or comfortable right now. We mostly walked to the casino across the street to gamble because of that.

allReviews.title: Luxury Townhouse off the strip - The Palms Place
allReviews.text: I love staying at the Palms Place when in Vegas - from the excellent service of valet - to the luxury rooms that are so spacious - be sure to ask for STRIP view - to the relaxing pools to the delicious food in their various restaurants -

allReviews.title: A great place to stay!
allReviews.text: Our room was very nice, well stocked and clean. Bed very comfortable and bathroom very roomy. Alex checked us in efficiently and all at the front desk were friendly. Wish we were here long enough to use the beautiful pool area.Palms Casino was a short walk for some gaming and food. Had a lovely view of the strip. Would stay here again!

allReviews.title: Great hotel in LV
allReviews.text: The first thing that I did was to rent a 111m2 apartment with a fireplace. The view was amazing. Spacious apartment as second home. A huge advantage for my wife is the bathtub. All in all, I was happy too, why? As someone knew it :) Stone bathroom done neatly, neat. Room very clean, very much with that in Las Vegas however hard. Breakfast delicious, huge selection. For those who value high quality I highly recommend. Close to all attractions, walking distance.

allReviews.title: Better than expected
allReviews.text: The room was a lot more than I expected when I originally booked it.  Two TVs, a full kitchen, shower and jacuzzi couldnt be beat at the rate we got it.  This hotel is also connected to the Palms which has a lot of accomodations if you want to avoid the crowds on the strip. Staff was also very informative and friendly during our stay. Definitely would stay again and recommend to friends..

allReviews.title: If we can give a mark of ZERO
allReviews.text: We arrived at Palms Place with the hopes of a nice stay, yet way further than the truth. To be brief, we check-in and checked out in the morning with two day left. We were still charged for the two days. We should of known when we first arrived to check-in there was already a dispute in front of us in line. The management is HORRIBLE. The hotel is owned by different owners that creates more problems. The so called 69-89 deal rate forget it. The hotel is isolated from casinos. This is NOT the original Palms KEEP in mind. We talked with management and he was confrontational similar to a bully that was extremely unprofessional. Anyhow, please remember the 129.00$ resort fee aside from any deal. We ended up staying at the Venetian with worth paying extra , with the experience going WAY up from the Palms Inn encounter.Palms Inn Bad ServicePalms Inn Terrible ManagementPalms Inn Unfair Price Changes

allReviews.title: Very nice Suite
allReviews.text: Very nice and quiet, large suite with marble bathroom, stainless steel kitchen appliances, very comfortable bed and great glass balcony. The room was very clean and quiet, the restaurant is great and the pool as well.I like that the casino is in another building so you don't have to walk through smoke all the time, plus you can see some move or music stars here as well

allReviews.title: Dirty
allReviews.text: Staff is not friendly at all and studio suite was not very clean. On the balcony there were glasses on the floor and it was sticky. The shower was dirty and we could not even use the tub. We requested housekeeping, but nobody cleaned during our stay. You can get a better place, even in the strip for that price.

allReviews.title: Nice place away from Strip
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Palms via Airbnb and had a really nice time. The place was clean and quiet. We had just come from hiking/camping in Zion National Park so we felt a little out of place until we settled in and got cleaned up, but overall a good experience. Pool wasn't available because of inclement weather (it was SUPER windy), so we were bummed we didn't get to experience that.

allReviews.title: Stay far away from this place if you care about service!
allReviews.text: We had booked a non-smoking studio suite with a balcony at Palms place on two different reservations with one day difference mostly to assess their rooms and service since we had read some really bad ratings about this property recently. We stayed there for the first night on October 18th 2017 to October 19th 2017. While we specifically mentioned that both my wife and I are very sensitive to smell of smoke, the first room given to us was saturated with heavy smoke coming out of everywhere. We requested them to switch the room. The second room was even worse; on the top of the smell of group smoking, there was a heavy deodorant sprayed in the air which I assume is their CREATIVE solution to ditch guests and try to hide the smoking problem. We requested a THIRD room (just imagine you have to go through this after being on a very long flight and almost at 12 a.m.!)Another jewel from the outstanding management at Palms place was that the balcony doors were locked!!! Their balconies are basically the most important feature they can offer on their rooms and if that is non-existent, there is little to no reason to stay in a hotel/casino far away from strip! To make the package complete, we found make-up on the bed sheet.... who knows what else was there that we didn't see ( this is was in the last room after switching us twice). We requested a room service after mid-night; we practically were sleeping on the chairs at this point.... completely disappointing. Stay far away and don't waste your money; you may pay a little more to stay in a hotel on strip but that would worth it since you will have to pay for transportation to the strip anyways. This hotel doesn't have much to offer anymore unfortunately.

allReviews.title: Bdangelo
allReviews.text: I spent 5 days at this hotel. It was under construction, dirty, understaffed and management was non responsive. Anyone thinking about making a reservation at this hotel needs to rethink their decision.

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: This was our second stay at Palms Place. Check in was good. Friendly and helpful staff. Luggage carts are for bellhop use only so was a little shocked at that and since we had a number of pieces to carry up it was an inconvenience (never sure what's a good tip for their service so didn't use). When we arrived in the room we were greeted by a very strong odor of curry and even with room spray wasn't much help. Bed was ok but not best ever. Had a few issues with getting wifi but after a few calls managed to finally connect 1 device at no charge. Poor overall cleaniness and even worse, was the visibility out the windows. We will not stay again.

allReviews.title: Terrible noise at 7AM to replace upstair rooms balcony glass, just terrible
allReviews.text: I stayed in Palms place on 10/3-10/6, and got a nice suite in high floor(52or56F). Everything was went not bad, but at 10/6 morning, we were supposed to get a nice rest until noon, but, we were awoken up by some very loud electric drill noise and some construction sound around 6:30AM. I think no one can sleep under that kind of noise, it’s like they drill thing right next to  my ear. I called the front desk at 7:30AM to ask why, the gentleman only answered: I did not aware we have construction on going now.  And then??? He just kept silence. I think this was not a good response. I still asked him to check for me, he sound like unwilling to, and he transferred me to a lady, the lady said they were changing glass balcony upstairs, I asked how long will it be, but she cannot answer. She told me she can check it and call me back, but after 1hour, she never called. I can see the working guys doing the work right above my room from my window, that is why the noises were terribly loud, the work was lasting until 9 or 10AM and I just cannot stay in my room anymore. Is it make any sense to have someone to use electric drill to replace balcony glasses when there were customers staying in underneath room, and the work took place at 6:30AM in the morning???? I really cannot understand. I was about to tell the front desk when I checked out that day noon, but the front desk gentlemen did not even ask how was my stay. It was the most unpleasant stay in Las Vegas .

allReviews.title: Rented privately owned condo suite
allReviews.text: We rented a 1220 sf condo from an individual owner for a trip with 3 adults and an infant. It was nice being in the Palms Place condos and not having to walk through a smoke filled casino. The parking was very easy/adequate and the facilities were nice enough. The strip shuttle only departs from the Palms Hotel which is a decent walk away, but we had a rental car (which I would highly recommend) so not a big deal to us. If you rent from an individual on AirBnB or VRBO this place is a bargain, if you rent directly from the Palms I believe the price is substantially higher and may not be quite as appealing. Our friends were in a smaller unit that we visited, also nice and clean, modern furnishing etc. The internet was disappointing and not free from what I could tell, so we stuck with cellular internet the whole time.

allReviews.title: Good, not great
allReviews.text: Truthfully, I did not spend much time in the suite. There is so much more to do around Las Vegas than sit in a hotel room. As a place to sleep, it works. Clean and efficient. I'm a photographer, and we did use the suite as a location twice. Since each room/suite varies, what worked or did not work for me, may not influence you.The floor plan I was shown prior to booking was slightly different than the actual room I received. As a room, this was no trouble, but as a photography studio, it did impact me. User beware.The room was filled with mirrors and reflective surfaces (TV screens). Not ideal for my purposes. The balcony was locked, and the hotel staff could not open it for me. Disappointing for trying to capture the view of the city at night. However, the staff was very helpful with many other services, especially valet parking and checking my luggage on my last day for late leave time. Friendly.

allReviews.title: Nice room but exercise options not for the early riser
allReviews.text: I booked off the strip based on the photos of the living space and relaxing resort quality exercise options. When I travel to Vegas it is most certainly for work. Being an east coaster I am up by 3 a.m. hoping to swim or at the very least hop on a treadmill.In a nutshell, pool not open until 11 and gym not open until 6. I am upset and frustrated and manager on duty (Chris?) didn't offer a solution or compromise. Not everyone is here for the nightlife or can easily adapt to the time difference. Even working options are limited with the slow "free" internet. I am disappointed and this is going to be a loooong week. I will never stay off the strip again. Even if the price is a bargain it isn't worth the lack of access to facilities or the uber fares...Apparently you are free to roam around in your evening wear after 4 a.m. and stumble around but not work out or swim...

allReviews.title: Nannied here for the first time
allReviews.text: Nannied here for the first time and they rented the room from Airbnb. The room was a spacious 1 king size bed w a decent sized couch. Also had a fridge, stove and dishwasher. The place wasn’t very clean though… had tile, wood floor and a small carpet area. The couch had tons of stains all over it and the carpet as well. The square glass table didn’t have stoppers under the glass and the glass moved everytime you touched it. The patio was nice with a great view!

allReviews.title: Somewhat Disappointed
allReviews.text: We booked a 2 night stay at PP/LV September '17. We specifically booked thru the actual hotel to avoid the mishaps I'd previously read about regarding privately rented units. Well let me say it didn't really make a difference..  The 1st room we were given had dinged/chipped furniture, stained pillows on the couch and just an overall "over used" feel.  We were in a hurry so we quickly checked in left our bags in the room and dashed off to an appointment.  All the time I had that feeling that I just wasn't satisfied with the room.  When we returned I went straight to the check-in desk to voice my concern. The staff I agent I spoke with checked with her manager and supposedly gave us a "nicer" suite which turned out to be a little better however still not what I expected.  This was our 1st and last stay at this property.  The lobby had a strange unpleasant odor every time we entered. And in the mornings I could smell exactly and quite clearly what one of the units near us was having for breakfast.  In the 2nd room we were given we had a balcony with a very nice view of the strip which was pretty at night but the door was locked preventing us from actually going outside the room.  The balcony had what looked like glass for the outer railing but it was either scratched or extremely dirty as you couldn't see thru it at all.  Also, this as most of the hotels in the strip area, charges a "resort" fee.  The 1st day we checked in we were alerted that we did not have access to the pool as there was a private event so it was closed.  After we left I thought I really should've asked for a credit since we didn't have the access for that day or at least pro-rated!!! As nice as the rooms are portrayed it just had on overall “overused” feel… not sparkly and clean.  There were only a couple of glasses and 2-3 pots.... no kitchen utensils at all ---cabinets were empty.  The bathroom appeared brighter due to the white marble tile, however the shower not so much.  The shower head looked really bad with hard water damage and what looked like mold and I couldn’t quite get it figured out as water came from both the hand held part and the rain head above from the ceiling. Also something that was just crazy strange is there are 2 TVs in the rooms both of which are merely a few feet away from each other.  Not sure what the attempted concept was but still don’t understand how you are supposed to watch one and someone else watch the other within the same space.  It was just weird.  Overall, it just wasn't the best stay I've had while visiting LV and probably wasn't the worse although thinking back I don't think I've really had a bad stay in all the years I've visited LV.    We had actually considered using this location to accommodate our guests for our upcoming wedding next year in LV.  It seemed a good choice with the listed amenities.  Sorry, PP but aside from the great customer service we received in switching out the rooms, we weren’t impressed with the property.

allReviews.title: Feels like home
allReviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for our birthday and had a really great time.  Alex was the front desk agent Who checked us in and he was great. When we checked in to our one bedroom suite we were very impressed. There was a jet tub, floor to ceiling panoramic windows, a fire place, a full kitchen, two bathrooms, we couldn't ask for anything else.  The view  at night was beautiful. There were lights everywhere. When we woke  up the next morning and looked out the window, we were very surprised to see that we had both a Mountain View and a view of the strip. This hotel really follows the Forbes standards.  Angie who was one of the pbx agents always addresses me by my last name, housekeeping never failed to service my room when I called and all request were taken care of in 15 minutes or less.  The showers were pretty darn awesome.  This hotel is HUGE there is a movie theater, you can take the skywall to the casino which is pretty cool.  You can also take the skywalk to alize where my boyfriend and I had dinner. Beautiful views great food and great service.  Now the salon is beautiful, service is good but the lady who did my makeup did a horrible job. I paid her, ran to my room and washed out my face and ended up doing my own make up. However, that didn't ruin the experience for the rest of the night was seamless. please make this your go to hotel if you are in Vegas. I know I will.  This place feels like home.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay
allReviews.text: We stayed at Palms Place for 3 days. It was an amazing stay. Valet gents as well as front desk staff were very kind and helpful. Hotel and rooms are very nice. Everything was clean - hotel itself, lobby, room... Our room was spacious and very comfortable with beautiful bathroom. It was on 31st floor so view was great, especially night one. Maybe one thing I was pretty shocked about - check out is 11am and at around 9am housekeeping knocked on our door and also rang the bell asking what time we will check out. It was so noisy I woke up wondering what's going on. But other than this, everything was great about our stay and I would definitely recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Spacious and Clean Room
allReviews.text: Rooms were clean, spacious and quiet.  If you stay at Palms Place, you'll need to walk to the tower building for the casino, food, transportation bus to the strip and registration.  Less than a 5 minute walk and all indoors.  They provide a bus to Caesars Palace every 30 min from 11 am to 8 pm.

allReviews.title: Disappointment
allReviews.text: First stay at Palms Place and they did not impress! Lobby staff is not paying any attention to you or your needs, just getting the job done. I've stayed at hotels in 35+ countries, thousands of nights altogether. This morning, checking out at Palms Place, was the first time ever when no one asked if everything had gone well - they must have known what the answer would have been. Room itself is nice and spacious but some of the lights were out, tv remote didn't work etc. These are sort of a usual things - but balcony glass is not... Highly advertised view of the strip doesn't really impress when balcony glasses are so dirty that you hardly see through. Damn, plywood might look better!Finally, renovation of Palms Casino and service areas is killing everything! Most of the restaurants are closed, the ones open are poorly staffed and even navigating through the construction sites can be a challenge. In a town with most astonishing alternatives, there's no reason for one to choose Palms Place.

allReviews.title: Upscale and modern hotel!
allReviews.text: Hotel was very clean and classy. Likewise for the rooms. We stayed on the 22nd floor and we can have a great view from there. Hotel is located off the strip so there's not too much traffic nearby. Free parking is provided and this is something which you can seldom find on the hotels on strip as most of the hotels there are charging people for self parking.Nonetheless, there's a travalator on the 2nd floor which leads you to the nearby palm's resort and casino if you are keen for some gambling! I mean, who doesn't gamble when in vegas?!  Bathroom came with showerhead and a bathtub/jacuzzi. it's especially good to know after a long walk on the strip and you can relax yourself in your own space's jacuzzi. there's even a mini lcd tv in the bathroom! I mean, this is the 1st time i had a mini tv in the bathroom! How class is that! You can relax in your bathtub while watching your tv programs!However, price might be on the higher end but i managed to snag a good deal by staying on a weekday. Will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Big Room & Great View
allReviews.text: Just stayed here for 11 nights. We had a big well appointed room with a great view of Vegas. Having a fridge and ice in the room is great for making up a few cocktails before you go out.  The room and hotel was spotless. The pools are great but  pricy for drinks and but there are restaurants, bars and diners to suit any pocket inside the palms and palms place.All good. Would stay again.

allReviews.title: ANOTHER FLAWLESS STAY, RELAXING BEYOND MEASURE...
allReviews.text: This property remains my absolute favorite in all of Las Vegas. The entire staff is phenomenal, and works tirelessly to provide the best in customer service. All the while, they remain perfectly attired and professionally presentable! It is truly refreshing to enter the property and see the smiling faces behind the front desk as they welcome guests from around the globe. Everyone here is exceptional, and truly versed in the finer details of the hospitality industry. They understand the intricacies and complexities of the business, and maneuver around obstacles and adversity like finely tuned experts! Annisse White, Brandon Evans, and the rest of the entire front desk deserve accolades and more! The Bellman, Valet (Brooke, Tom, etc) are exceedingly skilled, and are constantly working. The housekeeping department is phenomenal, and will attend to every request promptly and kindly. The Concierge (Christine) desk team is amazing, and always remembers me by name. The drift Spa team is superb, and I recently posted a kudo for them as well. I cannot say enough about this property. It is managed with excellence under the direction of Mr. Anthony Faranca. The standard is most assuredly five star, as I'd confirm a reservation here before I'd contact the Four Seasons or the Ritz any day! It remains a fact that the people employed under this roof make up one outstanding team, inimitable and unsurpassable. Such continuity in the hotel industry is rare, and is the foundation of any truly successful enterprise. I love your property, but truly return for the "people" working to ensure your future. Thanks to everyone, for one memorable adventure after another.

allReviews.title: Mini Vacay
allReviews.text: Palms Place was an amazing stay. The rooms are clean, quiet and updated. The pool was also very nice.. and pricing was a great deal on Hotwire. Justin at the front desk had exceptional customer service and he was able to offer a great view on floor 16. The only thing different that I would change was the fact that you can't access the balcony. I'm a sunrise lover but I still experienced an awesome view.

allReviews.title: Music Video shoot
allReviews.text: This was one of the best lodging investments I've ever made in my life! The view from this place is amazing! Literally incredible. I love everything about staying here. It was extremely dope!I would definitely stay there again!

allReviews.title: Great view, and nice staff
allReviews.text: We booked a room on the 51st floor according to the hotel, but its more lik thirtysomething floor because they just skipped the floors with number 4.The pool is well maintained, and nice, the staff is really nice and helpfull.

allReviews.title: great stay
allReviews.text: My boyfriend and I loved this resort. It is not on the strip and there is no casino in the hotel which means way less traffic and a more relaxing atmosphere. We loved it. The room was super clean and beautiful with one of the best hotel bathrooms I have ever seen. The pool is nice, the spa is amazing (they also have a tanning and fitness center in the spa area). We had no complaints except the balcony was not accessible (you have to book with someone who owns a room to have balcony access).The Casino at the Palms is connected through a sky bridge or you can just walk through the parking lot, the RIO is right across the street, the Orleans is right up the street, and the strip is only a 7 min drive from Palms Place....just a side note there is also a marijuana dispensary across the street for all my pot smoking friends.

allReviews.title: 2nd Home
allReviews.text: My husband and I first stayed at the Palms Place in 2012 for our anniversary which always falls during March Madness and St. Patrick's day. Our first stay was purely based on a deal but every other stay after has been great if not better. We've stayed twice in 6 months once for my birthday and to attend a Lakers preseason game in Oct of 2016 and again during March madness this year. The front desk staff is always accommodating, we arrived early both recent times and was able to check in. The views from the 52nd and 53rd floors facing the strip were amazing. We frequent the bar at the casino Tonic and Omar and the staff always takes great care of us while we play games and watch them also at the bar. We were able to have massages and refresh in the coed Hammam room at Drift Spa. We love to stay here because of the closeness to the strip and freeways and also because you can have fun but relax at the same time. We will be back very soon.

allReviews.title: Nice but could be cleaner
allReviews.text: Stayed 3 nights got a good deal on Vegas.com $330 for 3 nights (flight + hotel bundle). When I arrived I got randomly upgraded to a better room which was amazing. The interior of the room was really fancy and nicely decorated with modern furniture, a huge refrigerator, kitchen with stove top, and island/bar area. We had a big king size bed and the couch was a pull-out so there was plenty of room for me, my girlfriend and her daughter, and there was even a Jacuzzi tub facing the city in the living room area! My only negative comment of the room was that you could see smudges and fingerprints on the laminate/mirrored surface of the tables/walls. They should have windex'd it a bit more, it was a minor thing but for how fancy the Palms Place Hotel and Spa is I would have expected better. Also, there were some long hairs on the carpet, so another pass with the vacuum would have help. These are minor issues, but hindered to experience of staying at such a fancy hotel. The bar area was great, very friendly and attentive staff, I think there was only one pool table so we had to wait for the couple ahead of us to play a game. The location wasn't bad, we thought it was on the strip but found out when we got there that it was one block away which was fine.In order to save money the first night we walked to the strip and I think this a Las Vegas issue and not a hotel issue but as soon as we got to the side walk from the parking lot there were quite a few cockroaches roaming the sidewalks near the rocks and plants looking for food. It freaked my gf and her daughter out, that was their first time seeing a roach in real life lol Luckily we did not see any roaches in the hotel or in our room, but the girls were hyper vigilant after seeing them close to the sidewalk/parking lot area. Just minor things the hotel could do make the customer experience better: double check room cleanliness. Umm, that's it. That was my only complaint, which wasn't that big of a deal. The city of Las Vegas on the other hand, they have a pretty big roach problem but that cant be fixed unless everyone throws their trash in the appropriate containers or something. In conclusion, this was our first stay in Vegas as a couple and the hotel and staff were very helpful, accommodating and amazing. I would 100% stay here again, just hope the price is lowered lol

allReviews.title: Renewing our wedding vows
allReviews.text: We pulled up to the palms casino and informed we need to go to Palms place. Pulled up to valet parking. Informed the parking attendant we are dropping our luggage & my husband off to check-in but I will return. We arrive at 1130 and allowed to check-in. Our room is on floor 30 room 312. Phone did not work and balcony door does not open. I immediately went downstairs to address the issues and told they will fix the phone problem but the balcony door remains close per policy.  I saw the other people out in the balcony. I went outside to get my car from the parking attendant. He brought my car around he got out and immediately turned around to talk to another employee then walked away not closing my car door. Poor customer service. Throughout our stay the phone did not work and their was a message from the beginning of our stay. Place was quiet but the issue we had is it appeared like majority of people were smoking weed. The smell was extremely overwhelming at time from walking out the room, in the hallway, elevator and the second you are in the valet area. We got home all my stuff needing washing just seemed that smell was all over the place.

allReviews.title: Nice One-night Stay
allReviews.text: Very nice, off-the-strip property.  Like that there's a real parking lot so you can park right out front with no valet, parking garage hassles. Check-in was quick, room was very nice and comfortable--and quiet. 53rd floor had a nice view of the mountains to the west. Only one downer--no MSNBC on cable....

allReviews.title: Very nice place!
allReviews.text: I have been to Vegas a lot, but had never stayed at the Palms property. So I figured this time I would give it a shot. After looking at the Palms 3 diff hotels to stay at, the Palms Place looked the nicest! The only drawback is it's not right on the strip but it is a 5 min cab ride to Ceasers or Bellagio! Hotel was very clean, the rooms were great! Basically a full kitchen! The bathroom very fancy with a jetted tub! Thing is, in Vegas these days I'm noticing hotels not even having microwaves or refrigerators in their rooms! Not cool! You need at least one or the other!

allReviews.title: Not likely to stay here again - bad room experience
allReviews.text: I decided to stay at the Palms Place during July 4th for a few days. Palms Place is an apt. building/condos they rent.  Loooong walk from the Palms Casino Hotel area to Palms Place Rooms. The GO  airport shuttle wouldn't pick up or drop at Palms Place bldg front.   Upon arriving at my suite which was a corner room - overpowered by smell of pot. I also had maintenance issues such as: faucet in sink came off in my hand and jetted tub would turn on by itself at times. Would not stay here.After relaying my issues -- the Palms did refund my daily fee.. So kudos! for that to the Palms Management - was much appreciated.

allReviews.title: Better than Expected
allReviews.text: Stayed for the weekend and loved it. The suite had spectacular views of the strip. The suite was modern with all the newest amenities and appliances. I loved the free parking so I can come and go as I please without having to spend the extra on pay parking or valet. The location is also close to many great local restaurants for cheap dining.

allReviews.title: Best hotel EVER!
allReviews.text: We have stayed at a lot of luxury resorts but the suites at this place are the nicest hands down!  So much space, great views, luxury furnishings.  We won't stay anywhere else again in Vegas!  The only downside was it was quite a walk to the food and casino but room service was very affordable.

allReviews.title: State of the Art
allReviews.text: I absolutely love it here, the spa is state of the art.The workout facility is amazing with all the necessary equipment.We stayed on the 21st floor with amazing views.The pool is very nice offering shaded areas and cabanas for rent.I will stay here again!

allReviews.title: Value for money
allReviews.text: Great place to be. I will surely recommend. Well situated. Clean rooms and very spacious,bedroom, large bathroom and American cuisine, balcony viewing the strips. Casino, bar and lounge on the first level and staff members very friendly. If you are staying In Vegas check out ;"the palms "B&Jc

allReviews.title: Super clean
allReviews.text: Stayed one night at Palms Place just to get away.  The room was decked out with a super view of the city.   The walk to the Pals Casino was quick, easy and totally worth it!  On the way back, there is a people mover to help get you back to the room a little faster.  Back at the tower, you will be greeted by a a security guard who will check your room key to make sure you have a reason to access the Palms Place tower. In the room, all stainless steel appliances along with a electric stove top was a nice added touch.  The shower head was a overhead rainfall with great pressure.  The room also had a very clean jacuzzi tub.  The bed was top of the line with soft sheets and comfy oversized pillows.  We will be staying here next time for sure!

allReviews.title: Not a place to stay if your focus isn't casinos
allReviews.text: We stayed here with our son's basketball team during a Vegas tournament.  Not a good idea.  Both us and at least one room of players had great difficulty getting utensils and basic cookware in order to use the kitchenette (or just eat breakfast cereal).  Over the week we asked 3 times for a knife and a cutting board, and never received anything.  Both pools in the hotel are not open in the evenings (which is actually typical in Vegas, I think), BUT they were both closed one afternoon for simultaneous 'private functions'.  We were bummed out - families with small children were devastated.   Other weird stuff happened:  I had to take a small tote bag back to my room as 'backpacks were not allowed in the pool area'.   Meanwhile other people were walking in with big beach bags.  Just weird.  And you can't take any drinks into the pool area - not horrendous as you can ask for a class of tap water or spend quite a few dollars on a bottle of water.      The room rate was decent and room service was good.  But we wouldn't ever base ourselves here again for a similar trip or family vacation.

allReviews.title: Pretty good for the price.
allReviews.text: The room reasonably priced, as i stayed there on a weekday.  The room looks just like the images provided on the website. Modern-ish, spacious little studio. I requested a strip view on a high floor and that is what I received. Early check was no problem for this Amazing little place off the strip with an even better view. The only downside(s) was that the air conditioning did not get cold, so it was a little warm, even after I called downstairs to have someone come and check it out. Luckily the sun went down so it became a little more manageable at night. We did not have access to the patio, but I am assuming that is a liability thing. The shower head was a little crusty, so I was a little turned off by that.  I worked for years in customer service so I am a little picky, but the customer service could use a little improvement as a whole, not that it was bad, it just was something that would make me want to come back. The facility itself was nice and I will probably stay again and give them a second chance on the customer service and bathroom cleanliness piece.

allReviews.title: Worse than Bed Bugs
allReviews.text: This used to be my go-to Vegas hotel that I would recommend to all my LA friends. Well, that is no longer the case after my Aug 3 stay. I had a last-minute family emergency with my sweet nephew in ICU and was flying through Las Vegas to get back faster to see him before it was too late. I checked in at 1am and was out by 5:30am to head to airport. I explained the situation in near tears to the front desk person, Perla, who checked with her manager Elaine Gutierrez, about whether they could not charge the resort fee given the circumstances and the fact that we couldn't possibly have used any of the amenities during that time. Both employees cold as ice unapologetically said it was mandatory fee. Truth be told, the only reason I thought to ask was because my ex-boyfriend had had the resort fee waived a couple times for what I had always thought were pretty insignificant reasons. I knew it was actually very possible, which is what makes this situation all the more disgusting. I simply can't recommend a place that doesn't have compassion or human decency. This is not the place for me any longer. And it should not be for you either.

allReviews.title: Staycation
allReviews.text: The room was absolutely beautiful! The only drawback was that we didn't have access to the patio, but the view was stunning! The valet was free, and they were very nice. There is self parking as well, with casinos and restaurants within walking distance.

allReviews.title: Nice to visit although wouldn't want to live there
allReviews.text: This is right next-door to the Palms casino. We stayed thru Airbnb. Very easy to get to. Like the convenience of getting to your car and easy to check out and in. Parking is free and valet is free. Most of the workers and staff were pretty nice just a few who seemed like they didn't want to be there. There is a walkway inside to go to the Palms Casino. It takes you to a really good food court. About 10 minutes to walk through. Had a very nice pool area. You can also use the pool at the Palms Casino which is also very nice and not crowded since it was the weekdays. If you are using the pools you're not allowed to take any drinks or food to any pool area and that includes water! They check. Did not like that. Our room had a lovely view of the Rio and the strip in the distance. Rooms were very modern looking, stainless steel kitchenette.

allReviews.title: Horrible experience
allReviews.text: If I could give a 1/2 circle, I would. This has to be one of the worst hotels I've ever stayed in. The rooms are totally outdated, most of the showers are broken, and they are overall dirty. I couldn't wait to leave. Getting a suite in Vegas was impossible, everything sold out, so we took what we could get. We even got a room at the Bellagio just to use the pool and facilities because it's SOOOOO much nicer. Overall the Palms can only offer one thing....a lot of space for your money, and a washer and dryer, which I used daily. Other than that, it's a piece of crap.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: We had initially booked at the other Palms hotel and were graciously upgraded to the Palms Place with no extra charge. I've never stayed off the strip before, but I think this will be my new go to. The bed was insanely comfortable, nice big rooms, jacuzzi tubs and all staff we encountered were very hospitable. The pool on this side as well is a lot quieter, made for an older crowd. Although we did not spend much of any time in it, its still very nice. Only time I did not have the best experience was coming back late at night, they have security checking to make sure you are the hotel guest. That alone is fine, however the security staff were very very rude. Would recommend a stay here to anyone!

allReviews.title: Lovely
allReviews.text: I booked this place through Airbnb so my review might not exactly be true for the entire hotel. The room looked great, there was a tub in the bedroom and the view was great. I stayed on the 10th floor room 322. The issue I had was the cleaningness. The room looked like the cleaners rushed to get the place clean without doing a through job of cleaning it. The stove had vegetable oil dropping from its sides. The floors looked dusty. The ice compartment had dirt in it, the bath tub had dirt smudges. I wouldn't really have cared but I was pissed because I was charged a "cleaning fee" of over $100 bucks and when I asked what the cleaning fee was for it was basically to clean the room after checkout. Apart from the unclean aspects of the room everything else was great. The pool staff were really nice.

allReviews.title: I almost always stay at the Palms Place Hotel and Spa when in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I come to Las Vegas 8 or 9 times a year to teach a class that is near Palms Place.  I could also stay at the Gold Coast or the Rio and still be within walking distance of the training center.  The Gold Coast is too smoky and the Rio is a distance away.  But, I like the quiet atmosphere of the Palms Place, the restaurant and the lounge available.  Try it out!

allReviews.title: Horrible service, nasty staff and condition of rooms is unbelievable...in fact disgusting.
allReviews.text: Seats torn to shreds on chairs and staff refused to fix. Security is nasty, pushy and act like animals. Managers put you on hold and leave you there. This is the worst of Vegas at it's worst. Stay away....you were warned. SEE PHOTOS!

allReviews.title: Wow like staying home but being in vegas
allReviews.text: Great lace for a bit more homey quiet place off strip. Lots of parking.  Spa is ????the pool was off limits because it is on 3rd floor and too windy. We are in L.v what were they thinking. Of course it was windy as often the case. The pool next door at casino is available but you schlep there thru tunnel skywalk. Haha. Not sure gonna check it now. The buffet was crazy at casino. Sunday brunch 17.99 a lot of different type of food. Good for maybe 3 or 4 pm breakfast pricey for breakfast fixings. But food court coffee bean nathans mcdonald choices. So basically nice quiet no tumult but the pool is ???

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: It's located not far from the Strip, it's good rooms and has good location and you can have a shuttle service to the Bellagio. But unfortunately not geniune staff and the service is low. Have stayed her twice.

allReviews.title: Last minute
allReviews.text: Too bad I don't have the picture of the room but it's exactly how you see it online. We stood here 2 night because we had to help our friend at The Magic Convention. Even though we were off the strip it was still perfect and we weren't far away from the Convention Center. I highly recommend this place they'll take care of you

allReviews.title: Nice stay off the strip
allReviews.text: First time staying at Palms Place Suites. We had a studio suite which was very roomy for the two of us, nicely appointed, nice view. We were there on a Sunday and Monday night, so Sunday night was very quite in the casino, so we walked over to the Rio. Monday we took an inexpensive Uber to the Las Vegas north premium outlets, and later in the evenig an inexpensive Uber to the strip.The pool is very nice at Palms Place, a fun place to hang out, This is a great choice if you are looking for a more chill stay compared to a large, busy place on the strip. You still can enjoy all the action on the strip, but come back to your own suite without the crowds. I would imagine if you were plannnig a bachelor or bachelorette weekend, I would opt for the Aria, but if you wanted to balance the wekend with crowds and a few hours of r and r without the crazy massive crowds, the Palms Place is a nice choice. The kitchen allows for preparing meals if you choose to do that on vacation.

allReviews.title: Beautiful but falling apart
allReviews.text: Had a good trip with my bridesmaids in May. Arrived early in the day and got frustrated the valet entrance was not staffed with anyone directing traffic. When we pulled in they wrong lane they got upset at us. Yes I know there are signs at the top of the entrance but when the lanes are backed up and all cars and taxis are in every lane it's hard to follow signs without other direction.  Fortunately storing luggage was easy since we weren't checking immediately. Checking in late at night was thankfully quick. Used a third party to get the best rate available. We had two rooms right across from each other. Beautiful rooms and amenities including rain shower, floor to ceiling windows, fridge, stove, microwave and dishwasher. Down side not enough plug outlets by the bedside, no dishes to actually use, the beautiful shower was open to the whole bathroom and water would leak across the whole floor. The day we arrived my friend got locked in the bathroom. We got her out before maintenance arrived. The handle and lock came off both sides of the sliding door. When the engineer came I pointed out two other things that were broken in the room and they were not resolved during our stay.  The door handle/lock was not fixed until the second day of our stay and when it was, it was horribly fixed with thick glue and taped in place to allow the glue to dry. Looked like a child hot glued the handle back. One thing I did like was the doorbell and indicator lights for housekeeping service or privacy requested. A note about housekeeping: Who ever serviced the room prior to arrival did a poor job of making the bed. The flat sheet did not wrap the bed and the sheets were wrinkled underneath the down blanket and were not tucked properly. Very sloppy job. Lastly, we were picked up by a shuttle tour driver at the main entrance of the Palms casino around 9 am and part of the metal door bracket covering fell near us as we opened the door.  Engineering/maintenance department need to step up their game and preventative maintenance schedules.  Imagine what would have happened if that metal piece hit any of us.

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel, really! Room is large! Nice decoration, big fridge, microwave and much more! Quiet hotel (casino is in the next building). Wifi was good also. Big free parking lot. Strip few kilometres away. Easily 5/5!

allReviews.title: Goddaughters 21st Birthday Celebration
allReviews.text: We chose this hotel with the reviews of TripAdvisor and was not disappointed.The location is only a short distance to the strip,The hotel offers a shuttle bus service that runs from 11am till 8pm every half hour taxi to and from the strip only cost 10 dollars.We stayed on the 26th floor with amazing view of the strip the room was very modern decor large and clean with friendly staff.We visited the Ghost Bar one night with amazing views of the strip great for photos.We made great use of our hotel pool to chill out during the afternoons you are not allowed to take drinks from outside.Drink prices for a bottle of water 10 dollars.Thank you to all the friendly staff for making our stay amazing.D J  on reception desk for all your help.

allReviews.title: Unfriendly Stay!!!!!
allReviews.text: The staff was unfriendly, and unaccommodating. I made a few requests and the manager at Palms Place was unwilling to help me. This USED to be the place to be, but not anymore. I'll never stay here again, well maybe, if there's newer management. Palms and Palms Place management needs a revamping. Until then, I'll be staying on the strip where the LUXURY hotels are, and where guests are appreciated.

allReviews.title: Nice and comfortable
allReviews.text: The Palm is a Nice Hotel outside the strip. The rooms were big and the bathroom was really big. The got a room on the 30th floor and a had a amazing view. The palms have a to pools, noe big one and one which was smaller but a lot more quiet. They have a small bus that can take you to the stip which was Nice, but remember to go a few minutes before, because the bus is small.

allReviews.title: Has Been ...
allReviews.text: Nice room, large, stylish, good layout BUTRoom smelled like someone had consumed tons of marijuana and TVs did not function neither two of the room lamps. Hotel is not cheap and you should expect a clean smelling room and working appliances. Not here. BE CAREFUL!!

allReviews.title: Modern design, great views
allReviews.text: This hotel had an amazing modern entranceway and lobby. The security was good, they checked room keys at the lifts after 8pm. The room was a very generous size, again with modern decor. When we checked in we were asked if we wanted a higher or lower floor, and if we would prefer a desert or strip view - great that we got to choose. Some of the stools in the room were a little bit tatty but everything was very clean and comfortable. We didn't have time to explore the pool/outdoor lounge area. The location is a little bit away from the strip so it's quite a long walk - we had a car so were able to drive everywhere. It is also quite close to the chinatown area so we had a look around there too - lots of good places to eat! For breakfast there's a bagel place next door as well as a sandwich shop. Unfortunately there was no free wifi, this was probably the biggest down-side. I would certainly stay here again.

allReviews.title: Warehouse Manager
allReviews.text: Palms place and Spa A awesome hotel a pefect hotel if you looking for the extra very excellent staff but minus level to the supervisor for front desk he should look out for another jobhe was very unpleasant  and had very bad attitude. Me and my daughter has stay there 2 times but no more  stay there so long that supervisor works there  we are comming back to Vegas in October -17But proably not to Palm's this time.

allReviews.title: Love It!
allReviews.text: Definitely would recommend the palms to anyone. I loved the hotel and the staff is extremely friendly. Nice and quite also. Has free self and valet parking which is a plus and my room was clean and beautiful! I enjoyed my stay!

allReviews.title: Overall good experience
allReviews.text: We booked this room through Expedia in order to expand the number of Hotels we've stayed at in Las Vegas. This is the 19th so far and we're pretty impressed based on the price we paid for the room. We booked one of studio suites with a strip view. Check in was smooth and the front desk staff was professional, knowledgeable,  and courteous. The check in process was expedient and infomative. We were given a general once over of amenities and locations of restaurants and such. We got our keys and got to our room. The bell person, Ian, was a consummate professional. What a sharp guy. He gave us the run down of the room, layout of the Palms as well as Palms Place. He showed us where everything was in the room. The layout of the room is pretty neat. The bathroom has a rainfall shower, regular shower, jetted larger tub, partitioned dump area (without a door) and a TV. The kitchen has a regular fridge with ice maker, a wet bar fridge with ridiculously priced snacks and beverages ($5.71 for a diet coke). The layout of suite was nice with an L shaped sofa and king size bed. There are 2 TV's, oddly enough side by side and a foot and half from each other. Next to the couch an inaccessible balcony. Ian informed us that due to the nature of people often times dealing with incredible monetary losses and 20 something year old drunkards ejecting various items from the balconies,  they are now locked and off limits. The complete view of the strip was amazing and a great backdrop while sleeping. Being on the 51st floor we had a spectacular view. The couch, to be honest, was stiff and uncomfortable. The bed wasn't bad as far as comfort goes, I've slept on worse and better. The dining table bar stool type chars were absolutely uncomfortable and reminiscent of medieval torture devices. The bar running across the seat of the chair acted as a vice for my nether region. I'd recommemd not even sitting in them. The entertainment/movie rental system didn't work. That being said, still, I really like this place,  it has a good vibe. If you're not a cheapo who doesn't like paying for taxis or an uber in order to get to the strip or Fremomt, stay somewhere else if you're going to pinch pennies. The cleaning staff didn't seem to understand that the little red light indicating "do not disturb" literally means "do not disturb." Aftet a night of drinking and gambling we were woken up with repetitive knocks from the maid at nine in the morning,  three short hours after we retired from our night/morning of alcohol consumption and gambling. Had it not been for the maids insistance of getting us to acknowledge her, it would have been a PERFECT stay. There was a walkway that conveniently connected Palms Place to the Palms Casino, Restaurants,  and food court. The casino was fun but getting a drink was impossible so I bit the bullet and went to the food court. Overall it was a great stay with the exception of the maid. I'd say do it. The suites are pretty fun and give the feel of staying in a luxury condo.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Rooms with a View!
allReviews.text: We stayed in one of the larger suite rooms with full kitchen and living room. Room was really large and is nicer than most average hotels on the strip. The views were amazing as the windows surrounded two sides of the room and we faced the strip. Downside is it's not right on the strip so there is a bit less energy here. If you're looking for good views at a good price, this is the place to stay.

allReviews.title: Poor Customer Service
allReviews.text: I reached out to the hotel in March and again recently, regarding the below concern. Surprisingly, I've never received a response. I also shared my concern with a rep at the check-in desk during our stay, was told a manager would follow-up with me, and nothing came of it. We couldn't have enjoyed our stay more and the below situation was but a minor issue in an otherwise terrific weekend. But a failure to simply acknowledge our poor experience in any way...even just a simple "thank you for your feedback "...has made me never want to give the Palms My business again.- - - - - - - -Hello,I'm currently staying at Palms Place and wanted to share feedback regarding an event that took place today. One of the primary reasons I booked our stay at the Palms Place was to enjoy the pool. We had planned to spend this afternoon there but arrived and were told that it was closed for a private event. While that's certainly understandable, it would have been appreciated had the check-in staff informed us when we arrived so we could plan accordingly and go at a different time or visit another hotel's pool. Additionally, there was no hotel staff member there to intercept hotel guests. We had to pop into the spa to confirm what the situation was.A spa staff member told us we could we use the Palms pool by showing our guest card; however, when we arrived there, we were informed we also needed photo id. This required a trip back across the property to our rooms, which again would not have been frustrating had we known about the situation in advance and if I didn't currently have a foot injury.

allReviews.title: Coackroach!
allReviews.text: It was rated as a 4 1/2 star hotel. When we checked in -the room was a bit dusty and an old used tea cup was in the refrigerator. Most surprising when using the bathroom to get ready for bed a large cockroach climbing up the wall. We were only staying one night.  When we checked out I mentioned I felt the condition of our room was not up to standard- front desk said we should have called to be moved. We checked in late, and I expect a clean room- when there is one cockroach there are many more to follow. The dinner in the spa cafe was very nice for a quick bite.

allReviews.title: Weekend Getaway
allReviews.text: We made a reservation at this hotel on Expedia for a one night weekend getaway.When we arrived at check in and told the reservations person that this was our first time staying this hotel we were upgraded to a larger room on the 37th floor.  The room was awesome with floor to ceiling windows, full kitchen, jetted tub, gas fireplace and large bathroom. Great views of the Las Vegas valley The bed was comfortable. The was room was very quiet, very little hallway noise. The sliding doors to the balcony were locked, we were told that they could only be opened for the owner of the suite.  The room was very nice overall but could have been a cleaner (windows and carpeting). We would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Wish I could give 0 stars
allReviews.text: Here for work first off. I requested this side for a reason, it has a " working kitchen" . So I get here and I need ice, my " ice maker doesn't make Ice" so I called and the guy told me and I quote... " Ice maker works sir, it just takes time ! I said what? It takes time? How long? Been here 5 hours since I checked in all I got is one ice cube? He said yes, but I'll bring you ice! Today I get back from work mind you 24 hours later! No Ice still, called downstairs and Amy said " yeah these are mostly privately owned so there is no ice on the floors" i said so why would they own something if their amenities don't work? She couldn't answer, so I said how long would it take to fix it? She said I don't know, could be 30 min or longer. I said okay, I'll be at work from 8-5! She said no problem I will send an engineer to look at it!" Lol an engineer? It's an ice maker not structural damage to the hotel?! Fine I agreed! I asked for ice, took me 45 min to get, hence I had no problem getting it myself but no place for you to! I had dinner at cafe 6, some " big shot" who walked around claiming he lived here who is a producer or whatever for miss USA had no problem getting services from managers, bartenders and waitresses. Why do other people have such crappy services here specially when they charge you 36 dollars for resort fees yet you park your own car, the wifi sucks and their service sucks? The government needs to do something about these stupid resort fees when casinos already charge enough for rooms!

allReviews.title: Awesome place to stay just off the Las Vegas Strip!
allReviews.text: Palms Place is a condo/hotel tower next to and connected to The Palms Hotel and Casino.  If you are looking for a very nice place to stay and do not want to be in a casino atmosphere, Palms Place is a great choice.  We stayed in a studio suite which is 615 square feet which is much larger than a traditional hotel room.  If you need larger, they also have one-bedroom suites which are double the size.  The suite was nicely designed and equipped with a kitchenette, sitting area, a long desk and two flat screen TV's.  The bathroom is nice with a floor to ceiling glass shower door and a jacuzzi tub within the shower area.  Great for a romantic getaway!  We were only there overnight so did not take advantage of all the amenities,  There is a good restaurant, pool, fitness center and spa at the tower.  If you need more, take a quick walk to The Palms for more restaurants, gaming and nightlife.  We did enjoy the Ghost Bar at the top of The Palms.  It is a lounge with a nice bar, DJ playing music, dance floor and a great outdoor terrace with amazing view of the Strip.  There is no cover charge if you are staying at Palms Place.Looking forward to another staycation at Palms Place!  By the way, the rates are very reasonable!  I definitely recommend booking a stay there.

allReviews.title: Smokey rooms
allReviews.text: I was surprised there were not more reviews on this situation.  This hotel is rated about 3-4 star for the rooms.  Contemporary style, clean.  Couch and seating not comfortable, but it looks good I guess.  My room had two sliding doors.  You cannot open them they are locked.  You cannot get fresh air.  My first room really smelled smokey and sour.  Asked to be moved.  Although manager on duty was somewhat rude and not a customer-service type of guy, I got a new room.  At first it smelled clean.  Then by the next day the smoke smell was back.  So I believe it just runs through the HVAC.  The restaurants smell like smoke and it really is not healthy.  They are trying to hermetically seal this hotel, and the end result is unhealthy air quality.  Management will tell you this is a non smoking room.  However there are no signs, in the room indicating no smoking and smokers cannot get on the balcony.  So my guess, almost every room has had a smoker in it at one time and it is very hard to clean that out, especially if it was heavy smoke.Also I could not get the wifi to work.  Called front desk and they told me I needed to call Cox cable.  Really?  I have an iPad, just like everyone else.  So it wasn't my electronics.Casino and restaurants are dated.  Like stepping back into the 1980's.  The Italian restaurant however was very nice, and did not smell smokey.Valet, concierge and bell desk people very nice.  Front desk rude when I asked to be moved because of the air problem.  No one cares.

allReviews.title: Birthday trip
allReviews.text: I was referenced by a friend to stay here and it was so beautiful.  More than what I thought, I love everything about this hotel. Its very classy, lovely staff, outdoor pool with bar, and the casino were amazing. I'm definitely booking here again.

allReviews.title: Birthday trip!
allReviews.text: This place rox! There are three building on the property. The penthouse suites are on the west end, just so travelers will know. The penthouse was spacious, modern and clean. There is free valet and VIP parking for guests , several restaurants, ghost bar, pool and private cabanas. It's located across the bridge within walking distance of the strip. I'll always stay here while in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Always classy
allReviews.text: I have stayed here several times as we visit Vegas. And have never been disappointed with the fabulous rooms. Pleasant, clean and nice design. Comfortable beds and plenty of pillows. Even as we try other locations, we hold them to the level of the Palms.Not far from the strip, shuttle runs often (until 8 PM) to the Forum. And the palms has a iMax theater with attending food court.

allReviews.title: Large Suite, Worn Details
allReviews.text: The room was very large with a kitchenette, desk, and sitting area, as well as a balcony. It felt comfortable and clean, but some elements of the room felt very worn -- from the stripping on the shower door, to scratches on the desk, and fading on the chairs. I also found the check in / check out process a bit of a pain due to limited staff. I'd possibly stay hear again, but only if it was a great deal. Too many options in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Palms Place Views!
allReviews.text: Privately owned condos mean there are balconies which most if not all strip casinos do not have. For the particular unit we stayed at, access to the balcony provided breathtaking views of the Las Vegas strip/landscape. Free parking along with next door casino/restaurants were a huge plus!

allReviews.title: Not even there yet!!
allReviews.text: I booked and paid for this hotel back on January 14,2017 thru Hotels.com for a May 2017 arrival (what a mistake!).  Hotels.com,, when booking the venue states "Free Cancellation until May 1, 2017".  I cancelled this reservation on Feb. 10,2017 but was only refunded 50% of the money I paid (I booked 2 rooms for 7 nights).  When I called Hotels.com they told me that they do not charge for cancellations but cannot do anything about what the hotels policies are. I tried to get my total refund from the hotel but they refused to give me my full refund.  When I asked them to allow us to keep 3 nights (reinstate me so I'm not out $1,056.00) they told me no because the hotel was 100% booked for that week!  What poor customer service!!  If the hotel is completely booked then why not fully reimburse me, they are not losing any money???!!!!  Pretty sad!!  I will never book thru Hotel.com OR book a stay at Palms Place!

allReviews.title: Last minute upgrade to Palms Place for concert was worth it
allReviews.text: We originally booked a King Superior Room but decided at the last minute to upgrade to the Studio Suite at Palms Place.  The upgrade was worth it.  The room was much bigger and had a decent sized balcony that you could use.  Having a fridge separately from the mini bar was the primary reason for the upgrade, so we could walk to the gas station across the street and buy normal priced water, pop, alcohol, etc. and keep any leftover food from restaurants.  The room has a microwave, dishwasher, small mini fridge separate from the mini bar, and a small stovetop with 2 burners.  Note:  The rooms do not have any plates or silverware, but you can request them from the room service.  The room was a good size, it was nice to spread out and not be cramped.  The shower could have been bigger, but it does have a jacuzzi tub.  However the drain on the tub didn't work the best, and we had to figure out how to plug in the TV ourselves.  The Palms hotel and casino has 10+ restaurants including a food court with fast food.  It is a bit of a jaunt from Palms Place to the casino (~5 minutes), but there are two moving sidewalks.  It is close enough walking distance to the Rio casino (~0.6 miles) and the Gold Coast but you do have to cross a pretty busy and wide street.  There are sidewalks but it's not the most pedestrian-friendly.  It is easy to get an Uber from the downstairs of Palms Place to the strip - you don't have to walk to the casino - for ~$8-$12.  There is also a shuttle you can use from the casino to the strip which runs from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.  However, it is first come first serve and only seats 14 people.  We took the 11 a.m. shuttle on a Saturday and there was ~20 people in line.  When attending a concert at the Pearl, you have to go out into the casino to smoke.  They scan your ticket out and back in, which works out great when buying a poster or merch from the concert that you don't want to hold the whole time.  You cannot bring drinks from the casino into the venue.  Venue drinks are from $10-$20.     The line at check-in on a Friday afternoon was pretty long.  I know a lot of people have complained about the front desk service here.  Everything worked out fine with our reservation, but the people in front of us asked a lot about the amenities/restaurants at the hotel and the front desk gal was not very knowledgeable.  Overall we were really happy with our choice to stay at Palms Place.

allReviews.title: Do not stay here!!!
allReviews.text: Worst hote experience in my life. Bookes 2 rooms 4 months in advance and requested for them to be close to each other and to have a view if possible and when I arrived they were 32 floors apart and facing what I assume is some sort of an electrical unit.There was a constant noise inside the room which made it impossible to sleep at all. The hotel staff basically told me that if I don't like it I should buy another room and just did not care at all. I had used the cushions from the sofa and pillows from the bed to try and block out the noise, bus sadly with little difference... The room's were dirty, dusty with most light bulbs burned-out and kitchen units have had wires coming out of them.Never ever will consider staying here again!!!

allReviews.title: Dishonest, unhelpful, casually racist staff; filthy rooms.
allReviews.text: **Stay away**Better deals and values to be had in this city. Rigid and unhelpful staff who do nothing to rectify issues and seem incapable of thinking, perhaps a failure of management.
