Trying to report issues was in itself another waste of time, passing the buck over and over. Unsure if they even wrote anything down. Bathroom was filthy, took 36 hours for them to clean. The cheap wood floors creak and seem warped, FYI.

allReviews.title: Not a good start!!
allReviews.text: Just got here and already the worse experience I could imagine.   My company booked this place for me due to my extended 2 week stay.  Got here early so room wasn't ready. I found out that someone else owns the room I booked so I can't upgrade, ask questions or expect housekeeping during my stay.   Apparently we booked an Airbnb type reservation so this outside brokerage or leasing company is renting it to me.  Little did i know that all of the comforts that were advertised on Expedia may or may not be available to me during my stay.  Already know that my room won't be cleaned for the two weeks I'm in it, unbelievable!!All that being said there is still hope, right? No!!  I am still in the lobby waiting for my room to be ready and watching guest after guest walk up with complaints and walking away disappointed.  I watched the manager have a conversation with an upset guest and showed no care or interest in that guest.  It's a good thing that once the counter is clear all 5 of the hotel employees can sat there, laugh and told jokes while I still wait for my room.  At one point one of the girls behind the counter looked at me and laughed as though she was embarrassed.  I don't blame her.  I can't wait to see what's I store for me when I finally get my room.   I am not a fan.

allReviews.title: Horrible service. This place is a ripped off!
allReviews.text: Pro: Room is huge, and view is pretty (even though it's mountain view)Con: Room floor is dirty. Furniture was teared and old. Sheet was dirty after you pulled out from the side. (Did they changed the sheets at all!?) The construction workers across the street started working at 6am banging hammers and I can't sleep at all! Front desk service is the worse! They did not even tell you you'll be charged for resort fee when you check in, and they charged you anyway, and didn't even tell you what the resort fee includes! Make some phone calls which didn't even patch through, and got charged for $7.75 per minute! (5 less than a minute call for almost $40!!!) And you didn't even know you'll be charged for it because nobody tells you that or not even a warning message when you make the call! We complain to front desk about the charge, and the guy at front desk mock us and said "everything in Vegas is expensive!" We asked to talk to manager, he just went into some mysterious room behind the counter for about 5 minutes, then came out and said the manager is not here (how big is the room that'll take 5 minutes to see the manager is not there!?) He then gave us the manager's business card and said we can call, but the phone never get pick up, and mailbox is full (that tells you how terrible this hotel is that the compliant message flood the mail box!) I will avoid this place and will never stay at this place ever!

allReviews.title: Fabulous place off the strip with free  shuttle bus and uber only costing about $6.
allReviews.text: This is by far the best alternative if you want to go amd  visit the  crazy but don't want to be immersed  in it every  day. You have access to all the Palms casino stuff but palms place has its own pool and cafe bar which are lovely and quiet . The option to fix yourself a snack and use the gym means you don't have to do all you can eat buffets and be unhealthy if you don't want to. In can be tough to eat well in vegas unless you are spending a fortune but Walmart is a $10 uber away so you can shop healthily if you wish. The apartment itself really is great  spacious light modern . Great balcony if you book through air Bnb rather than direct with palms. It was our 4th time in Vegas.  2 x Mgm, 1x golden nugget but we would definitely use Palms rather than a strip hotel for any future visits. Enjoy the serenity whilst visiting the crazy.

allReviews.title: Upscale hotel at low price!
allReviews.text: The good about this hotel is big rooms, great views, comfortable beds, very trendy furniture, full kitchen, we had washer/dryer in our room.  Lots of food options-hooters, McDonald's, 10.99 buffet late at night.  Has IMAX theater and regular movie screens. They have 1 table for 5 dollar blackjack as well as many other tables and slots.  Biggest negative is you have to walk long distance in their sky tube to get to palms hotel from palms place.  They do have those flat escalators that move you though.  Gift shop was not that great.  Overall excellent experience, even though you are not on strip, they have free shuttle to caesars or use Uber.

allReviews.title: I'll NEVER stay here again!!!
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: Dont go there!
allReviews.text: Me and my girlfriend visited palms place 2 weeks ago and parked the car at the palms place parking (with palms place security and cameras), when we came back in the morning to the car the window was broken and many of our stuff from the back seat was taken, according to the security of the hotel there should be a patrol there and security camers of the hotel, apperently nobody saw anything during the night, as this is the official parking of the hotel.not only that we have been told that the risk manager of the hotel gonna contact us in few days to tell us what is going on with the case but nobody from palms place hotel ever contacted us about the case, and the phone number that they provided for us to check status is not working and nobody anwsers.will never back there again, if you come to the hotel i recommend not to park at the hotels parking place since nobody will care about your car.

allReviews.title: Ghetto
allReviews.text: Appearances can be deceiving.      When I arrived, I thought the place turned into "Section 8 Housing".  All sorts of characters hanging out in valet and lobby.   I felt very uncomfortable for my friends to stay at this property.  The hallway smelled of marijuana and cigarettes.    Maybe it was because of spring break?   My friends weren't comfortable about the atmosphere that this property seems to cater too.   The room was dingy, and the furniture badly worn.

allReviews.title: Spring Break Road Trip
allReviews.text: The Wifi I paid for was not roadrunner speed and if you want fast internet you have to pay 20 more dollars. I was so disappointed for their spa and pool hours. It should be open at least till 12 a.m. The room quality was excellent! It had tons of closet space for your luggage and the kitchen cabinets great for any late night snacks storage. The bed was very comfortable! The jetted tub was great and is ideal to use after walking on the strip. The hotel also provides free self-parking and free transportation to the strip. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to have a calm and relaxing stay in Vegas.I look forward staying at this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Great price no resort fee
allReviews.text: Great views of the strip, save your money from daily resort fees and use it for uber, buffets, or visit other hotel pools. Beautiful room with balcony, rainshower overhead faucet in shower & Jacuzzi. Great AC, in room kitchen, lounge couch. Search for deals on Air B & B

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel. Recommend but i just don't like how it's a little far from the strip. Loved how our room had a jacuzzi in the bathroom . Really bringing out the spa in the room. Great get away . But just the distance from everything

allReviews.title: Amazing as always!!!
allReviews.text: We are frequent visitors to Palms Place, especially for special occasions have stayed in the penthouse with the jacuzzi outside that was magical for us and the 1 bedroom suite which has the tub overlooking the strip was awesome as well. Its always a lovely getaway for my wife and I the front desk is always so courteous and hospitable, the house keeps are very nice and polite overall its always a great experience for us when we stay at Palms Place, which is why we stay so often, its my wife birthday coming up and we are def looking to stay here again!!!

allReviews.title: Clean rooms
allReviews.text: We were given a studio suite at the 21st floor with a King bed and a queen sofa bed. Room was huge and clean. There is also a jacuzzi/tub which we indulged in. Would definitely come back again and highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Visit to the Spa in Palms place, so relaxing
allReviews.text: We only visited the hotel to use the spa. There was free tea, coffee, water and soft drinks. The Plunge pool is cold and you are provided with frozen cold hand towels. The Haman was steamy but not hot. Great value for money using a voucher from travel zoo. Very friendly staff. You can use the hotel pool just next to the spa which is lovely. Cafe 6 is also right opposite the spa. Went on a Sunday and was very quiet.

allReviews.title: Excellent Room!
allReviews.text: We were surprised when we walked into our room on the 17th floor of Palms Place! The room was huge and updated and we had a great strip view,  The employee at the check-in desk was extremely nice and the process was fast.  The room was quiet so we didn't hear the usual hallway noise of people coming and going at all hours of the night.  We were going to a concert at the Pearl Theater so the location was perfect.  There is a inside walkway to the Palms Casino next door.  Great room for a great price!

allReviews.title: Room was nice, Casino was dead
allReviews.text: Room was beautiful, fireplace did not work and the ice maker was not turned on prior to our arrival. This casino has changed a great deal, it is dead now. Came back from the strip at 1am and there was nobody gambling. There were two food options open at 1am, McDonalds and Cronic Tacos, Cronic tocos was delicious. We also went to the ghost bar on a Friday and there were maybe 30 people in there. The music was good if you like 90's early 2000's hip hop.

allReviews.title: Wedding party
allReviews.text: We were in town for a wedding during Valentine's week. We arrived to the hotel around noon on a Monday and were able to check in right away. We flew in with the bride and groom and the hotel allowed us to be on the same floor as them. We also received a city view, which was very nice. The front desk was very accommodating and friendly. As for the room, we were pleasantly surprised how large it was. The bathroom was very spacious as was the bedroom area. It was nice to have a refrigerator in the room for snacks and drinks. Our room was pretty clean and the best part was our balcony was unlocked so we could enjoy the city view from there. Many of the other guest in the wedding party didn't get that luxury. The beds were very comfortable and the water pressure in the shower was amazing! Also, we were right next to the elevator which I was concerned about noise volume from outside the door, however, we heard nothing at all. There were only a few negative points. There wasn't a door on for the toilet portion of the bathroom but it wasn't the worst thing that there could be in a hotel room just more inconvenient than anything. And the room could have could use a deep cleaning. It was more of a surface clean than a deep scrub but it wasn't disgusting by any means. All in all, the Palms place was a good place to stay. I was slightly worried with the other reviews but we lucked out.

allReviews.title: Best Stay Ever
allReviews.text: This is such a great hotel, I'd really recommend it. The rooms are very big and you can get a beautiful view of Vegas at night if you live on one of the higher floors. The service is incredibly fast, the hotel is quiet and clean, and it's definitely one of the best hotels I've ever been to.

allReviews.title: One night but beautiful stay
allReviews.text: Great huge rooms ( looks more like one bedroom) with full kitchen, amazing view from the balcony. We stayed on 20th floor. Loved the huge bathroom too. Would definitely stay there again. Only down side when we came for check in there was only one receptionist, and it was quite busy, so you had to be on a big line to be assisted which I found strange at the prime evening time. Anyway hotel is nice and not so far away from the strip.

allReviews.title: New Years @ The Palms Place
allReviews.text: Starting from check in, the room was not ready but we got there around 11am so we knew and understood the rooms were not going to be available being that check in was at 3p. So we waited in the Lobby.  Frank who was checking us in, told me that he will send a text as soon as a room became available.  He never did.  I finally went to the counter and what a surprise a room was available.  He gave me my room key and didn't explain anything to me about the hotel.  He wasn't as nice as the other lady at the counter who I heard gave the customers who were checking in a more thorough run down of their hotel information (like how to get to the rooms, wifi, etc.) She asked if they had any questions.  Frank wasn't the friendliest and just gave me my room key and asked for the next guest.  Other than my initial experience, my room was nice.  Easy access to the Palms clubs and the shuttle is great to go to the strip.  Drops you off at Ceasars Palace.  There is also a food court in-between the palms place and the palms.  I like this hotel would definitely stay here again.  Just need to work on friendlier staff or maybe he was just one bad apple.

allReviews.title: Super suite
allReviews.text: Second time at Palms place we chose to get the  ungrade for a suite. Jacuzzi in the room, large living room 4 seats side kitchenette table, large fridge, oven, dishwasher, washer/dryer. One large bathroom and a second small one. Lots of spaces for your clothes. What a view of the strip from the 52th floor.....The hotel is of the strip but very closes by car or bus.In the Palm casino you can find anyting from food to théâtre. Good service, smile and your in good hand.

allReviews.title: Nice trip with my daughter and visit with Family in Town
allReviews.text: The hotel is far off of the strip, but provides shuttle service from morning until about 8pm to Caesar's Forum. Valet Parking is free and they were easy and fast (tips only). The rate was good, room spacious and clean and the check in desk accommodated my request for a lower floor room. We were in the Ivory Tower. Downside of this is that the smoke smell others noted from the Casino does seem to make it to the room. Also, the area outside of our room smelled heavily of weed for the last couple of days of our stay. My understanding is that weed is legal, but smoking in hotels is not. Gross, Stinky weed, next time pay more.  We used the Spa facilities (part of a Travelzoo deal) for a full day and really enjoyed them. Also the onsite Salon is really nice. The Spa is quite a distance from the Ivory tower, but it was our workout for the day. Breakfast was included in the room rate at the buffet and it was pretty standard LV stuff. All of the service personal we encountered were terrific. Couple of negs: Shower was backing up, had to call maint at 1030pm. They did come though. No towels or service of the room on a couple of days. Overall good value and nice people.

allReviews.title: Worst Customer Service
allReviews.text: I had an absolutely terrible experience during our recent stay with the front desk.  The gentleman I dealt with had no interest in helping us resolve our situation.  We requested a new mattress for the pull out bed after discovering how incredibly filthy it was in addition to being completely saggy.  It's a pull out bed, so we knew it wasn't going to be perfect.  When housekeeping tried to come and fluff the mattress, they discovered the absolute filthy condition of the mattress and called for a new one immediately.  The front desk did nothing to help us.  Thanks to housekeeping, particularly, John, the problem was fixed.  The rest of the unit was was just as unkept.  I would never recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: I guess we paid for what we get!
allReviews.text: This hotel is about 2 miles from Bellagio, which is not that far. It offers great view and reasonable pricing. I booked three rooms for a one night stay. However, 2 of 3 rooms has drainage problems. RM10115 and 10117. The sink in these two room takes hours to drain after wash hands. There were hair in the shower, some black spots in the shower caulking and the handle on the bathroom doors are rusted.

allReviews.title: Do Your Research
allReviews.text: I've read some terrible one or two star reviews (I focus on reading them as they are much more critical and specific about potential issues you may experience) about Palms Place and it has become obvious that if you do your research ahead of time, you can limit most of the likelihood of having a negative experience. Pay attention to "who" owns and manages the suite you plan on booking because there is a mixture of privately held properties along side of the Palms Place rooms. You can see examples in the Trip Advisor reviews of people who got stuck with suites that hadn't been renovated or refreshed in years vs. those who got to experience the wonderful luxury of a newly appointed property. I booked my suite through Air BnB for an excellent 50th floor newly renovated privately owned property with a remarkable view of the Strip. In addition, I was also able to access my balcony through the working sliding glass door whereas the rooms operated by Palms Place have balconies with locked doors due to liability issues. My decision to make a reservation was based on the numerous and unanimous five star ratings in the Air BnB feedback section for this suite and the great reviews were well-deserved. Also, since it was privately owned, we didn't have to pay a ridiculous resort fee. Do your homework and you won't be disappointed.

allReviews.title: Used AirBnB, AWESOME!
allReviews.text: Got a corner suite for 2 nights during our stay in Vegas for the Shot Show. Was pleasantly surprised with everything about this place: the parking area, check in, and the room itself. Although it was managed by an owner it was nice and we were happy with our choice. We had another couple stay with us and it was nice having 2 bathrooms, a HUGE master bathroom and a great view. Would certainly stay here again.

allReviews.title: Outstnanding stay
allReviews.text: We went to the Rick Astley concert.  First, the Pearl Theater was very nice, and we had awesome seats.  Not a bad seat in the house, what a wonderful place to watch a concert.  Second, the Palms Place Suite was just outstanding.  We had a wonderful suite room with a window looking out onto the Strip of Las Vegas.  The shower and bath facility was spacious, and dual shower heads.  The staff was extremely friendly in checking us in.  The room was immaculate.  The elevators were fast.  The buffet was affordable and also well stocked.  I would gladly stay at this hotel again, it was affordable and had everything we needed.  You do have to pay for wi-fi access, unfortunately.

allReviews.title: Clean and comfortable
allReviews.text: The hotel lobby, rooms, and casino area were all very clean and enjoyable. The room was bigger than any two people needed but it was comfortable and relaxing. This is the first hotel room I've wanted to stay in. The shower and jacuzzi combo was luxurious and made for an enjoyable stay!

allReviews.title: BEST STAY EVER!
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Palms Place Hotel and SPA from January 10th through 14th. I was there to celebrate my 50th birthday. Truly, I have never been in a better hotel complex EVER in Vegas. I've literally been going to Vegas since I was 10 years old. So, I've stayed everywhere.  Both concierge ladies: Christine Smith and Paige Davis were STELLAR.  Frank, the gentleman that checked me in and put me on the 50th floor was SUPERB! And, Ricky and Derrick in the SPA were EXCELLENT!  I found a new home for my Vegas stays.  I'll be returning in late February!

allReviews.title: The best!
allReviews.text: Our stay usually costs $39 a night. We always stay in the same suite of available. The valets are amazing and when we tipped. $20 our car was alway out front! Now when we visit the actually remember us we appreciate that. We will always stay here for the hospitality, value, and we can see the strip from our room. The food is great and the casino doesn't disappoint. We simply love The Palms Place...not to be confused with the original Palms Hotel nextdoor!

allReviews.title: Just fabulous
allReviews.text: It may be off the strip but I was impressed with the apartment and high specification  of it, having just been in New York where the rooms are tiny I was happy to have some space. The bathroom was nothing short of fabulous with a large jacuzzi  bath that could easily fit two, to the marble throughout, beautiful. In total there were 3 tvs, a fully stocked kitchen with self filling ice machine, I need one of these and a balcony with great views.The pool area was open even though the  weather wasn't  great this had another hot jacuzzi & would be a great summer hang out with cabanas to  hire.To get to the apartments there is a walk through the casino & so called Sky ride which is a flat moving walk way followed by a lift but after all the over indulgence we needed the exercise. The only down side is how far it is from the strip but the hotel runs a shuttle service from 11am til 8pm this takes you to the Forum shopping centre at Caesars Palce, I personally think it should run later but taxis are available all the time.A tip for the 1st shuttle is to arrive early as when it's full you will need to wait until the next one 30 minutes later.

allReviews.title: Concierge
allReviews.text: Prior to our arrival in Las Vegas, Christine- one of the Palms Place concierge- who helped with many of the details of the trip was total rockstar!! The customer service she provided  was over the top. Her attention to details and follow up was much appreciated and rarely realized in the travel business I believe. She  played a huge role in making this trip a home run for both myself and my wife. No question- the reason I would stay at Palms Place in the future.

allReviews.title: Perfect
allReviews.text: Fabulous rooms, stayed in a studio suite which was big and roomy with the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in! Was staying over new year so didn't want to stay on the strip, but it's easy to walk/get bus or the free shuttle bus to the strip. the peace of palms place was far enough away from the crowds and parties at the palms but only a 2 minute stagger home. Staff are lovely and very helpful too. Absolutely perfect. Will be booking again.

allReviews.title: Great views of The Strip, laid back
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Palms Place and had an amazing stay. Unlike the Strip casinos, it was never overrun with people and it was a very chill place to hang out when we were looking for a less crowded option. Of course we did all the normal Las Vegas attractions, but this was our 6th trip to Vegas in 8 years and it was time to be off strip! The pools are great and the casino is very clean. The rooms are phenomenal and the view of the strip was nothing short of amazing from our room. The furnishings are perfect and very up to date. The bathroom was huge and the shower was bigger than the one in my house! Our room had lots of closet and drawer space, a kitchenette,  king size bed and a huge couch. There were no chairs on the balcony but we just pulled the chairs out there at night and watched the Strip and drank beer! Very relaxing! The Palms has a shuttle to the Strip every day and while it always sucks to have to adjust your schedule to get picked up, it was worth it to be able to walk around, have a few drinks, gamble, and then have a free ride back to your hotel! Overall a great place to stay!

allReviews.title: Mixed bag
allReviews.text: Stayed at Palms Place during a recent work meeting. Overall thoughts:1. Room was extremely comfortable for sleeping, bathing and relaxing. It lacked proper wifi capabilities to support business a/v equipment. There is no real "workstation" or desk for getting work done and the lighting is not supportive. Bathroom was very comfortable but I think women would have difficulty getting ready as lighting wasn't great.2. Casino amenities are average. Alize was hit and miss with the items I tried.  Service was excellent.  Hooters was an absolute joke. I tried to get a simple chicken sandwich on a quick break from meetings. Sat at the bar for 20 minutes before being greeted. At that point, it was too late. Requested pickup on 3 items for dry cleaning, didn't get them back in time to actually wear to events they were needed for. Still was charged 34.50.3. I enjoy that they offer low limit tables. I'm not much of a gambler and it allowed me to try different games without feeling I was tossing money away.  4. The average guest here was older than other places I visited on my trip. Both pros and cons to that personally.5. Do not walk to/from the strip to the Palms. It's a 30 minute walk through areas that I wouldn't feel comfortable walking alone (and I'm a pretty big guy)Overall, I would stay here again gladly but with tempered expectations. I think this is easily a 4* establishment if I hadn't had some of the simple issues I expereinced.

allReviews.title: Family Friendly
allReviews.text: My family and I stayed on the 36th floor for 2 nights here. We had a corner suite with double balcony views. The main bathroom is luxurious. It was covered in marble with 3 head showers, double vanity and a separate room for the toilet, it was amazing! However the TV in the bathroom didn't work. Another issue was one of the down lights had fallen through and my partner had to push the bulb back in.The kitchen was fantastic, the lounge room had full views of Las Vegas that covered the north and south side. Our children ages 5 & 6 felt very comfortable in this room.The staff were very friendly and there was easy access to the casino. We would definitely come back here again.

allReviews.title: Greatly Satisfied!
allReviews.text: Arriving to Las Vegas was a birthday surprise, as well as a 2 night stay at the Palms Place Hotel! We were upgraded to the 19th floor and our King Studio Suite had an incredible view of the Las Vegas Strip! The room and bed was comfortable, and the jets in the large bathtub, and waterfall shower were icing on the cake!My partner and I wanted to go see several shows while we were in town. We had already seen two, with Zumanity being one of them. We really wanted to see 'Love' but the theater is dark on Tuesday's and Wednesday's.  We wanted to see another popular Cirque du Soleil show but needed assistance on which one, sp we decided to consult with the concierge team on the first floor of the hotel. Paige and Christine greeted us both (separately), and were incredibly helpful. They were very knowledgeable about the shows being offered, the availability, and assisted us with the reservations, and getting us 4th row seats to see Cirque du Soleil's  'La Reve' performed in the round with an aqua stage! My partner and I both have backgrounds of working within the hotel and hospitality industry, and it was clear that their conversations and demeanor with us came from the heart. We felt that they genuinely wanted us to experience Las Vegas as much as possible, and to make our trip memorable. We just wanted to reach out to these two women to let them know that they are doing an incredible job! and that we both left extremely satisfied with the services they provided for us! The show was INCREDIBLE! Thanks again!Troy and Ewen

allReviews.title: Great rooms let down by service
allReviews.text: The Palms Place is a great place to stay. I like that you enter via a separate entrance and so can avoid the Casino giving you a little sanctuary from the craziness. My suite was really nicely decorated with a large separate lounge/kitchen area including large fridge, oven and washer/dryer. The bathroom is large with an overlay elaborate 3 head shower system. My minor issues with the suite are as follows:-1) Having a full kitchen is great but without even a small selection of plates and utensils completely useless. 2) The lounge area is very dark with only dim table lamps making it hard to work in. 3) The chairs at the bench were very poor condition and heavily worn making them very uncomfortable. It's the service that lets the place down. I reported two issues (a broken handle and lamp) and while acknowledged neither was resolved during my week long stay. The concierge service is not well staffed and just to store some cases was a bit of a wait. Having said that I would definitely stay here  again. The location makes it easy to get taxis to different parts of the strip without hitting the traffic you get if you stay on the strip itself.

allReviews.title: Beautiful room
allReviews.text: We visited in between Christmas and New Year's.  The lobby is a little dark and it was a cold walk from the parking lot to the front door, but the room was amazing. Got a suite with one and a half bathrooms, a kitchen and a fireplace. It was a wonderful stay and the staff was helpful and friendly. This is a condo tower with units for sale but it didn't change our stay. It did feel more like an apartment than a hotel but that's a good thing.

allReviews.title: Needs to update the WiFi policy
allReviews.text: The room was pretty clean and decent.  I am not sure if its because the room didn't get used more frequently.  The bath room was a bit musky.  I love the fact, you are less then 5 minute from the car to your room.  Their WiFi policy needs to be updated to 2017 standards.  You can't be charging me $30 for resort fees and limit my WiFi usage to 1 device.  FYI Palms, no one plugs a cable into the laptop to get WiFI anymore!  Ironically, in January I did end up needing the heater.  The heater never worked right, it was hot or cold.  I called the maintenance to come down.  He changed the air filter and got it going for a bit.  But, the thing never really worked properly.

allReviews.title: "You should be honored to have the privilege of staying in our hotel."
allReviews.text: This is my third stay at the Palms in general (first at Place) and I wanted so much for this to be better than the last two stays. I went into it with hope. In the end, I was left extremely disappointed. First, upon arrival, the room I was given literally smelled like a bathroom, as if someone didn't properly clean the room. The second room was fine initially, and then I unpacked and found some serious issues. The knobs on the sink fell off. The knobs in the shower fell off. Not with force, just light use. Then, the sink - had a twisted knob that only emitted hot water. The dishwasher was also malfunctioning. I contacted executives at the hotel over email who did not fix the problem until about 27 hours after my first email. This, like many Vegas hotels, do not emit any true service, it's more about making the customer feel they should be the ones honored to be in their presence, in their hotel. I truly will never stay at the Palms again. Absolutely not.

allReviews.title: Wedding Trip
allReviews.text: I have lost the energy to write a detailed review as when i think about it, it upsets me.I would warn everyone off this hotel, especially if you are a regular 4/5* hotelguest as this hotels staff and customer services are far from 4* they lack any compassion, warmth or people skills.The rooms are nice IF you get the room you pay for if they haven't double booked you and then tried to put you in a worse room! Other than that there is nothing good that comes from staying here. Ruined our wedding trip by dampening our arrival and ghostbar killed the wedding day vibes.I have been to holiday inns better than this.Never again.I saw bad reviews before we arrived but hoped the good ones would out weigh it, hoping they would learn from them but they haven'tWhat you read in the other bad reviews is true.Don't risk it, spend the extra and go elsewhere

allReviews.title: Palms Place for New Years
allReviews.text: We had a trip planned for the New Years weekend in Vegas.  We thought that we would be staying 3 nights at Palms Place. We were excited as the rooms looked very nice! The day before we arrived to check in, we made a phone call to Palms Place to confirm our reservations. Were told that due to the method that we had booked (though a travel club) that our reservation had been moved to Westgate. The person on the phone said that Palms Place was overbooked (which I don't really believe). Anyhow... the reason for this review is Perla. When we arrived at the front desk to check in, she admitted, that yes, there was an issue with our reservation. We said that we really didn't want to stay at the Westgate, we had stayed there before and it was AWEFUL. She worked away on the computer for a few minutes, went into a back room and came back and said that we wouldn't have to go there. We would be able to stay at the Palms Casino for one night, and  then to Palms Place for 2 nights. We weren't thrilled about having to change rooms, but in our opinion it was better than the Westgate. Perla told us that for our inconvenience she would take care of us. We were given a 35th floor strip view room at the Palms Casino for the first night. We could see off toward Mandalay Bay and the Luxor. We were thrilled! Now here is  where she really took care of us. When we switched room, we were put on the 30th floor. We walked into the room (which was awesome itself) and our jaw dropped at the view. Perla was able to get us into a room with the best view in Vegas....mind you... for New Years Eve. We could see from the Stratosphere all the way to Mandalay Bay. We were able to sit in front our our floor to ceiling windows with a glass of wine and watch the firework on the strip. A few bumps in the road, but thanks to Perla, we were able to make the most of it and have a great time in Vegas! Thanks!

allReviews.title: The Palms in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Palms is off-strip on Flamingo Road, just down the street from the Rio Hotel & Casino.   The view from the roof-top bar is awesome.  The accommodations are very modern and roomy, we had a corner room and was very happy with it.   The Pool area is very modern and somewhat pricey if you want a cabana or pool couch, which looked very comfortable.  The service they provide is generally "bottle service", so the cost to obtain a cabana or pool couch includes the bottle service, which we did not take advantage because there was only the two of us.  We did see quite a "party groups" taking advantage of the service, which makes more sense on an economic scale.  The Casino was good, all the basic games and tables.  Restaurants were also good.

allReviews.title: グランドサークルツアーの前泊に
allReviews.text: タイトル通り、前泊に使いました。なのでカジノなども必要なし。ストリップから離れているため安く宿泊することができました。この値段でこの価格？？というくらいに綺麗で広い室内。キングサイズベッドにキッチン、大きな冷蔵庫、バスタブはジェットバス付き！しかしWi-Fiは別料金だったので繋ぎませんでした。ストリップからはUberを利用し10分程。ツアーもベラージオでピックアップだったので程よく近くてよかったです。静かで夜景が綺麗な部屋だったので、次回はのんびり過ごしたいです。Great hotel!Bit far from strip butreasonable and clean and gorgeous.I liked it.

allReviews.title: It was worth the upgrade
allReviews.text: My friend and I were in vegas for New years and I had booked the a room in the palms casino.  When we arrived we were offered an upgrade for 100 a night, we decided to do it.  The room in the palms place is the most amazing room I've stayed in. We were on the 22nd floor had 180 degree view of the mountains and the city. Large sliding glass doors and floor to ceiling windows,  the room was 1200 square feet with two bathrooms a double sided fireplace and stainless steel appliances.  Truly amazing.  Since we were off the strip we utilized uber for the 10 min ride to the strip. Uber was very fast, and had specific locations where they are allowed to pick up. We celebrated new years eve at Moon night club which was very convenient party location.... no driving involved. I'd recommend staying here at least once!

allReviews.title: Good value
allReviews.text: Stayed in lots of hotels on the strip.  And often stay in large multi room suites.The palms place suites are great value for money. I was a little concerned about the location using uber was great for getting around between the hotels back on the stripThere are a few minor shortcomings.The lighting in the rooms is all separate lamps and even with them all on it is dark.Great for a romantic evening awful for working.The service from the staff isn't upto Aria or Wynn ect.I would return as the suites are good value for money

allReviews.title: Excellent Time
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel so much! Great room, great bed, wifi internet, room service was amazing. Our room was provided with a full kitchen, big bathroom, king size bed and a sitting area. Although only downfall is the hotel is not right on the strip, however, the hotel has a free shuttle that takes you to Caesars Palace, or ubers are readily available. Staff was very friendly, and did excellent job at cleaning the room daily. The pool was a great place to relax and drink, I found not as crowded as compared to hotel pools on the strip. Overall, I would definitely stay at this hotel again!

allReviews.title: Roof Top Bar
allReviews.text: It's a must, the roof top bar simply has the best views of Vegas....great cocktails too :) We always make a point of going here at least once regardless of where we are staying in VegasAs is common in the USA make sure you have ID, I'm a 46 year old Brit, not used to getting asked my age in a pub and still got ID'd, very complimentary, but a tad annoying if you leave your ID at your Hotel

allReviews.title: Good off strip hotel
allReviews.text: I have nothing bad to say about this hotel.  The price is great, the rooms are large.  We heard that new management was taking over the hotel at the time we were there but there was no evidence of it.  I was there for business and it worked out great for me and minus the hassle of being on the strip.

allReviews.title: Worst service in Vegas
allReviews.text: Before booking we didn't know that this place has rooms which are owned by someone else and are rented out. This should not be a problem generally, but when we entered the room, one of the cupboard was locked because owner's stuff was inside it - Kind of weird!We called hotel for an early check-in as we were already in vegas 3 hrs early then planned, and they just plainly refused - bad first impression!During our stay we noticed that furniture in room was kind of old and worn out like the leather on chairs was torn and had marks. Bathroom sink was clogged every time I washed my hands. Biggest bummer was their Valet. Their valet was always full, even if we were staying with them. Their casino is separate from this property, still the valet was always full. First day we got valet, we took our car in evening and when we came back in night, they refused to park our car.Hence, not a good experience altogether.

allReviews.title: Pre-owned rooms, rented out as normal hotel rooms!
allReviews.text: Here are few of the bad things and experiences we had with Palm place hotel stay:- Pre-owned rooms rented as hotel rooms! - These are pre-owned rooms not normal hotel rooms, few closets were closed as the owner had kept their stuff in there.- Hotel didn't recognized our VIP+ status and didn't gave us any features.- Valet was always full and we had to park our car daily in self parking.- Bathroom sink was blocked!- Bathtub dirty with hair lying in it.- Room was not serviced, had to call!- Everyone day hotel staff were trying to get into our room to check if we had used paid refreshments in the room.They rang bell twice and then just opened the door, while I was trying to come to open the door- The chairs in the room were ripped off at many places.- Dirty closed balcony obstruct the view outside- Shower only gave out hot water, very bad experience in taking shower there- Hotel was pretty far off from the strip with nothing much to do around it.And few of the good things!- Room service was quick and good when asked! We asked them for plates and towels and room service!- Hotel room was good size.- Bathtub was nice and deep if only it was clean as well.

allReviews.title: New Year's Eve Rooms Going to the Highest Bidder!
allReviews.text: As frequent visitors of the two Palms properties, my wife and I had yet to spend a New Year's Eve in Las Vegas (our wedding anniversary by the way) and so we looked forward to our reservations at each of the properties starting last week. We were scheduled for a two night stay at the Palms Casino followed by a three night stay at Palms Place. Having stayed at both properties in the past, we are fully aware of the amenities that rooms at each location have and we consider Palms Place rooms to be superior to those at the regular Palms location considering that Palms Place studios come equipped with three TVs, a bathtub in addition to a shower, and a kitchen.  Our initial two night stay at the Palms Casino was uneventful and concluded with no issues. We checked out and looked forward to beginning our stay at Palms Place. However, as we attempted to check in, we were informed by the Assistant Manager, Nathan Hammett, that the hotel was sold out and our reservation and rate could not be honored. How is this even possible?? It's not like we booked the room at the last minute. We had reserved and prepaid our entire stay back in September after finding a great rate through our credit card provider. Apparently, Palms Place decided as it got closer to New Year's Eve that it could get a much higher rate for our room than what we paid and gave it away to someone else. Unbelievable!! Since we already paid in full, Nathan gave us two options: a full refund or go back to the Palms with a resort fee credit. We found both of these options unacceptable as they should never have given away our room in the first place. If the reservation and rate could not be honored, why we were not informed in advance, or at the very least, during our initial two night stay at the Palms? A full refund would have left us scrambling to book at another property at the last minute in a city where price gouging for New Year's Eve seems to be the norm. Going back to the Palms would mean that we would be paying for a lesser quality room than what we intended to stay in. Not to say that Palms Casino rooms are bad, because they are not, but comparing them to Palms Place rooms is like apples and oranges. After finding Nathan's solutions unsatisfactory, he directed us to speak with his manager, Joe D'Amico, at the Palms Casino. We went back over there to speak with him but apparently he was unavailable. We instead spoke with a Front Desk Representative named Trevor who informed us of the Palms ridiculous policy of overbooking hotel rooms (there was a specific name he gave it which is escaping me at this time). First of all, why would you need to overbook rooms during New Year's Eve which is historically a time of high demand for Las Vegas? Second, why should we be victims of this policy when we have prepaid the entire stay, not just the standard first night's room and tax? Trevor was unable to do anything for us so he contacted his manager, Joshua Boren, to come out to speak with us. Prior to speaking with Joshua, my wife and I were frustrated with the situation. After speaking with him however, and having some extra time to think it over, my wife and I have decided not to return to the Palms properties ever again.Joshua was especially smug and condescending while speaking to us and offered to relocate us to the Westin if we were unwilling to stay at the Palms. For those who have not stayed at the Westin (we have), that is a step down from the Palms just as Palms is step down from Palms Place. He finally decided to offer a one-time $25 food and beverage credit for our troubles as he believed we should have been satisfied with Nathan's offer of the resort fee credit. For a couple that has dined at N9ne Steakhouse and planned on having an anniversary dinner at Nove Italiano, that was like a slap in the face. During this time, Joshua and Trevor were both playing up the idea that the room we would be getting at Palms was a corner "suite", when in reality, it is just a slightly larger Premier room. We have stayed in the Palms Ivory Suite before so we know the difference between a suite and a regular room. With no other feasible options for us, we ended up staying at the Palms. However, we canceled our planned anniversary dinner at Nove Italiano and decided not to give the Palms properties any more of our money during our stay. My wife and I have stayed at Palms properties several times over the years, we've dined at all of their establishments, gambled at their tables, and spent pool days inside their cabanas. However, the lack of customer service we received and failure to admit any wrongdoing on their part with not even so much as an "I'm sorry" showed how much they value us and our previous loyalty to them. We will be back in Vegas in February at another property and never look back on these establishments.

allReviews.title: Worst Hotel Experience Ever
allReviews.text: My husband and I arrived in Las Vegas two days ago and started our stay at The Palms Hotel. Since New Years Eve is our Anniversary we wanted a nicer room so we had reservations from today 12/30 to 1/2. However upon checking into Palms Place we were told that the hotel had over booked and we were forced to either stay at The Palms or they would credit us a full refund. Who does that to people on the busiest weekend of the year?? We had already checked out of our other room, paid for bell service only to get thrown back to our original location. Nathan Hammett the gentleman who assisted us was only willing to offer us a credit for the resort fee, which in my opinion is unacceptable seeing as how the room we booked was a suite with a tub, refrigerator, and full kitchen. We were then told if we were not satisfied to speak with the Manager Mr. D'Amico. We went to speak with him however he never bothered to even speak with us. Instead, we first dealt with Trevor who told us that he could give us our original room at no cost. Honestly where is the customer service? This is a room that is no where near what we had and this character is trying to act as if we won the lottery! Get real! Then he calls out his Manager Joshua Boren who makes it seem as there had been no breach in service and we are getting a remarkable stay in our same room. When we are still not content with the lack of effort on their part, or the fact that they could have avoided this situation by letting us know when we first arrived or prior to checking he states we can either leave with a refund, stay and receive a $25 food/drink credit or we can relocate to the the Westin. With no other feasible options we had to stay at The Palms losing out on our suite. This is the second time we have had a problem with these properties in four months and I honestly recommend staying somewhere else in the future. The hotels I once loved are now the two worst hotels in Vegas due to their poor service.

allReviews.title: Amazing Experience
allReviews.text: We recently stayed at the Palms Place Hotel for 2 weeks.  I must say I was hesitant about staying here after staying at another hotel/condo for many years while  working the NFR for 2 weeks.  Some of our young employees got a great deal at the Palms Place so we decided to give it a try.  The rooms were beautiful and so comfortable. The beds were amazing.  Big, beautiful bathroom.  Awesome tub.  Very romantic.The staff at the hotel made us feel like we lived there.  The bartenders, valet guys, and bellman were great.  The concierge Christine Smith helped my husband get 40+tickets to a show and then found a great club to hold a company party, all last minute.  She was so helpful.  I can't rave enough about this hotel.  We felt like we were leaving home when we left.  We will be back.

allReviews.title: Quiet, basic, dated and not 4 star accommodations
allReviews.text: This was just a quick overnight stop for me.  I wanted a modern, clean, quiet hotel that was away from all the fuss of the strip.  The front desk clerk that checked me in wasn't very friendly and wasn't very helpful when I asked about self-parking.  My hotel room was a "premium room" in the ivory tower.  Nothing premium about it.  The tv wouldn't turn on, I think the remote needed batteries.  I asked for a non-smoking room, however someone was smoking in the hallway (maybe that's just Vegas), the smell carried into my room.   My room was cheap, so can't complain much  about the price, but I wouldn't stay here again if I had to pay a higher rate.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel For Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Don't be afraid of some comments you find on the internet, it's not that far from the strip, of course you'll need a taxi or can take the shuttle, but hey, the hotel is grate. It's the fifth time we stay at this place, studio suite and we really enjoy it. We had the strip view and get to see all lights at night from the balcony. There is a cinema inside the complex, food court, casino, buffette and even the largest hooters restaurant. So you have many amenities in here.

allReviews.title: NEVER STAY HERE**********
allReviews.text: One night with my gf at Vegas.  We stayed in room 303, 26th floor on 12/28/2016.  First of all, my gf got scared by a COCKROACH.  Then, we discovered they DIDN'T CHANGE BED SHEET!  There were other ppl's hairs when we uncovered the comforter and it's dirty.  We called front desk for changing our bed sheet, and we waited for nearly an hour for house keeping to change our bed sheet.  First front desk staff even said there's nothing she can do with it, have just have to wait. My gf and I were extremely tried (we drove a long way.)  I've to stay even some cheap hotel we stayed few days before is better than this place.  We slept at 1:45AM that night.  Thank you Palms Place Hotel and Spa by giving us this nightmare-like night.

allReviews.title: My AirBNB Palms Place Experience
allReviews.text: We booked this Suite through AirBNB for 11 nights. Our AirBNB service was phenomenal our hosts were attentive. Unfortunately we cannot say the same for the Palms Place staff at all! In fact we cannot believe that the staff of the actual hotel was so poor. We arrived at 11 am on a flight from New York, we were told at check-in the room was not ready but they would call when it was (which was fine with us we expected that) , our dates of stay was wrong and the front desk check in girl was rude and told me it is what it is since i booked through airbnb , i contacted my host who immediately contacted the palms and it was corrected. But why should i receive rude or poor quality service because i booked through airbnb? shouldn't the Palms Hotel staff supply me with the same quality of service as any other guest, maybe it would incline me to book directly through the hotel. But nonetheless this was just the beginning. 3:00 PM came and STILL NO CALL from the Palms. at 3:20 we came to the front desk and the room was not ready the front desk girl said it's not ready and i said the rooms are guaranteed at 3pm, she walks to the back and comes out with keys. The suite was nice, the balcony view is beautiful , the jacuzzi tub is nice however it is has an old style stopper that got stuck on first use and we called 3 times for someone to come and help us let the water out , i contacted my host and even after he called we waited an additional hour to the two we had already been waiting to get someone up there!! ridiculous there was no room service menu in the suite and after calling twice to get one , the menu was average and basic and we ordered twice and nothing served was worth the time . When traveling i set limits and alerts on my cards to help prevent theft and from hotels from over authorizing charges, so at 6:30 am my creditor called me to alert me that the Palms Place Front desk had attempted to authorize a charge and they were calling to confirm it was valid. I wen to the front desk to inquire about the attempted charge seeing as they were already holding incidentals that were sufficient to cover the stay and a male front desk agent , Frank i believe after i walked up to him told me he couldn't help me and kindve shooed me over to another front desk girl who was talking to a coworker not even paying attention . She tells me that she doesn't know what the charge is for and said well we should find out why my card is being ran telling me you don't know is not sufficient. out of irritation i paid the balance on the room then and there. but really? you don't know why you're authorizing someone's card? disgusting and unacceptable! i will never stay there again!

allReviews.title: Should have its own postcode is so big.
allReviews.text: Classed as 2 hotels (spa or casino)but joined together by a massive area in between with the casino floor, shops, restaurants & even a full sized cinema. We opted to stay in spa side but next time (and I would stay here again) I would stay in casino side. Just as less of a walk to the pool area we liked best (there is 2 but spa one bit small & quiet, depends what looking for) We upgraded room to something could only describe as a massive apartment. Was beautiful with 2 bathrooms, kitchen, living room with touch button log fire & slipper jacuzzi bath. Was trendy elegant & impressive. Bit of a treck to get to Pool area, reception or even ground floor but can't have it all I guess. Had a really nice meal in Italian restaurant & was a bit special. Somewhere to definitely impress your dinner partner or special occasion. Wasn't even too expensive considering. Then on flip side you could eat in the food court by cinema if just want a quick bite in hotel. Hotel has it all here which was good considering a little off the strip & a trip to other big hotels. If want a place where can escape Vegas in luxury without breaking the bank then this is hotel for you.

allReviews.title: Good Location off the strip
allReviews.text: The rooms are nice, but they don't tell you that the ice machines do not work. Our regular refrigerator did not work either so they had a little bar refrigerator in the room. Very close to the strip and the freeway. Love the location. There is a walking escalator into the Palms Casino. It is about a 5 minute walk. The 24/7 cafe is awful! Service is terrible. They don't get the order correct. Stay away if you can.Also, if you are not out of your room by 12:00 noon, housekeeping will leave a card saying you missed service that day. Really? This is Las Vegas.If you want dishes, silverware or plates in the room, you have to get them from room service. Also, you have to get ice from room service which we weren't told until the day we checked out.Head's up. They do take a 1.5% deposit and put it on your CC when you check in. We were never told about this and it has taken me over a week to get it resolved. I thought someone hacked our credit card. Caused us lots of issues as we weren't prepared for it. It takes 7 days after you check out to get it back. I thought I would stay here again, but after that fiasco with the credit card, probably won't. Figure it is close to another $1,000 they are tying up of your money. We only carry 1 credit card on vacation. Spent the whole morning we were leaving trying to figure this mess out. Make sure you ask questions before you book here. They are not upfront about what they do. They should tell you when you book the room. They just say they are taking one nights deposit. Not True!

allReviews.title: Convenient hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay tremendously at this hotel. First of all, check-in was a breeze, real quick and easy. Next, was pleasantly surprised by how spacious and modern the room is. I stayed at room 12-320. Roomy bathroom and nice kitchenette which you can use if you choose to prepare your own meals. However, it will not be necessary as there are many reasonable eating options at Palms Casino and near the hotel. Most tour companies have free pick up for Palms Place so not to worry about booking your day tours too. There are 2 TVs, one in front of the bed and one just beside which is directly in front of the couch area. Not really necessary but a nice touch nonetheless. Parking is convenient and there are so many lots to choose from. Check-out was really quick and hassle-free. Highly recommend staying in this hotel though I understand not all rooms are of the same standard.

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: While visiting Las Vegas, I always stay at Palms PLACE or Vdara as these properties give you quick access to your room without having to walk through a casino.  As  I am there for a lot of business trips and the last thing I would like to do is spend a ton of time walking through a casino. The beds are super comfy and the bath tub is unbelievable no matter what room you are in. I would especially like to thank Mohammad at the front desk as he goes above and beyond what defines hospitality. Every time I have a request or an accommodation he always make sure to follow up with the highest standards of customer service.

allReviews.title: Rude staff bad wifi
allReviews.text: Room was nice and big with a nice view, but you can only connect 1 device at a time to free wifi, when i went to ask about this at reception i was told... it is what it is..  not the answer i was looking for. We stayed at the 4 star palms the year before  with lovely  staff and multiple  wifi,  so didn't expect  this when we upgrade to the 5 star suites. Also had to call room service 3 times to get cutlery as there was coffee etc in room but no cups or spoons??Also when you have a couple  staying,  there is only  1 bathrobe?  Think i will stick to the 4 star palms in future  or a different  hotel.We also had friends with us who also  booked in the same hotel and they had the same problem  with cutlery etc and also bad rips in the furniture. After all this they still charge you a ridiculous  price of $33.54 per night resort fee, we stayed 6 nights so had a bill of just over $200  on top of what we paid for the room.

allReviews.title: Rude staff and bad wifi
allReviews.text: I would never stay here again or recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff in reception is very rude. When we ask if we could get wifi for a second device in the room we were told not possible and, I quote..it is what it is. In my opinion this is unacceptable for a 5 star. There is is kitchen unit in the room and we had to call 3 times and wait about 1 hour to get a knive and spoons. The room was nice and spacious,  but the charge for the room service is far to high. We are visiting Las Vegas every year and never had a bad experience with a hotel until this one.

allReviews.title: There is nothing redeeming about this hotel!
allReviews.text: The rooms are so dark that they could have filmed the X Files here.  The first room I was given had a broken TV and the blackout drakes did not close completely.  I called and was told that housekeeping would be right up.  They still didn't come after a second call.  They offered to send engineering.  I asked for a different room and was moved.  My new room was equally as dark as was my fruend's and some people I met in the elevator.  The sleep timer on the TV does not work, but I have gotten the idea that this is par for the course so I did not even bother to complain about that.  The casino is small and unappealing.  We ate our complimentary breakfast this morning.  They clear the breakfast foods and are out of them by 10:45.  My friend did not receive glasses that should have been replaced by housekeeping today.  She phoned and was told to call room service.  She still did not have glasses 45 minutes later.  There us NO sense of urgency in this place.The walk to the casino is way too far and not for older people.For a good time and light in your room, I would not stay here.

allReviews.title: Great place without the noise of the casinos
allReviews.text: This is a great "normal" hotel in Vegas. By normal, I mean that the lobby is just the front desk, bell desk and some sofas, so there are no stores, casino, etc. If you prefer a quite place instead of the noise of the casinos this is a great option. The room is big with a huge bathroom and it is very clean. The location is perfect. It is just 2.4 km or 1.5 miles of the Strip so you can go there easily.The lady of the front desk is a little rude and a smile to the guests will not hurt, but she was efficient and I checked-in in about 5 minutes.  In the other hand the bell desk service was great. I think that the the room is a little dark so you have to turn on a lot of lights around the room, I suggest placing a big lamp in the middle of the room to illuminate most of the room with a single switch.

allReviews.title: Absolutely Amazing Hotel
allReviews.text: I was in Vegas for 5 days and had the pleasure of staying at Palms Place. I opted for the One bed room suite and it was well worth it! I felt at home during my stay. There was a full kitchen, washer/dryer combo which made my stay a lot easier(I could cook or wash clothes as needed). The casino is a 5 minute walk to Club Palms. During my stay I attended two parties at Ghost bar and was not disappointed(entry is free). If you're looking for a great hotel 7 minutes off the strip look no further than Palms Place

allReviews.title: Bait & Switch. Full of Excuses. Be careful.
allReviews.text: The hotel didn't care that they gave away our reservation for the double beds, which we paid extra for! When they tried to resolve the issue they created, they had the audacity to charge more, which is unfair and wrong. Palms place doesn't even compare to the kind of amenities and quality service of the Cosmopolitan and Vdara. The shower had a weird sewage smell, not enough lighting and you have to tell housekeeping to clean the room and provide fresh towels. Room service doesn't even have fresh squeezed orange juice for a 4 star hotel. They offered minute maid. This hotel is more of a 2 or 3 star. My advice is never book a room at Palms Place. If you're going to end up paying extra for their negative bait and switch errors, you might as well spend the money on 5 star hotels.

allReviews.title: The worst
allReviews.text: So where to begin. Got to the hotel around 12am we were checking in and the lady at the desk was friendly and seemed helpful, we asked her did she have and rooms with a view so that we can have a nice view it is our first trip here to Vegas. As she searched through her computer I guess she did find a room and she put us in my room.as we get to the room the shower floor was wet I didn't think anything of it I just assumed that maybe they cleaned before we got into the room. I also noticed that the mini bar was open and there was drinks missing but we were just trying to go out and have a good time is our first night in Vegas didn't think anything of it.so the next day we start I'm getting ready to go out and we noticed that there's some lighting fixtures that aren't working. So as we left for the day we let the manager know that the lighting fixtures and the jets in the jacuzzi weren't working and they said that they would take care of it and we left for an hour we came back and the lights were not fixed. We go back to our room and as were on the way back to our room we see a young couple they let us know that they stayed in our room the previous night before the night that we checked in and claim that she left her ID and our room and that they were transferred out of that room because of the issues that we were also complaining about. With that being said we went downstairs to the management and brought this issue to them they explained to us that at this time they are booked and that there is nothing that they can do for us but take one of our day of a resort fees off.  At this point we are very unsatisfied we did not receive great customer service so we called the management and she was the night manager and she let us know that tomorrow a room would be ready and that she would let us know when the room is ready but it should be ready by 11 o'clock so that night we packed all of our things we packed everything up so that we can be ready to go and get into our another room and what bothered me the most was that she tried to tell us that we can come to another hotel a different palms why would we move all of our things all of our bags over to another hotel because of the hotel that we paid to stay at is having whatever it is she said they were having. So the next day we come downstairs to talk to the people at the desk to see if I am I'll bring my severity and we get a rude awakening that the message wasn't even relate and they're trying to tell me that they can't do anything until that night manager comes in and I felt like that was an issue so with all that being said we had to go and get higher up manager and all of a sudden they see notes on the account that we are supposed to be moved to a higher room all of a sudden out of nowhere so they move us to the new room after this is our third dayinto our Vegas trip we were only there for five days so for the first three days we had to deal with issues with our hotel room and issues with the staff at this place. I had a very inconvenient stay at the palms please because none of the management talk to each other there was no messages relayed I had a very bad trip just because of my stay.I was sent an email to do a survey I didn't get a chance to do the first day of eighth and they sent me a Reminders survey and I thought that survey out and they did not get back to me and I called and I left a message for the manager and they still haven't got back to me and I've sent multiple emails and I still haven't gotten any feedback from my stay I have had issues with all the employees and with the hotel and I want something done about it. I didn't feel like a priority because Floyd Mayweather with staying there while we were staying there so I guess all their attention went to him and not to any of their guest.

allReviews.title: Great luxury hotel off strip
allReviews.text: Check in was fast and easy.  Only about 10 minutes from the time we parked our car, checked in and were in our room.  (that won't have with the casino hotels).   The resort fee hadn't been advertised, but knowing vegas hotels it wasn't a surprise.  The $33/day fee is a money grab as the hotel does not have much for a pool area and there isn't much as far as resort benefits.  The room was large with more of a focus on modern than comfort, although the bed was great.  Other than one security event next door, the room was very quite.   We seldom had to wait long for elevators and we could be from our room to our car in less than 5 minutes.  From the parking lot we were only a couple of minutes drive till we were on the I-15 or the strip.  The shuttle to the strip was convenient but not sure why it stops running at 8:00.  The shuttle was always full leaving the hotel, but the one time we took it back there was lots of room.  All in all a great hotel and will do again if the price is right.

allReviews.title: The place to stay off the strip
allReviews.text: If you want to stay off the strip this is definitely the place. The bed is one of the best hotel beds I've ever slept in!! the end! the rooms that are actually suites are great, spacious and nice decor. Every comment and other reviews about the fixture in the bathroom is similar to our experience. They are often broken :D but for us that didn't matter. It worked with a little adjustment. The cleaning staff are amazing! the sweetest and so attentive. Choose this hotel if you want a "hotel feel" in Vegas which can actually be difficult to find bc all hotels have casino in the lobby - here you have to walk to palms resort across the skywalk to enter the casino. Also a very nice pool at this part of the hotel and an extremely nice gym. Nice spa with great treatments and finally nice service pool site. Depending on the season in walking distance to the strip ( about 25 min) but forget it in spring and summer - it's way to hot so plan  and budget for taking caps back and forth if you want to get to the strip - you can live perfectly fine without visiting the strip the resort has an excellent casino and great restaurants. Only minus was the hotel reception staff. They could be more service minded. but would definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Great Place
allReviews.text: I spent four nights at the Palms Place in October while attending a convention at another location.  The price was great for a large studio apartment with a full kitchenette.  The furnishings were very comfortable, there was a jacuzzi tub as well as a separate shower.  The only disappointment was not being able to go out on the balcony for security reasons.  Regardless I highly recommend the Palms Place!

allReviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful Stay
allReviews.text: The Palms Place is a fantastic off strip option for Hotel accommodations.  Check-in was easy and quick - less than 10 minutes.  There was free Valet and Self Parking to utilize.My room situated on the 22nd floor was beautiful, clean, and modern.  The two TV's in the room, not including the one in the restroom were great.  I was able to watch TV and accommodate my son with some cartoons. The only downside from my visit was the Complimentary Wifi (included in the resort fee) was not working.  If I pay a resort fee, I expect the Wifi to work.  Other than that, everyone was kind, helpful and overall just an amazing property.I like that's it's off the strip and no casino - it makes for a much quieter and peaceful stay.

allReviews.title: If you dont mind 'off the strip' Palms Place is a great option
allReviews.text: I am sure there are plenty of reviews, so this will be short and sweet.  We had a great time at Palms Place with no complaints.  We didnt use the kitchen but it was nice to have.  The Room, floor and hotel were quiet inspite of a young crowd, clean and stylish.  The staff was helpful and quick to get things done.  Transportation to the strip was easy and not too far.  The views were excellent and the bed/pillows were super comfortable!  We will be back.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Easy booking, room was exactly what I asked for and service was amazing. Easy to get to the strip and it would a great idea to go grocery shopping due to the mini kitchen they provide for you, there's even a dishwasher in case you have dishes.

allReviews.title: Amazing at first glance, just ok on the second
allReviews.text: Palms Place Hotel, the fancier/more upscale sister property to the mainline Palms Hotel and Casino, is at first glance a very attractive alternative to the other 4.5-5 star hotels on the Strip. Built in 2008, it is much more modern and, in my opinion, stylish than the other two Palms towers. Despite coming to Las Vegas regularly for years, I had never ventured over to the hotels west of I-15. I never really felt the need. When we were surprised by a last minute family member's wedding, I saw a good deal and decided to give it a chance.At first glance, I had no idea why I had waited too long. The quiet borderline tranquil lobby was quite a contrast to the party scene reputation the property had in my mind. No casino or smoke to deal with. Check in was smooth. We had a studio room on the 50th floor (which is actually the 40th floor, but for some reason they decided to just skip the 40's for some unknown reason). Up in the room, we were very pleased. Modern design, large marble bathroom with a huge jetted tub, fantastic bed. Everything at first glance put it on par with some of the best hotels we had stayed at in Vegas. It was on the second and subsequent glances that took it down a notch.It is pretty clear that these rooms are showing their age. The inside handle of the doorknob, while functional, was pretty loose. There were broken edges to the marble tile. Scuff marks and tears were on two of the chairs. Someone had bashed in the front of the minibar, which broke the display and super bright LED lights were shining throughout the room before we draped a jacket over it so we could sleep. The jets on the tub would randomly turn on in the middle of the night, which sounded like a giant vacuum cleaner. I am usually pretty accommodating to a little wear and tear, but this seemed to be a little higher than normal. I didnt mind the small distance between the hotel and the Strip. I actually enjoyed it. We had a car and there was almost always parking very close to the doors. The view of the Strip was incredible. Station Casinos purchased the property in May, so I hope they are able to get ahead of these small maintenance issues. Because if they were taken care of, this place would be fantastic.

allReviews.title: Studio room smells like pot
allReviews.text: When they received the fax order from booking.com they mixed up my last name into their reservation system and it took 1.5 hours back and forth to a successful check-in.We had one of the studio on the 15th floor facing the strip. When we entered it immediately smelt like pot in the room and made a phone call to the room service. They were too busy and asked us to walk to the front desk. We told the front desk and they sprayed the room with deodorant instead of accepting our request for a room exchange. When we came back 1 hour later, my throat hurt by the gas and had to went down the front desk to ask for a room exchange. Finally got a right room after 5 hours after we walked in the hotel.As far as food is concerned, since the station casino bought this hotel they got rid of the seafood buffet and instead have a $12.95 non-seafood dinner buffet. Thus a minus.

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: Nice hotel, off the strip but close enough to catch a quick Uber ride over. The buffet was good. Sunday brunch includes unlimited mimosas and with the free players card you get money off the buffet. Overall cool hotel!

allReviews.title: 5 Star Concierge, Christine Smith!
allReviews.text: The Palms Vegas Concierge, Christine Smith, is excellent at her job. She was extremely kind and resourceful, during my sons last minute birthday trip to Vegas and the Palms Hotel. When I called, the evening of my sons birthday, I was stressed; worried that it would be too late to get anything together for him. But, because of Christine's calming demeanor, and positive attitude, my worries disappeared within a matter of seconds. She was a Godsend; patient, a great listener, with many smart suggestions and she knew just who to call. She organized a cake, balloons, and all kinds of goodies for a last minute surprise. I travel an awful lot and I am certain Christine is among the best Concierges' on earth. I hope the Palms management realizes how lucky they are to have her! Thanks a million, Christine!!!

allReviews.title: Resort fee gets you hand towels for the pool
allReviews.text: I'm still here and from beginning there's been some kinda of daily issue.    I have family that came from Europe so brought them here.   When we got to their room we couldn't get into the room because the room key wasn't working they had to wait in the hallway with their bags like dummies while I went downstairs to get new keys.  Ok no big deal it happens.   I arrived to my room open safe and there is white powder in there that can be anything again no big deal it's  Vegas.   They said house keeping would be there in 15 min took them longer and we didn't want to leave the room without locking our personal stuff and a decent amount of cash in the safe.   So we waited around.  Again no big deal but it's starting to add up.    Now today we come back from lunch and our plan is to go to the pool we get ready then we find out our guest had to wait 15 min to get into their room because their keys wouldn't work and had to wait for someone to let them in.  On the way down to the pool I decided to go to lobby to fix their keys and meet them by the pool after.  When I arrived there was no towels so they were just sitting around not swimming because they don't have towels.  When I told the bartender she just said sorry we are out of towels and that I would have to go back to my room to get towels.  This whole hotel is out of towels for the pool? So what am I paying $34 daily resort fee for?  So I can constantly go up and down the elevator while my guest stand around like idiots.   So I went to my room to get towels all I had was one bath towel and 2 hand towels.   So gave them the bath towel and one hand towel for me and one for my wife.    Awesome! The thing is I told front desk so they are aware there are no towels at the pool and still nothing.   A lot of people just sitting around not able to use the pool because of no towels.   So it's just an empty pool.  It's sad because the rooms and layouts  are nice with good views but you can  get that anywhere in Vegas with towels and working room doors.

allReviews.title: Amazing room and view
allReviews.text: We wanted to be off the strip since this was simply an overnighter on the way to Palm Springs from Montana, not a party trip, or a sight seeing night in Vegas.  I searched Trip Advisor and found this hotel.  Huge BR, our unit was in the corner of the building so we had two glass walls of view of the city during the day and a light show at night.  And two bathrooms!  Like I said, large.  We wanted to go to the pool (and tried to) after dinner but it was closed...seasonal we were told.  Too bad.  We had happy hour drinks with snack food when we arrived, and later a nice dinner.  Price was very good for our great room.  Nothing bad to say except for no pool.

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel
allReviews.text: I found this hotel to be excellent. It is not to far from the strip, but far enough to be quiet at night. I had a suite, which was large and very comfortable. The bed was large. mattress was just right. Lighting was excellent. The bathroom was large and very clean. Huge bathtub, shower was great, lots of hot water. Lots of towels.  AC worked very well. Refrigerator was very well stocked, but a little expensive. The housekeeping was great. The valet parking and concierge were very good. Front desk personnel were friendly and very helpful. Access to the casino and restaurant was through a covered walkway. My only complaint is that I couldn't use he balcony. It was locked for some reason. It would have been nice to be able to open it and get a fresh breeze in the evening.

allReviews.title: Beware of this hotel
allReviews.text: Management is full of crap.  Don't ever stay on this hotel.  It's really bad.  We are trying to get refund because we did not able to sleep.  A microphone feedback sound every 15 seconds around 6am woke us up.  We got back in our hotel around 4am and trying to sleep.  We called the guest service desk 4-5times to check on that noise and asked them to send someone in our room.  NO ONE CAME.
