allReviews.text: This is the best resort that I feel. The location is very nice and is near two monorail stations. There are free parking provided. There are few huge casinos nearby that you will enjoy them very much.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: Had a great time!! I wish pool was open later and more then one bartender on duty. He had a tough time keeping up. He has said the drinks though I just felt bad for him. The rooms were nice and clean the staff at the front desk where nice. Great deal for the money!

allReviews.title: Hot water at a premium
allReviews.text: Overall actually an excellent place, convenient location to the convention center.  A couple of casinos and the monorail all within walking distance.  Perks include dvd movies and bottled water.Cold showers were a major downer, called the desk and there solution was to let the shower run 10 minutes first.  Not a great solution in a water challenged area and also that would have been nice to know before first cold shower.

allReviews.title: Amazing!
allReviews.text: This place is a hidden treasure just off the Strip. Great room, great amenities, great staff! I can't believe I had never stayed here before, but I don't think I will stay anyplace else in Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Couples Getaway
allReviews.text: One of the best Hilton properties that I've stay at. The room was well appointed. The facility was clean and the appliances all worked. The decor was bright and had a modern feel about it. Would be nice if there was a full service restaurant on site.

allReviews.title: HGV Las Vegas (North end of the Strip)
allReviews.text: The hotel was good. Quiet for the most part but I definitely blasted my music lol. It was cleaner than most Vegas hotels I’ve stayed at. You don’t have to worry about the smell of burning nicotine or the sound of people losing their money at the craps table either! The staff was extremely friendly and helpful also! I’d definitely stay here again. The double bed studio was also a plus because I was with my brother. In fact it’s the only HGV that comes with double bed studio. If you want to split the cost of the room and save money it’s really convenient to stay here. 4.5 out of 5 for me. Only reason I’m not giving it a 5 out of 5 is because the deli isn’t 24 hours lol. Other than that it’s an ideal place for people to stay in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel on good location
allReviews.text: The hotel is excellent, spacious rooms very clean and relaxing. Very good wifi and it’s just away from the strip, has free parking. Most hotels on the strip charge you for parking ($35-45 daily) tip parking is free at the selfparking of the Miracle Mile Shopping center, if you park there and walk outside you’re on the strip and have MGM, New York, Tropicana, Excaliber and Paris within 1000 ft.

allReviews.title: Just average, staff is fine but does not go the extra mile
allReviews.text: During check-in there was nothing to help the guest know the local area and how to enjoy it.  The timeshare was average.  It was clean.  What was disappointing was that there was no hot water at 5:00 AM.  I felt like I was in a foreign country that turns off the water at night.  Walls also are very thin.The view was as nice as it could be.

allReviews.title: Great Apartment - easy access to the strip via the Monorail
allReviews.text: We had a 2 bedroom apartment with a kitchen and full laundry facilities. We asked for a tea kettle and one was provided. Even though it wasn't on the strip it was a quick walk to the monorail station at the Westgate and a few minutes and at the strip. Also close to a bus stop that took you downtown and to the great factory outlets, would highly recommend this place, the beds were extremely comfortable and no noisy casino which was great, lovely and quiet

allReviews.title: No Hot Water
allReviews.text: Continual problems with getting and keeping hot water, never fixed during our stay! Additionally the pool was closed every night at 8 PM as was the Hot Tub. The grounds were clean and well kept and the little on-site market was very good and had a great variety of products, but no on-site dining as advertised.

allReviews.title: Excellent place to stay
allReviews.text: The one bedroom apartment had every thing necessary for a comfortable stay.  No casino and a little off the Strip meant it was a quiet and less frantic place to return to after a day out.  Five minute walk from the monorail at Westgate.  Relatively cheap restaurants at SLS and Westgate were good. Onsite shop very expensive with limited choice.  I would recommend the Hilton Grand on Paradise Karen Avenue.  We attended a time share talk with Hilton for 90 minutes resulting in no timeshare bought but a free lunch, free show voucher  and a free (expensive) restaurant meal voucher - try it.

allReviews.title: Calm Oasis
allReviews.text: Thankfully this hotel is away from the chaos of the strip, though it is an easy monorail trip to it all. The amenities are very good. This includes a pool, a small fitness center, an in room full washer/dryer, free DVD rentals and ample free secure parking. If you want to be in the thick the action for sleazy Vegas, this is not for.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel, but unfortunately not clean and ac didnt work. Parking was an issue.
allReviews.text: Nice hotel bath room and one beds sheets were dirty. Ac didnt work sweated all night. Poor staff help at check in attitude could have been improved for tourists. Early check out 10 am but the check out staff was nice to do a 12pm check out at no charge. Paid 232 for this room should have stayed in my truck. Just sad really.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel! Always a wonderful stay.
allReviews.text: This is a great property! Clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. It is in a great location, especially if you are attending an event at the Las Vegas Convention Center. It is an easy walk. Even though you are off the strip, the monorail is steps away and you can easily get to the strip. There is no smoky casino to traverse through to get to your room. The lobby area has two lounges to enjoy. One is more of a game room with a pool table. The other is a more quiet lounge where you can relax or conduct a business meeting. The little marketplace has lots of snacks and made to order food, which is convenient. If you are looking for a casino, the Westgate next door has a full casino. It also has several restaurants including a Benihana, Fresco Italian, and Edge Steakhouse. The rooms are clean, spacious, and comfortable. I was in a one bedroom suite with a small living room and separate bedroom. Plenty of room to spread out. The kitchen is complete with a full-size fridge, stove-top, oven, microwave, and coffee-maker. It is stocked with pots, pans, dishes, and utensils. The bathroom had a double vanity and separate tub and shower. Two large flat screen TV's and pull out couch. The fitness center is very nice with cardio machines and some free weights. Overall a great stay. Definitely, recommend. Will stay here again in the future.

allReviews.title: Far from the crowd perfect place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: The strip area are noisy and loud. For you who wish to sleep well should a bit far from that area. This hotel is perfect for us. We didn't need the casinos and this hotel has no casino. If you have young kids this hotel is highly recommended! The room was clean, no breakfast but they have kitchen in the room, washing and dryer, 1 shower and 1 tub (beside the bed), free parking and free wifi. I definitely will stay in this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Clean and comfortable.
allReviews.text: The rooms here are well maintained and fully stocked so that if you choose to do your own meal prep, you can. The staff is extremely responsive and friendly. The pool area is low-key and nicely appointed with lots of lounge chairs and towels. This is an excellent location if you don't want to be right in the craziness of The Strip. It's close enough (Monorail is a block away) for easy access, yet far enough away that it's relatively quiet and relaxing. The fact that it is not attached to a casino was for us a bonus. Great place if you're traveling with children.

allReviews.title: close to monorail
allReviews.text: We booked this timeshare through RCI .  It is very close to monorail (only one block walk in Westgate) this was super convenient  and we used that to get around the strip .   The pool is very small though and it has a small hot tub .  I was upset that they did not have jetted tubs in the rooms . After walking all day on the strip that would have been nice . instead the main suite has a soaker tub    .they were testing the alarms at 9 am for two days --bit of a nuisance

allReviews.title: Update the update
allReviews.text: The hotel is conveniently renovated with exception of the few rooms with heating cooling problems as well as hot water available during morning hours. For sure, don’t opt the breakfast upgrade in the morning because you’re find that the 40 up  charge is now for just a muffin and coffee

allReviews.title: Lovely place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: We've thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! Our two bedroom suite was beautifully decorated, roomy, clean and comfortable with a full kitchen, washer-dryer and huge soaking tub. Being somewhat removed from the strip, it was pleasantly quiet. The amenities were great and the staff friendly and helpful. Just a short walk to the monorail. Good security and privacy, nearby parking. The pool area was very nice. The pool was heated and clean, just wish it was open longer hours. It didn't open until 10 am and closed at 8 pm. We look forward to staying here again the next time we come to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas trip with friends
allReviews.text: Resort was clean and in good condition but we did not have hot water for 2 mornings and someone on our floor was smoking pot for 3-4 days and this was not addressed.  Every time we left the room or got off the elevator on our floor their was a strong stench of pot.

allReviews.title: Family Vacation to Vegas
allReviews.text: My family and I stayed at this Hilton and the rooms and staff were excellent. I had the two bedroom suite and they were very clean and beds comfortable to sleep in. Also easy excess to the trolley up and down the strip.

allReviews.title: Stay @ Hilton- cold showers
allReviews.text: We checked in tired @1:00am into 2 rooms a family vacation. Check in was good however a bit miss leading as was not told the water to shower would be completely cold he said under going maintenence and we will get warm water. Not impressed. He said he will give us 25.oops pet room as credit to use in restaurant market place. Went to room tried to shower water completely cold.... called reception @2:00 am and was told we were already told when we checked in.... Asked to speak with person who checked us in  Jorge and requested a resort credit for each room. Still waiting for credit!

allReviews.title: Noname
allReviews.text: Great stay great kitchen needed to cook so it worked out well that we had the oven. Hard to find in Vegas getting a kitchenette that's actually a real kitchen.  I'll be beck for sure and highly reccomend

allReviews.title: Nice & Clean
allReviews.text: Clean. Comfortable. Walls were thin though and I could hear every little thing happening in the rooms around me. Wifi was fast. Was close to the monorail and convention center. Great spot to stay if vacationing or on business.

allReviews.title: Relax off the strip
allReviews.text: Condo was recently renovated. Clean and comfortable. Maid service daily. Pool was a little disappointing as it is up front close to the parking lot and much smaller than it looks in the pictures. Coffee shop/store only takes credit or debit...no cash. I liked the security feature in the elevator!

allReviews.title: HILTON GRAND Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Had a great time in Las Vegas. Hilton Grand Vacation was a fantastic place to stay. Dany  at the front desk was extremely helpful.  The pool and spa area were both open and appeared to be well maintained.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacation at Paradise
allReviews.text: For the second time we have stayed at a Hilton in Las Vegas in an exchange. We chose the Hilton once again as the accommodations are well kept and provide for our needs and has a Market Place to purchase food and snacks from 7 AM-10 PM.

allReviews.title: Ask for a room away from the street side
allReviews.text: The resort is a nice hotel.  The downstairs store has pretty much everything you could ever want (has coke :D!) and reasonably priced as well.  The facilities were nice and updated.  My only issue with the resort was the fact they gave us a room facing the road, the room has no sound barriers in place.  We could hear cars and motorcycles drive my through all hours of the night.  So if you stay here, be sure to ask to stay on the other side :D!

allReviews.title: Excellent Place To Stay
allReviews.text: Although I am power wheelchair user, we opted to stay in a suite that was not deemed as "accessible", however there was plenty of space to get around and it had everything I required. The decor was welcoming and I loved the kitchenette and living room. There was even a washer and dryer included. It was bigger and more comfortable than staying at one of the more iconic hotels and was a fraction of the price!

allReviews.title: Great Place To Stay
allReviews.text: Staff is fantastic and always helpful in any way possible. Would recommend this place to anybody and is close to the monorail. They gave out two free bottles of water to us every day. They will go out of their way to help you with anything. Needed some things done and it was taken care of within the half hour.

allReviews.title: Apartment was robbed
allReviews.text: I have never had a stay so poor in my entire life. We left to go pick up our car rental, when we returned to our apartment on floor 8 my phone, my aunty's tablet and my sisters new coach bags had been taken. Being horrified we ran downstairs and told the staff. Security and staff were unhelpful and I understand not much could be done however to only have cameras on the 1st floor is quite disgusting. Moreover we were not moved to another room although a person had access to the room we were living in and sleeping in at night which caused many sleepless nights and made us want to leave Las Vegas asap. This is not the type of thing I would expect to happen at the Hilton and I expected the staff to be a bit more understanding. As we were being told the security manager was working on the case he simply called us once saying "only your key had been used to enter the room" which was as much as we had been helped which caused us to feel upset as we were basically accused of making the whole thing up. I am very disappointed as when you leave a room you do not expect to come back to it with valuebles missing. The break in clearly indicated that somebody had known we had left the apartment, had access to the room and knew there was no cameras which gives the idea that it was an inside job however I cannot confirm.

allReviews.title: Solid Business Stay
allReviews.text: This is the second time I have stayed at this hotel for business.  It is right next door to the Westgate and is connected by sidewalks.  It is also a short walk to the Las Vegas Convention Center.  The front desk staff is very friendly and always quick to welcome you when you walk in.  The rooms are fairly large and in good shape.  The pool an hot tub are pretty good if you are looking to spend some time there.  There is a "pool bar" that is a four seat bar with a TV adjacent to the pool.  It doesn't have a view of the pool.  There is also a poolside grill that can be used by guests.  Adjacent to the lobby is a very large business center with TVs and plenty of work seating.  There is also a game room with a pool table.  You can get a limited menu of hot food for breakfast, lunch and dinner which is better than most hotels and there is a very wide variety of food, drinks (including alcoholic) and sundries in case you forget anything or need a snack.

allReviews.title: A quiet oasis in the heart of a bustling city
allReviews.text: This property is just wonderful.Staff are very helpful right from check-in.The grounds and pool are so clean and inviting.We noticed that the pool is cleaned every night. The rooms are spacious and spotless.Very quiet and relaxing after a busy day.We highly recommend this property.

allReviews.title: Awesome affordable hotel perfect for families!
allReviews.text: After looking at dozens and dozens of locations for our family of five, we chose this location. Essentially the two rooms were adjoining. One a regular two bed room with full bath, and the second room had a full bedroom, living room, kitchen, and full bathroom. So plenty of space and privacy for everyone. So if you don't mind not staying at a loud, busy casino, this is a great alternative. The rooms were immaculate and updated. Hotel also offers free DVD movies, nice pool and bar area, and is within walking distance to the monorail station.

allReviews.title: An Oasis
allReviews.text: This is a respite from the neon lights; noisy gambling machines; all-you-can-eat foodbars and push-up bra barmaids. This hotel is very close to all of the above, only a block away, but its nice to have a refuge from it after all the indulgences.

allReviews.title: Comfortable Stay
allReviews.text: I needed a simple place for a quick stay in Las Vegas and this worked out perfect! Still close to the strip, but more quiet and quick to go to and from. We had a room with view to the strip. It was clean and the front desk staff was really friendly. The only downside is that our room smelled strong of lemon scented cleaner and it was a bit bothersome. also I wish the bathrooms had extractors. also we requested the staff to change the bedsheets because i spilled something and all they did was bring new sheets and throw them in my bed, so we had to pull the stained sheets and put in the new ones....a bit unprofessional. Other than that, excellent!

allReviews.title: Great place for families!
allReviews.text: The suite we stayed in exceeded our expectations. All basic amenities were provided, room was very clean, pool and spa were great! Despite it being a busy weekend for the hotel in general we were in constant communication with a member of the staff at all times via the handy text feature that’s available. Checkout was also quick in easy using the express checkout option. We’ll definitely stay here again the next time we’re in the area!

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Nice hotel, quiet and family friendly. Walking distance got casinos. Easy to get to and clean.This hotel is very nice, quiet and family friendly. It's easier to check into than the hotels on the strip. Hilton Grand on Paradise is walking distance to several casinos and restaurants and parking is freak and easy as well.

allReviews.title: A great property with huge suites
allReviews.text: Good as always - large 1 bedroom suite with accessible shower - requested & granted.Two very large TV's large kitchen with a number of appliances including dishwasher - but not much crockery.As an RCI exchange only midweek room refresh and as no dryer you have to request extra towels which immediately appear

allReviews.title: Charge upon charge upon charge for expected amenities
allReviews.text: Resort fees for a pool and hot tub are UNACCEPTABLE!!!  These are standard amenties and I resent being charged extra!!!  Additionally, there is NOT A GOOD REASON to charge for parking.  And to top it off, you charged to clean the room!!  Enough of this BS, we will not be returning to your or any location that robs us for visiting!!!

allReviews.title: Great Service and Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations. It is very close to the monorail (making getting to the Strip fast and cheaper than a taxi), has beautiful facilities (especially the pool) and overall nice rooms.The service was also excellent, as even after I checked out they were able to assist me in finding my misplaced passport.I will definitely stay here again if I go back to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Great off-strip location
allReviews.text: This HGVC offering is located off the strip but is near enough that one can stay in touch with the hustle and bustle.  It offers the same types of amenities as the other sites.  But, it lends itself to a more quiet experience if desired.Located near the Westgate Hotel/Resort (home of my favorite Sportsbook) and the LV Convention Center, this place is unique amongst Vegas HGVC spots.  It has free and (usually) plentiful parking and is within walking distance to the Westgate (the former LVH, Las Vegas Hilton) hotel.  While this is an older off-strip location, other than its affinity for Pepsi (instead of Coca-Cola) products, Westgate is working hard to re-vitalize.I visit here, at least once a year - often more.

allReviews.title: When casino hotels get too expensive
allReviews.text: My son and I go out to Vegas every  year for March Madness.  We have always stayed at a casino hotel.  This year the prices were too high so I looked into the Hilton Vacation Resort.  The prices were great, the hotel was great and it was a short work to the casino.  We have already decided to do it again next year

allReviews.title: Vegas Stay
allReviews.text: The resort was very clean. The staff was very friendly and did a nice job of assisting whenever they were needed. I really appreciated the market place on the main floor that was available whenever we needed something of convenience. I would highly recommend this destination.

allReviews.title: Un-accomodating!!!!
allReviews.text: Front desk denied my family entrance to the room I booked online, made them wait for hours. When the lady who denied my family access to the room left my family was given the room by someone else at the front desk. Upon my arrival later on in the evening I went to the front desk to formerly check in and he had locked the room door on us. Horrible check in, horrible customer service and would not accommodate any changes but they sure took my money anyways. Will not book here again.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: The staff were friendly and helpful. Weekly cleaning service was excellent.  Nice amenities including a quiet area, pool, hot tub, and coffee counter.. Provided bottled water on a daily basis. Resort was close to the monorail.

allReviews.title: Disappointed will not visit again
allReviews.text: I will preface my review with this. I spend approximately 200 nights a year in hotel rooms the majority of the time traveling for business. I had fairly high expectations for this hotel I've stayed at other "Resort" Hotels in the past. Arrival: Good size parking lot, small area for check in / temp parking, Room for oversized vehicles as well as covered garage parking.Check-In: At Check-in I requested to extend my stay an additional night (the parking lot was 80% empty) I didn't expect this to be an issue... they informed me they were booked full and could not accommodate my request. upon arrival at my room I found they had placed me in the room closest to the elevator doors. I returned to the lobby and requested a room away from the elevator. They claimed they could not accommodate. Room: Best part of the stay and the only reason this is not a 1 star review, well appointed, spacious and comfortable.Facilities: For a "Resort" hotel I was disappointed it did not have a true restaurant or lounge. The fitness center was clean but had a treadmill that was not functioning.inconsistencies: I was surprised they could not extend my stay for a 2nd night so I checked the Hilton app and found there were in fact rooms available for the extended stay as well as for my current stay. This means they were able to get me a different room away from the elevator and they were able to extend my stay but lied to me and told me they couldn't. When I told them about the inconsistencies during check out, they told me "their system my not show the same available rooms as the app". I have an extremely hard time believe the hotel lobby has less accurate information about their accommodations than my cell phone app. the poor service is why I will not visit again.PS. I am only sending this review because they sent me one of the annoying spam emails requesting my feedback (careful what you ask for).

allReviews.title: Great place to stay!
allReviews.text: We loved staying at this vacation/hotel. The staff were very friendly and the place is beautiful. Our deluxe 1 bedroom was spacious, clean, & comfortable. It was also quiet- we heard minimal hallway noise from our living room and only some helicopter noise from the bedroom. I liked having a separate shower and bathtub which means the shower was more comfortable and I wasn’t hitting my elbows on the wall or shower curtain. It was so convenient to have a full kitchen- we saved our dinner leftovers and ate them for breakfast. Plus we could make eggs and toast or whatever we wanted. It was also nice to have a washer/dryer in our room although we ended up not using it. We also enjoyed the little touches like the free DVD rentals (got to watch very recent movies) and free Evian water daily. The only things that were not perfect were that our room was not cleaned after the first night we stayed (which wasn’t a big deal) and the one morning we went to the cafe/market, it took about 20 minutes to get a cup of drip coffee! Overall, it was a great place to stay (esp with a toddler) close to but without all the hassle of the Strip.

allReviews.title: Great stay at this Hilton grand vacation property
allReviews.text: Great stay at this Hilton grand vacation property!  Hotel staff was very helpful and accommodating. Rooms were updated and clean. Location of this property was near an elevated monorail that’s had several stops to casinos on the strip. Marketplace food area offered many selections.

allReviews.title: Business Travel or Family Fun
allReviews.text: I generally avoid Vacation type hotels when I travel for business.  But, this one was quite different.  The rooms all offered a small kitchen, very useful, other room amenities are what you would expect to find.  Most importantly, it was very quiet.  Great to get work done.

allReviews.title: Perfect for Business Travel
allReviews.text: This property is perfect for business travel. Very quiet and relaxing stay with all the necessary amenities you can think of. I really loved that this location is smoke free and does not have a casino. The king suite was spotless, very roomy and the bed and pillows felt like heaven.

allReviews.title: Fabulous property!
allReviews.text: Love, love this hotel. Great customer service. We rented a one bedroom and it had all the comforts of home; full kitchen with the basic pots n pans, etc. Nice deep tub for soaking away the aches after your day. They offer the Grand Vacations speel, but aren't pushy at all. The employees all seem really happy to work there and it shows! Will definitely stay again. Another plus is you can walk to convention center.

allReviews.title: A Pleasant Surprise
allReviews.text: I've stayed at this property many times over the years and have always liked the consistently clean rooms and friendly staff. Our reception desk person "Alondra" was courteous and professional. Upon entering our suite (1506), I was surprised to see that (at least on our floor) everything had been completely renovated. Pretty much new everything, which gave our suite the look of a luxury apartment. Even the living room carpet had been replaced with upscale ceramic tile. A  same day follow-up text from Alondra asking if everything was to our satisfaction was a nice touch. Indoor parking is an added bonus. I highly recommend this property.

allReviews.title: Impressive - Better Than Expected & Affordable
allReviews.text: I stayed here with my family from 2-27 to 3-4 for the National ATA Taekwondo Tournament. I was very impressed with this Hilton for many reasons:Room: We stayed in a one-bedroom suite on the 4th floor. It was very clean and spacious. It was perfect for our needs. There was a separate bedroom with a very comfortable King bed. There was a living room with a pull out sofa-bed for our son, There a full kitchen and dining area. There was a large bath tub great for soaking after a long day. There was a nice closet and two bathroom sinks with a shower. It was very comfortable and housekeeping kept the room clean. The room was quite and relaxing after long days. Love that there was no casino and it was away from the busy strip. The lobby was also nice and comfortable. This hotel is right next to Westgate and unfortunately was not in walking distance of the Convention Center. Marketplace: This is the only dining option on the property and surprising it was better than expected. It's more like a cafe or a little market rather than restaurant. You can get chips, soda, water as well as prepared dishes like club sandwiches, great cheese fries, pizza, bagels and cream cheese, etc. Everything we ordered was well prepared and considering prices on the strip - it was affordable.  We did not have a view because we were not on the strip but it was worth it. You definitely get more for your buck here. It's cheaper to just get a ride to the strip. We also we did not have a chance to try the pool because it was chilly and we did not have time. The pool was on the smaller side but it did not matter to us for this trip considering our schedule and the climate. We also did not have a chance to try the fitness area. Customer service was good. If I were to come back to Vegas I would definitely consider coming back to this Hilton. I was pleasantly surprised by this property.

allReviews.title: Nice property
allReviews.text: We were very happy with the location, staff, and our room at this property. I would definitely stay here again. As a RCI exchange I am not happy about paying the daily amenity fee but that is not really a reflection on the hotel as much as a downside of the RCI program.

allReviews.title: Affoardable Grand Vacation Place!
allReviews.text: This was my 1st time staying at this property and it is nice hidden little jewel! If you can, stay in a king suite on a high floor. Great layout and good view of the city (at least my room had a great view). The staff was friendly and very helpful. Good spot off the strip with easy access to all your favorite places in Vegas. I would definitley stay here again.

allReviews.title: Good but but very low recognition for loyalty
allReviews.text: I stay at the Grand Vacations a few times a year for conferences as it is fairly convenient to the Las Vegas Convention Center. It’s a good stay very comfortable and clean, but if you’re a good or diamond don’t expect much. There is no breakfast option for Diamond or Gold and the pesky “resort fee” for being able to watch movies, and 2 bottles of water a day annoys me.  Never an upgrade or even a thanks for diamond.Business travelers who are loyal to the brand have earned these benefits.   Why build a hotel in the conference district and run it this way?

allReviews.title: 2 Brothers Vegas trip
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, amenities r great, many places to see. I would advise driving to strip. Thought strip was closer.Rented car from Pay less near airport.Trip was very short, but really glad we visited the Hoover Dam. Great tour, very informative, guides very knowledgeable.

allReviews.title: Off the Strip GEM
allReviews.text: Booked the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise because of the location. Off the strip, within 10 minutes driving. The suite was very spacious and immaculate.. The staff from guest services to housekeeping and in between were extremely friendly and helpful when asked questions. The Market Place was a nice surprise with a variety of supplies needed for a quick breakfast and even late night snacks such as great chicken wings and cold beers. My wife and I had an amazing week here and I know you would also.

allReviews.title: Close to convention center
allReviews.text: Great place close to convention center. Sleep well off the strip. Nice pool. Westgate casino is a 5 mon walk along with the monorail to convention center 1 stop away. Convenient to get to the strip using the monorail or Lyft.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Customer service, room, amenities are excellent. Staff are very helpful, the kitchenette is a plus. Our room was upgarded and really appreciated what was done. We will be back next month with the family

allReviews.title: Weekend away
allReviews.text: Definitely impressed once entered into Lobby the friendly staff Dany was our check in person very nice guy! the market staff don't remember there names but both AM and PM shift where very friendly and helpful.The pool girl didn't get her name but it was AM of 3/2/2019 so sweet and friendly.The cleanliness off public spaces areas clean the room was beautiful and clean no musty damp smells left behind from previous guest which is a HUGE plus....Keep up the good work guys doing an awesome job and I know housekeeping isn't easy especially in a busy city coodos to the housekeeping and maintenance team for keeping the property clean and well maintained!!!!!!! Definitely will be returning and recommending!

allReviews.title: OK place, but you need a car 2 get a round
allReviews.text: This is the only HGV property so far that charges a $25 charge per day stay once you check in, on top of what you have already paid to stay there. Beware, and its Nonrefundable. And there is an Older Homeless Guy that comes different Times of day & night. His song/dance is a different story to hustle you out of $. Don't let him con you. By the time you the Man to go, or get Security, the Old Man is already down the Street. Why Security and Front Desk don't use the Camera Overhead where the Cars pull up to prevent Guest from getting Hassled. I don't know.     The parking garage structure closes early. You can only get into the entrance from the Casino next door.  But you do still have access to the Big Empty Parking lot.     The Discount Coupons you are given are good if you want to go down to "Mile Mall", somewhere near the Venetian I think.    Handicap parking is an issue out front of the door. You can get dropped off the Front Door. But if you are the Driver, You have to walk up an incline or small set of stairs to get up to Front Door after you park the car if you don't make it into the Parking structure entrance by HGV or don't want to drive all the way over to the Casino Entrance to the Parking Structure.   Everybody in HGV was pleasant. Got 2 bottles of water free every morning from front desk. Was not expecting that. That was a nice surprise.

allReviews.title: Loved this Las Vegas hotel!
allReviews.text: The best thing about this hotel is the location if you’re looking to have some relaxation and peace and quiet on your trip. There is no casino on the property so it is a smoke free hotel. This is very appealing to many because it’s hard to escape the smoke in most locations. It is next door to a convention center at the Westgate which has a monorail station. We used Lyft to get around the city fairly easily. All the employees we encountered were friendly and helpful. There is a cafe and store on the 1st floor that has food, beverages, gifts and food to go. We ordered food from here several times and it was reasonably priced and delicious. There is a beautiful outdoor pool and jacuzzi area, but it was too cold for us to use during our trip. Our room had a kitchenette which was very handy for breakfast, snacks, morning coffee and beverages. If I was in the area I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Very Nice and Quiet
allReviews.text: We had a 2 bedroom as part of an RCI exchange.  The units were very nice and clean.  We had everything we might need.  It was great to have a store downstairs that sells coffee, food, groceries, etc.  We didn't use the pool but it looks adequate.  It's not huge, but it seemed fine.  Check in and check out were fast and efficient.  The hotel doesn't have a casino, so it's nice and quiet.  The Westgate Casino is within easy walking distance, so it's convenient for a meal, show, or fun gambling.  The monorail and the Convention Center are also nearby.

allReviews.title: Weekend getaway!
allReviews.text: Great one bedroom suite, very well equipped with full kitchen plus soaking tub! Good view from the upper floor! Amenities were good! Store with Starbucks coffee plus we even had a game of pool! Close to the strip!

allReviews.title: Close to the Strip, easy walk to monorail
allReviews.text: Stayed in a 1BR on 8th floor.  The unit is small but nice. The Hilton Grand  is on the far end of the strip closest to the Stratosphere.  The pool was nice and always had an attendant on duty.  It is heated and outside.  We swam in it several days with temperatures in the 50s.   Check in staff are very accommodating.  Easy for Uber to get in and out of pickup location which is convenient.  The monorail is only a short walk about a block away.  If you are going to the strip, this is the cheapest way to travel as the monorail runs every 7 or 8 minutes.  Check the schedule tho as on certain nights, transportation is only offered until midnight.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: A really great place i was really surprised. Its freaking nice. The room was amazing. We had a really amazing rest there. I was absolutely happy with that stay. They actually had everything you needed to cook and a washer and dryer. Awesome

allReviews.title: An excellent stay
allReviews.text: The staff was very helpful and made our stay very enjoyable. The accommodations are very comfortable and clean. The parking lot could use more handicap spots, but other than that our stay was perfect. We will definitely stay here on our next trip to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best trip ever
allReviews.text: It was a great experience over all. Would definitely return. The staff was great the room was beautiful. Loved all the extras that the room provided. From the extra pillows to the towels we all felt very special.  Thanks you!!

allReviews.title: No better place for the price.
allReviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom suite:  full kitchen, living room, 1 room with 2 queen beds and full bathroom (shower) and the second room with a king bed and a soaker tub and shower.  Super nice.  Nice surprise was a voucher for a free rental movie.

allReviews.title: Awesome Non-Casino Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed in a king suite on the 16th floor with a great view of the Stratosphere. The room was spacious, clean, and nicely updated. I especially loved the two person soaker tub, which appeared to be quite new. The bed was super comfortable with great quality bedding.  The location was a very short walk to the Westgate monorail station, so it was easy to get to the strip. I liked having a quiet non casino hotel to take refuge in after experiencing the busyness of the strip!

allReviews.title: Grand place
allReviews.text: They gave us one bedroom suite which was spacious and comfortable. The kitchen had full-size refrigerator and all appliances, though we did not use them other than making coffee. The building was clean and very secure. The staff was courteous and prompt. This is a great place for a family.

allReviews.title: Pretty good business travel option
allReviews.text: Nice accommodation with all of the usual amenities. Not far from the airport, and roughly 1.25 miles from the Strip. Staff was great and room was nice. Exercise room was closed for remodeling but pool was plenty warm in February.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel!
allReviews.text: Super clean.. great parking.. friendly staff.. always easy to get in and out of this place. Priced perfectly.. and just far away enough from the strip. Stay here 2 times a year and never had any problems!

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Get a way
allReviews.text: This resort is right off the strip off paradise road on e. karen ave.  Easy to get to.  It is further North on the strip so you are away from alot of the larger hotels with casinos, but we took taxi's up to them.  The Monorail is just a stones throw from HGV on E. Karen.  Staff was very friendly and accommodating.  Housekeeping came in on the 4th day and cleaned up, made beds, refreshed towels.  All in all it was a great time.  We were charged $147.oo upon leaving, which was for the $25.00 a day.  If you are not going to be their one day or 2, you let the front desk staff know and they won't  charge you for the days you are gone.  But, I do question a charge of $298.00 by the resort after I had already paid my $239.00 exchange fee.  Will be finding out about this tomorrow.   Internet worked very well.  Our 2 bedroom was very very roomy.  I would stay here again, but I do like to try out different places.

allReviews.title: Winner at Vega
allReviews.text: Access to transportation, Westgate sports book and other points of interest was great.  Guests enjoy free parking, movie kiosk, WiFi and gym.  View of mountains was great. Very happy with my choice of hotel.

allReviews.title: Great vacation because of WONDERFUL Staff
allReviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed this vacation because of the incredible staff and the great facility.  Everyone we met were extraordinarily helpful and many had clearly 'fun' personalities --loved Carlos and his sense of humor.  The bell staff, concierge, front desk and the snack bar folk were all great.  The facility was very clean and comfortable; the rooms well stocked and all of the equipment in great condition.  The beds could have been more comfortable but didn't detract from the overall experience.  We enjoyed our stay and all of the recommendations from the staff.

allReviews.title: Excellent Accomodations for my Family Business Trip
allReviews.text: The two bedroom setup was perfect for my family during our business trip to Las Vegas in January 2019.  Loved the quality of the rooms and the service provided by the staff. We will definitely be returning.

allReviews.title: Repeat Satisfied Customer
allReviews.text: This is my fourth stay at a Hilton Grand Vacation property, and my second at this particular location. I will definitely use it again. One of my favorite things about this location is that it is far enough away from the strip to be peaceful (I travel for business), but within walking distance of a tram location, so I can be on the strip in minutes.

allReviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
allReviews.text: The hotel is very nice and seemed to be well maintained. We had an adjoining room with our grandparents so having a full kitchen was really nice. This was a surprise trip for my husband's birthday with his grandparents being surprise guests! The staff did such an amazing job of helping pull it off and were also so gracious as to have a bottle of wine, balloons and a card in the room waiting for him when we got up there! The little market cafe also has some of the sweetest and nicest ladies working there. The food offerings were good, tasted great (the pizza was awesome) and very reasonably priced. I would recommend anyone to stay here as it is just off the strip (so more peaceful) and right next to a Monorail stop.

allReviews.title: Awesome Hotel!!
allReviews.text: I rarely feel the need to share a review but I had to brag on this hotel. The front desk check in was prompt and efficient, even checking on us after we got to the room to verify we had everything we needed.  The location is great and the hotel itself was updated, clean, with modern amenities. There is a wonderful cafe/store that served deli style food, that was delicious and convenient with friendly staff.The housekeeping was THE most impressive! I must say they blew me away with the attention to detail and pride the took with making everything sparkle. I’m a clean freak and they really impressed me. The bedding and linens were so comfortable AND the AC was nice and cold! We enjoyed our time at this hotel. We extended our stay an extra day. Thank you Hilton Paradise, you guys knocked it out of the park!

allReviews.title: No Breakfast.
allReviews.text: I was disappointed to find out that the hotel didn't offer breakfast. A shop was available and no cash was accepted as payment.They ask for ID everywhere you go and pay with a credit card, even if you spend U$ 5.00 or less; for those living in the UK can be a problem; we don"t have any kind of ID and carrying a passport everywhere is not really a good idea. I don't know if there is a different rule that applies to the State of Nevada.

allReviews.title: WOC convention stay
allReviews.text: Another good stay at this location while I went to the World of Concrete Convention.  Rooms were clean. Water was not always super hot in the morning but overall the experience was good and I would return again.

allReviews.title: Little Gem
allReviews.text: Small and no casino . Perfect . N end of strip . Great view of Stratosphere . Have stayed here 10 times Parking is difficult since Westgate owns all the adjacent parking . No big deal . We adapted . If you want easy access with no casino this facility is great

allReviews.title: Convenient location
allReviews.text: We stayed here for a week and absolutely loved it! The suite was spacious. The bathtub was the biggest I have ever encountered. The kitchen offered up all the home amenities like toaster and coffee machine. We had a washer and dryer in the room which made laundry so convenient. There is a heated outdoor pool that was busy even when the weather wasn't the best. There is a cafe where you can purchase food. Lyft and Uber found us easily even though we were off the strip. The monorail is right in front if you choose this method of transportation. The parking was free. The wifi was fast. You can access dvd's in the lobby. Our room was cleaned 2 x during our stay.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay
allReviews.text: Very convenient off strip location in Vegas. Close proximity to the airports as well as the strip & dowtown attractions.  Well appointed, comfortable guest room. Staff was helpful & friendly. Quiet stay!

allReviews.title: Excellent stay, quite and a away from the strip but close enough to join in when you want to.
allReviews.text: Love this hotel, clean, safe and great amenities.  The staff is always so friendly and ready to go out of their way to be helpful. Wonderful little market with great quality and variety of food choices. Suites are roomy to spread out and work or relax.  Have stayed here a few times and will be back again.

allReviews.title: Bad service
allReviews.text: Where do I start, first let me say me and my spouse are RCI member. It was our anniversary and both our first time in Vegas. When I went to check in I couldn't for some strange reason. The lady at the front desk was being so rude like she was aggravated and frustrated about something. remind you I'm checking late night. I'm steady asking her why I can't check in she telling me because the other party is not with you and you not on the reservations. I'm like ma'ma I made the reservation this is me this is my spouse who else could have made it. Make a long story short after waiting a hour in the lobby going back and forth with her and some manager she finally said she's sorry she was looking at the wrong thing and make a mistake. Once I got in a room the room was nice but the service was bad I had to pay for little packs of ketchup when I order something from the restaurant downstairs they wouldn't give me towels after I use the other ones things was crazy. Every time I ask them to do something they took they time do it. They didn't have to clean my room because I did it I had to sign on the door.  I just would never go there again. I have made a complaint not once have anyone call me back as a follow up to apologize or nothing. Not to mention I booked for 7 days and stay only 4 because of the service. The reason why I'm writing it now because it's time for us to take another trip and they Hotel came up won't happen again. Poor management

allReviews.title: Vegas
allReviews.text: Clean, lovely rooms, & pool area. Have a resort charge for each day ( adds up!). Bit of a hike to Vegas Blvd to catch the bus. Quiet resort. Lots of families there. Snack bar is bit expensive, Desk staff were very friendly

allReviews.title: Shhh! Geat Off Strip, Near to the Scene Suite Hotel
allReviews.text: Don't want the hassle of being on the strip but want to be near by? The Hilton is the spot convienently located a walk or taxi ride away from main strip, a casio right next door, a few minutes walk from Convention Centre and big name hotels and star restaurants across the street. Limited cleaning service (once a week, all staff were pleasant. All in a nice quite comforts of home suite hotel, probably shouldn't even be telling you all!

allReviews.title: Pleasant Surprise
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at this property. We loved the off strip location and ease of parking without the constant waiting and searching for an open space. The rooms are beautiful with a modern vibe in teal and cream tones. The front desk team was very professional and helpful. The business center and “common” room are nice with plenty of space. We will definitely return to this property on our next visit. The only downside, we could hear the kid above us running and jumping.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and Clean Accommodations
allReviews.text: Spent a week here in December during NFR and experienced a comfortable and enjoyable stay.  The rooms appear to have been updated recently.  The bed was comfortable and the kitchen was well appointed.  Hilton does a good job with their HGV locations.  The only drawback with this location is that it is difficult to walk to the strip.  Fortunately, the monorail is nearby and has a station at the Westgate that takes you to the strip.

allReviews.title: Welcoming 2019 in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The location is  convenient to get around by monorail in addition to other modes of transportation such as Uber, Lyft etc. Has excellent deli at the grounds. Extremely well maintained, with great staff

allReviews.title: Clean Property, No Honors Benefits, Would Not Return
allReviews.text: It was very clear and disappointing there are no Hilton Honors benefits.  (We did get 2 bottles of water.) A few years ago when we stayed at this same hotel, there was at least a breakfast benefit - now, there is nothing.  Very disappointing.  This was also a slow evening with many upgradable rooms available (per front desk person).  We were only there 1 night and a 1 level upgrade would have been appreciated with the 4 people in our party.  We were offered an upgraded room, but for more than what I could have booked myself online and more than the upgrade offer online - was almost comical.  The fact that no Honors benefits were acknowledged and almost scuffed at, was pretty disappointing.  I believe this is all due to the fact that this property is a "Hilton Grand Vacations" property - I believe a timeshare property.  But why Honors benefits can't be honored is disappointing - they could be honored if it was a priority.It's my experience that with all Hilton hotels you can now check-in online and select your room - something I've done dozens of times at other locations.  However this property had no online check-in. The towels in the room were really the worst I've ever had.  Not exaggerating - drying off with the towels hurt my face and body - was kind of like drying off using sand paper.  The toilet would run about once every 5 minutes for about 8 seconds.  The water out of the shower head came out very slowly.  No pressure at all.  I have very short hair - took ridiculous amount of time to get my hair wet.  The room was clean however and the property looked to be in good condition.  We had a 1 bedroom suite and the room size was a very good size.  2 people slept on the pullout couch bed and said it was better than average.  There were 2 large lounges with pool tables and other fun things to play/do.  The pool was not huge but still good size - but it was winter so we did not use it.However the whole experience left me disappointed and everything I experienced gave me no reason to want to return.  If you want any Hilton Honors benefits or expect any typical Honors experience, you will get none here.  But our room was clean and was not dated.  Depending on your priorities, this could be a good or bad property for you.

allReviews.title: Great service from counter staff and excellent rooms
allReviews.text: Stayed at the HGV on Paradise early December … the check-in staff were fantastic, quickly helping us out after a long 7 hour drive … realize we live in Sgp so a 7 hr drive is almost 4 times round our island :-)Rooms were generally clean and the hotel is great for families … if you want to party to the early hours, then this is not what you're looking for.Parking was plenty and free (can't say that for many other places in Vegas).Would definitely return

allReviews.title: Great home away from home, close to the strip
allReviews.text: A very short drive from the strip. Close to many restaurants, groceries etc. Excellent staff. Comfortable beddings. Clean facilities. Has a small fitness facility, adequate business center, convenient marketplace that has variety of snacks, quick eats and Starbucks coffee.

allReviews.title: business
allReviews.text: Great prices and great rooms.  The staff is amazing and very helpful. Having monorail within walking distance was very helpful as well. I really enjoyed the free DVD rental while I was there as well. This is great if you have kids.

allReviews.title: HGVC on Paradise
allReviews.text: This HGVC property is off the LV Strip and quiet (a plus). If you are looking for a LV Casino / Resort experience, this is not your place. This is more along the line of Hilton's Homewood Suites without the breakfast. This is a great place if you are using LV as take-off point for the Grand Canyon, Hoover Dam, etc.

allReviews.title: Casino-Free environment, next to tram line
allReviews.text: The room is a one bedroom suite  completed with kitchen and washer dryer.  Nice location within walking distance to tram station. There is no restaurant in the premises but we can walk to Westgate hotel next door. The small supermarket is a nice one. The good thing is there is no casino in the hotel, so we don't have to put up with smoking environment. The fitness, however,  is too small.

allReviews.title: Christmas in sin city-and Nick  not the Santa was the Grinch
allReviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacations Las Vegas December 25, 2018Nick at the front desk can benefit from some attitude adjustment while I explain the status that I have with Hilton Honors as Gold and one category up upgrade over the phone with customer service ... sarcasm with “they who is they” doesn’t help for someone carrying an infant and after 7 hours of driving. It just killed the kindest of services rendered by Jason from security, Carlos, Le Anne Myra, Dany and Colleen. Over all the design was efficient. The kitchen floor towards the bathroom is natural stone, while it was pleasing to the eyes and not slippery, it was easy to attract dirt. The upgrade in the bathroom mirror with backlight is pleasing to the eyes. We can utilize more electrical outlets in the living room on both sides of the sleeper sofa. It is currently occupied by phone and lampshades... leaving no spots to plug your cell or tablets  The tesla chargers are very convenient in the parking garage. There was a leaking gutter in the garage that left severe water marks in my car.   Will plan on returning again since majority of the services and experiences was great, will refuse to speak with Nicholas in the front desk, that ruined our Christmas The two hour delay with regards to our request for paper towels and dish washing liquid soap is really forgivable compared to the bad experience with Nicholas who made this for you that we are the third class citizens. We came in clean, properly dressed in Montcler, well shaven and we are highly educated with double masters degree, we speak English as primary language and certainly spoke respectfully. But the  constant rhetoric of Nick made us feel closer to rotten garbage. The property is convenient with regards to the location of the next monorail.

allReviews.title: Vegas vacation
allReviews.text: Great and friendly home environment at the hotel the front desk to every staff I met was very friendly and helpful. I am quite satisfied and will definitely recommend to friends and family. The main level layout was well organized.

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: Stayed 4 nights and was charged 70.00 house, keeping and $25.00 a day. These extra charges should be included in the booking.  Have never been charged this in the 16 years we have had this timeshare. Certainly fell that your greed took away from the hotel. Would not recommend this Hotel or location at all. . Money grab

allReviews.title: A beautiful place
allReviews.text: Check in was quick and easy.  Free parking, they have a lot or parkade. There are 2 spacious common areas one with a pool table, also a store/deli where you can get pizza, sandwiches and other necessities.  The room is spacious and perfect for our needs.  We will come back.

allReviews.title: Nice place but expensive
allReviews.text: The resort itself is very clean, nice rooms, decent location as far as access to places, but don't walk around outside at night. lots of homeless and beggars nearby. Also very disappointed in the $200 in resort fees for the week, that is for the 14 bottles of water that they give you at a rate of 2 a day and for the wifi that almost no one uses. For the money, the water could at least be in the fridge already. but instead, they do have 2 bottles of water in the room in case you get thirsty at $6 a bottle. the concierge can sell you show tickets and stuff, but again after the fees, you might as well just go to the box office. It is a nice place to stay, but for the money spent it better be, no value to be seen here. Also the A/C in the units have motion sensor thermostats. so every time you leave room for the day, the air automatically goes to 75.

allReviews.title: Trip 12/2018
allReviews.text: This property was just what we were looking for close to cowboy Christmas easy parking helpful staff,clean,just a great experience. Will go back to this location on our next trip..we did not use the pool,however did look at it and in the summer of with children would use, they did have a lifeguard on duty

allReviews.title: Nice place.
allReviews.text: Everything was really nice. It’s just a ways from the action but we used Lyft and it was quick. I’m just unimpressed with the timeshare scam. $25 resort fee per day for 2 bottles of water that you have to stop at the front desk and get. The 2 in your room are extra!

allReviews.title: December Vacation 2018
allReviews.text: Rooms were clean, fully equipped with everything we needed in kitchen (full kitchen), washer and dryer, King master suite with garden tub, separate bathroom with stand up shower. Living room had a full size pull out sofa. Staff was extremely accommodating. I would definitely use this hotel again. Plus it’s a close to monorail.

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel far enough from crowds
allReviews.text: Excellent location at walking distance to a Las Vegas monorail station.Regular hotel lobby with no casino and no noise.Nice rooms Starbucks and small basics food market.Free outside parking.Perfect for business travellers looking for rest after a busy day.

allReviews.title: Nice place
allReviews.text: Enjoyed this vacation. Located close to the monorail. Rooms were clean, nice living room and kitchen. The Market place has delicious breakfast.The beds were comfortable.  Staff was friendly I would recommend.

allReviews.title: A Gem Property Out of the LV Strip
allReviews.text: As soon as me and my 2 girlfriends walked in our Hilton Paradise Resort room , we were caught by surprise by the view of our upper level accommodation. The view was breath-taking. Even if the Resort was not exactly along the Strip, we were happy about what we were seeing. We did not rent a car, so the convenience to the Monorail, which was about a 5 minute walk , made HGVC o Paradise a best choice. We didn't want to be along The Strip because of the noise, but at the same time, we didn't want to be too far from where the action is. The room, facilities available, courtesy of Resort staff, cleanliness, proximity of the resort to public transportation, made our vacation a truly memorable one. There was only one downside, the Wi-Fi was very slow. But overall,  we will not hesitate to recommendthis Hilton property to our family and friends.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Full kitchen,great hot tub, clean property with helpful staff, quiet location.  Easy in and out, close to convention center and monorail.  Great supplies and kitchen wares.  Would definitely consider going here again

allReviews.title: Satisfied Customer
allReviews.text: My stay was relaxing. I only wished the facility had more of a variety of items at their Market Place. The prices were extremely high, also. The gym was nice but small. The lounge/business center area was very comfortable with sofa, chairs and access to a TV.

allReviews.title: Be aware of this scammers
allReviews.text: I was contacted by phone on what I thought was an Honors Members offer, this is a shared time. The hotel room was really small and far away from the strip, I could pick the hotels I wanted and since I didn’t attend to their meeting they charged me 3 times the cost of a normal room in Vegas. Stay away from this type of offers!!!

allReviews.title: Convenience
allReviews.text: The property is not on the strip however I found it very convenient transportation wisely as it is close to the train, and about 2 block from the trip. The stratosphere was in view. And if you drive it very close to the interstate. My drive back to the airport was directly on paradise or interstate 15.  The room were cozy and clean. The staff was very accommodating.

allReviews.title: A really nice place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a week while attending the SEMA convention in October/November.  I expected our room to be nice but it was better than nice as we ended up with a complete apartment with virtually all the comforts of home!  We ate breakfast in our room each day because there was a full kitchen and we had lunch in our room a few times too, reheating food in the microwave.  We were on the 16th floor and we could see a lot of the area from our windows, though not the strip because we were not near there although we were a short walk to the monorail which took us anywhere we wanted to go in the downtown area.  The bed was comfortable and there was a tv in both the living room and bedroom.  The bathroom was large and had a great shower.  Between the bathroom and bedroom there was a dressing room area with a large bathtub. There was a washer and dryer in a closet area and a dishwasher in the kitchen.  Dishwash detergent and laundry detergent were supplied as well as paper towels, etc. There is a small store downstairs where you can buy food items including frozen things.  Also a business room with computers and printers so i was able to print our boarding passes for our trip home.  We could have gotten free movies to borrow too although we never did.  We parked for free in the large parking garage next to the hotel.  There is an outdoor pool but it wasn't really pool weather as it was only hot the first day we were there.  There is no restaurant but there is an outdoor bar which seemed popular.  All in all we enjoyed our stay there and would stay there again

allReviews.title: Thanksgiving at HGV Paradise in Vegas
allReviews.text: The rooms are very comfortable and everything you need is in them.  We cooked breakfast in the room every day.  I prefer to stay in places not attached to a casino.  The pool was heated and the hot tub was great.  We also got a pass for free movie rentals which we took advantage of.  It was a very enjoyable trip.

allReviews.title: Watch out for costs that give you little for your money
allReviews.text: This was a very disappointing location. The additional costs were not worth the fee, the location was not attractive and only convenient if you were going to the convention center. I would not recommend this for a family vacation. Fine for business only.

allReviews.title: Great Value and Property
allReviews.text: Easy off the strip location, not connected to a smokey casino. Convenient to the convention center. Full kitchen with dishwasher, plus washer and dryer. Lovely tub and comfortable bed. Loved the unlimited DVD rental.

allReviews.title: Best place to stay off but near the strip
allReviews.text: HGVC is a great to stay at.  No loud casino to walk through each time you want to leave.  Parking is free and close to entrance. Easy to drive the back streets to get where you want to get to with out driving on the strip

allReviews.title: Nice Quiet stay
allReviews.text: Enjoyed a week at a trade show convention with the help of Hilton. Pleasant and friendly staff. Quiet rooms. Many amenities. Hot tub closes at 8pm. Convention ended at 6, then dinner, so never had the chance to soak my sore legs. Would have been nice to have been able to use it after 8. A 10pm closing would’ve been nice.

allReviews.title: Easy-going
allReviews.text: We wanted a how would I put it "less chaotic" hotel in Vegas. You know paying for parking and having to walk through a crowded lobby to get to the front desk. Then finding the right elevator to your room walking several hallways to finally find your small stinky room. Well this was none of that. Parking was free and with a quick walk to the front desk where Carlos was super helpful. Got to our amazing upgraded suite . I didn't mind that this was a non gaming  hotel. I wanted it that way. The metro was really close and Westgate was right across a parking structure. This hotel has so many amenities too long to list. I would happily stay here again anytime I'm in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Off strip, close to tram, quiet
allReviews.text: My first time staying at a Grand Vacations resort but as I was there for work I didn't really see what made it a vacation resort.  I choose the property for accessibility to the shuttle tram and off the strip. Area and room were quiet. The rooms have a small table instead of a desk so working is not as conducive as other Hilton hotels. If I were on vacation I would not call the property a grand vacation. The room did have kitchenette with a mini fridge, microwave, kitchen sink, toaster, and dishes for two.  A daily resort fee of $25.00 is charged but I am not sure what you get for the money besides DVD rentals. There is not a restaurant on site but a convenience store with a small deli.  One average size swimming pool, a larger than average sized business area, a small lobby, and a larger than average sized area with tables occupy the first floor. The decor seemed more sterile than grand vacation inspiring.  Stayed on the 16th floor with a view of the parking lot, the tram, and neighboring hotel. Basic service you expect, clean, comfortable, secure, efficient, convenient.  Not much vacation experience witnessed.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
allReviews.text: Great location, nice clean quiet and secure resort with large pool and hot tub, good deli with indoor/outdoor seating. Free DVD rentals and discount card for shows, bars, restaurants. Very friendly engaging staff. 4 minute walk to the adjacent Westgate casino resort and tourist monorail to the strip. $12 taxi ride to the North Premium outlets or the strip (ie Fashion Show mall). Planning next years return (happy wife, happy life) !

allReviews.title: Skip it and go to another Hilton
allReviews.text: The cafe onsite was always under staffed, and breakfast was impossible to get quick. And it wasn’t very good.  They give tickets to rent dvds for movies, and only have so many (so couldnt watch movies I wanted to see during the three day stay). Expect more when you travel to Vegas, and skip the hotel. Other Hilton’s are way more worth the price, with better amenities.

allReviews.title: good location off strip
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a convenient location (close to the strip, outlets and airport) with easy access to the surrounding Las Vegas areas choose this hotel. There is a monorail stop near the hotel  and you can leave the car at a nearby multi storey parking. we never had issue finding a space. The room was clean and had everything required for the stay (incl. basic body wash, shampoo etc). There was no kettle in the room (which had a kitchenette) which was slightly disappointing. Also, the walls are thin and you can hear other guests in the adjoining rooms. Staff very friendly. Check in and check out was efficient. For breakfast, I would recommend driving a few miles away as there are plenty choices (eg. nearer the south outlets). There is a small pool, gym, shop at the hotel - we did not visit it. The hotel does not have a Hilton feel (we stayed in a few of their hotels elsewhere in the world) however   overall it is a good accommodation and I would not hesitate to recommend it.

allReviews.title: Solo Stay
allReviews.text: My stay started out to be one to include 2 additional people butMy solo stay was great.  The HGV at Paradise have great accommodations and I found the staff to be friendly and helpful.  It’s near the monorail which is great for going to the strip.  I would definitely stay there again.

allReviews.title: Stay at Paradise
allReviews.text: Great stay but the added RCI costs exceed the value now. My comments on the newly raised costs by RCI are on the previous pages comments.  I do not approve of the added housekeeping $42 charge or the $25 per day plus taxes being added on to my bill.  I bought my Hilton Grand Vacation and utilize the RCI points exchange 20 years ago to cut my hotel costs when staying at locations.  The new RCI costs do not make it a convenience to be a property owner any longer.

allReviews.title: Good stay during SEMA show
allReviews.text: If you have anything going on at the convention center this is the perfect location. It's walking distance to convention center, walking distance to monorail to connect to strip.The place is CLEAN and SMOKE FREE!!!  And after a full day at convention center to me the best part is that is a quiet and secure hotel.  You must have a room key to get to any floor.  At night we slept with no issues.  No noise from neighbors, no noise from outside.   They did an excellent job sound proofing the room.

allReviews.title: Great Sema week
allReviews.text: The staff and management were outstanding! the rooms were always nice and very clean! Stayed 10 days in a suite overlooking the pool and sema action! Amenities were just right for a comfortable stay. Monorail was close so we didn't have to walk too much!

allReviews.title: Classy and convenient.
allReviews.text: A four star hotel with great staff and very comfortable rooms.  Close by to the monorail and all the Strip has to offer without all the hustle and bustle.  Very fairly priced, too. Our room was kept spotless by very efficient room service, front desk staff helpful and friendly but a bit overbusy at rush times and the wait can be over 10 minutes to get your two complimentary bottles of water daily.  Moving that job to the underworked concierge desk would be a good move.

allReviews.title: Great Stay at Hilton Grand Vacations
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this Las Vegas property on numerous occasions, for both business and personal travel. Hilton staff is guest-friendly, suites have been recently renovated and are extremely comfortable and accommodating.

allReviews.title: Not a good stay!
allReviews.text: Resort is not kept like their other resorts. Not clean around pool area. Rooms are nice but could be cleaner. We had no hot water for two days and the resort took hours before resolving the problem. They charge an extra $25 a day for their amenities, what amenities?

allReviews.title: Great experience!
allReviews.text: A little off the strip but definitely worth it, super clean rooms @ a good rate. Highly recommend it! Service was great! Beats the run down room offered on the strip for half the cost. Family friendly.

allReviews.title: nice location close to the tram no casino on location
allReviews.text: nice hotel.  rooms were very nice, furniture was really nice.  it was a quiet place and no night life without a 200 yard walk next door, which is also where you catch the tram all over.  We enjoyed it and it made it handy to stay here while we were there I was on business.

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel, best placed I have stayed for a long time
allReviews.text: I often stay at Hotels, and from a room and comfort perspective this one the best. Only stayed for one night.  Room was clean and had everying I needed and much more. It so good I didn't want to leave it. I had a One Bedroom Suite which was perfect. Staff were professional, and stay was straight forward without problem.

allReviews.title: Not worth it if you are a Hilton Gold Rewards member
allReviews.text: Don't bother staying here if you are a Hilton Gold Rewards Member. You don't get any of the benefits that your membership allows no late check out, no breakfast, etc. And their customer service was terrible! Avoid this place at all costs.

allReviews.title: The one bedroom suite
allReviews.text: The one bedroom suite is 10 times better than the single queen bed.   The single queen bedroom is small.  The one bedroom suite had a living room,  full kitchen,  bathroom with huge tub.  The walls are super thin.   It's about an 8-16 dollar Uber ride to the strip.   You're a few blocks from the convention center.   I felt safe because you needed a key card to get the elevator to move.  There is a little coffee shop with snacks and a small store in the hotel.   I didn't see a restaurant.   The pool was tiny.   They had a pool table and DVDs that you could rent (like a redbox) with new selections.

allReviews.title: Great stay on Paradise
allReviews.text: Awesome staff and nice facility off the main strip.  You can catch the monorail at the Westgate next door. There are some restaurants and a Walgreens within walking distance. We also walked over to the Stratophere, took about 10 mins. No complaints and we would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Consistent and nicw place to return to.
allReviews.text: The property was very nice. The Bell staff has been around for a while and it was Nice to be remembered. The rooms were updated and the design was a clensharp interior. It was a great place to visit with friends!

allReviews.title: AWESOME place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: This is a great location, close to Monorail, easy parking! The suites are amazing and even had a washer & dryer which was great to take home clean clothes. The bed was incredibly comfortable! Quiet! Will stay here every time we come to Vegas.

allReviews.title: STICK AROUND
allReviews.text: This Place is the kind of resort that will relax you, keep the doors open we will be back !!!!!!!!! The Resort should be rated " MAKE THIS AN EXAMPLE" The staff is the most friendly and helpful in any way

allReviews.title: Nice resort in a good location
allReviews.text: This is a very nice resort! We were there celebrating my wifes' 60th birthday and had a great time. Our 1 BR unit was clean and well furnished, nice pool area, workout room and common areas. There is no restaurant but there is a little market that is convenient but overpriced. There is a bar next to the pool that is open in the afternoon-early evening. The Westgate casino and LV monorail is right next door. We liked that it was off the strip. The only caveat is the $25/day "resort fee" that gets you 2 bottles of water/day, wifi, free parking and free DVD rentals but I guess that is common among Vegas resorts these days. Overall I would return here and would recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: Very clean and modern facility
allReviews.text: This property was very clean, smoke free, modern, and packed with amenities.  The location was within minutes of all attractions in Las Vegas.  The staff was super friendly and helpful also.  I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Dany helped to take care of mistakes.
allReviews.text: We want to thank Dany Rodas for not only getting the double room charge removed from our credit card but for thanking us for staying at the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise.  Thank you again, Dany Rodas!We originally wrote this review but replaced it with the review above: "We were lied to on the telephone regarding the location of hotel, we were lied to about cost of two night stay, Hilton charged our credit card twice and got an attitude when I ask them to remove one charge. It still is not removed so I will have to call the Citi Bank to straighten out the double charge. We will try to avoid Hiltons in the future."

allReviews.title: Decent hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel is a time share property that also operates as a standard hotel.  My company booked us here due to a trade show at the convention centre which is an easy walk away.  The rooms at this hotel are standard Hilton and I had no complaints except for poor in room coffee from a beat up old coffeemaker.  The hotel is located in a dead zone with not much around except for the Westgate hotel next door where there are numerous restaurants and a decent casino with a bar.  Uber is required to get to and from The Strip.  I think I will request a room on The Strip next time.

allReviews.title: Average
allReviews.text: The studio room was a bit small in space. I was also surprised that this Hilton Hotel/Resort did not have an on-site restaurant. The location of this property is close to the Las Vegas monorail system which will take you to many of the casino resorts and restaurants.

allReviews.title: Decent Living in Vegas
allReviews.text: This was a nice Hilton property but a bit aways from the Strip. Thanks to Uber, we were able to get around town.The only problem? There was no restaurant attached to the Hotel. Overall, a decent property.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay, just off the strip.
allReviews.text: The suites were very clean and well maintained.   The resort had plenty of ammenaties and the pool was great.  I would highly suggest this resort for families or couples.  Restaurants,  shopping,  and grocery stores were all within a short walk or drive.  The tram stop nearby makes getting around a breeze.

allReviews.title: Great property!
allReviews.text: This is a top notch property, excellent location, short (3 min.) walk to the Westgate casino/hotel and monorail station. I was treated very well by all the staff I dealt with and the accommodations were excellent and spotlessly clean.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacation Club
