allReviews.text: This was a wonderful place. We had a two bedroom and it allowed us to cook our dinners. The staff was great and efficient and helpful. Very close to the strip and airport. The pool was nice and clean and they had an area for check email with free printing if needed.

allReviews.title: Very average in a town full of above average hotels
allReviews.text: There was nothing terribly wrong with this place but it is very average with lots of little issues.  I only stayed one night on business so I wasn’t that bothered but if I had come to Vegas for pleasure and wanted a great vacation hotel I would have been annoyed.  The pool is very underwhelming and the hangout areas the same.  The biggest problem I experienced was with noise.  The sound barrier between rooms was so poor that when his alarm went off at 5 AM in the morning I actually thought it was mine.  I could also understand most of his lengthy and loud conversation.  Other annoyances was the fact that the USB Charging port on the lamp didn’t work, there only one accessible plug, the left two body lotions instead of a conditioner, and there was no desk.  The Bed was very comfortable and the staff I interacted with were professional and did a good job.

allReviews.title: Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice clean place to stay in Vegas if you have a car.  New, stylish furnishings. Handy parking.  Helpful staff.  Dai!y resort fee added.  A little hard to find at first.  Look for small, low sign in greenery.

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: so pleased clean beautiful, off the beaten path, great for relaxation, took the Tram for transportation two minutes away, in five minuted we were on the Vagas strip, very convenient. Loved the pool, suite private bedroom, private sunken tub, shower double  sink vanity. kitchen and living room. loved it. everyone was so helpful.

allReviews.title: Noise issues
allReviews.text: I was assigned a room across from the ice machine that HUMMED all the time!  The refrigerator in the room also was noisy and thumped when the cooling cycle turned off.  Could hear outside vehicle traffic and guests/staff talking outside of room.  Did not sleep well.  I was not asked if I had any preferences for room location when checking in.  I think front-desk personnel should have asked.

allReviews.title: Great if You’re Going to The Conference Center
allReviews.text: I stayed here while I attended a conference at the Las Vegas Convention Center about a half mile away. The hotel was clean, quiet and free of smoke and gambling. It was a nice alternative to the other hotels on the strip.

allReviews.title: Layover
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel and relaxing pool area. Rooms have full kitchens, hotel has great amenities with a full market that has not sandwiches, salads and many other items. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Near the strip.

allReviews.title: Great value
allReviews.text: We were there for 5 days and it was everything we need and want ,,  5 minutes from town jump on the monorail you're there,, the hotel its modern and the employees are friendly and welcoming,, Carlos at the front desk very helpful and knowledgeable about Vegas,, thank you very much for a great vacations

allReviews.title: Our Go-To Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I am allergic to cigarette smoke as it triggers my asthma, so I try to stay away from the Hotel Casinos, except Palazzo and Venetian. I discovered this hotel which is a non-gaming hotel and we’ve gone here and the one on the strip, whenever we go to Vegas with family. We love the fact that their suites are equipped with a complete kitchen with full size refrigerator, microwave and all utensils needed, including a dishwasher. They also have a washer and dryer. Very spacious and clean; very good service and free parking at this location. They keep increasing their rates, though, but we still would rather go there than anywhere.

allReviews.title: HH Vacation Pkg
allReviews.text: This was a false marketing sales. They sold you the pkg but they didn't tell me that I have to attend a Time Share sales meeting. They aid I received an email which wasn't part of the verbal sales pitch. If you don't attend Hilton will charge you more for the room rates and extra fees too.

allReviews.title: 6 Girls out in Vegas!
allReviews.text: I don't think one of us girls have any complaints about the resort.  The staff were so lfriendly and accomodated us VERY quickly for all our needs.  That goes for the front desk, the concierge, housekeeping and everyone there.   All of our wants and needs were met.   Very convenient to the monorail, but for everything else you need to either walk a fair distance of cab it.  We did walk from the hotel to the Fashion Mall so it is doable. About 45 minutes.  I brought these friends and was pleasantly pleased with the resort I picked!

allReviews.title: Gets better and better
allReviews.text: We always stay at this hotel every time we visit Vegas as it provides us with the accommodation we want plus is not on the strip but very near a monorail station so it is easy to get anywhere. It also has a huge free car park which makes it even better. The rooms have all been upgraded as have the entrance and other bits of the Hôtel so it just gets better and better and for the price it is real value for money. A little home from home for us.

allReviews.title: andrea myrick
allReviews.text: the bar was always closed when we went down, the gym was small and equipment didnt work. They really need a shuttle to get from airport to resort and to the strip. We had to Lyft or uber everywhere we went.

allReviews.title: Wonderful place to stay but not in adjoining rooms!
allReviews.text: I stayed at this hotel over a weekend in September.  I wanted a non-gaming hotel with a kitchen and a pool and this hotel did not disappoint.  It is clean and while off the strip, definitely within walking or Uber distance.  If you bring a car, the parking is ample, free and seems pretty safe.  The reception staff were really wonderful and send you texts through the day to make sure you are okay, give you hints on check out, ask if you would like your receipt emailed.  There is an amply stocked deli-grocery with hot and cold foods.  There is a poolside bar.   The pool is small but fine, very clean with plenty of towels and comfortable lounge chairs.  My only problem was I was in an adjoining room and could hear EVERYTHING in the room next door.  When the neighbors got WAY too loud, I contacted the desk who sent someone up right away..  Even so, I had to wear headphones not to hear the conversation in the next room.  In the hotel's defense, they offered to move me to another room but I hoped that it would be quiter the next day.  I would just suggest that, if you have the option, don't take one of the adjoining rooms.  Otherwise, the price was great, the staff was great, the place is clean and safe and new looking.

allReviews.title: One Night Stay
allReviews.text: The staff allowed us to check out late which was key after arriving really early in the morning the prior day. I would highly recommend this hotel because albeit not on the strip it is centrally located so access to different hotels were easy.

allReviews.title: weekend getaway
allReviews.text: fun Vegas getaway had a blast, love staying at this hotel . First time staying here will be back for sure . Staff is very helpful and friendly . The rooms are so nice and a perfect location . A great place to stay

allReviews.title: JLO
allReviews.text: Location bit far but with Monorail at the Westgate next door very convenient, no need for car rental.  Uber also convenient!! Staff very hospitable and quick when asking for supplies!! Water provided free every day, which came in handy

allReviews.title: Wonderful vacation location
allReviews.text: The resort has many of the necessities that you want when away from home.  the resort has an updated look and the suites are very nice.  Since it is in Las Vegas, not having to pay for parking was an added benefit,

allReviews.title: Excellent Service
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, not too far from the Strip. Staff is very friendly and Professional. I was able to check in a little early with out having to notify the front desk. I had requested for a good view and the hotel did not disappoint.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise
allReviews.text: Nice place to stay to get some quiet away from the strip but close enough to get to the strip when you want to get there. Food services and coffee was convenient and good.  Very comfortable stay and was actually able to get some work done and some sleep.

allReviews.title: great value
allReviews.text: Great Value.  The only thing is no food or beverage after 10 so dont come back to the hotel looking for food or drink lol.  Also the soda machines were busted on 5 levels that I tried.  Some took my money.  Overall great place to stay and I will stay here again just better prepared.

allReviews.title: ReeboeD
allReviews.text: Located on tram that goes to the strip on several stops.  Is located off the strip and near the Convention Center.  A golf club is nearby.  A giant parking garage is next door. Away from noisy street trafic.

allReviews.title: It was a good stay
allReviews.text: I had a good time at this location, clean and comfortable. I only wish that they had offered a free breakfast that would have made it even better. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel! Everything was clean and the beds were so comfortable! I loved that they gave us vouchers for water for our stay. It was nice to grab a couple of waters before heading out for the day. Everyone was extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend this hotel to family and friends.

allReviews.title: Hilton service and quality away from bustle of The Strip
allReviews.text: This was my second stay here, and I will be back. Often visit Vegas to take care of family business. Appreciate a quiet, clean Hilton-quality hotel away from noise and bustle of The Strip. This hotel is small by Vegas standards, and has no casino or restaurant, but it does have a great poolside bar. Convenience market off lobby is great if you have a suite with full kitchen and like to fix some of your meals in the room, as I do.

allReviews.title: Mother Daughter Trip
allReviews.text: Such a beautiful hotel. Very easy to access the monorail all the way to MGM Grand with easy access to the entire stip. Very quiet property good for vacations if you want to enjoy the city and some quiet. The only part that I found frustrating is that there is no cash in the shop so prepare to use credit card or room charge.

allReviews.title: Excellent staff away from the Strip
allReviews.text: Relax and Rejuvenate in this charming Club property. You do not have to be a Vacation Club Member to be treated like a valued guest. Beds are extremely comfortable. Rooms are immaculate. Staff is very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Great Place To Stay, home away from home
allReviews.text: The desk staff were always friendly and helpful with anything I needed. Check in and out was quick and easy. The resort was neat and clean. The rooms were clean, well maintained, and comfortable. I will stay here again!

allReviews.title: Nice & Quiet
allReviews.text: I stayed here for one night in preparation to fly out early the next morning. This property is located off the strip in a what seems to be a quieter part of the city. In Uber terms, it was an $8 trip to Freemont Street and a $12 trip to the airport. Although I didn’t have time to take a dip, the pool area was nice and not overcrowded. I appreciated the extra room and the in room washer and dryer. This was my first stay at a HGVC property but will certainly not be my last.

allReviews.title: Excellent Resort, Can't fault it!
allReviews.text: We have used this resort many times and wouldn't stay anywhere else in Las Vegas.  The resort is kept spotlessly clean, the units are very spacious and well appointed.  Full kitchen facilities and washing machine/driers are great extras included in the units.  Regular maid service and plenty of supplies e.g. coffee, tea, wash powder, complimentary toiletries.  The staff can't do enough for you, they are a pleasure to deal with from check in to check out, maids, deli and bar staff all just excellent and very efficient.  This resort is off the strip so you can return here for a bit of peace and quiet after a visit to the main strip!  That's great and the pool never gets too crowded.  To get about the LV Monorail station at the Westgate is a few minutes walk so this is the easiest and cheapest way to get about from this resort.  Can't recommend it enough, try it you won't be disappointed

allReviews.title: Decent Grand Vacation Property
allReviews.text: First off, the rooms themselves were modern and looked clean.  The major problems, I had with this property are:1. As a diamond member, they initially texted me a couple times asking me to how everything was and asking for a rating.  As soon as I provided honest feedback (rating of 7), they never responded even after I texted a couple of times.2. The bathroom sink was stuck and the laundry washer was leaking.  It's such a headache when they don't maintenance these things as it takes up my time and they have to take some time to address the problem.3. Amenities, such as business area and club room, were unavailable due to "renovation" even though we paid the resort fee.4. Did not seem like an upscale property and was not a family friendly hotel.

allReviews.title: Anniversary stay
allReviews.text: It was a wonderful experience with great customer service from all staff. Room was very clean and everything in working order. Suite rooms are tremendously roomy and felt like home, with the wonderful fully stocked kitchen utensils and etc. Bath tubs are huge and very relaxing. Our stay was excellent and will happen each year for our anniversary.

allReviews.title: Excellent and relaxing stop in Las Vegas during California and Nevada tour
allReviews.text: Walk distance from Las Vegas monorail, few minutes by car from big supermarket, inside the residence little marlet and Starbucks, excellent apartment with washing and drying maching, wide rooms; in the structure healty center, pool and small spa. Good position for Grand Canyon west RIM, Red Rock Canyon, Death Valley.

allReviews.title: Acceptable, a lot of construction
allReviews.text: When one is traveling for business, the requirements change a bit, at least for me. All I need is a quiet and clean room, hospitable personnel and easy access to major commuting avenues. This place was under construction when I visited, the store downstairs was literally separated from the construction area by a long, black curtain. Can imagine the dust everywhere!Otherwise, I enjoyed the jogging path around the property!

allReviews.title: Girls Trip
allReviews.text: This was my first time going to Vegas, I wasn't sure what to expect. Upon arrival, we requested early check in and a room was immediately available. We had a early 6am flight and were super tired. The rooms were really clean. The beds were super comfortable. We stayed for three nights. They gave us complimentary bottles of water everyday. We had 6PM flights upon checking out so we requested late checkout and was granted that as well. Overall, the hotel was nice as well as the staff. I would def stay again. It was worth the price paid.

allReviews.title: Average hotel
allReviews.text: Would not call this a resort. Resort fee is a scam. Housekeeping Wales up the whole corridor at 9am (In Vegas) by banging on the doors with her plastic card instead of knocking. No meaning putting up the don’t disturb sign, since you wake up when they bang on the neighbors doors.

allReviews.title: las vegas resort at its best
allReviews.text: The resort was beautifully maintained, clean and great service by the staff.  The concierge was super helpful with advice and booking of shows.  The resort was nicely located, quiet and only five minutes to the las vegas stripe.  The only negative is the $25.00 resort fee per day.

allReviews.title: Seems like it is brand new
allReviews.text: Great space to not be cramped.  We had the 2 bedroom/ 2 bath set up and it was great for a girls weekend with 4 of us.  The kitchen, livingroom and dining space made it great for just hanging out too.  It also has a washer & dryer so this was also helpful.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacation Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful place to stay. Great staff. Great condo. Close to the Las Vegas strip. Close to all the shopping. A great place to bring the family. The market place on the 1 frist floor is great place to shop. They have just about everything you need. I will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great vacation spot
allReviews.text: Will stay here rather than a casino every time I am in Vegas. No smoke or crowds. Easy parking. Check in and out was a breeze. Staff was wonderful. I stayed in the king suite. The price was comparable to staying on the strip.

allReviews.title: Not the best HGV in Vegas
allReviews.text: Choose this Hilton Honors location at the last minute.  Poor decision.  I have stayed here before and was VERY pleased, but our room this time was slightly better than a Route 66 Motel.  Noisy - seemed like water was running through our walls all night long.  Clean room but lots of hallway and air conditioning noises.  Staff was VERY friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Excellent experience
allReviews.text: This resort has beautiful facilities and grounds. The units themselves are well maintained and beautifully furnished. The decor is lovely and up to date, nothing at all worn or shabby as in some timeshares. I would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Repeat Visit
allReviews.text: I've stayed here before.  Loved it then and again this time.  Good location, good parking, good accommodations.  And very convenient to the monorail if you choose to use that.  I would return soon but for the 1-in-4 rule.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel - didn't get complimentary breakfast
allReviews.text: One bedroom suite was great, very clean and lots of space and amenities. Unfortunately the complimentary breakfast area was closed for remodeling or something during our stay. Everything else was great though.

allReviews.title: Nice friendly staff
allReviews.text: We were spending a couple of days in Las Vegas, but not liking the massive casino hotels where there are always queues checking in or out, we selected this hotel.Carparking in the open was complimentary, but wow! our rental car got so hot as the outdoor temperature reached 114 degreesF during out stay.Julian was very helpful and friendly with our check in. Our room near the top floor and at the far end of the hotel was quiet. The room was standard Hilton size, very clean and well serviced each day. The beds were comfortable for good sleeps.The  complimentary credit-card to access some recently released DVDs was a nice bonus during our stay. We used the Las Vegas Monorail on Day2 with the station being a 6 to 8 minute walk away.Overall, we enjoyed our stay and like the hotel. But, we felt receiving 3 text message from the hotel and 2 emails about the quality of the stay over 4 days seemed a bit over done, especially as the hotel offered to send an email receipt and we have yet to receive the receipt after 5 days.

allReviews.title: I want pillows like these.
allReviews.text: Worth it no matter the cost. OMG the pillows I 💖 them.   The staff is amazing and super helpful.    I even cooked in the kitchen the first night and I was able to find everything super easy.    The easy access to the monorail is a super great perk.  Made getting around so easy .

allReviews.title: Loved the spacious room.
allReviews.text: Absolutely loved our stay here.   We stayed in a one bedroom suite which was spacious and included a full size kitchen with plenty of amenities.  We loved the little market and the poolside bar.  The staff was professional and friendly.     Everything was top notch.  The free parking was convenient and there was both an open lot and a parking structure.   As previously stated it is a bit away from the strip, but the monorail is close by.

allReviews.title: Hilton Stay, Excellent service!
allReviews.text: Pleasant and quiet, Staff friendly and helpful, room very nice and clean. off the strip made for a quiet stay. Parking was great with plenty of spaces if you went to upper levels. No restaurant on site, but hotel store offered plenty of food and beverages.

allReviews.title: Jam On It
allReviews.text: My sister and I brought our children to the Jam On It Basketball Tournament at the Convention Center. The hotel was convenient and we could walk to the convention center. The staff was courteous and we request and received an early check in. We found the Marketplace to be fairly priced and use it daily. Our rooms were kept clean & cold. I ❤️‘d my morning time by the pool. I will stay here again because it is nice & quiet after long days. No night sounds from gambling!

allReviews.title: Great value for the money
allReviews.text: I was in Las Vegas for a conference at the Convention Center.  The Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise was the perfect place to stay.  It was very convenient to the Convention Center and not too crowded like the other resorts!  Will def. stay here again!

allReviews.title: On Our Way Back!
allReviews.text: This review is more of a pre-stay review, a little out of the norm of course. My wife and I stay at this property every year in the two bedroom suites for the last 5-6 years for vacation. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because last year the property was under renovation so we had to settle for a lower floor which was a little dated but it was still home away for us. My wife works for Hilton and I am a Hilton fanatic so this property is our favorite vacation spot. I love cooking breakfast in the morning for my wife and son. The store at ground level has everything you need to prepare meals in the apartment/condo style room. Even under renovation the property was still very inviting overall. Love the staff and we can't wait to experience one of the newly renovated rooms when we arrive next August so I can give the 5 stars it deserves.See you soon!Mr. Freddie Ellis

allReviews.title: Spacious!
allReviews.text: Stayed in one bedroom suite. Very nice and clean. Staff very friendly and responsive. Quiet. Thankfully we had a car. It is a couple of miles to the center of the strip. Would have been expensive to uber back and forth from this location.

allReviews.title: Into the unknown
allReviews.text: As we had never visited Las Vegas before we were confused by the amount of hotels and varying comments on quality. An offer through Agoda provided us with an opportunity to stay here for £45 a night + the dreadful LV resort fee.We arrived at 11pm and met by Nick on reception who was extremely helpful and made our check in speedy.The room was very comfortable/clean and was a great choice for us as Casinos are not our thing.The quality of the bed and bedding was excellent, great sleep both nights.The hotel is a fair walk to The Strip but again this was not an issue.The bonus of a coffee maker in the room was really helpful.All in all, a very good two night stay.

allReviews.title: Excellent location - wonderful and attentive staff
allReviews.text: The start of our USA road trip - and we couldn't have chosen a better location, the hotel is quite with a great pool and excellent rooms - we had a 2 bedroom end suite which was lovely and had a great kitchen which we didn't use but could have - some special touches nice soaps etc - pool was a great hit with my 12 year old and has lovely fluffy towels and a full time lifeguard. Some refurbishment underway which we wish we had know about - will be finished soon and then define would be a 5 rating,

allReviews.title: Being a RCI Owner doesn't have privleges
allReviews.text: Costly stay not only with money but using my RCI Points, expensive!  Also, I was informed after the third day that my room wouldn't be cleaned until the fourth day, no fresh towels, linen, etc.  So I asked the mananger why am I being charged a daily resort fee when I only offered room service only Mid-Week?  I was told that the Resort Fee was for WIFI, I told them I didn't need WIFI, they said it's included!

allReviews.title: Excellent resort with wonderful staff!
allReviews.text: We ended up at this resort after a grueling day that included sitting on the side of the road on a hot day in the middle of nowhere. We finally got to this resort around 3 am, after having made the reservation online half an hour before our arrival. To my horror, we were told at the front desk that we had booked a room for the following night. As my heart sank the staff member at the front desk very calmly told us she would take care of everything and modified our reservation, handed us our keys, and explained the basic info we needed to know since it was our first time at this location. The room was big and clean, and the staff I encountered the next morning we're just as friendly as the person who helped us check in. I will definitely be returning to this location and recommending it to anyone who is looking for a nice place to stay while visiting Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Just what we needed
allReviews.text: This trip was for my parents. I really liked how it was a suite. Gave my parents the bedroom and I got the sofa. Sofa bed was pretty comfortable. Plus side two TVs that way my dad got his own LOL. Next to Westgate. Gambling within distance. What made it better was the monorail being nearby. Easier access to strip. Gave two complimentary bottle water (Evian) for each day of stay. Saw people BBQ on premise and lots of people in pool. It’s a nice getaway from the strip. The only down side is the walls aren’t as insulated as I hoped. You can hear people walking and talking all sorts of hours. And you can hear when people on the floor above.

allReviews.title: AWESOME RESORT
allReviews.text: Love everything about the resort except ALL THE NEW ADDITIONAL FEES. Great location, quiet, clean, friendly staff. Will not stay here again though due to the new $25 a day resort fee. WHAT A BUMMER. Have stayed at this resort at least 4 times because we LOVE IT.

allReviews.title: Great property just off the strip
allReviews.text: While in Vegas for the Fourth of July, we had a horrible room experience at a hotel on the strip. We checked out of there two days early and were lucky and thankful to find this Hilton Grand Vacation resort. The property is beautiful and staff are very friendly. The one bedroom suite is gorgeous, spacious and clean!  Pool is a bit small but very nice and we still enjoyed it! Loved the extra benefit of complimentary DVD rentals to view in our room.

allReviews.title: Last Min Choice
allReviews.text: enojable stay with all suit purposes and very comfortable. Last Min Choice but it was great. i love how its not far from the vegas strip and it quiet clam and the most important it feel safe. This was good

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise Experience
allReviews.text: Off the strip so a lot quieter and family friendly.   The snack bar and family/play area was going through renovation but I know it will be a lot newer and fun once it's done.   It's really different from the other Hilton locations in Las Vegas - not as crowded and busy.   The rooms were nice and large one bedroom with a full kitchen to save money and cook what I wanted when we just wanted to hang out & enjoy the room.   I enjoyed my stay there and will definitely go back.

allReviews.title: Worst Experience... stay away from this hotel
allReviews.text: The worst experience and rude attitude I ever had in any Hilton hotels. I'm a gold member and was treated rudely and unprofessional.  Even the GM... she was unprofessional. Decided to never stay in this hotel for my business trips.

allReviews.title: A week with friends
allReviews.text: After a convention, we scheduled a week at this timeshare with another couple. Very convenient to get around Vegas. Next door to the Monorail. Great parking. Staff were super. Accommodations were excellent. Store on property was convenient.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel but...
allReviews.text: Nice hotel but walls are thin. Could hear a party next door all night. If the security or staff did regular rounds, they should have heard and seen. I know it’s Vegas but we were just passing through and needed to get some sleep in a comfortable hotel.

allReviews.title: Convenient location, nice and clean room
allReviews.text: We stayed at a one bedroom suite, very spacious and clean room, parking is on site and free. Very close to convention center. Staff are very nice and helpful. The only complaint I could think of is the food at the market place are kind of expensive.

allReviews.title: Fantastic accommodations
allReviews.text: Fantastic place to stay, great kitchen, living room, nice pool area, great grills convenient to use.... monorail 5 minute walk. Service fantastic!!! Very clean... great little store with everything needed for stay

allReviews.title: Clean, pleasant, and quiet
allReviews.text: Surprise!  Not everyone goes to Vegas to party.   I wanted to stay somewhere clean, comfortable and quiet, and didn't smell like a casino.  There's a store on the first floor that has everything you might want.  I was surprised at the selection of grocery items that were actual food and not just packaged, processed snack items.  I had a lot of luggage and was exhausted as I'd been hiking/camping Havasu Falls.  It would have been nice if they had offered to help me with my luggage.  There was a separate desk where someone REALLY wanted to talk to me; but I needed to put my bags up and said I'd come back.  When I got back down there the girl was gone; and they asked me to wait for her.  I just wanted to go to my room to shower and rest; and found it quite irritating to find out they were giving me coupons that I wouldn't be able to use; but that what they really wanted was to sell me touristy stuff, i.e. show tickets, etc.   It appeared that the vendor was part of the hotel concierge; and that was misleading.  Boo.  Hiss.

allReviews.title: very much family hotel
allReviews.text: No sign of any fruit machines , bar closes 8pm , so if you want a late drink go to Westgate . Very friendly staff . Nice rooms , but no kettle , only a coffee maker , so you might want to take a travel kettle . Small shop that sells very limited food , and they don’t take cash !!!!! Also the bar doesn’t take cash !!!!!

allReviews.title: I’ll be back!
allReviews.text: This hotel was super clean, the staff was friendly and helpful, but the fact that I could rent movies (for free), get a Starbucks coffee and breakfast or anything else (at a reasonable price) AND have a clean modern room with an AMAZING bathtub... that was the icing on the cake!

allReviews.title: A nice clean unit, decent value
allReviews.text: Positives:  (1) Our 2-bedroom unit at HGVC on Paradise was extremely clean and well-maintained.  (2) The air conditioning worked extremely well--which was good since temperatures were well over 100 degrees outside.  (3) PLENTY of easy parking in the garage.  (4) Proximity to Fremont Street, Circus Circus and the northern end of The Strip, but the only place you can actually walk to is the Westgate casino next door (a few-minute walk through the parking garage).Negatives:  (1) The $25+tax/day resort fee really only got us 2 bottles of water daily from the front desk, a complimentary USA Today in the lobby, and "free" wi-fi in the unit.  (2) The fitness center is rather small and only 2 of 3 treadmills were working during our visit so a couple mornings I had to wait since others were using the 2 that worked.  (3) The pool size is adequate but we wish it could have been larger.  (4)  There are really no activities at this resort but it's Las Vegas so I maybe none are needed?Summary:  Despite some of the negatives, our visit here was good despite the daily resort fee.  However, we stayed at the South Point for 3 nights prior to our week-long stay at this resort and though the unit at the South Point was a one-bedroom with 2 double beds, I think I enjoyed my stay at that resort a little more due to its on-site amenities (restaurants, bowling, movie theater, bingo, casino).  However, as a timeshare, I would consider staying here again due mainly to the cleanliness of the actual unit.

allReviews.title: A great experience
allReviews.text: My group and I stayed here for a business trip. Staff was courteous and professional. Rooms were nice, clean, and comfortable. Had a wonderful experience and I would definitely stay here again in the future.

allReviews.title: High School Reunion Family Trip
allReviews.text: Our family came to Las Vegas for a high school reunion which was being held at another hotel with a casino.  I wanted to use my Hilton Honors points and stay at a non-smoking hotel.  The Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise was a perfect choice:  close to the event venue, close to shopping amenities, close to movie theaters and close to the freeway.  The property was clean, the staff was courteous, our suite was superb, beds were comfy and the kids were happy too.  Bravo!  Our reunion experience was made even better by the Hilton accommodations.

allReviews.title: Newly remodeled rooms.
allReviews.text: Beautiful property with very welcoming and accommodating staff. I really like what HGVC did with the renovations. The rooms are very nicely done and clean. Very nice pool (with lifeguards) . There are also a couple of gas grills located next to the pool bar. Overall, I would recommend this property. Their staff is very helpful and courteous. Check it out.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay! Just wish during summer months and weekends the marketplace and the pool would stay open much later
allReviews.text: Great place to stay! Just wish during summer months and weekends the marketplace and the pool would stay open much later

allReviews.title: LOVED IT!!
allReviews.text: I loved this hotel! It wasn't directly on the strip, more like 7-10 minutes away, but we didn't  mind that. We stayed in a suite and the room was spacious and clean. The staff was friendly and the amenities were great. I would definitely come back again!

allReviews.title: Peace away from the strip
allReviews.text: Great location away from the bright lights of the strip, but convenient to all Vegas attractions.  Very clean, spacious and comfortable. Good parking.  Recommended for families. Better onsite food options would make it stellar.

allReviews.title: Resort fees too expensive
allReviews.text: We traded through RCI and having to pay $25 a day on top of our trading fee is absurd.  Timeshares are not worth it anymore when you add in your annual maintenance fee.  As far as Vegas goes, better deals at better resorts can be had online with airfare included.

allReviews.title: Friend Reunion Trip
allReviews.text: This hotel was truly great! It's not on the strip, which we preferred (less noise) and no casino. We are young adults who were looking to have fun, but also very much needed our sleep. We would just take Lyft to our destination. This suite we got was basically like an apartment, for half the price of what it cost on the strip. Definitely will be staying here again for our next Vegas trip.

allReviews.title: Large, comfortable suites
allReviews.text: This a quiet, non-gaming site on the north end of Paradise, adjacent to the Westgate hotel and LV Convention Center.  The 1 BR suites are large and have a fully equiped kitchen.  Parking is free but there is a $25/day

allReviews.title: Great trip!
allReviews.text: Great resort if you are taking your family to LasVegas! If you are wanting to stay within walking distance to the hot spots on the strip this is not your place. My husband and I were by ourselves without the children and there were alot of kids at this resort. The other thing was the pool closed at 10:00. So if your looking at a family vacation this is the perfect spot for you!

allReviews.title: Great Location off the strip
allReviews.text: The room was large enough for 4 women using the 2 bedrooms which were connecting 2 rooms.  I do prepare breakfast and lunch in my room so I was lacking salt and pepper shakers but  I was directed by the front desk to go to the market store. The market staff said they had no more as it was a popular item but they did give me some salt & pepper packets. I was also lacking a dish rack but called the front desk & got one sent to my room.

allReviews.title: Beautiful rooms 😎
allReviews.text: These were more like a beautiful condo than a hotel room.Clean & gorgeous 😊 We could not have been happier.  They had a market area in the hotel that had personal items (in case you forgot something) & food, sandwiches, snacks, etc.

allReviews.title: Over exaggerated amenities.
allReviews.text: The staff was friendly and check in was easy enough.  The amenities and photos online didn’t match our experience in real life.  The pool was tiny in comparison to the description. The hotel, for a Hilton, seemed a little dirty and the 12th floor smelled terrible.

allReviews.title: Nice and good for families
allReviews.text: We have stayed at other Hilton Grand Vacation properties and this one is a little smaller than some. It's a nice hotel and the staff is super nice. If you are going to the Westgate or the Convention center for meetings this is a nice place to stay.

allReviews.title: Perfect room perfect hotel.....that simple!
allReviews.text: Great room perfect space....tub shower room kitchen all perfect! Not one complaint everything close by like 10 minutes away. Bar downstairs pool evrytevery you need. Will definitely be staying there again

allReviews.title: Business and Pleasure
allReviews.text: Location, bit out of the way, but nicer then a hotel roomIf you want to gamble, only one option to walk next door, which is a mediocre hotel/casinoHad a week in the RCI bank so decided this would be a good time to use it up

allReviews.title: Love this place
allReviews.text: first time here and I love it,Great place great people Very clean even when they was having some work done inside I definitely will return to this hotel is out of all the noise and the smoking smell it’s a quiet place to enjoy your vacation.

allReviews.title: Convenient location close to the hustle but away from the bustle
allReviews.text: Took a youth sports team to stay and it was one of the few places able to accommodate 9 of us w/adj rooms so we only needed 1 chaperone. It was close to restaurants and the tourney but away from the smoke and casinos. Nice, comfortable facilities and a great staff! Highly recommend it to others to stay at!

allReviews.title: Resort fee's for a basic hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed here last year and were not charged resort fee's, we returned this year to learn at check in there is a 20/daily resort fee. This is a hotel. No on site restaurants or entertainment outside of a pool which is standard at any hotel.  No shuttle service to the strip

allReviews.title: Third Visit - Still Great
allReviews.text: I've come back to this hotel for a third visit. They have since remodeled and it actually looks better. The staff is super friendly but not in your face. Housekeeping works really hard and the rooms are huge. It's worth upgrading to a one bedroom which gives you full kitchen and a washer/dryer. The pool is never crowded, and parking is very easy, and free. It is a few blocks from the middle of everything so there's always something quiet to return to. Thanks!

allReviews.title: Off strip great hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel incredibly clean. Cleaning staff so friendly. Room lovely as was all public areas. Had issue with one member of staff this was dealt with on our return and a full refund given for last night as a gesture of goodwill. Certainly will return.

allReviews.title: Double charged with a clogged tub!
allReviews.text: I was charged double for one nights stay and management refuses to refund me.Also the tub was disgusting and clogged up.Very disappointed in this property.Also the guest services were very rude. ...

allReviews.title: Extremely Grateful..to the people who do 'little' jobs!
allReviews.text: Great customer service! Totally problem free stay. Fantastic internet connections for multiple devices! Dishes were done daily and early everyday. Cleaning lady was fantastic - We should learn to appreciate people who do these 'little' jobs and not take them for granted. Respect, greet and than them every time for a job we would probably not want to do and yet keep our stay so pleasant. Reception dude was a champion at guiding, support, advice giving..basically everything...THANK YOU!

allReviews.title: Perfect Vegas Getaway
allReviews.text: We absolutely loved staying here. A short walk to the train gave us access to all of Vegas quickly. You can get a train pass too.  incredibly friendly helpful staff, beautiful view, great amenities and a quiet sleep. We highly recommend this location!

allReviews.title: Amazing Place
allReviews.text: The hotel room was very clean and the check in staff was very friendly. To add to that, they were also very affordable and a reasonable distance from the city center. The rooms weren't too old nor too modern and overall I would go again.

allReviews.title: Check in problem
allReviews.text: Our problem was that we reserved (and paid upfront) for 2 rooms, but upon arrival the hotel had just 1. Staff at first was saying the hotel was sold out and trying to blame a "third party" for the problem (as if the final vendor wasn't the hotel itself...). After a long discussion they finally got us the second room. Very unfortunate situation when you are arriving from a 5 hour flight...

allReviews.title: Alternative for those who want to be close to monorail stop but not stay in a hotel with a casino
allReviews.text: This is a well-maintained facility with a business office and coffee/food with reasonable hours.  Staff is courteous and efficient.  Rooms are standard, all equipment was in good working order.  Room was clean.

allReviews.title: Great spot
allReviews.text: First stay here. Truly impressed. There was definitely an older crowd (I'm in my 20s) but its definitely did not bother me. The staff here is very courteous and the rooms were clean and beds are comfortable.

allReviews.title: One of the Best places to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the HGVC on Paradise many times over the years and to me though it is off the strip is one of the better properties Hilton has in Las Vegas.  It has lots of parking and is within walking distance of the WestGate and Monorail.  Staff is always friendly and professional.  You can't go wrong staying here.

allReviews.title: sinno17
allReviews.text: las vegas is a great place to visit. the gambling is a real experience in itself. we all had a great time. go to red rock and the grand canyan while your there. check out the old strip. there are some eye opening things to see and watch there so be ready. we also tried the escapology two times and we beat it both times great fun and adventures await u there. bring plenty of money

allReviews.title: Wonderful Experience
allReviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our time at this location.  Even little things, like quietly closing room doors,added greatly to our stay.  Wish every place we stayed followed their blueprint for rooms.Also, staff was very friendly in acknowledging our every departure and return.This is the second Hilton (Hampton) property we have stayed at this year and we have enjoyed both places.

allReviews.title: Not on the strip but as close as you can get.
allReviews.text: I like the fact that there is no casino in the motel and it is not right on the strip. The facility is very nice and comfortable. It has garage parking with close access. Very nice pool and patio area. I is also a great value! I will stay here any time I come to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Shower is OK if you are under 5' tall
allReviews.text: Poorly designed rooms with outdated products. They should demolish this building and put up another Vegas Casino. The review must be 200 characters minimum, but I doubt the management would really want me to go on.

allReviews.title: Good stay if you want to be off the strip
allReviews.text: Overall, it was a good stay. Room was clean. Bed was a little soft for my liking. Housekeeping was ok. I asked for service on Friday at or after a specific time and no one showed. Little disappointing but not upset at all. Room had great amenities, full kitchen, etc. Nice clean on arrival.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: We stayed at this Hilton after getting a good deal online. The staff were nice and helpful upon check-in. There is a parking garage next to the hotel.  The room was nice and they put us away from the elevators as requested. We had a nice view as well. There was some stuff in our sink that needed to be cleaned. Housekeeping had it clened within 5-10 minutes. The Concierge helped us pick out tickets to a show. Be forewarned they will try to get you with the "free tickets" to a show, by sitting through a time share presentation. Other than that good stay at a nice hotel.

allReviews.title: One of the best resorts we've stayed
allReviews.text: Spent a week here and had a fantastic time! Our second visit (last visit 4 years ago) here to HGVC. The staff is top notch and you feel like you're staying at a 4-star resort! There's a snack bar/grocery store inside the resort, the pool is very well kept, and the rooms feel so comfy. We recommend this place and would stay here again an again. It's off the strip and quiet, yet close enough to get around town.

allReviews.title: FIRE FIRE/ NO POOL /FEES FEES FOR WHAT
allReviews.text: I stayed at this resort for one week 4/14-4-21. The resort had  a FIRE in the food area on  the first floor that made the pool unusable for most of the vacation since it was closed due to the sprinkler system water  draining into the pool.First I would like to say the pool is located directly next to the parking lot not shown in pics provided.  Also everyone smokes directly next to the entrance to the resort located directly next to the pool.I paid $1189 to stay at this resort because it seemed like a nice place from reviews and limited pics provided on the web. I planned on seeing sights around VEGAS AND ARIZONA, with also relaxing days by the pool..Well Hilton didn't provide a pool or any compensation for no pool, They didn't even put up signs telling you when the pool would be available or if you could use another Hilton resort pool. which there are 2 resorts within a few miles, They could have moved us to for are  remaining stay or provide busing to the other resort.Regarding fees I was told before booking with RCI that I would have no fees, when I arrived they confirmed I would have no fees.  When I checked out they billed  me $25 a day plus tax per day. (I guess the resort  help doesn't  know policy regarding fees and RCI guest policy.)At that point I complained about the fees, and the resort would only wave 4 days of fees. Leaving me to pay $85.05 for fees that should never should be charged to anyone.  I had to leave at that point to catch a flight.  The resort and Hilton currently refuse to refund my fees .The Hilton just wants your money for fees that don't provide anything extra to your vacation that you can't provide yourself with a cell phone and a trip to buy water.LASTLY I CALLED THE GENERAL MANAGER ERNA FROM THE RESORT TO COMPLAIN AND SHE FELT THAT $100 WAS MORE THAN ENOUGH COMPANSATION..  SHE SAID THE REFUND WAS DUE TO THE POOL BEING CLOSED, BUT LATER EMAILED ME TO SAY IT WAS JUST COMPENSATION FOR 4 DAYS OF FEES ONLY.  MAYBE EVERYONE STAYING THAT WEEK WHEN THE POOL WAS CLOSED SHOULD GET $100 BECUASE THE POOL WAS CLOSED.If I was the Hilton resort every person staying at the resort should get a letter of apology with some monetary compensation for ruining peoples vacation that wanted a leisurely time at the pool.

allReviews.title: Newly renovated, clean with spacious rooms
allReviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised with this hotel. It's newly renovated, smells like new. Rooms are vacation club suites with a living room and a bedroom. Fully equipped kitchen. The king bed in the bedroom is super comfortable. Bathroom is big with a huge bathtub. It's not on the strip but it's close enough. Walking distance from the Convention Center. This was convenient for us because we were in Vegas for a tournament. It's connected to the Westgate hotel. They share the same garage. Parking is free. NO CASINOS. which I liked since there was no cigarette smoke and the crowds. No bars or restaurants though. The pool is decent size, not too big. Overall, a great experience. Would definitely come again.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and quiet
allReviews.text: I stayed at this hotel while attending an event at the Westgate (next door), and I am so happy I did. The room was clean, comfortable, and most of all, quiet. There is no casino, no smoking, and it has great amenities. The pool & hot tub are quite large, with an available bar outside and lots of seating. The hotel gives you a coupon at check-in for 2 bottles of Evian water for each day you're there as well as free DVD rentals (DVD player in each room). The beds and pillows were incredibly comfortable and the room itself was updated and really nice. I had a basic double queen room with a good size mini fridge, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, and all basic necessities to eat a meal with. The hotel even provided paper towels, dish soap, and a sponge. There is a small market on the 1st floor for snacks/food. The staff was friendly and provided too notch service from check-in to housekeeping. Located north of the strip, the monorail is a short walk to get you right where you need to go. Definitely a great place to stay if you're looking for a quieter hotel without the smoke and 'Vegas' feel. Wi-Fi is "free" with a daily $25 resort fee.

allReviews.title: Feel at home
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations several times. I like that it’s smoke free and no casinos! I travel to Las Vegas several times a year and enjoy HGV’s. The kitchen is a nice plus as well as a full en suite & whirlpool tub!The staff are always very attentive and welcoming!

allReviews.title: Nice Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Very convenient location. Close to the monorail for activities on the strip. Lots of free parking for the renal car for other areas. The front desk was always friendly. The provide bottled water which is good to keep hydrated in the desert.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: We were here two weekends in a row for volleyball tournaments and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay each time. The rooms are clean, loved the fact they had a well equipped kitchen and the staff was very friendly. As far as hotels go I found the market reasonably priced. Overall I’d stay here again.

allReviews.title: Nice vacation spot
allReviews.text: Just minutes away from monorail and all the noise on the strip. We really enjoyed the location, was away from the hustle and bustle but only a couple minutes away from it all. We had a suite so we had the comfort of home too.

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Nice location if your attending something at the convention center, they offered a shuttle or just a 15 minute easy walk.  Free just released dvds, bottled water and a morning paper.  Room was great.  We will be back.  A little hike to the strip but right by a monorail stop so not a problem

allReviews.title: No close to anything
allReviews.text: The pool and restaurant were closed the entire time I was there.  The pool area did not look great.  It is quite a walk to any casino except Westgate or the dirty Circus Circus.  That is all, but I need 200 characters to submit.

allReviews.title: Not Hilton Quality
allReviews.text: Pool was filthy, store closed, business center had giant fans to dry the floor.  Missing baseboards, sink & tub don’t drain.  Was extremely disappointed in this Hilton hotel, no pre notification that pool & marketplace would be closed.  Room requested was not given (king vs 2 queens).   Staff was nice enough but other than check-in we didn’t have any interaction

allReviews.title: disappointing stay
allReviews.text: We stayed for a week at this place and it was ridiculous that a resort in Vegas closes their pool at 8pm. Staff was very friendly and we were able to check in early which went very fast. In Vegas I would not stay here again,  the wyndham grand desert is a much better choice.

allReviews.title: The fire alarms work
allReviews.text: My wife and I have been HGVC owners at this property for over 10 years but never stayed there until recently. The location of the hotel, off the strip a block and across the parking lot from the Westgate and Monorail stop, is awesome. The hotel itself is a little more dated than any of the other HGVC places, all of which we have stayed at, but the accommodations were OK. A one bedroom King suite with living room and a full kitchen, washer and dryer, and cups, bowls, plates, silverware etc came with our room. They also have a nice pool and walk up bar area and two really nice and well maintained gas BBQ's near the pool and bar area. We used the BBQ's twice during our stay (Tri-Tip and Baby Back Ribs) and discovered they worked very well. They have a Deli inside but we didn't use it as we bought our food at Costco and cooked for ourselves in the room, or BBQ out by the pool. We also ate out a couple nights while attending a few shows. They have free parking available in a covered parking garage if you have a car, which was very convenient. We did have a little drama our last night as the fire alarm system went off at 1:30 am with very annoying blasts of sirens followed by voice instructions alerting us to a fire in the hotel. As annoying and unsettling as this was I think I would take annoying over being hurt/injured in a fire any day. As it was, it turned out that there really was an electrical fire of some kind in the deli area which was extinguished by the over head sprinkler system and eventually cleared by the fire department. The staff that we came in contact with were all excellent, cheerful, friendly, accommodating, and approachable. Overall, drama included, this was a good place to stay and I would recommend it to anyone staying in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nicely redone property!
allReviews.text: It had been about 6 years since we stayed at this HGVC in Vegas. I was pleased that the entire property has been updated. They did and excellent job on textures and colors,  and the new furniture and tv's were very nice. The bed is comfortable, and the rooms are quiet and air conditioned nicely. You can use the Monorail to get about the strip activity very easily, all the way from the MGM at the south end up to the SLS and Stratosphere at the north end. Quite reasonable too.

allReviews.title: Oasis just off the Strip
allReviews.text: This is an excellent quiet retreat from the sturm und drang of the Vegas Strip. No Casino, no smoke, no restaurant, just a small deli/convenience store for basic needs (there is a Starbucks however). A nice and quiet place for when you decide to lay your head down after dinner and partying. Yet very close to the convention center, and the Strip. All suites. Great place for families and Business travelers.

allReviews.title: Fabulous!
allReviews.text: Fantastic!!! Beautiful rooms, friendly and accommodating staff, and short walk from monorail, a short distance from the convention center.Great outside bar and pool area, short distance from the strip, restaurants, and shopping.

allReviews.title: Spring in Vegas
allReviews.text: Love this place - very clean.  The rooms have been remodeled and are very nice - the colors are beautiful.  The beds/pillows are really comfy too. The staff was friendly as usual.  While not on the Strip, the Monorail is a short walk away and that made it easy to get around.

allReviews.title: Perfect Las Vegas Timeshare
allReviews.text: This resort was just off the Las Vegas strip.  Enough to be a quiet place to retreat to in the evenings or spend the day at the pool.   Yet the monorail is located a short walk away, which takes you to all the Hotel hotspots on the Strip.   Resort is very well maintained and personnel are extremely professional and courteous.   Ample parking and proximity to downtown Las Vegas as well.   We had a wonderful time here.

allReviews.title: Hgvc is lovely
allReviews.text: Love staying at the HGVC off Paradise. They always treat you well, listen and accommodate your needs, as well as have such a close parking lot and no paying for parking. The rooms are always clean and the full Kitchen is amazing.

allReviews.title: Comfort
allReviews.text: Gave it a 5 star for staff especially front desk Carlos was very nice and helpful with a big smile as soon as we were greeted that is a big plus to start your short vacation.  The room is very clean and updated, full kitchen, with dishwasher, good size living room and kitchen, bathroom with extra large shower, separate bathtub, good size bedroom, bed was okay.  Two TV, washer dryer.Location is quite, short block from strip, short walk to west gate hotel with casino and restaurants.This Hotel does not have a restaurant 😔They have a mall market and outside bar by the pool.It’s a nice hotel, limited activities, quite and lots resting time if that’s what your looking for.  My wife and enjoy and we will return.Thanks

allReviews.title: Beautiful property off the strip
allReviews.text: If we could, we would have stayed another night! Warm welcome from the front desk greeted us upon check in and that was already midnight! Front desk text checking in on us was quite a nice touch!Our room on the top level was perfect / end of the hallway, noise was absent and it was perfect to catch up after a long drive!It had the perfect kitchen amenities that we could have used! Away from the bright lights and traffic craziness this was a perfect location !

allReviews.title: Perfect for us
allReviews.text: We had a 2 bedroom 2 bath suite for our family of 4. It was large (2 queens or fulls and 1 king was perfect), clean, quiet and extremely well equipped with a kitchen, living room and very much needed washer/dryer.It is kind of a long walk to the major strip action. This was not an issue for us. I love walking myself, it's a super fast and cheap cab/uber ride if you don't, the monorail is near by...and we really were not there to access the strip anyway. Westgate casino is just a few steps away (as is the convention center). Westgate is not the newest/fanciest/largest of all the casinos, but it had starbucks, bars, restaurants, casino play and all that kind of stuff just a few steps away if needed. It's quiet (love that). You access your room in like 2 minutes (rather than the more typical never ending hikes through huge/busy casinos trying to find the right elevator bank in others). It's clean. There's a pool (small but not crowded) and a deli/market like spot. Game room with DVD's, etc. Our room was probably 4x the size of a typical hotel room with a full kitchen to cook/store meals if that is your preference.The staff was super friendly and helpful. Carlos in particular did a great job both welcoming and assisting us - both in person and by text.It works really well and is a nice alternative to the usual hotel/casino stay option in Las Vegas - particularly for a family.

allReviews.title: Vegas without the crowds
allReviews.text: Great place to stay if you don't want to be on the strip.  Easy access to monorail at the Westgate.  Oh, they want 200 words, well as it's not a mega hotel it's easier to get in and out of.  The parking is free, and there is no resort fee.  The pool is nice, the guests are quite, and the hotel staff is extremely friendly and helpful.  The place is very clean, the little store makes a very good pizza and they also have sandwiches, and hamburgers, and other items you may have left at home.

allReviews.title: AMAZING!!
allReviews.text: This hotel is amazing! If your looking for a family friendly clean, quiet, excellent service, and fun place to stay choose this hotel! This is my second time staying with the Hilton grand and this experience was far better than the first. This place is excellent!

allReviews.title: This place is awesome
allReviews.text: It was so clean and spacious. We liked the mini kitchen area. There is a room with a pool table and games. The pool area was well kept and fun. The staff was so friendly. We ordered pizza from the deli and it was very good.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel. Nice amenities. Close to Convention Center
allReviews.text: This is a great property with nice amenities and very nice staff. It's smoke-free, so no smoky casino to have to walk through to get to your room. The rooms are large and clean. There are a couple of nice lounges to relax in, and a nice market-cafe for food and snacks. HGV is walking distance to the Las Vegas Convention Center and Las Vegas Monorail station. The monorail is an easy way to get to the strip. The Westgate Hotel is right next door if you want to gamble or find a close place to eat. There are several restaurants in the Westgate. I will definitely stay here in the future.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Room (2 queens) was compact but it had most of the thing we needed. We could fit 4 people in the room, but there was not a lot of free spaces to move around. The refrigerator and microwave was helpful. Check out time was 10 am.

allReviews.title: Great Location, professional staff and good rooms.
allReviews.text: Great location, easy commute to the strip. Great staff, very clean facility. There is a casino (Westgate) right next to the Hotel. Parking and internet is free. We booked a 700 sqft room and it was great with 2 kids and 2 adults. Enough space, this was the only one we found of this size. All appliances were clean and the room was well maintained. Everything was great.

allReviews.title: Pizza expo trip
allReviews.text: It was a nice resort very small compared to everything else in Las Vegas , but warm , feel like to were welcomed , I hope to come back in the future to this resort which is close to the convention center and also a good distance from the strip

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: I picked this resort because of the previous reviews and I am so glad I did.  The resort was beautiful.  The staff was very friendly and were ready to help with anything that you may need.  The resort is off the strip so quieter but a short walk and you have the tram to take you there.

allReviews.title: Great staff! Location the best!
allReviews.text: You can't find a better location for the Convention Center. Easy access to freeways. Self parking is very easy. Also very convenient to Disneyland & many restaurants. The staff here is very helpful & courteous.

allReviews.title: Completely ill-equipped for business travelers
allReviews.text: You would think a hotel room would have a desk in it, wouldn't you? According to Ms. Barton, the GM, the desks were "removed during the remodel" and I could pay "$35 to upgrade to a room that had a dining room table in it". She went on to explain that "this is a timeshare property" (completely irrelevant to me, it was sold as a hotel room), and that "our website doesn't say that we have desks" (nor does it say that you have toilets, but I assume there is one in there).There's a business center - that a) I don;'t know if it's open at 3AM when I have to be up for calls, and b) I bristle at the idea of paying for a hotel room then having to go elsewhere to get my work done.The room was cramped, well-worn, and the small round table (and two banquet chairs, great for the back) wouldn't do. I left and paid much less for a significantly larger room at the Mandalay Bay ... with a desk and a magnificent view, and convenient access to things other than just the convention center.If you're a business traveler, avoid this hotel. It's not ready for you to get work done.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Experience
allReviews.text: We traveled to Las Vegas for the school March Break and stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise.  The six days we spent there were great, lots to see and do.  We saw the Cirque show Ka (awesome), Vegas: The Show (Great) and the Donnie and Marie show ( Enjoyed very much).  Walked through most of the casinos which are amazing and huge.  Shopped at the North and South malls as well as on the strip.  Our first day we did the Big Bus hop on hop off tour to get the lay of the land and the narrators were great.  All in all a great vacation with the one exception of the cab driver from the airport.  We told him where we were going and the three streets to get there and asked for a price, he quoted $20 - $23 so we said fine and jumped in.  Unfortunately he took the expressway and upon arrival our bill was $40!  So our vacation started on a sour note but it was rectified by using Uber for the rest of our stay. Great service and prices from Uber.

allReviews.title: Strangely Disappointed
allReviews.text: First off, let me say the staff at this “resort” are some of the Friendliest, most responsive I’ve ever come across in Vegas. The location of this hotel is ideal if you want a break from Vegas Strip madness while here. The monorail is easily accessible from the parking lot (did I mention parking is free), so getting to the strip is a breeze. We were able to get a four night booking the day we arrived, after finding our previously booked motel to be a real fright! The check-in process was a breeze and there was help with our luggage available. Our room was a double queen, with a small refrigerator, small coffee maker, microwave, and dishes. We went down to the Marketplace to get a quick dinner. They have hot grill options, salads, plus an array of quick pick cold options. All options were “meh,” but beat having to go out after a long day of Travel. After our quick meal, we decided to relax in the hot tub, ummm, No, they closed the pool area at 8pm. Wait, what? Then I thought I’d go down in the morning before we head out to do the work we are here for. Nope, they don’t open the pool area until 10am. So we decided to call it an early night. :(The beds are Not firm, they are more what I would describe as Hard. The bedding was nice, with a good selection of pillows. The heat/air worked nicely, so we stayed comfortable temperature wise and the system was quiet, but the only thing quiet about the place (constant sound of Monorail, little refrigerator was extremely loud, neighbors going up/down hallways and every conversation heard like they were in the same room with you including housekeeping yelling back and forth at the crack of dawn). Luckily, I’m not a light sleeper or was too tired to let the noise keep me awake for too long. Day two, we rush back to have some hot tub time. We get down there with 30 minutes to spare and gate does not open. We go to lobby and they have an open discussion across the lobby about whether to let us in. I say, we were told the pool is open until 8, so manager (appears to be and least friendly of all staff we encountered) agrees to allow nice young lady at valet to let us in (wish I’d got her name, this was the second time she assisted/more than accommodated us, as she brought our bags in Thursday evening). Unfortunately, the jets were not working and water was more like a heated pool than a hot tub, temperature wise. We went ahead and stayed and visited with the three other people down there, but were told the pool was closed promptly at 8:00. The next day we tried again to use the hot tub, but the jets were still not working, so I called in to report the problem. We noticed it was working the next day but got in too late from work to use. The next morning I tried to watch a little TV, but couldn’t get the television to work. I called and they sent someone up right away. It was a remote issue that could’ve been easily resolved with a instruction sheet in the room, but the engineer was very kind. They do have a nice bar by the pool, a large business center, and recreation room with pool table and other games, plus DVD’s to check-out. None of which we had time to utilize,but saw lots of law enforcement that were here for the “Baker to Vegas” Marathon enjoying! As I’m preparing to check-out, I’m lamenting about how nice a soak in the hot tub would be with some actual bubbles, unfortunately check-out time is 10:00, did I mention the pool doesn’t open until 10:00, so much for a “Dream Vacation.” PfffI will add, this review would’ve only received three stars if it weren’t for the very kind-helpful young lady at the valet desk, the sweet-informative young man at the desk, and the nice ladies at the Marketplace that we frequented who were always busy and understaffed, but always said hello, and went the extra mile to assist us. Thank you! As for Housekeeping, they did not wash our dishes and were loud outside in the early morning. However, I left them a note that we needed bags for the ice bucket, soap to wash dishes, and the bathroom vent cleaned, all of which was done. I thought they did a good job straightening up our room each day, and we tipped accordingly. I have to say to Hilton, your sister hotel, Hampton does guest service much better (coffee/tea/cocoa options in lobby, comfortable beds, and free hot breakfast). Plus, an open pool area from 6am to 10pm is seriously not too much to ask from a Hilton Grand Vacation (don’t want to hear the excuses) just make it happen! We would stay here again because of the easy access location, free parking, and helpful staff.

allReviews.title: Comfortable and Clean
allReviews.text: The resort is close to the monorail so easy to get around. The staff is very well trained and very friendly. They check on you throughout your stay and value you as a guest. Hilton points are applied and they provide water at checkin. The only problem was no restaurant on site but a sandwich/ convenience store. But just hop in monorail, it’s only a 10 minute walk to the monorail.

allReviews.title: Great stay, super clean, great location
allReviews.text: This is my second time staying here.  I’ll be back in late summer.  If you have a family or just want some space, this is you place.  Rooms were very clean, large and comfortable.  I love the kitchen and full refrigerator.

allReviews.title: Very nice spacious room
allReviews.text: Well located not too far from the action and walking distance from the Convention Center next to the Westgate. My standard room was spacious and clean. Looks like all the rooms and floors have been updated. Nice and peaceful although I had a street view. Good wifi connection free. Only negative was that there is no restaurant serving breakfast. There is a coffee shop and they make a sandwich etc, but not a real breakfast. Close by is a McDonalds and a Dennis (10 min walk). The reception area personnel all very nice and helpful.

allReviews.title: Bathroom Obliviously Dirty.
allReviews.text: Bathroom Obliviously Dirty.  Room not vacuumed well.  I didn't report, because I didn't want to be labeled as difficult on the 1st day of my stay.  I just wore my slipper or shoes at all times.  If you life to sleep-in Don't forget to but up the privacy sign.  House keeper knocking at the door at 8:30am.  Then I heard her knocking the next 2 doors.

allReviews.title: Absolutely the Best Value for Money
allReviews.text: Had a 2 Bedroom Apt .... comfortable and appointed with every conceivable amenity, including Dishwasher, Washing Machine etc ... all new models and in excellent condition.Cheerful, Friendly and Helpful staff added to the pleasure of our stay at HGV. A bit away from the strip .... but Im a big fan of Lyft ... so no problems on that score. Will be my preferred place to stay if going with family and friends

allReviews.title: THE best hidden gem
allReviews.text: So this is NOT a casino type hotel - and that is exactly what we were looking for. So many great things about this place. But the best is the room itself. It totally feels like a beautiful apartment fully equipped, clean and absolutely comfortable. Probably one of the best i've stayed in. The convenient easy check in, parking and amenities are fantastic. The little store has everything you could need for your stay and more. While my family and I didn't have time to enjoy the pool - I did take a quick peek and it was beautiful. This place is super convenient a short distance from the strip in a much quieter location and is only a block or two from the convention center. Another plus was how huge the room is for a family of 4-5.

allReviews.title: Second time here
allReviews.text: The remodel was a nice update with new hard finishes throughout. We really found the bed mattress and coverings were well above average comfort. Well located and very quiet for being just off the main strip.

allReviews.title: Clean, quite Las Vegas stay.
allReviews.text: We stayed there for the first time last spring and it was phenomenal.  The room we stayed in was like a fully stocked condo.  There was no casino or restaurant on site which made the resort very quiet, clean and smoke free.  The stay included free water bottles every day and free movie rentals. If you want a quiet Vegas vacation away from the rowdiness Vegas can attract, this is your place.  I would highly recommend it for families too!

allReviews.title: Las Vagas plus Sightseeing; Perfect Combo
allReviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise is located just off famed Las Vegas Blvd.  Convenient walk to Monorail for Famous Strip locations, entertainment and dining and bus stop for Downtown Freemont Street lazer light show and original casinos.  Front door taxi pickup always available.  15 minute taxi from airport to your locations front door; approx. $25 USD.  Utilize this quiet Hilton for your stay and book shows, day trips and sightseeing tours.  Nevada and surrounding states abound with untold beauties.  Luxury suites are fully equipped, clean, comfortable with terrific friendly Hilton Staff and Consierge Service.  Just plan, go, do and rest.

allReviews.title: A, great for your shoulders, Jacuzzi bath tub.
allReviews.text: Excellent pool bar service. Huge outdoor hot tub. Close to the rail transit.Certainly not the Bellagio, but easy parking and a better lobby and gift shop than at the Trump hotel.A good Las Vegas location for a family.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas Suite Hotel!
allReviews.text: Stayed here in late January for a week for a convention my husband was attending, and we stayed for the Super Bowl weekend. For a long stay this hotel was perfect, I don’t think I can do more than 2 nights on the strip now, for a long stay I need a suite in a non-casino hotel. We arrived late but where quickly checked in. The hotel is a 10 minute walk to the convention center through the Westgate hotel next door, and that’s where you can catch the tram too, super close. The room was great! A big clean modern suite, with a completely stocked kitchen with dishwasher, great bathroom with great tub, lots of closet space and a washer/dryer, loved that! The room was very quite and the bed was really comfortable. It was very easy to Uber from there and did Uber eats a few times. There is a deli/grocery store downstairs that has a good selection and seemed to always be open, not sure if they close. Very happy with my stay and would comeback.

allReviews.title: Always goood with Hilton
allReviews.text: Was her for a show at the convention center.  Last year we stayed at a Hilton Grand VC away from the strip that was much bigger and nicer lobby and amenities.  But Paradise has newly renovated guest suites and is perfect if you are not looking for the hustle and bustle of Vegas or the strip (No restaurant, bar or casino).

allReviews.title: Beautiful updated suites
allReviews.text: This hotel is beautiful. I stayed on the 17th floor in a newly renovated suite. Full kitchen, living room, kitchen table, separate bedroom and a huge soaking tub. I love this hotel. The only bummer is no free breakfast. Parking is free and you get extra points at check out, taking the place of free breakfast if you are a diamond member. Perfect room for a family or business traveler such as myself.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: concierge service - helped with purchasing show tickets, dinner reservations, monorail tickets, etc.  The assistance offered is fantastic, the city itself was very friendly, the streets were clean & safe

allReviews.title: Very Nice contemporary hotel for both business and pleasure
allReviews.text: Beautiful suites and golf course view, couldn't find an in house good restaurants but that make up for the beautiful suites. Seem to be a franchisee rather than a regular Hilton Hotel. I'll definitely go back

allReviews.title: Highly commended!
allReviews.text: We enjoy our time in this hotel, the staff are very friendly and helpful. It is family friendly and not far from the mono rail. Our room is clean and tidy and the facilities are good as well.The concierge in the front the reservation staff are very helpful and accommodating ( we came to know Bonnie, Esther, Odette and others), our son has many colour pencils and rubber duckies from the staff. the security guard is very helpful and the cleaning lady ( Norma) did an excellent job with the room. Thank you for an excellent service.

allReviews.title: Great location off strip, clean and comfortable with great rooms
allReviews.text: My team of fitness instructors and I stayed here during the 2017 IDEA FIT conference. It was perfect.  Off the strip, calm with bar and snacks.  Rooms were AH-MAZING for a large group and we really enjoyed our stay here.  There was plenty of room for everyone.  The walk was quick over to the convention center, the monorail made travel easy enough to get over to the strip!

allReviews.title: Calm and Classy!
allReviews.text: Spent New Year's Eve and another four nights in this calm, classy, and family-friendly hotel. My sister booked for a family suite with two-bedroom complete with amenities such as fully furnished kitchen, with laundry and drying machine and living room. We couldn't ask for more. Service is efficient! Did not miss their strong spa which has the most warm effect on the body. Their two pools are refreshingly warm, with life guards always on alert. Will definitely go back in next year! More power to Hilton!

allReviews.title: A home away from home close to the strip
allReviews.text: We had a group of adult friends going to Las Vegas for a 3 day weekend to celebrate a birthday. When we booked we were looking for a room that would take 6 guests, so we could all stay together, and to avoid additional 'resort charges' that the area charges for each room.  It was actually more cost effective to rent a suite, than it was 3 double rooms.   And we found what we were looking for at the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise.  The suite was two units; a 1 bedroom king with a separate living room area (which had a comfortable sleeper sofa), and fully stocked kitchen (with full sized appliances).
