The 2nd bedroom was a jointing unit with 2 queen beds and a small bar sink, and mini frig. Everything was clean and orderly.  (We could have slept 8 guests in this room if needed, and the resort rules allowed it.) The lobby is small, but the Activity Room and the Business Center which are right off of the lobby gives plenty of space, comfort , & convenience.  The Activity Room is very kid friendly and has a pool table, DVD rental machine, big Screen TV, large sofa, lots of tables & chairs. The Business Center has two nice sitting areas, and an office space with desk top computers with printer access. Across the hall from the business center is a small shop with snack foods, drinks, and a Starbucks.  There is a small, but has most of what you need, Fitness Room.  There is a nice outdoor pool, hot tub, & patio.  Everything is easy access, clean, functional, and convenient.  There are no casino machines on property.  However the Westgate resort (use to be the old 'Elvis' Hilton) next door is in walking distance, and it has a large casino floor with all you want plus several retail stores, full service spa, restaurants, bars, and a really nice buffet. The Monorail is within walking distance of the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise. There are two monorail stops close by; One at the Westgate & one at the SLS.  The staff was great!  Friendly, helpful, attentive, & happy.  A fantastic stay, couldn't have asked for better.

allReviews.title: Eh...not my fav
allReviews.text: Stayed for business.  Wouldn’t stay again.   Too many options in Vegas...even other Hilton properties.  Room was decent.  Food not so much.  Location not the best. I will say the staff were EXTREMELY friendly which made up for what the hotel was lacking but I wouldn’t stay here again.

allReviews.title: Love this place!
allReviews.text: Great location and hotel staff is extremely helpful!Lots of space - very clean - outstanding service!  Ideal setup for a long stay - I was there for 21 nights and was very comfortable in my suite - washer and dryer in room so you can still pack light - full kitchen gives option of eating in!

allReviews.title: Good location...really thin walls..good luck on sleeping at night or in the morning
allReviews.text: Visited during MLK weekend and there were several large family groups (groups of families with several kids each traveling together) staying at this property with really loud, tantum-having kids.  The property sent security up twice but there was not much else they could do.  If it's noisy on your floor, good luck to you my friend.  We basically spent most of our time outside of the room and prayed the noisy next door neighbors would leave soon (no such luck...we checked out before they did).Otherwise, the property is off of the vegas strip which we liked...right on the monorail line and about a 10-15 Uber ride everywhere you'd want to go.  I'd never been to vegas on vacation before so it was nice to stay off the vegas strip and go to the old part of vegas and see the casinos and ambiance at some of the older nostalgic parts of vegas like the Golden Nugget, Oscars, Binions, etc.

allReviews.title: Nice to come home
allReviews.text: Always nice to come back to this HGVC on Karen ave. The reason I like this HGVC is the ease of parking. The HGVC on the boulevard is also good, but to park in the parking structure is a hassle. This HGVC the parking is so much easier.

allReviews.title: Not your typical Vegas hotel which is a nice break from the scene
allReviews.text: If you're looking for the whole Vegas feel in your hotel then HGVC Paradise is not the place for you. It's more like a typical hotel that just happens to be in Vegas which is perfect if you're looking for a little quiet from the casinos. That being said the location is still great, especially for any CES events you're going to in the LVCC or Westgate - you can walk there in 5-10 mins instead of dealing with transportation. The Wynn Encore is a 5 minute cab ride away and there's a monorail at Westgate (10 minute walk) if you're in the monorail mood.  The one downside is there's no sit down breakfast option here. They have a well stocked store downstairs where you can get about anything you'd need and a grill that can serve you up something hot to go. Their pizzas are surprisingly tasty.  I'd stay here again if I needed to be at this end of the strip.

allReviews.title: Convenient and family-friendly atmosphere :-)
allReviews.text: It was under renovation due to upgrades (so a lot of dust and construction going on) when we visited friends in the hotel.  Love the cozy and casual feel - not too overwhelming like the next door Westgate Hotel.  This hotel also just put installed nice designed new carpets on the hallways.  There was a  good-size sitting room in a 2-bedroom suite that our friends booked. Overall two-thumbs up if you want to get away from the madding Strip crowd, yet be close to the Convention Center - just a walking distance away.

allReviews.title: Best suite we had in Vegas
allReviews.text: We are here for CES, this is best suite hotel we been stay in last 10 yearNice room, friendly and great locationThe new remodel room are up to industary standardThat is little be off Blvd, so, not that busy as major hotel, easy to parking

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: Smoke free, friendly and homey stay.  Fitness center was just enough.  Parking was near and uncomplicated.  Some staff were friendly, greets us and smiles in the hallway and around the property however, some were just stoic.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel but poor location
allReviews.text: We stayed here from Dec 29 -Jan1, 2018 for the NYE celebration. We are owner and checked into a 1-bdrm suite. Room was cozy, clean, with comfortable bed and good shower. Nice and quiet, with no smoky lobby to cross, unlike those large hotels on the Strip. What they can improve is Front Desk/ Concierge Service regarding transportation info. We leaned the hard way. Information given to us was conflicting.  A piece of paper printed re transportation info would be a great help.This hotel is located far from the Strip. Don't try to walk there.  It will take over an hour.  Three options: Option 1, take the Monorail across from Westgate. It's $5 per person per trip. Buy your ticket from the machine before you board.  Option 2, take the  SDX (Strip Downtown Express) bus.  There is a SDX Bus Stop across from the Monorail SLS stop, south board to the Strip. Coming back, the Stop would be directly underneath the Monorail at SLS/Sahara stop. $6 per person good for 2 hours, or $8 per person for 24 hours, or 3 day pass for $20.  Option 3: Take a cab. Cab fare is around $14 to Bellagio.There's no restaurant on site, but there is a Marketplace where you can get most essential stuff, plus coffee and sandwiches.We moved to the Bellagio on New Year Day but the cigarettes smoke in their lobby was terrible.  Food is expensive on the Strip.  So this hotel is a nice little place to stay, only that it is inconvenient.  Stratosphere is 15 minutes walk away (north of this hotel)

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Had a great stay!Convienant location!Clean, friendly and very accommodating!I've stayed at many places in Cegas and would definetly stay here again!Also appreciated the security they had in property!

allReviews.title: 2017 HAPPY NEW YEAR in VEGAS
allReviews.text: HGV owner bucket list trip. Vegas fro NY'S should have been amazing but the Hotel did not live up to it's reputation.  Selected a Studio with K bed.  Got there studios have all been redone and now have 2 Q beds.  No where is site is this mentioned.  Would have upgraded if information would have been available.  A/C is totally controlled and the rooms would not go lower than 72.  Ended up having to use a fan - really!!  On vacation.  In a Hilton-come on man!  Good luck if you want 4 towels instead of two.  Oh yeah-room gets cleaned on the 4th day of your stay if you are an HGV owner and every other day of you are a regular guest.  Nice huh! Great way of treating Hilton Owner! This placed sucked and I will not come back here ever not do I recommend anyone to stay here.

allReviews.title: Great for families
allReviews.text: There are many HGVC properties in the area.  If you’re looking for something just off the Strip, but still close enough to walk to the sites, this is a great place.  It’s far more civilized and calmer than the HGVC Strip property.  Great heated outdoor pool and hot tub, but very limited hours (1000-1800).  I’ve never seen a hotel that closes the pool solely because there is no lifeguard on duty.  Front desk staff is hit or miss, but the overall experience is still a 10!

allReviews.title: Always perfect!!!
allReviews.text: I stay here every time I come to vegas and love the rooms and employees. Everyone is extremely accommodating. Room service is perfect. They have a great play room for pool and other activities, nice swimming pool and business room. Also a great store downstairs that had a large selection of food and drink

allReviews.title: Kinda Sterile
allReviews.text: We stopped in Las Vegas for one night on our way to the Grand Canyon.  The Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise is a clean, quiet hotel that was just a hotel.  Very sterile nothing to indicate what city you are in.  The rooms were fine, clean and roomy.  The "breakfast"  was a egg mcmuffin thing you could get at the starbucks coffee store in the lobby.

allReviews.title: Biggest. Bathtub. Ever.
allReviews.text: Yeah the bathtub was huge. I took two adults comfortably.But what I liked about this place was that it is off the strip, has no pokies and is family friendly overall.We booked a studio apartment but had a coupon/code to upgrade to a one bedroom suite. It was fabulous. One of the biggest I’ve had in a one BR suite before. The bed was comfortable and from our room had a night view of the Vegas lights at night.There was a large, well stocked kitchen, full size fridge and in-room washer and dryer.We expected the room to be serviced every third day, but it was attended ever day of our stay which was great.The only thing stopping me from giving this place five stars was the heavy sales pitch for Hilton’s time-share holiday scheme when we checked in. Worse, was the early morning (before 9am) phone call the following day checking again to see if we were interested in time-share. After a 30+hour flight we just wanted a sleep in and did NOT appreciate the wake up call!

allReviews.title: Lovely place to stay
allReviews.text: Family of three stayed in a one bedroom suite at Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise. Room was great. Master bedroom for 2 adults and pull out couch for miss 6. Sofa couch was comfy and queen size. Massive tub to swim in each night after waking the strip all day. Full size kitchen was a bonus. It’s not in the thick of the Vegas Strip but that’s what drew us to the hotel. Also no casino linked to it which again ticked our needs. So quiet and friendly staff. 5 minute walk to the bus that runs to the strip every 15 minutes. Great stay all round.

allReviews.title: Family fun in Vegas
allReviews.text: We had a lovely time during Christmas at the HGV resort in Karen Avenue. The resort was very family oriented, ie no casinos, no smoke with enough space for my husband, my 8 and 10 year old and my mother in law. I used the small gym every day and although it only has the basics it was good enough to keep with the fitness routine. It was inside Vegas but away from the traffic and chaos of the strip.

allReviews.title: Happy Thanksgiving Stay
allReviews.text: Our family stayed here during Thanksgiving week. We stayed here previously during the summer and they have since remodeled. We had a pool view renovated room at the end of the hall. The room upgrades look great - beautiful color scheme (teal, brown, grey), 2nd bedroom now has two queens rather than a king and sofa bed, new flooring in living room area. Kids love the free video rentals. Received discount card and coupons to spend in Vegas, and extra Hilton Honors points. Special thanks to the following staff who made the trip extra special: Ashley (called while we were in route to Las Vegas to see if there were any additional needs for our stay), Carlos (front desk - thumbs up, top notch customer service), Cecilia, Ramon, and Regla - all of the staff was great even though I did not get everyone's names.

allReviews.title: Visit to Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Las Vegas is a place that many think is only Casinos. We visit every year for NFR and keep busy and have fun without ever stepping into a casino. This hotel is a wonderful smoke free environment. The hotel has many things to do if you chose to just stay there. They also are always willing to help you find things to do like going to shows and such. The rooms are large and if you have a group, there is enough room to gather and enjoy.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel, Disappointing Room
allReviews.text: The hotel and grounds are very nice and look well-maintained and manicured.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The elevators were fast, with very little wait time.  By the lobby there is a large game room with pool table, video games, and a hang out area.  There is also a large business center across the hall and a very well stocked market/Starbucks coffee store.I stayed in a 2 queen bed studio room.  From everything I read online, I was expecting something a lot better.  The room was very nice, but also very small.  There was a tiny kitchen area with mini fridge, microwave, and small sink.  Across from the kitchen area was a very small bathroom.  The shower head and water pressure were excellent.  The rest of the room had very little space left for the two beds, TV, and little round table.  There was no desk and no power near the table to work.  The TV had a good assortment of channels to choose from, and also had available HDMI ports.  The bed was comfortable, but the pillows were all very soft.  There didn't seem to be a variety of firmness with the pillows.  The curtains did a great job of blocking out any light.  The air conditioner was hit or miss.  Sometimes it could keep the room cool, other times it seemed to just shut off on its own.  The low, medium, and high fan settings seemed to do little good, as it always seemed to blow air at a very low rate.The hotel has a decent gym with some cardio machines, a basic assortment of dumbbells, one bench, and a multi cable machine.  The pool area is nice and has a BBQ area with several tables and chairs.The hotel is located very close to the monorail station at the Westgate, making it easy to get to the strip, if you don't have a car.I will give this place one more try, and book a different room, hoping that it is better than the cramped studio room.

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: I asked for a renovated room so that the mattresses would be comfortable, but alas they were not. The sofa bed was however comfortable and did not squeak or sag as in other Hilton Resort rooms. The shower was nice and plenty of hot water. As this hotel is off the strip it was more quiet. Easy to get to the strip as near the monorail so did not need a car.

allReviews.title: Great no hassle stay
allReviews.text: Wonderful recently upgraded hotel. This hotel is a vacation club style resort. It has a nice store attached for food for your room. Wonderful Concierge staff that stay on top of your needs. Great size rooms considering you are in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice, Roomy, Clean
allReviews.text: Newly remodel room. Suite is very spacious with separate bedroom and its own hvac control. 2 sets of tv, comfortable sleeper sofa. Even has the new carpet smell on the hallway. Friendly staff. Free DVD rental

allReviews.title: No casino, no restaurant, NO SMOKING! YEAH!
allReviews.text: We love this hotel.  It is small with a "boutique" feel.  We come to Las Vegas to visit family and we do not smoke or gamble.  We avoid the strip traffic and no fee to park.  The pool is great, (when we have time to use it.)  The staff are friendly, helpful and accommodating.  We stay here several times per year.

allReviews.title: Great job on the well deserved renovations
allReviews.text: Wasn't all that great last year. The place look fabulous with the new carpet, paint, and furniture. The parking was messed up. Had to drive around to the West Gate drive way to park in front of the property. We don't feel safe parking in parking garage. Someone should control / direct how people with big rigs and trailers park so space could be utilized efficiently. Marking the stalls would also help.

allReviews.title: Nice Resort
allReviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise is a nice resort. The lobby is small but clean and welcoming. We were greeted by Ms, Auquanette who was VERY friendly and helpful. We arrived 3 hrs before check in and she was kind enough to let us  check in early for which we were grateful. Our suite was a lockout with an adjoining door between the 1 bedroom units. The rooms are spacious and nicely furnished. We had a view of the pool from the 12th floor. Ms. Auquanette was kind to text me later that afternoon to be sure that everything was good with the rooms. The Hilton does not have a full service restaurant. It does have a Marketplace that serves freshly made sandwiches and pizzas. There  are refrigerated cases with milk, water, ice cream, liquor, beer, sodas and a variety of food items. You can also purchase oatmeal, snacks and pastries. It is important to note that you CANNOT use cash in the Marketplace. You have to use a credit card with your ID or charge purchases to your room. If you must have a restaurant, next door to the Hilton is the Westgate Hotel which boasts several full service restaurants and a Buffett. You can also catch the Mono rail at the Westgate which will take you to several stops along the strip. Oh, I almost forgot. Ms. Merlyn  works at the Marketplace and she is a precious gem. She always greeted us with a beautiful smile. We really enjoyed our stay at the Hilton and we would stay again.

allReviews.title: Always happy with the facilities, ammenities and comfort
allReviews.text: The hotel has been updated. It's very clean and comfortable. Walking distance to fun places. Nice business lounge area. Nice game room with pool table, game machines, movie rental area. Didn't get a chance to use the pool because it was so cold but it looked nice.

allReviews.title: Highlights of Vegas
allReviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacation Resorts is a jewel, Fantastic location from the Strip. Covered Parking, elaborate room accommodations, quiet setting, and a professional friendly staff. I would definitely recommend this resort to my friends and family.

allReviews.title: First class!
allReviews.text: Absolutely the best place we've ever stayed.  We are repeat visitors.  NOBODY has better service or rooms. The wifi always worked and was FAST. The rooms are brand new. The beds and pillows are super comfortable. The STAFF are the best on the planet.  We will go back and this is our first choice for every vacation.

allReviews.title: Couldn't have been better
allReviews.text: Spotless, quiet, comfortable, great staff.  Everything you could ask for in a hotel and a terrific value. I've stayed here before and enjoyed it, but everything has been updated.  Fresh paint, new carpets, everything to a great hotel better.  The one bedroom suite with full kitchen and giant soaking tub was fantastic.

allReviews.title: Fabulous hote with easy access to Vegaa
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel. Staff was on point with everything. It’s off the strip but close to monorail access. Pool and fitness room we’re on point as well. No problems with anything. I look forward to staying here again and hopefully very soon!!

allReviews.title: Nice place, FANTASTIC staff
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my time at this hotel.  Really, really nice and helpful staff.  The place was clean, and well-kept.  Everything worked well, and the guest rooms were very comfortable.  I can't say enough about how nice and helpful the staff was.  It really made my stay even more enjoyable.

allReviews.title: I already miss Hgv on Paradise
allReviews.text: Enjoyed fully our 10 day stay in HGV on Paradise.  We had 1 bedroom apartment facing towards golf course. Absolutely nothing to complain. I liked the color palette of these renovated rooms. Kitchen was on spot. Big thanks that hgv was able to fulfill my wishes related to room. Appreciate the effort made to keep rooms up to date.

allReviews.title: Partly renovated room
allReviews.text: We stay at the HGVC Paradise/Convention Center 5-6 time per year.  Because we are visiting family, we are able to look for "down" weeks where there is not a big convention or event in town, so we get low rates.  This makes the 1 Br. suite with full kitchen quite a value.  It is large (750 sq. ft.) and has amenities such as a washer/dryer and spa tub.  The kitchen has range, microwave, dishwasher and large refrigerator/freezer.  Since the room had bee renovated, the furniture was new in the living room, and the cabinets had been refinished or replaced, so there were none of the dings and old paint we had experienced in the past. This is a non-gambling venue, and is usually fairly quiet.  The pool area is attractive, though small, and has a service bar which is open into the early evening.  The deli will prepare food, but also is a mini-market for food and sundry items. We have been staying here for many years, and find the location and free parking to be appealing.

allReviews.title: Great staff!
allReviews.text: We and our 2 teen aged sons found this to be a great oasis. Rooms are brand new and staff is extremely friendly and accommodating. Free, easy parking, good market in the lobby. Pool area and gym is nice - even has nice grilling area. They have pool table and video game area. Wish the pool side bar was open more - gave them that feedback, so maybe soon! Had holiday dinner delivered to suite from hotel food & beverage - was great!

allReviews.title: Thanksgiving weekend
allReviews.text: This is a very nice clean property.  The Westgate is a three minute walk with access to the tram system. The tram will move you from the convention center to the MGM. The pool is nice with a large hot tub. There are free DVD rentals with the room and the snack bar is well stocked but they do not take cash.

allReviews.title: A very good place to stay off the strip
allReviews.text: The Location is awesome, its off the strip but very accessible to the strip. Multi room suites for big groups with lots of amenities and if you feel like gambling, Westgate is walking distance and the rest of the strip is just a monorail ride away.

allReviews.title: Great Off Strip HGVC
allReviews.text: Stayed here for two nights recently. We were in a one bedroom suite which was of good size.  It appeared to be a remodeled unit with newer furnishings. The staff was friendly and check in and out was quick.  A good little gym as well as a snack deli store on site. Good experience all around.

allReviews.title: Excellent staff Great hotel
allReviews.text: Staff were very helpful with a booking mix up and made things right immediately.  Very clean and well maintained.  Hot tub was nice and pool was great.  Our 2 bedroom suite was perfect for us and our 2 teens.  Privacy, but a common room in the middle of the 2 rooms.  Loved it!

allReviews.title: Feels like home
allReviews.text: I love staying at this property.  Every time I come to Vegas this is where I stay.  I see all the same friendly and happy faces at the front desk and in the shop.  The property is undergoing a renovation but you would never know it.  I had a newly renovated room and it was awesome.  Every time I needed something they bent over backwards to help.  I will only stay at this property when staying in Vegas

allReviews.title: Hassle Free Stay
allReviews.text: Enjoyed my recent stay at this property.  Quaint property where you don't have to walk far from the parking garage, casino and smoke free, spacious rooms with comfy beds, all you've come to expect in a suite.  Nice market downstairs that can also whip up a burger, sandwich, or pizza.  Beautiful pool and spa.  Could do without the resort fee but the room was only $89 so hard to complain.  Service was very nice, no pressure to sit through a sales presentation.  A little far from the strip but a short uber ride will get you were you need to be.

allReviews.title: Close enough to the Convention Center if you want a hotel with no casino
allReviews.text: A nice property with lots of free parking.  A five minute walk to the neighbouring Westgate Hotel with all the amenities of a big strip hotel. (bars, restaurants, casino, shopping etc.) A further 10 minutes to walk to the Convention Center. I highly recommend walking to the Convention Center unless you are just dropping someone off in the morning as it is a quick easy drive with no congestion.  Picking up from the Convention Center at peak times is more difficult.  If you choose to park at the Convention Center there was a $10 charge as an exhibitor.  However, parking was hard to find and for free parking you had to park blocks away.Back to the hotel! Very nice King Suite room for a decent price overlooking the golf course and some mountains.  Coffee shop and a small market in the hotel.  Did not use the pool but it looked pleasant albeit a smaller pool.  The Front Desk and Housekeeping was excellent.  There is no full service restaurant in the hotel but they do have a listing of local area food delivery which was handy.  I would return here if attending a convention.

allReviews.title: clean and comfortable resort
allReviews.text: Came for 5 nights.  Was nice to have microwave and fridge. pool and hot tub are clean and warm.  walked to the strip many times - not a short walk, but easy enough. closer to the convention center, SLS, and Westgate casinos. city buses run nearby.

allReviews.title: Vegas for family
allReviews.text: Excellent location off of strip. Great for family away from noise and casinos. Resort is within walking distance to the monorail which takes you to major hotels and casinos. Close to Stratosphere Hotel and restaurants

allReviews.title: What a Hilton should be!
allReviews.text: We stayed here for a week and had an excellent time.  The staff are very friendly, and went out of their way to take care of us.  The rooms are very clean.  This is a non-gaming hotel, so its nice to be away from the normal Vegas atmosphere.  We loved the pool and hot tub.  Overall a great property for families.  Was close to the WestGate Monorail station, so you are within touch of all the Vegas action.  The only downfall, I was hounded a few days before arrival trying to set up a time that they could show me more about their time shares.  I wont let that bother me too much because everything else exceeded expectations, most notably the awesome staff.

allReviews.title: Our new favorite place to stay!
allReviews.text: This little hidden gem is fantastic!  Let's start with free parking, which we know is hard to find in Vegas these days.  There is a huge lot and also a parking structure right next to the hotel.  Easy Peasy. The property is small and there is no casino so once you check in it's a quick walk to the elevator and on up to your room.  No dragging your bags around machines, gamblers, waitresses, tables, etc.  And speaking of no casino, there is also no noise and no smoke!  Imagine coming back to a quiet place to lay your head after being in noisy casinos all day!The room itself was lovey.  It has everything you could want or need for your stay including a full kitchen.  I'm a snacker, so having things on hand in the room is a must for me and here I have a place to put it all!  Upgrade to the suite and have a hug spa tub right in the room with you!  It's fabulous.  The bed and linens were the best I've ever had.  We slept like babies here, and I can't wait to come back.  I  can't say enough wonderful things about the room.

allReviews.title: Nice place off the strip
allReviews.text: Overall a pleasant experience. I liked staying off the strip, but close to the monorail. The fitness center has a good variety of equipment, but seemed small when 3 men where all using it at the same time. The Market has a good variety of products to buy. I especially enjoyed the salads and pizza.

allReviews.title: Nice, Quiet & Comfortable
allReviews.text: It’s almost the end of our week long trip and it has been an enjoyable stay at HGVC on Paradise. Concierge Esther was always helpful and informative, whether it was getting seats at shows or giving us directions to and from places. We also enjoyed talking with José in the mornings when I came outside for a smoke and coffee. He was always quick with morning pleasantries and always asked our visit was going and offering to help us if we needed anything. I liked the fact that this place was away from all the hustle and bustle of the strip but close enough to enjoy. It’s a short jaunt to the Monarail (5 minute walk) and you can go back and forth to any of the major casinos throughout the day and night.The suites are spacious and has a washer/dryer, a full kitchen and a super comfortable bed. There’s a mini mart downstairs with Starbuck coffee, sandwiches, etc which was nice to have available. We have been able to enjoy the pool and hot tub in the afternoons.The minor negatives are with the newly renovated rooms. There’s not enough spacing between the kitchen cabinet drawers so the first time I opened a drawer, it gashed the side end with the handle of another drawer. I showed a maintenance guy we happened to run into that day. When coming back to our room Tuesday evening, the faucets in both the kitchen and bathroom sputtered and we no longer have cold water which is needed to make coffee and fill water bottles. The hot plate on the coffee maker is loose and worn. The biggest negative was there is no bar. There was a pool bar when we arrived on Saturday but they were closing for the season the next day until March. We’re not big drinkers and do not enjoy the same drinks so it didn’t make sense to go buy and stock the suite. It would of been nice to be able to grab a beer or have a cocktail here and there at the place.

allReviews.title: Newly Decorated room
allReviews.text: Great room recently remodeled. Large shower, comfortable bed.?We had a one bedroom with a great view of Vegas. The only issue I have was parking and traffic around hotel due to convention center ....Taxi meter just a running

allReviews.title: Very Nice!!
allReviews.text: An overnight stay here for a convention proved to be very nice and accommodating. The suite was lovely, spacious and well furnished. They allowed an early check in as I was traveling with my son who has special needs. An item got left outside and was still turned in to lost and found. I highly recommend staying here if you're looking for a nice place without casinos in a good part of town.

allReviews.title: Great off the strip place to stay, but no restaurants
allReviews.text: We stayed here for one night a Saturday, and then the next week on a Sunday on our way to and then from Park City, Utah.  We had a studio the Saturday night and a one bedroom on Sunday night.  We were very happy with the hotel, except there are no restaurants.  There's a small store with a deli in it that has things like pizza, sandwiches, breakfast burritos and breakfast muffins, etc., but not a real restaurant.  They also only have a part-time bar, that closes during late Fall and Winter.  There is a Westgate Resort within walking distance so you can go there and gamble, eat, drink, etc.  All in all it was a nice place with clean nice rooms and a very congenial staff.  I would definitely stay there again.  Be careful and conscientious as they share the parking structure with the Westgate and Westgate may charge for parking so get it validated at the Hilton Grand if you get a ticket.  When the convention center is loaded with parking the Westgate then has charged for parking so be wary.

allReviews.title: Great Vegas resort hotel
allReviews.text: THE HGVC is located near the Westgate Hotel on Paradise. The parking is free and always available. The HGVC is a quiet spot away from Vegas congestion. The rooms are very comfortable and spacious.  Even the studios are large and comfortable.

allReviews.title: Perfect place to stay
allReviews.text: Went for a staycation with friends and got the 2 room suite. It came stocked with glass dishes and had spacious accommodations. Everything was clean and the general store was nicely stocked and open until 10.

allReviews.title: Made a hectic week calm.
allReviews.text: Staff were completely accommodating and eager to help with anything I needed. The only issue I had was with the ATM in the business center, otherwise a 5 star rating. Classy, friendly staff, rooms were perfect.

allReviews.title: Water Shut Off!
allReviews.text: Everything was going well after 2 days. Got in late last night and went up to the room.Was woken up this morning by construction noise. Went to take a shower at about 11am; no water! Per the front desk, the hotel was doing some remodelling and the water would be off until at least 4pm. However, we could come down to the lobby and use the shower in the public rest-room!After yelling at the manager, she told us that a notice was posted in the elevator and a voicemail left. No voicemail on the room phone or my cellphone. The public notice was an 11×8 piece of paper with normal print in the activities board. Apparently, per the manager, it was too difficult to leave a note at each room or on each guest's cell phone. Though the timeshare reps and concierge had no problem contacting me to try to sell a timeshare (twice) - no notice of the construction.No advance notice when we checked in either. TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE FROM THE MANAGEMENT!

allReviews.title: awesome stay
allReviews.text: From time you arrive your welcomed by friendly professional staff that make sure your stay is a great one they make sure you know all the amenities are the free dvd rentals where the restaurants are in the area also the market place inside the hotel offers good food the hotel is being remodeled but it's still a great stay the rooms are awesome the area is perfect for a Vegas trip everything inside the hotel is worth a Five Star will stay again. One night and you be back.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: Suites were very nice.  Great location to relax after a long day at the Convention hall.  Quiet rooms and nice living space.  There is no restaurant but nice kitchen to make your own meals or go out to the many great places in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: This hotel is excellent for families or if you just want to be away from the Strip. Rooms are very clean, tidy and large. Staff were friendly. I wish they had a better on site cafe or a restaurant and bar (besides the pool bar).

allReviews.title: Exceeded all expectations
allReviews.text: I came to town to visit friends and picked the HGVP because I didn't want to have to fight my way through a casino to get to my room. My room (the smallest category) was newly renovated and beautiful.  It had a kitchenette with a sink, microwave, coffee maker and empty refrigerator and it was equipped with dishes and utensils.  The room had nice features like a multi-connector cell phone charger.  The beds were more comfortable than any hotel bed I've experienced in years.  I left my computer charger in the room and Steve the Security director located it and sent it back to me immediately.  There is a deli/market with a good selection of food items.  And they have a shuttle to take guests to the Strip.

allReviews.title: No consideration for high tier members
allReviews.text: It seems the personal in this hotel needs to be briefed and reminded on how much people spend per year to get a gold status ... just poor service overall for high tier members. Hotel was on going some upgrade work, so there was a smell of paint in the room.

allReviews.title: Vegas on business
allReviews.text: Attending a conference/exhibition at the Westgate nearby. Found the Grand Vacations to be everything I needed with good wifi, pleasant staff and decent facilities. Its not full service, the bar closes by 9 at night and if there was room service I couldnt find evidence, but this is Vegas and most evenings I was out! There's no slots, which for me was a plus.

allReviews.title: Sirbuz
allReviews.text: Very nice newly updated rooms. The entire resort was first class. Great front desk person. The only two deficiencies we're the location off the strip and the fact that there was no restaurant on site.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas ABC Kids Expo
allReviews.text: Nice non-casino facility, within walking distance of convention center. Good Pizza in the Marketplace convince store. Barbecue grills by the pool. Washer and dryer great for a longer stay. Oven not just a microwave.

allReviews.title: Close to convention center, OK rooms, 7-11 like food
allReviews.text: This hotel with a grandiose name is entirely equivalent to a small town Best-Western with the 7-11 across the street being the only choice for "in-house" dining.  Too bad the rates were more in line with the grandiose name.It's my fault, really for booking too late to get a room at the Westgate, the actual former LV-Hilton.  But I wanted to be able to walk to my conference.The front door is a brisk 15 minute walk from the central hall of the convention center (I timed it), if you cut across the Westgate hotel.  (& grab breakfast along the way to your conference)My room was entirely satisfactory. Clean, good bed, clean bathroom with good towels. In house dining consisted of a convenience store offering pastries, packaged sandwiches, and microwaved breakfast sandwiches and burritos,  And pizza. Just like a 7-11, but without the taquitos, and less choice for coffee. Your actual food options will be the Westgate hotel (so-so by LV standards), 5-10 minutes away by foot, or the SLS Hotel & casino, 10-15 minutes away by foot. Or anything you can access from the Monorail. Bottom line:  it'll do, eat somewhere else, walk to your conference. Hope work is paying.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Great location walked to convention center rooms were great for a group to meet super quite  family friendly  small grocery store had the basics two room suite was great to share with friends and have the living room/kitchen to share

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: This property fulfills it’s name “Paradise”. The pool at this property is amazing. It has a bar at the hotel. Lots of places to relax next to the pool. It has great beds and views from the rooms. The entry of the hotel was so nice. One of the best hotels I’ve ever stayed at.

allReviews.title: Renovations enhance this hotel
allReviews.text: Since our last visit, this hotel has gone through massive renovations. All rooms now renovated from 7th floor up.  Sadly there are a couple of negatives - very poor internet service and the art in the room is awful.  All three pictures featured the Las Vegas neon sign graveyard.  Just ghastly.  That being said the room was beautifully decorated - loved the color scheme - not quite sure why every room has to have a sleeper sofa. They are notoriously uncomfortable to sit on and the one in our room did not offer comfortable seating. Also appeared that the hotel is not so careful with appointing front of staff.  Guy that we most frequently dealt with would not even make eye contact when we spoke with him. We have such wonderful memories of previous visits that this place continues to draw us back for each visit to Las Vegas.  The cleaning staff deserve a mention as it was a delight to come back each day to a beautifully cleaned room.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Hilton
allReviews.text: The staff was super friendly and helpful.  The pool and bar provided an excellent place to sit and relax.  The rooms provided a lot of extra amenities That I did not know prior to visiting the hotel.  Excellent for families, the rooms had a full kitchen which you could easily cook meals and an outside grill that you could cookout and still enjoy the pool.  They had a game room for the kids and a store on site that provided a good selection of items for preparing meals in your room.  Overall, a great place to stay.

allReviews.title: not like any Hilton I stay in
allReviews.text: awful customer service.  unprofessional staff.  rude and unkind.   put me in a handicap room because they were sold out and never even asked me if I was ok with it, and when I asked why not, they said they don't have to tell me.  I just have no choice but to stay in that room or lose my deposit.

allReviews.title: Quiet and Easy access and Parking
allReviews.text: Nice place off the strip, quiet and easy access to and from, with excellent parking access.  Building, well kept, clean could use some updating, but very nice.  Pool and bar area very comfortable and not crowded.

allReviews.title: Nice clean hotel
allReviews.text: Super friendly check in and service throughout.  Room was clean and comfortable. Free WiFi was very fast. Pool bar was well stocked. No restaurant on property, small deli serving Starbucks by the lobby.  Food was not very good. 5 mins from the Las Vegas convention center and Uber will drop off and pickup at the front door of the hotel. If you want to stay off the strip with no gambling this could be the place for you.

allReviews.title: Nice quiet place to relax
allReviews.text: Rooms have just been renovated. very nice suites, felt like a one bedroom apartment. Nice, deep 2 person tub. Full kitchen. Staff is helpful and courteous. Only minor complaints keep it from being 5 stars. There is no restaurant on the property. Only a small shop and deli.

allReviews.title: Off the Strip
allReviews.text: I had an enjoyable stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations Convention Center location. The only downfalls were the lack of decent wine at the pool bar and the overbearing room freshener in my room. Everything else was comfortable and convenient. I loved having a market in the lobby for a snack or a meal and any forgotten items. Getting to the strip was an easy uber ride, and it was nice to stay out of the fray.

allReviews.title: Clean no gambling stay
allReviews.text: This was a pleasant surprise in a city where there are slot machines in bathrooms and airports! If you are looking for a clean, well-appointed place to stay not far from the strip, this is it. They don't have a restaurant but they do have snacks and beverages.

allReviews.title: The Standard for which all others should strive for.
allReviews.text: I travel a lot and stay in so many different hotels, you often forget where you are staying.  They all seem to be cut from the same cloth.  There are many places to stay in Las Vegas, and they all provide reasonable service.  Then there is the Hilton Grand Vacations on Paradise.  This place alone sets a new standard on what a hotel should be like.  It is about the people and the staff and managers at this hotel are amazing.  They don't have a casino or full service restaurant, but who cares.  What they have are beautiful rooms with a friendly and amazing staff that make you feel like you are a friend and not a customer.

allReviews.title: Perfect Haven After Long Day At Trade Show
allReviews.text: The facility and rooms in general are pleasantly comfortable and are perfect for "decelerating" from the long and tiring process of industry trade show. Also, the guest rooms have plenty of room to hold team meetings.

allReviews.title: Weekend in Vegas
allReviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Hilton Grand Suites. The location is a few blocks away from the strip, but close enough to walk there. The staff was very helpful, and made the stay better with good restaurant suggestions.

allReviews.title: Like being at home
allReviews.text: Every single staff member is xlnt here and so accomodating. The rooms are well appointed, very clean and fully stocked. I just love this place. It is so comfortable that you don't mind hanging around the property. The marketplace and deli is so convenient and food is actually really good and the ladies in there are very sweet. Carlos at front desk is such a sweetie and you can tell he really enjoys his. Housekeeping is also very quick to accomodate my needs such as towel exchange. job. Sam also deserves a shout out for helping me with questions I had. I will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Large suites
allReviews.text: We stayed here over Christmas and loved the huge suite we stayed in. It had a large lounge/ kitchen area, a decent sized bedroom, a decent sized bathroom, and a seperate room between for the bath.There was a store near the lobby wear you could order food/coffee and buy other necessities too. They also had a games room and a DVD rental machine.

allReviews.title: Property was clean, non-smoking, spacious, quiet
allReviews.text: I wasn't sure whether I should stay on or off the strip on my first trip to Las Vegas, but it turns out that this hotel was definitely the right choice for me.  The best part for me was that the property is non-smoking, so I could enjoy the pool without annoying smoke.  The room was spacious and nice.  My only complaint about the room was that because it is satellite, a couple of channels that I wanted to watch didn't come in well.  However, the free dvd rental downstairs more than made up for the satellite problems.  The convenience-type store on ground level was great.  The monorail to get to the strip is only a short walk away, and of course car services are available as well, so it was still easy to get to the strip.  We even ended up renting a car one day from a rental agency that was in a nearby hotel, which was also walking distance.  So, I highly recommend this property if you want the quiet of someplace off of the strip and to refresh your lungs after being surrounded by smoke all day.

allReviews.title: Off Strip hotel
allReviews.text: Convenient location. Close to the monorail or easily walkable to the Strip.  Get the full kitchen to save a ton of money of food. Secure hotel. Free parking. Friendly staff. Recommend especially for family trips.

allReviews.title: Welcoming stay
allReviews.text: The property is clean as always and the staff is always friendly and accmodaring. The always tray hard for the gusts. If your planning to stay in Las Vegas and want a clean and resonablly priced hotel book here .

allReviews.title: Mrs. Morell
allReviews.text: Excellent Hotel! If you looking for peace and quiet after being out all night. This property was perfect. The bed was so comfortable and the staff go out of their way to help you. I will be back very soon.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed here for a week and found the hotel to be ideal for what we wanted.The room was perfect and had a view over circus circus, lovely bed and bath in room lovely lounge and kitchen. The car park was ok but isn't connected to the hotel so drop off bags before parking up. One thing about the hotel is that it's a zero cash hotel so if you buy anything in the bar or market it's charged to the room (although we settled up with cash when we left ) The pool area was lovely but in the shade for most of the morning very refreshing though.

allReviews.title: Our fav place to stay in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Our fav place to stay in Las Vegas! Excellent staff, fab pool & hot tub, wonderful kitchen staff, no smoky casino to walk thru to get to our room! And only one property to walk to metro. A real vacation at the north end of the strip!

allReviews.title: Clean and Quite
allReviews.text: This newly renovated place is so clean. The staff are great and the location is quite. The monorail is a walking distance. If you don’t feel like driving and looking for a parking when you visit the strip, just hop on the monorail and get a pass.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand
allReviews.text: The Hilton Grand on Karen Avenue is a great place to stay if you prefer staying away from the busines of the Strip. Our room was clean, functional, quiet, and safe. We liked the safety requirements for hotel, elevator, and room access. The staff is great, helpful, and informed of all the amenities offered. I plan on staying here again since it does have close access to the monorail and it is a nice family-friendly hotel chain.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Excellent! Clean, new and doesn't smell like smoke. Small compared to casinos. Right next to Mono Rail so you don't have to call a cab to get to casinos. Has small store, and a small bar next to decent pool. It does not have a casino so it doesn't smell like an ashtray! Carlos at front desk was very professional and checked on my stay everyday (4 days) to make sure I was satisfied.

allReviews.title: Quiet, home-like suite hotel with friendly staff
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club (Las Vegas Convention Center) for a quick 2-night personal visit. When I got into my room - a 1-bdrm suite with full kitchen - I was sorry I wasn't going to be staying longer! The room was elegant and comfortable, and clean as a whistle. The full kitchen was great, and I even cooked a dinner. There was a whirlpool tub across from the large closet, adjacent to the well-stocked bathroom. All staff, from the front desk to the convenience store clerk to the poolside bartender, were friendly and helpful. it was quiet (which I like), and since there's no casino or restaurant in the hotel, you don't have to walk a mile to get to an elevator. If you want gambling and dining, you just walk 3 minutes next door to the Westgate Hotel (the old Hilton International). I will be back.

allReviews.title: Better than being in a hotel on the strip. Rooms are of the highest quality.
allReviews.text: It was very refreshing to be able to stay in a hotel like this one for business. I'd make myself a pot of coffee each morning in the full kitchen I had in my room. I was also able to wash my dirty workout clothes in my room and bring them back home clean, without ruining everything else in my suitcase. These rooms are literally 1 bedroom apartments, with everything you can think of. If you like to cook 'at home', the kitchen has everything you need (including pots, pans, dishes, cutlery) to be able to cook whatever you want. The rooms are just very clean and comfortable and I think they are perfect for small families. I enjoyed my stay here more, than anywhere on the strip. If you want to go to the strip, it's always only about a $10 Lyft ride away. For me, this hotel is worth the money and I would come back. I'd come here now more so than I would go and stay at the Aria, for example. It's more away from the craziness but not too far away that you can't go have fun on the Strip if you'd like. Overall, it was a great stay. Please note, however, this hotel does NOT have a shuttle to / from the airport. It's about a 15 minute drive from / to the airport.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel off the Strip
allReviews.text: My Mom and I spent a week here in September. We were on the 17th floor, nice renovated room. Great view of the Stratosphere and local mountains. The hotel is quiet and clean. A very relaxing environment. Nice pool area with a pool bar. I was really impressed with the little market on-site that made everything for sandwiches and wraps to pizza for day trips or even just a quick meal. The West Gate Hotel is right next door so easy access to a casino, a couple restaurants and tons of (free) parking. Also a quick 5 minute walk to the monorail station with quick access to the Strip.  If you are looking for a flashy Vegas hotel, this is not it, but if you need a nice quiet place to relax after days exploring the Strip or other areas, this is what you are looking for. I would recommend this hotel, especially if you are staying more than a couple days.

allReviews.title: Non existant housekeeping..laziness
allReviews.text: Booked at hilton grand vacations paradise for two weeks .We arrived 4 days into the 1st week of our booking.It was not explained that we would receive 1 day of housekeeping per week which entitles us to 2 housekeeping days for total of stay.We made arrangements for housekeeping yesterday evening for today and gave our preferred time of 11am...wr arrived ay the hotel at 10pm today and nothing done...totally disgusted with service...apparently the person on duty did not note it...my 1st week ends tomorrow ....pure laziness and incompetence by the Hilton group.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Hotel smells clean, spacious and all amenities are in great shape. Easy access and parking.  though Hotel is away from the Strip, the peaceful atmosphere and easy access compensated for the distance from the Trip

allReviews.title: Love this place
allReviews.text: Close to monorail and room are spacious.  Place comes with full kitchen, living room and jacuzzi.   Staff is super nice friendly and welcoming.  You can even BBQ by the pool.  Will plan on future trips here.

allReviews.title: WONDERFUL LOCATION IN LAS VEGAS
allReviews.text: Excellent accommodations ... very helpful staff. The one bedroom is perfectly furnished and has all the items you need for light meals.  Great value while being close to the strip and downtown.  The property has a wonderful pool, game room and business center.  Easy in and out access from parking lot.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Underrated Hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel was exactly what I needed for my stay in Las Vegas, it was absolutely perfect! There's a lot of much flashier hotels and resorts along the strip, including other Hilton Grand Vacation's, but this one was perfect for me.  It had a great location right by the monorail and just a block from the strip, but had a quiet, tranquil, low key vibe since it was removed from it a bit. The staff were all very accommodating and welcoming, and the rooms are kept very clean. We got the Go Out Package and had a BEAUTIFUL king suite.  I loved the jacuzzi!  You also get two free waters every day you stay at the front desk, which was helpful for our festival going at Life is Beautiful while here! Thank you for a beautiful and relaxing stay Hilton!  I'll be back the next time I'm in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice Stay
allReviews.text: Had one of the renovated rooms which is definitely an upgrade over the room I had in March. It's not Strip luxury but very nice, and you will not find a friendlier staff anywhere. From the maids to the front desk to Jason at the pool bar, everyone is top notch. Quiet area, relaxing but yet easy walk to Monorail. Only reason didn't give 5 stars is the walls are paper thin. I could literally hear the entire conversation from the couple in the room next to me. And they were talking in a normal tone. As I said it's a quiet hotel with mostly older clientele so it's not a problem going to sleep but if you want to sleep past 7 am then you better hope you don't have someone next door. Overall though it it good value.

allReviews.title: Tradeshow
allReviews.text: Overall I was pleased with cleanliness, parking and amenities. Bar was a nice touch but should have been open later. Front desk personnel were very pleasant to deal with and were always smiling. It would also be nice to have an actual restaurant in the hotel beside the efficient yet limited offerings of the grill/store.

allReviews.title: Beautiful suites
allReviews.text: I’m here on business and am a Hilton honors member. They are renovating the rooms so I got a newly remodeled room. Absolutely beautiful! Full kitchen with full size appliances. Full living room with large tv and pull out couch. Full size kitchen table. The bedroom is great too. Huge tv, comfortable bed and an enormous soaker tub. Bathroom has nice walk in shower and double sinks in the vanity. Market place is descent with ok food. All in all, great place to stay!

allReviews.title: Horrible stay
allReviews.text: Had to sleep on a wet bed and had to change some sheets myself, called front desk to solve the probleabd didnt do it the firts time left for 3 hours and had to called again and problem was still not solved

allReviews.title: Love it!
allReviews.text: Location was perfect...no casino which means zero cigarette smoke, which was a plus for us. The pool was fantastic. Rooms are newly renovated and are beautiful. We stayed in a king suite and it came with a large  soaking tub, and a fully equipped kitchen and laundry closet.  Hands down a beautiful hotel.

allReviews.title: Nice quiet resort
allReviews.text: we enjoyed our stay here very much. It was nice to have a quiet place after being at a noisy conference all day. staff were knowledgeable and helpful. It was in a good location and not far from the busy part of the strip.

allReviews.title: Always good
allReviews.text: We have stayed here a good few times and always use it to stay when we come to Vegas. We always have a one bedroom suite which is great and they have been upgraded recently so are really nice. The other great positive is there is a free car park next to it which takes all the hassle away.

allReviews.title: A home away from home
allReviews.text: A great place to come on a business trip. Quiet, clean, friendly. The staff is knowledgeable, there is food available so you don't always have to eat out. Coffee to go is delicious and reasonably priced. My favorite place to stay in Las Vegas. The resort is located just off Las Vegas Blvd do you can get to any strip locations fairly easy, however, I like how far away it is from the strip because of the less crowded and quiet atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Horrible experience
allReviews.text: This stay did not meet our Hilton expectations. Upon check in we were given a room on the 11th floor immediately outside of the elevator. Being a light sleeper and not wanting to be woken up by elevator traffic we went back to the front desk to request a room a bit further from the elevator. We were told the only other studio available was a handicap accessible room. When asked why there was no other studios in the entire building available we were then told that construction was being done on the 12th floor and above....finding out not only was our original room near the elevator but also the floor directly below construction. We requested to see what the handicapped room looked like before switching rooms. We then had to wait at least 20 minutes for the bell hop to escort us to the handicapped room. The handicapped room was ok but there was absolutely no shelves or cabinets due to the handicapped status. The mini fridge barely kept anything cold when put on full blast. We had water bottles in the freezer for days and they barely got frosty. Then a few days later they informed us via a note in the elevator that the entire buildings water (except for the main floor) would be shut off for 5 hours for maintenance. The adjoining rooms door was so paper thin we were awoken at 6:30am to the sound of our neighbors clanking dishes into the dishwasher and the smell of burning toast wafting under the connecting door. I almost forgot to mention our lovely view of the street directly outside, and the noise of cop sirens at 2am. Then on our last day we tried to use our "buy one get one drink free" coupon at the outdoor pool bar. There was a sign that read "be back shortly". We waited around the pool area for more than a half hour and there was no sign of the bartender. This was around 2pm. I can understand the staff might have been taking a lunch but can you please get a sign with a moveable/adjustable clock on it stating what time the bartender will be returning? We finally gave up and left drinkless. The only redeeming qualities for this Hilton were the 5 foot pool, clean (although super noisy) room, and free rental car parking. Upon check out they would not give us a luggage cart to load ourselves and insisted upon having a bell hop help us. We wanted to take our time loading the car so we ended up just wheeling our stuff our by hand in several trips.  Please get your act together Hilton Paradise this was my least favorite trip to Vegas

allReviews.title: Great Location and Access
allReviews.text: I like the location of the resort.  unlike other resorts in Vegas, this one is situated quiet side of the town, yet great access to freeway.  Parking is easy and has plenty spaces. Friendly staff and the room are great.

allReviews.title: Stay was OK
allReviews.text: Hotel and staff was nice. Only complaint was being woken up early to construction going on directly above our room. When I brought this to the staffs attention they failed to make me feel like they were really sorry or cared.

allReviews.title: A great hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: This is such a great hotel to escape the smoking and gaming and noise found everywhere in Vegas!  We went to a convention in Ballys and so very thankful we did not stay in that hotel. Hilton is so convenient with a monorail nearby and free easy parking. Pool and hot tub very nice as well. The little convenience store is fantastic as are the staff there!

allReviews.title: We love this place!
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at HGV at Paradise and we picked the perfect place. We were on the 17th floor with a great view. My 82 year old mother in law raved about this place. It was clean, quiet, comfortable and very fashionable. We could walk to the monorail and get anywhere we wanted. She felt safe and loved watching everything from the window when we were in. The staff went out of their way to be helpful and friendly. We could not have asked for a better place to stay. I also enjoyed the pool in the morning before heading out. The suites have a great floor plan for ease and comfort. Hats off to the management team for service and excellence.

allReviews.title: Excellent Choice
allReviews.text: This was definitely the place for a leisure 5 night stay.  It was quiet and the pool was wonderful, service was of the highest caliber and ALL the staff was friendly along with being efficient.  Will definitely stay here again.  Loved our room and all the appointments in it.  We had a King Suite and it was perfect.  We've stayed at other Hiltons in Las Vegas but this one is now our favorite.

allReviews.title: Always perfect
allReviews.text: This great hotel is exactly where I need it to be. I love that there is washer and dryer in the room. The complete staff is always great, positive and welcoming. Rooms are always clean. Will always come here every time I'm in vegas.

allReviews.title: Weekend getaway!
allReviews.text: This was my 2nd experience staying at this resort, I was not dissappointed! From the reservation process to checking out was seamless! I would recommend staying at this resort if you want good customer service, comfortable suite stay and great amenities for your time in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: "Awesome Resort"
allReviews.text: Our one bedroom suite on the 17th floor overlooked the golf course, nice furnitures, and very clean. The resort is a few minutes walk to the Westgate Hotel and Casino. The monorail at Westgate is the easy access to the strip area (avoid the parking hassle at the strip). The pool is a decent size, the resort gives you free access to DVDs, there is a small market on the 1st floor (expensive), there is a small fitness center, and a recreation area where you can play video games and pool. The employees are very accommodating and willing to please their guest. It was a very fun and relaxing week. I highly recommend this resort.

allReviews.title: A great place to have a relaxing getaway
allReviews.text: I love this location because of the kitchen, amenities offered, and the friendliness and helpful staff. Every experience from checking in to checking out was flawless! Thank you Hilton for an unforgettable stay at a great value

allReviews.title: Perfect oasis off the Strip
allReviews.text: What a welcome relief to come back to the quiet of the hotel at the end of a day on the Strip! Our 1-bedroom suite on the eleventh floor overlooked the swimming pool and was quiet, clean, comfortable, furnished with everything we could need or want, and was a wonderful value for the money (we got AAA rates). Only a 5 minute walk to the monorail at Westgate to bring us to the Strip. Parking garage next to the hotel was free and always had plenty of room to park.   Vegas had above average temperatures during our stay, but the air conditioning in the suite kept us very comfortable. All appliances and electronics worked great. Excellent selection of Blue-Ray DVDs to watch (no charge).Friendly, informative staff was very thoughtful. They made sure guests were aware that water had to be shut off for several hours one day due to hotel renovations, making the minor inconvenience as painless as possible. Speaking of renovations...we saw a large delivery truck unloading new mattresses another day.  We will definitely stay here when we return to Vegas in 2019. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Not the best experience this trip...
allReviews.text: Construction noise during day, Relentless party next door and water shut off during stay.  Five times had to ask security to quiet party. They should have been removed from property. 20+ people in a room and still tried to accommodate them.   Construction noise during day without advance warning.   Water shut off during stay, inconvenient as hell.   Not my best trip here, usually my go to place when in Vegas... They let me down big time this trip.

allReviews.title: AWESOME RESORT
allReviews.text: I would definitely book this resort in the future.  Very clean rooms and resort. Hotel Staff were very friendly and customer service was great. Loved the Happy hour special at the pool.  Housekeeping staff were very accommodating and paid attention to details of the cleanliness of the rooms. Business Center available and ATM on site.  Pool table, recreation room were great additions as well.

allReviews.title: Just okay
allReviews.text: Hotel was very clean which I appreciated. I did not care for the low shower head, thin walls, or small work area. There was not a desk in my room - had to work from small round table. Could hear my neighbors through the walls and people in hall. Not overly noisy but if you are sensitive to this it's something to note. My tv kept losing service so I could not watch it - they do have dvds you can rent.

allReviews.title: Nice, quiet stay!
allReviews.text: Nice location away from the strip. Well-maintained, quiet property.  We loved the fact that there was no casino on premises. The suite was very spacious and clean. On walking distance from the mono-rail. Recommended!

allReviews.title: Like a home away from home
allReviews.text: Nice rooms... Full kitchen with full size fridge, dishwasher,  stove oven and microwave.. also had nice washer and dryer in unit.... separate room for sleeping, living, dining. .. nice large jet tub.. really nice large shower...

allReviews.title: Nice, tidy hotel close to Las Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: The hotel is very clean and tidy.  Front Office staff is very personable.   They even text you to see if the room is in good order, which it is.  All of the equipment worked in the room.  And the hotel is quite convenient to get to the airport.  I like quiet hotels, and this is one of them.  All travelers need to make sure that they understand there is a resort fee tacked onto your bill.

allReviews.title: Great stay in vegas
allReviews.text: This was my first time staying at this resort and very impressed with arrival experience and liked that it was near the monorail station.  The room was very clean and enjoyed having a full kitchen to cook meals instead of eating out. Will definitely stay here again when in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Home away from home
allReviews.text: This room was so node and comfortable. The bath tub was absolutely huge! The bed was so comfortable. Honestly so affordable yet so upscale and nice. Not too far from the action yet far enough away to where it was quiet.

allReviews.title: Return customer, clean, good service
allReviews.text: This was at least the second time I've stayed here for a professional convention.  The price is right, the service excellent, and the rooms are clean and kept up.  An added bonus was the free movie that I was able to check out.  I particularly like the cafe on the first floor that makes hot dishes to order. I would stay here again.  It's nice to stay in a hotel that doesn't have a huge lobby with slot machines!

allReviews.title: Quiet place not far from the strip
allReviews.text: Our room was reasonably priced and well worth it. Our room had everything we would need for our stay. There was a kitchen equipped with fridge, dish washer, stove, microwave and even dishes and eating utensils. There was also a washer and dryer for our convenience. I have no complaints what so ever and really enjoyed my stay.

allReviews.title: Do You Wanna Win in Vegas?
allReviews.text: Surprisingly great super-clean room met all the needs of our three-member family group.  More than ample living spaces and bathroom facilities.  Separate shower and jetted whirlpool tub were a major plus.  Kitchen was complete right down to the small appliances and tools.  Lots of square footage so no one ever felt "under foot."  We also never felt crowded in the large outdoor swimming pool and over-sized hot tub.  The fully-equipped lobby convenience store had plenty of snack and grocery options as well as basic necessities.  Parking was convenient as was access to the Las Vegas Monorail system, a reasonable short walking distance away.  Each room has a DVD player and your added resort fee allows you one-at-a-time access to the current movies in two DVD loaner machines located in the large lobby rec room.  Staff was universally friendly and helpful.  The security system used card access effectively to most facilities and enhanced our sense of personal safety.  Since we were in town for a concert and not the casinos of the famous Strip, it was particularly important that our hotel excelled in home-away-from-home comfort.  It did, wonderfully.

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand on Paradise
allReviews.text: Staff was above average, room was not. Amenities we're minimal. We would stay again but only because it is next to the Westgate where the pool tournament is held each year. If the room had been clean, we would have been fine with everything else.

allReviews.title: I will return to Hilton
allReviews.text: The room was clean, staff friendly, and I just loved the kitchen, washer and dryer! Everything was provided: dish soap, towels, dishes, pots, pans, glasses, cups, washer soap, sponge, paper towels, and the hotel was a nice distance (within walking) from the Vegas strip.

allReviews.title: 25th Anniversary for couple
allReviews.text: We always stay at a Hilton Grand when we can.  Nice clean room as always. We like having space to move around and kitchen to cook what we want anytime. Washer and dryer is a must. It is also great for families.

allReviews.title: A quiet hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: The hotel was on the north end of the strip, and doesn't have a casino, so it is a good choice if you want quiet. This is a smoke free hotel, which was great because all the casino hotels are full of cigarette smoke. The front desk got us a room early when we arrived at 10am. The room was very clean and has a kitchenette. We had a view of the strip from the 5th floor. The walls are a bit thin. I could hear normal volume conversations and the TV on low in the next room. The bed was very comfortable. Real feather pillows. The alarm clock has nature sounds, which was a nice touch. The water pressure in the shower was less than I prefer. There is a deli downstairs with convenience store items and souvenirs. Prices are what you expect for a convenience store, but good selection and decent food. Very nice business center and quiet room. There is a free DVD rental included in the stay, but I didn't use it. Video games and a pool table in the game room.The pool is a play pool. They had towels and inflatables to use. I did not go into the jacuzzi. The water seemed clean and pool well maintained. There was an issue with teenagers doing backflips on the side of the pool in 4ft of water. There was a lifeguard on duty, but she didn't say anything to them until I walked up to her and made her tell them to stop. Later I saw the two lifeguards looking at their cell phones when children were in the pool. I notified management of this. I would swim at your own risk there and make sure you are watching your kids, because the lifeguards are not.The monorail stops at the Westgate casino next door. It is under a half mile walk there. There is a bus stop a half mile up the road at Sahara Blvd if you want to take the Deuce Bus. We stayed at the Hilton with Points and Money. Even for our two free nights we had coming to us, we were charged the $25 resort fee per day. They won't budge on that. Other than the items I mentioned, it was a good stay. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Not on the Strip but worth the driving
allReviews.text: Great Property away from traffic and Las Vegas Strip but did not bother the driving. Went for a convention at Rio (approximately 3 miles away). Access to the Rail, public transportation and main streets was easy.

allReviews.title: Work trip
allReviews.text: I was there for work it had everything I needed since this was a 10 day stay. It is off the strip which I really liked it was very quiet and very clean the beds and pillows were amazing. I would recommend this to anyone

allReviews.title: Fun with the Family
allReviews.text: We met up with family memebers for my mother's birthday weekend. We enjoyed our two room suite! We had to drive down to the main strip, but the family bond and closes on the property will be remembered. We also appreciated the available grocery market and DVD machine.

allReviews.title: Nice Place off The Strip
allReviews.text: We were on a quick trip to Vegas and just wanted a solid hotel near things. This place was great. Staff - very efficient & friendlyRoom - very clean, large, full kitchen, huge jacuzzi bathParking - lots of it in a garage WiFi - goodPool - a bit small, but sufficient if you are not looking for a "pool" vacation I'd definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: Nice and quiet hotel
allReviews.text: This is a nice off the Strip hotel. Relax and quiet environment. Away from the crowded and noisy Strip, but very close to the Strip. Just 5 minutes driving, you can get to all attractions on the Strip.My suite has one large bedroom, living room and a kitchen with dining table.Bathroom with jetted bathtub.If you want to stay a little off the Strip and get there by car, this hotel is recommended.

allReviews.title: Unhappy Hilton Member
allReviews.text: Was married to a Diamond Member and NEVER experienced this lack of service and Hilton Quality - Maybe Gold Membership at Hilton mean Zero - The jetted tub might have never been cleaned - After running the water and turning on the jets, the water turned brown! Disgusting! The

allReviews.title: Hilton Grand Vatcation (Paradise) UNDER RENOVATION
allReviews.text: Just experienced a horrible, noisy five day stay at Hilton Grand Vacation (Paradise) on Karen Avenue, Las Vegas area.  The hotel is under going renovations which made my stay noisy as hammering, and all sorts of vibrations woke me each morning PRIOR to 9 AM.  Hilton still has not posted this long term, planned renovation on their website, so be warned if you stay here!  Not romantic or restful.  Also had soiled sheets--not changed!  GROSS!!!

allReviews.title: Pleasant stay in a tranquil setting
allReviews.text: Only stayed 3 nights and thoroughly enjoyed this place. Quiet, spacious rooms housing mainly families. My partner said she could live in this room.Clean, roomy luxurious with friendly staff.Monorail only 5 min walk so for those who don't want the hype of the strip, this is your place. The extra you pay for this (suggest multi day passes)is well worth the reasonable room rates.If only we had this accomodation throughout our entire 5 weeks in the USA. Sigh.

allReviews.title: Convenient off-strip location
allReviews.text: Having stayed in the strip before (Mirage and Cosmopolitan), I decided to use my Wyndham points for an exchange here. Paid $99 for four nights and I was extremely satisfied with this decision. How cool is it that you don't have to walk thru a casino to go to the pool or your room? Family oriented, clean and suites are beautiful! We stayed in a one-bedroom suite (for 2 people) and it was more than we could have asked for. The close proximity to the monorail station is a huge plus! We saved a lot of money by purchasing the multi-day pass instead of paying uber. If you still feel like uber is better, it cost between $9 and $13 from the strip, not bad considering that you stay away from chaos. We would stay again in a heartbeat.

allReviews.title: Comfort and luxe
allReviews.text: Wr attived tired from a tre day tour in frand canyin, bryce canyon and monument valley... we really needed a very comfortable and cozy place where to spend the night and hilton grand vacation was a good solution.  The room is more like an apartment, huge and comfortable bedroom, awesome bathroom and the living room and kitchen are great There is everything you can wish.Till very late you can also use the market inside the hotel and prepare a good dinner.I recommend this hotel even if without casino

allReviews.title: Vegas Business
allReviews.text: Trip was for business. The hotel was clean. The hotel staff was friendly, helpful and professional. The room was well equipped plus stylish. The hotel was quiet. Good amenities pool, rec room & biz ctr

allReviews.title: Great for family
allReviews.text: Big suites perfect for families.  The no smoking property was so refreshing for smoky Vegas.  Loved that this hotel did not have a casino.  Wished they would of had a regular restaurant, it would of been much more convenient.

allReviews.title: Traded in through RCI - Excellent stay!
allReviews.text: We traded into this property through RCI and were very impressed.  Our two bedroom with a full kitchen was clean, spacious, and fully equipped with everything we needed.The two bedroom units are a one king single with a little kitchenette on one side of a lock out, and a full huge living room, full kitchen, table w/4 chairs, laundry closet in the middle, and then a full king bedroom with a large jacuzzi tub, shower, and bath on the other end.  Plenty of room and plenty of privacy for two couples.  I signed up for text messaging service from the concierge, which was perfect.  We texted to ask about nearby grocery stores for cases of water, breakfast food, and snacks.  Not only did they text back immediately with directions, they let us know that they have carts to borrow to bring the groceries up to the room.  The pool area was clean and offered plenty of lounging space and the pool bar offered daily specials that helped cool us down from the 110 degree heat.  Parking is free, safe, and easy to negotiate.  The property is centrally located to get quickly to the strip, Fremont Street, or the airport via Uber or taxi.
